verses.sanskrit: त्र्यम्बकं यजामहे सुगन्धिं पुष्टिवर्धनम् | उर्वारुकमिव बन्धनान्मृत्योर्मुक्षीय मामृतात् ||
verses.transliteration: tryambakaṃ yajāmahe sugandhiṃ puṣṭivardhanam | urvārukamiva bandhanānmṛtyormukṣīya māmṛtāt ||
verses.translation: We worship the three-eyed one (Shiva), the fragrant, the nourisher of all. Like a cucumber from its vine, may we be liberated from death — and not from immortality.
verses.hindi: हम त्र्यम्बक (तीन नेत्रों वाले शिव) की पूजा करते हैं, जो सुगन्धित और पोषण देने वाले हैं। जैसे खीरा बेल से मुक्त होता है, वैसे हमें मृत्यु से मुक्त करो — अमृत से नहीं।
verses.commentary: The Mrityunjaya Mantra contains extraordinary precision: "liberate us from death but not from immortality" — the goal is not escape from life but transcendence of the fear of death that diminishes life. The cucumber analogy is perfect: the fruit naturally separates from the vine when ripe — death as natural completion, not violent severance. Tryambaka (three-eyed Shiva) sees past, present, and future — death is not final to the one who sees all three.
verses.wordMeaning: The Mrityunjaya Mantra contains extraordinary precision: "liberate us from death but not from immortality" — the goal is not escape from life but transcendence of the fear of death that diminishes life. verses.sanskrit: यस्मिन् ऋचः साम यजूंषि यस्मिन् प्रतिष्ठिता रथनाभाविवाराः | यस्मिंश्चित्तं सर्वमोतं प्रजानां तन्मे मनः शिवसंकल्पमस्तु ||
verses.transliteration: yasmin ṛcaḥ sāma yajūṃṣi yasmin pratiṣṭhitā rathanābhāvivārāḥ | yasmiṃścittaṃ sarvamotaṃ prajānāṃ tanme manaḥ śivasaṃkalpam astu ||
verses.translation: That in which the Rig, Sama, and Yajur hymns are established like spokes in a wheel's hub — in which the minds of all beings are interwoven — may my mind be of auspicious resolve.
verses.hindi: जिसमें ऋचाएँ, साम और यजुष् वैसे ही स्थित हैं जैसे रथ के पहिये में आरे — जिसमें सभी प्राणियों का चित्त ओत-प्रोत है — वह मेरा मन शिवसंकल्पयुक्त हो।
verses.commentary: The second verse reveals: all scripture — Rig, Sama, Yajur — is contained in the mind. The mind is the hub of the wheel of all knowledge. Moreover, all beings' minds are "interwoven" — there is one cosmic mind in which all individual minds participate. This is not mysticism — it is a description of consciousness as a shared field, not a private possession.

verses.sanskrit: यज्जाग्रतो दूरमुदैति दैवं तदु सुप्तस्य तथैवैति | दूरङ्गमं ज्योतिषां ज्योतिरेकं तन्मे मनः शिवसंकल्पमस्तु ||
verses.transliteration: yajjāgrato dūramuadaiti daivaṃ tadu suptasya tathaivai ti | dūraṃgamaṃ jyotiṣāṃ jyotirekam tanme manaḥ śivasaṃkalpam astu ||
verses.translation: That which travels far in the waking state, and returns to the same place in sleep — that divine, far-ranging light of lights, the one — may my mind be of auspicious resolve (shiva-sankalpa).
verses.hindi: जो जागने पर दूर जाता है और सोने पर वापस आता है — वह दिव्य, दूर तक जाने वाला, ज्योतियों की ज्योति एक — वह मेरा मन शिवसंकल्पयुक्त हो।
verses.commentary: The Shiva-Sankalpa Sukta describes the mind's extraordinary nature: it travels everywhere in waking and dream states, yet always returns to the same person. It is "jyotisham jyotir ekam" — the one light of all lights. This is not a tiny, limited organ — it is a cosmic instrument. And the prayer: may this vast instrument be set toward the auspicious (shiva = good/auspicious). May my deepest intentions be wholesome, not destructive.

verses.sanskrit: नमस्ते रुद्र मन्यव उतो त इषवे नमः | नमस्ते अस्तु धन्वने बाहुभ्यामुत ते नमः ||
verses.transliteration: namaste rudra manyava uto ta iṣave namaḥ | namaste astu dhanvane bāhubhyāmuta te namaḥ ||
verses.translation: Salutations to your wrath, O Rudra, and to your arrow; salutations to your bow, and to your two arms.
verses.hindi: हे रुद्र! आपके क्रोध को नमस्कार, आपके बाण को नमस्कार। आपके धनुष को नमस्कार, आपकी दोनों भुजाओं को नमस्कार।
verses.commentary: The opening of the Shri Rudram does something remarkable: it salutes Rudra's WRATH first. This is not appeasement — it is the deep acknowledgement that even what we fear in the divine is the divine. Rudra is the fierce, raw, untamed aspect of reality — illness, death, sudden loss, the storm. The mature spiritual response is not to deny these but to bow to them too, recognising their source. By honouring even the wrath, the practitioner transmutes fear into reverence.

verses.sanskrit: ॐ सह नाववतु | सह नौ भुनक्तु | सह वीर्यं करवावहै | तेजस्विनावधीतमस्तु मा विद्विषावहै | ॐ शान्तिः शान्तिः शान्तिः ||
verses.transliteration: oṃ saha nāvavatu | saha nau bhunaktu | saha vīryaṃ karavāvahai | tejasvināvadhītamastu mā vidviṣāvahai | oṃ śāntiḥ śāntiḥ śāntiḥ ||
verses.translation: May He protect us both. May He nourish us both. May we work together with vigour. May our study be enlightening. May we not hate each other. Om — Peace, Peace, Peace.
verses.hindi: वह (परमात्मा) हम दोनों की रक्षा करे। हम दोनों का पालन करे। हम साथ मिलकर पराक्रम करें। हमारा अध्ययन तेजस्वी हो। हम परस्पर द्वेष न करें। ॐ शान्तिः शान्तिः शान्तिः।
verses.commentary: The Shanti Mantra recited before any guru-shishya study session. Notice the structure: every line is plural. Not "may I be protected" but "may we both be protected." Not "may my study be enlightening" but "may our study." Knowledge in Vedic culture is never an individual conquest — it is a shared transformation. Even the negation — "let us not hate each other" — acknowledges that close study often breeds friction, and prays specifically against it.

verses.sanskrit: अ॒ग्नेस्त॒नूर॑सि॒ विष्ण॑वे त्वा॒ सोम॑स्य त॒नूर॑सि॒ विष्ण॑वे॒ त्वा  ऽति॑थेराति॒थ्यम॑सि॒ विष्ण॑वे त्वा श्ये॒नाय॑ त्वा सोम॒भृते॒ विष्ण॑वे त्वा॒ऽग्नये॑ त्वा रायस्पोष॒दे विष्ण॑वे त्वा
verses.translation: com The Texts of the White Yajurveda, tr. Ralph T.H. Griffith, [1899], BOOK THE FIFTH BODY of Agni art thou. Thee for Vishnu. Body of Soma art thou. Thee for Vishnu. Thou art the Guest's Reception. Thee for Vishnu. Thee for the Soma-bringing Falcon. Thee for Vishnu. Thee for the giver of abundance, Agni. Thee for Vishnu.
verses.hindi: हम अपने को उत्साहमय व शक्तिशाली बनार्ए। प्राणशक्ति की वृद्धि करे, काम-क्रोध-लोभ से ऊपर उट ओर लोकदित में प्रवृत्त हो। मा यज्ञि ्धसिष्टं मा य॒ज्ञप॑तिं जातवेदसौ शिवौ भ॑वतम॒द्य न॑:॥॥३॥ १. प्रभु कहते है कि नः=मेरी प्राप्ति के लिए समनसौ समान मनवाले भवतम्=होओं।
verses.transliteration: agnestanūrasi viṣṇave tvā somasya tanūrasi viṣṇave tvā 'titherātithyamasi viṣṇave tvā śyenāya tvā somabhṛte viṣṇave tvā'gnaye tvā rāyaspoṣade viṣṇave tvā

verses.sanskrit: अ॒ग्नेर्ज॒नित्र॑मसि  वृष॑णौ स्थ  उ॒र्वश्य॑स्या॒युर॑सि  पुरू॒रवा॑ असि । गा॒य॒त्रेण॑ त्वा॒ छन्द॑सा मन्थामि॒ त्रै॑ष्टुभेन त्वा॒ छन्द॑सा मन्थामि॒ जाग॑तेन त्वा॒ छन्द॑सा मन्थामि
verses.translation: Birth-place art thou of Agni. Ye are sprinklers. Thou art Urvasi. Thou art Âyu. Thou art Purûravas. I rub and churn thee with Gâyatrî metre. I rub and churn thee with the Trishtup metre. I rub and churn thee with, the Jagatî metre.
verses.hindi: प्रभुभक्त अग्निरूप प्रभु में प्रवेश करके अग्नि-सा ही बन जाता है“ शुद्ध '। अब इसकी सब क्रियाँ पवित्र यज्ञात्मक होती हैँ।  अनाधृष्टमस्यनाधृष्यं देवानामोजो ऽ न॑भिशस्त्यभिशस्तिपाऽअंनभिशस्तेन्यमञ्ज॑सा सत्यमुंपगेषश्श्स्विते मां धाः॥५॥
verses.transliteration: agnerjanitramasi vṛṣaṇau stha urvaśyasyāyurasi purūravā asi | gāyatreṇa tvā chandasā manthāmi traiṣṭubhena tvā chandasā manthāmi jāgatena tvā chandasā manthāmi
verses.wordMeaning: Birth-place art thou of Agni. Ye are sprinklers. Thou art Urvasi. Thou art Âyu. Thou art Purûravas. I rub and churn thee with Gâyatrî metre. I rub and churn thee with the Trishtup metre. I rub and churn thee with, the Jagatî metre.

verses.sanskrit: भव॑तं न॒: सम॑नसौ॒ सचे॑तसावरे॒पसौ॑ । मा य॒ज्ञᳪ  हि॑ᳪसिष्टं॒ मा य॒ज्ञप॑तिं जातवेदसौ शिवौ भ॑वतम॒द्य न॑:
verses.translation: Be ye for us one-minded, be one-thoughted, free from spot and stain. Harm not the sacrifice, harm not the sacrifice's lord. Be kind to us this day, Omniscient Ones!
verses.hindi: प्रभु का उपासक सत्यभाषण करता है-उसका सत्य किसी कौ हिसा नहीं करता। यह सदा स्वित=उत्तम मार्ग पर चलता हे। १. है अग्ने आगे ले-चलनेवाले प्रभो! ब्रतपाः=आप ब्रतों के पालन करनेवाले हो। त्वे तेरे उपासक भी व्रतपा =त्रतों के पालने करनेवाले होते है, अर्थात् वे भी आपकी भाति
verses.transliteration: bhavataṃ na: samanasau sacetasāvarepasau | mā yajña hisiṣṭaṃ mā yajñapatiṃ jātavedasau śivau bhavatamadya na:
verses.wordMeaning: Be ye for us one-minded, be one-thoughted, free from spot and stain. Harm not the sacrifice, harm not the sacrifice's lord. Be kind to us this day, Omniscient Ones!
verses.commentary: Sense: Be ye for us one-minded, be one-thoughted, free from spot and stain. Harm not the sacrifice, harm not the sacrifice's lord. Be kind to us this day, Omniscient Ones!

verses.sanskrit: अ॒ग्नाव॒ग्निश्च॑रति॒ प्रवि॑ष्ट॒ ऋषी॑णां पु॒त्रो अ॑भिशस्ति॒पावा॑ । स न॑: स्यो॒नः सु॒यजा॑ यजे॒ह दे॒वेभ्यो॑ ह॒व्यᳪ  सद॒मप्र॑युच्छ॒न्त्स्वाहा॑
verses.translation: Preserver from the curse, Son of the Rishis, Agni is active having entered Agni. Here for us kindly with fair worship offer oblation to the Gods with care unceasing. Svâhâ!
verses.hindi: प्रभु "व्रतपा" है। मै भी "व्रतपा" बनूं। व्रतपा बनकर ही मेँ प्रभु का अभिन्न मित्र बनता हूँ। त्रतों के पालन के लिए मेरा जीवन तपस्वी हो। यचुर्वेदभाव्यम् १२९ पञ्चमोऽध्यायः कअश्शुरश्णुष्टे देव सोमाप्यायतामिन्दरयैकधनविदे। आ तुभ्यमिन्द्रः प्याय॑तामा त्वमिन्द्राय
verses.transliteration: agnāvagniścarati praviṣṭa ṛṣīṇāṃ putro abhiśastipāvā | sa na: syonaḥ suyajā yajeha devebhyo havya sadamaprayucchantsvāhā
verses.wordMeaning: Preserver from the curse, Son of the Rishis, Agni is active having entered Agni. Here for us kindly with fair worship offer oblation to the Gods with care unceasing. Svâhâ!
verses.commentary: Sense: Preserver from the curse, Son of the Rishis, Agni is active having entered Agni. Here for us kindly with fair worship offer oblation to the Gods with care unceasing. Svâhâ!

verses.sanskrit: आप॑तये त्वा॒ परि॑पतये गृह्णामि॒ तनू॒नप्त्रे॑   शाक्व॒राय॒ शक्व॑न॒ ओजि॑ष्ठाय । अना॑धृष्टमस्यनाधृ॒ष्यं दे॒वाना॒मोजोऽन॑भिशस्त्यभिशस्ति॒पा अ॑नभिशस्ते॒न्यमञ्ज॑सा स॒त्यमुप॑गेषᳪ  स्वि॒ते मा॑ धाः
verses.translation: For him who flies around and rushes onward I take thee, for Tanûnapât the mighty, the very strong, of all-surpassing vigour. Strength of the Gods, inviolate, inviolable still art thou, the strength that turns the curse away, uncursed and never to be cursed. May I go straight to truth. Place me in comfort.
verses.hindi: हम सोम की रक्षा करते हैं, परिणामतः धन, शक्ति व मेधा को प्राप्त करते हे। हमारा जीवन ऋत का पालन करनेवाला होता है। हम किसी के भी साथ व्यर्थं विवाद के इ्गडं में नहीं पडते। १. गत मन्त्र में सोमन्वीर्यशक्ति का उल्लेख था। यही वीर्य शरीर को “पत्थर
verses.transliteration: āpataye tvā paripataye gṛhṇāmi tanūnaptre śākvarāya śakvana ojiṣṭhāya | anādhṛṣṭamasyanādhṛṣyaṃ devānāmojo'nabhiśastyabhiśastipā anabhiśastenyamañjasā satyamupageṣa svite mā dhāḥ
verses.wordMeaning: For him who flies around and rushes onward I take thee, for Tanûnapât the mighty, the very strong, of all-surpassing vigour. Strength of the Gods, inviolate, inviolable still art thou, the strength that turns the curse away, uncursed and never to be cursed.…
verses.commentary: Sense: For him who flies around and rushes onward I take thee, for Tanûnapât the mighty, the very strong, of all-surpassing vigour. Strength of the Gods, inviolate, inviolable still art thou, the strength that turns the curse away, uncursed and never to be cursed.…

verses.sanskrit: अग्ने॑ व्रतपा॒स्त्वे व्र॑त॒पा या तव॑ त॒नूरि॒यᳪ  सा मयि॒ यो मम॑ त॒नूरे॒षा सा त्वयि॑ । स॒ह नौ॑ व्रतपते व्र॒तान्यनु॑ मे दी॒क्षां दी॒क्षाप॑ति॒र्मन्य॑ता॒मनु॒ तप॒स्तप॑स्पतिः
verses.translation: O Agni, Guardian of the Vow, O Guardian of the Vow, in thee Whatever form there is of thine, may that same form be here on me: un thee be every form of mine. O Lord of Vows, let our vows be united. May Dîkshâ's Lord allow my Consecration, may holy Fervour's Lord approve my Fervour.
verses.hindi: सोम से हमारा शरीर वजतुल्य बने, मन शिवसंकल्पवाला हो ओर मस्तिष्क दुःखहर ज्ञान से परिपूर्ण हो। हम न कटु वचन बोले न हौ अभिमानपूर्ण बातें करे। नामाग्नैऽअङ्धिर ऽआयुंना नाम्नि यु ऽस्यां पुंथिव्यामसि यत्ते ऽनाधृष्टं नाम॑ यज्ञियं पृथिव्यामसि यत्तेऽनाधृष्टं नाम॑ यज्ञियं तेन त्वा द॑धे विदेदन्नि्नभो नामाग्नैऽअद्धिर ऽआयुंना
verses.transliteration: agne vratapāstve vratapā yā tava tanūriya sā mayi yo mama tanūreṣā sā tvayi | saha nau vratapate vratānyanu me dīkṣāṃ dīkṣāpatirmanyatāmanu tapastapaspatiḥ
verses.wordMeaning: O Agni, Guardian of the Vow, O Guardian of the Vow, in thee Whatever form there is of thine, may that same form be here on me: un thee be every form of mine. O Lord of Vows, let our vows be united. May Dîkshâ's Lord allow my Consecration,…
verses.commentary: Sense: O Agni, Guardian of the Vow, O Guardian of the Vow, in thee Whatever form there is of thine, may that same form be here on me: un thee be every form of mine. O Lord of Vows, let our vows be united. May Dîkshâ's Lord allow my Consecration,…

verses.sanskrit: अ॒jशुर॑ᳪशुष्टे देव सो॒माप्या॑यता॒मिन्द्रा॑यैकधन॒विदे॑ । आ तुभ्य॒मिन्द्र॒: प्याय॑ता॒मा त्वमिन्द्रा॑य प्यायस्व । आ प्या॑यया॒स्मान्त्सखी॑न्त्स॒न्या मे॒धया॑ स्व॒स्ति ते॑ देव सोम सु॒त्याम॑शीय । एष्टा॒ राय॒: प्रेषे भगा॑य ऋ॒तमृ॑तवा॒दिभ्यो॒ नमो॒ द्यावा॑पृथि॒वीभ्या॑म्
verses.translation: May every stalk of thine wax full and strengthen for Indra Ekadhanavid, God Soma! May Indra grow in strength for thee: for Indra mayest thou grow strong. Increase us friends with strength and mental vigour. May all prosperity be thine, God Soma. May I attain the solemn Soma-pressing. May longed-for wealth come forth for strength and fortune. Let there be truth for those whose speech is truthful. To Heaven and Earth be adoration offered.
verses.hindi: सोम हमें उपतापो व पीड़ाओं से बचाता है। यह  स्थूल, सुक्ष्म व कारण" शरीरो मे अपराजित रूप से रहकर हमें नम्र व पवित्र बनाता है। इसकी रक्षा के अनुपात मेही हम दिव्य गुणों को प्राप्त करते हे। सिश्शह्यसि सपलसादी देवेभ्यः कल्पस्व सिश्ह्यसि
verses.transliteration: ajśuraśuṣṭe deva somāpyāyatāmindrāyaikadhanavide | ā tubhyamindra: pyāyatāmā tvamindrāya pyāyasva | ā pyāyayāsmāntsakhīntsanyā medhayā svasti te deva soma sutyāmaśīya | eṣṭā rāya: preṣe bhagāya ṛtamṛtavādibhyo namo dyāvāpṛthivībhyām
verses.wordMeaning: May every stalk of thine wax full and strengthen for Indra Ekadhanavid, God Soma! May Indra grow in strength for thee: for Indra mayest thou grow strong. Increase us friends with strength and mental vigour. May all prosperity be thine, God Soma.…
verses.commentary: Sense: May every stalk of thine wax full and strengthen for Indra Ekadhanavid, God Soma! May Indra grow in strength for thee: for Indra mayest thou grow strong. Increase us friends with strength and mental vigour. May all prosperity be thine, God Soma.…

verses.sanskrit:
या ते॑ अग्नेऽयःश॒या त॒नूर्वर्षि॑ष्ठा गह्वरे॒ष्ठा । उ॒ग्रं वचो॒ अपा॑वधीत्त्वे॒षं वचो॒ अपा॑वधी॒त्स्वाहा॑ ।
या ते॑ अग्ने रजःश॒या त॒नूर्वर्षि॑ष्ठा गह्वरे॒ष्ठा । उ॒ग्रं वचो॒ अपा॑वधीत्त्वे॒षं वचो॒ अपा॑वधी॒त्स्वाहा॑ ।
या ते॑ अग्ने हरिश॒या त॒नूर्वर्षि॑ष्ठा गह्वरे॒ष्ठा । उ॒ग्रं वचो॒ अपा॑वधीत्त्वे॒षं वचो॒ अपा॑वधी॒त्स्वाहा॑
verses.translation: That noblest body which is thine, O Agni, laid in the lowest deep, encased in iron, hath chased the awful word, the word of terror. Svâhâ! That noblest . . . . . . encased in silver, etc. Svâhâ That noblest . . . . with gold around it, etc. Svâhâ!
verses.hindi: वेदवाणी बुराइयों को नष्ट करती हे, ज्ञान का सेचन करती है, कामादि का पराभव करती है। बुराइयों को नष्ट करके यह हमें सबल बनाती है , सान-सेचन से यह हमारा शोधन करती है। कामादि के पराभव से यह हमारे जीवन को अलंकृत करती ह। पितृभिर्दक्षिणतः पातु विश्वकर्मा त्वादित्यरुत्तरतः पात्विदमहं तप्तं
verses.transliteration: yā te agne'yaḥśayā tanūrvarṣiṣṭhā gahvareṣṭhā | ugraṃ vaco apāvadhīttveṣaṃ vaco apāvadhītsvāhā | yā te agne rajaḥśayā tanūrvarṣiṣṭhā gahvareṣṭhā | ugraṃ vaco apāvadhīttveṣaṃ vaco apāvadhītsvāhā | yā te agne hariśayā tanūrvarṣiṣṭhā gahvareṣṭhā | ugraṃ vaco apāvadhīttveṣaṃ vaco apāvadhītsvāhā
verses.wordMeaning: That noblest body which is thine, O Agni, laid in the lowest deep, encased in iron, hath chased the awful word, the word of terror. Svâhâ! That noblest . . . . . . encased in silver, etc. Svâhâ That noblest . . . . with gold around it, etc. Svâhâ!
verses.commentary: Sense: That noblest body which is thine, O Agni, laid in the lowest deep, encased in iron, hath chased the awful word, the word of terror. Svâhâ! That noblest . . . . . . encased in silver, etc. Svâhâ That noblest . . . . with gold around it, etc. Svâhâ!

verses.sanskrit:
त॒प्ताय॑नी मेऽसि वि॒त्ताय॑नी मेऽस्यव॑तान्मा नाथि॒तादव॑तान्मा व्यथि॒तात् । वि॒देद॒ग्निर्नभो॒ नामा   ऽग्ने॑ अङ्गिर॒ आयु॑ना॒ नाम्नेहि॒
योऽस्यां पृ॑थि॒व्यामसि॒ यत्तेऽना॑धृष्टं॒ नाम॑ य॒ज्ञियं॒ तेन॒ त्वा द॑धे वि॒देद॒ग्निर्न॒भो॒ नामा  ऽग्ने॑ अङ्गिर॒ आयु॑ना॒ नाम्नेहि॒
यो द्वि॒तीय॑स्यां पृथि॒व्यामसि॒ यत्तेऽना॑धृष्टं॒ नाम॑ य॒ज्ञियं॒ तेन॒ त्वा द॑धे वि॒देद॒ग्निर्न॒भो नामा  ऽग्ने॑ अङ्गिर॒ आयु॑ना॒ नाम्नेहि॑  यस्तृ॒तीय॑स्यां पृथि॒व्यामसि॒ यत्तेऽना॑धृष्टं॒ नाम॑ य॒ज्ञियं॒ तेन॒ त्वा द॑धे । अनु॑ त्वा दे॒ववी॑तये
verses.translation: For me thou art the home of the afflicted. For me thou art the gathering-place of riches. Protect me from the, woe of destitution. Protect me from the state of perturbation. May Agni know thee, he whose name is Nabhas. Go, Agni, Angiras, with the name of Âyu. Thou whom this earth containeth, down I lay thee with each inviolate holy name thou bearest. Thou whom the second earth, etc. Thou whom the third earth, etc. Thee, further, for the Gods’ delight.
verses.hindi: हों। ब्रह्मचारी ' स्वस्थ, एक-दूसरे को ज्ञान देनेवाले, आपने को वासनाओं से बचानेवाले तथा अच्छाइयों को ग्रहण करनेवाले हों। शिक्षा हमें आगे ले-चले, विषयासक्ति से बचाए, कर्मकुशल बनाए ओर उन्नत करके संसार से तराये। १. गत मन्त्र में वर्णित आचार्यकुल मेँ पदाई जानेवाली वेदवाणी का उल्लेख करते
verses.transliteration: taptāyanī me'si vittāyanī me'syavatānmā nāthitādavatānmā vyathitāt | videdagnirnabho nāmā 'gne aṅgira āyunā nāmnehi yo'syāṃ pṛthivyāmasi yatte'nādhṛṣṭaṃ nāma yajñiyaṃ tena tvā dadhe videdagnirnabho nāmā 'gne aṅgira āyunā nāmnehi yo dvitīyasyāṃ pṛthivyāmasi yatte'nādhṛṣṭaṃ nāma yajñiyaṃ tena tvā dadhe videdagnirnabho nāmā 'gne aṅgira āyunā nāmnehi yastṛtīyasyāṃ pṛthivyāmasi yatte'nādhṛṣṭaṃ nāma yajñiyaṃ tena tvā dadhe | anu tvā devavītaye
verses.wordMeaning: For me thou art the home of the afflicted. For me thou art the gathering-place of riches. Protect me from the, woe of destitution. Protect me from the state of perturbation. May Agni know thee, he whose name is Nabhas. Go, Agni, Angiras, with the name of Âyu.…
verses.commentary: Sense: For me thou art the home of the afflicted. For me thou art the gathering-place of riches. Protect me from the, woe of destitution. Protect me from the state of perturbation. May Agni know thee, he whose name is Nabhas. Go, Agni, Angiras, with the name of Âyu.…

verses.sanskrit: सि॒jह्य॒सि सपत्नसा॒ही दे॒वेभ्य॑: कल्पस्व  सि॒jह्य॒सि सपत्नसा॒ही दे॒वेभ्य॑:शुन्धस्व सि॒jह्य॒सि सपत्नसा॒ही दे॒वेभ्य॑: शुम्भस्व
verses.translation: A foe-subduing lioness art thou: be fitted for the Gods. A foe-subduing lioness art thou: be purified for Gods. A foe-subduing lioness art thou: adorn thyself for Gods.
verses.hindi: वेदज्ान को प्राप्त करके हम प्रथमाश्रम में विज्ञान व बल का, दूसरे में सुसन्तान व धन का, तीसरे में प्रभु-प्राप्तिव चौथे में लोकषहित का साधन करे। १. गत मन्त्र की समाप्ति ' भूतेभ्यस्त्वा' शब्दों से हुई थी। एक परिव्राजक अपने जीवन का ध्येय बनाता है कि वह वेदवाणी का ज्ञान सब मनुष्यों को प्राप्त कराएगा ओर
verses.transliteration: sijhyasi sapatnasāhī devebhya: kalpasva sijhyasi sapatnasāhī devebhya:śundhasva sijhyasi sapatnasāhī devebhya: śumbhasva
verses.wordMeaning: A foe-subduing lioness art thou: be fitted for the Gods. A foe-subduing lioness art thou: be purified for Gods. A foe-subduing lioness art thou: adorn thyself for Gods.
verses.commentary: Sense: A foe-subduing lioness art thou: be fitted for the Gods. A foe-subduing lioness art thou: be purified for Gods. A foe-subduing lioness art thou: adorn thyself for Gods.

verses.sanskrit:
इ॒न्द्र॒घो॒षस्त्वा॒ वसु॑भिः पु॒रस्ता॑त्पातु प्रचे॑तास्त्वा रुद्रैः प॒श्चात्पा॑तु मनो॑जवास्त्वा पि॒तृभि॑र्दक्षिण॒तः पा॑तु
वि॒श्वक॑र्मा त्वाऽऽदि॒त्यैरु॑त्तर॒तः पा॑त्वि॒दम॒हं त॒प्तं वार्ब॑हि॒र्धा य॒ज्ञान्निः सृ॑जामि
verses.translation: Indra's shout guard thee in the front with Vasus. The Wise One guard thee from the rear with Rudras. The Thought-swift guard thee on the right with Fathers. The Omnific guard thee, leftward, with Âdityas. This heated water I eject and banish from the sacrifice.
verses.hindi: एक संन्यासी को ' धुव, ध्रुवक्षित् व अच्युतक्षित्' बनना चाहिए। प्रभु में मन का (योग) लगाना वि होत्रा दधे वयुनाविदेकऽ इन्मदही देवस्य सवितुः परिष्टुतिः स्वाह॥ ९४॥ १९. गत मन्त्र में ' धुव, ध्ुवक्षित् व अच्युतक्षित्' बनने के लिए मन्त्र का ऋषि
verses.transliteration: indraghoṣastvā vasubhiḥ purastātpātu pracetāstvā rudraiḥ paścātpātu manojavāstvā pitṛbhirdakṣiṇataḥ pātu viśvakarmā tvā''dityairuttarataḥ pātvidamahaṃ taptaṃ vārbahirdhā yajñānniḥ sṛjāmi
verses.wordMeaning: Indra's shout guard thee in the front with Vasus. The Wise One guard thee from the rear with Rudras. The Thought-swift guard thee on the right with Fathers. The Omnific guard thee, leftward, with Âdityas. This heated water I eject and banish from the sacrifice.
verses.commentary: Sense: Indra's shout guard thee in the front with Vasus. The Wise One guard thee from the rear with Rudras. The Thought-swift guard thee on the right with Fathers. The Omnific guard thee, leftward, with Âdityas. This heated water I eject and banish from the sacrifice.

verses.sanskrit:
सि॒jह्य॒सि॒ स्वाहा॑ सि॒jह्य॒स्यादित्य॒वनि॒: स्वाहा॑  सि॒jह्य॒सि ब्रह्म॒वनि॑: क्षत्र॒वनि॒: स्वाहा॑
सि॒jह्य॒सि सुप्रजा॒वनी॑ रायस्पोष॒वनि॒: स्वाहा॑  सि॒jह्यस्याव॑ह दे॒वान्  यज॑मानाय॒ स्वाहा॑
भू॒तेभ्य॑स्त्वा
verses.translation: Thou art a lioness. All-hail! Thou art a lioness winning Âdityas. All-hail! Thou art a lioness winning Brâhmans and Nobles. All-hail! Thou art a lioness that wins fair offspring, win abundant wealth. All-hail! A lioness art thou. Bring the Gods hither for him who offers sacrifice. All-hail! To living creatures; thee.
verses.hindi: हम मन को कन्द्रित करें, प्रभु की वाणी को सुनें ओर ज्ञानी बनकर सर्वत्र प्रभु की महिमा का दर्शन करं, स्वार्थमुक्त जीवन-यापन करे। १. गत मन्त्र की समाप्ति पर उस सविता देव कौ महान् स्तुति का उल्लेख था। उसी स्तुति को प्रस्तुत मन्त्र मेँ कहते हैँ कि विष्णुः वह व्यापक परमात्मा इदम्-इस ब्रह्माण्ड
verses.transliteration: sijhyasi svāhā sijhyasyādityavani: svāhā sijhyasi brahmavani: kṣatravani: svāhā sijhyasi suprajāvanī rāyaspoṣavani: svāhā sijhyasyāvaha devān yajamānāya svāhā bhūtebhyastvā
verses.wordMeaning: Thou art a lioness. All-hail! Thou art a lioness winning Âdityas. All-hail! Thou art a lioness winning Brâhmans and Nobles. All-hail! Thou art a lioness that wins fair offspring, win abundant wealth. All-hail! A lioness art thou.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Thou art a lioness. All-hail! Thou art a lioness winning Âdityas. All-hail! Thou art a lioness winning Brâhmans and Nobles. All-hail! Thou art a lioness that wins fair offspring, win abundant wealth. All-hail! A lioness art thou.…

verses.sanskrit: ध्रु॒वो॒ऽसि पृथि॒वीं दृ॑ᳪह  ध्रुव॒क्षिद॑स्य॒न्तरि॑क्षं दृᳪहाच्युत॒क्षिद॑सि॒ दिवं॑ दृᳪहा॒ग्नेः पुरी॑षमसि
verses.translation: Firm art thou, steady thou the earth. Firm-seated art thou, steady thou the air. Movelessly set art thou, steady the sky. Agni's completion art thou.
verses.hindi: यह सारा ब्रह्माण्ड प्रभु की महिमा का प्रतिपादक ेै। प्रभु ने तीन लोकों मे विभक्त करके इस सृष्टि कौ रचना कौ दहै। ये तीन लोक ही प्रभु के तीन पग है एञ्वमोऽध्यायः ९२६ यजुर्वेद भाष्यम् १. गत मन्त्र में विष्णु द्वारा संसार के निर्माण का उल्लेख दहे। इस संसार में मनुष्य
verses.transliteration: dhruvo'si pṛthivīṃ dṛha dhruvakṣidasyantarikṣaṃ dṛhācyutakṣidasi divaṃ dṛhāgneḥ purīṣamasi
verses.wordMeaning: Firm art thou, steady thou the earth. Firm-seated art thou, steady thou the air. Movelessly set art thou, steady the sky. Agni's completion art thou.
verses.commentary: Sense: Firm art thou, steady thou the earth. Firm-seated art thou, steady thou the air. Movelessly set art thou, steady the sky. Agni's completion art thou.

verses.sanskrit:
यु॒ञ्जते॒ मन॑ उ॒त यु॑ञ्जते॒ धियो॒ विप्रा॒ विप्र॑स्य बृह॒तो वि॑प॒श्चित॑: ।
वि होत्रा॑ दधे वयुना॒विदेक॒ इन्म॒ही दे॒वस्य॑ सवि॒तुः परि॑ष्टुति॒: स्वाहा॑
verses.translation: The priests of him the lofty Priest well-skilled in hymns harness their spirits, yea harness their holy thoughts. He only knowing works assigns their priestly tasks. Yea, lofty is the praise of Savitar the God. All-hail!
verses.hindi: मनुष्य इस सृष्टि में सब वस्तुओं का विचारपूर्वक प्रयोग करे। अन्न व दूध ही उसके भोजन हे। अधिक-से-अधिक खुले में रहने का प्रयत्न करे। यह अन्तरिक्ष प्राणशक्ति से भरा हआ है। देवश्रुतौ देवेष्वाघोषतं प्राची प्रेत॑मध्वरं कल्पय॑न्तीऽ ऊर्ध्वं यज्ञं न॑यतं मा जिंह्यरतम्।
verses.transliteration: yuñjate mana uta yuñjate dhiyo viprā viprasya bṛhato vipaścita: | vi hotrā dadhe vayunāvideka inmahī devasya savituḥ pariṣṭuti: svāhā
verses.wordMeaning: The priests of him the lofty Priest well-skilled in hymns harness their spirits, yea harness their holy thoughts. He only knowing works assigns their priestly tasks. Yea, lofty is the praise of Savitar the God. All-hail!
verses.commentary: Sense: The priests of him the lofty Priest well-skilled in hymns harness their spirits, yea harness their holy thoughts. He only knowing works assigns their priestly tasks. Yea, lofty is the praise of Savitar the God. All-hail!

verses.sanskrit: इ॒दं विष्णु॒र्वि च॑क्रमे त्रे॒धा नि द॑धे प॒दम् । समू॑ढमस्य पाᳪसु॒रे स्वाहा॑
verses.translation: Forth through This All strode Vishnu: thrice his foot he planted, and the whole was gathered in his footstep's dust. All-hail!
verses.hindi: हम देवश्रुत बनें, जीवन में यज्ञ को ऊँचा स्थान दे, कुटिलता से दूर रहं, इस प्रकार अपने जीवन व प्रजा को सुन्दर बना ओर अपने सुन्दर शरीरो मे आनन्द का अनुभव करें अथवा इस पृथिवी के देवयजनो में टी आनन्द का अनुभव करे। १. मैं विष्णोः= व्यापक परमात्मा के वीर्याणि पराक्रमयुक्त कर्मो को नु कं=शीघ
verses.transliteration: idaṃ viṣṇurvi cakrame tredhā ni dadhe padam | samūḍhamasya pāsure svāhā
verses.wordMeaning: Forth through This All strode Vishnu: thrice his foot he planted, and the whole was gathered in his footstep's dust. All-hail!
verses.commentary: Sense: Forth through This All strode Vishnu: thrice his foot he planted, and the whole was gathered in his footstep's dust. All-hail!

verses.sanskrit: इरा॑वती धेनु॒मती॒ हि भू॒तᳪ  सू॑यव॒सिनी॒ मन॑वे दश॒स्या । व्य॑स्कभ्ना॒ रोद॑सी विष्णवे॒ते दा॒धर्थ॑ पृथि॒वीम॒भितो॑ म॒यूखै॒: स्वाहा॑
verses.translation: Rich in sweet food be ye, and rich in milch-kine, with fertile pastures, fair to do men service. Both these worlds, Vishnu, hast thou stayed asunder, and firmly fixed the earth with pegs around it.
verses.hindi: वे प्रभु अत्यन्त शक्तिशाली कर्मो को करनेवाले हँ। सारे ब्रह्माण्ड को धारण करनेवाले है। उरुगाय है। मैं उन्हीं की शरण में जाता हूं। १. है विष्णो सर्वव्यापक प्रभो! दिवः वा=चाहे द्युलोक से उत वा पृथिव्याः=या पृथिवी से महः उरो अन्तरिक्षात् वाइस महनीय विशाल अन्तरिक्ष से उभा हि हस्ता-निश्चय
verses.transliteration: irāvatī dhenumatī hi bhūta sūyavasinī manave daśasyā | vyaskabhnā rodasī viṣṇavete dādhartha pṛthivīmabhito mayūkhai: svāhā
verses.wordMeaning: Rich in sweet food be ye, and rich in milch-kine, with fertile pastures, fair to do men service. Both these worlds, Vishnu, hast thou stayed asunder, and firmly fixed the earth with pegs around it.
verses.commentary: Sense: Rich in sweet food be ye, and rich in milch-kine, with fertile pastures, fair to do men service. Both these worlds, Vishnu, hast thou stayed asunder, and firmly fixed the earth with pegs around it.

verses.sanskrit:
दे॒व॒श्रुतौ॑ दे॒वेष्वा घो॑षतं॒  प्राची॒ प्रेत॑मध्व॒रं क॒ल्पय॑न्ती ऊ॒र्ध्वं य॒ज्ञं न॑यतं॒ मा जि॑ह्वरतम् ।
स्वं गो॒ष्ठमा व॑दतं देवी दुर्ये॒ आयु॒र्मा निर्वा॑दिष्टं प्र॒जां मा निर्वा॑दिष्ट॒मत्र॑ रमेथां॒ वर्ष्म॑न्  पृथि॒व्याः
verses.translation: Heard by the Gods, ye twain, to Gods proclaim it. Go eastward, O ye twain, proclaiming worship. Swerve ye not: bear the sacrifice straight upward. To your own cow-pen speak, ye godlike dwellings. Speak not away my life, speak not away my children. On the earth's summit here may ye be joyful.
verses.hindi: अनुकूल वातावरण पाकर हम प्रभु को प्राप्त करने के मार्ग पर चलें। वह विष्णुः सर्वव्यापक प्रभु मृगः (मार्ष्टि) हमारे जीवन का शोधन करनेवाले हे। प्रभु के स्मरण से वासनाओं का विनाश हो जाता हे। न भीमः=वे प्रभु हमारे लिए भयंकर नहीं है. वे तो पुत्रों के लिए पिता के समान है। कुचरः=(कौ चरति) वे प्रभु सम्पूर्ण
verses.transliteration: devaśrutau deveṣvā ghoṣataṃ prācī pretamadhvaraṃ kalpayantī ūrdhvaṃ yajñaṃ nayataṃ mā jihvaratam | svaṃ goṣṭhamā vadataṃ devī durye āyurmā nirvādiṣṭaṃ prajāṃ mā nirvādiṣṭamatra ramethāṃ varṣman pṛthivyāḥ
verses.wordMeaning: Heard by the Gods, ye twain, to Gods proclaim it. Go eastward, O ye twain, proclaiming worship. Swerve ye not: bear the sacrifice straight upward. To your own cow-pen speak, ye godlike dwellings. Speak not away my life, speak not away my children.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Heard by the Gods, ye twain, to Gods proclaim it. Go eastward, O ye twain, proclaiming worship. Swerve ye not: bear the sacrifice straight upward. To your own cow-pen speak, ye godlike dwellings. Speak not away my life, speak not away my children.…

verses.sanskrit:
विष्णो॒र्नुकं॑ वी॒र्या॒णि॒ प्र वो॑चं॒ यः पार्थि॑वानि विम॒मे रजा॑ᳪसि ।
यो अस्क॑भाय॒दुत्त॑रᳪ  स॒धस्थं॑ विचक्रमा॒णस्त्रे॒धोरु॑गा॒यो  विष्ण॑वे त्वा
verses.translation: Now will I tell the mighty deeds of Vishnu, of him who measured out the earthly regions. Who propped the highest place of congregation, thrice setting down his foot and widely striding. For Vishnu thee.
verses.hindi: पर वे सर्वत्र विद्यमान हँ। ये तीनों लोक प्रभुके ही तीन विक्रमण है। इन्हीं में सव प्राणियों गत मन्त्र के अनुसार विष्णु का स्मरण करनेवाले पवित्र बनते ं। विष्णु यज्ञरूप है , अतः इनका जीवन यज्ञमय होता है। मन्त्र में कहते हैँ कि तू विष्णोः=यज्ञ का रराटम् असि=ललार है, मस्तक है। यज्ञ करनेवालों का तू मूर्धन्य बनता हे। "रट परिभाषणे' धातु
verses.transliteration: viṣṇornukaṃ vīryāṇi pra vocaṃ yaḥ pārthivāni vimame rajāsi | yo askabhāyaduttara sadhasthaṃ vicakramāṇastredhorugāyo viṣṇave tvā
verses.wordMeaning: Now will I tell the mighty deeds of Vishnu, of him who measured out the earthly regions. Who propped the highest place of congregation, thrice setting down his foot and widely striding. For Vishnu thee.
verses.commentary: Sense: Now will I tell the mighty deeds of Vishnu, of him who measured out the earthly regions. Who propped the highest place of congregation, thrice setting down his foot and widely striding. For Vishnu thee.

verses.sanskrit:
दि॒वो वा॑ विष्ण उ॒त वा॑ पृथि॒व्या म॒हो वा॑ विष्ण उ॒रोर॒न्तरि॑क्षात् ।
उ॒भा हि हस्ता॒ वसु॑ना पृ॒णस्वा प्र य॑च्छ॒ दक्षि॑णा॒दोत स॒व्याद्विष्ण॑वे त्वा
verses.translation: Either from heaven or from the earth, O Vishnu, or, Vishnu, from the vast wide air's mid-region, Fill both thy hands full with abundant riches, and from the right and from the left bestow them. For Vishnu thee.
verses.hindi: हम अपने जीवनो को यज्ञमय बनाकर ' वैष्णव! बन जाँ। सूचना- यज्ञ विष्णु है विष्लृ व्याप्तौ-व्यापक कर्म हे। क्देवस्य॑ त्वा सवितुः प्र॑ंसवु ऽ श्विनो्बाहभ्या पूष्णो हस्ताभ्याम्। १९. गत मन्त्र में जीवन को यज्ञमय बनाने का उल्लेख था। जीवन को यज्ञमय
verses.transliteration: divo vā viṣṇa uta vā pṛthivyā maho vā viṣṇa urorantarikṣāt | ubhā hi hastā vasunā pṛṇasvā pra yaccha dakṣiṇādota savyādviṣṇave tvā
verses.wordMeaning: Either from heaven or from the earth, O Vishnu, or, Vishnu, from the vast wide air's mid-region, Fill both thy hands full with abundant riches, and from the right and from the left bestow them. For Vishnu thee.
verses.commentary: Sense: Either from heaven or from the earth, O Vishnu, or, Vishnu, from the vast wide air's mid-region, Fill both thy hands full with abundant riches, and from the right and from the left bestow them. For Vishnu thee.

verses.sanskrit:
प्र तद्विष्णु॑ स्तवते वी॒र्ये॒ण मृ॒गो न भी॒मः कु॑च॒रो गि॑रि॒ष्ठाः ।
यस्यो॒रुषु॑ त्रि॒षु वि॒क्रम॑णेष्वधिक्षि॒यन्ति॒ भुव॑नानि॒ विश्वा॑
verses.translation: For this his mighty deed is Vishnu lauded, like some wild beast, dread, prowling, mountain-roaming, He within whose three wide-extended paces all living creatures have their habitation,
verses.hindi: मै सब वस्तुओं का ठीक प्रयोग करूं। राक्षसो को जीतूं। प्रभु की वृहती १. पिछले मन्त्र कौ समाप्ति ' बृहतीं वाचं वद्" पर थी- बृहती वाक को बोलिए। उस बृहती वाक् को जो रक्षोहणम्-सब राक्षसी वृत्तियों को समाप्त कर देती हे। राक्षसी वृत्तियों को ही नदीं यह रोगकृमियों को भी नष्ट करनेवाली है। २. यह वाणी वलगहनम्=( वल
verses.transliteration: pra tadviṣṇu stavate vīryeṇa mṛgo na bhīmaḥ kucaro giriṣṭhāḥ | yasyoruṣu triṣu vikramaṇeṣvadhikṣiyanti bhuvanāni viśvā
verses.wordMeaning: For this his mighty deed is Vishnu lauded, like some wild beast, dread, prowling, mountain-roaming, He within whose three wide-extended paces all living creatures have their habitation,
verses.commentary: Sense: For this his mighty deed is Vishnu lauded, like some wild beast, dread, prowling, mountain-roaming, He within whose three wide-extended paces all living creatures have their habitation,

verses.sanskrit:
विष्णो॑ र॒राट॑मसि॒  विष्णो॒: श्नप्त्रे॑ स्थो  विष्णो॒: स्यूर॑सि॒ विष्णो॑र्ध्रु॒वो॒ऽसि ।
वै॒ष्ण॒वम॑सि॒ विष्ण॑वे त्वा
verses.translation: Thou art the frontlet for the brow of Vishnu. Ye are the corners of the mouth of Vishnu. Thou art the needle for the work of Vishnu. Thou art the firmly-fastened knot of Vishnu. To Vishnu thou belongest. Thee for Vishnu.
verses.hindi: मानव-जीवन का ध्येय यही होना चाहिए कि "में इस अनन्त कारणों से, न जाने कब उत्पन्न हो जानेवाली अदृश्य वासना को अवश्य ही उखाड फैकूगा। १. गत मन्त्र के अनुसार वासना का उच्छेद करनेवाला यह ' दीर्घतमा प्रभु का प्रिय नता े। प्रभु इससे कहते हैँ कि तू अपने इस जीवन के प्रथम प्रयाण में स्वराट् असि स्वराट्
verses.transliteration: viṣṇo rarāṭamasi viṣṇo: śnaptre stho viṣṇo: syūrasi viṣṇordhruvo'si | vaiṣṇavamasi viṣṇave tvā
verses.wordMeaning: Thou art the frontlet for the brow of Vishnu. Ye are the corners of the mouth of Vishnu. Thou art the needle for the work of Vishnu. Thou art the firmly-fastened knot of Vishnu. To Vishnu thou belongest. Thee for Vishnu.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thou art the frontlet for the brow of Vishnu. Ye are the corners of the mouth of Vishnu. Thou art the needle for the work of Vishnu. Thou art the firmly-fastened knot of Vishnu. To Vishnu thou belongest. Thee for Vishnu.

verses.sanskrit:
दे॒वस्य॑ त्वा सवि॒तुः प्र॑स॒वेऽश्विनो॑र्बा॒हुभ्यां॑ पू॒ष्णो हस्ता॑भ्याम् ।
आ द॑दे॒ नार्य॑सी॒दम॒हᳪ  रक्ष॑सां ग्री॒वा अपि॑ कृन्तामि ।
बृ॒हन्न॑सि बृ॒हद्र॑वा बृह॒तीमिन्द्रा॑य॒ वाचं॑ वद
verses.translation: By impulse of God Savitar I take thee with arms of Asvins and with hands of Pûshan. Thou art a woman. Here I cut the necks of Râkshasas away. Mighty art thou, mighty the sound thou makest. Utter thy mighty-sounding voice to Indra:
verses.hindi: हमे क्रमशः ' स्वराट्, सत्ररार् व जनराट्' बनकर सर्वराट् बनना हे। करक्षोहणो वो वलगहनः प्रोक्षामि वैष्णवार््रक्षोहणो वो वलगहनो ऽ व॑नयामि १. २ डवे मन्त्र में राक्षसी वृत्तियों व काम के विध्वंस का उल्लेख था। उन्हीं के विषय में प्रभु कहते हैँ कि वः=तुममें से रश्चोदणः =इन राक्षसी वृत्तियों का विध्वंस करनेवालों
verses.transliteration: devasya tvā savituḥ prasave'śvinorbāhubhyāṃ pūṣṇo hastābhyām | ā dade nāryasīdamaha rakṣasāṃ grīvā api kṛntāmi | bṛhannasi bṛhadravā bṛhatīmindrāya vācaṃ vada
verses.wordMeaning: By impulse of God Savitar I take thee with arms of Asvins and with hands of Pûshan. Thou art a woman. Here I cut the necks of Râkshasas away. Mighty art thou, mighty the sound thou makest. Utter thy mighty-sounding voice to Indra:
verses.commentary: Sense: By impulse of God Savitar I take thee with arms of Asvins and with hands of Pûshan. Thou art a woman. Here I cut the necks of Râkshasas away. Mighty art thou, mighty the sound thou makest. Utter thy mighty-sounding voice to Indra:

verses.sanskrit: र॒क्षो॒हणं॑ वलग॒हनं॑ वैष्ण॒वी मि॒दम॒हं तं व॑ल॒गमुत्कि॑रामि॒ यं मे॒ निष्ट्यो॒ यम॒मात्यो॑ निच॒खाने॒दम॒हं तं व॑ल॒गमुत्कि॑रामि॒ यं मे॑ समा॒नो यमस॑मानो निच॒खाने॒दम॒हं तं व॑ल॒गमुत्कि॑रामि॒ यं मे॒ सब॑न्धु॒र्यमस॑बन्धुर्निच॒खाने॒दम॒हं तं व॑ल॒गमुत्कि॑रामि॒ यं मे॑ सजा॒तो यमस॑जातो निच॒खानोत्कृ॒त्यां कि॑रामि
verses.translation: Fiend-killing, charm-destroying voice of Vishnu. Here I cast out that charm of magic power which stranger or housemate for me hath buried. Here I cast out the charm of magic power buried for me by equal or unequal. Here I cast out the charm that hath been buried for me by non-relation or relation. I cast the charm of magic out.
verses.hindi: ज्ानियों के सम्पर्क में रहकर हम अपने जीवनों को शुद्ध कर लें। हमारे श्ुवेण धर्मणणा। ब्रह्मवनिं त्वा क्षत्रवनिं रायस्पोषवनि पर्यूहामि । ब्रह्य द् ट क्षत्र दीर्घतमा को, जिसने. गत मन्त्र मे सब लोकों के शोधन की प्रार्थना कौ हे, प्रभु प्रणा देते हैँ कि--१. दिवं उत्स्तभानतू अपने मस्तिष्क को ऊपर भाम। जैसे पर्वत के
verses.transliteration: rakṣohaṇaṃ valagahanaṃ vaiṣṇavī midamahaṃ taṃ valagamutkirāmi yaṃ me niṣṭyo yamamātyo nicakhānedamahaṃ taṃ valagamutkirāmi yaṃ me samāno yamasamāno nicakhānedamahaṃ taṃ valagamutkirāmi yaṃ me sabandhuryamasabandhurnicakhānedamahaṃ taṃ valagamutkirāmi yaṃ me sajāto yamasajāto nicakhānotkṛtyāṃ kirāmi
verses.wordMeaning: Fiend-killing, charm-destroying voice of Vishnu. Here I cast out that charm of magic power which stranger or housemate for me hath buried. Here I cast out the charm of magic power buried for me by equal or unequal.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Fiend-killing, charm-destroying voice of Vishnu. Here I cast out that charm of magic power which stranger or housemate for me hath buried. Here I cast out the charm of magic power buried for me by equal or unequal.…

verses.sanskrit: स्व॒राड॑सि सपत्न॒हा स॑त्र॒राड॑स्यभिमाति॒हा ज॑न॒राड॑सि रक्षो॒हा स॑र्व॒राड॑स्यमित्र॒हा
verses.translation: Self-ruler art thou, conquering foes. Ruler for ever art thou, killing enemies. Men's ruler art thou, slaying fiends. All ruler, killing foes, art thou.
verses.hindi: प्रभु को प्राप्त करने के लिए जहाँ ज्ञान ओर बल की आवश्यकता है, वर्ह जीवन व सन्तान को सुन्दर बनाना भी नितान्त आवश्यक हे। १. गत मन्त्र की प्रेरणा ही प्रस्तुत मन्त्र मेँ चल रही है। प्रभु कहते हँ कि अपने ज्ञान च बल को दद् करके एक गृहपली श्चुवा असि=धरुव बनी है। यह अपने मार्ग से विचलित
verses.transliteration: svarāḍasi sapatnahā satrarāḍasyabhimātihā janarāḍasi rakṣohā sarvarāḍasyamitrahā
verses.wordMeaning: Self-ruler art thou, conquering foes. Ruler for ever art thou, killing enemies. Men's ruler art thou, slaying fiends. All ruler, killing foes, art thou.
verses.commentary: Sense: Self-ruler art thou, conquering foes. Ruler for ever art thou, killing enemies. Men's ruler art thou, slaying fiends. All ruler, killing foes, art thou.

verses.sanskrit:
र॒क्षो॒हणो॑ वो वलग॒हन॒: प्रोक्षा॑मि वैष्ण॒वान्  र॑क्षो॒हणो॑ वो वलग॒हनोऽव॑नयामि वैष्ण॒वान्  र॑क्षो॒हणो॑ वो वलग॒हनोऽव॑स्तृणामि वैष्ण॒वान्
र॑क्षो॒हणौ॑ वां वलग॒हना॒ उप॑ दधामि वैष्ण॒वी  र॑क्षो॒हणौ॑ वां वलग॒हनौ॒ पर्यू॑हामि वैष्ण॒वी  वै॑ष्ण॒वम॑सि वै॑ष्ण॒वा स्थ॑
verses.translation: I sprinkle you whom Vishnu owns, killers of fiends and evil charms. I buy down you whom Vishnu loves, killers of fiends and wicked charms. I scatter you whom Vishnu loves, killers of fiends and wicked charms. You two whom Vishnu loves, who kill fiends and ill charms do I lay down. You two whom Vishnu loves, who kill fiends and ill charms I compass round. To Vishnu thou belongest. Ye are Vishnu's.
verses.hindi: प्रभु मेरे रक्षक है। मै ओरों का सन्ताप दूर करनेवाला बनुं। मेरा मस्तिष्कं ज्ञानदीषप्ति से पूर्ण हो। मेरा शरीर मैल से रहित होकर स्वस्थ बने। १. पिछले मन्त्र कौ भावना के अनुसार यदि हम "प्रभु के आश्रय! वाले बनना चाहते है तो हमारी प्रार्थना का स्वरूप यह होता है -हे गिर्वणः (गीर्भिः स्तोतुमर्हः) वेद -
verses.transliteration: rakṣohaṇo vo valagahana: prokṣāmi vaiṣṇavān rakṣohaṇo vo valagahano'vanayāmi vaiṣṇavān rakṣohaṇo vo valagahano'vastṛṇāmi vaiṣṇavān rakṣohaṇau vāṃ valagahanā upa dadhāmi vaiṣṇavī rakṣohaṇau vāṃ valagahanau paryūhāmi vaiṣṇavī vaiṣṇavamasi vaiṣṇavā stha
verses.wordMeaning: I sprinkle you whom Vishnu owns, killers of fiends and evil charms. I buy down you whom Vishnu loves, killers of fiends and wicked charms. I scatter you whom Vishnu loves, killers of fiends and wicked charms. You two whom Vishnu loves,…
verses.commentary: Sense: I sprinkle you whom Vishnu owns, killers of fiends and evil charms. I buy down you whom Vishnu loves, killers of fiends and wicked charms. I scatter you whom Vishnu loves, killers of fiends and wicked charms. You two whom Vishnu loves,…

verses.sanskrit:
दे॒वस्य॑ त्वा सवि॒तुः प्र॑स॒वेऽश्विनो॑र्बा॒हुभ्यां॑ पू॒ष्णो हस्ता॑भ्याम् । आ द॑दे॒ नार्य॑सी॒दम॒हᳪ रक्ष॑सां ग्री॒वा अपि॑ कृन्तामि ।
यवो॑ऽसि य॒वया॒स्मद्द्वेषो॑ य॒वयारा॑तीर्दि॒वे त्वा॒ऽन्तरि॑क्षाय त्वा पृथि॒व्यै त्वा शुन्ध॑न्तांल्लो॒काः पि॑तृ॒षद॑नाः पितृ॒षद॑नमसि
verses.translation: By impulse of God Savitar I take thee with arms of Asvins, with the hands of Peahen. Thou art a woman. Here I cut the necks of Râkshasas away. Barley art thou. Bar off from us our haters, bar our enemies. Thee for heaven, thee for earth, thee for air's region. Pure be the worlds, the Fathers’ dwelling-places. Thou art the habitation of the Fathers.
verses.hindi: हम प्रभु- स्तवन करनेवाले बने। इससे हमारे जीवन उत्कृष्ट होगे, हमारे सन्तानं करे जीवन अच्छे वनेगे ओर अपना कर्तव्य सेवन करनेवाले बनकर सभी करे प्रिय होँगे। प्रभु के साथ सिल जाना ( इन्द्रस्य स्यूः) इन्द्र॑स्य स्यूर् सीन्द्रस्य ्ुव्रो ऽसि। ेनद्रम॑सि वैश्वदेवम॑सि।। ३०॥
verses.transliteration: devasya tvā savituḥ prasave'śvinorbāhubhyāṃ pūṣṇo hastābhyām | ā dade nāryasīdamaha rakṣasāṃ grīvā api kṛntāmi | yavo'si yavayāsmaddveṣo yavayārātīrdive tvā'ntarikṣāya tvā pṛthivyai tvā śundhantāṃllokāḥ pitṛṣadanāḥ pitṛṣadanamasi
verses.wordMeaning: By impulse of God Savitar I take thee with arms of Asvins, with the hands of Peahen. Thou art a woman. Here I cut the necks of Râkshasas away. Barley art thou. Bar off from us our haters, bar our enemies. Thee for heaven, thee for earth, thee for air's region.…
verses.commentary: Sense: By impulse of God Savitar I take thee with arms of Asvins, with the hands of Peahen. Thou art a woman. Here I cut the necks of Râkshasas away. Barley art thou. Bar off from us our haters, bar our enemies. Thee for heaven, thee for earth, thee for air's region.…

verses.sanskrit:
उद्दिव॑ᳪ  स्तभाना॒न्तरि॑क्षं पृण॒ दृᳪह॑स्व पृथि॒व्याम् द्यु॑ता॒नास्त्वा॑ मारु॒तो मिनो॑तु मि॒त्रावरु॑णौ ध्रु॒वेण॒ धर्म॑णा ।
ब्र॒ह्म॒वनि॑ त्वा क्षत्र॒वनि॑  रायस्पोष॒वनि॒ पर्यू॑हामि । ब्रह्म॑ दृᳪह क्ष॒त्रं दृ॒ᳪहायु॑र्दृᳪह प्र॒जां दृ॑ᳪह
verses.translation: Prop heaven, fill full the air, on earth stand firmly. Dyutâna, offspring of the Maruts, plant thee!, Mitra and Varuna with firm upholding. I close thee in, thou winner of the Brahmans, winner of Nobles and abundant riches. Strengthen the Brahmans, strengthen thou the Nobler, strengthen our vital power, strengthen our offspring.
verses.hindi: मधुच्छन्दा प्रार्थना करता है किमे प्रभु के साथ सिल जाऊं। उससे अलग होहीन सककँ। प्रभु ही मेरे धुव होँ-केन्द्रविन्दु हो। मेरी सारी क्रियाँ उन्ीं के चारों ओर घूमे जिससे मै भी परमैश्वर्य व दिव्य गुणों का अधिकरण बनू। मधुच्छन्दा का प्रभु-स्तवन
verses.transliteration: uddiva stabhānāntarikṣaṃ pṛṇa dṛhasva pṛthivyām dyutānāstvā māruto minotu mitrāvaruṇau dhruveṇa dharmaṇā | brahmavani tvā kṣatravani rāyaspoṣavani paryūhāmi | brahma dṛha kṣatraṃ dṛhāyurdṛha prajāṃ dṛha
verses.wordMeaning: Prop heaven, fill full the air, on earth stand firmly. Dyutâna, offspring of the Maruts, plant thee!, Mitra and Varuna with firm upholding. I close thee in, thou winner of the Brahmans, winner of Nobles and abundant riches. Strengthen the Brahmans, strengthen thou the Nobler,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Prop heaven, fill full the air, on earth stand firmly. Dyutâna, offspring of the Maruts, plant thee!, Mitra and Varuna with firm upholding. I close thee in, thou winner of the Brahmans, winner of Nobles and abundant riches. Strengthen the Brahmans, strengthen thou the Nobler,…

verses.sanskrit:
ध्रु॒वासि॑ ध्रु॒वोऽयं यज॑मानो॒ऽस्मिन्ना॒यत॑ने प्र॒जया॑ प॒शुभि॑र्भूयात् ।
घृ॒तेन॑ द्यावापृथिवी पूर्येथा॒मिन्द्र॑स्य छ॒दिर॑सि विश्वज॒नस्य॑ छा॒या
verses.translation: Firm-set art thou. Firm be this Sacrificer within this home with offspring and with cattle. O Heaven and Earth, be ye filled full of fatness. Indra's mat art thou, shelter of all people.
verses.hindi: हे प्रभो! "उशिग्" आदि शब्दों से आपका स्मरण करता हुआ मै भी वेसा द्वारौ मा मा सन्ताप्तमध्व॑नामध्वपते प्र मां तिर स्वस्ति मेऽस्मिन् पथि देवयाने १. है प्रभो! आप समुद्रः असि=( समुदद्रवन्ति भूतानि यस्मात्-द०) सब भूतो के है। अथवा ( सर्वे देवाः सम्यग् उत्कर्षेण द्रवन्ति अत्र-म०) सब देवता उत्कर्ष से आपमे ही
verses.transliteration: dhruvāsi dhruvo'yaṃ yajamāno'sminnāyatane prajayā paśubhirbhūyāt | ghṛtena dyāvāpṛthivī pūryethāmindrasya chadirasi viśvajanasya chāyā
verses.wordMeaning: Firm-set art thou. Firm be this Sacrificer within this home with offspring and with cattle. O Heaven and Earth, be ye filled full of fatness. Indra's mat art thou, shelter of all people.
verses.commentary: Sense: Firm-set art thou. Firm be this Sacrificer within this home with offspring and with cattle. O Heaven and Earth, be ye filled full of fatness. Indra's mat art thou, shelter of all people.

verses.sanskrit: परि॑ त्वा गिर्वणो॒ गिर॑ इ॒मा भ॑वन्तु वि॒श्वत॑:। वृ॒द्धायु॒मनु॒ वृद्ध॑यो॒ जुष्टा॑ भवन्तु॒ जुष्ट॑यः
verses.translation: Lover of song, may these our songs encompass thee on every side; Strengthening thee of lengthened life, may they be dear delights to thee
verses.hindi: मेरा प्रत्येक कार्य श्रद्धा ओौर विद्या से हो। मैं देवयान मार्गं पर चलता हुआ सगर अग्निर्यो ८ प्रभुभक्त माता-पिता व आचार्य ) मित्रस्य॑ मा चक्षुषेक्षध्वमग्न॑यः सगराः सग॑रा स्थ सग॑रेण नाम्ना रोद्रेणानीं केन पात १. गत मन्त्र के अनुसार “ यदि हम चाहते हैँ कि हमारे जीवन मार्गश्रष्ट न हों" तो
verses.transliteration: pari tvā girvaṇo gira imā bhavantu viśvata:| vṛddhāyumanu vṛddhayo juṣṭā bhavantu juṣṭayaḥ
verses.wordMeaning: Lover of song, may these our songs encompass thee on every side; Strengthening thee of lengthened life, may they be dear delights to thee
verses.commentary: Sense: Lover of song, may these our songs encompass thee on every side; Strengthening thee of lengthened life, may they be dear delights to thee

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्र॑स्य॒ स्यूर॒सीन्द्र॑स्य ध्रु॒वो॑ऽसि । ऐ॒न्द्रम॑सि वैश्वदे॒वम॑सि
verses.translation: Thou art the needle for the work of Indra. Thou art the firmly fastened knot of Indra. Indra's art thou. Thou art the Visvedevas’.
verses.hindi: में प्रभु के उपासक ' माता-पिता आचार्य" को प्राप्त करूं। उनके द्वारा मेरे जीवन में स्तुति, नम्रता, ज्ञान व तेजस्विता का सञ्चार हो। मेरा शरीर, मन व मस्तिष्क सभी ज्योतिरसि विश्वरूपं विश्वेषां देवाना॑श््समित्। त्वः्सोम तनूकृद्भ्यो द्वेषोभ्यो ऽ "गत मन्त्र के अनुसार उत्तम माता-पिता व आचार्य के सम्पर्क में आनेवाला यह
verses.transliteration: indrasya syūrasīndrasya dhruvo'si | aindramasi vaiśvadevamasi
verses.wordMeaning: Thou art the needle for the work of Indra. Thou art the firmly fastened knot of Indra. Indra's art thou. Thou art the Visvedevas’.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thou art the needle for the work of Indra. Thou art the firmly fastened knot of Indra. Indra's art thou. Thou art the Visvedevas’.

verses.sanskrit: वि॒भूर॑सि प्र॒वाह॑णो॒  वह्नि॑रसि हव्य॒वाह॑नः । श्वा॒त्रो॒ऽसि॒ प्रचे॑तास्तु॒थो॑ऽसि वि॒श्ववे॑दाः
verses.translation: All-present art thou, carrying off. Oblation-bearing priest art thou. Thou art the Swift, the Very Wise. Tutha art thou, who knoweth all.
verses.hindi: शरीर में सुरक्षित सोम ज्ञान को बद्धाता है, दिव्य गुणों को दीप्त करता हे, द्वेष से दूर करता है। शरीर, मन व बुद्धि सभी को सुरक्षित करता है। तेजस्वी बनाता हे। ब की ये ही उत्तम इच्छा हे। उसकी ये सब इच्छा सोम के अनुग्रह से पूर्णं होती अग्ने नय॑ सुपथा रायेऽअस्मान्विश्वानि देव वयुनानि विद्धान्।
verses.transliteration: vibhūrasi pravāhaṇo vahnirasi havyavāhanaḥ | śvātro'si pracetāstutho'si viśvavedāḥ
verses.wordMeaning: All-present art thou, carrying off. Oblation-bearing priest art thou. Thou art the Swift, the Very Wise. Tutha art thou, who knoweth all.
verses.commentary: Sense: All-present art thou, carrying off. Oblation-bearing priest art thou. Thou art the Swift, the Very Wise. Tutha art thou, who knoweth all.

verses.sanskrit:
उ॒शिग॑सि क॒विरङ्घा॑रिरसि॒ बम्भा॑रिरव॒स्यूर॑सि॒ दुव॑स्वाञ्छु॒न्ध्यूर॑सि मार्जा॒लीय॑: स॒म्राड॑सि कृ॒शानु॑: परि॒षद्यो॑ऽसि॒ पव॑मानो॒ नभो॑ऽसि प्र॒तक्वा॑
मृ॒ष्टो॒ऽसि हव्य॒सूद॑न ऋ॒त॒धा॑माऽसि॒ स्व॒र्ज्योतिः
verses.translation: Thou art the yearning one, the sage. Angnâri, Bambhâri art thou. Aid-seeker art thou, worshipping. Cleanser art thou, the cleansing-place. Krisânu, Sovran Lord, art thou. Thou art the Pavamâna of the assembly. Thou art the welkin ever moving forward. Swept clean art thou, preparer of oblations. Thou art the seat of Law, heaven's light and lustre.
verses.hindi: हम विष्णु बनें । हदय को विशाल, शरीर को निर्मल व बुद्धि को दीप्त बनाकर अपने हदय में उस यज्ञपति प्रभु को आसीन करे। तोकसेवा व बन्धनविच्छेद कदेव सवितरेष ते सोमस्तःर्षस्व मा त्वा दभन्। एतत्त्वं देव सोम देवो
verses.transliteration: uśigasi kaviraṅghārirasi bambhāriravasyūrasi duvasvāñchundhyūrasi mārjālīya: samrāḍasi kṛśānu: pariṣadyo'si pavamāno nabho'si pratakvā mṛṣṭo'si havyasūdana ṛtadhāmā'si svarjyotiḥ
verses.wordMeaning: Thou art the yearning one, the sage. Angnâri, Bambhâri art thou. Aid-seeker art thou, worshipping. Cleanser art thou, the cleansing-place. Krisânu, Sovran Lord, art thou. Thou art the Pavamâna of the assembly. Thou art the welkin ever moving forward. Swept clean art thou,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Thou art the yearning one, the sage. Angnâri, Bambhâri art thou. Aid-seeker art thou, worshipping. Cleanser art thou, the cleansing-place. Krisânu, Sovran Lord, art thou. Thou art the Pavamâna of the assembly. Thou art the welkin ever moving forward. Swept clean art thou,…

verses.sanskrit: स॒मु॒द्रो॒ऽसि वि॒श्वव्य॑चा अ॒जोऽस्येक॑पा॒दहि॑रसि बु॒ध्न्यो वाग॑स्यै॒न्द्रम॑सि॒ सदो॒ऽस्यृत॑स्य द्वारौ॒ मा मा॒ सनता॑प्त॒मध्व॑नामध्वपते॒ प्र मा॑ तिर स्व॒स्ति मे॒ऽस्मिन्प॒थि दे॑व॒याने॑ भूयात्
verses.translation: A sea art thou of all-embracing compass. Aja art thou, who hath one foot to bear him. Thou art the Dragon of the Depths of ocean. Speech art thou, thou the Sadas, thou art Indra's. Doors of the sacrifice, do not distress me! Lord, Ruler of the pathways, lead me onward. In this God-reaching path may I be happy.
verses.hindi: (क) प्रभुकृपा से मै सोम की रक्षा करता हँ (ख) सोमरक्षा से हैवी सम्पत्ति का वर्धन होता है। (ग) मै धनार्जन करके मनुष्यों के दुःख-दूरीकरण में धन का विनियोग करता दूं। (घ) ओर बन्धनो से मुक्त होकर ' ब्रह्मनिर्वाण ' को प्राप्त करता हूं। १. पिच्छले मन्त्र मे पाशमुक्त होने का उल्लेख है। इस पाशमुक्ति के लिए इसी
verses.transliteration: samudro'si viśvavyacā ajo'syekapādahirasi budhnyo vāgasyaindramasi sado'syṛtasya dvārau mā mā sanatāptamadhvanāmadhvapate pra mā tira svasti me'sminpathi devayāne bhūyāt
verses.wordMeaning: A sea art thou of all-embracing compass. Aja art thou, who hath one foot to bear him. Thou art the Dragon of the Depths of ocean. Speech art thou, thou the Sadas, thou art Indra's. Doors of the sacrifice, do not distress me! Lord, Ruler of the pathways, lead me onward.…
verses.commentary: Sense: A sea art thou of all-embracing compass. Aja art thou, who hath one foot to bear him. Thou art the Dragon of the Depths of ocean. Speech art thou, thou the Sadas, thou art Indra's. Doors of the sacrifice, do not distress me! Lord, Ruler of the pathways, lead me onward.…

verses.sanskrit: मि॒त्रस्य॑ मा॒ चक्षु॑षेक्षध्व॒मग्न॑यः सगराः॒ सग॑रा स्थ॒ सग॑रेण॒ नाम्ना॒ रौद्रे॒णानी॑केन पा॒त मा॑ऽग्नयः पिपृ॒त मा॑ऽग्नयो गोपा॒यत॑ मा॒ नमो॑ वोऽस्तु॒ मा मा॑ हिᳪसिष्ट
verses.translation: Look ye upon me with the eye of Mitra. O Agnis, ye, receivers of oblations, are by a lauded name lauded together. Protect me, Agnis! with your glittering army. Fill me with riches, Agnis! be my keepers. To you be adoration. Do not harm me.
verses.hindi: -हम हदयों को विशाल बनाँ। शरीर को निर्मल, नीरोग तथा मस्तिष्क को ज्ानदीप्त। इस प्रकार विष्णु बनकर, व्यापक उन्नति करके उस विष्णु के सच्चे उपासक त्वां जुषामहे देव वनस्पते देवयज्याय देवास्त्वां देवयज्यायै जुषन्तां विष्ण॑वे त्वा । १. गत मन्त्र मेँ तीन त्रतों का संकेत है। उन व्रतो का पालन ही "तीन पदों का
verses.transliteration: mitrasya mā cakṣuṣekṣadhvamagnayaḥ sagarāḥ sagarā stha sagareṇa nāmnā raudreṇānīkena pāta mā'gnayaḥ pipṛta mā'gnayo gopāyata mā namo vo'stu mā mā hisiṣṭa
verses.wordMeaning: Look ye upon me with the eye of Mitra. O Agnis, ye, receivers of oblations, are by a lauded name lauded together. Protect me, Agnis! with your glittering army. Fill me with riches, Agnis! be my keepers. To you be adoration. Do not harm me.
verses.commentary: Sense: Look ye upon me with the eye of Mitra. O Agnis, ye, receivers of oblations, are by a lauded name lauded together. Protect me, Agnis! with your glittering army. Fill me with riches, Agnis! be my keepers. To you be adoration. Do not harm me.

verses.sanskrit:
ज्योति॑रसि वि॒श्वरू॑पं॒ विश्वे॑षां दे॒वाना॑ᳪ स॒मित् । त्वᳪ सो॑म तनू॒कृद्भ्यो॒ द्वेषो॑भ्यो॒ऽन्यकृ॑तेभ्य उ॒रु य॒न्तासि॒ वरू॑थ॒ᳪ स्वाहा॑
जुषा॒णो अ॒प्तुराज्य॑स्य वेतु॒ स्वाहा॑
verses.translation: Thou art a light that wears all forms and figures, serving the general host of Gods as Kindler. Thou, Soma, wilt withhold thy wide protection from body-wounding hatreds shown by others. All-hail! Let the Swift graciously enjoy the butter. All-hail!
verses.hindi: प्रभु हमारे अन्दर ही है। उनकी उपासना से (क) दिव्य गुणों कौ प्राप्ति होती हे। (ख) व्यापक उन्नति हो पाती है। (ग) आसुर आक्रमणों से हमारी रक्षा होती है ओर (घ) हम प्रभु के आत्मीय बन जाते है। प्रणिनाय॑ महते सौभ॑गाय । अतस्त्वं देव वनस्पते शतवल्शो विरोह सहस््र॑वल्शा वि
verses.transliteration: jyotirasi viśvarūpaṃ viśveṣāṃ devānā samit | tva soma tanūkṛdbhyo dveṣobhyo'nyakṛtebhya uru yantāsi varūtha svāhā juṣāṇo apturājyasya vetu svāhā
verses.wordMeaning: Thou art a light that wears all forms and figures, serving the general host of Gods as Kindler. Thou, Soma, wilt withhold thy wide protection from body-wounding hatreds shown by others. All-hail! Let the Swift graciously enjoy the butter. All-hail!
verses.commentary: Sense: Thou art a light that wears all forms and figures, serving the general host of Gods as Kindler. Thou, Soma, wilt withhold thy wide protection from body-wounding hatreds shown by others. All-hail! Let the Swift graciously enjoy the butter. All-hail!

verses.sanskrit:
अग्ने॒ नय॑ सु॒पथा॑ रा॒ये  अ॒स्मान्विश्वा॑नि देव व॒युना॑नि वि॒द्वान् ।
यु॒यो॒ध्यस्मज्जु॑हुरा॒णमेनो॒ भूयि॑ष्ठां ते॒ नम॑ उक्तिं विधेम
verses.translation: By goodly paths lead us to riches, Agni, thou God who knowest every sacred duty. Remove the sin that makes us stray and wander: most ample adoration will we bring thee.
verses.hindi: हम अपने मे प्रभु का प्रादुर्भाव करें ओर प्रभुकृपा से हमारी शक्तियों का
verses.transliteration: agne naya supathā rāye asmānviśvāni deva vayunāni vidvān | yuyodhyasmajjuhurāṇameno bhūyiṣṭhāṃ te nama uktiṃ vidhema
verses.wordMeaning: By goodly paths lead us to riches, Agni, thou God who knowest every sacred duty. Remove the sin that makes us stray and wander: most ample adoration will we bring thee.
verses.commentary: Sense: By goodly paths lead us to riches, Agni, thou God who knowest every sacred duty. Remove the sin that makes us stray and wander: most ample adoration will we bring thee.

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒यं नो॑ अ॒ग्निर्वरि॑वस्कृणोत्व॒यं मृध॑: पु॒र ए॑तु प्रभि॒न्दन् ।
अ॒यं वाजा॑ञ्जयतु॒ वाज॑साताव॒यᳪ  शत्रू॑ञ्जयतु॒ जर्हृ॑षाण॒: स्वाहा॑
verses.translation: Wide room and comfort may this Agni give us, and go before us cleaving down our foemen. May he win booty in the fight for booty: May he quell foes in his triumphant onset.
verses.hindi: प्रभुकृपा से हम उत्साहमय, शक्तिशाली, प्रभुप्रवण, कर्मनिष्ठ व श्रीसम्पन्न हों। प्रभु को गोतम को प्रेरणा १. प्रभु आत्मार्पण करनेवाले गोतम को प्रेरणा देते हए कहते है कि अग्नेः जनित्रम् असित् अपने में अग्नि का उत्पन्न करनेवाला है- अर्थात् तेरा जीवन उत्साहमय ओर
verses.transliteration: ayaṃ no agnirvarivaskṛṇotvayaṃ mṛdha: pura etu prabhindan | ayaṃ vājāñjayatu vājasātāvaya śatrūñjayatu jarhṛṣāṇa: svāhā
verses.wordMeaning: Wide room and comfort may this Agni give us, and go before us cleaving down our foemen. May he win booty in the fight for booty: May he quell foes in his triumphant onset.
verses.commentary: Sense: Wide room and comfort may this Agni give us, and go before us cleaving down our foemen. May he win booty in the fight for booty: May he quell foes in his triumphant onset.

verses.sanskrit:
उ॒रु वि॑ष्णो॒ वि क्र॑मस्वो॒रु क्षया॑य नस्कृधि ।
घृ॒तं घृ॑तयोने पिब॒ प्रप्र॑ य॒ज्ञप॑तिं तिर॒ स्वाहा॑
verses.translation: O Vishnu, stride thou widely forth, give ample room for our abode. Drink butter, homed in butter! Still speed on the sacrifice's lord. All-hail!
verses.hindi: प्रभुप्रवण लोग ' समान मनवाले, संज्ञानवाले, निर्दोष, यज्ञशील, यज्ञो का गर्व न करनेवाले. धनसम्पादक व कल्याणकर' होते हेँ। स न॑: स्योनः सुयजा यजेह देवेभ्यो हृव्यःसदमग्र॑युच्छन्त्स्वाह।।। ४। पिचले मन्त्र में ' नः: भवतम्" शब्दों मे "प्रभु का बनने" का उल्लेख था। यह प्रभु
verses.transliteration: uru viṣṇo vi kramasvoru kṣayāya naskṛdhi | ghṛtaṃ ghṛtayone piba prapra yajñapatiṃ tira svāhā
verses.wordMeaning: O Vishnu, stride thou widely forth, give ample room for our abode. Drink butter, homed in butter! Still speed on the sacrifice's lord. All-hail!
verses.commentary: Sense: O Vishnu, stride thou widely forth, give ample room for our abode. Drink butter, homed in butter! Still speed on the sacrifice's lord. All-hail!

verses.sanskrit:
देव॑ सवितरे॒ष ते॒ सोम॒स्तᳪ  र॑क्षस्व॒ मा त्वा॑ दभन् ।
ए॒तत्त्वं दे॑व सोम दे॒वो दे॒वाँ२  उपा॑गा इ॒दम॒हं म॑नु॒ष्या॒न्त्स॒ह रा॒यस्पोषे॑ण स्वाहा॒ निर्वरु॑णस्य॒ पाशा॑न्मुच्ये
verses.translation: To thee, God Savitar, belongs this Soma. Guard him securely: let not demons harm thee. Now hast thou joined the Gods as God, God Soma: men have I joined here through abundant riches. All-hail! from Varuna's noose am I delivered.
verses.hindi: - प्रभुभक्त अग्निरूप प्रभु में प्रवेश करके अग्नि-सा ही बन जाता है“ शुद्ध '। अब इसकी सब क्रियाँ पवित्र यज्ञात्मक होती हैँ।  अनाधृष्टमस्यनाधृष्यं देवानामोजो ऽ न॑भिशस्त्यभिशस्तिपाऽअंनभिशस्तेन्यमञ्ज॑सा सत्यमुंपगेषश्श्स्विते मां धाः॥५॥
verses.transliteration: deva savitareṣa te somasta rakṣasva mā tvā dabhan | etattvaṃ deva soma devo devā~2 upāgā idamahaṃ manuṣyāntsaha rāyaspoṣeṇa svāhā nirvaruṇasya pāśānmucye
verses.wordMeaning: To thee, God Savitar, belongs this Soma. Guard him securely: let not demons harm thee. Now hast thou joined the Gods as God, God Soma: men have I joined here through abundant riches. All-hail! from Varuna's noose am I delivered.
verses.commentary: Sense: To thee, God Savitar, belongs this Soma. Guard him securely: let not demons harm thee. Now hast thou joined the Gods as God, God Soma: men have I joined here through abundant riches. All-hail! from Varuna's noose am I delivered.

verses.sanskrit:
अग्ने॑ व्रतपा॒स्त्वे व्र॑त॒पा या तव॑ त॒नूर्मय्यभू॑दे॒षा सा त्वयि॒ यो मम॑ त॒नूस्त्वय्यभू॑दि॒यᳪ  सा मयि॑ ।
य॒था॒य॒थं नौ॑ व्रतपते व्र॒तान्यनु॑ मे दी॒क्षां दी॒क्षाप॑ति॒रम॒ᳪस्तानु॒ तप॒स्तप॑स्पतिः
verses.translation: O Agni, Guardian of the Vow, O Guardian of the Vow, on me whatever form of thine path been, may that same form be upon thee. Whatever form of mine hath been on thee, may that he here on me. O Lord of Vows, our vows have been accomplished. Dîkshâ's Lord hath approved my Consecration, and holy Fervour's Lord allowed my Fervour.
verses.hindi: - हमे क्रमशः ' स्वराट्, सत्ररार् व जनराट्' बनकर सर्वराट् बनना हे। करक्षोहणो वो वलगहनः प्रोक्षामि वैष्णवार््रक्षोहणो वो वलगहनो ऽ व॑नयामि १. २ डवे मन्त्र में राक्षसी वृत्तियों व काम के विध्वंस का उल्लेख था। उन्हीं के विषय में प्रभु कहते हैँ कि वः=तुममें से रश्चोदणः =इन राक्षसी वृत्तियों का विध्वंस करनेवालों प्रभु हमें ज्ञान से अभिषिक्त करते है, वासनाओं के बन्धनो से दूर ले-जाते है, संसार के कष्टों से सुदूर सुरक्षित करते है, अपने समीप स्थापित करते है ओर सव सन्देहो से परे परहंचाते हेै। त्वा पृथिव्यै त्वा शुन्ध॑न्तोँल्लोकाः पितृषदनाः पितृषद॑नमसि।। २६॥
verses.transliteration: agne vratapāstve vratapā yā tava tanūrmayyabhūdeṣā sā tvayi yo mama tanūstvayyabhūdiya sā mayi | yathāyathaṃ nau vratapate vratānyanu me dīkṣāṃ dīkṣāpatiramastānu tapastapaspatiḥ
verses.wordMeaning: O Agni, Guardian of the Vow, O Guardian of the Vow, on me whatever form of thine path been, may that same form be upon thee. Whatever form of mine hath been on thee, may that he here on me. O Lord of Vows, our vows have been accomplished.…
verses.commentary: Sense: O Agni, Guardian of the Vow, O Guardian of the Vow, on me whatever form of thine path been, may that same form be upon thee. Whatever form of mine hath been on thee, may that he here on me. O Lord of Vows, our vows have been accomplished.…

verses.sanskrit: उ॒रु वि॑ष्णो॒ वि क्र॑मस्वो॒रु क्षया॑य नस्कृधि । घृ॒तं घृ॑तयोने पिब॒ प्रप्र॑ य॒ज्ञप॑तिं तिर॒ स्वाहा॑
verses.translation: O Vishnu, stride thou widely forth, make ample room for our abode. Drink butter, homed in butter! Still speed on the sacrifice's lord. All Hail!
verses.hindi: प्रभु सब वैभवोंवाले, सर्वसंसारवाहक , शीघ्र गतिवाले व सदा वृद्ध हे। ९. है प्रभो! आप उशिक् असि=(वष्टि) सब जीवों का भला चाहनेवाले हे, कविः=(कौति सर्वा विद्याः) सृष्टि के आरम्भ में ही सम्पूर्ण ज्ञानं के देनेवाले है । इस सान के द्वारा ही आप कल्याण करते है। देवों के रक्षण का प्रकार यह है कि जिसका हित
verses.transliteration: uru viṣṇo vi kramasvoru kṣayāya naskṛdhi | ghṛtaṃ ghṛtayone piba prapra yajñapatiṃ tira svāhā
verses.wordMeaning: O Vishnu, stride thou widely forth, make ample room for our abode. Drink butter, homed in butter! Still speed on the sacrifice's lord. All Hail!
verses.commentary: Sense: O Vishnu, stride thou widely forth, make ample room for our abode. Drink butter, homed in butter! Still speed on the sacrifice's lord. All Hail!

verses.sanskrit:
अत्य॒न्याँ२  अगां॒ नान्याँ२  उपा॑गाम॒र्वाक् त्वा॒ परे॒भ्योऽवि॑दं प॒रोऽव॑रेभ्यः ।
तं त्वा॑ जुषामहे देव वनस्पते देवय॒ज्यायै॑ दे॒वास्त्वा॑ देवय॒ज्यायै॑ जुषन्तां॒ विष्ण॑वे त्वा ।
ओष॑धे॒ त्राय॑स्व स्वधि॑ते॒ मैन॑ᳪ  हिᳪसीः
verses.translation: I have passed others, not approached to others. On the near side of those that were more distant, and farther than the nearer have I found thee. So, for the worship of the Gods, with gladness we welcome thee God, Sovran of the Forest! Let the Gods welcome thee for the Gods’ service. For Vishnu thee. Plant, guard!! Axe, do not harm it!
verses.hindi: हे प्रभो! हम आपका सतत स्मरण करे ओर कभी कुटिलता व पापसे अयं नोऽअग्निर्वरिंवस्कृणोत्वयं मृध॑ः पुरऽ एतु प्रभिन्दन् पिछले मन्त्र मेँ धन के लिए उत्तम मार्ग से ले-चलने की प्रार्थना थी। उसी प्रसङ्ख को कुछ विस्तार से कहते हैँ कि १. अयं अग्निः=सब उन्नतियों का साधक यह प्रभु प्रभुकृपा से ही हम सब प्रकार कौ विजय प्राप्त करते हे। घृतं घुतयोने पिर प्रप्र॑ यज्ञपतिं तिर् स्वाह।॥। ३८॥ १. अगस्त्य की इस प्रार्थना को सुनकर कि "यह अग्नि हमारे लिए धनों व शत्रुओं को जीते' प्रभु कहते है कि है विष्णोव्यापक उन्नति करनेवाले जीव! तू उरु्खूब ही
verses.transliteration: atyanyā~2 agāṃ nānyā~2 upāgāmarvāk tvā parebhyo'vidaṃ paro'varebhyaḥ | taṃ tvā juṣāmahe deva vanaspate devayajyāyai devāstvā devayajyāyai juṣantāṃ viṣṇave tvā | oṣadhe trāyasva svadhite maina hisīḥ
verses.wordMeaning: I have passed others, not approached to others. On the near side of those that were more distant, and farther than the nearer have I found thee. So, for the worship of the Gods, with gladness we welcome thee God,…
verses.commentary: Sense: I have passed others, not approached to others. On the near side of those that were more distant, and farther than the nearer have I found thee. So, for the worship of the Gods, with gladness we welcome thee God,…

verses.sanskrit:
द्यां मा ले॑खीर॒न्तरि॑क्षं॒ मा हि॑ᳪसीः पृथि॒व्या सम्भ॑व ।
अ॒यᳪ  हि त्वा॒ स्वधि॑ति॒स्तेति॑जानः प्रणि॒नाय॑ मह॒ते सौ॑भगाय ।
अत॒स्त्वं दे॑व वनस्पते श॒तव॑ल्शो॒ वि रो॑ह स॒हस्र॑वल्शा॒ वि व॒यᳪ  रु॑हेम
verses.translation: Graze not the sky. Harm not mid-air. Be in accordance with the earth. For this well-sharpened axe hath led thee forth to great felicity. Hence, with a hundred branches, God, Lord of the Forest, grow thou up. May we grow spreading with a hundred branches.
verses.hindi: प्रभु ' व्रतपा" है। उनका उपासक मै भी व्रतपा बनं। पञ्चमोऽध्यायः; १५२ यजुर्वेदभाव्यम् श्रिविक्रम बनना'=तीन मुख्य व्रतो का धारण करना घृतं घुतयोने पिब्र प्रप्र॑ यज्ञप॑तिं तिर स्वाह।।४९॥
verses.transliteration: dyāṃ mā lekhīrantarikṣaṃ mā hisīḥ pṛthivyā sambhava | aya hi tvā svadhitistetijānaḥ praṇināya mahate saubhagāya | atastvaṃ deva vanaspate śatavalśo vi roha sahasravalśā vi vaya ruhema
verses.wordMeaning: Graze not the sky. Harm not mid-air. Be in accordance with the earth. For this well-sharpened axe hath led thee forth to great felicity. Hence, with a hundred branches, God, Lord of the Forest, grow thou up. May we grow spreading with a hundred branches.
verses.commentary: Sense: Graze not the sky. Harm not mid-air. Be in accordance with the earth. For this well-sharpened axe hath led thee forth to great felicity. Hence, with a hundred branches, God, Lord of the Forest, grow thou up. May we grow spreading with a hundred branches.

verses.sanskrit:
दे॒वस्य॑ त्वा सवि॒तुः प्र॑स॒वेऽश्विनो॑र्बा॒हुभ्यां॑ पू॒ष्णो हस्ता॑भ्याम् । आ द॑दे॒ नार्य॑सी॒दम॒हᳪ  रक्ष॑सां ग्री॒वा अपि॑ कृन्तामि ।
यवो॑ऽसि य॒वया॒स्मद्  द्वेषो॑ य॒वयारा॑तीर्दि॒वे त्वा॒ऽन्तरि॑क्षाय त्वा पृथि॒व्यै त्वा॒ शुन्ध॑न्ताँल्लो॒काः पि॑तृ॒षद॑नाः ।
पि॑तृ॒षद॑नमसि
verses.translation: com The Texts of the White Yajurveda, tr. Ralph T.H. Griffith, [1899], BY impulse of God Savitar I take thee with arms of Asvins, with the hands of Pûshan. Thou art a woman. Here I cut the necks of Râkshasas away. Barley art thou. Bar off from us our haters, bar our enemies. Thee for heaven, thee for earth, thee for the welkin. Pure be the worlds, the Fathers’ dwelling-places. Thou art the habitation of the Fathers.
verses.hindi: हम प्रत्येक पदार्थं का प्रयोग ठीक करें जिससे नीरोग व निर्मल बनें। द्वेष व अदान से ऊपर उदे। त्रिविध उन्नति करके, ज्ञानियों के सम्पर्क में ज्ञानी बनकर प्रभु का यचुर्वेदभावष्यम् १५५ षष्ठोध्यायः १. गत मन्त्र की समाप्ति ' प्रभु का निवासस्थान बनने" से हुई है। यह अपने को प्रभु
verses.transliteration: devasya tvā savituḥ prasave'śvinorbāhubhyāṃ pūṣṇo hastābhyām | ā dade nāryasīdamaha rakṣasāṃ grīvā api kṛntāmi | yavo'si yavayāsmad dveṣo yavayārātīrdive tvā'ntarikṣāya tvā pṛthivyai tvā śundhantā~llokāḥ pitṛṣadanāḥ | pitṛṣadanamasi
verses.wordMeaning: com The Texts of the White Yajurveda, tr. Ralph T.H. Griffith, [1899], BY impulse of God Savitar I take thee with arms of Asvins, with the hands of Pûshan. Thou art a woman. Here I cut the necks of Râkshasas away. Barley art thou. Bar off from us our haters, bar our enemies.…
verses.commentary: Sense: com The Texts of the White Yajurveda, tr. Ralph T.H. Griffith, [1899], BY impulse of God Savitar I take thee with arms of Asvins, with the hands of Pûshan. Thou art a woman. Here I cut the necks of Râkshasas away. Barley art thou. Bar off from us our haters, bar our enemies.…

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒ग्रे॒णीर॑सि स्वावे॒श उ॑न्नेतॄ॒णामे॒तस्य॑ वित्ता॒दधि॑ त्वा स्थास्यति दे॒वस्त्वा॑ सवि॒ता मध्वा॑नक्तु सु॑पिप्प॒लाभ्य॒स्त्वौष॑धीभ्यः ।
द्यामग्रे॑णास्पृक्ष॒ आन्तरि॑क्षं॒ मध्ये॑नाप्राः पृथि॒वीमुप॑रेणादृᳪहीः
verses.translation: Thou art a leader, easy, to Unnetars, of access. Know this. It will stand upon thee. Savitar, God, anoint thee with sweet butter. Thee for the plants laden with goodly fruitage! Thou with thy top hast touched the sky, hast with thy middle filled the air, and steadied with thy base the earth.
verses.hindi: हम आगे बद, प्रभु के अधिष्ठातृत्व में जीवन को मधुर बना्ं। ज्ञान के द्वारा अज्ञान का खण्डन करे, मध्यमार्ग पर चलने से वासनाओं का विनाश कर दे, ओर उत्कृष्ट नियम से रोगों को भगा दे। प्रभु के परमपद का दीपन
verses.transliteration: agreṇīrasi svāveśa unnetṝṇāmetasya vittādadhi tvā sthāsyati devastvā savitā madhvānaktu supippalābhyastvauṣadhībhyaḥ | dyāmagreṇāspṛkṣa āntarikṣaṃ madhyenāprāḥ pṛthivīmupareṇādṛhīḥ
verses.wordMeaning: Thou art a leader, easy, to Unnetars, of access. Know this. It will stand upon thee. Savitar, God, anoint thee with sweet butter. Thee for the plants laden with goodly fruitage! Thou with thy top hast touched the sky, hast with thy middle filled the air,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Thou art a leader, easy, to Unnetars, of access. Know this. It will stand upon thee. Savitar, God, anoint thee with sweet butter. Thee for the plants laden with goodly fruitage! Thou with thy top hast touched the sky, hast with thy middle filled the air,…

verses.sanskrit:
या ते॒ धामा॑न्यु॒श्मसि॒ गम॑ध्यै॒ यत्र॒ गावो॒ भूरि॑शृङ्गा अ॒यास॑: । अत्राह॒ तदु॑रुगा॒यस्य॒ विष्णो॑: पर॒मं प॒दमव॑ भारि॒ भूरि॑ ।
ब्र॒ह्म॒वनि॑ त्वा क्षत्र॒वनि॑ रायस्पोष॒वनि॒ पर्यू॑हामि । ब्रह्म॑ दृᳪह क्ष॒त्रं दृ॒ᳪहायु॑र्दृᳪह प्र॒जां दृ॑ᳪह
verses.translation: Thou art a leader, easy, to Unnetars, of access. Know this. It will stand upon thee. Savitar, God, anoint thee with sweet butter. Thee for the plants laden with goodly fruitage! Thou with thy top hast touched the sky, hast with thy middle filled the air, and steadied with thy base the earth.
verses.hindi: हमारे जीवन प्रभु के तेजो व स्लानों को अपनाकर प्रभु के परम पद् को दीप्त करनेवाले हों। हम ज्ञान ओर बल के साथ धन भी प्राप्त करे। अपने ज्ञान, बल, जीवन व सन्तानो को दृद बनार्पैँ। १. आपने जीवन के मार्ग को निश्चित करने के लिए गत मन्त्र के  आयुर्दूह ' आदेश
verses.transliteration: yā te dhāmānyuśmasi gamadhyai yatra gāvo bhūriśṛṅgā ayāsa: | atrāha tadurugāyasya viṣṇo: paramaṃ padamava bhāri bhūri | brahmavani tvā kṣatravani rāyaspoṣavani paryūhāmi | brahma dṛha kṣatraṃ dṛhāyurdṛha prajāṃ dṛha
verses.wordMeaning: Thou art a leader, easy, to Unnetars, of access. Know this. It will stand upon thee. Savitar, God, anoint thee with sweet butter. Thee for the plants laden with goodly fruitage! Thou with thy top hast touched the sky, hast with thy middle filled the air,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Thou art a leader, easy, to Unnetars, of access. Know this. It will stand upon thee. Savitar, God, anoint thee with sweet butter. Thee for the plants laden with goodly fruitage! Thou with thy top hast touched the sky, hast with thy middle filled the air,…

verses.sanskrit: विष्णो॒: कर्मा॑णि पश्यत॒ यतो॑ व्र॒तानि॑ पस्प॒शे । इन्द्र॑स्य॒ युज्य॒: सखा॑
verses.translation: Look ye on Vishnu's works, whereby the Friend of Indra, close-allied, Hath let his holy ways be seen.
verses.hindi: हम प्रभु के कर्मो को देखें। उन्हीं व्रतो से अपने को बोधे ओर त्रतों से अपने को जोडुनेवाले हम प्रभु के मित्र बनें। ९. गत मन्त्र के अनुसार जो अपने को प्रभु के समान न्याय्य कर्मो से जोड़ने का प्रयल करता है, वही वस्तुतः प्रभु का सच्चा स्तोता हे। इसी प्रकार प्रभुभक्त वही है जो प्रभु
verses.transliteration: viṣṇo: karmāṇi paśyata yato vratāni paspaśe | indrasya yujya: sakhā
verses.wordMeaning: Look ye on Vishnu's works, whereby the Friend of Indra, close-allied, Hath let his holy ways be seen.
verses.commentary: Sense: Look ye on Vishnu's works, whereby the Friend of Indra, close-allied, Hath let his holy ways be seen.

verses.sanskrit: तद्विष्णो॑: पर॒मं प॒दᳪ सदा॑ पश्यन्ति सू॒रयो॑ ।दि॒वी॒व॒ चक्षु॒रात॑तम्
verses.translation: The princes evermore behold that loftiest place where Vishnu is, Laid as it were an eye in heaven.
verses.hindi: हम ज्ञानी बनें, उत्तम लोगों के केन्द्र बन पाँ, हमारा निवासस्थान यज्ञवेदि बन जाए। हम ज्ञान का प्रसार करनेवाले हो। सब लोको व हिंसखर-पशुओं को भी अपना प्रेम दे सक। उपावीरस्युप॑ दे वान्हैवीर्विशः प्रागरुशिजो वद्धितमान्। देव॑ त्वष्टर्वसुं रम हव्या ते स्वदन्ताम्।।७॥
verses.transliteration: tadviṣṇo: paramaṃ pada sadā paśyanti sūrayo |divīva cakṣurātatam
verses.wordMeaning: The princes evermore behold that loftiest place where Vishnu is, Laid as it were an eye in heaven.
verses.commentary: Sense: The princes evermore behold that loftiest place where Vishnu is, Laid as it were an eye in heaven.

verses.sanskrit:
प॒रि॒वीर॑सि॒ परि॑ त्वा॒ दैवी॒र्विशो॑ व्ययन्तां॒ परी॒मं यज॑मान॒j  रायो॑ मनु॒ष्या॒णाम् ।
दि॒वः सू॒नुर॑स्ये॒ष ते॑ पृथि॒व्याँल्लो॒क आ॑र॒ण्यस्ते॑ प॒शुः
verses.translation: Thou art invested. Heavenly hosts invest thee! Riches of men invest this Sacrificer! Heaven's son art thou. This is thine earthly station. Thine is the beast whose home is in the forest.
verses.hindi: जो व्यक्ति ओरों का भला करना चाहता है उसे स्वयं देव, उशिक् (मेधावी) व वहि (अपने को ऊँचे स्थान पर ले-जानेवाला) ' बनना चादिए। वह निवास के लिए आवश्यक धन से अधिक धन न चाहे ओर सात्विक भोजनों को ही करे। करेव॑ती रम॑ध्वं बृह॑स्पते धारया वसुंनि।
verses.transliteration: parivīrasi pari tvā daivīrviśo vyayantāṃ parīmaṃ yajamānaj rāyo manuṣyāṇām | divaḥ sūnurasyeṣa te pṛthivyā~lloka āraṇyaste paśuḥ
verses.wordMeaning: Thou art invested. Heavenly hosts invest thee! Riches of men invest this Sacrificer! Heaven's son art thou. This is thine earthly station. Thine is the beast whose home is in the forest.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thou art invested. Heavenly hosts invest thee! Riches of men invest this Sacrificer! Heaven's son art thou. This is thine earthly station. Thine is the beast whose home is in the forest.

verses.sanskrit: उ॒पा॒वीर॒स्युप॑ दे॒वान्दैवी॒र्विश॒: प्रागु॑रु॒शिजो॒ वह्नि॑तमान् । देव॑ त्वष्ट॒र्वसु॑ रम ह॒व्या ते॑ स्वदन्ताम्
verses.translation: Encourager art thou. The hosts of heaven have come to yearning Gods, the best conductors. God Tvashtar, make the wealth of cattle quiet. Delightful to the taste be thine oblations.
verses.hindi: हम अपने जीवन को ऋत के पाश से प्रतिबद्ध करे। हम वासनाओं का धर्षण करनेवाले हों ओर हमारा प्रत्येक कर्म मानवहित-साधक हो। कटदेवस्य॑ त्वा सवितुः प्र॑सव ऽ श्विनो्बाहभ्यौ पृष्णो हस्ता॑भ्याम्।  अग्नीषोमाभ्यां जुष्टं १. गत मन्त्र में ऋत करे पाश से अपने को बंधने का उल्लेख हे। प्रस्तुत मन्त्र में
verses.transliteration: upāvīrasyupa devāndaivīrviśa: prāguruśijo vahnitamān | deva tvaṣṭarvasu rama havyā te svadantām
verses.wordMeaning: Encourager art thou. The hosts of heaven have come to yearning Gods, the best conductors. God Tvashtar, make the wealth of cattle quiet. Delightful to the taste be thine oblations.
verses.commentary: Sense: Encourager art thou. The hosts of heaven have come to yearning Gods, the best conductors. God Tvashtar, make the wealth of cattle quiet. Delightful to the taste be thine oblations.

verses.sanskrit: रेव॑ती॒ रम॑ध्वं॒ बृह॑स्पते धा॒रया॒ वसू॑नि । ऋ॒तस्य॑ त्वा देवहविः॒ पाशे॑न॒ प्रति॑ मुञ्चामि॒ धर्षा॒ मानु॑षः
verses.translation: Joy, wealthy ones! Brihaspati, save our riches. I bind thee with the noose of holy Order, thou offering to the Gods. Bold be the Slayer.
verses.hindi: हम अपने को ऋत के पाश से बांधकर तेजस्वी व शान्त बनें। जल व वनस्पति ही हमारे सेव्य पदार्थ हों। हम प्रभु के सन्देशवाहक बवनें। क ञपां पेरूरस्यापो देवीः स्व॑दन्तु स्वात्तं चित्सदंवहविः। रसं ते प्राणो वातेन गच्छताश् समङ्खानि यज॑त्रैः सं यज्ञप॑तिराशिषां॥९०॥
verses.transliteration: revatī ramadhvaṃ bṛhaspate dhārayā vasūni | ṛtasya tvā devahaviḥ pāśena prati muñcāmi dharṣā mānuṣaḥ
verses.wordMeaning: Joy, wealthy ones! Brihaspati, save our riches. I bind thee with the noose of holy Order, thou offering to the Gods. Bold be the Slayer.
verses.commentary: Sense: Joy, wealthy ones! Brihaspati, save our riches. I bind thee with the noose of holy Order, thou offering to the Gods. Bold be the Slayer.

verses.sanskrit: दे॒वस्य॑ त्वा सवि॒तुः प्र॑स॒वेऽश्विनो॑र्बा॒हुभ्यां॑ पू॒ष्णो हस्ता॑भ्याम् । अ॒ग्नीषोमा॑भ्यां॒ जुष्टं॒ नि यु॑नज्मि । अ॒द्भ्यस्त्वौ॑षधी॒भ्योऽनु॑ त्वा मा॒ता म॑न्यता॒मनु॑ पि॒ताऽनु॒ भ्राता॒ सग॒र्भ्योऽनु॒ सखा॒ सयू॑थ्यः । अ॒ग्नीषोमा॑भ्यां त्वा॒ जुष्टं॒ प्रोक्षा॑मि
verses.translation: By impulse of God Savitar I bind thee, with arms of Asvins and with hands of Pûshan, thee welcome unto Agni and to Soma. Thee for the waters, thee for plants. Thy mother grant thee permission, and thy father, brother born of one dam, thy friend, thy herd-companion. I sprinkle thee welcome to Agni-Soma.
verses.hindi: हम वीर्यरक्षा के लिए खान-पान को सात्त्विक बनार्णे। हमारी प्राणशक्ति पति-पत्नी का यज्ञमय जीवन स्डरोरन्तरिश्षात्सजूर्देवेन वातेनास्य हविषस्त्मनां यज् सम॑स्य तन्त्रा भव। गवर्षो वर्षीयसि यज्ञे य॒ज्ञप॑तिं धाः स्वाहां देवेभ्यो! दे वेभ्यः स्वाह।।। ९९॥
verses.transliteration: devasya tvā savituḥ prasave'śvinorbāhubhyāṃ pūṣṇo hastābhyām | agnīṣomābhyāṃ juṣṭaṃ ni yunajmi | adbhyastvauṣadhībhyo'nu tvā mātā manyatāmanu pitā'nu bhrātā sagarbhyo'nu sakhā sayūthyaḥ | agnīṣomābhyāṃ tvā juṣṭaṃ prokṣāmi
verses.wordMeaning: By impulse of God Savitar I bind thee, with arms of Asvins and with hands of Pûshan, thee welcome unto Agni and to Soma. Thee for the waters, thee for plants. Thy mother grant thee permission, and thy father, brother born of one dam, thy friend, thy herd-companion.…
verses.commentary: Sense: By impulse of God Savitar I bind thee, with arms of Asvins and with hands of Pûshan, thee welcome unto Agni and to Soma. Thee for the waters, thee for plants. Thy mother grant thee permission, and thy father, brother born of one dam, thy friend, thy herd-companion.…

verses.sanskrit: अ॒पां पे॒रुर॒स्यापो॑ दे॒वीः स्व॑दन्तु स्वा॒त्तं चि॒त्सद्दे॑वह॒विः । सं ते॑ प्रा॒णो वाते॑न गच्छता॒jसमङ्गा॑नि॒ यज॑त्रै॒: सं य॒ज्ञप॑तिरा॒शिषा॑
verses.translation: Drinker art thou of water. May the Waters, the Goddesses, add sweetness to the oblation prepared for Gods, even though already sweetened. Thy breath join wind, thy limbs those meet for worship, the sacrifice's lord the boon he prays for.
verses.hindi: धृतस्य करुल्याऽ उप॑ऽ ऋतस्य पथ्याऽअनु।। ९२॥ पिछले मन्त्र की समाप्ति दिव्य गुणों को प्राप्त करने की प्रार्थना पर थी। उन्हीं दिव्य गुणों का संकेत प्रस्तुत मन्त्र में दिया गया हे। विद्धान् आचार्य मेधातिथि (समञ्जदार) को आदेश देते है कि १. अहिः मा भूः =तू सोप मत बन। तुञ्चमें सर्पवत् कुटिलता न हो। तू
verses.transliteration: apāṃ perurasyāpo devīḥ svadantu svāttaṃ citsaddevahaviḥ | saṃ te prāṇo vātena gacchatājsamaṅgāni yajatrai: saṃ yajñapatirāśiṣā
verses.wordMeaning: Drinker art thou of water. May the Waters, the Goddesses, add sweetness to the oblation prepared for Gods, even though already sweetened. Thy breath join wind, thy limbs those meet for worship, the sacrifice's lord the boon he prays for.
verses.commentary: Sense: Drinker art thou of water. May the Waters, the Goddesses, add sweetness to the oblation prepared for Gods, even though already sweetened. Thy breath join wind, thy limbs those meet for worship, the sacrifice's lord the boon he prays for.

verses.sanskrit:
घृ॒तेना॒क्तौ प॒शूँस्त्रा॑येथा॒j रेव॑ति॒ यज॑माने प्रि॒यं धा आ वि॑श । उ॒रोर॒न्तरि॑क्षात्स॒जूर्दे॒वेन॒ वाते॑ना॒स्य ह॒विष॒स्त्मना॑ यज॒ सम॑स्य त॒न्वा॒ भव ।
वर्षो॒ वर्षी॑यसि य॒ज्ञे य॒ज्ञप॑तिं  धा॒: स्वाहा॑ दे॒वेभ्यो॑  दे॒वेभ्य॒: स्वाहा॑
verses.translation: Balmed, both of you, with butter, guard the cattle. Grant, Rich! the Sacrificer's prayer. Approach thou. Meeting with heavenly Wind, from air's mid-region. Be thou united with this offering's body. O Great One, lead the sacrifice's master on to a sacrifice of loftier order. All-hail to Gods! To Gods All-hail!
verses.hindi: वेद के दृष्टिकोण में दिव्य जीवन यह है ९. कुटिलता का सर्वथा त्याग २. चुभनेवाली बातें न करना, कटु न बोलना ३. ओरों की सम्पत्ति को न हड़पना ४. अपना जीवन आदरणीय बनाना ५. हिंसा न करना ६. निरन्तर आगे बद्ना ७. ज्ञान प्राप्त करना देवीरापः शुद्धा वोद द्रः सुप॑रिविष्टा देवेषु
verses.transliteration: ghṛtenāktau paśū~strāyethāj revati yajamāne priyaṃ dhā ā viśa | urorantarikṣātsajūrdevena vātenāsya haviṣastmanā yaja samasya tanvā bhava | varṣo varṣīyasi yajñe yajñapatiṃ dhā: svāhā devebhyo devebhya: svāhā
verses.wordMeaning: Balmed, both of you, with butter, guard the cattle. Grant, Rich! the Sacrificer's prayer. Approach thou. Meeting with heavenly Wind, from air's mid-region. Be thou united with this offering's body. O Great One, lead the sacrifice's master on to a sacrifice of loftier order.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Balmed, both of you, with butter, guard the cattle. Grant, Rich! the Sacrificer's prayer. Approach thou. Meeting with heavenly Wind, from air's mid-region. Be thou united with this offering's body. O Great One, lead the sacrifice's master on to a sacrifice of loftier order.…

verses.sanskrit: माहि॑र्भू॒र्मा पृदा॑कु॒र्नम॑स्त आतानान॒र्वा प्रेहि॑ । घृ॒तस्य॑ कु॒ल्या उप॑ ऋ॒तस्य॒ पथ्या॒ अनु॑
verses.translation: Become no serpent, thou, become no viper. To thee, O widely-spread, be adoration. Advance, unhindered, on thy way. To rivers of butter move along the paths of Order.
