verses.hindi: इनके समीप रहकर विद्यार्थी ज्ञान का भोजन प्राप्त करे ओर स्वयं ज्ञान प्राप्त करक उस ज्ञान का सर्वत्र प्रसार करनेवाले हों। आचार्य विद्यार्थी के जीवन का किस प्रकार शोधन करता है? इस विषय को प्रस्तुत मन्त्र म कहते है कि--१. ते वाचं शुन्धामि आचार्य विद्यार्थी से कहता टे कि)
verses.transliteration: māhirbhūrmā pṛdākurnamasta ātānānarvā prehi | ghṛtasya kulyā upa ṛtasya pathyā anu
verses.wordMeaning: Become no serpent, thou, become no viper. To thee, O widely-spread, be adoration. Advance, unhindered, on thy way. To rivers of butter move along the paths of Order.
verses.commentary: Sense: Become no serpent, thou, become no viper. To thee, O widely-spread, be adoration. Advance, unhindered, on thy way. To rivers of butter move along the paths of Order.

verses.sanskrit: देवी॑रापः शु॒द्धा वो॑ढ्व॒j सुप॑रिविष्टा दे॒वेषु॒ सुप॑रिविष्टा व॒यं प॑रिवे॒ष्टारो॑ भूयास्म
verses.translation: Bear the oblation to the Gods, ye Waters celestial and pure and well-provided. May we become providers well-provided.
verses.hindi: आचार्य-कृपा से विद्यार्थी के सब अङ्कं का आप्यायन हो। उसका स्वभाव उत्तम हो। वह वासनाओं का शिकार न हो जापए्। करक्ष॑सां भागोऽसि निस्स्तररक्ष॑ऽइदमहश्रक्षो ऽ भितिष्ठामीदमहः रक्षो ऽ व॑बाधऽ स्तोकानांमग्निराज्य॑स्य वेतु स्वाहा स्वाहा॑कृतेऽ ऊर्ध्वन॑भसं मारुतं ग॑च्छतम्।। ९६॥
verses.transliteration: devīrāpaḥ śuddhā voḍhvaj supariviṣṭā deveṣu supariviṣṭā vayaṃ pariveṣṭāro bhūyāsma
verses.wordMeaning: Bear the oblation to the Gods, ye Waters celestial and pure and well-provided. May we become providers well-provided.
verses.commentary: Sense: Bear the oblation to the Gods, ye Waters celestial and pure and well-provided. May we become providers well-provided.

verses.sanskrit: वाचं॑ ते शुन्धामि प्रा॒णं ते॑ शुन्धामि॒  चक्षु॑स्ते शुन्धामि॒  श्रोत्रं॑ ते शुन्धामि॒  नाभिं॑ ते शुन्धामि॒  मेढ्रं॑ ते शुन्धामि पा॒युं ते॑ शुन्धामि  च॒रित्राँ॑स्ते शुन्धामि
verses.translation: I cleanse thy voice, thy breath, thine eye, thine ear, thy navel, and thy feet, thy sexual organ, and thy rump.
verses.hindi: हम रोगकृमियों व राक्षसी वृत्तियों को अपने से दूर कर दे। पति- पनी दोनों ही स्वस्थ व ज्ञानी बनें। छोटी-छोटी कमियोँ का ध्यान करके उन्हे दूर करे। स्वार्थत्याग करनेवाले ये पति-पन्नी उस ज्ञान रशमिसमूह को प्राप्त करं जो उनकी वासनाओं के अन्धकार गत मन्त्र का ' मेधातिथि ' ज्ञान-रश्मिसमूह से वासनान्धकार का विदारण करके अव
verses.transliteration: vācaṃ te śundhāmi prāṇaṃ te śundhāmi cakṣuste śundhāmi śrotraṃ te śundhāmi nābhiṃ te śundhāmi meḍhraṃ te śundhāmi pāyuṃ te śundhāmi caritrā~ste śundhāmi
verses.wordMeaning: I cleanse thy voice, thy breath, thine eye, thine ear, thy navel, and thy feet, thy sexual organ, and thy rump.
verses.commentary: Sense: I cleanse thy voice, thy breath, thine eye, thine ear, thy navel, and thy feet, thy sexual organ, and thy rump.

verses.sanskrit:
मन॑स्त॒ आ प्या॑यतां॒  वाक्त॒ आ प्या॑यतां प्रा॒णस्त॒ आ प्या॑यतां॒ चक्षु॑स्त॒ आ प्या॑यतां॒j
श्रोत्रं॑ त॒ आ प्या॑यताम् । यत्ते॑ क्रू॒रं यदास्थि॑तं॒ तत्त॒ आ प्या॑यतां॒ निष्ट्यायतां॒ तत्ते॑ शुध्यतु शमहो॑भ्यः ।
ओष॑धे॒ त्राय॑स्व॒ स्वधि॑ते॒ मैन॑ᳪ  हिᳪसीः
verses.translation: Let thy mind, voice, and breath increase in fulness, thine eye be fuller, and thine ear grow stronger. Whatever there is in thee sore or wounded, may that be filled for thee, cleansed and united. Blest be the days. Plant, guard! Axe, do not harm him.
verses.hindi: सबसे बडे पाप यही हैँ कि (क) किसी से द्रोह करना (ख) अनृत बोलना (ग) निष्पाप को कोसना। ज्ञानी, पवित्रात्मा लोग हमें इन पापों से छटा! पिछले मन्त्र के अनुसार जब "दीर्घतमा" पापमुक्त होता है तब प्रभु उससे कहते हे कि ९. ते=तेरा मनः=मन मनसा=मननशक्ति से सङ्गच्छताम्-सङ्गत हो ओर प्राणः = जीवन
verses.transliteration: manasta ā pyāyatāṃ vākta ā pyāyatāṃ prāṇasta ā pyāyatāṃ cakṣusta ā pyāyatāṃj śrotraṃ ta ā pyāyatām | yatte krūraṃ yadāsthitaṃ tatta ā pyāyatāṃ niṣṭyāyatāṃ tatte śudhyatu śamahobhyaḥ | oṣadhe trāyasva svadhite maina hisīḥ
verses.wordMeaning: Let thy mind, voice, and breath increase in fulness, thine eye be fuller, and thine ear grow stronger. Whatever there is in thee sore or wounded, may that be filled for thee, cleansed and united. Blest be the days. Plant, guard! Axe, do not harm him.
verses.commentary: Sense: Let thy mind, voice, and breath increase in fulness, thine eye be fuller, and thine ear grow stronger. Whatever there is in thee sore or wounded, may that be filled for thee, cleansed and united. Blest be the days. Plant, guard! Axe, do not harm him.

verses.sanskrit:
रक्ष॑सां भा॒गो॒ऽसि॒  निर॑स्त॒j  रक्ष॑ इ॒दम॒हᳪ  रक्षो॒ऽभि ति॑ष्ठामी॒दम॒हᳪ  रक्षोऽव॑ बाध इ॒दम॒हᳪ  रक्षो॑ऽध॒मं तमो॑ नयामि ।
घृ॒तेन॑ द्यावापृथिवी॒ प्रोर्णु॑वाथां॒  वायो॒ वे स्तो॒काना॑मग्निराज्य॑स्य वेतु॒ स्वाहा॒ स्वाहा॑कृते ऊ॒र्ध्वन॑भसं मारु॒तं ग॑च्छतम्
verses.translation: Thou art the demons’ share. Expelled are demons. Here I tread down; here I repel the demons; here lead the demons into lowest darkness. Invest, ye two, the heaven and earth with fatness. O Vâyu, eagerly enjoy the droppings. Let Agni eagerly enjoy the butter. All-hail! Go, both of you, by Svâhâ consecrated, to ûrdhvanabhas, offspring of the Maruts.
verses.hindi: पिछले मन्त्र कौ भावना को ही शब्दान्तर से कहते है कि ९. घृतपावानः =घृत अर्थात् मल-क्षरण का पान करनेवालो! घृतं पिबत=मल-क्षरण का पान करो। शरीर से मल-क्षरण का पूरी तरह से ध्यान करो। शरीर में मलों का सञ्चय न होगा तभी तुम स्वास्थ्य की दीप्ति से चमकोगे। प्राणशक्ति की वृद्धि का एकमात्र मार्ग यही है। २.
verses.transliteration: rakṣasāṃ bhāgo'si nirastaj rakṣa idamaha rakṣo'bhi tiṣṭhāmīdamaha rakṣo'va bādha idamaha rakṣo'dhamaṃ tamo nayāmi | ghṛtena dyāvāpṛthivī prorṇuvāthāṃ vāyo ve stokānāmagnirājyasya vetu svāhā svāhākṛte ūrdhvanabhasaṃ mārutaṃ gacchatam
verses.wordMeaning: Thou art the demons’ share. Expelled are demons. Here I tread down; here I repel the demons; here lead the demons into lowest darkness. Invest, ye two, the heaven and earth with fatness. O Vâyu, eagerly enjoy the droppings. Let Agni eagerly enjoy the butter. All-hail! Go,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Thou art the demons’ share. Expelled are demons. Here I tread down; here I repel the demons; here lead the demons into lowest darkness. Invest, ye two, the heaven and earth with fatness. O Vâyu, eagerly enjoy the droppings. Let Agni eagerly enjoy the butter. All-hail! Go,…

verses.sanskrit:
इ॒दमा॑प॒: प्र व॑हताव॒द्यं च॒ मलं॑ च॒ यत् । यच्चा॑भिदु॒द्रोहानृ॑तं॒ यच्च॑ शे॒पे अ॑भी॒रुण॑म् ।
आपो॑ मा॒ तस्मा॒देन॑स॒: पव॑मानश्च मुञ्चतु
verses.translation: Ye Waters, wash away this stain and whatsoever taint be here, Each sinful act that I have done, and every harmless curse of mine. May Waters rid me of that guilt, and Pavamâna set me free.
verses.hindi: हम स्वास्थ्य व मस्तिष्क की रक्षा करे। हदय को त्याग की भावना से परिपूर्ण करे ओर छह दिशाओं से आक्रमणकारी छह शत्रु महारथियों (काम, क्रोध, लोभ, मोह, मद, मत्सर) पर विजय प्राप्त करे। पेन्द्र: प्राणोऽअद्धैऽअ ङ्गे निदींध्यहै द्रऽ उदानोऽअद्धैऽअङ्गे निधीतः।
verses.transliteration: idamāpa: pra vahatāvadyaṃ ca malaṃ ca yat | yaccābhidudrohānṛtaṃ yacca śepe abhīruṇam | āpo mā tasmādenasa: pavamānaśca muñcatu
verses.wordMeaning: Ye Waters, wash away this stain and whatsoever taint be here, Each sinful act that I have done, and every harmless curse of mine. May Waters rid me of that guilt, and Pavamâna set me free.
verses.commentary: Sense: Ye Waters, wash away this stain and whatsoever taint be here, Each sinful act that I have done, and every harmless curse of mine. May Waters rid me of that guilt, and Pavamâna set me free.

verses.sanskrit:
सं ते॒ मनो॒ मन॑सा॒ सं प्रा॒णः प्रा॒णेन॑ गच्छताम् । रेड॑स्य॒ग्निष्ट्वा॑ श्रीणा॒त्वाप॑स्त्वा॒
सम॑रिण॒न्वात॑स्य त्वा॒ ध्राज्यै॑ पू॒ष्णो रᳪह्या॑ ऊ॒ष्मणो॑ व्यथिष॒त् प्रयु॑तं॒ द्वेष॑:
verses.translation: Be they united, with the Mind thy mind, and with the Breath thy breath. Thou quiverest. Let Agni make thee ready. Waters have washed together all thy juices. Thee for the Wind's rush, for the speed of Pûshan. From heated vapour may it reel and totter,—the disconcerted hatred of our foemen.
verses.hindi: हम जीवन में गाम्भीर्य, मध्यमार्गाक्रमण, तेजस्विता, स्नेह व द्वेषाभाव, कर्मठता व सुखनिद्रा, पाप-निवारण, देदीप्यमान मस्तिष्क व दृदढ् शरीर, यज्ञ, सोमरक्षा, प्रकाशमय अहिंसक वृत्ति तथा तीव्र जाठराग्नि को धारण करें। मन को वशीभूत करके पिक्छले मन्त्र में १९ सद्गुणों का उल्लेख था।  सब प्रजाओं के अन्दर ये दिव्य गुण
verses.transliteration: saṃ te mano manasā saṃ prāṇaḥ prāṇena gacchatām | reḍasyagniṣṭvā śrīṇātvāpastvā samariṇanvātasya tvā dhrājyai pūṣṇo rahyā ūṣmaṇo vyathiṣat prayutaṃ dveṣa:
verses.wordMeaning: Be they united, with the Mind thy mind, and with the Breath thy breath. Thou quiverest. Let Agni make thee ready. Waters have washed together all thy juices. Thee for the Wind's rush, for the speed of Pûshan.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Be they united, with the Mind thy mind, and with the Breath thy breath. Thou quiverest. Let Agni make thee ready. Waters have washed together all thy juices. Thee for the Wind's rush, for the speed of Pûshan.…

verses.sanskrit:
घृ॒तं घृ॑तपावानः पिबत॒ वसां॑ वसापावानः पिबता॒न्तरि॑क्षस्य ह॒विर॑सि॒ स्वाहा॑ ।
दिश॑: प्र॒दिश॑:  आ॒दिशो॑ वि॒दिश॑ उ॒द्दिशो॑ दि॒ग्भ्यः स्वाहा॑
verses.translation: Ye drinkers-up of fatness, drink the fatness; drink up the gravy, drinkers of the gravy! Thou art the oblation of the air's mid-region. All-hail! The regions, the fore-regions, the by-regions, the intermediate and the upper regions,—to all the regions Hail!
verses.hindi: हम जलो व ओषधियों को हिसित न करे। गो-हिसा को पाप समञ्लं। हविष्मान्देवोऽअ॑ध्वरो ह विष्य २।।ऽअस्तु सूर्यः। २३॥ करनेवाली हों। अब कहते हैँ कि इमाः ये जल, ओषधि व गौवों की हिसा न करनेवाली आपः = प्रजाँ हविष्मतीः हविवाली हों। ये सदा दानपूर्वक अदन करनेवाली हों। वस्तुतः
verses.transliteration: ghṛtaṃ ghṛtapāvānaḥ pibata vasāṃ vasāpāvānaḥ pibatāntarikṣasya havirasi svāhā | diśa: pradiśa: ādiśo vidiśa uddiśo digbhyaḥ svāhā
verses.wordMeaning: Ye drinkers-up of fatness, drink the fatness; drink up the gravy, drinkers of the gravy! Thou art the oblation of the air's mid-region. All-hail! The regions, the fore-regions, the by-regions, the intermediate and the upper regions,—to all the regions Hail!
verses.commentary: Sense: Ye drinkers-up of fatness, drink the fatness; drink up the gravy, drinkers of the gravy! Thou art the oblation of the air's mid-region. All-hail! The regions, the fore-regions, the by-regions, the intermediate and the upper regions,—to all the regions Hail!

verses.sanskrit:
ऐ॒न्द्रः प्रा॒णो अङ्गे॑ अङ्गे॒ नि दी॑ध्यदै॒न्द्र उ॑दा॒नो अङ्गे॑ अङ्गे॒ निधी॑तः । देव॑ त्वष्ट॒र्भूरि॑ ते॒ सᳪ स॑मेतु॒ सल॑क्ष्मा॒ यद्विषु॑रूपं॒ भवा॑ति ।
दे॑व॒त्रा यन्त॒मव॑से॒ सखा॒योऽनु॑ त्वा मा॒ता पि॒तरो॑ मदन्तु
verses.translation: In every limb is Indra's out-breath seated, in every limb is Indra's in-breath settled. God Tvashtar, let thine ample forms be blended, that what wears different shapes may be one-fashioned. To please thee let thy friends, mother and father, joy over thee as to the Gods thou goest.
verses.hindi: हमारे घरों में यज्ञो का कभी लोपन हो, हमारी सन्तानं सब देवांशं को धारण करनेवाली हों। विशेषतया उनमें " बल, प्रकाश, स्नेह व द्वेषाभाव' तो अवश्य ही हो। हृदे त्वा मन॑से त्वा दिवे त्वा सूयय त्वा। ऊर्ध्वमिममंध्वरं दिवि देवेषु होत्रा यच्छ।। २५॥
verses.transliteration: aindraḥ prāṇo aṅge aṅge ni dīdhyadaindra udāno aṅge aṅge nidhītaḥ | deva tvaṣṭarbhūri te sa sametu salakṣmā yadviṣurūpaṃ bhavāti | devatrā yantamavase sakhāyo'nu tvā mātā pitaro madantu
verses.wordMeaning: In every limb is Indra's out-breath seated, in every limb is Indra's in-breath settled. God Tvashtar, let thine ample forms be blended, that what wears different shapes may be one-fashioned. To please thee let thy friends, mother and father,…
verses.commentary: Sense: In every limb is Indra's out-breath seated, in every limb is Indra's in-breath settled. God Tvashtar, let thine ample forms be blended, that what wears different shapes may be one-fashioned. To please thee let thy friends, mother and father,…

verses.sanskrit:
स॒मु॒द्रं ग॑च्छ॒ स्वाहा॑ ऽन्तरि॑क्षं गच्छ॒ स्वाहा॑ दे॒वᳪ  स॑वि॒तारं॑ गच्छ॒ स्वाहा॑ मि॒त्रावरु॑णौ गच्छ॒ स्वाहा॑
ऽहोरा॒त्रे ग॑च्छ॒ स्वाहा॑  छन्दा॑ᳪसि गच्छ॒ स्वाहा॒ द्यावा॑पृथि॒वी ग॑च्छ॒ स्वाहा॑ य॒ज्ञं ग॑च्छ॒ स्वाहा॒ सोमं॑ गच्छ॒ स्वाहा॑ दि॒व्यं नभो॑ गच्छ॒ स्वाहा॒ ऽग्निं वै॑श्वान॒रं ग॑च्छ॒ स्वाहा॒ मनो॑ मे॒ हार्दि॑ यच्छ॒ दिवं॑ ते धू॒मो ग॑च्छतु॒ स्वर्ज्योति॑: पृथि॒वीं भस्म॒नाऽऽपृ॑ण॒ स्वाहा॑
verses.translation: Go to the sea. All-hail! Go to the air. All-hail! Go to God Savitar. All hail! Go thou to Mitra-Varuna. All-hail! Go thou to Day and Night. All-hail! Go to the Metres. till-hail! Go to Heaven and Earth. All-hail! Go to the sacrifice. All-hail! Go to Soma. All-hail! Go to the heavenly ether. All-hail! Go to Vaisvânara Agni. All hail! Bestow upon me mind and heart. Thy smoke mount to the sky, to heaven thy lustre. Fill thou the spacious earth full with thine ashes.
verses.hindi: राजा को निरभिमानी होना चाहिए। वह प्रजाओं के लिए अभिगम्य हो। ब्राह्मण उसे ज्ञान दे। आप्त बुद्धिमान् सत्पुरुष उसे राष्ट्कार्य में सहायता कररे। विवेक पुरुषों से वह उसी प्रकार ज्ञान प्राप्त करे जैसेकि वह विद्वानों से यज्ञ के विषय में सुनता हे। प्रभु देवीरापोऽअपान्नपाद्यो व॑ऽ ऊर्मिर्हविष्य ऽ इद्रियावांन् मदिन्त॑मः।
verses.transliteration: samudraṃ gaccha svāhā 'ntarikṣaṃ gaccha svāhā deva savitāraṃ gaccha svāhā mitrāvaruṇau gaccha svāhā 'horātre gaccha svāhā chandāsi gaccha svāhā dyāvāpṛthivī gaccha svāhā yajñaṃ gaccha svāhā somaṃ gaccha svāhā divyaṃ nabho gaccha svāhā 'gniṃ vaiśvānaraṃ gaccha svāhā mano me hārdi yaccha divaṃ te dhūmo gacchatu svarjyoti: pṛthivīṃ bhasmanā''pṛṇa svāhā
verses.wordMeaning: Go to the sea. All-hail! Go to the air. All-hail! Go to God Savitar. All hail! Go thou to Mitra-Varuna. All-hail! Go thou to Day and Night. All-hail! Go to the Metres. till-hail! Go to Heaven and Earth. All-hail! Go to the sacrifice. All-hail! Go to Soma.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Go to the sea. All-hail! Go to the air. All-hail! Go to God Savitar. All hail! Go thou to Mitra-Varuna. All-hail! Go thou to Day and Night. All-hail! Go to the Metres. till-hail! Go to Heaven and Earth. All-hail! Go to the sacrifice. All-hail! Go to Soma.…

verses.sanskrit:
माऽपो मौ॑षधीर्हिᳪसी॒र्धाम्नो॑ धाम्नो राजँ॒स्ततो॑ वरुण नो मुञ्च । यदा॒हुर॒घ्न्या इति॒ वरु॒णेति॒ शपा॑महे॒ ततो॑ वरुण नो मुञ्च ।
सुमि॒त्रि॒या न॒ आप॒ ओष॑धयः सन्तु दुर्मित्रि॒यास्तस्मै॑ सन्तु॒   योस्मान्द्वेष्टि॒ यं च॑ व॒यं द्वि॒ष्म:
verses.translation: Harm not the Waters, do the Plants no damage. From every place, King Varuna, thence save us. Their saying that we swear our oath by sacred cows, by Varuna, O Varuna, save us therefrom. To us let Waters and let Plants be friendly; to him who hates us, whom we hate, unfriendly.
verses.hindi: कर का उदेश्य है कि (क) एेसी व्यवस्था कौ जाए कि प्रजाओं का पतन न हो। (ख) वह प्रजाहित के लिए ही विनियुक्त हो। (ग) प्रजाओं को प्रशस्तेन्द्रिय व शक्तिशाली बनाये। (घ) प्रजाओं के लिए उत्तम आमोद-प्रमोद के साधनों को भी जुटाये। का्षिरसि समुद्रस्य त्वा क्षित्याऽ उन्न॑यामि।
verses.transliteration: mā'po mauṣadhīrhisīrdhāmno dhāmno rāja~stato varuṇa no muñca | yadāhuraghnyā iti varuṇeti śapāmahe tato varuṇa no muñca | sumitriyā na āpa oṣadhayaḥ santu durmitriyāstasmai santu yosmāndveṣṭi yaṃ ca vayaṃ dviṣma:
verses.wordMeaning: Harm not the Waters, do the Plants no damage. From every place, King Varuna, thence save us. Their saying that we swear our oath by sacred cows, by Varuna, O Varuna, save us therefrom. To us let Waters and let Plants be friendly; to him who hates us, whom we hate, unfriendly.
verses.commentary: Sense: Harm not the Waters, do the Plants no damage. From every place, King Varuna, thence save us. Their saying that we swear our oath by sacred cows, by Varuna, O Varuna, save us therefrom. To us let Waters and let Plants be friendly; to him who hates us, whom we hate, unfriendly.

verses.sanskrit: ह॒विष्म॑तीरि॒मा आपो॑ ह॒विष्माँ॒२ आ वि॑वासति । ह॒विष्मा॑न् दे॒वो अ॑ध्व॒रो ह॒विष्माँ॑२ अस्तु॒ सूर्य॑:
verses.translation: Thee for the heart, thee for the mind, thee for the heaven, thee for the Sun. Bear up erect to heaven, to Gods, this rite these sacrificial calls.
verses.hindi: राष्ट् में वैश्यवर्णं कृषि के कार्य मे किसी प्रकार का शैथिल्य न आने दे। यज्ञो के परिणामरूप वृष्टि समय-समय पर होती रहे, जिससे ओषधियों व अन्नं कौ उत्पत्ति युद्ध के समय भी वैश्यवर्गं की कृषि आदि में व्यापृतता पिच्छले मन्त्र की समाप्ति ' समोषधीभिरोषधीः' पर हुई शी कि ओषधियाँ ओषधियों
verses.transliteration: haviṣmatīrimā āpo haviṣmā~2 ā vivāsati | haviṣmān devo adhvaro haviṣmā~2 astu sūrya:
verses.wordMeaning: Thee for the heart, thee for the mind, thee for the heaven, thee for the Sun. Bear up erect to heaven, to Gods, this rite these sacrificial calls.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thee for the heart, thee for the mind, thee for the heaven, thee for the Sun. Bear up erect to heaven, to Gods, this rite these sacrificial calls.

verses.sanskrit: अ॒ग्नेर्वोऽप॑न्नगृहस्य॒ सद॑सि सादयामीन्द्रा॒ग्न्योर्भा॑ग॒धेयी॑ स्थ  मि॒त्रावरु॑णयोर्भाग॒धेयी॑ स्थ विश्वे॑षां दे॒वानां॑ भाग॒धेयी॑ स्थ । अ॒मूर्या उप॒ सूर्ये॒ याभि॑र्वा॒ सूर्य॑: स॒ह । ता नो॑ हिन्वन्त्वध्व॒रम्
verses.translation: I set you down in Agni's seat whose home is indestructible. Indra-and-Agni's share are ye, Mitra-and-Varuna's share are ye. The share of all the Gods are ye. May waters gathered near the Sun, and those wherewith the Sun is joined, Speed on this sacred rite of ours.
verses.hindi: राजा एेसी व्यवस्था करे कि युद्ध के समय भी खेती आदि कार्य निर्बाधरूप सूचना - अध्यात्म प्रकरण मे अर्थ यह होगा--हे अग्ने-उन्नति साधक प्रभो! पृत्सु-काम- क्रोधादि से संग्रामो मे यं मर्त्यम्-जिस मनुष्य की अवाः=आप रक्षा करते हो ओर यम् जिसको जुनाः प्रेरणा प्राप्त कराते हो सः=वह शाश्वतीः = क्रियामय अथवा सनातन इषः =प्रेरणाओं
verses.transliteration: agnervo'pannagṛhasya sadasi sādayāmīndrāgnyorbhāgadheyī stha mitrāvaruṇayorbhāgadheyī stha viśveṣāṃ devānāṃ bhāgadheyī stha | amūryā upa sūrye yābhirvā sūrya: saha | tā no hinvantvadhvaram
verses.wordMeaning: I set you down in Agni's seat whose home is indestructible. Indra-and-Agni's share are ye, Mitra-and-Varuna's share are ye. The share of all the Gods are ye. May waters gathered near the Sun, and those wherewith the Sun is joined, Speed on this sacred rite of ours.
verses.commentary: Sense: I set you down in Agni's seat whose home is indestructible. Indra-and-Agni's share are ye, Mitra-and-Varuna's share are ye. The share of all the Gods are ye. May waters gathered near the Sun, and those wherewith the Sun is joined, Speed on this sacred rite of ours.

verses.sanskrit: हृ॒दे त्वा॒ मन॑से त्वा दि॒वे त्वा॒ सूर्या॑य त्वा । ऊ॒र्ध्वमि॒मम॑ध्व॒रं दि॒वि दे॒वेषु॒ होत्रा॑ यच्छ
verses.translation: Descend, O Soma, King, to all thy people.
verses.hindi: राजा वेदानुकरूल प्रजाओं का शासन करे। प्रजा उचित 'कर' देकर राष्ट करौ नीव को दुद् करे। राष्ट् अन्य उन्नतियों के साथ शत्रु के आक्रमण से सुरक्षा के लिए उत्तम शस्त्रो से सुसन्जित हो। राष्ट में माधुर्य हो , आप्यायन हो। प्रजा्णँ नियन्त्रित जीवनवाली १. प्रस्तुत मन्त्र में राजा सभ्यो से कहता है कि है सभा ओर समिति के सदस्यो!
verses.transliteration: hṛde tvā manase tvā dive tvā sūryāya tvā | ūrdhvamimamadhvaraṃ divi deveṣu hotrā yaccha
verses.wordMeaning: Descend, O Soma, King, to all thy people.
verses.commentary: Sense: Descend, O Soma, King, to all thy people.

verses.sanskrit:
सोम॑ राज॒न्  विश्वा॒स्त्वं प्र॒जा उ॒पाव॑रोह विश्वा॒स्त्वां प्र॒जा उ॒पाव॑रोहन्तु ।
शृ॒णोत्व॒ग्निः स॒मिधा॑ ह॒वं मे॑ शृण्व॒न्त्वापो॑ धि॒षणा॑श्च दे॒वीः ।
श्रोता॑ ग्रावाणो वि॒दुषो॒ न य॒ज्ञᳪ शृ॒णोतु॑ दे॒वः स॑वि॒ता हवं॑ मे॒ स्वाहा॑
verses.translation: Down, unto thee, go, one and all, thy people! May Agni with his fuel hear my calling. Hear it the Waters and the Bowls, Divine Ones! Hear, Stones, as knowing sacrifice, my calling. May the God Savitar hear mine invocation. All hail!
verses.hindi: राष्ट्पतति वा राजा पूर्ण प्रयत्न व सुव्यवस्था से राज्य में लोगों को धन-प्राप्ति के उचित साधन प्राप्त कराए ओर घात-पात कौ मनोवृत्तिवाले लोगों की मनोवृत्ति को बदलने के लिए उनमें खूब (अधि) ज्ञान का प्रचार कराए (वोचः:)। राजा व राजसभा के सभ्यो की “पलिर्योँ'
verses.transliteration: soma rājan viśvāstvaṃ prajā upāvaroha viśvāstvāṃ prajā upāvarohantu | śṛṇotvagniḥ samidhā havaṃ me śṛṇvantvāpo dhiṣaṇāśca devīḥ | śrotā grāvāṇo viduṣo na yajña śṛṇotu devaḥ savitā havaṃ me svāhā
verses.wordMeaning: Down, unto thee, go, one and all, thy people! May Agni with his fuel hear my calling. Hear it the Waters and the Bowls, Divine Ones! Hear, Stones, as knowing sacrifice, my calling. May the God Savitar hear mine invocation. All hail!
verses.commentary: Sense: Down, unto thee, go, one and all, thy people! May Agni with his fuel hear my calling. Hear it the Waters and the Bowls, Divine Ones! Hear, Stones, as knowing sacrifice, my calling. May the God Savitar hear mine invocation. All hail!

verses.sanskrit:
देवी॑रापो अपां नपा॒द्यो व॑ ऊ॒र्मिर्ह॑वि॒ष्य॒ इन्द्रि॒यावा॑न्  म॒दिन्त॑मः ।
तं दे॒वेभ्यो॑ देव॒त्रा द॑त्त शुक्र॒पेभ्यो॒ येषां॑ भा॒ग स्थ॒ स्वाहा॑
verses.translation: Waters Divine, your wave, the Waters’ offspring, fit for oblation, potent, most delightful Upon those Gods among the Gods bestow it, who drink the pure, of whom ye are the portion. All-hail!
verses.hindi: हम अभय हों, अविचल हों, बल ओर प्राणशक्ति को धारण करे। बुद्धिमान् बनें, शक्तिशाली कर्मो को करते हुए पाप को विनष्ट करे ओर सौम्य स्वभाव को विकसित ९. गत मन्त्र में निर्भयता आदि सद्गुणो के धारण का प्रसङ्ख था। उल्लिखित गुणोवाले माता-पिता अपने सन्तानं के जीवन को सर्वतः शुद्ध बनाने का प्रयल करते हे।
verses.transliteration: devīrāpo apāṃ napādyo va ūrmirhaviṣya indriyāvān madintamaḥ | taṃ devebhyo devatrā datta śukrapebhyo yeṣāṃ bhāga stha svāhā
verses.wordMeaning: Waters Divine, your wave, the Waters’ offspring, fit for oblation, potent, most delightful Upon those Gods among the Gods bestow it, who drink the pure, of whom ye are the portion. All-hail!
verses.commentary: Sense: Waters Divine, your wave, the Waters’ offspring, fit for oblation, potent, most delightful Upon those Gods among the Gods bestow it, who drink the pure, of whom ye are the portion. All-hail!

verses.sanskrit: कार्षि॑रसि  स॑मु॒द्रस्य॒ त्वा क्षि॑त्या॒ उन्न॑यामि । समापो॑ अ॒द्भिर॑ग्मत॒ समोष॑धीभि॒रोष॑धीः
verses.translation: Drawing art thou: I draw thee up that Ocean ne’er may waste or wane. Let waters with the waters, and the plants commingle with the plants.
verses.hindi: माता-पिता अपने सन्तानो का, आचार्य शिष्यो का तथा राजा प्रजा का सर्वतः शोधन करे, उन्हें बुराइयों से दूर करे, जिससे सब सन्तान परस्पर संज्ञानवाली हो। त्वमङ्ग प्रश॑ःसिषो देवः श॑विष्ठ मर्त्यम्। १. माता-पिता सन्तानों को उत्तम उपदेश देते हें। पिछले मन्त्र मे इसका वर्णन हुआ
verses.transliteration: kārṣirasi samudrasya tvā kṣityā unnayāmi | samāpo adbhiragmata samoṣadhībhiroṣadhīḥ
verses.wordMeaning: Drawing art thou: I draw thee up that Ocean ne’er may waste or wane. Let waters with the waters, and the plants commingle with the plants.
verses.commentary: Sense: Drawing art thou: I draw thee up that Ocean ne’er may waste or wane. Let waters with the waters, and the plants commingle with the plants.

verses.sanskrit: यम॑ग्ने पृ॒त्सु मर्त्य॒मवा॒ वाजे॑षु॒ यं जु॒नाः । स यन्ता॒ शश्व॑ती॒रिष॒: स्वाहा॑
verses.translation: That man is lord of endless strength whom thou protectest in the fight, Agni, or urgest to the fray.
verses.hindi: हम सूरि ( वेदत्रित्), ञानी स्तोता बनें ओर प्रभु को आत्मतुल्य प्रिय हो। उस समय हम प्रभु का उतना ही स्पष्ट दर्शन कर रहे होगे जितना कि सूर्य का। प्रभु-द्रष्टा का आश्रम क्परिवीरंसि परि त्वा हैवीर्विशो व्ययन्तां परीमं यज॑मानध्रायों मनुष्याणाम् ।
verses.transliteration: yamagne pṛtsu martyamavā vājeṣu yaṃ junāḥ | sa yantā śaśvatīriṣa: svāhā
verses.wordMeaning: That man is lord of endless strength whom thou protectest in the fight, Agni, or urgest to the fray.
verses.commentary: Sense: That man is lord of endless strength whom thou protectest in the fight, Agni, or urgest to the fray.

verses.sanskrit:
दे॒वस्य॑ त्वा सवि॒तुः प्र॑स॒वेऽश्विनो॑र्बा॒हुभ्यां॑ पू॒ष्णो हस्ता॑भ्याम् । आ द॑दे॒ रावा॑सि गभी॒रमि॒मम॑ध्व॒रं कृ॒धीन्द्रा॑य सु॒षूत॑मम् ।
उ॒त्त॒मेन॑ प॒विनोर्ज॑स्वन्तं॒ मधु॑मन्तं॒ पय॑स्वन्तं  निग्रा॒भ्या॒ स्थ देव॒श्रुत॑स्त॒र्पय॑त मा
verses.translation: By impulse of God Savitar I take thee with arms of Asvins, with the hands of Pûshan. Free with thy gifts art thou. Perform for Indra this deep, most excellently ordered worship. With the most noble bolt I pay the worship enriched with strengthening food and milk and sweetness. Ye are Nigrâbhyâ waters. heard by Deities: make me content.
verses.hindi: आचार्य विद्यार्थी के जीवन को परिशुद्ध कर डालता हे। गत मन्त्र के शोधन' के बाद प्रस्तुत मन्त्र में ' आप्यायन" का वर्णन आता है। आचार्य विद्यार्थी से कहता है कि १. ते मनः आप्यायताम् तेरा मन बदे। तेरे मन मे सदा उत्साह का सञ्चार हो। निराशा तेरे मनःप्रसाद में किसी प्रकार की कमी को न आने दे।
verses.transliteration: devasya tvā savituḥ prasave'śvinorbāhubhyāṃ pūṣṇo hastābhyām | ā dade rāvāsi gabhīramimamadhvaraṃ kṛdhīndrāya suṣūtamam | uttamena pavinorjasvantaṃ madhumantaṃ payasvantaṃ nigrābhyā stha devaśrutastarpayata mā
verses.wordMeaning: By impulse of God Savitar I take thee with arms of Asvins, with the hands of Pûshan. Free with thy gifts art thou. Perform for Indra this deep, most excellently ordered worship. With the most noble bolt I pay the worship enriched with strengthening food and milk and sweetness.…
verses.commentary: Sense: By impulse of God Savitar I take thee with arms of Asvins, with the hands of Pûshan. Free with thy gifts art thou. Perform for Indra this deep, most excellently ordered worship. With the most noble bolt I pay the worship enriched with strengthening food and milk and sweetness.…

verses.sanskrit: मनो॑ मे तर्पयत॒ वाचं॑ मे तर्पयत प्रा॒णं मे॑ तर्पयत॒ चक्षु॑र्मे तर्पयत॒ श्रोत्रं॑ मे तर्पयता॒त्मानं॑ मे तर्पयत प्र॒जां मे॑ तर्पयत प॒शून्मे॑ तर्पयत ग॒णान्मे॑ तर्पयत ग॒णा मे॒ मा वि तृ॑षन्
verses.translation: Content my mind, content my speech, content my breath, content mine eye, content mine ear, content my soul, content my progeny, content my herds, content the troops of men about me: never may the bands of men about me suffer thirst.
verses.hindi: प्राण एवं उदान को सिद्ध करके हम जीवन का निर्माण करे। दिव्य गुणों की ओर बदे। हमारे जीवन को देखकर मित्रों व पिता-माता को प्रसन्नता हो। क्सखमुद्रं ग॑च्छ स्वाहा ऽन्तरिक्षं गच्छ स्वाहा ष्देवःसंवितार' गच्छ स्वाहां ग॑च्छ स्वाहा यज्ञं ग॑च्छ स्वाहा सोमं गच्छ स्वाहां दिव्यं नभो गच्छ स्वाहाग्निं
verses.transliteration: mano me tarpayata vācaṃ me tarpayata prāṇaṃ me tarpayata cakṣurme tarpayata śrotraṃ me tarpayatātmānaṃ me tarpayata prajāṃ me tarpayata paśūnme tarpayata gaṇānme tarpayata gaṇā me mā vi tṛṣan
verses.wordMeaning: Content my mind, content my speech, content my breath, content mine eye, content mine ear, content my soul, content my progeny, content my herds, content the troops of men about me: never may the bands of men about me suffer thirst.
verses.commentary: Sense: Content my mind, content my speech, content my breath, content mine eye, content mine ear, content my soul, content my progeny, content my herds, content the troops of men about me: never may the bands of men about me suffer thirst.

verses.sanskrit:
इन्द्रा॑य त्वा॒ वसु॑मते रु॒द्रव॑त॒ इन्द्रा॑य त्वा ऽऽदि॒त्यव॑त॒  इन्द्रा॑य त्वा ऽभिमाति॒घ्ने ।
श्ये॒नाय॑ त्वा सोम॒भृते॒  ऽग्नये॑ त्वा रायस्पोष॒दे
verses.translation: For Indra girt by Vasus and accompanied by Rudras, thee. For Indra with Âdityas, thee. For Indra foe-destroyer, thee. Thee for the Soma-bringing Hawk. For plenty-giving Agni, thee.
verses.hindi: पली-पति के जीवन में ' श्रद्धा, मननशक्ति, प्रकाश व नियमितता" को बद्धानेवाली हो। वह घर में यस को प्रमुख स्थान दे। यज्ञो मे जहां हवियों को डाले वहाँ विद्वानों से ज्ञान को प्राप्त करनेवाली हो। रशणोत्वग्निः समिधा हवं" मे शृण्वन्त्वापों धिषणांश्च देवीः।
verses.transliteration: indrāya tvā vasumate rudravata indrāya tvā ''dityavata indrāya tvā 'bhimātighne | śyenāya tvā somabhṛte 'gnaye tvā rāyaspoṣade
verses.wordMeaning: For Indra girt by Vasus and accompanied by Rudras, thee. For Indra with Âdityas, thee. For Indra foe-destroyer, thee. Thee for the Soma-bringing Hawk. For plenty-giving Agni, thee.
verses.commentary: Sense: For Indra girt by Vasus and accompanied by Rudras, thee. For Indra with Âdityas, thee. For Indra foe-destroyer, thee. Thee for the Soma-bringing Hawk. For plenty-giving Agni, thee.

verses.sanskrit: यत्ते॑ सोम दि॒वि ज्योति॒र्यत्पृ॑थि॒व्यां यदु॒राव॒न्तरि॑क्षे । तेनास्मै॒ यज॑मानायो॒रु रा॒ये कृ॒ध्यधि॑ दा॒त्रे वो॑चः
verses.translation: Soma, what light there is of thine in heaven, what on the earth, what in mid-air's wide region, Therewith give broad space to the Sacrificer for his enrichment: Comfort thou the giver.
verses.hindi: राष्टृपति जितेन्द्रिय हो। राष्ट में निवास के उत्तम साधनों को जुटाए। योग्य अध्यापक व ऊँचे सानी पुरुष राष्ट मे से अविद्यान्धकार को दूर करे। शत्रुओं के आक्रमण से राष्ट हो। राष्ट्रपति क्रियाशील व संयमी हो। वह राष्ट को उन्नति-पथ पर ले-चले राष्ट की सम्पत्ति को बढाने कौ व्यवस्था करे।
verses.transliteration: yatte soma divi jyotiryatpṛthivyāṃ yadurāvantarikṣe | tenāsmai yajamānāyoru rāye kṛdhyadhi dātre vocaḥ
verses.wordMeaning: Soma, what light there is of thine in heaven, what on the earth, what in mid-air's wide region, Therewith give broad space to the Sacrificer for his enrichment: Comfort thou the giver.
verses.commentary: Sense: Soma, what light there is of thine in heaven, what on the earth, what in mid-air's wide region, Therewith give broad space to the Sacrificer for his enrichment: Comfort thou the giver.

verses.sanskrit: श्वा॒त्रा स्थ॑ वृत्र॒तुरो॒ राधो॑गूर्ता अ॒मृत॑स्य॒ पत्नी॑: । ता दे॑वीर्देव॒त्रेमं य॒ज्ञं न॑य॒तोप॑हूता॒: सोम॑स्य पिबत
verses.translation: Auspicious are ye, conquerors of Vritra, formed for bestowing wealth, the Immortal's Consorts. Lead to the Gods this sacrifice, Divine Ones! and at our invitation drink of Soma.
verses.hindi: पली अपने उत्तम व्यवहार से पति को प्रसन्न व निश्चिन्त रक्खेंगी तो पति अपने कार्यो को उत्तमता से कर पार्पगे। गत मन्त्र में पली का कर्तव्य विशेषरूप से कहा गया। अब पति-पली दोनों के लिए कुक सामान्य बाते कहते है। १. मा भेः=तुम डरो नहीं। संसार में सबसे निकृष्ट वस्तु डर
verses.transliteration: śvātrā stha vṛtraturo rādhogūrtā amṛtasya patnī: | tā devīrdevatremaṃ yajñaṃ nayatopahūtā: somasya pibata
verses.wordMeaning: Auspicious are ye, conquerors of Vritra, formed for bestowing wealth, the Immortal's Consorts. Lead to the Gods this sacrifice, Divine Ones! and at our invitation drink of Soma.
verses.commentary: Sense: Auspicious are ye, conquerors of Vritra, formed for bestowing wealth, the Immortal's Consorts. Lead to the Gods this sacrifice, Divine Ones! and at our invitation drink of Soma.

verses.sanskrit: मा भे॒र्मा सं वि॑क्था॒ ऊर्जं॑ धत्स्व॒ धिष॑णे वी॒ड्वी स॒ती वी॑डयेथा॒मूर्जं॑ दधाथाम् । पा॒प्मा ह॒तो न सोम॑:
verses.translation: Be not afraid; shake not with terror. Take thou strength. Ye two Bowls, being firm, stay firm, and take ye strength. Mishap—not Soma—hath been killed.
verses.hindi: प्रभु ही सर्वमहान् उपदेष्टा है। वे ही हमारे जीवनों को सुखी करनेवाले हे। हमे उन्हीं से जान-प्राप्ति कौ प्रार्थना करनी चाहिए्।
verses.transliteration: mā bhermā saṃ vikthā ūrjaṃ dhatsva dhiṣaṇe vīḍvī satī vīḍayethāmūrjaṃ dadhāthām | pāpmā hato na soma:
verses.wordMeaning: Be not afraid; shake not with terror. Take thou strength. Ye two Bowls, being firm, stay firm, and take ye strength. Mishap—not Soma—hath been killed.
verses.commentary: Sense: Be not afraid; shake not with terror. Take thou strength. Ye two Bowls, being firm, stay firm, and take ye strength. Mishap—not Soma—hath been killed.

verses.sanskrit: प्रागपा॒गुद॑गध॒राक्स॒र्वत॑स्त्वा॒ दिश॒ आ धा॑वन्तु । अम्ब॒ निष्प॑र॒ सम॒रीर्वि॑दाम्
verses.translation: East, west, north, south, from every side to meet thee let the regions run. Fill him, O Mother, let the noble meet together.
verses.hindi: प्रभु ही सर्वमहान् उपदेष्टा है। वे ही हमारे जीवनों को सुखी करनेवाले हे। हमे उन्हीं से जान-प्राप्ति कौ प्रार्थना करनी चाहिए्।
verses.transliteration: prāgapāgudagadharāksarvatastvā diśa ā dhāvantu | amba niṣpara samarīrvidām
verses.wordMeaning: East, west, north, south, from every side to meet thee let the regions run. Fill him, O Mother, let the noble meet together.
verses.commentary: Sense: East, west, north, south, from every side to meet thee let the regions run. Fill him, O Mother, let the noble meet together.

verses.sanskrit: त्वम॒ङ्ग प्रश॑ᳪसिषो दे॒वः श॑विष्ठ॒ मर्त्य॑म् । न त्वद॒न्यो म॑घवन्नस्ति मर्डि॒तेन्द्र॒ ब्रवी॑मि ते॒ वच॑:
verses.translation: Thou, verily, O Mightiest, as God shalt gladden mortal man. O Bounteous Lord, there is no comforter but thou. Indra, I speak my words to thee.
verses.hindi: प्रभु ही सर्वमहान् उपदेष्टा है। वे ही हमारे जीवनों को सुखी करनेवाले हे। हमे उन्हीं से जान-प्राप्ति कौ प्रार्थना करनी चाहिए्।
verses.transliteration: tvamaṅga praśasiṣo devaḥ śaviṣṭha martyam | na tvadanyo maghavannasti marḍitendra bravīmi te vaca:
verses.wordMeaning: Thou, verily, O Mightiest, as God shalt gladden mortal man. O Bounteous Lord, there is no comforter but thou. Indra, I speak my words to thee.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thou, verily, O Mightiest, as God shalt gladden mortal man. O Bounteous Lord, there is no comforter but thou. Indra, I speak my words to thee.

verses.sanskrit: वा॒चस्पत॑ये पवस्व॒ वृष्णो॑ अ॒jशुभ्यां॒ गभ॑स्तिपूतः । दे॒वो दे॒वेभ्य॑: पवस्व॒ येषां॑ भा॒गोऽसि॑
verses.translation: com The Texts of the White Yajurveda, tr. Ralph T.H. Griffith, [1899], FLOW for Vâchaspati, cleansed by hands from the two off-shoots of the Bull. Flow pure, a Deity thyself, for Deities whose share thou art.
verses.hindi: अपने जीवन को पवित्र करके तू प्रभु को प्राप्त कर ओर ज्ञानवाणियों को ग्रहण करके गोतम ' बन। इस स्थिति में पहुंचने के लिए तू सोम की रक्षा कर। नीरोग व तीव्र बुद्धि बनकर तू देव बन। १. पिछले मन्त्र में प्रभु को हदयासीन करने के लिए गोतम ने अपने जीवन को
verses.transliteration: vācaspataye pavasva vṛṣṇo ajśubhyāṃ gabhastipūtaḥ | devo devebhya: pavasva yeṣāṃ bhāgo'si
verses.wordMeaning: com The Texts of the White Yajurveda, tr. Ralph T.H. Griffith, [1899], FLOW for Vâchaspati, cleansed by hands from the two off-shoots of the Bull. Flow pure, a Deity thyself, for Deities whose share thou art.
verses.commentary: Sense: com The Texts of the White Yajurveda, tr. Ralph T.H. Griffith, [1899], FLOW for Vâchaspati, cleansed by hands from the two off-shoots of the Bull. Flow pure, a Deity thyself, for Deities whose share thou art.

verses.sanskrit:
मधु॑मतीर्न॒ इष॑स्कृधि॒ यत्ते॑ सो॒मादा॑भ्यं॒ नाम॒ जागृ॑वि॒ तस्मै॑ ते सोम॒ सोमा॑य॒ स्वाहा॒
स्वाहो॒र्वन्तरि॑क्ष॒मन्वे॑मि॒
verses.translation: Sweeten the freshening draughts we drink. Soma, whatever name thou hast, unconquerable, giving life, To that thy Soma, Soma! Hail!
verses.hindi: सोम की रक्षा से मेरे मस्तिष्क व शरीर दोनों का विकास होता है, वासना का विनाश होकर प्राण व व्यानशक्ति बढती हे। गत मन्त्र में वर्णित सोम की रक्षाके लिए संयम आवश्यक हे। संयम ही योग हे। इस योग का उल्लेख प्रस्तुत मन्त्र में चलता हे। १. है गोतम! तू उपयाम गृहीतः असि
verses.transliteration: madhumatīrna iṣaskṛdhi yatte somādābhyaṃ nāma jāgṛvi tasmai te soma somāya svāhā svāhorvantarikṣamanvemi
verses.wordMeaning: Sweeten the freshening draughts we drink. Soma, whatever name thou hast, unconquerable, giving life, To that thy Soma, Soma! Hail!
verses.commentary: Sense: Sweeten the freshening draughts we drink. Soma, whatever name thou hast, unconquerable, giving life, To that thy Soma, Soma! Hail!

verses.sanskrit:
स्वाङ्कृ॑तोऽसि॒ विश्वे॑भ्य इन्द्रि॒येभ्यो॑ दि॒व्येभ्य॒: पार्थि॑वेभ्यो॒ मन॑स्त्वाष्टु॒ स्वाहा॑
त्वा सुभव॒ सूर्या॑य दे॒वेभ्य॑स्त्वा मरीचि॒पेभ्यो॒  देवा॑ᳪशो॒ यस्मै॒ त्वेडे॒ तत्स॒त्यमु॑परि॒प्रुता॑ भ॒ङ्गेन॑ ह॒तोऽसौ॒ फ़ट्
प्रा॒णाय॑ त्वा व्या॒नाय॑ त्वा
verses.translation: repeated). Thee for the upward breath.
verses.hindi: हम योग-नियमों का पालन कर मनोनिरोध कर। वासनाओंं को जीतकर ज्लान-धनों को प्राप्त करे। गत मन्त्र के “उपयामगृहीत"=योग के नियमों का पालन करनेवाले से प्रभु कहते हें कि मै १. ते अन्तः=तेरे अन्दर द्यावापुथिवीनद्युलोक व पृथिवीलोक को दधामिधारण
verses.transliteration: svāṅkṛto'si viśvebhya indriyebhyo divyebhya: pārthivebhyo manastvāṣṭu svāhā tvā subhava sūryāya devebhyastvā marīcipebhyo devāśo yasmai tveḍe tatsatyamupariprutā bhaṅgena hato'sau faṭ prāṇāya tvā vyānāya tvā
verses.wordMeaning: repeated). Thee for the upward breath.
verses.commentary: Sense: repeated). Thee for the upward breath.

verses.sanskrit: उ॒प॒या॒मगृ॑हीतोऽस्य॒न्तर्य॑च्छ मघवन्  पा॒हि सोम॑म् । उ॒रु॒ष्य राय॒ एषो॑ यजस्व
verses.translation: Taken upon a base art thou. Hold in, Rich Lord! be Soma's guard. Be thou protector of our wealth: win strengthening food by sacrifice.
verses.hindi: अवर व पर सब देवों से मित्रता होती है। ज्ञानैश्वर्य प्राप्त कर हम आनन्द प्राप्त करते हे। स्वाङकरतो ऽसि विश्वेभ्य इद्ियेभ्यो दिव्येभ्यः पार्थिवेभ्यो मन॑स्त्वाष्टु स्वाहां पिछले मन्त्र में योग द्वारा मन को अन्दर ही रोकने का उल्लेख था। इस मनोनिरोध करे परिणामस्वरूप सोम की रक्षा होती है। इस सोमरक्षा के परिणाम का वर्णन प्रस्तुत मन्त्र
verses.transliteration: upayāmagṛhīto'syantaryaccha maghavan pāhi somam | uruṣya rāya eṣo yajasva
verses.wordMeaning: Taken upon a base art thou. Hold in, Rich Lord! be Soma's guard. Be thou protector of our wealth: win strengthening food by sacrifice.
verses.commentary: Sense: Taken upon a base art thou. Hold in, Rich Lord! be Soma's guard. Be thou protector of our wealth: win strengthening food by sacrifice.

verses.sanskrit: अ॒न्तस्ते॒ द्यावा॑पृथि॒वी द॑धाम्य॒न्तर्द॑धाम्यु॒र्व॒न्तरि॑क्षम् । स॒जूर्दे॒वेभि॒रव॑रै॒: परै॑श्चान्तर्या॒मे म॑घवन्  मादयस्व
verses.translation: The heaven and spacious earth I lay within thee, I lay within thee middle air's wide region. Accordant with the Gods lower and higher, Rich Lord, rejoice thee in the Antaryâma. O Self-made art thou . . . . . light-atoms (verse
verses.hindi: मै सोमरक्षा द्वारा उदानवायु को सिद्ध करनेवाला बनं ओर अन्ततः मोक्ष उपो तेऽअन्धो मद्यमयामि यस्य॑ देव दधिषे पूर्वपेयं वायवे त्वा॥७॥। गत मन्त्र मे गोतम ने वीर्यरक्षा द्वारा उदानवायु की साधना कौ भी। इस प्रकार सयर्म जीवनवाला यह " वसिष्ठ ' बनता हे! प्रभु इस वसिष्ठ से कहते है-- १. वायो=(वा गतिगन्धनयोः)
verses.transliteration: antaste dyāvāpṛthivī dadhāmyantardadhāmyurvantarikṣam | sajūrdevebhiravarai: paraiścāntaryāme maghavan mādayasva
verses.wordMeaning: The heaven and spacious earth I lay within thee, I lay within thee middle air's wide region. Accordant with the Gods lower and higher, Rich Lord, rejoice thee in the Antaryâma. O Self-made art thou . . . . . light-atoms (verse
verses.commentary: Sense: The heaven and spacious earth I lay within thee, I lay within thee middle air's wide region. Accordant with the Gods lower and higher, Rich Lord, rejoice thee in the Antaryâma. O Self-made art thou . . . . . light-atoms (verse

verses.sanskrit:
स्वाङ्कृ॑तोऽसि॒ विश्वे॑भ्य इन्द्रि॒येभ्यो॑ दि॒व्येभ्य॒: पार्थि॑वेभ्यो॒ मन॑स्त्वाष्टु॒ स्वाहा॑
त्वा सुभव॒ सूर्या॑य दे॒वेभ्य॑स्त्वा मरीचि॒पेभ्य॑ उदा॒नाय॑ त्वा
verses.translation: O Vâyu, drinker of the pure, be near us: a thousand teams are thine, All-bounteous Giver.
verses.hindi: हम सोमरक्षा द्वारा शतशः शमादि गुणों से अपने जीवनो को अलंकृत करे। सोमरक्षा के विषय को ही प्रस्तुत मन्त्र में इन शब्दों में कहते है कि १. इन्द्रवायु-हे इन्द्र॒ ओर वायु ! इमे=ये सोमकण सुताः तुम्हारे अन्दर उत्पन्न किये गये हैँ। प्रयोभिः = सात्विक भोजनों (००५) से तथा आनन्दमयी मनोवृत्ति (१८। ९1. 012801८) से तथा त्याग कौ
verses.transliteration: svāṅkṛto'si viśvebhya indriyebhyo divyebhya: pārthivebhyo manastvāṣṭu svāhā tvā subhava sūryāya devebhyastvā marīcipebhya udānāya tvā
verses.wordMeaning: O Vâyu, drinker of the pure, be near us: a thousand teams are thine, All-bounteous Giver.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Vâyu, drinker of the pure, be near us: a thousand teams are thine, All-bounteous Giver.

verses.sanskrit: आ वा॑यो भूष शुचिपा॒ उप॑ नः स॒हस्रं॑ ते नि॒युतो॑ विश्ववार । उपो॑ ते॒ अन्धो॒ मद्य॑मयामि॒ यस्य॑ देव दधि॒षे पू॑र्व॒पेयं॑ वा॒यवे॑ त्वा
verses.translation: To thee the rapture-giving juice is offered, whose first draught, God, thou takest as thy portion.
verses.hindi: हम इन्द्र-जितेन्द्रिय ओर वायुचक्रियाशील बनकर सोम की रक्षा करनेवाले वनें। यही मधुरतम कामना हे। इस मधुर इच्छावाले हम ' मधुच्छन्दा ' वनते है। १. गत मन्त्र में ' मधुच्छन्दा "= माधुर्य -ही - माधुर्य को अपनानेवाला, सभी का स्नेही (मित्र) तथा किसीसे भी द्वेष न करनेवाला (वरुण) बनता है। यही प्रभु का सच्चा स्तवन
verses.transliteration: ā vāyo bhūṣa śucipā upa naḥ sahasraṃ te niyuto viśvavāra | upo te andho madyamayāmi yasya deva dadhiṣe pūrvapeyaṃ vāyave tvā
verses.wordMeaning: To thee the rapture-giving juice is offered, whose first draught, God, thou takest as thy portion.
verses.commentary: Sense: To thee the rapture-giving juice is offered, whose first draught, God, thou takest as thy portion.

verses.sanskrit:
इन्द्र॑वायू इ॒मे सु॒ता उप॒ प्रयो॑भि॒राग॑तम् । इन्द॑वो वामु॒शन्ति॒ हि ।
उ॒प॒या॒मगृ॑हीतोऽसि वा॒यव॑ इन्द्रवा॒युभ्यां॑ त्वै॒ष ते॒ योनि॑: स॒जोषो॑भ्यां त्वा
verses.translation: These, Indra-Vâyu! have been shed; come for our offered dainties’ sake: The drops are yearning for you both. Taken upon a base art thou. For Vâyu, Indra-Vâyu, thee. This is thy home. Thee for the close-knit friends.
verses.hindi: हम सबके साथ स्नेह करनेवाले, द्वेष से सदा दूर रहनेवाले बनकर सच्चे प्रभुभक्त बनें ओर प्रसन्नचित्त होकर सोमरक्षा में समर्थ हो। राया वयस॑सवाश्श्सों मदेम ह॒व्येन॑ देवा यव॑सेन गाव॑ः। तां धेनुं सिंत्रावरुणा १. पिछले मन्त्र कौ भावना के अनुसार जब हम सचमुच मित्र व वरूण बनकर प्रभु
verses.transliteration: indravāyū ime sutā upa prayobhirāgatam | indavo vāmuśanti hi | upayāmagṛhīto'si vāyava indravāyubhyāṃ tvaiṣa te yoni: sajoṣobhyāṃ tvā
verses.wordMeaning: These, Indra-Vâyu! have been shed; come for our offered dainties’ sake: The drops are yearning for you both. Taken upon a base art thou. For Vâyu, Indra-Vâyu, thee. This is thy home. Thee for the close-knit friends.
verses.commentary: Sense: These, Indra-Vâyu! have been shed; come for our offered dainties’ sake: The drops are yearning for you both. Taken upon a base art thou. For Vâyu, Indra-Vâyu, thee. This is thy home. Thee for the close-knit friends.

verses.sanskrit: अ॒यं वां॑ मित्रावरुणा सु॒तः सोम॑ ऋतावृधा । ममेदि॒ह श्रु॑त॒j हव॑म् । उ॒प॒या॒मगृ॑हीतोऽसि मि॒त्रावरु॑णाभ्यां त्वा
verses.translation: This Soma hath been shed for you, Law-strengtheners, Mitra-Varuna! Here listen ye to this my call. Taken upon a base art thou. For Mitra thee, for Varuna.
verses.hindi: हम सोमरक्षा द्वारा वाणी को मधुर बना्एँ। हमारे यज्ञ मधुर वाणी से सम्मत्त दोहसे धुनिमाशुं जय॑न्तमनु यासु वध॑से। '्डपयामगुंहतो ऽसि शण्डाय त्वैष ते योनिंवीरतौ पाद्यपमृष्टः शण्डो देवास्त्वां शुक्रपाः प्रण॑यन्त्वनाधृष्टासि।। ९२॥ १. गत मन्त्र की भावना के अनुसार पूर्ण मधुर जीवन बनाने के लिए कहते है कि
verses.transliteration: ayaṃ vāṃ mitrāvaruṇā sutaḥ soma ṛtāvṛdhā | mamediha śrutaj havam | upayāmagṛhīto'si mitrāvaruṇābhyāṃ tvā
verses.wordMeaning: This Soma hath been shed for you, Law-strengtheners, Mitra-Varuna! Here listen ye to this my call. Taken upon a base art thou. For Mitra thee, for Varuna.
verses.commentary: Sense: This Soma hath been shed for you, Law-strengtheners, Mitra-Varuna! Here listen ye to this my call. Taken upon a base art thou. For Mitra thee, for Varuna.

verses.sanskrit:
रा॒या व॒यᳪ स॑स॒वाᳪसो॑ मदेम ह॒व्येन॑ दे॒वा यव॑सेन॒ गाव॑: ।
तां धे॒नुं मि॑त्रावरुणा यु॒वं नो॑  वि॒श्वाहा॑ धत्त॒मन॑पस्फ़ुरन्तीमे॒ष ते॒ योनि॑रृता॒युभ्यां॑ त्वा
verses.translation: May we, possessing much, delight in riches, Gods in oblation, and the kine in pasture; And that Milch-cow who shrinks not from the milking, O Indra-Varuna, give to us daily. This is thy home. Thee for the righteous Twain.
verses.hindi: हम योगक्रियाओं द्वारा सोम कौ रक्षा करे। सुरक्षित सोम से हमारी वीरता वदे ओर हम वासनाओं से धर्षित न हों। १. गत मन्त्र की भावना के अनुसार अपने में वीरता का पूरण करनेवाला सुवीरः = उत्तम वीर वीरान् (५५५९७. उत्कृष्टगुणान्-द०) उत्तम गुणो को प्रजनयन् अपने में विकसित
verses.transliteration: rāyā vaya sasavāso madema havyena devā yavasena gāva: | tāṃ dhenuṃ mitrāvaruṇā yuvaṃ no viśvāhā dhattamanapasfurantīmeṣa te yonirṛtāyubhyāṃ tvā
verses.wordMeaning: May we, possessing much, delight in riches, Gods in oblation, and the kine in pasture; And that Milch-cow who shrinks not from the milking, O Indra-Varuna, give to us daily. This is thy home. Thee for the righteous Twain.
verses.commentary: Sense: May we, possessing much, delight in riches, Gods in oblation, and the kine in pasture; And that Milch-cow who shrinks not from the milking, O Indra-Varuna, give to us daily. This is thy home. Thee for the righteous Twain.

verses.sanskrit: या वां॒ कशा॒ मधु॑म॒त्यश्वि॑ना सू॒नृता॑वती । तया॑ य॒ज्ञं मि॑मिक्षतम् । उ॒प॒या॒मगृ॑हीतोऽस्य॒श्विभ्यां॑ त्वै॒ष ते॒ योनि॒र्माध्वी॑भ्यां त्वा
verses.translation: Distilling honey is your whip, Asvins, and full of pleasantness: Sprinkle therewith the sacrifice. Taken upon a base art thou. Thee for the Asvins. This is thy home. Thee for the Honey-lovers.
verses.hindi: ९. वीर्यरक्षा से वीर बनकर मनुष्य अपने में सद्गुणो का पोषण करता है २. धन की वृद्धि करके यज्ञशील बनता है। ३. देदीप्यमान मस्तिष्क व विस्तृत शक्तिवाले शरीर को प्राप्त करता है। ४. सब मालिन्यां से दूर होता है ओर ५. शमादि गुणों से युक्त होता हे। अच्छिन्नस्य ते देव सोम सुवीर्यस्य रायस्पोष॑स्य ददितारः स्याम।
verses.transliteration: yā vāṃ kaśā madhumatyaśvinā sūnṛtāvatī | tayā yajñaṃ mimikṣatam | upayāmagṛhīto'syaśvibhyāṃ tvaiṣa te yonirmādhvībhyāṃ tvā
verses.wordMeaning: Distilling honey is your whip, Asvins, and full of pleasantness: Sprinkle therewith the sacrifice. Taken upon a base art thou. Thee for the Asvins. This is thy home. Thee for the Honey-lovers.
verses.commentary: Sense: Distilling honey is your whip, Asvins, and full of pleasantness: Sprinkle therewith the sacrifice. Taken upon a base art thou. Thee for the Asvins. This is thy home. Thee for the Honey-lovers.

verses.sanskrit:
तं प्र॒त्नथा॑ पू॒र्वथा॑ वि॒श्वथे॒मथा॑ ज्येष्ठ॒ता॑तिं बर्हि॒षद॑ᳪ स्व॒र्विद॑म् । प्र॒ती॒ची॒नं वृ॒जनं॑ दोहसे॒ धुनि॑मा॒शुं जय॑न्त॒मनु॒ यासु॒ वर्ध॑से ।
उ॒प॒या॒मगृ॑हीतोऽसि॒ शण्डा॑य त्वै॒ष ते॒ योनि॑र्वी॒रतां॑ पा॒ह्यप॑मृष्ट॒: शण्डो॑ दे॒वास्त्वा॑ शुक्र॒पाः प्र ण॑य॒न्त्वना॑धृष्टाऽसि
verses.translation: Thou in the first old time, as all were wont, so now drawest from him, light-finder, throned on sacred grass, Preeminence and strength, from him turned hither, swift, roaring, who winneth those whereby thou waxest strong. Taken upon a base art thou. Thee for Sanda. This is thy home. Protect thou manly power. Sanda hath been removed, may Deities who drink the pure libation lead thee forward. Invincible art thou.
verses.hindi: मेधावी पुरूष ज्ञान को अपना आच्छादन बनाता है। यह अपने जीवन में शान्ति व शक्ति का मिश्रण करता है। ज्ञानी इसे प्रेम से ज्ञान प्राप्त कराते दे ओर यह गतिशील बनकर प्रभु का उपासक होता हुआ यम-नियमो का पालन करता है। प्रजाः पाह्यप॑मृष्टो मरको" देवास्त्वां मन्धिपाः प्रण॑यन्त्वनाधृष्टासि।। ९७॥
verses.transliteration: taṃ pratnathā pūrvathā viśvathemathā jyeṣṭhatātiṃ barhiṣada svarvidam | pratīcīnaṃ vṛjanaṃ dohase dhunimāśuṃ jayantamanu yāsu vardhase | upayāmagṛhīto'si śaṇḍāya tvaiṣa te yonirvīratāṃ pāhyapamṛṣṭa: śaṇḍo devāstvā śukrapāḥ pra ṇayantvanādhṛṣṭā'si
verses.wordMeaning: Thou in the first old time, as all were wont, so now drawest from him, light-finder, throned on sacred grass, Preeminence and strength, from him turned hither, swift, roaring, who winneth those whereby thou waxest strong. Taken upon a base art thou. Thee for Sanda.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Thou in the first old time, as all were wont, so now drawest from him, light-finder, throned on sacred grass, Preeminence and strength, from him turned hither, swift, roaring, who winneth those whereby thou waxest strong. Taken upon a base art thou. Thee for Sanda.…

verses.sanskrit:
सु॒वीरो॑ वी॒रान्  प्र॑ज॒नय॒न्  परी॑ह्य॒भि रा॒यस्पोषे॑ण॒ यज॑मानम् ।
स॒ञ्ज॒ग्मा॒नो दि॒वा पृ॑थि॒व्या शु॒क्रः शु॒क्रशो॑चिषा॒  निर॑स्त॒: शण्ड॑: शु॒क्रस्या॑धि॒ष्ठान॑मसि
verses.translation: Well stored with heroes and begetting heroes, with growth of wealth surround the Sacrificer. The Bright, conjoined with Heaven and with Earth, with the brightly-shining one. Expelled is Sanda. Thou art Sukra's dwelling.
verses.hindi: प्रभु-उपासना से मन शान्त होता है। जीवन शुद्ध होता है। यह शुक्रशक्ति अपराजेय है। इसकी रक्षा से ही शरीर निर्दोष होता हे। मन्थी मन्थिशोचिषा निरस्तो मर्को व्मन्थिनों ऽ धिष्ठान॑मसि।। ९८॥ १. गत मन्त्र का मनोविजेता सुप्रजाः =उत्तम प्रजाओंवाला होता है। यह प्रजाः =प्रजा ओं
verses.transliteration: suvīro vīrān prajanayan parīhyabhi rāyaspoṣeṇa yajamānam | sañjagmāno divā pṛthivyā śukraḥ śukraśociṣā nirasta: śaṇḍa: śukrasyādhiṣṭhānamasi
verses.wordMeaning: Well stored with heroes and begetting heroes, with growth of wealth surround the Sacrificer. The Bright, conjoined with Heaven and with Earth, with the brightly-shining one. Expelled is Sanda. Thou art Sukra's dwelling.
verses.commentary: Sense: Well stored with heroes and begetting heroes, with growth of wealth surround the Sacrificer. The Bright, conjoined with Heaven and with Earth, with the brightly-shining one. Expelled is Sanda. Thou art Sukra's dwelling.

verses.sanskrit:
अच्छि॑न्नस्य ते देव सोम सु॒वीर्य॑स्य रा॒यस्पोष॑स्य ददि॒तार॑: स्याम ।
सा प्र॑थ॒मा सँस्कृ॑तिर्वि॒श्ववा॑रा॒ स प्र॑थ॒मो वरु॑णो मि॒त्रो अ॒ग्निः
verses.translation: May we, O radiant Soma, be the keepers of thine uninjured strength and growth of riches. This is the first all-bounteous Consecration: he the first, Varuna, Mitra, and Agni.
verses.hindi: वीर्यरक्षा से मनुष्य 'सुप्रजाः' होता है, स्वस्थ व ज्ञानी बनकर प्रभु को प्राप्त करनेवाला होता है, निर्दोष शरीरवाला बनता हे। ये देवासो दिव्येकादश स्थ पुंथिव्यामध्येकादश्ञा स्थ। अप्सुक्षितो महिनैकादश स्थ ते देवासो यज्ञमिमं जुंषध्वम्।। ९९॥
verses.transliteration: acchinnasya te deva soma suvīryasya rāyaspoṣasya daditāra: syāma | sā prathamā sa~skṛtirviśvavārā sa prathamo varuṇo mitro agniḥ
verses.wordMeaning: May we, O radiant Soma, be the keepers of thine uninjured strength and growth of riches. This is the first all-bounteous Consecration: he the first, Varuna, Mitra, and Agni.
verses.commentary: Sense: May we, O radiant Soma, be the keepers of thine uninjured strength and growth of riches. This is the first all-bounteous Consecration: he the first, Varuna, Mitra, and Agni.

verses.sanskrit:
स प्र॑थ॒मो बृह॒स्पति॑श्चिकि॒त्वाँस्तस्मा॒ इन्द्रा॑य सु॒तमा जु॑होत॒ स्वाहा॑ ।
तृ॒म्पन्तु॒ होत्रा॒ मध्वो॒ याः स्वि॑ष्टा॒ याः सुप्री॑ता॒: सुहु॑ता॒ यत्स्वाहा  ऽया॑ड॒ग्नीत्
verses.translation: He is the first Brihaspati, the Prudent. Offer ye juice with Svâhâ! to that Indra. Content be priestly offices, those with good sacrifice of meath, those that are pleased when they have gained fair offerings with the solemn Hail! The Kindler of the Fire hath sacrificed.
verses.hindi: मेरा जीवन यज्ञरूप हो। यह देवों का आश्रम बने ओर प्रभु को प्राप्त उपयामगृहीतो ऽ स्याग्रद्यणोऽसि स्त्राग्रयणः। पाहि यज्ञं पाहि य॒ज्ञप॑तिं १. गत मन्त्र के तेतीस देवों का अधिष्ठान बननेवाले व्यक्ति के लिए कहते है कि तू उपयामगृहीतः असि =प्रभु-उपासना के द्वारा यम-नियमों को धारण करनेवाला बना हे।
verses.transliteration: sa prathamo bṛhaspatiścikitvā~stasmā indrāya sutamā juhota svāhā | tṛmpantu hotrā madhvo yāḥ sviṣṭā yāḥ suprītā: suhutā yatsvāhā 'yāḍagnīt
verses.wordMeaning: He is the first Brihaspati, the Prudent. Offer ye juice with Svâhâ! to that Indra. Content be priestly offices, those with good sacrifice of meath, those that are pleased when they have gained fair offerings with the solemn Hail! The Kindler of the Fire hath sacrificed.
verses.commentary: Sense: He is the first Brihaspati, the Prudent. Offer ye juice with Svâhâ! to that Indra. Content be priestly offices, those with good sacrifice of meath, those that are pleased when they have gained fair offerings with the solemn Hail! The Kindler of the Fire hath sacrificed.

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒यं वे॒नश्चो॑दय॒त्पृश्नि॑गर्भा॒ ज्योति॑र्जरायू॒ रज॑सो वि॒माने॑ ।
इ॒मम॒पाᳪ सं॑ग॒मे सूर्य॑स्य॒ शिशुं॒ न विप्रा॑ म॒तिभी॑ रिहन्ति ।
उ॒प॒या॒मगृ॑हीतोऽसि॒ मर्का॑य त्वा
verses.translation: See, Vena, born in light hath driven hither on chariot of the air the calves of Prisni. Singers with hymns caress him as an infant there where the waters and the sunlight mingle. Taken upon a base art thou. Thee for Marka.
verses.hindi: हमारा जीवन यज्ञमय हो, परन्तु हमें उन यज्ञो का गर्व न हो जाए। "प्रभु ही सब यज्ञो के पति हँ" इस बात को हम भूलें नही। १. गत मन्त्र कौ मुख्य भावना यह है कि प्रभु ही सब यज्ञं के पति हे। वस्तुतः जीव से समय-समय पर किये जानेवाले सब यज्ञो को करने की शक्ति उसे प्रभु ही देते
verses.transliteration: ayaṃ venaścodayatpṛśnigarbhā jyotirjarāyū rajaso vimāne | imamapā saṃgame sūryasya śiśuṃ na viprā matibhī rihanti | upayāmagṛhīto'si markāya tvā
verses.wordMeaning: See, Vena, born in light hath driven hither on chariot of the air the calves of Prisni. Singers with hymns caress him as an infant there where the waters and the sunlight mingle. Taken upon a base art thou. Thee for Marka.
verses.commentary: Sense: See, Vena, born in light hath driven hither on chariot of the air the calves of Prisni. Singers with hymns caress him as an infant there where the waters and the sunlight mingle. Taken upon a base art thou. Thee for Marka.

verses.sanskrit:
मनो॒ न येषु॒ हव॑नेषु ति॒ग्मं विप॒: शच्या॑ वनु॒थो द्रव॑न्ता ।
आ यः शर्या॑भिस्तुविनृ॒म्णो अ॒स्याश्री॑णीता॒दिशं॒ गभ॑स्तावे॒ष ते॒ योनि॑: प्र॒जाः
पा॒ह्यप॑मृष्टो॒ मर्को॑  दे॒वास्त्वा॑ मन्थि॒पाः प्र ण॑य॒न्त्वना॑धृष्टासि
verses.translation: To his oblation, swift as thought ye hurried and welcomed eagerly the prayers he offered. With arrows in his hand the Very Mighty forced from him all obedience of a servant. This is thy dwelling-place. Protect the people. Marka hath been removed. Gods, drinkers of the Man thin, lead thee forward! Invincible art thou.
verses.hindi: शरीर के अन्दर जलों व ओषधियों से उत्पन्न वीर्य ‹ स्ान-बल-एेश्वर्य' को दानेवाला होता है। यह शरीर व मस्तिष्क दोनों को सुन्दर बनाता हुआ सब दिव्य गुणों देवेभ्यस्त्वा देवाव्यं यज्ञस्यायुषे गृह्णामि।। २२॥ ९. गत मन्त्र मे जलों व ओषधियों से उत्पन्न सोम का वर्णन था। उसी का उल्लेख
verses.transliteration: mano na yeṣu havaneṣu tigmaṃ vipa: śacyā vanutho dravantā | ā yaḥ śaryābhistuvinṛmṇo asyāśrīṇītādiśaṃ gabhastāveṣa te yoni: prajāḥ pāhyapamṛṣṭo marko devāstvā manthipāḥ pra ṇayantvanādhṛṣṭāsi
verses.wordMeaning: To his oblation, swift as thought ye hurried and welcomed eagerly the prayers he offered. With arrows in his hand the Very Mighty forced from him all obedience of a servant. This is thy dwelling-place. Protect the people. Marka hath been removed. Gods, drinkers of the Man thin,…
verses.commentary: Sense: To his oblation, swift as thought ye hurried and welcomed eagerly the prayers he offered. With arrows in his hand the Very Mighty forced from him all obedience of a servant. This is thy dwelling-place. Protect the people. Marka hath been removed. Gods, drinkers of the Man thin,…

verses.sanskrit:
सु॒प्र॒जाः प्र॒जाः प्र॑ज॒नय॒न्  परी॑ह्य॒भि रा॒यस्पोषे॑ण॒ यज॑मानम् ।
स॒ञ्ज॒ग्मा॒नो दि॒वा पृ॑थि॒व्या म॒न्थी म॒न्थिशो॑चिषा निर॑स्तो॒ मर्को॑  म॒न्थिनो॑ऽधि॒ष्ठान॑मसि
verses.translation: Well stored with people and begetting people, with growth of wealth surround the Sacrificer. The Manthin joined with Heaven and Earth and with the Manthin-shining one. Expelled is Marka. Thou art Manthin's dwelling.
verses.hindi: सोमरक्षा के द्वारा मेरा जीवन दिव्य व यज्ञमय बनता है। ष्मित्रावरूणाभ्यां त्वा देवाव्यं यज्ञस्यायुषे गृह्णामीन्द्रौय त्वा देवाव्यं यज्ञस्यायुषे गृह्णामीचद्राग्निभ्यौ त्वा देवाव्यं यज्ञस्यायुषे गृह्णामीन््रावस णाभ्यां त्वा देवाव्यं यज्ञस्यायुषे गृह्णामीभद्रावृहस्पतिंभ्यां त्वा देवाव्यं यज्ञस्यायुषे गृह्णामीन्द्राविष्णभ्यां त्वा देवां
verses.transliteration: suprajāḥ prajāḥ prajanayan parīhyabhi rāyaspoṣeṇa yajamānam | sañjagmāno divā pṛthivyā manthī manthiśociṣā nirasto marko manthino'dhiṣṭhānamasi
verses.wordMeaning: Well stored with people and begetting people, with growth of wealth surround the Sacrificer. The Manthin joined with Heaven and Earth and with the Manthin-shining one. Expelled is Marka. Thou art Manthin's dwelling.
verses.commentary: Sense: Well stored with people and begetting people, with growth of wealth surround the Sacrificer. The Manthin joined with Heaven and Earth and with the Manthin-shining one. Expelled is Marka. Thou art Manthin's dwelling.

verses.sanskrit:
ये दे॑वासो दि॒व्येका॑दश॒ स्थ पृ॑थि॒व्यामध्येका॑दश॒ स्थ ।
अ॒प्सु॒क्षितो॑ महि॒नैका॑दश॒ स्थ ते दे॑वासो य॒ज्ञमि॒मं जु॑षध्वम्
verses.translation: O ye eleven Gods whose home is heaven, O ye eleven who make earth your dwelling. Ye who with might, eleven, live in waters, accept this sacrifice, Ye Gods, with pleasure.
verses.hindi: हम सोमरक्षा के द्वारा " अग्नि-वरुण- वृहस्पति व विष्णु ' वनें। हममें इन्द्रशक्ति का विकास हो। हम सोम कौ रक्षा करनेवाले ' अवत्सार' बने। कविर्सम्राजमतिंथि जनानामासन्ना पात्रं जनयन्त देवाः।। २४॥ पिछले मन्त्रों का ऋषि " अवत्सार' सोम की रक्षा करने के द्वारा ' भरद्वाज '=अपने में
verses.transliteration: ye devāso divyekādaśa stha pṛthivyāmadhyekādaśa stha | apsukṣito mahinaikādaśa stha te devāso yajñamimaṃ juṣadhvam
verses.wordMeaning: O ye eleven Gods whose home is heaven, O ye eleven who make earth your dwelling. Ye who with might, eleven, live in waters, accept this sacrifice, Ye Gods, with pleasure.
verses.commentary: Sense: O ye eleven Gods whose home is heaven, O ye eleven who make earth your dwelling. Ye who with might, eleven, live in waters, accept this sacrifice, Ye Gods, with pleasure.

verses.sanskrit:
उ॒प॒या॒मगृ॑हीतोऽस्याग्रय॒णो॒ऽसि॒ स्वा॒ग्रयणः ।
पा॒हि य॒ज्ञं पा॒हि य॒ज्ञप॑तिं॒ विष्णु॒स्त्वामि॑न्द्रि॒येण॑ पातु॒ विष्णुं॒ त्वं पा॑ह्य॒भि सव॑नानि पाहि
verses.translation: Taken upon a base art thou. Thou art Âgrayana, good first libation. Be thou the guard of sacrifice: protect the sacrifice's lord. Vishnu with might protect thee. Guard thou Vishnu. Guard on all sides the Soma sacrifices.
verses.hindi: सोमरक्षा के द्वारा हम स्वयं ज्ञान के शिखर पर पदहँचें तथा ओरो को यह ज्ञान देकर उनकी रक्षा करनेवाले बनें। भरद्वाज का प्रभुभजन (उपासना व प्रेम) इद्विशो।ऽ सपत्नाः सम॑नसस्करंत्।। २५५॥ +
verses.transliteration: upayāmagṛhīto'syāgrayaṇo'si svāgrayaṇaḥ | pāhi yajñaṃ pāhi yajñapatiṃ viṣṇustvāmindriyeṇa pātu viṣṇuṃ tvaṃ pāhyabhi savanāni pāhi
verses.wordMeaning: Taken upon a base art thou. Thou art Âgrayana, good first libation. Be thou the guard of sacrifice: protect the sacrifice's lord. Vishnu with might protect thee. Guard thou Vishnu. Guard on all sides the Soma sacrifices.
verses.commentary: Sense: Taken upon a base art thou. Thou art Âgrayana, good first libation. Be thou the guard of sacrifice: protect the sacrifice's lord. Vishnu with might protect thee. Guard thou Vishnu. Guard on all sides the Soma sacrifices.

verses.sanskrit:
सोम॑: पवते॒ सोम॑: पवते॒ऽस्मै॒ ब्रह्म॑णे॒ऽस्मै क्ष॒त्राया॒स्मै सु॑न्व॒ते यज॑मानाय पवत इ॒ष ऊ॒र्जे
प॑वते॒ऽद्भ्य  ओष॑धीभ्यः पवते॒ द्यावा॑पृथि॒वीभ्यां॑ पवते सुभू॒ताय॑ पवते॒ विश्वे॑भ्यस्त्वा दे॒वेभ्य॑
ए॒ष ते॒ योनि॒र्विश्वे॑भ्यस्त्वा दे॒वेभ्य॑:
verses.translation: Soma flows pure, Soma flows pure for this Priesthood, for the Nobility, pure for the worshipper who presses out the juice, flows pure for food and energy, for waters and for plants; flows pure for general prosperity. Thee for the Universal Gods. This is thy home. Thee for the Universal Gods.
verses.hindi: प्रभु यम-नियमों के पालन से गृहीत होते हैँ। उस ध्रुवो में धुव प्रभु को हम ध्रुव मनसे ही प्राप्त कर सकते है। उस प्रभु का हदय में प्रकाश होने पर सब वैरभाव समाप्त हो जाते है ओर प्रेम का प्रसार होता है। एवं, प्रस्तुत मन्त्र मे ९. प्रभु के स्वरूप का क है, २. प्रभु-प्राप्ति के उपाय का वर्णन हे, ३. ओर प्रभु-प्राप्ति के लाभोंका
verses.transliteration: soma: pavate soma: pavate'smai brahmaṇe'smai kṣatrāyāsmai sunvate yajamānāya pavata iṣa ūrje pavate'dbhya oṣadhībhyaḥ pavate dyāvāpṛthivībhyāṃ pavate subhūtāya pavate viśvebhyastvā devebhya eṣa te yonirviśvebhyastvā devebhya:
verses.wordMeaning: Soma flows pure, Soma flows pure for this Priesthood, for the Nobility, pure for the worshipper who presses out the juice, flows pure for food and energy, for waters and for plants; flows pure for general prosperity. Thee for the Universal Gods. This is thy home.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Soma flows pure, Soma flows pure for this Priesthood, for the Nobility, pure for the worshipper who presses out the juice, flows pure for food and energy, for waters and for plants; flows pure for general prosperity. Thee for the Universal Gods. This is thy home.…

verses.sanskrit:
उ॒प॒या॒मगृ॑हीतो॒ऽसीन्द्रा॑य त्वा बृ॒हद्व॑ते॒ वय॑स्वत उक्था॒व्यं॒ गृह्णामि । यत्त॑ इन्द्र बृ॒हद्वय॒स्तस्मै॑ त्वा॒ विष्ण॑वे त्वै॒ष ते॒ योनि॑रु॒क्थेभ्य॑स्त्वा
दे॒वेभ्य॑स्त्वा देवा॒व्यं॒  य॒ज्ञस्यायु॑षे गृह्णामि
verses.translation: Taken upon a base art thou. For Indra Lord of the Brihat, strong with vital vigour, I take thee lover of the invocation. Indra, what mighty vigour thou possessest, for that do I take thee, take thee for Vishnu This is thy home. Thee for the recitations. For the Gods take I thee, the Gods’ protector; yea, for the sacrifice's life I take thee.
verses.hindi: सोम ' प्राण-व्यान-उदान-वाणी-प्रज्ञा ओर बल-श्रोत्र व चक्षु' को वर्चस् आत्मन मे वर्चोदा वर्चसे पवस्वौज॑से मे वर्चोदा वर्चसे पवस्वायुंषे मे वर्चोदा वर्चसे पवस्व विश्वाभ्यो मे प्रजाभ्यो वर्योदसौ वर्चसे पवेथाम्।। २८॥ १. है सोम! मे आत्मने=मेरे मन के लिए तू वर्चोदाः=वर्चस् देनेवाला है। तू
verses.transliteration: upayāmagṛhīto'sīndrāya tvā bṛhadvate vayasvata ukthāvyaṃ gṛhṇāmi | yatta indra bṛhadvayastasmai tvā viṣṇave tvaiṣa te yonirukthebhyastvā devebhyastvā devāvyaṃ yajñasyāyuṣe gṛhṇāmi
verses.wordMeaning: Taken upon a base art thou. For Indra Lord of the Brihat, strong with vital vigour, I take thee lover of the invocation. Indra, what mighty vigour thou possessest, for that do I take thee, take thee for Vishnu This is thy home. Thee for the recitations.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Taken upon a base art thou. For Indra Lord of the Brihat, strong with vital vigour, I take thee lover of the invocation. Indra, what mighty vigour thou possessest, for that do I take thee, take thee for Vishnu This is thy home. Thee for the recitations.…

verses.sanskrit: मि॒त्रावरु॑णाभ्यां त्वा देवा॒व्यं॒ य॒ज्ञस्यायु॑षे गृह्णा॒मीन्द्रा॑य त्वा देवा॒व्यं॒ य॒ज्ञस्यायु॑षे गृह्णा॒मीन्द्रा॒ग्निभ्यां॑ त्वा देवा॒व्यं॒ य॒ज्ञस्यायु॑षे गृह्णा॒मीन्द्रा॒वरु॑णाभ्यां त्वा देवा॒व्यं॒ य॒ज्ञस्यायु॑षे गृह्णा॒मीन्द्रा॒बृह॒स्पति॑भ्यां त्वा देवा॒व्यं॒ य॒ज्ञस्यायु॑षे गृह्णा॒मीन्द्रा॒विष्णु॑भ्यां त्वा देवा॒व्यं॒ य॒ज्ञस्यायु॑षे गृह्णामि
verses.translation: For Mitra-Varuna thee, the Gods protector, yea, for the sacrifice's life I take thee. For Indra, thee, etc. For Indra-Agni, thee, etc. For Indra- Varuna, thee, etc. For Indra-Brihaspati thee, etc. For Indra-Vishnu thee, etc.
verses.hindi: सोम की रक्षा से मन बलवान् होता हे, शरीर के अङ्क -प्रत्यज्खं को बदानेवाली शक्ति पुष्ट होती है, जीवन स्फूर्तिमय बनता है ओर सब शक्तियों का विकास होता है। शारीरिक, मानस व बौद्धिक-विकास का मूल यह सोम ही है। देवश्रवा का प्रभुस्तवन
verses.transliteration: mitrāvaruṇābhyāṃ tvā devāvyaṃ yajñasyāyuṣe gṛhṇāmīndrāya tvā devāvyaṃ yajñasyāyuṣe gṛhṇāmīndrāgnibhyāṃ tvā devāvyaṃ yajñasyāyuṣe gṛhṇāmīndrāvaruṇābhyāṃ tvā devāvyaṃ yajñasyāyuṣe gṛhṇāmīndrābṛhaspatibhyāṃ tvā devāvyaṃ yajñasyāyuṣe gṛhṇāmīndrāviṣṇubhyāṃ tvā devāvyaṃ yajñasyāyuṣe gṛhṇāmi
verses.wordMeaning: For Mitra-Varuna thee, the Gods protector, yea, for the sacrifice's life I take thee. For Indra, thee, etc. For Indra-Agni, thee, etc. For Indra- Varuna, thee, etc. For Indra-Brihaspati thee, etc. For Indra-Vishnu thee, etc.
verses.commentary: Sense: For Mitra-Varuna thee, the Gods protector, yea, for the sacrifice's life I take thee. For Indra, thee, etc. For Indra-Agni, thee, etc. For Indra- Varuna, thee, etc. For Indra-Brihaspati thee, etc. For Indra-Vishnu thee, etc.

verses.sanskrit:
मू॒र्धानं॑ दि॒वो अ॑र॒तिं पृ॑थि॒व्या वै॑श्वान॒रमृ॒त आ जा॒तम॒ग्निम् ।
क॒विᳪ  स॒म्राज॒मति॑थिं॒ जना॑नामा॒सन्ना पात्रं॑ जनयन्त दे॒वाः
verses.translation: Him, messenger of earth and head of heaven, Agni Vaisvânara , born in holy Order, The Sage, the King, the Guest of men, a vessel fit for their mouths, the Gods have generated.
verses.hindi: आनन्दमय प्रभु कौ उपासना हम “ मनःप्रसाद' को सिद्ध करके ही कर सकते हं। प्रभु-उपासन से सोमरक्षा होती है। सोमरक्षा से प्रभु का प्रीणन होता है। हम स्वस्थ, ज्ञानी व जितेन्द्रिय बनते हैँ। उत्तम प्रजावाले, वीर व उत्तम धनोंवाले होते हे। बारह मास प्रभु-चिन्तन ५
verses.transliteration: mūrdhānaṃ divo aratiṃ pṛthivyā vaiśvānaramṛta ā jātamagnim | kavi samrājamatithiṃ janānāmāsannā pātraṃ janayanta devāḥ
verses.wordMeaning: Him, messenger of earth and head of heaven, Agni Vaisvânara , born in holy Order, The Sage, the King, the Guest of men, a vessel fit for their mouths, the Gods have generated.
verses.commentary: Sense: Him, messenger of earth and head of heaven, Agni Vaisvânara , born in holy Order, The Sage, the King, the Guest of men, a vessel fit for their mouths, the Gods have generated.

verses.sanskrit:
उ॒प॒या॒मगृ॑हीतोऽसि ध्रु॒वो॒ऽसि ध्रु॒वक्षि॑तिर्ध्रु॒वाणां॑ ध्रु॒वत॒मोऽच्यु॑तानामच्युत॒क्षित्त॑म
ए॒ष ते॒ योनि॑र्वैश्वान॒राय॑ त्वा । ध्रु॒वं ध्रु॒वेण॒ मन॑सा वा॒चा सोम॒मव॑ नयामि ।
अथा॑ न॒ इन्द्र॒ इद्विशो॑ऽसप॒त्नाः सम॑नस॒स्कर॑त्
verses.translation: Taken upon a base art thou. Firm, firmly resting, the firmest of the firm, the most securely grounded of those who never have been shaken. This is thy home. Thee for Vaisvânara. I pour forth with firm mind, with voice, firm Soma. So now may Indra verily make our people all of. One heart and mind and free from foemen.
verses.hindi: यदि हम देवश्रवाः=दिव्य गुणों के कारण कीर्तिवाले बनना चाहते है तो हम वर्ष के सभी मासो में प्रभु का स्मरण करनेवाले बनें। यह स्मरण हमें दिव्य गुणों को धारण करनेवाला बनाएगा। हमारे जीवन में " माधुर्य, लक्ष्मी , क्रियाशीलता, शुचिता, असुर- संहार , अपशब्दराहित्य, प्रभु-प्रेरणा श्रवण, बल व प्राणशक्ति, सहनशक्ति, उत्तम बल, तप, मर्यादा
verses.transliteration: upayāmagṛhīto'si dhruvo'si dhruvakṣitirdhruvāṇāṃ dhruvatamo'cyutānāmacyutakṣittama eṣa te yonirvaiśvānarāya tvā | dhruvaṃ dhruveṇa manasā vācā somamava nayāmi | athā na indra idviśo'sapatnāḥ samanasaskarat
verses.wordMeaning: Taken upon a base art thou. Firm, firmly resting, the firmest of the firm, the most securely grounded of those who never have been shaken. This is thy home. Thee for Vaisvânara. I pour forth with firm mind, with voice, firm Soma. So now may Indra verily make our people all of.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Taken upon a base art thou. Firm, firmly resting, the firmest of the firm, the most securely grounded of those who never have been shaken. This is thy home. Thee for Vaisvânara. I pour forth with firm mind, with voice, firm Soma. So now may Indra verily make our people all of.…

verses.sanskrit:
यस्ते॑ द्र॒प्स स्कन्द॑ति॒ यस्ते॑ अ॒jशुर्ग्राव॑च्युतो धि॒षण॑योरु॒पस्था॑त् ।
अ॒ध्व॒र्योर्वा॒ परि॑ वा॒ यः प॒वित्रा॒त्तं ते॑ जु॑होमि॒ मन॑सा॒ वष॑ट्कृत॒j स्वाहा॑  दे॒वाना॑मु॒त्क्रम॑णमसि
verses.translation: Whatever drop of thine leaps forth, whatever stalk from the bowls’ lap, shaken by the press-stone, From the Adhvaryu's hand or from the filter, that, consecrated in my mind with Vashat I offer unto thee with cry of Svâhâ! Thou art the way by which the Gods ascended.
verses.hindi: ज्ञान व स्तुति कौ वाणियों से तथा ज्ञानपूर्वक कर्म करने से हम सोम की रक्षा करे ओर सोमरक्षा द्वारा शक्ति व प्रकाश को प्राप्त करके सबके साथ स्नेह करनेवाले ज्ञा घा येऽअग्निमिन्धते स्तृणन्ति बर्हिरानुषक््। येषामिन्द्रो युवा सखा॑। ९. गत मन्त्र का विश्वामित्र" माधुर्यमय जीवन से शरीर के स्वास्थ्य', 'मन के
verses.transliteration: yaste drapsa skandati yaste ajśurgrāvacyuto dhiṣaṇayorupasthāt | adhvaryorvā pari vā yaḥ pavitrāttaṃ te juhomi manasā vaṣaṭkṛtaj svāhā devānāmutkramaṇamasi
verses.wordMeaning: Whatever drop of thine leaps forth, whatever stalk from the bowls’ lap, shaken by the press-stone, From the Adhvaryu's hand or from the filter, that, consecrated in my mind with Vashat I offer unto thee with cry of Svâhâ! Thou art the way by which the Gods ascended.
verses.commentary: Sense: Whatever drop of thine leaps forth, whatever stalk from the bowls’ lap, shaken by the press-stone, From the Adhvaryu's hand or from the filter, that, consecrated in my mind with Vashat I offer unto thee with cry of Svâhâ! Thou art the way by which the Gods ascended.

verses.sanskrit: प्रा॒णाय॑ मे वर्चो॒दा वर्च॑से पवस्व व्या॒नाय॑ मे वर्चो॒दा वर्च॑से पवस्वोदा॒नाय॑ मे वर्चो॒दा वर्च॑से पवस्व वा॒चे मे॑ वर्चो॒दा वर्च॑से पवस्व॒  क्रतू॒दक्षा॑भ्यां मे वर्चो॒दा वर्च॑से पवस्व॒  श्रोत्रा॑य मे वर्चो॒दा वर्च॑से पवस्व॒ चक्षु॑र्भ्यां मे वर्चो॒दसौ॒ वर्च॑से पवेथाम्
verses.translation: Giver of splendour, grow thou pure for splendour for my outward breath. Giver of splendour, grow thou pure for splendour for my spreading breath. Giver, etc. ... ... ... for my upward breath. Giver, etc. ... ... ... for my power of speech. Giver, etc. ... ... ... for my sense and will. Giver, etc. ... ... ... for my hearing power. Givers of splendor, grow ye pure for splendour for my orbs of sight.
verses.hindi: -(क) मैं अग्निहोत्र करू तथा प्रभु का ध्यान भी। (ख) हदय को वासनाशून्य बनाऊं। (ग) प्रभु की मित्रता को प्राप्त करूं। (घ) इस प्रभु को मित्र बनाकर हम विश्वबन्धुत्व की भावना का आनन्द ले। क्ञओमांसष्चर्षणीधृतो विश्वै देवासऽआग॑त। दाश्वाश्सो दाशुष॑ः सुतम्।
verses.transliteration: prāṇāya me varcodā varcase pavasva vyānāya me varcodā varcase pavasvodānāya me varcodā varcase pavasva vāce me varcodā varcase pavasva kratūdakṣābhyāṃ me varcodā varcase pavasva śrotrāya me varcodā varcase pavasva cakṣurbhyāṃ me varcodasau varcase pavethām
verses.wordMeaning: Giver of splendour, grow thou pure for splendour for my outward breath. Giver of splendour, grow thou pure for splendour for my spreading breath. Giver, etc. ... ... ... for my upward breath. Giver, etc. ... ... ... for my power of speech. Giver, etc. ... ... ...…
verses.commentary: Sense: Giver of splendour, grow thou pure for splendour for my outward breath. Giver of splendour, grow thou pure for splendour for my spreading breath. Giver, etc. ... ... ... for my upward breath. Giver, etc. ... ... ... for my power of speech. Giver, etc. ... ... ...…

verses.sanskrit:
आ॒त्मने॑ मे वर्चो॒दा वर्च॑से पवस्वौज॑से मे वर्चो॒दा वर्च॑से पवस्वायु॑षे मे वर्चो॒दा वर्च॑से पवस्व॒
विश्वा॑भ्यो मे प्र॒जाभ्यो॑ वर्चो॒दसौ॒ वर्च॑से पवेथाम्
verses.translation: Giver of splendour, grow thou pure for splendour for my living self. Giver, etc. ... ... ... for my energy. Giver, etc. ... ... ... for my vital power. Givers of splendour, grow ye pure for splendour for all sprung from me.
verses.hindi: प्रभुकृपा से हम ९. वासनाओं से अपना रक्षण करनेवाले हो। २. मनुष्यो का धारण करनेवाले हों। ३. दिव्य गुणोवाले हों ४. दान कौ वृत्तिवाले हों। ५. दान कौ वृत्तिवाले के धन को प्राप्त हों। ६. इस प्रकार सब दिव्य गु्णोवाले हौ। कविश्वै देवासऽ आग॑त श्रृणुता म॑ इमध्टव॑म्। एदं लर्हिर्निषीदत।
verses.transliteration: ātmane me varcodā varcase pavasvaujase me varcodā varcase pavasvāyuṣe me varcodā varcase pavasva viśvābhyo me prajābhyo varcodasau varcase pavethām
verses.wordMeaning: Giver of splendour, grow thou pure for splendour for my living self. Giver, etc. ... ... ... for my energy. Giver, etc. ... ... ... for my vital power. Givers of splendour, grow ye pure for splendour for all sprung from me.
verses.commentary: Sense: Giver of splendour, grow thou pure for splendour for my living self. Giver, etc. ... ... ... for my energy. Giver, etc. ... ... ... for my vital power. Givers of splendour, grow ye pure for splendour for all sprung from me.

verses.sanskrit: को॑ऽसि कत॒मो॒ऽसि॒ कस्या॑सि॒ को नामा॑सि । यस्य॑ ते॒ नामाम॑न्महि॒ यं त्वा॒ सोमे॑नाती॑तृपाम । भूर्भुव॒: स्व॒: सुप्र॒जाः प्र॒जाभि॑: स्याᳪ सु॒वीरो॑ वी॒रैः सु॒पोष॒: पोषै॑:
verses.translation: Who art thou? Which of all art thou? Whose art thou? Who art thou by name? Even thou on whose name we have meditated, then whom we have delighted with our Soma.
verses.hindi: हम प्रभु के उपासक बनें। सदा प्रसन्न रहे. जिससे सब दिव्य गुणों के पात्र तव॑ शूर शर्मन्नाविंवासन्ति कवय॑ः सुयज्ञाः। ग्डपयामगुदीतो ऽ सीन्द्राय त्वा मरुत्व॑तऽ एष १. " गृत्समद ' प्रभु का स्तवन करता है ओर प्रसन्न रहता है। यह सभी के साथ स्नेह करता है, अतः " विश्वामित्र' बन जाता है। इस विश्वामित्र के लिए कहते हैः कि हे
verses.transliteration: ko'si katamo'si kasyāsi ko nāmāsi | yasya te nāmāmanmahi yaṃ tvā somenātītṛpāma | bhūrbhuva: sva: suprajāḥ prajābhi: syā suvīro vīraiḥ supoṣa: poṣai:
verses.wordMeaning: Who art thou? Which of all art thou? Whose art thou? Who art thou by name? Even thou on whose name we have meditated, then whom we have delighted with our Soma.
verses.commentary: Sense: Who art thou? Which of all art thou? Whose art thou? Who art thou by name? Even thou on whose name we have meditated, then whom we have delighted with our Soma.

verses.sanskrit: उ॒प॒या॒मगृ॑हीतोऽसि॒ मध॑वे त्वोपया॒मगृ॑हीतोऽसि॒ माध॑वाय त्वोपया॒मगृ॑हीतोऽसि शु॒क्राय॑ त्वोपया॒मगृ॑हीतोऽसि॒ शुच॑ये त्वोपया॒मगृ॑हीतोऽसि॒ नभ॑से त्वोपया॒मगृ॑हीतोऽसि नभ॒स्या॒य त्वोपया॒मगृ॑हीतोऽसी॒षे त्वो॑पया॒मगृ॑हीतोऽस्यू॒र्जे त्वोपया॒मगृ॑हीतोऽसि॒ सह॑से त्वोपया॒मगृ॑हीतोऽसि सह॒स्या॒य त्वोपया॒मगृ॑हीतोऽसि॒ तप॑से त्वोपया॒मगृ॑हीतोऽसि तप॒स्या॑य त्वोपया॒मगृ॑हीतोऽस्यᳪहसस्प॒तये॑ त्वा
verses.translation: Taken upon a base art thou. For Madhu thee: Taken upon a base art thou. For Mâdhava thee. Taken, etc. For Sukra thee. Taken, etc. For Suchi thee. Taken, etc. For Nabhas thee. Taken, etc. For Nabhasya thee. Taken, etc. For Food thee. Taken, etc. For Energy thee. Taken, etc. For Sahas thee. Taken, etc. For Sahasya thee. Taken, etc. For Tapas thee. Taken, etc. For Tapasya thee. Taken, etc. For Amhasaspati thee.
verses.hindi: में सोमपान करके मरुत्वान् इन्द्रनप्रकृष्ट प्राणोवाला, जितेन्द्रिय, परमैश्वर्यशाली ‹ म॒रुत्व॑न्तं वृषभं वावृधानमकवारिं दिव्यच्शासमिन्द्र॑म्। विश्वासाहमवसे त्का मरुत्व॑ते। +उपयामगुंहीतो ऽ सि मरुतां त्वौज॑ से।। ३६॥ १. गत मन्त्र में मरुत्वान् इन्द्र ' बनने की कल्पना थी। "यथा राजा तथा प्रजा' इस
verses.transliteration: upayāmagṛhīto'si madhave tvopayāmagṛhīto'si mādhavāya tvopayāmagṛhīto'si śukrāya tvopayāmagṛhīto'si śucaye tvopayāmagṛhīto'si nabhase tvopayāmagṛhīto'si nabhasyāya tvopayāmagṛhīto'sīṣe tvopayāmagṛhīto'syūrje tvopayāmagṛhīto'si sahase tvopayāmagṛhīto'si sahasyāya tvopayāmagṛhīto'si tapase tvopayāmagṛhīto'si tapasyāya tvopayāmagṛhīto'syahasaspataye tvā
verses.wordMeaning: Taken upon a base art thou. For Madhu thee: Taken upon a base art thou. For Mâdhava thee. Taken, etc. For Sukra thee. Taken, etc. For Suchi thee. Taken, etc. For Nabhas thee. Taken, etc. For Nabhasya thee. Taken, etc. For Food thee. Taken, etc. For Energy thee. Taken, etc.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Taken upon a base art thou. For Madhu thee: Taken upon a base art thou. For Mâdhava thee. Taken, etc. For Sukra thee. Taken, etc. For Suchi thee. Taken, etc. For Nabhas thee. Taken, etc. For Nabhasya thee. Taken, etc. For Food thee. Taken, etc. For Energy thee. Taken, etc.…

verses.sanskrit:
इन्द्रा॑ग्नी॒ आ ग॑तᳪ सु॒तं गी॒र्भिर्नभो॒ वरे॑ण्यम् । अ॒स्य पा॑तं धि॒येषि॒ता ।
उ॒प॒या॒मगृ॑हीतोऽसीन्द्रा॒ग्निभ्यां॑ त्वै॒ष ते॒ योनि॑रिन्द्रा॒ग्निभ्यां॑ त्वा
verses.translation: Moved, Indra-Agni, by our hymns, come to the juice, the precious dew. Drink ye thereof, impelled by song. Taken upon a base art thou. For Indra-Agni thee. This is thy dwelling. Thee for Indra-Agni.
verses.hindi: इन्द्र, अर्थात् राजा “ मरुत्वान् ' हो तो प्रजा भी प्राणों के बलवाली होती हे। १. गत मन्त्र के राजा के साथ मिलकर कार्य करनेवाला सेनापति है। राजा ओर सेनापति राष्ट के मुख्य अधिकारी है । आन्तरव्यवस्था का मुख्य दायित्व राजा पर है तो राष्ट की बाह्य शत्नुओं से रक्षा करने के लिए सेनापति ने सेना को सन्नद्ध रखना दहै। यह सेनापति
verses.transliteration: indrāgnī ā gata sutaṃ gīrbhirnabho vareṇyam | asya pātaṃ dhiyeṣitā | upayāmagṛhīto'sīndrāgnibhyāṃ tvaiṣa te yonirindrāgnibhyāṃ tvā
verses.wordMeaning: Moved, Indra-Agni, by our hymns, come to the juice, the precious dew. Drink ye thereof, impelled by song. Taken upon a base art thou. For Indra-Agni thee. This is thy dwelling. Thee for Indra-Agni.
verses.commentary: Sense: Moved, Indra-Agni, by our hymns, come to the juice, the precious dew. Drink ye thereof, impelled by song. Taken upon a base art thou. For Indra-Agni thee. This is thy dwelling. Thee for Indra-Agni.

verses.sanskrit:
आ घा॒ ये अ॒ग्निमि॑न्ध॒ते स्तृ॒णन्ति॑ ब॒र्हिरा॑नु॒षक् । येषा॒मिन्द्रो॒ युवा॒ सखा॑ ।
उ॒प॒या॒मगृ॑हीतोऽस्यग्नी॒न्द्राभ्यां॑ त्वै॒ष  ते॒ योनि॑रग्नी॒न्द्राभ्यां॑ त्वा
verses.translation: Hitherward! they who light the flame and straightway strew the sacred grass, Whose Friend is Indra ever young. Taken upon a base art thou. For Indra-Agni thee. This is thy dwelling. Thee for Indra-Agni.
verses.hindi: राजा की भोति सेनापति भी, प्राणसाधाना करनेवाला जितेन्द्रिय पुरुष हो। यही राष्ट की उत्तमता से रक्षा कर सकेगा। राष्ट में राजा व सेनापति के उत्तम होने पर प्रजा का जीवन भी बडा सुन्दर बनता हे, अतः कहते है कि ९. मरुत्वान्=तू प्राणोवाला है, तूने प्राणों कौ साधना करके उन्हं
verses.transliteration: ā ghā ye agnimindhate stṛṇanti barhirānuṣak | yeṣāmindro yuvā sakhā | upayāmagṛhīto'syagnīndrābhyāṃ tvaiṣa te yoniragnīndrābhyāṃ tvā
verses.wordMeaning: Hitherward! they who light the flame and straightway strew the sacred grass, Whose Friend is Indra ever young. Taken upon a base art thou. For Indra-Agni thee. This is thy dwelling. Thee for Indra-Agni.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hitherward! they who light the flame and straightway strew the sacred grass, Whose Friend is Indra ever young. Taken upon a base art thou. For Indra-Agni thee. This is thy dwelling. Thee for Indra-Agni.

verses.sanskrit:
ओमा॑सश्चर्षणीधृतो॒ विश्वे॑ देवास॒ आ ग॑त । दा॒श्वाᳪसो॑ दा॒शुष॑: सु॒तम् ।
उ॒प॒या॒मगृ॑हीतोऽसि॒ विश्वे॑भ्यस्त्वा दे॒वेभ्य॑  ए॒ष ते॒ योनि॒र्विश्वे॑भ्यस्त्वा दे॒वेभ्य॑:
verses.translation: Ye Visvedevas who protect, reward, and cherish men, approach Your worshipper's drink-offering. Taken upon a base art thou. Thee for the Universal Gods. This is thy home. Thee for the Visvedevas.
verses.hindi: -उपासना मे आगे ओर आगे बढते हुए मनुष्य इन्द्र से महेन्द्र बनने का यल करे। १. गत मन्त्र की भावना के अनुसार इन्द्र से महेन्द्र बननेवाला व्यक्ति ही वस्तुतः प्रभु का उपासक है। इसका जीवन प्रभु का प्रतिपादन करनेवाला होता हे।  वदतीति वत्सः' इसी कारण यह " वत्स" कहलाता है। यह प्रभु को निम्न रूप में देखता है। २. महान्ये प्रभु
verses.transliteration: omāsaścarṣaṇīdhṛto viśve devāsa ā gata | dāśvāso dāśuṣa: sutam | upayāmagṛhīto'si viśvebhyastvā devebhya eṣa te yonirviśvebhyastvā devebhya:
verses.wordMeaning: Ye Visvedevas who protect, reward, and cherish men, approach Your worshipper's drink-offering. Taken upon a base art thou. Thee for the Universal Gods. This is thy home. Thee for the Visvedevas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Ye Visvedevas who protect, reward, and cherish men, approach Your worshipper's drink-offering. Taken upon a base art thou. Thee for the Universal Gods. This is thy home. Thee for the Visvedevas.

verses.sanskrit:
विश्वे॑ देवास॒ आ ग॑त शृणु॒ता म॑ इ॒मᳪ हव॑म् । एदं ब॒र्हिर्निषी॑दत ।
उ॒प॒या॒मगृ॑हीतोऽसि॒ विश्वे॑भ्यस्त्वा दे॒वेभ्य॑  ए॒ष ते॒ योनि॒र्विश्वे॑भ्यस्त्वा दे॒वेभ्य॑:
verses.translation: O ye All-Gods, come hitherward: hear this my invocation seat Yourselves upon this sacred grass. Taken upon a base art thou. Thee for the Universal Gods. This is thy home. Thee for the Visvedevas.
verses.hindi: हम प्रभु की भाति विशाल हदय (महान्) , शक्ति से शत्रुओं का विदारण करनेवाले (इन्द्र) ओर सबके सन्ताप को दूर करनेवाले (पर्जन्य) . बनेगे तभी प्रभु के प्रिय उदु त्यं जातवेदसं देवं व॑हन्ति केतव॑ः। दृशो विश्वाय सूर्यश्शस्वाह।।।९॥ गत मन्त्र का "वत्स ' प्रकृति से ऊपर उठकर प्रभु के गुणों को धारण करता हे। यही
verses.transliteration: viśve devāsa ā gata śṛṇutā ma ima havam | edaṃ barhirniṣīdata | upayāmagṛhīto'si viśvebhyastvā devebhya eṣa te yonirviśvebhyastvā devebhya:
verses.wordMeaning: O ye All-Gods, come hitherward: hear this my invocation seat Yourselves upon this sacred grass. Taken upon a base art thou. Thee for the Universal Gods. This is thy home. Thee for the Visvedevas.
verses.commentary: Sense: O ye All-Gods, come hitherward: hear this my invocation seat Yourselves upon this sacred grass. Taken upon a base art thou. Thee for the Universal Gods. This is thy home. Thee for the Visvedevas.

verses.sanskrit:
इन्द्र॑ मरुत्व इ॒ह पा॑हि॒ सोमं॒ यथा॑ शार्या॒ते अपि॑बः सु॒तस्य॑ ।
तव॒ प्रणी॑ती॒ तव॑ शूर॒ शर्म॒न्ना वि॑वासन्ति क॒वय॑: सुय॒ज्ञाः ।
उ॒प॒या॒मगृ॑हीतो॒ऽसीन्द्रा॑य त्वा म॒रुत्व॑त  ए॒ष ते॒ योनि॒रिन्द्रा॑य त्वा म॒रुत्व॑ते
verses.translation: Here drink the Soma, Indra girt by Maruts! as thou didst drink the juice beside Sâryâta. Under thy guidance, in thy keeping, Hero! the singers serve, skilled in fair sacrifices. Taken upon a base art thou. For Indra girt by Maruts thee. This is thy home. For Indra girt by Maruts thee.
