verses.hindi: हम अपने इस मानव-जीवन को इसी प्रकार सफल कर सकते है कि प्रकृति से ऊपर उठे ओर उस "जातवेदस् देव ' का दर्शन करे। चित्रं देवानामुदगादनीकं चक्ुर्भित्रस्य वरूणस्याग्नेः। गत मन्त्र के अनुसार प्रभु का दर्शन करनेवाला ' प्रस्कण्व '= मेधावी पुरुष सब बुराइयों
verses.transliteration: indra marutva iha pāhi somaṃ yathā śāryāte apibaḥ sutasya | tava praṇītī tava śūra śarmannā vivāsanti kavaya: suyajñāḥ | upayāmagṛhīto'sīndrāya tvā marutvata eṣa te yonirindrāya tvā marutvate
verses.wordMeaning: Here drink the Soma, Indra girt by Maruts! as thou didst drink the juice beside Sâryâta. Under thy guidance, in thy keeping, Hero! the singers serve, skilled in fair sacrifices. Taken upon a base art thou. For Indra girt by Maruts thee. This is thy home.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Here drink the Soma, Indra girt by Maruts! as thou didst drink the juice beside Sâryâta. Under thy guidance, in thy keeping, Hero! the singers serve, skilled in fair sacrifices. Taken upon a base art thou. For Indra girt by Maruts thee. This is thy home.…

verses.sanskrit:
म॒रुत्व॑न्तं वृष॒भं वा॑वृधा॒नमक॑वारिं दि॒व्यᳪशा॒समिन्द्र॑म् ।
वि॑श्वा॒साह॒मव॑से॒ नूत॑नायो॒ग्रᳪस॑हो॒दामि॒ह तᳪ हु॑वेम ।
उ॒प॒या॒मगृ॑हीतो॒ऽसीन्द्रा॑य त्वा म॒रुत्व॑ते ए॒ष ते॒ योनि॒रिन्द्रा॑य त्वा म॒रुत्व॑ते ।
उ॒प॒या॒मगृ॑हीतोऽसि म॒रुतां॒ त्वौज॑से
verses.translation: The Bull whose strength hath waxed, whom Maruts follow, free-giving Indra, the Celestial Ruler, Mighty, all-conquering, the victory-giver, him we invoke to give us new protection. Taken upon a base art thou. For Indra girt by Maruts thee. This is thy home. For Indra girt by Maruts thee. Taken upon a base art thou. Thee for the Maruts’ energy.
verses.hindi: कुत्स वही बनता है जो सर्वत्र प्रभु की व्याप्ति को देखने का प्रयत्न करता है। उसी कौ शक्ति को सर्वत्र कार्य करता हुआ देखने पर मनुष्य निरभिमान हो जाता है। अग्ने नय॑ सुपथा रायेऽअस्मान्विषटवानि देव वयुनानि विद्धान्। गत मन्त्र का ' कुत्स" ही ! आङ्भिरस' बनता हे। सब दुर्गुणों का संहार ही मनुष्य को
verses.transliteration: marutvantaṃ vṛṣabhaṃ vāvṛdhānamakavāriṃ divyaśāsamindram | viśvāsāhamavase nūtanāyograsahodāmiha ta huvema | upayāmagṛhīto'sīndrāya tvā marutvate eṣa te yonirindrāya tvā marutvate | upayāmagṛhīto'si marutāṃ tvaujase
verses.wordMeaning: The Bull whose strength hath waxed, whom Maruts follow, free-giving Indra, the Celestial Ruler, Mighty, all-conquering, the victory-giver, him we invoke to give us new protection. Taken upon a base art thou. For Indra girt by Maruts thee. This is thy home.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The Bull whose strength hath waxed, whom Maruts follow, free-giving Indra, the Celestial Ruler, Mighty, all-conquering, the victory-giver, him we invoke to give us new protection. Taken upon a base art thou. For Indra girt by Maruts thee. This is thy home.…

verses.sanskrit:
स॒जोषा॑ इन्द्र॒ सग॑णो म॒रुद्भि॒: सोमं॑ पिब वृत्र॒हा शू॑र वि॒द्वान् ।
ज॒हि शत्रूँ॒२रप॒ मृधो॑ नुद॒स्वाथाभ॑यं कृणुहि वि॒श्वतो॑ नः ।
उ॒प॒या॒मगृ॑हीतो॒ऽसीन्द्रा॑य त्वा म॒रुत्व॑त  ए॒ष ते॒ योनि॒रिन्द्रा॑य त्वा म॒रुत्व॑ते
verses.translation: Indra, accordant with the banded Maruts, drink Soma, Hero! as wise Vritra-slayer. Slay thou our foemen, drive away assailants, and make us safe on every side from danger. Taken, etc. For Indra girt by Maruts thee. This is thy home. For Indra girt by Maruts thee.
verses.hindi: हम सदा न्याय-मार्ग से ही धन कमार्ण। पाप व कुटिलता से दूर रहे। अयं नोऽअग्निर्वसिवस्कृणोत्वयं मृध॑ः पुरऽ एतु प्रभिन्दन्। १. गत मन्त्र में न्याय-मार्ग से धन कमाने का उल्लेख धा, वस्तुतः धन देनेवाले तो प्रभुदहै। जीव को तो प्रभु से उपदिष्ट न्याय-मार्ग पर चलते चलना है। इसी बात को इन
verses.transliteration: sajoṣā indra sagaṇo marudbhi: somaṃ piba vṛtrahā śūra vidvān | jahi śatrū~2rapa mṛdho nudasvāthābhayaṃ kṛṇuhi viśvato naḥ | upayāmagṛhīto'sīndrāya tvā marutvata eṣa te yonirindrāya tvā marutvate
verses.wordMeaning: Indra, accordant with the banded Maruts, drink Soma, Hero! as wise Vritra-slayer. Slay thou our foemen, drive away assailants, and make us safe on every side from danger. Taken, etc. For Indra girt by Maruts thee. This is thy home. For Indra girt by Maruts thee.
verses.commentary: Sense: Indra, accordant with the banded Maruts, drink Soma, Hero! as wise Vritra-slayer. Slay thou our foemen, drive away assailants, and make us safe on every side from danger. Taken, etc. For Indra girt by Maruts thee. This is thy home. For Indra girt by Maruts thee.

verses.sanskrit:
म॒रुत्वाँ॑२ इन्द्र वृष॒भो रणा॑य॒ पिबा॒ सोम॑मनुष्व॒धं मदा॑य ।
आ सि॑ञ्चस्व ज॒ठरे॒ मध्व॑ ऊ॒र्मिं त्वᳪ राजा॑ऽसि॒ प्रति॑पत्सु॒ताना॑म् ।
उ॒प॒या॒मगृ॑हीतो॒ऽसीन्द्रा॑य त्वा म॒रुत्व॑त
ए॒ष ते॒ योनि॒रिन्द्रा॑य त्वा म॒रुत्व॑ते
verses.translation: Drink, Indra Marut-girt, as Bull, the Soma: for joy, for rapture even as thou pleasest. Pour down the wave of meath within thy belly thou art the King of juices shed fortnightly. Taken, etc.......Maruts thee (as above).
verses.hindi: सवब धनो का विजय व प्रापण करानेवाले प्रभुदहै। वे ही हमें संग्रामो में रूपेण वो रूपमभ्याग तुथो वो विर्ववेदा विभ॑जतु। १९. गत मन्त्र की भावना थी कि हम आगे ओर आगे बढते चले। उसी भावना को अधिक व्यक्त शब्दों में प्रस्तुत मन्त्र में कहते हे। यहाँ जीवन -यात्रा को चार भागों मे बाँटकर
verses.transliteration: marutvā~2 indra vṛṣabho raṇāya pibā somamanuṣvadhaṃ madāya | ā siñcasva jaṭhare madhva ūrmiṃ tva rājā'si pratipatsutānām | upayāmagṛhīto'sīndrāya tvā marutvata eṣa te yonirindrāya tvā marutvate
verses.wordMeaning: Drink, Indra Marut-girt, as Bull, the Soma: for joy, for rapture even as thou pleasest. Pour down the wave of meath within thy belly thou art the King of juices shed fortnightly. Taken, etc.......Maruts thee (as above).
verses.commentary: Sense: Drink, Indra Marut-girt, as Bull, the Soma: for joy, for rapture even as thou pleasest. Pour down the wave of meath within thy belly thou art the King of juices shed fortnightly. Taken, etc.......Maruts thee (as above).

verses.sanskrit:
म॒हाँ२ इन्द्रो॑ नृ॒वदा च॑र्षणि॒प्रा उ॒त द्वि॒बर्हा॑ अमि॒नः सहो॑भिः ।
अ॒स्म॒द्र॒य्ग्वावृधे वी॒र्या॒यो॒रुः पृ॒थुः सुकृ॑तः क॒र्तृभि॑र्भूत् ।
उ॒प॒या॒मगृ॑हीतोऽसि महे॒न्द्राय॑ त्वै॒ष ते॒ योनि॑र्महे॒न्द्राय॑ त्वा
verses.translation: Great, hero-like, controlling men is Indra, unwasting in his powers, doubled in vastness. He, turned to us, hath grown to hero vigour: broad, wide, he hath been decked by those who serve him. Taken upon a base art thou. Thee for Mahendra. This is thy dwelling-place. Thee for Mahendra.
verses.hindi: आत्मदर्शन व आत्मालोचन तथा चतुर्थ मे ज्ञानप्रदान यही हमारे जीवन का कार्यक्रम हो। दक्षिणा के योग्य ब्राह्मण अस्मद्राता देवत्रा ग॑च्छत प्रदातार् माविंशत।। ४६॥ गत मन्त्र में गृहस्थ का एक कर्तव्य "दान" भी बताया गया धा। दान पात्र को ही
verses.transliteration: mahā~2 indro nṛvadā carṣaṇiprā uta dvibarhā aminaḥ sahobhiḥ | asmadraygvāvṛdhe vīryāyoruḥ pṛthuḥ sukṛtaḥ kartṛbhirbhūt | upayāmagṛhīto'si mahendrāya tvaiṣa te yonirmahendrāya tvā
verses.wordMeaning: Great, hero-like, controlling men is Indra, unwasting in his powers, doubled in vastness. He, turned to us, hath grown to hero vigour: broad, wide, he hath been decked by those who serve him. Taken upon a base art thou. Thee for Mahendra. This is thy dwelling-place.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Great, hero-like, controlling men is Indra, unwasting in his powers, doubled in vastness. He, turned to us, hath grown to hero vigour: broad, wide, he hath been decked by those who serve him. Taken upon a base art thou. Thee for Mahendra. This is thy dwelling-place.…

verses.sanskrit:
म॒हाँ२ इन्द्रो॒ य ओज॑सा प॒र्जन्यो॑ वृष्टि॒माँ२ इ॑व । स्तोमै॑र्व॒त्सस्य॑ वावृधे ।
उ॒प॒या॒मगृ॑हीतोऽसि महे॒न्द्राय॑ त्वै॒ष ते॒ योनि॑र्महे॒न्द्राय॑ त्वा
verses.translation: Indra, great in his power and might, and like Parjanya rich In rain, Is magnified by Vatsa's lauds. Taken, etc. (as in 39).
verses.hindi: दान व प्रतिग्रह का प्रयोजन १. लेनेवाला ग्राह्य वस्तु को सम्बोधित करते हुए कहता है कि त्वाचतुद्धे मह्यं अग्नये मुञ्च अग्नि के लिए वरुणः =पात्र का वरण करनेवाला दाता ददातु=दे। सः=वह मेँ तुञ्ध प्राप्त करके अमृतत्त्वम् अशीय=अमृतत्व को प्राप्त करू, अर्थात् तेरे अभाव में आवश्यक
verses.transliteration: mahā~2 indro ya ojasā parjanyo vṛṣṭimā~2 iva | stomairvatsasya vāvṛdhe | upayāmagṛhīto'si mahendrāya tvaiṣa te yonirmahendrāya tvā
verses.wordMeaning: Indra, great in his power and might, and like Parjanya rich In rain, Is magnified by Vatsa's lauds. Taken, etc. (as in 39).
verses.commentary: Sense: Indra, great in his power and might, and like Parjanya rich In rain, Is magnified by Vatsa's lauds. Taken, etc. (as in 39).

verses.sanskrit: उदु॒ त्यं जा॒तवे॑दसं दे॒वं व॑हन्ति के॒तव॑: । दृ॒शे विश्वा॑य॒ सूर्य॒j स्वाहा॑
verses.translation: His bright rays bear him up aloft, the God who knoweth all that lives, Sûrya, that all may look on him. All-hail!
verses.hindi: हम दान दे, परन्तु उस दान का हमे गर्व न हो, क्योंकि वस्तुतः यह दानादि उत्तम कार्य हमारे माध्यम से उस प्रभु द्धारा ही किये जा रहे होते े।
verses.transliteration: udu tyaṃ jātavedasaṃ devaṃ vahanti ketava: | dṛśe viśvāya sūryaj svāhā
verses.wordMeaning: His bright rays bear him up aloft, the God who knoweth all that lives, Sûrya, that all may look on him. All-hail!
verses.commentary: Sense: His bright rays bear him up aloft, the God who knoweth all that lives, Sûrya, that all may look on him. All-hail!

verses.sanskrit:
चि॒त्रं दे॒वाना॒मुदगा॒दनी॑कं॒ चक्षु॑र्मि॒त्रस्य॒ वरु॑णस्या॒ग्नेः ।
आप्रा॒ द्यावा॑पृथि॒वी अ॒न्तरि॑क्ष॒j सूर्य॑ आ॒त्मा जग॑तस्त॒स्थुष॑श्च॒ स्वाहा॑
verses.translation: The brilliant presence of the Gods hath risen, the eye of Mitra, Varuna, and Agni. Soul of all moving, soul of all that moves not, the Sun hath filled the air and earth and heaven.
verses.hindi: प्रभु का नाम-स्मरण करने से हम वासनाओं व रोगों के शिकार नहीं होते। यह नाम हमारा सदा जागरित रक्षक बन जाता है। हम नाम का सुन्दरता से उच्चारण करें, जिससे उस सोम शान्तस्वरूप प्रभु को प्राप्त कर सकै। हम स्वार्थ-त्याग करके अपने हदयान्तरिक्ष को विशाल बनार्।
verses.transliteration: citraṃ devānāmudagādanīkaṃ cakṣurmitrasya varuṇasyāgneḥ | āprā dyāvāpṛthivī antarikṣaj sūrya ātmā jagatastasthuṣaśca svāhā
verses.wordMeaning: The brilliant presence of the Gods hath risen, the eye of Mitra, Varuna, and Agni. Soul of all moving, soul of all that moves not, the Sun hath filled the air and earth and heaven.
verses.commentary: Sense: The brilliant presence of the Gods hath risen, the eye of Mitra, Varuna, and Agni. Soul of all moving, soul of all that moves not, the Sun hath filled the air and earth and heaven.

verses.sanskrit:
अग्ने॒ नय॑ सु॒पथा॑ रा॒ये अ॒स्मान्विश्वा॑नि देव व॒युना॑नि वि॒द्वान् ।
यु॒यो॒ध्यस्मज्जु॑हुरा॒णमेनो॒ भूयि॑ष्ठां ते॒ नम॑ उक्तिं विधेम॒ स्वाहा॑
verses.translation: By goodly paths lead us to riches, Agni, thou God who knowest every sacred duty. Remove the sin that makes us stray and wander: most ample adoration will we bring thee.
verses.hindi: सोमरक्षा द्वारा हमारा जीवन ऋतमय हो ओर हम दीर्घायुष्य प्राप्त करे। षिः मेधातिथिः। देवता-अश्विनौ। छन्द:  त्राटम्युष्णिक्। स्वरः-ऋषभः।। या वां कशा मधुमत्यज्विना सूनृतावती । तया यज्ञं मिरमिक्षतम्। १. पिछले मन्त्र मेँ "मित्रावरुणौ ' का प्रकरण था-' सबके साथ स्नेह करनेवाले, द्वेष
verses.transliteration: agne naya supathā rāye asmānviśvāni deva vayunāni vidvān | yuyodhyasmajjuhurāṇameno bhūyiṣṭhāṃ te nama uktiṃ vidhema svāhā
verses.wordMeaning: By goodly paths lead us to riches, Agni, thou God who knowest every sacred duty. Remove the sin that makes us stray and wander: most ample adoration will we bring thee.
verses.commentary: Sense: By goodly paths lead us to riches, Agni, thou God who knowest every sacred duty. Remove the sin that makes us stray and wander: most ample adoration will we bring thee.

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒यं नो॑ अ॒ग्निर्वरि॑वस्कृणोत्व॒यं मृध॑: पु॒र ए॑तु प्रभि॒न्दन् ।
अ॒यं वाजा॑न्जयतु॒ वाज॑साताव॒यᳪ शत्रू॑ञ्जयतु॒ जर्हृ॑षाण॒: स्वाहा॑
verses.translation: Wide room and comfort may this Agni give us, and go before us cleaving down our foemen. May he win booty in the fight for booty: may he quell foes in his triumphant onset.
verses.hindi: सबसे स्वीकार करनेयोग्य संस्कृति यही है कि १. हम अविच्छिन्न वीर्य को धारण करनेवाले बने, शक्ति की रक्षा करे। २. ओर दान दिये जानेवाले (रा दाने ) धन १. गत मन्त्र की भावना के अनुसार संस्कृति को अपनानेवाला सः=वह व्यक्ति पालक बनता है विद्यायुक्त वाणी का अधिष्ठाता होता है। सर्वोच्च ऊर्ध्वा दिशा का यह
verses.transliteration: ayaṃ no agnirvarivaskṛṇotvayaṃ mṛdha: pura etu prabhindan | ayaṃ vājānjayatu vājasātāvaya śatrūñjayatu jarhṛṣāṇa: svāhā
verses.wordMeaning: Wide room and comfort may this Agni give us, and go before us cleaving down our foemen. May he win booty in the fight for booty: may he quell foes in his triumphant onset.
verses.commentary: Sense: Wide room and comfort may this Agni give us, and go before us cleaving down our foemen. May he win booty in the fight for booty: may he quell foes in his triumphant onset.

verses.sanskrit:
रू॒पेण॑ वो रू॒पम॒भ्यागां॑ तु॒थो वो॑ वि॒श्ववे॑दा॒ वि भ॑जतु ।
ऋ॒तस्य॑ प॒था प्रेत॑ च॒न्द्रद॑क्षिणा॒ वि स्व॒: पश्य॒ व्यन्तरि॑क्षं॒  यत॑स्व सद॒स्यै॒:
verses.translation: I through your beauty have attained to beauty. The Tutha, the omniscient, allot you! Go forth, bright-gifted! on the path of Order. Look thou upon the heaven and air's mid-region. Unite thee with the priests who keep the Sadas.
verses.hindi: प्रभुरूप अग्नि को समिद्ध करनेवाला सदा मधुर वाणी का प्रयोग करता है. मधुर सत्यवाणी से ही सबका सत्कार करता है। शक्ति व शान्ति का समन्वय १. अयम्-गत मन्त्र में वर्णित मधुर वाणियोवाला यह व्यक्ति ही वेनः=मेधावी है हम सोम कौ रक्षा करं, जिससे हममे प्राणशक्ति कौ वृद्धि हो ओर दिव्य 'प्राणाय॑ मे वर्चोदा वर्चसे पवस्व च्व्यानाय॑ मे वर्चोदा वर्चसे पवस्वोदानाय॑ मे वर्चोदा वर्चसे पवस्व भ्वाचे म वर्चोदा वर्चसे पवस्व “क्रतूदक्षाभ्यां मे वर्चोदा वर्च+से पवस्व शश्रोत्राय मे वर्योदा वर्चसे पवस्व चक्षुर्भ्यां मे वर्चोदसौ वर्चसे
verses.transliteration: rūpeṇa vo rūpamabhyāgāṃ tutho vo viśvavedā vi bhajatu | ṛtasya pathā preta candradakṣiṇā vi sva: paśya vyantarikṣaṃ yatasva sadasyai:
verses.wordMeaning: I through your beauty have attained to beauty. The Tutha, the omniscient, allot you! Go forth, bright-gifted! on the path of Order. Look thou upon the heaven and air's mid-region. Unite thee with the priests who keep the Sadas.
verses.commentary: Sense: I through your beauty have attained to beauty. The Tutha, the omniscient, allot you! Go forth, bright-gifted! on the path of Order. Look thou upon the heaven and air's mid-region. Unite thee with the priests who keep the Sadas.

verses.sanskrit:
ब्रा॒ह्म॒णम॒द्य वि॑देयं पितृ॒मन्तं॑ पैतृम॒त्यमृषि॑मार्षे॒यᳪ  सु॒धातु॑दक्षिणम् ।
अ॒स्मद्रा॑ता देव॒त्रा ग॑च्छत प्रदा॒तार॒मा वि॑शत
verses.translation: This day may it he mine to find a Brâhman sprung from a lauded father and grandfather, Offspring of Rishis and himself a Rishi, the fit recipient of priestly guerdon. Go to the Gods, bestowed by me, and enter into him who gives.
verses.hindi: - प्रभुकृपा से हम ९. वासनाओं से अपना रक्षण करनेवाले हो। २. मनुष्यो का धारण करनेवाले हों। ३. दिव्य गुणोवाले हों ४. दान कौ वृत्तिवाले हों। ५. दान कौ वृत्तिवाले के धन को प्राप्त हों। ६. इस प्रकार सब दिव्य गु्णोवाले हौ। कविश्वै देवासऽ आग॑त श्रृणुता म॑ इमध्टव॑म्। एदं लर्हिर्निषीदत।
verses.transliteration: brāhmaṇamadya videyaṃ pitṛmantaṃ paitṛmatyamṛṣimārṣeya sudhātudakṣiṇam | asmadrātā devatrā gacchata pradātāramā viśata
verses.wordMeaning: This day may it he mine to find a Brâhman sprung from a lauded father and grandfather, Offspring of Rishis and himself a Rishi, the fit recipient of priestly guerdon. Go to the Gods, bestowed by me, and enter into him who gives.
verses.commentary: Sense: This day may it he mine to find a Brâhman sprung from a lauded father and grandfather, Offspring of Rishis and himself a Rishi, the fit recipient of priestly guerdon. Go to the Gods, bestowed by me, and enter into him who gives.

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒ग्नये॑ त्वा॒ मह्यं॒ वरु॑णो ददातु॒ सो॒ऽमृत॒त्त्वम॑शी॒यायु॑र्दा॒त्र ए॑धि॒ मयो॒ मह्यं॑ प्रतिग्रही॒त्रे रु॒द्राय॑ त्वा॒ मह्यं॒ वरु॑णो ददातु॒ सो॒ऽमृत॒त्त्वम॑शीय प्रा॒णो दा॒त्र ए॑धि॒ वयो॒ मह्यं॑ प्रतिग्रही॒त्रे  बृह॒स्पत॑ये त्वा॒ मह्यं॒ वरु॑णो ददातु॒ सो॒ऽमृत॒त्त्वम॑शीय॒ त्वग्दा॒त्र ए॑धि॒ मयो॒ मह्यं॑ प्रतिग्रही॒त्रे
य॒माय॑ त्वा॒ मह्यं॒ वरु॑णो ददातु॒ सो॒ऽमृत॒त्त्वम॑शीय॒ हयो॑ दा॒त्र ए॑धि॒ वयो॒ मह्यं॑ प्रतिग्रही॒त्रे
verses.translation: To Agni, yea, to me let Varuna give thee. May I gain life that shall endure for ever. Be thou strong vital power to him who gives thee, and com- fort unto me the gift's receiver. To Rudra, yea, to me let Varuna........................for ever. Be thou the breath of life to him who gives thee, and vigour unto me the gift's receiver. To me Brihaspati let Varuna........................for ever. Be thou a covering skin to him who gives thee, and comfort unto me the gift's receiver. To Varna, yea, to me let Varuna........................for ever. Be thou a steed to him who gives the guerdon, and vital power to me the gift's receiver.
verses.hindi: - इन्द्र, अर्थात् राजा “ मरुत्वान् ' हो तो प्रजा भी प्राणों के बलवाली होती हे। १. गत मन्त्र के राजा के साथ मिलकर कार्य करनेवाला सेनापति है। राजा ओर सेनापति राष्ट के मुख्य अधिकारी है । आन्तरव्यवस्था का मुख्य दायित्व राजा पर है तो राष्ट की बाह्य शत्नुओं से रक्षा करने के लिए सेनापति ने सेना को सन्नद्ध रखना दहै। यह सेनापति प्रभु ने हमारे जीवनं मे सोम की स्थापना इसलिए की है कि हमारी प्रज्ञा अस्मद्र्यग्वावृधे वीर्यायोरुः पृथुः सुकतः कर्तृभिंर्भृत्। १. गत मन्त्र कौ भावना के अनुसार जब विश्वामित्र सोमरक्षा द्वारा अद्ध -प्रत्यङ्ध को रमणीय बनाता है ओर प्रज्ञा को दीप्त करता है तब वह प्रस्तुत मन्त्र का ऋषि ' भरद्वाज!
verses.transliteration: agnaye tvā mahyaṃ varuṇo dadātu so'mṛtattvamaśīyāyurdātra edhi mayo mahyaṃ pratigrahītre rudrāya tvā mahyaṃ varuṇo dadātu so'mṛtattvamaśīya prāṇo dātra edhi vayo mahyaṃ pratigrahītre bṛhaspataye tvā mahyaṃ varuṇo dadātu so'mṛtattvamaśīya tvagdātra edhi mayo mahyaṃ pratigrahītre yamāya tvā mahyaṃ varuṇo dadātu so'mṛtattvamaśīya hayo dātra edhi vayo mahyaṃ pratigrahītre
verses.wordMeaning: To Agni, yea, to me let Varuna give thee. May I gain life that shall endure for ever. Be thou strong vital power to him who gives thee, and com- fort unto me the gift's receiver. To Rudra, yea, to me let Varuna........................for ever.…
verses.commentary: Sense: To Agni, yea, to me let Varuna give thee. May I gain life that shall endure for ever. Be thou strong vital power to him who gives thee, and com- fort unto me the gift's receiver. To Rudra, yea, to me let Varuna........................for ever.…

verses.sanskrit:
को॑ऽदा॒त्कस्मा॑ अदा॒त्कामो॑ऽदा॒त्कामा॑यादात् ।
कामो॑ दा॒ता काम॑: प्रतिग्रही॒ता कामै॒तत्ते॑
verses.translation: Who hath bestowed it? Upon whom bestowed it? Desire bestowed it, for Desire he gave it. Desire is giver and Desire receiver. This, O Desire, to thee is dedicated.
verses.hindi: हम पात्र का विचार करके दान देनेवाले बनें। कोऽ दात्कस्मांऽअदात्कामों ऽ दात्कामायादात्। कामो दाता काम॑ः प्रतिग्रहीता कामैतत्ते।।४८॥ ९. गत मन्त्र में दान का महत्त्व सुव्यक्त है। “जुहोत प्र च तिष्ठत' इस वेदवाक्य
verses.transliteration: ko'dātkasmā adātkāmo'dātkāmāyādāt | kāmo dātā kāma: pratigrahītā kāmaitatte
verses.wordMeaning: Who hath bestowed it? Upon whom bestowed it? Desire bestowed it, for Desire he gave it. Desire is giver and Desire receiver. This, O Desire, to thee is dedicated.
verses.commentary: Sense: Who hath bestowed it? Upon whom bestowed it? Desire bestowed it, for Desire he gave it. Desire is giver and Desire receiver. This, O Desire, to thee is dedicated.

verses.sanskrit: उ॒प॒या॒मगृ॑हीतोऽस्यादि॒त्येभ्य॑स्त्वा । विष्ण॑ उरुगायै॒ष ते॒ सोम॒स्तᳪ र॑क्षस्व॒ मा त्वा॑ दभन्
verses.translation: com The Texts of the White Yajurveda, tr. Ralph T.H. Griffith, [1899], TAKEN upon a base art thou. Thee for the Âdityas. Here, O Far-striding Vishnu, is thy Soma. Guard it from injury. Let them not harm thee.
verses.hindi: आदर्श पति वही है जो १. यम-नियमों से संयत जीवनवाला है २. उदार हदय है। ३. प्रभु का सतत स्मरण व कीर्तन करनेवाला है। ४. सोम के महत्त्व को समञ्चकर उसकौ रक्षा करता है। यही व्यक्ति उत्तम सन्तान को जन्म देता है। एक आदर्शं वधू वर का वरण इसीलिए करती है कि वह आदित्यसम देदीप्यमान सन्तानं को जन्म दे सके।
verses.transliteration: upayāmagṛhīto'syādityebhyastvā | viṣṇa urugāyaiṣa te somasta rakṣasva mā tvā dabhan
verses.wordMeaning: com The Texts of the White Yajurveda, tr. Ralph T.H. Griffith, [1899], TAKEN upon a base art thou. Thee for the Âdityas. Here, O Far-striding Vishnu, is thy Soma. Guard it from injury. Let them not harm thee.
verses.commentary: Sense: com The Texts of the White Yajurveda, tr. Ralph T.H. Griffith, [1899], TAKEN upon a base art thou. Thee for the Âdityas. Here, O Far-striding Vishnu, is thy Soma. Guard it from injury. Let them not harm thee.

verses.sanskrit:
क॒दा च॒न स्त॒रीर॑सि॒ नेन्द्र॑ सश्चसि दा॒शुषे॑ ।
उपो॒पेन्नु म॑घव॒न्  भूय॒ इन्नु ते॒ दानं॑ दे॒वस्य॑ पृच्यत आदि॒त्येभ्य॑स्त्वा
verses.translation: Ne’er art thou fruitless, Indra; ne’er dost thou desert thy worshipper. But now, O Liberal Lord, thy bounty as a God is poured forth ever more and more. Thee for the Âdityas.
verses.hindi: १. पति पली से किसी प्रकार का छ्िपाव न रक्खे। यह चछ्िपाव ही एक-दूसरे मे शक पैदा करता है। २. पति पली को पूर्णतया प्राप्त हो, क्योंकि पली ने पति करे प्रति अपना अर्पण किया है। ३. उसमें प्रभु-प्रवणता हो। ४. वह दानशील हो। पति के ही विषय में कहते हैँ कि आप १. कदा च=कभी भी न प्रयुच्छसि- प्रमाद
verses.transliteration: kadā cana starīrasi nendra saścasi dāśuṣe | upopennu maghavan bhūya innu te dānaṃ devasya pṛcyata ādityebhyastvā
verses.wordMeaning: Ne’er art thou fruitless, Indra; ne’er dost thou desert thy worshipper. But now, O Liberal Lord, thy bounty as a God is poured forth ever more and more. Thee for the Âdityas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Ne’er art thou fruitless, Indra; ne’er dost thou desert thy worshipper. But now, O Liberal Lord, thy bounty as a God is poured forth ever more and more. Thee for the Âdityas.

verses.sanskrit:
क॒दा च॒न प्र यु॑च्छस्यु॒भे नि पा॑सि॒ जन्म॑नी ।
तुरी॑यादित्य॒ सव॑नं त इन्द्रि॒यमात॑स्थाव॒मृतं॑ दि॒व्या॒दि॒त्येभ्य॑स्त्वा
verses.translation: Never art thou neglectful: thou guardest both races with thy care. The Soma feast, O Fourth Âditya, is thy strength. Amrit is stablished in the heavens. Thee for the Âdityas.
verses.hindi: १. आप प्रमादशून्य हो। २. इहलोक व परलोक दोनों का ध्यान करते हो। ३. आप मानवता को लिये हुए हो। ४. गुणों का आह्वान करनेवाले हो। ५. उत्पादक शक्ति से युक्त हो। ६. शक्ति को नष्ट नहीं होने देते हो। ७. नीरोग हो। ८. शक्ति को ज्ञानाग्नि यज्ञो देवानां प्रत्येति सुम्नमादित्यासो भव॑ता मृडयन्तः
verses.transliteration: kadā cana pra yucchasyubhe ni pāsi janmanī | turīyāditya savanaṃ ta indriyamātasthāvamṛtaṃ divyādityebhyastvā
verses.wordMeaning: Never art thou neglectful: thou guardest both races with thy care. The Soma feast, O Fourth Âditya, is thy strength. Amrit is stablished in the heavens. Thee for the Âdityas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Never art thou neglectful: thou guardest both races with thy care. The Soma feast, O Fourth Âditya, is thy strength. Amrit is stablished in the heavens. Thee for the Âdityas.

verses.sanskrit:
य॒ज्ञो दे॒वानां॒ प्रत्ये॑ति सु॒म्नमादि॑त्यासो॒ भव॑ता मृड॒यन्त॑: ।
आ वो॒ऽर्वाची॑ सुम॒तिर्व॑वृत्याद॒होश्चि॒द्या व॑रिवो॒वित्त॒रास॑दादि॒त्येभ्य॑स्त्वा
verses.translation: The sacrifice obtains the Gods’ acceptance. Be graciously inclined to us, Âdityas. Hitherward let your favour be directed and be our best deliverer from trouble. Thee for the Âdityas.
verses.hindi: १. घरों में अग्निहोत्र नियम से हो, जिससे वहाँ सुख का राज्य हो। २. विद्वान् अतिथियों का आना-जाना बना रहे, जिससे उनकी सुमति इन्दे सदा प्राप्त रहे। घरों मे उत्तम सन्तान का निर्माण हो। श्रद॑स्मै नरो वच॑से दधातन यदांशीर्दा दम्प॑ती वाममंश्नुतः।
verses.transliteration: yajño devānāṃ pratyeti sumnamādityāso bhavatā mṛḍayanta: | ā vo'rvācī sumatirvavṛtyādahościdyā varivovittarāsadādityebhyastvā
verses.wordMeaning: The sacrifice obtains the Gods’ acceptance. Be graciously inclined to us, Âdityas. Hitherward let your favour be directed and be our best deliverer from trouble. Thee for the Âdityas.
verses.commentary: Sense: The sacrifice obtains the Gods’ acceptance. Be graciously inclined to us, Âdityas. Hitherward let your favour be directed and be our best deliverer from trouble. Thee for the Âdityas.

verses.sanskrit:
विव॑स्वन्नादित्यै॒ष ते॑ सोमपी॒थस्तस्मि॑न्  मत्स्व ।
श्रद॑स्मै नरो॒ वच॑से दधातन॒ यदा॑शी॒र्दा दम्प॑ती वा॒मम॑श्नु॒तः ।
पुमा॑न्  पु॒त्रो जा॑यते वि॒न्दते॒ वस्वधा॑ वि॒श्वाहा॑र॒प ए॑धते गृ॒हे
verses.translation: This is thy Soma draught, O bright Âditya: take delight therein. To this mine utterance, O ye men, give credence, what good the man and wife obtain by praying: A manly son is burn and gathers riches, and thrives for ever sinless in the dwelling.
verses.hindi: पति ' ज्ञानी, गुणग्राही व संयमी ' हो। पति-पली दिल खोलकर उदारता से दान देनेवाले हों तो उनके घरों में "उत्तम, वीर, पवित्र व पापशून्य' सन्तान होते हे। वाममद्य सवितर्वाममु श्वो दिवेदिवे वाममस्मभ्यःसावीः। वामस्य हि क्षय॑स्य देव भूरेरया धिया वामभाजः स्याम।।६॥
verses.transliteration: vivasvannādityaiṣa te somapīthastasmin matsva | śradasmai naro vacase dadhātana yadāśīrdā dampatī vāmamaśnutaḥ | pumān putro jāyate vindate vasvadhā viśvāhārapa edhate gṛhe
verses.wordMeaning: This is thy Soma draught, O bright Âditya: take delight therein. To this mine utterance, O ye men, give credence, what good the man and wife obtain by praying: A manly son is burn and gathers riches, and thrives for ever sinless in the dwelling.
verses.commentary: Sense: This is thy Soma draught, O bright Âditya: take delight therein. To this mine utterance, O ye men, give credence, what good the man and wife obtain by praying: A manly son is burn and gathers riches, and thrives for ever sinless in the dwelling.

verses.sanskrit:
वा॒मम॒द्य स॑वितर्वा॒ममु॒ श्वो दि॒वे दि॑वे वा॒मम॒स्मभ्य॑ᳪ सावीः ।
वा॒मस्य॒ हि क्षय॑स्य देव॒ भूरे॑र॒या धि॒या वा॑म॒भाज॑: स्याम
verses.translation: Fair wealth, O Savitar, to-day, to-morrow, fair wealth produce for us each day that passes. May we, through this our song, be happy gainers, God! of a fair and spacious habitation.
verses.hindi: हम शक्तिशाली बनकर अपने कर्मो से घरों को सौन्दर्य से अलंकृत करनेवाले हो। जिन्व॑ यज्ञं जिन्व॑ य॒ज्ञप॑तिं भगाय दवाय॑ त्वा सवित्रे।।७॥ ९. पली पति से कहती है कि--आप उपयामगृहीतः असि=उपासना के द्वारा यम-नियमां के धारण करनेवाले है। २. आप सावित्रः असि=सविता देव के उपासक हैं. अर्थात्
verses.transliteration: vāmamadya savitarvāmamu śvo dive dive vāmamasmabhya sāvīḥ | vāmasya hi kṣayasya deva bhūrerayā dhiyā vāmabhāja: syāma
verses.wordMeaning: Fair wealth, O Savitar, to-day, to-morrow, fair wealth produce for us each day that passes. May we, through this our song, be happy gainers, God! of a fair and spacious habitation.
verses.commentary: Sense: Fair wealth, O Savitar, to-day, to-morrow, fair wealth produce for us each day that passes. May we, through this our song, be happy gainers, God! of a fair and spacious habitation.

verses.sanskrit:
उ॒प॒या॒मगृ॑हीतोऽसि सावि॒त्रो॒ऽसि चनो॒धाश्च॑नो॒धा अ॑सि॒ चनो॒ मयि॑ धेहि ।
जिन्व॑ य॒ज्ञं जिन्व॑ य॒ज्ञप॑तिं॒ भगा॑य दे॒वाय॑ त्वा सवि॒त्रे
verses.translation: Taken upon a base art thou. Savitar's giver of delight art thou. Giver of joy art thou: vouchsafe me joy. Speed thou the sacrifice, speed thou the sacrifice's lord to win his share. Thee for the God, for Savitar.
verses.hindi: पति इतना कमाये कि घर का व्यय भी चले ओर यज्ञ-यागादि के लिए भी खर्च निकलता रहे। घर में एश्वर्य कौ वृद्धि हो, देवत्व का विकास हो ओर उत्तम विश्वेभ्यस्त्वा देवेभ्य॑ऽ एष ते योनिर्विंश्वेभ्यस्त्वा देवेभ्य॑ः।।८॥ १. पली कह रही है कि-उपयामगृहीतः असि आप प्रभु-उपासना के द्वारा स्वीकार
verses.transliteration: upayāmagṛhīto'si sāvitro'si canodhāścanodhā asi cano mayi dhehi | jinva yajñaṃ jinva yajñapatiṃ bhagāya devāya tvā savitre
verses.wordMeaning: Taken upon a base art thou. Savitar's giver of delight art thou. Giver of joy art thou: vouchsafe me joy. Speed thou the sacrifice, speed thou the sacrifice's lord to win his share. Thee for the God, for Savitar.
verses.commentary: Sense: Taken upon a base art thou. Savitar's giver of delight art thou. Giver of joy art thou: vouchsafe me joy. Speed thou the sacrifice, speed thou the sacrifice's lord to win his share. Thee for the God, for Savitar.

verses.sanskrit:
उ॒प॒या॒मगृ॑हीतोऽसि सु॒शर्मा॑ऽसि सुप्रतिष्ठा॒नो बृ॒हदु॑क्षाय॒ नम॑: ।
विश्वे॑भ्यस्त्वा दे॒वेभ्य॑ ए॒ष ते॒ योनि॒र्विश्वे॑भ्यस्त्वा दे॒वेभ्य॑:
verses.translation: Taken upon a base art thou. Thou art a good protector, firmly stablished. To the Great Bull be reverential homage. Thee for the Visvedevas. This is thy home: Thee for the Visvedevas.
verses.hindi: पति यम-नियम का पालन करे। वह अपने घर को उत्तम बनाए्। उसके कार्य उसे यशस्वी बनानेवाले हों। उसके कारण घर में दिव्य गुणों की वृद्धि हो। सूचना -' शर्म ' शब्द सुखवाची भी है। तब ' सुशर्मा" का अर्थ यह होगा कि जिसके कारण घर में सुख-ही-सुख है, जो घर में क्लेश बद्धाने का कारण नहीं बनता।
verses.transliteration: upayāmagṛhīto'si suśarmā'si supratiṣṭhāno bṛhadukṣāya nama: | viśvebhyastvā devebhya eṣa te yonirviśvebhyastvā devebhya:
verses.wordMeaning: Taken upon a base art thou. Thou art a good protector, firmly stablished. To the Great Bull be reverential homage. Thee for the Visvedevas. This is thy home: Thee for the Visvedevas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Taken upon a base art thou. Thou art a good protector, firmly stablished. To the Great Bull be reverential homage. Thee for the Visvedevas. This is thy home: Thee for the Visvedevas.

verses.sanskrit:
उ॒प॒या॒मगृ॑हीतोऽसि॒ बृह॒स्पति॑सुतस्य देव सोम त॒ इन्दो॑रिन्द्रि॒याव॑त॒: पत्नी॑वतो॒ ग्रहाँ॑२ ऋध्यासम् ।
अ॒हं प॒रस्ता॑द॒हम॒वस्ता॒द्यद॒न्तरि॑क्षं॒ तदु॑ मे पि॒ताऽभू॑त् ।
अ॒हᳪ सूर्य॑मुभ॒यतो॑ ददर्शा॒हं दे॒वानां॑ पर॒मं गुहा॒ यत्
verses.translation: Taken upon a base art thou. May it be mine to prosper the libations of thee Brihaspati's son, O radiant Soma, of thee, strong Indu, mated with thy Consorts. I am in heaven above, on earth beneath it. The intermediate region was my father. I saw the Sun both from above and under. I am what Gods in secret hold the highest.
verses.hindi: पति यम-नियम का पालन करनेवाला, जानी आचार्यो से शिक्षा पाया हुआ, शक्तिशाली तथा प्रशस्तेन्द्रिय हो ओर उत्तम पली कौ सहायता से ब्रतो का पालन करे। पत्री भी इहलोक व परलोक दोनों को देखे, सदा मध्यमार्ग पर चले। वह बाह्य सूर्य से क्रियाशीलता की प्रेरणा ले ओर अन्तःसूर्य से मार्गं का ज्ञान प्राप्त करे जिससे भटक न जाए्।
verses.transliteration: upayāmagṛhīto'si bṛhaspatisutasya deva soma ta indorindriyāvata: patnīvato grahā~2 ṛdhyāsam | ahaṃ parastādahamavastādyadantarikṣaṃ tadu me pitā'bhūt | aha sūryamubhayato dadarśāhaṃ devānāṃ paramaṃ guhā yat
verses.wordMeaning: Taken upon a base art thou. May it be mine to prosper the libations of thee Brihaspati's son, O radiant Soma, of thee, strong Indu, mated with thy Consorts. I am in heaven above, on earth beneath it. The intermediate region was my father.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Taken upon a base art thou. May it be mine to prosper the libations of thee Brihaspati's son, O radiant Soma, of thee, strong Indu, mated with thy Consorts. I am in heaven above, on earth beneath it. The intermediate region was my father.…

verses.sanskrit:
अग्ना३इ॒ पत्नी॑वन्त्स॒जूर्दे॒वेन॒ त्वष्ट्रा॒ सोमं॑ पिब॒ स्वाहा॑ ।
प्र॒जाप॑ति॒र्वृषा॑ऽसि रेतो॒धा रेतो॒ मयि॑ धेहि प्र॒जाप॑तेस्ते॒  वृष्णो॑ रेतो॒धसो॑ रेतो॒धाम॑शीय
verses.translation: Agni, associate with the Dames, accordant with the God Tvashtar, drink. All-hail! Thou art Prajâpati, strong male, impregner: may I obtain from thee, strong male, impregner, a son who shall himself become a father.
verses.hindi: भोजन वही ठीक टै जो कर्मेन्द्रियं को क्रियाशील ओर ज्ञानेन््ियो को ज्लानप्राप्तिक्षम बनाता है ओर जिसकी वेद मे इस रूप मे प्रार्थना है कि यह नीरोगता व शत्नु-शोषण-शक्ति को देनेवाला हो। इससे पति का जीवन इतना सुन्दर लनेगा कि वे यजुर्मनत्रो से यज्ञ करनेवाले बनेगे। साममन्त्रों से प्रभु-स्तवन करेगे तथा ऋृडःमन्त्रो का
verses.transliteration: agnā3i patnīvantsajūrdevena tvaṣṭrā somaṃ piba svāhā | prajāpatirvṛṣā'si retodhā reto mayi dhehi prajāpateste vṛṣṇo retodhaso retodhāmaśīya
verses.wordMeaning: Agni, associate with the Dames, accordant with the God Tvashtar, drink. All-hail! Thou art Prajâpati, strong male, impregner: may I obtain from thee, strong male, impregner, a son who shall himself become a father.
verses.commentary: Sense: Agni, associate with the Dames, accordant with the God Tvashtar, drink. All-hail! Thou art Prajâpati, strong male, impregner: may I obtain from thee, strong male, impregner, a son who shall himself become a father.

verses.sanskrit: उ॒प॒या॒मगृ॑हीतोऽसि॒ हरि॑रसि हारियोज॒नो हरि॑भ्यां त्वा । हर्यो॑र्धा॒ना स्थ॑ स॒हसो॑मा॒ इन्द्रा॑य
verses.translation: Taken upon a base art thou. Thou art bay-coloured, Yoker of Bay Coursers. Thee for the pair of tawny-coloured horses. United with the Soma, ye, for Indra, are corn for his two tawny steeds to feed on.
verses.hindi: सात्विक आहार से शुद्ध बुद्धिवाले होकर हम पापों से ऊपर उठ जारण। आप्यायन - न्यूनता का दूरीकरण १. सात्त्विक आहार से शुद्ध बुद्धिवाले होकर हम वर्चसाब्रह्यवर्चस् से, ज्ानाध्ययन सम्पत्ति सै समगन्महि -सङ्खत हों । सात्विक आहार से शरीर मे शक्ति सुरक्षित होती है ओर
verses.transliteration: upayāmagṛhīto'si harirasi hāriyojano haribhyāṃ tvā | haryordhānā stha sahasomā indrāya
verses.wordMeaning: Taken upon a base art thou. Thou art bay-coloured, Yoker of Bay Coursers. Thee for the pair of tawny-coloured horses. United with the Soma, ye, for Indra, are corn for his two tawny steeds to feed on.
verses.commentary: Sense: Taken upon a base art thou. Thou art bay-coloured, Yoker of Bay Coursers. Thee for the pair of tawny-coloured horses. United with the Soma, ye, for Indra, are corn for his two tawny steeds to feed on.

verses.sanskrit: यस्ते॑ अश्व॒सनि॑र्भ॒क्षो यो गो॒सनि॒स्तस्य॑ त इ॒ष्टय॑जुष स्तु॒तसो॑मस्य श॒स्तोक्थ॒स्योप॑हूत॒स्योप॑हूतो भक्षयामि
verses.translation: That draught of thine which winneth cows or horses, offered with sacrificial text and lauded With chanted hymns and songs of adoration—of that permitted do I take permitted.
verses.hindi: सात्विक आहार के द्वारा प्रभु हमारी रुचि को ही परिवर्तित कर देते हैँ ओर हम विद्वानों - यज्ञिय देवों के सम्पर्क में रहकर अपने जीवनो को उत्तम बना पाते है। देवों कौ कल्याणी मति में रहते हुए हम ¦ काम-क्रोध-लोभ' से ऊपर उठते है। हमारा मन उत्तम होता है. कामादि तीनों से शून्य होने के कारण हम अ-त्रि' होते है।
verses.transliteration: yaste aśvasanirbhakṣo yo gosanistasya ta iṣṭayajuṣa stutasomasya śastokthasyopahūtasyopahūto bhakṣayāmi
verses.wordMeaning: That draught of thine which winneth cows or horses, offered with sacrificial text and lauded With chanted hymns and songs of adoration—of that permitted do I take permitted.
verses.commentary: Sense: That draught of thine which winneth cows or horses, offered with sacrificial text and lauded With chanted hymns and songs of adoration—of that permitted do I take permitted.

verses.sanskrit:
दे॒वकृ॑त॒स्यैन॑सोऽव॒यज॑नमसि मनु॒ष्य॒कृत॒स्यैन॑सोऽव॒यज॑नमसि पि॒तृकृ॑त॒स्यैन॑सोऽव॒यज॑नमस्या॒त्मकृ॑तस्यैनसोऽव॒यज॑नम॒स्येन॑स एनसोऽव॒यज॑नमसि ।
यच्चा॒हमेनो॑ वि॒द्वाँश्च॒कार॒ यच्चावि॑द्वाँ॒स्तस्य॒ सर्वस्यैन॑सोऽव॒यज॑नमसि
verses.translation: Of sin against the Gods thou art atonement. Of sin against mankind thou art atonement. For sin against the Fathers thou atonest. Of sin against oneself thou art atonement. Of every sort of sin thou art atonement. The sin that I have knowingly committed, the sin that unawares I have committed, of all that wickedness thou art the atonement.
verses.hindi: वे प्रभु हमें उत्तम ज्ञान का दान करके अल्पीभाव से शून्य करे। हम न्यूनताओं को दूर करके शरीर, मन व मस्तिष्क में पूर्णता का स्थापन करे। गृहस्थ मे कौन प्रवेश करे धाता रातिः सवितेदं जुषन्तां प्रजापंतिर्निधिपा देवोऽअग्निः।
verses.transliteration: devakṛtasyainaso'vayajanamasi manuṣyakṛtasyainaso'vayajanamasi pitṛkṛtasyainaso'vayajanamasyātmakṛtasyainaso'vayajanamasyenasa enaso'vayajanamasi | yaccāhameno vidvā~ścakāra yaccāvidvā~stasya sarvasyainaso'vayajanamasi
verses.wordMeaning: Of sin against the Gods thou art atonement. Of sin against mankind thou art atonement. For sin against the Fathers thou atonest. Of sin against oneself thou art atonement. Of every sort of sin thou art atonement. The sin that I have knowingly committed,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Of sin against the Gods thou art atonement. Of sin against mankind thou art atonement. For sin against the Fathers thou atonest. Of sin against oneself thou art atonement. Of every sort of sin thou art atonement. The sin that I have knowingly committed,…

verses.sanskrit:
सं वर्च॑सा॒ पय॑सा॒ सं त॒नूभि॒रग॑न्महि॒ मन॑सा॒ सᳪ शि॒वेन॑ ।
त्वष्टा॑ सु॒दत्रो॒ वि द॑धातु॒ रायोऽनु॑मार्ष्टु त॒न्वो यद्विलि॑ष्टम्
verses.translation: repeated.
verses.hindi: १. धातृत्व आदि नव गुणों से युक्त पुरुष ही गृहस्थ में प्रवेश का अधिकारी है। २. उसे प्रजा के निर्माण में आनन्द अनुभव करना चाहिए, तथा ३. पात्रों में दान सुगा वो देवाः सद॑नाऽअकर्म यञऽआंजग्मेद सव॑नं जुषाणाः। भर॑माणा वह॑माना हवीश्श्ष्यस्मे ध॑त्त वसवो वसनि स्वाह।।। ९८॥
verses.transliteration: saṃ varcasā payasā saṃ tanūbhiraganmahi manasā sa śivena | tvaṣṭā sudatro vi dadhātu rāyo'numārṣṭu tanvo yadviliṣṭam

verses.sanskrit:
समि॑न्द्र णो॒ मन॑सा नेषि॒ गोभि॒: सᳪ  सू॒रिभि॑र्मघव॒न्त्सᳪ  स्व॒स्त्या ।
सं ब्रह्म॑णा दे॒वकृ॑तं॒ यदस्ति॒ सं दे॒वाना॑ᳪ सुम॒तौ य॒ज्ञिया॑ना॒ᳪ स्वाहा॑
verses.translation: Lead us with thought to wealth in kine, O Indra, to princes, Lord of Bounty! and to welfare. Lead thou us on to God-inspired devotion, to favour of the Gods who merit worship. All-hail!
verses.hindi: ९. हम गृहस्थ को यज्ञ समञ्ञे। २. इसमें गृहजनों के पालन-पोषण तथा यज्ञो के लिए धन कमानेवाले बनें ओर ३. उत्तम रत्नं को, रमणीय गुणों को धारण करें जिससे प्रभु को प्राप्त करनेवाले बने। षिः - अत्रि ः। देवता- विश्वेदेवा गृहपतयः। छन्दः -निचृदार्षीत्रिष्टुप्। स्वरः -धैवतः।।
verses.transliteration: samindra ṇo manasā neṣi gobhi: sa sūribhirmaghavantsa svastyā | saṃ brahmaṇā devakṛtaṃ yadasti saṃ devānā sumatau yajñiyānā svāhā
verses.wordMeaning: Lead us with thought to wealth in kine, O Indra, to princes, Lord of Bounty! and to welfare. Lead thou us on to God-inspired devotion, to favour of the Gods who merit worship. All-hail!
verses.commentary: Sense: Lead us with thought to wealth in kine, O Indra, to princes, Lord of Bounty! and to welfare. Lead thou us on to God-inspired devotion, to favour of the Gods who merit worship. All-hail!

verses.sanskrit:
सं वर्च॑सा॒ पय॑सा॒ सं त॒नूभि॒रग॑न्महि॒ मन॑सा॒ सᳪ शि॒वेन॑ ।
त्वष्टा॑ सु॒दत्रो॒ वि द॑धातु॒ रायोऽनु॑मार्ष्टु त॒न्वो यद्विलि॑ष्टम्
verses.translation: Verse
verses.hindi: हम घरों मे विद्वान् अतिथियों को आमन्त्रित कररे। उनपर यह प्रभाव न पड कि घर मे पति-पली में मेल नहीं है। हम यज्ञशेष के खानेवाले बने। ' प्राणशक्ति की वृद्धि, यज्ञो की प्रवृत्ति व घर को स्वर्गतुल्य बनाना" हमारा लक्ष्य हो। वयःहि त्वां प्रयति यज्ञेऽअस्मिन्नग्ने होतार मवुंणीमहीह।
verses.transliteration: saṃ varcasā payasā saṃ tanūbhiraganmahi manasā sa śivena | tvaṣṭā sudatro vi dadhātu rāyo'numārṣṭu tanvo yadviliṣṭam

verses.sanskrit:
धा॒ता रा॒तिः स॑वि॒तेदं जु॑षन्तां प्र॒जाप॑तिर्निधि॒पा दे॒वो अ॒ग्निः ।
त्वष्टा॒ विष्णु॑: प्र॒जया॑ सᳪररा॒णा यज॑मानाय॒ द्रवि॑णं दधात॒ स्वाहा॑
verses.translation: O restless Purifying Bath, thou glidest onward restlessly. May I with aid of Gods remove the stain of sin against the Gods, and wash away with mortals’ help the wrong that hath been done to men. Preserve me, God, from injury, from the loud-roaring demon foe. Thou art the fuel of the Gods.
verses.hindi: हम यज्ञं के लिए ज्ञानी होता का वरण करते हैँ। उनकी सद्खति मे हमारे यज्ञ निर्विघ्न पूर्ण होते रहते हेँ। हमारी चित्तवृत्ति भी शान्त होती हे। देवा गातुविदो गातुं वित्त्वा गातुमिंत। मन॑सस्पत्तऽ इमं देव यज्ञश्शस्वादा वात धाः २९॥
verses.transliteration: dhātā rātiḥ savitedaṃ juṣantāṃ prajāpatirnidhipā devo agniḥ | tvaṣṭā viṣṇu: prajayā sararāṇā yajamānāya draviṇaṃ dadhāta svāhā
verses.wordMeaning: O restless Purifying Bath, thou glidest onward restlessly. May I with aid of Gods remove the stain of sin against the Gods, and wash away with mortals’ help the wrong that hath been done to men. Preserve me, God, from injury, from the loud-roaring demon foe.…
verses.commentary: Sense: O restless Purifying Bath, thou glidest onward restlessly. May I with aid of Gods remove the stain of sin against the Gods, and wash away with mortals’ help the wrong that hath been done to men. Preserve me, God, from injury, from the loud-roaring demon foe.…

verses.sanskrit:
सु॒गा वो॑ देवा॒: सद॑ना अकर्म॒ य आ॑ज॒ग्मेदᳪ सव॑नं जुषा॒णाः ।
भर॑माणा॒ वह॑माना ह॒वीᳪष्य॒स्मे ध॑त्त वसवो॒ वसू॑नि॒ स्वाहा॑
verses.translation: Gods, we have made your seats easy of access, who, pleased with us, have come to this libation. Bearing and bringing hitherward your treasures, grant to this man, good Lords, abundant riches. All-hail!
verses.hindi: यज्ञ ही हमारी जीवनयात्रा के मार्ग हों। इनसे जहाँ हमारा जीवन पवित्र हो, वँ वायुमण्डल की पवित्रता से आधिहैविक आपत्तियाँ भी दूर हों। न्न्यज्ञ यज्ञं ग॑च्छ य॒ज्ञप॑तिं गच्छ स्वां योनिं गच्छ स्वाहा। गएष तै यज्ञो य॑ज्ञपते सहसूक्तवाकः सर्व'वीर स्तं जुषस्व स्वाह।।। २२॥
verses.transliteration: sugā vo devā: sadanā akarma ya ājagmeda savanaṃ juṣāṇāḥ | bharamāṇā vahamānā havīṣyasme dhatta vasavo vasūni svāhā
verses.wordMeaning: Gods, we have made your seats easy of access, who, pleased with us, have come to this libation. Bearing and bringing hitherward your treasures, grant to this man, good Lords, abundant riches. All-hail!
verses.commentary: Sense: Gods, we have made your seats easy of access, who, pleased with us, have come to this libation. Bearing and bringing hitherward your treasures, grant to this man, good Lords, abundant riches. All-hail!

verses.sanskrit:
याँ२  आऽव॑ह उश॒तो दे॑व दे॒वाँस्तान् प्रेर॑य॒ स्वे अ॑ग्ने स॒धस्थे॑ ।
ज॒क्षि॒वाᳪस॑: पपि॒वाjस॑श्च॒ विश्वेऽसुं॑ घ॒र्मᳪ स्व॒राति॑ष्ठ॒तानु॒ स्वाहा॑
verses.translation: The willing Gods whom, God, thou hast brought hither, send them to their own dwelling-place, O Agni. As all of you have eaten and have drunken, approach the air, the heat, the light of heaven.
verses.hindi: हम विद्वानों के सत्काररूप अतिधियज्ञ व प्रभु की उपासनारूप ब्रह्मयज्ञ को प्रतिदिन करनेवाले बनें। उत्तम कर्मो द्वारा प्रभु को प्रीणित करनेवाले हो। विशाल संसार में सभी के लिए स्थान है अपराहि भरमा पृदाकुः । न्डरूरहि राजा वरुणश्चकार सूर्यीय पन्थामन्वतवाऽ उ ।
verses.transliteration: yā~2 ā'vaha uśato deva devā~stān preraya sve agne sadhasthe | jakṣivāsa: papivājsaśca viśve'suṃ gharma svarātiṣṭhatānu svāhā
verses.wordMeaning: The willing Gods whom, God, thou hast brought hither, send them to their own dwelling-place, O Agni. As all of you have eaten and have drunken, approach the air, the heat, the light of heaven.
verses.commentary: Sense: The willing Gods whom, God, thou hast brought hither, send them to their own dwelling-place, O Agni. As all of you have eaten and have drunken, approach the air, the heat, the light of heaven.

verses.sanskrit:
व॒यᳪ  हि त्वा॑ प्रय॒ति य॒ज्ञे अ॒स्मिन्न॑ग्ने॒ होता॑र॒मवृ॑णीमही॒ह ।
ऋध॑गया॒ ऋध॑गु॒ताश॑मिष्ठाः प्रजा॒नन्  य॒ज्ञमुप॑ याहि वि॒द्वान्त्स्वाहा॑
verses.translation: Here, Agni, as this sacrifice proceedeth, have we elected thee to be our Hotar. Special have been thine offerings and thy labour. Well knowing sacrifice, as sage, come near us.
verses.hindi: हम संसार में सरलवृत्ति से चलें, ओरों के भाग को न हड़प जार्णँ। संसार अत्यन्त विशाल हे, छोटे-छोटे भू-भागो के लिए परस्पर लड नहीं। कभी मर्मपीडाकर वचन गृहस्थ के लिए ही कहते हैँ कि १. तुम अपना जीवन एेसा बनाओ कि अग्नेः-अग्नि का अनीकम् =वल अपः आविवेश=जलो मे प्रविष्ट हो। तुम्हारा जीवन जल की भांति
verses.transliteration: vaya hi tvā prayati yajñe asminnagne hotāramavṛṇīmahīha | ṛdhagayā ṛdhagutāśamiṣṭhāḥ prajānan yajñamupa yāhi vidvāntsvāhā
verses.wordMeaning: Here, Agni, as this sacrifice proceedeth, have we elected thee to be our Hotar. Special have been thine offerings and thy labour. Well knowing sacrifice, as sage, come near us.
verses.commentary: Sense: Here, Agni, as this sacrifice proceedeth, have we elected thee to be our Hotar. Special have been thine offerings and thy labour. Well knowing sacrifice, as sage, come near us.

verses.sanskrit: देवा॑ गातुविदो गा॒तुं वि॒त्त्वा गा॒तुमि॑त । मन॑सस्पत इ॒मं दे॑व य॒ज्ञᳪ  स्वाहा॒ वाते॑ धाः
verses.translation: Do ye, O Gods, discoverers of the Pathway, go forward on the path when ye have found it. O God, thou Lord and Master of the Spirit, bestow— All-hail!—this sacrifice on Vâta.
verses.hindi: हम अपने जीवनो में शान्ति व शक्ति का समन्वय करे। वीर्य की रक्षा करे, यही हमें प्राणशक्ति-सम्पन्न करेगा। हम इन्द्रिय-विजय के लिए प्रभु का उपासन करे। उपासक बनकर उत्तम शब्द ही बोले। समुद्र में हदय का धारण
verses.transliteration: devā gātuvido gātuṃ vittvā gātumita | manasaspata imaṃ deva yajña svāhā vāte dhāḥ
verses.wordMeaning: Do ye, O Gods, discoverers of the Pathway, go forward on the path when ye have found it. O God, thou Lord and Master of the Spirit, bestow— All-hail!—this sacrifice on Vâta.
verses.commentary: Sense: Do ye, O Gods, discoverers of the Pathway, go forward on the path when ye have found it. O God, thou Lord and Master of the Spirit, bestow— All-hail!—this sacrifice on Vâta.

verses.sanskrit:
यज्ञ॑ य॒ज्ञं ग॑च्छ य॒ज्ञपतिं॑ गच्छ॒ स्वां योनिं॑ गच्छ॒ स्वाहा॑ ।
ए॒ष ते॑ य॒ज्ञो य॑ज्ञपते स॒हसू॑क्तवाक॒: सर्व॑वीर॒स्तं  जु॑षस्व॒ स्वाहा॑
verses.translation: Go, Sacrifice, to the sacrifice: seek thou the sacrifice's lord, seek thine own home. All-hail! Lord of the sacrifice, this is thy sacrifice, followed by many heroes, loud with hymns of praise. Accept it thou. All-hail!
verses.hindi: त् प्रभु मेव सोमरक्षा में अपने हृदय को स्थापित कर। वानस्पतिक भोजन व जल का सेवन करनेवोला बन। तेरा जीवन यज्ञमय हो। तू निरन्तर प्रभु-उपासन करनेवाला हो। पत्ति-पल्ी की पारस्परिक प्रेरणा देवीरापऽएष वो गर्भ॑स्तःसुप्रीतःसुभूंतं बिभृत।
verses.transliteration: yajña yajñaṃ gaccha yajñapatiṃ gaccha svāṃ yoniṃ gaccha svāhā | eṣa te yajño yajñapate sahasūktavāka: sarvavīrastaṃ juṣasva svāhā
verses.wordMeaning: Go, Sacrifice, to the sacrifice: seek thou the sacrifice's lord, seek thine own home. All-hail! Lord of the sacrifice, this is thy sacrifice, followed by many heroes, loud with hymns of praise. Accept it thou. All-hail!
verses.commentary: Sense: Go, Sacrifice, to the sacrifice: seek thou the sacrifice's lord, seek thine own home. All-hail! Lord of the sacrifice, this is thy sacrifice, followed by many heroes, loud with hymns of praise. Accept it thou. All-hail!

verses.sanskrit:
माहि॑र्भू॒र्मा पृदा॑कुः । उ॒रुᳪ  हि राजा॒ वरु॑णश्च॒कार॒ सूर्या॑य॒ पन्था॒मन्वे॑त॒वा उ॑ ।
अ॒पदे॒ पादा॒ प्रति॑धातवेऽकरु॒ताप॑व॒क्ता हृ॑दया॒विध॑श्चित् ।
नमो॒ वरु॑णाया॒भिष्ठि॑तो॒ वरु॑णस्य॒ पाश॑:
verses.translation: Become no serpent thou, become no viper. King Vat-tins hath made a spacious pathway, a pathway for the Sun wherein to travel. Where no way was he made him set his footstep, and warned afar whate’er afflicts the spirit. To Varuna be reverential homage! Varuna's noose beneath our feet is trampled.
verses.hindi: पली गर्भकाप्रेम से व पोषण की वृत्ति से धारण करे। पति इस बालक के लिए उसकी माता के दोहद् (गर्भवती कौ इच्छा) को पूरा करता हआ कल्याण प्राप्त कराए ओर अकल्याण को दूर करे। सूचना-' आपः" शब्द नित्य बहुवचनान्त हे, अतः यहोँ बहुवचन को देखकर बहुपलीत्व
verses.transliteration: māhirbhūrmā pṛdākuḥ | uru hi rājā varuṇaścakāra sūryāya panthāmanvetavā u | apade pādā pratidhātave'karutāpavaktā hṛdayāvidhaścit | namo varuṇāyābhiṣṭhito varuṇasya pāśa:
verses.wordMeaning: Become no serpent thou, become no viper. King Vat-tins hath made a spacious pathway, a pathway for the Sun wherein to travel. Where no way was he made him set his footstep, and warned afar whate’er afflicts the spirit.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Become no serpent thou, become no viper. King Vat-tins hath made a spacious pathway, a pathway for the Sun wherein to travel. Where no way was he made him set his footstep, and warned afar whate’er afflicts the spirit.…

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒ग्नेरनी॑कम॒प आ वि॑वेशा॒पां नपा॑त्  प्रति॒रक्ष॑न्नसु॒र्य॒म् ।
दमे॑दमे स॒मिधं॑ यक्ष्यग्ने॒ प्रति॑ ते जि॒ह्वा घृ॒तमुच्च॑रण्य॒त्  स्वाहा॑
verses.translation: The waters, face of Agni, have I entered, O Waters’ Child, repelling evil spirits. Offer the fuel in each home, O Agni. Let thy tongue dart —All-hail!—to meet the butter.
verses.hindi: हम प्रत्येक कार्य में सफल हों, शान्तिपूर्वक चलें, उत्तम गुणों का चयन कररे। न देवों के विषय में पाप करे, न मर्त्यो के विषय में। वासनाओं से प्राप्त होनेवाली हिंसा को दान द्वारा विनष्ट करे। दिव्य गुणों को दीप्त करे। ९. अब गर्भस्थ बालक बाहर आता है। उसके लिए कहते है कि-यह दशमास्यः दस
verses.transliteration: agneranīkamapa ā viveśāpāṃ napāt pratirakṣannasuryam | damedame samidhaṃ yakṣyagne prati te jihvā ghṛtamuccaraṇyat svāhā
verses.wordMeaning: The waters, face of Agni, have I entered, O Waters’ Child, repelling evil spirits. Offer the fuel in each home, O Agni. Let thy tongue dart —All-hail!—to meet the butter.
verses.commentary: Sense: The waters, face of Agni, have I entered, O Waters’ Child, repelling evil spirits. Offer the fuel in each home, O Agni. Let thy tongue dart —All-hail!—to meet the butter.

verses.sanskrit:
स॒मु॒द्रे ते॒ हृद॑यम॒प्स्वन्तः सं त्वा॑ विश॒न्त्वोष॑धीरु॒ताप॑: ।
य॒ज्ञस्य॑ त्वा यज्ञपते सू॒क्तोक्तौ॑ नमोवा॒के वि॑धेम॒ यत्स्वाहा॑
verses.translation: Thy heart is in the flood, within the waters. With thee let plants and waters be commingled, That, Lard of Sacrifice, we may adore thee with singing praise and telling forth our homage. All-hail!
verses.hindi: जेसे वायु व समुद्र की स्वाभाविक गति व कम्पन है, इसी प्रकार दशमास्य गर्भ मेँ भी कम्पन हो ओर वह मातृगर्भं से बाहर आये। यस्यै ते यज्ञियो गभो यस्यै योनिर्हिर् ण्ययीं। अद्कान्यहूंता यस्य तं मात्रा सम॑जीगमश्स्वाह॥। २९॥
verses.transliteration: samudre te hṛdayamapsvantaḥ saṃ tvā viśantvoṣadhīrutāpa: | yajñasya tvā yajñapate sūktoktau namovāke vidhema yatsvāhā
verses.wordMeaning: Thy heart is in the flood, within the waters. With thee let plants and waters be commingled, That, Lard of Sacrifice, we may adore thee with singing praise and telling forth our homage. All-hail!
verses.commentary: Sense: Thy heart is in the flood, within the waters. With thee let plants and waters be commingled, That, Lard of Sacrifice, we may adore thee with singing praise and telling forth our homage. All-hail!

verses.sanskrit:
देवी॑राप ए॒ष वो॒ गर्भ॒स्तᳪ  सुप्री॑त॒ᳪ सुभृ॑तं बिभृत ।
देव॑ सोमै॒ष ते॑ लो॒कस्तस्मि॒ञ्छं च॒ वक्ष्व॒ परि॑ च॒ वक्ष्व॑
verses.translation: This, O celestial Waters, is your offspring. Support him dearly loved and gently nurtured. This is thy station, O celestial Soma; therein bring happiness and ward off evil.
verses.hindi: माता गर्भं में बालक के चरित्र का निर्माण कर देती है। वह माता है गर्भमानकर्त्री है- गर्भं में बच्चे को बनानेवाली हेै। सन्तान- इन्दु का उदय ( चन्द्रोदय ) गत मन्त्र के अनुसार यदि माता गर्भ में ही बालक का सुन्दरता से निर्माण करती
verses.transliteration: devīrāpa eṣa vo garbhasta suprīta subhṛtaṃ bibhṛta | deva somaiṣa te lokastasmiñchaṃ ca vakṣva pari ca vakṣva
verses.wordMeaning: This, O celestial Waters, is your offspring. Support him dearly loved and gently nurtured. This is thy station, O celestial Soma; therein bring happiness and ward off evil.
verses.commentary: Sense: This, O celestial Waters, is your offspring. Support him dearly loved and gently nurtured. This is thy station, O celestial Soma; therein bring happiness and ward off evil.

verses.sanskrit:
अव॑भृथ निचुम्पुण निचे॒रुर॑सि निचुम्पु॒णः ।
अव॑ देवैर्दे॒वकृ॑त॒मेनो॑ऽयासिष॒मव॒ मर्त्यै॒र्मर्त्य॑कृतं पुरु॒राव्णो॑ देव रि॒षस्पा॑हि ।
दे॒वाना॑ᳪ  स॒मिद॑सि
verses.translation: Let, still unborn, the ten-month calf move with the following after-birth.
verses.hindi: घ्र में सन्तान आये तो एेसा अनुभव हो कि चन्द्रोदय हो गया हे। वेदवाणी करे अनुसार जीवन बनाने की हमारी प्रवृत्ति बदे। ९. पिक्छले मन्त्र के वर्णन के अनुसार हमारे सन्तान सुन्दर, श्रेष्ठ बनें" इसके लिए आवश्यक है कि माता-पिता प्राणसाधना करनेवाले हों, क्योंकि इस प्राणसाधना से इद्धियों
verses.transliteration: avabhṛtha nicumpuṇa nicerurasi nicumpuṇaḥ | ava devairdevakṛtameno'yāsiṣamava martyairmartyakṛtaṃ pururāvṇo deva riṣaspāhi | devānā samidasi
verses.wordMeaning: Let, still unborn, the ten-month calf move with the following after-birth.
verses.commentary: Sense: Let, still unborn, the ten-month calf move with the following after-birth.

verses.sanskrit:
एज॑तु॒ दश॑मास्यो॒ गर्भो॑ ज॒रायु॑णा स॒ह । यथा॒ऽयं वा॒युरेज॑ति॒ यथा॑ समु॒द्र एज॑ति ।
ए॒वा॒यं दश॑मास्यो॒ अस्र॑ज्ज॒रायु॑णा स॒ह
verses.translation: Even as the-wind is moving, as the gathered flood of ocean moves, So may this ten-month calf come forth together with the after-birth.
verses.hindi: हम प्राणसाधना करेगे तो हमारे सन्तान मारुति=हनुमान् के समान प्रभु के सेवक बनेगे। हमारे खन्तानों की इन्द्रियां बडी शुद्ध होंगी। मही द्यौः पुंथिवी च॑ नऽडमं यज्ञं मिमिक्षताम् । पिपृतां नो भरींमभिः॥३२॥ ९. गत मन्त्र के अनुसार प्राणसराधना करनेवाला ओर मही=(मह पूजायाम्) प्रभु
verses.transliteration: ejatu daśamāsyo garbho jarāyuṇā saha | yathā'yaṃ vāyurejati yathā samudra ejati | evāyaṃ daśamāsyo asrajjarāyuṇā saha
verses.wordMeaning: Even as the-wind is moving, as the gathered flood of ocean moves, So may this ten-month calf come forth together with the after-birth.
verses.commentary: Sense: Even as the-wind is moving, as the gathered flood of ocean moves, So may this ten-month calf come forth together with the after-birth.

verses.sanskrit:
यस्यै॑ ते य॒ज्ञियो॒ गर्भो॒ यस्यै॒ योनि॑र्हिरण्यी ।
अङ्गा॒न्यह्रु॑ता॒ यस्य॒ तं मा॒त्रा सम॑जीगम॒ᳪ स्वाहा॑
verses.translation: O thou who hast a womb of gold and offspring meet for sacrifice, Him with all limbs unbroken have I brought together with his dam. All-hail!
verses.hindi: माता-पिता प्रकाशमय जीवनवाले तथा विस्तृत शक्तियोंवाले होँ। ये सन्तानो को उत्तम ज्ञान व गुणों से सङ्गत करे। ये इसके शरीर को नीरोग बना तथा मन को दिव्य ९. माता-पिता ' गत मन्त्र की भावना के अनुसार बन सके" उसके लिए प्रभु जीव को निर्देश करते है कि-हे वृत्रहन्-कामवासना को नष्ट करनेवाले जीव! तू रथम्-इस
verses.transliteration: yasyai te yajñiyo garbho yasyai yonirhiraṇyī | aṅgānyahrutā yasya taṃ mātrā samajīgama svāhā
verses.wordMeaning: O thou who hast a womb of gold and offspring meet for sacrifice, Him with all limbs unbroken have I brought together with his dam. All-hail!
verses.commentary: Sense: O thou who hast a womb of gold and offspring meet for sacrifice, Him with all limbs unbroken have I brought together with his dam. All-hail!

verses.sanskrit:
पुरुद॒स्मो विषु॑रूप॒ इन्दु॑र॒न्तर्म॑हि॒मान॑मानञ्ज॒ धीर॑: ।
एक॑पदीं द्वि॒पदीं॑ त्रि॒पदीं॒ चतु॒ष्पदीम॒ष्टाप॑दीं॒ भुव॒नानु॑ प्रथन्ता॒ᳪ  स्वाहा॑
verses.translation: Multiform, rich in wondrous operation, the strong juice hath enrobed itself with greatness. Let the worlds praise her uniped and biped, three-footed and four-footed and eight-footed. All-hail!
verses.hindi: -हम इन्द्रियों को इस शरीररूपी रथ के घोडे समञ्े। उन्हें रथ में जोतकर यात्रा को पूरा कर। इसी जीवन मे हमने संयमी बनकर षोडशी बनना है। "इस प्रकार हमारी इच्छां मधुर बनी रहीं" तो हम मन्त्र के ऋषि मधुच्छन्दा" होगे। च्डन्द्रमिद्धरी बहतो ऽप्र॑तिधृष्टशवसम्। ऋषीणां च स्तुतीरुप यज्ञं च मानुषाणाम् ।
verses.transliteration: purudasmo viṣurūpa indurantarmahimānamānañja dhīra: | ekapadīṃ dvipadīṃ tripadīṃ catuṣpadīmaṣṭāpadīṃ bhuvanānu prathantā svāhā
verses.wordMeaning: Multiform, rich in wondrous operation, the strong juice hath enrobed itself with greatness. Let the worlds praise her uniped and biped, three-footed and four-footed and eight-footed. All-hail!
verses.commentary: Sense: Multiform, rich in wondrous operation, the strong juice hath enrobed itself with greatness. Let the worlds praise her uniped and biped, three-footed and four-footed and eight-footed. All-hail!

verses.sanskrit: मरु॑तो॒ यस्य॒ हि क्षये॑ पा॒था दि॒वो वि॑महसः । स सु॑गो॒पात॑मो॒ जन॑:
verses.translation: Verily, best of guardians hath he in whose dwelling-place ye drink, O Maruts, giants of the sky.
verses.hindi: मेरा जीवन  इन्द्र" का जीवन हो, जितेन्द्रिय बनकर मै ऋषियों के समान स्तवन करनेवाला बनू ओर मानवहितकारी यज्ञो में प्रवृत्त होऊॐँ। गत मन्त्र मे स्तुति करने का उल्लेख धभा। प्रस्तुत मन्त्र मे स्तुति का स्वरूप प्रतिपादित करते है। १. यस्मात् जिससे अधिक जातः प्रसिद्ध व परः=उत्तम अन्य: =दूसरा न अस्ति
verses.transliteration: maruto yasya hi kṣaye pāthā divo vimahasaḥ | sa sugopātamo jana:
verses.wordMeaning: Verily, best of guardians hath he in whose dwelling-place ye drink, O Maruts, giants of the sky.
verses.commentary: Sense: Verily, best of guardians hath he in whose dwelling-place ye drink, O Maruts, giants of the sky.

verses.sanskrit: म॒ही द्यौः पृ॑थि॒वी च॑ न इ॒मं य॒ज्ञं मि॑मिक्षताम् । पि॒पृ॒तां नो॒ भरी॑मभिः
verses.translation: May Heaven and Earth, the Mighty Pair, besprinkle this our sacrifice, And feed us full with nourishments.
verses.hindi: प्रभु सर्वोपरि सत्ता हे। सब देवों को देवत्व व सब प्राणियों को सोलह कलाएं वे प्रभु ही प्राप्त कराया करते है। इस प्रकार प्रभु-स्तवन करनेवाला “ विवस्वान् ' - सूर्य के समान अन्धकार को दूर करके प्रकाशवाला बनता है। स्तुति के लिए सोम्य भोजन
verses.transliteration: mahī dyauḥ pṛthivī ca na imaṃ yajñaṃ mimikṣatām | pipṛtāṃ no bharīmabhiḥ
verses.wordMeaning: May Heaven and Earth, the Mighty Pair, besprinkle this our sacrifice, And feed us full with nourishments.
verses.commentary: Sense: May Heaven and Earth, the Mighty Pair, besprinkle this our sacrifice, And feed us full with nourishments.

verses.sanskrit:
आ ति॑ष्ठ वृत्रह॒न्रथं॑ यु॒क्ता ते॒ ब्रह्म॑णा॒ हरी॑ । अ॒र्वा॒चीन॒ᳪ  सु ते॒ मनो॒ ग्रावा॑ कृणोतु व॒ग्नुना॑ ।
उ॒प॒या॒मगृ॑हीतो॒ऽसीन्द्रा॑य त्वा षोड॒शिन॑  ए॒ष ते॒ योनि॒रिन्द्रा॑य त्वा षोड॒शिने॑
verses.translation: Slayer of Vritra, mount thy car: thy Bay Steeds have been yoked by prayer. May, with its voice, the pressing-stone draw thine attention hither ward. Taken upon a base art thou. For Indra thee, for Shodasî. This is a dwelling-place for thee. For Indra thee, for Shodasî.
verses.hindi: भोजन का दुष्टिकोण “जितेन्द्रियता, तेजस्विता, मानसपवित्रता व व्यवस्थित जीवन' हो। हम सौम्य भोजन करके प्राणशक्ति-सम्पन्न बनें। स्वाद को छोडं। यह ध्यान रक्खें कि आग्नेय पदार्थ प्रभु ने ओषधरूप में बरतने के लिए बनाये है। सात्विक भोजन करके में ज्ञान कौ दीप्तिवाला "विवस्वान्" बनूँगा।
verses.transliteration: ā tiṣṭha vṛtrahanrathaṃ yuktā te brahmaṇā harī | arvācīna su te mano grāvā kṛṇotu vagnunā | upayāmagṛhīto'sīndrāya tvā ṣoḍaśina eṣa te yonirindrāya tvā ṣoḍaśine
verses.wordMeaning: Slayer of Vritra, mount thy car: thy Bay Steeds have been yoked by prayer. May, with its voice, the pressing-stone draw thine attention hither ward. Taken upon a base art thou. For Indra thee, for Shodasî. This is a dwelling-place for thee. For Indra thee, for Shodasî.
verses.commentary: Sense: Slayer of Vritra, mount thy car: thy Bay Steeds have been yoked by prayer. May, with its voice, the pressing-stone draw thine attention hither ward. Taken upon a base art thou. For Indra thee, for Shodasî. This is a dwelling-place for thee. For Indra thee, for Shodasî.

verses.sanskrit:
यु॒क्ष्वा हि के॒शिना॒ हरी॒ वृष॑णा कक्ष्य॒प्रा । अथा॑ न इन्द्र सोमपा गि॒रामुप॑श्रुतिं चर ।
उ॒प॒या॒मगृ॑हीतो॒ऽसीन्द्रा॑य त्वा षोड॒शिन॑  ए॒ष ते॒ योनि॒रिन्द्रा॑य त्वा षोड॒शिने॑
verses.translation: Harness thy pair of strong Bay Steeds, long-maned, whose bodies fill the girths, And, Indra, Soma-drinker, come to listen to our songs of praise. Taken upon a base, etc., as in 33.
verses.hindi: हम उस अग्नि के समान ' वर्चस्वान्" बने। क्डपयामगुंहीतो ऽ सीन्द्रौय त्वौज॑सञऽएष ते योनिरिन्द्राय त्वोज॑से। १९. गत मन्त्र का ' वर्चस्वान् ' प्रस्तुत मन्त्र में ओजिष्ठ" बनता है। यह सोमपान करता है ओर ओजस्वी बनकर शत्रुओं के जबडों को हिला देता हे। प्रस्तुत मन्त्र मे कहते है कि
verses.transliteration: yukṣvā hi keśinā harī vṛṣaṇā kakṣyaprā | athā na indra somapā girāmupaśrutiṃ cara | upayāmagṛhīto'sīndrāya tvā ṣoḍaśina eṣa te yonirindrāya tvā ṣoḍaśine
verses.wordMeaning: Harness thy pair of strong Bay Steeds, long-maned, whose bodies fill the girths, And, Indra, Soma-drinker, come to listen to our songs of praise. Taken upon a base, etc., as in 33.
verses.commentary: Sense: Harness thy pair of strong Bay Steeds, long-maned, whose bodies fill the girths, And, Indra, Soma-drinker, come to listen to our songs of praise. Taken upon a base, etc., as in 33.

verses.sanskrit:
इन्द्र॒मिद्धरी॑ वह॒तोऽप्र॑तिधृष्टशवसम् । ऋषी॑णां च स्तु॒तीरुप॑ य॒ज्ञं च॒ मानु॑षाणाम् ।
उ॒प॒या॒मगृ॑हीतो॒ सीन्द्रा॑य त्वा षोड॒शिने॑  ए॒ष ते॒ योनि॒रिन्द्रा॑य त्वा षोड॒शिने॑
verses.translation: His pair of tawny Coursers bring Indra of unresisted might Hither to Rishis’ songs of praise and sacrifice performed by men. Taken upon a base, etc., as in 33.
verses.hindi: हम उस “इन्द्र के अनुसार ओजिष्ठ बने। उअदुश्रमस्य केतवो वि रश्मयो जनाँ २ऽअनुं । भ्राज॑न्तो अग्नयो यथा । स्सूर्य' भ्राजिष्ठ भ्राजिष्ठस्त्वं दे वेष्वसि भ्राजिष्ठो ऽ हं मनुष्येषु भूयासम्।।४०॥ १. प्रभु के समान ओजिष्ठ बनता हुआ यह चाहता टै कि जनान् अनु-अपनी
verses.transliteration: indramiddharī vahato'pratidhṛṣṭaśavasam | ṛṣīṇāṃ ca stutīrupa yajñaṃ ca mānuṣāṇām | upayāmagṛhīto sīndrāya tvā ṣoḍaśine eṣa te yonirindrāya tvā ṣoḍaśine
verses.wordMeaning: His pair of tawny Coursers bring Indra of unresisted might Hither to Rishis’ songs of praise and sacrifice performed by men. Taken upon a base, etc., as in 33.
verses.commentary: Sense: His pair of tawny Coursers bring Indra of unresisted might Hither to Rishis’ songs of praise and sacrifice performed by men. Taken upon a base, etc., as in 33.

verses.sanskrit:
यस्मा॒न्न जा॒तः परो॑ अ॒न्यो अस्ति॒ य आ॑वि॒वेश॒ भुव॑नानि॒ विश्वा॑ ।
प्र॒जाप॑तिः प्र॒जया॑ सᳪररा॒णस्त्रीणि॒ ज्योती॑ᳪषि सचते॒ स षो॑डशी
verses.translation: Than whom there is none other born more mighty, who hath pervaded all existing creatures— Prajâpati, rejoicing in his offspring, he, Shodasî, maintains the three great lustres.
verses.hindi: “वर्चस्वान्, ओजिष्ठ व भ्राजिष्ठ ' बनने का साधन क्उदु त्यं जातवेदसं देवं व॑हन्ति केतवः । दृशो विश्वाय सूर्य॑म् । १. गत मन्त्रों में वर्चस्वान्, ओजिष्ठ व भ्राजिष्ठ" बनने की प्रेरणा दी गई है। प्रस्तुत बन सकता हे, परन्तु प्रकृति से ऊपर उठकर ही। २. जब प्रकृति से ऊपर उठकर हम उस
verses.transliteration: yasmānna jātaḥ paro anyo asti ya āviveśa bhuvanāni viśvā | prajāpatiḥ prajayā sararāṇastrīṇi jyotīṣi sacate sa ṣoḍaśī
verses.wordMeaning: Than whom there is none other born more mighty, who hath pervaded all existing creatures— Prajâpati, rejoicing in his offspring, he, Shodasî, maintains the three great lustres.
verses.commentary: Sense: Than whom there is none other born more mighty, who hath pervaded all existing creatures— Prajâpati, rejoicing in his offspring, he, Shodasî, maintains the three great lustres.

verses.sanskrit:
इन्द्र॑श्च स॒म्राड्वरु॑णश्च॒ राजा तौ ते भ॒क्षं च॑क्रतु॒रग्र॑ ए॒तम् ।
तयो॑र॒हमनु॑ भ॒क्षं भ॑क्षयामि॒ वाग्दे॒वी जु॑षा॒णा सोम॑स्य तृप्यतु  स॒ह प्रा॒णेन॒ स्वाहा॑
verses.translation: Indra chief Lord and Varuna the Sovran have made this draught of thine the first and foremost. I, after, drink their draught. May she, the Goddess of Speech, rejoicing, sate herself with Soma—All-hail!—with Prâna as her feast-companion.
verses.hindi: हम प्राकृतिक भोगों से ऊपर उठे, प्रभु को हदय में धारण करें, सर्वहित की भावना से ओत-प्रोत हों, जीवन संयमी हो ओर हम सूर्यं कौ भांति चमकनेवाले बने। १. पिछले मन्त्रों में " षोडशी ' शब्द का प्रयोग कई बार हआ हे। प्रभु षोडशी इसलिए है कि वे सोलह कलाओं के स्वामी है ओर जीव षोडशी इसलिए है कि उसने इन सोलह
verses.transliteration: indraśca samrāḍvaruṇaśca rājā tau te bhakṣaṃ cakraturagra etam | tayorahamanu bhakṣaṃ bhakṣayāmi vāgdevī juṣāṇā somasya tṛpyatu saha prāṇena svāhā
verses.wordMeaning: Indra chief Lord and Varuna the Sovran have made this draught of thine the first and foremost. I, after, drink their draught. May she, the Goddess of Speech, rejoicing, sate herself with Soma—All-hail!—with Prâna as her feast-companion.
verses.commentary: Sense: Indra chief Lord and Varuna the Sovran have made this draught of thine the first and foremost. I, after, drink their draught. May she, the Goddess of Speech, rejoicing, sate herself with Soma—All-hail!—with Prâna as her feast-companion.

verses.sanskrit:
अग्ने॒ पव॑स्व॒ स्वपा॑ अ॒स्मे वर्च॑: सु॒वीर्य॑म् । दध॑द्र॒यिं मयि॒ पोष॑म् ।
उ॒प॒या॒मगृ॑हीतोऽस्य॒ग्नये॑ त्वा॒ वर्च॑स  ए॒ष ते॒ योनि॑र॒ग्नये॑ त्वा॒ वर्च॑से ।
अग्ने॑ वर्चस्वि॒न्वर्च॑स्वाँ॒स्त्वं दे॒वेष्वसि॒ वर्च॑स्वान॒हं म॑नु॒ष्ये॑षु भूयासम्
verses.translation: Skilled in thy task, O Agni, pour lustre and hero strength on us, Granting me wealth and affluence. Taken upon a base art thou. For Agni thee, for splendour This is thy home. For Agni thee, for splendour. Thou, lustrous Agni, mid the Gods art splendid. May I among mankind be bright with lustre.
verses.hindi: हम सर्वत्र प्रभु की महिमा देखे, प्रभु के उपासक बनें ओर प्रभु की शक्ति से अपने को शक्ति-सम्पन्न करें। प्रभु से अपना मेल करनेवाला व्यक्ति 'कुसुरु' है (कुस् 10 €1019८८) इस मेल से शक्ति-लाभ करनेवाला यह ‹ विन्दु ' (विन्दति=लभते) है। एवं, इसका नाम ही ' कुसुरुविन्दु ' पड गया हे।
verses.transliteration: agne pavasva svapā asme varca: suvīryam | dadhadrayiṃ mayi poṣam | upayāmagṛhīto'syagnaye tvā varcasa eṣa te yoniragnaye tvā varcase | agne varcasvinvarcasvā~stvaṃ deveṣvasi varcasvānahaṃ manuṣyeṣu bhūyāsam
verses.wordMeaning: Skilled in thy task, O Agni, pour lustre and hero strength on us, Granting me wealth and affluence. Taken upon a base art thou. For Agni thee, for splendour This is thy home. For Agni thee, for splendour. Thou, lustrous Agni, mid the Gods art splendid.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Skilled in thy task, O Agni, pour lustre and hero strength on us, Granting me wealth and affluence. Taken upon a base art thou. For Agni thee, for splendour This is thy home. For Agni thee, for splendour. Thou, lustrous Agni, mid the Gods art splendid.…

verses.sanskrit:
उ॒त्तिष्ठ॒न्नोज॑सा स॒ह पी॒त्वी शिप्रे॑ अवेपयः । सोम॑मिन्द्र च॒मू सु॒तम् ।
उ॒प॒या॒मगृ॑हीतो॒ऽसीन्द्रा॑य॒ त्वौज॑स ए॒ष ते॒ योनि॒रिन्द्रा॑य त्वौजसे ।
इन्द्रौ॑जिष्ठौजि॑ष्ठ॒स्त्वं दे॒वेष्वस्योजि॑ष्ठो॒ऽहं म॑नु॒ष्ये॒षु भूयासम्
verses.translation: Arising in thy might thy jaws thou shookest, Indra, having drunk The Soma which the mortar pressed. Taken upon a base art thou. For Indra thee, for mighty strength. This is thy home. For Indra thee, for might. Among the Gods thou art the mightiest, Indra. Among mankind I fain would be most mighty.
verses.hindi: वेदवाणी को " अघ्न्या" जानकर हम उसका नित्य स्वाध्याय करे ओर अपने कर्तव्यो को जानकर पुण्य का आचरण करे। यह आचरण ही हमें ' कुसुरु "प्रभु से मेलवाला व ‹ विन्दु '=मोक्षलाभ. करनेवाला बनाएगा। क्वि न॑ऽइन्द्र॒ मृधो जहि नीचा य॑च्छ पृतन्यतः। योऽअस्मोँ २।ऽअभिदासत्यध॑रं
verses.transliteration: uttiṣṭhannojasā saha pītvī śipre avepayaḥ | somamindra camū sutam | upayāmagṛhīto'sīndrāya tvaujasa eṣa te yonirindrāya tvaujase | indraujiṣṭhaujiṣṭhastvaṃ deveṣvasyojiṣṭho'haṃ manuṣyeṣu bhūyāsam
verses.wordMeaning: Arising in thy might thy jaws thou shookest, Indra, having drunk The Soma which the mortar pressed. Taken upon a base art thou. For Indra thee, for mighty strength. This is thy home. For Indra thee, for might. Among the Gods thou art the mightiest, Indra.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Arising in thy might thy jaws thou shookest, Indra, having drunk The Soma which the mortar pressed. Taken upon a base art thou. For Indra thee, for mighty strength. This is thy home. For Indra thee, for might. Among the Gods thou art the mightiest, Indra.…

verses.sanskrit:
अदृ॑श्रमस्य के॒तवो॒ वि र॒श्मयो॒ जनाँ॒२ अनु॑ । भ्राज॑न्तो अ॒ग्नयो॑ यथा ।
उ॒प॒या॒मगृ॑हीतोऽसि॒ सूर्या॑य त्वा भ्रा॒जायै॒ष ते॒ योनि॒: सूर्या॑य त्वा भ्रा॒जाय॑ ।
सूर्य॑ भ्राजिष्ठ॒ भ्राजि॑ष्ठ॒स्त्वं दे॒वेष्वसि॒ भ्राजि॑ष्ठो॒ऽहं म॑नु॒ष्ये॒षु भूयासम्
verses.translation: His herald rays are seen afar refulgent o’er the world of men, Like flames of fire that burn and blaze. Taken upon a base art thou. For Sûrya, for the Bright One, thee. This is thy home. For Sûrya, for the Bright One, thee. Thou among Gods art brightest, brightest Sûrya. Among mankind I fain would be the brightest.
verses.hindi: मैं इन्द्र बनूं। इद्धियों का शासन करनेवाला "शास" होऊं। वासनाओं को क्वाचस्पतिं विश्वकर्माणमूतये मनोजुवं वाजेैऽअद्या ह्वेम। स नो विशवानि हव॑नानि जोषद्धिश्वश॑म्भूरवं से साधुक॑र्मा। ष्डपयामगुंहीतो ऽ सीन्द्रौय त्वा गत मन्त्र मे 'शास' ने प्रभु कौ इस प्रेरणा को सुना था कि 'विमृधे'=शत्रुओं के
verses.transliteration: adṛśramasya ketavo vi raśmayo janā~2 anu | bhrājanto agnayo yathā | upayāmagṛhīto'si sūryāya tvā bhrājāyaiṣa te yoni: sūryāya tvā bhrājāya | sūrya bhrājiṣṭha bhrājiṣṭhastvaṃ deveṣvasi bhrājiṣṭho'haṃ manuṣyeṣu bhūyāsam
verses.wordMeaning: His herald rays are seen afar refulgent o’er the world of men, Like flames of fire that burn and blaze. Taken upon a base art thou. For Sûrya, for the Bright One, thee. This is thy home. For Sûrya, for the Bright One, thee. Thou among Gods art brightest, brightest Sûrya.…
verses.commentary: Sense: His herald rays are seen afar refulgent o’er the world of men, Like flames of fire that burn and blaze. Taken upon a base art thou. For Sûrya, for the Bright One, thee. This is thy home. For Sûrya, for the Bright One, thee. Thou among Gods art brightest, brightest Sûrya.…

verses.sanskrit:
उदु॒ त्यं जा॒तवे॑दसं दे॒वं व॑हन्ति के॒तव॑: । दृ॒शे विश्वा॑य॒ सूर्य॑म् ।
उ॒प॒या॒मगृ॑हीतोऽसि॒ सूर्या॑य त्वा भ्रा॒जायै॒ष ते॒ योनि॒: सूर्या॑य त्वा भ्रा॒जाय॑
verses.translation: His herald rays bear him aloft, the God who knoweth all that lives, Sûrya, that all may look at him. Taken upon a base, etc., as in 40.
verses.hindi: प्रभु वेदवाणी के पति दहै। वे हमें हृदयस्थरूपेण प्रेरणा देते है। हम उनकी प्ररणा को सुनें ओर तदनुसार कर्मो को करते हुए जीवन को शान्त बनार्णँ। क्विश्व॑कर्मन् हविषा वर्ध'नेन त्रातार मिन्द्र॑मकृणोरवध्यम्। तस्मै विशः सम॑नमन्त "लोगों के जीवन वेदानुकूल बनें" इसमें राजा का भी मुख्य हाथ होता है, अतः
verses.transliteration: udu tyaṃ jātavedasaṃ devaṃ vahanti ketava: | dṛśe viśvāya sūryam | upayāmagṛhīto'si sūryāya tvā bhrājāyaiṣa te yoni: sūryāya tvā bhrājāya
verses.wordMeaning: His herald rays bear him aloft, the God who knoweth all that lives, Sûrya, that all may look at him. Taken upon a base, etc., as in 40.
verses.commentary: Sense: His herald rays bear him aloft, the God who knoweth all that lives, Sûrya, that all may look at him. Taken upon a base, etc., as in 40.

verses.sanskrit:
आ जि॑घ्र क॒लशं॑ म॒ह्या त्वा॑ विश॒न्त्विन्द॑वः।
पुन॑रू॒र्जा नि व॑र्तस्व॒ सा न॑: स॒हस्रं॑ धुक्ष्वो॒रुधा॑रा॒ पय॑स्वती॒ पुन॒र्मा वि॑शताद्र॒यिः
verses.translation: Smell thou the vat. Let Soma drops pass into thee, O Mighty One. Return again with store of sap. Pour for us wealth in thou- sands thou with full broad streams and floods of milk. A Let riches come again to me.
verses.hindi: राजा उचित कर 'लेनेवाला ओर प्रजा की रक्षा करनेवाला हो, जिससे यह प्रजा का आदरणीय बने। प्रजा का आदरणीय बनकर यह तेजस्वी हो ओर सब राष्ट के आमन्त्रण में विहव्य=विशिष्ट आदर से निमन्त्रित किया जाने योग्य हो। गृह्णामि विश्वैभ्यस्त्वा देवेभ्यो जग॑च्छन्दसं गृह्णाम्यनुष्टुप्ते ऽ भिग्रः।॥४७॥
verses.transliteration: ā jighra kalaśaṃ mahyā tvā viśantvindavaḥ| punarūrjā ni vartasva sā na: sahasraṃ dhukṣvorudhārā payasvatī punarmā viśatādrayiḥ
verses.wordMeaning: Smell thou the vat. Let Soma drops pass into thee, O Mighty One. Return again with store of sap. Pour for us wealth in thou- sands thou with full broad streams and floods of milk. A Let riches come again to me.
verses.commentary: Sense: Smell thou the vat. Let Soma drops pass into thee, O Mighty One. Return again with store of sap. Pour for us wealth in thou- sands thou with full broad streams and floods of milk. A Let riches come again to me.

verses.sanskrit:
इडे॒ रन्ते॒ हव्ये॒ काम्ये॒ चन्द्रे॒ ज्योतेऽदि॑ते॒ सर॑स्वति॒ महि॒ विश्रु॑ति ।
ए॒ता ते॑ अघ्न्ये॒ नामा॑नि दे॒वेभ्यो॑ मा सु॒कृतं॑ ब्रूतात्
verses.translation: Idâ, delightful, worshipful, loveable, splendid, shining One, Inviolable, full of sap, the Mighty One, most glorious, These are thy names, O Cow: tell thou the Gods that I act righteously.
verses.hindi: राजा बनने योग्य बह है जो १. राष्ट कौ प्रगति के लिए प्रभु-स्तवन कौ कामनावाला है। २. शत्रुओं के विद्रावण के लिए काम-क्रोध-लोभ को जीतने कौ इच्छा करता है। ३. दिव्य गुणों के विस्तार के लिए निरन्तर क्रियाशील होता है। ४. प्रजा के अनज्ञानान्धकार को दूर करना ही अपना प्रभु-स्तवन मानता है।
verses.transliteration: iḍe rante havye kāmye candre jyote'dite sarasvati mahi viśruti | etā te aghnye nāmāni devebhyo mā sukṛtaṃ brūtāt
verses.wordMeaning: Idâ, delightful, worshipful, loveable, splendid, shining One, Inviolable, full of sap, the Mighty One, most glorious, These are thy names, O Cow: tell thou the Gods that I act righteously.
verses.commentary: Sense: Idâ, delightful, worshipful, loveable, splendid, shining One, Inviolable, full of sap, the Mighty One, most glorious, These are thy names, O Cow: tell thou the Gods that I act righteously.

verses.sanskrit:
वि न॑ इन्द्र॒ मृधो॑ जहि नी॒चा य॑च्छ पृतन्य॒तः ।
यो अ॒स्माँ२  अ॑भि॒दास॒त्यध॑रं गमया॒ तम॑: ।
उ॒प॒या॒मगृ॑हीतो॒ऽसीन्द्रा॑य त्वा वि॒मृधे॑  ए॒ष ते॒ योनि॒रिन्द्रा॑य त्वा वि॒मृधे॑
verses.translation: O Indra, beat our foes away, humble the men who challenge us: Send down to nether darkness him who seeks to do us injury. Taken upon a base art thou. For Indra, foe-dispeller, thee. This is thy home. For Indra, foe-dispeller, thee.
verses.hindi: असंयम या व्यभिचार मनुष्य को निर्वीर्य, निस्तेज व मूर्ख बना देता है। संयमी जीवनवाला उत्तम शुक्र (वीर्य) को प्राप्त होता है, उसका चेहरा दिन कै प्रकाश के समान चमकता है ओर वह जानरश्मियों से सूर्य के समान देदीप्यमान होता है। शुद्धता व शक्ति की श्रेणी में प्रथम
verses.transliteration: vi na indra mṛdho jahi nīcā yaccha pṛtanyataḥ | yo asmā~2 abhidāsatyadharaṃ gamayā tama: | upayāmagṛhīto'sīndrāya tvā vimṛdhe eṣa te yonirindrāya tvā vimṛdhe
verses.wordMeaning: O Indra, beat our foes away, humble the men who challenge us: Send down to nether darkness him who seeks to do us injury. Taken upon a base art thou. For Indra, foe-dispeller, thee. This is thy home. For Indra, foe-dispeller, thee.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Indra, beat our foes away, humble the men who challenge us: Send down to nether darkness him who seeks to do us injury. Taken upon a base art thou. For Indra, foe-dispeller, thee. This is thy home. For Indra, foe-dispeller, thee.

verses.sanskrit:
वा॒चस्पतिं॑ वि॒श्वक॑र्माणमू॒तये॑ मनो॒जुवं॒ वाजे॑ अ॒द्या हु॑वेम ।
स नो॒ विश्वा॑नि॒ हव॑नानि जोषद्वि॒श्वश॑म्भू॒रव॑से सा॒धुक॑र्मा ।
उ॒प॒या॒मगृ॑हीतो॒ऽसीन्द्रा॑य त्वा वि॒श्वक॑र्मणे
ए॒ष ते॒ योनि॒रिन्द्रा॑य त्वा वि॒श्वक॑र्मणे
verses.translation: Let us invoke to-day, to aid our labour, the Lord of Speech, the thought-swift Visvakarman. May he hear kindly all our invocations, who gives all bliss for aid, whose works are righteous. Taken upon a base art thou. For Indra Visvakarman thee. This is thy home. For Indra Visvakarman thee.
verses.hindi: राजा शुद्धता व शक्ति के दृष्टिकोण से सर्वप्रथम बनने का प्रयत्न करता े। एेसे ही राजा के प्रति प्रजाँ नतमस्तक होती है। प्रकाश, शक्ति व दिव्यता उशिक् त्वं देव सोमाग्नेः प्रियं पाथो ऽपीहि वशी त्वं देव सोमेन्द्र॑स्य प्रियं
verses.transliteration: vācaspatiṃ viśvakarmāṇamūtaye manojuvaṃ vāje adyā huvema | sa no viśvāni havanāni joṣadviśvaśambhūravase sādhukarmā | upayāmagṛhīto'sīndrāya tvā viśvakarmaṇe eṣa te yonirindrāya tvā viśvakarmaṇe
verses.wordMeaning: Let us invoke to-day, to aid our labour, the Lord of Speech, the thought-swift Visvakarman. May he hear kindly all our invocations, who gives all bliss for aid, whose works are righteous. Taken upon a base art thou. For Indra Visvakarman thee. This is thy home.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Let us invoke to-day, to aid our labour, the Lord of Speech, the thought-swift Visvakarman. May he hear kindly all our invocations, who gives all bliss for aid, whose works are righteous. Taken upon a base art thou. For Indra Visvakarman thee. This is thy home.…

verses.sanskrit:
विश्व॑कर्मन्   ह॒विषा॒ वर्ध॑नेन त्रा॒तार॒मिन्द्र॑मकृणोरव॒ध्यम् ।
तस्मै॒ विश॒: सम॑नमन्त पू॒र्वीर॒यमु॒ग्रो वि॒हव्यो॒ यथास॑त् ।
उ॒प॒या॒मगृ॑हीतो॒ऽसीन्द्रा॑य त्वा वि॒श्वक॑र्मण
ए॒ष ते॒ योनि॒रिन्द्रा॑य त्वा वि॒श्वक॑र्मणे
verses.translation: With strengthening libation, Visvakarman, thou madest Indra an undying guardian. The people of old time bowed down before him because the Mighty One was meet for worship. Taken upon a base, etc., as in 45.
verses.hindi: घर में ही आनन्द, एश्वर्य व आत्मदर्शन है। इधर-उधर भटकने का क्या लाभ? सन्तान को दूध पिलाने के साथ ही माता उसे धारणात्मक वृत्तिवाला बनाने का प्रयल करे। दिवं पृथिव्याऽअध्यासुहामाविंदाम देवान्त्स्वर्ज्योतिंः॥॥५२॥ पिछले मन्त्र के अनुसार घर में ' रति, धृति व स्वधृति" को समञ्लनेवाले पति-पली
verses.transliteration: viśvakarman haviṣā vardhanena trātāramindramakṛṇoravadhyam | tasmai viśa: samanamanta pūrvīrayamugro vihavyo yathāsat | upayāmagṛhīto'sīndrāya tvā viśvakarmaṇa eṣa te yonirindrāya tvā viśvakarmaṇe
verses.wordMeaning: With strengthening libation, Visvakarman, thou madest Indra an undying guardian. The people of old time bowed down before him because the Mighty One was meet for worship. Taken upon a base, etc., as in 45.
verses.commentary: Sense: With strengthening libation, Visvakarman, thou madest Indra an undying guardian. The people of old time bowed down before him because the Mighty One was meet for worship. Taken upon a base, etc., as in 45.

verses.sanskrit:
उ॒प॒या॒मगृ॑हीतोऽस्य॒ग्नये॑ त्वा गाय॒त्रच्छ॑न्दसं गृह्णामीन्द्रा॑य त्वा त्रि॒ष्टुप्छ॑न्दसं गृह्णामि॒
विश्वे॑भ्यस्त्वा दे॒वेभ्यो॒ जग॑च्छन्दसं गृह्णाम्यनु॒ष्टुप्ते॑ऽभिग॒रः
verses.translation: Taken upon a base art thou. I take thee lord of Gâyatrî for Agni. For Indra take I thee the lord of Trishtup. I lake thee lord of Jagatî for All-Gods. Anushtup is the song that sings thy praises.
verses.hindi: गृहस्थ की सफलता इसी बात में है कि हम धारणात्मक सन्तान को प्राप्त करे। उसके बाद स्वाध्याय आदि से अपने ज्ञान को बढाने में लगे रे ओर विद्वानों के सम्पर्क में आते हुए हम स्वयं देदीप्यमान ज्योति प्रभु को प्राप्त करे। यचुर्वेदभाष्यम् २३ अष्टमोऽध्याय;
verses.transliteration: upayāmagṛhīto'syagnaye tvā gāyatracchandasaṃ gṛhṇāmīndrāya tvā triṣṭupchandasaṃ gṛhṇāmi viśvebhyastvā devebhyo jagacchandasaṃ gṛhṇāmyanuṣṭupte'bhigaraḥ
verses.wordMeaning: Taken upon a base art thou. I take thee lord of Gâyatrî for Agni. For Indra take I thee the lord of Trishtup. I lake thee lord of Jagatî for All-Gods. Anushtup is the song that sings thy praises.
verses.commentary: Sense: Taken upon a base art thou. I take thee lord of Gâyatrî for Agni. For Indra take I thee the lord of Trishtup. I lake thee lord of Jagatî for All-Gods. Anushtup is the song that sings thy praises.

verses.sanskrit: व्रेशी॑नां त्वा॒ पत्म॒न्ना धू॑नोमि कुकू॒नना॑नां त्वा॒ पत्म॒न्ना धू॑नोमि भ॒न्दना॑नां त्वा॒ पत्म॒न्ना धू॑नोमि म॒दिन्त॑मानां त्वा॒ पत्म॒न्ना धू॑नोमि म॒धुन्त॑मानां त्वा॒ पत्म॒न्ना धू॑नोमि शु॒क्रं त्वा॑ शु॒क्र आ धू॑नो॒म्यह्नो॑ रू॒पे सूर्य॑स्य र॒श्मिषु॑
verses.translation: I stir thee for the fall of cloud-borne waters. I stir thee for the fall of streams that gurgle. I stir thee for the fall of those that gladden. I stir thee for their fall who are most lovely. I stir thee for their fall that are the sweetest. I stir thee for the waters’ fall, I stir thee, pure one, in the pure, in the day's form, in Sûrya's beams.
verses.hindi: हम क्रियाशीलता से कामादि शत्नुओं को समाप्त करनेवाले हों। इन शत्रुओं को हम प्रारम्भावस्था में ही नष्ट करने का प्रयत्न कर। हम सुप्रजा, सुवीर व सुपोष हो। सविता सन्या विश्वकर्मां दीक्षायौ पूषा सोंमक्रय॑ण्याम्।॥५४।। गत मन्त्र के ऋषि "देवाः' थे, वे सब देवों को अपने अनुकूल बनाकर उत्तम
verses.transliteration: vreśīnāṃ tvā patmannā dhūnomi kukūnanānāṃ tvā patmannā dhūnomi bhandanānāṃ tvā patmannā dhūnomi madintamānāṃ tvā patmannā dhūnomi madhuntamānāṃ tvā patmannā dhūnomi śukraṃ tvā śukra ā dhūnomyahno rūpe sūryasya raśmiṣu
verses.wordMeaning: I stir thee for the fall of cloud-borne waters. I stir thee for the fall of streams that gurgle. I stir thee for the fall of those that gladden. I stir thee for their fall who are most lovely. I stir thee for their fall that are the sweetest. I stir thee for the waters’…
verses.commentary: Sense: I stir thee for the fall of cloud-borne waters. I stir thee for the fall of streams that gurgle. I stir thee for the fall of those that gladden. I stir thee for their fall who are most lovely. I stir thee for their fall that are the sweetest. I stir thee for the waters’…

verses.sanskrit:
ककु॒भᳪ  रू॒पं वृ॑ष॒भस्य॑ रोचते बृ॒हच्छु॒क्रः शु॒क्रस्य॑ पुरो॒गाः सोम॒: सोम॑स्य पुरो॒गाः ।
यत्ते॑ सोमा॒दा॑भ्यं॒ नाम॒ जागृ॑वि॒ तस्मै॑ त्वा गृह्णामि॒ तस्मै॑ ते सोम॒ सोमा॑य॒ स्वाहा॑
verses.translation: The Bull's majestic form is shining brightly, the pure the pure's preceder, Soma Soma's. Whatever name invincible, stimulating, is thine, O Soma, for that name I take thee. All-hail to Soma, unto thee, O Soma.
