verses.sanskrit: अ॒र्थेत॑ स्थ राष्ट्र॒दा रा॒ष्ट्रं मे॑ दत्त॒ स्वाहा॒  ऽर्थेत॑ स्थ राष्ट्र॒दा रा॒ष्ट्रम॒मुष्मै॑ द॒त्तौज॑स्वती स्थ राष्ट्र॒दा रा॒ष्ट्रं मे॑ दत्त॒ स्वाहौज॑स्वती स्थ राष्ट्र॒दा रा॒ष्ट्रम॒मुष्मै॑ द॒त्ताप॑: परिवा॒हिणी॑ स्थ राष्ट्र॒दा रा॒ष्ट्रं मे॑ दत्त॒ स्वाहा॑ ऽप॑: परिवा॒हिणी॑ स्थ राष्ट्र॒दा रा॒ष्ट्रम॒मुष्मै॑ दत्ता॒पां पति॑रसि राष्ट्र॒दा रा॒ष्ट्रं मे॑ देहि॒ स्वाहा॒  ऽपां पति॑रसि राष्ट्र॒दा रा॒ष्ट्रम॒मुष्मै॑ देह्य॒पां गर्भो॑ऽसि राष्ट्र॒दा रा॒ष्ट्रं मे॑ देहि॒ स्वाहा॒ ऽपां गर्भो॑ सि राष्ट्र॒दा रा॒ष्ट्रम॒मुष्मै॑ देहि॒
verses.translation: Swift at your work are ye, givers of kingship. Do ye— All-hail!—bestow on me the kingdom. Swift at your work are ye, givers of kingship. Do ye on So-and-So bestow the kingdom. Endowed with strength are ye, givers of kingship, etc. O’erflowing floods are ye, etc. The Waters’ Lord art thou, giver of kingship. Do thou, etc. The Waters’ Child art thou, etc.
verses.hindi: प्रजाप १. धन कमानेवाली बने। २. शक्ति व प्रकाश को धारण करे। ३. वीर्य कौ रक्षा कररे। ओर ४. शक्ति से परिपूर्ण हों। एेसी ही प्रजाँ एक शक्तिशाली राष्ट का निर्माण करनेवाली होती है। गत मन्त्र के अनुसार प्रस्तुत मन्त्र में भी कहते हैँ कि है प्रजाओ! आप १. सूर्यत्वचसः
verses.transliteration: artheta stha rāṣṭradā rāṣṭraṃ me datta svāhā 'rtheta stha rāṣṭradā rāṣṭramamuṣmai dattaujasvatī stha rāṣṭradā rāṣṭraṃ me datta svāhaujasvatī stha rāṣṭradā rāṣṭramamuṣmai dattāpa: parivāhiṇī stha rāṣṭradā rāṣṭraṃ me datta svāhā 'pa: parivāhiṇī stha rāṣṭradā rāṣṭramamuṣmai dattāpāṃ patirasi rāṣṭradā rāṣṭraṃ me dehi svāhā 'pāṃ patirasi rāṣṭradā rāṣṭramamuṣmai dehyapāṃ garbho'si rāṣṭradā rāṣṭraṃ me dehi svāhā 'pāṃ garbho si rāṣṭradā rāṣṭramamuṣmai dehi
verses.wordMeaning: Swift at your work are ye, givers of kingship. Do ye— All-hail!—bestow on me the kingdom. Swift at your work are ye, givers of kingship. Do ye on So-and-So bestow the kingdom. Endowed with strength are ye, givers of kingship, etc. O’erflowing floods are ye, etc.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Swift at your work are ye, givers of kingship. Do ye— All-hail!—bestow on me the kingdom. Swift at your work are ye, givers of kingship. Do ye on So-and-So bestow the kingdom. Endowed with strength are ye, givers of kingship, etc. O’erflowing floods are ye, etc.…

verses.sanskrit: सूर्य॑त्वचस स्थ राष्ट्र॒दा रा॒ष्ट्रं मे॑ दत्त॒ स्वाहा॒ सूर्य॑त्वचस स्थ राष्ट्र॒दा रा॒ष्ट्रम॒मुष्मै॑ दत्त सूर्य॑वर्चस स्थ राष्ट्र॒दा रा॒ष्ट्रं मे॑ दत्त॒ स्वाहा॒ सूर्य॑वर्चस स्थ राष्ट्र॒दा रा॒ष्ट्रम॒मुष्मै॑ दत्त॒ मान्दा॑ स्थ राष्ट्र॒दा रा॒ष्ट्रं मे॑ दत्त॒ स्वाहा॒ मान्दा॑ स्थ राष्ट्र॒दा रा॒ष्ट्रम॒मुष्मै॑ दत्त व्रज॒क्षित॑ स्थ राष्ट्र॒दा रा॒ष्ट्रं मे॑ दत्त॒ स्वाहा॑ व्रज॒क्षित॑ स्थ राष्ट्र॒दा रा॒ष्ट्रम॒मुष्मै॑ दत्त॒ वाशा॑ स्थ राष्ट्र॒दा रा॒ष्ट्रं मे॑ दत्त॒ स्वाहा॒ वाशा॑ स्थ राष्ट्र॒दा रा॒ष्ट्रम॒मुष्मै॑ दत्त॒ शवि॑ष्ठा स्थ राष्ट्र॒दा रा॒ष्ट्रं मे॑ दत्त॒ स्वाहा॒ शवि॑ष्ठा स्थ राष्ट्र॒दा रा॒ष्ट्रम॒मुष्मै॑ दत्त॒  शक्व॑री स्थ राष्ट्र॒दा रा॒ष्ट्रं मे॑ दत्त॒ स्वाहा॒ शक्व॑री स्थ राष्ट्र॒दा रा॒ष्ट्रम॒मुष्मै॑ दत्त जन॒भृत॑ स्थ राष्ट्र॒दा रा॒ष्ट्रं मे॑ दत्त॒ स्वाहा॑ जन॒भृत॑ स्थ राष्ट्र॒दा रा॒ष्ट्रम॒मुष्मै॑ दत्त विश्व॒भृत॑ स्थ राष्ट्र॒दा रा॒ष्ट्रं मे॑ दत्त॒ स्वाहा॑ विश्व॒भृत॑ स्थ राष्ट्र॒दा रा॒ष्ट्रम॒मुष्मै॑ द॒त्ताप॑: स्व॒राज॑ स्थ राष्ट्र॒दा रा॒ष्ट्रम॒मुष्मै॑ दत्त । मधु॑मती॒र्मधु॑मतीभिः पृच्यन्तां॒ महि॑ क्ष॒त्रं क्ष॒त्रिया॑य वन्वा॒नांना॑धृष्टाः सीदत स॒हौज॑सो॒ महि॑ क्ष॒त्रं क्ष॒त्रिया॑य॒ दध॑तीः
verses.translation: With sun-bright skins are ye, givers, etc. Brilliant as Suns are ye, etc. Bringers of joy are ye, etc. Dwellers in cloud are ye, etc Desirable are ye, etc. Most powerful are ye, etc. Endowed with might are ye, etc. Man-nourishing are ye, etc. All-nourishing are ye, etc. Self-ruling Waters are ye, giving kingship. On So-and-So do ye bestow the kingdom. Together with the sweet let sweet ones mingle, obtaining for the Kshatriya mighty power. Rest in your place inviolate and potent, bestowing on the Kshatriya mighty power.
verses.hindi: राजा को अग्नि आदि के गुणों से सम्पन्न होकर उत्तमता से राष्ट की राष्ट् के “स्त्री-पुरुष' राष्ट् के स्त्री- पुरुषों को सम्बोधित करके पुरोहित कहता है कि ९. पवित्रे स्थः= आप पवित्र जीवनवाले, वैष्णव्यौ = व्यापक मनोवृत्तिवाले हो। वस्तुतः इस व्यापक मनोवृत्ति
verses.transliteration: sūryatvacasa stha rāṣṭradā rāṣṭraṃ me datta svāhā sūryatvacasa stha rāṣṭradā rāṣṭramamuṣmai datta sūryavarcasa stha rāṣṭradā rāṣṭraṃ me datta svāhā sūryavarcasa stha rāṣṭradā rāṣṭramamuṣmai datta māndā stha rāṣṭradā rāṣṭraṃ me datta svāhā māndā stha rāṣṭradā rāṣṭramamuṣmai datta vrajakṣita stha rāṣṭradā rāṣṭraṃ me datta svāhā vrajakṣita stha rāṣṭradā rāṣṭramamuṣmai datta vāśā stha rāṣṭradā rāṣṭraṃ me datta svāhā vāśā stha rāṣṭradā rāṣṭramamuṣmai datta śaviṣṭhā stha rāṣṭradā rāṣṭraṃ me datta svāhā śaviṣṭhā stha rāṣṭradā rāṣṭramamuṣmai datta śakvarī stha rāṣṭradā rāṣṭraṃ me datta svāhā śakvarī stha rāṣṭradā rāṣṭramamuṣmai datta janabhṛta stha rāṣṭradā rāṣṭraṃ me datta svāhā janabhṛta stha rāṣṭradā rāṣṭramamuṣmai datta viśvabhṛta stha rāṣṭradā rāṣṭraṃ me datta svāhā viśvabhṛta stha rāṣṭradā rāṣṭramamuṣmai dattāpa: svarāja stha rāṣṭradā rāṣṭramamuṣmai datta | madhumatīrmadhumatībhiḥ pṛcyantāṃ mahi kṣatraṃ kṣatriyāya vanvānāṃnādhṛṣṭāḥ sīdata sahaujaso mahi kṣatraṃ kṣatriyāya dadhatīḥ
verses.wordMeaning: With sun-bright skins are ye, givers, etc. Brilliant as Suns are ye, etc. Bringers of joy are ye, etc. Dwellers in cloud are ye, etc Desirable are ye, etc. Most powerful are ye, etc. Endowed with might are ye, etc. Man-nourishing are ye, etc. All-nourishing are ye, etc.…
verses.commentary: Sense: With sun-bright skins are ye, givers, etc. Brilliant as Suns are ye, etc. Bringers of joy are ye, etc. Dwellers in cloud are ye, etc Desirable are ye, etc. Most powerful are ye, etc. Endowed with might are ye, etc. Man-nourishing are ye, etc. All-nourishing are ye, etc.…

verses.sanskrit:
सोम॑स्य॒ त्विषि॑रसि॒ तवे॑व मे॒ त्विषि॑र्भूयात् । अ॒ग्नये॒ स्वाहा॒ सोमा॑य॒ स्वाहा॑  सवि॒त्रे स्वाहा॒  सर॑स्वत्यै॒ स्वाहा॑
पू॒ष्णे स्वाहा॒  बृह॒स्पत॑ये॒ स्वाहेन्द्रा॑य॒ स्वाहा॒ घोषा॑य॒ स्वाहा॒  श्लोका॑य॒ स्वाहा
ऽᳪशा॑य॒ स्वाहा॒ भगा॑य॒ स्वाहा॑ ऽर्य॒म्णे स्वाहा॑
verses.translation: Brilliance of Soma art thou: may my brilliance grow like thine. To Agni Hail! To Soma Hail! To Savitar Hail! To Sarasvatî Hail! To Pûshan Hail! To Brihaspati Hail! To Indra Hail! To the Noise Hail! To Fame Hail To Amsa Hail! To Bhaga Hail! To Aryaman Hail!
verses.hindi: राष्ट् का प्रत्येक स्त्रीपुरुष पवित्र बनने का प्रयल करे। प्रजाओं का चित्रण करते हुए कहते दँ कि १. ये सधमाद: =( सह मद्) साथ- मिलकर रहने मे आनन्द लेनेवाली है। प्रजा ओ में परस्पर प्रेम है लडाई-ञ्ञगडों मे ये उल्ल हई नहीं हे। २. द्युम्निनीः=सानरूप ज्योतिवाली देँ, मूर्खं नहीं हे। ३. आपः=सदा कर्मो में व्याप्त
verses.transliteration: somasya tviṣirasi taveva me tviṣirbhūyāt | agnaye svāhā somāya svāhā savitre svāhā sarasvatyai svāhā pūṣṇe svāhā bṛhaspataye svāhendrāya svāhā ghoṣāya svāhā ślokāya svāhā 'śāya svāhā bhagāya svāhā 'ryamṇe svāhā
verses.wordMeaning: Brilliance of Soma art thou: may my brilliance grow like thine. To Agni Hail! To Soma Hail! To Savitar Hail! To Sarasvatî Hail! To Pûshan Hail! To Brihaspati Hail! To Indra Hail! To the Noise Hail! To Fame Hail To Amsa Hail! To Bhaga Hail! To Aryaman Hail!
verses.commentary: Sense: Brilliance of Soma art thou: may my brilliance grow like thine. To Agni Hail! To Soma Hail! To Savitar Hail! To Sarasvatî Hail! To Pûshan Hail! To Brihaspati Hail! To Indra Hail! To the Noise Hail! To Fame Hail To Amsa Hail! To Bhaga Hail! To Aryaman Hail!

verses.sanskrit:
प॒वित्रे॑ स्थो वैष्ण॒व्यौ॒  सवि॒तुर्व॑: प्रस॒व उत्पु॑ना॒म्यच्छि॑द्रेण प॒वित्रे॑ण॒ सूर्य॑स्य र॒श्मिभि॑: ।
अनि॑भृष्टमसि वा॒चो बन्धु॑स्तपो॒जाः सोम॑स्य दा॒त्रम॑सि॒ स्वाहा॑ राज॒स्व॒:
verses.translation: Ye are two strainers, Varuna's own possession. I make you pure at Savitar's impulsion, with flawless strainer, with the beams of Sûrya. Thou, friend of speech, heat-born, art undefeated. Soma's share art thou. Hail, ye king producers!
verses.hindi: उत्तम प्रजां वे ही है जो परस्पर मेलवाली, ज्ञान के प्रकाशवाली, कर्मो मे व्यापृत, वासनाओं से अनाधृष्ट, कर्म- कुशल व दोषों से अपने को बचानेवाली हेँ। इन्हीं क अन्दर राजा का निवास है। राजा प्रजाओं की सन्तान है, प्रजाँ राजा की उत्कृष्ट राजा के लिए कहते हैँ कि १. है राजन्! तू क्षत्रस्य उल्ब असि उल्व' शब्द
verses.transliteration: pavitre stho vaiṣṇavyau saviturva: prasava utpunāmyacchidreṇa pavitreṇa sūryasya raśmibhi: | anibhṛṣṭamasi vāco bandhustapojāḥ somasya dātramasi svāhā rājasva:
verses.wordMeaning: Ye are two strainers, Varuna's own possession. I make you pure at Savitar's impulsion, with flawless strainer, with the beams of Sûrya. Thou, friend of speech, heat-born, art undefeated. Soma's share art thou. Hail, ye king producers!
verses.commentary: Sense: Ye are two strainers, Varuna's own possession. I make you pure at Savitar's impulsion, with flawless strainer, with the beams of Sûrya. Thou, friend of speech, heat-born, art undefeated. Soma's share art thou. Hail, ye king producers!

verses.sanskrit:
स॒ध॒मादो॑ द्यु॒म्निनी॒राप॑ ए॒ता अना॑धृष्टा अप॒स्यो वसा॑नाः ।
प॒स्त्या॒सु चक्रे॒ वरु॑णः स॒धस्थ॑म॒पाᳪ  शिशु॑र्मा॒तृत॑मास्व॒न्तः
verses.translation: Sharers in joy are these majestic Waters, inviolate, industrious, investing. In these as homes hath Varuna made his dwelling, he, Child of Waters, in the best of mothers.
verses.hindi: राजा को शक्ति का केन्द्र व पुञ्ज होना चाहिए। यही शत्रुओं को नष्ट करनेवाला है। प्रजाओं को चाहिए कि उसकी सर्वतः रक्षा करे। मित्रावरूणौ धृतव्र॑तावाविंत्तः पूषा विश्ववेदाऽअआविंत्ते द्यावापृथिवी हे मर्याः= मनुष्यो! आविः तुम्हारे सामने यह राजा प्रकटरूप से उपस्थित ठै। १.
verses.transliteration: sadhamādo dyumninīrāpa etā anādhṛṣṭā apasyo vasānāḥ | pastyāsu cakre varuṇaḥ sadhasthamapā śiśurmātṛtamāsvantaḥ
verses.wordMeaning: Sharers in joy are these majestic Waters, inviolate, industrious, investing. In these as homes hath Varuna made his dwelling, he, Child of Waters, in the best of mothers.
verses.commentary: Sense: Sharers in joy are these majestic Waters, inviolate, industrious, investing. In these as homes hath Varuna made his dwelling, he, Child of Waters, in the best of mothers.

verses.sanskrit:
क्ष॒त्रस्योल्ब॑मसि क्ष॒त्रस्य॑ ज॒राय्व॑सि क्ष॒त्रस्य॒ योनि॑रसि क्ष॒त्रस्य॒ नाभि॑र॒सीन्द्र॑स्य॒ वार्त्र॑घ्नमसि मि॒त्रस्या॑सि॒ वरु॑णस्यासि॒
त्वया॒ऽयं वृ॒त्रं ब॑धेत् । दृ॒बाऽसि॑ रु॒जाऽसि॑ क्षु॒माऽसि॑ । पा॒तैनं॒ प्राञ्चं॑ पा॒तैनं प्र॒त्यञ्चं॑ पा॒तैनं॑ ति॒र्यञ्चं॑ दि॒ग्भ्यः पा॑त
verses.translation: Thou art the inner caul of princely power, Thou art the outer caul of princely power. Of princely power thou art the womb, the navel. Thou art the Vritra-slaying arm of Indra. Mitra's art thou, thou Varuna's possession. With thee to aid may this man slaughter Vritra. Cleaver art thou; thou Render; thou art Shaker. Protect him ye in front, protect him rearwards; protect him sidewards; from all quarters guard him.
verses.hindi: राजा उसे ही बनाना चाहिए जिसकी प्रसिद्धि इस रूप में हो कि यह  अग्नि, गृहपति, इन्द्र, वृद्धश्रवाः मित्र, वरुण, धृतव्रत, पूषा, विश्ववेदा :=उत्तम शरीर व -मस्तिष्कवाला, सबको शान्ति प्राप्त करानैवाला, अदिति व उरुशर्मा' दे। अवेष्टा दन्दशूकाः प्राचीमारोंह गाय॒त्री त्वावतु
verses.transliteration: kṣatrasyolbamasi kṣatrasya jarāyvasi kṣatrasya yonirasi kṣatrasya nābhirasīndrasya vārtraghnamasi mitrasyāsi varuṇasyāsi tvayā'yaṃ vṛtraṃ badhet | dṛbā'si rujā'si kṣumā'si | pātainaṃ prāñcaṃ pātainaṃ pratyañcaṃ pātainaṃ tiryañcaṃ digbhyaḥ pāta
verses.wordMeaning: Thou art the inner caul of princely power, Thou art the outer caul of princely power. Of princely power thou art the womb, the navel. Thou art the Vritra-slaying arm of Indra. Mitra's art thou, thou Varuna's possession. With thee to aid may this man slaughter Vritra.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Thou art the inner caul of princely power, Thou art the outer caul of princely power. Of princely power thou art the womb, the navel. Thou art the Vritra-slaying arm of Indra. Mitra's art thou, thou Varuna's possession. With thee to aid may this man slaughter Vritra.…

verses.sanskrit:
आ॒विर्म॑या॒ आवि॑त्तो अ॒ग्निर्गृ॒हप॑तिरावि॑त्त॒ इन्द्रो॑ वृ॒द्धश्र॑वा॒ आवि॑त्तौ मि॒त्रावरु॑णौ धृ॒तव्र॑ता॒वावि॑त्तः पू॒षा वि॒श्ववे॑दा॒
आवि॑त्ते॒ द्यावा॑पृथि॒वी वि॒श्वश॑म्भुवा॒वावि॒त्तादि॑तिरु॒रुश॑र्मा
verses.translation: Visible, O ye men, Informed is Agni, Master of the House. hold. Informed is Indra of exalted glory. Informed are Mitra-Varuna, Law-Maintainers. Informed is Pûshan, Lord of all Possessions. Informed are Heaven and Earth, the All-propitious. Informed is Aditi who gives wide shelter.
verses.hindi: राजा के मुख्य कार्य दो हैं। पाप व रोगों से बचाना, शत्रुओं के आक्रमण को रोकना। इससे राजा मित्र ओर वरुण नामवाला होता है। उसे उषःकाल में ही जाग जाना चाहिए ओर सूर्योदय के साथ ही रथारूढ हो राज्य के निरीक्षण में प्रवृत्त हो जाना चाहिए, जिससे वह आर्य व दस्युओं का विवेक कर सके।
verses.transliteration: āvirmayā āvitto agnirgṛhapatirāvitta indro vṛddhaśravā āvittau mitrāvaruṇau dhṛtavratāvāvittaḥ pūṣā viśvavedā āvitte dyāvāpṛthivī viśvaśambhuvāvāvittāditiruruśarmā
verses.wordMeaning: Visible, O ye men, Informed is Agni, Master of the House. hold. Informed is Indra of exalted glory. Informed are Mitra-Varuna, Law-Maintainers. Informed is Pûshan, Lord of all Possessions. Informed are Heaven and Earth, the All-propitious.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Visible, O ye men, Informed is Agni, Master of the House. hold. Informed is Indra of exalted glory. Informed are Mitra-Varuna, Law-Maintainers. Informed is Pûshan, Lord of all Possessions. Informed are Heaven and Earth, the All-propitious.…

verses.sanskrit: अवे॑ष्टा दन्द॒शूका॑:  प्राची॒मा रो॑ह गाय॒त्री त्वा॑ऽवतु रथन्त॒रᳪ साम॑ त्रि॒वृत्स्तोमो॑ वस॒न्त ऋ॒तुर्ब्रह्म॒ द्रवि॑णम्
verses.translation: Appeased by sacrifice are biting creatures, Ascend the East. May Gâyatrî protect thee, the psalm Rathantara, the triple praise-song, the season Spring, and the rich treasure, Priesthood.
verses.hindi: राजा वही होने योग्य है जो चन्द्रमा के समान दीप्ति व शान्तिवाला हे, अग्नि करे समान स्वास्थ्य की दीप्तिवाला है, सूर्य के समान प्राणशक्ति का पुञ्ज हे, जितेन्द्रिय पुरुष के बलवाला है। बलवानों से भी बलवान् है, राष्ट् को सब आक्रमणों से बचाता हे। तषि: -देववातः। देवता-यजमानः। छन्दः स्वराड्व्राह्यीत्रिष्टुप्। स्वरः-धैवतः।।
verses.transliteration: aveṣṭā dandaśūkā: prācīmā roha gāyatrī tvā'vatu rathantara sāma trivṛtstomo vasanta ṛturbrahma draviṇam
verses.wordMeaning: Appeased by sacrifice are biting creatures, Ascend the East. May Gâyatrî protect thee, the psalm Rathantara, the triple praise-song, the season Spring, and the rich treasure, Priesthood.
verses.commentary: Sense: Appeased by sacrifice are biting creatures, Ascend the East. May Gâyatrî protect thee, the psalm Rathantara, the triple praise-song, the season Spring, and the rich treasure, Priesthood.

verses.sanskrit: दक्षि॑णा॒मा रो॑ह त्रि॒ष्टुप् त्वा॑ऽवतु बृ॒हत्साम॑ पञ्चद॒श स्तोमो॑ ग्री॒ष्म ऋ॒तुः क्ष॒त्रं द्रवि॑णम्
verses.translation: Ascend the South. Be thy protectors Trishtup, the Brihat Sâman, the fifteenfold praise-song, the Reason Summer, and the treasure Kingship.
verses.hindi: -राष्टूपति का वरण यथासम्भव एेकमत्येन होना ही ठीक है। विद्वान् बृहस्पति तुल्य ब्राह्मण इस राष्टूपति का मार्ग- प्रदर्शक होता है। इनसे प्रेरणा प्राप्त करनेवाला राजा यहाँ “देववात ' कहलाता है। दिनरात्रि के पर्वरूप प्रातः-सायं के समय जिसका उद्बोधन किया जाता है उस ' पर्वत
verses.transliteration: dakṣiṇāmā roha triṣṭup tvā'vatu bṛhatsāma pañcadaśa stomo grīṣma ṛtuḥ kṣatraṃ draviṇam
verses.wordMeaning: Ascend the South. Be thy protectors Trishtup, the Brihat Sâman, the fifteenfold praise-song, the Reason Summer, and the treasure Kingship.
verses.commentary: Sense: Ascend the South. Be thy protectors Trishtup, the Brihat Sâman, the fifteenfold praise-song, the Reason Summer, and the treasure Kingship.

verses.sanskrit: प्र॒तीची॒मा रो॑ह॒ जग॑ती त्वाऽवतु वैरू॒पᳪ साम॑ सप्तद॒श स्तोमो॑ व॒र्षा ऋ॒तुर्विड् द्रवि॑णम्
verses.translation: Ascend the West. May Jagatî protect thee, the psalm Vairûpa, the seventeenfold praise-song, the Rain-time, and that store of wealth, the People.
verses.hindi: प्रभु का नाम हमारा व्र हो। स्नेह व निर््ंषता हमारे जीवन का सूत्र हो। हमारा जीवन वासनाओं से अहिसित व उज्ज्वल हो। हम सोम पान करे, शक्ति से युक्त हों। तिष्ठा रथमधि यं वज्रहस्ता रश्मीन्देव यमसे स्वश्वांन् ॥ २२॥ १. है इन्द्र-सब शत्रुओं के संहारक प्रभो! तुराषाट् = (तूर्णं सहते) शीघ्रता से शत्रुजँ
verses.transliteration: pratīcīmā roha jagatī tvā'vatu vairūpa sāma saptadaśa stomo varṣā ṛturviḍ draviṇam
verses.wordMeaning: Ascend the West. May Jagatî protect thee, the psalm Vairûpa, the seventeenfold praise-song, the Rain-time, and that store of wealth, the People.
verses.commentary: Sense: Ascend the West. May Jagatî protect thee, the psalm Vairûpa, the seventeenfold praise-song, the Rain-time, and that store of wealth, the People.

verses.sanskrit: उदी॑ची॒मा रो॑हानु॒ष्टुप् त्वा॑ऽवतु वैरा॒जᳪ सामै॑कवि॒ᳪश स्तोम॑: श॒रदृ॒तुः फलं॒ द्रवि॑णम्
verses.translation: Ascend the North. Thy guardians be Anushtup, Vairâja psalm, the twenty-onefold praise-song, the season Autumn, that rich treasure Fruitage.
verses.hindi: 'हम अग्नि, गृहपति, सोम, सानी, ओजस्वी व इन्द्र" बने। हध्सः शंचिषद्वसुरन्तरिक्चसद्दधोतां वेदिषद तिंधिर्दुरोणसत् । २रवें मन्त्र मे अपने को प्रभु से अयुक्त न करने की भावना थी। जब हम सदा प्रभु का स्मरण करते हे, प्रभु-स्मरण के साथ ही हमारी सब क्रियाँ होती हैँ तब वे प्रभु हमारे
verses.transliteration: udīcīmā rohānuṣṭup tvā'vatu vairāja sāmaikaviśa stoma: śaradṛtuḥ phalaṃ draviṇam
verses.wordMeaning: Ascend the North. Thy guardians be Anushtup, Vairâja psalm, the twenty-onefold praise-song, the season Autumn, that rich treasure Fruitage.
verses.commentary: Sense: Ascend the North. Thy guardians be Anushtup, Vairâja psalm, the twenty-onefold praise-song, the season Autumn, that rich treasure Fruitage.

verses.sanskrit:
ऊ॒र्ध्वामा रो॑ह प॒ङ्क्तिस्त्वा॑ऽवतु शाक्वररैव॒ते साम॑नी त्रिणवत्रयस्त्रि॒ᳪशौ॒ स्तोमौ॑ हेमन्तशिशि॒रावृ॒तू वर्चो॒ द्रवि॑णं॒
प्रत्य॑स्तं॒ नमु॑चे॒: शिर॑:
verses.translation: Ascend the Zenith. Pankti be thy keeper, Sâkvara, Raivata the pair of Sâmans, Praise-songs the thirty-threefold and thrice-ninefold, both seasons, Winter, Dews, that treasure lustre. The head of Namuchi hath been cast from me.
verses.hindi: हम इस सृष्टि में प्रभु की महिमा को देखें । जीवन को पवित्र बनाकर प्रभु के निवास-स्थान बनें। हम अनुभव करे किवे प्रभु सत्यदहे, वे सदा वृद्ध देँं। इस प्रकार जीवन बनाते हए हम “वामदेव ' सुन्दर दिव्य गुणोँवाले हों। १. वामदेव प्रभु-आराधन करता हुआ कहता है कि “इयत् असि '=आप ‹ एतावान्
verses.transliteration: ūrdhvāmā roha paṅktistvā'vatu śākvararaivate sāmanī triṇavatrayastriśau stomau hemantaśiśirāvṛtū varco draviṇaṃ pratyastaṃ namuce: śira:
verses.wordMeaning: Ascend the Zenith. Pankti be thy keeper, Sâkvara, Raivata the pair of Sâmans, Praise-songs the thirty-threefold and thrice-ninefold, both seasons, Winter, Dews, that treasure lustre. The head of Namuchi hath been cast from me.
verses.commentary: Sense: Ascend the Zenith. Pankti be thy keeper, Sâkvara, Raivata the pair of Sâmans, Praise-songs the thirty-threefold and thrice-ninefold, both seasons, Winter, Dews, that treasure lustre. The head of Namuchi hath been cast from me.

verses.sanskrit: सोम॑स्य॒ त्विषि॑रसि॒ तवे॑व मे॒ त्विषि॑र्भूयात् । मृ॒त्योः पा॒ह्योजो॑ऽसि॒ सहो॑ऽस्य॒मृत॑मसि
verses.translation: Brilliance of Soma art thou, may my brilliance grow like thine. Save me from death. Vigour art thou, victory, everlasting life.
verses.hindi: प्रभु के सम्पर्क से हमें  आयु, वर्चस् व ऊर्ज्" प्राप्त होता हे। प्रभु-स्मरण करते हुए शक्ति-सम्पत्न बनकर हम सदा भुजाओं को कार्यव्यापृत रक्खे। गत मन्त्र की भावना के अनुसार प्रभु-स्मरण से शक्ति-सम्पन्न बनकर निरन्तर क्रिया करनेवाला व्यक्ति इस पृथिवी को बडा सुन्दर बनाता है। मन्त्र में कहते है कि ९. है पृथिवि!
verses.transliteration: somasya tviṣirasi taveva me tviṣirbhūyāt | mṛtyoḥ pāhyojo'si saho'syamṛtamasi
verses.wordMeaning: Brilliance of Soma art thou, may my brilliance grow like thine. Save me from death. Vigour art thou, victory, everlasting life.
verses.commentary: Sense: Brilliance of Soma art thou, may my brilliance grow like thine. Save me from death. Vigour art thou, victory, everlasting life.

verses.sanskrit:
हिर॑ण्यरूपा उ॒षसो॑ विरो॒क उ॒भावि॑न्द्रा॒ उदि॑थ॒: सूर्य॑श्च ।
आ रो॑हतं वरुण मित्र॒ गर्त्तं॒ तत॑श्चक्षाथा॒मदि॑तिं॒ दितिं॑ च मि॒त्रो॒ऽसि॒ वरु॑णोऽसि
verses.translation: With golden bodies, at the flush of morning, ye rise on high, two Sovran Lords, and Sûrya. Ascend your car, O Varuna and Mitra: thence view infinity and limitation. Thou art Mitra, thou art Varuna.
verses.hindi: यह पृथिवी सुखरूप है, सुख से बैठने योग्य है, शक्ति का स्रोत हे। निरन्तर क्रियाशीलता के द्वारा "वामदेव ' पृथिवी को एेसा ही बना लेता हेै। १. उल्लिखित मन्त्रों में वर्णित ' वामदेव ' लोगों में से चुना जाकर (वरुण) जीवन को उत्तमता से व्यवस्थित करने के लिए सिंहासन पर बिठाया जाता है। इसने उत्तम शासन
verses.transliteration: hiraṇyarūpā uṣaso viroka ubhāvindrā uditha: sūryaśca | ā rohataṃ varuṇa mitra garttaṃ tataścakṣāthāmaditiṃ ditiṃ ca mitro'si varuṇo'si
verses.wordMeaning: With golden bodies, at the flush of morning, ye rise on high, two Sovran Lords, and Sûrya. Ascend your car, O Varuna and Mitra: thence view infinity and limitation. Thou art Mitra, thou art Varuna.
verses.commentary: Sense: With golden bodies, at the flush of morning, ye rise on high, two Sovran Lords, and Sûrya. Ascend your car, O Varuna and Mitra: thence view infinity and limitation. Thou art Mitra, thou art Varuna.

verses.sanskrit:
सोम॑स्य त्वा द्यु॒म्नेना॒भि षि॑ञ्चाम्य॒ग्नेर्भ्राज॑सा॒ सूर्य॑स्य॒ वर्च॒सेन्द्र॑स्येन्द्रि॒येण॑ ।
क्ष॒त्राणां॑ क्ष॒त्रप॑तिरे॒ध्यति॑ दि॒द्यून् पा॑हि
verses.translation: Thee with the strength of Soma, Agni's lustre, with Sûrya's splendour, Indra's might I sprinkle. Be Lord of princes: safe past arrows guard him. 18 = IX. 40.
verses.hindi: राजा को  धृत-त्रत व सुक्रतु' होना चाहिए, जिससे उसका राज्य साम्राज्य अभिभूर॑स्येतास्ते पञ्च दिश॑ः कल्पन्तां ब्रह्यंस्त्वं ब्रह्मासि सवितासि सत्यप्र॑सवो वरूणो ऽसि सत्यौजाऽ इन्द्रो ऽसि विशौजा रुद्रोऽसि सुशोव॑ः । हकार श्रेयस्कर भूय॑स्करेनद्रस्य वस्रं ऽसि तेन॑ मे रध्य ॥२८॥
verses.transliteration: somasya tvā dyumnenābhi ṣiñcāmyagnerbhrājasā sūryasya varcasendrasyendriyeṇa | kṣatrāṇāṃ kṣatrapatiredhyati didyūn pāhi
verses.wordMeaning: Thee with the strength of Soma, Agni's lustre, with Sûrya's splendour, Indra's might I sprinkle. Be Lord of princes: safe past arrows guard him. 18 = IX. 40.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thee with the strength of Soma, Agni's lustre, with Sûrya's splendour, Indra's might I sprinkle. Be Lord of princes: safe past arrows guard him. 18 = IX. 40.

verses.sanskrit:
इ॒मं दे॑वा असप॒त्नᳪ सु॑वध्वं मह॒ते क्ष॒त्राय॑ मह॒ते ज्यै॑ष्ठ्याय मह॒ते जान॑राज्या॒येन्द्र॑स्येन्द्रि॒याय॑ ।
इ॒मम॒मुष्य॑ पु॒त्रम॒मुष्यै॑ पु॒त्रमस्यै वि॒श ए॒ष वो॑ऽमी॒ राजा॒ सोमो॒ऽस्माकं॑ ब्राह्म॒णाना॒ᳪराजा॑
verses.translation: Forth from the summit of the bull, the mountain, pouring spontaneously, the ships keep moving.
verses.hindi: मै जानी बनू, सत्य के ओजवाला होऊं, ओजस्वी प्रजावाला तथा उत्तम कल्याण को प्राप्त करनेवाला बनँ। प्रभु ही मेरे वज्र हों। मेँ क्रियाशील रहता हुआ सब शत्रुओं को अपने वश मेँ कर सककू। अग्निः पृथर्धर्म'णस्पतिंर्जुषाणोऽअनग्निः पुथुर्धर्म॑णस्पतिराज्य॑स्य वेतु, स्वाहा ।
verses.transliteration: imaṃ devā asapatna suvadhvaṃ mahate kṣatrāya mahate jyaiṣṭhyāya mahate jānarājyāyendrasyendriyāya | imamamuṣya putramamuṣyai putramasyai viśa eṣa vo'mī rājā somo'smākaṃ brāhmaṇānārājā
verses.wordMeaning: Forth from the summit of the bull, the mountain, pouring spontaneously, the ships keep moving.
verses.commentary: Sense: Forth from the summit of the bull, the mountain, pouring spontaneously, the ships keep moving.

verses.sanskrit:
प्र पर्व॑तस्य वृष॒भस्य॑ पृ॒ष्ठान्नाव॑श्चरन्ति स्व॒सिच॑ इया॒नाः ।
ता आऽव॑वृत्रन्नध॒रागुद॑क्ता॒ अहिं॑ बु॒ध्न्य॒मनु॒ रीय॑माणाः ।
विष्णो॑र्वि॒क्रम॑णमसि॒ विष्णो॒र्विक्रा॑न्तमसि॒ विष्णो॑: क्रा॒न्तम॑सि
verses.translation: They, lifted up, have turned them back and downward, still flowing onward, after Ahibudhnya. Thou art the stepping-forth of Vishnu: thou art Vishnu's outstep; Vishnu's step art thou.
verses.hindi: हम “अग्नि-पृथु-धर्मणस्पति' बनकर मलों का क्षरण करे ओर दीप्ति प्राप्त करे। स्वार्थ की भावना से ऊपर उठकर निरन्तर क्रिया में लगे रहे ओर इस प्रकार अपने सजातों में श्रेष्ठ वनें। देवत॑या प्रसुतः प्रसंर्पामि ॥३०॥
verses.transliteration: pra parvatasya vṛṣabhasya pṛṣṭhānnāvaścaranti svasica iyānāḥ | tā ā'vavṛtrannadharāgudaktā ahiṃ budhnyamanu rīyamāṇāḥ | viṣṇorvikramaṇamasi viṣṇorvikrāntamasi viṣṇo: krāntamasi
verses.wordMeaning: They, lifted up, have turned them back and downward, still flowing onward, after Ahibudhnya. Thou art the stepping-forth of Vishnu: thou art Vishnu's outstep; Vishnu's step art thou.
verses.commentary: Sense: They, lifted up, have turned them back and downward, still flowing onward, after Ahibudhnya. Thou art the stepping-forth of Vishnu: thou art Vishnu's outstep; Vishnu's step art thou.

verses.sanskrit:
प्रजा॑पते॒ न त्वदे॒तान्य॒न्यो विश्वा॑ रू॒पाणि॒ परि॒ ता ब॑भूव । यत्का॑मास्ते जुहु॒मस्तन्नो॑ अस्त्व॒यम॒मुष्य॑ पि॒तासाव॒स्य पि॒ता व॒यᳪ स्या॑म॒ पत॑यो रयी॒णाᳪ स्वाहा॑ ।
रुद्र॒ यत्ते॒ क्रिवि॒ परं॒ नाम॒ तस्मि॑न्हु॒तम॑स्यमे॒ष्टम॑सि॒ स्वाहा॑
verses.translation: Prajâpati, thou only comprehendest all these created forms, and none beside thee. Give us our heart's desire when we invoke thee. So-and-So's father is this man. Sire of this man is So-and-So. May we—All-hail!—be lords of rich possessions. What active highest name thou hast, O Rudra, therein thou art an offering, art an offering at home. All-hail!
verses.hindi: हमारा जीवन देवों के आशीर्वाद से प्रेरणा लेकर चले। प्रेरणा यह है सूर्य--आगे बद , स्तुति- निन्दा से विचलित न होओ, बिना पक्षपात के तुम्हारा व्यवहार हो। सरस्वती-अधिक-से-अधिक ज्ञानवाणियों का उपादान करना। त्वष्टा- स्वास्थ्य से सुरूप रहना। पूषा-घर मेँ गौ अवश्य रखनी। गौ का स्थान कुत्ता न ले-ले। इन्द्र-प्रभु का ही बने
verses.transliteration: prajāpate na tvadetānyanyo viśvā rūpāṇi pari tā babhūva | yatkāmāste juhumastanno astvayamamuṣya pitāsāvasya pitā vaya syāma patayo rayīṇā svāhā | rudra yatte krivi paraṃ nāma tasminhutamasyameṣṭamasi svāhā
verses.wordMeaning: Prajâpati, thou only comprehendest all these created forms, and none beside thee. Give us our heart's desire when we invoke thee. So-and-So's father is this man. Sire of this man is So-and-So. May we—All-hail!—be lords of rich possessions.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Prajâpati, thou only comprehendest all these created forms, and none beside thee. Give us our heart's desire when we invoke thee. So-and-So's father is this man. Sire of this man is So-and-So. May we—All-hail!—be lords of rich possessions.…

verses.sanskrit:
इन्द्र॑स्य॒ वज्रो॑ऽसि मि॒त्रावरु॑णयोस्त्वा प्रशा॒स्त्रोः प्र॒शिषा॑ युनज्मि ।
अव्य॑थायै त्वा स्व॒धायै॒ त्वाऽरि॑ष्टो॒ अर्जु॑नो म॒रुतां॑ प्रस॒वेन॑ ज॒यापा॑म॒ मन॑सा॒ समि॑न्द्रि॒येण॑
verses.translation: Indra's bolt art thou. I by the direction of Mitra-Varuna, Directors, yoke thee. I, the uninjured Arjuna, mount thee for firmness, thee for food. By quickening of the Maruts be thou victor. May we obtain by mind: with power united.
verses.hindi: हम एक-एक कोश से ऊपर उठते हुए आत्म-तत््व का दर्शन करनेवाले बनें। उपयामगृहीत बनें। प्राणापान की साधना करे, ज्ञान-प्राप्तिवाले हों। विपिपाना शुभस्पतीऽ इन्द्रं कर्मस्वावतम् ।॥ ३३॥ १. जब जीवात्मा परमात्मा से सम्पर्क स्थापित कर लेता है तवर प्रभु पति हैँ जीवात्मा
verses.transliteration: indrasya vajro'si mitrāvaruṇayostvā praśāstroḥ praśiṣā yunajmi | avyathāyai tvā svadhāyai tvā'riṣṭo arjuno marutāṃ prasavena jayāpāma manasā samindriyeṇa
verses.wordMeaning: Indra's bolt art thou. I by the direction of Mitra-Varuna, Directors, yoke thee. I, the uninjured Arjuna, mount thee for firmness, thee for food. By quickening of the Maruts be thou victor. May we obtain by mind: with power united.
verses.commentary: Sense: Indra's bolt art thou. I by the direction of Mitra-Varuna, Directors, yoke thee. I, the uninjured Arjuna, mount thee for firmness, thee for food. By quickening of the Maruts be thou victor. May we obtain by mind: with power united.

verses.sanskrit:
मा त॑ इन्द्र ते व॒यं तु॑राषा॒डयु॑क्तासो अब्र॒ह्मता॒ विद॑साम ।
तिष्ठा॒ रथ॒मधि॒ यं व॑ज्रह॒स्ता र॒श्मीन्  दे॑व युवसे॒ स्वश्वा॑न्
verses.translation: Let us not, Indra, conqueror of the mighty, unfit through lack of prayer fail to obtain thee. Ascend the car which thou whose hand bears thunder controllest, and the reins with noble horses.
verses.hindi: परमात्मा के सम्पर्क से हमारा अहंकार नष्ट हो। हम सोम का पान करं ओर शुभ कार्यो में प्रवृत्त रहे। पुत्रमिव पितरावश्िनोभेन्द्रावथुः काव्यैर् सनाभिः । १. है इन्द्र-इन्द्रियों के अधिष्ठाता जीव! इव पितरौ जैसे माता-पिता पुत्रम्-पुत्र को
verses.transliteration: mā ta indra te vayaṃ turāṣāḍayuktāso abrahmatā vidasāma | tiṣṭhā rathamadhi yaṃ vajrahastā raśmīn deva yuvase svaśvān
verses.wordMeaning: Let us not, Indra, conqueror of the mighty, unfit through lack of prayer fail to obtain thee. Ascend the car which thou whose hand bears thunder controllest, and the reins with noble horses.
verses.commentary: Sense: Let us not, Indra, conqueror of the mighty, unfit through lack of prayer fail to obtain thee. Ascend the car which thou whose hand bears thunder controllest, and the reins with noble horses.

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒ग्नये॑ गृ॒हप॑तये॒ स्वाहा॒ सोमा॑य॒ वन॒स्पत॑ये॒ स्वाहा॑
म॒रुता॒मोज॑से॒ स्वाहेन्द्र॑स्येन्द्रि॒याय॒ स्वाहा॑ । पृथि॑वि मात॒र्मा मा॑ हिᳪसी॒र्मो अ॒हं त्वाम्
verses.translation: All hail to Agni, Master of the Household! All-hail to Soma, Sovran of the Forest! All-hail to the great vigour of the Maruts! All-hail to the effectual might of Indra! Injure me not, O Mother Earth, and may I never injure thee.
verses.hindi: प्राण-साधना से हम तत्त्व- ज्ञान व यज्ञात्मक कर्मोवाले बनें, यही प्रभु-प्राप्ति
verses.transliteration: agnaye gṛhapataye svāhā somāya vanaspataye svāhā marutāmojase svāhendrasyendriyāya svāhā | pṛthivi mātarmā mā hisīrmo ahaṃ tvām
verses.wordMeaning: All hail to Agni, Master of the Household! All-hail to Soma, Sovran of the Forest! All-hail to the great vigour of the Maruts! All-hail to the effectual might of Indra! Injure me not, O Mother Earth, and may I never injure thee.
verses.commentary: Sense: All hail to Agni, Master of the Household! All-hail to Soma, Sovran of the Forest! All-hail to the great vigour of the Maruts! All-hail to the effectual might of Indra! Injure me not, O Mother Earth, and may I never injure thee.

verses.sanskrit:
ह॒ᳪसः शु॑चि॒षद्वसु॑रन्तरिक्ष॒सद्धोता॑ वेदि॒षदति॑थिर्दुरोण॒सत् ।
नृ॒षद्व॑र॒सदृ॑त॒सद्व्यो॑म॒सद॒ब्जा गो॒जा ऋ॑त॒जा अ॑द्रि॒जा ऋ॒तं बृ॒हत्
verses.translation: The Hamsa throned in light, the Vasu in mid-air, the Priest beside the altar, Guest within the house, Dwelling in noblest place, mid men, in truth, in sky, born of flood, kine, truth, mountain, be is mighty Law.
verses.hindi: प्रजा शक्तिशाली व माधुर्य से पूर्ण हो, परस्पर मेल से राष्ट कौ शक्ति को बद्धानेवाली हो। एेसी स्थिति में ही यह शत्रुओं से अनाधृष्य होती हे। घोषाय स्वाहा श्लोकाय स्वाहाश्शछांय स्वाहा भगाय स्वाहार्यम्णे स्वाह।५॥ प्रजा राजा से कहती है कि १. सोमस्य त्विषिः असिचत सोम की कान्तिवाला हे।
verses.transliteration: hasaḥ śuciṣadvasurantarikṣasaddhotā vediṣadatithirduroṇasat | nṛṣadvarasadṛtasadvyomasadabjā gojā ṛtajā adrijā ṛtaṃ bṛhat
verses.wordMeaning: The Hamsa throned in light, the Vasu in mid-air, the Priest beside the altar, Guest within the house, Dwelling in noblest place, mid men, in truth, in sky, born of flood, kine, truth, mountain, be is mighty Law.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Hamsa throned in light, the Vasu in mid-air, the Priest beside the altar, Guest within the house, Dwelling in noblest place, mid men, in truth, in sky, born of flood, kine, truth, mountain, be is mighty Law.

verses.sanskrit:
इय॑द॒स्यायु॑र॒स्यायु॒र्मयि॑ धेहि॒ युङ्ङ॑सि॒ वर्चो॑ऽसि॒ वर्चो॒ मयि॑ धे॒ह्यूर्ग॒स्यूर्जं॒ मयि॑ धेहि ।।
इन्द्र॑स्य वां वीर्य॒कृतो॑ बा॒हू अ॑भ्यु॒पाव॑हरामि
verses.translation: So great art thou: life art thou; give me life, Mate art thou: thou art splendour; give me splendour. Strength art thou: give me strength. I draw you downward, two arms of Indra mighty in achievement.
verses.hindi: १. राष्ट मेँ राजा मित्र" हे, सारी प्रजा को“ प्रमीते: जयते ' मृत्यु एवं पापों से बचाने के लिए प्रयशील है तो “वरूण ' सेनापति है, जो राष्ट पर होनेवाले शत्रुओं के आक्रमण का निवारण करता है। ये उभौ दोनों हिरण्यरूपौ =ज्योर्तिमय रूपवाले हैँ। हिरण्य के समान अति तेजस्वी हैं, इन्द्रौ -परमैश्वर्यवाले अथवा सामर्थ्यं से युक्त हे। ये दोनों उषसः विरोके
verses.transliteration: iyadasyāyurasyāyurmayi dhehi yuṅṅasi varco'si varco mayi dhehyūrgasyūrjaṃ mayi dhehi || indrasya vāṃ vīryakṛto bāhū abhyupāvaharāmi
verses.wordMeaning: So great art thou: life art thou; give me life, Mate art thou: thou art splendour; give me splendour. Strength art thou: give me strength. I draw you downward, two arms of Indra mighty in achievement.
verses.commentary: Sense: So great art thou: life art thou; give me life, Mate art thou: thou art splendour; give me splendour. Strength art thou: give me strength. I draw you downward, two arms of Indra mighty in achievement.

verses.sanskrit:
स्यो॒नाऽसि॑ सु॒षदा॑ऽसि क्ष॒त्रस्य॒ योनि॑रसि ।
स्यो॒नामा सी॑द सु॒षदा॒मा सी॑द क्ष॒त्रस्य॒ योनि॒मा सी॑द
verses.translation: Fair art thou, good to sit on, womb of kingship. Sit on the fair one, sit on that which offers a pleasant seat: sit in the womb of kingship.
verses.hindi: प्रत्येक मनुष्य का कर्त्तव्य है कि वह रेतस् की रक्षा द्वारा इन रेतःकणों को शरीर में ही व्याप्त करनेवाला बने ओर अपने शरीर, मन व बुद्धि को स्वस्थ रखनेवाला हो। प्रजापते न त्वदेतान्यन्यो विष्वा रूपाणि परि ता ब॑भूव । यत्कामास्ते गत मन्त्र में रेतस् कौ रक्षा द्वारा त्रिलोकौ के विक्रमण का उपदेश था। उसी को
verses.transliteration: syonā'si suṣadā'si kṣatrasya yonirasi | syonāmā sīda suṣadāmā sīda kṣatrasya yonimā sīda
verses.wordMeaning: Fair art thou, good to sit on, womb of kingship. Sit on the fair one, sit on that which offers a pleasant seat: sit in the womb of kingship.
verses.commentary: Sense: Fair art thou, good to sit on, womb of kingship. Sit on the fair one, sit on that which offers a pleasant seat: sit in the womb of kingship.

verses.sanskrit: नि ष॑साद घृ॒तव्र॑तो॒ वरु॑णः प॒स्त्यास्वा । साम्रा॑ज्याय सु॒क्रतु॑:
verses.translation: Varuna, Law's maintainer, hath sat down among his people, he Most wise, for universal sway.
verses.hindi: प्रभु ही सबका धारण कर रहे है, वे ही हम सबके पितादहै। उस प्रभुके नाम-स्मरण में अपने को अर्पित करते हुए हम लोक-त्रयी का विजय करें १. गत मन्त्र के अनुसार प्रभु-नामस्मरण करनेवाले देववात से कहते है कि तू इन्द्रस्य=उस परमैश्वर्यशाली, सब शत्रुओं के संहारक प्रभु के वज्रः असि वज्रवाला (वज्रम्
verses.transliteration: ni ṣasāda ghṛtavrato varuṇaḥ pastyāsvā | sāmrājyāya sukratu:
verses.wordMeaning: Varuna, Law's maintainer, hath sat down among his people, he Most wise, for universal sway.
verses.commentary: Sense: Varuna, Law's maintainer, hath sat down among his people, he Most wise, for universal sway.

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒भि॒भूर॑स्ये॒तास्ते॒ पञ्च॒ दिश॑: कल्पन्तां॒ ब्रह्मँ॒स्त्वं ब्र॒ह्माऽसि॑ सवि॒ताऽसि॑ स॒त्यप्र॑सवो॒ वरु॑णोऽसि स॒त्यौजा॒ इन्द्रो॑ऽसि॒ विशौ॑जा रु॒द्रो॒ऽसि सु॒शेव॑: ।
बहु॑कार॒ श्रेय॑स्कर॒ भूय॑स्क॒रेन्द्र॑स्य॒ वज्रो॑ऽसि॒ तेन॑ मे रध्य
verses.translation: Supreme Lord art thou. May these five regions of thine be prosperous. Brahman! Thou art Brahman, Savitar art thou, faithful in impulsion, Varuna art thou, he whose power is real. Indra art thou, whose strength is of the people. Rudra art thou, the very kind and gracious. Doer of much, Improver, Wealth-increaser! Indra's holt art thou. Be therewith my vassal.
verses.hindi: हम ईश्वर के हों। अनीश्वरवाद हमारे नाश का कारण बनता हे। वे प्रभु ही वज्रहस्त हे, हमारे शत्रुओं का शीघ्रता से विनाश करनेवाले हे। अग्नये गृहप॑तये स्वाहा सोमाय वनस्पत॑ ये स्वाहां मरुतामोजं॑से स्वाहेनदरस्येद्धरियाय देववात प्रार्थना करता है कि गत मन्त्र के अनुसार मैं अपने शरीर-रूप रथ की
verses.transliteration: abhibhūrasyetāste pañca diśa: kalpantāṃ brahma~stvaṃ brahmā'si savitā'si satyaprasavo varuṇo'si satyaujā indro'si viśaujā rudro'si suśeva: | bahukāra śreyaskara bhūyaskarendrasya vajro'si tena me radhya
verses.wordMeaning: Supreme Lord art thou. May these five regions of thine be prosperous. Brahman! Thou art Brahman, Savitar art thou, faithful in impulsion, Varuna art thou, he whose power is real. Indra art thou, whose strength is of the people. Rudra art thou, the very kind and gracious.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Supreme Lord art thou. May these five regions of thine be prosperous. Brahman! Thou art Brahman, Savitar art thou, faithful in impulsion, Varuna art thou, he whose power is real. Indra art thou, whose strength is of the people. Rudra art thou, the very kind and gracious.…

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒ग्निः पृ॒थुर्धर्म॑ण॒स्पति॑र्जुषा॒णो अ॒ग्निः पृ॒थुर्धर्म॑ण॒स्पति॒राज्य॑स्य वेतु॒ स्वाहा॑
स्वाहा॑कृता॒: सूर्य॑स्य र॒श्मिभि॑र्यतध्वᳪ सजा॒तानां॑ मध्य॒मेष्ठ्या॑य
verses.translation: May spacious Agni, Lord of Duty, gladly, vast Agni, Duty's Lord, accept the butter. All-hail! Hallowed by Svâhâ, with the beams of Sûrya, strive for his central place among the kinsmen.
verses.hindi: -यह पृथिवी सुखरूप है, सुख से बैठने योग्य है, शक्ति का स्रोत हे। निरन्तर क्रियाशीलता के द्वारा "वामदेव ' पृथिवी को एेसा ही बना लेता हेै। १. उल्लिखित मन्त्रों में वर्णित ' वामदेव ' लोगों में से चुना जाकर (वरुण) जीवन को उत्तमता से व्यवस्थित करने के लिए सिंहासन पर बिठाया जाता है। इसने उत्तम शासन
verses.transliteration: agniḥ pṛthurdharmaṇaspatirjuṣāṇo agniḥ pṛthurdharmaṇaspatirājyasya vetu svāhā svāhākṛtā: sūryasya raśmibhiryatadhva sajātānāṃ madhyameṣṭhyāya
verses.wordMeaning: May spacious Agni, Lord of Duty, gladly, vast Agni, Duty's Lord, accept the butter. All-hail! Hallowed by Svâhâ, with the beams of Sûrya, strive for his central place among the kinsmen.
verses.commentary: Sense: May spacious Agni, Lord of Duty, gladly, vast Agni, Duty's Lord, accept the butter. All-hail! Hallowed by Svâhâ, with the beams of Sûrya, strive for his central place among the kinsmen.

verses.sanskrit: स॒वि॒त्रा प्र॑सवि॒त्रा सर॑स्वत्या वा॒चा त्वष्ट्रा॑ रू॒पैः पू॒ष्णा प॒शुभि॒रिन्द्रे॑णा॒स्मे बृह॒स्पति॑ना॒ ब्रह्म॑णा॒ वरु॑णे॒नौज॑सा॒ऽग्निना॒ तेज॑सा॒ सोमे॑न॒ राज्ञा॒ विष्णु॑ना दश॒म्या दे॒वत॑या॒ प्रसू॑त॒: प्र स॑र्पामि
verses.translation: I creep forth urged onward by Savitar the Impeller; by Sarasvatî, Speech; by Tvashtar, created forms; by Pûshan, cattle; by this Indra; by Brihaspati, Devotion; by Varuna, Power; by Agni, Brilliance; by Soma, the King; by Vishnu the tenth Deity.
verses.hindi: -यह पृथिवी सुखरूप है, सुख से बैठने योग्य है, शक्ति का स्रोत हे। निरन्तर क्रियाशीलता के द्वारा "वामदेव ' पृथिवी को एेसा ही बना लेता हेै। १. उल्लिखित मन्त्रों में वर्णित ' वामदेव ' लोगों में से चुना जाकर (वरुण) जीवन को उत्तमता से व्यवस्थित करने के लिए सिंहासन पर बिठाया जाता है। इसने उत्तम शासन
verses.transliteration: savitrā prasavitrā sarasvatyā vācā tvaṣṭrā rūpaiḥ pūṣṇā paśubhirindreṇāsme bṛhaspatinā brahmaṇā varuṇenaujasā'gninā tejasā somena rājñā viṣṇunā daśamyā devatayā prasūta: pra sarpāmi
verses.wordMeaning: I creep forth urged onward by Savitar the Impeller; by Sarasvatî, Speech; by Tvashtar, created forms; by Pûshan, cattle; by this Indra; by Brihaspati, Devotion; by Varuna, Power; by Agni, Brilliance; by Soma, the King; by Vishnu the tenth Deity.
verses.commentary: Sense: I creep forth urged onward by Savitar the Impeller; by Sarasvatî, Speech; by Tvashtar, created forms; by Pûshan, cattle; by this Indra; by Brihaspati, Devotion; by Varuna, Power; by Agni, Brilliance; by Soma, the King; by Vishnu the tenth Deity.

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒श्विभ्यां॑  पच्यस्व॒ सर॑स्वत्यै पच्य॒स्वेन्द्रा॑य सु॒त्राम्णे॑ पच्यस्व ।
वा॒युः पू॒तः प॒वित्रे॑ण प्र॒त्यङ्क्सोमो॒ अति॑स्रुतः । इन्द्र॑स्य॒ युज्य॒: सखा॑
verses.translation: Get dressed for the Asvins. Get dressed for Sarasvatî: Get dressed for Indra the Good Deliverer: Soma the Wind, purified by the strainer, Indra's meet friend, hath gone o’erflowing backward.
verses.hindi: -यह पृथिवी सुखरूप है, सुख से बैठने योग्य है, शक्ति का स्रोत हे। निरन्तर क्रियाशीलता के द्वारा "वामदेव ' पृथिवी को एेसा ही बना लेता हेै। १. उल्लिखित मन्त्रों में वर्णित ' वामदेव ' लोगों में से चुना जाकर (वरुण) जीवन को उत्तमता से व्यवस्थित करने के लिए सिंहासन पर बिठाया जाता है। इसने उत्तम शासन
verses.transliteration: aśvibhyāṃ pacyasva sarasvatyai pacyasvendrāya sutrāmṇe pacyasva | vāyuḥ pūtaḥ pavitreṇa pratyaṅksomo atisrutaḥ | indrasya yujya: sakhā
verses.wordMeaning: Get dressed for the Asvins. Get dressed for Sarasvatî: Get dressed for Indra the Good Deliverer: Soma the Wind, purified by the strainer, Indra's meet friend, hath gone o’erflowing backward.
verses.commentary: Sense: Get dressed for the Asvins. Get dressed for Sarasvatî: Get dressed for Indra the Good Deliverer: Soma the Wind, purified by the strainer, Indra's meet friend, hath gone o’erflowing backward.

verses.sanskrit:
कु॒विद॒ङ्ग यव॑मन्तो यवं॑  चि॒द्यथा॒ दान्त्य॑नुपू॒र्वं वि॒यूय॑ ।
इ॒हेहै॑षां कृणुहि॒ भोज॑नानि॒ ये ब॒र्हिषो॒ नम॑ उक्तिं॒ यज॑न्ति ।
उ॒प॒या॒मगृ॑हीतोऽस्य॒श्विभ्यां॑ त्वा॒ सर॑स्वत्यै॒ त्वेन्द्रा॑य त्वा सु॒त्राम्णे॑
verses.translation: What then? As men whose fields are full of barley reap the ripe corn, removing it in order, So bring the food of these men, bring it hither, who pay the Sacred Grass their spoken homage. Taken upon a base art thou. Thee for the Asvins. Thee for Sarasvatî, and thee for Indra, for the Excellent Protector.
verses.hindi: -यह पृथिवी सुखरूप है, सुख से बैठने योग्य है, शक्ति का स्रोत हे। निरन्तर क्रियाशीलता के द्वारा "वामदेव ' पृथिवी को एेसा ही बना लेता हेै। १. उल्लिखित मन्त्रों में वर्णित ' वामदेव ' लोगों में से चुना जाकर (वरुण) जीवन को उत्तमता से व्यवस्थित करने के लिए सिंहासन पर बिठाया जाता है। इसने उत्तम शासन
verses.transliteration: kuvidaṅga yavamanto yavaṃ cidyathā dāntyanupūrvaṃ viyūya | ihehaiṣāṃ kṛṇuhi bhojanāni ye barhiṣo nama uktiṃ yajanti | upayāmagṛhīto'syaśvibhyāṃ tvā sarasvatyai tvendrāya tvā sutrāmṇe
verses.wordMeaning: What then? As men whose fields are full of barley reap the ripe corn, removing it in order, So bring the food of these men, bring it hither, who pay the Sacred Grass their spoken homage. Taken upon a base art thou. Thee for the Asvins. Thee for Sarasvatî, and thee for Indra,…
verses.commentary: Sense: What then? As men whose fields are full of barley reap the ripe corn, removing it in order, So bring the food of these men, bring it hither, who pay the Sacred Grass their spoken homage. Taken upon a base art thou. Thee for the Asvins. Thee for Sarasvatî, and thee for Indra,…

verses.sanskrit: यु॒वᳪ सु॒राम॑मश्विना॒ नमु॑चावासु॒रे सचा॑ । वि॒पि॒पा॒ना शु॑भस्पती॒ इन्द्रं॒ कर्म॑स्वावतम्
verses.translation: Ye Asvins, Lords of Splendour, drank full draughts of grateful Soma juice, And aided Indra in his deeds with Namuchi of Asura birth.
verses.hindi: -यह पृथिवी सुखरूप है, सुख से बैठने योग्य है, शक्ति का स्रोत हे। निरन्तर क्रियाशीलता के द्वारा "वामदेव ' पृथिवी को एेसा ही बना लेता हेै। १. उल्लिखित मन्त्रों में वर्णित ' वामदेव ' लोगों में से चुना जाकर (वरुण) जीवन को उत्तमता से व्यवस्थित करने के लिए सिंहासन पर बिठाया जाता है। इसने उत्तम शासन
verses.transliteration: yuva surāmamaśvinā namucāvāsure sacā | vipipānā śubhaspatī indraṃ karmasvāvatam
verses.wordMeaning: Ye Asvins, Lords of Splendour, drank full draughts of grateful Soma juice, And aided Indra in his deeds with Namuchi of Asura birth.
verses.commentary: Sense: Ye Asvins, Lords of Splendour, drank full draughts of grateful Soma juice, And aided Indra in his deeds with Namuchi of Asura birth.

verses.sanskrit:
पु॒त्रमि॑व पि॒तरा॑व॒श्विनो॒भेन्द्रा॒वथु॒: काव्यै॑र्द॒ᳪसना॑भिः ।
यत्सु॒रामं॒ व्यपि॑ब॒: शची॑भि॒: सर॑स्वती त्वा मघवन्नभिष्णक्
verses.translation: As parents aid a son, both Asvins aided thee, Indra, with their wondrous powers and wisdom. When thou with might hadst drunk the draught that gladdens, Sarasvatî, O Bounteous Lord, refreshed thee.
verses.hindi: -यह पृथिवी सुखरूप है, सुख से बैठने योग्य है, शक्ति का स्रोत हे। निरन्तर क्रियाशीलता के द्वारा "वामदेव ' पृथिवी को एेसा ही बना लेता हेै। १. उल्लिखित मन्त्रों में वर्णित ' वामदेव ' लोगों में से चुना जाकर (वरुण) जीवन को उत्तमता से व्यवस्थित करने के लिए सिंहासन पर बिठाया जाता है। इसने उत्तम शासन
verses.transliteration: putramiva pitarāvaśvinobhendrāvathu: kāvyairdasanābhiḥ | yatsurāmaṃ vyapiba: śacībhi: sarasvatī tvā maghavannabhiṣṇak
verses.wordMeaning: As parents aid a son, both Asvins aided thee, Indra, with their wondrous powers and wisdom. When thou with might hadst drunk the draught that gladdens, Sarasvatî, O Bounteous Lord, refreshed thee.
verses.commentary: Sense: As parents aid a son, both Asvins aided thee, Indra, with their wondrous powers and wisdom. When thou with might hadst drunk the draught that gladdens, Sarasvatî, O Bounteous Lord, refreshed thee.

verses.sanskrit: यु॒ञ्जा॒नः प्र॑थ॒मं मन॑स्त॒त्त्वाय॑ सवि॒ता धिय॑: । अ॒ग्नेर्ज्योति॑र्नि॒चाय्य॑ पृथि॒व्या अध्याऽभ॑रत्
verses.translation: com The Texts of the White Yajurveda, tr. Ralph T.H. Griffith, [1899], HARNESSING, first of all, the mind, Savitar having stretched the thought With reverent look upon the light of Agni bore them up from earth.
verses.hindi: मोक्षमार्ग का क्रम यह है-१. मन को आत्मतत्त्व में लगाना २. योग द्वारा बुद्धि का तनूकरण, बुद्धि को तीत्र बनाना ३. प्रभु के प्रकाश को देखना ४. विषय-रस युक्तेन मन॑सा वयं देवस्य॑ सवितुः सवे । स्वर्ग्या य॒ शक्त्या ।। २॥ १. पिचछले मन्त्र में मन को विषयों से हटाकर आत्मतत्त्व मेँ लगाने का प्रतिपादन
verses.transliteration: yuñjānaḥ prathamaṃ manastattvāya savitā dhiya: | agnerjyotirnicāyya pṛthivyā adhyā'bharat
verses.wordMeaning: com The Texts of the White Yajurveda, tr. Ralph T.H. Griffith, [1899], HARNESSING, first of all, the mind, Savitar having stretched the thought With reverent look upon the light of Agni bore them up from earth.
verses.commentary: Sense: com The Texts of the White Yajurveda, tr. Ralph T.H. Griffith, [1899], HARNESSING, first of all, the mind, Savitar having stretched the thought With reverent look upon the light of Agni bore them up from earth.

verses.sanskrit: यु॒क्तेन॒ मन॑सा व॒यं दे॒वस्य॑ सवि॒तुः स॒वे । स्व॒र्ग्या॒य॒ शक्त्या॑
verses.translation: By impulse of God Savitar we with our spirit harnessed strive With might to win the heavenly.
verses.hindi: १. मन को युक्त करें २. प्रभु से आदिष्ट कर्मों में उसे यथाशक्ति लगाये रव्यं ३. यही स्वर्ग-प्राप्ति का मार्ग हेै। युक्त्वाय सविता देवान्त्स्व॑र्यतो धिया दिव॑म् । बृहज्ज्योतिः. करिष्यतः संविता प्रसुवाति तान् ॥३॥
verses.transliteration: yuktena manasā vayaṃ devasya savituḥ save | svargyāya śaktyā
verses.wordMeaning: By impulse of God Savitar we with our spirit harnessed strive With might to win the heavenly.
verses.commentary: Sense: By impulse of God Savitar we with our spirit harnessed strive With might to win the heavenly.

verses.sanskrit: यु॒क्त्वाय॑ सवि॒ता दे॒वान्त्स्व॑र्य॒तो धि॒या दिव॑म् । बृ॒हज्ज्योति॑: करिष्य॒तः स॑वि॒ता प्र सु॑वाति॒ तान्
verses.translation: Savitar, having harnessed Gods who go to light and heavenly thought, Who will create the lofty light—Savitar urge them on their way!
verses.hindi: हम अपने मनँ को प्रभु में लगाने का प्रयत्न करे ओर उसकौ बनाई इस सृष्टि मे उसकी महिमा को देखने का प्रयल करे। १. वाम् तुम दोनों पति-पली को नमोभिः=नमन के द्वारा पूर्व्यम् सृष्टि से पहले होनेवाले (अग्रे समवर्तत) ब्रह्य चप्रभु से युजे=सङ्खत करता हूं। प्रातः-सायं नमस् कौ उक्तियां
verses.transliteration: yuktvāya savitā devāntsvaryato dhiyā divam | bṛhajjyoti: kariṣyataḥ savitā pra suvāti tān
verses.wordMeaning: Savitar, having harnessed Gods who go to light and heavenly thought, Who will create the lofty light—Savitar urge them on their way!
verses.commentary: Sense: Savitar, having harnessed Gods who go to light and heavenly thought, Who will create the lofty light—Savitar urge them on their way!

verses.sanskrit:
यु॒ञ्जते॒ मन॑ उ॒त यु॑ञ्जते॒ धियो॒ विप्रा॒ विप्र॑स्य बृह॒तो वि॑प॒श्चित॑: ।
वि होत्रा॑ दधे वयुना॒विदेक॒ इन्म॒ही दे॒वस्य॑ सवि॒तुः परि॑ष्टुतिः
verses.translation: The priests of him the lofty priest well skilled in hymns, harness their spirit, yea, harness their holy thoughts. He only, skilled in rules, assigns their priestly tasks. Yea, lofty is the praise of Savitar the God.
verses.hindi: हम विषय-व्यावृत्त होकर उस अमृत पिता के अमूत पुत्र बनें, ओर उस पिता की प्रकाशमयी वाणियों को सुने। यस्य॑ प्रयाणमन्वन्यऽ इद्ययुर्देवा देवस्य॑ महिमानमोजं॑सा । यः पार्थिष्वानि विममे सऽएतंशो रजा॑श्सि देवः सर॑विता महित्वना ।६॥
verses.transliteration: yuñjate mana uta yuñjate dhiyo viprā viprasya bṛhato vipaścita: | vi hotrā dadhe vayunāvideka inmahī devasya savituḥ pariṣṭutiḥ
verses.wordMeaning: The priests of him the lofty priest well skilled in hymns, harness their spirit, yea, harness their holy thoughts. He only, skilled in rules, assigns their priestly tasks. Yea, lofty is the praise of Savitar the God.
verses.commentary: Sense: The priests of him the lofty priest well skilled in hymns, harness their spirit, yea, harness their holy thoughts. He only, skilled in rules, assigns their priestly tasks. Yea, lofty is the praise of Savitar the God.

verses.sanskrit:
यु॒जे वां॒ ब्रह्म॑ पू॒र्व्यं नमो॑भि॒र्वि श्लोक॑ एतु प॒थ्ये॒व सू॒रेः ।
शृ॒ण्वन्तु॒ विश्वे॑ अ॒मृत॑स्य पु॒त्रा आ ये धामा॑नि दि॒व्यानि॑ त॒स्थुः
verses.translation: I yoke with prayer your ancient inspiration: may the laud rise as on the prince's pathway. All Sons of the Immortal One shall hear it, who have resorted to celestial dwellings.
verses.hindi: १. प्रभु के प्रशासन में ही सब देव गति कर रहे है। २. उसके ओज से ही ये महिमावाले हो रहे हैँ। ३. वही इन सबका निर्माण करते है। ४. वही इनका धारण प्रभु-भक्त के लक्षण ( ज्ञान+माधुर्य ) देव॑ सवितः प्रसुव यज्ञं प्रसुव यज्ञपतिं भगाय ।
verses.transliteration: yuje vāṃ brahma pūrvyaṃ namobhirvi śloka etu pathyeva sūreḥ | śṛṇvantu viśve amṛtasya putrā ā ye dhāmāni divyāni tasthuḥ
verses.wordMeaning: I yoke with prayer your ancient inspiration: may the laud rise as on the prince's pathway. All Sons of the Immortal One shall hear it, who have resorted to celestial dwellings.
verses.commentary: Sense: I yoke with prayer your ancient inspiration: may the laud rise as on the prince's pathway. All Sons of the Immortal One shall hear it, who have resorted to celestial dwellings.

verses.sanskrit:
यस्य॑ प्र॒याण॒मन्व॒न्य इद्य॒युर्दे॒वा दे॒वस्य॑ महि॒मान॒मोज॑सा ।
यः पार्थि॑वानि विम॒मे स एत॑शो॒ रजा॑ᳪसि दे॒वः स॑वि॒ता म॑हित्व॒ना
verses.translation: Even he, the God whose going forth and majesty the other Deities have followed with their might, He who hath measured the celestial regions out by his great power, he is the Courser Savitar.
verses.hindi: १. हमारा जीवन यज्ञमय हो। २. यज्ञिय उपायों से ही हम सेवनीय धन को प्राप्त करे। ३. हमारा ज्ञान पवित्र व उज्ज्वल हो। ४. वाणी मधुर हो। संक्षेप में यक्ञका परिणाम भग--धन है, ज्ञान का परिणाम माधुर्या यज्ञ से हम भग को प्राप्त कर, जान से माधुर्य को। यही प्रभु-भक्त के लक्षण दँ। प्रभु-भक्त के अन्दर ज्लानाग्नि दीप्त हो रही होती
verses.transliteration: yasya prayāṇamanvanya idyayurdevā devasya mahimānamojasā | yaḥ pārthivāni vimame sa etaśo rajāsi devaḥ savitā mahitvanā
verses.wordMeaning: Even he, the God whose going forth and majesty the other Deities have followed with their might, He who hath measured the celestial regions out by his great power, he is the Courser Savitar.
verses.commentary: Sense: Even he, the God whose going forth and majesty the other Deities have followed with their might, He who hath measured the celestial regions out by his great power, he is the Courser Savitar.

verses.sanskrit:
देव॑ सवित॒: प्र सु॑व य॒ज्ञं प्र सु॑व य॒ज्ञप॑तिं॒ भगा॑य ।
दि॒व्यो ग॑न्ध॒र्वः के॑त॒पूः केतं॑ नः पुनातु वा॒चस्पति॒र्वाचं॑ नः स्वदतु
verses.translation: Our sacrifice, God Savitar! speed forward: speed to his share the sacrifice's patron. May the celestial Gandharva, Cleanser of thought and will, make clean our thoughts and wishes. The Lord of Speech sweeten the words we utter!
verses.hindi: हमारे जीवन मे यज्ञ हो। विज्ञान के साथ स्तुत्ति हो। प्राणशक्ति के साथ ब्रह्मवर्चस् हो। प्राणशक्ति की वृद्धि के साथ हमारे जीवन मे वह स्तुति हो जो हमारी वृद्धि देवस्य त्वा सवितुः प्र॑सतु,ऽश्विनोर्बाहुभ्यौ पूष्णो हस्ताभ्याम् । १. पिछले मन्त्र के अनुसार अपना जीवन बनाने के लिए मैं त्वा=तुञ्चे अर्थात् प्रत्येक
verses.transliteration: deva savita: pra suva yajñaṃ pra suva yajñapatiṃ bhagāya | divyo gandharvaḥ ketapūḥ ketaṃ naḥ punātu vācaspatirvācaṃ naḥ svadatu
verses.wordMeaning: Our sacrifice, God Savitar! speed forward: speed to his share the sacrifice's patron. May the celestial Gandharva, Cleanser of thought and will, make clean our thoughts and wishes. The Lord of Speech sweeten the words we utter!
verses.commentary: Sense: Our sacrifice, God Savitar! speed forward: speed to his share the sacrifice's patron. May the celestial Gandharva, Cleanser of thought and will, make clean our thoughts and wishes. The Lord of Speech sweeten the words we utter!

verses.sanskrit:
इ॒मं नो॑ देव सवितर्य॒ज्ञं प्र ण॑य देवा॒व्य॒ᳪ सखि॒विद॑ᳪ सत्रा॒जितं॑ धन॒जित॑ᳪ स्व॒र्जित॑म् ।
ऋ॒चा स्तोम॒ᳪ सम॑र्धय गाय॒त्रेण॑ रथन्त॒रं बृ॒हद्गा॑य॒त्रव॑र्तनि॒ स्वाहा॑
verses.translation: God Savitar, speed this God-loved sacrifice of ours, friend-finding, ever-conquering, winning wealth and heaven. Speed praise-song with the sacred verse, Rathantara with Gâyatra, Brihat that runs in Gâyatra. All-hail!
verses.hindi: में संसार में प्रभु की अनुज्ञा के अनुसार, यलपूर्वक , पोषण के दृष्टिकोण से वस्तुं का ग्रहण करूं। ' प्राणशक्ति कौ रक्षा व काम-क्रोध-लोभ के वेग को रोकना' मेरे जीवन का ध्येय हो। मैं "अङ्गिरस" बनूँ। अङ्खिरस् की भांति अग्निहोत्र करनेवाला बनूँ। अभ्रिरसि नार्य॑सि त्वयां वयमण्निश॑केम खनिंतुश्सधस्थ आ ।
verses.transliteration: imaṃ no deva savitaryajñaṃ pra ṇaya devāvya sakhivida satrājitaṃ dhanajita svarjitam | ṛcā stoma samardhaya gāyatreṇa rathantaraṃ bṛhadgāyatravartani svāhā
verses.wordMeaning: God Savitar, speed this God-loved sacrifice of ours, friend-finding, ever-conquering, winning wealth and heaven. Speed praise-song with the sacred verse, Rathantara with Gâyatra, Brihat that runs in Gâyatra. All-hail!
verses.commentary: Sense: God Savitar, speed this God-loved sacrifice of ours, friend-finding, ever-conquering, winning wealth and heaven. Speed praise-song with the sacred verse, Rathantara with Gâyatra, Brihat that runs in Gâyatra. All-hail!

verses.sanskrit:
दे॒वस्य॑ त्वा सवि॒तुः प्र॑स॒वेऽश्विनो॑र्बा॒हुभ्यां॑ पू॒ष्णो हस्ता॑भ्याम् ।
आ द॑दे गाय॒त्रेण॒ छन्द॑साऽङ्गिर॒स्वत्पृ॑थि॒व्याः स॒धस्था॑द॒ग्निं पु॑री॒ष्य॒मङ्गिर॒स्वदा भ॑र॒ त्रैष्टु॑भेन॒ छन्द॑साऽङ्गिर॒स्वत्
verses.translation: By impulse of God Savitar I take thee, with arms of Asvins, with the hands of Pûshan, in Angiras’ manner, with Gâyatrî metre. From the earth's seat bring thou Purîshya Agni, as Angiras was wont, with Trishtup metre.
verses.hindi: हम हदयरूप गुहा में स्थित प्रभु का दर्शन करने का प्रयल करे। उस कार्य में यह वेदवाणी हमारी सहायिका होगी। यह हमारे सब मलों को दूर करती है। शुद्ध हदय मेँ प्रभु का प्रकाश होता है। लोकदित के दृष्टिकोण से हम अग्निहोत्र को अपनार्णँ। यह वायु-शुद्धि द्वारा नीरोगता को उत्पन्न कर जगती का कल्याण करता है।
verses.transliteration: devasya tvā savituḥ prasave'śvinorbāhubhyāṃ pūṣṇo hastābhyām | ā dade gāyatreṇa chandasā'ṅgirasvatpṛthivyāḥ sadhasthādagniṃ purīṣyamaṅgirasvadā bhara traiṣṭubhena chandasā'ṅgirasvat
verses.wordMeaning: By impulse of God Savitar I take thee, with arms of Asvins, with the hands of Pûshan, in Angiras’ manner, with Gâyatrî metre. From the earth's seat bring thou Purîshya Agni, as Angiras was wont, with Trishtup metre.
verses.commentary: Sense: By impulse of God Savitar I take thee, with arms of Asvins, with the hands of Pûshan, in Angiras’ manner, with Gâyatrî metre. From the earth's seat bring thou Purîshya Agni, as Angiras was wont, with Trishtup metre.

verses.sanskrit: अभ्रि॑रसि॒ नार्य॑सि॒ त्वया॑ व॒यम॒ग्निᳪ श॑केम॒ खनि॑तुᳪ स॒धस्थ॒ आ । जाग॑तेन॒ छन्द॑साऽङ्गिर॒स्वत्
verses.translation: Spade art thou; woman art thou. Ours be power with thee to dig out Agni in his dwelling, as Angiras was wont, with Jagatî metre.
verses.hindi: हम वेदवाणी का स्मरण करे। उसकी ज्ञान-ज्योति को देखें । प्रभु के प्रकाश का अनुभव कर। प्रतिक्षण प्रभु-स्मरण से जीवन को सरस बना्े। त ९ से ११९ तक क्रमशः "गायत्र, त्रेष्टुभ, जागत व आनुष्टुभ' छन्दों का उल्लेख है। सामान्यतः ब्रह्यचारी को ! गायत्र" छन्दवाला होना है, वीर्यरक्षा द्वारा अपनी
verses.transliteration: abhrirasi nāryasi tvayā vayamagni śakema khanitu sadhastha ā | jāgatena chandasā'ṅgirasvat
verses.wordMeaning: Spade art thou; woman art thou. Ours be power with thee to dig out Agni in his dwelling, as Angiras was wont, with Jagatî metre.
verses.commentary: Sense: Spade art thou; woman art thou. Ours be power with thee to dig out Agni in his dwelling, as Angiras was wont, with Jagatî metre.

verses.sanskrit: हस्त॑ आ॒धाय॑ सवि॒ता बिभ्र॒दभ्रि॑ᳪ हिर॒ण्ययी॑म् । अ॒ग्नेर्ज्योति॑र्नि॒चाय्य॑ पृथि॒व्या अध्याऽभ॑र॒दानु॑ष्टुभेन॒ छन्द॑साऽङ्गिर॒स्वत्
verses.translation: Savitar, bearing in his hand the gold spade which he took therewith, Looking with reverence on the light of Agni, raised it from the earth, With the Anushtup metre and as Angiras was wont to do.
verses.hindi: हमारे जीवन का केन्द्र प्रभु हों। उस केन्द्र से ज्ञान, नैर्मल्य व स्वास्थ्य की रश्मियों का प्रसार हो। युञ्जाथाश्शरासंभं युवमस्मिन् यामे वृषण्वसू । अग्निं भर॑न्तमस्मयुम् ॥ ९३॥। ९. गत मन्त्र कौ भावना के अनुसार जो पति-प्री प्रभु को अपने जीवन का केन्द्र
verses.transliteration: hasta ādhāya savitā bibhradabhri hiraṇyayīm | agnerjyotirnicāyya pṛthivyā adhyā'bharadānuṣṭubhena chandasā'ṅgirasvat
verses.wordMeaning: Savitar, bearing in his hand the gold spade which he took therewith, Looking with reverence on the light of Agni, raised it from the earth, With the Anushtup metre and as Angiras was wont to do.
verses.commentary: Sense: Savitar, bearing in his hand the gold spade which he took therewith, Looking with reverence on the light of Agni, raised it from the earth, With the Anushtup metre and as Angiras was wont to do.

verses.sanskrit: प्रतू॑र्तं वाजि॒न्ना द्र॑व॒ वरि॑ष्ठा॒मनु॑ सं॒वत॑म् । दि॒वि ते॒ जन्म॑ पर॒मम॒न्तरि॑क्षे॒ तव॒ नाभि॑: पृथि॒व्यामधि॒ योनि॒रित्
verses.translation: Run hither, urged to speed, O Horse, along the most extended space. Thy loftiest birthplace is in heaven. thy navel is in air's mid-realm, the womb that bare thee is on earth.
verses.hindi: हम अपनी जीवनयात्रा में प्रभु को अपने से युक्त करके चलें । उस प्रभु की वाणियोँ हमारे जीवन में अग्नि-उष्णता व उत्साह का सञ्चार कररेगी। १९. गत मन्त्र में. अपने जीवन-मार्ग में प्रभु को युक्त करने का उपदेश था। उसी प्रसङ्ग मे कहते हैँ कि योगेयोगे=जब-जब हम प्रभु से अपना योग करते है तब वे प्रभु
verses.transliteration: pratūrtaṃ vājinnā drava variṣṭhāmanu saṃvatam | divi te janma paramamantarikṣe tava nābhi: pṛthivyāmadhi yonirit
verses.wordMeaning: Run hither, urged to speed, O Horse, along the most extended space. Thy loftiest birthplace is in heaven. thy navel is in air's mid-realm, the womb that bare thee is on earth.
verses.commentary: Sense: Run hither, urged to speed, O Horse, along the most extended space. Thy loftiest birthplace is in heaven. thy navel is in air's mid-realm, the womb that bare thee is on earth.

verses.sanskrit: यु॒ञ्जाथा॒ᳪ रास॑भं यु॒वम॒स्मिन् यामे॑ वृषण्वसू । अ॒ग्निं भर॑न्तमस्म॒युम्
verses.translation: Upon this course, O lords of wealth, harness; ye twain, the Ass who bears Agni, and kindly favours us.
verses.hindi: प्रभु की उपासना हमें शक्तिशाली बनाती है। शत्रुओं के साथ संग्राम में हमे विजयी करती है। हमारा जीवन सुखमय होता हे। १. पिछले मन्त्र के अनुसार प्रत्येक संग्राम के अवसर पर प्रभु को पुकारते हए अशस्तीः=-सब अशुभ--अशंसनीय बातों को अवक्रामन् (क्रमु पादविक्षेपे) = पावो तले कुचलते
verses.transliteration: yuñjāthā rāsabhaṃ yuvamasmin yāme vṛṣaṇvasū | agniṃ bharantamasmayum
verses.wordMeaning: Upon this course, O lords of wealth, harness; ye twain, the Ass who bears Agni, and kindly favours us.
verses.commentary: Sense: Upon this course, O lords of wealth, harness; ye twain, the Ass who bears Agni, and kindly favours us.

verses.sanskrit: योगे॑-योगे त॒वस्त॑रं॒ वाजे॑-वाजे हवामहे । सखा॑य॒ इन्द्र॑मू॒तये॑
verses.translation: In every need, in every race we call, as friends, to succour us, Indra, the mightiest of all.
verses.hindi: हम अशुभ का विनाश करें। उस रुद्र के गण के पति बनें। विशाल हदयवाले, शुभ-मार्गवाले, निर्भय तथा सदा प्रभु के सयुज् सखा बने। यथुर्वेद भाष्यम् ३९१ एकादसोऽ ध्यायः अग्निअग्निहोत्र क्ती ओर
verses.transliteration: yoge-yoge tavastaraṃ vāje-vāje havāmahe | sakhāya indramūtaye
verses.wordMeaning: In every need, in every race we call, as friends, to succour us, Indra, the mightiest of all.
verses.commentary: Sense: In every need, in every race we call, as friends, to succour us, Indra, the mightiest of all.

verses.sanskrit: प्र॒तूर्व॒न्नेह्य॑व॒क्राम॒न्नश॑स्ती रु॒द्रस्य॒ गाण॑पत्यं मयो॒भूरेहि॑ । उ॒र्वन्तरि॑क्षं॒ वी॑हि स्व॒स्तिग॑व्यूति॒रभ॑यानि कृ॒ण्वन् पू॒ष्णा स॒युजा॑ स॒ह
verses.translation: Come speeding on and trampling imprecations; come gladdening to the chieftainship of Rudra. Speed through the wide air thou whose paths are pleasant, with Pûshan for thy mate, providing safety.
verses.hindi: हम अग्निहोत्र को सदा अपने घरों का पति बनार्णेगे, जिससे हमारी मनोवृत्तियोँ “पुरोधाः' का हैनिक कार्यक्रम अन्वग्निरुषसामग्र॑मख्यदन्वहानि प्रथमो जातवेदाः । प्रस्तुत मन्त्र का ऋषि "पुरोधाः" हे, जो ओरो से पहले अपना धारण करता है। "यह
verses.transliteration: pratūrvannehyavakrāmannaśastī rudrasya gāṇapatyaṃ mayobhūrehi | urvantarikṣaṃ vīhi svastigavyūtirabhayāni kṛṇvan pūṣṇā sayujā saha
verses.wordMeaning: Come speeding on and trampling imprecations; come gladdening to the chieftainship of Rudra. Speed through the wide air thou whose paths are pleasant, with Pûshan for thy mate, providing safety.
verses.commentary: Sense: Come speeding on and trampling imprecations; come gladdening to the chieftainship of Rudra. Speed through the wide air thou whose paths are pleasant, with Pûshan for thy mate, providing safety.

verses.sanskrit: पृ॒थि॒व्याः स॒धस्था॑द॒ग्निं पु॑री॒ष्य॒मङ्गिर॒स्वदा भ॑रा॒ग्निं पु॑री॒ष्य॒मङ्गिर॒स्वदच्छे॑मो॒ ऽग्निं पु॑री॒ष्य॒मङ्गिर॒स्वद्भ॑रिष्यामः
verses.translation: From the Earth's seat, like Anginas, bring thou Purîshya Agni forth. After the wont of Angiras we to Purîshya Agni go. Agni Purîshya we will bear after the went of Angiras.
verses.hindi: १. उषा के प्रारम्भ से पहले ही उठकर यह प्रभु-कौर्तन करता है। २. उचित व्यायाम करता है। ३. प्रभु के बनाये पदार्थो की रचना का ज्ञान प्राप्त करता ह जिससे इनमें प्रभु की महिमा को देखे ओर इन पदार्थो का ठीक प्रयोग कर सके। ४. अव आजीविका के लिए कर्म में लगता है। ५. कार्य को इतना नहीं फैला लेता कि यह उसके
verses.transliteration: pṛthivyāḥ sadhasthādagniṃ purīṣyamaṅgirasvadā bharāgniṃ purīṣyamaṅgirasvadacchemo 'gniṃ purīṣyamaṅgirasvadbhariṣyāmaḥ
verses.wordMeaning: From the Earth's seat, like Anginas, bring thou Purîshya Agni forth. After the wont of Angiras we to Purîshya Agni go. Agni Purîshya we will bear after the went of Angiras.
verses.commentary: Sense: From the Earth's seat, like Anginas, bring thou Purîshya Agni forth. After the wont of Angiras we to Purîshya Agni go. Agni Purîshya we will bear after the went of Angiras.

verses.sanskrit:
अन्व॒ग्निरु॒षसा॒मग्र॑मख्य॒दन्वहा॑नि प्रथ॒मो जा॒तवे॑दाः ।
अनु॒ सूर्य॑स्य पुरु॒त्रा च॑ र॒श्मीननु॒ द्यावा॑पृथि॒वी आ त॑तन्थ
verses.translation: Agni hath looked along the van of Mornings, looked on the days, the earliest Jâtavedas, And many a time along the beams of Sûrya: along the heaven and earth hast thou extended.
verses.hindi: मयोभूः=कल्याण का भावन करनेवाला तीन बातें करता ह -९. सन्मार्ग पर क है। २. विष्नों को दूर करता है। ३. अन्तर्मुख होकर हदयस्थ प्रभु के दर्शन करता प्रभु-अन्वेषणा (5्लात ट ०।६८१ ००५) १. है वाजिन्-शक्तिशालिन्! पृथिवीम् आक्रम्य=इस पृथिवी पर आक्रमण करते
verses.transliteration: anvagniruṣasāmagramakhyadanvahāni prathamo jātavedāḥ | anu sūryasya purutrā ca raśmīnanu dyāvāpṛthivī ā tatantha
verses.wordMeaning: Agni hath looked along the van of Mornings, looked on the days, the earliest Jâtavedas, And many a time along the beams of Sûrya: along the heaven and earth hast thou extended.
verses.commentary: Sense: Agni hath looked along the van of Mornings, looked on the days, the earliest Jâtavedas, And many a time along the beams of Sûrya: along the heaven and earth hast thou extended.

verses.sanskrit: आ॒गत्य॑ वा॒ज्यध्वा॑न॒ᳪ सर्वा॒ मृधो॒ वि धू॑नुते । अ॒ग्निᳪ स॒धस्थे॑ मह॒ति चक्षु॑षा॒ नि चि॑कीषते
verses.translation: The Courser, started on his way, shakes from him all hostilities. He longs to look with reverent eye on Agni is the mighty. seat.
verses.hindi: ' ज्ञान, मिलकर रहना, मध्यमार्म मे चलना, प्रसन्नता, आत्मदर्शन तथा कामादि का पराभव" ये बातें तेरे जीवन के मुख्य अद्ध हो। एकादशोऽध्यायः ३२९२४ यजुर्कंदभाष्यम् वयश्स्यांम सुमतौ पुंथिव्याऽअग्निं खन॑न्तऽ उपस्थऽअस्याः ॥ २९॥
verses.transliteration: āgatya vājyadhvāna sarvā mṛdho vi dhūnute | agni sadhasthe mahati cakṣuṣā ni cikīṣate
verses.wordMeaning: The Courser, started on his way, shakes from him all hostilities. He longs to look with reverent eye on Agni is the mighty. seat.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Courser, started on his way, shakes from him all hostilities. He longs to look with reverent eye on Agni is the mighty. seat.

verses.sanskrit: आ॒क्रम्य॑ वाजिन् पृथि॒वीम॒ग्निमि॑च्छ रु॒चा त्वम् । भूम्या॑ वृ॒त्वाय॑ नो ब्रूहि॒ यत॒: खने॑म॒ तं व॒यम्
verses.translation: O Courser, having come to earth, seek Agni with a longing wish. Tell us by trampling on the ground where we may dig him from the earth.
verses.hindi: प्रभु-दर्शन ही महान् सौभाग्य है। उसके लिए हमें वैषयिक जगत् से परे पदंचना है, अतः हमारी वृत्ति धन के त्यागवाली हो ओर हम शक्तिशाली हों। १. द्रविणोदाः धन का दान करनेवाला वाजी=शक्तिशाली पुरुष उदक्रमीत्-विषयों से ऊपर उठता है। २. यह अर्बा=( अर्व हिंसायाम्) विषय-वासनाओं की हिंसा करनेवाला-
verses.transliteration: ākramya vājin pṛthivīmagnimiccha rucā tvam | bhūmyā vṛtvāya no brūhi yata: khanema taṃ vayam
verses.wordMeaning: O Courser, having come to earth, seek Agni with a longing wish. Tell us by trampling on the ground where we may dig him from the earth.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Courser, having come to earth, seek Agni with a longing wish. Tell us by trampling on the ground where we may dig him from the earth.

verses.sanskrit:
द्यौ॑स्ते पृ॒ष्ठं पृ॑थि॒वी स॒धस्थ॑मा॒त्माऽन्तरि॑क्षᳪ समु॒द्रो योनि॑: ।
वि॒ख्याय॒ चक्षु॑षा॒ त्वम॒भि ति॑ष्ठ पृतन्य॒तः
verses.translation: Heaven is thy back, the earth thy seat, the air thy soul, the sea thy womb. Looking around thee with thine eye trample the adversaries down.
verses.hindi: जीवन को सुखी बनाने का मार्ग यही है कि हम (क) धन का दान करे। (ख) वैषयिकवृत्ति से ऊपर उ्ँ। (ग) पुण्यवाले उत्तम लोक का निर्माण करें। (घ) घर को स्वर्ग बनाते हुए प्रभु-दर्शन के लिए प्रयलशील हो। देश-काल से अनविच्छिन्न प्रभु
verses.transliteration: dyauste pṛṣṭhaṃ pṛthivī sadhasthamātmā'ntarikṣa samudro yoni: | vikhyāya cakṣuṣā tvamabhi tiṣṭha pṛtanyataḥ
verses.wordMeaning: Heaven is thy back, the earth thy seat, the air thy soul, the sea thy womb. Looking around thee with thine eye trample the adversaries down.
verses.commentary: Sense: Heaven is thy back, the earth thy seat, the air thy soul, the sea thy womb. Looking around thee with thine eye trample the adversaries down.

verses.sanskrit:
उत्क्रा॑म मह॒ते सौ॑भगाया॒स्मादा॒स्थाना॑द् द्रविणो॒दा वा॑जिन् ।
व॒यᳪ स्या॑म सुम॒तौ पृ॑थि॒व्या अ॒ग्निं खन॑न्त उ॒पस्थे॑ अस्याः
verses.translation: Wealth-giver, Courser, from this place step forth to great felicity. May we enjoy Earth's favour while we dig forth Agni from her
verses.hindi: वे सर्वव्यापी प्रभु पवित्र मन से दिखते हे। वे देश व काल से सीमित नही है। अत्यन्त विस्तारवाले वे प्रभु अन्नों से हमें शक्ति देते हँ ओर तत्त्व -दर्शन से मस्तिष्क को मर्यश्री स्मृहयद्रर्णोऽअग्निर्नाभिमृशे तन्व, जर्भुराणः ॥ २४॥ एकादशोऽध्यायः ३१६ यजुर्केदभाष्यम्
verses.transliteration: utkrāma mahate saubhagāyāsmādāsthānād draviṇodā vājin | vaya syāma sumatau pṛthivyā agniṃ khananta upasthe asyāḥ
verses.wordMeaning: Wealth-giver, Courser, from this place step forth to great felicity. May we enjoy Earth's favour while we dig forth Agni from her
verses.commentary: Sense: Wealth-giver, Courser, from this place step forth to great felicity. May we enjoy Earth's favour while we dig forth Agni from her

verses.sanskrit:
उद॑क्रमीद् द्रविणो॒दा वा॒ज्य॒र्वाक॒: सुलो॒कᳪ सुकृ॑तं पृथि॒व्याम् ।
तत॑: खनेम सु॒प्रती॑कम॒ग्निᳪ स्वो॒ रुहा॑णा॒ अधि॒ नाक॑मुत्त॒मम्
verses.translation: Down hath he stepped, wealth-giver, racer, courser. Good and auspicious room on earth thou madest. Thence let us dig forth Agni, fair to look on, while to the loftiest vault we mount, to heaven.
verses.hindi: प्रभु का उपासन पवित्र मन से होता है। एक सच्चा उपासक लोगों में शोभावाला होता है, उसके चेहरे पर अन्तःस्थित प्रभु का प्रकाश चमकता है, जिसके तेज में सब मल भस्म हो जाते है। वह अपने शरीर को प्राजापत्य यज्ञ मे आहुत कर देता है। ९. पिछले मन्त्र का गृत्समद ऋषि प्रभु-स्तवन करता हुआ शक्तिशाली बनता ठै,
verses.transliteration: udakramīd draviṇodā vājyarvāka: suloka sukṛtaṃ pṛthivyām | tata: khanema supratīkamagni svo ruhāṇā adhi nākamuttamam
verses.wordMeaning: Down hath he stepped, wealth-giver, racer, courser. Good and auspicious room on earth thou madest. Thence let us dig forth Agni, fair to look on, while to the loftiest vault we mount, to heaven.
verses.commentary: Sense: Down hath he stepped, wealth-giver, racer, courser. Good and auspicious room on earth thou madest. Thence let us dig forth Agni, fair to look on, while to the loftiest vault we mount, to heaven.

verses.sanskrit:
आ त्वा॑ जिघर्मि॒ मन॑सा घृ॒तेन॑ प्रतिक्षि॒यन्तं॒ भुव॑नानि॒ विश्वा॑ ।
पृ॒थुं ति॑र॒श्चा वय॑सा बृ॒हन्तं॒ व्यचि॑ष्ठ॒मन्नै॑ रभ॒सं दृशा॑नम्
verses.translation: I thoughtfully besprinkle thee with butter, thee dwelling near to all existing creatures. Broad, vast through vital power that moves transversely, conspicuous, strong with all the food that feeds thee.
verses.hindi: प्रभु के प्रति आत्मसमर्पण करते हुए हम प्रभु से दिये रमणीय पदार्थो के सम्यक् प्रयोग से शक्ति व जान के पति बने। धृषद्वर्णं दिवेदिवे हन्तारं भङ्गुरावताम् ॥ २६॥ १९. गत मन्त्र का "सोमक '=विनीत प्रभु के प्रति अपना अर्पण करके पूर्णरूप से
verses.transliteration: ā tvā jigharmi manasā ghṛtena pratikṣiyantaṃ bhuvanāni viśvā | pṛthuṃ tiraścā vayasā bṛhantaṃ vyaciṣṭhamannai rabhasaṃ dṛśānam
verses.wordMeaning: I thoughtfully besprinkle thee with butter, thee dwelling near to all existing creatures. Broad, vast through vital power that moves transversely, conspicuous, strong with all the food that feeds thee.
verses.commentary: Sense: I thoughtfully besprinkle thee with butter, thee dwelling near to all existing creatures. Broad, vast through vital power that moves transversely, conspicuous, strong with all the food that feeds thee.

verses.sanskrit:
आ वि॒श्वत॑: प्र॒त्यञ्चं॑ जिघर्म्यर॒क्षसा॒ मन॑सा॒ तज्जु॑षेत ।
मर्य॑श्री स्पृह॒यद्व॑र्णो अ॒ग्निर्नाभि॒मृशे॑ त॒न्वा जर्भु॑राणः
verses.translation: I sprinkle him who moves in all directions: may he accept it with a friendly spirit. Agni with bridegroom's face and lovely colour may not be touched when all his form is fury.
verses.hindi: वे प्रभु 'अग्नि-पुरं विप्र-सहस्य-धृषद्वर्णं व भगुरावत्-हन्ता' है। हम भंगुर-वृत्तिवाले न बनकर स्थितप्रज्ञ बनें ओर प्रभु के रक्षणीय हों। प्रभु को परितः धारण करनेवाला ही प्रभु का रक्षणीय होता है। त्वं वनेैभ्यस्त्वमोष॑धीभ्यस्त्वं नृणां नुंपते जायसे शुचिः ॥ २७॥
verses.transliteration: ā viśvata: pratyañcaṃ jigharmyarakṣasā manasā tajjuṣeta | maryaśrī spṛhayadvarṇo agnirnābhimṛśe tanvā jarbhurāṇaḥ
verses.wordMeaning: I sprinkle him who moves in all directions: may he accept it with a friendly spirit. Agni with bridegroom's face and lovely colour may not be touched when all his form is fury.
verses.commentary: Sense: I sprinkle him who moves in all directions: may he accept it with a friendly spirit. Agni with bridegroom's face and lovely colour may not be touched when all his form is fury.

verses.sanskrit: परि॒ वाज॑पतिः क॒विर॒ग्निर्ह॒व्यान्य॑क्रमीत् । दध॒द्रत्ना॑नि दा॒शुषे॑
verses.translation: Round the oblation bath he paced, Agni the wise, the Lord of Strength, Giving the offerer precious boons.
verses.hindi: हम प्रभु-दर्शन के लिए वनौषधियों को ही भोजन बनाएँ, मेघजलों को ही पेय द्रव्य सखमञ्चँ। निरन्तर आगे बने कौ भावनावाले हों। अवश्य हममे प्रभु कौ ज्योति जगेगी ओर उस ज्योति से सब वासना भस्म हो जार्पगी। देवस्य॑ त्वा सुवितुः प्र॑ंसवु ऽश्विनोर्बाहुभ्यौ पृष्णो हस्ताभ्याम् । पृथिव्याः
verses.transliteration: pari vājapatiḥ kaviragnirhavyānyakramīt | dadhadratnāni dāśuṣe
verses.wordMeaning: Round the oblation bath he paced, Agni the wise, the Lord of Strength, Giving the offerer precious boons.
verses.commentary: Sense: Round the oblation bath he paced, Agni the wise, the Lord of Strength, Giving the offerer precious boons.

verses.sanskrit: परि॑ त्वाऽग्ने॒ पुरं॑ व॒यं विप्र॑ᳪ सहस्य धीमहि । धृ॒षद्व॑र्णं दि॒वे-दि॑वे ह॒न्तारं॑ भङ्गु॒राव॑ताम्
verses.translation: We set thee round us as a fort, victorious Agni, thee a Sage, Of hero lineage, day by day destroyer of our treacherous foes.
verses.hindi: इस ज्योतिर्मय प्रभु का दर्शन ही हमारे जीवन का ध्येय हो। इसी में आनन्द है, इसी मेँ अङ्ख-प्रत्यङ्क कौ शक्ति का मूल हेै। ये कर्म तेरे जीवन-मन्द्रि कौ नीव ही है। २. अग्नेः योनिः=तू उत्साह (अग्नि) का उत्पत्ति स्थान है। तेरे जीवन में उत्साह की उष्णता है। निराशा की शीतता ने तुञ्े जकड़ नहीं लिया।
verses.transliteration: pari tvā'gne puraṃ vayaṃ vipra sahasya dhīmahi | dhṛṣadvarṇaṃ dive-dive hantāraṃ bhaṅgurāvatām
verses.wordMeaning: We set thee round us as a fort, victorious Agni, thee a Sage, Of hero lineage, day by day destroyer of our treacherous foes.
verses.commentary: Sense: We set thee round us as a fort, victorious Agni, thee a Sage, Of hero lineage, day by day destroyer of our treacherous foes.

verses.sanskrit:
त्वम॑ग्ने॒ द्युभि॒स्त्वमा॑शुशु॒क्षणि॒स्त्वम॒द्भ्यस्त्वमश्म॑न॒स्परि॑ ।
त्वं वने॑भ्य॒स्त्वमोष॑धीभ्य॒स्त्वं नृ॒णां नृ॑पते जायसे॒ शुचि॑:
verses.translation: Thou, Agni, with the days, fain to shine hitherward, art brought to life from out the waters, from the stone, From out the forest trees and herbs that grow on ground. thou, Sovran Lord of men, art generated pure.
verses.hindi: गृत्समद के लक्षण ये है-१. व्यापक कर्म ही इसके जीवन का आधार होते है। २. इसके जीवन में कभी उत्साह-शून्यता नहीं आती। ३. काम्य पदार्थो को प्राप्त करता हुआ यह मर्यादा मेँ रहता है। ४. अपने निर्लिप्त हदय को विशाल बनाता है। ५. ज्ञान की मात्रा से तथा शक्ति कौ वृद्धि से यह अपने को विस्तृत करता है।
verses.transliteration: tvamagne dyubhistvamāśuśukṣaṇistvamadbhyastvamaśmanaspari | tvaṃ vanebhyastvamoṣadhībhyastvaṃ nṛṇāṃ nṛpate jāyase śuci:
verses.wordMeaning: Thou, Agni, with the days, fain to shine hitherward, art brought to life from out the waters, from the stone, From out the forest trees and herbs that grow on ground. thou, Sovran Lord of men, art generated pure.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thou, Agni, with the days, fain to shine hitherward, art brought to life from out the waters, from the stone, From out the forest trees and herbs that grow on ground. thou, Sovran Lord of men, art generated pure.

verses.sanskrit:
दे॒वस्य॑ त्वा सवि॒तुः प्र॑स॒वेऽश्विनो॑र्बा॒हुभ्यां॑ पू॒ष्णो हस्ता॑भ्याम् ।
पृ॒थि॒व्याः स॒धस्था॑द॒ग्निं पु॑री॒ष्य॒मङ्गिर॒स्वत्ख॑नामि ।
ज्योति॑ष्मन्तं त्वाऽग्ने सु॒प्रती॑क॒मज॑स्रेण भा॒नुना॒ दीद्य॑तम् ।
शि॒वं प्र॒जाभ्योऽहि॑ᳪसन्तं पृथि॒व्या: स॒धस्था॑द॒ग्निं पु॑री॒ष्य॒मङ्गिर॒स्वत्ख॑नामः
verses.translation: At Savitar's, the Shining One's, impulsion, with arms of Asvins and with hands of Pûshan, As Angiras was wont to do, I dig thee forth from the seat of Earth, Agni Purîshya. Thee, Agni, luminous and fair of aspect, resplendent with imperishable lustre, gracious to living creatures, never harming, As Angiras was wont to do, we dig thee forth from the seat of Earth, Agni Purîshya.
verses.hindi: ९. प्रभु के उपासक पति-पली प्रभुरूप घर मे ही निवास करते है। र. प्रभु ही इनका कवच होता है। ३. इसी से इनका जीवन दोषशून्य होता है। ४. इनकौ "मैं" में बहतो का समावेश होता है। ५. ये विस्तारवाले होते हैँ। ६. मिलकर रहते हँ । ७. आनन्दमय प्रभु को धारण करते हैँ।
verses.transliteration: devasya tvā savituḥ prasave'śvinorbāhubhyāṃ pūṣṇo hastābhyām | pṛthivyāḥ sadhasthādagniṃ purīṣyamaṅgirasvatkhanāmi | jyotiṣmantaṃ tvā'gne supratīkamajasreṇa bhānunā dīdyatam | śivaṃ prajābhyo'hisantaṃ pṛthivyā: sadhasthādagniṃ purīṣyamaṅgirasvatkhanāmaḥ
verses.wordMeaning: At Savitar's, the Shining One's, impulsion, with arms of Asvins and with hands of Pûshan, As Angiras was wont to do, I dig thee forth from the seat of Earth, Agni Purîshya. Thee, Agni, luminous and fair of aspect, resplendent with imperishable lustre,…
verses.commentary: Sense: At Savitar's, the Shining One's, impulsion, with arms of Asvins and with hands of Pûshan, As Angiras was wont to do, I dig thee forth from the seat of Earth, Agni Purîshya. Thee, Agni, luminous and fair of aspect, resplendent with imperishable lustre,…

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒पां पृ॒ष्ठम॑सि॒ योनि॑र॒ग्नेः स॑मु॒द्रम॒भित॒: पिन्व॑मानम् ।
वर्ध॑मानो म॒हाँ२ आ च॒ पुष्क॑रे दि॒वो मात्र॑या वरि॒म्णा प्र॑थस्व
verses.translation: Thou art the Waters’ back, the womb of Agni, around the ocean as it swells and surges. Waxing to greatness, resting on the lotus, spread thou in amplitude with heaven's own measure.
verses.hindi: प्रभु ही सुखों का पूरण करनेवाले तथा सबका भरण करनेवाले है। हम अपने हदयं को विषय-पङ्क से अलिप्त रक्खें, मस्तिष्क को सम्पूर्णं ज्ञान से भरने का प्रयत करे यही प्रभु-दर्शन का मार्ग हे। £ १. भरद्वाज ही कहते हैँ कि तम् उ त्वा=निश्चय से उस आपको ईधे=अपने हृदय-कमल
verses.transliteration: apāṃ pṛṣṭhamasi yoniragneḥ samudramabhita: pinvamānam | vardhamāno mahā~2 ā ca puṣkare divo mātrayā varimṇā prathasva
verses.wordMeaning: Thou art the Waters’ back, the womb of Agni, around the ocean as it swells and surges. Waxing to greatness, resting on the lotus, spread thou in amplitude with heaven's own measure.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thou art the Waters’ back, the womb of Agni, around the ocean as it swells and surges. Waxing to greatness, resting on the lotus, spread thou in amplitude with heaven's own measure.

verses.sanskrit:
शर्म॑ च स्थो॒ वर्म॑ च॒ स्थोऽछि॑द्रे बहु॒ले उ॒भे ।
व्यच॑स्वती॒ सं व॑साथां भृ॒तम॒ग्निं पु॑री॒ष्य॒म्
verses.translation: Yea are a shelter and a shield, uninjured both, and widely spread. Do ye; expansive, cover him: bear ye Purîshya Agni up.
verses.hindi: प्रभु-दर्शन उन्हें होता है जो ध्यानी, तत्तवद्रष्टा,. पवित्र व वासनाओं से अपना ताण करनेवाले होते है। यह दर्शन वासनाओं से अनान्दोलित मन मे होता है। दर्शन होने पर वासना विनष्ट हो जाती है, असुरो के किले भूमिसात् हो जाते हैँ ओर हमारे “शरीर, मन व बुद्धि" तीनों ही पवित्र हो जाते है।
verses.transliteration: śarma ca stho varma ca stho'chidre bahule ubhe | vyacasvatī saṃ vasāthāṃ bhṛtamagniṃ purīṣyam
verses.wordMeaning: Yea are a shelter and a shield, uninjured both, and widely spread. Do ye; expansive, cover him: bear ye Purîshya Agni up.
verses.commentary: Sense: Yea are a shelter and a shield, uninjured both, and widely spread. Do ye; expansive, cover him: bear ye Purîshya Agni up.

verses.sanskrit:
सं व॑साथाᳪ स्व॒र्विदा॑ स॒मीची॒ उर॑सा॒ त्मना॑ ।
अ॒ग्निम॒न्तर्भ॑रि॒ष्यन्ती॒ ज्योति॑ष्मन्त॒मज॑स्र॒मित्
verses.translation: Cover him, finders of the light, united both with breast and self, Bearing between you Agni, the refulgent, everlasting One.
verses.hindi: ९. प्रभु का स्मरण करनेवाला ' भरद्वाज '= अपने मे शक्ति को भरनेवाला बनता है। २. प्रभु का प्रकाश वही देखता है जो मार्ग पर चलता है ओर मार्ग पर चलने करे कारण शक्तिशाली बनता है। अथवा जो मार्ग पर चलता है ओर ओरों पर भी सुखों कौ वर्षा करता है। ३. प्रभु-दर्टन करनेवाला व्यक्ति नाशक तत्त्वो व आसुर वृत्तियों का संहार
verses.transliteration: saṃ vasāthā svarvidā samīcī urasā tmanā | agnimantarbhariṣyantī jyotiṣmantamajasramit
verses.wordMeaning: Cover him, finders of the light, united both with breast and self, Bearing between you Agni, the refulgent, everlasting One.
verses.commentary: Sense: Cover him, finders of the light, united both with breast and self, Bearing between you Agni, the refulgent, everlasting One.

verses.sanskrit:
पु॒री॒ष्यो॒ऽसि वि॒श्वभ॑रा॒ अथ॑र्वा त्वा प्रथ॒मो निर॑मन्थदग्ने ।
त्वाम॑ग्ने॒ पुष्क॑रा॒दध्यथ॑र्वा॒ निर॑मन्थत । मू॒र्ध्नो विश्व॑स्य वा॒घत॑:
verses.translation: Thou art Purîshya, thou support of all. Atharvan was the first, Agni, who rubbed thee into life. Agni, Atharvan brought thee forth by rubbing from the lotus, from The head of Visva, of the Priest.
verses.hindi: मार्ग यह है-हम १. दानपूर्वक अदन (भक्षण) करनेवाले बनकर स्वस्थ -बनें। २. आत्म-निरीक्षण करते हुए अपने ही दोषों को देखें । ३. समज्लदार बनें । ४. इस धर्मार्थ प्राप्त शरीर में निवास करते हए यज्ञो को करनेवाले बनें। ५. दिव्य गुणों का अपने में दोहन करे। ६. त्यागवृत्ति से दिव्य गुणों को बदा ७. वृद्धिशील जीवनवाले हों।
