verses.transliteration: purīṣyo'si viśvabharā atharvā tvā prathamo niramanthadagne | tvāmagne puṣkarādadhyatharvā niramanthata | mūrdhno viśvasya vāghata:
verses.wordMeaning: Thou art Purîshya, thou support of all. Atharvan was the first, Agni, who rubbed thee into life. Agni, Atharvan brought thee forth by rubbing from the lotus, from The head of Visva, of the Priest.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thou art Purîshya, thou support of all. Atharvan was the first, Agni, who rubbed thee into life. Agni, Atharvan brought thee forth by rubbing from the lotus, from The head of Visva, of the Priest.

verses.sanskrit: तमु॑ त्वा द॒ध्यङ्ङृषि॑: पु॒त्र ई॑धे॒ अथ॑र्वणः । वृ॑त्र॒हणं॑ पुरन्द॒रम्
verses.translation: Thee too as Vritra-slayer, thee breaker of forts, the Sage Dadhyach, Son of Atharvan, lighted up.
verses.hindi: ' गृत्समद ' वही है जो उल्लिखित ९१९ बातों को अपने जीवन में लाता हे। वस्तुतः जीवन का ठीक मार्ग है ही यह। प्रस्कण्व" की “ज्ञान-सृष्टि' सश्सीदस्व महाँ २।।ऽअसि शोच॑स्व देववीत॑मः ।
verses.transliteration: tamu tvā dadhyaṅṅṛṣi: putra īdhe atharvaṇaḥ | vṛtrahaṇaṃ purandaram
verses.wordMeaning: Thee too as Vritra-slayer, thee breaker of forts, the Sage Dadhyach, Son of Atharvan, lighted up.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thee too as Vritra-slayer, thee breaker of forts, the Sage Dadhyach, Son of Atharvan, lighted up.

verses.sanskrit: तमु॑ त्वा पा॒थ्यो वृषा॒ समी॑धे दस्यु॒हन्त॑मम् । ध॒न॒ञ्ज॒यᳪ रणे॑-रणे
verses.translation: Pâthya the Bull, too, kindled thee the Dasyus’ most destructive foe, Winner of spoil in every fight.
verses.hindi: हम उस ज्लान को उत्पन्न करने का प्रय करे जो १. हमारी वासनाओं को नष्ट करता है। २. हमें क्रोध- शून्य बनाता है। ३. ओर कर््तव्य-पथ दिखाता है। अपो देवीरुप॑सृज मधुंमतीरयक्ष्माय॑ प्रजाभ्यः । ९. पिच्छले तीन मन्त्रों मे उस मार्ग का प्रदर्शन है, जिसपर चलकर हमें प्रभु का दर्शन
verses.transliteration: tamu tvā pāthyo vṛṣā samīdhe dasyuhantamam | dhanañjaya raṇe-raṇe
verses.wordMeaning: Pâthya the Bull, too, kindled thee the Dasyus’ most destructive foe, Winner of spoil in every fight.
verses.commentary: Sense: Pâthya the Bull, too, kindled thee the Dasyus’ most destructive foe, Winner of spoil in every fight.

verses.sanskrit:
सीद॑ होत॒: स्व उ॑ लो॒के चि॑कि॒त्वान्सा॒दया॑ य॒ज्ञᳪ सु॑कृ॒तस्य॒ योनौ॑ ।
दे॒वा॒वीर्दे॒वान्ह॒विषा॑ यजा॒स्यग्ने॑ बृ॒हद्यज॑माने॒ वयो॑ धाः
verses.translation: Sit, Hotar, in the Hotar's place, observant: lay down the sacrifice in the place of worship. Thou, dear to Go is, shalt serve them with oblation. Agni, give long life to the Sacrificer.
verses.hindi: जल दिव्य गुणोवाले है, ये माधुर्य को उत्पन्न करते है, यक्ष्मा को नष्ट करते है। इनसे उत्पन्न ओषधिरयोँ उत्तम फलवाली होती है। यो देवानां चर॑सि प्राणथेन कस्मै देव॒ वष॑डस्तु तुभ्य॑म् ।॥३९॥ १. घर में पति-पल्ली दो ही मुख्य प्राणी है। इनमें पली के लिए कहते है कि
verses.transliteration: sīda hota: sva u loke cikitvānsādayā yajña sukṛtasya yonau | devāvīrdevānhaviṣā yajāsyagne bṛhadyajamāne vayo dhāḥ
verses.wordMeaning: Sit, Hotar, in the Hotar's place, observant: lay down the sacrifice in the place of worship. Thou, dear to Go is, shalt serve them with oblation. Agni, give long life to the Sacrificer.
verses.commentary: Sense: Sit, Hotar, in the Hotar's place, observant: lay down the sacrifice in the place of worship. Thou, dear to Go is, shalt serve them with oblation. Agni, give long life to the Sacrificer.

verses.sanskrit:
नि होता॑ होतृ॒षद॑ने॒ विदा॑नस्त्वे॒षो दी॑दि॒वाँ२  अ॑सदत्सु॒दक्ष॑: ।
अद॑ब्धव्रतप्रमति॒र्वसि॑ष्ठः सहस्रम्भ॒रः शुचि॑जिह्वो अ॒ग्निः
verses.translation: Accustomed to the Hotar's place, the Hotar hath seated him, bright, splendid, passing mighty, Whose foresight keeps the Law from violation, excellent, pure-tongued, bringing thousands, Agni.
verses.hindi: शुद्ध वायु में प्राणायाम के द्वारा अपने हदय का विकास करके तथा अपने जीवन को दिव्य बनाकर हम इन्दे प्रभु-चरणों में अर्पित करनेवाले बनें। विश्वरूप वस्त्र का धारण १. गत मन्त्रों में वर्णित जल ओर वायु के समुचित प्रयोग के साथ प्रस्तुत मन्त्र में
verses.transliteration: ni hotā hotṛṣadane vidānastveṣo dīdivā~2 asadatsudakṣa: | adabdhavratapramatirvasiṣṭhaḥ sahasrambharaḥ śucijihvo agniḥ
verses.wordMeaning: Accustomed to the Hotar's place, the Hotar hath seated him, bright, splendid, passing mighty, Whose foresight keeps the Law from violation, excellent, pure-tongued, bringing thousands, Agni.
verses.commentary: Sense: Accustomed to the Hotar's place, the Hotar hath seated him, bright, splendid, passing mighty, Whose foresight keeps the Law from violation, excellent, pure-tongued, bringing thousands, Agni.

verses.sanskrit:
सᳪ सी॑दस्व म॒हाँ२ अ॑सि॒ शोच॑स्व देव॒वीत॑मः ।
वि धू॒मम॑ग्ने अरु॒षं मि॑येध्य सृ॒ज प्र॑शस्त दर्श॒तम्
verses.translation: Seat thee, for thou art mighty: shine, best entertainer of the Gods. Worthy of sacred food, praised Agni! loose the smoke, ruddy and beautiful to see.
verses.hindi: हम अचञ्चलता, दृदढाङ्गता, कार्यव्याप्तता, शक्तिमत्ता=विष्नों का दूरीकरण-- हदय को विशालता, उत्तम कार्यो में स्थिति तथा नेता के पालनात्मक गुणों को धारण १. है अङ्गिरः अङ्ग - प्रत्यङ्ग में रसवाले! त्वम्=तू मानुषीभ्यः प्रजाभ्यः = मानव प्रजा ओं करे लिए शिवः भव =कल्याण करनेवाला हो। तेरा सारा व्यवहार एेसा हो जिससे ओौरो का
verses.transliteration: sa sīdasva mahā~2 asi śocasva devavītamaḥ | vi dhūmamagne aruṣaṃ miyedhya sṛja praśasta darśatam
verses.wordMeaning: Seat thee, for thou art mighty: shine, best entertainer of the Gods. Worthy of sacred food, praised Agni! loose the smoke, ruddy and beautiful to see.
verses.commentary: Sense: Seat thee, for thou art mighty: shine, best entertainer of the Gods. Worthy of sacred food, praised Agni! loose the smoke, ruddy and beautiful to see.

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒पो दे॒वीरुप॑ सृज॒ मधु॑मतीरय॒क्ष्माय॑ प्र॒जाभ्य॑: ।
तासा॑मा॒स्थाना॒दुज्जि॑हता॒मोष॑धयः सुपिप्प॒लाः
verses.translation: Pour heavenly Waters honey-sweet here for our health, for progeny. Forth from the place whereon they fall let plants with goodly berries spring.
verses.hindi: तरित (काम, क्रोध, लोभविजयी) का जीवन लोक-कल्याण के लिए ही होता हे, अकल्याण के लिए नहीं। १. वाजी=गत मन्त्र कौ भावना के अनुसार सबके साथ मधुरता से वर्तता हुआ, शाक सब्जियों का प्रयोग करता हुआ यह शक्तिशाली जीव प्रएतु-आगे ओर आगे बदे।
verses.transliteration: apo devīrupa sṛja madhumatīrayakṣmāya prajābhya: | tāsāmāsthānādujjihatāmoṣadhayaḥ supippalāḥ
verses.wordMeaning: Pour heavenly Waters honey-sweet here for our health, for progeny. Forth from the place whereon they fall let plants with goodly berries spring.
verses.commentary: Sense: Pour heavenly Waters honey-sweet here for our health, for progeny. Forth from the place whereon they fall let plants with goodly berries spring.

verses.sanskrit:
सं ते॑ वा॒युर्मा॑त॒रिश्वा॑ दधातूत्ता॒नाया॒ हृद॑यं॒ यद्विक॑स्तम् ।
यो दे॒वानां॒ चर॑सि प्रा॒णथे॑न॒ कस्मै॑ देव॒ वष॑डस्तु॒ तुभ्य॑म्
verses.translation: May Vâyu Mâtarisvan heal and comfort thy broken heart as there supine thou liest. Thou unto whom the breath of Gods gives motion, to Ka, yea, unto thee, O God, be Vashat!
verses.hindi: हम अपने जीवन में ऋक्-यजुः-साम' मन्त्रों को पदकर उनके अनुसार क्रिया करते हए जीवन-यापन करे, प्रभु को अपने हदयों में धारण करके पूर्णं आयुष्य का उपभोग करे। प्रभु से शक्ति प्राप्त करके प्रकाश को धारण करे। ऋत-सत्य व पुरीष्य अग्नि
verses.transliteration: saṃ te vāyurmātariśvā dadhātūttānāyā hṛdayaṃ yadvikastam | yo devānāṃ carasi prāṇathena kasmai deva vaṣaḍastu tubhyam
verses.wordMeaning: May Vâyu Mâtarisvan heal and comfort thy broken heart as there supine thou liest. Thou unto whom the breath of Gods gives motion, to Ka, yea, unto thee, O God, be Vashat!
verses.commentary: Sense: May Vâyu Mâtarisvan heal and comfort thy broken heart as there supine thou liest. Thou unto whom the breath of Gods gives motion, to Ka, yea, unto thee, O God, be Vashat!

verses.sanskrit:
सुजा॑तो॒ ज्योति॑षा स॒ह शर्म॒ वरू॑थ॒माऽस॑द॒त्स्व॑: ।
वासो॑ अग्ने वि॒श्वरू॑प॒ᳪ सं व्य॑यस्व विभावसो
verses.translation: He, nobly born with lustre, shield and refuge, hath sat down in light. O Agni, Rich in Splendour, robe thyself in many-hued attire.
verses.hindi: आचार्य परा व अपरा विद्या मे निपुण है। विद्यार्थी आचार्य के समीप विद्या- ग्रहण के काल तक रहता है। समावृत्त होकर पुराने पितृगृह मे लौरता है। प्रभु के नेतृत्ववाला उत्कील १. आचार्यकुल मे परा व अपरा विद्या का ज्ञान प्राप्त करके जव विद्यार्थी संसार
verses.transliteration: sujāto jyotiṣā saha śarma varūthamā'sadatsva: | vāso agne viśvarūpa saṃ vyayasva vibhāvaso
verses.wordMeaning: He, nobly born with lustre, shield and refuge, hath sat down in light. O Agni, Rich in Splendour, robe thyself in many-hued attire.
verses.commentary: Sense: He, nobly born with lustre, shield and refuge, hath sat down in light. O Agni, Rich in Splendour, robe thyself in many-hued attire.

verses.sanskrit: उदु॑ तिष्ठ स्वध्व॒रावा॑ नो दे॒व्या धि॒या । दृ॒शे च॑ भा॒सा बृ॑ह॒ता सु॑शु॒क्वनि॒राग्ने॑ याहि सुश॒स्तिभि॑:
verses.translation: Lord of fair sacrifice; arise! With Godlike thought protect us well. With great light splendid to behold come, Agni, through sweet hymns of praise.
verses.hindi: उत्कृष्ट बन्धनवाला बनकर मैं शक्ति से चमवकँ। देष, हिंसा व रोगो से दूर रहूँ! प्रभु की शरण मेँ मेरा वास हो। प्रभु नेता हों मै उनका अनुयायी बनं। आपो हि ष्ठा म॑योभुवस्ता न॑ऽ ऊर्जे द॑धातन । महे रणाय चक्ष॑से ।॥५०॥ ९. “उत्कील ' गत मन्त्र का ऋषि धा। उत्कील बनने के लिए यह जलो का ठीक
verses.transliteration: udu tiṣṭha svadhvarāvā no devyā dhiyā | dṛśe ca bhāsā bṛhatā suśukvanirāgne yāhi suśastibhi:
verses.wordMeaning: Lord of fair sacrifice; arise! With Godlike thought protect us well. With great light splendid to behold come, Agni, through sweet hymns of praise.
verses.commentary: Sense: Lord of fair sacrifice; arise! With Godlike thought protect us well. With great light splendid to behold come, Agni, through sweet hymns of praise.

verses.sanskrit: ऊ॒र्ध्व ऊ॒ षु ण॑ ऊ॒तये॒ तिष्ठा॑ दे॒वो न स॑वि॒ता । ऊ॒र्ध्वो वाज॑स्य॒ सनि॑ता॒ यद॒ञ्जिभि॑र्वा॒घद्भि॑र्वि॒ह्वया॑महे
verses.translation: Rise up erect to give us aid, stand up like Savitar the God; Erect as strength-bestower when we call aloud, with unguents and with priests on thee.
verses.hindi: हम जलो का आचमन करे। धीमे-धीमे पीप, तभी जल हितकर होगे। १. ठे जलो! वः आपके तस्मै-उस रस को पाने के लिए अरम्=पर्याप्त गमाम जानेवाले हों, अर्थात् उस रस को खूब ही प्राप्त करें, यस्य क्षयाय= (क्षयेण) जिस रस के निवास के कारण जिन्वथतुम प्रीणित करते हो, तृप्त करते हो। जलो में एक रस है जो एक
verses.transliteration: ūrdhva ū ṣu ṇa ūtaye tiṣṭhā devo na savitā | ūrdhvo vājasya sanitā yadañjibhirvāghadbhirvihvayāmahe
verses.wordMeaning: Rise up erect to give us aid, stand up like Savitar the God; Erect as strength-bestower when we call aloud, with unguents and with priests on thee.
verses.commentary: Sense: Rise up erect to give us aid, stand up like Savitar the God; Erect as strength-bestower when we call aloud, with unguents and with priests on thee.

verses.sanskrit:
स जा॒तो गर्भो॑ असि॒ रोद॑स्योरग्ने॒ चारु॒र्विभृ॑त॒ ओष॑धीषु ।
चि॒त्रः शिशु॒: परि॒ तमा॑ᳪस्य॒क्तून्प्र मा॒तृभ्यो॒ अधि॒ कनि॑क्रद॒द्गाः
verses.translation: Thou, being horn, art Child of Earth and Heaven, parted, fair Babe, among the plants, O Agni. The glooms of night thou, brilliant child, subduest, and art come forth, loud roaring, from the Mothers.
verses.hindi: ये जल अपने अद्धुत रस से हमें प्रीणित करते है ओर शक्तियों के विकास करे कारणभूत होकर जननशक््तियुक्त करते है। १. प्रभु सिन्धुद्वीप से कहते है कि तू पृथिवीम्-इस विस्तृत हदयान्तरिक्च (प्रभ विस्तारे) को भूमिं च=ओर जिसमे मनुष्य बना ही रहता है (भवन्ति यस्यां सा भूमिः) ,
verses.transliteration: sa jāto garbho asi rodasyoragne cārurvibhṛta oṣadhīṣu | citraḥ śiśu: pari tamāsyaktūnpra mātṛbhyo adhi kanikradadgāḥ
verses.wordMeaning: Thou, being horn, art Child of Earth and Heaven, parted, fair Babe, among the plants, O Agni. The glooms of night thou, brilliant child, subduest, and art come forth, loud roaring, from the Mothers.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thou, being horn, art Child of Earth and Heaven, parted, fair Babe, among the plants, O Agni. The glooms of night thou, brilliant child, subduest, and art come forth, loud roaring, from the Mothers.

verses.sanskrit: स्थि॒रो भ॑व वी॒ड्व॒ङ्ग आ॒शुर्भ॑व वा॒ज्य॒र्वन् । पृ॒थुर्भ॑व सु॒षद॒स्त्वम॒ग्नेः पु॑रीष॒वाह॑णः
verses.translation: Steady be thou, and firm of limb. Steed, be a racer fleet of foot. Broad be thou, pleasant as a seat, bearing the store which Agni needs.
verses.hindi: १. मनुष्य विशाल हदय, स्वस्थ शरीर व ज्योतिर्मय मस्तिष्कवाला बनकर नीरोग व निष्पाप बनता हे। २. यह समविकासवाला व्यक्ति उचित धन प्राप्त करके पूर्ण नीरोग होता है। गरीबी भी तो एक रोग ही है। ३. इस व्यक्ति को चाहिए कि अब लोकदहित के कार्यो में संलग्न रहे।
verses.transliteration: sthiro bhava vīḍvaṅga āśurbhava vājyarvan | pṛthurbhava suṣadastvamagneḥ purīṣavāhaṇaḥ
verses.wordMeaning: Steady be thou, and firm of limb. Steed, be a racer fleet of foot. Broad be thou, pleasant as a seat, bearing the store which Agni needs.
verses.commentary: Sense: Steady be thou, and firm of limb. Steed, be a racer fleet of foot. Broad be thou, pleasant as a seat, bearing the store which Agni needs.

verses.sanskrit:
शि॒वो भ॑व प्र॒जाभ्यो॒ मानु॑षीभ्य॒स्त्वम॑ङ्गिरः ।
मा द्यावा॑पृथि॒वी अ॒भि शो॑ची॒र्माऽन्तरि॑क्षं॒ मा वन॒स्पती॑न्
verses.translation: Be thou propitious, Angiras, to creatures of the human race. Set not on fire the heaven and earth, nor air's mid-region, nor the trees.
verses.hindi: १. वासनाओं को नष्ट करके हम पवित्र हदय में प्रभु की ज्योति जगार्पँ। २. उस ज्योति के जगने पर हमारा यह प्रकाश अविच्छिन्न हो, सतत रहनेवाला हो। ३. ठम क्रियाशील, पवित्र व दीप्त बनकर देवों में भी शोभा पापं। सर्खुष्टां वसुभी रुद्रैर्धीरः कर्मण्या मृदम् ।
verses.transliteration: śivo bhava prajābhyo mānuṣībhyastvamaṅgiraḥ | mā dyāvāpṛthivī abhi śocīrmā'ntarikṣaṃ mā vanaspatīn
verses.wordMeaning: Be thou propitious, Angiras, to creatures of the human race. Set not on fire the heaven and earth, nor air's mid-region, nor the trees.
verses.commentary: Sense: Be thou propitious, Angiras, to creatures of the human race. Set not on fire the heaven and earth, nor air's mid-region, nor the trees.

verses.sanskrit:
प्रै॑तु वा॒जी कनि॑क्रद॒न्नान॑द॒द्रास॑भ॒: पत्वा॑ । भर॑न्न॒ग्निं पु॑री॒ष्यं मा पा॒द्यायु॑षः पु॒रा ।
वृषा॒ग्निं वृष॑णं॒ भर॑न्न॒पां गर्भ॑ᳪ समु॒द्रिय॑म् । अग्न॒ आ या॑हि वी॒तये॑
verses.translation: Forth with loud neighing go the Steed, the Ass that shouteth as he runs. Bearing Purîshya Agni on, let him not perish ere his time, Male bearer of male Agni, Child of Waters, Offspring of the Sea. Agni, come hither to the feast.
verses.hindi: पली वही ठीक है जो आयुर्वेद, मनोविज्ञान व आत्मविज्ञान का अध्ययन किये हए है, जो क्रियाशील, कोमल स्वभाववाली हे, सदा प्रसन्न रहनेवाली तथा घर में अत्न की वृद्धि करनेवाली है। १. सिनीवाली आह्वादयुक्त मनोवृत्तिवाली, सदा पति के साथ रहनेवाली सुकपर्दा=(सु-
verses.transliteration: praitu vājī kanikradannānadadrāsabha: patvā | bharannagniṃ purīṣyaṃ mā pādyāyuṣaḥ purā | vṛṣāgniṃ vṛṣaṇaṃ bharannapāṃ garbha samudriyam | agna ā yāhi vītaye
verses.wordMeaning: Forth with loud neighing go the Steed, the Ass that shouteth as he runs. Bearing Purîshya Agni on, let him not perish ere his time, Male bearer of male Agni, Child of Waters, Offspring of the Sea. Agni, come hither to the feast.
verses.commentary: Sense: Forth with loud neighing go the Steed, the Ass that shouteth as he runs. Bearing Purîshya Agni on, let him not perish ere his time, Male bearer of male Agni, Child of Waters, Offspring of the Sea. Agni, come hither to the feast.

verses.sanskrit:
ऋ॒तᳪ स॒त्यमृ॒तᳪ स॒त्यम॒ग्निं पु॑री॒ष्य॒मङ्गिर॒स्वद्भ॑रामः ।
ओष॑धय॒: प्रति॑ मोदध्वम॒ग्निमे॒तᳪ शि॒वमा॒यन्त॑म॒भ्यत्र॑ यु॒ष्माः ।
व्यस्य॒न् विश्वा॒ अनि॑रा॒ अमी॑वा नि॒षीद॑न्नो॒ अप॑ दुर्म॒तिं ज॑हि
verses.translation: The Law the Truth, the Law the Truth. As Angiras was wont to do, we bear Purîshya Agni on. Ye Plants, with joyous welcome greet this Agni, auspicious One who cometh on to meet you. Removing all distresses and afflictions, here settle down and banish evil purpose.
verses.hindi: पली को भोजन का विभाग सदा अपने हाथ में रखना चाहिए। इसे नौकरों को नहीं सौप देना चाहिए। सूचना- आचार्य दयानन्द ने ' स्वौपशा ' का अर्थ " भोजन के अच्छे पदार्थं बनानेवाली ' किया है। उव्वट ने अर्थं किया है-“ उत्तम अवयवोँवाली '।
verses.transliteration: ṛta satyamṛta satyamagniṃ purīṣyamaṅgirasvadbharāmaḥ | oṣadhaya: prati modadhvamagnimeta śivamāyantamabhyatra yuṣmāḥ | vyasyan viśvā anirā amīvā niṣīdanno apa durmatiṃ jahi
verses.wordMeaning: The Law the Truth, the Law the Truth. As Angiras was wont to do, we bear Purîshya Agni on. Ye Plants, with joyous welcome greet this Agni, auspicious One who cometh on to meet you. Removing all distresses and afflictions, here settle down and banish evil purpose.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Law the Truth, the Law the Truth. As Angiras was wont to do, we bear Purîshya Agni on. Ye Plants, with joyous welcome greet this Agni, auspicious One who cometh on to meet you. Removing all distresses and afflictions, here settle down and banish evil purpose.

verses.sanskrit: ओष॑धय॒: प्रति॑ गृभ्णीत॒ पुष्प॑वतीः सुपिप्प॒लाः । अ॒यं वो॒ गर्भ॑ ऋ॒त्विय॑: प्र॒त्नᳪ स॒धस्थ॒माऽस॑दत्
verses.translation: Welcome him joyfully, ye Plants, laden with bloom and goodly fruit. This seasonable Child of yours hath settled in his ancient seat.
verses.hindi: १. प्ली भोजनों को शक्ति के दृष्टिकोण से बनाये। २. अपने हाथों से बुद्धिपूर्वक भोजनों को बनाती हुई यह सबको स्वस्थ रखती है। ३. माता पाकाग्नि को अत्यन्त प्रिय वस्तु समञ्ञे, भोजन बनाने में उसे आनन्द आता हो। ४. सबके स्वास्थ्य कौ साधिका होने से प्ली गृहस्थ-यज्ञ कौ मूर्धन्य है।
verses.transliteration: oṣadhaya: prati gṛbhṇīta puṣpavatīḥ supippalāḥ | ayaṃ vo garbha ṛtviya: pratna sadhasthamā'sadat
verses.wordMeaning: Welcome him joyfully, ye Plants, laden with bloom and goodly fruit. This seasonable Child of yours hath settled in his ancient seat.
verses.commentary: Sense: Welcome him joyfully, ye Plants, laden with bloom and goodly fruit. This seasonable Child of yours hath settled in his ancient seat.

verses.sanskrit:
वि पाज॑सा पृ॒थुना॒ शोशु॑चानो॒ बाध॑स्व द्वि॒षो र॒क्षसो॒ अमी॑वाः ।
सु॒शर्म॑णो बृह॒तः शर्म॑णि स्याम॒ग्नेर॒हᳪ सु॒हव॑स्य॒ प्रणी॑तौ
verses.translation: Resplendent with thy wide-extending lustre dispel the terrors of the fiends who hate us. May lofty Agni be my guide and shelter, ready to hear our call, the good Protector.
verses.hindi: पली विशाल हदयान्तरिक्षवाली, मध्यमार्ग पर चलनेवाली, प्रकाशमय जीवनवाली तथा सभी को उचित निर्देश देनेवाली हो। ९. है पलि! तू अदित्यै=अदिति के लिए रास्ना=मेखला है, अर्थात् अदिति बनने के लिए कटिबद्ध है। तुञ्चे ' अदीना देवमाता” बनना हे, सब प्रकार की दीनताओं से ऊपर दिव्य
verses.transliteration: vi pājasā pṛthunā śośucāno bādhasva dviṣo rakṣaso amīvāḥ | suśarmaṇo bṛhataḥ śarmaṇi syāmagneraha suhavasya praṇītau
verses.wordMeaning: Resplendent with thy wide-extending lustre dispel the terrors of the fiends who hate us. May lofty Agni be my guide and shelter, ready to hear our call, the good Protector.
verses.commentary: Sense: Resplendent with thy wide-extending lustre dispel the terrors of the fiends who hate us. May lofty Agni be my guide and shelter, ready to hear our call, the good Protector.

verses.sanskrit: आपो॒ हि ष्ठा म॑यो॒भुव॒स्ता न॑ ऊ॒र्जे द॑धातन । म॒हे रणा॑य॒ चक्ष॑से
verses.translation: Ye, Waters, are beneficent, so help ye us to energy That we may look on great delight.
verses.hindi: माता का मुख्य कर्त्तव्य बच्चों को स्वस्थ बनाना तथा उनके जीवन का उत्तम परिपाक करना है। इसी दृष्टिकोण से वह भोजन को महत्त्व देती है, क्योंकि भोजन ने ही उनके शरीर व मनों को स्वस्थ करना हे। १. है जीव! वसवः= आयुर्वेद के आचार्य, उत्तम निवास का मार्गं सिखानेवाले विद्वान्
verses.transliteration: āpo hi ṣṭhā mayobhuvastā na ūrje dadhātana | mahe raṇāya cakṣase
verses.wordMeaning: Ye, Waters, are beneficent, so help ye us to energy That we may look on great delight.
verses.commentary: Sense: Ye, Waters, are beneficent, so help ye us to energy That we may look on great delight.

verses.sanskrit: यो व॑: शि॒वत॑मो॒ रस॒स्तस्य॑ भाजयते॒ह न॑: । उ॒श॒तीरि॑व मा॒तर॑:
verses.translation: Give us a portion of the sap, the most propitious that ye have. Like mothers in their longing love.
verses.hindi: हम प्रभु-भक्त बनें। प्रभु-भक्त सभी का मित्र होता है, सभी का धारण एकादशोऽध्यायः ३४० यजुर्वेदश्ाष्यम् करता है, सभी के कामों को सिद्ध करता है। यह स्वयं सम्भजनीय वस्तुओं को प्राप्त करता हे, ज्योतिर्मय जीवनवाला होता है, संसार में यशस्वी बनता हे।
verses.transliteration: yo va: śivatamo rasastasya bhājayateha na: | uśatīriva mātara:
verses.wordMeaning: Give us a portion of the sap, the most propitious that ye have. Like mothers in their longing love.
verses.commentary: Sense: Give us a portion of the sap, the most propitious that ye have. Like mothers in their longing love.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मा॒ अरं॑ गमाम वो॒ यस्य॒ क्षया॑य॒ जिन्व॑थ । आपो॑ ज॒नय॑था च नः
verses.translation: To you we gladly come for him to whose abode ye lead us on: And, Waters, give us procreant strength.
verses.hindi: प्रभु-कृपा से हममें उत्तम गुणों के बीज ही अंकुरित हों ओर हम अनथकभाव से सदा कार्य करनेवाले हों। १. है प्रभु-भक्त पलि! उत्थाय=उठकर, आलस्य छोडकर बृहती भव सदा वृद्धि को प्राप्त होनेवाली हो। आलस्य में गुणों का वास नहीं, गुण क्रियाशीलता में ही रहते हेै।
verses.transliteration: tasmā araṃ gamāma vo yasya kṣayāya jinvatha | āpo janayathā ca naḥ
verses.wordMeaning: To you we gladly come for him to whose abode ye lead us on: And, Waters, give us procreant strength.
verses.commentary: Sense: To you we gladly come for him to whose abode ye lead us on: And, Waters, give us procreant strength.

verses.sanskrit:
मि॒त्रः स॒ᳪसृज्य॑ पृथि॒वीं भूमिं॑ च॒ ज्योति॑षा स॒ह ।
सुजा॑तं जा॒तवे॑दसमय॒क्ष्माय॑ त्वा॒ सᳪ सृ॑जामि प्र॒जाभ्य॑:
verses.translation: Mitra, having commingled earth and ground together with the light For health to creatures mix I thee Omniscient and nobly born.
verses.hindi: पत्री आलस्य शून्य हो, विषयों से ऊपर उठी हर्द, घर में स्थिरता से रहे। घर के पाकादि कार्यो में अपने को व्यापृत रक्खे, जिससे वृत्ति सदा स्वस्थ रहे। स्वदादित्यास्त्वाचछुन्दन्तु जाग॑तेन छन्द॑साद्धिरस्वद्विश्व त्वा देवा वैशवानराऽ १. है प्रभु-भक्त! वसवः उत्तम निवास की विद्या के आचार्य त्वा=तुञ्चे गायत्रेण
verses.transliteration: mitraḥ sasṛjya pṛthivīṃ bhūmiṃ ca jyotiṣā saha | sujātaṃ jātavedasamayakṣmāya tvā sa sṛjāmi prajābhya:
verses.wordMeaning: Mitra, having commingled earth and ground together with the light For health to creatures mix I thee Omniscient and nobly born.
verses.commentary: Sense: Mitra, having commingled earth and ground together with the light For health to creatures mix I thee Omniscient and nobly born.

verses.sanskrit: रु॒द्राः स॒ᳪसृज्य॑ पृथि॒वीं बृ॒हज्ज्योति॒: समी॑धिरे । तेषां॑ भा॒नुरज॑स्र॒ इच्छु॒क्रो दे॒वेषु॑ रोचते
verses.translation: The Rudras, having mixed the earth, set all aglow the lofty light. Bright and perpetual their light verily shines among the Gods.
verses.hindi: हम प्राणरक्षण, 'काम, क्रोध व लोभ!'- निवारण, जगती के हित की कामना तथा प्रतिक्षण प्रभु-स्तवन से अपने जीवनों को दीप्त करे। मनु प्रजापत्ति व वैश्वानर अग्नि १. विश्वामित्र निश्चय करता है कि आकूतिम्-( बलं आत्मनो धर्मोः मनसः
verses.transliteration: rudrāḥ sasṛjya pṛthivīṃ bṛhajjyoti: samīdhire | teṣāṃ bhānurajasra icchukro deveṣu rocate
verses.wordMeaning: The Rudras, having mixed the earth, set all aglow the lofty light. Bright and perpetual their light verily shines among the Gods.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Rudras, having mixed the earth, set all aglow the lofty light. Bright and perpetual their light verily shines among the Gods.

verses.sanskrit: सᳪसृ॑ष्टा॒ वसु॑भी रुद्रै॒र्धीरै॑: कर्म॒ण्या मृद॑म् । हस्ता॑भ्यां मृ॒द्वीं कृ॒त्वा सि॑नीवा॒ली कृ॑णोतु॒ ताम्
verses.translation: The lump of clay that hath been mixed by Vasus, Rudras, by the wise, May Sinîvâlî with her hands soften and fit it for the work.
verses.hindi: हमें ' संकल्प, मनन, मेधाचित्त, विज्ञात व नपे-तुले शब्दों को बोलने की वृत्ति" को धारण करना चाहिए, जिससे हम विचारशील प्रजापति बन सक अथवा सवका हित करनेवाले अग्रणी बन पाँ। विश्वो देवस्य॑ नेतुर्मर्तो वुरीत सख्यम् ।
verses.transliteration: sasṛṣṭā vasubhī rudrairdhīrai: karmaṇyā mṛdam | hastābhyāṃ mṛdvīṃ kṛtvā sinīvālī kṛṇotu tām
verses.wordMeaning: The lump of clay that hath been mixed by Vasus, Rudras, by the wise, May Sinîvâlî with her hands soften and fit it for the work.
verses.commentary: Sense: The lump of clay that hath been mixed by Vasus, Rudras, by the wise, May Sinîvâlî with her hands soften and fit it for the work.

verses.sanskrit: सि॒नी॒वा॒ली सु॑कप॒र्दा सु॑कुरी॒रा स्वौ॑प॒शा । सा तुभ्य॑मदिते म॒ह्योखां द॑धातु॒ हस्त॑योः
verses.translation: May Sinîvâlî with fair braids, with beauteous crest, with lovely locks, May she, O mighty Aditi, bestow the Fire-pan in thy hands.
verses.hindi: हम प्रभु की मित्रता का वरण करे। यह अद्धुत बात है कि सव कोई धन यजुकेदभाष्यम् ३२२ एकादशोऽध्यायः की कामना करता है। धन की कामना करनी चाहिए, परन्तु हमें उतना ही धन जुटाना चाहिए जिससे हमारी स्वतन्त्रता सुरक्षित रह सक।
verses.transliteration: sinīvālī sukapardā sukurīrā svaupaśā | sā tubhyamadite mahyokhāṃ dadhātu hastayoḥ
verses.wordMeaning: May Sinîvâlî with fair braids, with beauteous crest, with lovely locks, May she, O mighty Aditi, bestow the Fire-pan in thy hands.
verses.commentary: Sense: May Sinîvâlî with fair braids, with beauteous crest, with lovely locks, May she, O mighty Aditi, bestow the Fire-pan in thy hands.

verses.sanskrit: उ॒खां कृ॑णोतु॒ शक्त्या॑ बा॒हुभ्या॒मदि॑तिर्धि॒या । मा॒ता पु॒त्रं यथो॒पस्थे॒ साऽग्निं बि॑भर्तु॒ गर्भ॒ आ । म॒खस्य॒ शिरो॑ऽसि
verses.translation: Aditi shape the Fire-pan with her power, her arms, her intellect, And in her womb bear Agni as a mother, in her lap, her son.
verses.hindi: १. पली को पति के साथ अभिन्न मेत्रीपूर्वक रहना चादिए्। २. उसके प्रत्येक कर्म में शक्ति का प्रकाश हो। ३. वह पाचन-कर्म को उत्तमता से करनेवाली हो। दुह॑स्व देवि पृथिवि स्वस्तय॑ऽआसुरी माया स्वधया कृतासि । जुष्ट देवेभ्य॑ऽ इदमस्तु हव्यमरिष्टा त्वमुदिहि यज्ञेऽअस्मिन् ॥६९॥
verses.transliteration: ukhāṃ kṛṇotu śaktyā bāhubhyāmaditirdhiyā | mātā putraṃ yathopasthe sā'gniṃ bibhartu garbha ā | makhasya śiro'si
verses.wordMeaning: Aditi shape the Fire-pan with her power, her arms, her intellect, And in her womb bear Agni as a mother, in her lap, her son.
verses.commentary: Sense: Aditi shape the Fire-pan with her power, her arms, her intellect, And in her womb bear Agni as a mother, in her lap, her son.

verses.sanskrit:
वस॑वस्त्वा कृण्वन्तु गाय॒त्रेण॒ छन्द॑साऽङ्गिर॒स्वद्ध्रु॒वाऽसि॑ पृथि॒व्य॒सि धा॒रया॒ मयि॑ प्र॒जाᳪ रा॒यस्पोषं॑ गौप॒त्यᳪ सु॒वीर्य॑ᳪ सजा॒तान्यज॑मानाय रु॒द्रास्त्वा॑ कृण्वन्तु॒ त्रैष्टु॑भेन॒ छन्द॑साऽङ्गिर॒स्वद्ध्रु॒वाऽस्य॒न्तरि॑क्षमसि धा॒रया॒ मयि॑ प्र॒जाᳪ रा॒यस्पोषं॑ गौप॒त्यᳪ सु॒वीर्य॑ᳪ सजा॒तान्यज॑मानायादि॒त्यास्त्वा॑ कृण्वन्तु॒ जाग॑तेन॒ छन्द॑साऽङ्गिर॒स्वद्ध्रु॒वासि द्यौर॑सि धा॒रया॒ मयि॑ प्र॒जाᳪ रा॒यस्पोषं॑ गौप॒त्यᳪ सु॒वीर्य॑ᳪ
सजा॒तान्यज॑मानाय॒ विश्वे॑ त्वा दे॒वा वै॑श्वान॒राः कृ॑ण्व॒न्त्वानु॑ष्टुभेन॒ छन्द॑साऽङ्गिर॒स्वद्ध्रु॒वाऽसि॒ दिशो॑ऽसि धा॒रया॒ मयि॑ प्र॒जाᳪ रा॒यस्पोषं॑ गौप॒त्यᳪ सु॒वीर्य॑ᳪ सजा॒तान्यज॑मानाय
verses.translation: With Gâyatrî, like Angiras the Vasus form and fashion thee! Stedfast art then, thou art the Earth. Establish in me progeny, command of cattle, growth of wealth, kinsmen for me the worshipper. With Trishtup may the Rudras, like Angiras, form and fashion thee. Stedfast art thou, thou art the Air. Establish in me, etc., as above. With Jagatî, like Angiras, Âdityas form and fashion thee! Stedfast art thou, thou art the Sky. Establish in me, etc. Friends of all men, the All-Gods with Anushtup form thee Angiras-like. Stedfast art thou, thou art the Quarters. Establish in me, etc.
verses.hindi: १. पती को गृह में स्थिर होकर रहना है। २. उसे ज्लानपूर्वक भोजन बनाना है, जिससे सभी की प्राणशक्ति बदे। ३. अन्न-पाचन मं वह कुशल हो। ४. यञ्च करके यज्ञशेष ही सबको देनवाली हो। ५. इस यज्ञशेष के सेवन के परिणामरूप अहिंसित होती हूर यह गृहस्थ यज्ञ को खूब उन्नत करनेवाली हो।
verses.transliteration: vasavastvā kṛṇvantu gāyatreṇa chandasā'ṅgirasvaddhruvā'si pṛthivyasi dhārayā mayi prajā rāyaspoṣaṃ gaupatya suvīrya sajātānyajamānāya rudrāstvā kṛṇvantu traiṣṭubhena chandasā'ṅgirasvaddhruvā'syantarikṣamasi dhārayā mayi prajā rāyaspoṣaṃ gaupatya suvīrya sajātānyajamānāyādityāstvā kṛṇvantu jāgatena chandasā'ṅgirasvaddhruvāsi dyaurasi dhārayā mayi prajā rāyaspoṣaṃ gaupatya suvīrya sajātānyajamānāya viśve tvā devā vaiśvānarāḥ kṛṇvantvānuṣṭubhena chandasā'ṅgirasvaddhruvā'si diśo'si dhārayā mayi prajā rāyaspoṣaṃ gaupatya suvīrya sajātānyajamānāya
verses.wordMeaning: With Gâyatrî, like Angiras the Vasus form and fashion thee! Stedfast art then, thou art the Earth. Establish in me progeny, command of cattle, growth of wealth, kinsmen for me the worshipper. With Trishtup may the Rudras, like Angiras, form and fashion thee. Stedfast art thou,…
verses.commentary: Sense: With Gâyatrî, like Angiras the Vasus form and fashion thee! Stedfast art then, thou art the Earth. Establish in me progeny, command of cattle, growth of wealth, kinsmen for me the worshipper. With Trishtup may the Rudras, like Angiras, form and fashion thee. Stedfast art thou,…

verses.sanskrit:
अदि॑त्यै॒ रास्ना॒स्यदि॑तिष्टे॒ बिलं॑ गृभ्णातु । कृ॒त्वाय॒ सा म॒हीमु॒खां मृ॒न्मयीं॒ योनि॑म॒ग्नये॑ ।
पु॒त्रेभ्य॒: प्राय॑च्छ॒ददि॑तिः श्र॒पया॒निति॑
verses.translation: The zone of Aditi art thou. Aditi seize thy hollow space. She, having made the great Fire-pan, a womb for Agni, formed of clay, Aditi, gave it to her Sons and, Let them bake it, were her words.
verses.hindi: आदर्शं पति सौम्य भोजनोवाला हो, मद्य-मांस से ऊपर उठा हुआ हो। दान करौ वृत्तिवाला हो। ठीक चुनाव करनेवाला हो। शक्ति का पुञ्ज बने ओर अभूतपूर्वं उन्नति प्रस्तुत मन्त्र का ऋषि “विरूप ' है, विशिष्ट रूपवाला। यह वधू से कहता है कि ९. अब तू मुञ्चसे "ऊद्" (विवाहित) हई यत्र अहम् अस्मि-जहांँ मे हुँ तान्-उन्हें (मेरे
verses.transliteration: adityai rāsnāsyaditiṣṭe bilaṃ gṛbhṇātu | kṛtvāya sā mahīmukhāṃ mṛnmayīṃ yonimagnaye | putrebhya: prāyacchadaditiḥ śrapayāniti
verses.wordMeaning: The zone of Aditi art thou. Aditi seize thy hollow space. She, having made the great Fire-pan, a womb for Agni, formed of clay, Aditi, gave it to her Sons and, Let them bake it, were her words.
verses.commentary: Sense: The zone of Aditi art thou. Aditi seize thy hollow space. She, having made the great Fire-pan, a womb for Agni, formed of clay, Aditi, gave it to her Sons and, Let them bake it, were her words.

verses.sanskrit:
वस॑वस्त्वा धूपयन्तु गाय॒त्रेण॒ छन्द॑साऽङ्गिर॒स्वद्रुद्रास्त्वा॑ धूपयन्तु त्रैष्टुभेन॒ छन्द॑साऽङ्गिर॒स्वदादि॒त्यास्त्वा॑ धूपयन्तु॒ जाग॑तेन॒ छन्द॑साऽङ्गिर॒स्वद्विश्वे॑ त्वा दे॒वा वै॑श्वान॒रा धू॑पय॒न्त्वानु॑ष्टुभेन॒ छन्द॑साऽङ्गिर॒स्वदिन्द्र॑स्त्वा धूपयतु॒ वरु॑णस्त्वा  धूपयतु॒ विष्णु॑स्त्वा
धूपयतु
verses.translation: The Vasus make thee fragrant, as Angiras did, with Gâyatrî! The Rudras make thee fragrant with the Trishtup, as did Angiras! With Gâyatrî, like Angiras, may the Âdityas perfume thee. Dear to all men, may the All-Gods with the Anushtup sweeten thee, as Angiras was wont to do. May Indra make thee odorous. May Varuna make thee odorous. May Vishnu make thee odorous.
verses.hindi: कन्या के लिए पितृगृह  अवर" व पत्तिगृह पर ' होना चाहिए। वह पतिगृह का निर्माण करती हुई उस घर में सबका पालन करनेवाली बने। प्रस्तुत मन्त्र में दूर-दूर से आये हुए व्यक्तियों मे से वधू एक का वरण करती है। यह निश्चित है कि वह ओरों की अपेक्षा श्रेष्ठ रूपवाले ‹ विरूप का ही वरण करेगी, अतः
verses.transliteration: vasavastvā dhūpayantu gāyatreṇa chandasā'ṅgirasvadrudrāstvā dhūpayantu traiṣṭubhena chandasā'ṅgirasvadādityāstvā dhūpayantu jāgatena chandasā'ṅgirasvadviśve tvā devā vaiśvānarā dhūpayantvānuṣṭubhena chandasā'ṅgirasvadindrastvā dhūpayatu varuṇastvā dhūpayatu viṣṇustvā dhūpayatu
verses.wordMeaning: The Vasus make thee fragrant, as Angiras did, with Gâyatrî! The Rudras make thee fragrant with the Trishtup, as did Angiras! With Gâyatrî, like Angiras, may the Âdityas perfume thee. Dear to all men, may the All-Gods with the Anushtup sweeten thee, as Angiras was wont to do.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The Vasus make thee fragrant, as Angiras did, with Gâyatrî! The Rudras make thee fragrant with the Trishtup, as did Angiras! With Gâyatrî, like Angiras, may the Âdityas perfume thee. Dear to all men, may the All-Gods with the Anushtup sweeten thee, as Angiras was wont to do.…

verses.sanskrit:
अदि॑तिष्ट्वा दे॒वी वि॒श्वदे॑व्यावती पृथि॒व्याः स॒धस्थे॑ अङ्गिर॒स्वत् ख॑नत्ववट
दे॒वानां॑ त्वा॒ पत्नी॑र्दे॒वीर्वि॒श्वदे॑व्यावतीः पृथि॒व्याः स॒धस्थे॑ अङ्गिर॒स्वद्द॑धतूखे
धि॒षणा॑स्त्वा दे॒वीर्वि॒श्वदे॑व्यावतीः पृथि॒व्याः स॒धस्थे॑ अङ्गिर॒स्वद॒भी॒न्धतामुखे॒
वरू॑त्रीष्ट्वा दे॒वीर्वि॒श्वदे॑व्यावतीः पृथि॒व्याः स॒धस्थे॑ अङ्गिर॒स्वच्छ्र॑पयन्तूखे॒
ग्नास्त्वा॑ दे॒वीर्वि॒श्वदे॑व्यावतीः पृथि॒व्याः स॒धस्थे॑ अङ्गिर॒स्वत्प॑चन्तूखे॒
जन॑य॒स्त्वाच्छि॑न्नपत्रा दे॒वीर्वि॒श्वदे॑व्यावतीः पृथि॒व्याः स॒धस्थे॑ अङ्गिर॒स्वत्प॑चन्तूखे
verses.translation: Pit! Angiras-like may Aditi the Goddess, beloved by all Gods, dig thee in Earth's bosom. Pan! Angiras-like may the Gods’ heavenly Consorts, dear to all Gads, in the Earth's bosom place thee. Pan! Angiras-like may Dhishanâs, Divine Ones, dear to alt Gods, in the Earth's bosom light thee. Pan! Angiras-like may the divine Varûtrîs, dear to all Gods, in the earth's bosom heat thee, Pan! Angiras-like may the celestial Ladies, dear to all Gods, in the earth's bosom bake thee. Angiras-like may the celestial Matrons, beloved by all the Gods, with unclipped pinions, within the lap of Earth, O Fire pan, bake thee.
verses.hindi: पति की योग्यतार्णँ ये है-९. दूर का हो, नजदीकी रिश्तेदार व परिचित न हो। २. विकसित इद्दिय-शक्तियोंवाला हो। ३. पालन करने कौ योग्यता रखता हो। ४. प्रिय हो। ५. काम, क्रोध व लोभादि वासनाओं को तैरे हुए हो। यदग्ने कानि कानि चिदा ते दारूणि दध्मसि ।
verses.transliteration: aditiṣṭvā devī viśvadevyāvatī pṛthivyāḥ sadhasthe aṅgirasvat khanatvavaṭa devānāṃ tvā patnīrdevīrviśvadevyāvatīḥ pṛthivyāḥ sadhasthe aṅgirasvaddadhatūkhe dhiṣaṇāstvā devīrviśvadevyāvatīḥ pṛthivyāḥ sadhasthe aṅgirasvadabhīndhatāmukhe varūtrīṣṭvā devīrviśvadevyāvatīḥ pṛthivyāḥ sadhasthe aṅgirasvacchrapayantūkhe gnāstvā devīrviśvadevyāvatīḥ pṛthivyāḥ sadhasthe aṅgirasvatpacantūkhe janayastvācchinnapatrā devīrviśvadevyāvatīḥ pṛthivyāḥ sadhasthe aṅgirasvatpacantūkhe
verses.wordMeaning: Pit! Angiras-like may Aditi the Goddess, beloved by all Gods, dig thee in Earth's bosom. Pan! Angiras-like may the Gods’ heavenly Consorts, dear to all Gads, in the Earth's bosom place thee. Pan! Angiras-like may Dhishanâs, Divine Ones, dear to alt Gods,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Pit! Angiras-like may Aditi the Goddess, beloved by all Gods, dig thee in Earth's bosom. Pan! Angiras-like may the Gods’ heavenly Consorts, dear to all Gads, in the Earth's bosom place thee. Pan! Angiras-like may Dhishanâs, Divine Ones, dear to alt Gods,…

verses.sanskrit: मि॒त्रस्य॑ चर्षणी॒धृतोऽवो॑ दे॒वस्य॑ सान॒सि । द्यु॒म्नं चि॒त्रश्र॑वस्तमम्
verses.translation: The gainful grace of Mitra, God, supporter of the race of man, Is glorious, of most wondrous fame.
verses.hindi: वर को चाहिए कि वधू के गुणों को महत्त्व दे, न कि वधू-गृह कौ सम्पत्ति को। ७३, ७४्वें मन्त्रं का ऋषि  जमदग्नि है। “ चक्षु जमदग्नितऋषिः, यदनेन जगत् पश्यति अथो मनुते तस्माच्चक्षर्जमदग्निऋषिः'-श० १।२।१।३ के अनुसार जमदग्नि " चक्षुः" एकादस्मोऽध्यायः ३ यजुर्वेदभावष्यम्
verses.transliteration: mitrasya carṣaṇīdhṛto'vo devasya sānasi | dyumnaṃ citraśravastamam
verses.wordMeaning: The gainful grace of Mitra, God, supporter of the race of man, Is glorious, of most wondrous fame.
verses.commentary: Sense: The gainful grace of Mitra, God, supporter of the race of man, Is glorious, of most wondrous fame.

verses.sanskrit:
दे॒वस्त्वा॑ सवि॒तोद्व॑पतु सुपा॒णिः स्व॑ङ्गु॒रिः सु॑बा॒हुरु॒त शक्त्या॑ ।
अव्य॑थमाना पृथि॒व्यामाशा॒ दिश॒ आ पृ॑ण
verses.translation: With lovely arms, with lovely hands, with lovely fingers may the God Savitar make thee clean, yea, by the power be hath. Not trembling on the earth fill thou the regions, fill the Quarters full.
verses.hindi: वर ने गुणग्राही बनना है. धनाग्रही नही। १. गत मन्त्रों मे वर्णित पति बड़े यज्ञिय स्वभाव का बनता है। यज्ञ को भुवन की नाभि कहा गया है। इस नाभि (यज्ञ) के सदा समीप रहने से यह ' नाभानेदिष्ठ ' कहलाता हे-सदा यज्ञो के समीप निवास करनेवाला। २. घर मे पती व गृह करे अन्य सभ्य (राला
verses.transliteration: devastvā savitodvapatu supāṇiḥ svaṅguriḥ subāhuruta śaktyā | avyathamānā pṛthivyāmāśā diśa ā pṛṇa
verses.wordMeaning: With lovely arms, with lovely hands, with lovely fingers may the God Savitar make thee clean, yea, by the power be hath. Not trembling on the earth fill thou the regions, fill the Quarters full.
verses.commentary: Sense: With lovely arms, with lovely hands, with lovely fingers may the God Savitar make thee clean, yea, by the power be hath. Not trembling on the earth fill thou the regions, fill the Quarters full.

verses.sanskrit:
उ॒त्थाय॑ बृह॒ती भ॒वोदु॑ तिष्ठ ध्रु॒वा त्वम् ।
मित्रै॒तां त॑ उ॒खां परि॑ ददा॒म्यभि॑त्त्या ए॒षा मा भे॑दि
verses.translation: Having arisen wax thou great, yea, stand thou up immovable. To thee, O Mitra, I entrust this Fire-pan for security. May it remain without a break.
verses.hindi: पति कमानेवाला हो। पत्री उसके भोजन का उचित ध्यान करनेवाली हो। पली पति से बहुत दूर न रहे। यचुर्वेदभाष्यम् ३४७ एकादशोऽध्यायः १. इरम्मदम्= (इरया माद्यति) अत्न से हर्षित होनेवाले, अर्थात् वानस्पतिक भोजन में
verses.transliteration: utthāya bṛhatī bhavodu tiṣṭha dhruvā tvam | mitraitāṃ ta ukhāṃ pari dadāmyabhittyā eṣā mā bhedi
verses.wordMeaning: Having arisen wax thou great, yea, stand thou up immovable. To thee, O Mitra, I entrust this Fire-pan for security. May it remain without a break.
verses.commentary: Sense: Having arisen wax thou great, yea, stand thou up immovable. To thee, O Mitra, I entrust this Fire-pan for security. May it remain without a break.

verses.sanskrit: वस॑व॒स्त्वाऽऽछृ॑न्दन्तु गाय॒त्रेण॒ छन्द॑साऽङ्गिर॒स्वद्रुद्रास्त्वा॒ऽऽछृ॑न्दन्तु॒ त्रैष्टु॑भेन॒ छन्दसाऽङ्गिर॒स्वदा॑दि॒त्यास्त्वाऽऽछृ॑न्दन्तु॒ जाग॑तेन॒ छन्द॑साऽङ्गिर॒स्वद्विश्वे॑ त्वा दे॒वा वै॑श्वान॒रा आछृ॑न्द॒न्त्वानु॑ष्टुभेन॒ छन्द॑साऽङ्गिर॒स्वत्
verses.translation: Thee may the Vasus, Angiras-like, fill with the metre Gâyatrî. Thee may the Rudras, Angiras-like, fill with the Trishtup metre full. Thee may Âdityas, Angiras-like, fill with the metre Jagatî. With the Anushtup metre may the All-Gods, dear to all men, fill thee full, as Angiras was wont.
verses.hindi: ब्रह्यचर्याश्रम में हमारी साधना इस प्रकार हो कि हम द्वितीयाश्रम मेँ प्रवेश करने पर एक सदगृहस्थ बन सक। याः सेनाऽअभीत्व॑रीराव्याधिनीरुग॑णाऽ उत । १. गत मन्त्र में वर्णित सद्गृहस्थ बनने के लिए राज्य-व्यवस्था का उत्तम होना
verses.transliteration: vasavastvā''chṛndantu gāyatreṇa chandasā'ṅgirasvadrudrāstvā''chṛndantu traiṣṭubhena chandasā'ṅgirasvadādityāstvā''chṛndantu jāgatena chandasā'ṅgirasvadviśve tvā devā vaiśvānarā āchṛndantvānuṣṭubhena chandasā'ṅgirasvat
verses.wordMeaning: Thee may the Vasus, Angiras-like, fill with the metre Gâyatrî. Thee may the Rudras, Angiras-like, fill with the Trishtup metre full. Thee may Âdityas, Angiras-like, fill with the metre Jagatî. With the Anushtup metre may the All-Gods, dear to all men, fill thee full,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Thee may the Vasus, Angiras-like, fill with the metre Gâyatrî. Thee may the Rudras, Angiras-like, fill with the Trishtup metre full. Thee may Âdityas, Angiras-like, fill with the metre Jagatî. With the Anushtup metre may the All-Gods, dear to all men, fill thee full,…

verses.sanskrit: आकू॑तिम॒ग्निं प्र॒युज॒ᳪ स्वाहा॑ मनो॑ मे॒धाम॒ग्निं प्र॒युज॒ᳪ स्वाहा॑ चि॒त्तं विज्ञा॑तम॒ग्निं प्र॒युज॒ᳪ स्वाहा॑ वा॒चो विधृ॑तिम॒ग्निं प्र॒युज॒ᳪ स्वाहा॑ प्र॒जाप॑तये॒ मन॑वे॒ स्वाहा॑ ऽग्नये॑ वैश्वान॒राय॒ स्वाहा॑
verses.translation: Intention, Agni. Motive, Hail! Mind, Wisdom, Agni, Motive, Hail! Thought, Knowledge, Agni, Motive, Hail! Rule of Speech, Agni, Motive, Hail! To Manu Lord of creatures, Hail! To Agni dear to all men, Hail!
verses.hindi: किसी भी प्रकार की उन्नति तभी सम्भव है जब न वाह्य शत्रुओं के आक्रमणों की आशंका हो, न चोर-लुटेरों के उपद्रव का भय। इस सुराज्य को वही राजा ला सकता है जो 'नाभानेदिष्ठ' है-सदा यनज्ञरूप-केन्द्र के समीप रहनेवाला हे। १. है भगवः राष्ट के उत्तम एश्वर्य के कारणभूत राजन्! दष्टाभ्याम्-जैसे दाढ़ों
verses.transliteration: ākūtimagniṃ prayuja svāhā mano medhāmagniṃ prayuja svāhā cittaṃ vijñātamagniṃ prayuja svāhā vāco vidhṛtimagniṃ prayuja svāhā prajāpataye manave svāhā 'gnaye vaiśvānarāya svāhā
verses.wordMeaning: Intention, Agni. Motive, Hail! Mind, Wisdom, Agni, Motive, Hail! Thought, Knowledge, Agni, Motive, Hail! Rule of Speech, Agni, Motive, Hail! To Manu Lord of creatures, Hail! To Agni dear to all men, Hail!
verses.commentary: Sense: Intention, Agni. Motive, Hail! Mind, Wisdom, Agni, Motive, Hail! Thought, Knowledge, Agni, Motive, Hail! Rule of Speech, Agni, Motive, Hail! To Manu Lord of creatures, Hail! To Agni dear to all men, Hail!

verses.sanskrit: विश्वो॑ दे॒वस्य॑ ने॒तुर्मर्तो॑ वुरीत स॒ख्यम् । विश्वो॑ रा॒य इ॑षुध्यति द्यु॒म्नं वृ॑णीत पु॒ष्यसे॒ स्वाहा॑
verses.translation: May every mortal man elect the friendship of the guiding God. Each one solicits him for wealth: let him seek fame to prosper him. All-hail!
verses.hindi: राजा एेसी व्यवस्था करे कि राष्ट में मलिन आचरणवाले, लुटेरे, चोर व विना श्रम के मजे से खानेवाले लोग न रहें। १. है राजन्! तान्=उन्हे ते= तेरे जम्भयोः = तीत्र दांतों मे दधामि स्थापित करता हँ, अर्थात् आपके द्वारा उनका नाश करवाता हूँ, ये=जो जनेषु=लोगों के विषय मे मलिम्लवः-मलिन
verses.transliteration: viśvo devasya neturmarto vurīta sakhyam | viśvo rāya iṣudhyati dyumnaṃ vṛṇīta puṣyase svāhā
verses.wordMeaning: May every mortal man elect the friendship of the guiding God. Each one solicits him for wealth: let him seek fame to prosper him. All-hail!
verses.commentary: Sense: May every mortal man elect the friendship of the guiding God. Each one solicits him for wealth: let him seek fame to prosper him. All-hail!

verses.sanskrit: मा सु भि॑त्था॒ मा सु रि॒षोऽम्ब॑ धृ॒ष्णु वी॒रय॑स्व॒ सु । अ॒ग्निश्चे॒दं क॑रिष्यथः
verses.translation: Break not, nor suffer any harm. Endure, O Mother, and be brave; This work will thou and Agni do.
verses.hindi: राजा का कर्तव्य है कि वह मलिनाचरणवालों, चोो, लुटेरों तथा परिपन्थियों को (घात लगाकर बैठे लोगों को) समाप्त कर दे। मस्मसा-करण ( चूर्णीकरण ) निन्दाद्योऽअस्मान् धिप्सांच्च सर्व तं म॑स्मसा करु ।॥८०॥
verses.transliteration: mā su bhitthā mā su riṣo'mba dhṛṣṇu vīrayasva su | agniścedaṃ kariṣyathaḥ
verses.wordMeaning: Break not, nor suffer any harm. Endure, O Mother, and be brave; This work will thou and Agni do.
verses.commentary: Sense: Break not, nor suffer any harm. Endure, O Mother, and be brave; This work will thou and Agni do.

verses.sanskrit:
दृᳪह॑स्व देवि पृथिवि स्व॒स्तय॑ आसु॒री मा॒या स्व॒धया॑ कृ॒तासि॑ ।
जुष्टं॑ दे॒वेभ्य॑ इ॒दम॑स्तु ह॒व्यमरि॑ष्टा॒ त्वमुदि॑हि य॒ज्ञे अ॒स्मिन्
verses.translation: Be firm for weal, O Goddess Earth. Made in the wonted manner thou Art a celestial design. Acceptable to Gods he this oblation. Arise thou in this sacrifice uninjured.
verses.hindi: राजा अपनी प्रजा में परस्पर प्रेम की वृत्ति को जगाने का प्रयल्ल करे। १. पुरोहित राजा के लिए कामना करता है कि यस्य=-जिसका अहम् मै पुरोहितः अस्मि=पुरोहित दूँ, उसका क्षेत्रम्-बल संशितम्- तीव्र हो, प्रभावशाली हो। उसका बल -जिष्णु=-सदा विजयशील हो, अपना कार्य करने मेँ सदा सफल हो। एक शाक्तिशाली राजा
verses.transliteration: dṛhasva devi pṛthivi svastaya āsurī māyā svadhayā kṛtāsi | juṣṭaṃ devebhya idamastu havyamariṣṭā tvamudihi yajñe asmin
verses.wordMeaning: Be firm for weal, O Goddess Earth. Made in the wonted manner thou Art a celestial design. Acceptable to Gods he this oblation. Arise thou in this sacrifice uninjured.
verses.commentary: Sense: Be firm for weal, O Goddess Earth. Made in the wonted manner thou Art a celestial design. Acceptable to Gods he this oblation. Arise thou in this sacrifice uninjured.

verses.sanskrit: द्र्व॑न्न: स॒र्पिरा॑सुतिः प्र॒त्नो होता॒ वरे॑ण्यः । सह॑सस्पु॒त्रो अद्भु॑तः
verses.translation: Wood-fed, bedewed with sacred oil, ancient, Invoker, excellent, The Son of Strength, the Wonderful.
verses.hindi: राष्टर् में पुरोहित ज्ञानी, वीर्यवान् व सबल हों, जिससे वे राजा के लिए १. एक पुरोहित अपने राष्ट्- पुरुषों मे शक्ति का सञ्चार करता हआ कहता है कि एषाम्-इन राष्ट्- पुरुषों कौ बाहू भुजाओं को पुरुषार्थ-साधक बाहुओं को उत् अतिरम् मेँ बद्धाता हं। एषाम्=इनकी वर्चः =रोगनिवारक शक्तिं को अथो=ओौर बलम्=शत्नु-विनाशक
verses.transliteration: drvanna: sarpirāsutiḥ pratno hotā vareṇyaḥ | sahasasputro adbhutaḥ
verses.wordMeaning: Wood-fed, bedewed with sacred oil, ancient, Invoker, excellent, The Son of Strength, the Wonderful.
verses.commentary: Sense: Wood-fed, bedewed with sacred oil, ancient, Invoker, excellent, The Son of Strength, the Wonderful.

verses.sanskrit:
पर॑स्या॒ अधि॑ सं॒वतोऽव॑राँ२ अ॒भ्या त॑र ।
यत्रा॒हम॑स्मि॒ ताँ२ अ॑व
verses.translation: Abandoning the foeman's host, pass hither to this company: Assist the men with whom I stand.
verses.hindi: पुरोहित का यह कर्तव्य है कि वह राष्ट्- पुरुषो में शक्ति का सञ्चार करे , उन्हे सब प्रकार से उन्नत करने के लिए यलशील हो। १. सव प्रकार कौ उतन्नतियोँ अन्न पर निर्भर करती हें, अतः अन्न के विषय में प्रार्थना करते है कि अन्नपते=हे सब अत्नं के पति प्रभो! न= हमे अन्नस्य देहि अन्न प्राप्त कराइए्।
verses.transliteration: parasyā adhi saṃvato'varā~2 abhyā tara | yatrāhamasmi tā~2 ava
verses.wordMeaning: Abandoning the foeman's host, pass hither to this company: Assist the men with whom I stand.
verses.commentary: Sense: Abandoning the foeman's host, pass hither to this company: Assist the men with whom I stand.

verses.sanskrit: प॒र॒मस्या॑: परा॒वतो॑ रो॒हिद॑श्व इ॒हा ग॑हि । पु॒री॒ष्य॒: पुरुप्रि॒योऽग्ने॒ त्वं त॑रा॒ मृध॑:
verses.translation: From the remotest distance come, Lord of the Red Steeds, hitherward. Do thou Purîshya, Agni, loved of many, overcome our foes.
verses.hindi: १. हमारा अन्न निश्चितरूप से अनमीव (नीरोग) व शुष्मी (बलदायक ) हो। २. हम सदा देकर बचे हए अन्न को खानेवाले हो। ३. हमारे अन्न हमे बल ओौर
verses.transliteration: paramasyā: parāvato rohidaśva ihā gahi | purīṣya: purupriyo'gne tvaṃ tarā mṛdha:
verses.wordMeaning: From the remotest distance come, Lord of the Red Steeds, hitherward. Do thou Purîshya, Agni, loved of many, overcome our foes.
verses.commentary: Sense: From the remotest distance come, Lord of the Red Steeds, hitherward. Do thou Purîshya, Agni, loved of many, overcome our foes.

verses.sanskrit: यद॑ग्ने॒ कानि॒ कानि॑ चि॒दा ते॒ दारू॑णि द॒ध्मसि॑ । सर्वं॒ तद॑स्तु ते घृ॒तं तज्जु॑षस्व यविष्ठ्य
verses.translation: O Agni, whatsoever be the fuel that we lay on thee, May that he butter unto thee. Be pleased therewith, Most Youthful God.
verses.hindi: इद्द्िय-संयम-यज्ञ को करते हुए् हम स्वर्ग साधक-कर्मो को ही करें। ज्ञान प्राप्त करे। परमात्म- दर्शन के लिए प्रयलशील हों। इन्द्रियों को सदा उत्तम प्रेरणा दे। वि होत्रां दधे वयुनाविदेकऽ इन्मही देवस्य॑ सवितुः परष्टुतिः।॥।४॥ एकादशोऽध्यायः ३०४ यजुर्वेद भाष्यम्
verses.transliteration: yadagne kāni kāni cidā te dārūṇi dadhmasi | sarvaṃ tadastu te ghṛtaṃ tajjuṣasva yaviṣṭhya
verses.wordMeaning: O Agni, whatsoever be the fuel that we lay on thee, May that he butter unto thee. Be pleased therewith, Most Youthful God.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Agni, whatsoever be the fuel that we lay on thee, May that he butter unto thee. Be pleased therewith, Most Youthful God.

verses.sanskrit: यदत्त्यु॑प॒जिह्वि॑का॒ यद्व॒म्रो अ॑ति॒सर्प॑ति । सर्वं॒ तद॑स्तु ते घृ॒तं तज्जु॒षस्व॑ यविष्ठ्य
verses.translation: That which the termite eats away, that over which the emmet crawls— Butter be all of this to thee. Be pleased therewith, Most Youthful God.
verses.hindi: ९. हम शक्तिशाली बनकर जीवन-यात्रा को सफलता से चलार्प् २. पार्थिव भोगों मे न फैसकर आत्मा का अन्वेषण करें, तभी जीवन दीप्त होगा। १. पिले मन्त्र मेँ चमकते जीवन" का संकेत था। उसी का कु विस्तार से हो , मेरुदण्ड = (७००।८७०१८) हो , अर्थात् ज्ञान तेरे जीवन का मूलाधार हो। तेरा जीवन ज्ञानमय
verses.transliteration: yadattyupajihvikā yadvamro atisarpati | sarvaṃ tadastu te ghṛtaṃ tajjuṣasva yaviṣṭhya
verses.wordMeaning: That which the termite eats away, that over which the emmet crawls— Butter be all of this to thee. Be pleased therewith, Most Youthful God.
verses.commentary: Sense: That which the termite eats away, that over which the emmet crawls— Butter be all of this to thee. Be pleased therewith, Most Youthful God.

verses.sanskrit: अह॑रह॒रप्र॑यावं॒ भर॒न्तोऽश्वा॑येव॒ तिष्ठ॑ते घा॒सम॑स्मै । रा॒यस्पोषे॑ण॒ समि॒षा मद॒न्तोऽग्ने॒ मा ते॒ प्रति॑वेशा रिषाम
verses.translation: Bringing to him, with care unceasing, fodder day after day as to a stabled courser, Joying in food and in the growth of riches, may we thy neighbours, Agni, ne’er be injured.
verses.hindi: प्रभु-भक्त पति-पली की विशेषताएं निम्न है -१. मेल से चलते हैं, २. घर को स्वर्ग बनाने का प्रयल्न करते हैँ, ३. उत्तम गत्तिवाले होते है , ४. आत्मनिर्भरता से चलते है, ५. हृदयो में प्रभु को धारण करते है, परिणामतः कभी अन्धकार में नहीं होते। निर्लिप्त मन+दीप्त मस्तिष्क- भरद्वाज का प्रभु-स्तवन
verses.transliteration: aharaharaprayāvaṃ bharanto'śvāyeva tiṣṭhate ghāsamasmai | rāyaspoṣeṇa samiṣā madanto'gne mā te prativeśā riṣāma
verses.wordMeaning: Bringing to him, with care unceasing, fodder day after day as to a stabled courser, Joying in food and in the growth of riches, may we thy neighbours, Agni, ne’er be injured.
verses.commentary: Sense: Bringing to him, with care unceasing, fodder day after day as to a stabled courser, Joying in food and in the growth of riches, may we thy neighbours, Agni, ne’er be injured.

verses.sanskrit:
नाभा॑ पृथि॒व्याः स॑मिधा॒ने अग्नौ रा॒यस्पोषा॑य बृह॒ते ह॑वामहे ।
इ॒र॒म्म॒दं बृ॒हदु॑क्थ्यं॒ यज॑त्रं॒ जेता॑रम॒ग्निं पृत॑नासु सास॒हिम्
verses.translation: While on earth's navel Agni is enkindled, we call, for ample increase of our riches, On Agni joying in the draught, much-lauded, worshipful; victor conquering in battle.
verses.hindi: -' गृत्समद ' वही है जो उल्लिखित ९१९ बातों को अपने जीवन में लाता हे। वस्तुतः जीवन का ठीक मार्ग है ही यह। प्रस्कण्व" की “ज्ञान-सृष्टि' सश्सीदस्व महाँ २।।ऽअसि शोच॑स्व देववीत॑मः ।
verses.transliteration: nābhā pṛthivyāḥ samidhāne agnau rāyaspoṣāya bṛhate havāmahe | irammadaṃ bṛhadukthyaṃ yajatraṃ jetāramagniṃ pṛtanāsu sāsahim
verses.wordMeaning: While on earth's navel Agni is enkindled, we call, for ample increase of our riches, On Agni joying in the draught, much-lauded, worshipful; victor conquering in battle.
verses.commentary: Sense: While on earth's navel Agni is enkindled, we call, for ample increase of our riches, On Agni joying in the draught, much-lauded, worshipful; victor conquering in battle.

verses.sanskrit:
याः सेना॑ अ॒भीत्व॑रीराव्या॒धिनी॒रुग॑णा उ॒त ।
ये स्ते॒ना ये च॒ तस्क॑रा॒स्ताँस्ते॑ अ॒ग्नेऽपि॑ दधाम्या॒स्ये॑
verses.translation: Whatever hosts there are, fiercely assailant, charging in lengthened lines, drawn up in order, Whatever thieves there are, whatever robbers, all these I cast into thy mouth, O Agni.
verses.hindi: प्रभुरूप वस्त्र को धारण करने पर मेँ सर्दी -गर्मीरूप वासनाओं से आक्रान्त उद्! तिष्ठ स्वध्वरावा नो देव्या धिया। प्रभु कहते है कि-- १. उ=निश्चय से उत्तिष्ठ उठ खड़ा हो। उदास व निराश बनकर पडा मत रह। २. स्वध्वरावा=( सु अध्वर अव) =उत्तम-हिंसा-शून्य कर्मो कौ रक्षा करनेवाला
verses.transliteration: yāḥ senā abhītvarīrāvyādhinīrugaṇā uta | ye stenā ye ca taskarāstā~ste agne'pi dadhāmyāsye
verses.wordMeaning: Whatever hosts there are, fiercely assailant, charging in lengthened lines, drawn up in order, Whatever thieves there are, whatever robbers, all these I cast into thy mouth, O Agni.
verses.commentary: Sense: Whatever hosts there are, fiercely assailant, charging in lengthened lines, drawn up in order, Whatever thieves there are, whatever robbers, all these I cast into thy mouth, O Agni.

verses.sanskrit:
दᳪष्ट्रा॑भ्यां म॒लिम्लू॒ञ्जम्भ्यै॒स्तस्क॑राँ२ उ॒त ।
हनु॑भ्याᳪ स्ते॒नान् भ॑गव॒स्ताँस्त्वं खा॑द॒ सुखा॑दितान्
verses.translation: Devour the burglars with both tusks, destroy the robbers with thy teeth. With both thy jaws, thou Holy One, eat up those thieves well champed and chewed.
verses.hindi: तू उट खडा हो, अहिसात्मक कर्मोवाला बन। पवित्र बुद्धि. बढते हुए ज्ञान तथा उत्तम प्रशंसनीय कर्मो से हमें प्राप्त हो। ऊर्ध्वऽऊ घु ण॑ऽऊतये तिष्ठां देवो न स॑विता। १. गत मन्त्र का  विश्वमना वैयश्व ' =नैत्यिक स्वाध्याय से ज्ञान को बदाकर 'कण्व'
verses.transliteration: daṣṭrābhyāṃ malimlūñjambhyaistaskarā~2 uta | hanubhyā stenān bhagavastā~stvaṃ khāda sukhāditān
verses.wordMeaning: Devour the burglars with both tusks, destroy the robbers with thy teeth. With both thy jaws, thou Holy One, eat up those thieves well champed and chewed.
verses.commentary: Sense: Devour the burglars with both tusks, destroy the robbers with thy teeth. With both thy jaws, thou Holy One, eat up those thieves well champed and chewed.

verses.sanskrit: ये जने॑षु म॒लिम्ल॑व स्ते॒नास॒स्तस्क॑रा॒ वने॑ । ये कक्षे॑ष्वघा॒यव॒स्ताँस्ते॑ दधामि॒ जम्भ॑योः
verses.translation: The burglars living among men, the thieves and robbers in the wood, Criminals lurking in their lairs, these do I lay between thy jaws.
verses.hindi: सर्वव्यापक प्रभु के दर्शन के लिए निर्दोष अन्तःकरण चादिए। वे प्रभु हृदयस्थ हो वेदवाणियों का उच्चारण कर रहे हैँ। हमारी प्रत्येक क्रिया मपी -तुली हो तो हम अवश्य उन वाणियों को सुन पार्णेग। प्रभु का त्रित को उपदेश
verses.transliteration: ye janeṣu malimlava stenāsastaskarā vane | ye kakṣeṣvaghāyavastā~ste dadhāmi jambhayoḥ
verses.wordMeaning: The burglars living among men, the thieves and robbers in the wood, Criminals lurking in their lairs, these do I lay between thy jaws.
verses.commentary: Sense: The burglars living among men, the thieves and robbers in the wood, Criminals lurking in their lairs, these do I lay between thy jaws.

verses.sanskrit: यो अ॒स्मभ्य॑मराती॒याद्यश्च॑ नो॒ द्वेष॑ते॒ जन॑: । निन्दा॒द्यो अ॒स्मान्धिप्सा॑च्च॒ सर्वं॒ तं भ॑स्म॒सा कु॑रु
verses.translation: Him who would seek to injure us, the man who looks oh us with hate Turn thou to ashes, and the man who slanders and would injure us.
verses.hindi: हमारा जीवन भौतिक क्षेत्र में ऋतवाला, व्यावहारिक क्षेत्र में सत्यवाला तथा अध्यात्म में ' पुरीष्य अग्निवाला' हो। आचार्यकुल से विद्यार्थी का समावर्तन १. ओषधयः =हे दोषों का दहन करनेवाले आचार्यो! पुष्पवतीः उत्तम पुष्पोंवाली
verses.transliteration: yo asmabhyamarātīyādyaśca no dveṣate jana: | nindādyo asmāndhipsācca sarvaṃ taṃ bhasmasā kuru
verses.wordMeaning: Him who would seek to injure us, the man who looks oh us with hate Turn thou to ashes, and the man who slanders and would injure us.
verses.commentary: Sense: Him who would seek to injure us, the man who looks oh us with hate Turn thou to ashes, and the man who slanders and would injure us.

verses.sanskrit: सᳪशि॑तं मे॒ ब्रह्म॒ सᳪशि॑तं वी॒र्यं बल॑म् । सᳪशि॑तं क्ष॒त्रं जि॒ष्णु यस्या॒हमस्मि॑ पु॒रोहि॑तः
verses.translation: Quickened is this my priestly rank, quickened is manly strength and force, Quickened is his victorious power of whom I am the Household priest.
verses.hindi: - उत्कृष्ट बन्धनवाला बनकर मैं शक्ति से चमवकँ। देष, हिंसा व रोगो से दूर रहूँ! प्रभु की शरण मेँ मेरा वास हो। प्रभु नेता हों मै उनका अनुयायी बनं। आपो हि ष्ठा म॑योभुवस्ता न॑ऽ ऊर्जे द॑धातन । महे रणाय चक्ष॑से ।॥५०॥ ९. “उत्कील ' गत मन्त्र का ऋषि धा। उत्कील बनने के लिए यह जलो का ठीक
verses.transliteration: saśitaṃ me brahma saśitaṃ vīryaṃ balam | saśitaṃ kṣatraṃ jiṣṇu yasyāhamasmi purohitaḥ
verses.wordMeaning: Quickened is this my priestly rank, quickened is manly strength and force, Quickened is his victorious power of whom I am the Household priest.
verses.commentary: Sense: Quickened is this my priestly rank, quickened is manly strength and force, Quickened is his victorious power of whom I am the Household priest.

verses.sanskrit: उदे॑षां बा॒हू अ॑तिर॒मुद्वर्चो॒ अथो॒ बल॑म् । क्षि॒णोमि॒ ब्रह्म॑णा॒ऽमित्रा॒नुन्न॑यामि॒ स्वाँ२  अ॒हम्
verses.translation: The arms of these men have I raised, have raised their lustre and their strength With priestly power I ruin foes and lift my friends to high estate.
verses.hindi: प्राण-रक्तषण कौ इच्छा, काम-क्रोध-लोभ को रोकने की इच्छा, लोकदहित कौ भावना, अनुक्षण प्रभु-स्तवन की इच्छा, जितेन्द्रियता, निर्द्षता तथा विशालता" ये बातें मानव-जीवन को संस्कृत करती है। क्अदिंतिष्ट्वा देवी विषुवदेंव्यावती पृथिव्याः सधस्थेंऽअङ्धिर स्वत् खख॑नत्ववट १. प्रभु  अवट '=अनिन्दिति व “उखा "= भोगों से ऊपर उठकर देखने योग्य े। २. प्रभु- दर्शन करनेवाला अङ्खिरस्-एक-एक अङ्क में रस के सज्चारवाला बनता है। ३. प्रभु- दर्शन विशाल हदयान्तरिक्ष में होता है। ४. प्रभु-दर्शन “अदिति, देवपन्नी, धिषणा, वरूत्री , ग्ना, आच्छिन्नपत्रा, जनयः तथा देवी विश्वदेव्यावती ' को होता हे। अदीना देवमाता,
verses.transliteration: udeṣāṃ bāhū atiramudvarco atho balam | kṣiṇomi brahmaṇā'mitrānunnayāmi svā~2 aham
verses.wordMeaning: The arms of these men have I raised, have raised their lustre and their strength With priestly power I ruin foes and lift my friends to high estate.
verses.commentary: Sense: The arms of these men have I raised, have raised their lustre and their strength With priestly power I ruin foes and lift my friends to high estate.

verses.sanskrit:
अन्न॑प॒तेऽन्न॑स्य नो देह्यनमी॒वस्य॑ शु॒ष्मिण॑: ।
प्र-प्र॑ दा॒तारं॑ तारिष॒ ऊर्जं॑ नो धेहि द्वि॒पदे॒ चतु॑ष्पदे
verses.translation: A share of food, O Lord of Food, vouchsafe us, invigorating food that brings no sickness. Onward, still onward lead the giver. Grant us maintenance both for quadruped and biped.
verses.hindi: - पुरोहित का यह कर्तव्य है कि वह राष्ट्- पुरुषो में शक्ति का सञ्चार करे , उन्हे सब प्रकार से उन्नत करने के लिए यलशील हो। १. सव प्रकार कौ उतन्नतियोँ अन्न पर निर्भर करती हें, अतः अन्न के विषय में प्रार्थना करते है कि अन्नपते=हे सब अत्नं के पति प्रभो! न= हमे अन्नस्य देहि अन्न प्राप्त कराइए्।
verses.transliteration: annapate'nnasya no dehyanamīvasya śuṣmiṇa: | pra-pra dātāraṃ tāriṣa ūrjaṃ no dhehi dvipade catuṣpade
verses.wordMeaning: A share of food, O Lord of Food, vouchsafe us, invigorating food that brings no sickness. Onward, still onward lead the giver. Grant us maintenance both for quadruped and biped.
verses.commentary: Sense: A share of food, O Lord of Food, vouchsafe us, invigorating food that brings no sickness. Onward, still onward lead the giver. Grant us maintenance both for quadruped and biped.

verses.sanskrit:
दृ॒शा॒नो रु॒क्म उ॒र्व्या व्य॑द्यौद् दु॒र्मर्ष॒मायु॑: श्रि॒ये रु॑चा॒नः ।
अ॒ग्निर॒मृतो॑ अभव॒द्वयो॑भि॒र्यदे॑नं॒ द्यौरज॑नयत्सु॒रेता॑:
verses.translation: repeated).
verses.hindi: श्यावाश्व १. छन्दो को अपना कवच बनाता हे। २. क्रान्तदर्शी बनता है ३. सबका भला करता है। ४. स्वर्ग में स्थित होता है। ५. सबको उत्तम प्रेरणा देता हुआ निर्माणात्मक कार्यो को करता है। ६. श्रेय का ही वरण करता है। ६. जीवन कौ क्रियाओं में बड़ा व्यवस्थित होता हे।
verses.transliteration: dṛśāno rukma urvyā vyadyaud durmarṣamāyu: śriye rucānaḥ | agniramṛto abhavadvayobhiryadenaṃ dyaurajanayatsuretā:

verses.sanskrit:
नक्तो॒षासा॒ सम॑नसा॒ विरू॑पे धा॒पये॑ते॒ शिशु॒मेक॑ᳪ समी॒ची ।
द्यावा॒क्षामा॑ रु॒क्मो अ॒न्तर्वि भा॑ति दे॒वा अ॒ग्निं धा॑रयन्द्रविणो॒दाः
verses.translation: Night and Dawn, different in hue, accordant, meeting together, suckle one same infant. Golden between the heaven and earth he shineth. The wealth-possessing Gods supported Agni.
verses.hindi: “श्यावाश्व ' सदा पालनादि उत्तम कर्मो में लगा हुआ विशाल हदयवाला बनकर ज्योति को प्राप्त करता है ओर प्रभु के दर्शन कर पाता हे। १. श्यावाश्व के लिए ही कहते है कि तू विष्णोः (यज्ञो वै विष्णुः) यज्ञ के क्रमः असि=पराक्रमवाला प्रसिद्ध हे। तू यज्ञिय पगों को रखनेवाला है। सपल्नहा=शरीर मे अपना
verses.transliteration: naktoṣāsā samanasā virūpe dhāpayete śiśumeka samīcī | dyāvākṣāmā rukmo antarvi bhāti devā agniṃ dhārayandraviṇodāḥ
verses.wordMeaning: Night and Dawn, different in hue, accordant, meeting together, suckle one same infant. Golden between the heaven and earth he shineth. The wealth-possessing Gods supported Agni.
verses.commentary: Sense: Night and Dawn, different in hue, accordant, meeting together, suckle one same infant. Golden between the heaven and earth he shineth. The wealth-possessing Gods supported Agni.

verses.sanskrit:
विश्वा॑ रू॒पाणि॒ प्रति॑ मुञ्चते क॒विः प्रासा॑वीद्भ॒द्रं द्वि॒पदे॒ चतु॑ष्पदे ।
वि नाक॑मख्यत्सवि॒ता वरे॒ण्योऽनु॑ प्र॒याण॑मु॒षसो॒ वि रा॑जति
verses.translation: The Sapient One arrays himself in every form: for quadruped and biped he hath brought forth good. Excellent Savitar hath looked on heaven's high vault: he shineth after the outgoings of the Dawn.
verses.hindi: जीव के चार पग है १. रोगों को नष्ट करना। २. अभिमान को नष्ट करना। ३. अदान की भावना को नष्ट करना। ४. ओर शत्रुता में स्थित मन को निरुद्ध करना। शरीर को ठीक करना, मन को ठीक करना, मस्तिष्क को ठीक करना ओर अन्तःस्थित प्रभु के गत मन्त्र के अनुसार चार पगों को रखकर जो भी प्रभु का दर्शन करता है, वह
verses.transliteration: viśvā rūpāṇi prati muñcate kaviḥ prāsāvīdbhadraṃ dvipade catuṣpade | vi nākamakhyatsavitā vareṇyo'nu prayāṇamuṣaso vi rājati
verses.wordMeaning: The Sapient One arrays himself in every form: for quadruped and biped he hath brought forth good. Excellent Savitar hath looked on heaven's high vault: he shineth after the outgoings of the Dawn.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Sapient One arrays himself in every form: for quadruped and biped he hath brought forth good. Excellent Savitar hath looked on heaven's high vault: he shineth after the outgoings of the Dawn.

verses.sanskrit:
सु॒प॒र्णो॒ऽसि ग॒रुत्माँ॑स्त्रि॒वृत्ते॒ शिरो॑ गाय॒त्रं चक्षु॑र्बृहद्रथन्त॒रे पक्षौ ।
स्तोम॑ आ॒त्मा छन्दा॒ᳪस्यङ्गा॑नि॒ यजूँ॑ᳪषि॒ नाम॑ । साम॑ ते त॒नूर्वा॑मदे॒व्यं य॑ज्ञाय॒ज्ञियं॒ पुच्छं॒ धिष्ण्या॑: श॒पाः ।
सु॒प॒र्णो॒ऽसि ग॒रुत्मा॒न्दिवं॑ गच्छ॒ स्व॑: पत
verses.translation: Thou art the goodly-pinioned Bird: thou hast the Trivrit for thy head. Gâyatra is thine eye, thy wings are Brihat and Rathantara. The hymn is self, the metres are his limbs, the formulas his name. The Vâmadevya Sâman is thy form, the Yajñâyajñiya thy tail, the fire-hearths are thy hooves. Thou art the goodly-pinioned Bird: go skyward, soar to heavenly light.
verses.hindi: १. हदयस्थ प्रभु निरन्तर प्रेरणा दे रहे है। यदि हम उस प्रेरणा को सुनें तो हमारा जीवन आनन्दमय हो जाता है। २. जीवन में सब शक्तियों का विकास होता हे। ३. सारा जीवन प्रकाशमय हो जाता है। ४. सारा संसार भी प्रकाशमय व उलञ्चनों से रहित गत मन्त्र के अनुसार प्रभु- दर्शन करनेवाला ' वत्सप्री' कहता है कि १. अग्नेहे
verses.transliteration: suparṇo'si garutmā~strivṛtte śiro gāyatraṃ cakṣurbṛhadrathantare pakṣau | stoma ātmā chandāsyaṅgāni yajū~ṣi nāma | sāma te tanūrvāmadevyaṃ yajñāyajñiyaṃ pucchaṃ dhiṣṇyā: śapāḥ | suparṇo'si garutmāndivaṃ gaccha sva: pata
verses.wordMeaning: Thou art the goodly-pinioned Bird: thou hast the Trivrit for thy head. Gâyatra is thine eye, thy wings are Brihat and Rathantara. The hymn is self, the metres are his limbs, the formulas his name. The Vâmadevya Sâman is thy form, the Yajñâyajñiya thy tail,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Thou art the goodly-pinioned Bird: thou hast the Trivrit for thy head. Gâyatra is thine eye, thy wings are Brihat and Rathantara. The hymn is self, the metres are his limbs, the formulas his name. The Vâmadevya Sâman is thy form, the Yajñâyajñiya thy tail,…

verses.sanskrit:
विष्णो॒: क्रमो॑ऽसि सपत्न॒हा गा॑य॒त्रं छन्द॒ आ रो॑ह पृथि॒वीमनु॒ वि क्र॑मस्व॒
विष्णो॒: क्रमो॑ऽस्यभिमाति॒हा त्रै॑ष्टुभं॒ छन्द॒ आ रो॑हा॒न्तरि॑क्ष॒मनु॒ वि क्र॑मस्व
विष्णो॒: क्रमो॑ऽस्यरातीय॒तो ह॒न्ता जाग॑तं॒ छन्द॒ आ रो॑ह॒ दिव॒मनु॒ वि क्र॑मस्व
विष्णो॒: क्रमो॑ऽसि शत्रूय॒तो ह॒न्ताऽऽनु॑ष्टुभं॒ छन्द॒ आ रो॑ह॒ दिशोऽनु॒ वि क्र॑मस्व
verses.translation: Thou art the riyal-slaying stride of Vishnu. Mount the Gâyatra metre: stride along the earth. Thou art the foe-destroying stride of Vishnu. Mount the Trishtup metre: stride along mid-air. Thou art the traitor-slaying stride of Vishnu. Mount the Jagatî metre: stride along the sky. Thou art the foeman-slaying stride of Vishnu. Mount Anushtup metre: stride along the Quarters.
verses.hindi: प्रभो! मै आपको प्राप्त करूं ओर आपकी प्राप्ति से मुञ्ञे दीर्घं जीवन, द्वादस्णोऽध्यायः ३५8 यजुर्वेद भाष्यम् अधा पोष॑स्य पोषेण पुन॑र्नो नष्टमाकुधि पुन॑नों रयिमाकरुधि ॥८॥ १. टे अग्ने=अग्रेणी व अङ्किरः=अङ्ग-अङ्ग मे रस का सञ्चार करनेवाले प्रभो!
verses.transliteration: viṣṇo: kramo'si sapatnahā gāyatraṃ chanda ā roha pṛthivīmanu vi kramasva viṣṇo: kramo'syabhimātihā traiṣṭubhaṃ chanda ā rohāntarikṣamanu vi kramasva viṣṇo: kramo'syarātīyato hantā jāgataṃ chanda ā roha divamanu vi kramasva viṣṇo: kramo'si śatrūyato hantā''nuṣṭubhaṃ chanda ā roha diśo'nu vi kramasva
verses.wordMeaning: Thou art the riyal-slaying stride of Vishnu. Mount the Gâyatra metre: stride along the earth. Thou art the foe-destroying stride of Vishnu. Mount the Trishtup metre: stride along mid-air. Thou art the traitor-slaying stride of Vishnu.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Thou art the riyal-slaying stride of Vishnu. Mount the Gâyatra metre: stride along the earth. Thou art the foe-destroying stride of Vishnu. Mount the Trishtup metre: stride along mid-air. Thou art the traitor-slaying stride of Vishnu.…

verses.sanskrit:
अक्र॑न्दद॒ग्नि स्त॒नय॑न्निव॒ द्यौ॒: क्षामा॒ रेरि॑हद्वी॒रुध॑: सम॒ञ्जन् ।
स॒द्यो ज॑ज्ञा॒नो वि हीमि॒द्धो अख्य॒दा रोद॑सी भा॒नुना॑ भात्य॒न्तः
verses.translation: repeated).
verses.hindi: हम उस धन को प्राप्त करे जिसका हम दान देनेवाले बनें ओर जिससे हम सभी का धारण करनेवाले बनें। सबके धारण की यह भावना ही हमें ' वत्सप्री ' बनाएगी। प्रभु हमारे धारणात्मक कर्मसे ही प्रीणित होगे। १. प्रजाओं का जीवन बहुत कुक राजा के जीवन पर निर्भर है। "यथा राजा तथा
verses.transliteration: akrandadagni stanayanniva dyau: kṣāmā rerihadvīrudha: samañjan | sadyo jajñāno vi hīmiddho akhyadā rodasī bhānunā bhātyantaḥ

verses.sanskrit:
अग्ने॑ऽभ्यावर्तिन्न॒भि मा॒ नि व॑र्त॒स्वायु॑षा॒ वर्च॑सा प्र॒जया॒ धने॑न ।
स॒न्या मे॒धया॑ र॒य्या पोषे॑ण
verses.translation: Return to me, thou still-returning Agni, with life, with lustre, progeny, and treasure, With profit, wisdom, riches, and abundance.
verses.hindi: हम तीनों बन्धनों से ऊपर उटे। आदित्य के व्रत में चलें ओर अदिति को अग्निर्भानुना रुश॑ता स्वद्गुऽआ जातो विश्वा सद्ांन्यप्राः ॥९३॥ १. गत मन्त्र के अनुसार तीनों बन्धनो को तैरकर अव यह “त्रित ' (त्रीन् तरति) बना है। इसका जीवन एेसा है- (२) यह उषसां बृहत् अग्रे=उषाकाल करे बहुत पहले ही
verses.transliteration: agne'bhyāvartinnabhi mā ni vartasvāyuṣā varcasā prajayā dhanena | sanyā medhayā rayyā poṣeṇa
verses.wordMeaning: Return to me, thou still-returning Agni, with life, with lustre, progeny, and treasure, With profit, wisdom, riches, and abundance.
verses.commentary: Sense: Return to me, thou still-returning Agni, with life, with lustre, progeny, and treasure, With profit, wisdom, riches, and abundance.

verses.sanskrit:
अग्ने॑ अङ्गिरः श॒तं ते॑ सन्त्वा॒वृत॑: स॒हस्रं॑ त उपा॒वृत॑: ।
अधा॒ पोष॑स्य॒ पोषे॑ण॒ पुन॑र्नो न॒ष्टमा कृ॑धि॒ पुन॑र्नो र॒यिमा कृ॑धि
verses.translation: A hundred, Agni Angiras! be thy ways, a thousand thy returns. With increment of increase bring thou back to us what we have lost. Again bring hitherward our wealth.
verses.hindi: प्रभु कौ महिमा द्युलोक के तारों में, शरीर की रचना में तथा जलो व समुद्रो मे सुव्यक्त है। उस प्रभु के ध्यान का प्रतिदिन अभ्यास करना आवश्यक हे। तृषिः- वत्सप्रीः। देवता--अग्निः। छन्दः-निचृदार्षीत्रिष्टुप्। स्वरः-धेवतः।। १. है अग्ने-सबके प्रकाशक प्रभो! ते= आपके त्रेधा तीन प्रकार से रखे गये त्रयाणि
verses.transliteration: agne aṅgiraḥ śataṃ te santvāvṛta: sahasraṃ ta upāvṛta: | adhā poṣasya poṣeṇa punarno naṣṭamā kṛdhi punarno rayimā kṛdhi
verses.wordMeaning: A hundred, Agni Angiras! be thy ways, a thousand thy returns. With increment of increase bring thou back to us what we have lost. Again bring hitherward our wealth.
verses.commentary: Sense: A hundred, Agni Angiras! be thy ways, a thousand thy returns. With increment of increase bring thou back to us what we have lost. Again bring hitherward our wealth.

verses.sanskrit: पुन॑रू॒र्जा नि व॑र्तस्व॒ पुन॑रग्न इ॒षाऽऽयु॑षा । पुन॑र्नः पा॒ह्यᳪह॑सः
verses.translation: Return again with nourishment; Agni, again with food and life. Again preserve us from distress.
verses.hindi: -हम स्वार्थ से ऊपर उठकर प्रसादयुक्त मन मेँ प्रभु का दर्शन करे। प्रभु-दर्शन के लिए कर्मो मे लगे रहना तथा साथ ही ज्ञान के उषःकाल को अपने जीवन में लाना १. अग्निः=वह अग्रेणी परमात्मा अक्रन्दत्-पवित्र हदयोंँ में वेदवाणी का नाद करता हे। स्तनयन्निव दद्यौः=वह तो मेघ के समान गर्जना कर रहा हे, परन्तु दुभाग्यवश हम उस
verses.transliteration: punarūrjā ni vartasva punaragna iṣā''yuṣā | punarnaḥ pāhyahasaḥ
verses.wordMeaning: Return again with nourishment; Agni, again with food and life. Again preserve us from distress.
verses.commentary: Sense: Return again with nourishment; Agni, again with food and life. Again preserve us from distress.

verses.sanskrit: स॒ह र॒य्या नि व॑र्त॒स्वाग्ने॒ पिन्व॑स्व॒ धार॑या । वि॒श्वप्स्न्या॑ वि॒श्वत॒स्परि॑
verses.translation: repeated).
verses.hindi: हम अपने जीवन को प्रकाशमय बनाकर संसार को प्रकाश देनेवाले बने ओर सभी को उत्तम निवासवाला व नीरोग बनाने का प्रयत्न कर। उशिक् पावको अरतिः सुमेधा मर्त्यष्वभ्निरमृतो नि धाचि । १. यह वत्सप्री :=प्रभु का प्यारा उशिक् = (वश्) सबका भला चाहनेवाला होता है,
verses.transliteration: saha rayyā ni vartasvāgne pinvasva dhārayā | viśvapsnyā viśvataspari

verses.sanskrit: आ त्वा॑ऽहार्षम॒न्तर॑भूर्ध्रु॒वस्ति॒ष्ठावि॑चाचलिः । विश॑स्त्वा॒ सर्वा॑ वाञ्छन्तु॒ मा त्वद्रा॒ष्ट्रमधि॑भ्रशत्
verses.translation: I brought thee: thou hast entered in. Stand stedfast and immovable. Lot all the people long for thee. Let not thy kingship fall away.
verses.hindi: हमें सभी के भले की कामना करनी चाहिए, अतः स्वयं विषयों से ऊपर उठकर ज्ञान का प्रसार करनेवाला होना चाहिए्। अग्निर मृतोऽअभवद्वयोंभिर्यदेनं द्यौरज॑नयत्सुरेताः । २५॥ १. दुश्ानः=यह वस्तुतत्व को देखता हे, बाह्य रूप से ही विचलित नहीं हो जाता--विषयों
verses.transliteration: ā tvā'hārṣamantarabhūrdhruvastiṣṭhāvicācaliḥ | viśastvā sarvā vāñchantu mā tvadrāṣṭramadhibhraśat
verses.wordMeaning: I brought thee: thou hast entered in. Stand stedfast and immovable. Lot all the people long for thee. Let not thy kingship fall away.
verses.commentary: Sense: I brought thee: thou hast entered in. Stand stedfast and immovable. Lot all the people long for thee. Let not thy kingship fall away.

verses.sanskrit:
उदु॑त्त॒मं व॑रुण॒ पाश॑म॒स्मदवा॑ध॒मं वि म॑ध्य॒मᳪ श्र॑थाय ।
अथा॑ व॒यमा॑दित्य व्र॒ते तवाना॑गसो॒ अदि॑तये स्याम
verses.translation: Varuna, from the upmost bond release us, let down the lowest and remove the midmost. So in thy holy law may we made sinless belong to Aditi, O thou Âditya.
verses.hindi: संसार में हमें तत्त्वदर्शी बनकर विषयों में नहीं उलज्ञना। ज्ञानी, ब्रह्मचारी आचार्यो की कृपा से ही एेसा जीवन बनता हेै। गुरु का आदर, प्रभु की भक्ति यस्तैऽओद्य कृणवंद्रद्रशोचे ऽपृपं हैव घृतव॑न्तमग्ने।
verses.transliteration: uduttamaṃ varuṇa pāśamasmadavādhamaṃ vi madhyama śrathāya | athā vayamāditya vrate tavānāgaso aditaye syāma
verses.wordMeaning: Varuna, from the upmost bond release us, let down the lowest and remove the midmost. So in thy holy law may we made sinless belong to Aditi, O thou Âditya.
verses.commentary: Sense: Varuna, from the upmost bond release us, let down the lowest and remove the midmost. So in thy holy law may we made sinless belong to Aditi, O thou Âditya.

verses.sanskrit:
अग्रे॑ बृ॒हन्नु॒षसा॑मू॒र्ध्वो अ॑स्थान्निर्जग॒न्वान् तम॑सो॒ ज्योति॒षाऽऽगा॑त् ।
अ॒ग्निर्भा॒नुना॒ रुश॑ता॒ स्वङ्ग॒ आ जा॒तो विश्वा॒ सद्मा॑न्यप्राः
verses.translation: High hath the Mighty risen before the Mornings, and come to us with light from out the darkness. Fair-shapen Agni with white-shining splendour hath filled at birth all human habitations.
verses.hindi: -१. हम प्रभु का स्तवन करे। २. द्वेष से ऊपर उठें। ३. देवों से शक्ति प्राप्त करे। देवों से शक्ति प्राप्त करके हम द्वेष से ऊपर उठे। निर्ेष बनकर सभी का भला चाहना व करना ही सच्चा प्रभु-कीर्तन है। यही व्यक्ति वत्सप्री' है प्रभु का सच्चा प्यारा हे। १. पिछले मन्त्र कौ समाप्ति इस बात पर थी कि सब देव हमारे अङ्खोँ में अपनी-अपनी
verses.transliteration: agre bṛhannuṣasāmūrdhvo asthānnirjaganvān tamaso jyotiṣā''gāt | agnirbhānunā ruśatā svaṅga ā jāto viśvā sadmānyaprāḥ
verses.wordMeaning: High hath the Mighty risen before the Mornings, and come to us with light from out the darkness. Fair-shapen Agni with white-shining splendour hath filled at birth all human habitations.
verses.commentary: Sense: High hath the Mighty risen before the Mornings, and come to us with light from out the darkness. Fair-shapen Agni with white-shining splendour hath filled at birth all human habitations.

verses.sanskrit:
ह॒ᳪसः शु॑चि॒षद्वसु॑रन्तरिक्ष॒सद्धोता॑ वेदि॒षदति॑थिर्दूरोण॒सत् ।
नृ॒षद्व॑र॒सदृ॑त॒सद् व्योम॒सद॒ब्जा गो॒जा ऋ॑त॒जा अ॑द्रि॒जा ऋ॒तं बृ॒हत्
verses.translation: Again let the Âdityas, Rudras, Yams, and Brahmans with their rites light thee, Wealth-bringer! Increase thy body with presented butter: effectual be the Sacrificer's wishes.
verses.hindi: एक परिव्राजक प्रचारक को तपस्वी, ज्ञानी व प्रियदर्शन होना चाहिए। १. है अग्ने=अपने ज्ञानोपदेशों से सबको आगे ले-चलनेवाले “तापस '! त्वम्=तू ज्योतिष्मान् ञान की ज्योतिवाला बनकर शिवेभिः अर्चिभिः=कल्याणकर ज्ञान की ज्वालाओं से इत्=निश्चयपूर्वक प्रयाहि आगे बद्। वस्तुतः यह तापस अपनी ज्ञान-ज्वालाओं से प्रजाओं
verses.transliteration: hasaḥ śuciṣadvasurantarikṣasaddhotā vediṣadatithirdūroṇasat | nṛṣadvarasadṛtasad vyomasadabjā gojā ṛtajā adrijā ṛtaṃ bṛhat
verses.wordMeaning: Again let the Âdityas, Rudras, Yams, and Brahmans with their rites light thee, Wealth-bringer! Increase thy body with presented butter: effectual be the Sacrificer's wishes.
verses.commentary: Sense: Again let the Âdityas, Rudras, Yams, and Brahmans with their rites light thee, Wealth-bringer! Increase thy body with presented butter: effectual be the Sacrificer's wishes.

verses.sanskrit:
सीद॒ त्वं मा॒तुर॒स्या उ॒पस्थे॒ विश्वा॑न्यग्ने व॒युना॑नि वि॒द्वान् ।
मै॑नां॒ तप॑सा॒ मार्चिषा॒ऽभि शो॑चीर॒न्तर॑स्याᳪ शु॒क्रज्यो॑ति॒र्वि भा॑हि
verses.translation: Knowing all holy ordinances, Agni, be seated in the lap of this thy mother. Do not with heat or glowing flame consume her: shine thou within her with refulgent lustre.
verses.hindi: स्वयं ज्योतिर्मय अहिंसक वृत्तिवाले बनकर हम ज्ञान-प्रसार द्वारा लोककल्याण १. अग्निः=सब उन्नतियों के साधक, प्रकाश देनेवाले प्रभु स्तनयन् इव द्यौः = गर्जते हए मेघ के समान अक्रन्दत्-उच्च स्वर से वेदज्ञान का उच्चारण कर रहे है। २. जब हम द्वाद्णोऽध्यायः ३७० यजुरवेदश्राष्यम्
verses.transliteration: sīda tvaṃ māturasyā upasthe viśvānyagne vayunāni vidvān | maināṃ tapasā mārciṣā'bhi śocīrantarasyā śukrajyotirvi bhāhi
verses.wordMeaning: Knowing all holy ordinances, Agni, be seated in the lap of this thy mother. Do not with heat or glowing flame consume her: shine thou within her with refulgent lustre.
verses.commentary: Sense: Knowing all holy ordinances, Agni, be seated in the lap of this thy mother. Do not with heat or glowing flame consume her: shine thou within her with refulgent lustre.

verses.sanskrit: अ॒न्तर॑ग्ने रु॒चा त्वमु॒खायाः॒ सद॑ने॒ स्वे । तस्या॒स्त्वᳪ हर॑सा॒ तप॒ञ्जात॑वेदः शि॒वो भ॑व
verses.translation: Within this Fire-pan with thy light, O Agni, in thy proper seat, Glowing with warmth, be gracious thou, O Jâtavedas, unto her.
verses.hindi: प्रभु की वाणी के सुनने पर मनुष्य ज्लान-सूर्य से चमकता है, काम पर विजय पाता है, स्वस्थ, दिव्य गुणोवाला, निरन्तर क्रियाशील व सभी का कल्याण करनेवाला होता है। काम पर विजय पानेवाला यह ' वशिष्ट ' कहलाता है--वशियों में श्रेष्ठ। चसिष्ठ का स्वागत 1रद्द्वप्०ष
verses.transliteration: antaragne rucā tvamukhāyāḥ sadane sve | tasyāstva harasā tapañjātavedaḥ śivo bhava
verses.wordMeaning: Within this Fire-pan with thy light, O Agni, in thy proper seat, Glowing with warmth, be gracious thou, O Jâtavedas, unto her.
verses.commentary: Sense: Within this Fire-pan with thy light, O Agni, in thy proper seat, Glowing with warmth, be gracious thou, O Jâtavedas, unto her.

verses.sanskrit:
शि॒वो भू॒त्वा मह्य॑मग्ने॒ अथो॑ सीद शि॒वस्त्वम् ।
शि॒वा: कृ॒त्वा दिश॒: सर्वा॒: स्वं योनि॑मि॒हास॑दः
verses.translation: Being propitious unto me, O Agni, sit propitiously. Having made all the regions blest, in thine own dwelling seat thyself.
verses.hindi: उत्तम वृत्तिवाली प्रजाओं का यह कर्त्तव्य है कि वे लोकदित में तत्पर, काम-विजयी वसिष्ठ का स्वागत करे। उसे सुविधाजनक स्थान पर ठहराषं। नम्रता से उसके उपदेश को सुने। उसे माता के समान अपने लिए हितकर समञ्घे। अप्स्त्रगने सधिष्टव सौष॑धीरनु रुध्यसे। गर्भे सञ्जायसे पुन॑ः ॥३६॥
verses.transliteration: śivo bhūtvā mahyamagne atho sīda śivastvam | śivā: kṛtvā diśa: sarvā: svaṃ yonimihāsadaḥ
verses.wordMeaning: Being propitious unto me, O Agni, sit propitiously. Having made all the regions blest, in thine own dwelling seat thyself.
verses.commentary: Sense: Being propitious unto me, O Agni, sit propitiously. Having made all the regions blest, in thine own dwelling seat thyself.

verses.sanskrit:
दि॒वस्परि॑ प्रथ॒मं ज॑ज्ञे अ॒ग्निर॒स्मद् द्वि॒तीयं॒ परि॑ जा॒तवे॑दाः ।
तृ॒तीय॑म॒प्सु नृ॒मणा॒ अज॑स्र॒मिन्धा॑न एनं जरते स्वा॒धीः
verses.translation: First Agni sprang to life from out of heaven, the second time from us came Jâtavedas. Thirdly the Manly-souled was in the waters. The pious lauds and kindles him Eternal.
verses.hindi: आदर्श पुरुष वही है जो प्रजाओं के साथ ही रहता है, वानस्पत्तिक भोजन करता है। चार मास एकान्त में अपने को ज्ञान से भरकर फिर स्लान-प्रसार के लिए बाहर से बनता है, अतः यह विरूप=ओरों की अपेक्षा उत्कृष्ट रूपवाला-ज्ञान-प्रसार में रत व्यक्ति ओषधीनाम् ओषधियों का गर्भः असि-निगलनेवाला- खानेवाला है। यह वनस्पतीनाम्
verses.transliteration: divaspari prathamaṃ jajñe agnirasmad dvitīyaṃ pari jātavedāḥ | tṛtīyamapsu nṛmaṇā ajasramindhāna enaṃ jarate svādhīḥ
verses.wordMeaning: First Agni sprang to life from out of heaven, the second time from us came Jâtavedas. Thirdly the Manly-souled was in the waters. The pious lauds and kindles him Eternal.
verses.commentary: Sense: First Agni sprang to life from out of heaven, the second time from us came Jâtavedas. Thirdly the Manly-souled was in the waters. The pious lauds and kindles him Eternal.

verses.sanskrit:
वि॒द्मा ते॑ अग्ने त्रे॒धा त्र॒याणि॑ वि॒द्मा ते॒ धाम॒ विभृ॑ता पुरु॒त्रा ।
वि॒द्मा ते॒ नाम॑ पर॒मं गुहा॒ यद्वि॒द्मा तमुत्सं॒ यत॑ आज॒गन्थ॑
verses.translation: Agni, we know thy three powers in three stations, we know thy forms in many a place divided. We know what name supreme thou hast in secret: we know the source from which thou hast proceeded.
verses.hindi: एक आदर्श प्रचारक को शाकाहारी व विश्ववन्धुत्व की भावनावाला होना १. भस्मना=-( भस दीप्तौ, प्रदीपकं तेजः-द०) अपने ज्ञान के दीप्त तेज से योनिः = मूलस्थान ब्रह्म में प्रसद्य=स्थित होकर, अर्थात् प्रभु कौ उपासना करके है अग्ने=सनके लिए मार्गं दिखानेवाले विदन्! तू अपःप्रजाओं मेव कर्मो मे स्थित हो, अर्थात् तेरे दिन
verses.transliteration: vidmā te agne tredhā trayāṇi vidmā te dhāma vibhṛtā purutrā | vidmā te nāma paramaṃ guhā yadvidmā tamutsaṃ yata ājagantha
verses.wordMeaning: Agni, we know thy three powers in three stations, we know thy forms in many a place divided. We know what name supreme thou hast in secret: we know the source from which thou hast proceeded.
verses.commentary: Sense: Agni, we know thy three powers in three stations, we know thy forms in many a place divided. We know what name supreme thou hast in secret: we know the source from which thou hast proceeded.

verses.sanskrit:
स॒मु॒द्रे त्वा॑ नृ॒मणा॑ अ॒प्स्वन्तर्नृ॒चक्षा॑ ईधे दि॒वो अ॑ग्न॒ ऊध॑न् ।
तृ॒तीये॑ त्वा॒ रज॑सि तस्थि॒वाᳪस॑म॒पामु॒पस्थे॑ महि॒षा अ॑वर्धन्
verses.translation: The Manly-souled lit thee in sea and waters, Man's Viewer lit thee in the breast of heaven. There as thou stoodest in the third high region the Bulls increased thee in the waters’ bosom.
verses.hindi: विद्वान् अपने जीवन को सान-ज्योति से दीप्त करे। ब्रह्यदर्शन करता हआ वह ईशचिन्तन से दिन का आरम्भ करे. प्रजाओं में ज्ञान-प्रसार करता हआ उदार हदय बने ओर दिनावसान पर पुनः प्रभु का ध्यान करता हुआ रात्निशयन में चला जाए। यजुर्केदभाव्यम् ३७३ द्वादशोऽध्यायः
verses.transliteration: samudre tvā nṛmaṇā apsvantarnṛcakṣā īdhe divo agna ūdhan | tṛtīye tvā rajasi tasthivāsamapāmupasthe mahiṣā avardhan
verses.wordMeaning: The Manly-souled lit thee in sea and waters, Man's Viewer lit thee in the breast of heaven. There as thou stoodest in the third high region the Bulls increased thee in the waters’ bosom.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Manly-souled lit thee in sea and waters, Man's Viewer lit thee in the breast of heaven. There as thou stoodest in the third high region the Bulls increased thee in the waters’ bosom.

verses.sanskrit:
अक्र॑न्दद॒ग्नि स्त॒नय॑न्निव॒ द्यौ: क्षामा॒ रेरि॑हद्वी॒रुध॑: सम॒ञ्जन् ।
स॒द्यो ज॑ज्ञा॒नो वि हीमि॒द्धो अख्य॒दा रोद॑सी भा॒नुना॑ भात्य॒न्तः
verses.translation: repeated.)
verses.hindi: - विद्वान् संन्यासी प्रजाओं में ज्ञान फैलाते हुए उनका अधिक-से-अधिक षिः-- वत्सप्रीः। देवत्ता-अग्निः। छन्दः- निचृदार्षीगायत्री। स्वरः-षड्जः।। शक्ति-लाभ व पाप से निवृत्ति १. पिले मन्त्रों में "विरूप" को प्रभु ने लोकहित के उद्देश्य से प्रजाओं में ज्ञान-प्रचार
verses.transliteration: akrandadagni stanayanniva dyau: kṣāmā rerihadvīrudha: samañjan | sadyo jajñāno vi hīmiddho akhyadā rodasī bhānunā bhātyantaḥ

verses.sanskrit:
श्री॒णामु॑दा॒रो ध॒रुणो॑ रयी॒णां म॑नी॒षाणां॒ प्रार्प॑ण॒: सोम॑गोपाः ।
वसु॑: सू॒नुः सह॑सो अ॒प्सु राजा॒ वि भा॒त्यग्र॑ उ॒षसा॑मिधा॒नः
