verses.sanskrit: त्वमु॑त्त॒मास्यो॑षधे॒ तव॑ वृ॒क्षा उप॑स्तयः । उप॑स्तिरस्तु॒ सोऽस्माकं॒ यो अ॒स्माँ२  अ॑भि॒दास॑ति
verses.translation: Long-lived be he who digs thee, Plant, and he for whom I dig thee up. So mayst thou also, grown long-lived, rise upward with a hundred shoots.
verses.hindi: समीप व दूर स्थित सब ओषधि्योँ मिलकर इस रोगिणी स्त्री को शक्ति द्रादखोऽध्यायः अ. युर्वेदभाष्यम् १. है ओषधियो! (क) वः=आपका खनिता=खोदनेवाला मा रिषत्-मत हिंसित हो, अर्थात् तुम्हारे खोदने मे खोदनेवाले को इस प्रकार की चोट आदि न आए जो अन्ततः
verses.transliteration: tvamuttamāsyoṣadhe tava vṛkṣā upastayaḥ | upastirastu so'smākaṃ yo asmā~2 abhidāsati
verses.wordMeaning: Long-lived be he who digs thee, Plant, and he for whom I dig thee up. So mayst thou also, grown long-lived, rise upward with a hundred shoots.
verses.commentary: Sense: Long-lived be he who digs thee, Plant, and he for whom I dig thee up. So mayst thou also, grown long-lived, rise upward with a hundred shoots.

verses.sanskrit:
मा मा॑ हिᳪसीज्जनि॒ता यः पृ॑थि॒व्या यो वा॒ दिव॑ᳪ स॒त्यध॑र्मा॒ व्यान॑ट् ।
यश्चा॒पश्च॒न्द्राः प्र॑थ॒मो ज॒जान॒ कस्मै॑ दे॒वाय॑ ह॒विषा॑ विधेम
verses.translation: Most excellent of all art thou, O Plant; thy vassals are the trees. Let him be subject to our power, the man who seeks to injure us.
verses.hindi: उस-उस रोग के नाश करनेवाली ओषध को जानकर हम उस-उस रोग से मुक्त होने का प्रयलल करे। ९. है ओषधे! त्वाम्=तुञ्धे गन्धर्वाः गन्धर्वो ने अखनन्-खोदा है, इष्ट-कार्य की सिद्धि के लिए भूमि से प्राप्त किया हे। २. त्वाम् तुजे इन्द्रः=इन्द्र ने खोदा है। त्वाम् तुज
verses.transliteration: mā mā hisījjanitā yaḥ pṛthivyā yo vā diva satyadharmā vyānaṭ | yaścāpaścandrāḥ prathamo jajāna kasmai devāya haviṣā vidhema
verses.wordMeaning: Most excellent of all art thou, O Plant; thy vassals are the trees. Let him be subject to our power, the man who seeks to injure us.
verses.commentary: Sense: Most excellent of all art thou, O Plant; thy vassals are the trees. Let him be subject to our power, the man who seeks to injure us.

verses.sanskrit: अ॒भ्या व॑र्तस्व पृथिवि य॒ज्ञेन॒ पय॑सा स॒ह । व॒पां ते॑ अ॒ग्निरि॑षि॒तो अ॑रोहत्
verses.translation: May he not harm me who is earth's begetter, nor he whose laws are faithful, sky's pervades; Nor he who first begot the lucid waters. To Ka the God let us present oblation.
verses.hindi: ओषध्यो शत्रुरूप रोगों को नष्ट करती है, उनपर आक्रमण करनेवाली सूचना- सम्भवतः “ अराति" शब्द बहुत न फौलनेवाले रोगों के लिए प्रयुक्त हुआ है ओर परतनायतः-फैलनेवाले (10५११८७) रोगों के लिए आया हे। दीर्घायुंस्तऽओषधे खनिता यस्मै च त्वा खनाम्यहम् ।
verses.transliteration: abhyā vartasva pṛthivi yajñena payasā saha | vapāṃ te agniriṣito arohat
verses.wordMeaning: May he not harm me who is earth's begetter, nor he whose laws are faithful, sky's pervades; Nor he who first begot the lucid waters. To Ka the God let us present oblation.
verses.commentary: Sense: May he not harm me who is earth's begetter, nor he whose laws are faithful, sky's pervades; Nor he who first begot the lucid waters. To Ka the God let us present oblation.

verses.sanskrit:
अग्ने॒ यत्ते॑ शु॒क्रं यच्च॒न्द्रं यत्पू॒तं यच्च॑ य॒ज्ञिय॑म् ।
तद्दे॒वेभ्यो॑ भरामसि
verses.translation: Turn thyself hitherward, O Earth, to us with sacrifice and milk. Thy covering skin Agni, urged forth, hath mounted.
verses.hindi: आओषधिर्याँ रोग-निवारण करनेवाली हैँ, परन्तु हमे विरोधी से कभी ओषध नहीं लेनी चाहिए, हितचिन्तक से ही ओषध का ग्रहण करे। सूचना- यहाँ मन्त्र के उत्तरार्धं में एेसा संकेत स्पष्ट है कि विरोधी व्यक्ति से ली गई ओषध गुणकारी न होकर हमारी समाप्ति ही कर देगी। हम सदा ओषध उसी वैद्य से
verses.transliteration: agne yatte śukraṃ yaccandraṃ yatpūtaṃ yacca yajñiyam | taddevebhyo bharāmasi
verses.wordMeaning: Turn thyself hitherward, O Earth, to us with sacrifice and milk. Thy covering skin Agni, urged forth, hath mounted.
verses.commentary: Sense: Turn thyself hitherward, O Earth, to us with sacrifice and milk. Thy covering skin Agni, urged forth, hath mounted.

verses.sanskrit:
इष॒मूर्ज॑म॒हमि॒त आद॑मृ॒तस्य॒ योनिं॑ महि॒षस्य॒ धारा॑म् ।
आ मा॒ गोषु॑ विश॒त्वा त॒नूषु॒ जहा॑मि से॒दिमनि॑रा॒ममी॑वाम्
verses.translation: All, Agni, that in thee is bright, pure, cleansed, and meet for sacrifice, That do we bring unto the Gods.
verses.hindi: वे प्रभु पृथिवी, द्युलोक, जल व चन्द्रादि के निर्माता हैं ये सब लोक हमारे कल्याण के लिए है। कल्याण तभी होगा जब हम दानपूर्वक खानेवाले बनें। एेसा बनने में ही सच्ची प्रभु-पूजा है। यज्ञ व पुथिवी की उत्पादन-शाक्ति
verses.transliteration: iṣamūrjamahamita ādamṛtasya yoniṃ mahiṣasya dhārām | ā mā goṣu viśatvā tanūṣu jahāmi sedimanirāmamīvām
verses.wordMeaning: All, Agni, that in thee is bright, pure, cleansed, and meet for sacrifice, That do we bring unto the Gods.
verses.commentary: Sense: All, Agni, that in thee is bright, pure, cleansed, and meet for sacrifice, That do we bring unto the Gods.

verses.sanskrit:
अग्ने॒ तव॒ श्रवो॒ वयो॒ महि॑ भ्राजन्ते अ॒र्चयो॑ विभावसो ।
बृह॑द्भानो॒ शव॑सा॒ वाज॑मु॒क्थ्यं दधा॑सि दा॒शुषे॑ कवे
verses.translation: I from this place have fed on strength and vigour, the womb of holy Law, stream of the mighty. In cows let it possess me and in bodies. I quit decline and lack of food, and sickness.
verses.hindi: हम यज्ञ करे, बादल पृथिवी को सीचंगे ओर इस प्रकार यह यज्ञाग्नि पृथिवी की उत्पादनशक्ति को बद्धा देगी। अग्ने यत्ते शुक्रं यच्चन्द्रं यत्पूतं यच्च॑ यज्ञियम् । तदेवेभ्यो भरामसि ॥ १०४॥ १९. गत मन्त्र मेँ कहा है कि अग्नि पृथिवी की उत्पादनशक्ति को बदा देता है।
verses.transliteration: agne tava śravo vayo mahi bhrājante arcayo vibhāvaso | bṛhadbhāno śavasā vājamukthyaṃ dadhāsi dāśuṣe kave
verses.wordMeaning: I from this place have fed on strength and vigour, the womb of holy Law, stream of the mighty. In cows let it possess me and in bodies. I quit decline and lack of food, and sickness.
verses.commentary: Sense: I from this place have fed on strength and vigour, the womb of holy Law, stream of the mighty. In cows let it possess me and in bodies. I quit decline and lack of food, and sickness.

verses.sanskrit:
पा॒व॒कव॑र्चाः शु॒क्रव॑र्चा॒ अनू॑नवर्चा॒ उदि॑यर्षि भा॒नुना॑ ।
पु॒त्रो मा॒तरा॑ वि॒चर॒न्नुपा॑वसि पृ॒णक्षि॒ रोद॑सी उ॒भे
verses.translation: Agni, life-power and fame are thine: thy fires blaze mightily, thou rich in wealth of beams! Sage, passing bright, thou givest to the worshipper, with strength, the food that merits laud.
verses.hindi: १. यज्ञ से वह अन्न-रस प्राप्त होता है जो ९. हमारे जीवन को व्यवस्थित = ऋतवाला करता है , २. यह हमें पूज्य प्रभु के प्रति ज्ुकाववाला करता है तथा उसकौ वाणी को समञ्जन के योग्य बनता है, ३. इससे हमारी इन्द्रिय -शक्तियों का विकास होता है ओर ५. हमारे शरीर अविकृत होते हे। ५. इन यज्ञो से हमारे घरों में अन्नाभाव दूर होता है ओर
verses.transliteration: pāvakavarcāḥ śukravarcā anūnavarcā udiyarṣi bhānunā | putro mātarā vicarannupāvasi pṛṇakṣi rodasī ubhe
verses.wordMeaning: Agni, life-power and fame are thine: thy fires blaze mightily, thou rich in wealth of beams! Sage, passing bright, thou givest to the worshipper, with strength, the food that merits laud.
verses.commentary: Sense: Agni, life-power and fame are thine: thy fires blaze mightily, thou rich in wealth of beams! Sage, passing bright, thou givest to the worshipper, with strength, the food that merits laud.

verses.sanskrit:
ऊर्जो॑ नपाज्जातवेदः सुश॒स्तिभि॒र्मन्द॑स्व धी॒तिभि॑र्हि॒तः ।
त्वे इष॒: सन्द॑धु॒र्भूरि॑वर्पसश्चि॒त्रोत॑यो वा॒मजा॑ताः
verses.translation: With brilliant, purifying sheen, with perfect sheen thou liftest up thyself in light. Thou, visiting both thy Mothers, aidest them as Son: thou joinest close the earth and heaven.
verses.hindi: पावकाग्नि के जीवन में माता-पिता कौ सेवा का प्रमुख स्थान हे। इसी क द्वारा वह प्रभु की सच्ची उपासना करता है , स्वस्थ शरीरवाला बनता है ओर उज्ज्वल रषिः पावकाग्निः। देवता-अग्निः। छन्द :-- निचृत्पङ्किः। स्वरः पञ्चमः।। पावकाग्नि का प्रभु-स्तवन
verses.transliteration: ūrjo napājjātavedaḥ suśastibhirmandasva dhītibhirhitaḥ | tve iṣa: sandadhurbhūrivarpasaścitrotayo vāmajātāḥ
verses.wordMeaning: With brilliant, purifying sheen, with perfect sheen thou liftest up thyself in light. Thou, visiting both thy Mothers, aidest them as Son: thou joinest close the earth and heaven.
verses.commentary: Sense: With brilliant, purifying sheen, with perfect sheen thou liftest up thyself in light. Thou, visiting both thy Mothers, aidest them as Son: thou joinest close the earth and heaven.

verses.sanskrit:
इ॒र॒ज्यन्न॑ग्ने प्रथयस्व ज॒न्तुभि॑र॒स्मे रायो॑ अमर्त्य ।
स द॑र्श॒तस्य॒ वपु॑षो॒ वि रा॑जसि पृ॒णक्षि॑ सान॒सिं क्रतु॑म्
verses.translation: O Jâtavedas, Son of Strength, rejoice thyself, gracious, in our fair hymns and songs. In thee are treasured various forms of strengthening food, born nobly and of wondrous help.
verses.hindi: हम अपने ईश्वर हों। प्राणिहित के उदेश्य से धनों का विनियोग करे। हमारे शरीर सुन्दर हों। उनमें “उपासना, प्रज्ञान व कर्म" का समुच्चय हो। इष्करत्तारमध्वरस्य प्रचेतसं क्षय॑न्तशराध॑सो म॒हः । १. पावकाग्नि प्रभु से प्रार्थना करता है कि-आप दधासि=धारण व पोषण करते हो।
verses.transliteration: irajyannagne prathayasva jantubhirasme rāyo amartya | sa darśatasya vapuṣo vi rājasi pṛṇakṣi sānasiṃ kratum
verses.wordMeaning: O Jâtavedas, Son of Strength, rejoice thyself, gracious, in our fair hymns and songs. In thee are treasured various forms of strengthening food, born nobly and of wondrous help.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Jâtavedas, Son of Strength, rejoice thyself, gracious, in our fair hymns and songs. In thee are treasured various forms of strengthening food, born nobly and of wondrous help.

verses.sanskrit:
इ॒ष्क॒र्तार॑मध्व॒रस्य॒ प्रचे॑तसं॒ क्षय॑न्त॒ᳪ राध॑सो म॒हः ।
रा॒तिं वा॒मस्य॑ सु॒भगां॑ म॒हीमिषं॒ दधा॑सि सान॒सिᳪ र॒यिम्
verses.translation: Agni, spread forth, as Ruler, over living things: give wealth to us, Immortal God. Thou shinest out from beauty fair to look upon: thou leadest us to conquering power.
verses.hindi: प्रभु ' यज्ञशील-ज्ञानी-सफलता के साधनाभूत धन के धारण करनेवाले, बल व प्रकाश के पुञ्ज ओर उत्तम वस्तुओं के दाता' का धारण करते है। इस पुरुष को प्रभु उत्तम एेश्वर्य के प्रापक तथा पूजा की वृत्ति के जनक" अन्न को देते हें तथा वह धन देते है जिसका वह दान करता है, जिसे बोँटकर खाता है।
verses.transliteration: iṣkartāramadhvarasya pracetasaṃ kṣayanta rādhaso mahaḥ | rātiṃ vāmasya subhagāṃ mahīmiṣaṃ dadhāsi sānasi rayim
verses.wordMeaning: Agni, spread forth, as Ruler, over living things: give wealth to us, Immortal God. Thou shinest out from beauty fair to look upon: thou leadest us to conquering power.
verses.commentary: Sense: Agni, spread forth, as Ruler, over living things: give wealth to us, Immortal God. Thou shinest out from beauty fair to look upon: thou leadest us to conquering power.

verses.sanskrit:
ऋ॒तावा॑नं महि॒षं वि॒श्वद॑र्शतम॒ग्निᳪ सु॒म्नाय॑ दधिरे पु॒रो जना॑: ।
श्रुत्क॑र्णᳪ स॒प्रथ॑स्तमं त्वा गि॒रा दै॑व्यं॒ मानु॑षा यु॒गा
verses.translation: To him, the wise, who orders sacrifice, who hath great riches under his control, Thou givest blest award of good, and plenteous food, givest him wealth that conquers all.
verses.hindi: प्रभुशक्ति मनुष्य का वर्धन करनेवाली होती है। उसे सौम्य व सशक्त करती है। यह ज्ञानी बनकर त्यागशील होता है। १. है मेरे आराधक! तेतु पयांसि=दूध सम् यन्तु=उत्तमता से प्राप्त हों, अर्थात् तू गौ इत्यादि पशुओं के पालन के द्वारा उत्तम दूध प्राप्त करनेवाला बन। २. उ=ओर इस
verses.transliteration: ṛtāvānaṃ mahiṣaṃ viśvadarśatamagni sumnāya dadhire puro janā: | śrutkarṇa saprathastamaṃ tvā girā daivyaṃ mānuṣā yugā
verses.wordMeaning: To him, the wise, who orders sacrifice, who hath great riches under his control, Thou givest blest award of good, and plenteous food, givest him wealth that conquers all.
verses.commentary: Sense: To him, the wise, who orders sacrifice, who hath great riches under his control, Thou givest blest award of good, and plenteous food, givest him wealth that conquers all.

verses.sanskrit: आ प्या॑यस्व॒ समे॑तु ते वि॒श्वत॑: सोम॒ वृष्ण्य॑म् । भवा॒ वाज॑स्य सङ्ग॒थे
verses.translation: The men have set before them for their welfare Agni, strong, visible to all, the Holy. Thee, Godlike One, with ears to hear, most famous, men's generations magnify with praise-songs.
verses.hindi: प्रभु अत्यन्त आनन्दमय हैँ, शान्त व शक्ति-सम्पन्न हे, अत्यन्त विस्तारवाले हैं, सभी के मित्रहै। मै भी ज्ञान प्राप्त करके एेसा ही बनने का प्रयल कर्ूं। अग्ने त्वां कामया गिरा ॥९९५५॥ १. पिछले मन्त्र की बातों को अपने जीवन में लाने के लिए "गोतम ' अपनी शक्ति
verses.transliteration: ā pyāyasva sametu te viśvata: soma vṛṣṇyam | bhavā vājasya saṅgathe
verses.wordMeaning: The men have set before them for their welfare Agni, strong, visible to all, the Holy. Thee, Godlike One, with ears to hear, most famous, men's generations magnify with praise-songs.
verses.commentary: Sense: The men have set before them for their welfare Agni, strong, visible to all, the Holy. Thee, Godlike One, with ears to hear, most famous, men's generations magnify with praise-songs.

verses.sanskrit:
सं ते॒ पया॑ᳪसि॒ समु॑ यन्तु॒ वाजा॒: सं वृष्ण्या॑न्यभिमाति॒षाह॑: ।
आ॒प्याय॑मानो अ॒मृता॑य सोम दि॒वि श्रवा॑ᳪस्युत्त॒मानि॑ धिष्व
verses.translation: Soma, wax great. From every side may vigorous powers unite in thee. Be in the gathering-place of strength.
verses.hindi: में प्रभु का प्रिय बनूं। मेरा जीवन प्रभु का प्रतिपादन करनेवाला हो। मेँ मोक्ष की रट न लगाकर ज्ञान-प्राप्ति के लिए प्रभु को चादहूं। मेरा जान बद्देगा। यह सान ही तुभ्यं ताऽअंद्खिरस्तम् विश्वाः सुश्चितयः पृथ॑क् । अग्ने कामाय येमिरे ॥९९६॥ १. पिछले मन्त्र का अवत्सार प्रभु से ज्ञान प्राप्त करके विशिष्ट रूपवाला, ज्लान-ज्योति
verses.transliteration: saṃ te payāsi samu yantu vājā: saṃ vṛṣṇyānyabhimātiṣāha: | āpyāyamāno amṛtāya soma divi śravāsyuttamāni dhiṣva
verses.wordMeaning: Soma, wax great. From every side may vigorous powers unite in thee. Be in the gathering-place of strength.
verses.commentary: Sense: Soma, wax great. From every side may vigorous powers unite in thee. Be in the gathering-place of strength.

verses.sanskrit: आ प्या॑यस्व मदिन्तम॒ सोम॒ विश्वे॑भिर॒ᳪशुभि॑: । भवा॑ नः स॒प्रथ॑स्तम॒: सखा॑ वृ॒धे
verses.translation: In thee be juicy nutriments united, and power and mighty foe-subduing vigour. Waxing to immortality, O Soma, win highest glory for thyself in heaven.
verses.hindi: में प्रभु का प्रिय बनूं। मेरा जीवन प्रभु का प्रतिपादन करनेवाला हो। मेँ मोक्ष की रट न लगाकर ज्ञान-प्राप्ति के लिए प्रभु को चादहूं। मेरा जान बद्देगा। यह सान ही तुभ्यं ताऽअंद्खिरस्तम् विश्वाः सुश्चितयः पृथ॑क् । अग्ने कामाय येमिरे ॥९९६॥ १. पिछले मन्त्र का अवत्सार प्रभु से ज्ञान प्राप्त करके विशिष्ट रूपवाला, ज्लान-ज्योति
verses.transliteration: ā pyāyasva madintama soma viśvebhiraśubhi: | bhavā naḥ saprathastama: sakhā vṛdhe
verses.wordMeaning: In thee be juicy nutriments united, and power and mighty foe-subduing vigour. Waxing to immortality, O Soma, win highest glory for thyself in heaven.
verses.commentary: Sense: In thee be juicy nutriments united, and power and mighty foe-subduing vigour. Waxing to immortality, O Soma, win highest glory for thyself in heaven.

verses.sanskrit: आ ते॑ व॒त्सो मनो॑ यमत्पर॒माच्चि॑त्स॒धस्था॑त् । अग्ने॒ त्वाङ्का॑मया गि॒रा
verses.translation: Wax, O most gladdening Soma, great through all thy filaments, and be A friend of most illustrious fame to prosper us.
verses.hindi: में प्रभु का प्रिय बनूं। मेरा जीवन प्रभु का प्रतिपादन करनेवाला हो। मेँ मोक्ष की रट न लगाकर ज्ञान-प्राप्ति के लिए प्रभु को चादहूं। मेरा जान बद्देगा। यह सान ही तुभ्यं ताऽअंद्खिरस्तम् विश्वाः सुश्चितयः पृथ॑क् । अग्ने कामाय येमिरे ॥९९६॥ १. पिछले मन्त्र का अवत्सार प्रभु से ज्ञान प्राप्त करके विशिष्ट रूपवाला, ज्लान-ज्योति
verses.transliteration: ā te vatso mano yamatparamāccitsadhasthāt | agne tvāṅkāmayā girā
verses.wordMeaning: Wax, O most gladdening Soma, great through all thy filaments, and be A friend of most illustrious fame to prosper us.
verses.commentary: Sense: Wax, O most gladdening Soma, great through all thy filaments, and be A friend of most illustrious fame to prosper us.

verses.sanskrit: तुभ्यं॒ ता अ॑ङ्गिरस्तम॒ विश्वा॑: सुक्षि॒तय॒: पृथ॑क् । अग्ने॒ कामा॑य येमिरे
verses.translation: May Vatsa draw thy mind away, even from thy loftiest dwelling-place, Agni, with song that yearns for thee.
verses.hindi: में प्रभु का प्रिय बनूं। मेरा जीवन प्रभु का प्रतिपादन करनेवाला हो। मेँ मोक्ष की रट न लगाकर ज्ञान-प्राप्ति के लिए प्रभु को चादहूं। मेरा जान बद्देगा। यह सान ही तुभ्यं ताऽअंद्खिरस्तम् विश्वाः सुश्चितयः पृथ॑क् । अग्ने कामाय येमिरे ॥९९६॥ १. पिछले मन्त्र का अवत्सार प्रभु से ज्ञान प्राप्त करके विशिष्ट रूपवाला, ज्लान-ज्योति
verses.transliteration: tubhyaṃ tā aṅgirastama viśvā: sukṣitaya: pṛthak | agne kāmāya yemire
verses.wordMeaning: May Vatsa draw thy mind away, even from thy loftiest dwelling-place, Agni, with song that yearns for thee.
verses.commentary: Sense: May Vatsa draw thy mind away, even from thy loftiest dwelling-place, Agni, with song that yearns for thee.

verses.sanskrit: अ॒ग्निः प्रि॒येषु॒ धाम॑सु॒ कामो॑ भू॒तस्य॒ भव्य॑स्य । स॒म्राडेको॒ वि रा॑जति
verses.translation: Agni, best Angiras, to thee all people who have pleasant homes Apart have turned to gain their wish.
verses.hindi: में प्रभु का प्रिय बनूं। मेरा जीवन प्रभु का प्रतिपादन करनेवाला हो। मेँ मोक्ष की रट न लगाकर ज्ञान-प्राप्ति के लिए प्रभु को चादहूं। मेरा जान बद्देगा। यह सान ही तुभ्यं ताऽअंद्खिरस्तम् विश्वाः सुश्चितयः पृथ॑क् । अग्ने कामाय येमिरे ॥९९६॥ १. पिछले मन्त्र का अवत्सार प्रभु से ज्ञान प्राप्त करके विशिष्ट रूपवाला, ज्लान-ज्योति
verses.transliteration: agniḥ priyeṣu dhāmasu kāmo bhūtasya bhavyasya | samrāḍeko vi rājati
verses.wordMeaning: Agni, best Angiras, to thee all people who have pleasant homes Apart have turned to gain their wish.
verses.commentary: Sense: Agni, best Angiras, to thee all people who have pleasant homes Apart have turned to gain their wish.

verses.sanskrit: मयि॑ गृह्णा॒म्यग्रे॑ अ॒ग्निᳪ रा॒यस्पोषा॑य सुप्रजा॒स्त्वाय॑ सु॒वीर्या॑य । मामु॑ दे॒वता॑: सचन्ताम्
verses.translation: com The Texts of the White Yajurveda, tr. Ralph T.H. Griffith, [1899], BOOK THE THIRTEENTH I TAKE within me Agni first, for increase of my wealth, good offspring, manly strength: So may the Deities wait on me.
verses.hindi: यदि हम अपने में प्रभु को धारण करेगे तो १. हम धन का पोषण करनेवाले होगे २. हमारी सन्तान उत्तम होगी ३. हम उत्तम वीर्य का पोषण करेगे ४. दिव्य गुणों के धारणवाले होंगे। वर्ध'मानो महँ २।ऽअ च पुष्करे दिवो मात्र॑या वरिम्णा प्र॑थस्व ॥२॥
verses.transliteration: mayi gṛhṇāmyagre agni rāyaspoṣāya suprajāstvāya suvīryāya | māmu devatā: sacantām
verses.wordMeaning: com The Texts of the White Yajurveda, tr. Ralph T.H. Griffith, [1899], BOOK THE THIRTEENTH I TAKE within me Agni first, for increase of my wealth, good offspring, manly strength: So may the Deities wait on me.
verses.commentary: Sense: com The Texts of the White Yajurveda, tr. Ralph T.H. Griffith, [1899], BOOK THE THIRTEENTH I TAKE within me Agni first, for increase of my wealth, good offspring, manly strength: So may the Deities wait on me.

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒पां पृ॒ष्ठम॑सि॒ योनि॑र॒ग्नेः स॑मु॒द्रम॒भित॒: पिन्व॑मानम् ।
वर्ध॑मानो म॒हाँ२  आ च॒ पुष्क॑रे दि॒वो मात्र॑या वरि॒म्णा प्र॑थस्व
verses.translation: Thou art the waters’ back, the womb of Agni, around the ocean as it swells and surges. Waxing to greatness, resting on the lotus, spread forth in amplitude with heaven's own measure.
verses.hindi: प्रभु पूर्ण, अनादि व अजन्मा हे। प्रभु का दर्शन परिष्कृत इच्छाओंवाले, जान से दीप्त मेधावी को होता है। वह मेधावी प्रभु के बनाये लोक-लोकान्तरों का ज्ञान प्राप्त करता है ओर उन लोकों की अद्भुत रचना में परमेश्वर की महिमा को अनुभव करता है। स दाधार पृथिवीं द्यामुतेमां कस्मै देवाय॑ हविषां विधेम ।॥।४॥
verses.transliteration: apāṃ pṛṣṭhamasi yoniragneḥ samudramabhita: pinvamānam | vardhamāno mahā~2 ā ca puṣkare divo mātrayā varimṇā prathasva
verses.wordMeaning: Thou art the waters’ back, the womb of Agni, around the ocean as it swells and surges. Waxing to greatness, resting on the lotus, spread forth in amplitude with heaven's own measure.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thou art the waters’ back, the womb of Agni, around the ocean as it swells and surges. Waxing to greatness, resting on the lotus, spread forth in amplitude with heaven's own measure.

verses.sanskrit:
ब्रह्म॑ जज्ञा॒नं प्र॑थ॒मं पु॒रस्ता॒द्वि सी॑म॒तः सु॒रुचो॑ वे॒न आ॑वः ।
स बु॒ध्न्या॒ उप॒मा अ॑स्य वि॒ष्ठाः स॒तश्च॒ योनि॒मस॑तश्च॒ वि व॑:
verses.translation: Eastward at first was Brahma generated. Vena o’erspread the bright Ones from the summit, Disclosed his deepest nearest revelations, womb of existent and of non-existent.
verses.hindi: वे प्रभु द्रप्स ठे, आनन्दमय है। सब लोकों मे व्याप्त होकर गति कर रहे है। सभी प्राणियों को प्राणित करनेवाले है। उस प्रभु को मै अपने अन्दर धारण करता द, जिससे सब ज्ञानेन्द्रिय, मन व बुद्धि मेरे अनुकूल हों ओर मेरा ज्ञान उत्तरोत्तर बढता चले। नमोऽस्तु सर्पेभ्यो ये के च॑ पृथिवीमनु ।
verses.transliteration: brahma jajñānaṃ prathamaṃ purastādvi sīmataḥ suruco vena āvaḥ | sa budhnyā upamā asya viṣṭhāḥ sataśca yonimasataśca vi va:
verses.wordMeaning: Eastward at first was Brahma generated. Vena o’erspread the bright Ones from the summit, Disclosed his deepest nearest revelations, womb of existent and of non-existent.
verses.commentary: Sense: Eastward at first was Brahma generated. Vena o’erspread the bright Ones from the summit, Disclosed his deepest nearest revelations, womb of existent and of non-existent.

verses.sanskrit:
हि॒र॒ण्य॒ग॒र्भः सम॑वर्त॒ताग्रे॑ भू॒तस्य॑ जा॒तः पति॒रेक॑ आसीत् ।
स दा॑धार पृथि॒वीं द्यामु॒तेमां कस्मै॑ दे॒वाय॑ ह॒विषा॑ विधेम
verses.translation: In the beginning rose Hiranyagarbha, born Only Lord of all created being. He fixed and holdeth up this earth and heaven. Worship we Ka the God with our oblation.
verses.hindi: -यातुधानों राक्षसो के गतिरूप वे अन्धकारमय लोक हँ जर्होँ चने जङ्गल व १ हे। इनमें अन्य व्यक्तियों से दूर रहते हए वे पीड़ा देने की वृत्ति को भूल १. गत मन्त्र में पृथिवीलोक से निचले असुर्यलोकों का वर्णन किया हेै। प्रस्तुत मन्त्र में उन प्रकाशमय लोकों का उल्लेख करते है जिनमें कि योगयुक्त परित्रार् व रण मेँ पीठ
verses.transliteration: hiraṇyagarbhaḥ samavartatāgre bhūtasya jātaḥ patireka āsīt | sa dādhāra pṛthivīṃ dyāmutemāṃ kasmai devāya haviṣā vidhema
verses.wordMeaning: In the beginning rose Hiranyagarbha, born Only Lord of all created being. He fixed and holdeth up this earth and heaven. Worship we Ka the God with our oblation.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the beginning rose Hiranyagarbha, born Only Lord of all created being. He fixed and holdeth up this earth and heaven. Worship we Ka the God with our oblation.

verses.sanskrit:
द्र॒प्सश्च॑स्कन्द पृथि॒वीमनु॒ द्यामि॒मं च॒ योनि॒मनु॒ यश्च॒ पूर्व॑: ।
स॒मा॒नं योनि॒मनु॑ स॒ञ्चर॑न्तं द्र॒प्सं जु॑हो॒म्यनु॑ स॒प्त होत्रा॑:
verses.translation: The Drop leaped onward through the earth and heaven, along this place and that which was before it. I offer up, throughout the seven oblations, the Drop still moving to the common dwelling.
verses.hindi: प्रभु-कृपा से हम उत्तम कर्म करके उन प्रकाशमय लोकों को प्राप्त करे, जिनमें सूर्य का प्रकाश ज्ञान का प्रतीक है ओर जल शान्ति का। जहाँ ज्ञान है, शान्ति हे। १. गत मन्त्र मेँ हिरण्यगर्भ प्रकाशमय लोकों मे पहुंचने कौ कामना करता है, जिन लोकों में ' लान है, शान्ति" है। एेसा व्यक्ति ही वहाँ पहुंच सकता है जो प्रस्तुत मन्त्र के
verses.transliteration: drapsaścaskanda pṛthivīmanu dyāmimaṃ ca yonimanu yaśca pūrva: | samānaṃ yonimanu sañcarantaṃ drapsaṃ juhomyanu sapta hotrā:
verses.wordMeaning: The Drop leaped onward through the earth and heaven, along this place and that which was before it. I offer up, throughout the seven oblations, the Drop still moving to the common dwelling.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Drop leaped onward through the earth and heaven, along this place and that which was before it. I offer up, throughout the seven oblations, the Drop still moving to the common dwelling.

verses.sanskrit: नमो॑ऽस्तु स॒र्पेभ्यो॒ ये के च॑ पृथि॒वीमनु॑ । ये अ॒न्तरि॑क्षे॒ ये दि॒वि तेभ्य॑: स॒र्पेभ्यो॒ नम॑:
verses.translation: Homage be paid to Serpents unto all of them that are on earth, To those that dwell in air, to those that dwell in sky be homage paid.
verses.hindi: -१. हम क्रियाशील हों। २. क्रियाशीलता से हममे वह धर्षण-शक्ति उत्पन्न हो जो सब शत्रुओं को कुचल डालती है। ३. हम दानपूर्वक अदन से सन्तापक व बारम्बार आक्रमण करनेवाले राक्षसी भावों को उल्काओंं के तुल्य दूर विनष्ट कर दे। १. जैसे वामदेव ने अध्यात्मक्षेत्र मे कामादि शत्रुओं का संहार करना हे. उसी प्रकार
verses.transliteration: namo'stu sarpebhyo ye ke ca pṛthivīmanu | ye antarikṣe ye divi tebhya: sarpebhyo nama:
verses.wordMeaning: Homage be paid to Serpents unto all of them that are on earth, To those that dwell in air, to those that dwell in sky be homage paid.
verses.commentary: Sense: Homage be paid to Serpents unto all of them that are on earth, To those that dwell in air, to those that dwell in sky be homage paid.

verses.sanskrit: या इष॑वो यातु॒धाना॑नां॒ ये वा॒ वन॒स्पतीँ॒१ रनु॑ । ये वा॑व॒टेषु॒ शेर॑ते॒ तेभ्य॑: स॒र्पेभ्यो॒ नम॑:
verses.translation: To those that are the demons’ darts, to those that live upon the trees, To all the Serpents that lie low in holes be adoration paid.
verses.hindi: राजा राष्ट के सब शत्रुओं का विध्वंस करके राष्ट का उत्थान करनेवाला बने। दण्ड-व्यवस्था मे सम्बन्ध का विचार न करके न्याय-मार्गसेदही दण्ड देना चाहिरए्। १. पिछले मन्त्रो के अनुसार राष्ट्-व्यवस्था के उत्तम होने पर प्रत्येक पुरुष को चाहिए कि वह अपने अन्दर दिव्य गुणों को उपजाने के लिए य्नणील हो। वह कैसा बने?
verses.transliteration: yā iṣavo yātudhānānāṃ ye vā vanaspatī~1 ranu | ye vāvaṭeṣu śerate tebhya: sarpebhyo nama:
verses.wordMeaning: To those that are the demons’ darts, to those that live upon the trees, To all the Serpents that lie low in holes be adoration paid.
verses.commentary: Sense: To those that are the demons’ darts, to those that live upon the trees, To all the Serpents that lie low in holes be adoration paid.

verses.sanskrit: ये वा॒मी रो॑च॒ने दि॒वो ये वा॒ सूर्य॑स्य र॒श्मिषु॑ । येषा॑म॒प्सु सद॑स्कृ॒तं तेभ्य॑: स॒र्पेभ्यो॒ नम॑:
verses.translation: Or those that are in heaven's bright sphere, or those that dwell in the Sun's beams: Serpents, whose home has been prepared in waters, homage unto them!
verses.hindi: हमारे हाथ यज्ञात्मक कर्मो में लगे हों, मस्तिष्क ज्ञान में, तथा जिह्वा प्रभु-नामोच्चारण में ओर सात्विक अन्न के सेवन मे। १. स्त्री. भी खूब उन्नत जीवनवाली हो। कैसी? ध्रुवा असि-तू घर में ध्रुव होकर रहनेवाली है। छोटी -छोटी बातों से रूठकर पितृगृह कौ ओर जानेवाली नहीं। साथ ही अपने
verses.transliteration: ye vāmī rocane divo ye vā sūryasya raśmiṣu | yeṣāmapsu sadaskṛtaṃ tebhya: sarpebhyo nama:
verses.wordMeaning: Or those that are in heaven's bright sphere, or those that dwell in the Sun's beams: Serpents, whose home has been prepared in waters, homage unto them!
verses.commentary: Sense: Or those that are in heaven's bright sphere, or those that dwell in the Sun's beams: Serpents, whose home has been prepared in waters, homage unto them!

verses.sanskrit:
कृ॒णु॒ष्व पाज॒: प्रसि॑तिं॒ न पृ॒थ्वीं या॒हि राजे॒वाम॑वाँ॒२  इभे॑न ।
तृ॒ष्वीमनु॒ प्रसि॑तिं द्रूणा॒नोऽस्ता॑सि॒ विध्य॑ र॒क्षस॒स्तपि॑ष्ठैः
verses.translation: Put forth like a wide-spreading net thy vigour: go like a mighty King with his attendants. Thou, following thy swift net, shootest arrows: transfix the fiends with darts that burn most fiercely.
verses.hindi: पत्री धुव हो, धरुण हो, कर्मो में लगी हो, बांके-कछैले युवकों का शिकार न हो जाए। अविचलित होती हुई अपने शरीर को दृद बनाये। १. पत्नी के लिए ही कहते है कि प्रजापतिः सव प्रजाओं का पति प्रभु त्वाचतुञ्ध कर्मो मे व्यापृत रहे। २. समुद्रस्य तू आनन्दमय प्रभु के एमन्प्राप्तव्य स्थान को प्राप्त हो।
verses.transliteration: kṛṇuṣva pāja: prasitiṃ na pṛthvīṃ yāhi rājevāmavā~2 ibhena | tṛṣvīmanu prasitiṃ drūṇāno'stāsi vidhya rakṣasastapiṣṭhaiḥ
verses.wordMeaning: Put forth like a wide-spreading net thy vigour: go like a mighty King with his attendants. Thou, following thy swift net, shootest arrows: transfix the fiends with darts that burn most fiercely.
verses.commentary: Sense: Put forth like a wide-spreading net thy vigour: go like a mighty King with his attendants. Thou, following thy swift net, shootest arrows: transfix the fiends with darts that burn most fiercely.

verses.sanskrit:
तव॑ भ्र॒मास॑ आशु॒या प॑त॒न्त्यनु॑स्पृश धृष॒ता शोशु॑चानः ।
तपू॑ᳪष्यग्ने जु॒ह्वा॒ पत॒ङ्गानस॑न्दितो॒ वि सृ॑ज॒ विष्व॑गु॒ल्काः
verses.translation: Forth go in rapid flight thy whirling weapons: follow them closely glowing in thy fury. Spread with thy tongue the wingd flames, O Agni: unfettered cast thy firebrands all around thee.
verses.hindi: पली क्रियाशील हो, प्रभु के मार्गं पर चले। ज्ञानी, विशाल हदय सन्तति को जन्म दे। वंश का विस्तार करनेवाली हो। १. पली के लिए ही कहते है कि भूः असि=( भवन्ति यस्याम्) तुञ्चसे ही सन्तानं का जन्म होता हे। २. भूमिः असि=( भवन्ति यस्याम्) उत्पन्न होकर सन्तान तेरे ही आधार
verses.transliteration: tava bhramāsa āśuyā patantyanuspṛśa dhṛṣatā śośucānaḥ | tapūṣyagne juhvā pataṅgānasandito vi sṛja viṣvagulkāḥ
verses.wordMeaning: Forth go in rapid flight thy whirling weapons: follow them closely glowing in thy fury. Spread with thy tongue the wingd flames, O Agni: unfettered cast thy firebrands all around thee.
verses.commentary: Sense: Forth go in rapid flight thy whirling weapons: follow them closely glowing in thy fury. Spread with thy tongue the wingd flames, O Agni: unfettered cast thy firebrands all around thee.

verses.sanskrit:
प्रति॒ स्पशो॒ वि सृ॑ज॒ तूर्णि॑तमो॒ भवा॑ पा॒युर्वि॒शो अ॒स्या अद॑ब्धः ।
यो नो॑ दू॒रे अ॒घश॑ᳪसो॒ यो अन्त्यग्ने॒ मा कि॑ष्टे॒ व्यथि॒रा द॑धर्षीत्
verses.translation: Send thy spies forward, fleetest in thy motion: be, ne’er deceived, the guardian of this people From him who, near or far, is bent on evil, and let no trouble sent from thee o’ercome us.
verses.hindi: -एक माता “ अदिति" बनकर दिव्य सन्तानो को जन्म दे। इस प्रकार वह राष्ट का धारण कर सकती है। उसे अपने शरीर को व्यवस्थित, दुद् व स्वस्थ बनाना ५ अव्यवस्थित, ढीली-ढाली व अस्वस्थ माता तो एेसी ही सन्तानो को जन्म देगी जो राष्ट के लिए बोञ्ञ दी होंगे।
verses.transliteration: prati spaśo vi sṛja tūrṇitamo bhavā pāyurviśo asyā adabdhaḥ | yo no dūre aghaśaso yo antyagne mā kiṣṭe vyathirā dadharṣīt
verses.wordMeaning: Send thy spies forward, fleetest in thy motion: be, ne’er deceived, the guardian of this people From him who, near or far, is bent on evil, and let no trouble sent from thee o’ercome us.
verses.commentary: Sense: Send thy spies forward, fleetest in thy motion: be, ne’er deceived, the guardian of this people From him who, near or far, is bent on evil, and let no trouble sent from thee o’ercome us.

verses.sanskrit:
उद॑ग्ने तिष्ठ॒ प्रत्या त॑नुष्व॒ न्यमित्राँ॑२ ओषतात्तिग्महेते ।
यो नो॒ अरा॑तिᳪ समिधान च॒क्रे नी॒चा तं ध॑क्ष्यत॒सं न शुष्क॑म्
verses.translation: Rise up, O Agni, spread thee out before us, burn down our foes, thou who hast sharpened arrows. Him, blazing Agni! who hath worked us mischief, consume thou utterly like dried-up stubble.
verses.hindi: वंश के निर्दोष होने पर वंश हजारो पीडियों तक चलता है तथा वंश में प्रायः शतायु पुरुष होते है। इसका बहुत- कुछ निर्भर पी पर है जो "दूर्वा ' है, वंश के रोगों व बुराइयों का ध्वंस कर देती है। तस्यास्ते देवीष्टके विधेम हविषा वयम् ।॥२९॥
verses.transliteration: udagne tiṣṭha pratyā tanuṣva nyamitrā~2 oṣatāttigmahete | yo no arāti samidhāna cakre nīcā taṃ dhakṣyatasaṃ na śuṣkam
verses.wordMeaning: Rise up, O Agni, spread thee out before us, burn down our foes, thou who hast sharpened arrows. Him, blazing Agni! who hath worked us mischief, consume thou utterly like dried-up stubble.
verses.commentary: Sense: Rise up, O Agni, spread thee out before us, burn down our foes, thou who hast sharpened arrows. Him, blazing Agni! who hath worked us mischief, consume thou utterly like dried-up stubble.

verses.sanskrit:
ऊ॒र्ध्वो भ॑व॒ प्रति॑ वि॒ध्याध्य॒स्मदा॒विष्कृ॑णुष्व॒ दैव्या॑न्यग्ने ।
अव॑ स्थि॒रा त॑नुहि यातु॒जूनां॑ जा॒मिमजा॑मिं॒ प्र मृ॑णीहि॒ शत्रू॑न् ।
अ॒ग्नेष्ट्वा॒ तेज॑सा सादयामि
verses.translation: Rise, Agni, drive off those who fight against us: make manifest thine own celestial vigour. Slacken the strong bows of the demon-driven: destroy our foemen whether kin or stranger. I settle thee with Agni's fiery ardour.
verses.hindi: पल्ली घर में यज्ञो की प्रवर्तिका, इष्टका हे। यज्ञो द्वारा घर में दिव्य गुणों के व्यवस्थापन से यह देवी है। हम अपना सब धन इन्हें सौपकर उनसे दिये गये को खाकर ही इनका समुचित आदर करते है। वे हमारे दीर्घ-जीवन का कारण बनती हैः ओर वंश को विच्छिन्न नहीं होने देतीं।
verses.transliteration: ūrdhvo bhava prati vidhyādhyasmadāviṣkṛṇuṣva daivyānyagne | ava sthirā tanuhi yātujūnāṃ jāmimajāmiṃ pra mṛṇīhi śatrūn | agneṣṭvā tejasā sādayāmi
verses.wordMeaning: Rise, Agni, drive off those who fight against us: make manifest thine own celestial vigour. Slacken the strong bows of the demon-driven: destroy our foemen whether kin or stranger. I settle thee with Agni's fiery ardour.
verses.commentary: Sense: Rise, Agni, drive off those who fight against us: make manifest thine own celestial vigour. Slacken the strong bows of the demon-driven: destroy our foemen whether kin or stranger. I settle thee with Agni's fiery ardour.

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒ग्निर्मू॒र्धा दि॒वः क॒कुत्पति॑: पृथि॒व्या अ॒यम् । अ॒पाᳪ रेता॑ᳪसि जिन्वति ।
इन्द्र॑स्य॒ त्वौज॑सा सादयामि
verses.translation: Agni is head and height of heaven, the Master of the earth is he: He quickeneth the waters’ seed. I settle thee with the great strength of Indra.
verses.hindi: पति-पली का कर्त्तव्य है कि अपने जीवनों को "सूर्य व अग्नि" की भाँति बनाकर घर को स्वर्गं बनाने का प्रयल करें। जयोदखोऽध्यायः ४३० यजुर्वेद भाष्यम् यावो देवाः सूर्ये रुचो गोष्वश्वेषु या रुच॑: ।
verses.transliteration: agnirmūrdhā divaḥ kakutpati: pṛthivyā ayam | apā retāsi jinvati | indrasya tvaujasā sādayāmi
verses.wordMeaning: Agni is head and height of heaven, the Master of the earth is he: He quickeneth the waters’ seed. I settle thee with the great strength of Indra.
verses.commentary: Sense: Agni is head and height of heaven, the Master of the earth is he: He quickeneth the waters’ seed. I settle thee with the great strength of Indra.

verses.sanskrit:
भुवो॑ य॒ज्ञस्य॒ रज॑सश्च ने॒ता यत्रा॑ नि॒युद्भि॒: सच॑से शि॒वाभि॑: ।
दि॒वि मू॒र्धानं॑ दधिषे स्व॒र्षां जि॒ह्वाम॑ग्ने चकृषे हव्य॒वाह॑म्
verses.translation: Thou art the leader of the rite and region to which with thine auspicious teams thou tendest. Thy light-bestowing head to heaven thou liftest, making thy tongue the oblation-bearer, Agni!
verses.hindi: प्रतिक्षण प्रसन्नता से स्वधर्म में लगे रहने से, आलस्य को त्यागकर मूर्तिमान् कर्म बन जाने से मनुष्य १. सर्दी-गर्मीं को सहन कर पाता है। २. उसकौ पाचनशक्ति ठीक बनी ४ हे। ३. उसकी सन्ताने स्वस्थ, सर्वाङ्ग होती है। ४. उसे एक अद्धुत आनन्द प्राप्त तीन समुद्र व तीन स्वर्ग-भूत, वर्तमान व भविष्यत् में,
verses.transliteration: bhuvo yajñasya rajasaśca netā yatrā niyudbhi: sacase śivābhi: | divi mūrdhānaṃ dadhiṣe svarṣāṃ jihvāmagne cakṛṣe havyavāham
verses.wordMeaning: Thou art the leader of the rite and region to which with thine auspicious teams thou tendest. Thy light-bestowing head to heaven thou liftest, making thy tongue the oblation-bearer, Agni!
verses.commentary: Sense: Thou art the leader of the rite and region to which with thine auspicious teams thou tendest. Thy light-bestowing head to heaven thou liftest, making thy tongue the oblation-bearer, Agni!

verses.sanskrit:
ध्रु॒वाऽसि॑ ध॒रुणाऽऽस्तृ॑ता वि॒श्वक॑र्मणा ।
मा त्वा॑ समु॒द्र उद्व॑धी॒न्मा सु॑प॒र्णोऽव्य॑थमाना पृथि॒वीं दृ॑ᳪह
verses.translation: Steady art thou, sustainer, laid by Visvakarman in thy place. Let not the ocean nor the bird harm thee: unshaking, steady earth.
verses.hindi: हमारा जीवन यक्ञमय हो। यज्ञो से हम प्रभु को धारण करनेवाले बनें। विष्णोः कर्माणि पश्यत् यतो व्रतानि पस्पशे । इन्द्रस्य युज्यः सखा ॥ ३३॥ १. गत मन्त्र में यज्ञं पर बल दिया हे। प्रस्तुत मन्त्र में सारे ब्रह्माण्ड का धारण करनेवाले प्रभु की ओर ध्यान दिलाते हैँ ओर कहते हैँ कि विष्णोः = ( विष्णुर्वाव यज्ञः) उस
verses.transliteration: dhruvā'si dharuṇā''stṛtā viśvakarmaṇā | mā tvā samudra udvadhīnmā suparṇo'vyathamānā pṛthivīṃ dṛha
verses.wordMeaning: Steady art thou, sustainer, laid by Visvakarman in thy place. Let not the ocean nor the bird harm thee: unshaking, steady earth.
verses.commentary: Sense: Steady art thou, sustainer, laid by Visvakarman in thy place. Let not the ocean nor the bird harm thee: unshaking, steady earth.

verses.sanskrit: प्र॒जाप॑तिष्ट्वा सादयत्व॒पां पृ॒ष्ठे स॑मु॒द्रस्येम॑न् । व्यच॑स्वतीं॒ प्रथ॑स्वतीं॒ प्रथ॑स्व पृथि॒व्य॒सि
verses.translation: Thee let Prajâpati settle on the waters’ back, in Ocean's course, Thee the capacious, widely spread. Thou art the Wide One: spread thee wide
verses.hindi: प्रभु के कर्मों को देखकर हम अपने कर्तव्यो का निर्धारण करे। एेसा करने पर वे प्रभु सदा हमारे पूर्ण मित्र होते हेै। पल्ली व पति की विशोषतार्ेँ श्चुवासिं धरुणेतो ज॑ज्ञे प्रथममेभ्यो योनिंभ्योऽअधि जातवेदाः ।
verses.transliteration: prajāpatiṣṭvā sādayatvapāṃ pṛṣṭhe samudrasyeman | vyacasvatīṃ prathasvatīṃ prathasva pṛthivyasi
verses.wordMeaning: Thee let Prajâpati settle on the waters’ back, in Ocean's course, Thee the capacious, widely spread. Thou art the Wide One: spread thee wide
verses.commentary: Sense: Thee let Prajâpati settle on the waters’ back, in Ocean's course, Thee the capacious, widely spread. Thou art the Wide One: spread thee wide

verses.sanskrit:
भूर॑सि॒ भूमि॑र॒स्यदि॑तिरसि वि॒श्वधा॑या॒ विश्व॑स्य॒ भुव॑नस्य ध॒र्त्री ।
पृ॒थि॒वीं य॑च्छ पृथि॒वीं दृ॑ᳪह पृथि॒वीं मा हि॑ᳪसीः
verses.translation: Thou art the earth, the ground, thou art the all-sustaining Aditi, she who supporteth all the world. Control the earth, steady the earth, do thou the earth no injury.
verses.hindi: पलरी धरुवा व धरुणा हो। पति हव्य का सेवन करनेवाला हो। इषे राये र॑मस्व सह॑से द्युम्नऽ ऊर्जऽअप॑त्याय । १. इस संसार के अन्दर पति-पली क्या-क्या कर? इसे स्पष्ट करते हुए कहते हें कि इषे=अन्न के लिए राये=धन के लिए रमस्वतू क्रीडा कर, प्रसन्नतापूर्वक यल कर।
verses.transliteration: bhūrasi bhūmirasyaditirasi viśvadhāyā viśvasya bhuvanasya dhartrī | pṛthivīṃ yaccha pṛthivīṃ dṛha pṛthivīṃ mā hisīḥ
verses.wordMeaning: Thou art the earth, the ground, thou art the all-sustaining Aditi, she who supporteth all the world. Control the earth, steady the earth, do thou the earth no injury.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thou art the earth, the ground, thou art the all-sustaining Aditi, she who supporteth all the world. Control the earth, steady the earth, do thou the earth no injury.

verses.sanskrit:
विश्व॑स्मै प्रा॒णाया॑पा॒नाय॑ व्या॒नायो॑दा॒नाय॑ प्रति॒ष्ठायै॑ च॒रित्रा॑य ।
अ॒ग्निष्ट्वा॒ऽभि पा॑तु म॒ह्या स्व॒स्त्या छ॒र्दिषा॒ शन्त॑मेन॒ तया॑ दे॒वत॑याऽङ्गिर॒स्वद् ध्रु॒वा सी॑द
verses.translation: For all breath, out-breath; through-breath, upward-breathing, for high position, for prescribed observance, May Agni keep thee safe with great well-being, with the securest shelter. As aforetime with Angiras, with that Deity lie steady.
verses.hindi: हम स्वराट् बनें। मन ओर वाणी को उपासना व ज्ञान में लगार्ँ। अग्न युक्ष्वा हि ये तवाश्वासो देव साधवः । अरं वह॑न्ति मन्यवे ।॥३६॥ १. गत मन्त्र के अनुसार मनुष्य ‹ स्वराट् '=जितेन्द्रिय बनकर शक्तिशाली बनता हे ओर प्रस्तुत मन्त्र का ऋषि ' भारद्वाज ' होता है-अपने में शक्ति को भरनेवाला। यह प्रभु से
verses.transliteration: viśvasmai prāṇāyāpānāya vyānāyodānāya pratiṣṭhāyai caritrāya | agniṣṭvā'bhi pātu mahyā svastyā chardiṣā śantamena tayā devatayā'ṅgirasvad dhruvā sīda
verses.wordMeaning: For all breath, out-breath; through-breath, upward-breathing, for high position, for prescribed observance, May Agni keep thee safe with great well-being, with the securest shelter. As aforetime with Angiras, with that Deity lie steady.
verses.commentary: Sense: For all breath, out-breath; through-breath, upward-breathing, for high position, for prescribed observance, May Agni keep thee safe with great well-being, with the securest shelter. As aforetime with Angiras, with that Deity lie steady.

verses.sanskrit: काण्डा॑त्काण्डात्प्र॒रोह॑न्ती॒ परु॑षः परुष॒स्परि॑ । ए॒वा नो॑ दूर्वे॒ प्र त॑नु स॒हस्रे॑ण श॒तेन॑ च
verses.translation: Upspringing from thine every joint, upspringing from each knot of thine, Thus with a thousand, Dûrvâ! with a hundred do thou stretch us out.
verses.hindi: विशिष्ट रूपवाला वही बनता है जोकि ९. अपने में दिव्यता का अवतरण करता है। २. दानपूर्वक अदन करता हे। ३. लक्ष्य स्थान पर पहुंचकर ही विश्रान्त होता हे। ४. इन्द्रियाश्वों को पूर्णतया वश में करके उन्हे मार्ग-भ्रष्ट नहीं होने देता ओर आगे-आगे १. गत मन्त्र के अनुसार जब एक व्यक्ति इद्द्रियाश्वों को उत्तम सारथि की भाँति
verses.transliteration: kāṇḍātkāṇḍātprarohantī paruṣaḥ paruṣaspari | evā no dūrve pra tanu sahasreṇa śatena ca
verses.wordMeaning: Upspringing from thine every joint, upspringing from each knot of thine, Thus with a thousand, Dûrvâ! with a hundred do thou stretch us out.
verses.commentary: Sense: Upspringing from thine every joint, upspringing from each knot of thine, Thus with a thousand, Dûrvâ! with a hundred do thou stretch us out.

verses.sanskrit: या श॒तेन॑ प्रत॒नोषि॑ स॒हस्रे॑ण वि॒रोह॑सि । तस्या॑स्ते देवीष्टके वि॒धेम॑ ह॒विषा॑ व॒यम्
verses.translation: Thou spreading with a hundred, thou that branched with a thousand shoots, Thee, such, with our oblation will we worship, O celestial Brick.
verses.hindi: उस प्रभु की प्राप्ति से हमारी वाणी स्तुति ही करती है, निन्दा नहीं। हमारे मनों की रुचियँ उत्तम ही होती हैँ, हीन नहीं। हमारी आंख स्वास्थ्य की दीप्ति से चमकती है ओर श्रोत्र ज्ञान-श्रवण से चमकते है। अन्ततः इस साक्षात् प्रभु को ब्रह्माण्ड का सञ्चालन ५) हए देखते हैँ ओर अपने शरीरो में वैश्वानररूप से अन्न-पाचन भी उसी से होता देखते
verses.transliteration: yā śatena pratanoṣi sahasreṇa virohasi | tasyāste devīṣṭake vidhema haviṣā vayam
verses.wordMeaning: Thou spreading with a hundred, thou that branched with a thousand shoots, Thee, such, with our oblation will we worship, O celestial Brick.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thou spreading with a hundred, thou that branched with a thousand shoots, Thee, such, with our oblation will we worship, O celestial Brick.

verses.sanskrit: यास्ते॑ अग्ने॒ सूर्ये॒ रुचो॒ दिव॑मात॒न्वन्ति॑ र॒श्मिभि॑: । ताभि॑र्नो अ॒द्य सर्वा॑भी रु॒चे जना॑य नस्कृधि
verses.translation: Thy lights, O Agni, in the Sun that with their beams o’erspread the sky,— With all of those assist thou us to-day to light and progeny. 23. Lights of yours in the Sun, O Gods, or lights that are in kine and steeds, O Indra-Agni, with all those vouchsafe us light, Brihaspati!
verses.hindi: -९. विरूप--विशिष्ट रूपवाले के लिए क्रिया इस प्रकार स्वाभाविक हो जाए जैसे वायु के लिए। २, वह किसी से द्धेष न करे। ३. इन्द्रियों को गति व ज्ञान में रखकर विकसित शक्तिवाला हो ओर ४. हृदयदेश में स्थित उस प्रभु को कभी भूले नहीं जो स्तोताओं के ज्ञान को बाते है, उनके कष्टों का निवारण करते हैँ, ओर उनके न
verses.transliteration: yāste agne sūrye ruco divamātanvanti raśmibhi: | tābhirno adya sarvābhī ruce janāya naskṛdhi
verses.wordMeaning: Thy lights, O Agni, in the Sun that with their beams o’erspread the sky,— With all of those assist thou us to-day to light and progeny. 23. Lights of yours in the Sun, O Gods, or lights that are in kine and steeds, O Indra-Agni, with all those vouchsafe us light,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Thy lights, O Agni, in the Sun that with their beams o’erspread the sky,— With all of those assist thou us to-day to light and progeny. 23. Lights of yours in the Sun, O Gods, or lights that are in kine and steeds, O Indra-Agni, with all those vouchsafe us light,…

verses.sanskrit: या वो॑ दे॒वाः सूर्ये॒ रुचो॒ गोष्वश्वे॑षु॒ या रुच॑: । इन्द्रा॑ग्नी॒ ताभि॒: सर्वा॑भी॒ रुचं॑ नो धत्त बृहस्पते
verses.translation: The Far.-Refulgent held the light.
verses.hindi: हम प्रभु का स्मरण करे ओर ज्ञान, स्वास्थ्य व मानस शासन को नष्ट न १. है विरूप! गत मन्त्र के अनुसार स्तवन करनेवाला बनकर विशिष्टरूपता को सिद्ध करनेवाला ओर अग्ने आगे बद्नेवाला! तू परमे व्योमन्इस हदयाकाश में प्रभु के स्थापन के कारण उत्पन्न हुई असुरस्य मायाम् प्राणशक्ति देनेवाले (असून् रातति) प्रभु की
verses.transliteration: yā vo devāḥ sūrye ruco goṣvaśveṣu yā ruca: | indrāgnī tābhi: sarvābhī rucaṃ no dhatta bṛhaspate
verses.wordMeaning: The Far.-Refulgent held the light.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Far.-Refulgent held the light.

verses.sanskrit: वि॒राड्ज्योति॑रधारयत्स्व॒राड्ज्योति॑रधारयत् । प्र॒जाप॑तिष्ट्वा सादयतु पृ॒ष्ठे पृ॑थि॒व्या ज्योति॑ष्मतीम् । विश्व॑स्मै प्रा॒णाया॑पा॒नाय॑ व्या॒नाय॒ विश्वं॒ ज्योति॑र्यच्छ । अ॒ग्निष्टेऽधि॑पति॒स्तया॑ दे॒वत॑याऽङ्गिर॒स्वद् ध्रु॒वा सी॑द
verses.translation: The Self-Refulgent held the light. Thee, luminous, may Prajâpati settle upon the back of Earth. Give, to all breathing, all the light, to out-breath, to diffusive breath. Thy Sovran Lord is Agni. With that Deity, as with Angiras, lie firmly settled in thy place.
verses.hindi: हम हदयाकाश में प्रकट होनेवाले प्रभु के प्रकाश को नष्ट न होने दे, यचुर्वेदभाव्यम् ४४३ योदस्ोऽध्यायः जिससे हम द्वेष व दुर्गुणों से ऊपर उठकर सहस्रशः प्राणियों का कल्याण करनेवाले बने। योऽअग्निर ग्नेरध्यजायत् शोकात्पृथिव्याऽ ङ्त वां दिवस्परि ।
verses.transliteration: virāḍjyotiradhārayatsvarāḍjyotiradhārayat | prajāpatiṣṭvā sādayatu pṛṣṭhe pṛthivyā jyotiṣmatīm | viśvasmai prāṇāyāpānāya vyānāya viśvaṃ jyotiryaccha | agniṣṭe'dhipatistayā devatayā'ṅgirasvad dhruvā sīda
verses.wordMeaning: The Self-Refulgent held the light. Thee, luminous, may Prajâpati settle upon the back of Earth. Give, to all breathing, all the light, to out-breath, to diffusive breath. Thy Sovran Lord is Agni. With that Deity, as with Angiras, lie firmly settled in thy place.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Self-Refulgent held the light. Thee, luminous, may Prajâpati settle upon the back of Earth. Give, to all breathing, all the light, to out-breath, to diffusive breath. Thy Sovran Lord is Agni. With that Deity, as with Angiras, lie firmly settled in thy place.

verses.sanskrit:
मधु॑श्च॒ माध॑वश्च॒ वास॑न्तिकावृ॒तू अ॒ग्नेर॑न्तः श्ले॒षो॒ऽसि॒ कल्पे॑तां॒ द्यावा॑पृथि॒वी कल्प॑न्ता॒माप॒ ओष॑धय॒: कल्प॑न्ताम॒ग्नय॒: पृथ॒ङ्नम॒ ज्यैष्ठ्या॑य॒ सव्र॑ताः । ये अ॒ग्नय॒: सम॑नसोऽन्त॒रा द्यावा॑पृथि॒वी इ॒मे |
वास॑न्तिकावृ॒तू अ॑भि॒कल्प॑माना॒ इन्द्र॑मिव दे॒वा अ॑भि॒संवि॑शन्तु॒ तया॑ दे॒वत॑याऽङ्गिर॒स्वद् ध्रु॒वे सी॑दतम्
verses.translation: Madhu and Mâdhava, the two Spring seasons—thou art the innermost cement of Agni. May Heaven and Earth, may Waters, Plants and Agnis help, separate, accordant, my precedence. May all the Fires ’twixt heaven and earth, one-minded, well-fitted, gather round these two Spring seasons, As the Gods gathering encompass Indra: firm with that Deity, Angiras-like, be seated.
verses.hindi: प्रभु का प्रिय वह होता है जो १. उत्तम माता, पिता व आचार्य के सम्पर्क में आकर ज्ञानी बनता है। २. शरीर मेँ स्वास्थ्य की कान्तिवाला होता है। ३. मस्तिष्क मं ज्ञानाग्नि से दीप्त होता है तथा ४. उत्तम सन्तान का निर्माण करता है ओर उस सन्तान को प्रभु की ही समञ्जता हे।
verses.transliteration: madhuśca mādhavaśca vāsantikāvṛtū agnerantaḥ śleṣo'si kalpetāṃ dyāvāpṛthivī kalpantāmāpa oṣadhaya: kalpantāmagnaya: pṛthaṅnama jyaiṣṭhyāya savratāḥ | ye agnaya: samanaso'ntarā dyāvāpṛthivī ime | vāsantikāvṛtū abhikalpamānā indramiva devā abhisaṃviśantu tayā devatayā'ṅgirasvad dhruve sīdatam
verses.wordMeaning: Madhu and Mâdhava, the two Spring seasons—thou art the innermost cement of Agni. May Heaven and Earth, may Waters, Plants and Agnis help, separate, accordant, my precedence. May all the Fires ’twixt heaven and earth, one-minded, well-fitted,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Madhu and Mâdhava, the two Spring seasons—thou art the innermost cement of Agni. May Heaven and Earth, may Waters, Plants and Agnis help, separate, accordant, my precedence. May all the Fires ’twixt heaven and earth, one-minded, well-fitted,…

verses.sanskrit:
अषा॑ढाऽसि॒ सह॑माना॒ सह॒स्वारा॑ती॒: सह॑स्व पृतनाय॒तः ।
स॒हस्र॑वीर्याऽसि॒ सा मा॑ जिन्व
verses.translation: Thou art Ashâdhâ, Conquering One. Conquer our foemen, conquer thou the men who fain would-fight with us. A thousand manly powers hast thou: so do thou aid and quicken me.
verses.hindi: हम सब देवों के तेज प्रभु का सर्वत्र दर्शन करे ओर उसी को अन्तयीमी जान अपने में "पौरुष' के रूप में उस प्रभु को देखें। १. गत मन्त्र के अनुसार सन जंगम स्थावर के अन्दर प्रभु व्याप्त हो रहे है। सबमें प्रभु को व्याप्ति को देखनेवाला कभी किसी की हिंसा नहीं कर सकता, अतः प्रभु कहते
verses.transliteration: aṣāḍhā'si sahamānā sahasvārātī: sahasva pṛtanāyataḥ | sahasravīryā'si sā mā jinva
verses.wordMeaning: Thou art Ashâdhâ, Conquering One. Conquer our foemen, conquer thou the men who fain would-fight with us. A thousand manly powers hast thou: so do thou aid and quicken me.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thou art Ashâdhâ, Conquering One. Conquer our foemen, conquer thou the men who fain would-fight with us. A thousand manly powers hast thou: so do thou aid and quicken me.

verses.sanskrit:
मधु॒ वाता॑ ऋताय॒ते मधु॑ क्षरन्ति॒ सिन्ध॑वः ।
माध्वी॑र्नः स॒न्त्वोष॑धीः
verses.translation: The winds waft sweets, the rivers pour sweets for the man who keeps the Law: So may the plants be sweet for us.
verses.hindi: घोडा तेरे लिए अत्यन्त उपयोगी पशु है। आरण्य गौरमृग भी तेरे जीवन में उपयोगी है। यदि वह संख्या मेँ बहुत बद़कर तुम्हारी कृषि आदि के विनाशक हो जाँ तभी १. इमम्=इस साहस््रम्-( सहस््रोपकारक्षमम्-म०) हजारों का उपकार करने में समर्थ शतधारम्-शतसंख्याक क्षीर धाराओं से युक्त उत्सम्न्द्ध के कूं के समान अतएव
verses.transliteration: madhu vātā ṛtāyate madhu kṣaranti sindhavaḥ | mādhvīrnaḥ santvoṣadhīḥ
verses.wordMeaning: The winds waft sweets, the rivers pour sweets for the man who keeps the Law: So may the plants be sweet for us.
verses.commentary: Sense: The winds waft sweets, the rivers pour sweets for the man who keeps the Law: So may the plants be sweet for us.

verses.sanskrit: मधु॒ नक्त॑मु॒तोषसो॒ मधु॑म॒त्पार्थि॑व॒ᳪ रज॑: । मधु॒ द्यौर॑स्तु नः पि॒ता
verses.translation: Sweet be the night and sweet the dawns, sweet the terrestrial atmosphere: Sweet be our Father Heaven to us.
verses.hindi: -गौ मनुष्य के लिए अत्यन्त उपकारी पशु है, इसे मारना नहीं, गवय से भी प्रेम करना है। हाँ, यदि वह ध्वंसक हो जार्णँँ तब उसे समाप्त करना ही है। यह न भूलना कि यह गौ तेरे लिए " अदिति" है-तेरा किसी भी तरह खण्डन न होने देनेवाली हे, अतः तू भी इसका खण्डन न करना, इसे † अघ्न्या" समञ्चना।
verses.transliteration: madhu naktamutoṣaso madhumatpārthiva raja: | madhu dyaurastu naḥ pitā
verses.wordMeaning: Sweet be the night and sweet the dawns, sweet the terrestrial atmosphere: Sweet be our Father Heaven to us.
verses.commentary: Sense: Sweet be the night and sweet the dawns, sweet the terrestrial atmosphere: Sweet be our Father Heaven to us.

verses.sanskrit: मधु॑मान्नो॒ वन॒स्पति॒र्मधु॑माँ२  अस्तु॒ सूर्य॑: । माध्वी॒र्गावो॑ भवन्तु नः
verses.translation: May the tall tree be full of sweets for us and, and full of sweets the Sun: May our milch-kine be sweet for us.
verses.hindi: हम भेड् कौ उपयोगिता समञ्े। ऊँट भी कितना उपयोगी है, परन्तु यदि वह पागल होकर ध्वंसक हो जाता है तब तो उसे समाप्त करना दही होता हेै। अजो ह्यग्नेरजनिष्ट शोकात्सोऽअपश्यज्जनितार मग्र । तेन॑ देवा देवतामग्र॑मारयंस्तेन १. आजः (जज गतिक्षेपणयोः) क्रियाशीलता के द्वारा सब बुराइयों को दूर निराकृत
verses.transliteration: madhumānno vanaspatirmadhumā~2 astu sūrya: | mādhvīrgāvo bhavantu naḥ
verses.wordMeaning: May the tall tree be full of sweets for us and, and full of sweets the Sun: May our milch-kine be sweet for us.
verses.commentary: Sense: May the tall tree be full of sweets for us and, and full of sweets the Sun: May our milch-kine be sweet for us.

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒पां गम्भ॑न्त्सीद॒ मा त्वा॒ सूर्यो॒ऽभि ता॑प्सी॒न्माऽग्निर्वै॑श्वान॒रः ।
अच्छि॑न्नपत्राः प्र॒जा अ॑नु॒वीक्ष॒स्वानु॑ त्वा दि॒व्या वृष्टि॑: सचताम्
verses.translation: Seat thyself in the deepness of the waters, lest Sûrya, lest Vaisvânara Agni scorch thee. With wing unclipped, survey created beings: may rain that cometh down from heaven attend thee.
verses.hindi: हम “अज! की रक्षा कररे। अप्रीतिकर हानिकर शरभ को दूर करे। सूचना- परमं वै एतत् पयः यदजाक्षीरम्-तै० ५।९।७-सवबसे बकर यह दूध है जो आग्नेयी वा एषा यदजा त° ३।७।३।९--यह अजा अग्नितत्तव प्रधान है। सा अजायत् त्रिः संवत्सरस्य विजायते तेन परमःपशुः-श० ३।३।३।८ यह अजा वर्ष में तीन बार
verses.transliteration: apāṃ gambhantsīda mā tvā sūryo'bhi tāpsīnmā'gnirvaiśvānaraḥ | acchinnapatrāḥ prajā anuvīkṣasvānu tvā divyā vṛṣṭi: sacatām
verses.wordMeaning: Seat thyself in the deepness of the waters, lest Sûrya, lest Vaisvânara Agni scorch thee. With wing unclipped, survey created beings: may rain that cometh down from heaven attend thee.
verses.commentary: Sense: Seat thyself in the deepness of the waters, lest Sûrya, lest Vaisvânara Agni scorch thee. With wing unclipped, survey created beings: may rain that cometh down from heaven attend thee.

verses.sanskrit:
त्रीन्त्स॑मु॒द्रान्त्सम॑सृपत् स्व॒र्गान॒पां पति॑र्वृष॒भ इष्ट॑कानाम् ।
पुरी॑षं॒ वसा॑नः सुकृ॒तस्य॑ लो॒के तत्र॑ गच्छ॒ यत्र॒ पूर्वे॒ परे॑ताः
verses.translation: He crept across the three heaven-reaching oceans, the Bull of Bricks, the Master of the Waters. Clad in the world with his, the Well-Made's, vesture, go whither those before thee have departed.
verses.hindi: -हम मन्त्र में वर्णित २० भागों में विभक्त ज्ञान को प्राप्त करनेवाले बने। व्यर्थ की बातों में दिमाग को खराब करके ' मोघनज्ञान' न बन जापँ। अग्नि (पुरो भुवः) प्राण-ग्रहण=वसिष्ठ १. अयम्=यह पुरः भुवः पूर्वं दिशा मे होनेवाला अग्नि है (भवति सर्वरूपेण,
verses.transliteration: trīntsamudrāntsamasṛpat svargānapāṃ patirvṛṣabha iṣṭakānām | purīṣaṃ vasānaḥ sukṛtasya loke tatra gaccha yatra pūrve paretāḥ
verses.wordMeaning: He crept across the three heaven-reaching oceans, the Bull of Bricks, the Master of the Waters. Clad in the world with his, the Well-Made's, vesture, go whither those before thee have departed.
verses.commentary: Sense: He crept across the three heaven-reaching oceans, the Bull of Bricks, the Master of the Waters. Clad in the world with his, the Well-Made's, vesture, go whither those before thee have departed.

verses.sanskrit: म॒ही द्यौः पृ॑थि॒वी च॑ न इ॒मं य॒ज्ञं मि॑मिक्षताम् । पि॒पृ॒तां नो॒ भरी॑मभिः
verses.translation: May Heaven and Earth, the Mighty Pair, besprinkle this our sacrifice, And feed us full with nourishments.
verses.hindi: हम पूर्व दिशा के अधिपति अग्नि को अपनाकर अपने में प्राणशक्ति का धारण करते हुए उत्तम प्राणशक्ति- सम्पन्न सन्तानो को जन्म देनेवाले बने। वायु (दक्षिणा विश्वकर्मा ) मनो-ग्रहण= भरद्वाज अयं दक्षिणा विश्वकर्मां तस्य मनो वैश्वकर्मणं ग्रीष्मो मांनसस्िष्टुल्गरष्मी
verses.transliteration: mahī dyauḥ pṛthivī ca na imaṃ yajñaṃ mimikṣatām | pipṛtāṃ no bharīmabhiḥ
verses.wordMeaning: May Heaven and Earth, the Mighty Pair, besprinkle this our sacrifice, And feed us full with nourishments.
verses.commentary: Sense: May Heaven and Earth, the Mighty Pair, besprinkle this our sacrifice, And feed us full with nourishments.

verses.sanskrit: विष्णो॒: कर्मा॑णि पश्यत॒ यतो॑ व्र॒तानि॑ पस्प॒शे । इन्द्र॑स्य॒ युज्य॒: सखा॑
verses.translation: Look ye on Vishnu's works whereby the Friend of Indra, close allied, Hath let his holy ways be seen.
verses.hindi: हम इस दक्षिणा के अधिपति वायु के समान सदा, सब कर्मों के अधिपति होते हए उत्तम क्रियाशील, जितमनाः=मनस्वी सन्तानं को ही जन्म देनेवाले हो। त्रयोदशेऽध्यायः ४५र यजुर्केदभाव्यम् १. अयम्=यह पश्चात् विश्वव्यचाः (असौ वादित्यो विश्वव्यचाः यदाह मैवेष
verses.transliteration: viṣṇo: karmāṇi paśyata yato vratāni paspaśe | indrasya yujya: sakhā
verses.wordMeaning: Look ye on Vishnu's works whereby the Friend of Indra, close allied, Hath let his holy ways be seen.
verses.commentary: Sense: Look ye on Vishnu's works whereby the Friend of Indra, close allied, Hath let his holy ways be seen.

verses.sanskrit:
ध्रु॒वाऽसि॑ ध॒रुणे॒तो ज॑ज्ञे प्रथ॒ममे॒भ्यो योनि॑भ्यो॒ अधि॑ जा॒तवे॑दा: ।
स गा॑य॒त्र्या त्रि॒ष्टुभा॑ऽनु॒ष्टुभा॑ च दे॒वेभ्यो॑ ह॒व्यं व॑हतु प्रजा॒नन्
verses.translation: Firm art thou, a sustainer. Hence engendered, forth from these wombs at first came Jâtavedas. By Gâyatrî, by Trishtup, by Anushtup, may he who knows bear to the Gods oblation.
verses.hindi: -हम निरन्तर पश्चिम कौ ओर चलनेवाले सूर्य के समान ज्ञान व प्रकाश के अधिपति हों। अपनी चक्षु को वश में करके उत्तम सन्तानों को प्राप्त करे। १. इदम्=यह उत्तरात्-उत्तर कौ ओर स्वः=दिशा्पँ अधिपति रूपेण हे। (स्वर्गो हि लोको दिशः श० ८।१।२।४)। ये दिशाँ निर्देशों का-उपदेशों का प्रतीक हैँ प्रत्येक दिशा
verses.transliteration: dhruvā'si dharuṇeto jajñe prathamamebhyo yonibhyo adhi jātavedā: | sa gāyatryā triṣṭubhā'nuṣṭubhā ca devebhyo havyaṃ vahatu prajānan
verses.wordMeaning: Firm art thou, a sustainer. Hence engendered, forth from these wombs at first came Jâtavedas. By Gâyatrî, by Trishtup, by Anushtup, may he who knows bear to the Gods oblation.
verses.commentary: Sense: Firm art thou, a sustainer. Hence engendered, forth from these wombs at first came Jâtavedas. By Gâyatrî, by Trishtup, by Anushtup, may he who knows bear to the Gods oblation.

verses.sanskrit: इ॒षे रा॒ये र॑मस्व॒ सह॑से द्यु॒म्न ऊ॒र्जे अप॑त्याय । स॒म्राड॑सि स्व॒राड॑सि सारस्व॒तौ त्वोत्सौ॒ प्राव॑ताम्
verses.translation: Take thou thine ease for food, for store of riches, for might in splendour, and for strength and offspring. Thou art all-ruling, independent Ruler: both fountains of Sarasvatî protect thee!
verses.hindi: जलो मे, अग्निमेव समुद्रो में प्रभु की महिमा का प्रकाश हो रहा हे। म अपने ज्ञान को बद्धाकर पवित्र व विशाल हदय मं प्रभु का दर्शन करूं। १. गत मन्त्र के अनुसार जिस प्रभु की महिमा का गायन जल, अग्निव समुद्र कर रहे है, वह ब्रह्म =( बृहि वृद्धौ) सदा वृद्ध है, सदा से बद हुए हे, उनमें कोई वृद्धि नहीं
verses.transliteration: iṣe rāye ramasva sahase dyumna ūrje apatyāya | samrāḍasi svarāḍasi sārasvatau tvotsau prāvatām
verses.wordMeaning: Take thou thine ease for food, for store of riches, for might in splendour, and for strength and offspring. Thou art all-ruling, independent Ruler: both fountains of Sarasvatî protect thee!
verses.commentary: Sense: Take thou thine ease for food, for store of riches, for might in splendour, and for strength and offspring. Thou art all-ruling, independent Ruler: both fountains of Sarasvatî protect thee!

verses.sanskrit: अग्ने॑ यु॒क्ष्वा हि ये तवाश्वा॑सो देव सा॒धव॑: । अरं॒ वह॑न्ति म॒न्यवे॑
verses.translation: O radiant Agni, harness thou thy steeds which are most excellent! They bear thee as thy spirit wills.
verses.hindi: लोकत्रयी में निर्मित सभी पिण्ड प्रभु की महिमा को प्रकट कर रहे है ओर उन लोकों के द्वारा हमारी अन्न-प्राप्ति की सुन्दर व्यवस्था हो रही है) १. गत मन्त्र के ' पृथिवी, अन्तरिक्ष व द्युलोक ' में होनेवाले लोकों के अतिरिक्त कुच वे लोक भी टै जो “असुर्या नाम ते लोका अन्धेन तमसावृताः ' = अन्ध- तमस् से
verses.transliteration: agne yukṣvā hi ye tavāśvāso deva sādhava: | araṃ vahanti manyave
verses.wordMeaning: O radiant Agni, harness thou thy steeds which are most excellent! They bear thee as thy spirit wills.
verses.commentary: Sense: O radiant Agni, harness thou thy steeds which are most excellent! They bear thee as thy spirit wills.

verses.sanskrit: यु॒क्ष्वा हि दे॑व॒हूत॑माँ२  अश्वाँ॑२ अग्ने र॒थीरि॑व । नि होता॑ पू॒र्व्यः स॑दः
verses.translation: Yoke, Agni, as a charioteer, thy steeds who best invoke the Gods: As ancient Hotar take thy seat.
verses.hindi: शक्तिशाली बन। सांसारिक भोगों को बन्धन समञ्च। जितेद्दरिय बनकर बन्धनो को नष्ट कर डाल। तपुंशशष्यग्ने जुह्वा पतद्घानसंद्दितो विसुंज विष्वगुल्काः ।९०॥ १. प्रभु वामदेव से ही कह रहे है कि तव=तेरे आशुया=शीघ्र गतिवाले भ्रमासः=
verses.transliteration: yukṣvā hi devahūtamā~2 aśvā~2 agne rathīriva | ni hotā pūrvyaḥ sadaḥ
verses.wordMeaning: Yoke, Agni, as a charioteer, thy steeds who best invoke the Gods: As ancient Hotar take thy seat.
verses.commentary: Sense: Yoke, Agni, as a charioteer, thy steeds who best invoke the Gods: As ancient Hotar take thy seat.

verses.sanskrit:
स॒म्यक् स्र॑वन्ति स॒रितो॒ न धेना॑ अ॒न्तर्हृ॒दा मन॑सा पू॒यमा॑नाः ।
घृ॒तस्य॒ धारा॑ अ॒भि चा॑कशीमि हिर॒ण्ययो॑ वेत॒सो मध्ये॑ अ॒ग्नेः
verses.translation: Like rivers our libations flow together, cleansing themselves in inmost heart and spirit. I look upon the flowing streams of butter: the golden reed is in the midst of Agni.
verses.hindi: राजा स्वयं आलस्यादि शत्रुजों से मुक्त होता हा प्रजा कौ शत्रुओं से रक्षा करे, जिससे सुरक्षित प्रजाँ उन्नति-पथ पर आगे बदनेवाली बनें। १. पिले मन्त्र के ही विषय को इस रूप मेँ कहते है कि अग्ने उत् तिष्ठे राजन्! तू ऊपर उठ। आलस्य को छोडकर प्रजा-रक्षण के कार्य के लिए उद्यत हो जा।
verses.transliteration: samyak sravanti sarito na dhenā antarhṛdā manasā pūyamānāḥ | ghṛtasya dhārā abhi cākaśīmi hiraṇyayo vetaso madhye agneḥ
verses.wordMeaning: Like rivers our libations flow together, cleansing themselves in inmost heart and spirit. I look upon the flowing streams of butter: the golden reed is in the midst of Agni.
verses.commentary: Sense: Like rivers our libations flow together, cleansing themselves in inmost heart and spirit. I look upon the flowing streams of butter: the golden reed is in the midst of Agni.

verses.sanskrit:
ऋ॒चे त्वा॑ रु॒चे त्वा॑ भा॒से त्वा॒ ज्योति॑षे त्वा ।
अभू॑दि॒दं विश्व॑स्य॒ भुव॑नस्य॒ वाजि॑नम॒ग्नेर्वै॑श्वान॒रस्य॑ च
verses.translation: Thee for the praise-verse, thee for sheen, thee for bright splendour, thee for light. This hath become the energetic spirit of all the world and of Vaisvânara Agni.
verses.hindi: राजा प्रजा के शत्रुओं का दहन करता हुआ प्रजा को उन्नति का सु-अवसर ऊर्ध्वो भ॑व प्रतिं विध्याध्यस्मदाविष्कणुष्ठ हैव्यान्यग्ने । १. गत मन्त्र की भावना को ही पुनः दुहराते है कि अग्ने ऊर्ध्वः भवह राजन्! तू आलस्य को छोडकर उठ खडा हो। तुञ्ये सदा "जागृवि" बनना हे-जागना है। २. प्रतिविध्य
verses.transliteration: ṛce tvā ruce tvā bhāse tvā jyotiṣe tvā | abhūdidaṃ viśvasya bhuvanasya vājinamagnervaiśvānarasya ca
verses.wordMeaning: Thee for the praise-verse, thee for sheen, thee for bright splendour, thee for light. This hath become the energetic spirit of all the world and of Vaisvânara Agni.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thee for the praise-verse, thee for sheen, thee for bright splendour, thee for light. This hath become the energetic spirit of all the world and of Vaisvânara Agni.

verses.sanskrit: अ॒ग्निर्ज्योति॑षा॒ ज्योति॑ष्मान् रु॒क्मो वर्च॑सा॒ वर्च॑स्वान् । स॒ह॒स्र॒दा अ॑सि स॒हस्रा॑य त्वा
verses.translation: Agni, all-luminous with light, splendid with splendour, golden One. Giver of thousands art thou: for a thousand thee.
verses.hindi: हम आगे बदँ, शिखर तक पहुचे, लान से महान् बनें, शरीर के स्वास्थ्य की रक्षा करं ओर इस प्रकार इन्द्रशक्ति के विकास के लिए रेतःकणों का अपने मेँ पोषण करे। तीनों वृष्टिकोणों से शिखर पर-त्रिशिराः भुवो यज्ञस्य रज॑सश्च नेता यत्रां नियुद्धिः सच॑से शिवाभिः ।
verses.transliteration: agnirjyotiṣā jyotiṣmān rukmo varcasā varcasvān | sahasradā asi sahasrāya tvā
verses.wordMeaning: Agni, all-luminous with light, splendid with splendour, golden One. Giver of thousands art thou: for a thousand thee.
verses.commentary: Sense: Agni, all-luminous with light, splendid with splendour, golden One. Giver of thousands art thou: for a thousand thee.

verses.sanskrit:
आ॒दि॒त्यं गर्भं॒ पय॑सा॒ सम॑ङ्धि स॒हस्र॑स्य प्रति॒मां वि॒श्वरू॑पम् ।
परि॑ वृङ्धि॒ हर॑सा॒ माऽभि म॑ᳪस्थाः श॒तायु॑षं कृणुहि ची॒यमा॑नः
verses.translation: Balm thou with milk the unborn babe Âditya, wearing all forms, creator of a thousand. Spare, him with heat, nor plot against him: give him a hundred years of life while thou art building.
verses.hindi: पति का मुख्य कार्य यह है कि वह उत्तम घर तथा महनीय योगक्षेम (खान-पान की सामग्री) कौ प्राप्त कराने के लिए यलशील हो। पली इस बात का ध्यान रक्खे कि गृहसभ्यों की प्राण, अपान, व्यान व उदान शक्तियाँ ठीक बनी रहें। घर कौ प्रतिष्ठा बदे तथा सदाचार का मापक ऊँचा बना रहे।
verses.transliteration: ādityaṃ garbhaṃ payasā samaṅdhi sahasrasya pratimāṃ viśvarūpam | pari vṛṅdhi harasā mā'bhi masthāḥ śatāyuṣaṃ kṛṇuhi cīyamānaḥ
verses.wordMeaning: Balm thou with milk the unborn babe Âditya, wearing all forms, creator of a thousand. Spare, him with heat, nor plot against him: give him a hundred years of life while thou art building.
verses.commentary: Sense: Balm thou with milk the unborn babe Âditya, wearing all forms, creator of a thousand. Spare, him with heat, nor plot against him: give him a hundred years of life while thou art building.

verses.sanskrit:
वात॑स्य जू॒तिं वरु॑णस्य॒ नाभि॒मश्वं॑ जज्ञा॒नᳪ स॑रि॒रस्य॒ मध्ये॑ ।
शिशुं॑ न॒दीना॒ᳪ ह॒रि॒मद्रि॑बुध्न॒मग्ने॒ मा हि॑ᳪसीः पर॒मे व्यो॑मन्
verses.translation: The wind's impetuous rush, Varuna's navel! the horse that springs to life amid the waters! The rivers’ tawny child, based on the mountain, harm not, O Agni, in the loftiest region.
verses.hindi: में लिखते हैँ“ यत्र स्त्रीपुरुषौ परस्परं प्रीतिमन्तौ स्यातां तत्र सर्व कल्याणमेव '=पति-पती करे प्रीतिमान होने पर सब शुभ-ही-शुभ होता है, अतः मन्त्र में कहते है कि ताभिः सर्वाभिः=उन सब प्रीतियों से नः=हमें (अस्मान्) रुचे=-शोभा के लिए कृथि=कीजिए। इन परस्पर प्रीतियों से सन्तानो के सब लक्षण शुभ-ही-शुभ होते हैँ । उस प्रीति को नः=हमारी
verses.transliteration: vātasya jūtiṃ varuṇasya nābhimaśvaṃ jajñāna sarirasya madhye | śiśuṃ nadīnā harimadribudhnamagne mā hisīḥ parame vyoman
verses.wordMeaning: The wind's impetuous rush, Varuna's navel! the horse that springs to life amid the waters! The rivers’ tawny child, based on the mountain, harm not, O Agni, in the loftiest region.
verses.commentary: Sense: The wind's impetuous rush, Varuna's navel! the horse that springs to life amid the waters! The rivers’ tawny child, based on the mountain, harm not, O Agni, in the loftiest region.

verses.sanskrit:
अज॑स्र॒मिन्दु॑मरु॒षं भु॑र॒ण्युम॒ग्निमी॑डे पू॒र्वचि॑त्तिं॒ नमो॑भिः ।
स पर्व॑भिरृतु॒शः कल्प॑मानो॒ गां मा हि॑ᳪसी॒रदि॑तिं वि॒राज॑म्
verses.translation: Unwasting Drop, red, eager, pressing forward, Agni I worship with repeated homage. Forming thyself with joints in proper order, harm not the Cow, Aditi widely ruling!
verses.hindi: माता-पिता व आचार्य जब उत्तम मस्तिष्क, ज्ानेन्द्रियों व कर्मन्द्रियोवाले होते है तब वे सन्तानों के जीवनों को भी ज्योतिर्मय बना पाते हे। अग्निष्टे ऽधिंपतिस्तयां देवत॑याङ्धिर स्वद् श्चुवा सीद ॥। २४॥ १. पिछले मन्त्र की समाप्ति ' सन्तानो में ज्योति के धारण पर' हुई थी। इस ज्योति
verses.transliteration: ajasramindumaruṣaṃ bhuraṇyumagnimīḍe pūrvacittiṃ namobhiḥ | sa parvabhirṛtuśaḥ kalpamāno gāṃ mā hisīraditiṃ virājam
verses.wordMeaning: Unwasting Drop, red, eager, pressing forward, Agni I worship with repeated homage. Forming thyself with joints in proper order, harm not the Cow, Aditi widely ruling!
verses.commentary: Sense: Unwasting Drop, red, eager, pressing forward, Agni I worship with repeated homage. Forming thyself with joints in proper order, harm not the Cow, Aditi widely ruling!

verses.sanskrit:
वरू॑त्रीं॒ त्वष्टु॒र्वरु॑णस्य॒ नाभि॒मविं॑ जज्ञा॒नाᳪ रज॑स॒: पर॑स्मात् ।
म॒हीᳪ सा॑ह॒स्रीमसु॑रस्य मा॒यामग्ने॒ मा हि॑ᳪसीः पर॒मे व्यो॑मन्
verses.translation: Her who is Tvashtar's guardian, Varuna's navel, the Ewe brought forth from out the loftiest region, The Asura's mighty thousandfold contrivance, injure not in the highest sphere, O Agni.
verses.hindi: विराट् पिता ओर ज्योतिष्मती माता ही सन्तानो में ज्योति का धारण कर क्मधुश्च माध॑वश्च वासंन्तिकावृतूऽअग्नेरन्तःश्ले ष्ठो ऽसि कल्पैतां द्यावापृथिवी स्येऽअग्नयः सम॑नसो ऽन्तरा दद्यावांपृथिवीऽ इमे । वासंन्तिकावृतूऽअंभिकल्प॑- मानाऽइन्द्र॑मिव देवाऽअंभिसंविंशन्तु तया देवत॑याङ्धिर स्वद् श्रुवे सीदतम् ॥ २५॥
verses.transliteration: varūtrīṃ tvaṣṭurvaruṇasya nābhimaviṃ jajñānā rajasa: parasmāt | mahī sāhasrīmasurasya māyāmagne mā hisīḥ parame vyoman
verses.wordMeaning: Her who is Tvashtar's guardian, Varuna's navel, the Ewe brought forth from out the loftiest region, The Asura's mighty thousandfold contrivance, injure not in the highest sphere, O Agni.
verses.commentary: Sense: Her who is Tvashtar's guardian, Varuna's navel, the Ewe brought forth from out the loftiest region, The Asura's mighty thousandfold contrivance, injure not in the highest sphere, O Agni.

verses.sanskrit:
यो अ॒ग्निर॒ग्नेरध्यजा॑यत॒ शोका॑त्पृथि॒व्या उ॒त वा॑ दि॒वस्परि॑ ।
येन॑ प्र॒जा वि॒श्वक॑र्मा ज॒जान॒ तम॑ग्ने॒ हेड॒: परि॑ ते वृणक्तु
verses.translation: The Agni who from Agni had his being, from heat of Earth or also heat of Heaven, Whereby the Omnific One engendered creatures, him may thy fierce displeasure spare, O Agni.
verses.hindi: पति-पली १. मधु-माधव हों, २. वासन्तिक हों, ३. ऋतु हों, ४. हदय में प्रभु का आलिङ्गन करनेवाले हो, ५. शरीर व मस्तिष्क को सशक्त बनाएँ, ६. जलो व वनस्पतियों का ही सेवन करे, ७. उत्तम माता-पिता व आचार्यवाले हों, ८. इनके माता-पिता व आचार्य का ध्येय इन्हें ज्येष्ठ बनाना हो, ९. वस्तुतः सब माता-पिता व आचार्य परस्पर
verses.transliteration: yo agniragneradhyajāyata śokātpṛthivyā uta vā divaspari | yena prajā viśvakarmā jajāna tamagne heḍa: pari te vṛṇaktu
verses.wordMeaning: The Agni who from Agni had his being, from heat of Earth or also heat of Heaven, Whereby the Omnific One engendered creatures, him may thy fierce displeasure spare, O Agni.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Agni who from Agni had his being, from heat of Earth or also heat of Heaven, Whereby the Omnific One engendered creatures, him may thy fierce displeasure spare, O Agni.

verses.sanskrit:
चि॒त्रं दे॒वाना॒मुद॑गा॒दनी॑कं॒ चक्षु॑र्मि॒त्रस्य॒ वरु॑णस्या॒ग्नेः ।
आऽप्रा॒ द्यावा॑पृथि॒वी अ॒न्तरि॑क्ष॒ᳪ सूर्य॑ आ॒त्मा जग॑तस्त॒स्थुष॑श्च
verses.translation: The brilliant presence of the Gods hath risen, the eye of Mitra, Varuna, and Agni. The soul of all that moveth not or moveth, the Sun hath filled the air, and earth and heaven.
verses.hindi: पल्ली कामादि शत्नुओं का पराभव करनेवाली हो, तभी वह शक्तिसम्पत्न होगी ओर उत्तम सन्तानं को जन्म देनेवाली बनेगी। १. गत मन्त्र के अनुसार अपना सुन्दर जीवन बनानेवाले व्यक्ति ही ऋतायन्' हे, ऋतम् आत्मन इछन्ति जो अपने जीवन मेँ सब क्रियाँ ऋत के अनुसार करते हे। ऋत =;९1!=
verses.transliteration: citraṃ devānāmudagādanīkaṃ cakṣurmitrasya varuṇasyāgneḥ | ā'prā dyāvāpṛthivī antarikṣa sūrya ātmā jagatastasthuṣaśca
verses.wordMeaning: The brilliant presence of the Gods hath risen, the eye of Mitra, Varuna, and Agni. The soul of all that moveth not or moveth, the Sun hath filled the air, and earth and heaven.
verses.commentary: Sense: The brilliant presence of the Gods hath risen, the eye of Mitra, Varuna, and Agni. The soul of all that moveth not or moveth, the Sun hath filled the air, and earth and heaven.

verses.sanskrit:
इ॒मं मा हि॑ᳪसीर्द्वि॒पादं॑ प॒शुᳪ स॑हस्रा॒क्षो मेधा॑य ची॒यमा॑नः ।
म॒युं प॒शुं मेध॑मग्ने जुषस्व॒ तेन॑ चिन्वा॒नस्त॒न्वो नि षी॑द ।
म॒युं ते॒ शुगृ॑च्छतु॒ यं द्वि॒ष्मस्तं ते॒ शुगृ॑च्छतु
verses.translation: Injure not, thousand-eyed, while thou art building for sacrifice, this animal, the biped. Accept as pith man's counterfeit the victim, Agni: therewith building thy forms, be settled. Let thy flame reach man's counterfeit: let thy flame reach the man we hate.
verses.hindi: हमारा जीवन ऋतमय हो, जिससे हमारा संसार मधुर बने। ऋतमय जीवनवाला ही गोतम, प्रशस्तेन्द्रिय होता है। एेसा होने पर ही इन्द्र कौ कृपा होती छी ९. अपाम्-कर्मो कौ गम्भन्-( गम्भीरे ) गम्भीरता में सीद =तू स्थित हो, अर्थात् सदा गम्भीरता से कर्मो में व्यापृत रह। गम्भीरता का अभिप्राय प्रसन्नता का अभाव नहीं हे। इसका
verses.transliteration: imaṃ mā hisīrdvipādaṃ paśu sahasrākṣo medhāya cīyamānaḥ | mayuṃ paśuṃ medhamagne juṣasva tena cinvānastanvo ni ṣīda | mayuṃ te śugṛcchatu yaṃ dviṣmastaṃ te śugṛcchatu
verses.wordMeaning: Injure not, thousand-eyed, while thou art building for sacrifice, this animal, the biped. Accept as pith man's counterfeit the victim, Agni: therewith building thy forms, be settled. Let thy flame reach man's counterfeit: let thy flame reach the man we hate.
verses.commentary: Sense: Injure not, thousand-eyed, while thou art building for sacrifice, this animal, the biped. Accept as pith man's counterfeit the victim, Agni: therewith building thy forms, be settled. Let thy flame reach man's counterfeit: let thy flame reach the man we hate.

verses.sanskrit:
इ॒मं मा हि॑ᳪसी॒रेक॑शफं प॒शुं क॑निक्र॒दं वा॒जिनं॒ वाजि॑नेषु ।
गौ॒रमा॑र॒ण्यमनु॑ ते दिशामि॒ तेन॑ चिन्वा॒नस्त॒न्वो नि षी॑द ।
गौ॒रं ते॒ शुगृ॑च्छतु॒ यं द्वि॒ष्मस्तं ते॒ शुगृ॑च्छतु
verses.translation: Harm not this animal whose hooves are solid, the courser neighing in the midst of coursers. I dedicate to thee the forest Gaura: building thy bodies up with him be settled. Let thy flame reach the Gaura, let thy flame reach him whom we detest.
verses.hindi: - प्रतिक्षण प्रसन्नता से स्वधर्म में लगे रहने से, आलस्य को त्यागकर मूर्तिमान् कर्म बन जाने से मनुष्य १. सर्दी-गर्मीं को सहन कर पाता है। २. उसकौ पाचनशक्ति ठीक बनी ४ हे। ३. उसकी सन्ताने स्वस्थ, सर्वाङ्ग होती है। ४. उसे एक अद्धुत आनन्द प्राप्त तीन समुद्र व तीन स्वर्ग-भूत, वर्तमान व भविष्यत् में,
verses.transliteration: imaṃ mā hisīrekaśaphaṃ paśuṃ kanikradaṃ vājinaṃ vājineṣu | gauramāraṇyamanu te diśāmi tena cinvānastanvo ni ṣīda | gauraṃ te śugṛcchatu yaṃ dviṣmastaṃ te śugṛcchatu
verses.wordMeaning: Harm not this animal whose hooves are solid, the courser neighing in the midst of coursers. I dedicate to thee the forest Gaura: building thy bodies up with him be settled. Let thy flame reach the Gaura, let thy flame reach him whom we detest.
verses.commentary: Sense: Harm not this animal whose hooves are solid, the courser neighing in the midst of coursers. I dedicate to thee the forest Gaura: building thy bodies up with him be settled. Let thy flame reach the Gaura, let thy flame reach him whom we detest.

verses.sanskrit:
इ॒मᳪ सा॑ह॒स्रᳪ श॒तधा॑र॒मुत्सं॑ व्य॒च्यमा॑नᳪ सरि॒रस्य॒ मध्ये॑ ।
घृ॒तं दुहा॑ना॒मदि॑तिं॒ जना॒याग्ने॒ मा हि॑ᳪसीः पर॒मे व्यो॑मन् ।
ग॒व॒यमा॑र॒ण्यमनु॑ ते दिशामि॒ तेन॑ चिन्वा॒नस्त॒न्वो नि षी॑द ।
ग॒व॒यं ते॒ शुगृ॑च्छतु॒ यं द्वि॒ष्मस्तं ते॒ शुगृ॑च्छतु
verses.translation: Thousandfold, with a hundred streams, this fountain, expanded in the middle of the waters, Infinite, yielding butter for the people, harm not, O Agni, in the highest region. This wild bull of the forest I assign thee: building thy bodies up therewith be settled. Let thy flame reach the wild hull, etc. (as in 48).
verses.hindi: १. मनुष्य तीनों कालों मे- भूत, वर्तमान व भविष्यत् में अथवा बाल्य, यौवन व वार्धक्य मे सदा कार्यो मेँ लगा रे, तभी इसके तीनों काल स्वर्ग बनते हे। २. यज्ञशील पति र में पल्लियों के जीवन को सुखी बनाता है। ३. यह पालनात्मक कर्मो को करनेवाला व्यक्ति सदा पुण्यकृत् लोगों के लोकों को प्राप्त करता है।
verses.transliteration: ima sāhasra śatadhāramutsaṃ vyacyamāna sarirasya madhye | ghṛtaṃ duhānāmaditiṃ janāyāgne mā hisīḥ parame vyoman | gavayamāraṇyamanu te diśāmi tena cinvānastanvo ni ṣīda | gavayaṃ te śugṛcchatu yaṃ dviṣmastaṃ te śugṛcchatu
verses.wordMeaning: Thousandfold, with a hundred streams, this fountain, expanded in the middle of the waters, Infinite, yielding butter for the people, harm not, O Agni, in the highest region. This wild bull of the forest I assign thee: building thy bodies up therewith be settled.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Thousandfold, with a hundred streams, this fountain, expanded in the middle of the waters, Infinite, yielding butter for the people, harm not, O Agni, in the highest region. This wild bull of the forest I assign thee: building thy bodies up therewith be settled.…

verses.sanskrit:
इ॒ममू॑र्णा॒युं वरु॑णस्य॒ नाभिं॒ त्वचं॑ पशू॒नां द्वि॒पदां॒ चतु॑ष्पदाम् ।
त्वष्टु॑: प्र॒जानां॑ प्रथ॒मं ज॒नित्र॒मग्ने॒ मा हि॑ᳪसीः पर॒मे व्यो॑मन् ।
उष्ट्र॑मार॒ण्यमनु॑ ते दिशामि॒ तेन॑ चिन्वा॒नस्त॒वो नि षी॑द ।
उष्ट्रं॑ ते॒ शुगृ॑च्छतु॒ यं द्वि॒ष्मस्तं ते॒ शुगृ॑च्छतु
verses.translation: This creature clothed in wool, Varuna's navel, the skin of animals quadruped and biped, The first that was produced of Tvashtar's creatures, O Agni, harm not in the highest region. The forest buffalo do I assign thee: building, etc., as above mutato mutando.
verses.hindi: हमारी इन्द्र्यो कर्मो में व्याप्त होनेवाली, परहित को सिद्ध करनेवाली, अनथक कार्य करनेवाली तथा हमें ज्ञान-दीप्ति व यज्ञादि उत्तम कर्मों को प्राप्त करानेवाली युक्ष्वा हि दे'वहूत॑मँ २।।ऽअश्वौ २।ऽअग्ने र् थीरिंव । नि होता पूर्व्यः स्र॑दः॥३७॥
verses.transliteration: imamūrṇāyuṃ varuṇasya nābhiṃ tvacaṃ paśūnāṃ dvipadāṃ catuṣpadām | tvaṣṭu: prajānāṃ prathamaṃ janitramagne mā hisīḥ parame vyoman | uṣṭramāraṇyamanu te diśāmi tena cinvānastavo ni ṣīda | uṣṭraṃ te śugṛcchatu yaṃ dviṣmastaṃ te śugṛcchatu
verses.wordMeaning: This creature clothed in wool, Varuna's navel, the skin of animals quadruped and biped, The first that was produced of Tvashtar's creatures, O Agni, harm not in the highest region. The forest buffalo do I assign thee: building, etc., as above mutato mutando.
verses.commentary: Sense: This creature clothed in wool, Varuna's navel, the skin of animals quadruped and biped, The first that was produced of Tvashtar's creatures, O Agni, harm not in the highest region. The forest buffalo do I assign thee: building, etc., as above mutato mutando.

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒जो ह्य॒ग्नेरज॑निष्ट॒ शोका॒त्सो अ॑पश्यज्जनि॒तार॒मग्रे॑ ।
तेन॑ दे॒वा दे॒वता॒मग्र॑मायँ॒स्तेन॒ रोह॑माय॒न्नुप॒ मेध्या॑सः ।
श॒र॒भमा॑र॒ण्यमनु॑ ते दिशामि॒ तेन॑ चिन्वा॒नस्त॒न्वो नि षी॑द ।
श॒र॒भं ते॒ शुगृ॑च्छतु॒ यं द्वि॒ष्मस्तं ते॒ शुगृ॑च्छतु
verses.translation: From Agni's warmth the he-goat had his being: he looked at first upon his generator. Thereby the Gods at first attained to Godhead: those meet for worship to the height ascended. The forest Sarabha do I assign thee: building, etc.
verses.hindi: हममे ज्ञान की वाणिर्योँ बहे, अर्थात् हम निरन्तर स्वाध्याय करें। श्रद्धा व तर्क से ज्ञान को निर्मल कररे। जब इस ज्ञान के प्रकाश को हम अपने में देेगे तव हदय में उस प्रभु का दर्शन करेगे जो ज्योतिर्मय है ओर सब बुराइयों को परे फक देते है। ऋचे त्वां रुचे त्वां भासे त्वा ज्योतिषे त्वा ।
verses.transliteration: ajo hyagnerajaniṣṭa śokātso apaśyajjanitāramagre | tena devā devatāmagramāya~stena rohamāyannupa medhyāsaḥ | śarabhamāraṇyamanu te diśāmi tena cinvānastanvo ni ṣīda | śarabhaṃ te śugṛcchatu yaṃ dviṣmastaṃ te śugṛcchatu
verses.wordMeaning: From Agni's warmth the he-goat had his being: he looked at first upon his generator. Thereby the Gods at first attained to Godhead: those meet for worship to the height ascended. The forest Sarabha do I assign thee: building, etc.
verses.commentary: Sense: From Agni's warmth the he-goat had his being: he looked at first upon his generator. Thereby the Gods at first attained to Godhead: those meet for worship to the height ascended. The forest Sarabha do I assign thee: building, etc.

verses.sanskrit: त्वं य॑विष्ठ दा॒शुषो॒ नॄँ:  पा॑हि शृणु॒धी गिर॑: । रक्षा॑ तो॒कमु॒त त्मना॑
verses.translation: Do thou, Most Youthful God, protect the men who offer, hear their songs, Protect his offspring and himself.
verses.hindi: हम अग्नि बनकर ज्ञान-ज्योति से चमक ओर वर्चस्वी बनकर रुक्म (तेजस्वी) हों। खूब कमा, खूब दें, जिससे हमारा जीवन आनन्दमय हो। क्रोध ब अभिमान का त्याग १. गत मन्त्र की समाप्ति इस बात पर थी कि खून दें" दे वही पाता है जो लोभ
verses.transliteration: tvaṃ yaviṣṭha dāśuṣo nṝ~: pāhi śṛṇudhī gira: | rakṣā tokamuta tmanā
verses.wordMeaning: Do thou, Most Youthful God, protect the men who offer, hear their songs, Protect his offspring and himself.
verses.commentary: Sense: Do thou, Most Youthful God, protect the men who offer, hear their songs, Protect his offspring and himself.

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒पां त्वेम॑न्त्सादयाम्य॒पां त्वोद्म॑न्त्सादयाम्य॒पां त्वा॒ भस्म॑न्त्सादयाम्य॒पां त्वा॒ ज्योति॑षि सादयाम्य॒पां त्वाऽय॑ने सादयाम्यर्ण॒वे त्वा॒ सद॑ने सादयामि समु॒द्रे त्वा॒ सद॑ने सादयामि सरि॒रे त्वा॒ सद॑ने सादयाम्य॒पां त्वा॒ क्षये॑ सादयाम्य॒पां त्वा॒ सधि॑षि सादयाम्य॒पां त्वा॒ सद॑ने सादयाम्य॒पां त्वा॑ स॒धस्थे॑ सादयाम्य॒पां त्वा॒ योनौ॑ सादयाम्य॒पां त्वा॒ पुरी॑षे सादयाम्य॒पां त्वा॒ पाथ॑सि सादयामि
गाय॒त्रेण॑ त्वा॒ छन्द॑सा सादयामि॒ त्रै॑ष्टुभेन त्वा॒ छन्द॑सा सादयामि॒ जाग॑तेन त्वा॒ छन्द॑सा सादया॒म्यानु॑ष्टुभेन त्वा॒ छन्द॑सा सादयामि॒
पाङ्क्ते॑न त्वा॒ छन्द॑सा सादयामि
verses.translation: I set thee in the passage of the waters. I set thee in the swelling of the waters. I set thee in the ashes of the waters. I set thee in the lustre of the waters. I set thee in the way which waters travel. I set thee in the flood, the place to test in. I set thee in the sea, the place to rest in. I set thee in the stream, the place to rest in. I set thee in the water's habitation. I set thee in the resting-place of waters. I set thee in the station of the waters. I set thee in the meeting-place of waters. I set thee in the birthplace of the waters. I set thee in the refuse of the waters. I set thee in the residence of waters. I settle thee with the Gâyatrî metre. I settle thee with the Trishtup metre. I settle thee with the Jagatî metre. I settle thee with the Anushtup metre. I settle thee with the Pankti metre.
verses.hindi: प्रभु की भक्ति शरीर, मन व बुद्धि के आप्यायन से होती है। प्रभु-प्राप्ति करे लिए साधना यह है कि हम क्रोध छोड, अभिमान न करें, ओर उन्नति करते हुए सौ वर्ष तक जीनेवाले बनें। प्रभु- प्राप्ति होने पर हमें आनन्द प्राप्त हो। इससे अनायास योगक्षेम ९. विरूप करे लिए कहते है कि अपनी इस विरूपता को स्थिर रखने के लिए मा
