verses.transliteration: apāṃ tvemantsādayāmyapāṃ tvodmantsādayāmyapāṃ tvā bhasmantsādayāmyapāṃ tvā jyotiṣi sādayāmyapāṃ tvā'yane sādayāmyarṇave tvā sadane sādayāmi samudre tvā sadane sādayāmi sarire tvā sadane sādayāmyapāṃ tvā kṣaye sādayāmyapāṃ tvā sadhiṣi sādayāmyapāṃ tvā sadane sādayāmyapāṃ tvā sadhasthe sādayāmyapāṃ tvā yonau sādayāmyapāṃ tvā purīṣe sādayāmyapāṃ tvā pāthasi sādayāmi gāyatreṇa tvā chandasā sādayāmi traiṣṭubhena tvā chandasā sādayāmi jāgatena tvā chandasā sādayāmyānuṣṭubhena tvā chandasā sādayāmi pāṅktena tvā chandasā sādayāmi
verses.wordMeaning: I set thee in the passage of the waters. I set thee in the swelling of the waters. I set thee in the ashes of the waters. I set thee in the lustre of the waters. I set thee in the way which waters travel. I set thee in the flood, the place to test in. I set thee in the sea,…
verses.commentary: Sense: I set thee in the passage of the waters. I set thee in the swelling of the waters. I set thee in the ashes of the waters. I set thee in the lustre of the waters. I set thee in the way which waters travel. I set thee in the flood, the place to test in. I set thee in the sea,…

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒यं पु॒रो भुव॒स्तस्य॑ प्रा॒णो भौ॑वाय॒नो व॑स॒न्तः प्रा॑णाय॒नो गा॑य॒त्री वा॑स॒न्ती
गा॑य॒त्र्यै गा॑य॒त्रं गा॑य॒त्रादु॑पा॒ᳪशुरु॑पा॒ᳪशोस्त्रि॒वृत् त्रि॒वृतो॑ रथन्त॒रं वसि॑ष्ठ॒ ऋषि॑:
प्र॒जाप॑तिगृहीतया॒ त्वया॑ प्रा॒णं गृ॑ह्णामि प्र॒जाभ्य॑:
verses.translation: This, in front, is Bhuva. His offspring, Breath, is Bhauvâyana. Spring is Prânâyana. The Gâyatrî is the daughter of Spring. From the Gâyatrî comes the Gâyatra tune. From the Gâyatra the Upâmsu. From the Upâmsu the Trivrit. From the Trivrit the Rathantara. The Rishi Vasishtha. By thee, taken by Prajâpati, I take vital breath for creatures.
verses.hindi: हम सब मनुष्यों का भला करे। व्यापक दृष्टिकोणवाले बनें। प्रभु-सङ्खम के लिए अपनी शक्तियों का वर्धन करे। मयु आदि पशुओं से भी, अपने जीवन के लिए उन्हे उपयोगी जानते हुए प्रेम करनेवाले बने। नाशक प्राणियों पर ही हमारा क्रोध हो। १. गत मन्त्र की भावना का ही विकास करते हए कहते है कि इमं एकशफम्
verses.transliteration: ayaṃ puro bhuvastasya prāṇo bhauvāyano vasantaḥ prāṇāyano gāyatrī vāsantī gāyatryai gāyatraṃ gāyatrādupāśurupāśostrivṛt trivṛto rathantaraṃ vasiṣṭha ṛṣi: prajāpatigṛhītayā tvayā prāṇaṃ gṛhṇāmi prajābhya:
verses.wordMeaning: This, in front, is Bhuva. His offspring, Breath, is Bhauvâyana. Spring is Prânâyana. The Gâyatrî is the daughter of Spring. From the Gâyatrî comes the Gâyatra tune. From the Gâyatra the Upâmsu. From the Upâmsu the Trivrit. From the Trivrit the Rathantara. The Rishi Vasishtha.…
verses.commentary: Sense: This, in front, is Bhuva. His offspring, Breath, is Bhauvâyana. Spring is Prânâyana. The Gâyatrî is the daughter of Spring. From the Gâyatrî comes the Gâyatra tune. From the Gâyatra the Upâmsu. From the Upâmsu the Trivrit. From the Trivrit the Rathantara. The Rishi Vasishtha.…

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒यं द॑क्षि॒णा वि॒श्वक॑र्मा॒ तस्य॒ मनो॑ वैश्वकर्म॒णं ग्री॒ष्मो मा॑न॒सस्त्रिष्टुब्ग्रै॒ष्मी॑ त्रि॒ष्टुभ॑: स्वा॒रᳪ
स्वा॒राद॑न्तर्या॒मो॒ऽन्तर्या॒मात्प॑ञ्चद॒शः प॑ञ्चद॒शाद् बृ॒हद् भ॒रद्वा॑ज॒  ऋषि॑: प्र॒जाप॑तिगृहीतया॒ त्वया॒ मनो॑ गृह्णामि प्र॒जाभ्य॑:
verses.translation: This on the right, the Omnific. His, the Omnific's offspring, Mind. Summer sprang from Mind. The Trishtup is the daughter of Summer. From the Trishtup came the Svâra song. From the Svâra the Antaryâma. From the Antaryâma the Pañchadasa. From the Pañchadasa the Brihat. The Rishi Bharadvâja. By thee, taken by Prajâpati, I take Mind for creatures.
verses.hindi: उशना-हित की कामनावाले के तीन मौलिक सिद्धान्त होने चाहिए-(१) शरणागत की रक्षा (२) ज्ञान को नैत्यिक भोजन समञ्जना। (३) स्वयं सन्तानों का सरक्षक १. प्रभु (सबका भला चाहनेवाले) उशना से कहते है कि त्वा=तुञ्ञे अपाम् एमन्=वायु में (वायुर्वा अपामेम- श० ७।५।२।४६) सादयामि स्थापित करता हूं, अर्थात् तुञ्ञे वायु के
verses.transliteration: ayaṃ dakṣiṇā viśvakarmā tasya mano vaiśvakarmaṇaṃ grīṣmo mānasastriṣṭubgraiṣmī triṣṭubha: svāra svārādantaryāmo'ntaryāmātpañcadaśaḥ pañcadaśād bṛhad bharadvāja ṛṣi: prajāpatigṛhītayā tvayā mano gṛhṇāmi prajābhya:
verses.wordMeaning: This on the right, the Omnific. His, the Omnific's offspring, Mind. Summer sprang from Mind. The Trishtup is the daughter of Summer. From the Trishtup came the Svâra song. From the Svâra the Antaryâma. From the Antaryâma the Pañchadasa. From the Pañchadasa the Brihat.…
verses.commentary: Sense: This on the right, the Omnific. His, the Omnific's offspring, Mind. Summer sprang from Mind. The Trishtup is the daughter of Summer. From the Trishtup came the Svâra song. From the Svâra the Antaryâma. From the Antaryâma the Pañchadasa. From the Pañchadasa the Brihat.…

verses.sanskrit: अ॒यं प॒श्चाद्वि॒श्वव्य॑चा॒तस्य॒ चक्षु॑र्वैश्वव्यच॒सं व॒र्षाश्चाक्षु॑ष्यो जग॑ती वा॒र्षी  जग॑त्या॒ ऋक्स॑म॒मृक्स॑माच्छु॒क्रः शु॒क्रात्स॑प्तद॒शः स॑प्तद॒शाद्वै॑रू॒पं ज॒मद॑ग्नि॒रृषि॑: प्र॒जाप॑तिगृहीतया॒ त्वया॒ चक्षु॑र्गृह्णामि प्र॒जाभ्य॑:
verses.translation: This on the western side, the All-Embracer. His, the All-Embracer's offspring, the Eye. The Rains sprang from the Eye. The Jagatî is the daughter of the Rains. From the Jagatî came the Riksama. From the Riksama the Sukra. From the Sukra the Saptadasa. From the Saptadasa the Vairûpa. The Rishi Jamadagni. By thee, taken by Prajâpati, I take the Eye for creatures.
verses.hindi: दिशाओं के उपदेश को सुनते हुए हम श्रोत्र को पूर्णरूप से वश में करके कभी अशुभ का श्रवण न करें, जिससे हमारी सन्ताने उत्तम ही हों। मतिः ( उपरिमतिः ) वाग्-ग्रहण, विश्वकर्मा ९. इयम्=यह उपरि मतिः ऊध्वदेश में स्थित चन्द्रमा है (मन्येत यया-मतिः--उव्वट,
verses.transliteration: ayaṃ paścādviśvavyacātasya cakṣurvaiśvavyacasaṃ varṣāścākṣuṣyo jagatī vārṣī jagatyā ṛksamamṛksamācchukraḥ śukrātsaptadaśaḥ saptadaśādvairūpaṃ jamadagnirṛṣi: prajāpatigṛhītayā tvayā cakṣurgṛhṇāmi prajābhya:
verses.wordMeaning: This on the western side, the All-Embracer. His, the All-Embracer's offspring, the Eye. The Rains sprang from the Eye. The Jagatî is the daughter of the Rains. From the Jagatî came the Riksama. From the Riksama the Sukra. From the Sukra the Saptadasa.…
verses.commentary: Sense: This on the western side, the All-Embracer. His, the All-Embracer's offspring, the Eye. The Rains sprang from the Eye. The Jagatî is the daughter of the Rains. From the Jagatî came the Riksama. From the Riksama the Sukra. From the Sukra the Saptadasa.…

verses.sanskrit: इ॒दमु॑त्त॒रात् स्व॒स्तस्य॒ श्रोत्र॑ᳪ सौ॒वᳪ श॒रच्छ्रौ॒त्र्य॒नु॒ष्टुप् शा॑र॒द्य॒नु॒ष्टुभ॑ ऐ॒डमै॒डान्म॒न्थी म॒न्थिन॑ एकवि॒ᳪश ए॑कविᳪशाद्वै॑रा॒जं वि॒श्वामि॑त्र॒ ऋषि॑: प्र॒जाप॑तिगृहीतया॒ त्वया॒ श्रोत्रं॑ गृह्णामि प्र॒जाभ्य॑:
verses.translation: This on the north side, heaven. This, heaven's offspring, the Ear. Autumn, the daughter of the Ear. The Anushtup sprang from Autumn. From the Anushtup came the Aida. From the Aida the Manthin. From the Manthin the Ekavimsa. From the Ekavimsa the Vairâja. The Rishi Visvâmitra. By thee, taken by Prajâpati, I take the Ear for creatures.
verses.hindi: हम सर्वोपरि स्थित मानस-आह्ाद (चन्द्रचदि आह्छादे) को अपनाकर मधुर वाणीवाले हो। इस वाणी को वश में करके उत्तम सन्तानो को प्राप्त करे। यही मार्ग हमें उत्तम लोक व प्रभु को भी प्राप्त कराएगा। सूचना १. ऊपर के पंच मन्त्रों मेँ ' प्रजापतिगृहीतया" शब्द की भावना (प्रजापतिः
verses.transliteration: idamuttarāt svastasya śrotra sauva śaracchrautryanuṣṭup śāradyanuṣṭubha aiḍamaiḍānmanthī manthina ekaviśa ekaviśādvairājaṃ viśvāmitra ṛṣi: prajāpatigṛhītayā tvayā śrotraṃ gṛhṇāmi prajābhya:
verses.wordMeaning: This on the north side, heaven. This, heaven's offspring, the Ear. Autumn, the daughter of the Ear. The Anushtup sprang from Autumn. From the Anushtup came the Aida. From the Aida the Manthin. From the Manthin the Ekavimsa. From the Ekavimsa the Vairâja. The Rishi Visvâmitra.…
verses.commentary: Sense: This on the north side, heaven. This, heaven's offspring, the Ear. Autumn, the daughter of the Ear. The Anushtup sprang from Autumn. From the Anushtup came the Aida. From the Aida the Manthin. From the Manthin the Ekavimsa. From the Ekavimsa the Vairâja. The Rishi Visvâmitra.…

verses.sanskrit: इ॒यमु॒परि॑ म॒तिस्तस्यै॒ वाङ्मा॒त्या हे॑म॒न्तो वा॒च्यः प॒ङ्क्तिर्है॑म॒न्ती प॒ङ्क्त्यै नि॒धन॑वन्नि॒धन॑वत आग्रय॒ण आ॑ग्रय॒णात् त्रि॑णवत्रयस्त्रि॒ᳪशौ त्रि॑णवत्रयस्त्रि॒ᳪशाभ्या॑ᳪ शाक्वररैव॒ते वि॒श्वक॑र्म॒ ऋषि॑: प्र॒जाप॑तिगृहीतया॒ त्वया॒ वाचं॑ गृह्णामि प्र॒जाभ्यो॑ लो॒कं ता इन्द्र॑म्
verses.translation: This above, Intellect. Its, Intellect's offspring, Speech. Winter the offspring of Speech. Pankti sprang from Winter. From Pankti the Nidhanavat. From the Nidhanavat came the Âgrayana. From the Âgrayana the Trinava and the Trayastrimsa. From the Trinava and the Trayastrimsa the Sâkvara and the Raivata. The Rishi Visvakarman. By thee, taken by Visvakarman, I take Speech for people. Fill up the room, etc. The dappled kine, etc. All sacred songs, etc., three texts repeated from XII. 54-56.
verses.hindi: हम सर्वोपरि स्थित मानस-आह्ाद (चन्द्रचदि आह्छादे) को अपनाकर मधुर वाणीवाले हो। इस वाणी को वश में करके उत्तम सन्तानो को प्राप्त करे। यही मार्ग हमें उत्तम लोक व प्रभु को भी प्राप्त कराएगा। सूचना १. ऊपर के पंच मन्त्रों मेँ ' प्रजापतिगृहीतया" शब्द की भावना (प्रजापतिः
verses.transliteration: iyamupari matistasyai vāṅmātyā hemanto vācyaḥ paṅktirhaimantī paṅktyai nidhanavannidhanavata āgrayaṇa āgrayaṇāt triṇavatrayastriśau triṇavatrayastriśābhyā śākvararaivate viśvakarma ṛṣi: prajāpatigṛhītayā tvayā vācaṃ gṛhṇāmi prajābhyo lokaṃ tā indram
verses.wordMeaning: This above, Intellect. Its, Intellect's offspring, Speech. Winter the offspring of Speech. Pankti sprang from Winter. From Pankti the Nidhanavat. From the Nidhanavat came the Âgrayana. From the Âgrayana the Trinava and the Trayastrimsa.…
verses.commentary: Sense: This above, Intellect. Its, Intellect's offspring, Speech. Winter the offspring of Speech. Pankti sprang from Winter. From Pankti the Nidhanavat. From the Nidhanavat came the Âgrayana. From the Âgrayana the Trinava and the Trayastrimsa.…

verses.sanskrit: ध्रु॒वक्षि॑तिर्ध्रु॒वयो॑निर्ध्रु॒वाऽसि॑ ध्रु॒वं योनि॒मा सी॑द साधु॒या । उख्य॑स्य के॒तुं प्र॑थ॒मं जु॑षा॒णाऽश्विना॑ऽध्व॒र्यू सा॑दयतामि॒ह त्वा॑
verses.translation: com The Texts of the White Yajurveda, tr. Ralph T.H. Griffith, [1899], WITH stedfast site and birthplace thou art stedfast: settle thou duly in thy stedfast birthplace, rejoicing in the Ukhya's first appearance. Here let the Asvins, the Adhvaryus, seat thee.
verses.hindi: पति धुव हो, कन्या के माता-पिता श्रुव हों, पल्ली स्वयं भी ध्रुव हो। वह 'पाचन-कुशल हो। क्रियाशील--यज्ञशील माता-पिता उसे घर के निर्माण के लिए गृहस्थाश्रम १. ०१ (कुलायो नीडम्=गृहम्) तू उत्तम गृहवाली हो। पली ने ही घर को बनाना है- वह चादहेगी वैसा ही घर वह बना लेगी। ताण्ड्य ब्राह्मण में "प्रजा" वै
verses.transliteration: dhruvakṣitirdhruvayonirdhruvā'si dhruvaṃ yonimā sīda sādhuyā | ukhyasya ketuṃ prathamaṃ juṣāṇā'śvinā'dhvaryū sādayatāmiha tvā
verses.wordMeaning: com The Texts of the White Yajurveda, tr. Ralph T.H. Griffith, [1899], WITH stedfast site and birthplace thou art stedfast: settle thou duly in thy stedfast birthplace, rejoicing in the Ukhya's first appearance. Here let the Asvins, the Adhvaryus, seat thee.
verses.commentary: Sense: com The Texts of the White Yajurveda, tr. Ralph T.H. Griffith, [1899], WITH stedfast site and birthplace thou art stedfast: settle thou duly in thy stedfast birthplace, rejoicing in the Ukhya's first appearance. Here let the Asvins, the Adhvaryus, seat thee.

verses.sanskrit:
कुला॒यिनी॑ घृ॒तव॑ती॒ पुरु॑न्धिः स्यो॒ने सी॑द॒ सद॑ने पृथि॒व्याः ।
अ॒भि त्वा॑ रु॒द्रा वस॑वो गृणन्त्वि॒मा ब्रह्म॑ पीपिहि॒ सौभ॑गायाश्विना॑ऽध्व॒र्यू सा॑दयतामि॒ह त्वा॑
verses.translation: Nesting, intelligent, dripping with butter, in the auspicious seat of earth be seated. Let Rudras, Vasus welcome thee with praises: fill full these prayers for our propitious fortune. Here let the Asvins, the Adhvaryus, seat thee.
verses.hindi: पली का मौलिक कर््तेव्य यह है कि वह घर को उत्तम बनाये, स्वयं स्वस्थ व ज्ञान कौ दीप्तिवाली हो। घर के पालन व पूरण का ध्यान करे। प्राथमिक व विद्यालय की उच्च शिक्षा प्राप्त करके वह अन्तः व बाह्य शत्रुओं को दूर कर सके। ज्लानपूर्वक कार्य करनेवाली हो, जिससे उसके प्रत्येक कार्य मे सौन्दर्य हो।
verses.transliteration: kulāyinī ghṛtavatī purundhiḥ syone sīda sadane pṛthivyāḥ | abhi tvā rudrā vasavo gṛṇantvimā brahma pīpihi saubhagāyāśvinā'dhvaryū sādayatāmiha tvā
verses.wordMeaning: Nesting, intelligent, dripping with butter, in the auspicious seat of earth be seated. Let Rudras, Vasus welcome thee with praises: fill full these prayers for our propitious fortune. Here let the Asvins, the Adhvaryus, seat thee.
verses.commentary: Sense: Nesting, intelligent, dripping with butter, in the auspicious seat of earth be seated. Let Rudras, Vasus welcome thee with praises: fill full these prayers for our propitious fortune. Here let the Asvins, the Adhvaryus, seat thee.

verses.sanskrit:
स्वैर्दक्षै॒र्दक्ष॑पिते॒ह सी॑द दे॒वाना॑ᳪ सु॒म्ने बृ॑ह॒ते रणा॑य ।
पि॒तेवै॑धि सू॒नव॒ आ सु॒शेवा॑ स्वावे॒शा त॒न्वा सं वि॑शस्वा॒श्विना॑ऽध्व॒र्यू सा॑दयतामि॒ह त्वा॑
verses.translation: Here, Guard of Strength, with thine own powers be seated for the Gods’ happiness and great enjoyment. Even as a father to his son, be friendly: with easy entrance enter with thy body. Here let the Asvins, the Adhvaryus seat thee:
verses.hindi: पली सास के सुख का ध्यान करे। उसकी वाणी में रस हो। घर के सब व्यक्ति उसकी प्रशंसा करे। यह वीर सन्तानों को जन्म दे। स्वस्थ व ज्ञान-दीप्त हो। घर मं उत्तम सन्तानों व णेश्वर्यो को लानेवाली हो। ऊमिरदरप्सोऽअपाम॑सि विश्वकर्मा तऽ ऋषिर् श्विनांध्वरय सादयतामिह त्वा ।॥५॥
verses.transliteration: svairdakṣairdakṣapiteha sīda devānā sumne bṛhate raṇāya | pitevaidhi sūnava ā suśevā svāveśā tanvā saṃ viśasvāśvinā'dhvaryū sādayatāmiha tvā
verses.wordMeaning: Here, Guard of Strength, with thine own powers be seated for the Gods’ happiness and great enjoyment. Even as a father to his son, be friendly: with easy entrance enter with thy body. Here let the Asvins, the Adhvaryus seat thee:
verses.commentary: Sense: Here, Guard of Strength, with thine own powers be seated for the Gods’ happiness and great enjoyment. Even as a father to his son, be friendly: with easy entrance enter with thy body. Here let the Asvins, the Adhvaryus seat thee:

verses.sanskrit:
पृ॒थि॒व्याः पुरी॑षम॒स्यप्सो॒ नाम॒ तां त्वा॒ विश्वे॑ अ॒भि गृ॑णन्तु दे॒वाः ।
स्तोम॑पृष्ठा घृ॒तव॑ती॒ह सी॑द प्र॒जाव॑द॒स्मे द्रवि॒णाऽऽय॑जस्वा॒श्विना॑ऽध्व॒र्यू सा॑दयतामि॒ह त्वा॑
verses.translation: Thou art the filling-stuff of earth called Apsas. May all the Gods celebrate thee with praises. Enriched with songs of praise, Prishthas and butter, sit here and give us wealth with store of children. Here let the Asvins, etc.
verses.hindi: प्रस्तुतः मन्त्र के सात नियम अवश्य ध्यान में रखने चाहिरपं, जिससे हम उनके पालन में प्रवृत्त हो पार्णँ। इनद्राग्नीऽअव्य॑थमानामिष्टंकां दृःहतं युवम् । १. प्रभु पति-पती को सम्बोधित करते हुए कहते है कि- “इन्द्रः अग्निःच '=पति ने
verses.transliteration: pṛthivyāḥ purīṣamasyapso nāma tāṃ tvā viśve abhi gṛṇantu devāḥ | stomapṛṣṭhā ghṛtavatīha sīda prajāvadasme draviṇā''yajasvāśvinā'dhvaryū sādayatāmiha tvā
verses.wordMeaning: Thou art the filling-stuff of earth called Apsas. May all the Gods celebrate thee with praises. Enriched with songs of praise, Prishthas and butter, sit here and give us wealth with store of children. Here let the Asvins, etc.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thou art the filling-stuff of earth called Apsas. May all the Gods celebrate thee with praises. Enriched with songs of praise, Prishthas and butter, sit here and give us wealth with store of children. Here let the Asvins, etc.

verses.sanskrit: अदि॑त्यास्त्वा पृ॒ष्ठे सा॑दयाम्य॒न्तरि॑क्षस्य ध॒र्त्रीं वि॒ष्टम्भ॑नीं दि॒शामधि॑पत्नीं॒ भुव॑नानाम् |ऊ॒र्मिर्द्र॒प्सो अ॒पाम॑सि वि॒श्वक॑र्मा त॒ ऋषि॑र॒श्विना॑ऽध्व॒र्यू सा॑दयतामि॒ह त्वा॑
verses.translation: Upon the back of Aditi I lay thee the sky's supporter, pillar of the Quarters, Queen over creatures. Wave and drop of waters art thou; and Visvakarman is thy Rishi.
verses.hindi: पली हदय में सेवा की वृत्तिवाली हो, ज्ञान के लिए विस्तारवाली, विशाल हदयवाली हो। मन को दृट् व नियमित रक्खे। पति उत्तम गौ, उत्तम घर व समृद्धता का १. है पलि! राज्ञी असित् (राज् दीप्तौ) शरीर में स्वास्थ्य की दीप्तिवाली है-मन में भक्ति कौ दीप्तिवाली तथा मस्तिष्क में ज्ञान कौ दीप्तिवाली है। इसी से प्राची दिक्छ=तेरी
verses.transliteration: adityāstvā pṛṣṭhe sādayāmyantarikṣasya dhartrīṃ viṣṭambhanīṃ diśāmadhipatnīṃ bhuvanānām |ūrmirdrapso apāmasi viśvakarmā ta ṛṣiraśvinā'dhvaryū sādayatāmiha tvā
verses.wordMeaning: Upon the back of Aditi I lay thee the sky's supporter, pillar of the Quarters, Queen over creatures. Wave and drop of waters art thou; and Visvakarman is thy Rishi.
verses.commentary: Sense: Upon the back of Aditi I lay thee the sky's supporter, pillar of the Quarters, Queen over creatures. Wave and drop of waters art thou; and Visvakarman is thy Rishi.

verses.sanskrit:
शु॒क्रश्च॒ शुचि॑श्च ग्रैष्मा॑वृ॒तू अ॒ग्नेर॑न्तः श्ले॒षो॒ऽसि॒ कल्पे॑तां॒ द्यावा॑पृथि॒वी कल्प॑न्ता॒माप॒ ओष॑धय॒: कल्प॑न्ताम॒ग्नय॒: पृथ॒ङ्नम॒ ज्यैष्ठ्या॑य॒ सव्र॑ताः|
ये अ॒ग्नय॒: सम॑नसोऽन्त॒रा द्यावा॑पृथि॒वी इ॒मे | ग्रै॒ष्मा॑वृ॒तू अ॑भि॒कल्प॑माना॒ इन्द्र॑मिव दे॒वा अ॑भि॒संवि॑शन्तु॒ तया॑ दे॒वत॑याऽङ्गिर॒स्वद् ध्रुवे सी॑दतम्
verses.translation: Sukra and Suchi, seasons, both, of summer—thou art the innermost cement of Agni. May Heaven and Earth, may Waters, Plants and Agnis help, separate, accordant, my precedence. Let all the Agnis ’twixt the earth and heaven gather together round these summer seasons, as the Gods gather in their hosts round Indra, Firm, with that Deity, Angiras-like, be seated.
verses.hindi: पली का जीवन भी ज्योतिर्मय हो, जिससे वह सन्तानो को भी ज्ञान दे सके। नभ॑श्च नभस्यश्च वार्षि"कावृतूऽअग्नेरन्तःश्लेघो ऽखि कल्पैतां द्यावापृथिवी सम॑नसो ऽन्तरा द्यावा पृथिवीऽ डमे । वार्षिकावृतूऽअभिकल्प॑मानाऽ इन्द्र॑मिव देवाऽअ॑भिसंविंशन्तु तयां देवत॑याद्धिर स्वद् शुवे सीदतम् ।॥ ९५॥
verses.transliteration: śukraśca śuciśca graiṣmāvṛtū agnerantaḥ śleṣo'si kalpetāṃ dyāvāpṛthivī kalpantāmāpa oṣadhaya: kalpantāmagnaya: pṛthaṅnama jyaiṣṭhyāya savratāḥ| ye agnaya: samanaso'ntarā dyāvāpṛthivī ime | graiṣmāvṛtū abhikalpamānā indramiva devā abhisaṃviśantu tayā devatayā'ṅgirasvad dhruve sīdatam
verses.wordMeaning: Sukra and Suchi, seasons, both, of summer—thou art the innermost cement of Agni. May Heaven and Earth, may Waters, Plants and Agnis help, separate, accordant, my precedence. Let all the Agnis ’twixt the earth and heaven gather together round these summer seasons,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Sukra and Suchi, seasons, both, of summer—thou art the innermost cement of Agni. May Heaven and Earth, may Waters, Plants and Agnis help, separate, accordant, my precedence. Let all the Agnis ’twixt the earth and heaven gather together round these summer seasons,…

verses.sanskrit:
स॒जूरृ॒तुभि॑: स॒जूर्वि॒धाभि॑: स॒जूर्दे॒वैः स॒जूर्दे॒वैर्व॑योना॒धैर॒ग्नये॑ त्वा वैश्वान॒राया॒श्विना॑ऽध्व॒र्यू सा॑दयतामि॒ह त्वा॑
स॒जूरृ॒तुभि॑: स॒जूर्वि॒धाभि॑: स॒जूर्वसु॑भिः स॒जूर्दे॒वैर्व॑योनाधैर॒ग्नये॑ त्वा वैश्वान॒राया॒श्विना॑ऽध्व॒र्यू सा॑दयतामि॒ह त्वा॑
स॒जूरृ॒तुभि॑: स॒जूर्वि॒धाभि॑: स॒जू रु॒द्रैः स॒जूर्दे॒वैर्व॑योना॒धैर॒ग्नये॑ त्वा वैश्वान॒राया॒श्विना॑ऽध्व॒र्यू सा॑दयतामि॒ह त्वा॑
स॒जूरृ॒तुभि॑: स॒जूर्वि॒धाभि॑: स॒जूरा॑दि॒त्यैः स॒जूर्दे॒वैर्व॑योना॒धैर॒ग्नये॑ त्वा वैश्वान॒राया॒श्विना॑ऽध्व॒र्यू सा॑दयतामि॒ह त्वा॑
स॒जूरृ॒तुभि॑: स॒जूर्वि॒धाभि॑: स॒जूर्विश्वै॑र्दे॒वैः स॒जूर्दे॒वैर्व॑योनाधैर॒ग्नये॑ त्वा वैश्वान॒राया॒श्विना॑ऽध्व॒र्यू सा॑दयतामि॒ह त्वा॑
verses.translation: Associate with the Seasons, with the Modes with the Gods, with the health-establishing Gods—may the Asvins the Adhvaryus settle thee here for Agni Vaisvânara. Associate.............with the Vasus, etc. Associate.............with the Rudras, etc. Associate.............with the Âdityas, etc. Associate.............with the Visvedevas, etc.
verses.hindi: पत्ि-पली ज्लान-ज्योतियों का प्रणयन करनेवाले तथा बुराइयों को समाप्त करनेवालों में उत्तम बनकर, प्रभु-सम्पर्क से अपने को शक्ति-सम्पन्न करते हुए, श्रुवता से, म्यदा व शान्ति से घर में निवास करे। सूचना-नभः=श्रावण मास का नाम हे, नभस्य भाद्रपद का, श्रवण ही ज्ञान-प्रणयन
verses.transliteration: sajūrṛtubhi: sajūrvidhābhi: sajūrdevaiḥ sajūrdevairvayonādhairagnaye tvā vaiśvānarāyāśvinā'dhvaryū sādayatāmiha tvā sajūrṛtubhi: sajūrvidhābhi: sajūrvasubhiḥ sajūrdevairvayonādhairagnaye tvā vaiśvānarāyāśvinā'dhvaryū sādayatāmiha tvā sajūrṛtubhi: sajūrvidhābhi: sajū rudraiḥ sajūrdevairvayonādhairagnaye tvā vaiśvānarāyāśvinā'dhvaryū sādayatāmiha tvā sajūrṛtubhi: sajūrvidhābhi: sajūrādityaiḥ sajūrdevairvayonādhairagnaye tvā vaiśvānarāyāśvinā'dhvaryū sādayatāmiha tvā sajūrṛtubhi: sajūrvidhābhi: sajūrviśvairdevaiḥ sajūrdevairvayonādhairagnaye tvā vaiśvānarāyāśvinā'dhvaryū sādayatāmiha tvā
verses.wordMeaning: Associate with the Seasons, with the Modes with the Gods, with the health-establishing Gods—may the Asvins the Adhvaryus settle thee here for Agni Vaisvânara. Associate.............with the Vasus, etc. Associate.............with the Rudras, etc.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Associate with the Seasons, with the Modes with the Gods, with the health-establishing Gods—may the Asvins the Adhvaryus settle thee here for Agni Vaisvânara. Associate.............with the Vasus, etc. Associate.............with the Rudras, etc.…

verses.sanskrit:
प्रा॒णं मे॑ पाह्यपा॒नं मे॑ पाहि व्या॒नं मे॑ पाहि॒ चक्षु॑र्म उ॒र्व्या वि भा॑हि॒ श्रोत्रं॑ मे श्लोकय ।
अ॒पः पि॒न्वौष॑धीर्जिन्व द्वि॒पाद॑व चतु॑ष्पात् पाहि दि॒वो वृष्टि॒मेर॑य
verses.translation: Guard thou my breath. Guard my out-breathing. Guard my through-breathing. Illume mine eye with far-reaching vision. Give power of hearing to mine ear. Pour forth waters. Quicken plants. Protect bipeds. Protect quadrupeds. Send rain from heaven.
verses.hindi: -यह मन्त्र पृथिवी, अन्तरिक्ष व द्यौ" से प्रारम्भ होता है, शरीर, मन व मस्तिष्क को उत्तम बनाने कौ कामना हमे करनी ही चाहिए। समाप्ति पर “गौ-अजा व अश्व ' हें। गौ -दुग्ध हमारे मस्तिष्को को सुन्दर बनाएगा, अजा दुग्ध हमारे मनो को तथा अश्व हमारे शरीर को सबल बनानेवाले होगे।
verses.transliteration: prāṇaṃ me pāhyapānaṃ me pāhi vyānaṃ me pāhi cakṣurma urvyā vi bhāhi śrotraṃ me ślokaya | apaḥ pinvauṣadhīrjinva dvipādava catuṣpāt pāhi divo vṛṣṭimeraya
verses.wordMeaning: Guard thou my breath. Guard my out-breathing. Guard my through-breathing. Illume mine eye with far-reaching vision. Give power of hearing to mine ear. Pour forth waters. Quicken plants. Protect bipeds. Protect quadrupeds. Send rain from heaven.
verses.commentary: Sense: Guard thou my breath. Guard my out-breathing. Guard my through-breathing. Illume mine eye with far-reaching vision. Give power of hearing to mine ear. Pour forth waters. Quicken plants. Protect bipeds. Protect quadrupeds. Send rain from heaven.

verses.sanskrit:
मू॒र्धा वय॑: प्र॒जाप॑ति॒श्छन्द॑: क्ष॒त्रं वयो॒ मय॑न्दं॒ छन्दो॑ विष्ट॒म्भो वयोऽधि॑पति॒श्छन्दो॑
वि॒श्वक॑र्मा॒ वय॑: परमे॒ष्ठी छन्दो॑ ब॒स्तो वयो॑ विव॒लं छन्दो॒ वृष्णि॒र्वयो॑ विशा॒लं छन्द॒:
पुरु॑षो॒ वय॑स्त॒न्द्रं छन्दो॑ व्या॒घ्रो वयोऽना॑धृष्टं॒ छन्द॑:  सि॒ᳪहो वय॑श्छ॒दिश्छन्द॑: पष्ठ॒वाड्वयो॑ बृह॒ती छन्द॑  उ॒क्षा वय॑: क॒कुप् छन्द॑ ऋष॒भो वय॑: स॒तोबृ॑हती॒ छन्द॑:
verses.translation: The head is vital vigour. Prajâpati became the metre. Royalty is vital vigour, health-giving metre. The Supporter is vital vigour, the Sovran Lord the metre. Visvakarman is vital vigour, Parameshthin the metre. The he-goat is vital vigour, excellent the metre. The bull is vital vigour, extensive the metre. Man is vital vigour, languid the metre. The tiger is vital vigour, invincible the metre. The lion is vital vigour, covering the metre. The four-year bull is vital vigour, Brihatî the metre. The ox is vital vigour, Kakup the metre. The steer is vital vigour, Satobrihatî the metre.
verses.hindi: हमारा जीवन, ऊपर कौ अठारह बातों को धारण करके, पूर्ण यज्ञिय बन जाए, हम आशु" से जीवन को प्रारम्भ करें, शीघ्रता से कार्यो को करनेवाले बनें ओर " चतुष्टोम" पर हमारे जीवन का अन्त हो। चारों वेदों से हमारा प्रभु-स्तवन चल रहा हो। १. अग्नेः=अग्नि का भागः (भज सेवायाम्) = भजन करनेवाला, अतएव अग्नि का
verses.transliteration: mūrdhā vaya: prajāpatiśchanda: kṣatraṃ vayo mayandaṃ chando viṣṭambho vayo'dhipatiśchando viśvakarmā vaya: parameṣṭhī chando basto vayo vivalaṃ chando vṛṣṇirvayo viśālaṃ chanda: puruṣo vayastandraṃ chando vyāghro vayo'nādhṛṣṭaṃ chanda: siho vayaśchadiśchanda: paṣṭhavāḍvayo bṛhatī chanda ukṣā vaya: kakup chanda ṛṣabho vaya: satobṛhatī chanda:
verses.wordMeaning: The head is vital vigour. Prajâpati became the metre. Royalty is vital vigour, health-giving metre. The Supporter is vital vigour, the Sovran Lord the metre. Visvakarman is vital vigour, Parameshthin the metre. The he-goat is vital vigour, excellent the metre.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The head is vital vigour. Prajâpati became the metre. Royalty is vital vigour, health-giving metre. The Supporter is vital vigour, the Sovran Lord the metre. Visvakarman is vital vigour, Parameshthin the metre. The he-goat is vital vigour, excellent the metre.…

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒न॒ड्वान्वय॑: प॒ङ्क्तिश्छन्दो॑ धे॒नुर्वयो॒ जग॑ती॒ छन्द॒त्र्यवि॒र्वय॑स्त्रि॒ष्टुप् छन्दो॑ दित्य॒वाड्वयो॑ वि॒राट् छन्द॒: पञ्चा॑वि॒र्वयो॑ गाय॒त्री छन्द॑ स्त्रिव॒त्सो वय॑ उ॒ष्णिक् छन्द॑ऽ स्तु॑र्य॒वाड्वयो॑ऽनु॒ष्टुप् छन्दो॑  लो॒कं  ता इन्द्र॑म्  ।। १ ०।।
इन्द्रा॑ग्नी॒ अव्य॑थमाना॒मिष्ट॑कां दृᳪहतं यु॒वम् ।
पृ॒ष्ठेन॒ द्यावा॑पृथि॒वी अ॒न्तरि॑क्षं च॒ वि बा॑धसे
verses.translation: Indra and Agni, in its place securely set the unshaking brick. Thou with thy back sunderest heaven and the broad earth and firmament.
verses.hindi: अग्नि के उपासक बनकर हम ज्ञान कौ रक्षा करे। इन्द्र के उपासक बनकर हम बल की रक्षा करे। देवों के उपासक बनकर प्रजाओं कौ रक्षा करे। मित्र स्नेह की पूष्णऽआधिंपत्यमोज॑ स्पृतं त्रिंणव स्तोमो देवस्य॑ सवितुर्भागो ऽसि १. तू बसूनाम्-वसुओं कौ भागः=उपासना करनेवाला हे, निवास के लिए आवश्यक
verses.transliteration: anaḍvānvaya: paṅktiśchando dhenurvayo jagatī chandatryavirvayastriṣṭup chando dityavāḍvayo virāṭ chanda: pañcāvirvayo gāyatrī chanda strivatso vaya uṣṇik chanda' sturyavāḍvayo'nuṣṭup chando lokaṃ tā indram || 1 0|| indrāgnī avyathamānāmiṣṭakāṃ dṛhataṃ yuvam | pṛṣṭhena dyāvāpṛthivī antarikṣaṃ ca vi bādhase
verses.wordMeaning: Indra and Agni, in its place securely set the unshaking brick. Thou with thy back sunderest heaven and the broad earth and firmament.
verses.commentary: Sense: Indra and Agni, in its place securely set the unshaking brick. Thou with thy back sunderest heaven and the broad earth and firmament.

verses.sanskrit:
वि॒श्वक॑र्मा त्वा सादयत्व॒न्तरि॑क्षस्य पृ॒ष्ठे व्यच॑स्वतीं॒ प्रथ॑स्वतीम॒न्तरि॑क्षं यच्छा॒न्तरि॑क्षं दृᳪहा॒न्तरि॑क्षं॒ मा हि॑ᳪसीः । विश्व॑स्मै प्रा॒णाया॑पा॒नाय॑ व्या॒नायो॑दा॒नाय॑ प्रति॒ष्ठायै॑ च॒रित्रा॑य ।
वा॒युष्ट्वा॒ऽभि पा॑तु म॒ह्या स्व॒स्त्या छ॒र्दिषा॒ शन्त॑मेन॒ तया॑ दे॒वत॑याऽङ्गिर॒स्वद् ध्रु॒वा सी॑द
verses.translation: On the air's back let Visvakarman set thee, thee the capacious, thee the far-extended. Control the air, fix firm the air, do thou the air no injury. For all breath, out-breath, through-breath, upward breathing, for high position, for prescribed observance, May Vâyu keep thee safe with great well-being, with securest shelter. In the manner of Angiras, with that Deity lie steady.
verses.hindi: पल्ली शक्ति की रक्षा करनेवाली हो, जिससे उसकी सब इन्द्रियों उत्तम हों ओर उसके अद्ख -प्रत्यङ्ख में रमणीयता हो। घर मे सभी के सुख का वह ध्यान करें, उसकी प्रत्येक क्रिया उत्तम हो। वह अपनी शक्तियों का हास न होने दे। ृषिः--उशनाः। देवता-अश्विनौ। छन्दः - भुरिग्ब्राह्यीवृहती। स्वरः-मध्यमः।
verses.transliteration: viśvakarmā tvā sādayatvantarikṣasya pṛṣṭhe vyacasvatīṃ prathasvatīmantarikṣaṃ yacchāntarikṣaṃ dṛhāntarikṣaṃ mā hisīḥ | viśvasmai prāṇāyāpānāya vyānāyodānāya pratiṣṭhāyai caritrāya | vāyuṣṭvā'bhi pātu mahyā svastyā chardiṣā śantamena tayā devatayā'ṅgirasvad dhruvā sīda
verses.wordMeaning: On the air's back let Visvakarman set thee, thee the capacious, thee the far-extended. Control the air, fix firm the air, do thou the air no injury. For all breath, out-breath, through-breath, upward breathing, for high position, for prescribed observance,…
verses.commentary: Sense: On the air's back let Visvakarman set thee, thee the capacious, thee the far-extended. Control the air, fix firm the air, do thou the air no injury. For all breath, out-breath, through-breath, upward breathing, for high position, for prescribed observance,…

verses.sanskrit: राज्ञ्य॑सि॒ प्राची॒ दिग्वि॒राड॑सि॒ दक्षि॑णा॒ दिक् स॒म्राड॑सि प्र॒तीची॒ दिक् स्व॒राड॒स्युदी॑ची॒ दिगधि॑पत्न्यसि बृह॒ती दिक्
verses.translation: Queen art thou, Quarter of the East. Wide-ruler, Quarter of the South. West Quarter, thou art Sovran. Thou Autocrat, Quarter of the North. Queen Paramount art thou, the Lofty Point.
verses.hindi: पली का जीवन स्वास्थ्य-सम्पन्न हो। यह मध्यमार्ग मे चलनेवाली हो, वेद के आदेशो को ग्रहण करनेवाली, शरीर, हदय व मस्तिष्करूप लोकों को धारण करनेवाली , कर्मो में उत्साह के कारण आनन्दमय जीवनवाली हो। प्रभु का इसपर अनुग्रह हो। षिः उशनाः। देवता- ग्रीष्मर्तुः। छन्दः - निचृदुत्कृतिः। स्वरः-षडजः।।
verses.transliteration: rājñyasi prācī digvirāḍasi dakṣiṇā dik samrāḍasi pratīcī dik svarāḍasyudīcī digadhipatnyasi bṛhatī dik
verses.wordMeaning: Queen art thou, Quarter of the East. Wide-ruler, Quarter of the South. West Quarter, thou art Sovran. Thou Autocrat, Quarter of the North. Queen Paramount art thou, the Lofty Point.
verses.commentary: Sense: Queen art thou, Quarter of the East. Wide-ruler, Quarter of the South. West Quarter, thou art Sovran. Thou Autocrat, Quarter of the North. Queen Paramount art thou, the Lofty Point.

verses.sanskrit:
वि॒श्वक॑र्मा त्वा सादयत्व॒न्तरि॑क्षस्य पृ॒ष्ठे ज्योति॑ष्मतीम् ।
विश्व॑स्मै प्रा॒णाया॑पा॒नाय॑ व्या॒नाय॒ विश्वं॒ ज्योति॑र्यच्छ ।
वा॒युष्टेऽधि॑पति॒स्तया॑ दे॒वत॑याऽङ्गिर॒स्वद् ध्रु॒वा सी॑द
verses.translation: On the air's back may Visvakarman set thee luminous. Control all light for all breath, for out-breath, up-breath, through-breath. Thy Lord is Vâyu, with that Deity, Angiras-like, lie firm.
verses.hindi: पति-पली क्रियाशील व पवित्रतावाले हों। प्रतिदिन प्रभु-सम्पर्क से अपने को प्रकृष्ट बलवाला बनाते हए ये मर्यादा का पालन करनेवाले होकर घर में निवास करे। उसजूऋतुभिः सजूर्विधाभिः सजूर्देवैः सजूर्देवैर्वयोनाधेर ग्नय त्वा वेश्वानराया- सजू रुद्रैः सजुर्देवैर्वयोनाधैर् ग्नय त्वा वैश्वानरायाश्विनांध्वरयू सादयतापिह त्वां
verses.transliteration: viśvakarmā tvā sādayatvantarikṣasya pṛṣṭhe jyotiṣmatīm | viśvasmai prāṇāyāpānāya vyānāya viśvaṃ jyotiryaccha | vāyuṣṭe'dhipatistayā devatayā'ṅgirasvad dhruvā sīda
verses.wordMeaning: On the air's back may Visvakarman set thee luminous. Control all light for all breath, for out-breath, up-breath, through-breath. Thy Lord is Vâyu, with that Deity, Angiras-like, lie firm.
verses.commentary: Sense: On the air's back may Visvakarman set thee luminous. Control all light for all breath, for out-breath, up-breath, through-breath. Thy Lord is Vâyu, with that Deity, Angiras-like, lie firm.

verses.sanskrit:
नभ॑श्च नभ॒स्य॒श्च॒ वार्षि॑कावृ॒तू अ॒ग्नेर॑न्तः श्ले॒षो॒ऽसि॒ कल्पे॑तां॒ द्यावा॑पृथि॒वी कल्प॑न्ता॒माप॒ ओष॑धय॒: कल्प॑न्ताम॒ग्नय॒: पृथ॒ङ्नम॒ ज्यैष्ठ्या॑य॒ सव्र॑ताः।
ये अ॒ग्नय॒: सम॑नसोऽन्त॒रा द्यावा॑पृथि॒वी इ॒मे | वार्षि॑कावृ॒तू अ॑भि॒कल्प॑माना॒ इन्द्र॑मिव दे॒वा अ॑भि॒संवि॑शन्तु॒ तया॑ दे॒वत॑याऽङ्गिर॒स्वद् ध्रु॒वे सी॑दतम्
verses.translation: Two Rainy Seasons, Nabhas and Nabhasya—thou art the innermost cement of Agni, etc. (as in XIII. 25).
verses.hindi: प्राणशक्ति-सम्पन्न हो (नाजुक नहीं ) ओर पति ' अग्नि"=उन्नतिशील व ' वैश्वानर' सबका भला ही करनेवाला हो। एेसा होने पर ही ये प्रस्तुत मन्त्र के ऋषि ‹ विश्वेदेवाः” बन सकेगे। १. गत मन्त्र के पति-पल्ी से प्रभु कहते है कि हैँ कि-हे जीव! मे प्राणं पाहि=मेरे दिये हुए प्राण कौ तू रक्षा करना। प्राणशक्ति का अपव्यय न करना। २. मे अपानं पाहि
verses.transliteration: nabhaśca nabhasyaśca vārṣikāvṛtū agnerantaḥ śleṣo'si kalpetāṃ dyāvāpṛthivī kalpantāmāpa oṣadhaya: kalpantāmagnaya: pṛthaṅnama jyaiṣṭhyāya savratāḥ| ye agnaya: samanaso'ntarā dyāvāpṛthivī ime | vārṣikāvṛtū abhikalpamānā indramiva devā abhisaṃviśantu tayā devatayā'ṅgirasvad dhruve sīdatam
verses.wordMeaning: Two Rainy Seasons, Nabhas and Nabhasya—thou art the innermost cement of Agni, etc. (as in XIII. 25).
verses.commentary: Sense: Two Rainy Seasons, Nabhas and Nabhasya—thou art the innermost cement of Agni, etc. (as in XIII. 25).

verses.sanskrit:
इ॒षश्चो॒र्जश्च॑ शार॒दावृ॒तू अ॒ग्नेर॑न्तः श्ले॒षो॒ऽसि॒ कल्पे॑तां॒ द्यावा॑पृथि॒वी कल्प॑न्ता॒माप॒ ओष॑धय॒: कल्प॑न्ताम॒ग्नय॒: पृथ॒ङ्नम॒ ज्यैष्ठ्याय॒ सव्र॑ताः ।
ये अ॒ग्नय॒: सम॑नसोऽन्त॒रा द्यावा॑पृथि॒वी इ॒मे शा॒र॒दावृ॒तू अ॑भि॒कल्प॑माना॒  इन्द्र॑मिव दे॒वा अ॑भि॒संवि॑शन्तु॒ तया॑ दे॒वत॑याऽङ्गिर॒स्वद् ध्रु॒वे सी॑दतम्
verses.translation: Isha and ûrja, two Autumnal Seasons—thou art the innermost cement of Agni, etc.
verses.hindi: कौ रक्षा करें, विशाल दुष्टि व उत्तम श्रवणवाले बनें, जलों व ओषधियों का ही ग्रहण करे, मनुष्य व अन्य प्राणियों का ध्यान करे ओर अन्त में यज्ञादि से सामयिक वर्षा को सिद्ध करे। विश्वकर्मां वय॑ः परमेष्ठी छन्दो वस्तो वयो विवलं छन्दो वृष्णिर्वयो विशालं छन्दः स्पुरुषो वय॑स्तन्द्रं छन्दो, व्याघ्रो वयो ऽनाधृष्टं छन्द॑; सिश्डो वय॑श्छदिश्छन्द॑: पष्ठवाड्
verses.transliteration: iṣaścorjaśca śāradāvṛtū agnerantaḥ śleṣo'si kalpetāṃ dyāvāpṛthivī kalpantāmāpa oṣadhaya: kalpantāmagnaya: pṛthaṅnama jyaiṣṭhyāya savratāḥ | ye agnaya: samanaso'ntarā dyāvāpṛthivī ime śāradāvṛtū abhikalpamānā indramiva devā abhisaṃviśantu tayā devatayā'ṅgirasvad dhruve sīdatam
verses.wordMeaning: Isha and ûrja, two Autumnal Seasons—thou art the innermost cement of Agni, etc.
verses.commentary: Sense: Isha and ûrja, two Autumnal Seasons—thou art the innermost cement of Agni, etc.

verses.sanskrit:
आयु॑र्मे पाहि प्रा॒णं मे॑ पाह्यपा॒नं मे॑ पाहि व्या॒नं मे॑ पाहि॒ चक्षु॑र्मे पाहि॒
श्रोत्रं॑ मे पाहि॒ वाचं॑ मे पिन्व॒ मनो॑ मे जिन्वात्मानं॑ मे पाहि॒ ज्योति॑र्मे यच्छ
verses.translation: Preserve my life. Preserve my breath. Guard mine out-breath. Preserve mine eyes. Preserve mine ears. Strengthen my voice. Quicken my mind. Preserve my self. Vouchsafe me light.
verses.hindi: १३. गत मन्त्र मे १२ संख्या हो चुकी है, अतः १३ से यहाँ प्रारम्भ करते है कि अनड्वान् वयः=यदि जीवन को गृहस्थ कौ गाड़ी के वहन के योग्य बनाना है तो पदकः इस गृहस्थ में पाँच यजतं को विधिपूर्वक करने का संकल्प रखना। इन यज्ञो के अभाव में गृहस्थ-शकट उत्तमता से नहीं चलता। १९४. धेनुः वयः=यदि तुम्हारा जीवन धेनु" का बना
verses.transliteration: āyurme pāhi prāṇaṃ me pāhyapānaṃ me pāhi vyānaṃ me pāhi cakṣurme pāhi śrotraṃ me pāhi vācaṃ me pinva mano me jinvātmānaṃ me pāhi jyotirme yaccha
verses.wordMeaning: Preserve my life. Preserve my breath. Guard mine out-breath. Preserve mine eyes. Preserve mine ears. Strengthen my voice. Quicken my mind. Preserve my self. Vouchsafe me light.
verses.commentary: Sense: Preserve my life. Preserve my breath. Guard mine out-breath. Preserve mine eyes. Preserve mine ears. Strengthen my voice. Quicken my mind. Preserve my self. Vouchsafe me light.

verses.sanskrit:
मा छन्द॑: प्र॒मा छन्द॑: प्र॑ति॒मा छन्दो॑ अस्रीवय॒श्छन्द॑: प॒ङ्क्तिश्छन्द॑ उ॒ष्णिक् छन्दो॑
बृह॒ती छन्दो॑  ऽनु॒ष्टुप् छन्दो॑ वि॒राट् छन्दो॑ गा॑य॒त्री छन्द॑ स्त्रि॒ष्टुप् छन्दो॒ जग॑ती॒ छन्द॑:
verses.translation: Mâ metre. Pramâ metre. Pratimâ metre. Âsrivayas metre. Pankti metre. Ushnih metre. Brihatî metre. Anushtup metre. Virâj metre. Gâyatrî metre, Trishtup metre. Jagatî metre.
verses.hindi: पति जितेन्द्रिय हो, पली घर कौ उत्रति-साधिका हो। घरों में यज्ञ अविच्छिन्न रूप से चले। मस्तिष्क ज्ञानमय, शरीर तेजस्वी व हदय भक््ति-सम्पत्न हो। वायुष्ट्वाभिपांतु मह्या स्वस्त्या छर्दिषा शन्त॑मेन तयां देवत॑याद्धिर स्वद् श्रुवा सीद ॥९२॥ १. पल्ली के लिए कहते हैँ कि विश्वकर्मा-सब कर्मो को करनेवाला प्रभु त्वा=तुञ्ञ
verses.transliteration: mā chanda: pramā chanda: pratimā chando asrīvayaśchanda: paṅktiśchanda uṣṇik chando bṛhatī chando 'nuṣṭup chando virāṭ chando gāyatrī chanda striṣṭup chando jagatī chanda:
verses.wordMeaning: Mâ metre. Pramâ metre. Pratimâ metre. Âsrivayas metre. Pankti metre. Ushnih metre. Brihatî metre. Anushtup metre. Virâj metre. Gâyatrî metre, Trishtup metre. Jagatî metre.
verses.commentary: Sense: Mâ metre. Pramâ metre. Pratimâ metre. Âsrivayas metre. Pankti metre. Ushnih metre. Brihatî metre. Anushtup metre. Virâj metre. Gâyatrî metre, Trishtup metre. Jagatî metre.

verses.sanskrit:
पृ॒थि॒वी छन्दो॒  ऽन्तरि॑क्षं॒ छन्दो॒ द्यौ॒श्छन्द॒: समा॒श्छन्दो॒ नक्ष॑त्राणि॒ छन्दो॒ वाक् छन्दो॒ मन॒श्छन्द॑:
कृ॒षिश्छन्दो॒ हिर॑ण्यं॒ छन्दो॒ गौश्छन्दो॒ ऽजाश्छन्दो ऽश्व॒श्छन्द॑:
verses.translation: Earth metre. Sky metre. Heaven metre. Years metre. Nakshatras metre. Vâk metre. Mind metre. Husbandry metre. Gold metre. Cow metre. She-goat metre. Horse metre.
verses.hindi: पली ने “राज्ञी, विराट्, सम्राट्, स्वराड् व अधिपली' बनना है। व्यानाय विश्वं ज्योतिर्यच्छ । वायुष्टे ऽधिंपतिस्तयां देवत॑याद्धिरस्वद् ्रुवा १. विश्वकर्मा=सारे संसार के कर्मो का सञ्चालक वह प्रभु तुले अन्तरिक्षस्य होकर बैठता हे, उसी प्रकार तू मन पर अधिष्ठित हो। मन पूर्णरूप से तेरे वश मे हो अथवा
verses.transliteration: pṛthivī chando 'ntarikṣaṃ chando dyauśchanda: samāśchando nakṣatrāṇi chando vāk chando manaśchanda: kṛṣiśchando hiraṇyaṃ chando gauśchando 'jāśchando 'śvaśchanda:
verses.wordMeaning: Earth metre. Sky metre. Heaven metre. Years metre. Nakshatras metre. Vâk metre. Mind metre. Husbandry metre. Gold metre. Cow metre. She-goat metre. Horse metre.
verses.commentary: Sense: Earth metre. Sky metre. Heaven metre. Years metre. Nakshatras metre. Vâk metre. Mind metre. Husbandry metre. Gold metre. Cow metre. She-goat metre. Horse metre.

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒ग्निर्दे॒वता॒ वातो॑ दे॒वता॒ सूर्यो॑ दे॒वता॑ च॒न्द्रमा॑ दे॒वता॒  वस॑वो दे॒वता॑ रु॒द्रा दे॒वता॑
ऽऽदि॒त्या दे॒वता॑ म॒रुतो॑ दे॒वता॒  विश्वे॑ दे॒वा देवता॒ बृह॒स्पति॑र्दे॒वतेन्द्रो॑ दे॒वता॒ वरु॑णो दे॒वता॑
verses.translation: The Deity Agni. The Deity Vita. The Deity Sûrya. The Deity Moon. The Deity Vasus. The Deity Rudras. The Deity Âdityas The Deity Maruts. The Deity Visvedevas. The Deity Brihaspati. The Deity Indra. The Deity Varuna.
verses.hindi: पति-पली गतिशील हों। गतिशीलता से शक्तिशाली बनें। शक्ति से सब शत्नुओं को शीर्ण करनेवाले होँ। नियमित गतिवाले होकर, प्रभु की उपासना से अङ्क-अङ्क मे रस का सञ्चार करे ओर ध्रुव होकर घर में निवास करे। आयुर्मे पाहि प्राणं मे पाह्यपानं मे पाहि व्यानं में पाहि चक्षुर्मे पाहि श्रोत्रं
verses.transliteration: agnirdevatā vāto devatā sūryo devatā candramā devatā vasavo devatā rudrā devatā ''dityā devatā maruto devatā viśve devā devatā bṛhaspatirdevatendro devatā varuṇo devatā
verses.wordMeaning: The Deity Agni. The Deity Vita. The Deity Sûrya. The Deity Moon. The Deity Vasus. The Deity Rudras. The Deity Âdityas The Deity Maruts. The Deity Visvedevas. The Deity Brihaspati. The Deity Indra. The Deity Varuna.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Deity Agni. The Deity Vita. The Deity Sûrya. The Deity Moon. The Deity Vasus. The Deity Rudras. The Deity Âdityas The Deity Maruts. The Deity Visvedevas. The Deity Brihaspati. The Deity Indra. The Deity Varuna.

verses.sanskrit:
मू॒र्धाऽसि॒ राड् ध्रु॒वाऽसि॑ ध॒रुणा॑ ध॒र्त्र्य॒सि॒ धर॑णी ।
आयु॑षे त्वा॒ वर्च॑से त्वा कृ॒ष्यै त्वा॒ क्षेमा॑य त्वा
verses.translation: Chief art thou, bright, supporting, firm, thou art the great sustainer, Earth. Thee for life, thee for lustre, thee for tillage, thee for peace and rest.
verses.hindi: हो, जिससे हम प्रभु-दर्शन में समर्थ हों। १. प्रभु पति-पली से कहते है क्रि तुम्हारी पहली छन्दः =इच्छा मा लक्ष्मी की हो। तुम धन को धर्म्य मार्गो से कमाने का ध्यान करो। धन के विना गृहस्थ व संसार नहीं चल सकता। तुम्हारे ध्येय “ मा+धव ' हों, लक्ष्मीपति विष्णु हों , परन्तु धन को सुपथा कमाने का
verses.transliteration: mūrdhā'si rāḍ dhruvā'si dharuṇā dhartryasi dharaṇī | āyuṣe tvā varcase tvā kṛṣyai tvā kṣemāya tvā
verses.wordMeaning: Chief art thou, bright, supporting, firm, thou art the great sustainer, Earth. Thee for life, thee for lustre, thee for tillage, thee for peace and rest.
verses.commentary: Sense: Chief art thou, bright, supporting, firm, thou art the great sustainer, Earth. Thee for life, thee for lustre, thee for tillage, thee for peace and rest.

verses.sanskrit:
यन्त्री॒ राड् य॒न्त्र्य॒सि॒ यम॑नी ध्रु॒वाऽसि॒ धरि॑त्री ।
इ॒षे त्वो॒र्जे त्वा॑ र॒य्यै त्वा॒ पोषा॑य त्वा लो॒कं ता इन्द्र॑म्
verses.translation: Controller, brilliant art thou, managing controller, firm sustainer. For strength, for energy thee, for riches thee, for prosperity thee. Fill up the room, etc. The dappled kine, etc. All sacred songs, etc. (as in 10).
verses.hindi: हम अग्नि आदि देवों से प्रेरणा प्राप्त करके देव बनें ओर अन्त मेंप्रभु को प्राप्त करनेवाले हों। आयुषे त्वा वर्चसे त्वा कृष्यै त्वा क्षेमाय त्वा ॥२९॥ भति ज्ञान कौ दीप्ति से चमकनेवाली है, ओर अतएव राट्=बडे व्यवस्थित (1९2121९0 )
verses.transliteration: yantrī rāḍ yantryasi yamanī dhruvā'si dharitrī | iṣe tvorje tvā rayyai tvā poṣāya tvā lokaṃ tā indram
verses.wordMeaning: Controller, brilliant art thou, managing controller, firm sustainer. For strength, for energy thee, for riches thee, for prosperity thee. Fill up the room, etc. The dappled kine, etc. All sacred songs, etc. (as in 10).
verses.commentary: Sense: Controller, brilliant art thou, managing controller, firm sustainer. For strength, for energy thee, for riches thee, for prosperity thee. Fill up the room, etc. The dappled kine, etc. All sacred songs, etc. (as in 10).

verses.sanskrit:
आ॒शुस्त्रि॒वृद्भा॒न्तः प॑ञ्चद॒शो व्यो॑मा सप्तद॒शो ध॒रुण॑ एकवि॒ᳪशः
प्रतू॑र्तिरष्टाद॒शस्तपो॑ नवद॒शो॒ ऽभीव॒र्त्त: स॑वि॒ᳪशो वर्चो॑ द्वावि॒ᳪशः
स॒म्भर॑णस्त्रयोवि॒ᳪशो योनि॑श्चतुर्वि॒ᳪशो गर्भा॑: पञ्चवि॒ᳪश ओज॑स्त्रिण॒वः
क्रतु॑रेकत्रि॒ᳪशः प्र॑ति॒ष्ठा त्र॑यस्त्रि॒ᳪशो ब्र॒ध्नस्य॑ वि॒ष्टपं॑ चतुस्त्रि॒ᳪशो नाक॑: षट्त्रि॒ᳪशो
वि॑व॒र्तो॒ऽष्टाचत्वारि॒ᳪशो ध॒र्त्रं च॑तुष्टो॒मः
verses.translation: This Swift, the triple praise-song. The Shining, the Pañchadasa hymn. Heaven, the Saptadasa. The Supporter, the Ekavimsa. Speed, the Ashtâdasa. Ardour, the Navadasa. Triumphant Onset, Savimsa, Vigour, Dvâvimsa. Maintenance, Trayovimsa. Womb, Chaturvimsa. Embryos, Pañchavimsa. Energy, the Trinava. Intention, the Ekatrimsa. The Basis, the Trayastrimsa. The Bright One's Station, the Chatustrimsa. The Vault of Heaven, the Shattrimsa. The Revolving One, the Ashtâchatvârimsa. The Support, the Four-divisioned praise-song.
verses.hindi: गृहपली ज्ञान द्वारा सूर्यं की भांति चमके, पृथिवी के समान धारण करनेवाली हो ओर वायु के समान शरीर के स्वास्थ्य को सुरक्षित करनेवाली हो। वायु बनकर आयु १. तू यन्त्री=अपने जीवन पर पूर्ण नियन्त्रण रखनेवाली है ओर इसी का परिणाम है कि तू राट्चमकती है। जैसे नियमित गति के कारण सूर्यं चमकता है, उसी प्रकार
verses.transliteration: āśustrivṛdbhāntaḥ pañcadaśo vyomā saptadaśo dharuṇa ekaviśaḥ pratūrtiraṣṭādaśastapo navadaśo 'bhīvartta: saviśo varco dvāviśaḥ sambharaṇastrayoviśo yoniścaturviśo garbhā: pañcaviśa ojastriṇavaḥ kraturekatriśaḥ pratiṣṭhā trayastriśo bradhnasya viṣṭapaṃ catustriśo nāka: ṣaṭtriśo vivarto'ṣṭācatvāriśo dhartraṃ catuṣṭomaḥ
verses.wordMeaning: This Swift, the triple praise-song. The Shining, the Pañchadasa hymn. Heaven, the Saptadasa. The Supporter, the Ekavimsa. Speed, the Ashtâdasa. Ardour, the Navadasa. Triumphant Onset, Savimsa, Vigour, Dvâvimsa. Maintenance, Trayovimsa. Womb, Chaturvimsa. Embryos, Pañchavimsa.…
verses.commentary: Sense: This Swift, the triple praise-song. The Shining, the Pañchadasa hymn. Heaven, the Saptadasa. The Supporter, the Ekavimsa. Speed, the Ashtâdasa. Ardour, the Navadasa. Triumphant Onset, Savimsa, Vigour, Dvâvimsa. Maintenance, Trayovimsa. Womb, Chaturvimsa. Embryos, Pañchavimsa.…

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒ग्नेर्भा॒गो॒ऽसि दी॒क्षाया॒ आधि॑पत्यं॒ ब्रह्म॑ स्पृ॒तं त्रि॒वृत्स्तोम॒
इन्द्र॑स्य भा॒गो॒ऽसि॒ विष्णो॒राधि॑पत्यं क्ष॒त्रᳪ स्पृ॒तं प॑ञ्चद॒शः स्तोमो॑
नृ॒चक्ष॑सां भा॒गो॒ऽसि धा॒तुराधि॑पत्यं ज॒नित्र॑ᳪ स्पृ॒तᳪ स॑प्तद॒श स्तोमो
मि॒त्रस्य॑ भा॒गो॒ऽसि॒ वरु॑ण॒स्याधि॑पत्यं दि॒वो वृष्टि॒र्वात॑ स्पृ॒त ए॑कवि॒ᳪश स्तोम॑:
verses.translation: Thou art the portion of Agni, chief control of Consecration. The Priesthood is saved; the Trivrit Stoma. Thou art the portion of Indra, the sovranty of Vishnu. The Nobility is saved; the Pañchadasa Stoma. Thou art the share of the Man-beholders; the supremacy of the Creator; the birthplace is saved; the Saptadasa Stoma. Thou art the share of Mitra, the sovranty of Varuna. Rain of heaven and wind are saved; the Ekavimsa Stoma.
verses.hindi: पली को चाहिए कि अपने जीवन को नियमित बनाकर घर मेँ सबके जीवन को व्यवस्थित करनेवाली हो। पति ने अन्न, रस, धन व पोषण का ध्यान करना है। इस प्रकार अपने-अपने कर्त्तव्य को करने से इनका यह लोक अच्छा बनेगा। १. आशुः (अश्नुते कर्मसु) =तू सदा कर्मो में व्याप्त होनेवाला बनता है ओर आलस्य
verses.transliteration: agnerbhāgo'si dīkṣāyā ādhipatyaṃ brahma spṛtaṃ trivṛtstoma indrasya bhāgo'si viṣṇorādhipatyaṃ kṣatra spṛtaṃ pañcadaśaḥ stomo nṛcakṣasāṃ bhāgo'si dhāturādhipatyaṃ janitra spṛta saptadaśa stomo mitrasya bhāgo'si varuṇasyādhipatyaṃ divo vṛṣṭirvāta spṛta ekaviśa stoma:
verses.wordMeaning: Thou art the portion of Agni, chief control of Consecration. The Priesthood is saved; the Trivrit Stoma. Thou art the portion of Indra, the sovranty of Vishnu. The Nobility is saved; the Pañchadasa Stoma. Thou art the share of the Man-beholders; the supremacy of the Creator;…
verses.commentary: Sense: Thou art the portion of Agni, chief control of Consecration. The Priesthood is saved; the Trivrit Stoma. Thou art the portion of Indra, the sovranty of Vishnu. The Nobility is saved; the Pañchadasa Stoma. Thou art the share of the Man-beholders; the supremacy of the Creator;…

verses.sanskrit:
वसू॑नां भा॒गो॒ऽसि रु॒द्राणा॒माधि॑पत्यं॒ चतु॑ष्पात् स्पृ॒तं च॑तुर्वि॒ᳪश स्तोम॑
आदि॒त्यानां॑ भा॒गो॒ऽसि म॒रुता॒माधि॑पत्यं॒ गर्भा॑ स्पृ॒ताः प॑ञ्चवि॒ᳪश॒ स्तोमो
ऽदि॑त्यै भा॒गो॒ऽसि पू॒ष्ण आधि॑पत्य॒मोज॑ स्पृ॒तं त्रि॑ण॒व स्तोमो॑
दे॒वस्य॑ सवि॒तुर्भा॒गो॒ऽसि बृह॒स्पते॒राधि॑पत्यᳪ स॒मीची॒र्दिश॑ स्पृ॒ताश्च॑तुष्टो॒म स्तोम॑:
verses.translation: Thou art the share of the Vasus, the sovranty of the Rudras. Quadrupeds are saved; the Chaturvimsa Stoma. Thou art the share of the Âdityas; the sovranty of the Maruts. The Embryos are saved; the Pañchavimsa Stoma. Thou art the share of Aditi; the sovranty of Pûshan. Strength is saved; the Trinava Stoma. Thou art the share of God Savitar; the sovranty of Brihaspati. The universal Quarters are saved; the Chatushtoma Stoma.
verses.hindi: हम उत्तम निवासवाले बनकर चतुष्पात् धर्म ( स्वाध्याय, यन्न, तप व दान) कौ रक्षा करे। गुणों का आदान करनेवाले बनकर हम अपनी सब इन्द्रियो की अनर्थो से रक्षा करें। अदिति (पूर्ण स्वास्थ्य) के उपासक बनकर हम ओजस्वी बनें ओर उत्पादक देव कौ उपासना करते हए दिशाओं से दिये गये उपदेशों को जीवन में अनूदित करे।
verses.transliteration: vasūnāṃ bhāgo'si rudrāṇāmādhipatyaṃ catuṣpāt spṛtaṃ caturviśa stoma ādityānāṃ bhāgo'si marutāmādhipatyaṃ garbhā spṛtāḥ pañcaviśa stomo 'dityai bhāgo'si pūṣṇa ādhipatyamoja spṛtaṃ triṇava stomo devasya saviturbhāgo'si bṛhaspaterādhipatya samīcīrdiśa spṛtāścatuṣṭoma stoma:
verses.wordMeaning: Thou art the share of the Vasus, the sovranty of the Rudras. Quadrupeds are saved; the Chaturvimsa Stoma. Thou art the share of the Âdityas; the sovranty of the Maruts. The Embryos are saved; the Pañchavimsa Stoma. Thou art the share of Aditi; the sovranty of Pûshan.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Thou art the share of the Vasus, the sovranty of the Rudras. Quadrupeds are saved; the Chaturvimsa Stoma. Thou art the share of the Âdityas; the sovranty of the Maruts. The Embryos are saved; the Pañchavimsa Stoma. Thou art the share of Aditi; the sovranty of Pûshan.…

verses.sanskrit:
यवा॑नां भा॒गोऽस्यय॑वाना॒माधि॑पत्यं प्र॒जा स्पृ॒ताश्च॑तुश्चत्वारि॒ᳪश स्तोम॑
ऋ॑भू॒णां भा॒गो॒ऽसि विश्वे॑षां दे॒वाना॒माधि॑पत्यं भू॒तᳪ स्पृ॒तं त्र॑यस्त्रि॒ᳪश स्तोम॑:
verses.translation: Thou art the share of the Yavas; the sovranty of the Ayavas. Creatures are saved; the Chatuschatvârimsa Stoma. Thou art the share of the Ribhus; the sovranty of the Visvedevas. The Being is saved; the Trayastrimsa Stoma.
verses.hindi: शुक्लपक्ष हमें गुण--कला वृद्धि का उपदेश दे रहा है ओर कृष्णापक्ष एक-एक करके अवगुणों को समाप्त करके प्रभु के समीप पचने का संकेत करता हे, अतः हम ज्ञानदीप्त, ऋतमय जीवनवाले मेधावियोँ के उपासक बनकर जीवन में सब दिव्य गुणों को धारण करनेवाले बनें।
verses.transliteration: yavānāṃ bhāgo'syayavānāmādhipatyaṃ prajā spṛtāścatuścatvāriśa stoma ṛbhūṇāṃ bhāgo'si viśveṣāṃ devānāmādhipatyaṃ bhūta spṛtaṃ trayastriśa stoma:
verses.wordMeaning: Thou art the share of the Yavas; the sovranty of the Ayavas. Creatures are saved; the Chatuschatvârimsa Stoma. Thou art the share of the Ribhus; the sovranty of the Visvedevas. The Being is saved; the Trayastrimsa Stoma.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thou art the share of the Yavas; the sovranty of the Ayavas. Creatures are saved; the Chatuschatvârimsa Stoma. Thou art the share of the Ribhus; the sovranty of the Visvedevas. The Being is saved; the Trayastrimsa Stoma.

verses.sanskrit:
सह॑श्च सह॒स्य॒श्च हैम॑न्तिकावृ॒तू अ॒ग्नेर॑न्तः श्ले॒षो॒ऽसि॒ कल्पे॑तां॒ द्यावा॑पृथि॒वी कल्प॑न्ता॒माप॒ ओष॑धय॒: कल्प॑न्ताम॒ग्नय॒: पृथ॒ङ्नम॒ ज्यैष्ठ्या॑य॒ सव्र॑ताः।
ये अ॒ग्नय॒: सम॑नसोऽन्त॒रा द्यावा॑पृथि॒वी इ॒मे| है॑मन्तिकावृ॒तू अ॑भि॒कल्प॑माना॒ इन्द्र॑मिव दे॒वा अ॑भि॒संवि॑शन्तु॒ तया॑ दे॒वत॑याऽङ्गिर॒स्वद् ध्रु॒वे सी॑दतम्
verses.translation: Sahas, Sahasya, the two Winter Seasons—thou art the innermost cement of Agni, etc. (as in XIII. 25).
verses.hindi: सहनशक्ति व बल का सम्पादन करके हम गतिशील व प्रगतिशील बने। हमारा जीवन व्यवस्थित हो। हम जलों व ओषधियों का ही सेवन करे। यह ध्यान रक्खें कि "मांस" न खाँ, क्योंकि वह तो मुञ्े ही खा जाएगा। प्रभु-उपासना करते हए हम घर में ध्रुव निवासवाले हों. वहो हमारा जीवन बड़ा मर्यादित हो।
verses.transliteration: sahaśca sahasyaśca haimantikāvṛtū agnerantaḥ śleṣo'si kalpetāṃ dyāvāpṛthivī kalpantāmāpa oṣadhaya: kalpantāmagnaya: pṛthaṅnama jyaiṣṭhyāya savratāḥ| ye agnaya: samanaso'ntarā dyāvāpṛthivī ime| haimantikāvṛtū abhikalpamānā indramiva devā abhisaṃviśantu tayā devatayā'ṅgirasvad dhruve sīdatam
verses.wordMeaning: Sahas, Sahasya, the two Winter Seasons—thou art the innermost cement of Agni, etc. (as in XIII. 25).
verses.commentary: Sense: Sahas, Sahasya, the two Winter Seasons—thou art the innermost cement of Agni, etc. (as in XIII. 25).

verses.sanskrit: एक॑यास्तुवत प्र॒जा अ॑धीयन्त प्र॒जाप॑ति॒रधि॑पतिरासीत् ति॒सृभि॑रस्तुवत॒ ब्रह्मा॑सृज्यत॒ ब्रह्म॑ण॒स्पति॒रधि॑पतिरासीत्  प॒ञ्चभि॑रस्तुवत भू॒तान्य॑सृज्यन्त भू॒तानां॒ पति॒रधि॑पतिरासीत् स॒प्तभि॑रस्तुवत सप्त ऋ॒षयो॑ऽसृज्यन्त धा॒ताऽधि॑पतिरासीत्
verses.translation: With one they praised; creatures were produced. Prajâpati was over-lord. With three they praised; the Priesthood was created. Brihaspati was over-lord. With five they praised; beings were created. The Lord of Beings was over-lord. With seven they praised; the Seven Rishis were created. Dhâtar was over-lord.
verses.hindi: उस प्रभु "का स्तवन हम ' प्रजापति, ब्रह्मणस्पति, भूतानांपति व धाता! इन कनृवभिरस्तुवत पितरो ऽस्ज्यन्तादिः तिरधिंपल्यासीदेकादशभिरस्तुवतऽ ऋतवो ऽ १. पितरः असुज्यन्त=(पितरः=नव जगद्रक्षका रश्मयः। नव वै प्राणाः सप्तशीर्षन्नवाञ्चौ द्रो-श० ८।४।३।७) ज्ञानेद्धिर्योँ व॒ कर्मेन्दियोँ रक्षा करने के प्रमुख साधन होने से यँ
verses.transliteration: ekayāstuvata prajā adhīyanta prajāpatiradhipatirāsīt tisṛbhirastuvata brahmāsṛjyata brahmaṇaspatiradhipatirāsīt pañcabhirastuvata bhūtānyasṛjyanta bhūtānāṃ patiradhipatirāsīt saptabhirastuvata sapta ṛṣayo'sṛjyanta dhātā'dhipatirāsīt
verses.wordMeaning: With one they praised; creatures were produced. Prajâpati was over-lord. With three they praised; the Priesthood was created. Brihaspati was over-lord. With five they praised; beings were created. The Lord of Beings was over-lord. With seven they praised;…
verses.commentary: Sense: With one they praised; creatures were produced. Prajâpati was over-lord. With three they praised; the Priesthood was created. Brihaspati was over-lord. With five they praised; beings were created. The Lord of Beings was over-lord. With seven they praised;…

verses.sanskrit: न॒वभि॑रस्तुवत पि॒तरो॑ऽसृज्य॒न्तादि॑ति॒रधि॑पत्न्यासीदेकाद॒शभि॑रस्तुवत ऋ॒तवो॑ऽसृज्यन्तार्त॒वा अधि॑पतय आसँस्त्रयोद॒शभि॑रस्तुवत॒ मासा॑ असृज्यन्त संवत्स॒रोऽधि॑पतिरासीत् पञ्चद॒शभि॑रस्तुवत क्ष॒त्रम॑सृज्य॒तेन्द्रो॑ऽधि॑पतिरासीत् सप्तद॒शभि॑रस्तुवत ग्रा॒म्याः प॒शवो॑ऽसृज्यन्त॒ बृह॒स्पति॒रधि॑पतिरासीत्
verses.translation: With nine they praised; the Fathers were created. Aditi was Sovran Lady. With eleven they praised; the Seasons were created. The Season-Lords were over-lords. With thirteen they praised; the Months were created. The Year was over-lord. With fifteen they praised; the Nobility was created. Indra was over-lord. With seventeen they praised; domestic animals were created. Brihaspati was over-lord.
verses.hindi: हमारा रोम-रोम उस प्रभु का स्तवन “अदिति, आर्तव, संवत्सर, इन्द्र व वृहस्पति" इन नामों से कर रहा हो। उन्नीस-इक्कीस-तेईस-पच्यीस व सताईस १९. अव गत मन्त्र के ग्राम्य पशुओं से सीधे कार्य लेनेवाले शूद्रार्यौ =शद्र व वेश्य
verses.transliteration: navabhirastuvata pitaro'sṛjyantāditiradhipatnyāsīdekādaśabhirastuvata ṛtavo'sṛjyantārtavā adhipataya āsa~strayodaśabhirastuvata māsā asṛjyanta saṃvatsaro'dhipatirāsīt pañcadaśabhirastuvata kṣatramasṛjyatendro'dhipatirāsīt saptadaśabhirastuvata grāmyāḥ paśavo'sṛjyanta bṛhaspatiradhipatirāsīt
verses.wordMeaning: With nine they praised; the Fathers were created. Aditi was Sovran Lady. With eleven they praised; the Seasons were created. The Season-Lords were over-lords. With thirteen they praised; the Months were created. The Year was over-lord. With fifteen they praised;…
verses.commentary: Sense: With nine they praised; the Fathers were created. Aditi was Sovran Lady. With eleven they praised; the Seasons were created. The Season-Lords were over-lords. With thirteen they praised; the Months were created. The Year was over-lord. With fifteen they praised;…

verses.sanskrit:
न॒वद॒शभि॑रस्तुवत शूद्रा॒र्याव॑सृज्येतामहोरा॒त्रे अधि॑पत्नी आस्ता॒मेक॑विᳪशत्यास्तुव॒तैक॑शपाः प॒शवो॑ऽसृज्यन्त॒ वरु॒णोऽधि॑पतिरासी॒त्
त्रयो॑विᳪशत्यास्तुवत क्षु॒द्रा: प॒शवो॑ऽसृज्यन्त पू॒षाऽधि॑पतिरासी॒त् पञ्च॑विᳪशत्यास्तुवतार॒ण्याः प॒शवो॑ऽसृज्यन्त वा॒युरधि॑पतिरासीत्
स॒प्तवि॑ᳪशत्याऽस्तुवत॒ द्यावा॑पृथि॒वी व्यै॑तां॒ वस॑वो रु॒द्रा आ॑दि॒त्या अ॑नु॒व्या॒यँ॒स्त ए॒वाधि॑पतय आसन्
verses.translation: With nineteen they praised; Sûdra and Arya were created. Day and Night were Sovran Ladies. With twenty-one they praised; solid-hoofed animals were created. Varuna was over-lord. With twenty-three they praised; small animals were created. Pûshan was over-lord. With twenty-five they praised; forest animals were created. Vâyu was over-lord. With twenty-seven they praised; earth and heaven came apart. Vasus, Rudras, Âdityas followed separately, so they were over-lords.
verses.hindi: हम 'एकशफ, क्षुद्र व आरण्य ' पशुओं का भी उपयोग समञ्चं ओर इनमें भी चदठदशोऽध्यायः फर यचुर्वेदभाव्यम् प्रभु कौ महिमा को देखने का प्रयल करे। हमारा प्रत्येक अङ्क प्रभु का स्तवन करनेवाला हो। हम उस प्रभु  को ' अहोरात्र-वरुण-पूषा-वायु तथा वसु, रुद्र व आदित्य ' नाम से स्मरण करे।
verses.transliteration: navadaśabhirastuvata śūdrāryāvasṛjyetāmahorātre adhipatnī āstāmekaviśatyāstuvataikaśapāḥ paśavo'sṛjyanta varuṇo'dhipatirāsīt trayoviśatyāstuvata kṣudrā: paśavo'sṛjyanta pūṣā'dhipatirāsīt pañcaviśatyāstuvatāraṇyāḥ paśavo'sṛjyanta vāyuradhipatirāsīt saptaviśatyā'stuvata dyāvāpṛthivī vyaitāṃ vasavo rudrā ādityā anuvyāya~sta evādhipataya āsan
verses.wordMeaning: With nineteen they praised; Sûdra and Arya were created. Day and Night were Sovran Ladies. With twenty-one they praised; solid-hoofed animals were created. Varuna was over-lord. With twenty-three they praised; small animals were created. Pûshan was over-lord.…
verses.commentary: Sense: With nineteen they praised; Sûdra and Arya were created. Day and Night were Sovran Ladies. With twenty-one they praised; solid-hoofed animals were created. Varuna was over-lord. With twenty-three they praised; small animals were created. Pûshan was over-lord.…

verses.sanskrit: नव॑विᳪशत्याऽस्तुवत॒ वन॒स्पत॑योऽसृज्यन्त॒ सोमोऽधि॑पतिरासी॒देक॑त्रिᳪशताऽस्तुवत प्र॒जा अ॑सृज्यन्त॒ यवा॒श्चाय॑वा॒श्चाधि॑पतय आसँ॒त्रय॑स्त्रिᳪशताऽस्तुवत भू॒तान्य॑शाम्यन् प्र॒जाप॑तिः परमे॒ष्ठ्यधि॑पतिरासील्लो॒कं ता इन्द्र॑म्
verses.translation: With twenty-nine they praised; Trees were created. Soma was over-lord. With thirty-one they praised; creatures were created. The Yavas and the Ayavas were over-lords. With thirty-three they praised; living beings. were happy. Prajâpati, the Supreme in Place, was over-lord. Fill up the room, etc. The dappled kine, etc. All sacred songs, etc. Repeated from XII. 14-16.
verses.hindi: प्रभु विविध वनस्पतियों के उत्पादन द्वारा हमारी सब शक्तियों के विकास का कारण बनते है ओर हमारे जीवनों मे शान्ति उत्पन्न करते ै। हम उस प्रभु का "सोम, यव, अयव तथा प्रजापति, परमेष्ठी ' नाम से स्तवन करे। सूचना-- गत मन्त्रो मे यह भावना बारम्बार दोहराई गई है कि मेरा अङ्क- अद्ध उस
verses.transliteration: navaviśatyā'stuvata vanaspatayo'sṛjyanta somo'dhipatirāsīdekatriśatā'stuvata prajā asṛjyanta yavāścāyavāścādhipataya āsa~trayastriśatā'stuvata bhūtānyaśāmyan prajāpatiḥ parameṣṭhyadhipatirāsīllokaṃ tā indram
verses.wordMeaning: With twenty-nine they praised; Trees were created. Soma was over-lord. With thirty-one they praised; creatures were created. The Yavas and the Ayavas were over-lords. With thirty-three they praised; living beings. were happy. Prajâpati, the Supreme in Place, was over-lord.…
verses.commentary: Sense: With twenty-nine they praised; Trees were created. Soma was over-lord. With thirty-one they praised; creatures were created. The Yavas and the Ayavas were over-lords. With thirty-three they praised; living beings. were happy. Prajâpati, the Supreme in Place, was over-lord.…

verses.sanskrit:
अग्ने॑ जा॒तान् प्र णु॑दा नः स॒पत्ना॒न् प्रत्यजा॑तान् नुद जातवेदः।
अधि॑ नो ब्रूहि सु॒मना॒ अहे॑डँ॒स्तव॑ स्याम॒ शर्मँ॑स्त्रि॒वरू॑थ उ॒द्भौ
verses.translation: com The Texts of the White Yajurveda, tr. Ralph T.H. Griffith, [1899], DRIVE our born enemies away, O Agni; drive from us foes unborn, O Jâtavedas. Graciously-minded, free from anger, bless us: may we enjoy my firm thrice-guarding shelter. Drive off with might our foemen born and living: keep off these yet unborn, O Jâtavedas. Benevolent in thought and spirit bless us. May we remain alive: drive off our foemen.
verses.hindi: पति ओजस्वी व वर्चस्वी हो! पली पति की पूरिका, किसी के आगे हाथ न कैलानेवाली तथा वीर सन्तानो को जन्म देने के ब्रतवाली, स्वस्थ्य व ज्ञान-दीप्त हो। काव्यं छन्दोऽअङ्कुपं छन्दो ऽक्षर॑पद्धिर्छन्द॑ः पदपंद्धिर्छन्दो। विष्टारपं ्कि्छन्दः १. प्रभु  परमेष्ठी '=परम स्थान में स्थित होने के निश्चयवाले से कहते है कि तेरी
verses.transliteration: agne jātān pra ṇudā naḥ sapatnān pratyajātān nuda jātavedaḥ| adhi no brūhi sumanā aheḍa~stava syāma śarma~strivarūtha udbhau
verses.wordMeaning: com The Texts of the White Yajurveda, tr. Ralph T.H. Griffith, [1899], DRIVE our born enemies away, O Agni; drive from us foes unborn, O Jâtavedas. Graciously-minded, free from anger, bless us: may we enjoy my firm thrice-guarding shelter.…
verses.commentary: Sense: com The Texts of the White Yajurveda, tr. Ralph T.H. Griffith, [1899], DRIVE our born enemies away, O Agni; drive from us foes unborn, O Jâtavedas. Graciously-minded, free from anger, bless us: may we enjoy my firm thrice-guarding shelter.…

verses.sanskrit:
सह॑सा जा॒तान् प्र णु॑दा नः स॒पत्ना॒न् प्रत्यजा॑ताञ्जातवेदो नुदस्व ।
अधि॑ नो ब्रूहि सुमन॒स्यमा॑नो व॒यᳪ स्या॑म॒ प्र णु॑दा नः स॒पत्ना॑न्
verses.translation: The Sixteenfold Stoma, strength and wealth.
verses.hindi: -इसर जीवन में मेरी कामना मन्त्र वर्णित १८ शब्दों के अनुसार हो। “ ज्ञान, सेवा, शान्ति, पुरुषार्थ, दोषापावरण, मनन, आत्म-विस्तार एवं सद्गुण ग्रहण, सहज क्रियाँ गम्भीरता, शान्ति व माधुर्य, शिखर पर पहुंचना, स्वास्थ्य नैर्मल्य, प्रभु के काव्य को अपनाना, अकुटिलता, सदा प्रभु-स्मरण, न्यायमार्ग- प्रवृत्ति, शक्ति- विस्तार, अन्धकार विलेखन व
verses.transliteration: sahasā jātān pra ṇudā naḥ sapatnān pratyajātāñjātavedo nudasva | adhi no brūhi sumanasyamāno vaya syāma pra ṇudā naḥ sapatnān
verses.wordMeaning: The Sixteenfold Stoma, strength and wealth.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Sixteenfold Stoma, strength and wealth.

verses.sanskrit:
षो॒ड॒शी स्तोम॒ ओजो॒ द्रवि॑णं चतुश्चत्वारि॒ᳪश स्तोमो॒ वर्चो॒ द्रवि॑णम् ।
अ॒ग्नेः पुरी॑षम॒स्यप्सो॒ नाम॒ तां त्वा॒ विश्वे॑ अ॒भि गृ॑णन्तु दे॒वाः ।
स्तोम॑पृष्ठा घृ॒तव॑ती॒ह सी॑द प्र॒जाव॑द॒स्मे द्रवि॒णा य॑जस्व
verses.translation: The Forty- fourth Stoma, splendour and wealth. Apsas art thou, the complement of Agni. As such may all the Gods greet thee with praises. Enriched with songs of praise, Prishthas, and butter, sit here and give us wealth with store of children.
verses.hindi: हम आच्छत् छन्द से अङ्काङ्कः छन्द तक पहँचनेवाले बनें। पाप-निवारणात्मक कर्मों को करते हुए हम प्रभु की गोद मेँ पहुंचने का ध्यान करे। फञ्चदखोऽध्यायः २८८ यजुर्वेद भाष्यम् रश्मिना स॒त्याय॑ सत्यं जिन्व प्रतिना धर्म॑णा धर्म॑ जिन्वाग्वित्या दिवादिव॑ जिन्व
verses.transliteration: ṣoḍaśī stoma ojo draviṇaṃ catuścatvāriśa stomo varco draviṇam | agneḥ purīṣamasyapso nāma tāṃ tvā viśve abhi gṛṇantu devāḥ | stomapṛṣṭhā ghṛtavatīha sīda prajāvadasme draviṇā yajasva
verses.wordMeaning: The Forty- fourth Stoma, splendour and wealth. Apsas art thou, the complement of Agni. As such may all the Gods greet thee with praises. Enriched with songs of praise, Prishthas, and butter, sit here and give us wealth with store of children.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Forty- fourth Stoma, splendour and wealth. Apsas art thou, the complement of Agni. As such may all the Gods greet thee with praises. Enriched with songs of praise, Prishthas, and butter, sit here and give us wealth with store of children.

verses.sanskrit:
एव॒श्छन्दो॒ वरि॑व॒श्छन्द॑: श॒म्भूश्छन्द॑: परि॒भूश्छन्द॑ आ॒च्छच्छन्दो॒ मन॒श्छन्दो॒
व्यच॒श्छन्द॒: सिन्धु॒श्छन्द॑: समु॒द्रश्छन्द॑:सरि॒रं छन्द॑: क॒कुप्छन्द॑स्त्रिक॒कुप्छन्द॑: का॒व्यं छन्दो॒
अङ्कु॒॒पं छन्दो॒ ऽक्षर॑पङ्क्ति॒श्छन्द॑: प॒दप॑ङ्क्ति॒श्छन्दो॑ विष्टा॒रप॑ङ्क्ति॒श्छन्द॑: क्षु॒रो भ्रज॒श्छन्द॑:
verses.translation: Course metre. Space metre. Happy metre, Encompassing metre. Covering metre. Mind metre. Expanse metre. River metre. Sea metre. Water metre. Kakup metre. Trikakup metre. Kâvya metre. Ankupa metre Aksharapankti metre. Padapankti metre. Vishtârapankti metre. Kshurabhrâja metre.
verses.hindi: हम “त्रिवृत्, प्रवृत्, विवृत् व सवृत्' बनकर " आक्रम, संक्रम व उत्क्रम ¢ हो ओर एक विशिष्ट (उत्कृष्ट) क्रान्ति के लिए प्रभु-सम्पर्क से अपने में शक्ति का क्दाज्य॑सि प्राची दिग्वस॑वस्ते देवाऽअधिंपतयो ऽन्निर्ह'तीनां प्र॑तिधर्ता त्रिवृत्त्वा अन्तरिश्चऽ ऋष॑यस्त्वा स्प्रथमजा देवेषु दिवो मात्र॑या वरिम्णा प्र॑थन्तु विधर्ता
verses.transliteration: evaśchando varivaśchanda: śambhūśchanda: paribhūśchanda ācchacchando manaśchando vyacaśchanda: sindhuśchanda: samudraśchanda:sariraṃ chanda: kakupchandastrikakupchanda: kāvyaṃ chando aṅkupaṃ chando 'kṣarapaṅktiśchanda: padapaṅktiśchando viṣṭārapaṅktiśchanda: kṣuro bhrajaśchanda:
verses.wordMeaning: Course metre. Space metre. Happy metre, Encompassing metre. Covering metre. Mind metre. Expanse metre. River metre. Sea metre. Water metre. Kakup metre. Trikakup metre. Kâvya metre. Ankupa metre Aksharapankti metre. Padapankti metre. Vishtârapankti metre. Kshurabhrâja metre.
verses.commentary: Sense: Course metre. Space metre. Happy metre, Encompassing metre. Covering metre. Mind metre. Expanse metre. River metre. Sea metre. Water metre. Kakup metre. Trikakup metre. Kâvya metre. Ankupa metre Aksharapankti metre. Padapankti metre. Vishtârapankti metre. Kshurabhrâja metre.

verses.sanskrit:
आ॒च्छच्छन्द॑: प्र॒च्छच्छन्द॑: सं॒यच्छन्दो॑ वि॒यच्छन्दो॑ बृ॒हच्छन्दो॑ रथन्त॒रञ्छन्दो॑ निका॒यश्छन्दो॑
विवधश्छन्दो॒ गिर॒श्छन्दो॒ भ्रज॒श्छन्द॑: स॒ᳪस्तुप्छन्दो॑ ऽनु॒ष्टुप्छन्द॒ एव॒श्छन्दो॒ वरि॑व॒श्छन्दो॒ वय॒श्छन्दो॑ वय॒स्कृच्छन्दो॒ विष्प॑र्धा॒श्छन्दो॑
विशा॒लं छन्द॑श्छ॒दिश्छन्दो॑ दूरोह॒णं छन्द॑स्त॒न्द्रं छन्दो॑ अङ्का॒ङ्कं छन्द॑:
verses.translation: Covering metre. Clothing metre. Collecting metre. Parting metre. Brihat metre. Rathantara metre, Group metre. Vivadhra metre. Swallower metre. Bright metre. Samstup metre. Anushtup metre. Course metre. Space metre. Vigour metre. Vigour-giving metre. Emulating metre. Spacious metre, Inaccessible metre. Slow metre. Ankânka metre.
verses.hindi: पल्ली ज्ञान-दीप्त, निरन्तर उन्नति-पथ पर बदनेवाली हो, धर्मार्थ, काम का समानुपात में सेवन करती हो। घृतादि करे प्रयोग से शरीर को स्वस्थ रक्खे। शरीररूप रथ से जीवन-यात्रा को पूर्णं करने का निश्चय करे। पति ' अग्नि" अग्रेणी हो। एेसा होने पर ज्विराङसि दक्षिणा दिग्रद्रास्त देवाऽअधिंपतयऽ इन्द्रौ हेतीनां प्र॑तिधर््ता
verses.transliteration: ācchacchanda: pracchacchanda: saṃyacchando viyacchando bṛhacchando rathantarañchando nikāyaśchando vivadhaśchando giraśchando bhrajaśchanda: sastupchando 'nuṣṭupchanda evaśchando varivaśchando vayaśchando vayaskṛcchando viṣpardhāśchando viśālaṃ chandaśchadiśchando dūrohaṇaṃ chandastandraṃ chando aṅkāṅkaṃ chanda:
verses.wordMeaning: Covering metre. Clothing metre. Collecting metre. Parting metre. Brihat metre. Rathantara metre, Group metre. Vivadhra metre. Swallower metre. Bright metre. Samstup metre. Anushtup metre. Course metre. Space metre. Vigour metre. Vigour-giving metre. Emulating metre.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Covering metre. Clothing metre. Collecting metre. Parting metre. Brihat metre. Rathantara metre, Group metre. Vivadhra metre. Swallower metre. Bright metre. Samstup metre. Anushtup metre. Course metre. Space metre. Vigour metre. Vigour-giving metre. Emulating metre.…

verses.sanskrit: र॒श्मिना॑ स॒त्याय॑ स॒त्यं जि॑न्व॒ प्रेति॑ना॒ धर्म॑णा॒ धर्मं॑ जि॒न्वान्वि॑त्या दि॒वा दिवं॑ जिन्व स॒न्धिना॒ऽन्तरि॑क्षेणा॒न्तरि॑क्षं जिन्व प्रति॒धिना॑ पृथि॒व्या पृ॑थि॒वीं जि॑न्व विष्ट॒म्भेन॒ वृष्ट्या॒ वृष्टिं॑ जिन्व प्र॒वयाऽह्नाऽह॑र्जिन्वानु॒या रात्र्या॒ रात्रीं॑ जिन्वो॒शिजा॒ वसु॑भ्यो॒ वसू॑ञ्जिन्व प्रके॒तेना॑दि॒त्येभ्य॑ आदि॒त्याञ्जि॑न्व
verses.translation: With the ray for truth quicken thou truth. With advance by duty quicken duty. With following by heaven quicken heaven. With union by middle air quicken middle air. With Pratidhi by Earth quicken Earth. With support by rain quicken rain. With blowing away by day quicken day. With following by eight quicken night. With clarified butter by the Vasus quicken the Vasus. With perception by the Âdityas quicken the Âdityas.
verses.hindi: पलरी घर की अधिपती हो। उसका शरीर, मन-व बुद्धि तीनों को नवीन (त्रि+नव) व पुष्ट बनाये रखना व मन मे सब गुणो को धारण करना" ये मौलिक सिद्धान्त हो जाँ वह “शरीर को शक्तिशाली बनाये, मस्तिष्क को ज्लानधन सम्पन्न करे' इन्ीं को वह प्रभु उपासन जाने। पति ऊँचे-से-ऊँचा ज्ञानी बनने का प्रयल करे।
verses.transliteration: raśminā satyāya satyaṃ jinva pretinā dharmaṇā dharmaṃ jinvānvityā divā divaṃ jinva sandhinā'ntarikṣeṇāntarikṣaṃ jinva pratidhinā pṛthivyā pṛthivīṃ jinva viṣṭambhena vṛṣṭyā vṛṣṭiṃ jinva pravayā'hnā'harjinvānuyā rātryā rātrīṃ jinvośijā vasubhyo vasūñjinva praketenādityebhya ādityāñjinva
verses.wordMeaning: With the ray for truth quicken thou truth. With advance by duty quicken duty. With following by heaven quicken heaven. With union by middle air quicken middle air. With Pratidhi by Earth quicken Earth. With support by rain quicken rain. With blowing away by day quicken day.…
verses.commentary: Sense: With the ray for truth quicken thou truth. With advance by duty quicken duty. With following by heaven quicken heaven. With union by middle air quicken middle air. With Pratidhi by Earth quicken Earth. With support by rain quicken rain. With blowing away by day quicken day.…

verses.sanskrit: तन्तु॑ना रा॒यस्पोषे॑ण रा॒यस्पोषं॑ जिन्व सᳪस॒र्पे॑ण श्रु॒ताय॑ श्रु॒तं जि॑न्वै॒डेनौ॑षधीभि॒रोष॑धीर्जिन्वोत्त॒मेन॑ त॒नूभि॑स्त॒नूर्जि॑न्व व॑यो॒धसाधी॑ते॒नाधी॑तं जिन्वाभि॒जिता॒ तेज॑सा॒ तेजो॑ जिन्व
verses.translation: With the thread by prosperity quicken prosperity. With the creeper by revelation quicken revelation. With refreshment by plants quicken plants. With the best by bodies quicken bodies. With the invigorating by religious study quicken religious study. With the victorious by brilliance quicken brilliance.
verses.hindi: राजा राष्ट को आगे ले-चलनेवाला, दुःख का हरणकारी, ज्ञान से परिपूर्ण, सूर्य के समान ज्ञान की रश्मयो से प्रजा मेँ प्रकाश फैलानेवाला हो। इसके परिचारक रथां से प्रजा में विचरण करनेवाले हो-कुर्सियों को ही संभाले रखनेवांले नदीं। अयं द॑क्चिणा विश्वकर्मा तस्य॑ रथस्वनश्च रथचित्रश्च सेनानीग्रामण्य्यो। मेनका
verses.transliteration: tantunā rāyaspoṣeṇa rāyaspoṣaṃ jinva sasarpeṇa śrutāya śrutaṃ jinvaiḍenauṣadhībhiroṣadhīrjinvottamena tanūbhistanūrjinva vayodhasādhītenādhītaṃ jinvābhijitā tejasā tejo jinva
verses.wordMeaning: With the thread by prosperity quicken prosperity. With the creeper by revelation quicken revelation. With refreshment by plants quicken plants. With the best by bodies quicken bodies. With the invigorating by religious study quicken religious study.…
verses.commentary: Sense: With the thread by prosperity quicken prosperity. With the creeper by revelation quicken revelation. With refreshment by plants quicken plants. With the best by bodies quicken bodies. With the invigorating by religious study quicken religious study.…

verses.sanskrit: प्रति॒पद॑सि प्रति॒पदे॑ त्वा ऽनु॒पद॑स्यनु॒पदे॑ त्वा स॒म्पद॑सि स॒म्पदे॑ त्वा तेजो॑ऽसि॒ तेज॑से त्वा
verses.translation: Thou art Pratipad, for Pratipad thee. Thou art Anupad, for Anupad thee. Thou art Sampad, for Sampad thee. Thou art brilliance, for brilliance thee.
verses.hindi: राजा का यह महान् कार्य है कि वह राष्ट में धन का पूर्ण नियमन करे। इसी के विषम असम-विभाग से राष्ट में अतिभुक्तं (०५९५) व अल्पसभुक्त (1146150 ) ये दो श्रेणियाँ उत्पन्न हो जाती है ओर राष्ट रोगी हो जाता है। इसके सैनिक सारे प्रान्त-भाग मे व्याप्त होकर देश की रक्षा करें ओर अन्य अध्यक्ष जीवन की आवश्यक वस्तुओं को
verses.transliteration: pratipadasi pratipade tvā 'nupadasyanupade tvā sampadasi sampade tvā tejo'si tejase tvā
verses.wordMeaning: Thou art Pratipad, for Pratipad thee. Thou art Anupad, for Anupad thee. Thou art Sampad, for Sampad thee. Thou art brilliance, for brilliance thee.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thou art Pratipad, for Pratipad thee. Thou art Anupad, for Anupad thee. Thou art Sampad, for Sampad thee. Thou art brilliance, for brilliance thee.

verses.sanskrit:
त्रि॒वृद॑सि त्रि॒वृते॑ त्वा  प्र॒वृद॑सि प्र॒वृते॑ त्वा वि॒वृद॑सि वि॒वृते॑ त्वा  स॒वृद॑सि स॒वृते॑ त्वा
ऽऽक्र॒मो॒ऽस्याक्र॒माय॑ त्वा संक्र॒मो॒ऽसि संक्र॒माय॑ त्वोत्क्र॒मो॒ऽस्युत्क्र॒माय॒ त्वोत्क्रा॑न्तिर॒स्युत्क्रा॑न्त्यै॒ त्वा
ऽधि॑पतिनो॒र्जोर्जं॑ जिन्व
verses.translation: Trivrit (triple) art thou, thee for Trivrit. Pravrit art thou, thee for Pravrit. Vivrit art thou, thee for Vivrit. Savrit art thou, thee for Savrit. Thou art attack, thee for attack. Thou art concurrence, thee for concurrence. Thou art ascent, thee for ascent. Thou art upstriding, thee for upstriding. With Energy as over-lord quicken food-essence.
verses.hindi: हदय को हम पुष्कर=कमल बना, मस्तिष्क को सम्पूर्ण ज्ञान का वाहक ओर इस प्रकार प्रभु का दर्शन करनेवाले बनें। प्रभु-धारक के लक्षण, आत्मद्रष्टा के चिह्ठ भुवो यज्ञस्य रज॑सश्च नेता यत्रां नियुद््िः सच॑से शिवाभिः ।
verses.transliteration: trivṛdasi trivṛte tvā pravṛdasi pravṛte tvā vivṛdasi vivṛte tvā savṛdasi savṛte tvā ''kramo'syākramāya tvā saṃkramo'si saṃkramāya tvotkramo'syutkramāya tvotkrāntirasyutkrāntyai tvā 'dhipatinorjorjaṃ jinva
verses.wordMeaning: Trivrit (triple) art thou, thee for Trivrit. Pravrit art thou, thee for Pravrit. Vivrit art thou, thee for Vivrit. Savrit art thou, thee for Savrit. Thou art attack, thee for attack. Thou art concurrence, thee for concurrence. Thou art ascent, thee for ascent.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Trivrit (triple) art thou, thee for Trivrit. Pravrit art thou, thee for Pravrit. Vivrit art thou, thee for Vivrit. Savrit art thou, thee for Savrit. Thou art attack, thee for attack. Thou art concurrence, thee for concurrence. Thou art ascent, thee for ascent.…

verses.sanskrit:
राज्ञ्य॑सि॒ प्राची॒ दिग्वस॑वस्ते दे॒वा अधि॑पतयो॒ऽग्निर्हे॑ती॒नां प्र॑तिध॒र्ता त्रि॒वृत् त्वा॒ स्तोम॑: पृथि॒व्याᳪ श्र॑य॒त्वाज्य॑मु॒क्थमव्य॑थायै स्तभ्नातु रथन्त॒रᳪ साम॒ प्रति॑ष्ठित्या अ॒न्तरि॑क्ष॒ ऋष॑यस्त्वा प्रथम॒जा दे॒वेषु॑ दि॒वो मात्र॑या वरि॒म्णा प्र॑थन्तु विध॒र्ता चा॒यमधि॑पतिश्च॒ ते त्वा॒ सर्वे॑ संविदा॒ना नाक॑स्य पृ॒ष्ठे स्व॒र्गे लो॒के यज॑मानं च सादयन्तु ।। १ ०।।
वि॒राड॑सि॒ दक्षि॑णा॒ दिग्रु॒द्रास्ते॑ दे॒वा अधि॑पतय॒ इन्द्रो॑ हेती॒नां प्र॑तिध॒र्ता प॑ञ्चद॒स्त्वा॒ स्तोम॑: पृथि॒व्याᳪश्र॑यतु॒ प्र उ॑गमु॒क्थमव्य॑थायै स्तभ्नातु बृ॒हत्साम॒ प्रति॑ष्ठित्या अ॒न्तरि॑क्ष॒ ऋष॑यस्त्वा प्रथम॒जा दे॒वेषु॑ दि॒वो मात्र॑या वरि॒म्णा प्र॑थन्तु विध॒र्ता चा॒यमधि॑पतिश्च॒ ते त्वा॒ सर्वे॑ संविदा॒ना नाक॑स्य पृ॒ष्ठे स्व॒र्गे लो॒के यज॑मानं च सादयन्तु
verses.translation: Thou art Far-ruling, the Southern region. The bright Rudras are thine over-lords. Indra is thy warder-off of arrows. May the Pañchadasa Stoma support thee on earth. The Praüga Uktha fix thee firmly against slipping. The Brihat Sâman establish thee in the sky, etc. (the rest as in 10).
verses.hindi: -आत्मद्रष्टा पुरुष वह है जो १. यज्ञमय जीवनवाला होता है। २. यज्ञार्थं ही धनार्जन करता है। ३. शिव मार्ग में प्रवृत्त होनेवाले इन्द्रियाश्वों का स्वामी बनता है। ४. मस्तिष्क को ज्ञान में स्थापित करता हे। ५. जिह्वा से प्रभु-नामोच्चरण करता है। ६. सात्विक पदार्थो का ही सेवन करता है।
verses.transliteration: rājñyasi prācī digvasavaste devā adhipatayo'gnirhetīnāṃ pratidhartā trivṛt tvā stoma: pṛthivyā śrayatvājyamukthamavyathāyai stabhnātu rathantara sāma pratiṣṭhityā antarikṣa ṛṣayastvā prathamajā deveṣu divo mātrayā varimṇā prathantu vidhartā cāyamadhipatiśca te tvā sarve saṃvidānā nākasya pṛṣṭhe svarge loke yajamānaṃ ca sādayantu || 1 0|| virāḍasi dakṣiṇā digrudrāste devā adhipataya indro hetīnāṃ pratidhartā pañcadastvā stoma: pṛthivyāśrayatu pra ugamukthamavyathāyai stabhnātu bṛhatsāma pratiṣṭhityā antarikṣa ṛṣayastvā prathamajā deveṣu divo mātrayā varimṇā prathantu vidhartā cāyamadhipatiśca te tvā sarve saṃvidānā nākasya pṛṣṭhe svarge loke yajamānaṃ ca sādayantu
verses.wordMeaning: Thou art Far-ruling, the Southern region. The bright Rudras are thine over-lords. Indra is thy warder-off of arrows. May the Pañchadasa Stoma support thee on earth. The Praüga Uktha fix thee firmly against slipping. The Brihat Sâman establish thee in the sky, etc.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Thou art Far-ruling, the Southern region. The bright Rudras are thine over-lords. Indra is thy warder-off of arrows. May the Pañchadasa Stoma support thee on earth. The Praüga Uktha fix thee firmly against slipping. The Brihat Sâman establish thee in the sky, etc.…

verses.sanskrit: स॒म्राड॑सि प्र॒तीची॒ दिगा॑दि॒त्यास्ते॑ दे॒वा अधि॑पतयो॒ वरु॑णो हेती॒नां प्र॑तिध॒र्ता स॑प्तद॒शस्त्वा॒ स्तोम॑: पृथि॒व्याᳪ श्र॑यतु मरुत्व॒तीय॑मु॒क्थमव्य॑थायै स्तभ्नातु वैरू॒पᳪसाम॒ प्रति॑ष्ठित्या अ॒न्तरि॑क्ष॒ ऋष॑यस्त्वा प्रथम॒जा दे॒वेषु॑ दि॒वो मात्र॑या वरि॒म्णा प्र॑थन्तु विध॒र्ता चा॒यमधि॑पतिश्च॒ ते त्वा॒ सर्वे॑ संविदा॒ना नाक॑स्य पृ॒ष्ठे स्व॒र्गे लो॒के यज॑मानं च सादयन्तु
verses.translation: Thou art Universal Ruler, the Western region. The Âdityas are thine over-lords. Varuna is thy warder-off of missiles. The Saptadasa Stoma support thee on earth. The Marutvatîya Uktha fix thee firmly against slipping. The Vairûpa Sâman establish thee, etc. (as above).
verses.hindi: मेरी वाणी प्रभु नाम का उच्चारण करे। हृदय नग्रतापूर्वक प्रभु- स्तवन करता हो, मस्तिष्क प्रभु के साम्राज्य के ज्ञान से दीप्त हो ओर हाथ अधिक-से-अधिक प्राणियों के हित मेंलगे हो। (उस्र प्रभु के लिए) वनेषु चित्रम्
verses.transliteration: samrāḍasi pratīcī digādityāste devā adhipatayo varuṇo hetīnāṃ pratidhartā saptadaśastvā stoma: pṛthivyā śrayatu marutvatīyamukthamavyathāyai stabhnātu vairūpasāma pratiṣṭhityā antarikṣa ṛṣayastvā prathamajā deveṣu divo mātrayā varimṇā prathantu vidhartā cāyamadhipatiśca te tvā sarve saṃvidānā nākasya pṛṣṭhe svarge loke yajamānaṃ ca sādayantu
verses.wordMeaning: Thou art Universal Ruler, the Western region. The Âdityas are thine over-lords. Varuna is thy warder-off of missiles. The Saptadasa Stoma support thee on earth. The Marutvatîya Uktha fix thee firmly against slipping. The Vairûpa Sâman establish thee, etc. (as above).
verses.commentary: Sense: Thou art Universal Ruler, the Western region. The Âdityas are thine over-lords. Varuna is thy warder-off of missiles. The Saptadasa Stoma support thee on earth. The Marutvatîya Uktha fix thee firmly against slipping. The Vairûpa Sâman establish thee, etc. (as above).

verses.sanskrit: स्व॒राड॒स्युदी॒ची॒ दिङ्म॒रुत॑स्ते दे॒वा अधि॑पतय॒: सोमो॑ हेती॒नां प्र॑तिध॒र्तैक॑वि॒ᳪशस्त्वा॒ स्तोम॑: पृथि॒व्याᳪ श्र॑यतु॒ निष्के॑वल्यमु॒क्थमव्य॑थायै स्तभ्नातु वैरा॒जँ साम॒ प्रति॑ष्ठित्या अ॒न्तरि॑क्ष॒ ऋष॑यस्त्वा प्रथम॒जा दे॒वेषु॑ दि॒वो मात्र॑या वरि॒म्णा प्र॑थन्तु विध॒र्ता चा॒यमधि॑पतिश्च॒ ते त्वा॒ सर्वे॑ संविदा॒ना नाक॑स्य पृ॒ष्ठे स्व॒र्गे लो॒के यज॑मानं च सादयन्तु
verses.translation: Thou art Independent Ruler, the Northern region. (The rest is identical with 12, with the substitution of Maruts . . . Soma . . . .Vimsa Stoma . . . Nishkevalya Uktha. . . . Vairâja Sâman for the corresponding names).
verses.hindi: वे प्रभु हमें परस्पर मिलाते हे। हमपर सुखो कौ वर्षा करते है। हमें उन्नत करते हे। परमेश्वर होते हए सब आवश्यक वस्तुओं को प्राप्त कराते है। उस प्रभु का दर्शन ज्ञानवाणियों के अध्ययन से ज्ञान को बद्ाकर होता हे। १. है चित्रश्रवस्तम (चित्+र, श्रवः=धनम्) ज्ञानयुक्त धन के अतिशयवाले प्रभो!
verses.transliteration: svarāḍasyudīcī diṅmarutaste devā adhipataya: somo hetīnāṃ pratidhartaikaviśastvā stoma: pṛthivyā śrayatu niṣkevalyamukthamavyathāyai stabhnātu vairāja~ sāma pratiṣṭhityā antarikṣa ṛṣayastvā prathamajā deveṣu divo mātrayā varimṇā prathantu vidhartā cāyamadhipatiśca te tvā sarve saṃvidānā nākasya pṛṣṭhe svarge loke yajamānaṃ ca sādayantu
verses.wordMeaning: Thou art Independent Ruler, the Northern region. (The rest is identical with 12, with the substitution of Maruts . . . Soma . . . .Vimsa Stoma . . . Nishkevalya Uktha. . . . Vairâja Sâman for the corresponding names).
verses.commentary: Sense: Thou art Independent Ruler, the Northern region. (The rest is identical with 12, with the substitution of Maruts . . . Soma . . . .Vimsa Stoma . . . Nishkevalya Uktha. . . . Vairâja Sâman for the corresponding names).

verses.sanskrit: अधि॑पत्न्यसि बृह॒ती दिग्विश्वे॑ ते दे॒वा अधि॑पतयो॒ बृह॒स्पति॑र्हेती॒नां प्र॑तिध॒र्ता त्रि॑णवत्रयस्त्रि॒ᳪशौ त्वा॒ स्तोमौ॑ पृथि॒व्याᳪ श्र॑यतां वैश्वदेवाग्निमारु॒ते उ॒क्थे अव्य॑थायै स्तभ्नीताᳪ शाक्वररैव॒ते साम॑नी॒ प्रति॑ष्ठित्या अ॒न्तरि॑क्ष॒ ऋष॑यस्त्वा प्रथम॒जा दे॒वेषु॑ दि॒वो मात्र॑या वरि॒म्णा प्र॑थन्तु विध॒र्ता चा॒यमधि॑पतिश्च॒ ते त्वा॒ सर्वे॑ संविदा॒ना नाक॑स्य पृ॒ष्ठे स्व॒र्गे लो॒के यज॑मानं च सादयन्तु
verses.translation: Thou art Lady-Paramount, the Lofty region. (The rest as above, Visvedevas. . . Brihaspati . . .Trinava and Trayastrimsa Stomas . . .Vaisvadeva and Mâruta Ukthas . . . Sâkvara and Raivata Sâmans being substituted for the corresponding names.
verses.hindi: हे प्रभो) हमें धन दीजिए्। धन के साथ प्रकाश भी प्राप्त कराइए। १. है तिग्मजम्भ (तिग्म- वज्र) व्र के समान दष्टरावाले अथवा तीक्ष्ण दष्टावाले! राजन्=राष्ट् के जीवन को व्यवस्थित करनेवाले राजन्! अग्नेतराष्ट् को उन्नत करनेवाले अग्रेण! सः=वे आप त्मना-स्वयं क्षपः रात्रि में (नि० १।७) उत= ओर वस्तोः=दिन में
verses.transliteration: adhipatnyasi bṛhatī digviśve te devā adhipatayo bṛhaspatirhetīnāṃ pratidhartā triṇavatrayastriśau tvā stomau pṛthivyā śrayatāṃ vaiśvadevāgnimārute ukthe avyathāyai stabhnītā śākvararaivate sāmanī pratiṣṭhityā antarikṣa ṛṣayastvā prathamajā deveṣu divo mātrayā varimṇā prathantu vidhartā cāyamadhipatiśca te tvā sarve saṃvidānā nākasya pṛṣṭhe svarge loke yajamānaṃ ca sādayantu
verses.wordMeaning: Thou art Lady-Paramount, the Lofty region. (The rest as above, Visvedevas. . . Brihaspati . . .Trinava and Trayastrimsa Stomas . . .Vaisvadeva and Mâruta Ukthas . . . Sâkvara and Raivata Sâmans being substituted for the corresponding names.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thou art Lady-Paramount, the Lofty region. (The rest as above, Visvedevas. . . Brihaspati . . .Trinava and Trayastrimsa Stomas . . .Vaisvadeva and Mâruta Ukthas . . . Sâkvara and Raivata Sâmans being substituted for the corresponding names.

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒यं पु॒रो हरि॑केश॒: सूर्य॑रश्मि॒स्तस्य॑ रथगृ॒त्सश्च॒ रथौ॑जाश्च सेनानीग्राम॒ण्यौ॒ |
पु॒ञ्जि॒क॒स्थ॒ला च॑ क्रतुस्थ॒ला चा॑प्स॒रसौ॑ द॒ङ्क्ष्णव॑: प॒शवो॑ हे॒तिः पौ॑रुषेयो व॒धः प्रहे॑ति॒स्तेभ्यो॒ नमो॑ अस्तु॒ ते नो॑ऽवन्तु॒ ते नो॑ मृडयन्तु॒ ते यं द्वि॒ष्मो यश्च॑ नो॒ द्वेष्टि॒ तमे॑षां॒ जम्भे॑ दध्मः
verses.translation: This one in front, golden-tressed, with sunbeams; the leader of his host and his chieftain are Rathagritsa and Rathaujas, and Puñjikasthalâ: and Kratusthalâ his Apsarases. Biting animals are his weapon, homicide his missile weapon; to them be homage: may they protect us, may they have mercy upon us. In their jaws we place the man whom we hate and who hates us.
verses.hindi: राजा यथार्हदण्ड होकर राष्ट में राक्षसी वृत्ति का अन्त करे। इस सुरक्षित राष्ट में सब व्यक्ति उन्नति के मार्ग पर आगे बद भद्रो नोऽअग्निरातो भद्रा रातिः सुभग भद्रोऽअध्वरः। १. गत मन्त्र के अनुसार उत्तमता से शासित ओर अतएव शान्त राज्य में सब
