verses.transliteration: ayaṃ puro harikeśa: sūryaraśmistasya rathagṛtsaśca rathaujāśca senānīgrāmaṇyau | puñjikasthalā ca kratusthalā cāpsarasau daṅkṣṇava: paśavo hetiḥ pauruṣeyo vadhaḥ prahetistebhyo namo astu te no'vantu te no mṛḍayantu te yaṃ dviṣmo yaśca no dveṣṭi tameṣāṃ jambhe dadhmaḥ
verses.wordMeaning: This one in front, golden-tressed, with sunbeams; the leader of his host and his chieftain are Rathagritsa and Rathaujas, and Puñjikasthalâ: and Kratusthalâ his Apsarases. Biting animals are his weapon, homicide his missile weapon; to them be homage: may they protect us,…
verses.commentary: Sense: This one in front, golden-tressed, with sunbeams; the leader of his host and his chieftain are Rathagritsa and Rathaujas, and Puñjikasthalâ: and Kratusthalâ his Apsarases. Biting animals are his weapon, homicide his missile weapon; to them be homage: may they protect us,…

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒यं द॑क्षि॒णा वि॒श्वक॑र्मा॒ तस्य॑ रथस्व॒नश्च॒ रथे॑चित्रश्च सेनानीग्राम॒ण्यौ॒ ।
मे॒न॒का च॑ सहज॒न्या चा॑प्स॒रसौ॑ यातुधा॒ना हे॒ती रक्षा॑ᳪसि॒ प्रहे॑ति॒स्तेभ्यो॒ नमो॑ अस्तु॒ ते नो॑ऽवन्तु॒ ते नो॑ मृडयन्तु॒ ते यं द्वि॒ष्मो यश्च॑ नो॒ द्वेष्टि॒ तमे॑षां॒ जम्भे॑ दध्मः
verses.translation: This one on the right, the Omnific; the leader of his host and his chieftain are Rathasvana and Rathechitra, and Menakâ and Sahajanyâ his Apsarases. Yâtudhânas are his weapon, Râkshasas his missile weapon; to them be homage, etc. (as in 15).
verses.hindi: हम प्रभु का शंसन करे। मन को उत्तम बना्पँ। दुढ् निश्चय करके कामादि से संग्राम में उनका पराजय करनेवाले हो। ९. है प्रभो! हमें गत मन्त्र में वर्णित वह भद्र मन ' दीजिए येन-जिससे समत्सु संग्रामा में सासहः = शत्रुओं का पराभव कर सके। २. आप कृपा करके भूरि शर्धताम्-नाना प्रकार
verses.transliteration: ayaṃ dakṣiṇā viśvakarmā tasya rathasvanaśca rathecitraśca senānīgrāmaṇyau | menakā ca sahajanyā cāpsarasau yātudhānā hetī rakṣāsi prahetistebhyo namo astu te no'vantu te no mṛḍayantu te yaṃ dviṣmo yaśca no dveṣṭi tameṣāṃ jambhe dadhmaḥ
verses.wordMeaning: This one on the right, the Omnific; the leader of his host and his chieftain are Rathasvana and Rathechitra, and Menakâ and Sahajanyâ his Apsarases. Yâtudhânas are his weapon, Râkshasas his missile weapon; to them be homage, etc. (as in 15).
verses.commentary: Sense: This one on the right, the Omnific; the leader of his host and his chieftain are Rathasvana and Rathechitra, and Menakâ and Sahajanyâ his Apsarases. Yâtudhânas are his weapon, Râkshasas his missile weapon; to them be homage, etc. (as in 15).

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒यं प॒श्चाद्वि॒श्वव्य॑चा॒स्तस्य॒ रथ॑प्रो॒तश्चास॑मरथश्च सेनानीग्राम॒ण्यौ॒  ।
प्र॒म्लोच॑न्ती चानु॒म्लोच॑न्ती चाप्स॒रसौ॑ व्या॒घ्रा हे॒तिः स॒र्पा: प्रहे॑ति॒स्तेभ्यो॒ नमो अ॑स्तु॒ ते नो॑ऽवन्तु॒ ते नो॑ मृडयन्तु॒ ते यं द्वि॒ष्मो यश्च॑ नो॒ द्वेष्टि॒ तमे॑षां॒ जम्भे॑ दध्मः
verses.translation: This one behind, the All-comprising; the leader of his host and his chieftain are Rathaprota and Asamaratha, and Pramlochantî and Anumochlantî are his Apsarases. Tigers are his weapon, Serpents his missile weapon; to them be homage, etc.
verses.hindi: घर वही हे, जिसमें १. दुधारू गौवें आती है। २. तीव्र गतिवाले घोडे आते हं, ओर ३. सदा यज्ञ की वृत्तिवाले लोग आते है। इन घरों में रहनेवाला अग्नि=उन्नतिशील पुरुष वही है जिसने अपने को पूर्ण स्वस्थ बनाकर उत्तमता से निवास किया है। सूचना- नित्यास: वाजिनः" का अर्थ यह भी हो सकता है कि सदा यज्ञिय कर्मो
verses.transliteration: ayaṃ paścādviśvavyacāstasya rathaprotaścāsamarathaśca senānīgrāmaṇyau | pramlocantī cānumlocantī cāpsarasau vyāghrā hetiḥ sarpā: prahetistebhyo namo astu te no'vantu te no mṛḍayantu te yaṃ dviṣmo yaśca no dveṣṭi tameṣāṃ jambhe dadhmaḥ
verses.wordMeaning: This one behind, the All-comprising; the leader of his host and his chieftain are Rathaprota and Asamaratha, and Pramlochantî and Anumochlantî are his Apsarases. Tigers are his weapon, Serpents his missile weapon; to them be homage, etc.
verses.commentary: Sense: This one behind, the All-comprising; the leader of his host and his chieftain are Rathaprota and Asamaratha, and Pramlochantî and Anumochlantî are his Apsarases. Tigers are his weapon, Serpents his missile weapon; to them be homage, etc.

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒यमु॑त्त॒रात्सं॒यद्व॑सु॒स्तस्य॒ तार्क्ष्य॒श्चारि॑ष्टनेमिश्च सेनानीग्राम॒ण्यौ॒  ।
वि॒श्वाची॑ च घृ॒ताची॑ चाप्स॒रसा॒वापो॑ हे॒तिर्वात॒: प्रहे॑ति॒स्तेभ्यो॒ नमो॑ अस्तु॒ ते नो॑ऽवन्तु॒ ते नो॑ मृडयन्तु॒ ते यं द्वि॒ष्मो यश्च॑ नो॒ द्वेष्टि॒ तमे॑षां॒ जम्भे॑ दध्मः
verses.translation: This one on the left, Lord of uninterrupted riches; the leader of his host and his chieftain are Târkshya and Arishtanemi, and Visvâchî and Ghritâchi his Apsarases. Water is his weapon, wind his missile weapon; to them be homage, etc.
verses.hindi: उन्नतिशील व्यक्ति के लक्षण ये है। १. स्वस्थ बनता है, शरीर में उत्तम निवासवाला होता है। २. गौवों के दुग्ध का प्रयोग करता है। ३. विकासशील विद्वानों का सङ्ग करता है। ४. प्रभु-स्तवन के द्वारा प्रभु-प्रेरणा को प्राप्त करने का प्रयल करता है। १. है सुश्चन्द्र (शोभनं चन्दति आह्ादते आह्ादयति वा) उत्तम आनन्द को प्राप्त
verses.transliteration: ayamuttarātsaṃyadvasustasya tārkṣyaścāriṣṭanemiśca senānīgrāmaṇyau | viśvācī ca ghṛtācī cāpsarasāvāpo hetirvāta: prahetistebhyo namo astu te no'vantu te no mṛḍayantu te yaṃ dviṣmo yaśca no dveṣṭi tameṣāṃ jambhe dadhmaḥ
verses.wordMeaning: This one on the left, Lord of uninterrupted riches; the leader of his host and his chieftain are Târkshya and Arishtanemi, and Visvâchî and Ghritâchi his Apsarases. Water is his weapon, wind his missile weapon; to them be homage, etc.
verses.commentary: Sense: This one on the left, Lord of uninterrupted riches; the leader of his host and his chieftain are Târkshya and Arishtanemi, and Visvâchî and Ghritâchi his Apsarases. Water is his weapon, wind his missile weapon; to them be homage, etc.

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒यमु॒पर्य॒र्वाग्व॑सु॒स्तस्य॑ सेन॒जिच्च॑ सु॒षेण॑श्च सेनानीग्राम॒ण्यौ॒  ।
उ॒र्वशी॑ च पू॒र्वचि॑त्तिश्चाप्स॒रसा॑वब॒स्फूर्ज॑न् हे॒तिर्वि॒द्युत्प्रहे॑ति॒स्तेभ्यो॒ नमो॑ अस्तु॒ ते नो॑ऽवन्तु॒ ते नो॑ मृडयन्तु॒ ते यं द्वि॒ष्मो यश्च॑ नो॒ द्वेष्टि॒ तमे॑षां॒ जम्भे॑ दध्मः
verses.translation: This one above, Wealth-giver; the leader of his host and his chieftain are Senajit and Sushena, and Urvasi and Pûrvachitti his Apsarases. Thundering is his weapon and lightning his missile weapon; to them be homage, etc.
verses.hindi: हम स्तुति करे, यक्ञमय जीवनवाले होँ, हमारी इन्द्रियों सशक्त हों, संकल्प १. है अग्ने=हमारे जीवन के अग्रेणी प्रभो! आप अद्य=अवब हमारे स्तवन के वाद् हि=निश्चय से भद्रस्य क्रतोः=शुभ संकल्प, प्रज्ञान व यज्ञरूप कर्म के रथीः=सारथि के समान निर्वाहक होते हो। आप हमें शुभ संकल्प, प्रज्ञान व कर्म प्राप्त कराते हो। (क्रतु=संकल्प,
verses.transliteration: ayamuparyarvāgvasustasya senajicca suṣeṇaśca senānīgrāmaṇyau | urvaśī ca pūrvacittiścāpsarasāvabasphūrjan hetirvidyutprahetistebhyo namo astu te no'vantu te no mṛḍayantu te yaṃ dviṣmo yaśca no dveṣṭi tameṣāṃ jambhe dadhmaḥ
verses.wordMeaning: This one above, Wealth-giver; the leader of his host and his chieftain are Senajit and Sushena, and Urvasi and Pûrvachitti his Apsarases. Thundering is his weapon and lightning his missile weapon; to them be homage, etc.
verses.commentary: Sense: This one above, Wealth-giver; the leader of his host and his chieftain are Senajit and Sushena, and Urvasi and Pûrvachitti his Apsarases. Thundering is his weapon and lightning his missile weapon; to them be homage, etc.

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒ग्निर्मू॒र्धा दि॒वः क॒कुत्पति॑: पृथि॒व्या अ॒यम् ।
अ॒पाᳪ रेता॑ᳪसि जिन्वति
verses.translation: Agni is head and height of heaven, the Master of the earth is he. He quickeneth the waters’ seed.
verses.hindi: वे प्रभु हमारे अत्यन्त समीप है। वे हमारी रक्षा करते हे, हमारे घरों पर आते है ओर यदि हम द्वार खोले तो ज्ञानयुक्त धन देते हेँ। येनऽ ऋष॑यस्तप॑सा सत्रमायन्निन्धानाऽअग्निश्छस्व॑राभरंन्तः । तस्मिंत्रहं निदधे नाकैऽअग्निं यमाहर्मन॑व स्तीर्णवंर्हिषम् ॥४९॥
verses.transliteration: agnirmūrdhā divaḥ kakutpati: pṛthivyā ayam | apā retāsi jinvati
verses.wordMeaning: Agni is head and height of heaven, the Master of the earth is he. He quickeneth the waters’ seed.
verses.commentary: Sense: Agni is head and height of heaven, the Master of the earth is he. He quickeneth the waters’ seed.

verses.sanskrit: अ॒यम॒ग्निः स॑ह॒स्रिणो॒ वाज॑स्य श॒तिन॒स्पति॑: । मू॒र्धा क॒वी र॑यी॒णाम्
verses.translation: This Agni is the Master of spoil thousandfold and hundredfold, the sapient one, the head of wealth.
verses.hindi: हम मिलकर चलें, प्रभु के उपासक बनें, देवताओं के मार्गं पर चले। वाणी व मन को संस्कृत करके यज्ञो का विस्तार करें। यज्ञो मे लगे हर् वाणी ओर मन अस्मिन्त्सधस्थेऽअध्युत्त॑रस्मिन् विश्व देवा यज॑मानश्च सीदत ॥५४॥ १. गत मन्त्र की समाप्ति यज्ञ का विस्तार करने पर हई थी। उसी यज्ञ का वर्णन
verses.transliteration: ayamagniḥ sahasriṇo vājasya śatinaspati: | mūrdhā kavī rayīṇām
verses.wordMeaning: This Agni is the Master of spoil thousandfold and hundredfold, the sapient one, the head of wealth.
verses.commentary: Sense: This Agni is the Master of spoil thousandfold and hundredfold, the sapient one, the head of wealth.

verses.sanskrit: त्वाम॑ग्ने॒ पुष्क॑रा॒दध्यथ॑र्वा॒ निर॑मन्थत । मू॒र्ध्नो विश्व॑स्य वा॒घत॑:
verses.translation: Agni, Atharvan brought thee forth by rubbing from the lotus-leaf, the head of Visva, of the Priest.
verses.hindi: -घर-घर में अग्निहोत्र हो। अग्नि में डाले हुए घृतादि पदार्थो को अग्नि सारे आकाश मे भर देता है। (०पाऽ=पूरयति)। इस आपूर्ति के द्वारा यह यज्ञाग्नि वायुमण्डल को तो शुद्ध करता ही है साथ दही ये घृतादि पदार्थ सूक्ष्म कणो में विभक्त होकर वृष्टिजल के बिन्दुओं का केन्द्र बनकर वृष्टि मै भी सहायक होते है। यह बरसकर भूमि में होनेवाले
verses.transliteration: tvāmagne puṣkarādadhyatharvā niramanthata | mūrdhno viśvasya vāghata:
verses.wordMeaning: Agni, Atharvan brought thee forth by rubbing from the lotus-leaf, the head of Visva, of the Priest.
verses.commentary: Sense: Agni, Atharvan brought thee forth by rubbing from the lotus-leaf, the head of Visva, of the Priest.

verses.sanskrit:
भुवो॑ य॒ज्ञस्य॒ रज॑सश्च ने॒ता यत्रा॑ नि॒युद्भि॒: सच॑से शि॒वाभि॑: ।
दि॒वि मू॒र्धानं॑ दधिषे स्व॒र्षां जि॒ह्वाम॑ग्ने चकृषे हव्य॒वाह॑म्
verses.translation: Guide of the rite art thou and of the region to which with thine auspicious teams thou tendest. Thy light-bestowing head to heaven thou liftest, making thy tongue oblation-bearer, Agni.
verses.hindi: हम आनन्दमय प्रभु का ज्ञान प्राप्त करें ओर प्रभु के अनुरूप बनने के लिए यन्नशील हों, प्रभु के गुणों का उत्तोलन करें ओर सच्चे प्रभु-भक्त बनकर प्रभु को पाने यँ पञ्चदशाध्याय की समाप्ति पर “ साहस्र ' बनने का उल्लेख हे। ' साहस्न' आनन्दमय प्रभु का भक्त टै। यह साहस्र १६बें अध्याय मेँ प्रभु का स्तवन करता हुआ कहता है कि-
verses.transliteration: bhuvo yajñasya rajasaśca netā yatrā niyudbhi: sacase śivābhi: | divi mūrdhānaṃ dadhiṣe svarṣāṃ jihvāmagne cakṛṣe havyavāham
verses.wordMeaning: Guide of the rite art thou and of the region to which with thine auspicious teams thou tendest. Thy light-bestowing head to heaven thou liftest, making thy tongue oblation-bearer, Agni.
verses.commentary: Sense: Guide of the rite art thou and of the region to which with thine auspicious teams thou tendest. Thy light-bestowing head to heaven thou liftest, making thy tongue oblation-bearer, Agni.

verses.sanskrit:
अबो॑ध्य॒ग्निः स॒मिधा॒ जना॑नां॒ प्रति॑ धे॒नुमि॑वाय॒तीमु॒षास॑म् ।
य॒ह्वा इव॒ प्र व॒यामु॒ज्जिहा॑ना॒: प्र भा॒नव॑: सिस्रते॒ नाक॒मच्छ॑
verses.translation: Agni is wakened by the people's fuel to meet the Dawn who cometh like a milch-cow. Like young trees shooting up on high their branches his flames are rising to the vault of heaven.
verses.hindi: प्रभुकृपा से हमारे दोष दूर हों, हम प्रभु के सन्देश को सुने ओर प्रभु कौ उस शरण में सदा निवास करं, जो ' काम, क्रोध व लोभ" इन तीनों का निवारण करके (त्रिवरूथ निवारण) "प्रेम, दया व दान ' आदि उत्कृष्ट भावनाओं को हममे जन्म देती हे ओर इसी कारण “उद्धि' कहलाती है (भवतेः) ।
verses.transliteration: abodhyagniḥ samidhā janānāṃ prati dhenumivāyatīmuṣāsam | yahvā iva pra vayāmujjihānā: pra bhānava: sisrate nākamaccha
verses.wordMeaning: Agni is wakened by the people's fuel to meet the Dawn who cometh like a milch-cow. Like young trees shooting up on high their branches his flames are rising to the vault of heaven.
verses.commentary: Sense: Agni is wakened by the people's fuel to meet the Dawn who cometh like a milch-cow. Like young trees shooting up on high their branches his flames are rising to the vault of heaven.

verses.sanskrit:
अवो॑चाम क॒वये॒ मेध्या॑य॒ वचो॑ व॒न्दारु॑ वृष॒भाय॒ वृष्णे॑ ।
गवि॑ष्ठिरो॒ नम॑सा॒ स्तोम॑म॒ग्नौ दि॒वी॒व रु॒क्ममु॑रु॒व्यञ्च॑मश्रेत्
verses.translation: To him adorable, sage, strong and mighty we have sung forth our song of praise and homage. Gavishthira hath raised with prayer to Agni this laud far-reaching as the gold in heaven.
verses.hindi: कामादि अत्यन्त प्रबल है। हमारे न चाहते हुए भी ये हममे आ घुसते हे। हम सबका भला चाहनेवाले प्रभु से प्रार्थना करते है कि आप हमारे इन शत्रुओं को दूर प्रेरित करें, जिससे हम इस शरीर मे सदा बने रहे। इन शत्रुओं से धकेले जाकर जीवन से दूर न कर दिये जारण, मार न दिये जा।
verses.transliteration: avocāma kavaye medhyāya vaco vandāru vṛṣabhāya vṛṣṇe | gaviṣṭhiro namasā stomamagnau divīva rukmamuruvyañcamaśret
verses.wordMeaning: To him adorable, sage, strong and mighty we have sung forth our song of praise and homage. Gavishthira hath raised with prayer to Agni this laud far-reaching as the gold in heaven.
verses.commentary: Sense: To him adorable, sage, strong and mighty we have sung forth our song of praise and homage. Gavishthira hath raised with prayer to Agni this laud far-reaching as the gold in heaven.

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒यमि॒ह प्र॑थ॒मो धा॑यि धा॒तृभि॒र्होता॒ यजि॑ष्ठो अध्व॒रेष्वीड्य॑: ।
यमप्न॑वानो॒ भृग॑वो विरुरु॒चुर्वने॑षु चि॒त्रं वि॒भ्वं॒ वि॒शे-वि॑शे
verses.translation: Here by ordainers was this God appointed first Invoker, best at worship, to be praised at rites; Whom Apnavâna and the Bhrigus caused to shine bright-coloured in the wood, spreading to every house.
verses.hindi: प्रभु ने हमें प्रस्तुत मन्त्र मे दस आदेश दिये हँ। उन आदेशो के अनुसार हमें सत्य, धर्म, प्रकाश, मध्यमार्ग, शरीर का स्वास्थ्य, आनन्द- वृष्टि कौ अनुभूति, समय कौ अव्यर्थता, रात्रि का रमयितृत्व--वासक तत्त्व तथा प्रकेत (प्रकृष्ट ज्ञान) कौ साधना ४. है। हम इन आदेशो का पालन करते हैँ तो वे ही हमारे स्तोम-प्रभु-स्तवन हो जाते
verses.transliteration: ayamiha prathamo dhāyi dhātṛbhirhotā yajiṣṭho adhvareṣvīḍya: | yamapnavāno bhṛgavo virurucurvaneṣu citraṃ vibhvaṃ viśe-viśe
verses.wordMeaning: Here by ordainers was this God appointed first Invoker, best at worship, to be praised at rites; Whom Apnavâna and the Bhrigus caused to shine bright-coloured in the wood, spreading to every house.
verses.commentary: Sense: Here by ordainers was this God appointed first Invoker, best at worship, to be praised at rites; Whom Apnavâna and the Bhrigus caused to shine bright-coloured in the wood, spreading to every house.

verses.sanskrit:
जन॑स्य गो॒पा अ॑जनिष्ट॒ जागृ॑विर॒ग्निः सु॒दक्ष॑: सुवि॒ताय॒ नव्य॑से ।
घृ॒तप्र॑तीको बृह॒ता दि॑वि॒स्पृशा॑ द्यु॒मद्वि भा॑ति भर॒तेभ्य॒: शुचि॑:
verses.translation: The watchful Guardian of the people hath been born, Agni the very strong, for fresh prosperity. With oil upon his face, with high heaven-touching flame, he shineth splendidly, pure for the Bharatas.
verses.hindi: मानव जीवन को प्राप्त करके हम “धन, जान (श्रुत) सात्विक अन्न, शक्ति- विस्तार, अध्ययन व तेज' को सिद्ध करने के लिए यलशील हो। प्रतिपद -अनुपद् -सम्पत्-तेज १७ से २० तक सम्पदे! त्वा तेजो! ऽसि तेज॑से त्वा ॥८॥
verses.transliteration: janasya gopā ajaniṣṭa jāgṛviragniḥ sudakṣa: suvitāya navyase | ghṛtapratīko bṛhatā divispṛśā dyumadvi bhāti bharatebhya: śuci:
verses.wordMeaning: The watchful Guardian of the people hath been born, Agni the very strong, for fresh prosperity. With oil upon his face, with high heaven-touching flame, he shineth splendidly, pure for the Bharatas.
verses.commentary: Sense: The watchful Guardian of the people hath been born, Agni the very strong, for fresh prosperity. With oil upon his face, with high heaven-touching flame, he shineth splendidly, pure for the Bharatas.

verses.sanskrit:
त्वाम॑ग्ने॒ अङ्गि॑रसो॒ गुहा॑ हि॒तमन्व॑विन्दञ्छिश्रिया॒णं वने॑ – वने ।
स जा॑यसे म॒थ्यमा॑न॒: सहो॑ म॒हत्त्वामा॑हु॒: सह॑सस्पु॒त्रम॑ङ्गिरः
verses.translation: Agni, Angirases discovered thee what time thou layest hidden, fleeing back from wood to wood. Thou by attrition art produced as conquering, might, and men, O Angiras, call thee the Son of Strength.
verses.hindi: गृहस्थ को स्वर्गतुल्य बनाने के लिए चार बाते आवश्यक है-९. ज्ञान (समञ्लदारी ), २. अनुकूलता, ३. कार्यसाधिका सम्पत्ति, ४. तेजस्विता (संयम के द्वारा) । इक्कीस से उनतीस तक स्तोमभाग त्वोत्क्रान्तिरस्युत्करान्त्यै त्वाधिंपतिनोर्जोर्ज" जिन्व ॥९॥
verses.transliteration: tvāmagne aṅgiraso guhā hitamanvavindañchiśriyāṇaṃ vane – vane | sa jāyase mathyamāna: saho mahattvāmāhu: sahasasputramaṅgiraḥ
verses.wordMeaning: Agni, Angirases discovered thee what time thou layest hidden, fleeing back from wood to wood. Thou by attrition art produced as conquering, might, and men, O Angiras, call thee the Son of Strength.
verses.commentary: Sense: Agni, Angirases discovered thee what time thou layest hidden, fleeing back from wood to wood. Thou by attrition art produced as conquering, might, and men, O Angiras, call thee the Son of Strength.

verses.sanskrit:
सखा॑य॒: सं व॑: स॒म्यञ्च॒मिष॒ᳪ स्तोमं॑ चा॒ग्नये॑ ।
वर्षि॑ष्ठाय क्षिती॒नामू॒र्जो नप्त्रे॒ सह॑स्वते
verses.translation: Offer to Agni, O my friends, your seemly food, your seemly praise; To him supremest o’er the folk, the Son of Strength, the Mighty Lord.
verses.hindi: - हम “त्रिवृत्, प्रवृत्, विवृत् व सवृत्' बनकर " आक्रम, संक्रम व उत्क्रम ¢ हो ओर एक विशिष्ट (उत्कृष्ट) क्रान्ति के लिए प्रभु-सम्पर्क से अपने में शक्ति का क्दाज्य॑सि प्राची दिग्वस॑वस्ते देवाऽअधिंपतयो ऽन्निर्ह'तीनां प्र॑तिधर्ता त्रिवृत्त्वा अन्तरिश्चऽ ऋष॑यस्त्वा स्प्रथमजा देवेषु दिवो मात्र॑या वरिम्णा प्र॑थन्तु विधर्ता
verses.transliteration: sakhāya: saṃ va: samyañcamiṣa stomaṃ cāgnaye | varṣiṣṭhāya kṣitīnāmūrjo naptre sahasvate
verses.wordMeaning: Offer to Agni, O my friends, your seemly food, your seemly praise; To him supremest o’er the folk, the Son of Strength, the Mighty Lord.
verses.commentary: Sense: Offer to Agni, O my friends, your seemly food, your seemly praise; To him supremest o’er the folk, the Son of Strength, the Mighty Lord.

verses.sanskrit: सᳪस॒मिद्यु॑वसे वृष॒न्नग्ने॒ विश्वा॑न्य॒र्य आ । इ॒डस्प॒दे समि॑ध्यसे॒ स नो॒ वसू॒न्या भ॑र
verses.translation: Thou, mighty Agni, gatherest up all that is precious for thy friend: Bring us all treasure as thou art enkindled in libation's place.
verses.hindi: - पल्ली ज्ञान-दीप्त, निरन्तर उन्नति-पथ पर बदनेवाली हो, धर्मार्थ, काम का समानुपात में सेवन करती हो। घृतादि करे प्रयोग से शरीर को स्वस्थ रक्खे। शरीररूप रथ से जीवन-यात्रा को पूर्णं करने का निश्चय करे। पति ' अग्नि" अग्रेणी हो। एेसा होने पर ज्विराङसि दक्षिणा दिग्रद्रास्त देवाऽअधिंपतयऽ इन्द्रौ हेतीनां प्र॑तिधर््ता
verses.transliteration: sasamidyuvase vṛṣannagne viśvānyarya ā | iḍaspade samidhyase sa no vasūnyā bhara
verses.wordMeaning: Thou, mighty Agni, gatherest up all that is precious for thy friend: Bring us all treasure as thou art enkindled in libation's place.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thou, mighty Agni, gatherest up all that is precious for thy friend: Bring us all treasure as thou art enkindled in libation's place.

verses.sanskrit: त्वां चि॑त्रश्रवस्तम॒ हव॑न्ते वि॒क्षु ज॒न्तव॑: । शो॒चिष्के॑शं पुरुप्रि॒याग्ने॑ ह॒व्याय॒ वोढ॑वे
verses.translation: O Agni, loved of many, thou of fame most wondrous, in their homes Men call on thee whose hair is flame to be the bearer of their gifts.
verses.hindi: पल्ली व्यवस्थित व दीप्त जीवनवाली हो। गृहकार्यो में बड़ी दक्षिण व निपुण हो, प्राणशक्ति-सम्पन्न हो। उसकी ज्ञानेन्द्रिय, कर्मेन्द्रियाँ व प्राण सभी स्वस्थ हों। उत्तम वस्तुओं का वह प्रशंसनीय प्रयोग करनेवाली हो। “ वृद्धि" को जीवन का सूत्र बनाकर चले। पति इन्द्र' हो, एेश्वर्यशाली व जितेन्द्रिय। घर को स्वर्गं बनाने के लिए यह सब
verses.transliteration: tvāṃ citraśravastama havante vikṣu jantava: | śociṣkeśaṃ purupriyāgne havyāya voḍhave
verses.wordMeaning: O Agni, loved of many, thou of fame most wondrous, in their homes Men call on thee whose hair is flame to be the bearer of their gifts.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Agni, loved of many, thou of fame most wondrous, in their homes Men call on thee whose hair is flame to be the bearer of their gifts.

verses.sanskrit: ए॒ना वो॑ अ॒ग्निं नम॑सो॒र्जो नपा॑त॒मा हु॑वे । प्रि॒यं चेति॑ष्ठमर॒तिᳪ स्व॑ध्व॒रं विश्व॑स्य दू॒तम॒मृत॑म्
verses.translation: With this my reverent hymn I call Agni for you, the Son. of Strength, Dear, wisest envoy, served with noble sacrifice, immortal messenger of all.
verses.hindi: पली घर में उत्तमता से शासन करनेवाली हो। अच्छाइयों के ग्रहण के स्वभाववाली, मितभाषिणी, विशिष्ट रूपता को ध्येय बनाकर चलनेवाली हो। पति सब प्रकार के द्वेष का निवारण करनेवाला हो। ये बातें घर को अवश्य स्वर्ग बनार्णेगी। क्स्वराडस्युदीची दिडः मरुत॑स्ते देवाऽअधिंपतयः सोमो हेतीनां प्र॑तिधर्तैकःविः
verses.transliteration: enā vo agniṃ namasorjo napātamā huve | priyaṃ cetiṣṭhamarati svadhvaraṃ viśvasya dūtamamṛtam
verses.wordMeaning: With this my reverent hymn I call Agni for you, the Son. of Strength, Dear, wisest envoy, served with noble sacrifice, immortal messenger of all.
verses.commentary: Sense: With this my reverent hymn I call Agni for you, the Son. of Strength, Dear, wisest envoy, served with noble sacrifice, immortal messenger of all.

verses.sanskrit: विश्व॑स्य दू॒तम॒मृतं॒ विश्व॑स्य दू॒तम॒मृत॑म् । स यो॑जते अरु॒षा वि॒श्वभो॑जसा॒ स दु॑द्रव॒त्स्वा॑हुतः
verses.translation: Immortal messenger of all, immortal messenger of all, His two red steeds, all-cherishing; he harnesseth: let him, well-worshipped, urge them fast.
verses.hindi: पली स्वराट् पूर्णं जितेन्द्रिय हो, मितभाषिता उसके दीर्घ जीवन का कारण बने। वह विशिष्टरूप से जीवन को व्यवस्थित करनेवाली हो। वह ज्ञान के साथ हदय की विशालतावाली हो। पति सौम्य व शान्त स्वभाव हो-यही घर को स्वर्ग बनाने का मार्ग है। क्ञधिंपत्यसि बृह॒ती दिण्विश्वे ते देवाऽअधिंपतयो बृहस्पतिंहतीनां प्र॑तिधर्ता
verses.transliteration: viśvasya dūtamamṛtaṃ viśvasya dūtamamṛtam | sa yojate aruṣā viśvabhojasā sa dudravatsvāhutaḥ
verses.wordMeaning: Immortal messenger of all, immortal messenger of all, His two red steeds, all-cherishing; he harnesseth: let him, well-worshipped, urge them fast.
verses.commentary: Sense: Immortal messenger of all, immortal messenger of all, His two red steeds, all-cherishing; he harnesseth: let him, well-worshipped, urge them fast.

verses.sanskrit: स दु॑द्रव॒त्स्वा॒हुत॒: स दु॑द्रव॒त्स्वा॒हुतः । सु॒ब्रह्मा॑ य॒ज्ञः सु॒शमी॒ वसू॑नां दे॒वᳪ राधो॒ जना॑नाम्
verses.translation: Let him well-worshipped urge them fast, let him well-worshipped urge them fast. Then hath the sacrifice good prayer and happy end, and heavenly gift of wealth to men.
verses.hindi: राजा वायु कौ भांति नैसर्गिकी क्रियावाला है-आलस्य से दूर है। इसके सेनानी शत्नु-पराजय द्वारा राष्ट का मान बद्धाते है ओर ग्रामणी लोगों मे मिलकर कार्य करने के द्वारा विकास कौ भावना को दुद्-मूल करते है। अयं पश्चाद् विश्वव्य॑चास्तस्य रथ॑प्रोतश्चासंमरथश्च सेनानीग्रामण्यौ ।
verses.transliteration: sa dudravatsvāhuta: sa dudravatsvāhutaḥ | subrahmā yajñaḥ suśamī vasūnāṃ deva rādho janānām
verses.wordMeaning: Let him well-worshipped urge them fast, let him well-worshipped urge them fast. Then hath the sacrifice good prayer and happy end, and heavenly gift of wealth to men.
verses.commentary: Sense: Let him well-worshipped urge them fast, let him well-worshipped urge them fast. Then hath the sacrifice good prayer and happy end, and heavenly gift of wealth to men.

verses.sanskrit: अग्ने॒ वाज॑स्य॒ गोम॑त॒ ईशा॑नः सहसो यहो । अ॒स्मे धे॑हि जातवेदो॒ महि॒ श्रव॑:
verses.translation: O Agni, thou who art the Lord of wealth in kine, the Son of Strength, Vouchsafe to us, O Jâtavedas, high renown.
verses.hindi: राजा सूर्य की भाँति सर्वत्र प्रकाश फैलानेवाला हो, रोगकृमियों के नाश के लिए सफाई का प्रबन्ध करे, सूर्यकिरणे जैसे जल को ले-जाती हें, यह भी थोड़ा-थोडा कर ले। इसके कर्मचारी स्वयं क्रियाशील हों ओर प्रजा में भी क्रियाशीलता की प्रवृत्ति को पैदा करे। अयमुंत्तरात् संयद्॑सुस्तस्य तारक्यश्चारिष्टनेमिश्च सेनानीग्रामण्यौ । विश्वाचीं
verses.transliteration: agne vājasya gomata īśānaḥ sahaso yaho | asme dhehi jātavedo mahi śrava:
verses.wordMeaning: O Agni, thou who art the Lord of wealth in kine, the Son of Strength, Vouchsafe to us, O Jâtavedas, high renown.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Agni, thou who art the Lord of wealth in kine, the Son of Strength, Vouchsafe to us, O Jâtavedas, high renown.

verses.sanskrit: स इ॑धा॒नो वसु॑ष्क॒विर॒ग्निरी॒डेन्यो॑ गि॒रा । रे॒वद॒स्मभ्यं॑ पुर्वणीक दीदिहि
verses.translation: He, Agni, kindled, good and wise, must be exalted in our song: Shine, thou of many forms, shine radiantly on us.
verses.hindi: राजा करादि से प्राप्त धन को प्रजाहित मे ही विनियुक्त करे। राष्ट की सेना उत्तम हो। सेनानी शत्रुओं को वश में करे तो ग्रामनायक प्रत्येक कार्य को सोचकर करे। राष्ट की उन्नति के लिए प्रजाजन क्रानून को अपने हाथमे न लें, इन अध्यक्षों को ही न्याय का कार्य सौपा जाए।
verses.transliteration: sa idhāno vasuṣkaviragnirīḍenyo girā | revadasmabhyaṃ purvaṇīka dīdihi
verses.wordMeaning: He, Agni, kindled, good and wise, must be exalted in our song: Shine, thou of many forms, shine radiantly on us.
verses.commentary: Sense: He, Agni, kindled, good and wise, must be exalted in our song: Shine, thou of many forms, shine radiantly on us.

verses.sanskrit: क्ष॒पो रा॑जन्नु॒त त्मनाग्ने॒ वस्तो॑रु॒तोषस॑: । स ति॑ग्मजम्भ र॒क्षसो॑ दह॒ प्रति॑
verses.translation: O Agni, shining of thyself by night and when the morning breaks, Burn, thou whose teeth are sharp, against the Râkshasas.
verses.hindi: १. राजा को राष्ट का अग्रणी बनना है। २. यह राष्ट्-शरीर का मस्तिष्क ने। ३. प्रजाओं के ज्ञान व स्वास्थ्य का ध्यान करे। ४. प्रजाओं को शक्ति- सम्पन्न बनाये। १. पिछले मन्त्र में कहे गये अग्नि का ही उल्लेख करते हुए कहते है कि अग्निः अयम् आगे बद्नेवाला यह वह है जोकि सहस्रिणः=(स हस्) सदा हास्य व आनन्द से
verses.transliteration: kṣapo rājannuta tmanāgne vastorutoṣasa: | sa tigmajambha rakṣaso daha prati
verses.wordMeaning: O Agni, shining of thyself by night and when the morning breaks, Burn, thou whose teeth are sharp, against the Râkshasas.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Agni, shining of thyself by night and when the morning breaks, Burn, thou whose teeth are sharp, against the Râkshasas.

verses.sanskrit: भ॒द्रो नो॑ अ॒ग्निराहु॑तो भ॒द्रा रा॒तिः सु॑भग भ॒द्रो अ॑ध्व॒रः । भ॒द्रा उ॒त प्रश॑स्तयः
verses.translation: May Agni, worshipped, bring us bliss, may the gift, Blessed One! and sacrifice bring bliss, Yea, may our praises bring us bliss.
verses.hindi: हम आनन्दयुक्त शतवर्षं पर्यन्त चलनेवाली शक्ति के पति हों। शिखर पर 'पहुंचे। धन के वास्तविक स्वरूप को समञ्ते हए उसमें उलञ्ँ नदीं। - ऋषिः-परमेष्ठी। देवता--अग्निः। छन्दः-निचृद्गायत्री। स्वरः-षडजः।। त्वाम॑ग्ने पुष्करादध्यथर्वा निरमन्थत । मूर्ध्नो विश्व॑स्य वाघतं: ।॥२२॥
verses.transliteration: bhadro no agnirāhuto bhadrā rātiḥ subhaga bhadro adhvaraḥ | bhadrā uta praśastayaḥ
verses.wordMeaning: May Agni, worshipped, bring us bliss, may the gift, Blessed One! and sacrifice bring bliss, Yea, may our praises bring us bliss.
verses.commentary: Sense: May Agni, worshipped, bring us bliss, may the gift, Blessed One! and sacrifice bring bliss, Yea, may our praises bring us bliss.

verses.sanskrit: भ॒द्रा उ॒त प्रश॑स्तयो भ॒द्रं मन॑: कृणुष्व वृत्र॒तूर्ये॑ । येना॑ स॒मत्सु॑ सा॒सह॑:
verses.translation: Yea, may our praises bring us bliss. Show forth the mind that brings success in war with fiends, wherewith thou conquerest in fights:
verses.hindi: जीवन के चार प्रयाण=पडाव है। प्रथम में ज्ञानदीप्त बनना हे, द्वितीय में सभी का पालन करना है, तृतीय मेँ घर को छोड वनस्थ हो उस प्रभु की ओर चलना हे, उसी को पुकारना है ओर चतुर्थं में प्रकृष्ट दीप्तिवाले ठोकर प्रभु को पाना है। १. जीवन के इन प्रयाणों मेँ चलते हए हम उस प्रभु के लिए वन्दारु वचः =अभिवादन
verses.transliteration: bhadrā uta praśastayo bhadraṃ mana: kṛṇuṣva vṛtratūrye | yenā samatsu sāsaha:
verses.wordMeaning: Yea, may our praises bring us bliss. Show forth the mind that brings success in war with fiends, wherewith thou conquerest in fights:
verses.commentary: Sense: Yea, may our praises bring us bliss. Show forth the mind that brings success in war with fiends, wherewith thou conquerest in fights:

verses.sanskrit: येना॑ स॒मत्सु॑ सा॒सहोऽव॑ स्थि॒रा त॑नुहि॒ भूरि॒ शर्ध॑ताम् । व॒नेमा॑ ते अ॒भिष्टि॑भिः
verses.translation: Wherewith thou conquerest in fights. Bring down the many firm hopes of our enemies, and let us vanquish with thine aid.
verses.hindi: प्रभु धाताओं से-ओौरों का धारण करनेवालों से धारण किया जाता हे। उपासको को वे प्रभु ज्ञान देते है, वे सबको शक्ति प्राप्त कराते है। जन॑स्य गोपाऽंजनिष्ट जागुंविरग्निः सुदक्षः सुविताय नव्य॑से । घृतप्र॑तीको बृहता दिविस्पृशा द्युमद्विभांति भर तेभ्यः शुचिः ॥ २७॥
verses.transliteration: yenā samatsu sāsaho'va sthirā tanuhi bhūri śardhatām | vanemā te abhiṣṭibhiḥ
verses.wordMeaning: Wherewith thou conquerest in fights. Bring down the many firm hopes of our enemies, and let us vanquish with thine aid.
verses.commentary: Sense: Wherewith thou conquerest in fights. Bring down the many firm hopes of our enemies, and let us vanquish with thine aid.

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒ग्निं तं म॑न्ये॒ यो वसु॒रस्तं॒ यं यन्ति॑ धे॒नव॑: ।
अस्त॒मर्व॑न्त आ॒शवोऽस्तं॒ नित्या॑सो वा॒जिन॒ इष॑ᳪ स्तो॒तृभ्य॒ आ भ॑र
verses.translation: I value Agni, that good Lord, the home to which the kind return; Whom fleet-foot coursers seek as home, and strong enduring steeds as home. Bring food to those who sing thy praise.
verses.hindi: प्रभु- दर्शन उन भक्तोंको ही होता है जो ओरों का भरण करनेवाले यज्तिय स जायसे मथ्यमानः सहो महत् त्वामाह: सह॑सस्पुत्रमद्धिरः ॥ २८॥ १. है अग्ने=अग्रेणी-- सर्वोन्नति-साधक प्रभो! गुहा हितम्-हदयरूप निगूढ प्रदेश में स्थित त्वाम्-आपको अङ्किरसः=अङ्ख-अङ्क में रसवाले, अर्थात् पूर्ण स्वस्थ व्यक्ति अनु
verses.transliteration: agniṃ taṃ manye yo vasurastaṃ yaṃ yanti dhenava: | astamarvanta āśavo'staṃ nityāso vājina iṣa stotṛbhya ā bhara
verses.wordMeaning: I value Agni, that good Lord, the home to which the kind return; Whom fleet-foot coursers seek as home, and strong enduring steeds as home. Bring food to those who sing thy praise.
verses.commentary: Sense: I value Agni, that good Lord, the home to which the kind return; Whom fleet-foot coursers seek as home, and strong enduring steeds as home. Bring food to those who sing thy praise.

verses.sanskrit:
सो अ॒ग्निर्यो वसु॑र्गृ॒णे सं यमा॒यन्ति॑ धे॒नव॑: ।
समर्व॑न्तो रघु॒द्रुव॒: सᳪ सु॑जा॒तास॑: सू॒रय॒ इष॑ᳪ स्तो॒तृभ्य॒ आ भ॑र
verses.translation: ’Tis Agni whom we laud as good, to whom the milch-kine come in herds, To whom the coursers swift of foot, to whom our well-born princes come. Bring food to those who sing thy praise.
verses.hindi: हम अद्धिरस् बनें। सहस् व बल का धारण करर। जितेन्द्रिय बनकर ज्ञानी बनें तभी हम हृदयस्थ प्रभु का दर्शन कर पार्णेगे। पञ्कदश्ोऽध्यायः ५० यजुर्वेद भाष्यम् १. सखायः =ज्ञान- सम्पादन के द्वारा प्रभु के मित्र बननेवालो! अग्नये=उस अग्रणी प्रभु
verses.transliteration: so agniryo vasurgṛṇe saṃ yamāyanti dhenava: | samarvanto raghudruva: sa sujātāsa: sūraya iṣa stotṛbhya ā bhara
verses.wordMeaning: ’Tis Agni whom we laud as good, to whom the milch-kine come in herds, To whom the coursers swift of foot, to whom our well-born princes come. Bring food to those who sing thy praise.
verses.commentary: Sense: ’Tis Agni whom we laud as good, to whom the milch-kine come in herds, To whom the coursers swift of foot, to whom our well-born princes come. Bring food to those who sing thy praise.

verses.sanskrit:
उ॒भे सु॑श्चन्द्र स॒र्पिषो॒ दर्वी॑ श्रीणीष आ॒सनि॑ ।
उ॒तो न॒ उत्पु॑पूर्या उ॒क्थेषु॑ शवसस्पत॒ इष॑ᳪ स्तो॒तृभ्य॒ आ भ॑र
verses.translation: Thou, brilliant God, within thy mouth warmest both ladles of the oil. So fill us also in our hymns abundantly, O Lord of Strength. Bring food to those who sing thy praise.
verses.hindi: प्रभु-प्राप्ति के साधन ' पूजा, गति व स्तुति! है। वे प्रभु १. अग्नित्ठमारी उन्नति के साधक है। २. वृद्धतम व सर्वाधिक आनन्द के वर्षक है। ३. हमारी शक्तियों को नष्ट न होने देनेवाले है तथा ४. सहस् के पुञ्ज है। ससमिद्युवसे वृषन्नग्ने विश्वान्यर्यऽअआा ।
verses.transliteration: ubhe suścandra sarpiṣo darvī śrīṇīṣa āsani | uto na utpupūryā uktheṣu śavasaspata iṣa stotṛbhya ā bhara
verses.wordMeaning: Thou, brilliant God, within thy mouth warmest both ladles of the oil. So fill us also in our hymns abundantly, O Lord of Strength. Bring food to those who sing thy praise.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thou, brilliant God, within thy mouth warmest both ladles of the oil. So fill us also in our hymns abundantly, O Lord of Strength. Bring food to those who sing thy praise.

verses.sanskrit: अग्ने॒ तम॒द्याश्वं॒ न स्तोमै॒: क्रतुं॒ न भ॒द्रᳪ हृ॑दि॒स्पृश॑म् । ऋ॒ध्यामा॑ त॒ ओहै॑:
verses.translation: Agni, with lauds this day may we bring thee that which thou lovest, Right judgment, like a horse, with our devotions.
verses.hindi: वे प्रभु हमें आगे ले-चलते हे, हमें अक्षीण शक्ति बनाते हें, प्रीति को देनेवाले है, सर्वाधिक ज्ञानवाले देँ, सदा सहायता के लिए उद्यत हैँ, हमारे सब यज्ञ उन्हीं की कृपा से पूर्ण होते है, सब कष्टों व अज्ञानं को दूर करनेवाले व अमर हेँ। हम उन्दी १. वे प्रभु विश्वस्य दूतम्-( दूतः जवतेर्वा द्रवतेर्वा--वारयतेर्वा-नि० ५।९) सम्पूर्णं
verses.transliteration: agne tamadyāśvaṃ na stomai: kratuṃ na bhadra hṛdispṛśam | ṛdhyāmā ta ohai:
verses.wordMeaning: Agni, with lauds this day may we bring thee that which thou lovest, Right judgment, like a horse, with our devotions.
verses.commentary: Sense: Agni, with lauds this day may we bring thee that which thou lovest, Right judgment, like a horse, with our devotions.

verses.sanskrit: अधा॒ ह्य॒ग्ने॒ क्रतो॑र्भ॒द्रस्य॒ दक्ष॑स्य सा॒धोः । र॒थीरृ॒तस्य॑ बृह॒तो ब॒भूथ॑
verses.translation: For thou hast ever been the car-driver, Agni, of noble Strength, lofty sacrifice, and rightful judgment.
verses.hindi: ठम प्रभु के प्रति अपना अर्पण करे व उसे पुकारे तो प्रभु सहायता के लिए सदा उपस्थित होते है। वे हमारे शरीर-रथ मे शीघ्रता से मार्ग का व्यापन करनेवाले व ज्ञान. प्रकाश द्वारा पालक इन्द्रियाश्वों को जोतते है। स्वाहुतः दुद्रवत् देवराधः
verses.transliteration: adhā hyagne kratorbhadrasya dakṣasya sādhoḥ | rathīrṛtasya bṛhato babhūtha
verses.wordMeaning: For thou hast ever been the car-driver, Agni, of noble Strength, lofty sacrifice, and rightful judgment.
verses.commentary: Sense: For thou hast ever been the car-driver, Agni, of noble Strength, lofty sacrifice, and rightful judgment.

verses.sanskrit: ए॒भिर्नो॑ अर्कै॒र्भवा॑ नो अ॒र्वाङ्  स्व॒र्ण ज्योति॑: । अग्ने॒ विश्वे॑भिः सु॒मना॒ अनी॑कैः
verses.translation: Through these our praises come thou to meet us, bright as the sunlight, O Agni, well-disposed, with all thine aspects.
verses.hindi: प्रभु को वही पाता है जो ९. स्वस्थ व ज्ञानी बनकर क्रियाशील होता है ओर इस प्रकार जीवन को एक यज्ञ ना देता है। तथा २. जो अपनी शक्तियों का विकास करता हुआ देवोचित न्यायमार्ग से व्यवहार-साधक धन कमाता है। अग्ने वाज॑स्य गोम॑तऽ ईशानः सहस्रो यहो ।
verses.transliteration: ebhirno arkairbhavā no arvāṅ svarṇa jyoti: | agne viśvebhiḥ sumanā anīkaiḥ
verses.wordMeaning: Through these our praises come thou to meet us, bright as the sunlight, O Agni, well-disposed, with all thine aspects.
verses.commentary: Sense: Through these our praises come thou to meet us, bright as the sunlight, O Agni, well-disposed, with all thine aspects.

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒ग्निᳪ होता॑रं मन्ये॒ दास्व॑न्तं॒ वसु॑ᳪ सू॒नुᳪ सह॑सो जा॒तवे॑दसं॒ विप्रं॒ न जा॒तवे॑दसम् ।
य ऊ॒र्ध्वया॑ स्वध्व॒रो दे॒वो दे॒वाच्या॑ कृ॒पा । घृ॒तस्य॒ विभ्रा॑ष्टि॒मनु॑ वष्टि शो॒चिषा॒ऽऽजुह्वा॑नस्य स॒र्पिष॑:
verses.translation: Agni I hold as Herald, the munificent, the gracious Son of Strength who knoweth all that live, as holy singer knowing all; Lord of fair rites, a God with form erected, turning to the Gods, He, when the flame hath sprung forth from the sacred oil, the offered fatness, longeth for it with his glow.
verses.hindi: ब्रह्मचारी का मूलमन्त्र "माता-पिता व आचार्य के प्रति अर्पण! हो। गृहस्थ का दान, वनस्थ का यज्ञ तथा संन्यास का प्रभु-स्तवन ही मुख्य ध्येय हो। यचुर्वेदभाष्यम् ५११ पञ्चदशोऽध्यायः १. भद्राः उत प्रशस्तयः=उस प्रभु की प्रशस्तियँ तो निश्चय से हमारा कल्याण करें
verses.transliteration: agni hotāraṃ manye dāsvantaṃ vasu sūnu sahaso jātavedasaṃ vipraṃ na jātavedasam | ya ūrdhvayā svadhvaro devo devācyā kṛpā | ghṛtasya vibhrāṣṭimanu vaṣṭi śociṣā''juhvānasya sarpiṣa:
verses.wordMeaning: Agni I hold as Herald, the munificent, the gracious Son of Strength who knoweth all that live, as holy singer knowing all; Lord of fair rites, a God with form erected, turning to the Gods, He, when the flame hath sprung forth from the sacred oil, the offered fatness,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Agni I hold as Herald, the munificent, the gracious Son of Strength who knoweth all that live, as holy singer knowing all; Lord of fair rites, a God with form erected, turning to the Gods, He, when the flame hath sprung forth from the sacred oil, the offered fatness,…

verses.sanskrit:
अग्ने॒ त्वं नो॒ अन्त॑म उ॒त त्रा॒ता शि॒वो भ॑व वरू॒थ्य॒: ।
वसु॑र॒ग्निर्वसु॑श्रवा॒ अच्छा॑ नक्षि द्यु॒मत्त॑मᳪ र॒यिं दा॑: ।
तं त्वा॑ शोचिष्ठ दीदिवः सु॒म्नाय॑ नू॒नमी॑महे॒ सखि॑भ्यः
verses.translation: O Agni, be our nearest Friend, be thou a kind deliverer and a gracious Friend. Come as good Agni, come as excellent and give us wealth most splendidly renowned. To thee then, O most bright, O radiant God, we come with prayer for happiness for our friends.
verses.hindi: हे प्रभो! आपकी कृपा से अत्यन्त प्रबल भी इन काम, क्रोध आदि को हम जीतनेवाले बनें। इन अभिबलायमान कामादि के अस्त्र शिथिल हो जाएँ ओर हम इन्दे अग्निं तं म॑न्ये यो वसुरस्तं यं यन्ति धेनवः । १९. गत मन्त्र के अनुसार कामादि का पराजय करके यः=जो वसुः=शरीर मेँ अपने
verses.transliteration: agne tvaṃ no antama uta trātā śivo bhava varūthya: | vasuragnirvasuśravā acchā nakṣi dyumattama rayiṃ dā: | taṃ tvā śociṣṭha dīdivaḥ sumnāya nūnamīmahe sakhibhyaḥ
verses.wordMeaning: O Agni, be our nearest Friend, be thou a kind deliverer and a gracious Friend. Come as good Agni, come as excellent and give us wealth most splendidly renowned. To thee then, O most bright, O radiant God, we come with prayer for happiness for our friends.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Agni, be our nearest Friend, be thou a kind deliverer and a gracious Friend. Come as good Agni, come as excellent and give us wealth most splendidly renowned. To thee then, O most bright, O radiant God, we come with prayer for happiness for our friends.

verses.sanskrit:
येन॒ ऋष॑य॒स्तप॑सा स॒त्रमाय॒न्निन्धा॑ना अ॒ग्निᳪ स्व॑रा॒भर॑न्तः ।
तस्मि॑न्न॒हं नि द॑धे॒ नाके॑ अ॒ग्निं यमा॒हुर्मन॑व स्ती॒र्णब॑र्हिषम्
verses.translation: With what devotion, winning light, the Rishis came, kindling Agni, to the Holy session, Even with that in heaven I stablish Agni whom men call him whose sacred grass is scattered.
verses.hindi: नियम से अग्निहोत्र करनेवाला व्यक्ति सदा आनन्दमय जीवनवाला व सौमनस्यवाला होता है। वह अग्निहोत्र से अपने अन्न-भण्डारों को पूर्णं करता है ओर प्रभु-स्तवन से सशक्त बनता है। १. है अग्ने=हमारी उन्नरतियों के साधक प्रभो! ते ओदहैः=८तव प्रापणौः) आपको
verses.transliteration: yena ṛṣayastapasā satramāyannindhānā agni svarābharantaḥ | tasminnahaṃ ni dadhe nāke agniṃ yamāhurmanava stīrṇabarhiṣam
verses.wordMeaning: With what devotion, winning light, the Rishis came, kindling Agni, to the Holy session, Even with that in heaven I stablish Agni whom men call him whose sacred grass is scattered.
verses.commentary: Sense: With what devotion, winning light, the Rishis came, kindling Agni, to the Holy session, Even with that in heaven I stablish Agni whom men call him whose sacred grass is scattered.

verses.sanskrit:
तं पत्नी॑भि॒रनु॑ गच्छेम देवाः पु॒त्रैर्भ्रातृ॑भिरु॒त वा॒ हिर॑ण्यैः ।
नाकं॑ गृभ्णा॒नाः सु॑कृ॒तस्य॑ लो॒के तृ॒तीये॑ पृ॒ष्ठे अधि॑ रोच॒ने दि॒वः ।। ५०।
आ वा॒चो मध्य॑मरुहद्भुर॒ण्युर॒यम॒ग्निः सत्प॑ति॒श्चेकि॑तानः ।
पृ॒ष्ठे पृ॑थि॒व्या निहि॑तो॒ दवि॑द्युतद॒धस्प॒दं कृ॑णुतां॒ ये पृ॑त॒न्यव॑:
verses.translation: This Agni mounted up to Speech's Centre, Lord of the Brave, observant, ever-active. Laid on the back of Earth, may he, resplendent, cast under foot those who would fight against us.
verses.hindi: प्रभु हमे ९. भद्र क्रतु=उत्तम संकल्पवाला बनाते है। २. कार्यसाधक शक्ति प्राप्त कराते है। ३. संकल्प ओर शक्ति प्रदान कर हमारी वृद्धि के कारणभूत यज्ञो के प्रभु-प्राप्ति के लिए रपौँच बातें अग्ने विश्वेभिः सुमनाऽअनींकेः ॥।४६॥
verses.transliteration: taṃ patnībhiranu gacchema devāḥ putrairbhrātṛbhiruta vā hiraṇyaiḥ | nākaṃ gṛbhṇānāḥ sukṛtasya loke tṛtīye pṛṣṭhe adhi rocane divaḥ || 50| ā vāco madhyamaruhadbhuraṇyurayamagniḥ satpatiścekitānaḥ | pṛṣṭhe pṛthivyā nihito davidyutadadhaspadaṃ kṛṇutāṃ ye pṛtanyava:
verses.wordMeaning: This Agni mounted up to Speech's Centre, Lord of the Brave, observant, ever-active. Laid on the back of Earth, may he, resplendent, cast under foot those who would fight against us.
verses.commentary: Sense: This Agni mounted up to Speech's Centre, Lord of the Brave, observant, ever-active. Laid on the back of Earth, may he, resplendent, cast under foot those who would fight against us.

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒यम॒ग्निर्वी॒रत॑मो वयो॒धाः स॑ह॒स्रियो॑ द्योतता॒मप्र॑युच्छन् ।
वि॒भ्राज॑मानः सरि॒रस्य॒ मध्य॒ उप॒ प्र या॑हि दि॒व्यानि॒ धाम॑
verses.translation: May this most manly Agni, strength-bestower, giver of thousands, shine with care that fails not. Resplendent in the middle of the water, make thine approach to the celestial mansions.
verses.hindi: प्रभु-प्राप्ति के लिए मन्त्र में पाँच बातों का संकेत है। १. वेद-मन्त्राध्ययन, २. नम्रता, ३. सूर्य के समान ज्ञान से दीप्त होना ओरों को भी अपने जीवन से ज्ञान का प्रकाश प्राप्त कराना, ४. तेजस्विता ओर ५. सौमनस्य। अग्निध्ोतारं मन्ये दास्व॑न्तं वसु॑श्सूनुश्सह॑सो जातवेदसं विप्रं न जातवेदसम् ।
verses.transliteration: ayamagnirvīratamo vayodhāḥ sahasriyo dyotatāmaprayucchan | vibhrājamānaḥ sarirasya madhya upa pra yāhi divyāni dhāma
verses.wordMeaning: May this most manly Agni, strength-bestower, giver of thousands, shine with care that fails not. Resplendent in the middle of the water, make thine approach to the celestial mansions.
verses.commentary: Sense: May this most manly Agni, strength-bestower, giver of thousands, shine with care that fails not. Resplendent in the middle of the water, make thine approach to the celestial mansions.

verses.sanskrit:
स॒म्प्रच्य॑वध्व॒मुप॑ स॒म्प्रया॒ताग्ने॑ प॒थो दे॑व॒याना॑न् कृणुध्वम् ।
पुन॑: कृण्वा॒ना पि॒तरा॒ युवा॑ना॒ऽन्वाता॑ᳪसी॒त् त्वयि॒ तन्तु॑मे॒तम्
verses.translation: Make him go forth from all sides: meet, Approach ye. O Agni, make the paths for Godward travel. Making the Parents young with life's renewal, the out spun thread in thee have they extended.
verses.hindi: प्रभु-प्राप्ति के लिए निम्न बातें चाहिए -१. होता व दानशील बनना। २. उत्तम निवासवाला व शक्ति का पुञ्ज बनना। ३. उचित धनार्जन व खूब ज्ञानार्जन करना। ४. शक्तिशाली व देव बनकर अ्हिंसात्मक कर्मो में प्रवृत्त होना। ५. घृत प्रयोग से शरीर को स्वस्थ बनाना ओर ज्ान-दीप्ति से प्रभु-दर्शन की कामना करना।
verses.transliteration: sampracyavadhvamupa samprayātāgne patho devayānān kṛṇudhvam | puna: kṛṇvānā pitarā yuvānā'nvātāsīt tvayi tantumetam
verses.wordMeaning: Make him go forth from all sides: meet, Approach ye. O Agni, make the paths for Godward travel. Making the Parents young with life's renewal, the out spun thread in thee have they extended.
verses.commentary: Sense: Make him go forth from all sides: meet, Approach ye. O Agni, make the paths for Godward travel. Making the Parents young with life's renewal, the out spun thread in thee have they extended.

verses.sanskrit:
उद्बु॑ध्यस्वाग्ने॒ प्रति॑ जागृहि॒ त्वमि॑ष्टापू॒र्ते सᳪ सृ॑जेथाम॒यं च॑ ।
अ॒स्मिन्त्स॒धस्थे॒ अध्युत्त॑रस्मि॒न् विस्वे॑ देवा॒ यज॑मानाश्च सीदत
verses.translation: Wake up, O Agni, thou, and keep him watchful. Wish and fruition, meet, and he, together. In this and in the loftier habitation be seated, All-Gods! and the Sacrificer.
verses.hindi: तप से ज्ञान, यज्ञ व सुख की प्राप्ति होती हे। यही तप परमात्मा-प्राप्ति का साधन बनता है, उस परमात्मा की प्राप्ति का जो हदय को आच्छादित करके आसुर वृत्तियों प्रभु चरणों में (सब मिलकर ) तं पल्नीभिरनु गच्छेम देवाः पुतरैर्भ्रातुंभिरुत वा हिरण्यैः ।
verses.transliteration: udbudhyasvāgne prati jāgṛhi tvamiṣṭāpūrte sa sṛjethāmayaṃ ca | asmintsadhasthe adhyuttarasmin visve devā yajamānāśca sīdata
verses.wordMeaning: Wake up, O Agni, thou, and keep him watchful. Wish and fruition, meet, and he, together. In this and in the loftier habitation be seated, All-Gods! and the Sacrificer.
verses.commentary: Sense: Wake up, O Agni, thou, and keep him watchful. Wish and fruition, meet, and he, together. In this and in the loftier habitation be seated, All-Gods! and the Sacrificer.

verses.sanskrit:
येन॒ वह॑सि स॒हस्रं॒ येना॑ग्ने सर्ववेद॒सम् ।
तेने॒मं य॒ज्ञं नो॑ नय॒ स्व॒र्दे॒वेषु॒ गन्त॑वे
verses.translation: Convey our sacrifice to heaven that it may reach the God with that Whereby thou, Agni, bearest wealth in thousands and all precious things. 6 56 This is thine ordered place of birth whence sprung to life thou shonest forth. Knowing this, Agni, rise thou up and cause our riches to increase.
verses.hindi: घर के सब व्यक्ति मिलकर प्रभु कौ उपासना कररे। अपने धनं को प्रभु-चरणों मेँ अर्पित करे ओर सुकृतो के द्वारा देदीप्यमान सुखमय स्थिति का लाभ करे। पञ्चदस्ोऽध्यायः ५१८ यजुर्वेद भाव्यम् १९. अयं अग्निः =यह प्रगतिशील विद्वान् (द०) वाचः मध्यम् अरुहत्-वाणी के
verses.transliteration: yena vahasi sahasraṃ yenāgne sarvavedasam | tenemaṃ yajñaṃ no naya svardeveṣu gantave
verses.wordMeaning: Convey our sacrifice to heaven that it may reach the God with that Whereby thou, Agni, bearest wealth in thousands and all precious things. 6 56 This is thine ordered place of birth whence sprung to life thou shonest forth. Knowing this, Agni,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Convey our sacrifice to heaven that it may reach the God with that Whereby thou, Agni, bearest wealth in thousands and all precious things. 6 56 This is thine ordered place of birth whence sprung to life thou shonest forth. Knowing this, Agni,…

verses.sanskrit: अ॒यं ते॒ योनि॑रृ॒त्वियो॒ यतो॑ जा॒तो अरो॑चथा । तं जा॒नन्न॑ग्न आ रो॒हाथा॑ नो वर्धया र॒यिम्
verses.translation: Tapa, Tapasya, pair of Dewy Seasons: thou art, etc.
verses.hindi: अग्नि ' ज्ञानी बनता है, ओरोँं के भरण का भी ध्यान करता हे' सत्कर्म का रक्षक व समञ्चदार बनता है। यह शरीर को पूर्ण स्वस्थ करके ज्लान-दीप्त होता है ओर वासनाओं को कुचल डालता हेै। १. पिच्छले मन्त्र के अन्तिम वाक्य के अनुसार शत्रुओं को पाव तले कुचल डालनेवाला
verses.transliteration: ayaṃ te yonirṛtviyo yato jāto arocathā | taṃ jānannagna ā rohāthā no vardhayā rayim
verses.wordMeaning: Tapa, Tapasya, pair of Dewy Seasons: thou art, etc.
verses.commentary: Sense: Tapa, Tapasya, pair of Dewy Seasons: thou art, etc.

verses.sanskrit:
तप॑श्च तप॒स्य॒श्च शैशि॒रावृ॒तू अ॒ग्नेर॑न्तः श्ले॒षो॒ऽसि॒ कल्पे॑तां॒ द्यावा॑पृथि॒वी कल्प॑न्ता॒माप॒ ओष॑धय॒: कल्प॑न्ताम॒ग्नय॒: पृथ॒ङ्मम॒ ज्यैष्ठ्या॑य॒ सव्र॑ताः। ये अ॒ग्नय॒: सम॑नसोऽन्त॒रा द्यावा॑पृथि॒वी इ॒मे|
शै॒शि॒रावृ॒तू अ॑भि॒कल्प॑माना॒ इन्द्र॑मिव दे॒वा अ॑भि॒संवि॑शन्तु॒ तया॑ दे॒वत॑याऽङ्गिर॒स्वद्ध्रु॒वे सी॑दतम्
verses.translation: (as in XIII. 25).
verses.hindi: कामादि शत्नु-विजेता अग्नि वीरतम है, उत्कृष्ट जीवनवाला है , प्रसन्न. ज्ञानी, अप्रमत्त है। इन कोशो में यह दीप्त जीवनवाला है ओर तभी स्वर्ग को प्राप्त करता सम्प्रच्य॑वध्वमुप॑ सम्प्रयाताग्न पथो देवयानान् कृणुध्वम् । १. सम्प्रच्यवध्वम्= (सं गच्छध्वम्) तुम सब मिलकर चलो ओर मिलकर चलने के
verses.transliteration: tapaśca tapasyaśca śaiśirāvṛtū agnerantaḥ śleṣo'si kalpetāṃ dyāvāpṛthivī kalpantāmāpa oṣadhaya: kalpantāmagnaya: pṛthaṅmama jyaiṣṭhyāya savratāḥ| ye agnaya: samanaso'ntarā dyāvāpṛthivī ime| śaiśirāvṛtū abhikalpamānā indramiva devā abhisaṃviśantu tayā devatayā'ṅgirasvaddhruve sīdatam
verses.wordMeaning: (as in XIII. 25).
verses.commentary: Sense: (as in XIII. 25).

verses.sanskrit:
प॒र॒मे॒ष्ठी त्वा॑ सादयतु दि॒वस्पृ॒ष्ठे ज्योति॑ष्मतीम् । विश्व॑स्मै प्रा॒णाया॑पा॒नाय॑ व्या॒नाय॒ विश्वं॒ ज्योति॑र्यच्छ ।
सूर्य॒स्तेऽधि॑पति॒स्तया॑ दे॒वत॑याऽङ्गिर॒स्वद् ध्रु॒वा सी॑द
verses.translation: On the sky's back may Parameshthin lay thee, etc. (as in XIV. 14). Thy Lord is Sûrya, etc. (as in XIV. 14).
verses.hindi: यज्ञाग्नि में डाले गये पदार्थं सहस्रगुणित होकर हमें फिर प्राप्त हो जाते हेै। ये हमारी सुखमय स्थिति का कारण हे। यजुरवेदभाष्यम् ५२१ पञ्चवद्ोऽध्यायः १. पिछले मन्त्र की ही भावना को कि “हममे यज्ञो का प्रणयन हो ', घर-घर मे यज्ञ
verses.transliteration: parameṣṭhī tvā sādayatu divaspṛṣṭhe jyotiṣmatīm | viśvasmai prāṇāyāpānāya vyānāya viśvaṃ jyotiryaccha | sūryaste'dhipatistayā devatayā'ṅgirasvad dhruvā sīda
verses.wordMeaning: On the sky's back may Parameshthin lay thee, etc. (as in XIV. 14). Thy Lord is Sûrya, etc. (as in XIV. 14).
verses.commentary: Sense: On the sky's back may Parameshthin lay thee, etc. (as in XIV. 14). Thy Lord is Sûrya, etc. (as in XIV. 14).

verses.sanskrit: लो॒कं पृ॑ण छि॒द्रं पृ॒णाथो॑ सीद ध्रु॒वा त्वम् । इ॒न्द्रा॒ग्नी त्वा॒ बृह॒स्पति॑र॒स्मिन्योना॑वसीषदन्
verses.translation: Repeated from XII. 54.
verses.hindi: पति-पली जान से चमक, उत्तम तपस्वी हो। तीव्र गत्तिवाले, अर्थात् सदा विष्वं ज्योति्यच्छ । सूर्यस्ते ऽधिंपतिस्तयां देवतया ऽङ्गिरस्वद् ध्रुवा सीद ॥५५८॥ पर सादयतु-विठाए, अर्थात् प्रभु कौ कृपा से तू ऊँचे-से-ऊँचे स्ानवाली हो। ज्योतिष्मतीम् प्रभु तेरे जीवन को ज्योतिर्मय करे। २. विश्वस्मै प्राणाय अपानाय व्यानाय -घर में तू सबके
verses.transliteration: lokaṃ pṛṇa chidraṃ pṛṇātho sīda dhruvā tvam | indrāgnī tvā bṛhaspatirasminyonāvasīṣadan
verses.wordMeaning: Repeated from XII. 54.
verses.commentary: Sense: Repeated from XII. 54.

verses.sanskrit: ता अ॑स्य॒ सूद॑दोहस॒: सोम॑ᳪ श्रीणन्ति॒ पृश्न॑यः । जन्म॑न्दे॒वानां॒ विश॑स्त्रि॒ष्वा रो॑च॒ने दि॒वः
verses.translation: Repeated from XII. 55.
verses.hindi: पली का जीवन ज्योतिर्मय हो। वह सबके स्वास्थ्य का ध्यान करे। सन्तानों यचुर्वेदभाष्यम् ५२२ पञ्चदशोऽध्यायः कौ उत्तम ज्ञान देनेवाली हो। पति सूर्य की भांति सतत क्रियाशील होकर घर का उत्कृष्ट इन्द्र, अग्नि व बृहस्पति
verses.transliteration: tā asya sūdadohasa: soma śrīṇanti pṛśnayaḥ | janmandevānāṃ viśastriṣvā rocane divaḥ
verses.wordMeaning: Repeated from XII. 55.
verses.commentary: Sense: Repeated from XII. 55.

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्रं॒ विश्वा॑ अवीवृधन्त्समु॒द्रव्य॑चसं॒ गिर॑: । र॒थीत॑मᳪ र॒थीनां॒ वाजा॑ना॒ᳪ सत्प॑तिं॒ पति॑म्
verses.translation: Repeated from XII. 56.
verses.hindi: पली घर में अपने सौन्दर्य व ज्ञान से प्रकाश भर दे, दोषों को दूर करनेवाली जन्म॑न्देवानां विश॑स्तिष्वारोचने दिवः ॥६०॥ १. उल्लिखित मन्त्र में वर्णित प्रकार के ताः=वे व्यक्ति अस्यइस प्रभु के होते है, हैवी वृत्तिवाले बनकर प्रभु-प्राप्ति के मार्ग पर चल रहे होते े। २. जो सूदवोहसः=( षूद
verses.transliteration: indraṃ viśvā avīvṛdhantsamudravyacasaṃ gira: | rathītama rathīnāṃ vājānā satpatiṃ patim
verses.wordMeaning: Repeated from XII. 56.
verses.commentary: Sense: Repeated from XII. 56.

verses.sanskrit:
प्रोथ॒दश्वो॒ न यव॑सेऽवि॒ष्यन्य॒दा म॒हः सं॒वर॑णा॒द्वयस्था॑त् ।
आद॑स्य॒ वातो॒ अनु॑वाति शो॒चिरध॑ स्म ते॒ व्रज॑नं कृ॒ष्णम॑स्ति
verses.translation: Like a horse neighing, eager for the pasture, when he hath stepped forth from the great enclosure: Then the wind following blows upon his splendour, and, straight, the path is black which thou hast travelled.
verses.hindi: जो प्रभु के उपासक होते हैः वे १. अवगुणों को दूर करके गुणों का ग्रहण करते हँ। २. अपनी वीर्यशक्ति को संयमी जीवन से परिपक्व बनाते है। ३. ज्ञान-रश्मियों से सूर्यं कौ भाँति चमकनेवाले बनते हैँ। ४. दिव्य गुणों को धारण करके धर्मार्थकाम का समान रूप से सेवन करते हेै। ५. सदा ज्ञान के प्रकाश मे रहते है।
verses.transliteration: prothadaśvo na yavase'viṣyanyadā mahaḥ saṃvaraṇādvayasthāt | ādasya vāto anuvāti śociradha sma te vrajanaṃ kṛṣṇamasti
verses.wordMeaning: Like a horse neighing, eager for the pasture, when he hath stepped forth from the great enclosure: Then the wind following blows upon his splendour, and, straight, the path is black which thou hast travelled.
verses.commentary: Sense: Like a horse neighing, eager for the pasture, when he hath stepped forth from the great enclosure: Then the wind following blows upon his splendour, and, straight, the path is black which thou hast travelled.

verses.sanskrit:
आ॒योष्ट्वा॒ सद॑ने सादया॒म्यव॑तश्छा॒याया॑ᳪ समु॒द्रस्य॒ हृद॑ये ।
र॒श्मी॒वतीं॒ भास्व॑ती॒मा या द्यां भास्यापृ॑थि॒वीमोर्व॒न्तरि॑क्षम्
verses.translation: In Âyu's seat I set thee, in the shadow of the protector in the heart of Ocean, Thee luminous, bright with eyes, thee who illumest the sky, the earth, and air's broad realm between them.
verses.hindi: वेदवाणियों का उच्चारण करते हए जब हम उनके अनुसार आचरण करते हैः तब वासनाओं से बच जाते है। उपासक बनकर वृत्र को परे फक हम उठ खडे होते है। प्राण-साधना करके अपने चरित्र को ऊँचा कर पाते है। १. पली से कहते हैँ कि त्वा=तुडो आयोः= (एति) गतिशील पुरुष के सदने=घर
verses.transliteration: āyoṣṭvā sadane sādayāmyavataśchāyāyā samudrasya hṛdaye | raśmīvatīṃ bhāsvatīmā yā dyāṃ bhāsyāpṛthivīmorvantarikṣam
verses.wordMeaning: In Âyu's seat I set thee, in the shadow of the protector in the heart of Ocean, Thee luminous, bright with eyes, thee who illumest the sky, the earth, and air's broad realm between them.
verses.commentary: Sense: In Âyu's seat I set thee, in the shadow of the protector in the heart of Ocean, Thee luminous, bright with eyes, thee who illumest the sky, the earth, and air's broad realm between them.

verses.sanskrit:
प॒र॒मे॒ष्ठी त्वा॑ सादयतु दि॒वस्पृ॒ष्ठे व्यच॑स्वतीं॒ प्रथ॑स्वतीं॒ दिवं॑ यच्छ॒ दिवं॑ दृᳪह॒ दिवं॒ मा हि॑ᳪसीः ।
विश्व॑स्मै प्रा॒णाया॑पा॒नाय॑ व्या॒नायो॑दा॒नाय॑ प्रति॒ष्ठायै॑ च॒रित्रा॑य ।
सूर्य॑स्त्वा॒ऽभि पा॑तु म॒ह्या स्व॒स्त्या छ॒र्दिषा॒ शन्त॑मेन॒ तया॑ दे॒वत॑याऽङ्गिर॒स्वद् ध्रु॒वे सी॑दतम्
verses.translation: On the sky's back may Parameshthin set thee, etc. (as in XIV. 12, substituting sky for air and Sûrya for Vâyu).
verses.hindi: पति को गतिशील, वासनाओं से अपनी रक्षा करनेवाला व प्रसन्न स्वभावावाला होना है तथा पली ने वश्येन्द्रिय व प्रकाशमय जीवनवाला बनकर मस्तिष्क, शरीर व हृदय तीनों को ही दीप्त करना है। सूर्यस्त्वाभिपांतु मह्या स्वस्त्या छर्दिषा शन्तमेन तया। देवत॑या ऽद्धिर स्वद् ध्वे
verses.transliteration: parameṣṭhī tvā sādayatu divaspṛṣṭhe vyacasvatīṃ prathasvatīṃ divaṃ yaccha divaṃ dṛha divaṃ mā hisīḥ | viśvasmai prāṇāyāpānāya vyānāyodānāya pratiṣṭhāyai caritrāya | sūryastvā'bhi pātu mahyā svastyā chardiṣā śantamena tayā devatayā'ṅgirasvad dhruve sīdatam
verses.wordMeaning: On the sky's back may Parameshthin set thee, etc. (as in XIV. 12, substituting sky for air and Sûrya for Vâyu).
verses.commentary: Sense: On the sky's back may Parameshthin set thee, etc. (as in XIV. 12, substituting sky for air and Sûrya for Vâyu).

verses.sanskrit: स॒हस्र॑स्य प्र॒माऽसि॑  स॒हस्र॑स्य प्रति॒माऽसि॑ स॒हस्र॑स्यो॒न्माऽसि॑ साह॒स्रो॒ऽसि स॒हस्रा॑य त्वा
verses.translation: Thou art the measure of a thousand. Thou art the representative of a thousand. Thou art the equivalent of a thousand. Thou art worth a thousand. Thee for a thousand.
verses.hindi: पली प्रशस्त विद्याओं का अध्ययन-मनन करनेवाली तथा उत्तम प्रशंसावाली व विशाल हदयवाली हो। वह सबके प्राणापान आदि का वर्धन करनेवाली हो। पति सूर्य के समान सदा गतिशील होकर घर का रक्षण करे। घर में गौ हो, समृद्धि हो तथा घर स्वयं अधिक-से-अधिक शान्ति देनेवाला हो। इस घर मेँ पति-पली प्रभु का उपासन करते हुए
verses.transliteration: sahasrasya pramā'si sahasrasya pratimā'si sahasrasyonmā'si sāhasro'si sahasrāya tvā
verses.wordMeaning: Thou art the measure of a thousand. Thou art the representative of a thousand. Thou art the equivalent of a thousand. Thou art worth a thousand. Thee for a thousand.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thou art the measure of a thousand. Thou art the representative of a thousand. Thou art the equivalent of a thousand. Thou art worth a thousand. Thee for a thousand.

verses.sanskrit: नम॑स्ते रुद्र म॒न्यव॑ उ॒तो त॒ इष॑वे॒ नम॑: । बा॒हुभ्या॑मु॒त ते॒ नम॑:
verses.translation: regions, to the trees with their green tresses, to the Lord of beasts be homage; homage to him whose sheen is like green grass, homage to the radiant Lord of paths, homage to the golden-haired wearer of the sacrificial cord, homage to the Lord of the well-endowed.
verses.hindi: हम अपने जीवन को वेदवाणी के अनुसार बनाते हए प्रभु को प्राप्त करनेवाले बने। हमारे शरीर व्याधियों से शून्य हों ओर मन आधियों से। अध्यवोचदधिवक्ता प्र॑थमो हैव्यो भिषक् । १. गत मन्त्र में आधि-व्याधियों के दूरीकरण का प्रसङ्ग था। इन आधि-व्याधियाों
verses.transliteration: namaste rudra manyava uto ta iṣave nama: | bāhubhyāmuta te nama:
verses.wordMeaning: regions, to the trees with their green tresses, to the Lord of beasts be homage; homage to him whose sheen is like green grass, homage to the radiant Lord of paths, homage to the golden-haired wearer of the sacrificial cord, homage to the Lord of the well-endowed.
verses.commentary: Sense: regions, to the trees with their green tresses, to the Lord of beasts be homage; homage to him whose sheen is like green grass, homage to the radiant Lord of paths, homage to the golden-haired wearer of the sacrificial cord, homage to the Lord of the well-endowed.

verses.sanskrit: या ते॑ रुद्र शि॒वा त॒नूरघो॒राऽपा॑पकाशिनी । तया॑ नस्त॒न्वा शन्त॑मया॒ गिरि॑शन्ता॒भि चा॑कशीहि
verses.translation: With that auspicious form of thine, mild, Rudra! pleasant to behold, Even with that most blessd form, look, Mountain-haunter! here on us.
verses.hindi: हे प्रभो! आप ही अधिवक्ता हैं, प्रथम हैव्य भिषक् है। आप हमारे मनां से कुटिलता व हिंसा को भगाकर स्वस्थ कीजिए तथा रोगों को दूर करके शरीर की पीडा भगाने के लिए ही राजा एक राष्ट की व्यवस्था करता है। इस राज्य का मुखिया या राजा असौ-वह होता है यः=जो (क) ताम्रः =(ताग्रवत् कविनाङ्ख:-द०) ताग्न की तरह दृढ
verses.transliteration: yā te rudra śivā tanūraghorā'pāpakāśinī | tayā nastanvā śantamayā giriśantābhi cākaśīhi
verses.wordMeaning: With that auspicious form of thine, mild, Rudra! pleasant to behold, Even with that most blessd form, look, Mountain-haunter! here on us.
verses.commentary: Sense: With that auspicious form of thine, mild, Rudra! pleasant to behold, Even with that most blessd form, look, Mountain-haunter! here on us.

verses.sanskrit: यामिषुं॑  गिरिशन्त॒ हस्ते॑ बि॒भर्ष्यस्त॑वे । शि॒वां गि॑रित्र॒ तां कु॑रु॒ मा हि॑ᳪसी॒: पुरु॑षं॒ जग॑त्
verses.translation: The shaft which, Mountain-haunter, thou art holding in thy hand to shoot, Make that auspicious, Mountain-Lord! Injure not man nor moving thing.
verses.hindi: राजा का धनुष शत्रुओं के निधन का कारण बने। शत्रुओं से देश को सुरक्षित कर राजा राष्ट के एश्वर्य को बदढानेवाला हो। १. शत्रुओं को दुर भगाकर कपर्दिनः=' केन . सुखेन परं पूर्तिं ददाति=प्रजाओं में सुख- विस्तार से तृप्ति देनेवाले, प्रजाओं में सुख को फैलानेवाले इस राजा का धनुः धनुष, अव
verses.transliteration: yāmiṣuṃ giriśanta haste bibharṣyastave | śivāṃ giritra tāṃ kuru mā hisī: puruṣaṃ jagat
verses.wordMeaning: The shaft which, Mountain-haunter, thou art holding in thy hand to shoot, Make that auspicious, Mountain-Lord! Injure not man nor moving thing.
verses.commentary: Sense: The shaft which, Mountain-haunter, thou art holding in thy hand to shoot, Make that auspicious, Mountain-Lord! Injure not man nor moving thing.

verses.sanskrit: शि॒वेन॒ वच॑सा त्वा गिरि॒शाच्छा॑ वदामसि । यथा॑ न॒: सर्व॒मिज्जग॑दय॒क्ष्मᳪ सु॒मना॒ अस॑त्
verses.translation: O Dweller on the Mountain, we salute thee with auspicious hymn; That all, yea, all our people may be healthy and well-satisfied.
verses.hindi: प्रजा में सुख-सञ्चार करनेवाले राजा का अस्त्रागार शत्रुओं के संहार के लिए है, प्रजा पर अत्याचार के लिए नहीं। १. शत्रुओं के नाश व प्रजाओं के कल्याण करे द्वारा यह राजा प्रजा पर सुखो की वर्षा करनेवाला हे। है मीदधुष्टम=अधिक-से-अधिक सुखो के वर्षक राजन्! याजो ते=तेरा
verses.transliteration: śivena vacasā tvā giriśācchā vadāmasi | yathā na: sarvamijjagadayakṣma sumanā asat
verses.wordMeaning: O Dweller on the Mountain, we salute thee with auspicious hymn; That all, yea, all our people may be healthy and well-satisfied.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Dweller on the Mountain, we salute thee with auspicious hymn; That all, yea, all our people may be healthy and well-satisfied.

verses.sanskrit:
अध्य॑वोचदधिव॒क्ता प्र॑थ॒मो दैव्यो॑ भि॒षक् ।
अहीँ॑श्च॒ सर्वा॑ञ्ज॒म्भय॒न्त्सर्वा॑श्च यातुधा॒न्यो॒ऽध॒राची॒: परा॑ सुव
verses.translation: The Advocate, the first divine Physician, hath defended us. Crushing all serpents, drive away all Yâtudhânis down below.
verses.hindi: -अस्त्र-शस्त्र का प्रयोग शत्रुओं के शातन के लिए हो। अस्त्र-शस्त्रों को प्रजा से दूर ही रखना हे। १९. है शत्रुओं के विजेता सह स््राक्ष=गुप्तचररूपी हजारों ओंखोवाले! गुप्तचरं के द्वारा प्रजा कौ स्थिति या शत्रुओं कौ गतिविधि को भली प्रकार देखनेवाले! शतेषुधे =शत्रु- संहार
verses.transliteration: adhyavocadadhivaktā prathamo daivyo bhiṣak | ahī~śca sarvāñjambhayantsarvāśca yātudhānyo'dharācī: parā suva
verses.wordMeaning: The Advocate, the first divine Physician, hath defended us. Crushing all serpents, drive away all Yâtudhânis down below.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Advocate, the first divine Physician, hath defended us. Crushing all serpents, drive away all Yâtudhânis down below.

verses.sanskrit:
असौ॒ यस्ता॒म्रो अ॑रु॒ण उ॒त ब॒भ्रुः सु॑म॒ङ्गल॑: ।
ये चै॑नᳪ रु॒द्रा अ॒भितो॑ दि॒क्षु श्रि॒ताः स॑हस्र॒शोऽवै॑षा॒ᳪ हेड॑ ईमहे
verses.translation: That most auspicious One whose hue is coppery and red and brown, And those, the Rudras who maintain their station in the regions, who surround him in a thousand bands, of these we deprecate the wrath.
verses.hindi: -१. राजा शत्रु की गतिविधि के ज्ञान के लिए शतशः गुप्तचरं को नियत करता हे, अनन्त अस्त्र-शस्त्रों को सुसज्जित करता है। एवं, राजा शत्रु के लिए भयंकर हे, २. परन्तु प्रजा के लिए निरस्त्र होकर कल्याणकर व शोभन मनवाला हे। १. है राजन्! तेत तेरे धृष्णवे धर्षणशील--शत्नुसंहार मेँ निपुण, पर अनातताय=जिसकौ
verses.transliteration: asau yastāmro aruṇa uta babhruḥ sumaṅgala: | ye caina rudrā abhito dikṣu śritāḥ sahasraśo'vaiṣā heḍa īmahe
verses.wordMeaning: That most auspicious One whose hue is coppery and red and brown, And those, the Rudras who maintain their station in the regions, who surround him in a thousand bands, of these we deprecate the wrath.
verses.commentary: Sense: That most auspicious One whose hue is coppery and red and brown, And those, the Rudras who maintain their station in the regions, who surround him in a thousand bands, of these we deprecate the wrath.

verses.sanskrit: असौ॒ यो॑ऽव॒सर्प॑ति॒ नील॑ग्रीवो॒ विलो॑हितः । उ॒तैनं॑ गो॒पा अ॑दृश्र॒न्नदृ॑श्रन्नुदहा॒र्यः स दृ॒ष्टो मृ॑डयाति नः
verses.translation: May he who glides away, whose neck is azure, and whose hue is red, He whom the herdsmen, whom the girls who carry water have beheld, may he when seen be kind to us.
verses.hindi: हम  शत्रुनाशक , राष्टरक्षक ' राजा का आद्र करे। राष्ट की रक्षा करनेवाला राजा ही प्रस्तुत मन्त्रों का ऋषि "प्रजापति" कहलाने योग्य हे। १. राज्य-व्यवस्था के उत्तम होने पर अपने जीवनों को उत्तम बनाकर हम प्रभु से- प्रार्थना करें है रुद्र=ज्लान देनेवाले ओर. उस ज्ञान के अनुसार आचरण करनेवालों के
verses.transliteration: asau yo'vasarpati nīlagrīvo vilohitaḥ | utainaṃ gopā adṛśrannadṛśrannudahāryaḥ sa dṛṣṭo mṛḍayāti naḥ
verses.wordMeaning: May he who glides away, whose neck is azure, and whose hue is red, He whom the herdsmen, whom the girls who carry water have beheld, may he when seen be kind to us.
verses.commentary: Sense: May he who glides away, whose neck is azure, and whose hue is red, He whom the herdsmen, whom the girls who carry water have beheld, may he when seen be kind to us.

verses.sanskrit: नमो॑ऽस्तु॒ नील॑ग्रीवाय सहस्रा॒क्षाय॑ मी॒ढुषे॑ । अथो॒ ये अ॑स्य॒ सत्वा॑नो॒ऽहं तेभ्यो॑ऽकरं॒ नम॑:
verses.translation: Homage to him the Azure-nested, the thousand-eyed, the bountiful, Yea, and his spirit ministers—to them I offer reverence.
verses.hindi: प्रभु-कृपा से हमारे पुत्रपौत्र दीर्घजीवी होँ। हमारे गवादि पशु सुरक्षित हो। हमारे तेजस्वी युवक असमय में न चले जापं। नमो हिर॑ण्यबाहवे सेनान्ये दिशां च पत॑ये नमो नमो वृक्षेभ्यो हस्किशेभ्यः हरिकेशायोपवीतिने पुष्टानां पत॑ये नम॑: ॥ ९७॥
verses.transliteration: namo'stu nīlagrīvāya sahasrākṣāya mīḍhuṣe | atho ye asya satvāno'haṃ tebhyo'karaṃ nama:
verses.wordMeaning: Homage to him the Azure-nested, the thousand-eyed, the bountiful, Yea, and his spirit ministers—to them I offer reverence.
verses.commentary: Sense: Homage to him the Azure-nested, the thousand-eyed, the bountiful, Yea, and his spirit ministers—to them I offer reverence.

verses.sanskrit: प्रमु॑ञ्च॒ धन्व॑न॒स्त्वमु॒भयो॒रार्त्न्यो॒र्ज्याम् । याश्च॑ ते॒ हस्त॒ इष॑व॒: परा॒ ता भ॑गवो वप
verses.translation: Loosen thy bowstring, loosen it from thy bow's two extremities, And cast away, O Lord Divine, the arrows that are in thy hand.
verses.hindi: ग्राम के मुखिया को शास्त्रानुसार व्यवहार करना है ओर कुलुञ्चों का नाश करने के लिए रक्चा-पुरुषोँ को नियत करना है १. विसृजद्भ्यो नमः=शत्ुओं पर बाणों को छोडते हओं का हम आद्र करते हे (1100०10 11०8९) विद्ध्यद्भ्यः च वः=ओर तुममें से शत्रुओं का वेधन करते हओं के
verses.transliteration: pramuñca dhanvanastvamubhayorārtnyorjyām | yāśca te hasta iṣava: parā tā bhagavo vapa
verses.wordMeaning: Loosen thy bowstring, loosen it from thy bow's two extremities, And cast away, O Lord Divine, the arrows that are in thy hand.
verses.commentary: Sense: Loosen thy bowstring, loosen it from thy bow's two extremities, And cast away, O Lord Divine, the arrows that are in thy hand.

verses.sanskrit: विज्यं॒ धनु॑: कप॒र्दिनो॒ विश॑ल्यो॒ वाण॑वाँ२ उ॒त । अने॑शन्नस्य॒ या इष॑व आ॒भुर॑स्य निषङ्ग॒धिः
verses.translation: Now stringless be Kapardin's bow, his quiver hold no pointed shaft. The shafts he had have perished and the sheath that held his sword is bare.
verses.hindi: हम उन सब रक्षा-पुरुषों का आदर करते हैँ जो कार्य पर उपस्थित है या कार्य के बाद विश्राम की स्थिति में दहे। १. सभाभ्यः =शान्ति व युद्ध के समय देश कौ समृद्धि व रक्षा के विषय में विचार करने के लिए (सह भान्ति) एकत्र हुए विद्वानों का हम नमः= आदर करते है, च=ओौर
verses.transliteration: vijyaṃ dhanu: kapardino viśalyo vāṇavā~2 uta | aneśannasya yā iṣava ābhurasya niṣaṅgadhiḥ
verses.wordMeaning: Now stringless be Kapardin's bow, his quiver hold no pointed shaft. The shafts he had have perished and the sheath that held his sword is bare.
verses.commentary: Sense: Now stringless be Kapardin's bow, his quiver hold no pointed shaft. The shafts he had have perished and the sheath that held his sword is bare.

verses.sanskrit: या ते॑ हे॒तिर्मी॑ढुष्टम॒ हस्ते॑ ब॒भूव॑ ते॒ धनु॑: । तया॒ऽस्मान्वि॒श्वत॒स्त्वम॑य॒क्ष्मया॒ परि॑ भुज
verses.translation: Thy weapon, O Most Bountiful, the bow that resteth in thy hand,— With that, deprived of power to harm, protect thou us on every side.
verses.hindi: राष्ट् की सभाओं, सभापतियों, अश्वो, अश्वपतियों व अन्य शत्रुसंहारक १. गणेभ्यः=एक स्थान पर रहनेवालों ने जो सहकर्मकर्तृ संघ ((०-०९।५८ ७०८९11९5) बना लिये हैँ, उन ' संघों" का नमः=हम आदर करते है च=ओर वः-आप गणपतिभ्यः=इन संघों के अध्यक्षों के लिए नमः=हम आदर देते हे। २. ब्रातेभ्यः-एक
verses.transliteration: yā te hetirmīḍhuṣṭama haste babhūva te dhanu: | tayā'smānviśvatastvamayakṣmayā pari bhuja
verses.wordMeaning: Thy weapon, O Most Bountiful, the bow that resteth in thy hand,— With that, deprived of power to harm, protect thou us on every side.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thy weapon, O Most Bountiful, the bow that resteth in thy hand,— With that, deprived of power to harm, protect thou us on every side.

verses.sanskrit: परि॑ ते॒ धन्व॑नो हे॒तिर॒स्मान्वृ॑णक्तु वि॒श्वत॑: । अथो॒ य इ॑षु॒धिस्तवा॒रे अ॒स्मन्नि धे॑हि॒ तम्
verses.translation: So may the arrow of thy bow, in all directions, pass us by, And in a place remote from us lay thou the quiver that thou hast.
verses.hindi: हम राष्ट में वने हुए गणों व त्रातो को उचित सम्मान दे। मेधावी पुरुष व तेजस्वी पुरुष तथा वसुधैव कुटुम्बकम्" के सिद्धान्त को माननेवाले पुरुष आदरणीय द। नमः सेनाभ्यः सेनानिभ्य॑श्च वो नमो नमो रथिभ्योऽअरथेभ्य॑र्च वो नमो नम॑ः क्षत्तभ्य॑ः संग्रदीतभ्य॑श्च वो नमो नमो महद्धधयोंऽअर्भकेभ्य॑ङ्च वो नम॑: ॥ २६॥
verses.transliteration: pari te dhanvano hetirasmānvṛṇaktu viśvata: | atho ya iṣudhistavāre asmanni dhehi tam
verses.wordMeaning: So may the arrow of thy bow, in all directions, pass us by, And in a place remote from us lay thou the quiver that thou hast.
verses.commentary: Sense: So may the arrow of thy bow, in all directions, pass us by, And in a place remote from us lay thou the quiver that thou hast.

verses.sanskrit: अ॒व॒तत्य॒ धनु॒ष्ट्वᳪ सह॑स्राक्ष॒ शते॑षुधे । नि॒शीर्य॑ श॒ल्यानां॒ मुखा॑ शि॒वो न॑: सु॒मना॑ भव
verses.translation: Having unbent thy how O thou hundred-eyed, hundred-quivered One! And dulled thy pointed arrows' heads, be kind and gracious unto us.
verses.hindi: -हम राष्ट के उन ब्राह्यणो का आदर करते हैँ जो सदा शुभ गुणों में निवास करनेवाले, लान देनेवाले, बुराइयों का संहार करनेवाले, काम- क्रोध को वशीभूत करनेवाले, नम॑: कपर्दिनं च व्युप्तकेशाय च नम॑: सहस्राक्षाय च श॒तध॑न्वने च नमो गिरिशयायं १९. कपर्दिने-(क-पर- द्) सुख की पूर्तिं को देनेवाले ज्लान- प्रचारक ब्राह्मण का
verses.transliteration: avatatya dhanuṣṭva sahasrākṣa śateṣudhe | niśīrya śalyānāṃ mukhā śivo na: sumanā bhava
verses.wordMeaning: Having unbent thy how O thou hundred-eyed, hundred-quivered One! And dulled thy pointed arrows' heads, be kind and gracious unto us.
verses.commentary: Sense: Having unbent thy how O thou hundred-eyed, hundred-quivered One! And dulled thy pointed arrows' heads, be kind and gracious unto us.

verses.sanskrit: नम॑स्त॒ आयु॑धा॒याना॑तताय धृ॒ष्णवे॑ ।  उ॒भाभ्या॑मु॒त ते॒ नमो॑ बा॒हुभ्यां॒ तव॒ धन्व॑ने
verses.translation: To thy fierce weapon, now unstrung, be reverent obeisance paid. Homage be paid to both thine arms, and to thy bow be reverence!
verses.hindi: आयु की दुष्टि से विविध स्थितियों में स्थित, राष्ट के अङ्कभूत सब व्यक्तियों का हम आदर करते हेै। ९. आशवे अश्नुते कर्मसु" कर्मो में व्याप्त होनेवाले के लिए च=ओर अजिराय=' अज गतिक्षेपणयो ' क्रियाशीलता के द्वारा विष्नों को दूर फैकनेवाले को नमः=हम आदर देते देँ।
verses.transliteration: namasta āyudhāyānātatāya dhṛṣṇave | ubhābhyāmuta te namo bāhubhyāṃ tava dhanvane
verses.wordMeaning: To thy fierce weapon, now unstrung, be reverent obeisance paid. Homage be paid to both thine arms, and to thy bow be reverence!
verses.commentary: Sense: To thy fierce weapon, now unstrung, be reverent obeisance paid. Homage be paid to both thine arms, and to thy bow be reverence!

verses.sanskrit:
मा नो॑ म॒हान्त॑मु॒त मा नो॑ अर्भ॒कं मा न॒ उक्ष॑न्तमु॒त मा न॑ उक्षि॒तम् ।
मा नो॑ वधीः पि॒तरं॒ मोत मा॒तरं॒ मा न॑: प्रि॒यास्त॒न्वो॒ रुद्र रीरिषः
verses.translation: Do thou no injury to great or small of us, harm not the growing boy, harm not the full grown man. Slay not a sire among us, slay no mother here, and to our own dear bodies, Rudra! do no harm.
verses.hindi: सदा राष्ट्-हित करे उदेश्य से विविध संस्थानों में कार्यो में रत पुरुषों को १. ज्येष्ठाय अत्यन्त प्रशस्य ज्येष्ठ के लिए- आयुष्य के दृष्टिकोण से सबसे बडे के लिए नमः=हम नमस्कार करते हैं, च=ओर कनिष्ठाय आयुष्य के दृष्टिकोण से छोटे के लिए युवा व अल्प के लिए नमस्कार हो। पूर्वजाय=सबसे प्रथम उत्पन्न हए के लिए
verses.transliteration: mā no mahāntamuta mā no arbhakaṃ mā na ukṣantamuta mā na ukṣitam | mā no vadhīḥ pitaraṃ mota mātaraṃ mā na: priyāstanvo rudra rīriṣaḥ
verses.wordMeaning: Do thou no injury to great or small of us, harm not the growing boy, harm not the full grown man. Slay not a sire among us, slay no mother here, and to our own dear bodies, Rudra! do no harm.
verses.commentary: Sense: Do thou no injury to great or small of us, harm not the growing boy, harm not the full grown man. Slay not a sire among us, slay no mother here, and to our own dear bodies, Rudra! do no harm.

verses.sanskrit:
मा न॑स्तो॒के तन॑ये॒ मा न॒ आयु॑षि॒ मा नो॒ गोषु॒ मा नो॒ अश्वे॑षु रीरिषः ।
मा नो॑ वी॒रान् रु॑द्र भा॒मिनो॑ वधीर्ह॒विष्म॑न्त॒: सद॒मित् त्वा॑ हवामहे
verses.translation: Harm us not in our seed or in our progeny, harm us not in our life or in our cows or steeds. Slay not our heroes in the fury of their wrath. We with oblations ever call on only thee.
verses.hindi: -हम उस राजा का आदर करें जो वनों व कक्ष-प्रदेशों का भी उत्तम रक्षक हे, जो प्रजा कौ बात सुनता है ओर शिकायतों को दूर करता है। शीघ्रगामी सेनावाला ओर शत्रुओं का संहार करनेवाला है। श्रुतसेनाय॑ च नमो दुन्दुभ्याय चाहनन्याय च ॥ ३५॥
verses.transliteration: mā nastoke tanaye mā na āyuṣi mā no goṣu mā no aśveṣu rīriṣaḥ | mā no vīrān rudra bhāmino vadhīrhaviṣmanta: sadamit tvā havāmahe
verses.wordMeaning: Harm us not in our seed or in our progeny, harm us not in our life or in our cows or steeds. Slay not our heroes in the fury of their wrath. We with oblations ever call on only thee.
verses.commentary: Sense: Harm us not in our seed or in our progeny, harm us not in our life or in our cows or steeds. Slay not our heroes in the fury of their wrath. We with oblations ever call on only thee.

verses.sanskrit: नमो॒ हिर॑ण्यबाहवे सेना॒न्ये॒ दि॒शां च॒ पत॑ये॒ नमो॒ नमो॑ वृ॒क्षेभ्यो॒ हरि॑केशेभ्यः पशू॒नां पत॑ये॒ नमो॒ नम॑: श॒ष्पिञ्ज॑राय॒ त्विषी॑मते पथी॒नां पत॑ये॒ नमो॒ नमो॒ हरि॑केशायोपवी॒तिने॑ पु॒ष्टानां॒ पत॑ये॒ नम॑:
verses.translation: Homage to the golden-armed leader of hosts, lord of the
verses.hindi: राष्ट् कौ रक्षा करनेवाले क्षत्रियो का हमें उचित मान अवश्य करना चाहिए। १. धृष्णवे च=बाह्य शत्रुओं तथा अपने काम-क्रोधादि अन्तन्शत्नुओं का धर्षण करनेवाले ( धृष्णोतीति एवं शीलः) राजा के लिए नमः=हम आदर का भाव धारण करते है, च=ओर प्रमृशाय (प्रमृशति विचारयति) सदा विचारशील राजा के लिए, कामादि से
verses.transliteration: namo hiraṇyabāhave senānye diśāṃ ca pataye namo namo vṛkṣebhyo harikeśebhyaḥ paśūnāṃ pataye namo nama: śaṣpiñjarāya tviṣīmate pathīnāṃ pataye namo namo harikeśāyopavītine puṣṭānāṃ pataye nama:
verses.wordMeaning: Homage to the golden-armed leader of hosts, lord of the
verses.commentary: Sense: Homage to the golden-armed leader of hosts, lord of the

verses.sanskrit: नमो॑ बभ्लु॒शाय॑ व्या॒धिने ऽन्ना॑नां॒ पत॑ये॒ नमो॒ नमो॑ भ॒वस्य॑ हेत्यै॒ जग॑तां॒ पत॑ये॒ नमो॒ नमो॑ रु॒द्राया॑तता॒यिने॒ क्षेत्रा॑णां॒ पत॑ये॒ नमो॒ नम॑: सू॒तायाह॑न्त्यै॒  वना॑नां॒ पत॑ये॒ नम॑:
verses.translation: Homage to the brown-hued piercer, to the Lord of food be homage. Homage to Bhava's weapon, homage to the Lord of moving things! homage to Rudra whose bow is bent to slay, to the Lord of fields homage, homage to the charioteer who injures, none, to the Lord of forests be homage.
verses.hindi: राष्ट् के उत्थान में भिन्न-भित्न कार्यो मे लगे हए सब व्यक्तियों का- विशेषतः रोगों को दूर करके प्रजा के जीवन को सुखी बनानेवाले ओषध-विज्ञान के पण्डित व प्रयोग में कुशल वैद्यं का हम आदर करते हैँ। च नमो हृन््रे च हनीयसे च नमो वृक्षेभ्यो हस्किशेभ्यो नमस्ताराय ॥॥४०॥
verses.transliteration: namo babhluśāya vyādhine 'nnānāṃ pataye namo namo bhavasya hetyai jagatāṃ pataye namo namo rudrāyātatāyine kṣetrāṇāṃ pataye namo nama: sūtāyāhantyai vanānāṃ pataye nama:
verses.wordMeaning: Homage to the brown-hued piercer, to the Lord of food be homage. Homage to Bhava's weapon, homage to the Lord of moving things! homage to Rudra whose bow is bent to slay, to the Lord of fields homage, homage to the charioteer who injures, none, to the Lord of forests be homage.
verses.commentary: Sense: Homage to the brown-hued piercer, to the Lord of food be homage. Homage to Bhava's weapon, homage to the Lord of moving things! homage to Rudra whose bow is bent to slay, to the Lord of fields homage, homage to the charioteer who injures, none, to the Lord of forests be homage.

verses.sanskrit: नमो॒ रोहि॑ताय स्थ॒पत॑ये वृ॒क्षाणां॒ पत॑ये॒ नमो॒ नमो॑ भुव॒न्तये॑ वारिवस्कृ॒तायौष॑धीनां॒ पत॑ये॒ नमो॒ नमो॑ म॒न्त्रिणे॑ वाणि॒जाय॒ कक्षा॑णां॒ पत॑ये॒ नमो॒ नम॑ उ॒च्चैर्घो॑षायाक्र॒न्दय॑ते पत्ती॒नां पत॑ये॒ नम॑:
verses.translation: Homage to the red architect, to the Lord of trees homage! Homage to him who stretched out the earth, to him who gives relief be homage. Homage to the Lord of Plants, homage to the prudent merchant! Homage to the Lord of bushes, to the shouting Lord of foot-soldiers who makes foes weep be homage.
verses.hindi: राजा 'द्रापि-अन्धसस्पति-दरिद्र व नीललोहित" हो ओर उसकी व्यवस्था इतनी उत्तम हो कि किसी को मार्गों मे भय न हो, असफलता्पँ न हों ओर रोग न फले ९. रुद्राय = (रुत् ज्ञानं राति, रुतं दुःखं द्रावयति) ज्ञान देनेवाले-सारे राष्ट में ज्ञान का प्रसार करनेवाले ओर प्रजा के दुःखों को दूर करनेवाले राजा के लिए, २. तवसे-महान् व
verses.transliteration: namo rohitāya sthapataye vṛkṣāṇāṃ pataye namo namo bhuvantaye vārivaskṛtāyauṣadhīnāṃ pataye namo namo mantriṇe vāṇijāya kakṣāṇāṃ pataye namo nama uccairghoṣāyākrandayate pattīnāṃ pataye nama:
verses.wordMeaning: Homage to the red architect, to the Lord of trees homage! Homage to him who stretched out the earth, to him who gives relief be homage. Homage to the Lord of Plants, homage to the prudent merchant! Homage to the Lord of bushes,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Homage to the red architect, to the Lord of trees homage! Homage to him who stretched out the earth, to him who gives relief be homage. Homage to the Lord of Plants, homage to the prudent merchant! Homage to the Lord of bushes,…

verses.sanskrit: नम॑: कृत्स्नाय॒तया॒ धाव॑ते॒ सत्व॑नां॒ पत॑ये॒ नमो॒ नम॒: सह॑मानाय निव्या॒धिन॑ आव्या॒धिनी॑नां॒ पत॑ये॒ नमो॒ नमो॑ निष॒ङ्गिणे॑ ककु॒भाय॑ स्ते॒नानां॒ पत॑ये॒ नमो॒ नमो॑ निचे॒रवे॑ परिच॒रायार॑ण्यानां॒ पत॑ये॒ नम॑:
verses.translation: Homage to the runner at full stretch, to the Lord of ministering spirits, homage! Homage to the conquering, piercing Lord of assailing bands, homage to the towering sword-bearer, to the Lord of thieves homage! Homage to the gliding robber, to the roamer, to the Lord of forests homage!
verses.hindi: शतशः शस्त्रो के प्रयोग में निपुण राजा शत्रुओं पर ही शस्त्र-प्रयोग करता हे, उसके शस्त्र प्रजापीड्न का कारण नहीं बनते। १. राष्ट में राजपुरुषो कौ नियुक्ति की कोई निश्चित संख्या नहीं हे। राष्ट छोटा होगा तो राजपुरुषो की संख्या भी थोडी होगी। राष्ट के बडे होने पर यह संख्या भी बडी हो जाती
verses.transliteration: nama: kṛtsnāyatayā dhāvate satvanāṃ pataye namo nama: sahamānāya nivyādhina āvyādhinīnāṃ pataye namo namo niṣaṅgiṇe kakubhāya stenānāṃ pataye namo namo nicerave paricarāyāraṇyānāṃ pataye nama:
verses.wordMeaning: Homage to the runner at full stretch, to the Lord of ministering spirits, homage! Homage to the conquering, piercing Lord of assailing bands, homage to the towering sword-bearer, to the Lord of thieves homage! Homage to the gliding robber, to the roamer,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Homage to the runner at full stretch, to the Lord of ministering spirits, homage! Homage to the conquering, piercing Lord of assailing bands, homage to the towering sword-bearer, to the Lord of thieves homage! Homage to the gliding robber, to the roamer,…

verses.sanskrit: नमो॒ वञ्च॑ते परि॒वञ्च॑ते स्तायू॒नां पत॑ये॒ नमो॒ नमो॑ निष॒ङ्गिण॑ इषुधि॒मते॒ तस्क॑राणां॒ पत॑ये॒ नमो॒ नम॑: सृका॒यिभ्यो॒ जिघा॑ᳪसद्भ्यो मुष्ण॒तां पत॑ये॒ नमो॒ नमो॑ऽसि॒मद्भ्यो॒ नक्त॒ञ्चर॑द्भ्यो विकृ॒न्तानां॒ पत॑ये॒ नम॑:
verses.translation: Homage to the cheat, to the arch-deceiver, to the Lord of stealers homage! Homage to the wearer of sword and quiver, to the Lord of robbers homage! Homage to the boltarmed homicides, to the Lord of pilferers homage! Homage to the sword-bearers, to those who roam at night, to the Lord of plunderers homage!
verses.hindi: राजपुरुषो को (क) पूर्णं स्वस्थ होना चाहिए, (ख) ज्ञान की ज्योतिवाला होना चाहिए तथा (ग) उनका ध्येय प्रजा के जीवन को सुखी करना हो (कपर्दिनः)। १. ये-जो पथां पथिरक्षय: = मार्गो के रक्षक है, लौकिक व वैदिक मार्गो का अपने जीवन में पालन करते है तथा सुशासन से प्रजाओं के जीवन में भी मर्यदाओं को लुप्त
verses.transliteration: namo vañcate parivañcate stāyūnāṃ pataye namo namo niṣaṅgiṇa iṣudhimate taskarāṇāṃ pataye namo nama: sṛkāyibhyo jighāsadbhyo muṣṇatāṃ pataye namo namo'simadbhyo naktañcaradbhyo vikṛntānāṃ pataye nama:
verses.wordMeaning: Homage to the cheat, to the arch-deceiver, to the Lord of stealers homage! Homage to the wearer of sword and quiver, to the Lord of robbers homage! Homage to the boltarmed homicides, to the Lord of pilferers homage! Homage to the sword-bearers, to those who roam at night,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Homage to the cheat, to the arch-deceiver, to the Lord of stealers homage! Homage to the wearer of sword and quiver, to the Lord of robbers homage! Homage to the boltarmed homicides, to the Lord of pilferers homage! Homage to the sword-bearers, to those who roam at night,…

verses.sanskrit: नम॑ उष्णी॒षिणे॑ गिरिच॒राय॑ कुलु॒ञ्चानां॒ पत॑ये॒ नमो॒ नम॑ इषु॒मद्भ्यो॑ धन्वा॒यिभ्य॑श्च वो॒ नमो॒ नम॑ आतन्वा॒नेभ्य॑: प्रति॒दधा॑नेभ्यश्च वो॒ नमो॒ नम॑ आ॒यच्छ॒द्भ्यो ऽस्य॑द्भ्यश्च वो॒ नम॑:
verses.translation: To the turban-wearing haunter of mountains, Lord of land-grabbers homage! Homage to you who bear arrows and to you who carry bows. Homage to you with bent bows, and to you who adjust your arrows, to you who draw the bow and to you who shoot be homage!
verses.hindi: राजपुरुष १. मार्ग-रक्षक (मर्यादा-पालक) हों, २. अन्न के धारण करनेवाले-अन्न की कमी न होने देनेवाले हों ३. प्राणपन से राष्टरोत्नति में लगे हए हो। ये तीर्थानि प्रचरन्ति सृकाहस्ता निषद्धिण॑ः । १. ये=जो तीर्थानि अविद्यादि से तरानेवाले ( तारयन्ति-द०) आचार्यो का प्रचरन्ति
