verses.transliteration: nama uṣṇīṣiṇe giricarāya kuluñcānāṃ pataye namo nama iṣumadbhyo dhanvāyibhyaśca vo namo nama ātanvānebhya: pratidadhānebhyaśca vo namo nama āyacchadbhyo 'syadbhyaśca vo nama:
verses.wordMeaning: To the turban-wearing haunter of mountains, Lord of land-grabbers homage! Homage to you who bear arrows and to you who carry bows. Homage to you with bent bows, and to you who adjust your arrows, to you who draw the bow and to you who shoot be homage!
verses.commentary: Sense: To the turban-wearing haunter of mountains, Lord of land-grabbers homage! Homage to you who bear arrows and to you who carry bows. Homage to you with bent bows, and to you who adjust your arrows, to you who draw the bow and to you who shoot be homage!

verses.sanskrit: नमो॑ विसृ॒जद्भ्यो॒ विध्य॑द्भ्यश्च वो॒ नमो॒ नम॑: स्व॒पद्भ्यो॒ जाग्र॑द्भ्यश्च वो॒ नमो॒ नम॒: शया॑नेभ्य॒ आसी॑नेभ्यश्च वो॒ नमो॒ नम॒स्तिष्ठ॑द्भ्यो॒ धाव॑द्भ्यश्च वो॒ नम॑:
verses.translation: Homage to you who let fly and to you who pierce, homage to you who sleep and to you who wake, homage to you who lie and to you who sit, homage to you who stand and to you who run.
verses.hindi: -राष्ट् के रक्षापुरुष (क) आचार्य-चरणों मे उपस्थित होकर अपने कर्तव्य को सदा समञ्लनेवाले हों, विद्या-वयोवृद्धों के ये उपासक हों। (ख) रक्षा के लिए अस्त्रो खान-पान के विषय में प्रेरणा ८ स्वास्थ्य विभाग) १. ये=जो अन्नेषु अन्नो करे विषयों में विविध्यन्ति=(विघ्-० व्वा, ९०४८ )
verses.transliteration: namo visṛjadbhyo vidhyadbhyaśca vo namo nama: svapadbhyo jāgradbhyaśca vo namo nama: śayānebhya āsīnebhyaśca vo namo namastiṣṭhadbhyo dhāvadbhyaśca vo nama:
verses.wordMeaning: Homage to you who let fly and to you who pierce, homage to you who sleep and to you who wake, homage to you who lie and to you who sit, homage to you who stand and to you who run.
verses.commentary: Sense: Homage to you who let fly and to you who pierce, homage to you who sleep and to you who wake, homage to you who lie and to you who sit, homage to you who stand and to you who run.

verses.sanskrit: नम॑: स॒भाभ्य॑: स॒भाप॑तिभ्यश्च वो॒ नमो॒ नमोऽश्वे॒भ्यो ऽश्व॑पतिभ्यश्च वो॒ नमो॒ नम॑ आव्या॒धिनी॑भ्यो वि॒विध्य॑न्तीभ्यश्च वो॒ नमो॒ नम॒ उग॑णाभ्यस्तृᳪह॒तीभ्य॑श्च वो॒ नम॑:
verses.translation: Homage to assemblies and to you lords of assemblies, homage to horses and to you masters of horses, homage to you hosts that wound and pierce, to you destructive armies with excellent bands be homage.
verses.hindi: राजपुरुषो को प्रजा के अन्दर "खान-पान" के नियमों का भी विशेषरूप से अनुशासन करना हे, जिससे सब प्रजाँ नीरोग होकर सुखी होः सकरं। १. ये=जो एतावन्तः च=इतने, जिनका कि ऊपर मन्त्रो में उल्लेख किया गया हे, च=अथवा भूयांसः= ओर भी जिनका स्पष्ट उल्लेख नहीं हुआ- वे सबके सब रुद्राः =प्रजा-
verses.transliteration: nama: sabhābhya: sabhāpatibhyaśca vo namo namo'śvebhyo 'śvapatibhyaśca vo namo nama āvyādhinībhyo vividhyantībhyaśca vo namo nama ugaṇābhyastṛhatībhyaśca vo nama:
verses.wordMeaning: Homage to assemblies and to you lords of assemblies, homage to horses and to you masters of horses, homage to you hosts that wound and pierce, to you destructive armies with excellent bands be homage.
verses.commentary: Sense: Homage to assemblies and to you lords of assemblies, homage to horses and to you masters of horses, homage to you hosts that wound and pierce, to you destructive armies with excellent bands be homage.

verses.sanskrit: नमो॑ ग॒णेभ्यो॑ ग॒णप॑तिभ्यश्च वो॒ नमो॒ नमो॒ व्राते॑भ्यो॒ व्रात॑पतिभ्यश्च वो॒ नमो॒ नमो॒ गृत्से॑भ्यो॒ गृत्स॑पतिभ्यश्च वो॒ नमो॒ नमो॒ विरू॑पेभ्यो वि॒श्वरू॑पेभ्यश्च वो॒ नम॑:
verses.translation: Homage to the troops and to you lords of troops be homage. Homage to the companies and to you lords of companies, homage. Homage to sharpers and to you lords of sharpers, homage. Homage to you the deformed, and to you who wear all forms, homage!
verses.hindi: वे राज्याधिकारी, जो प्रजा के मस्तिष्क को उज्ज्वल बनाने के लिए, ज्ञानवर्षण के लिए नियुक्त हुए है, उन राज्याधिकारियों का हम आदर करते है। १. रुद्रेभ्यः नमः अस्तुचरुद्रो के लिए, राजा कौ ओर से नियुक्त (रोरूयमाणो द्रवति) प्रभु का नाम लेकर वासनाओं पर आक्रमण करनेवाले पुरुषों के लिए नमस्कार हो।
verses.transliteration: namo gaṇebhyo gaṇapatibhyaśca vo namo namo vrātebhyo vrātapatibhyaśca vo namo namo gṛtsebhyo gṛtsapatibhyaśca vo namo namo virūpebhyo viśvarūpebhyaśca vo nama:
verses.wordMeaning: Homage to the troops and to you lords of troops be homage. Homage to the companies and to you lords of companies, homage. Homage to sharpers and to you lords of sharpers, homage. Homage to you the deformed, and to you who wear all forms, homage!
verses.commentary: Sense: Homage to the troops and to you lords of troops be homage. Homage to the companies and to you lords of companies, homage. Homage to sharpers and to you lords of sharpers, homage. Homage to you the deformed, and to you who wear all forms, homage!

verses.sanskrit: नम॒: सेना॑भ्यः सेना॒निभ्य॑श्च वो॒ नमो॒ नमो॑ र॒थिभ्यो॑ अर॒तेभ्य॑श्च वो॒ नमो॒ नम॑: क्ष॒त्तृभ्य॑: संग्रही॒तृभ्य॑श्च वो॒ नमो॒ नमो॑ म॒हद्भ्यो॑ अर्भ॒केभ्य॑श्च वो॒ नम॑:
verses.translation: Homage to armies and to you the leaders of armies, homage. Homage to you car-borne and to you who are carless, homage. Homage to the charioteers and to you drivers of horses, homage. Homage to you the great and to you the small, homage.
verses.hindi: उन राजाधिकारियों को, जो प्रजा को वायु की भोति निरन्तर क्रियाशीलता का उपदेश करके पवित्र-हदय बनाने मे लगे हैँ, हम आदर देते हेँ। ९. रुद्रेभ्यः नमः अस्तु-उन राज्याधिकारियों के लिए हम नमस्कार करते हे, ये जो पुथिव्याम्=( पृथिवी शरीरम्) लोगों के शरीरो के विषयों में नियुक्त हुए है, जिनका कार्य
verses.transliteration: nama: senābhyaḥ senānibhyaśca vo namo namo rathibhyo aratebhyaśca vo namo nama: kṣattṛbhya: saṃgrahītṛbhyaśca vo namo namo mahadbhyo arbhakebhyaśca vo nama:
verses.wordMeaning: Homage to armies and to you the leaders of armies, homage. Homage to you car-borne and to you who are carless, homage. Homage to the charioteers and to you drivers of horses, homage. Homage to you the great and to you the small, homage.
verses.commentary: Sense: Homage to armies and to you the leaders of armies, homage. Homage to you car-borne and to you who are carless, homage. Homage to the charioteers and to you drivers of horses, homage. Homage to you the great and to you the small, homage.

verses.sanskrit: नम॒स्तक्ष॑भ्यो रथका॒रेभ्य॑श्च वो॒ नमो॒ नम॒: कुला॑लेभ्यः कु॒र्मारे॑भ्यश्च वो॒ नमो॒ नमो॑ निषा॒देभ्य॑: पु॒ञ्जिष्टे॑भ्यश्च वो॒ नमो॒ नम॑: श्व॒निभ्यो॑ मृग॒युभ्य॑श्च वो॒ नम॑:
verses.translation: Homage to you carpenters, and to you chariot-makers homage. Homage to you potters and to you blacksmiths, homage. Homage to you Nishâdas and to you Puñjishthas, homage. Homage to you dog-leaders, and to you hunters, homage.
verses.hindi: -उन राज्याधिकारियों का हम आदर करे जो अन्न के विषय में उचित व्यवस्थां करते हुए हमारे शरीरो को स्वस्थ व विस्तृत शक्तिवाला बनाने का प्रयल करते है। सूचना-इस रुद्राध्याय को अन्न के उचित सेवन" के उपदेश के साथ समाप्त किया गया है। इस अन्न-सेवन के विषय से सप्तदशाध्याय का प्रारम्भ करते है
verses.transliteration: namastakṣabhyo rathakārebhyaśca vo namo nama: kulālebhyaḥ kurmārebhyaśca vo namo namo niṣādebhya: puñjiṣṭebhyaśca vo namo nama: śvanibhyo mṛgayubhyaśca vo nama:
verses.wordMeaning: Homage to you carpenters, and to you chariot-makers homage. Homage to you potters and to you blacksmiths, homage. Homage to you Nishâdas and to you Puñjishthas, homage. Homage to you dog-leaders, and to you hunters, homage.
verses.commentary: Sense: Homage to you carpenters, and to you chariot-makers homage. Homage to you potters and to you blacksmiths, homage. Homage to you Nishâdas and to you Puñjishthas, homage. Homage to you dog-leaders, and to you hunters, homage.

verses.sanskrit: नम॒: श्वभ्य॒: श्वप॑तिभ्यश्च वो॒ नमो॒ नमो॑ भ॒वाय॑ च रु॒द्राय॑ च॒ नम॑: श॒र्वाय॑ च पशु॒पत॑ये च॒ नमो॒ नील॑ग्रीवाय च शिति॒कण्ठा॑य च
verses.translation: Homage to dogs, and to you masters of dogs, homage. Homage to Bhava, and to Rudra homage, homage to Sarva and to Pasupati, and to Nîlagrîva and Sitikantha, homage.
verses.hindi: प्रभु से दिये जानेवाले ज्ञान के लिए, उस ज्ञान द्वारा दी जानेवाली प्रेरणाओं ओर उन प्रेरणाओं से सिद्ध होनेवाले अभ्युदय व निःश्रेयस के लिए हम नतमस्तक होते है। याते रुद्र शिवा तनूरघोराऽपांपकाशिनी । १. गत मन्त्र के ज्ञान का ही उल्लेख करते हुए कहते है कि है रुद्र-ज्ञान देकर
verses.transliteration: nama: śvabhya: śvapatibhyaśca vo namo namo bhavāya ca rudrāya ca nama: śarvāya ca paśupataye ca namo nīlagrīvāya ca śitikaṇṭhāya ca
verses.wordMeaning: Homage to dogs, and to you masters of dogs, homage. Homage to Bhava, and to Rudra homage, homage to Sarva and to Pasupati, and to Nîlagrîva and Sitikantha, homage.
verses.commentary: Sense: Homage to dogs, and to you masters of dogs, homage. Homage to Bhava, and to Rudra homage, homage to Sarva and to Pasupati, and to Nîlagrîva and Sitikantha, homage.

verses.sanskrit:
नम॑: कप॒र्दिने॑ च॒ व्यु॒प्तकेशाय च॒ नम॑: सहस्रा॒क्षाय॑ च श॒तध॑न्वने च॒ नमो॑ गिरिश॒याय॑ च शिपिवि॒ष्टाय॑ च॒ नमो॑ मी॒ढुष्ट॑माय॒ चेषु॑मते
च
verses.translation: Homage to him with braided hair and to him with shaven hair, homage! homage to the thousand-eyed and to him with a hundred bows, homage! To the mountain-haunter and to Sipivishta, homage! To the most bountiful, armed with arrows, homage!
verses.hindi: उस प्रभु का दिया हुआ ज्ञान शिव, अघोर व पुण्य का प्रकाशक! है ओर शन्तम=अधिक-से-अधिक शान्ति देनेवाला है। इस ज्ञान से ही प्रभु हमारा पालन करते है। शिवां गिरित्र तां कुरु मा हिसीः पुरुषं जग॑त् ॥३॥ ९. है गिरिशन्त वेदवाणी में स्थित होकर इस ज्लानवाणी के द्वारा शान्ति का विस्तार
verses.transliteration: nama: kapardine ca vyuptakeśāya ca nama: sahasrākṣāya ca śatadhanvane ca namo giriśayāya ca śipiviṣṭāya ca namo mīḍhuṣṭamāya ceṣumate ca
verses.wordMeaning: Homage to him with braided hair and to him with shaven hair, homage! homage to the thousand-eyed and to him with a hundred bows, homage! To the mountain-haunter and to Sipivishta, homage! To the most bountiful, armed with arrows, homage!
verses.commentary: Sense: Homage to him with braided hair and to him with shaven hair, homage! homage to the thousand-eyed and to him with a hundred bows, homage! To the mountain-haunter and to Sipivishta, homage! To the most bountiful, armed with arrows, homage!

verses.sanskrit: नमो॑ ह्र॒स्वाय॑ च वाम॒नाय॑ च॒ नमो॑ बृह॒ते च॒ वर्षी॑यसे च॒ नमो॑ वृ॒द्धाय॑ च स॒वृधे॑ च॒ नमोऽग्र्या॑य च प्रथ॒माय॑ च
verses.translation: Homage to the short, and to the dwarf, homage, homage to the great and to the adult, homage! Homage to the full-grown and to the growing, to the foremost and to the first be homage.
verses.hindi: हे प्रभो! आप वेदवाणी के ब्रोडकारस्टिङ्ख स्टेशन है, भै उसका ग्रहण करनेवाला रेडियो सेट बनं। उस प्रेरणा को ग्रहण करके अपना कल्याण सिद्ध कर सर्कूः। षोडशोऽध्यायः ५३० यजुर्केदभाष्यम् ९. है गिरिश वेदवाणी मेँ निवास करनेवाले प्रभो! सारी वाणियाँ आपका ही वर्णन
verses.transliteration: namo hrasvāya ca vāmanāya ca namo bṛhate ca varṣīyase ca namo vṛddhāya ca savṛdhe ca namo'gryāya ca prathamāya ca
verses.wordMeaning: Homage to the short, and to the dwarf, homage, homage to the great and to the adult, homage! Homage to the full-grown and to the growing, to the foremost and to the first be homage.
verses.commentary: Sense: Homage to the short, and to the dwarf, homage, homage to the great and to the adult, homage! Homage to the full-grown and to the growing, to the foremost and to the first be homage.

verses.sanskrit: नम॑ आ॒शवे॑ चाजि॒राय॑ च॒ नम॒: शीघ्र्या॑य च॒ शीभ्या॑य च॒ नम॒ ऊर्म्या॑य चावस्व॒न्या॒य च॒ नमो॑ नादे॒याय॑ च॒ द्वीप्या॑य च
verses.translation: Homage to him in woods and to him in bushes, homage! Homage to him as sound and to him as echo, homage! Homage to him with swift armies and to him with swift chariots, homage! Homage to the hero, and to him who rends asunder be homage.
verses.hindi: करती हुई इनके क्रोध का पात्र न बने। १. गत मन्त्र के राजा का ही वर्णन करते हुए कहते ठँ कि असौ वह यः-जो फोडखोऽध्यायः ५३२ यजु्वेदभाष्यम् अवसर्पति-अपने उच्च सिंहासन से नीचे (अव) आता हे, आसन पर ही नहीं जमा बैठा
verses.transliteration: nama āśave cājirāya ca nama: śīghryāya ca śībhyāya ca nama ūrmyāya cāvasvanyāya ca namo nādeyāya ca dvīpyāya ca
verses.wordMeaning: Homage to him in woods and to him in bushes, homage! Homage to him as sound and to him as echo, homage! Homage to him with swift armies and to him with swift chariots, homage! Homage to the hero, and to him who rends asunder be homage.
verses.commentary: Sense: Homage to him in woods and to him in bushes, homage! Homage to him as sound and to him as echo, homage! Homage to him with swift armies and to him with swift chariots, homage! Homage to the hero, and to him who rends asunder be homage.

verses.sanskrit: नमो॑ ज्ये॒ष्ठाय॑ च कनि॒ष्ठाय॑ च॒ नम॑: पूर्व॒जाय॑ चापर॒जाय॑ च॒ नमो॑ मध्य॒माय॑ चापग॒ल्भाय॑ च॒ नमो॑ जघ॒न्या॒य च बु॒ध्न्या॒य च
verses.translation: Homage to the eldest and to the youngest, to the first-born and to the last-born, homage! Homage to the middle-most and to the immature, to the lowest and to him who is in the depth, be homage!
verses.hindi: राजा प्रजा में विचरता है, खूब ज्ञानी व मधुर स्वरवाला है, खूब उन्नत व विशिष्ट रुधिरवाला तथा तेजस्वी हे। छोटे-से-छोटे व्यक्ति के लिए अभिगम्य है। वह सबकी शिकायतों को दूर करके उन्हे सुखी करता हे। अथो येऽअ॑स्य सत्वानो ऽहं तेभ्यो ऽकरं नम॑: ॥८॥
verses.transliteration: namo jyeṣṭhāya ca kaniṣṭhāya ca nama: pūrvajāya cāparajāya ca namo madhyamāya cāpagalbhāya ca namo jaghanyāya ca budhnyāya ca
verses.wordMeaning: Homage to the eldest and to the youngest, to the first-born and to the last-born, homage! Homage to the middle-most and to the immature, to the lowest and to him who is in the depth, be homage!
verses.commentary: Sense: Homage to the eldest and to the youngest, to the first-born and to the last-born, homage! Homage to the middle-most and to the immature, to the lowest and to him who is in the depth, be homage!

verses.sanskrit: नम॒: सोभ्या॑य च प्रतिस॒र्या॒य च॒ नमो॒ याम्या॑य च॒ क्षेम्या॑य च॒ नम॒: श्लोक्या॑य चावसा॒न्या॒य च॒ नम॑ उर्व॒र्या॒य च॒ खल्या॑य च
verses.translation: Homage to Sobhya and to the dweller in the magic amulet, homage! Homage to him who is allied to Yama, to him who prospers be homage! Homage to the famous and to the endmost, to him of the sown corn-land and to him of the threshing-floor be homage.
verses.hindi: राजा चार चक्षु होता है। प्रजा की स्थिति को उनके द्वारा जानकर वह यजुरवदभाष्यम् ५३३ कोडखोऽ ध्यायः उचित व्यवस्था से सुखों का वर्षक होता है। व्यवस्था के लिए नियत उसके कर्मचारियों का भी हमें उचित आद्र करना चाहिप।
verses.transliteration: nama: sobhyāya ca pratisaryāya ca namo yāmyāya ca kṣemyāya ca nama: ślokyāya cāvasānyāya ca nama urvaryāya ca khalyāya ca
verses.wordMeaning: Homage to Sobhya and to the dweller in the magic amulet, homage! Homage to him who is allied to Yama, to him who prospers be homage! Homage to the famous and to the endmost, to him of the sown corn-land and to him of the threshing-floor be homage.
verses.commentary: Sense: Homage to Sobhya and to the dweller in the magic amulet, homage! Homage to him who is allied to Yama, to him who prospers be homage! Homage to the famous and to the endmost, to him of the sown corn-land and to him of the threshing-floor be homage.

verses.sanskrit: नमो॒ वन्या॑य च॒ कक्ष्या॑य च॒ नम॑: श्र॒वाय॑ च प्रतिश्र॒वाय॑ च॒ नम॑ आ॒शुषे॑णाय चा॒शुर॑थाय च॒ नम॒: शूरा॑य चावभे॒दिने॑ च
verses.translation: Homage to him who wears a helmet, and to him who wears a cuirass, homage!
verses.hindi: ' मीदुष्टम' वह राजा है जो हाथ में धनुष लिये हुए चारों ओर से होनेवाले आक्रमणों से राष्ट को सुरक्षित रखता (करता) हे। १. है राजन्! ते=तेरा धन्वनः हेतिः=धनुष- सम्बन्धी नाशक बाण अस्मान् हमें विश्वतः सब ओर से परिवृणक्तु=शच्रु-संकट से मुक्त करे (परिवर्जयतु-उ०), अर्थात् सब प्रान्तभाग
verses.transliteration: namo vanyāya ca kakṣyāya ca nama: śravāya ca pratiśravāya ca nama āśuṣeṇāya cāśurathāya ca nama: śūrāya cāvabhedine ca
verses.wordMeaning: Homage to him who wears a helmet, and to him who wears a cuirass, homage!
verses.commentary: Sense: Homage to him who wears a helmet, and to him who wears a cuirass, homage!

verses.sanskrit: नमो॑ बि॒ल्मिने॑ च कव॒चिने॑ च॒ नमो॑ व॒र्मिणे॑ च वरू॒थिने॑ च॒ नम॑: श्रु॒ताय॑ च श्रुतसे॒नाय॑ च॒ नमो॑ दुन्दु॒भ्या॒य चाहन॒न्या॒य च
verses.translation: To him who wears mail and defensive armour, homage! To the renowned one and to him whose army is renowned be homage, to him who is in drums and to him who makes himself known by beating them.
verses.hindi: प्रभु हम सबका रक्षण करनेवाले है। हमे भी चाहिए कि युद्ध उपस्थित होने पर भी युद्ध में भाग न लेनेवालों का हम संहार न करे। मा न॑स्तोके तन॑ये मा नञऽआयुंषि मा नो गोषु मा नोऽअश्वेषु रीरिषः । ९. नः = हमारे तोके=पुत्र के विषय में मा रीरिषः=हिसा मत कीजिए। तनये वंश
verses.transliteration: namo bilmine ca kavacine ca namo varmiṇe ca varūthine ca nama: śrutāya ca śrutasenāya ca namo dundubhyāya cāhananyāya ca
verses.wordMeaning: To him who wears mail and defensive armour, homage! To the renowned one and to him whose army is renowned be homage, to him who is in drums and to him who makes himself known by beating them.
verses.commentary: Sense: To him who wears mail and defensive armour, homage! To the renowned one and to him whose army is renowned be homage, to him who is in drums and to him who makes himself known by beating them.

verses.sanskrit: नमो॑ धृ॒ष्णवे॑ च प्रमृ॒शाय॑ च॒ नमो॑ निष॒ङ्गिणे॑ चेषुधि॒मते॑ च॒ नम॑स्ती॒क्ष्णेष॑वे चायु॒धिने॑ च॒ नम॑: स्वायु॒धाय॑ च सु॒धन्व॑ने च
verses.translation: Homage to the bold one and to the prudent, homage to him who carries sword and quiver, homage to him who hath keen arrows and is armed with weapons, homage to him who hath good weapons and a good bow.
verses.hindi: हम राष्ट के मन्त्र-वर्णित अधिकारियों के उचित आदर से राष्टोत्नति में ९. बभ्लुशाय ( बभ्लुषु राज्यधारकेषु शेते कर्मसु-द०)=सदा राज्यधारक कर्मो में निवास करनेवाले , व्याधिने (विध्यति-उ० ) =शत्नुओं का वेधन करनेवाले के लिए, राष्ट-रक्षा के लिए शत्रुओं का संहार करनेवाले का नमः=हम आदर करते है। शत्रु-संहार के साथ
verses.transliteration: namo dhṛṣṇave ca pramṛśāya ca namo niṣaṅgiṇe ceṣudhimate ca namastīkṣṇeṣave cāyudhine ca nama: svāyudhāya ca sudhanvane ca
verses.wordMeaning: Homage to the bold one and to the prudent, homage to him who carries sword and quiver, homage to him who hath keen arrows and is armed with weapons, homage to him who hath good weapons and a good bow.
verses.commentary: Sense: Homage to the bold one and to the prudent, homage to him who carries sword and quiver, homage to him who hath keen arrows and is armed with weapons, homage to him who hath good weapons and a good bow.

verses.sanskrit: नम॒: स्रुत्या॑य च॒ पथ्या॑य च॒ नम॒: काट्या॑य च॒ नीप्या॑य च॒ नम॒: कुल्या॑य च सर॒स्या॒य च॒ नमो॑ नादे॒याय॑ च वैश॒न्ताय॑ च
verses.translation: Homage to him who dwells on paths and roads, homage to him who dwells in rugged spots and on the skirts of mountains, homage to him who dwells in water courses and lakes, homage to him who dwells in rivers and mores.
verses.hindi: हम राष्ट्-रक्षक पुरुषों का उचित आदर करे। १. रोहिताय ( वृद्धिकराय-द०) राष्ट की सम्पत्ति को बदानेवाले स्थपतये=गृहादि के बनानेवाले शिल्पियों का नमः=हम आदर करते है। इसी शिल्प की उन्नति के लिए वृक्षाणां पतये=-शिल्पोपयोगी काष्ठं को प्राप्त करानेवाले वृक्षों के रक्षकों का नमः=हम
verses.transliteration: nama: srutyāya ca pathyāya ca nama: kāṭyāya ca nīpyāya ca nama: kulyāya ca sarasyāya ca namo nādeyāya ca vaiśantāya ca
verses.wordMeaning: Homage to him who dwells on paths and roads, homage to him who dwells in rugged spots and on the skirts of mountains, homage to him who dwells in water courses and lakes, homage to him who dwells in rivers and mores.
verses.commentary: Sense: Homage to him who dwells on paths and roads, homage to him who dwells in rugged spots and on the skirts of mountains, homage to him who dwells in water courses and lakes, homage to him who dwells in rivers and mores.

verses.sanskrit: नम॒: कूप्या॑य चाव॒ट्या॑य च॒ नमो॒ वीध्र्या॑य चात॒प्या॒य च॒ नमो॒ मेघ्या॑य च च विद्यु॒त्या॒य च॒ नमो॒ वर्ष्या॑य चाव॒र्ष्याय॑ च
verses.translation: Homage to him who dwells in wells and pits, homage to him who dwells in bright sky and sunlight. Homage to him who dwells in cloud and lightning, homage to him who dwells in rain and to him who dwells in fair weather.
verses.hindi: राष्ट में "शिल्पी, कृषक या व्यापारी" ये सब उचित आदर पार्णँ तथा प्रान्तभाग पर रक्षा के लिए नियत पत्तियों के पति का भी हमें आदर करना हे। १. गत मन्त्र की समाप्ति ' प्रान्तभाग पर नियुक्त रक्षको के आद्र! से हुई थी। उसी प्रसङ्ख को आगे कहते है कि कृत्स्नायतया-पूर्णरूप से (कृत्स्न) आयत रखेचे हए आकर्णपूर्ण
verses.transliteration: nama: kūpyāya cāvaṭyāya ca namo vīdhryāya cātapyāya ca namo meghyāya ca ca vidyutyāya ca namo varṣyāya cāvarṣyāya ca
verses.wordMeaning: Homage to him who dwells in wells and pits, homage to him who dwells in bright sky and sunlight. Homage to him who dwells in cloud and lightning, homage to him who dwells in rain and to him who dwells in fair weather.
verses.commentary: Sense: Homage to him who dwells in wells and pits, homage to him who dwells in bright sky and sunlight. Homage to him who dwells in cloud and lightning, homage to him who dwells in rain and to him who dwells in fair weather.

verses.sanskrit: नमो॒ वात्या॑य च॒ रेष्म्या॑य च॒ नमो॑ वास्त॒व्या॒य च वास्तु॒पाय॑ च॒ नम॒: सोमा॑य च रु॒द्राय॑ च॒ नम॑स्ता॒म्राय॑ चारु॒णाय॑ च
verses.translation: Homage to him who dwells in wind and to him who dwells in tempest, homage to the dweller in houses and to the house-protector. Homage to Soma and to Rudra, homage to the copper-coloured and to the ruddy One.
verses.hindi: चोरों व शत्रुओं से बचाकर सब वनस्थो की रक्षा करनेवाले राजपुरुषो को नमो वञ्च॑ते परिवञ्चते स्तायूनां पत॑ ये नमो नमो निषद्धिण॑ऽ इषुधिमते तस्कराणां पत॑ये नमो नम॑: सृकायिभ्यो जिघांश््सद्धयो मुष्णतां पत॑ये नमो नमो।ऽसिमद्धयो ९. (क) वञ्चते=गति करनेवाले के लिए ओर परिवजञ्चते=राष्ट मे सर्वत्र विचरनेवाले
verses.transliteration: namo vātyāya ca reṣmyāya ca namo vāstavyāya ca vāstupāya ca nama: somāya ca rudrāya ca namastāmrāya cāruṇāya ca
verses.wordMeaning: Homage to him who dwells in wind and to him who dwells in tempest, homage to the dweller in houses and to the house-protector. Homage to Soma and to Rudra, homage to the copper-coloured and to the ruddy One.
verses.commentary: Sense: Homage to him who dwells in wind and to him who dwells in tempest, homage to the dweller in houses and to the house-protector. Homage to Soma and to Rudra, homage to the copper-coloured and to the ruddy One.

verses.sanskrit: नम॑: श॒ङ्गवे॑ च पशु॒पत॑ये च॒ नम॑ उ॒ग्राय॑ च भी॒माय॑ च॒ नमो॑ऽग्रेव॒धाय॑ च दूरेव॒धाय॑ च॒ नमो॑ ह॒न्त्रे च॒ हनी॑यसे च॒ नमो॑ वृ॒क्षेभ्यो॒ हरि॑केशेभ्यो॒ नम॑स्ता॒राय॑
verses.translation: Homage to the giver of weal, and to Pasupati, homage to the fierce and to the terrific. Homage to him who slays in front and to him who slays at a distance, homage to the slayer and to the frequent slayer, homage to the green-tressed trees, homage to the deliverer.
verses.hindi: रक्षापुरुषों का कार्य है कि वे १. घर में ही रहनेवाले ओर चोरी कर लेनैवाले नौकरों से, २. लुटेरों से, ३. खेत आदि से धान का अपहरण करनेवालों से तथा, ठ. गठकतरों व छेदन-भेदन करनेवालों से प्रजा-जनों की रक्षा करें। यचुर्वेदभाव्यम् ५४१ षोडशोऽध्यायः
verses.transliteration: nama: śaṅgave ca paśupataye ca nama ugrāya ca bhīmāya ca namo'grevadhāya ca dūrevadhāya ca namo hantre ca hanīyase ca namo vṛkṣebhyo harikeśebhyo namastārāya
verses.wordMeaning: Homage to the giver of weal, and to Pasupati, homage to the fierce and to the terrific. Homage to him who slays in front and to him who slays at a distance, homage to the slayer and to the frequent slayer, homage to the green-tressed trees, homage to the deliverer.
verses.commentary: Sense: Homage to the giver of weal, and to Pasupati, homage to the fierce and to the terrific. Homage to him who slays in front and to him who slays at a distance, homage to the slayer and to the frequent slayer, homage to the green-tressed trees, homage to the deliverer.

verses.sanskrit: नम॑: शम्भ॒वाय॑ च मयोभ॒वाय॑ च॒ नम॑: शङ्क॒राय॑ च मयस्क॒राय॑ च॒ नम॑: शि॒वाय॑ च शि॒वत॑राय च
verses.translation: Homage to the source of happiness and to the source of delight, homage to the causer of happiness and to the causer of delight, homage to the auspicious, homage to the most auspicious.
verses.hindi: राष्ट्-रक्षा करनेवाली सेनाओं, सेनापतियो, रथियों, पैदलों, अश्वाध्यक्षों, अश्वचालकों तथा बडे-ोटे सभी का प्रजाजन आदर करे। तक्षा-रथकार ( शिल्प-जातिर्योँ ) नमस्तक्षभ्यो रथकारेभ्य॑श्च वो नमो नमः कुलांलेभ्यः कमरिभ्यश्च वो नमो
verses.transliteration: nama: śambhavāya ca mayobhavāya ca nama: śaṅkarāya ca mayaskarāya ca nama: śivāya ca śivatarāya ca
verses.wordMeaning: Homage to the source of happiness and to the source of delight, homage to the causer of happiness and to the causer of delight, homage to the auspicious, homage to the most auspicious.
verses.commentary: Sense: Homage to the source of happiness and to the source of delight, homage to the causer of happiness and to the causer of delight, homage to the auspicious, homage to the most auspicious.

verses.sanskrit: नम॒: पार्या॑य चावा॒र्या॒य च॒ नम॑: प्र॒तर॑णाय चो॒त्तर॑णाय च॒ नम॒स्तीर्थ्या॑य च॒ कूल्या॑य च॒ नम॒: शष्प्या॑य च॒ फेन्या॑य च
verses.translation: Homage to him who is beyond and to him who is on this side, homage to him who crosses over and to him who crosses back. Homage to him who is in fords and on river banks, homage to him who is in tender grass and in foam.
verses.hindi: राष्ट के सब शिल्पकारों व शिकारियों का भी हम उचित मान करे। १. राष्ट में शिकार व पहरे आदि में उपयोगी, चोरी आदि के अन्वेषण में पुलिस की मदद करनेवाले शवभ्यः=कुत्तों को नमः=अन्नादि द्वारा उचितरूप से आदृत करते हें, च ओर वः=आपके इन वपतिभ्यः = कुत्तो (12०९ ५५००७) को शिक्षित करनेवालोँ को
verses.transliteration: nama: pāryāya cāvāryāya ca nama: prataraṇāya cottaraṇāya ca namastīrthyāya ca kūlyāya ca nama: śaṣpyāya ca phenyāya ca
verses.wordMeaning: Homage to him who is beyond and to him who is on this side, homage to him who crosses over and to him who crosses back. Homage to him who is in fords and on river banks, homage to him who is in tender grass and in foam.
verses.commentary: Sense: Homage to him who is beyond and to him who is on this side, homage to him who crosses over and to him who crosses back. Homage to him who is in fords and on river banks, homage to him who is in tender grass and in foam.

verses.sanskrit: नम॑: सिक॒त्या॒य च प्रवा॒ह्या॒य च॒ नम॑: किᳪशि॒लाय॑ च क्षय॒णाय॑ च॒ नम॑: कप॒र्दिने॑ च पुल॒स्तये॑ च॒ नम॑ इरि॒ण्या॒य च प्रप॒थ्या॒य च
verses.translation: Homage to him who is in sand and to him who is in running water, homage to him who is on pebbly ground and to him who is where still water stands. Homage to him who wears braided hair and to him whose hair is smooth. Homage to him who is in deserts and to him who is on broad roads.
verses.hindi: ज्ञानी ब्राह्मणों का तथा रक्षक क्षत्रियो का सदा मान करना चाहिपए्। नमो हस्वाय॑ च वामनाय च नमो बृहते च वर्षीयसे च नमो वृद्धाय च १. उस हस्वाय=छोरी उगम्रवाले के लिए च परन्तु वामनाय=' वामं प्रशस्तं विज्ञानं विद्यते यस्य-द० ' प्रशस्त विज्ञानवाले का नमः=हम आद्र करते है अथवा चोरी उम्रवाले
verses.transliteration: nama: sikatyāya ca pravāhyāya ca nama: kiśilāya ca kṣayaṇāya ca nama: kapardine ca pulastaye ca nama iriṇyāya ca prapathyāya ca
verses.wordMeaning: Homage to him who is in sand and to him who is in running water, homage to him who is on pebbly ground and to him who is where still water stands. Homage to him who wears braided hair and to him whose hair is smooth.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Homage to him who is in sand and to him who is in running water, homage to him who is on pebbly ground and to him who is where still water stands. Homage to him who wears braided hair and to him whose hair is smooth.…

verses.sanskrit: नमो॒ व्रज्या॑य च॒ गोष्ठ्या॑य च॒ नम॒स्तल्प्या॑य च॒ गेह्या॑य च॒ नमो॑ हृद॒य्या॒य च निवे॒ष्प्या॒य च॒ नम॒: काट्या॑य च गह्वरे॒ष्ठाय॑ च
verses.translation: Homage to him who is in herds of cattle and to him who is in cow-pens, homage to him who is on beds and to him who is in houses. Homage to him who is in hearts, and to him who is in whirlpools, homage to him who is in wells and to him who is in abysses.
verses.hindi: राष्ट मे उत्पन्न छोटे बड तथा छोटे-बडे कुलो मे उत्पन्नो के लिए नमस्कार १. सोभ्याय=( उभाभ्यां सहितः सोभः तत्र साधुः) परा तथा अपरा-विद्या से युक्त पुरुषों मे उत्तम ब्राह्मण के लिए नमः=हम नतमस्तक होते है। च=फिर प्रतिसर्यायप्रत्येक उत्तम कर्म में गतिशील पुरुषों मेँ उत्तम ब्राह्मण के लिए (प्रति+सर्+य) हम आद्रवान् होते
verses.transliteration: namo vrajyāya ca goṣṭhyāya ca namastalpyāya ca gehyāya ca namo hṛdayyāya ca niveṣpyāya ca nama: kāṭyāya ca gahvareṣṭhāya ca
verses.wordMeaning: Homage to him who is in herds of cattle and to him who is in cow-pens, homage to him who is on beds and to him who is in houses. Homage to him who is in hearts, and to him who is in whirlpools, homage to him who is in wells and to him who is in abysses.
verses.commentary: Sense: Homage to him who is in herds of cattle and to him who is in cow-pens, homage to him who is on beds and to him who is in houses. Homage to him who is in hearts, and to him who is in whirlpools, homage to him who is in wells and to him who is in abysses.

verses.sanskrit: नम॒: शुष्क्या॑य च हरि॒त्या॒य च॒ नम॑: पाᳪस॒व्या॒य च रज॒स्या॒य च॒ नमो॒ लोप्या॑य चोल॒प्या॒य च॒ नम॒ ऊर्व्या॑य च॒ सूर्व्या॑य च
verses.translation: Homage to him who is in dry things and to him who is in green things. Homage to him who is in dust and to him who is in vapour. Homage to him who is in inaccessible places, homage to him who is in creeping plants, homage to him who is in the earth and to him who is in good soil.
verses.hindi: हम सोभ्य व प्रतिसर्य ब्राह्मणों का आदर करे। याम्य-क्षेम्य क्षत्रियो का, श्लोक्य व अवसान्य वैश्यो का तथा उर्वर्य व खल्य शूद्रो का भी हम उचित आदर करे। जीविका के लिए किये गये किन्दीं भी शास्त्रीय कर्मो से कोई छोटा-बड़ा नहीं होता। १. वन्याय=वन- प्रदेश में भी रक्षा की व्यवस्था करनेवाले राजा का नमः=हम आदर
verses.transliteration: nama: śuṣkyāya ca harityāya ca nama: pāsavyāya ca rajasyāya ca namo lopyāya colapyāya ca nama ūrvyāya ca sūrvyāya ca
verses.wordMeaning: Homage to him who is in dry things and to him who is in green things. Homage to him who is in dust and to him who is in vapour. Homage to him who is in inaccessible places, homage to him who is in creeping plants, homage to him who is in the earth and to him who is in good soil.
verses.commentary: Sense: Homage to him who is in dry things and to him who is in green things. Homage to him who is in dust and to him who is in vapour. Homage to him who is in inaccessible places, homage to him who is in creeping plants, homage to him who is in the earth and to him who is in good soil.

verses.sanskrit: नम॑: प॒र्णाय॑ च पर्णश॒दाय॑ च॒ नम॑ उद्गु॒रमा॑णाय चाभिघ्न॒ते च॒ नम॑ आखिद॒ते च॑ प्रखिद॒ते च॒ नम॑ इषु॒कृद्भ्यो॑ धनु॒ष्कृद्भ्य॑श्च वो॒ नमो॒ नमो॑ वः किरि॒केभ्यो॑ दे॒वाना॒ᳪ हृद॑येभ्यो॒ नमो॑ विचिन्व॒त्केभ्यो॒ नमो॑ विक्षिण॒त्केभ्यो॒ नम॑ आनिर्ह॒तेभ्य॑:
verses.translation: Homage to him who is in leaves and to him who is in the falling of leaves. Homage to him with the threatening voice and to him who slays, homage to him who troubles and to him who afflicts. Homage to you arrow-makers and to you bow-makers, homage to you sprinklers, to the hearts of the Gods. Homage to the discerners, homage to the destroyers; homage to the indestructible.
verses.hindi: विविध शस्त्रास्त्रं से सुसन्जित सैनिकों का हमें सदा सम्मान करना चाहिए ओर इनके मुखिया शत्रुधर्षक , विचारशील राजा को भी आदर के भाव से देखना चाहिए। नमः स्रुत्याय च पथ्याय च नमः कार्याय च नीप्याय च॒ नमः कुल्यांय च १. स्वुत्याय च नमः=स्रोतों- नाले आदि में नियुक्त पुरुष. का ठम आदर करते हं
verses.transliteration: nama: parṇāya ca parṇaśadāya ca nama udguramāṇāya cābhighnate ca nama ākhidate ca prakhidate ca nama iṣukṛdbhyo dhanuṣkṛdbhyaśca vo namo namo vaḥ kirikebhyo devānā hṛdayebhyo namo vicinvatkebhyo namo vikṣiṇatkebhyo nama ānirhatebhya:
verses.wordMeaning: Homage to him who is in leaves and to him who is in the falling of leaves. Homage to him with the threatening voice and to him who slays, homage to him who troubles and to him who afflicts. Homage to you arrow-makers and to you bow-makers, homage to you sprinklers,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Homage to him who is in leaves and to him who is in the falling of leaves. Homage to him with the threatening voice and to him who slays, homage to him who troubles and to him who afflicts. Homage to you arrow-makers and to you bow-makers, homage to you sprinklers,…

verses.sanskrit:
द्रापे॒ अन्ध॑सस्पते॒ दरि॑द्र॒ नील॑लोहित ।
आ॒सां प्र॒जाना॑मे॒षां प॑शू॒नां मा भे॒र्मा रो॒ङ्मो च॑ न॒: किंच॒नाम॑मत्
verses.translation: Pursuer, Lord of Soma juice, thou cleaver, coloured blue and red, Cleave not, destroy not one of these our children, nor of these our beasts, let nothing that is ours be sick.
verses.hindi: राष्ट मेः भिन्न-भित्न स्थानों में नियुक्त जलाध्यक्षों का उचित आदर करना चाहिए। इनके कार्य की शुद्धि पर ही राष्ट में सारे क्षेत्रों की सिंचाई निर्भर है, अतः अन्नोत्पादन मे इनका स्थान बडा महत्त्वपूर्णं हे। १. कूप्याय कूओं से सिंचाई करने योग्य देश के अध्यक्ष के लिए हम नमः नमस्कार
verses.transliteration: drāpe andhasaspate daridra nīlalohita | āsāṃ prajānāmeṣāṃ paśūnāṃ mā bhermā roṅmo ca na: kiṃcanāmamat
verses.wordMeaning: Pursuer, Lord of Soma juice, thou cleaver, coloured blue and red, Cleave not, destroy not one of these our children, nor of these our beasts, let nothing that is ours be sick.
verses.commentary: Sense: Pursuer, Lord of Soma juice, thou cleaver, coloured blue and red, Cleave not, destroy not one of these our children, nor of these our beasts, let nothing that is ours be sick.

verses.sanskrit:
इ॒मा रु॒द्राय॑ त॒वसे॑ कप॒र्दिने॑ क्ष॒यद्वी॑राय॒ प्र भ॑रामहे म॒तीः ।
यथा॒ शमस॑द् द्वि॒पदे॒ चतु॑ष्पदे॒ विश्वं॑ पु॒ष्टं ग्रामे॑ अ॒स्मिन्न॑नातु॒रम्
verses.translation: To the strong Rudra bring we these our songs of praise, to him the Lord of Heroes, with the braided hair, That it be well with all our cattle and our men, that in this village all be healthy and well-fed.
verses.hindi: विविध देशों मे नियुक्त राजपुरुषो के लिए हम उचित मान दे। १. वात्याय च नमः=वायु-विद्या मेँ कुशल अतएव वायु के रुख कौ सूचना देने के कार्य में नियुक्त मेटेरौलौजिकल विभाग के अध्यक्ष के लिए हम आदर देते हें, च=ओौर रेष्म्याय= (रिष हिंसायाम्) रेष्म में होनेवाले=डिस्टृक्शन के कार्य में नियुक्त स्लम क्लियरैन्स
verses.transliteration: imā rudrāya tavase kapardine kṣayadvīrāya pra bharāmahe matīḥ | yathā śamasad dvipade catuṣpade viśvaṃ puṣṭaṃ grāme asminnanāturam
verses.wordMeaning: To the strong Rudra bring we these our songs of praise, to him the Lord of Heroes, with the braided hair, That it be well with all our cattle and our men, that in this village all be healthy and well-fed.
verses.commentary: Sense: To the strong Rudra bring we these our songs of praise, to him the Lord of Heroes, with the braided hair, That it be well with all our cattle and our men, that in this village all be healthy and well-fed.

verses.sanskrit: या ते॑ रुद्र शि॒वा त॒नूः शि॒वा वि॒श्वाहा॑ भेष॒जी । शि॒वा रु॒तस्य॑ भेष॒जी तया॑ नो मृड जी॒वसे॑
verses.translation: Rudra, with that auspicious form of thine which healeth every day, Auspicious, healer of disease, be kind to us that we may live.
verses.hindi: राष्ट मे “शं, मयः व शिव'=शान्ति, सुख व कल्याण करनेवालों का हम कर्ल्याय च नमः शष्प्याय च फेन्याय च ॥४२॥ १. पार्याय च नमः (परायां साधु) पराविद्या, अर्थात् ब्रह्मविद्याओं में निपुण आचार्य का हम आदर करते हैँ, च=ओर अवार्याय=(भवरायां साधु) अपराविद्या, अर्थात् प्रकृतिविद्या
verses.transliteration: yā te rudra śivā tanūḥ śivā viśvāhā bheṣajī | śivā rutasya bheṣajī tayā no mṛḍa jīvase
verses.wordMeaning: Rudra, with that auspicious form of thine which healeth every day, Auspicious, healer of disease, be kind to us that we may live.
verses.commentary: Sense: Rudra, with that auspicious form of thine which healeth every day, Auspicious, healer of disease, be kind to us that we may live.

verses.sanskrit:
परि॑ नो रु॒द्रस्य॑ हे॒तिर्वृ॑णक्तु॒ परि॑ त्वे॒षस्य॑ दुर्म॒तिर॑घा॒योः ।
अव॑ स्थि॒रा म॒घव॑द्भ्यस्तनुष्व॒ मीढ्व॑स्तो॒काय॒ तन॑याय मृड
verses.translation: May Rudra's missile turn aside and spare us, the great wrath of the impetuous One avoid us. Turn, Bounteous God, thy strong bow from our princes, and be thou gracious to our seed and offspring. I Most bounteous, most auspicious, be auspicious, well inclined to us. On some remotest tree lay down thy weapon. and clad in robe of skin approach, bearing thy bow come hitherward.
verses.hindi: पारोवर्यवित् आचार्यो का हम सदा मान करनेवाले बनें। हम भी इनकौ भोति वनस्पति व दुग्ध पर ही जीवन-निर्वाह करनेवाले हो। तरृषिः--परमेष्टी प्रजापतिर्वा देवाः। देवता-रुद्राः। छन्द:-जगती। स्वरः- निषादः।। १. सिकत्याय च नमः (सिकतासु भवः) बालू (रेता) के विज्ञान को जाननेवाले
verses.transliteration: pari no rudrasya hetirvṛṇaktu pari tveṣasya durmatiraghāyoḥ | ava sthirā maghavadbhyastanuṣva mīḍhvastokāya tanayāya mṛḍa
verses.wordMeaning: May Rudra's missile turn aside and spare us, the great wrath of the impetuous One avoid us. Turn, Bounteous God, thy strong bow from our princes, and be thou gracious to our seed and offspring. I Most bounteous, most auspicious, be auspicious, well inclined to us.…
verses.commentary: Sense: May Rudra's missile turn aside and spare us, the great wrath of the impetuous One avoid us. Turn, Bounteous God, thy strong bow from our princes, and be thou gracious to our seed and offspring. I Most bounteous, most auspicious, be auspicious, well inclined to us.…

verses.sanskrit:
मीढु॑ष्टम॒ शिव॑तम शि॒वो न॑: सु॒मना॑ भव ।
प॒र॒मे वृ॒क्ष आयु॑धं नि॒धाय॒ कृत्तिं॒ वसा॑न॒ आ च॑र॒ पिना॑कं॒ बिभ्र॒दा ग॑हि
verses.translation: O Wound averter, purple-hued, to thee be homage, holy Lord!
verses.hindi: राष्ट मे गडरिये से लेकर गम्भीर जलाशयो के निर्माता आदि मन्त्र. वर्णित सभी कर्मकरो का हम आदर करें, उन्हे तुच्छ न समञ्ञे। तऋषिः- परमेष्ठी प्रजापतिर्वा देवाः। देवता-रुद्राः। छन्दः-निचृदार्षीत्रिष्टुप्। स्वरः धैवतः।। १- शुष्क्याय च .नमः= शुष्क पदार्थो (सूखे मेवों) के व्यापारी के लिए आदर हो,
verses.transliteration: mīḍhuṣṭama śivatama śivo na: sumanā bhava | parame vṛkṣa āyudhaṃ nidhāya kṛttiṃ vasāna ā cara pinākaṃ bibhradā gahi
verses.wordMeaning: O Wound averter, purple-hued, to thee be homage, holy Lord!
verses.commentary: Sense: O Wound averter, purple-hued, to thee be homage, holy Lord!

verses.sanskrit: विकि॑रिद्र॒ विलो॑हित॒ नम॑स्ते अस्तु भगवः । यास्ते॑ स॒हस्र॑ᳪ हे॒तयो॒ऽन्यम॒स्मन्नि व॑पन्तु॒ ताः
verses.translation: May all those thousand darts of thine strike dead another one than us.
verses.hindi: राष्ट के सब व्यापारियों व कृषकों का हम आदर करे। ओषधि- विक्रेता व काष्ठवाहक च॑ प्रखिदते च॒ नम॑ऽइषुकृ्धयो। धनुष्कृद्धय॑श्च वो नमो नमो वः किरिकेभ्यो दे वानाऽहद॑येभ्यो नमो विचिन्वत्केभ्यो नमो! विक्षिणत्केभ्यो नम॑ऽ-
verses.transliteration: vikiridra vilohita namaste astu bhagavaḥ | yāste sahasra hetayo'nyamasmanni vapantu tāḥ
verses.wordMeaning: May all those thousand darts of thine strike dead another one than us.
verses.commentary: Sense: May all those thousand darts of thine strike dead another one than us.

verses.sanskrit: स॒हस्रा॑णि सहस्र॒शो बा॒ह्वोस्तव॑ हे॒तय॑: । तासा॒मीशा॑नो भगवः परा॒चीना॒ मुखा॑ कृधि
verses.translation: Thousands of thousands are the shafts, the missiles ready in thy hands: Thou holy Lord, who hast the power, turn thou their points away from us.
verses.hindi: ओषधि- विक्रेताओं , क्ेत्र-रक्षकों, शस्त्र-निर्माताओं तथा विविध शिल्पियों ओर निर्मल हदयवाले, आत्म-निरीक्षण के अभ्यासियों का हम आदर करते है। ९. गत मन्त्र में राष्ट के सब अधिकारियों व अन्य कर्मकरों का उल्लेख करके कहते है कि द्रापे (द्रा कुत्सायां गतौ , तस्याः पात्ति) कुत्सित गति से सबकी रक्षा करनेवाले!
verses.transliteration: sahasrāṇi sahasraśo bāhvostava hetaya: | tāsāmīśāno bhagavaḥ parācīnā mukhā kṛdhi
verses.wordMeaning: Thousands of thousands are the shafts, the missiles ready in thy hands: Thou holy Lord, who hast the power, turn thou their points away from us.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thousands of thousands are the shafts, the missiles ready in thy hands: Thou holy Lord, who hast the power, turn thou their points away from us.

verses.sanskrit: असं॑ख्याता स॒हस्रा॑णि॒ ये रु॒द्रा अधि॒ भूम्या॑म् । तेषा॑ᳪ सहस्रयोज॒नेऽव॒ धन्वा॑नि तन्मसि
verses.translation: Innumerable thousands are the Rudras on the face of earth: Of all these Rudras we unbend the bows a thousand leagues away.
verses.hindi: राजा “रुद्र, तवस्, कपदीं व क्षयद्वीर ' हो। उसकी उत्तम व्यवस्था से सव शिवा रुतस्य॑ भेषजी तयां नो मृड जीवसे ।॥॥४९॥ १. है रुद्र=राष्ट् के दुःखों को दूर करनेवाले राजन्! याजो ते तेरी शिवा=कल्याणकर तनूः = विस्तृत राजनीति है (द्०) वह शिवा=सचमुच कल्याणकर हो। २. विश्वाहा=सदा
verses.transliteration: asaṃkhyātā sahasrāṇi ye rudrā adhi bhūmyām | teṣā sahasrayojane'va dhanvāni tanmasi
verses.wordMeaning: Innumerable thousands are the Rudras on the face of earth: Of all these Rudras we unbend the bows a thousand leagues away.
verses.commentary: Sense: Innumerable thousands are the Rudras on the face of earth: Of all these Rudras we unbend the bows a thousand leagues away.

verses.sanskrit: अ॒स्मिन् म॑ह॒त्य॒र्ण॒वे ऽन्तरि॑क्षे भ॒वा अधि॑ । तेषा॑ᳪ सहस्रयोज॒नेऽव॒ धन्वा॑नि तन्मसि
verses.translation: Bhavas there are above us in this mighty billowy sea of air, Of all of these do we unbend, etc.
verses.hindi: राजा की राजनीति एेसी सुन्दर हो कि उससे ९. प्रजा के कष्ट दूर हों। ३. वह कल्याणकर होती हुई सब रोगों को दूर करनेवाली हो। २. उससे प्रजा के जीवन अव॑ स्थिरा मघव॑द्धयस्तनुष्व मीढ्वस्तोकाय तन॑याय मृड ॥५०॥ १. नः=हमें रुद्रस्य =अन्यायकारियों को रुलानेवाले (रोदयति) राजा का हेतिः = अस्त्र
verses.transliteration: asmin mahatyarṇave 'ntarikṣe bhavā adhi | teṣā sahasrayojane'va dhanvāni tanmasi
verses.wordMeaning: Bhavas there are above us in this mighty billowy sea of air, Of all of these do we unbend, etc.
verses.commentary: Sense: Bhavas there are above us in this mighty billowy sea of air, Of all of these do we unbend, etc.

verses.sanskrit: नील॑ग्रीवाः शिति॒कण्ठा॒ दिव॑ᳪ रु॒द्रा उप॑श्रिताः । तेषा॑ᳪ सहस्रयोज॒नेऽव॒ धन्वा॑नि तन्मसि
verses.translation: Rudras are dwelling in the sky, whose necks are blue, whose throats are white: Of these do we unbend the bows a thousand leagues away from us.
verses.hindi: राजा राष्ट मे एेसी उत्तम दण्ड-व्यवस्था करे कि दुर्जन सज्जनो को तद्ध न कर सके। यज्ञशीलो पर दण्डपात न हो। १. मीदुष्टम=अतिशयेन मीद्वान्= सर्वाधिक सुखों का सेचन करनेवाले शिवतम = अधिक-से-अधिक कल्याण करनेवाले राजन्! नः=हमारे लिए शिवः=कल्याण करनेवाले
verses.transliteration: nīlagrīvāḥ śitikaṇṭhā diva rudrā upaśritāḥ | teṣā sahasrayojane'va dhanvāni tanmasi
verses.wordMeaning: Rudras are dwelling in the sky, whose necks are blue, whose throats are white: Of these do we unbend the bows a thousand leagues away from us.
verses.commentary: Sense: Rudras are dwelling in the sky, whose necks are blue, whose throats are white: Of these do we unbend the bows a thousand leagues away from us.

verses.sanskrit: नील॑ग्रीवाः शिति॒कण्ठा॑: श॒र्वा अ॒धः क्ष॑माच॒राः । तेषा॑ᳪ सहस्रयोज॒नेऽव॒ धन्वा॑नि तन्मसि
verses.translation: Sarvas haunt realms beneath the earth—their necks are blue, their throats are white: Of these, etc.
verses.hindi: राजा ने प्रजा पर सुखों कौ वर्षा करनी है-प्रजा का कल्याण सिद्ध करना है। शत्रुओं पर शस्त्र-प्रयोग द्वारा उनका छेदन करते हुए प्रजा के रक्षण के लिए धनुर्धर १. विकिरिद्र-( विकिरन् इषून् द्रावयति इति-उ०) बाणो कौ विशिष्ट वर्षा के द्वारा शत्रुओं को भगानेवाले राजन्! २. विलोहित विशिष्टरूप से प्रवृद्ध शक्तियोंवाले व विशिष्ट
verses.transliteration: nīlagrīvāḥ śitikaṇṭhā: śarvā adhaḥ kṣamācarāḥ | teṣā sahasrayojane'va dhanvāni tanmasi
verses.wordMeaning: Sarvas haunt realms beneath the earth—their necks are blue, their throats are white: Of these, etc.
verses.commentary: Sense: Sarvas haunt realms beneath the earth—their necks are blue, their throats are white: Of these, etc.

verses.sanskrit: ये वृ॒क्षेषु॑ श॒ष्पिञ्ज॑रा॒ नील॑ग्रीवा॒ विलो॑हिताः । तेषा॑ᳪ सहस्रयोज॒नेऽव॒ धन्वा॑नि तन्मसि
verses.translation: These, green like young grass, in the trees, with azure necks and purple hue, Of those, etc.
verses.hindi: राजा विचार करके दण्ड को दण्ड्यो पर ही डाले, जिससे वह दण्ड सारी प्रजाओं के रञ्जन का कारण बने। ९. है भगवः समग्र एेश्वर्य-सम्पत्न राजन्! तव बाह्लोः= आपकी भुजाओं मे सहस्राणि = हजारों प्रकार के सहस््रशः=संख्या मे हस्रारों हेतयः=हनन-साधन शस्त्र हे। २. तासाम्
verses.transliteration: ye vṛkṣeṣu śaṣpiñjarā nīlagrīvā vilohitāḥ | teṣā sahasrayojane'va dhanvāni tanmasi
verses.wordMeaning: These, green like young grass, in the trees, with azure necks and purple hue, Of those, etc.
verses.commentary: Sense: These, green like young grass, in the trees, with azure necks and purple hue, Of those, etc.

verses.sanskrit: ये भू॒ताना॒मधि॑पतयो विशि॒खास॑: कप॒र्दिन॑: । तेषा॑ᳪ सहस्रयोज॒नेऽव॒ धन्वा॑नि तन्मसि
verses.translation: Those, ministering spirits’ lords, with no hair-tufts, with braided locks, Of these, etc.
verses.hindi: राजपुरुष १. स्वास्थ्य के दृष्टिकोण से शरीर के पूर्ण प्रभु हों, तथा २. अस्त्र-चालन-विद्या में निपुण हों। १. है भवाः=( भवति अस्मिन्) जिनके रक्षाकार्य मे ही राष्ट कौ स्थिति सम्भव हे वे राजपुरुष, जो अस्मिन्-इस महत्ति-विशाल अर्णवे=-दया करे जलवाले अन्तरिक्षे अधि
verses.transliteration: ye bhūtānāmadhipatayo viśikhāsa: kapardina: | teṣā sahasrayojane'va dhanvāni tanmasi
verses.wordMeaning: Those, ministering spirits’ lords, with no hair-tufts, with braided locks, Of these, etc.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those, ministering spirits’ lords, with no hair-tufts, with braided locks, Of these, etc.

verses.sanskrit: ये प॒थां प॑थि॒रक्ष॑य ऐलबृ॒दा आ॑यु॒र्युध॑: । तेषा॑ᳪ सहस्रयोज॒नेऽव॒ धन्वा॑नि तन्मसि
verses.translation: Those, the protectors of the paths, bringers of food, who fight for life. Of these, etc.
verses.hindi: राजपुरुष ९. हदय के दृष्टिकोण से सदा मध्यमार्ग पर चलनेवाले हो। २. १. जो द्राः दु ःखद्रावक राजपुरुष नीलग्रीवाः =विविध विद्याओं से सुभूषित ग्रीवावाले है। २. शित्तिकण्ठा-- (शितिः श्वेत=शुद्ध ) शुद्ध कण्ठ स्वरवाले है। ३. दिवं उपश्रिताः = तान के प्रकाश को जिन्होने समीपता से सेवन किया है, अर्थात् खूब ऊँचे ज्ञानी वने हेँ। ४.
verses.transliteration: ye pathāṃ pathirakṣaya ailabṛdā āyuryudha: | teṣā sahasrayojane'va dhanvāni tanmasi
verses.wordMeaning: Those, the protectors of the paths, bringers of food, who fight for life. Of these, etc.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those, the protectors of the paths, bringers of food, who fight for life. Of these, etc.

verses.sanskrit: ये ती॒र्थानि॑ प्र॒चर॑न्ति सृ॒काह॑स्ता निष॒ङ्गिण॑: । तेषा॑ᳪ सहस्रयोज॒नेऽव॒ धन्वा॑नि तन्मसि
verses.translation: Those who with arrows in their hand, and armed with words, frequent the fords, Of these, etc.
verses.hindi: राजपुरुष १. मस्तिष्क के दृष्टिकोण से विविध विद्याओं से सुभूषित, खून ज्ञानी हों। इनका कण्ठस्वर भी बड़ा शुद्ध हो। २. अस्त्र-विद्या के पारङ्गत तो हों ही। फोडसखोऽध्यायः ५५८ यजुकेदशाव्यम् १- नीलग्रीवाः =विविध विद्याओं से सुभूषित गर्दनवाले, २. शितिकण्ठाः शुद्ध कण्टस्वर
verses.transliteration: ye tīrthāni pracaranti sṛkāhastā niṣaṅgiṇa: | teṣā sahasrayojane'va dhanvāni tanmasi
verses.wordMeaning: Those who with arrows in their hand, and armed with words, frequent the fords, Of these, etc.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those who with arrows in their hand, and armed with words, frequent the fords, Of these, etc.

verses.sanskrit: येऽन्ने॑षु वि॒विध्य॑न्ति॒ पात्रे॑षु॒ पिब॑तो॒ जना॑न् । तेषा॑ᳪ सहस्रयोज॒नेऽव॒ धन्वा॑नि तन्मसि
verses.translation: Those who, inhabiting the food, vex men while drinking from their cups, etc.
verses.hindi: राजपुरुष १. उद्धत न होकर विनीत हो। २. प्रजा की गालियो से तैश में १. ये=जो वृक्षेषु (व्रश्चनीय छेदनीय) छेदन के योग्य काम, क्रोध व लोभ आदि शत्रुओं के विषय में शष्पिञ्जराः=(शड् उत्प्लुतं बन्धनं पिञ्जर येन) बन्धन से ऊपर उट गये है, अर्थात् कामादि के बन्धन से जो ऊपर उठ गये है २. नीलग्रीवाः विविध विद्याओं
verses.transliteration: ye'nneṣu vividhyanti pātreṣu pibato janān | teṣā sahasrayojane'va dhanvāni tanmasi
verses.wordMeaning: Those who, inhabiting the food, vex men while drinking from their cups, etc.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those who, inhabiting the food, vex men while drinking from their cups, etc.

verses.sanskrit: य ए॒ताव॑न्तश्च॒ भूया॑ᳪसश्च॒ दिशो॑ रु॒द्रा वि॑तस्थि॒रे । तेषा॑ᳪ सहस्रयोज॒नेऽव॒ धन्वा॑नि तन्मसि
verses.translation: Rudras so many and still more, lodged in the quarters of the sky, etc.
verses.hindi: राजपुरुष विषयों के बन्धनो को परे फक चुके हो। विशिखासः ( विशिष्ट ज्ञान की ज्वालावाले ) १. ये=जो भूतानाम् अधिपतयः=शरीर के अङ्खभूत ' पृथिवी, जल, तेज, वायु व आकाश' इन पाचों भूतों के अधिपति है, अर्थात् इन्हे जिन्होनि पूर्णतया अपने अनुकूल
verses.transliteration: ya etāvantaśca bhūyāsaśca diśo rudrā vitasthire | teṣā sahasrayojane'va dhanvāni tanmasi
verses.wordMeaning: Rudras so many and still more, lodged in the quarters of the sky, etc.
verses.commentary: Sense: Rudras so many and still more, lodged in the quarters of the sky, etc.

verses.sanskrit:
नमो॑ऽस्तु रु॒द्रेभ्यो॒ ये दि॒वि येषां॑ व॒र्षमिष॑वः । तेभ्यो॒ दश॒ प्राची॒र्दश॑ दक्षि॒णा दश॑ प्र॒तीची॒र्दशोदी॑ची॒र्दशो॒र्ध्वाः ।
तेभ्यो॒ नमो॑ अस्तु॒ ते नो॑ऽवन्तु॒ ते नो॑ मृडयन्तु॒ ते यं द्वि॒ष्मो यश्च॑ नो॒ द्वेष्टि॒ तमे॑षां॒ जम्भे॑ दध्मः
verses.translation: Homage to Rudras, those whose home is sky, whose arrows floods of rain. To them ten eastward, southward ten, ten to the south, ten to the north, ten to the region uppermost! To them be homage! May they spare and guard us. Within their jaws we lay the man who hates us and whom we abhor.
verses.hindi: सव राजपुरुषो का एक ही ध्येय होना चाहिए कि शस्त्र. प्रयोग करे नैपुण्य से शत्रुओं का शातन (नाश) करके प्रजा के दुःखों को दूर करें ओर उसके सुख का वर्धन करे। इसी मेँ  रुद्र" नाम'की सार्थकता हे। सूचना-' एतावन्तः भूयांसः ' शब्द स्पष्ट संकेत कर रहे है कि राजपुरुषो की संख्या
verses.transliteration: namo'stu rudrebhyo ye divi yeṣāṃ varṣamiṣavaḥ | tebhyo daśa prācīrdaśa dakṣiṇā daśa pratīcīrdaśodīcīrdaśordhvāḥ | tebhyo namo astu te no'vantu te no mṛḍayantu te yaṃ dviṣmo yaśca no dveṣṭi tameṣāṃ jambhe dadhmaḥ
verses.wordMeaning: Homage to Rudras, those whose home is sky, whose arrows floods of rain. To them ten eastward, southward ten, ten to the south, ten to the north, ten to the region uppermost! To them be homage! May they spare and guard us.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Homage to Rudras, those whose home is sky, whose arrows floods of rain. To them ten eastward, southward ten, ten to the south, ten to the north, ten to the region uppermost! To them be homage! May they spare and guard us.…

verses.sanskrit:
नमो॑ऽस्तु रु॒द्रेभ्यो॒ येऽन्तरि॑क्षे॒ येषां॒ वात॒ इष॑वः । तेभ्यो॒ दश॒ प्राची॒र्दश॑ दक्षि॒णा दश॑ प्र॒तीची॒र्दशोदी॑ची॒र्दशो॒र्ध्वाः ।
तेभ्यो॒ नमो॑ अस्तु॒ ते नो॑ऽवन्तु॒ ते नो॑ मृडयन्तु॒ ते यं द्वि॒ष्मो यश्च॑ नो॒ द्वेष्टि॒ तमे॑षां॒ जम्भे॑ दध्मः
verses.translation: Homage to Rudras, those whose home is air, whose arrows is the rain. To them, etc.
verses.hindi: सव राजपुरुषो का एक ही ध्येय होना चाहिए कि शस्त्र. प्रयोग करे नैपुण्य से शत्रुओं का शातन (नाश) करके प्रजा के दुःखों को दूर करें ओर उसके सुख का वर्धन करे। इसी मेँ  रुद्र" नाम'की सार्थकता हे। सूचना-' एतावन्तः भूयांसः ' शब्द स्पष्ट संकेत कर रहे है कि राजपुरुषो की संख्या
verses.transliteration: namo'stu rudrebhyo ye'ntarikṣe yeṣāṃ vāta iṣavaḥ | tebhyo daśa prācīrdaśa dakṣiṇā daśa pratīcīrdaśodīcīrdaśordhvāḥ | tebhyo namo astu te no'vantu te no mṛḍayantu te yaṃ dviṣmo yaśca no dveṣṭi tameṣāṃ jambhe dadhmaḥ
verses.wordMeaning: Homage to Rudras, those whose home is air, whose arrows is the rain. To them, etc.
verses.commentary: Sense: Homage to Rudras, those whose home is air, whose arrows is the rain. To them, etc.

verses.sanskrit:
नमो॑ऽस्तु रु॒द्रेभ्यो॒ ये पृ॑थि॒व्यां येषा॒मन्न॒मिष॑वः । तेभ्यो॒ दश॒ प्राची॒र्दश॑ दक्षि॒णा दश॑ प्र॒तीची॒र्दशोदी॑ची॒र्दशो॒र्ध्वाः ।
तेभ्यो॒ नमो॑ अस्तु॒ ते नो॑ऽवन्तु॒ ते नो॑ मृडयन्तु॒ ते यं द्वि॒ष्मो यश्च॑ नो॒ द्वेष्टि॒ तमे॑षां॒ जम्भे॑ दध्मः
verses.translation: Homage to Rudras, those whose home is earth, whose arrows is men's food. To them be homage, etc.
verses.hindi: सव राजपुरुषो का एक ही ध्येय होना चाहिए कि शस्त्र. प्रयोग करे नैपुण्य से शत्रुओं का शातन (नाश) करके प्रजा के दुःखों को दूर करें ओर उसके सुख का वर्धन करे। इसी मेँ  रुद्र" नाम'की सार्थकता हे। सूचना-' एतावन्तः भूयांसः ' शब्द स्पष्ट संकेत कर रहे है कि राजपुरुषो की संख्या
verses.transliteration: namo'stu rudrebhyo ye pṛthivyāṃ yeṣāmannamiṣavaḥ | tebhyo daśa prācīrdaśa dakṣiṇā daśa pratīcīrdaśodīcīrdaśordhvāḥ | tebhyo namo astu te no'vantu te no mṛḍayantu te yaṃ dviṣmo yaśca no dveṣṭi tameṣāṃ jambhe dadhmaḥ
verses.wordMeaning: Homage to Rudras, those whose home is earth, whose arrows is men's food. To them be homage, etc.
verses.commentary: Sense: Homage to Rudras, those whose home is earth, whose arrows is men's food. To them be homage, etc.

verses.sanskrit:
अश्म॒न्नूर्जं॒ पर्व॑ते शिश्रिया॒णाम॒द्भ्य ओष॑धीभ्यो॒ वन॒स्पतिभ्यो॒ अधि॒ सम्भृ॑तं॒ पय॑: ।
तां न॒ इष॒मूर्जं॑ धत्त मरुतः सᳪररा॒णाः अश्मँ॑स्ते॒ क्षुन्मयि॑ त॒ ऊर्ग्यं द्वि॒ष्मस्तं ते॒ शुगृ॑च्छतु
verses.translation: com The Texts of the White Yajurveda, tr. Ralph T.H. Griffith, [1899], THE food and strength contained in stone and mountain, drink gathered from the plants and trees and waters, That food and strength, Maruts! free-givers, grant us. In the stone is thy hunger. In me is thy food. Let thy pain reach the man we hate.
verses.hindi: ९. हम वृष्टि से उत्पन्न अन्न व रस को प्राप्त करे। २. हमें इन ओषधियों का सेवन करनेवाली गौवों का दृध प्राप्त हो। ३. हमें सदा उचित भूख लगे। ४. अन्न हमारे इमा मेऽअग्नऽडइष्ट॑का धेनवः सन्त्वेकां च दश॑ च दश च शतं च॑ शातं च॑ सहस्त्र मध्यं चान्त॑श्च परार्द्धश्चैता मेऽअग्नऽ इष्ट॑का धेनवः सन्त्वमुत्रामुर्मिल्लोके ॥२॥
verses.transliteration: aśmannūrjaṃ parvate śiśriyāṇāmadbhya oṣadhībhyo vanaspatibhyo adhi sambhṛtaṃ paya: | tāṃ na iṣamūrjaṃ dhatta marutaḥ sararāṇāḥ aśma~ste kṣunmayi ta ūrgyaṃ dviṣmastaṃ te śugṛcchatu
verses.wordMeaning: com The Texts of the White Yajurveda, tr. Ralph T.H. Griffith, [1899], THE food and strength contained in stone and mountain, drink gathered from the plants and trees and waters, That food and strength, Maruts! free-givers, grant us. In the stone is thy hunger.…
verses.commentary: Sense: com The Texts of the White Yajurveda, tr. Ralph T.H. Griffith, [1899], THE food and strength contained in stone and mountain, drink gathered from the plants and trees and waters, That food and strength, Maruts! free-givers, grant us. In the stone is thy hunger.…

verses.sanskrit: इ॒मा मे॑ अग्न॒ इष्ट॑का धे॒नव॑: स॒न्त्वेका॑ च॒ दश॑ च॒ दश॑ च श॒तं च॑ श॒तं च॑ स॒हस्रं॑ च स॒हस्रं॑ चा॒युतं॑ चा॒युतं॑ च नि॒युतं॑ च नि॒युतं॑ च प्र॒युतं॒ चार्बु॑दं च॒ न्य॑र्बुदं समु॒द्रश्च॒ मध्यं॒ चान्त॑श्च परा॒र्धश्चै॒ता मे॑ अग्न॒ इष्ट॑का धे॒नव॑: सन्त्व॒मुत्रा॒मुष्मिँ॑ल्लो॒के
verses.translation: O Agni, may these bricks be mine own milch kine: one, and ten, and ten tens, a hundred, and ten hundreds, a thousand, and ten thousand a myriad, and a hundred thousand, and a million, and a hundred millions, and an ocean middle and end, and a hundred thousand millions, and a billion. May these bricks be mine own milch-kine in yonder world and in this world.
verses.hindi: हम अपने जीवनों को यज्ञमय बनाएं यज्ञ इस लोक में सात्विक अन्न व नीरोगता देनेवाला होकर कल्याण करता है तथा यज्ञ में निहित त्याग की भावना परलोक मे कल्याण करनेवाली होती हे। घृतश्च्युतो मधुश्च्युतों विराजो नाम॑ कामदुघाऽअक्षीयमाणाः ॥३॥
verses.transliteration: imā me agna iṣṭakā dhenava: santvekā ca daśa ca daśa ca śataṃ ca śataṃ ca sahasraṃ ca sahasraṃ cāyutaṃ cāyutaṃ ca niyutaṃ ca niyutaṃ ca prayutaṃ cārbudaṃ ca nyarbudaṃ samudraśca madhyaṃ cāntaśca parārdhaścaitā me agna iṣṭakā dhenava: santvamutrāmuṣmi~lloke
verses.wordMeaning: O Agni, may these bricks be mine own milch kine: one, and ten, and ten tens, a hundred, and ten hundreds, a thousand, and ten thousand a myriad, and a hundred thousand, and a million, and a hundred millions, and an ocean middle and end, and a hundred thousand millions,…
verses.commentary: Sense: O Agni, may these bricks be mine own milch kine: one, and ten, and ten tens, a hundred, and ten hundreds, a thousand, and ten thousand a myriad, and a hundred thousand, and a million, and a hundred millions, and an ocean middle and end, and a hundred thousand millions,…

verses.sanskrit:
ऋ॒तव॑ स्थ ऋता॒वृध॑ ऋतु॒ष्ठा स्थ॑ ऋता॒वृध॑: ।
घृ॒त॒श्च्युतो॑ मधु॒श्च्युतो॑ वि॒राजो॒ नाम॑ काम॒दुघा॒ अक्षी॑यमाणाः
verses.translation: Ye are the Seasons, strengthening Law, fixed in due season, strengthening Law, Called Splendid, dropping butter down and honey, yielders of every wish, imperishable.
verses.hindi: -हमारी गति नियमित हो। यज्ञो से हम शक्तियों का वर्धन करे। अनिष्ट समुद्र की अवक्रा ( रक्षा-शक््ति) समुद्रस्य त्वाव॑कयाग्ने परि व्ययामसि । पावकोऽअस्मभ्य॑-शिवो भ॑व ।४॥ १९. गत मन्त्र के अनुसार जीवन-निर्माण से शरीर का स्वास्थ्य -ही नहीं, मनःस्वास्थ्य
verses.transliteration: ṛtava stha ṛtāvṛdha ṛtuṣṭhā stha ṛtāvṛdha: | ghṛtaścyuto madhuścyuto virājo nāma kāmadughā akṣīyamāṇāḥ
verses.wordMeaning: Ye are the Seasons, strengthening Law, fixed in due season, strengthening Law, Called Splendid, dropping butter down and honey, yielders of every wish, imperishable.
verses.commentary: Sense: Ye are the Seasons, strengthening Law, fixed in due season, strengthening Law, Called Splendid, dropping butter down and honey, yielders of every wish, imperishable.

verses.sanskrit: स॒मु॒द्रस्य॒ त्वाऽव॑क॒याग्ने॒ परि॑ व्ययामसि । पा॒व॒को अ॒स्मभ्य॑ᳪ शि॒वो भ॑व
verses.translation: With the lake's mantling need we robe thee, Agni: to us he purifying and auspicious.
verses.hindi: १. हम कर्मो के तो निवास-स्थान बन जार्ण। २. सदा प्रसन्न मन का हममें प्रवेश हो। ३. प्रभु-प्राप्त प्रेरणाओं को ओरों तक पहंचानेवाले बनें। ४. पवित्र जीवनवाले युर्वेदभाष्यम् ५5७ सप्तदशोऽध्यायः होकर। ५. सभी का कल्याण करे। यही प्रभु-प्राप्ति का मार्ग हे।
verses.transliteration: samudrasya tvā'vakayāgne pari vyayāmasi | pāvako asmabhya śivo bhava
verses.wordMeaning: With the lake's mantling need we robe thee, Agni: to us he purifying and auspicious.
verses.commentary: Sense: With the lake's mantling need we robe thee, Agni: to us he purifying and auspicious.

verses.sanskrit: हि॒मस्य॑ त्वा ज॒रायु॒णाऽग्ने॒ परि॑ व्ययामसि । पा॒व॒को अ॒स्मभ्य॑ᳪ शि॒वो भ॑व
verses.translation: With cold's investing garb we gird thee, Agni: to us be purifying and auspicious.
verses.hindi: प्रभु का प्रिय वही है जो ज्लान-दीप्त व मधुर वाणीवाला बनकर लोकहित मेँ प्रवृत्त होता है ओर प्रभु के सन्देश को मधुर शब्दों मे उन तक पहँचाता है। स न॑; पावक दीदिवो ऽग्न देवांँर। इहावह । उप॑ यज्ञश्ह विश्च नः ॥ ९॥ १. गत मन्त्र की भावना को ही अधिक विस्तृत करते हए कहते है कि हे
verses.transliteration: himasya tvā jarāyuṇā'gne pari vyayāmasi | pāvako asmabhya śivo bhava
verses.wordMeaning: With cold's investing garb we gird thee, Agni: to us be purifying and auspicious.
verses.commentary: Sense: With cold's investing garb we gird thee, Agni: to us be purifying and auspicious.

verses.sanskrit: उप॒ ज्मन्नुप॑ वेत॒सेऽव॑ तर न॒दीष्वा । अग्ने॑ पि॒त्तम॒पाम॑सि॒ मण्डू॑कि॒ ताभि॒रा ग॑हि॒ सेमं नो॑ य॒ज्ञं पा॑व॒कव॑र्णᳪ शि॒वं कृ॑धि
verses.translation: Descend upon the earth, the reed, the rivers: thou art the gall, O Agni, of the waters. With them come hither, female Frog, and render this sacrifice of ours bright-hued, successful.
verses.hindi: प्रभु का प्यारा दिव्य गुणों को अपनाता है, यज्ञशील होता है ओर अपने जीवन को हविरूप बना देता है, सदा दानपूर्वक यज्ञशेष को ही खानेवाला होता हे। सप्तदशोऽध्यायः ५६८ युर्वेदभाव्यम् १. पिछले मन्त्रों कौ प्रेरणा को सुननेवाला व्यक्ति अपने में शक्ति को भरनेवाला
verses.transliteration: upa jmannupa vetase'va tara nadīṣvā | agne pittamapāmasi maṇḍūki tābhirā gahi semaṃ no yajñaṃ pāvakavarṇa śivaṃ kṛdhi
verses.wordMeaning: Descend upon the earth, the reed, the rivers: thou art the gall, O Agni, of the waters. With them come hither, female Frog, and render this sacrifice of ours bright-hued, successful.
verses.commentary: Sense: Descend upon the earth, the reed, the rivers: thou art the gall, O Agni, of the waters. With them come hither, female Frog, and render this sacrifice of ours bright-hued, successful.

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒पामि॒दं न्यय॑नᳪ समु॒द्रस्य॑ नि॒वेश॑नम् ।
अ॒न्याँस्ते॑ अ॒स्मत्त॑पन्तु हे॒तय॑: पाव॒को अ॒स्मभ्य॑ᳪ शि॒वो भ॑व
verses.translation: This is the place where waters meet; here is the gathering of the flood. Let thy shaft burn others than us: be thou cleanser, propitious unto us.
verses.hindi: हम ऊँचे-से-ऊंचे ज्ञानी बनें। ज्ञान को चारों ओर फलाने का प्रयल करे। ज्ञान को फैलाकर वातावरण को पवित्र वनां। अनज्ञानावृत लोगों से घृणा करके सुदूर पर्वत- अन्यास्तैऽअस्मत्त॑पन्तु हेतयः: पावकोऽअस्मभ्यैःशिवो भ॑व । ९५५॥ यचुर्वेदभाव्यम् ५७१ सप्तदसोऽध्यायः
verses.transliteration: apāmidaṃ nyayana samudrasya niveśanam | anyā~ste asmattapantu hetaya: pāvako asmabhya śivo bhava
verses.wordMeaning: This is the place where waters meet; here is the gathering of the flood. Let thy shaft burn others than us: be thou cleanser, propitious unto us.
verses.commentary: Sense: This is the place where waters meet; here is the gathering of the flood. Let thy shaft burn others than us: be thou cleanser, propitious unto us.

verses.sanskrit: अग्ने॑ पावक रो॒चिषा॑ म॒न्द्रया॑ देव जि॒ह्वया॑ । आ दे॒वान् व॑क्षि॒ यक्षि॑ च
verses.translation: O Agni, purifier, God, with splendour and thy pleasant tongue Bring hither, and adore, the Gods.
verses.hindi: वे प्रभु वन=उपास्य है, यह संसार वृक्षनकछेदनीय है। याते धामानि परमाणि यावमा या म॑ध्य॒मा विंश्वकर्म्नुतेमा । १. है विष्वकर्मन्-सारे संसार के निर्माण करनेवाले! स्वधावः अपनी धारण शक्तिवाले! ओर किसी से न धारण किये जानेवाले प्रभो! ते=आपकं याजो परमाणि धामानि उत्कृष्ट
verses.transliteration: agne pāvaka rociṣā mandrayā deva jihvayā | ā devān vakṣi yakṣi ca
verses.wordMeaning: O Agni, purifier, God, with splendour and thy pleasant tongue Bring hither, and adore, the Gods.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Agni, purifier, God, with splendour and thy pleasant tongue Bring hither, and adore, the Gods.

verses.sanskrit:
स न॑: पावक दीदि॒वोऽग्ने॑ दे॒वाँ२  इ॒हा व॑ह ।
उप॑ य॒ज्ञᳪ ह॒विश्च॑ नः
verses.translation: So, Agni, purifying, bright, bring hither to our sacrifice, To our oblation bring the Gods.
verses.hindi: उन्नति के मार्ग पर चलें। ४. शरीर की शक्तियों को बदार्णँ, मस्तिष्क को प्रकाशमय करे। ५. बाह्य व आन्तर शत्रुओं को जीते। ६. यज्ञशील हों। ७. ज्ञानी बनकर ओरों को भी उत्तम वाचस्पतिः विश्वकर्माणमूतये मनोजुवं वाजैऽअद्या हुवेम । स नो विश्वानि हव॑नानि जोषद्धिश्वशंम्भूरव॑से साधुकर्मा । २३॥
verses.transliteration: sa na: pāvaka dīdivo'gne devā~2 ihā vaha | upa yajña haviśca naḥ
verses.wordMeaning: So, Agni, purifying, bright, bring hither to our sacrifice, To our oblation bring the Gods.
verses.commentary: Sense: So, Agni, purifying, bright, bring hither to our sacrifice, To our oblation bring the Gods.

verses.sanskrit:
पा॒व॒कया॒ यश्चि॒तय॑न्त्या कृ॒पा क्षाम॑न् रुरु॒च उ॒षसो॒ न भा॒नुना॑ ।
तूर्व॒न् न याम॒न्नेत॑शस्य॒ नू रण॒ आ यो घृ॒णे न त॑तृषा॒णो अ॒जर॑:
verses.translation: He who with purifying, eye-attracting form hath shone upon the earth as with the light of Dawn; Who speeding on, as in the fleet steed's race, in fight, cometh untouched by age, as one athirst in heat.
verses.hindi: प्रभु की उपासना से मेरा जीवन शान्त होगा, मेरा योगक्षेम ठीक चलेगा सप्तदसोऽध्यायः ५७६ यजुर्वेद भाष्यम् (अवसे) मेरे कर्म सदा उत्तम व सफलतावाले होगे। विश्व॑कर्मन् हविषा वर्दधनेन त्रातारमिन्द्र॑मकृणोरवध्यम् ।
verses.transliteration: pāvakayā yaścitayantyā kṛpā kṣāman ruruca uṣaso na bhānunā | tūrvan na yāmannetaśasya nū raṇa ā yo ghṛṇe na tatṛṣāṇo ajara:
verses.wordMeaning: He who with purifying, eye-attracting form hath shone upon the earth as with the light of Dawn; Who speeding on, as in the fleet steed's race, in fight, cometh untouched by age, as one athirst in heat.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who with purifying, eye-attracting form hath shone upon the earth as with the light of Dawn; Who speeding on, as in the fleet steed's race, in fight, cometh untouched by age, as one athirst in heat.

verses.sanskrit:
नम॑स्ते॒ हर॑से शो॒चिषे॒ नम॑स्ते अस्त्व॒र्चिषे॑ ।
अ॒न्याँस्ते॑ अ॒स्मत्त॑पन्तु हे॒तय॑: पाव॒को अ॒स्मभ्य॑ᳪ शि॒वो भ॑व
verses.translation: Obeisance to thy wrath and glow! Obeisance to thy fiery flame! Let thy shot missiles burn others than us: be thou cleanser, propitious unto us.
verses.hindi: -हम अपनी इन्द्रियों को एकाग्र करके उस परमात्मा का चिन्तन करें जो “विश्वकर्मा विमना-विहाया-धाता--विधाता- परम व सन्दृक् ' है, जो "पर! है। एेसा करने पर हम प्रेरणा के सुननेव्पले होंगे ओर आनन्द का अनुभव करेगे। यो न॑: पिता ज॑निता यो विधाता धामानि वेद् भुव॑नानि विश्वां ।
verses.transliteration: namaste harase śociṣe namaste astvarciṣe | anyā~ste asmattapantu hetaya: pāvako asmabhya śivo bhava
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to thy wrath and glow! Obeisance to thy fiery flame! Let thy shot missiles burn others than us: be thou cleanser, propitious unto us.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to thy wrath and glow! Obeisance to thy fiery flame! Let thy shot missiles burn others than us: be thou cleanser, propitious unto us.

verses.sanskrit: नृ॒षदे॒ वेड॑प्सु॒षदे॒ वेड् ब॑र्हि॒षदे॒ वेड् व॑न॒सदे॒ वेड् स्व॒र्विदे॒ वेट्
verses.translation: To him who dwells in man, Hail! To him who dwells in waters, Hail! To him who dwells in sacred grass, Hail! To him who dwells in the wood, Hail! To him who finds the light, Hail!
verses.hindi: - १. मस्तिष्क व मस्तिष्क की साधना करनेवाले देवों से वह प्रभु दूर हे। २. शरीर व शरीर की साधना करनेवाले असुरो से तो वह निश्चित ही दूर है। ३. उस ग्रहणीय व्यापक प्रभु को प्राण ही धारण करते है। ४. इस प्राण-साधना के होने पर अधीतपूर्णविद्या देव उस प्रभु का सम्यग् दर्शन करते है।
verses.transliteration: nṛṣade veḍapsuṣade veḍ barhiṣade veḍ vanasade veḍ svarvide veṭ
verses.wordMeaning: To him who dwells in man, Hail! To him who dwells in waters, Hail! To him who dwells in sacred grass, Hail! To him who dwells in the wood, Hail! To him who finds the light, Hail!
verses.commentary: Sense: To him who dwells in man, Hail! To him who dwells in waters, Hail! To him who dwells in sacred grass, Hail! To him who dwells in the wood, Hail! To him who finds the light, Hail!

verses.sanskrit:
ये दे॒वा दे॒वानां॑ य॒ज्ञिया॑ य॒ज्ञिया॑नाᳪ संवत्स॒रीण॒मुप॑ भा॒गमास॑ते ।
अ॑हु॒तादो॑ ह॒विषो॑ य॒ज्ञे अ॒स्मिन्त्स्व॒यं पि॑बन्तु॒ मधु॑नो घृ॒तस्य॑
verses.translation: Worshipful Gods of Gods who merit worship, those who sit down beside their yearly portion, Let them who eat not sacrificial presents drink in this rite of honey and of butter.
verses.hindi: प्रभु-दर्शन के लिए आवश्यक है कि ९. हम अज्ञान को दूर करें। २. गपशप न मारते रहे। ३. सांसारिक सुख-साधनों का ही संग्रह न करते रह जाँ ओर ४. यज्ञो द्वारा स्वर्ग प्राप्ति ही हमारा ध्येय न बन जाए्। विष्वकर्मा ह्यज॑निष्ट देवऽआदिद् ग॑न्धर्वोऽअ॑भवव् द्वितीयः ।
verses.transliteration: ye devā devānāṃ yajñiyā yajñiyānā saṃvatsarīṇamupa bhāgamāsate | ahutādo haviṣo yajñe asmintsvayaṃ pibantu madhuno ghṛtasya
verses.wordMeaning: Worshipful Gods of Gods who merit worship, those who sit down beside their yearly portion, Let them who eat not sacrificial presents drink in this rite of honey and of butter.
verses.commentary: Sense: Worshipful Gods of Gods who merit worship, those who sit down beside their yearly portion, Let them who eat not sacrificial presents drink in this rite of honey and of butter.

verses.sanskrit:
ये दे॒वा दे॒वेष्वधि॑ देव॒त्वमाय॒न् ये ब्रह्म॑णः पुर ए॒तारो॑ अ॒स्य ।
येभ्यो॒ न ऋ॒ते पव॑ते॒ धाम॒ किञ्च॒न न ते दि॒वो न पृ॑थि॒व्या अधि॒ स्नुषु॑
verses.translation: Those Gods who have attained to Godhead over Gods, they who have led the way in this our holy work, Without whose aid no body whatsoever moves, not on heaven's heights are they, nor on the face of earth.
verses.hindi: - हम अपनी आत्मा को ' संक्रन्दन-अनिमिष-जिष्णु- युत्कार- दुश्च्यवन - धृष्णु इषुहस्त व वृषण ' बनाएंगे तो इस आत्मा से शत्रुओं को अवश्य पराभूत करेगे। १. सः=वह “अप्रतिरथ ' अद्वितीय योद्धा इषुहस्तैः -प्रेरणारूप हाथों से, अर्थात् प्रभु की प्रेरणा के अनुसार कार्य करनेवाले हाथों से ओर सः=वह न -भिः=अनासक्ति-
verses.transliteration: ye devā deveṣvadhi devatvamāyan ye brahmaṇaḥ pura etāro asya | yebhyo na ṛte pavate dhāma kiñcana na te divo na pṛthivyā adhi snuṣu
verses.wordMeaning: Those Gods who have attained to Godhead over Gods, they who have led the way in this our holy work, Without whose aid no body whatsoever moves, not on heaven's heights are they, nor on the face of earth.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those Gods who have attained to Godhead over Gods, they who have led the way in this our holy work, Without whose aid no body whatsoever moves, not on heaven's heights are they, nor on the face of earth.

verses.sanskrit:
प्रा॒ण॒दा अ॑पान॒दा व्या॑न॒दा व॑र्चो॒दा व॑रिवो॒दाः ।
अ॒न्याँस्ते॑ अ॒स्मत्त॑पन्तु हे॒तय॑: पाव॒को अ॒स्मभ्य॑ᳪ शि॒वो भ॑व
verses.translation: Giver of breath, of out-breath, breath diffusive, giver of lustre, giving room and freedom, Let thy shot missiles burn others than us: be thou cleanser, propitious unto us.
verses.hindi: -हम अपने शरीररूप रथों से चमक, उन्नति करनेवाले बने। १. अप्रतिरथ वह है जो बलविज्ञायः =अपने बल के कारण प्रसिद्ध है। २. स्थविरः= स्थिरमति= स्थितप्रज्ञ हे, विषयों से डँवोँडोल होनेवाला नहीं है। ३. प्रवीरः प्रकृष्ट वीर है, यह वैषयिक वृत्तियों को विशेषरूपेण कम्पित करनेवाला है (विशेषेण ईरयति) ४.
verses.transliteration: prāṇadā apānadā vyānadā varcodā varivodāḥ | anyā~ste asmattapantu hetaya: pāvako asmabhya śivo bhava
verses.wordMeaning: Giver of breath, of out-breath, breath diffusive, giver of lustre, giving room and freedom, Let thy shot missiles burn others than us: be thou cleanser, propitious unto us.
verses.commentary: Sense: Giver of breath, of out-breath, breath diffusive, giver of lustre, giving room and freedom, Let thy shot missiles burn others than us: be thou cleanser, propitious unto us.

verses.sanskrit: अ॒ग्निस्ति॒ग्मेन॑ शो॒चिषा॒ यास॒द्विश्वं॒ न्यत्रिण॑म् । अ॒ग्निर्नो॑ वनते र॒यिम्
verses.translation: May Agni with his sharpened blaze cast down each fierce devouring fiend. May Agni win us wealth by war.
verses.hindi: हम अपने जीवन में बल ओर ज्ञान का समन्वय करके विजयी बनें। इमर्संजाताऽअनु वीरयध्वमिन्द्र॑सखायोऽअनु सश्रभध्वम् ।३८॥ १. प्रभु कहते हहे सजाताः=समान जन्मवाले जीवो! इमम्-इस इन्द्र के अनु- वीरयध्वम्-अनुसार तुम भी वीरतापूर्णं कर्म करो। उस इन्दर के अनुसार जो गोत्रभिदम्=( गोत्र
verses.transliteration: agnistigmena śociṣā yāsadviśvaṃ nyatriṇam | agnirno vanate rayim
verses.wordMeaning: May Agni with his sharpened blaze cast down each fierce devouring fiend. May Agni win us wealth by war.
verses.commentary: Sense: May Agni with his sharpened blaze cast down each fierce devouring fiend. May Agni win us wealth by war.

verses.sanskrit:
य इ॒मा विश्वा॒ भुव॑नानि॒ जुह्व॒दृषि॒र्होता॒ न्यसी॑दत् पि॒ता न॑: ।
स आ॒शिषा॒ द्रवि॑णमि॒च्छमा॑नः प्रथम॒च्छदव॑राँ॒२ आ वि॑वेश
verses.translation: He who sate down as Hotar priest, the Rishi, our Father offering, up all things existent He, seeking with his wish a great possession, came among men on earth as archetypal.
verses.hindi: -हम धनों का अवगाहन करें, परन्तु उनमें ही आसक्त न हो जापं। हममे दिव्य गुणों का विकास हो। लोभ ही दिव्य गुणरूप पुरुषों के लिए तुहिनरूप होता है। इन्द्र॑ऽआसां नेता वृहस्पतिर्दक्षिणा यज्ञः पुरऽ एतु सोम॑: । देवसेनानांमभिभजञ्जतीनां जयन्तीनां मरुतो यन्त्वग्र॑म् ॥४०॥
verses.transliteration: ya imā viśvā bhuvanāni juhvadṛṣirhotā nyasīdat pitā na: | sa āśiṣā draviṇamicchamānaḥ prathamacchadavarā~2 ā viveśa
verses.wordMeaning: He who sate down as Hotar priest, the Rishi, our Father offering, up all things existent He, seeking with his wish a great possession, came among men on earth as archetypal.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who sate down as Hotar priest, the Rishi, our Father offering, up all things existent He, seeking with his wish a great possession, came among men on earth as archetypal.

verses.sanskrit:
किᳪस्वि॑दासीदधि॒ष्ठान॑मा॒रम्भ॑णं कत॒मत्स्वि॑त्क॒थाऽऽसी॑त् ।
यतो॒ भूमिं॑ ज॒नय॑न् वि॒श्वक॑र्मा॒ वि द्यामौर्णो॑न्महि॒ना वि॒श्वच॑क्षाः
verses.translation: What was the place whereon he took his station? What was it that upheld him? What the manner, Whence Visvakarman, seeing all, producing the earth, with mighty power disclosed the heavens?
verses.hindi: -हम प्राण-साधना करें, जिससे हममे दिव्य गुणों का विकास हो। इन्द्रियों के अधिष्ठाता बनकर हम देवसेनाओं के सेनापति बनें। हमारे जीवन में ‹ ज्ञान-दान- यज्ञ- सौम्यता व सोमरक्षा' को महत्त्व प्राप्त हो। म॒हाम॑नसां भुवनच्यवानां घोषो देवानां जय॑तामुद॑स्थात् ।॥ ४९॥
verses.transliteration: kisvidāsīdadhiṣṭhānamārambhaṇaṃ katamatsvitkathā''sīt | yato bhūmiṃ janayan viśvakarmā vi dyāmaurṇonmahinā viśvacakṣāḥ
verses.wordMeaning: What was the place whereon he took his station? What was it that upheld him? What the manner, Whence Visvakarman, seeing all, producing the earth, with mighty power disclosed the heavens?
verses.commentary: Sense: What was the place whereon he took his station? What was it that upheld him? What the manner, Whence Visvakarman, seeing all, producing the earth, with mighty power disclosed the heavens?

verses.sanskrit:
वि॒श्वत॑श्चक्षुरु॒त वि॒श्वतो॑मुखो वि॒श्वतो॑बाहुरु॒त वि॒श्वत॑स्पात् ।
सं बा॒हुभ्यां॒ धम॑ति॒ सं पत॑त्रै॒र्द्यावा॒भूमी॑ ज॒नय॑न् दे॒व एक॑:
verses.translation: He who hath eyes on all sides round about him, a mouth on all sides, arms and feet on all sides, He the sole God, producing earth and heaven, weldeth them with his arms as wings together.
verses.hindi: हम इन्द्र, वरूण व आदित्य" बनने का प्रय करे। विशाल हदयवाले हों, अधिक-से-अधिक त्याग कौ वृत्तिवाले हों। उद्धर्षय मघवन्नायुंधान्युत्सत्व॑नां मामकानां मनाश्सि । १. विजय के लिए अस्त्रो का ठीक होना अत्यन्त आवश्यक है। अध्यात्म संग्राम के
verses.transliteration: viśvataścakṣuruta viśvatomukho viśvatobāhuruta viśvataspāt | saṃ bāhubhyāṃ dhamati saṃ patatrairdyāvābhūmī janayan deva eka:
verses.wordMeaning: He who hath eyes on all sides round about him, a mouth on all sides, arms and feet on all sides, He the sole God, producing earth and heaven, weldeth them with his arms as wings together.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who hath eyes on all sides round about him, a mouth on all sides, arms and feet on all sides, He the sole God, producing earth and heaven, weldeth them with his arms as wings together.

verses.sanskrit:
किᳪस्वि॒द्वनं॒ क उ॒ स वृ॒क्ष आ॑स॒ यतो॒ द्यावा॑पृथि॒वी नि॑ष्टत॒क्षुः ।
मनी॑षिणो॒ मन॑सा पृ॒च्छतेदु॒ तद्यद॒ध्यति॑ष्ठ॒द्भुव॑नानि धा॒रय॑न्
verses.translation: What was the tree, what wood in sooth produced it, from which they fashioned out the earth and heaven? Ye thoughtful men, inquire within your spirit whereon he stood when he established all things.
verses.hindi: जीवन-संग्राम में विजय के लिए हमारे मन, इन्दिय व शरीररूप सब अस्माक वीराऽ उत्त॑रे भवन्त्वस्मोँ २।ऽॐ देवाऽअवता ह वेषु ।॥४३॥ १. ध्वजेषु समृतेषु=ध्वजाओं व पताकाओं के ठीकरूप से प्राप्त कर लेने पर अस्माकम्-हम आस्तिक बुद्धिवालों का नियामक इन्द्रः = परमात्मा हो, अर्थात् हम प्रभु को
verses.transliteration: kisvidvanaṃ ka u sa vṛkṣa āsa yato dyāvāpṛthivī niṣṭatakṣuḥ | manīṣiṇo manasā pṛcchatedu tadyadadhyatiṣṭhadbhuvanāni dhārayan
verses.wordMeaning: What was the tree, what wood in sooth produced it, from which they fashioned out the earth and heaven? Ye thoughtful men, inquire within your spirit whereon he stood when he established all things.
verses.commentary: Sense: What was the tree, what wood in sooth produced it, from which they fashioned out the earth and heaven? Ye thoughtful men, inquire within your spirit whereon he stood when he established all things.

verses.sanskrit:
या ते॒ धामा॑नि पर॒माणि॒ याऽव॒मा या म॑ध्य॒मा वि॑श्वकर्मन्नु॒तेमा ।
शिक्षा॒ सखि॑भ्यो ह॒विषि॑ स्वधावः स्व॒यं य॑जस्व त॒न्वं॒ वृधा॒नः
verses.translation: Thine highest, lowest sacrificial natures, and these thy midmost here, O Visvakarman, Teach thou thy friends at sacrifice, O Blessd, and come thy- self, exalted, to our worship.
verses.hindi: -१. जीवन-लक््य को ओङ्लल न होने देते हुए हम प्रभु को अपना आश्रय समञ्चं। २. हमारे जीवन मे हृदयस्थ प्रभु की प्रेरणा की विजय हो, न कि हमारी इच्छा की। ३. हम सदा वीरतापूर्ण कार्य ही करे ओर ४. हम सदा अध्यात्म-संग्रामों में देवों की रक्षा १. लोभ कौ प्रवृत्ति बड़ी विचित्र है (क) यह कम-से-कम प्रयत से अधिक-से-
verses.transliteration: yā te dhāmāni paramāṇi yā'vamā yā madhyamā viśvakarmannutemā | śikṣā sakhibhyo haviṣi svadhāvaḥ svayaṃ yajasva tanvaṃ vṛdhānaḥ
verses.wordMeaning: Thine highest, lowest sacrificial natures, and these thy midmost here, O Visvakarman, Teach thou thy friends at sacrifice, O Blessd, and come thy- self, exalted, to our worship.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thine highest, lowest sacrificial natures, and these thy midmost here, O Visvakarman, Teach thou thy friends at sacrifice, O Blessd, and come thy- self, exalted, to our worship.

verses.sanskrit:
विश्व॑कर्मन् ह॒विषा॑ वावृधा॒नः स्व॒यं य॑जस्व पृथि॒वीमु॒त द्याम् ।
मुह्य॑न्त्व॒न्ये अ॒भित॑: स॒पत्ना॑ इ॒हास्माकं॑ म॒घवा॑ सू॒रिर॑स्तु
verses.translation: Bring those, thyself exalted with oblation, O Visvakarman, Earth and Heaven to worship. Let enemies around us live in folly: here let us have a rich and liberal patron. 23, 24. = VIII. 45, 46.
verses.hindi: १. हमारा जीवन लक्ष्य-दृष्टि से शून्य न हो। २. हम द्वेषादि कौ भावना सप्तदशोऽध्यायः ५९० यजुर्वेद भाष्यम् १. पिछले मन्त्र की भावना के अनुसार हमारे जीवन का लक्ष्य बनता है ' वासनाओं का समूल उन्मूलन '। यह वासनाओं का उन्मूलन करनेवाला व्यक्ति "न रम्" है, “न रम्'त्न
verses.transliteration: viśvakarman haviṣā vāvṛdhānaḥ svayaṃ yajasva pṛthivīmuta dyām | muhyantvanye abhita: sapatnā ihāsmākaṃ maghavā sūrirastu
verses.wordMeaning: Bring those, thyself exalted with oblation, O Visvakarman, Earth and Heaven to worship. Let enemies around us live in folly: here let us have a rich and liberal patron. 23, 24. = VIII. 45, 46.
verses.commentary: Sense: Bring those, thyself exalted with oblation, O Visvakarman, Earth and Heaven to worship. Let enemies around us live in folly: here let us have a rich and liberal patron. 23, 24. = VIII. 45, 46.

verses.sanskrit:
वा॒चस्पतिं॑  वि॒श्वक॑र्माणमू॒तये॑ मनो॒जुवं॒ वाजे॑ अ॒द्या हु॑वेम ।
स नो॒ विश्वा॑नि॒ हव॑नानि जोषद्वि॒श्वश॑म्भू॒रव॑से सा॒धुक॑र्मा
verses.translation: The Father of the eye, the Wise in spirit, created both these worlds submerged in fatness.
verses.hindi: हम लक्ष्य की ओर आगे बद, विघ्नों को जीते। प्रयल में लगे रहे, जिससे वासनाओं का शिकार न हों। प्रयल में लगे हुए को प्रभु भी कल्याण प्राप्त कराते हेै। असौ या सेनां मरुतः परेंषामभ्यैति नऽओज॑सा स्पर्धमाना । १. असौो=वह याजो परेषाम् पराये, अर्थात् शत्रुभूत कामादि की सेना स्पर्धमाना
verses.transliteration: vācaspatiṃ viśvakarmāṇamūtaye manojuvaṃ vāje adyā huvema | sa no viśvāni havanāni joṣadviśvaśambhūravase sādhukarmā
verses.wordMeaning: The Father of the eye, the Wise in spirit, created both these worlds submerged in fatness.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Father of the eye, the Wise in spirit, created both these worlds submerged in fatness.

verses.sanskrit:
विश्व॑कर्मन् ह॒विषा॒ वर्ध॑नेन त्रा॒तार॒मिन्द्र॑मकृणोरव॒ध्यम् ।
तस्मै॒ विश॒: सम॑नमन्त पू॒र्वीर॒यमु॒ग्रो वि॒हव्यो॒ यथाऽस॑त्
verses.translation: Mighty in mind and power is Visvakarman, Maker, Disposer, and most lofty Presence.
verses.hindi: वासनाओं के त्याग के दुद् निश्चय से ही हम वासनाओं को जीत सकगे। १. यत्र=जर्होँ, अर्थात् जिस स्थान से बाणाः=(शरो ह्यात्मा) प्रणवरूप धनुष के शर बने हुए आत्मा, निरन्तर प्रणव-जप में लगे आत्मा अथवा “वण् 10 5०76 ' प्रभु के नाम का निरन्तर जप करनेवाले आत्मा सम्पतन्ति-सम्यक् गतिशील होते है ओर अपने को सदा
verses.transliteration: viśvakarman haviṣā vardhanena trātāramindramakṛṇoravadhyam | tasmai viśa: samanamanta pūrvīrayamugro vihavyo yathā'sat
verses.wordMeaning: Mighty in mind and power is Visvakarman, Maker, Disposer, and most lofty Presence.
verses.commentary: Sense: Mighty in mind and power is Visvakarman, Maker, Disposer, and most lofty Presence.

verses.sanskrit:
चक्षु॑षः पि॒ता मन॑सा॒ हि धीरो॑ घृ॒तमे॑ने अजन॒न्नम्न॑माने ।
य॒देदन्ता॒ अद॑दृहन्त॒ पूर्व॒ आदिद् द्यावा॑पृथि॒वी अ॑प्रथेताम्
verses.translation: Then when the eastern ends were firmly fastened, the heavens and the earth were far extended.
verses.hindi: हम बाण हों, प्रभु लक्ष्य हों। हम शर की भति ब्रह्मरूप लक्ष्य में तन्मय हो जा्ेँ। यही कल्याण- प्राप्ति का साधन हेै। उरोर्वरीयो वरूणस्ते कृणोतु जय॑न्तं त्वानुं देवा म॑दन्तु ॥४९॥ ९. इस वासना-संग्राम में ते मर्माणि=तेरे मर्मस्थलों को वर्मणा-कवच से
verses.transliteration: cakṣuṣaḥ pitā manasā hi dhīro ghṛtamene ajanannamnamāne | yadedantā adadṛhanta pūrva ādid dyāvāpṛthivī aprathetām
verses.wordMeaning: Then when the eastern ends were firmly fastened, the heavens and the earth were far extended.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then when the eastern ends were firmly fastened, the heavens and the earth were far extended.

verses.sanskrit:
वि॒श्वक॑र्मा॒ विम॑ना॒ आद्विहा॑या धा॒ता वि॑धा॒ता प॑र॒मोत स॒न्दृक् ।
तेषा॑मि॒ष्टानि॒ समि॒षा म॑दन्ति॒ यत्रा॑ सप्त ऋ॒षीन् प॒र एक॑मा॒हुः
verses.translation: Their offerings joy in rich juice where they value One, only One beyond the Seven Rishis.
