verses.commentary: Sense: With Darbha-bunch, with fencing-wood, with spoon, with altar, holy grass, With laud , lead this our sacrifice to go to heaven among the Gods.

verses.sanskrit: यद्द॒त्तं यत्प॑रा॒दानं॒ यत्पू॒र्तं याश्च॒ दक्षि॑णाः । तद॒ग्निर्वै॑श्वकर्म॒णः स्व॑र्दे॒वेषु॑ नो दधत्
verses.translation: Our gifts, our charitable grants, our pious works, our fees to priests, May the Omnific's Agni set all this among the Gods in heaven.
verses.hindi: कामादि शत्रुओं को जीतने के लिए आवश्यक है कि हम (क ) आत्मालोचन करें (मृगः), (ख) कल्पनाओंं में न उडत रहकर पृथिवी पर विचरनेवाले बनें ( कुचरः), (ग) "गिरिष्ठा" बनें वेदवाणी के अनुकूल चले, (घ) क्रियाशीलता में आनन्द लें (सकम्), (ङ) पवित्रता को ज्ञानदीप्त करे (पविं तिग्मम्)।
verses.transliteration: yaddattaṃ yatparādānaṃ yatpūrtaṃ yāśca dakṣiṇāḥ | tadagnirvaiśvakarmaṇaḥ svardeveṣu no dadhat
verses.wordMeaning: Our gifts, our charitable grants, our pious works, our fees to priests, May the Omnific's Agni set all this among the Gods in heaven.
verses.commentary: Sense: Our gifts, our charitable grants, our pious works, our fees to priests, May the Omnific's Agni set all this among the Gods in heaven.

verses.sanskrit: यत्र॒ धारा॒ अन॑पेता॒ मधो॑र्घृ॒तस्य॑ च॒ याः । तद॒ग्निर्वै॑श्वकर्म॒णः स्व॑दे॒र्वेषु॑ नो दधत्
verses.translation: There where all never-failing streams of honey and of butter flow, May Agni, Visvakarman's own, place us in heaven among the Gods.
verses.hindi: (क) हम सब प्राणियों के हित कौ भावना से कार्यो में प्रवृत्त हों। (ख) हममे आगे बने की प्रवृत्ति हो। (ग) प्रभु के उत्तम स्तवन में प्रवृत्त हों। पृष्टो दिवि पृष्टोऽअग्निः पुंथिव्यां पृष्टो विशुवाऽओष॑धीराविंवेश। वैश्वानरः सह॑सा पुष्टोऽअग्निः स नो दिवा स रिषस्पातु नक्त॑म्।।७३॥
verses.transliteration: yatra dhārā anapetā madhorghṛtasya ca yāḥ | tadagnirvaiśvakarmaṇaḥ svaderveṣu no dadhat
verses.wordMeaning: There where all never-failing streams of honey and of butter flow, May Agni, Visvakarman's own, place us in heaven among the Gods.
verses.commentary: Sense: There where all never-failing streams of honey and of butter flow, May Agni, Visvakarman's own, place us in heaven among the Gods.

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒ग्निर॑स्मि॒ जन्म॑ना जा॒तवे॑दा घृ॒तं मे॒ चक्षु॑र॒मृतं॑ म आ॒सन् ।
अ॒र्कस्त्रि॒धातू॒ रज॑सो वि॒मानोऽज॑स्रो घ॒र्मो ह॒विर॑स्मि॒ नाम॑
verses.translation: Agni am who know by birth all creatures. Mine eye is butter, in my mouth is nectar. I am the triple light, the region's meter: exhaustless heat am I, named burnt oblation.
verses.hindi: हम प्रभु के जिज्ञासु भक्त बरनेगे तो धीमे-धीमे सर्वत्र हमें उस प्रभु कौ प्रभु-रक्षणा के चार त्नाभ अश्याम तं काममग्ने तवोतीऽअश्यामं रयिर॑यिवः सुवीरम्। १. गतमन्त्र की समाप्ति पर कहा था किवे प्रभु दिन-रात हमारी रक्षा करते हे। प्रस्तुत
verses.transliteration: agnirasmi janmanā jātavedā ghṛtaṃ me cakṣuramṛtaṃ ma āsan | arkastridhātū rajaso vimāno'jasro gharmo havirasmi nāma
verses.wordMeaning: Agni am who know by birth all creatures. Mine eye is butter, in my mouth is nectar. I am the triple light, the region's meter: exhaustless heat am I, named burnt oblation.
verses.commentary: Sense: Agni am who know by birth all creatures. Mine eye is butter, in my mouth is nectar. I am the triple light, the region's meter: exhaustless heat am I, named burnt oblation.

verses.sanskrit:
ऋचो॒ नामा॑स्मि॒ यजू॑ ᳪषि॒ नामा॑स्मि॒ सामा॑नि॒ नामा॑स्मि ।
ये अ॒ग्नय॒: पाञ्च॑जन्या अ॒स्यां पृ॑थि॒व्यामधि॑ ।
तेषा॑मसि॒ त्वमु॑त्त॒मः प्र नो॑ जी॒वात॑वे सुव
verses.translation: Praise-verses, sacrificial texts, and chanted hymns am I in name. Thou art the best of all the Fires among the fivefold race of man That burn upon this earth of ours. Speed thou us on to lengthened life.
verses.hindi: (क) हम अपनी इच्छा को प्रभु की इच्छा मेंमिलादे। (ख) नम्रतासे प्रभु का उपासन करते हुए उत्कृष्ट कर्मो में हाथो को व्यापृत रक्खें। (ग) यजिष्ठ मन से अपने जीवन को देवों से सङ्गत करें, दिव्य गुणों से पूर्णं करे। (घ) प्रभु का अनन्य चिन्तन करते हए अपनी सब न्यूनताओं को दूर करके अपना उत्तम पूरण करे।
verses.transliteration: ṛco nāmāsmi yajū ṣi nāmāsmi sāmāni nāmāsmi | ye agnaya: pāñcajanyā asyāṃ pṛthivyāmadhi | teṣāmasi tvamuttamaḥ pra no jīvātave suva
verses.wordMeaning: Praise-verses, sacrificial texts, and chanted hymns am I in name. Thou art the best of all the Fires among the fivefold race of man That burn upon this earth of ours. Speed thou us on to lengthened life.
verses.commentary: Sense: Praise-verses, sacrificial texts, and chanted hymns am I in name. Thou art the best of all the Fires among the fivefold race of man That burn upon this earth of ours. Speed thou us on to lengthened life.

verses.sanskrit: वार्त्र॑हत्याय॒ शव॑से पृतना॒षाह्या॑य च । इन्द्र॒ त्वाऽऽव॑र्तयामसि
verses.translation: O Indra, for the strength that slays Vritra and conquers in the fight We torn thee hitherward to us.
verses.hindi: हम 'अग्नि' आदि के उपासक बनकर अपनी तेजस्विता का रक्षण करे। ज्ञानियों से यज्ञ की प्रेरणा प्राप्त करके हम शुभ का साधन करे। १. गतमन्त्र का उत्कील ! तेजस्विता कौ रक्षा" व यज्लिय वृत्ति" के द्वारा प्रभु-प्राप्तिकी कामना करनेवाला होने से "उशनाः" नामवाला होता है। यह प्रभु कौ आराधना करता है कि
verses.transliteration: vārtrahatyāya śavase pṛtanāṣāhyāya ca | indra tvā''vartayāmasi
verses.wordMeaning: O Indra, for the strength that slays Vritra and conquers in the fight We torn thee hitherward to us.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Indra, for the strength that slays Vritra and conquers in the fight We torn thee hitherward to us.

verses.sanskrit:
स॒हदा॑नुं पुरुहूत क्षि॒यन्त॑मह॒स्तमि॑न्द्र॒ सं पि॑ण॒क् कुणा॑रुम् ।
अ॒भि वृ॒त्रं वर्ध॑मानं॒ पिया॑रुम॒पाद॑मिन्द्र त॒वसा॑ जघन्थ
verses.translation: Thou, Indra, much-invoked, didst crush to pieces, Kunâru, handless fiend who dwelt with Dânus. Thou with might, Indra, smotest dead the scorner, the footless Vritra as he waxed in vigour.
verses.hindi: प्रभु यविष्ठ है। दाश्वान् कौ रक्षा करते ह। हमें चाहिए कि ज्ञान व स्तुति वाणियों का ही उच्चारण करे ओर प्रभु के सुपुत्र बने। सूचना- इस अन्तिम मन्त्र मे उशनाः (प्रभु की प्राप्ति कौ कामनावाला) प्रभु का सुपुत्र बनना चाहता हे। प्रभु का सुपुत्र वही हो पाता है जो इस मानव-जीवन मेँ सोम कौ
verses.transliteration: sahadānuṃ puruhūta kṣiyantamahastamindra saṃ piṇak kuṇārum | abhi vṛtraṃ vardhamānaṃ piyārumapādamindra tavasā jaghantha
verses.wordMeaning: Thou, Indra, much-invoked, didst crush to pieces, Kunâru, handless fiend who dwelt with Dânus. Thou with might, Indra, smotest dead the scorner, the footless Vritra as he waxed in vigour.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thou, Indra, much-invoked, didst crush to pieces, Kunâru, handless fiend who dwelt with Dânus. Thou with might, Indra, smotest dead the scorner, the footless Vritra as he waxed in vigour.

verses.sanskrit:
वि न॑ इन्द्र॒ मृधो॑ जहि नी॒चा य॑च्छ पृतन्य॒तः ।
यो अ॒स्माँ२ अ॑भि॒दास॒त्यध॑रं गमया॒ तम॑:
verses.translation: O Indra, beat our foes away, etc. as in VIII. 44.
verses.hindi: मे जीवन में ज्येष्ठता का सम्पादन करू। ज्ञानी व तेजस्वी बनू प्राणशक्ति-सम्पत्न व आत्मसन्तोषवाला होऊँ। विजय व महत्त्व को प्राप्त करूं, परिवार व सम्पत्ति से बदँ, दीर्घ जीवन व वंश विस्तारवाला होऊ। धन, विद्यादि गुणों से उत्कृष्ट बन्ं। सत्यं च॑ मे श्रद्धा च॑ मे जग॑च्च ये धनं च ये विश्वं च मे मह॑श्च मे क्रीडा च॑
verses.transliteration: vi na indra mṛdho jahi nīcā yaccha pṛtanyataḥ | yo asmā~2 abhidāsatyadharaṃ gamayā tama:
verses.wordMeaning: O Indra, beat our foes away, etc. as in VIII. 44.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Indra, beat our foes away, etc. as in VIII. 44.

verses.sanskrit:
मृ॒गो न भी॒मः कु॑च॒रो गि॑रि॒ष्ठाः प॑रा॒वत॒ आ ज॑गन्था॒ पर॑स्याः ।
सृ॒कᳪ स॒ᳪशाय॑ प॒विमि॑न्द्र ति॒ग्मं वि शत्रू॑न् ताढि॒ वि मृधो॑ नुदस्व
verses.translation: Like some dread wild beast roaming on the mountain thou hast approached us from the farthest distance. Whetting thy bolt and thy sharp blade, O Indra, crush thou the foes and scatter those who hate us.
verses.hindi: मै ऋत के द्वारा अमृतत्व-अयक्ष्मत्व व अनामयत्व को सिद्ध करूं। मेरा जीवन पथ्य-सेवन से दीर्घायु तक चले। शत्रुता व भय से रहित होकर मै सुखी बनं एवं सुख की नींद सो सकूँ। मेरा प्रातःकाल उत्तम हो तथा सारा दिन सुन्दरता से व्यतीत हो। १. पिछले मन्त्र मेँ “सुदिन' पर समाप्ति हुई धी कि मेरा सारा दिन उत्तमता से बीते।
verses.transliteration: mṛgo na bhīmaḥ kucaro giriṣṭhāḥ parāvata ā jaganthā parasyāḥ | sṛka saśāya pavimindra tigmaṃ vi śatrūn tāḍhi vi mṛdho nudasva
verses.wordMeaning: Like some dread wild beast roaming on the mountain thou hast approached us from the farthest distance. Whetting thy bolt and thy sharp blade, O Indra, crush thou the foes and scatter those who hate us.
verses.commentary: Sense: Like some dread wild beast roaming on the mountain thou hast approached us from the farthest distance. Whetting thy bolt and thy sharp blade, O Indra, crush thou the foes and scatter those who hate us.

verses.sanskrit: वै॒श्वा॒न॒रो न॑ ऊ॒तय॒ आ प्र या॑तु परा॒वत॑: । अ॒ग्निर्न॑: सुष्टु॒तीरुप॑
verses.translation: To aid us let Vaisvânara come from the distance far away: Come Agni, to our eulogies!
verses.hindi: - प्रभुकृपा से मुद्ध वसु व वसति की प्राप्ति हो। कर्मो द्वारा मेँ शक्तिसम्पत्न बनू। मेरे कार्य निष्प्रयोजन न हो जीवन निरुदेश्य न हो। मैं उदेश्य की ओर चलँ ओर उसे प्राप्त अग्निश्च मऽ इन्द्र॑श्च मे सोम॑श्च मऽ इन्द्र॑श्च मे सविता च॑ म॒ऽडन्द्र॑श्च मे सर॑स्वती च मऽडन्द्रश्च मे पूषा च॑ मऽडइन्द्र्॑च मे बृहस्पतिश्च म॒ऽइन्द्र॑श्च मे यज्ञेन : मेरे ये सब पदार्थ होम कौ क्रिया करने से समर्थ हों। यज्ञ आदि उत्तम कर्मो में इन पदार्थो की नियुक्ति सेमे प्रभु-प्राप्ति के लिए समर्थं बनू। अग्निश्च मे घर्मश्च मेऽर्कश्च मे सूर्यश्च मे प्राणश्च मे ऽवमेधण्च मे पृथिवी च १. अग्निः च मे=मेरे जीवन के अन्दर अग्नि हो, घर्मः च मेम शक्ति कौ
verses.transliteration: vaiśvānaro na ūtaya ā pra yātu parāvata: | agnirna: suṣṭutīrupa
verses.wordMeaning: To aid us let Vaisvânara come from the distance far away: Come Agni, to our eulogies!
verses.commentary: Sense: To aid us let Vaisvânara come from the distance far away: Come Agni, to our eulogies!

verses.sanskrit:
पृ॒ष्टो दि॒वि पृ॒ष्टो अ॒ग्निः पृ॑थि॒व्यां पृ॒ष्टो विश्वा॒ ओष॑धी॒रा वि॑वेश ।
वै॒श्वा॒न॒रः सह॑सा पृ॒ष्टो अ॒ग्निः स नो॒ दिवा॒ स रि॒षस्पा॑तु॒ नक्त॑म्
verses.translation: Sought in the sky, sought on the earth, sought after, all plants that grow on ground hath Agni entered. May Agni, may Vaisvânara with vigour, sought for, by day and night from harm preserve us.
verses.hindi: प्रभुकृपा से मुञ्में आगे बने का उत्साह हो, उससे मेँ शक्तिसम्पन्न बना रहू। मुञ्में प्रभु -उपासन हो, उससे मुञ्चमें ज्ञान के सूर्य का उदय हो। मुञ्चमें प्राणशक्ति हो ओर वह राष्ट्-सेवा मे लगे। मेरे शरीर की शक्तियों का विस्तार हो ओर वहाँ रोगजनित खण्डन न हों। वासनाओं का खण्डन करके मैं ज्ञान के प्रकाशवाला वनूँ। उस ज्लान के अनुसार
verses.transliteration: pṛṣṭo divi pṛṣṭo agniḥ pṛthivyāṃ pṛṣṭo viśvā oṣadhīrā viveśa | vaiśvānaraḥ sahasā pṛṣṭo agniḥ sa no divā sa riṣaspātu naktam
verses.wordMeaning: Sought in the sky, sought on the earth, sought after, all plants that grow on ground hath Agni entered. May Agni, may Vaisvânara with vigour, sought for, by day and night from harm preserve us.
verses.commentary: Sense: Sought in the sky, sought on the earth, sought after, all plants that grow on ground hath Agni entered. May Agni, may Vaisvânara with vigour, sought for, by day and night from harm preserve us.

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒श्याम॒ तं काम॑मग्ने॒ तवो॒ती अ॒श्याम॑ र॒यिᳪ र॑यिवः सु॒वीर॑म् ।
अ॒श्याम॒ वाज॑म॒भि वा॒जय॑न्तो॒ऽश्याम॑ द्यु॒म्नम॑जरा॒जरं॑ ते
verses.translation: Help its that we may gain this wish, O Agni, gain riches, Wealthy One! with store of heroes. Desiring strength from thee may we be strengthened, and win, Eternal! thine eternal glory.
verses.hindi: प्रभु की उपासना से मेँ व्रती, ऋतुओं के अनुसार नियमित जीवनवाला, वृद्धिशील तथा शरीर-रथ से जीवन-यात्रा को तीर्णं करनेवाला बनूं। कएकां च मे तिस्रश्च मे तिस्रश्च मे पञ्च॑ च मे पञ्च॑ च मे सप्त च॑ मे सप्त च॑ मे नव॑च मे नव॑ च मऽएकादश च मऽएकांदश च मे त्रयोदश चये त्रयोदश च गोरक्षा द्वारा गोदुग्ध को अपना मुख्य भोजन बनाकर मे सात्विक बनू, दिव्य गुणोवाला बनं। आदित्य बनकर जीवनयात्रा को पूर्णं करूं। १. प्रस्तुत मन्त्र मे वाजादि शब्दों से चैत्रादि मासों का उल्लेख करके कहते है कि उस-उस मास के लिए स्वाहा=-हम सम्यक् आहुति देते है-(क) वाजायचेत्र मास के
verses.transliteration: aśyāma taṃ kāmamagne tavotī aśyāma rayi rayivaḥ suvīram | aśyāma vājamabhi vājayanto'śyāma dyumnamajarājaraṃ te
verses.wordMeaning: Help its that we may gain this wish, O Agni, gain riches, Wealthy One! with store of heroes. Desiring strength from thee may we be strengthened, and win, Eternal! thine eternal glory.
verses.commentary: Sense: Help its that we may gain this wish, O Agni, gain riches, Wealthy One! with store of heroes. Desiring strength from thee may we be strengthened, and win, Eternal! thine eternal glory.

verses.sanskrit:
व॒यं ते॑ अ॒द्य र॑रि॒मा हि काम॑मुत्ता॒नह॑स्ता॒ नम॑सोप॒सद्य॑ ।
यजि॑ष्ठेन॒ मन॑सा यक्षि दे॒वानस्रे॑धता॒ मन्म॑ना॒ विप्रो॑ अग्ने
verses.translation: Approaching with raised hands and adoration, we have this day fulfilled for thee thy longing. Worship the Gods with most devoted spirit as Priest with no unfriendly thought. O Agni.
verses.hindi: राजा 'ऋताषाट्, ऋतधामा, अग्नि व गन्धर्व" हो। उसके अध्यक्ष ' ओषधि व मुद्' हो ये प्रजा करे ब्रह्यव क्षत्र कौ रक्षा करें। प्रजाँ राजा को कर दे। राजा उस करका प्रजाहित में ही विनियोग करे। प्रजाँ अप्सरो को कार्य मे सुविधा प्ुचाने का प्रयत्न करे। १. संहितः =( सन्दधाति) यह सम्राट् अपनी प्रजाओं में अधिक-से-अधिक मेल पैदा
verses.transliteration: vayaṃ te adya rarimā hi kāmamuttānahastā namasopasadya | yajiṣṭhena manasā yakṣi devānasredhatā manmanā vipro agne
verses.wordMeaning: Approaching with raised hands and adoration, we have this day fulfilled for thee thy longing. Worship the Gods with most devoted spirit as Priest with no unfriendly thought. O Agni.
verses.commentary: Sense: Approaching with raised hands and adoration, we have this day fulfilled for thee thy longing. Worship the Gods with most devoted spirit as Priest with no unfriendly thought. O Agni.

verses.sanskrit: धा॒म॒च्छद॒ग्निरिन्द्रो॑ ब्र॒ह्मा दे॒वो बृह॒स्पति॑: । सचे॑तसो॒ विश्वे॑ दे॒वा य॒ज्ञं प्राव॑न्तु नः शु॒भे
verses.translation: Home-hider Agni, Indra, and Brahma, and bright Brihaspati— May the All Gods, one-minded, guard our sacrifice in happy place.
verses.hindi: - राष्ट मे कोई भूखा न मरे। राजा एेसी व्यवस्था करे कि प्रजा के जीवन में न्यूनतापं उत्पन्न न हों। अध्यक्ष कुशलता से कार्य करे। इतनी कुशलता से कि वे प्रजा मे प्रशंसित हो। १. सम्रार् का कर्त्तव्य एक शब्द में यह है कि वह प्रजापतिः प्रजा का पालक हो। प्रजा रक्षा कर उदेश्य से दही राजा ने उस-उस कार्य को करना है। २. विषशवकर्मा-यह राजा हम यज्ञशील बनकर 'स्व-गा' आत्मा कौ ओर चलनेवाले बनें। इस आत्मा की ओर चलते हुए हम उसी के छोटे रूप बरने। “गा ओर "लव ' नें। गालव बनकर हम दिव्य गुणों के धारण के लिए नम्र बनें। नम्रता ही दिव्य गुणों कौ जननी हे। इन दिव्य गुणों को पैदा करके ही हम महादेव को पार्णेगे।
verses.transliteration: dhāmacchadagnirindro brahmā devo bṛhaspati: | sacetaso viśve devā yajñaṃ prāvantu naḥ śubhe
verses.wordMeaning: Home-hider Agni, Indra, and Brahma, and bright Brihaspati— May the All Gods, one-minded, guard our sacrifice in happy place.
verses.commentary: Sense: Home-hider Agni, Indra, and Brahma, and bright Brihaspati— May the All Gods, one-minded, guard our sacrifice in happy place.

verses.sanskrit: त्वं य॑विष्ठ दा॒शुषो॒ नॄँ: पा॑हि शृणु॒धी गिर॑: । रक्षा॑ तो॒कमु॒त त्मना॑
verses.translation: Guard thou the Sacrificer's men, O Youthfullest, etc., as in XIII. 52.
verses.hindi: प्रभुके रक्षण से हम १. अपनी इष्ट कामनाओं को सिद्ध करनेवाले बनें। २. वीरतायुक्त धन के स्वामी हों, ३. वासनाओंं के साथ संग्राम करके उनके विजय से शरीर में शक्ति व मस्तिष्क में ज्ञान को भरनेवाले हों, ४. हम उस अजर प्रभु की ज्ञान-ज्योति को अपनी इच्छा को प्रभु-इच्छामें
verses.transliteration: tvaṃ yaviṣṭha dāśuṣo nṝ~: pāhi śṛṇudhī gira: | rakṣā tokamuta tmanā
verses.wordMeaning: Guard thou the Sacrificer's men, O Youthfullest, etc., as in XIII. 52.
verses.commentary: Sense: Guard thou the Sacrificer's men, O Youthfullest, etc., as in XIII. 52.

verses.sanskrit:
स्वा॒द्वीं त्वा॑ स्वा॒दुना॑ ती॒व्रां ती॒व्रेणा॒मृता॑म॒मृते॑न । मधु॑मतीं॒ मधु॑मता सृ॒जामि॒ सᳪ सोमे॑न ।
सोमो॑ऽस्य॒श्विभ्यां॑ पच्यस्व॒ सर॑स्वत्यै पच्य॒स्वेन्द्रा॑य सु॒त्राम्णे॑ पच्यस्व
verses.translation: com The Texts of the White Yajurveda, tr. Ralph T.H. Griffith, [1899], SWEET with the sweet, I sprinkle thee with Soma, strong with the strong, the nectar with the nectar, The honey-sweet with what is sweet as honey. Soma art thou. Get dressed for the Asvins. Get dressed for Sarasvatî. Get dressed for Indra the Good Deliverer.
verses.hindi: हम सोम को शरीर मे ही सुरक्षित कर। सोम कौ रक्षा करे लिए प्रभु का पूजन व कर्मो में व्याप्ति आवश्यश्क हे। प्रभु-स्मरणपूर्वक कर्मरत पुरुष सोम को वासनाओं से विनष्ट नहीं होने देता। १. गतमन्त्र में वर्णित स्रोमः=सोम वायोः=वायु के द्वारा पूतः=पवित्र होता है, अर्थात्
verses.transliteration: svādvīṃ tvā svādunā tīvrāṃ tīvreṇāmṛtāmamṛtena | madhumatīṃ madhumatā sṛjāmi sa somena | somo'syaśvibhyāṃ pacyasva sarasvatyai pacyasvendrāya sutrāmṇe pacyasva
verses.wordMeaning: com The Texts of the White Yajurveda, tr. Ralph T.H. Griffith, [1899], SWEET with the sweet, I sprinkle thee with Soma, strong with the strong, the nectar with the nectar, The honey-sweet with what is sweet as honey. Soma art thou. Get dressed for the Asvins.…
verses.commentary: Sense: com The Texts of the White Yajurveda, tr. Ralph T.H. Griffith, [1899], SWEET with the sweet, I sprinkle thee with Soma, strong with the strong, the nectar with the nectar, The honey-sweet with what is sweet as honey. Soma art thou. Get dressed for the Asvins.…

verses.sanskrit:
परी॒तो षि॑ञ्च॒ता सु॒तᳪ सोमो॒ य उ॑त्त॒मᳪ ह॒विः ।
द॒ध॒न्वा यो नर्यो॑ अ॒प्स्वन्तरा सु॒षाव॒ सोम॒मद्रि॑भिः
verses.translation: Hence pour ye forth the flowing juice, Soma, best Sacrificial food. He who, man's friend, hath run within the waters hath with the pressing-stones poured out the Soma.
verses.hindi: प्राणायाम के द्वारा सोम शरीर में ही गमनवाला होकर ऊर्ध्वं गमनवाला होता हे। ज्ानाग्नि के दीपन मे इसका व्यय होता है। इसके रक्षण से मनुष्य खूब क्रियामय जोवनवाला होता है ओर सदा प्रभु का मित्र बनता है १. प्रभु ' आभूति' से कहते है कि तेतर परिस्तरुतम्-शरीर में सर्वतः प्राप्त इस
verses.transliteration: parīto ṣiñcatā suta somo ya uttama haviḥ | dadhanvā yo naryo apsvantarā suṣāva somamadribhiḥ
verses.wordMeaning: Hence pour ye forth the flowing juice, Soma, best Sacrificial food. He who, man's friend, hath run within the waters hath with the pressing-stones poured out the Soma.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence pour ye forth the flowing juice, Soma, best Sacrificial food. He who, man's friend, hath run within the waters hath with the pressing-stones poured out the Soma.

verses.sanskrit: वा॒योः पू॒तः प॒वित्रे॑ण प्र॒त्यङ्क्सोमो॒ अति॑द्रुतः । इन्द्र॑स्य॒ युज्य॒: सखा॑
verses.translation: Purified by Vâyu's strainer, Soma that has passed away forward is Indra's proper friend. Purified by Vâyu's strainer, Soma that has passed away backward is Indra's proper friend.
verses.hindi: श्रद्धा सोम को पवित्र करती हे, क्योंकि यह वासनाओं का निवारण करती है, हमें स्पूर्ति-सम्पतन व कर्मठ बनाती है तथा शक्तियों के विस्तार के लिए प्रेरित करती ठै। शुक्रेण देव देवता: पिपृग्धि रसेनान्नं यज॑मानाय धेहि ॥५॥ ९. सुतः = उत्पन्न हुञा सोमः यह सोम सुरया=( सुरा 10 ०ला11. 10 111€) शासन के
verses.transliteration: vāyoḥ pūtaḥ pavitreṇa pratyaṅksomo atidrutaḥ | indrasya yujya: sakhā
verses.wordMeaning: Purified by Vâyu's strainer, Soma that has passed away forward is Indra's proper friend. Purified by Vâyu's strainer, Soma that has passed away backward is Indra's proper friend.
verses.commentary: Sense: Purified by Vâyu's strainer, Soma that has passed away forward is Indra's proper friend. Purified by Vâyu's strainer, Soma that has passed away backward is Indra's proper friend.

verses.sanskrit: पु॒नाति॑ ते परि॒स्रुत॒ᳪ सोम॒ᳪ सूर्य॑स्य दुहि॒ता । वारे॑ण॒ शश्व॑ता॒ तना॑
verses.translation: By means of this eternal sieve may Sûrya's Daughter purify The Soma that flows forth from thee.
verses.hindi: हम रस व अन्न का सेवन करें। उससे उत्पन्न सोम हमारे ज्ञान, बल व तेज को बद्धाएगा, हमारी इच्दरियों की शक्ति का वर्धन करेगा, उल्लास का कारण बनेगा ओर हमें दिव्य गुणयुक्त जीवनवाला बनाएगा, अतः हम सोम को शरीर मेँ ही नियन्त्रित करें ( सुरया) । ऋषि :-आभूतिः। देवता- इन्द्रः। छन्द :-विराट्प्रक्रतिः। स्वरः-धेवतः॥
verses.transliteration: punāti te parisruta soma sūryasya duhitā | vāreṇa śaśvatā tanā
verses.wordMeaning: By means of this eternal sieve may Sûrya's Daughter purify The Soma that flows forth from thee.
verses.commentary: Sense: By means of this eternal sieve may Sûrya's Daughter purify The Soma that flows forth from thee.

verses.sanskrit:
ब्रह्म॑ क्ष॒त्रं प॑वते॒ तेज॑ इन्द्रि॒यᳪ सुर॑या॒ सोम॑: सु॒त आसु॑तो॒ मदा॑य ।
शु॒क्रेण॑ देव दे॒वता॑: पिपृग्धि॒ रसे॒नान्नं॒ यज॑मानाय धेहि
verses.translation: Soma with Wine, pressed; filtered for the banquet, cleanses priest, noble, brilliancy and vigour. God, with the Bright give Deities enjoyment: give food with flavour to the Sacrificer.
verses.hindi: प्रभु-उपासन हमारे जीवन में "मोद, आनन्द व महस्" को भरनेवाला होता है। १. गतमन्त्र में "प्रभु करे उपासन से 'महस्' की प्राप्ति होती है' एेसा कहा था। उसी का व्याख्यान प्रस्तुत मन्त्र मेँ करते है -तेजः असि-हे प्रभो! आप तेज के पुञ्ज हें, मूर्तिमान् तेज है। मयि-मुङ्ञमे तेजः=तेज का धेहि-आधान कीलजिए। मेरा यह अन्नमयकोश तेजस्वी
verses.transliteration: brahma kṣatraṃ pavate teja indriya surayā soma: suta āsuto madāya | śukreṇa deva devatā: pipṛgdhi rasenānnaṃ yajamānāya dhehi
verses.wordMeaning: Soma with Wine, pressed; filtered for the banquet, cleanses priest, noble, brilliancy and vigour. God, with the Bright give Deities enjoyment: give food with flavour to the Sacrificer.
verses.commentary: Sense: Soma with Wine, pressed; filtered for the banquet, cleanses priest, noble, brilliancy and vigour. God, with the Bright give Deities enjoyment: give food with flavour to the Sacrificer.

verses.sanskrit:
कु॒विद॒ङ्ग यव॑मन्तो॒ यवं॑ चि॒द्यथा॒ दान्त्य॑नुपू॒र्वं वि॒यूय॑ ।
इ॒हेहै॑षां कृणुहि॒ भोज॑नानि॒ ये ब॒र्हिषो॒ नम॑ उक्तिं॒ यज॑न्ति ।
उ॒प॒या॒मगृ॑हीतोऽस्य॒श्विभ्यां॑ त्वा॒ सर॑स्वत्यै॒ त्वेन्द्रा॑य त्वा सु॒त्राम्ण॑ ए॒ष ते॒ योनि॒स्तेज॑से त्वा वी॒र्या॒य त्वा॒ बला॑य त्वा
verses.translation: What then? As men whose fields are full of barley, etc., as in X. 32. Taken upon a base art thou. I take thee for the Asvin Pair. Thee for Sarasvatî. Thee for Indra the Good Deliverer. This is thy home. For splendour thee. Thee for mans’ vigour. Thee for strength.
verses.hindi: हम शक्ति-सम्पादन करके अपने को पापों व कष्टो से बचानेवाले हो। यदांपिपेष॑ मातर पुत्रः प्रमुदितो धय॑न्। एतत्तद॑ग्नेऽअनृणो भ॑वाम्यह॑तौ पितरौ १. गतमन्त्र के अनुसार शक्तिशाली बनकर उत्तम जीवनवाले माता-पिता उत्तम सन्तान को ही जन्म देते है। उस समय वे कहते है कि यदा=जव प्रमुदितः =प्रकृष्ट प्रसत्नतावाला,
verses.transliteration: kuvidaṅga yavamanto yavaṃ cidyathā dāntyanupūrvaṃ viyūya | ihehaiṣāṃ kṛṇuhi bhojanāni ye barhiṣo nama uktiṃ yajanti | upayāmagṛhīto'syaśvibhyāṃ tvā sarasvatyai tvendrāya tvā sutrāmṇa eṣa te yonistejase tvā vīryāya tvā balāya tvā
verses.wordMeaning: What then? As men whose fields are full of barley, etc., as in X. 32. Taken upon a base art thou. I take thee for the Asvin Pair. Thee for Sarasvatî. Thee for Indra the Good Deliverer. This is thy home. For splendour thee. Thee for mans’ vigour. Thee for strength.
verses.commentary: Sense: What then? As men whose fields are full of barley, etc., as in X. 32. Taken upon a base art thou. I take thee for the Asvin Pair. Thee for Sarasvatî. Thee for Indra the Good Deliverer. This is thy home. For splendour thee. Thee for mans’ vigour. Thee for strength.

verses.sanskrit:
नाना॒ हि वां॑ दे॒वहि॑त॒ᳪ सद॑स्कृ॒तं मा सᳪ सृ॑क्षाथां पर॒मे व्यो॑मन् ।
सुरा॒ त्वमसि॑ शु॒ष्मिणी॒ सोम॑ ए॒ष मा मा॑ हिᳪसी॒: स्वां योनि॑मावि॒शन्ती॑
verses.translation: For each of you is made a God-appointed place: so grant to me a portion in the highest sphere. Surâ the strong art thou. This here is Soma. Entering thine own place do me no mischief.
verses.hindi: हम सदा उत्तम कर्मो मे व्यापृत रहकर प्राणापान कौ शक्ति से नीरोग लने तथा लान के द्वारा पवित्र बनें। यह नीरोगता व पवित्रता हमें सर्वाङ्धं सम्पूर्णं जौवनवाला १. पिक्छले मन्त्र मेँ देवों द्वारा यज्ञ-विस्तार का संकेत था। उसरी यज्ञ को जीवन में लाने करे लिए प्रस्तुत मन्त्र में कहते है कि दीश्चायै= (दीक्षायाः षष्ठ्यर्थ चतुर्थ ) त्रत ग्रहण का
verses.transliteration: nānā hi vāṃ devahita sadaskṛtaṃ mā sa sṛkṣāthāṃ parame vyoman | surā tvamasi śuṣmiṇī soma eṣa mā mā hisī: svāṃ yonimāviśantī
verses.wordMeaning: For each of you is made a God-appointed place: so grant to me a portion in the highest sphere. Surâ the strong art thou. This here is Soma. Entering thine own place do me no mischief.
verses.commentary: Sense: For each of you is made a God-appointed place: so grant to me a portion in the highest sphere. Surâ the strong art thou. This here is Soma. Entering thine own place do me no mischief.

verses.sanskrit:
उ॒प॒या॒मगृ॑हीतो॒ऽस्याश्वि॑नं॒ तेज॑: सारस्व॒तं वी॒र्य॒मै॒न्द्रं बल॑म् ।
ए॒ष ते॒ योनि॒र्मोदा॑य त्वा ऽऽन॒न्दाय॑ त्वा॒ मह॑से त्वा
verses.translation: Taken upon a base art thou. Splendour of Asvins, Sarasvatî's manly vigour, might of Indra. This is thy home. I take thee for enjoyment. I take thee for delight, take thee for greatness.
verses.hindi: प्रभु कौ ओर चलनेवाले को सभी मास सुन्दर लगते है। महान् वीर वह है जो स्वयं भूखा रहकर भी ओरो को खिलाता है। आचार्य चरणों में रहनेवाला आत्म- नियन्त्रण व ज्ञान कौ साधना करता हे। १. तेरहवे मन्त्र मेँ का था कि “सोमक्रय' सोम का खरीदार बनने का निरूपक चि
verses.transliteration: upayāmagṛhīto'syāśvinaṃ teja: sārasvataṃ vīryamaindraṃ balam | eṣa te yonirmodāya tvā ''nandāya tvā mahase tvā
verses.wordMeaning: Taken upon a base art thou. Splendour of Asvins, Sarasvatî's manly vigour, might of Indra. This is thy home. I take thee for enjoyment. I take thee for delight, take thee for greatness.
verses.commentary: Sense: Taken upon a base art thou. Splendour of Asvins, Sarasvatî's manly vigour, might of Indra. This is thy home. I take thee for enjoyment. I take thee for delight, take thee for greatness.

verses.sanskrit: तेजो॑ऽसि॒ तेजो॒ मयि॑ धेहि वी॒र्य॒मसि वी॒र्यं मयि॑ धेहि बल॑मसि॒ बलं॒ मयि॑ धे॒ह्योजो॒ऽस्योजो॒ मयि॑ धेहि  म॒न्युर॑सि म॒न्युं मयि॑ धेहि॒ सहो॑ऽसि॒ सहो॒ मयि॑ धेहि
verses.translation: Thou art lustre: give me lustre, Thou art manly vigour: give me manly vigour. Thou art strength: give me strength. Thou art energy: give me energy. Thou art passion: Give me passion. Thou art conquering might: give me conquering might.
verses.hindi: सोम का क्रय तो उसने ही किया जिसने कि इसे अद्ध प्रत्यङ्ख में सिक्त करके रोगों का निवर्तक बनाया ओर आत्मशक्ति के विकास तथा ज्ञानवृद्धि के द्वारा परमात्मा-प्राप्ति का साधन बनाया। आखन्दी रूपध्राजासन्है वेद्य कुम्भी सुंराधानीं।
verses.transliteration: tejo'si tejo mayi dhehi vīryamasi vīryaṃ mayi dhehi balamasi balaṃ mayi dhehyojo'syojo mayi dhehi manyurasi manyuṃ mayi dhehi saho'si saho mayi dhehi
verses.wordMeaning: Thou art lustre: give me lustre, Thou art manly vigour: give me manly vigour. Thou art strength: give me strength. Thou art energy: give me energy. Thou art passion: Give me passion. Thou art conquering might: give me conquering might.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thou art lustre: give me lustre, Thou art manly vigour: give me manly vigour. Thou art strength: give me strength. Thou art energy: give me energy. Thou art passion: Give me passion. Thou art conquering might: give me conquering might.

verses.sanskrit: या व्या॒घ्रं विषू॑चिकोभौ॒ वृकं॑ च॒ रक्ष॑ति । श्ये॒नं प॑त॒त्रिण॑ᳪ सि॒ᳪहᳪ सेमं पा॒त्वᳪह॑सः
verses.translation: My she, Vishûchikâ, who guards these two, the tiger and the wolf, The lion and the wingd hawk, may she guard this man from distress.
verses.hindi: सोम को अपनी आसन्दी बनाकर हम राजा नें। इस सोमासन्दी से जीवन मै आनन्द का सञ्चार करे। ज्ञानी बनकर नियन्त्रित जीवनवाले हौं। उत्कृष्ट ज्ञानी बनकर सदा आत्मनिरीक्षण करे। कर्मो में लगे रहकर आधि-व्याधियों के वशमेंनहो। सन्तान माता-पिता कर अनुरूप
verses.transliteration: yā vyāghraṃ viṣūcikobhau vṛkaṃ ca rakṣati | śyenaṃ patatriṇa siha semaṃ pātvahasaḥ
verses.wordMeaning: My she, Vishûchikâ, who guards these two, the tiger and the wolf, The lion and the wingd hawk, may she guard this man from distress.
verses.commentary: Sense: My she, Vishûchikâ, who guards these two, the tiger and the wolf, The lion and the wingd hawk, may she guard this man from distress.

verses.sanskrit:
यदा॑पि॒पेष॑ मा॒तरं॑ पु॒त्रः प्रमु॑दितो॒ धय॑न् । ए॒तत्तद॑ग्ने अनृ॒णो भ॑वा॒म्यह॑तौ पि॒तरौ॒ मया॑ ।
स॒म्पृच॑ स्थ॒ सं मा॑ भ॒द्रेण॑ पृङ्क्त वि॒पृच॑ स्थ॒ वि मा॑ पा॒प्मना॑ पृङ्क्त
verses.translation: When, a delighted boy, I bruised my mother as I sucked her breast, Free from my debt, O Agni, I become thereby. My parents are by me unharmed. United are ye all: with bliss unite me. Parted are ye, keep me apart from evil.
verses.hindi: -सन्तान माता-पिता के अनुरूप होते है। ज्ञानी का ज्ञान सम्पन्न, निर्वासन का वासनाशुन्य ओर शक्तिसम्पत्त, सदगुणसम्पन्न का सद्गुणी तथा उन्नतिशील का उत्रतिशील ९.यत्-यदि अश्विनाप्राणापान अपेक्षित है तो आवश्यक है कि हम 'हविधरनिं' अग्निकुण्ड में हवि का आह्वान करें. अर्थात् घर में नियम से अग्निहोत्र कर। इससे
verses.transliteration: yadāpipeṣa mātaraṃ putraḥ pramudito dhayan | etattadagne anṛṇo bhavāmyahatau pitarau mayā | sampṛca stha saṃ mā bhadreṇa pṛṅkta vipṛca stha vi mā pāpmanā pṛṅkta
verses.wordMeaning: When, a delighted boy, I bruised my mother as I sucked her breast, Free from my debt, O Agni, I become thereby. My parents are by me unharmed. United are ye all: with bliss unite me. Parted are ye, keep me apart from evil.
verses.commentary: Sense: When, a delighted boy, I bruised my mother as I sucked her breast, Free from my debt, O Agni, I become thereby. My parents are by me unharmed. United are ye all: with bliss unite me. Parted are ye, keep me apart from evil.

verses.sanskrit: दे॒वा य॒ज्ञम॑तन्वत भेष॒जं भि॒षजा॒ऽश्विना॑ । वा॒चा सर॑स्वती भि॒षगिन्द्रा॑येन्द्रि॒याणि॒ दध॑तः
verses.translation: The Asvins, the Physicians, Gods, stretched out the healing sacrifice, Sarasvatî with speech was a Physician, all with heroic powers investing Indra.
verses.hindi: हमारा घ्र हविधनि हो, अग्नीध्र, एेन्द्रसदस् तथा पत्नीशाल हो। उसमें अग्निहोत्र, आचार्यो से ज्ञानोपार्जन, प्रभु का उपासन तथा गृह-सम्बन्धी कार्य उत्तमता खे सूचना पत्नीशालं गार्हपत्यः" शब्द से यह बात स्पष्ट है कि पत्नी का स्थान घर में है, उसे गृहकृत्यों मे निपुण बनकर घर के कार्यो को उत्तमता खे करना है।
verses.transliteration: devā yajñamatanvata bheṣajaṃ bhiṣajā'śvinā | vācā sarasvatī bhiṣagindrāyendriyāṇi dadhataḥ
verses.wordMeaning: The Asvins, the Physicians, Gods, stretched out the healing sacrifice, Sarasvatî with speech was a Physician, all with heroic powers investing Indra.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Asvins, the Physicians, Gods, stretched out the healing sacrifice, Sarasvatî with speech was a Physician, all with heroic powers investing Indra.

verses.sanskrit: दी॒क्षायै॑ रू॒पᳪ शष्पा॑णि प्राय॒णीय॑स्य॒ तोक्मा॑नि । क्र॒यस्य॑ रू॒पᳪ सोम॑स्य ला॒जाः सो॑मा॒ᳪशवो॒ मधु॑
verses.translation: Symbols of Dîkshâ are grass buds, of Prâyanîya sprouts of corn, Of Soma-purchasing fried grains are symbols, Soma-shoots and meath.
verses.hindi: माता-पिता का उत्तम आचरण सन्तान को भी सच्चरित्र बनाता हे। ऋषि :-हैमवर्चिः। देवता-यजमानः। छन्दः-भुरिगुष्णिक्। स्वरः-ऋषभः।) १. पशुभिः=पशुओं से पशुन्=-पशुओं को आप्नोततिनप्राप्त करता है। यदि दौर्भाग्यवश माता-पिता में “कामः पशुः क्रोधः पशुः" इस उपनिषद् वाक्य के अनुसार काम-क्रोधादि
verses.transliteration: dīkṣāyai rūpa śaṣpāṇi prāyaṇīyasya tokmāni | krayasya rūpa somasya lājāḥ somāśavo madhu
verses.wordMeaning: Symbols of Dîkshâ are grass buds, of Prâyanîya sprouts of corn, Of Soma-purchasing fried grains are symbols, Soma-shoots and meath.
verses.commentary: Sense: Symbols of Dîkshâ are grass buds, of Prâyanîya sprouts of corn, Of Soma-purchasing fried grains are symbols, Soma-shoots and meath.

verses.sanskrit: आ॒ति॒थ्य॒रू॒पं मास॑रं महावी॒रस्य॑ न॒ग्नहु॑: । रू॒पमु॑प॒सदा॑मे॒तत्ति॒स्रो रात्री॒: सुराऽऽसु॑ता
verses.translation: Âtithya's sign is Mâsara, the Gharma's symbol Nagnahu. Three nights with Surâ poured, this is the symbol of the Upasads.
verses.hindi: माता-पिता का पाशविक आचरण सन्तानो को पशुतुल्य बना देता हे। ऋषि:- हैमवर्चिः। देवता-सोमः। छन्द:- अनुष्टुप्। स्वरः--गान्धारः॥ धानाः करम्भः सक्तवः परीवापः पयो दधि। १. गतमन्त्रो का विषय “उत्तम सन्तान कौ प्राप्ति कैसे हो सकती ह ', यह था। अपनी
verses.transliteration: ātithyarūpaṃ māsaraṃ mahāvīrasya nagnahu: | rūpamupasadāmetattisro rātrī: surā''sutā
verses.wordMeaning: Âtithya's sign is Mâsara, the Gharma's symbol Nagnahu. Three nights with Surâ poured, this is the symbol of the Upasads.
verses.commentary: Sense: Âtithya's sign is Mâsara, the Gharma's symbol Nagnahu. Three nights with Surâ poured, this is the symbol of the Upasads.

verses.sanskrit: सोम॑स्य रू॒पं क्री॒तस्य॑ परि॒स्रुत्परि॑ षिच्यते । अ॒श्विभ्यां॑ दु॒ग्धं भे॑ष॒जमिन्द्रा॑यै॒न्द्रᳪ सर॑स्वत्या
verses.translation: Emblem of purchased Soma is Parisrut, foaming drink effused: Indra's balm milked for Indra by the Asvins and Sarasvatî.
verses.hindi: हम हविष्य पदार्थो का ही सेवन करें, जिससे शुद्धान्तकरणोवाले हौ सकर। सक्तूनाश्शरूपं बरद॑रमुपवाकाः करम्भस्य ।॥ २२॥ १. गतमन्त्र मे धान आदि हविष्य अन्नं का वर्णन हु हे। प्रस्तुत मन्त्र मे उनमं स कुक के स्यानापन्न पदार्थो का उल्लेख करते है धानानाम् भृष्ट भुने हृए् यवो का रूपम्-
verses.transliteration: somasya rūpaṃ krītasya parisrutpari ṣicyate | aśvibhyāṃ dugdhaṃ bheṣajamindrāyaindra sarasvatyā
verses.wordMeaning: Emblem of purchased Soma is Parisrut, foaming drink effused: Indra's balm milked for Indra by the Asvins and Sarasvatî.
verses.commentary: Sense: Emblem of purchased Soma is Parisrut, foaming drink effused: Indra's balm milked for Indra by the Asvins and Sarasvatî.

verses.sanskrit: आ॒स॒न्दी रू॒पᳪ रा॑जासन्द्यै॒ वेद्यै॑ कु॒म्भी सु॑रा॒धानी॑ । अन्त॑र उत्तरवे॒द्या रू॒पं का॑रोत॒रो भि॒षक्
verses.translation: The Sacrificer's seat is the throne's symbol, the jar containing Surâ of the Altar. The mid-space is the northern Altar's symbol: the cloth for filtering is the physician.
verses.hindi: हम मन्त्रवर्णित ' कुवल-गोधूम-बदर् व उपवाक ' का भोजनरूप में प्रयोग करे। पय॑सो रूपं यद्वां दध्नो रूपं कर्कन्धुंनि। ९. यत् यवाः त्ये जो जौ रै, वे पयसः रूपम्=दूध का स्थानापत्न भोजन है, २. दध्नः रूपम्=दही का स्थानापत्न भोजन कर्कन्धूनिस्थूल बदरी फल है ३. सोमस्य रूपम्-सोम
verses.transliteration: āsandī rūpa rājāsandyai vedyai kumbhī surādhānī | antara uttaravedyā rūpaṃ kārotaro bhiṣak
verses.wordMeaning: The Sacrificer's seat is the throne's symbol, the jar containing Surâ of the Altar. The mid-space is the northern Altar's symbol: the cloth for filtering is the physician.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Sacrificer's seat is the throne's symbol, the jar containing Surâ of the Altar. The mid-space is the northern Altar's symbol: the cloth for filtering is the physician.

verses.sanskrit: वेद्या॒ वेदि॒: समा॑प्यते ब॒र्हिषा॑ ब॒र्हिरि॑न्द्रि॒यम् । यूपे॑न॒ यूप॑ आप्यते॒ प्रणी॑तो अ॒ग्निर॒ग्निना॑
verses.translation: Altar by Altar is produced, power, holy grass by holy grass. The stake is by the stake obtained, by Agni Agni carried forth.
verses.hindi: 'यव-कर्कन्धु-वाजिन तथा आमिक्षा" ये हमारे प्रिय भोजन हौ। १. गतमन्त्रौ के अनुसार सात्विक अन्नो का सेवनकरने वाले “गुरु ओर शिष्य किस प्रकार अध्ययनाध्यापन करे" इस बात का प्रतिपादन करते हर् कहते हैँ कि है अध्यापक! आप आश्रावय (समन्तात् विद्योपदेशान् कुरु-द्०) सब प्रकार से विद्यार्थियों को ज्ञान का
verses.transliteration: vedyā vedi: samāpyate barhiṣā barhirindriyam | yūpena yūpa āpyate praṇīto agniragninā
verses.wordMeaning: Altar by Altar is produced, power, holy grass by holy grass. The stake is by the stake obtained, by Agni Agni carried forth.
verses.commentary: Sense: Altar by Altar is produced, power, holy grass by holy grass. The stake is by the stake obtained, by Agni Agni carried forth.

verses.sanskrit: ह॒वि॒र्धानं॒ यद॒श्विनाऽऽग्नी॑ध्रं॒ यत्सर॑स्वती । इन्द्रा॑यै॒न्द्रᳪ सद॑स्कृ॒तं प॑त्नी॒शालं॒ गार्ह॑पत्यः
verses.translation: The Asvins are the Soma store, Sarasvatî the sacred hearth. For Indra formed is Indra s seat, the Matrons' Hall, the house-lord's fire.
verses.hindi: प्रभु-प्राप्ति के लिए ज्ञानवृद्धि तो आवश्यक है ही। जप से वासना को दूर करना भी आवश्यक है ओर सात्विक भोजनं से सोम का वर्धन करते हए अङ्ग-प्रत्यङ्ख की शक्ति को बढाना भी आवश्यक हे। वैशुवदेवसस्स्वत्या तृतीय॑माप्तर्सवंनम् । २६॥
verses.transliteration: havirdhānaṃ yadaśvinā''gnīdhraṃ yatsarasvatī | indrāyaindra sadaskṛtaṃ patnīśālaṃ gārhapatyaḥ
verses.wordMeaning: The Asvins are the Soma store, Sarasvatî the sacred hearth. For Indra formed is Indra s seat, the Matrons' Hall, the house-lord's fire.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Asvins are the Soma store, Sarasvatî the sacred hearth. For Indra formed is Indra s seat, the Matrons' Hall, the house-lord's fire.

verses.sanskrit: प्रै॒षेभि॑: प्रै॒षाना॑प्नोत्या॒प्रीभि॑रा॒प्रीर्य॒ज्ञस्य॑ । प्र॒या॒जेभि॑रनुया॒जान् व॑षट्का॒रेभि॒राहु॑तीः
verses.translation: Orders he gains by orders, by Âprîs Âprîs of sacrifice, Post-offerings by fore-offerings, and by calls of Vashat Âhutis.
verses.hindi: ९. आचार्य चरणों में "उपसद्" बनने का पहला लाभ यह है कि प्राणापान शक्ति देकर हमें स्वस्थ बनाते है (अश्विभ्यां, वसु) २. दूसरा लाभ यह है कि हम आसुरवृत्तियों का संहार करनेव्राले “रुद्र! बनकर प्रभु बनते है (इन्द्रस्य इति एन्द्रम्) ओर अन्त मे ३. सरस्वती कौ अराधना करते हए ज्ञान व दिव्य गुणों को बद्ाकर हम ' आदित्य
verses.transliteration: praiṣebhi: praiṣānāpnotyāprībhirāprīryajñasya | prayājebhiranuyājān vaṣaṭkārebhirāhutīḥ
verses.wordMeaning: Orders he gains by orders, by Âprîs Âprîs of sacrifice, Post-offerings by fore-offerings, and by calls of Vashat Âhutis.
verses.commentary: Sense: Orders he gains by orders, by Âprîs Âprîs of sacrifice, Post-offerings by fore-offerings, and by calls of Vashat Âhutis.

verses.sanskrit: प॒शुभि॑: प॒शूना॑प्नोति पुरो॒डाशै॑र्ह॒वीᳪष्या । छन्दो॑भिः सामिधे॒नीर्या॒ज्या॒भिर्वषट्का॒रान्
verses.translation: By victims he gains victims, by ground rice-cakes sacrificial food, By metres kindling-verses, and Vashat-calls by Inviting prayers.
verses.hindi: हों तथा हमारी उत्तम स्तुति का कारण बने। छन्दो के द्वारा मेरी वासनाओं का हिसन हो ओर इस वासना-संहार से मेरा जीवन साममय हो। यह शान्ति मेरे जीवनकाल का अवभृथ यज्ञान्त स्नान हो। इस शान्ति में मेरे जीवन कौ पूर्णं पवित्रता हो। इडा॑भिरर्भक्षानाप्नोति सूक्तवाकेनाशिष॑ः।
verses.transliteration: paśubhi: paśūnāpnoti puroḍāśairhavīṣyā | chandobhiḥ sāmidhenīryājyābhirvaṣaṭkārān
verses.wordMeaning: By victims he gains victims, by ground rice-cakes sacrificial food, By metres kindling-verses, and Vashat-calls by Inviting prayers.
verses.commentary: Sense: By victims he gains victims, by ground rice-cakes sacrificial food, By metres kindling-verses, and Vashat-calls by Inviting prayers.

verses.sanskrit: धा॒नाः क॑र॒म्भः सक्त॑वः परीवा॒पः पयो॒ दधि॑ । सोम॑स्य रू॒पᳪ ह॒विष॑ आ॒मिक्षा॒ वाजि॑नं॒ मधु॑
verses.translation: Grain roasted, gruel, barley-meal, grains of rice roasted, milk and curd Are types of Soma: mingled milk, sweet whey, of sacrificial food.
verses.hindi: दिव्य गुणों के धारण, ज्ञान की प्राप्ति व शरीर कौ रोगों से पूर्णरक्षा के द्वारा सुरावन्तं बर्हिषदसुवीर' यज्ञःदिन्वन्ति महिषा नमोभिः । दधानाः सोमं दिवि देवतासु मदेमेन्द्रं यज॑मानाः स्वर्काः ।॥३२॥ १. गतमन्त्र के अनुसार सौत्रामणी यज्ञ के करनेवाले महिषा-(मह् पूजायाम्) पूजा कौ
verses.transliteration: dhānāḥ karambhaḥ saktavaḥ parīvāpaḥ payo dadhi | somasya rūpa haviṣa āmikṣā vājinaṃ madhu
verses.wordMeaning: Grain roasted, gruel, barley-meal, grains of rice roasted, milk and curd Are types of Soma: mingled milk, sweet whey, of sacrificial food.
verses.commentary: Sense: Grain roasted, gruel, barley-meal, grains of rice roasted, milk and curd Are types of Soma: mingled milk, sweet whey, of sacrificial food.

verses.sanskrit: धा॒नाना॑ᳪ रू॒पं कुव॑लं परीवा॒पस्य॑ गो॒धूमा॑: । सक्तू॑नाᳪ रू॒पं बद॑रमुप॒वाका॑: कर॒म्भस्य॑
verses.translation: Type of parched corn is jujube-fruit; wheat of the roasted grains of rice; Jujube the type of barley-meal, and Indra-grains of gruel-groats.
verses.hindi: हम प्रभु का उपासन करे। प्रभु--उपासन के लिए चित्तवृत्ति को ठीक रखने के उदेश्य से सात्विक अन्न का सेवन करे। ओर उस रस के द्वारा सुरया-आत्मनियन्त्रण के साथ सुतस्य सोमस्य उत्पन्न किये गये सोम (वीर्यशक्ति) का शुष्मः=शत्र-णोषक बल है तेनउस सोम के बल से यजमानम्प्रभ
verses.transliteration: dhānānā rūpaṃ kuvalaṃ parīvāpasya godhūmā: | saktūnā rūpaṃ badaramupavākā: karambhasya
verses.wordMeaning: Type of parched corn is jujube-fruit; wheat of the roasted grains of rice; Jujube the type of barley-meal, and Indra-grains of gruel-groats.
verses.commentary: Sense: Type of parched corn is jujube-fruit; wheat of the roasted grains of rice; Jujube the type of barley-meal, and Indra-grains of gruel-groats.

verses.sanskrit: पय॑सो रू॒पं यद्यवा॑ द॒ध्नो रू॒पं क॒र्कन्धू॑नि । सोम॑स्य रू॒पं वाजि॑नᳪ सौ॒म्यस्य॑ रू॒पमा॒मिक्षा॑
verses.translation: By sacrificial texts are gained the Grahas, and by the Grahas lauds and laud-arrangements. By metres are obtained Ukthas and praise-songs, and by the Sâma-chant the Avabhritha.
verses.hindi: हम ओषधियों के सेवन से सोम को शरीर में उत्पन्न करे। आत्मनियन्त्रण के द्वारा इस सोम कौ रक्षा करे। यह सुरक्षित सोम हमें आनन्द से प्रीणित करे। हमें यह प्रभु के मेलवाला (यजमान ) , जानी (सरस्वती ) , दीर्घजीवी (अश्विनौ ) , शक्तिसम्पन्न इन्द्रियोवाला (इन्द्र) तथा दोषदहनपूर्वक आगे बदनेवाला (अग्नि) बनाता है
verses.transliteration: payaso rūpaṃ yadyavā dadhno rūpaṃ karkandhūni | somasya rūpaṃ vājina saumyasya rūpamāmikṣā
verses.wordMeaning: By sacrificial texts are gained the Grahas, and by the Grahas lauds and laud-arrangements. By metres are obtained Ukthas and praise-songs, and by the Sâma-chant the Avabhritha.
verses.commentary: Sense: By sacrificial texts are gained the Grahas, and by the Grahas lauds and laud-arrangements. By metres are obtained Ukthas and praise-songs, and by the Sâma-chant the Avabhritha.

verses.sanskrit: आ श्रा॑व॒येति॑ स्तो॒त्रिया॑: प्रत्याश्रा॒वो अनु॑रूपः । यजेति॑ धाय्यारू॒पं प्र॑गा॒था ये॑यजाम॒हाः
verses.translation: The Strophe is the cry, Bid hear? the answer is the antistrophe. Sacrifice! is the Dhâyyâ's form, Pragâthas’ the Yajâmahas.
verses.hindi: प्राणायाम कौ साधना वीर्य की केवल रक्षा ही नहीं करती, अपितु उस वीर पुरुष को अभिमान का शिकार भी नदीं होने देती। ज्ान-प्राप्ति मे लगना" उस वीर्य का सदव्यय करके आत्मशक्ति को बद्ानेवाला होता हेै। १. यत्- जो रसिनः=रसवाले जीवन को माधुर्य से भरनेवाले सुतस्य =जभिषुत (उत्पतन)
verses.transliteration: ā śrāvayeti stotriyā: pratyāśrāvo anurūpaḥ | yajeti dhāyyārūpaṃ pragāthā yeyajāmahāḥ
verses.wordMeaning: The Strophe is the cry, Bid hear? the answer is the antistrophe. Sacrifice! is the Dhâyyâ's form, Pragâthas’ the Yajâmahas.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Strophe is the cry, Bid hear? the answer is the antistrophe. Sacrifice! is the Dhâyyâ's form, Pragâthas’ the Yajâmahas.

verses.sanskrit: अ॒र्ध॒ – ऋ॒चैरु॒क्थाना॑ᳪ रू॒पं प॒दैरा॑प्नोति नि॒विद॑: । प्र॒ण॒वै: श॒स्त्राणा॑ᳪ रू॒पं पय॑सा॒ सोम॑ आप्यते
verses.translation: By verse-halves comes the Ukthas’ type, Nivids by Padas he obtains. The type of Sastras is obtained by Pranavas, Soma by milk.
verses.hindi: १. सोमरक्षा का प्रकार यह है कि हम कर्मो में लगे रहे, ज्ञान प्राप्त करें ओर प्रभु के नाम का जप करें। २. रक्षित सोम (क) हमारे जीवन को मधुर बनाएगा, (ख) मन को शिव बनाएगा (रसिनः) तथा (ग) हमारे मस्तिष्क को ज्ञान- दीप्त करेगा (राजानम्) । १. गतमन््र के अनुसार सोम का रक्षण करनेवाले युवक व युवति रसमय व मधुर
verses.transliteration: ardha – ṛcairukthānā rūpaṃ padairāpnoti nivida: | praṇavai: śastrāṇā rūpaṃ payasā soma āpyate
verses.wordMeaning: By verse-halves comes the Ukthas’ type, Nivids by Padas he obtains. The type of Sastras is obtained by Pranavas, Soma by milk.
verses.commentary: Sense: By verse-halves comes the Ukthas’ type, Nivids by Padas he obtains. The type of Sastras is obtained by Pranavas, Soma by milk.

verses.sanskrit: अ॒श्विभ्यां॑ प्रातः सव॒नमिन्द्रे॑णै॒न्द्रं माध्यं॑न्दिनम् । वै॒श्व॒दे॒वᳪ सर॑स्वत्या तृ॒तीय॑मा॒प्तᳪ सव॑नम्
verses.translation: Gained by the Asvins is the morn's libation, Indra's libation of mid-day by Indra. Sarasvatî obtains the third outpouring, the offering sacred to the Visve Devas.
verses.hindi: हम पिता-पितामह व प्रपितामहो को वानप्रस्थाश्रमो से समय-समय पर घ्र मे आमन्त्रित करे। उनका अन्नादि द्वारा सत्कार करे। उनसे उपदेश व प्रेरणा लेकर अपने १. गततमन्त्र के अनुसार पितृश्राद्ध करनेवाला प्रार्थना करता है कि मा-=मुञ्धे सोम्यासः = अत्यन्त सौम्य--शान्त स्वभाववाले पितरः=यै पिता पुनन्तु-पवित्र करें। उनके जीवन कौ
verses.transliteration: aśvibhyāṃ prātaḥ savanamindreṇaindraṃ mādhyaṃndinam | vaiśvadeva sarasvatyā tṛtīyamāpta savanam
verses.wordMeaning: Gained by the Asvins is the morn's libation, Indra's libation of mid-day by Indra. Sarasvatî obtains the third outpouring, the offering sacred to the Visve Devas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Gained by the Asvins is the morn's libation, Indra's libation of mid-day by Indra. Sarasvatî obtains the third outpouring, the offering sacred to the Visve Devas.

verses.sanskrit: वा॒य॒व्यै॒र्वाय॒व्या॒न्याप्नोति॒ सते॑न द्रोणकल॒शम् । कु॒म्भीभ्या॑मम्भृ॒णौ सु॒ते स्था॒लीभि॑ स्था॒लीरा॑प्नोति
verses.translation: By Vâyu cups he gains the cups of Vâyu, and by the basket gains the vat for Soma. By the two jars he gains two cleansing-vessels, and by the cooking-pot the pot for cooking.
verses.hindi: में पितरों की प्रेरणाओं से व उनके आचरण से अपने जीवन को शुद्ध बनाऊं 3, शुद्ध जीवनवाला बनकर पूरे सौ वर्षं तक चलनेवाला बनँ। ' पवित्रशतायुष्य' ही मेरा दीर्घायुष्य के तीन साधन ९ अग्ने टे परमात्मन्! आयूँषि आयुष्य के पावक कर्मों को ही पवसे=( पावयसे
verses.transliteration: vāyavyairvāyavyānyāpnoti satena droṇakalaśam | kumbhībhyāmambhṛṇau sute sthālībhi sthālīrāpnoti
verses.wordMeaning: By Vâyu cups he gains the cups of Vâyu, and by the basket gains the vat for Soma. By the two jars he gains two cleansing-vessels, and by the cooking-pot the pot for cooking.
verses.commentary: Sense: By Vâyu cups he gains the cups of Vâyu, and by the basket gains the vat for Soma. By the two jars he gains two cleansing-vessels, and by the cooking-pot the pot for cooking.

verses.sanskrit: यजु॑र्भिराप्यन्ते॒ ग्रहा॒ ग्रहै॒ स्तोमा॑श्च॒ विष्टु॑तीः । छन्दो॑भिरुक्थाश॒स्त्राणि॒ साम्ना॑वभृ॒थ आ॑प्यते
verses.translation: He gains by vow of fasting Consecration, by Consecration gains the priestly guerdon.
verses.hindi: दीर्घजीवन के लिए आवश्यक है कि १. क्रियाशील बना जाए (पवसे) २. व्रीहि व दधि आदि अन्न-रसों काही प्रयोग किया जाए ३. दुष्ट-सद्खं से दूर रहा जाए। पुनन्तु मा देवजनाः पुनन्तु मन॑सा धियंः। पुनन्तु विश्वां भूतानि जात॑वेदः पुनीहि मा ।३९॥
verses.transliteration: yajurbhirāpyante grahā grahai stomāśca viṣṭutīḥ | chandobhirukthāśastrāṇi sāmnāvabhṛtha āpyate
verses.wordMeaning: He gains by vow of fasting Consecration, by Consecration gains the priestly guerdon.
verses.commentary: Sense: He gains by vow of fasting Consecration, by Consecration gains the priestly guerdon.

verses.sanskrit: इडा॑भिर्भ॒क्षाना॑प्नोति सूक्तवा॒केना॒शिष॑: । शं॒युना॑ पत्नीसंया॒जान्त्स॑मिष्टय॒जुषा॑ स॒ᳪस्थाम्
verses.translation: Draughts he obtains by pouring out libations, and wishes by the utterance of praises, By Samyu he obtains Patnîsamyâjas, and Consummation by Samishtayajus.
verses.hindi: १. देवजन मुञ्जे पवित्र करें। २. विचारपूर्वक किये गये कर्म मुञ्ञे पवित्र करें ३. पृथिवी आदि भूत मुदे पवित्र करे ४. सर्वज्ञ प्रभु मुदे पवित्र करे। ज्ञान-शक्ति व कर्मसंकल्प पवित्रैण पुनीहि मा शक्रेण देव दीद्य॑त् । अग्ने क्रत्वा रतुं २।।५ रनु ॥४०॥।
verses.transliteration: iḍābhirbhakṣānāpnoti sūktavākenāśiṣa: | śaṃyunā patnīsaṃyājāntsamiṣṭayajuṣā sasthām
verses.wordMeaning: Draughts he obtains by pouring out libations, and wishes by the utterance of praises, By Samyu he obtains Patnîsamyâjas, and Consummation by Samishtayajus.
verses.commentary: Sense: Draughts he obtains by pouring out libations, and wishes by the utterance of praises, By Samyu he obtains Patnîsamyâjas, and Consummation by Samishtayajus.

verses.sanskrit: व्र॒तेन॑ दी॒क्षामा॑प्नोति दी॒क्षया॑ऽऽप्नोति॒ दक्षि॑णाम् । दक्षि॑णा श्र॒द्धामा॑प्नोति श्र॒द्धया॑ स॒त्यमा॑प्यते
verses.translation: He gains by priestly guerdon faith: by faith comes knowledge of the truth.
verses.hindi: सोम मुञ्ञे नीरोग करके स्वास्थ्य कौ दीप्ति दे। सर्वव्यापक प्रभु के सामीप्य को अनुभव करके मै पापों से बचँ। प्रभु नाम-स्मरण मेरी ढाल बन जाए। उभाभ्यौं देव सवितः पवित्रैण स्वेन॑ च । मां पुनीहि विरुवत॑;॥। ४३॥ ९. टे देव=सब दिव्य गुणों के पुञ्ज तथा जानदीप्त प्रभो! है सवितः =सत्कर्मो मे सतत
verses.transliteration: vratena dīkṣāmāpnoti dīkṣayā''pnoti dakṣiṇām | dakṣiṇā śraddhāmāpnoti śraddhayā satyamāpyate
verses.wordMeaning: He gains by priestly guerdon faith: by faith comes knowledge of the truth.
verses.commentary: Sense: He gains by priestly guerdon faith: by faith comes knowledge of the truth.

verses.sanskrit: ए॒ताव॑द्रू॒पं य॒ज्ञस्य॒ यद्दे॒वैर्ब्रह्म॑णा कृ॒तम् । तदे॒तत्सर्व॑माप्नोति य॒ज्ञे सौ॑त्राम॒णी सु॒ते
verses.translation: So far the type of sacrifice was formed by Brahma, and the Gods. All this he gains, when juice is shed, in the Santrâmanî sacrifice.
verses.hindi: -लान व कर्म मेरे जीवन कौ पवित्र करनेवाले हों। मेँ पक्षी के समान दरतो ज्ञान व कर्म मेरे पंख हां। ये मुदे ऊपर ले-जानेवाले हो। वैश्वदेवी पुनती देव्यागाद्यस्यांमिमा बह्वघ्स्तन्त्रो वीतपष्ठाः । ९. वैश्वदेवी =( विश्वेभ्यः देवेभ्यः आगता द० ) सब देवताओं के लिए प्राप्त होनैवाली
verses.transliteration: etāvadrūpaṃ yajñasya yaddevairbrahmaṇā kṛtam | tadetatsarvamāpnoti yajñe sautrāmaṇī sute
verses.wordMeaning: So far the type of sacrifice was formed by Brahma, and the Gods. All this he gains, when juice is shed, in the Santrâmanî sacrifice.
verses.commentary: Sense: So far the type of sacrifice was formed by Brahma, and the Gods. All this he gains, when juice is shed, in the Santrâmanî sacrifice.

verses.sanskrit:
सुरा॑वन्तं बर्हि॒षद॑ᳪ सु॒वीरं॑ य॒ज्ञᳪ हि॑न्वन्ति महि॒षा नमो॑भिः ।
दधा॑ना॒: सोमं॑ दि॒वि दे॒वता॑सु॒ मदे॒मेन्द्रँ॒ यज॑मानाः स्व॒र्काः
verses.translation: The rite with sacred grass, wine, store of heroes, the mighty ones speed on with adorations. May we, sweet-singing sacrificers, setting Soma mid Gods in heaven, give joy to Indra.
verses.hindi: वेदवाणी ' वैश्वदेवी पुनती-देवी ' हे। इसमे स्नान कर शरीर का प्रक्षालन हो जाने से लोग चमक उठते है। इकट्ठे होने पर इसी कौ चर्चा करते हँ। धनं के कभी दास तेषौ लोकः स्वधा नमो यज्ञो देवेषु कल्पताम्।। ४५। ९. ये-जो हमारे पितरः=पिता- पितामह प्रपितामह आदि समानाः सुख-दुःख में
verses.transliteration: surāvantaṃ barhiṣada suvīraṃ yajña hinvanti mahiṣā namobhiḥ | dadhānā: somaṃ divi devatāsu mademendra~ yajamānāḥ svarkāḥ
verses.wordMeaning: The rite with sacred grass, wine, store of heroes, the mighty ones speed on with adorations. May we, sweet-singing sacrificers, setting Soma mid Gods in heaven, give joy to Indra.
verses.commentary: Sense: The rite with sacred grass, wine, store of heroes, the mighty ones speed on with adorations. May we, sweet-singing sacrificers, setting Soma mid Gods in heaven, give joy to Indra.

verses.sanskrit: यस्ते॒ रस॒: सम्भृ॑त॒ ओष॑धीषु॒ सोम॑स्य॒ शुष्म॒: सुर॑या सु॒तस्य॑ । तेन॑ जिन्व॒ यज॑मानं॒ मदे॑न॒ सर॑स्वतीम॒श्विना॒विन्द्र॑म॒ग्निम्
verses.translation: Agni, thou poorest life: send down upon us food and vigorous strength. Drive thou misfortune far away.
verses.hindi: १. "पितर ' शब्द से कहलाने योग्य व्यक्ति वे है जो (क) समचित्त स्थितप्रल है। (ख) समान विज्ञानवाले है। (ग) नियन्त्रण के संसार मेँ विचरते हं, अर्थात् ब्रती जीवनवाले है। २. इन पितरों को (क) उत्तम यश प्राप्त होता है। (ख) धारण के लिए आवश्यक अन्न दुर्लभ नहीं होता। (ग) इनमें नमन कौ वृत्ति होती है अथवा इन्दं सब
verses.transliteration: yaste rasa: sambhṛta oṣadhīṣu somasya śuṣma: surayā sutasya | tena jinva yajamānaṃ madena sarasvatīmaśvināvindramagnim
verses.wordMeaning: Agni, thou poorest life: send down upon us food and vigorous strength. Drive thou misfortune far away.
verses.commentary: Sense: Agni, thou poorest life: send down upon us food and vigorous strength. Drive thou misfortune far away.

verses.sanskrit:
यम॒श्विना॒ नमु॑चेरासु॒रादधि॒ सर॑स्व॒त्यसु॑नोदिन्द्रि॒याय॑ ।
इ॒मं तᳪ शु॒क्रं मधु॑मन्त॒मिन्दु॒ᳪ सोम॒ᳪ राजा॑नमि॒ह भ॑क्षयामि
verses.translation: That which Sarasvatî poured out for Indra, by Asvins brought from Namuchi the demon, This flowing drop, brilliant and full of sweetness, I drink and feed on here, the King, the Soma.
verses.hindi: इस संसार में मनुष्यों के लिए दो ही मार्ग हे। १. ज्ञान की अपरिपक्व अवस्था में 'पितृयाण' है, जिससे आगे चलकर सकाम यज्ञो को करते हुए हम अभ्युदय का साधन करते है तथा २. ज्ञान के परिपक्व होने पर मनुष्य "देवयान ' मार्ग से चलता है। इसमे उन्ीं यज्ञो कौ वे निष्काम होकर कर्तव्य बुद्धि से करते हैँ ओर निःश्रेयस को सिद्ध
verses.transliteration: yamaśvinā namucerāsurādadhi sarasvatyasunodindriyāya | imaṃ ta śukraṃ madhumantamindu soma rājānamiha bhakṣayāmi
verses.wordMeaning: That which Sarasvatî poured out for Indra, by Asvins brought from Namuchi the demon, This flowing drop, brilliant and full of sweetness, I drink and feed on here, the King, the Soma.
verses.commentary: Sense: That which Sarasvatî poured out for Indra, by Asvins brought from Namuchi the demon, This flowing drop, brilliant and full of sweetness, I drink and feed on here, the King, the Soma.

verses.sanskrit:
यदत्र॑ रि॒प्तᳪ र॒सिन॑: सु॒तस्य॒ यदिन्द्रो॒ अपि॑ब॒च्छची॑भिः ।
अ॒हं तद॑स्य॒ मन॑सा शि॒वेन॒ सोम॒ᳪ राजा॑नमि॒ह भ॑क्षयामि
verses.translation: Whatever portion of the savoury fluid is clinging here, what Indra drank with powers, That drop thereof with pure and holy spirit I drink and feed upon, the King, the Soma.
verses.hindi: पितरों की विशेषतार्प ये हैवे स्वस्थ हें (अङ्धिरसः) , सदाचारी है (नवग्वाः) स्थिरवृत्ति के है (अथर्वाण), सदज्ञान से परिपक्व विचारोवाले है ( भृगवः) तथा सौम्य (विनीत) हे। ठम सव इन पितरों की सुमति व सौमनस में स्थित हो। तेभिर्यमः स॑दरराणो हवीश्ष्युान्चुशद्धिः प्रतिकाममंततु॥॥५९॥
verses.transliteration: yadatra ripta rasina: sutasya yadindro apibacchacībhiḥ | ahaṃ tadasya manasā śivena soma rājānamiha bhakṣayāmi
verses.wordMeaning: Whatever portion of the savoury fluid is clinging here, what Indra drank with powers, That drop thereof with pure and holy spirit I drink and feed upon, the King, the Soma.
verses.commentary: Sense: Whatever portion of the savoury fluid is clinging here, what Indra drank with powers, That drop thereof with pure and holy spirit I drink and feed upon, the King, the Soma.

verses.sanskrit: पि॒तृभ्य॑: स्वधा॒यिभ्य॑: स्व॒धा नम॑:  पिताम॒हेभ्य॑: स्वधा॒यिभ्य॑: स्व॒धा नम॒: प्रपि॑तामहेभ्यः स्वधा॒यिभ्य॑: स्व॒धा नम॑: । अक्ष॑न् पि॒तरो ऽमी॑मदन्त पि॒तरो  ऽती॑तृपन्त पि॒तर॒: पित॑र॒: शुन्ध॑ध्वम्
verses.translation: To Fathers who claim Svadhâ be Svadhâ and homage! To Grandfathers who claim Svadhâ be Svadhâ and homage! To Great-grandfathers who claim Svadhâ be Svadhâ and homage! The Fathers have eaten. The Fathers have rejoiced. The Fathers have been satisfied, Fathers, be ye purified.
verses.hindi: हम भोजन वह करर, जिसकी शरीर को आवश्यकता हे। उसे सदा प्रसत्रतापूर्वक ही खाँं। हमारा भोजन यस्लशोष हो, हविरूप हो। उत्तेजक भोजनां से हम वचने का प्रयत्न करे। सदा सोम का पान करनेवाले, शक्ति की रक्षा करनेवाले बने। तव प्रणीती पितरो नऽइन्दो देवेषु रल्र॑मभजन्त॒ धीरां: ।॥५२॥
verses.transliteration: pitṛbhya: svadhāyibhya: svadhā nama: pitāmahebhya: svadhāyibhya: svadhā nama: prapitāmahebhyaḥ svadhāyibhya: svadhā nama: | akṣan pitaro 'mīmadanta pitaro 'tītṛpanta pitara: pitara: śundhadhvam
verses.wordMeaning: To Fathers who claim Svadhâ be Svadhâ and homage! To Grandfathers who claim Svadhâ be Svadhâ and homage! To Great-grandfathers who claim Svadhâ be Svadhâ and homage! The Fathers have eaten. The Fathers have rejoiced. The Fathers have been satisfied, Fathers, be ye purified.
verses.commentary: Sense: To Fathers who claim Svadhâ be Svadhâ and homage! To Grandfathers who claim Svadhâ be Svadhâ and homage! To Great-grandfathers who claim Svadhâ be Svadhâ and homage! The Fathers have eaten. The Fathers have rejoiced. The Fathers have been satisfied, Fathers, be ye purified.

verses.sanskrit:
पु॒नन्तु॑ मा पि॒तर॑: सो॒म्यास॑: पु॒नन्तु॑ मा पिताम॒हाः पु॒नन्तु॒ प्रपि॑तामहाः । प॒वित्रे॑ण श॒तायु॑षा ।
पु॒नन्तु॑ मा पिताम॒हाः पु॒नन्तु॒ प्रपि॑तामहाः । प॒वित्रे॑ण श॒तायु॑षा॒ विश्व॒मायु॒र्व्य॒श्नवै
verses.translation: Cleanse me the Fathers who enjoy Soma! Grandfathers make me clean! May Great-grandfathers cleanse me with a sieve that brings a century. May my Grandfathers cleanse me, may my Great-grand-fathers make me clean. With sieve that brings a century may I obtain full length of life.
verses.hindi: आचार्य व पितर मिलकर युवक सन्तानं मेँ रमणीय गुणों का आधान करा्। त्वया हि न॑ः पितर; सोम पूर्वे कर्मणि चक्रुः प॑वमान धीरः। १. है सोम=शान्तात्मन्! आचार्य! नः= हमारे पूर्वे-हमसे पूर्वं काल में होनैवाले धीराः=धीमान् व ध्यानवान्, धैर्यशाली पितरः =पितर हि=निश्चय से त्वया=तुङ्ञसे, अर्थात् आपके निर्देशों
verses.transliteration: punantu mā pitara: somyāsa: punantu mā pitāmahāḥ punantu prapitāmahāḥ | pavitreṇa śatāyuṣā | punantu mā pitāmahāḥ punantu prapitāmahāḥ | pavitreṇa śatāyuṣā viśvamāyurvyaśnavai
verses.wordMeaning: Cleanse me the Fathers who enjoy Soma! Grandfathers make me clean! May Great-grandfathers cleanse me with a sieve that brings a century. May my Grandfathers cleanse me, may my Great-grand-fathers make me clean. With sieve that brings a century may I obtain full length of life.
verses.commentary: Sense: Cleanse me the Fathers who enjoy Soma! Grandfathers make me clean! May Great-grandfathers cleanse me with a sieve that brings a century. May my Grandfathers cleanse me, may my Great-grand-fathers make me clean. With sieve that brings a century may I obtain full length of life.

verses.sanskrit: अग्न॒ आयू॑ ᳪषि पवस॒ आ सु॒वोर्ज॒मिषं॑ च नः । आ॒रे बा॑धस्व दु॒च्छुना॑म्
verses.translation: Cleanse me the companies of Gods!
verses.hindi: आचार्य व माता-पिता का प्रयत्न हमें जानोज्ज्वल व स्वस्थ-शरीरवाला बनाए्। हम स्वार्थं की वृत्ति से ऊपर उठे रहें, कभी धन के दास न बनें। त्र्िंषद् पितरों का स्वागत ९. बर्हिषद := पवित्र हदय में स्थित होनेवाले पिततरः=पितरो! ऊतीचरक्षण के हेतु से
verses.transliteration: agna āyū ṣi pavasa ā suvorjamiṣaṃ ca naḥ | āre bādhasva ducchunām
verses.wordMeaning: Cleanse me the companies of Gods!
verses.commentary: Sense: Cleanse me the companies of Gods!

verses.sanskrit: पु॒नन्तु॑ मा देवज॒ना॑: पु॒नन्तु॒ मन॑सा॒ धिय॑: । पु॒नन्तु॒ विश्वा॑ भू॒तानि॒ जात॑वेदः पुनी॒हि मा॑
verses.translation: May thoughts with spirit make me clean. Cleanse me all things that be! Do thou, O Jâtavedas, make me clean.
verses.hindi: हम समय-समय पर पितरों को आमन्त्रित करे। वे हमारे रक्षण के लिए हमारे समीप आने की कृपा करें। हम उनके लिए पवित्र हव्य पदार्थो को प्राप्त करारप। उनकी उत्तम प्रेरणाओं से हमारी व्याधियोँ व आधियाँ दूर हों ओर हम निष्पाप बने। ९. अहम्=मै सुविदत्रान्-उत्तम ज्ञान से रक्षा करनेवाले पितृन्=पितरो को - ज्ञानदाता
verses.transliteration: punantu mā devajanā: punantu manasā dhiya: | punantu viśvā bhūtāni jātavedaḥ punīhi mā
verses.wordMeaning: May thoughts with spirit make me clean. Cleanse me all things that be! Do thou, O Jâtavedas, make me clean.
verses.commentary: Sense: May thoughts with spirit make me clean. Cleanse me all things that be! Do thou, O Jâtavedas, make me clean.

verses.sanskrit: प॒वित्रे॑ण पुनीहि मा शु॒क्रेण॑ देव॒ दीद्य॑त् । अग्ने॒ क्रत्वा॒ क्रतूँ॒१ रनु॑
verses.translation: Purify me, O Agni, God, refulgent with thy pure bright sieve, With powers according to thine own.
verses.hindi: हमें उन पितरों का, ज्ञानप्रद आचार्यो का सम्पर्क सदा प्राप्त हो जो हमें इस अविनाशी सृष्टि-प्रलय-चक्र का लान देनेवाले हों ओर जिनका खान-पान अत्यन्त सात्विक हे। उत्तम ज्ञान देकर ये हमारा जण करते है। ९. बर्हिष्येषु =( वर्हिषु उत्तमेषु-द०) हृदयो को वासनाशन्य बनाने में उत्तम प्रियेषु=तृप्ति
verses.transliteration: pavitreṇa punīhi mā śukreṇa deva dīdyat | agne kratvā kratū~1 ranu
verses.wordMeaning: Purify me, O Agni, God, refulgent with thy pure bright sieve, With powers according to thine own.
verses.commentary: Sense: Purify me, O Agni, God, refulgent with thy pure bright sieve, With powers according to thine own.

verses.sanskrit: यत्ते॑ प॒वित्र॑म॒र्चिष्यग्ने॒ वित॑तमन्त॒रा । ब्रह्म॒ तेन॑ पुनातु मा
verses.translation: O Agni, may the cleansing sieve, diffused through all thy fiery glow, Holy devotion, make me clean.
verses.hindi: उत्तम सात्विक लान से हृदयो को निर्वासन बनानेवाले सौम्य पितर हमसे आमन्त्रित होकर यहाँ आँ ओर हमें अपने सदुपदेशों से प्रीणित करे। आ य॑न्तु नः पितरः सोम्यासो ऽग्निष्वात्ताः पथिभिर्देवयानैः । अस्मिन् यज्ञे स्वधया मदन्तो ऽधि ब्रुवन्तु ते ऽवन्त्वस्मान्।।५८॥।
verses.transliteration: yatte pavitramarciṣyagne vitatamantarā | brahma tena punātu mā
verses.wordMeaning: O Agni, may the cleansing sieve, diffused through all thy fiery glow, Holy devotion, make me clean.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Agni, may the cleansing sieve, diffused through all thy fiery glow, Holy devotion, make me clean.

verses.sanskrit: पव॑मान॒: सो अ॒द्य न॑: प॒वित्रे॑ण॒ विच॑र्षणिः । यः पोता॒ स पु॑नातु मा
verses.translation: May Pavamâna with his sieve, Guest of all tribes, cleanse us to-day, He who is Cleanser make us clean.
verses.hindi: ज्ञान दें जो ज्ञान हमे इस जीवन मे वासनाओं से सुरक्षित करे। सुप्रणीतयः- उत्तम प्रणयन करनेवाले अग्निष्वात्ताः पितरऽ एह ग॑च्छत॒ सदःसदः सदत सुप्रणीतयः । ९. डे अग्निष्वात्ताः=अग्नि आदि पदार्थो के विज्ञान को सम्यक् ग्रहण करनेवाले
verses.transliteration: pavamāna: so adya na: pavitreṇa vicarṣaṇiḥ | yaḥ potā sa punātu mā
verses.wordMeaning: May Pavamâna with his sieve, Guest of all tribes, cleanse us to-day, He who is Cleanser make us clean.
verses.commentary: Sense: May Pavamâna with his sieve, Guest of all tribes, cleanse us to-day, He who is Cleanser make us clean.

verses.sanskrit: उ॒भाभ्यां॑ देव सवितः प॒वित्रे॑ण स॒वेन॑ च । मां पु॑नीहि वि॒श्वत॑:
verses.translation: Savitar, God, by both of these, libation, purifying power, Purify me on every side.
verses.hindi: हम विज्ञान मे निपुण पितरों के सदुपदेशों से सुनीति के मार्गं पर चलते हए वासनाओं को जीते ओर अपने प्राणों को सबल बनार्ँ। प्रक्रतिवित् व ब्रह्मवित् ( ४७८5 ७१त ४ त+27070551८5 ) का पण्डित येऽअग्निष्वात्ता येऽअनंग्निष्वात्ता मध्य दिवः स्वधयां मादयंन्ते।
verses.transliteration: ubhābhyāṃ deva savitaḥ pavitreṇa savena ca | māṃ punīhi viśvata:
verses.wordMeaning: Savitar, God, by both of these, libation, purifying power, Purify me on every side.
verses.commentary: Sense: Savitar, God, by both of these, libation, purifying power, Purify me on every side.

verses.sanskrit:
वै॒श्व॒दे॒वी पु॑न॒ती दे॒व्यागा॒द्यस्या॑मि॒मा ब॒ह्व्य॒स्त॒न्वो॑ वी॒तपृ॑ष्ठाः ।
तया॒ मद॑न्तः सध॒मादे॑षु व॒यᳪ स्या॑म॒ पत॑यो रयी॒णाम्
verses.translation: Dear to all Gods hath come the cleansing Goddess, she who contains these many smooth-backed figures. Through her may we in sacrificial banquets taking our pleasure be the lords of riches.
verses.hindi: प्रकृतिविज्ञान व ब्रह्यस्लान में निपुण ज्ञानी लोग प्रभु से प्राप्त असुनीतितप्राणविद्या को हमें भी प्राप्त कराण, जिससे हम अपने जीवनो को तदनुसार चलाते हुए दीर्घं बना पार्णे। अग्निष्वात्तानुतुमतों हवामहे नाराशसे सोमपीथं यञऽआशुः। ९. अग्निष्वात्तान्ग्रहण कौ है अग्नि आदि पदार्थो कौ विद्या जिन्होने उन ऋतुमतः=प्रशस्त
verses.transliteration: vaiśvadevī punatī devyāgādyasyāmimā bahvyastanvo vītapṛṣṭhāḥ | tayā madantaḥ sadhamādeṣu vaya syāma patayo rayīṇām
verses.wordMeaning: Dear to all Gods hath come the cleansing Goddess, she who contains these many smooth-backed figures. Through her may we in sacrificial banquets taking our pleasure be the lords of riches.
verses.commentary: Sense: Dear to all Gods hath come the cleansing Goddess, she who contains these many smooth-backed figures. Through her may we in sacrificial banquets taking our pleasure be the lords of riches.

verses.sanskrit: ये स॑मा॒नाः सम॑नसः पि॒तरो॑ यम॒राज्ये॑ । तेषाँ॑ल्लो॒कः स्व॒धा नमो॑ य॒ज्ञो दे॒वेषु॑ कल्पताम्
verses.translation: The Fathers who in Yama's realm are equal and unanimous— Their world is Svadhâ, reverence. To Gods let sacrifice be paid.
verses.hindi: हम अग्नि आदि सव पदार्थो के विज्ञान मे कुशल बनकर ऋतु करे अनुसार भोजनादि क्रियाओं को करते हुए नरहित करे प्रशंसनीय कर्मो को करनेवाले बनें। इस नाराशंस के निमित्त सोमपान करे, अर्थात् शरीर मे सोम कौ रक्षा करे। आच्या जानु दक्षिणतो निषद्येमं यज्ञमभि गुंणीत विष्व ।
verses.transliteration: ye samānāḥ samanasaḥ pitaro yamarājye | teṣā~llokaḥ svadhā namo yajño deveṣu kalpatām
verses.wordMeaning: The Fathers who in Yama's realm are equal and unanimous— Their world is Svadhâ, reverence. To Gods let sacrifice be paid.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Fathers who in Yama's realm are equal and unanimous— Their world is Svadhâ, reverence. To Gods let sacrifice be paid.

verses.sanskrit: ये स॑मा॒नाः सम॑नसो जी॒वा जी॒वेषु॑ माम॒काः । तेषा॒ᳪ श्रीर्मयि॑ कल्पताम॒स्मिँल्लो॒के श॒तᳪ समा॑:
verses.translation: Equals, unanimous, my folk yet living among those who live— On me be set their glory through a hundred years in this our world.
verses.hindi: उपहूत पितर हमसे समादृत होकर हमें उत्तम कर्मो का उपदेश दें ओर हमारे व्यवहार मे अन्ञानवश रह गई कमी को क्षमा करे। प्रातःकाल का स्वाध्याय १. (क) अरूणीनाम्तप्रातःकाल की अरुण किरणौ कौ उपस्थे-गोद में आसीनासः=वेठे
verses.transliteration: ye samānāḥ samanaso jīvā jīveṣu māmakāḥ | teṣā śrīrmayi kalpatāmasmi~lloke śata samā:
verses.wordMeaning: Equals, unanimous, my folk yet living among those who live— On me be set their glory through a hundred years in this our world.
verses.commentary: Sense: Equals, unanimous, my folk yet living among those who live— On me be set their glory through a hundred years in this our world.

verses.sanskrit:
द्वे सृ॒ती अ॑शृणवं पितॄ॒णाम॒हं दे॒वाना॑मु॒त मर्त्या॑नाम् ।
ताभ्या॑मि॒दं विश्व॒मेज॒त्समे॑ति॒ यद॑न्त॒रा पि॒तरं॑ मा॒तरं॑ च
verses.translation: I have heard mention of two several pathways, way of the Fathers, way of Gods and mortals. On these two roads each moving creature travels, each thing between the Father and the Mother.
verses.hindi: आचार्यो से प्रकृति के सव देवों का ज्ञान प्राप्त करके, इनमे उस प्रभु की महिमा को देखता हुआ मैं उस प्रभु से अपना सम्बन्ध बना पाङ योऽअग्निः कव्यवाहनः पितृन्यक्ष॑दृतावृध॑ः । १. गत मन्त्र के अनुसार आचार्य से ज्ञान प्राप्त करके विद्यार्थी भी ज्ञानी बना हेै।
verses.transliteration: dve sṛtī aśṛṇavaṃ pitṝṇāmahaṃ devānāmuta martyānām | tābhyāmidaṃ viśvamejatsameti yadantarā pitaraṃ mātaraṃ ca
verses.wordMeaning: I have heard mention of two several pathways, way of the Fathers, way of Gods and mortals. On these two roads each moving creature travels, each thing between the Father and the Mother.
verses.commentary: Sense: I have heard mention of two several pathways, way of the Fathers, way of Gods and mortals. On these two roads each moving creature travels, each thing between the Father and the Mother.

verses.sanskrit:
इ॒दᳪ ह॒विः प्र॒जन॑नं मे अस्तु॒ दश॑वीर॒ᳪ सर्व॑गणᳪ स्व॒स्तये॑ ।
आ॒त्म॒सनि॑ प्रजा॒सनि॑ पशु॒सनि॑ लोक॒सन्य॑भय॒सनि॑ ।
अ॒ग्निः प्र॒जां ब॑हु॒लां मे॑ करो॒त्वन्नं॒ पयो॒ रेतो॑ अ॒स्मासु॑ धत्त
verses.translation: May this my sacrifice bring store of children, with ten brave sons, full-companied, for welfare— Life-winning, winning offspring, winning cattle, winning this world of ours and peace and safety. May Agni make nay progeny abundant. Do ye confer food, milk, and wanly vigour.
verses.hindi: हम आचार्यो से कव्य=सब सत्यविद्याओं के प्रतिपादक ज्ञान को ग्रहण करे। इसे आचार्यो को सुनाकर सब प्रजाओं में उस ज्ञान को देनेवाले वनें। हमारा "कल्य! ! हव्य' हो जाए, प्रजाओं में आहुति के योग्य हो जाप्। प्रादा: पितुभ्य॑ः स्वधया तेऽअंक्षन्नद्धि त्वं देव प्रय॑ता हवीश्छषिं ।॥६६॥
verses.transliteration: ida haviḥ prajananaṃ me astu daśavīra sarvagaṇa svastaye | ātmasani prajāsani paśusani lokasanyabhayasani | agniḥ prajāṃ bahulāṃ me karotvannaṃ payo reto asmāsu dhatta
verses.wordMeaning: May this my sacrifice bring store of children, with ten brave sons, full-companied, for welfare— Life-winning, winning offspring, winning cattle, winning this world of ours and peace and safety. May Agni make nay progeny abundant. Do ye confer food, milk, and wanly vigour.
verses.commentary: Sense: May this my sacrifice bring store of children, with ten brave sons, full-companied, for welfare— Life-winning, winning offspring, winning cattle, winning this world of ours and peace and safety. May Agni make nay progeny abundant. Do ye confer food, milk, and wanly vigour.

verses.sanskrit:
उदी॑रता॒मव॑र॒ उत्परा॑स॒ उन्म॑ध्य॒माः पि॒तर॑: सो॒म्यास॑: ।
असुं॒ य ई॒युर॑वृ॒का ऋ॑त॒ज्ञास्ते नो॑ऽवन्तु पि॒तरो॒ हवे॑षु
verses.translation: May they ascend, the lowest, highest, midmost, the Fathers who deserve a share of Soma. May Fathers who have gained the world of spirits, gentle and righteous, aid us when we call them.
verses.hindi: हम "पूर्व" अर्थात् विद्यावयोवृद्ध "उपर ' =विषयों से उपरत "पार्थिवे रजसि आनिषत्ता'-अग्नि मे यज्ञ-यागादि करनेवाले तथा उत्तम धर्मरूप बलवाले पितरों का अन्नाद से सत्कार करनेवाले बने। ९. अधअवब यथा-जेसे नः-ठमारे पितरः =पितर परासः=जो उत्कृष्ट है विद्या आदि
verses.transliteration: udīratāmavara utparāsa unmadhyamāḥ pitara: somyāsa: | asuṃ ya īyuravṛkā ṛtajñāste no'vantu pitaro haveṣu
verses.wordMeaning: May they ascend, the lowest, highest, midmost, the Fathers who deserve a share of Soma. May Fathers who have gained the world of spirits, gentle and righteous, aid us when we call them.
verses.commentary: Sense: May they ascend, the lowest, highest, midmost, the Fathers who deserve a share of Soma. May Fathers who have gained the world of spirits, gentle and righteous, aid us when we call them.

verses.sanskrit:
अङ्गि॑रसो नः पि॒तरो॒ नव॑ग्वा॒ अथ॑र्वाणो॒ भृग॑वः सो॒म्यास॑: ।
तेषां॑ व॒यᳪ सु॑म॒तौ य॒ज्ञिया॑ना॒मपि॑ भ॒द्रे सौ॑मन॒से स्या॑म
verses.translation: Our Fathers are Angirases, Navagvas, Atharvans, Bhrigus, who deserve the Soma. May these the holy look on us with favour: may we enjoy their gracious loving-kindness.
verses.hindi: हम उन ज्ञानी पितरों का सम्पर्कं प्राप्त करं जो गुणों से उत्कृष्ट है, वयोवृद्ध हे, यज्ञादि कर्मो में व्याप्त जीवनवाले हें, पवित्र ज्ञान-किरणो को प्राप्त है, उक्थो का शंसन करनेवाले, पार्थिव भोगों से ऊपर उवे हए तथा ज्ञान की किरणो को अनावृत करनेवाले है। १- गतमन्त्र के अनुसार “अआग्नि' से प्रार्थना करते हुए कहते हैँ कि उशशन्तः-कामना
verses.transliteration: aṅgiraso naḥ pitaro navagvā atharvāṇo bhṛgavaḥ somyāsa: | teṣāṃ vaya sumatau yajñiyānāmapi bhadre saumanase syāma
verses.wordMeaning: Our Fathers are Angirases, Navagvas, Atharvans, Bhrigus, who deserve the Soma. May these the holy look on us with favour: may we enjoy their gracious loving-kindness.
verses.commentary: Sense: Our Fathers are Angirases, Navagvas, Atharvans, Bhrigus, who deserve the Soma. May these the holy look on us with favour: may we enjoy their gracious loving-kindness.

verses.sanskrit:
ये न॒: पूर्वे॑ पि॒तर॑: सो॒म्यासो॑ऽनूहि॒रे सो॑मपी॒थं वसि॑ष्ठाः ।
तेभि॑र्य॒मः स॑ररा॒णो ह॒वीᳪष्यु॒शन्नु॒शद्भि॑: प्रतिका॒मम॑त्तु
verses.translation: Our ancient Fathers who deserve the Soma, who came, most noble, to our Soma banquet— With these let Yama, yearning with the yearning, rejoicing eat our offerings at his pleasure.
verses.hindi: हम प्रभु-प्राप्ति कौ प्रबल कामनावाले हों। प्रभु को हदयों मे धारण करें, इसी उदेश्य से ज्ञान को समिद्ध करे। ज्ञानप्रद पितरों के सम्पर्क को प्राप्त करके हवि के खाने का पाठ पदं। यह हवि ही हमारा प्रभुपूजन बन जाएगी। १. गतमन्त्र के अनुसार पितरों के सम्पर्क में रहकर पुरुष अपने जीवन को यज्ञमय
verses.transliteration: ye na: pūrve pitara: somyāso'nūhire somapīthaṃ vasiṣṭhāḥ | tebhiryamaḥ sararāṇo havīṣyuśannuśadbhi: pratikāmamattu
verses.wordMeaning: Our ancient Fathers who deserve the Soma, who came, most noble, to our Soma banquet— With these let Yama, yearning with the yearning, rejoicing eat our offerings at his pleasure.
verses.commentary: Sense: Our ancient Fathers who deserve the Soma, who came, most noble, to our Soma banquet— With these let Yama, yearning with the yearning, rejoicing eat our offerings at his pleasure.

verses.sanskrit:
त्वᳪ सो॑म॒ प्र चि॑कितो मनी॒षा त्वᳪ रजि॑ष्ठ॒मनु॑ नेषि॒ पन्था॑म् ।
तव॒ प्रणी॑ती पि॒तरो॑ न इन्दो दे॒वेषु॒ रत्न॑मभजन्त॒ धीरा॑:
verses.translation: Thou, Soma, art preeminent for wisdom: along the straightest path thou art our leader. Our prudent Fathers by thy wisdom, Soma, dealt out among the Gods their share of treasure.
verses.hindi: कर्मो में लगे रहने से मनुष्य आसुरवृत्तियों का शिकार नहीं होता। ऋतेन॑ सत्यपि द्दियं विपान॑शुक्रमन्धसऽ इन्द्र॑स्येद्धिययिदं पयो ऽमृतं मधुं ॥७२॥ १. गतमन्त्र के अनुसार क्रियाशीलता के द्वारा वासनाओं से ऊपर उठ जाने पर शरीर मे सोम सुरक्षित रहता है ओर यह सोमः=सोम राजा (राज् दीप्तौ) उसके जीवन को दीप्त
verses.transliteration: tva soma pra cikito manīṣā tva rajiṣṭhamanu neṣi panthām | tava praṇītī pitaro na indo deveṣu ratnamabhajanta dhīrā:
verses.wordMeaning: Thou, Soma, art preeminent for wisdom: along the straightest path thou art our leader. Our prudent Fathers by thy wisdom, Soma, dealt out among the Gods their share of treasure.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thou, Soma, art preeminent for wisdom: along the straightest path thou art our leader. Our prudent Fathers by thy wisdom, Soma, dealt out among the Gods their share of treasure.

verses.sanskrit:
त्वया॒ हि न॑: पि॒तर॑: सोम॒ पूर्वे॒ कर्मा॑णि च॒क्रुः प॑वमान॒ धीरा॑: ।
व॒न्वन्नवा॑तः परि॒धीँ१ रपो॑र्णु वी॒रेभि॒रश्वै॑र्म॒घवा॑ भवा नः
verses.translation: For our sage Fathers, Soma Pavamâna, of old performed by thee their sacred duties. Fighting unvanquished, open the enclosures: enrich us with large gifts of steeds and heroes.
verses.hindi: सोम की रक्षा करनेवाला व्यक्ति सरल वृत्ति व स्वभाव का बनता हे। इसके जीवन मे व्यर्थं की चिन्तां उत्पत्र नहीं होती, इसीलिए यह दीर्घजीवी बनता हे। इसके जीवन में सत्य तथा माधुर्य होता दे। सूचना-' ऋतेन ' का अर्थ "यज्ञ से" भी है। यह सोम हममे यक्िय वृत्ति को उत्पन्न
verses.transliteration: tvayā hi na: pitara: soma pūrve karmāṇi cakruḥ pavamāna dhīrā: | vanvannavātaḥ paridhī~1 raporṇu vīrebhiraśvairmaghavā bhavā naḥ
verses.wordMeaning: For our sage Fathers, Soma Pavamâna, of old performed by thee their sacred duties. Fighting unvanquished, open the enclosures: enrich us with large gifts of steeds and heroes.
verses.commentary: Sense: For our sage Fathers, Soma Pavamâna, of old performed by thee their sacred duties. Fighting unvanquished, open the enclosures: enrich us with large gifts of steeds and heroes.

verses.sanskrit:
त्वᳪ सो॑म पि॒तृभि॑: संविदा॒नोऽनु॒ द्यावा॑पृथि॒वी आ त॑तन्थ ।
तस्मै॑ त इन्दो ह॒विषा॑ विधेम व॒यᳪ स्या॑म॒ पत॑यो रयी॒णाम्
verses.translation: Associate with the Fathers thou, O Soma, hast spread thyself abroad through earth and heaven. So with oblation let us serve thee, Indu, and so let us become the lords of riches.
verses.hindi: हम प्र्ञापूर्वक कर्मो में लगे रहने के द्वारा सोम का शरीर मेँ रक्षण करनेवाले ऋतेन सत्यमिं दियं विपान॑रशुक्रमन्ध॑सऽ इन्द्रस्येद्ियमिदं पयो ऽमुतं मधु।।७४॥ १. शुचिषत् ( पवित्रेषु विद्वत्सु सीदति-- द०) पवित्र जीवनवाले विद्वानों के सम्पर्क मे रहनेवाला, उन्हीं के सङ्क में बैठने-उठनेवाला हसः=( ठन्ति पाप्मानम्) सत्सङ् द्वारा पापों
verses.transliteration: tva soma pitṛbhi: saṃvidāno'nu dyāvāpṛthivī ā tatantha | tasmai ta indo haviṣā vidhema vaya syāma patayo rayīṇām
verses.wordMeaning: Associate with the Fathers thou, O Soma, hast spread thyself abroad through earth and heaven. So with oblation let us serve thee, Indu, and so let us become the lords of riches.
verses.commentary: Sense: Associate with the Fathers thou, O Soma, hast spread thyself abroad through earth and heaven. So with oblation let us serve thee, Indu, and so let us become the lords of riches.

verses.sanskrit:
बर्हि॑षदः पितर ऊ॒त्य र्वागि॒मा वो॑ ह॒व्या च॑कृमा जु॒षध्व॑म् ।
त आ ग॒ताव॑सा॒ शन्त॑मे॒नाथा॑ न॒: शं योर॑र॒पो द॑धात
verses.translation: Fathers who sit on sacred grass, come help us: these offerings we have made for you; accept them. So come to us with most auspicious favour, and give us health and strength without a trouble.
verses.hindi: शरीर मे सोम की रक्षा के लिए हम सत्सङ्ख के द्वारा आसुरवृत्ति को नष्ट करे। प्राणसाधना करर तथा ज्ञान की रुचिवाले हों। ऋतेन॑ सत्यम द्धियं विपानर्शुक्रमन्ध॑सऽडन्द्रस्येद्धिययिदं पयो ऽमृतं मधु॥।७५॥ ९. परिस्ुतः=( सर्वतः खुतः पक्वात्-द० ) सब प्रकार से परिपक्व अच्नात्-(यवादे:- द० )
verses.transliteration: barhiṣadaḥ pitara ūtya rvāgimā vo havyā cakṛmā juṣadhvam | ta ā gatāvasā śantamenāthā na: śaṃ yorarapo dadhāta
verses.wordMeaning: Fathers who sit on sacred grass, come help us: these offerings we have made for you; accept them. So come to us with most auspicious favour, and give us health and strength without a trouble.
verses.commentary: Sense: Fathers who sit on sacred grass, come help us: these offerings we have made for you; accept them. So come to us with most auspicious favour, and give us health and strength without a trouble.

verses.sanskrit:
आऽहं पि॒तॄन्त्सु॑वि॒दत्राँ॑२ अवित्सि॒ नपा॑तं च वि॒क्रम॑णं च॒ विष्णो॑: ।
ब॒र्हि॒षदो॒ ये स्व॒धया॑ सु॒तस्य॒ भज॑न्त पि॒त्वस्त इ॒हाग॑मिष्ठाः
verses.translation: I have attained the gracious-minded Fathers, have gained a son and progeny from Vishnu. They who enjoy pressed juices with oblation, seated on sacred grass, come oftenest hither.
verses.hindi: प्रजा का रक्षक राजा परिपक्व अन्नं का सेवन करता हुआ उत्पन्न सारभूत सोम का शरीर मे पान करता है, तभी यह प्रजाओं को क्षतो से वचानैवाला व प्रजाओं का वर्धन करनेवाला होता है। ब्रह्मचर्येण राजा राष्ट विरक्षतिब्रह्यचर्य से ही राजा राष्ट् कौ रेतः मूत्रं ( प्रजापति क्री राष्ट् कोदो भटे)
verses.transliteration: ā'haṃ pitṝntsuvidatrā~2 avitsi napātaṃ ca vikramaṇaṃ ca viṣṇo: | barhiṣado ye svadhayā sutasya bhajanta pitvasta ihāgamiṣṭhāḥ
verses.wordMeaning: I have attained the gracious-minded Fathers, have gained a son and progeny from Vishnu. They who enjoy pressed juices with oblation, seated on sacred grass, come oftenest hither.
verses.commentary: Sense: I have attained the gracious-minded Fathers, have gained a son and progeny from Vishnu. They who enjoy pressed juices with oblation, seated on sacred grass, come oftenest hither.

verses.sanskrit:
उप॑हूताः पि॒तर॑: सो॒म्यासो॑ बर्हि॒ष्ये॒षु नि॒धिषु॑ प्रि॒येषु॑ ।
त आ ग॑मन्तु॒ त इ॒ह श्रु॑व॒न्त्वधि॑ ब्रुवन्तु॒ ते॑ऽवन्त्व॒स्मान्
verses.translation: May they, the Fathers, worthy of the Soma, invited to their favourite oblations Laid on the sacred grass, come nigh and listen: may they be gracious unto us and bless us.
verses.hindi: चुना जाने पर राष्ट के सिंहासन पर वैठता हुजा राजा प्रजा मे शक्ति व गति का आधान करता है। प्रजा को वश में रखता हुआ यह शब्रुशोषक शक्ति से युक्त होता है। विकास के द्वारा राष्ट कौ उन्नति के आवरणों को दूर करता है। राष्ट पर आनेवाली आपत्तियों से राष्ट को वचाता है।
verses.transliteration: upahūtāḥ pitara: somyāso barhiṣyeṣu nidhiṣu priyeṣu | ta ā gamantu ta iha śruvantvadhi bruvantu te'vantvasmān
verses.wordMeaning: May they, the Fathers, worthy of the Soma, invited to their favourite oblations Laid on the sacred grass, come nigh and listen: may they be gracious unto us and bless us.
verses.commentary: Sense: May they, the Fathers, worthy of the Soma, invited to their favourite oblations Laid on the sacred grass, come nigh and listen: may they be gracious unto us and bless us.

verses.sanskrit:
आ य॑न्तु नः पि॒तर॑: सो॒म्यासो॑ऽग्निष्वा॒त्ताः प॒थिभि॑र्देव॒यानै॑: ।
अ॒स्मिन् य॒ज्ञे स्व॒धया॒ मद॒न्तोऽधि॑ ब्रुवन्तु॒ ते॒ऽवन्त्व॒स्मान्
verses.translation: May they our Fathers whom the flames have tasted, worthy of Soma, come on God-ward pathways. Enjoying at this sacrifice their portion, may they be gracious unto us and bless us.
verses.hindi: राजा राष्ट् में सत्यासत्य का ठीक विवेचन करनेवाला होता है तथा प्रजा में सत्य के प्रति श्रद्धा व अनृत के प्रति अश्रद्धा को उत्पन्न करने के लिए यत्नशील होता है। वेदेन रूपे व्य॑पिबत्सुतासुतौ प्रजापतिः । ऋतेन॑ सत्यमिं द्दरियं विपानःशुक्रमन्ध॑स्रऽ इन्द्रस्येद्धियमिदः पयो ऽमृतं मधु ॥।७८॥
verses.transliteration: ā yantu naḥ pitara: somyāso'gniṣvāttāḥ pathibhirdevayānai: | asmin yajñe svadhayā madanto'dhi bruvantu te'vantvasmān
verses.wordMeaning: May they our Fathers whom the flames have tasted, worthy of Soma, come on God-ward pathways. Enjoying at this sacrifice their portion, may they be gracious unto us and bless us.
verses.commentary: Sense: May they our Fathers whom the flames have tasted, worthy of Soma, come on God-ward pathways. Enjoying at this sacrifice their portion, may they be gracious unto us and bless us.

verses.sanskrit:
अग्नि॑ष्वात्ताः पितर॒ एह ग॑च्छत॒ सद॑: – सदः सदत सुप्रणीतयः ।
अ॒त्ता ह॒वीᳪषि॒ प्रय॑तानि ब॒र्हिष्यथा॑ र॒यिᳪ सर्व॑वीरं दधातन
verses.translation: Fathers whom Agni's flames have tasted, come ye nigh: ye kindly leaders, take ye each your proper place. Eat sacrificial food presented on the grass: grant riches with a multitude of hero sons.
verses.hindi: परिपक्व अन्न के रसो से उत्पन्न वीर्य मनुष्य-शरीर मेँ सुरक्षित होकर उसका आप्यायन करनेवाला होता है ओर उसे शान्त बनाता हे। अश्विनं यज्ञश्संविता सर॑स्वतीन्द्र॑स्य रूपं वरूणो भिषज्यन् ॥८०॥ ९. गतमन्त्रो मे राजा के राष्ट को सुरक्षित करने, उसमें न्याय-व्यवस्था को ठीक रखने
