verses.transliteration: agniṣvāttāḥ pitara eha gacchata sada: – sadaḥ sadata supraṇītayaḥ | attā havīṣi prayatāni barhiṣyathā rayi sarvavīraṃ dadhātana
verses.wordMeaning: Fathers whom Agni's flames have tasted, come ye nigh: ye kindly leaders, take ye each your proper place. Eat sacrificial food presented on the grass: grant riches with a multitude of hero sons.
verses.commentary: Sense: Fathers whom Agni's flames have tasted, come ye nigh: ye kindly leaders, take ye each your proper place. Eat sacrificial food presented on the grass: grant riches with a multitude of hero sons.

verses.sanskrit:
ये अ॑ग्निष्वा॒त्ता ये अन॑ग्निष्वात्ता॒ मध्ये॑ दि॒वः स्व॒धया॑ मा॒दय॑न्ते ।
तेभ्य॑: स्व॒राडसु॑नीतिमे॒तां य॑थाव॒शं त॒न्वं॒ कल्पयाति
verses.translation: For those who, burnt with fire or not cremated, joy in their portion in the midst of heaven, May the Self-Ruler form the world of spirits and this their body as his pleasure wills it.
verses.hindi: १. राजा राष्ट में कुटीर उद्योग की इस प्रकार व्यवस्था करे कि लोगों के जीवन में आर्थिक समस्यां उत्पन्न न हों। २. जीवनयज्ञ के उत्तम सञ्चालन करे लिए प्राणापान कौ शक्ति का वर्धन हो, निर्माण की वृत्ति हो तथा विज्ञान कौ वृद्धि हो। ३. ्र्प्या, द्वेष, मात्सर्य आदि के अभाव से सभी नीरोग व सुरूप हो।
verses.transliteration: ye agniṣvāttā ye anagniṣvāttā madhye divaḥ svadhayā mādayante | tebhya: svarāḍasunītimetāṃ yathāvaśaṃ tanvaṃ kalpayāti
verses.wordMeaning: For those who, burnt with fire or not cremated, joy in their portion in the midst of heaven, May the Self-Ruler form the world of spirits and this their body as his pleasure wills it.
verses.commentary: Sense: For those who, burnt with fire or not cremated, joy in their portion in the midst of heaven, May the Self-Ruler form the world of spirits and this their body as his pleasure wills it.

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒ग्नि॒ष्वा॒त्तानृ॑तु॒मतो॑ हवामहे नाराश॒ᳪसे सो॑मपी॒थं य आ॒शुः ।
ते नो॒ विप्रा॑सः सु॒हवा॑ भवन्तु व॒यᳪ स्या॑म॒ पत॑यो रयी॒णाम्
verses.translation: We call the Agnishvâttas, true to seasons, those who drank Soma in the Nârâsamsa. Prompt to give ear to us be they, the sages, and then let us be lords of wealth and treasure.
verses.hindi: प्रज्ञापूर्वक कर्मो से हमारे शरीर की कान्ति बनी रहती है। २. हमारे जीवन मे सूर्यं के समान ानज्योति हो, चन्द्र के समान मानस आह्वाद हो तथा अग्नि के समान शरीर में शक्ति कौ उष्णता हो। ३. शाष्प, तोक्म व लाजा प्रयोग खे हमारे लोम, त्वचा व अस्थि मज्जानं मासरैः कारोतरेण दध॑तो गवौ त्वचि।।८२॥
verses.transliteration: agniṣvāttānṛtumato havāmahe nārāśase somapīthaṃ ya āśuḥ | te no viprāsaḥ suhavā bhavantu vaya syāma patayo rayīṇām
verses.wordMeaning: We call the Agnishvâttas, true to seasons, those who drank Soma in the Nârâsamsa. Prompt to give ear to us be they, the sages, and then let us be lords of wealth and treasure.
verses.commentary: Sense: We call the Agnishvâttas, true to seasons, those who drank Soma in the Nârâsamsa. Prompt to give ear to us be they, the sages, and then let us be lords of wealth and treasure.

verses.sanskrit:
आच्या॒ जानु॑ दक्षिण॒तो नि॒षद्ये॒मं य॒ज्ञम॒भि गृ॑णीत॒ विश्वे॑ ।
मा हि॑ᳪसिष्ट पितर॒: केन॑ चिन्नो॒ यद्व॒ आग॑: पुरु॒षता॒ करा॑म
verses.translation: Bowing the bended knee and seated southward, accept ye, all, this sacrifice with favour. Injure us not for any sin, O Fathers, which we through human frailty have committed.
verses.hindi: प्राणापान वैद्य हैँ, लान से अन्तःसौन्दर्य प्राप्त होता हे। सदा प्रसन्न रहने से अस्थि, मज्जा आदि टीक रहते है। उत्तमता से कर्मो मे लगे रहने से मनुष्य ज्ञान कौ १. सरस्वती =जलान की अधिदेवता मनसा-मनन- संकल्प से तथा नासत्याभ्याम् प्राणापाना के द्वारा पेशलम् लचकीले, कोमल (5०१), सूखे काठ कौ भांति न अकडे हए, वसु
verses.transliteration: ācyā jānu dakṣiṇato niṣadyemaṃ yajñamabhi gṛṇīta viśve | mā hisiṣṭa pitara: kena cinno yadva āga: puruṣatā karāma
verses.wordMeaning: Bowing the bended knee and seated southward, accept ye, all, this sacrifice with favour. Injure us not for any sin, O Fathers, which we through human frailty have committed.
verses.commentary: Sense: Bowing the bended knee and seated southward, accept ye, all, this sacrifice with favour. Injure us not for any sin, O Fathers, which we through human frailty have committed.

verses.sanskrit:
आसी॑नासो अरु॒णीना॑मु॒पस्थे॑ र॒यिं ध॑त्त दा॒शुषे॒ मर्त्या॑य ।
पु॒त्रेभ्य॑: पितर॒स्तस्य॒ वस्व॒: प्र य॑च्छत॒ त इ॒होर्जं॑ दधात
verses.translation: Lapped in the bosom of the purple Mornings give riches to the man who brings oblation. Grant to his sons a portion of your treasure, and, present, give us energy, ye Fathers.
verses.hindi: (क) हमें ज्ञानपूर्वक आहार विहार करना चादिए, (ख) विचारशील उत्तम संकल्पवाला होना चाहिए. (ग) प्राणापान की शक्ति का वर्धन करना चाहिए, (घ) शरीर की उन्नति के लिए पक्वान्नं के रस का ग्रहण करना चाहिए तथा (ङ) त्यागवृत्तिवाला व धर्यशील बनकर नीरोग व विकसित शरीरवाला बनना चाहिए्।
verses.transliteration: āsīnāso aruṇīnāmupasthe rayiṃ dhatta dāśuṣe martyāya | putrebhya: pitarastasya vasva: pra yacchata ta ihorjaṃ dadhāta
verses.wordMeaning: Lapped in the bosom of the purple Mornings give riches to the man who brings oblation. Grant to his sons a portion of your treasure, and, present, give us energy, ye Fathers.
verses.commentary: Sense: Lapped in the bosom of the purple Mornings give riches to the man who brings oblation. Grant to his sons a portion of your treasure, and, present, give us energy, ye Fathers.

verses.sanskrit: यम॑ग्ने कव्यवाहन॒ त्वं चि॒न्मन्य॑से र॒यिम् । तन्नो॑ गी॒र्भिः श्र॒वाय्यं॑ देव॒त्रा प॑नया॒ युज॑म्
verses.translation: O Agni Kavyavâhana, cause us to praise before the Gods, As our associate meet for lauds, wealth which e’en thou reputest wealth.
verses.hindi: (क) दूध के प्रयोग से वीर्यशक्ति को उत्सन्न करे. (ख) आत्म- नियन्त्रण व गतिशीलता से उस शक्ति की रक्षा करे (ग) अमति व दुर्मित कौ अपने से दूर करें, (घ) आमाशय-नाडी (आन्त्र) व पक्वाशय में प्रविष्ट अन्न के उपादेयांश को अपने समीप रक्खे तथा मलरूप हेयांश को अपने से दूर करं, जिससे पूर्णं स्वास्थ्य कौ प्राप्त कर सक।
verses.transliteration: yamagne kavyavāhana tvaṃ cinmanyase rayim | tanno gīrbhiḥ śravāyyaṃ devatrā panayā yujam
verses.wordMeaning: O Agni Kavyavâhana, cause us to praise before the Gods, As our associate meet for lauds, wealth which e’en thou reputest wealth.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Agni Kavyavâhana, cause us to praise before the Gods, As our associate meet for lauds, wealth which e’en thou reputest wealth.

verses.sanskrit:
यो अ॒ग्निः क॑व्य॒वाह॑नः पि॒तॄन् यक्ष॑दृता॒वृध॑: ।
प्रेदु॑ ह॒व्यानि॑ वोचति दे॒वेभ्य॑श्च पि॒तृभ्य॒ आ
verses.translation: May Agni, Kavya-bearer, who hath worshipped Fathers true to Law. Announce to Gods and Fathers these our sacrificial offerings.
verses.hindi: (क) जितेन्द्रिय पुरुष शरीर को स्वस्थ्य, हदय को सत्यमय तथा मस्तिष्क को निर्माणात्मक विचारोँवाला बनाता है, (ख) ईर्प्यादि से ऊपर उठकर यह अपने यकृत्, क्लोम व मसानों को विकृत नहीं होने देता (ग) वायव्य पदार्थो के प्रयोग से पित्त को संयत ९. गतमन्त्र के "सुत्रामा इन्द्र' कौ मधु-मधुरगुणान्विति अन्न को पिन्वमानाः=सेवन
verses.transliteration: yo agniḥ kavyavāhanaḥ pitṝn yakṣadṛtāvṛdha: | predu havyāni vocati devebhyaśca pitṛbhya ā
verses.wordMeaning: May Agni, Kavya-bearer, who hath worshipped Fathers true to Law. Announce to Gods and Fathers these our sacrificial offerings.
verses.commentary: Sense: May Agni, Kavya-bearer, who hath worshipped Fathers true to Law. Announce to Gods and Fathers these our sacrificial offerings.

verses.sanskrit:
त्वम॑ग्न ईडि॒तः क॑व्यवाह॒नावा॑ड्ढ॒व्यानि॑ सुर॒भीणि॑ कृ॒त्वी ।
प्रादा॑: पि॒तृभ्य॑: स्व॒धया॒ ते अ॑क्षन्न॒द्धि त्वं दे॑व॒ प्रय॑ता ह॒वीᳪषि॑
verses.translation: Thou. Agni Kavya-bearer, when entreated, didst bear the offerings which thou madest fragrant, And gayest to the Fathers who did eat them with Svadhâ. Eat, thou God, the gifts we bring thee.
verses.hindi: (क) जिस समय हमारी ओते अन्न का ठीक परिपाक करेगी, (ख) गुदा आदि इन्द्रियो मल के दूरीकरण से रक्षिका होगी, (ग) धमनिर्योँ रुधिरादि का ठीक पूरण करेगी (घ) प्लीहा अविकृत होकर हमारे उत्थान का कारण बनेगा, (ङ) नाभि सब शक्तियों च प्रज्ञानों का आधार बनेगी ओर (च) उदर रुधिरादि का निर्माण करेगा, तभी हम
verses.transliteration: tvamagna īḍitaḥ kavyavāhanāvāḍḍhavyāni surabhīṇi kṛtvī | prādā: pitṛbhya: svadhayā te akṣannaddhi tvaṃ deva prayatā havīṣi
verses.wordMeaning: Thou. Agni Kavya-bearer, when entreated, didst bear the offerings which thou madest fragrant, And gayest to the Fathers who did eat them with Svadhâ. Eat, thou God, the gifts we bring thee.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thou. Agni Kavya-bearer, when entreated, didst bear the offerings which thou madest fragrant, And gayest to the Fathers who did eat them with Svadhâ. Eat, thou God, the gifts we bring thee.

verses.sanskrit:
ये चे॒ह पि॒तरो॒ ये च॒ नेह याँश्च॑ वि॒द्म याँ२ उ॑ च॒ न प्र॑वि॒द्म ।
त्वं वे॑त्थ॒ यति॒ ते जा॑तवेदः स्व॒धाभि॑र्य॒ज्ञँ सुकृ॑तं जुषस्व
verses.translation: Thou, Jâtavedas, knowest well the number of Fathers who are here and who are absent, Of Fathers whom we know and whom we know not. Accept the sacrifice arranged with portions.
verses.hindi: ‹ कुम्भ" अर्थात् अपने अन्दर शक्ति व आनन्द का पूरण करनेवाले के सब अङ्क सुन्दर होते हैँ। मुख ओर सिर तो उत्कृष्ट होते ही है, इसकी जिह्वा व इसके प्राणापान -पवित्र होते है। इसके मुख मे सरस्वती का निवास होता है। इसकौ मलशोधक इदर्यो भी मलशोधन के द्वारा इसे बलवान् बनाती हे।
verses.transliteration: ye ceha pitaro ye ca neha yā~śca vidma yā~2 u ca na pravidma | tvaṃ vettha yati te jātavedaḥ svadhābhiryajña~ sukṛtaṃ juṣasva
verses.wordMeaning: Thou, Jâtavedas, knowest well the number of Fathers who are here and who are absent, Of Fathers whom we know and whom we know not. Accept the sacrifice arranged with portions.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thou, Jâtavedas, knowest well the number of Fathers who are here and who are absent, Of Fathers whom we know and whom we know not. Accept the sacrifice arranged with portions.

verses.sanskrit:
इ॒दं पि॒तृभ्यो॒ नमो॑ अस्त्व॒द्य ये पूर्वा॑सो॒ य उप॑रास ई॒युः ।
ये पार्थि॑वे॒ रज॒स्या निष॑त्ता॒ ये वा॑ नू॒नᳪ सु॑वृ॒जना॑सु वि॒क्षु
verses.translation: Now let us pay this homage to the Fathers, to those who passed of old and those who followed, Those who have rested in the earthly region and those who dwell among the Mighty Races.
verses.hindi: मनुष्य को चाहिए कि प्राणशक्ति के साथ ज्ञान का भी वर्धन करे। बकरी के दूध तथा ठीक पके ठव्य पदार्थो के सेवन से तेजस्वी बरने। अत्न के ग्रहण के साथ गुणों को भी ग्रहण करे। सुन्दर वस्त्रौ के साथ शब्द भी सुन्दर बोले। इसकी शक्ति इसे स्वास्थ्य का सौन्दर्य प्राप्त कराये। कपडे बहुत तंग न पहने।
verses.transliteration: idaṃ pitṛbhyo namo astvadya ye pūrvāso ya uparāsa īyuḥ | ye pārthive rajasyā niṣattā ye vā nūna suvṛjanāsu vikṣu
verses.wordMeaning: Now let us pay this homage to the Fathers, to those who passed of old and those who followed, Those who have rested in the earthly region and those who dwell among the Mighty Races.
verses.commentary: Sense: Now let us pay this homage to the Fathers, to those who passed of old and those who followed, Those who have rested in the earthly region and those who dwell among the Mighty Races.

verses.sanskrit:
अधा॒ यथा॑ नः पि॒तर॒: परा॑सः प्र॒त्नासो॑ अग्न ऋ॒तमा॑शुषा॒णाः ।
शुचीद॑य॒न् दीधि॑तिमुक्थ॒शास॒: क्षामा॑ भि॒न्दन्तो॑ अरु॒णीरप॑ व्रन्
verses.translation: As in the days of old our ancient Fathers speeding the work of holy worship, Agni! Sought pure light and devotion, singing praises, they cleft the ground and made red Dawns apparent.
verses.hindi: हम अपना रक्षण करे। उत्तमत्ता में स्पर्धावाले हो। सदा नासिका से श्वास लेते हुए शक्ति का वर्धन कर। आचार्य से उक्त का अनुवाद करते हुए ज्ञान को बाण तथा इन्द्रियों, मन व बुद्धि की स्थिरता से नाडी- संस्थान को ठीक रक्खे, प्राणापान का वर्धन करर तथा हदय को वासनाशन्य बनाएं।
verses.transliteration: adhā yathā naḥ pitara: parāsaḥ pratnāso agna ṛtamāśuṣāṇāḥ | śucīdayan dīdhitimukthaśāsa: kṣāmā bhindanto aruṇīrapa vran
verses.wordMeaning: As in the days of old our ancient Fathers speeding the work of holy worship, Agni! Sought pure light and devotion, singing praises, they cleft the ground and made red Dawns apparent.
verses.commentary: Sense: As in the days of old our ancient Fathers speeding the work of holy worship, Agni! Sought pure light and devotion, singing praises, they cleft the ground and made red Dawns apparent.

verses.sanskrit: उ॒शन्त॑स्त्वा॒ नि धी॑मह्यु॒शन्त॒: समि॑धीमहि । उ॒शन्नु॑श॒त आ व॑ह पि॒तॄन् ह॒विषे॒ अत्त॑वे
verses.translation: Right gladly do we set thee down, right gladly make thee burn and glow. Gladly bring yearning Fathers nigh to eat the food of sacrifice.
verses.hindi: जितेन्द्रिय पुरुष-(क) क्रिया के द्वारा शक्तिशाली होता है, (ख) कानों से खदा ज्ञान की वाणियों को सुनता है, (ग) प्राणापान के द्वारा शुद्ध वायु के ग्रहण से नीरोग बनता है, (घ) जौ आदि सात्विक अत्रं के प्रयोग से इसका हदय वासनाशून्य होता है, (ङ) इसका मन इसके मन;प्रसाद को प्रकट करता है ओर (च) यह उत्साहमय सारभूत
verses.transliteration: uśantastvā ni dhīmahyuśanta: samidhīmahi | uśannuśata ā vaha pitṝn haviṣe attave
verses.wordMeaning: Right gladly do we set thee down, right gladly make thee burn and glow. Gladly bring yearning Fathers nigh to eat the food of sacrifice.
verses.commentary: Sense: Right gladly do we set thee down, right gladly make thee burn and glow. Gladly bring yearning Fathers nigh to eat the food of sacrifice.

verses.sanskrit: अ॒पां फेने॑न॒ नमु॑चे॒: शिर॑ इ॒न्द्रोद॑वर्तयः । विश्वा॒ यदज॑य॒ स्पृध॑:
verses.translation: Indra, with waters’ foam didst thou wrench off the head of Namuchi, Subduing all contending hosts.
verses.hindi: उपासक अस्तेय धर्म का पालन करता है। भरपूर युवावस्था मे भी विषयों का परिग्रही नहीं बनता। ज्ञान के कारण यशस्वी व श्रीसम्पन्न कार्यो कौ ही करता हे। इसका ज्ञान इसे अहिसक बनाता दहै। यह दीप्त होता हे, वीर्यसम्पत्त अङ्गौवाला होता हे। शतस्रानम् जायुः "प्रसाद-प्रकाश-प्रभाव'
verses.transliteration: apāṃ phenena namuce: śira indrodavartayaḥ | viśvā yadajaya spṛdha:
verses.wordMeaning: Indra, with waters’ foam didst thou wrench off the head of Namuchi, Subduing all contending hosts.
verses.commentary: Sense: Indra, with waters’ foam didst thou wrench off the head of Namuchi, Subduing all contending hosts.

verses.sanskrit:
सोमो॒ राजा॒मृत॑ᳪ सु॒त ऋ॑जी॒षेणा॑जहान्मृ॒त्युम् ।
ऋ॒तेन॑ स॒त्यमि॑न्द्रि॒यं वि॒पान॑ᳪ शु॒क्रमन्ध॑स॒ इन्द्र॑स्येन्द्रि॒यमि॒दं पयो॒ऽमृतं॒ मधु॑
verses.translation: King Soma, pressed, the Drink of Life, left Death behind with Soma-dregs. By Law came truth and Indra-power, the pure bright drinking-off of juice. The power of Indra was this sweet immortal milk.
verses.hindi: जितेन्द्रिय पुरुष अपने अङ्कं को आत्मा में स्थापित करने का प्रयत्न करता है, प्राणापान-शक्ति की वृद्धि से नीरोग होता है, ज्ञान व योगाद्धों से प्रभु से मेल करता हे, सौ वर्ष तक जीता ठै, प्रसन्न रहता हे, ज्योतिर्मय व विषयों के पीक्ठे न मरनेवाला होता हे। कर्मो मे रख व उसका त्नाभ
verses.transliteration: somo rājāmṛta suta ṛjīṣeṇājahānmṛtyum | ṛtena satyamindriyaṃ vipāna śukramandhasa indrasyendriyamidaṃ payo'mṛtaṃ madhu
verses.wordMeaning: King Soma, pressed, the Drink of Life, left Death behind with Soma-dregs. By Law came truth and Indra-power, the pure bright drinking-off of juice. The power of Indra was this sweet immortal milk.
verses.commentary: Sense: King Soma, pressed, the Drink of Life, left Death behind with Soma-dregs. By Law came truth and Indra-power, the pure bright drinking-off of juice. The power of Indra was this sweet immortal milk.

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒द्भ्यः क्षी॒रं व्य॑पिब॒त् क्रुङ्ङा॑ङ्गिर॒सो धि॒या ।
ऋ॒तेन॑ स॒त्यमि॑न्द्रि॒यं वि॒पान॑ᳪ शु॒क्रमन्ध॑स॒ इन्द्र॑स्येन्द्रि॒यमि॒दं पयो॒ऽमृतं॒ मधु॑
verses.translation: The Snipe of Angiras by thought from out the waters drank up milk. By Law came truth, etc., as in 72.
verses.hindi: पशुओं का दूध, यज्ञशेष अन्न व शहद के प्रयोग से मै अमरत=नीरोग बनं। चुद्धि की तीव्रता से ज्ञानी बनकर ( विनीत बनूँ)। ठीक अन्नं का प्रयोग मुड्े शक्तिशाली लनाये। यह ' अमृत- सोम -इन्दु' ही राजा बनने के -योग्य है। इस राजा के वर्णन से ही अगले
verses.transliteration: adbhyaḥ kṣīraṃ vyapibat kruṅṅāṅgiraso dhiyā | ṛtena satyamindriyaṃ vipāna śukramandhasa indrasyendriyamidaṃ payo'mṛtaṃ madhu
verses.wordMeaning: The Snipe of Angiras by thought from out the waters drank up milk. By Law came truth, etc., as in 72.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Snipe of Angiras by thought from out the waters drank up milk. By Law came truth, etc., as in 72.

verses.sanskrit:
सोम॑म॒द्भ्यो व्य॑पिब॒च्छन्द॑सा ह॒ᳪसः शु॑चि॒षत् ।
ऋ॒तेन॑ स॒त्यमि॑न्द्रि॒यं वि॒पान॑ᳪ शु॒क्रमन्ध॑स॒ इन्द्र॑स्येन्द्रि॒यमि॒दं पयो॒ऽमृतं॒ मधु॑
verses.translation: The Hamsa throned in light drank up by metre Soma from the floods. By Law, etc.
verses.hindi: मधुर व्यवहारवाले हो। (ङ) सोम कौ रक्षा करनेवाले ब उसका शरीर में ठीक परिपाक करनेवाले हों, जिससे उनकी प्राणापान शक्ति बनी रहे, वे उत्तम ज्ञान को प्राप्त करनेवाले ओर अन्त में सूक्ष्म बुद्धि द्वारा प्रभु का दर्शन करनेवाले हों। १. गतमन्त्र के अनुसार सोम का शरीर में रक्षण व परिपाक करते हए ये पति-पत्नी
verses.transliteration: somamadbhyo vyapibacchandasā hasaḥ śuciṣat | ṛtena satyamindriyaṃ vipāna śukramandhasa indrasyendriyamidaṃ payo'mṛtaṃ madhu
verses.wordMeaning: The Hamsa throned in light drank up by metre Soma from the floods. By Law, etc.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Hamsa throned in light drank up by metre Soma from the floods. By Law, etc.

verses.sanskrit:
अन्ना॑त्परि॒स्रुतो॒ रसं॒ ब्रह्म॑णा॒ व्य॑पिबत् क्ष॒त्रं पय॒: सोमं॑ प्र॒जाप॑तिः ।
ऋ॒तेन॑ स॒त्यमि॑न्द्रि॒यं वि॒पान॑ᳪ शु॒क्रमन्ध॑स॒ इन्द्र॑स्येन्द्रि॒यमि॒दं पयो॒ऽमृतं॒ मधु॑
verses.translation: Prajâpati by Brahma drank the essence from the foaming food, the princely power, milk, Soma juice. By Law, etc.
verses.hindi: -श्रद्धा सोम को पवित्र करती हे, क्योंकि यह वासनाओं का निवारण करती है, हमें स्पूर्ति-सम्पतन व कर्मठ बनाती है तथा शक्तियों के विस्तार के लिए प्रेरित करती ठै। शुक्रेण देव देवता: पिपृग्धि रसेनान्नं यज॑मानाय धेहि ॥५॥ ९. सुतः = उत्पन्न हुञा सोमः यह सोम सुरया=( सुरा 10 ०ला11. 10 111€) शासन के
verses.transliteration: annātparisruto rasaṃ brahmaṇā vyapibat kṣatraṃ paya: somaṃ prajāpatiḥ | ṛtena satyamindriyaṃ vipāna śukramandhasa indrasyendriyamidaṃ payo'mṛtaṃ madhu
verses.wordMeaning: Prajâpati by Brahma drank the essence from the foaming food, the princely power, milk, Soma juice. By Law, etc.
verses.commentary: Sense: Prajâpati by Brahma drank the essence from the foaming food, the princely power, milk, Soma juice. By Law, etc.

verses.sanskrit:
रेतो॒ मूत्रं॒ वि ज॑हाति॒ योनिं॑ प्रवि॒शदि॑न्द्र॒यिम् । गर्भो॑ ज॒रायु॒णाऽऽवृ॑त॒ उल्बं॑ जहाति॒ जन्म॑ना ।
ऋ॒तेन॑ स॒त्यमि॑न्द्रि॒यं वि॒पान॑ᳪ शु॒क्रमन्ध॑स॒ इन्द्र॑स्येन्द्रि॒यमि॒दं पयो॒ऽमृतं॒ मधु॑
verses.translation: The generative part enters the yoni: it leaves aside the retas and the mûtra. The caul-invested embryo leaves by its birth the covering folds. By Law, etc.
verses.hindi: हम यव आदि सात्विक भोजनों खे पवित्र विचारोवाले हौकर प्रभु का उपासन करे। वे प्रभु " कुविदज् ' है, शक्तिशाली गति देनेवाले है। प्रभु के सम्पर्क सेमे भी तेज, वीर्य व बल को प्राप्त करता ह। सूचना-' कुवित् इति बल नाम । कुवित् बल वाचक टै, सम्भवतः यही शब्द विकृत
verses.transliteration: reto mūtraṃ vi jahāti yoniṃ praviśadindrayim | garbho jarāyuṇā''vṛta ulbaṃ jahāti janmanā | ṛtena satyamindriyaṃ vipāna śukramandhasa indrasyendriyamidaṃ payo'mṛtaṃ madhu
verses.wordMeaning: The generative part enters the yoni: it leaves aside the retas and the mûtra. The caul-invested embryo leaves by its birth the covering folds. By Law, etc.
verses.commentary: Sense: The generative part enters the yoni: it leaves aside the retas and the mûtra. The caul-invested embryo leaves by its birth the covering folds. By Law, etc.

verses.sanskrit:
दृ॒ष्ट्वा रू॒पे व्याक॑रोत् सत्यानृ॒ते प्र॒जाप॑तिः । अश्र॑द्धा॒मनृ॒तेऽद॑धाच्छ्र॒द्धाᳪ स॒त्ये प्र॒जाप॑तिः ।
ऋ॒तेन॑ स॒त्यमि॑न्द्रि॒यं वि॒पान॑ᳪ शु॒क्रमन्ध॑स॒ इन्द्र॑स्येन्द्रि॒यमि॒दं पयो॒ऽमृतं॒ मधु॑
verses.translation: Viewing both forms Prajâpati gave truth and falsehood different shapes. Prajâpati assigned the lack of faith to falsehood, faith to truth. By Law, etc.
verses.hindi: पति-पत्नी अपने-अपने कार्यक्ेत्र का ग्रहण करके प्रभु-स्मरणपूर्वक अपने कार्यो को करेगे तो घर सचमुच "आभूति' का घ्र बनेगा, जो सब दुष्टिकोणों से फूला-फला है (आ भूति)। वहं स्वास्थ्य होगा, सुसन्तान होगी. सम्पत्ति होगी ओर इन सबसे बदकर वर्ह " सत्य' होगा।
verses.transliteration: dṛṣṭvā rūpe vyākarot satyānṛte prajāpatiḥ | aśraddhāmanṛte'dadhācchraddhā satye prajāpatiḥ | ṛtena satyamindriyaṃ vipāna śukramandhasa indrasyendriyamidaṃ payo'mṛtaṃ madhu
verses.wordMeaning: Viewing both forms Prajâpati gave truth and falsehood different shapes. Prajâpati assigned the lack of faith to falsehood, faith to truth. By Law, etc.
verses.commentary: Sense: Viewing both forms Prajâpati gave truth and falsehood different shapes. Prajâpati assigned the lack of faith to falsehood, faith to truth. By Law, etc.

verses.sanskrit:
वेदे॑न रू॒पे व्य॑पिबत् सुतासु॒तौ प्र॒जाप॑तिः ।
ऋ॒तेन॑ स॒त्यमि॑न्द्रि॒यं वि॒पान॑ᳪ शु॒क्रमन्ध॑स॒ इन्द्र॑स्येन्द्रि॒यमि॒दं पयो॒ऽमृतं॒ मधु॑
verses.translation: By holy lore Prajâpati drank up both forms, pressed and unpressed. By Law, etc.
verses.hindi: मेरा अत्रमयकोश तेजस्वी हो, प्राणमयकोश वीर्यवान् हो। मनोमयकोश में मे बल व ओज को धारण करूं। मेरा विज्ञानमयकोश मन्यु जान से परिपूर्णं हो, ओर सहस् को अपनाकर मेँ आनन्दमयकोशवाला बनू। श्येनं प॑तत्त्िण॑सिश्टःसेमं पात्वश्टंसः।॥॥९०॥
verses.transliteration: vedena rūpe vyapibat sutāsutau prajāpatiḥ | ṛtena satyamindriyaṃ vipāna śukramandhasa indrasyendriyamidaṃ payo'mṛtaṃ madhu
verses.wordMeaning: By holy lore Prajâpati drank up both forms, pressed and unpressed. By Law, etc.
verses.commentary: Sense: By holy lore Prajâpati drank up both forms, pressed and unpressed. By Law, etc.

verses.sanskrit:
दृ॒ष्ट्वा प॑रि॒स्रुतो॒ रस॑ᳪ शु॒क्रेण॑ शु॒क्रं व्य॑पिबत् पय॒: सोमं॑ प्र॒जाप॑तिः ।
ऋ॒तेन॑ स॒त्यमि॑न्द्रि॒यं वि॒पान॑ᳪ शु॒क्रमन्ध॑स॒ इन्द्र॑स्येन्द्रि॒यमि॒दं पयो॒ऽमृतं॒ मधु॑
verses.translation: Seeing the farming liquor's sap, Prajâpati with the bright drank nut the bright the milk, the Soma juice. By Law, etc.
verses.hindi: हम शक्तिसम्पन्न बनकर स्वस्थ, प्रमुदित सन्तान को जन्म दे। उन सन्तानं को सद्गुणो से संपृक्त करें तथा विगुणो से विपृक्त करक पितृऋण से अनृण हो। देवा यज्ञम॑तन्वत भेषजं भिषजाश्विना १. गतमन्त्र में अपने को भद्र से संपृक्त करने व पाप से विपृक्त करने का उल्लेख हे।
verses.transliteration: dṛṣṭvā parisruto rasa śukreṇa śukraṃ vyapibat paya: somaṃ prajāpatiḥ | ṛtena satyamindriyaṃ vipāna śukramandhasa indrasyendriyamidaṃ payo'mṛtaṃ madhu
verses.wordMeaning: Seeing the farming liquor's sap, Prajâpati with the bright drank nut the bright the milk, the Soma juice. By Law, etc.
verses.commentary: Sense: Seeing the farming liquor's sap, Prajâpati with the bright drank nut the bright the milk, the Soma juice. By Law, etc.

verses.sanskrit:
सीसे॑न॒ तन्त्रं॒ मन॑सा मनी॒षिण॑ ऊर्णासू॒त्रेण॑ क॒वयो॑ वयन्ति ।
अ॒श्विना॑ य॒ज्ञᳪ स॑वि॒ता सर॑स्व॒तीन्द्र॑स्य रू॒पं वरु॑णो भिष॒ज्यन्
verses.translation: Wise, with mind, lead, and thread of wool the sages twine an amulet. Sarasvatî, Savitar, Varuna, the Asvins span sacrifice and healed his form for Indra.
verses.hindi: दीक्षित व्यक्ति शष्पभोजन का व्रत लेता हे, प्रकृष्ट जीवन बितानेवाला नव प्ररूढ यवों के प्रयोग का निश्चय करता है ओर सोम के क्रय (प्राप्ति) की इच्छावाला सोम का सौदागर बनने कौ कामनावाला " लाजा, सोमांशु व मधु! का प्रयोग करता हे। १. "अत सातत्यगमने से बनकर  अतिथि" शब्द प्रभु कौ ओर निरन्तर चलनेवाले का
verses.transliteration: sīsena tantraṃ manasā manīṣiṇa ūrṇāsūtreṇa kavayo vayanti | aśvinā yajña savitā sarasvatīndrasya rūpaṃ varuṇo bhiṣajyan
verses.wordMeaning: Wise, with mind, lead, and thread of wool the sages twine an amulet. Sarasvatî, Savitar, Varuna, the Asvins span sacrifice and healed his form for Indra.
verses.commentary: Sense: Wise, with mind, lead, and thread of wool the sages twine an amulet. Sarasvatî, Savitar, Varuna, the Asvins span sacrifice and healed his form for Indra.

verses.sanskrit:
तद॑स्य रू॒पम॒मृत॒ᳪ शची॑भिस्त॒स्रो द॑धुर्दे॒वता॑: सᳪररा॒णाः ।
लोमा॑नि॒ शष्पै॑र्बहु॒धा न तोक्म॑भि॒स्त्वग॑स्य मा॒ᳪसम॑भव॒न्न ला॒जाः
verses.translation: This his immortal shape with mighty powers three Deities bestowing gifts compounded. His hair they made with sprouts of grass and barley, and roasted grain with skin and flesh supplied him.
verses.hindi: (क) आचार्यो का एक ही कार्यो कि वे ज्ञान देने में लगे रहें, (ख) विद्यार्थियों का भी एक ही कार्यदहौ कि वे उस ज्ञान को अपने साथ सङ्कत करने का प्रयत्न अर्धऽऋचैरुक्थानाश्शररूपं पहैरराप्नोति निविदः ९. अर्धऋचैः- मन्त्र भाग से उक्थानाम्प्रवचनों का रूपम्-सोन्दर्य आप्नोतिनप्राप्त
verses.transliteration: tadasya rūpamamṛta śacībhistasro dadhurdevatā: sararāṇāḥ | lomāni śaṣpairbahudhā na tokmabhistvagasya māsamabhavanna lājāḥ
verses.wordMeaning: This his immortal shape with mighty powers three Deities bestowing gifts compounded. His hair they made with sprouts of grass and barley, and roasted grain with skin and flesh supplied him.
verses.commentary: Sense: This his immortal shape with mighty powers three Deities bestowing gifts compounded. His hair they made with sprouts of grass and barley, and roasted grain with skin and flesh supplied him.

verses.sanskrit:
तद॒श्विना॑ भि॒षजा॑ रु॒द्रव॑र्तनी॒ सर॑स्वती वयति॒ पेशो॒ अन्त॑रम् ।
अस्थि॑ म॒ज्जानं॒ मास॑रैः कारोत॒रेण॒ दध॑तो॒ गवां॑ त्व॒चि
verses.translation: His inner shape Sarasvatî arranges and, borne on bright paths, the Physician Asvins: With Mâsaras and sieve his bone and marrow, as on the Oxen's hide they lay the liquor.
verses.hindi: हम वायु की भाँति क्रियाशील व बुराइयों का संहार करनेवाले बने, संविभागपूर्वक कार्यो को करते हए हम गतिशील व षोडशकला सम्पूर्णं देहवाले हों। आनन्दमयता से हम महान् बनें, स्थिरता को अपनार्। रषिः-हैमवर्चिः। देवता-यज्ञः। छन्दः-अनुष्टुप्। स्वरः गान्धारः।।
verses.transliteration: tadaśvinā bhiṣajā rudravartanī sarasvatī vayati peśo antaram | asthi majjānaṃ māsaraiḥ kārotareṇa dadhato gavāṃ tvaci
verses.wordMeaning: His inner shape Sarasvatî arranges and, borne on bright paths, the Physician Asvins: With Mâsaras and sieve his bone and marrow, as on the Oxen's hide they lay the liquor.
verses.commentary: Sense: His inner shape Sarasvatî arranges and, borne on bright paths, the Physician Asvins: With Mâsaras and sieve his bone and marrow, as on the Oxen's hide they lay the liquor.

verses.sanskrit:
सर॑स्वती॒ मन॑सा पेश॒लं वसु॒ नास॑त्याभ्यां वयति दर्श॒तं वपु॑: ।
रसं॑ परि॒स्रुता॒ न रोहि॑तं न॒ग्नहु॒र्धीर॒स्तस॑रं॒ न वेम॑
verses.translation: By thought Sarasvatî with both Nâsatyas forms lovely treasure and a beauteous body. Like shuttle through the loom the steady ferment mixes the red juice with the foaming spirit.
verses.hindi: हमारा भोजन अन्न, फल, शाक व दूध्हो। हम सत्य से सव इष्टकार्यो कौ सिद्ध करे। शान्ति से गृहस्थ में यज्ञो का सेवन करे। इन सम्यक् कृत यज्ञो के द्वारा स्थितप्रज्ञता व ब्राह्मीस्थिति को प्राप्त करे। दर्षिणा श्रद्धा्माप्नोति श्रद्धयां सत्यमांप्यते ॥॥३०॥
verses.transliteration: sarasvatī manasā peśalaṃ vasu nāsatyābhyāṃ vayati darśataṃ vapu: | rasaṃ parisrutā na rohitaṃ nagnahurdhīrastasaraṃ na vema
verses.wordMeaning: By thought Sarasvatî with both Nâsatyas forms lovely treasure and a beauteous body. Like shuttle through the loom the steady ferment mixes the red juice with the foaming spirit.
verses.commentary: Sense: By thought Sarasvatî with both Nâsatyas forms lovely treasure and a beauteous body. Like shuttle through the loom the steady ferment mixes the red juice with the foaming spirit.

verses.sanskrit:
पय॑सा शु॒क्रम॒मृतं॑ ज॒नित्र॒ᳪ सुर॑या॒ मूत्रा॑ज्जनयन्त॒ रेत॑: ।
अपाम॑तिं दुर्म॒तिं बाध॑माना॒ ऊव॑ध्यं॒ वात॑ᳪ स॒ब्वं तदा॒रात्
verses.translation: By milk they generated bright immortal, productive seed, by Surâ seed from urine, Chasing afar folly and ill intention, crude food and wind and meat that loads the stomach.
verses.hindi: - प्राणायाम कौ साधना वीर्य की केवल रक्षा ही नहीं करती, अपितु उस वीर पुरुष को अभिमान का शिकार भी नदीं होने देती। ज्ान-प्राप्ति मे लगना" उस वीर्य का सदव्यय करके आत्मशक्ति को बद्ानेवाला होता हेै। १. यत्- जो रसिनः=रसवाले जीवन को माधुर्य से भरनेवाले सुतस्य =जभिषुत (उत्पतन)
verses.transliteration: payasā śukramamṛtaṃ janitra surayā mūtrājjanayanta reta: | apāmatiṃ durmatiṃ bādhamānā ūvadhyaṃ vāta sabvaṃ tadārāt
verses.wordMeaning: By milk they generated bright immortal, productive seed, by Surâ seed from urine, Chasing afar folly and ill intention, crude food and wind and meat that loads the stomach.
verses.commentary: Sense: By milk they generated bright immortal, productive seed, by Surâ seed from urine, Chasing afar folly and ill intention, crude food and wind and meat that loads the stomach.

verses.sanskrit:
इन्द्र॑: सु॒त्रामा॒ हृद॑येन स॒त्यं पु॑रो॒डाशे॑न सवि॒ता ज॑जान ।
यकृ॑त् क्लो॒मानं॒ वरु॑णो भिष॒ज्यन् मत॑स्ने वाय॒व्यैर्न मि॑नाति पि॒त्तम्
verses.translation: Heart with his heart Indra Good Guardian gendered: with rice-cake Savitar gave truth its being. Varuna, doctoring the lungs and liver, forms, as with Vâyu cups, the gall and kidneys.
verses.hindi: हे प्रभो! मुञ्धे ज्ञानशक्ति तथा उत्तम कर्मों के संकल्पो द्वारा पवित्र कौजिए। १. "परमात्मा क्या है? ' इस प्रश्न का उत्तर यही है कि वह ज्योतिरूप हैँ मानो वह ज्ञानाग्नि की प्रसृत ज्वाला है। उस न्योतीरूप प्रभु से ' वैखानस! प्रार्थना करता है कि हे अग्ने-ज्ञानाग्निरूप प्रभो! यत्-जो पवित्रं ब्रह्मसव पवित्रताओं का साधनभूत ज्ञान ते-आपके
verses.transliteration: indra: sutrāmā hṛdayena satyaṃ puroḍāśena savitā jajāna | yakṛt klomānaṃ varuṇo bhiṣajyan matasne vāyavyairna mināti pittam
verses.wordMeaning: Heart with his heart Indra Good Guardian gendered: with rice-cake Savitar gave truth its being. Varuna, doctoring the lungs and liver, forms, as with Vâyu cups, the gall and kidneys.
verses.commentary: Sense: Heart with his heart Indra Good Guardian gendered: with rice-cake Savitar gave truth its being. Varuna, doctoring the lungs and liver, forms, as with Vâyu cups, the gall and kidneys.

verses.sanskrit:
आ॒न्त्राणि॑ स्था॒लीर्मधु॒ पिन्व॑माना॒ गुदा॒: पात्रा॑णि सु॒दुघा॒ न धे॒नुः ।
श्ये॒नस्य॒ पत्रं॒ न प्ली॒हा शची॑भिरास॒न्दी नाभि॑रु॒दरं॒ न मा॒ता
verses.translation: Cooking-pots pouring honey were the entrails: like a well-milking cow the pans were bowels. A hawk's wing was the spleen: through mighty powers the stool as mother was navel and belly.
verses.hindi: ज्ञान मेरे जीवन को उज्ज्वल कर दे। १. स: पवमानः=वह शोधक सोम अद्य=-आज नः= हमे पुनातु पवित्र करे। हमारे शरीर के रोगों को नष्ट करके हमें स्वास्थ्य कौ दीप्ति देनेवाला हो। २. विचर्षणिः = वह तगण5ञ जड (कृत) को देखनेवाला परमात्मा पवित्रेण पवित्र करनेवाले ज्ञान से माचमुञ्े
verses.transliteration: āntrāṇi sthālīrmadhu pinvamānā gudā: pātrāṇi sudughā na dhenuḥ | śyenasya patraṃ na plīhā śacībhirāsandī nābhirudaraṃ na mātā
verses.wordMeaning: Cooking-pots pouring honey were the entrails: like a well-milking cow the pans were bowels. A hawk's wing was the spleen: through mighty powers the stool as mother was navel and belly.
verses.commentary: Sense: Cooking-pots pouring honey were the entrails: like a well-milking cow the pans were bowels. A hawk's wing was the spleen: through mighty powers the stool as mother was navel and belly.

verses.sanskrit:
कु॒म्भो व॑नि॒ष्ठुर्ज॑नि॒ता शची॑भि॒र्यस्मि॒न्नग्रे॒ योन्यां॒ गर्भो॑ अ॒न्तः ।
प्ला॒शिर्व्य॑क्तः श॒तधा॑र॒ उत्सो॑ दु॒हे न कु॒म्भी स्व॒धां पि॒तृभ्य॑:
verses.translation: The pitcher was the father of the rectum by powers, the womb which first contained the infant. Plain was the hundred-streaming fount as penis: the jar poured forth libations to the Father.
verses.hindi: मुद्धे उत्तम पैतृक संस्कार प्राप्त हो। जीवित पितरों का जीवन मेरे जीवन के लिए आदर्श बने ओर मैं अपने जीवन को अधिकाधिक श्रीसम्न्न बनाऊँ। द्वे सृतीऽअंशृणवं पितृणामहं देवानामुत मत्यौनाम्। ९. मर्त्यानाम्-मनुष्यों के अहम्-मैने दवे सृती-दो मार्ग अशृणवम्=सुने ै। एक तो
verses.transliteration: kumbho vaniṣṭhurjanitā śacībhiryasminnagre yonyāṃ garbho antaḥ | plāśirvyaktaḥ śatadhāra utso duhe na kumbhī svadhāṃ pitṛbhya:
verses.wordMeaning: The pitcher was the father of the rectum by powers, the womb which first contained the infant. Plain was the hundred-streaming fount as penis: the jar poured forth libations to the Father.
verses.commentary: Sense: The pitcher was the father of the rectum by powers, the womb which first contained the infant. Plain was the hundred-streaming fount as penis: the jar poured forth libations to the Father.

verses.sanskrit:
मुख॒ᳪ सद॑स्य॒ शिर॒ इत् सते॑न जि॒ह्वा प॒वित्र॑म॒श्विना॒सन्त्सर॑स्वती ।
चप्पं॒ न पा॒युर्भि॒षग॑स्य॒ वालो॑ व॒स्तिर्न शेपो॒ हर॑सा तर॒स्वी
verses.translation: His face the basket, thence his head; the strainer his tongue, his mouth Sarasvatî and Asvins. The Chapya was his rump, his leech the filter, the bladder was his penis keen with ardour.
verses.hindi: पिता-पितामह व प्रपितामह सभी हमें समय-समय पर उत्तम प्रेरणा प्राप्त कराके अपने क्रियात्मक उदाहरण से स्वस्थ, निर्लोभ व सत्यज्ञान परिपूर्ण बनने के लि तेषौ वयश्सुमतौ यज्ञियानामपि भद्रे सौमनसे स्याम ॥५०॥ टै। बडे स्वस्य हे, पूर्वं मन्त्र के शब्दों मे प्राणशक्ति-सम्यन्न है। २. नवग्वा-अतएव नवम
verses.transliteration: mukha sadasya śira it satena jihvā pavitramaśvināsantsarasvatī | cappaṃ na pāyurbhiṣagasya vālo vastirna śepo harasā tarasvī
verses.wordMeaning: His face the basket, thence his head; the strainer his tongue, his mouth Sarasvatî and Asvins. The Chapya was his rump, his leech the filter, the bladder was his penis keen with ardour.
verses.commentary: Sense: His face the basket, thence his head; the strainer his tongue, his mouth Sarasvatî and Asvins. The Chapya was his rump, his leech the filter, the bladder was his penis keen with ardour.

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒श्विभ्यां॒ चक्षु॑र॒मृतं॒ ग्रहा॑भ्यां॒ छागे॑न॒ तेजो॑ ह॒विषा॑ शृ॒तेन॑ ।
पक्ष्मा॑णि गो॒धूमै॒: कुव॑लैरु॒तानि॒ पेशो॒ न शु॒क्रमसि॑तं वसाते
verses.translation: Asvins with both cups made his eye immortal, the goat and cooked oblation gave it keenness. With wheat eyelashes and with jujube eyebrows they clothe as ’twere a black and brilliant figure.
verses.hindi: १. हम आचार्यो के निर्देशों के अनुसार कर्मो को करनेवाले हों। २. वासनाओं का पराजय करें ३. शक्तिसम्पत्न इन्द्रियों से यज्ञात्मक कर्मो के करनेवाले होँ। ९. है सोम=शान्तात्मन् आचार्य! त्वम्=-आप पित्तृभिः=मेरे संरक्षकं के साथ संविदानः = सम्यक् एेकमत्यवाले होते हुए संज्ञानवाले होते हए द्यावापृथिवी अनु-मस्तिष्क व शरीर
verses.transliteration: aśvibhyāṃ cakṣuramṛtaṃ grahābhyāṃ chāgena tejo haviṣā śṛtena | pakṣmāṇi godhūmai: kuvalairutāni peśo na śukramasitaṃ vasāte
verses.wordMeaning: Asvins with both cups made his eye immortal, the goat and cooked oblation gave it keenness. With wheat eyelashes and with jujube eyebrows they clothe as ’twere a black and brilliant figure.
verses.commentary: Sense: Asvins with both cups made his eye immortal, the goat and cooked oblation gave it keenness. With wheat eyelashes and with jujube eyebrows they clothe as ’twere a black and brilliant figure.

verses.sanskrit:
अवि॒र्न मे॒षो न॒सि वी॒र्या॒य प्रा॒णस्य॒ पन्था॑ अ॒मृतो॒ ग्रहा॑भ्याम् ।
सर॑स्वत्युप॒वाकै॑र्व्या॒नं नस्या॑नि ब॒र्हिर्बद॑रैर्जजान
verses.translation: The sheep, the ram to give his nostril vigour. the immortal path of breath by both libations. By Indra-grains and sacrificial jujubes Sarasvatî produced through-breath and nose hairs.
verses.hindi: - आचार्य व माता-पिता का प्रयत्न हमें जानोज्ज्वल व स्वस्थ-शरीरवाला बनाए्। हम स्वार्थं की वृत्ति से ऊपर उठे रहें, कभी धन के दास न बनें। त्र्िंषद् पितरों का स्वागत ९. बर्हिषद := पवित्र हदय में स्थित होनेवाले पिततरः=पितरो! ऊतीचरक्षण के हेतु से
verses.transliteration: avirna meṣo nasi vīryāya prāṇasya panthā amṛto grahābhyām | sarasvatyupavākairvyānaṃ nasyāni barhirbadarairjajāna
verses.wordMeaning: The sheep, the ram to give his nostril vigour. the immortal path of breath by both libations. By Indra-grains and sacrificial jujubes Sarasvatî produced through-breath and nose hairs.
verses.commentary: Sense: The sheep, the ram to give his nostril vigour. the immortal path of breath by both libations. By Indra-grains and sacrificial jujubes Sarasvatî produced through-breath and nose hairs.

verses.sanskrit:
इन्द्र॑स्य रू॒पमृ॑ष॒भो बला॑य॒ कर्णा॑भ्या॒ᳪ श्रोत्र॑म॒मृतं॒ ग्रहा॑भ्याम् ।
यवा॒ न ब॒र्हिर्भ्रु॒वि केस॑राणि क॒र्कन्धु॑ जज्ञे॒ मधु॑ सार॒घं मुखा॑त्
verses.translation: The hull for strength made Indra's form: the immortal bearing for both his ears by two libations. Barley and sacred grass composed his eyebrows: from his mouth came the jujube and sweet honey.
verses.hindi: ्ान की किरणों मेँ ही निवास करनेवाले ज्ञानी पितरों से ज्ञान प्राप्त करके हम बल व प्राणशक्ति का धारण करनेवाले बनेँ। यम॑ग्ने कव्यवाहन त्वं चिन्मन्यसे रयिम् । तन्नो गीर्भिः श्रवाय्यः देवत्रा प॑नया युज॑म् ॥ ६४॥
verses.transliteration: indrasya rūpamṛṣabho balāya karṇābhyā śrotramamṛtaṃ grahābhyām | yavā na barhirbhruvi kesarāṇi karkandhu jajñe madhu sāraghaṃ mukhāt
verses.wordMeaning: The hull for strength made Indra's form: the immortal bearing for both his ears by two libations. Barley and sacred grass composed his eyebrows: from his mouth came the jujube and sweet honey.
verses.commentary: Sense: The hull for strength made Indra's form: the immortal bearing for both his ears by two libations. Barley and sacred grass composed his eyebrows: from his mouth came the jujube and sweet honey.

verses.sanskrit:
आ॒त्मन्नु॒पस्थे॒ न वृक॑स्य॒ लोम॒ मुखे॒ श्मश्रू॑णि॒ न व्या॑घ्रलो॒म ।
केशा॒ न शी॒र्षन्यश॑से श्रियै॒ शिखा॑ सि॒ᳪहस्य॒ लोम॒ त्विषि॑रिन्द्रि॒याणि॑
verses.translation: Hair of the wolf was on his waist and body: the beard upon his face was hair of tigers. Lions hair were his locks, for fame and beauty, worn on his head, his crest and sheen and vigour.
verses.hindi: हम उत्कृष्ट ज्ञान को धारण करे। २. उसे बड मिठास के साथ लोगों तक पहँचाँ ३. आचार्यो को , पितरों को सात्विक अन्न देनेवाले हों। स्वयं भी पवित्र, प्रयत्नार्जित हव्य पदार्थो को ही खार्णे। स्वदेशा व विदे के विद्धान् हमें विद्वानों का आदर करना चाहिए चाहे वे स्वदेश के हों चाहे विदेश के। चाहे वै हमारे परिचित हों चाहे अपरिचित। इतना जानना पर्याप्त है कि उनका जीवन पवित्र है या नहीं। यदि वे "यति" संयत जीवनवाले है. तो वे हमारे लिए आदरणीय ही है ९. अद्य=आज पितृभ्यः ज्ञानप्रद पितरों के लिए इदं नमः अस्तु यह सत्कार व अन्न
verses.transliteration: ātmannupasthe na vṛkasya loma mukhe śmaśrūṇi na vyāghraloma | keśā na śīrṣanyaśase śriyai śikhā sihasya loma tviṣirindriyāṇi
verses.wordMeaning: Hair of the wolf was on his waist and body: the beard upon his face was hair of tigers. Lions hair were his locks, for fame and beauty, worn on his head, his crest and sheen and vigour.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hair of the wolf was on his waist and body: the beard upon his face was hair of tigers. Lions hair were his locks, for fame and beauty, worn on his head, his crest and sheen and vigour.

verses.sanskrit:
अङ्गा॑न्या॒त्मन् भि॒षजा॒ तद॒श्विना॒त्मान॒मङ्गै॒: सम॑धा॒त् सर॑स्वती ।
इन्द्र॑स्य रू॒पᳪ श॒तमा॑न॒मायु॑श्च॒न्द्रेण॒ ज्योति॑र॒मृतं॒ दधा॑नाः
verses.translation: The Asvins, Leeches, joined his limbs and body, Sarasvatî put limbs and frame together, Giving the form and vital power of Indra, hundredfold, deathless and delightful lustre.
verses.hindi: -हम "पूर्व" अर्थात् विद्यावयोवृद्ध "उपर ' =विषयों से उपरत "पार्थिवे रजसि आनिषत्ता'-अग्नि मे यज्ञ-यागादि करनेवाले तथा उत्तम धर्मरूप बलवाले पितरों का अन्नाद से सत्कार करनेवाले बने। ९. अधअवब यथा-जेसे नः-ठमारे पितरः =पितर परासः=जो उत्कृष्ट है विद्या आदि
verses.transliteration: aṅgānyātman bhiṣajā tadaśvinātmānamaṅgai: samadhāt sarasvatī | indrasya rūpa śatamānamāyuścandreṇa jyotiramṛtaṃ dadhānāḥ
verses.wordMeaning: The Asvins, Leeches, joined his limbs and body, Sarasvatî put limbs and frame together, Giving the form and vital power of Indra, hundredfold, deathless and delightful lustre.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Asvins, Leeches, joined his limbs and body, Sarasvatî put limbs and frame together, Giving the form and vital power of Indra, hundredfold, deathless and delightful lustre.

verses.sanskrit:
सर॑स्वती॒ योन्यां॒ गर्भ॑म॒न्तर॒श्विभ्यां॒ पत्नी॒ सुकृ॑तं बिभर्ति ।
अ॒पाᳪ रसे॑न॒ वरु॑णो॒ न साम्नेन्द्र॑ᳪ श्रि॒यै ज॒नय॑न्न॒प्सु राजा॑
verses.translation: Sarasvatî, as Consort of the Asvins, bears in her womb the nobly fashioned Infant. King Varuna with waters’ wealthy essence begetting Indra in the floods for glory.
verses.hindi: पति व पत्नी शक्तिशाली व प्रसन्न मनवाले हों। शरीरपोषक अन्न के सेवन से सव उन्नत्तियों को सिद्ध करे। अङ्क -प्रत्यङ्क का स्वरूप ९. अस्य=इस--गतमन्त्र के " कुम्भ" का मुखम्-मुख सत्-उत्कृष्ट होता हे। (सत् इति -‹ कुम्भ" अर्थात् अपने अन्दर शक्ति व आनन्द का पूरण करनेवाले के सब अङ्क सुन्दर होते हैँ। मुख ओर सिर तो उत्कृष्ट होते ही है, इसकी जिह्वा व इसके प्राणापान -पवित्र होते है। इसके मुख मे सरस्वती का निवास होता है। इसकौ मलशोधक इदर्यो भी मलशोधन के द्वारा इसे बलवान् बनाती हे।
verses.transliteration: sarasvatī yonyāṃ garbhamantaraśvibhyāṃ patnī sukṛtaṃ bibharti | apā rasena varuṇo na sāmnendra śriyai janayannapsu rājā
verses.wordMeaning: Sarasvatî, as Consort of the Asvins, bears in her womb the nobly fashioned Infant. King Varuna with waters’ wealthy essence begetting Indra in the floods for glory.
verses.commentary: Sense: Sarasvatî, as Consort of the Asvins, bears in her womb the nobly fashioned Infant. King Varuna with waters’ wealthy essence begetting Indra in the floods for glory.

verses.sanskrit:
तेज॑: पशू॒नाᳪ ह॒विरि॑न्द्रि॒याव॑त् परि॒स्रुता॒ पय॑सा सार॒घं मधु॑ ।
अ॒श्विभ्यां॑ दु॒ग्धं भि॒षजा॒ सर॑स्वत्या सुतासु॒ताभ्या॑म॒मृत॒: सोम॒ इन्दु॑:
verses.translation: Splendour of victims, powerful oblation, honey and meath with milk and foaming liquor, Healing Sarasvatî effused, and Asvins; from pressed and unpressed Soma, deathless Indu.
verses.hindi: १. गृहिणी को चाह कि गृहकार्यो को करती हई प्रभु में निवास करे। २. सब गृहसभ्यों के लिए उत्तम सात्विक अन्न को सिद्ध करके प्राप्त कराए। ३. कर्मो मे लगे रहने से ईर्ष्या द्वेष से ऊपर रहे। ४. शान्ति व उपासना से प्रभु के तेजोऽश को आपने में धारण करे। ५५. व्यवस्थित कर्मो से चमक उठे ओर प्रजाओं मं राजा बनने क्के योग्य हो।
verses.transliteration: teja: paśūnā havirindriyāvat parisrutā payasā sāraghaṃ madhu | aśvibhyāṃ dugdhaṃ bhiṣajā sarasvatyā sutāsutābhyāmamṛta: soma indu:
verses.wordMeaning: Splendour of victims, powerful oblation, honey and meath with milk and foaming liquor, Healing Sarasvatî effused, and Asvins; from pressed and unpressed Soma, deathless Indu.
verses.commentary: Sense: Splendour of victims, powerful oblation, honey and meath with milk and foaming liquor, Healing Sarasvatî effused, and Asvins; from pressed and unpressed Soma, deathless Indu.

verses.sanskrit: क्ष॒त्रस्य॒ योनि॑रसि क्ष॒त्रस्य॒ नाभि॑रसि । मा त्वा॑ हिᳪसी॒न्मा मा॑ हिᳪसीः
verses.translation: com The Texts of the White Yajurveda, tr. Ralph T.H. Griffith, [1899], BIRTH PLACE of princely power art thou: centre art thou of princely power. Harm not thyself: do me no harm.
verses.hindi: हम बल के उत्पत्ति-स्थान व बल का केन्द्र बनने का प्रयत्न करे। यह बल का केन्द्र बनना हमें रोगो मे फंसने से बचाए्। इसी उदेश्य से हम प्रभु का सदा स्मरण करे। १. गतमन्त्र का क्षत्र का केन्द्र" बननेवाला व्यक्ति निषसाद निश्चय से व नम्रता कै साथ सिंहासन पर बैठता है। २. धृतव्रतः यह त्रत का धारण करता है। ' प्रजारक्षण' ही
verses.transliteration: kṣatrasya yonirasi kṣatrasya nābhirasi | mā tvā hisīnmā mā hisīḥ
verses.wordMeaning: com The Texts of the White Yajurveda, tr. Ralph T.H. Griffith, [1899], BIRTH PLACE of princely power art thou: centre art thou of princely power. Harm not thyself: do me no harm.
verses.commentary: Sense: com The Texts of the White Yajurveda, tr. Ralph T.H. Griffith, [1899], BIRTH PLACE of princely power art thou: centre art thou of princely power. Harm not thyself: do me no harm.

verses.sanskrit: नि ष॑साद घृ॒तव्र॑तो॒ वरु॑णः प॒स्त्यास्वा । साम्रा॑ज्याय सु॒क्रतु॑: । मृ॒त्योः पा॑हि  वि॒द्योत्पा॑हि
verses.translation: Varuna, Law's maintainer, hath sat down, etc., as in X. 27. Save me from death. Save me from lightning.
verses.hindi: प्रजारक्षण के व्रत को लेकर राजा गदी पर बेठे। वह प्रज्ञापूर्वक कर्म करनेवाला हो। राष्ट को रोगों से होनेवाली मृत्यु से बचाए तथा विद्युत्पतन आदि आधिहैविक आपत्तियों से भी बचाए। देवस्य त्वा सवितुः प्र॑स॒व ऽश्विनोर्बाहभ्यौ पूष्णो हस्ताभ्याम् ।
verses.transliteration: ni ṣasāda ghṛtavrato varuṇaḥ pastyāsvā | sāmrājyāya sukratu: | mṛtyoḥ pāhi vidyotpāhi
verses.wordMeaning: Varuna, Law's maintainer, hath sat down, etc., as in X. 27. Save me from death. Save me from lightning.
verses.commentary: Sense: Varuna, Law's maintainer, hath sat down, etc., as in X. 27. Save me from death. Save me from lightning.

verses.sanskrit:
दे॒वस्य॑ त्वा सवि॒तुः प्र॑स॒वेऽश्विनो॑र्बा॒हुभ्यां॑ पू॒ष्णो हस्ता॑भ्याम् ।
अ॒श्विनोर्भैष॑ज्येन॒ तेज॑से ब्रह्मवर्च॒साया॒भि षि॑ञ्चामि॒ सर॑स्वत्यै॒ भैष॑ज्येन वी॒र्या॒या॒न्नाद्या॑या॒भि षि॑ञ्चा॒मीन्द्र॑स्येन्द्रि॒येण॒ बला॑य श्रियै॒ यश॑से॒ऽभि षि॑ञ्चामि
verses.translation: Thee, by the radiant Savitar's impulsion, with arms of Asvins, with the hands of Pûshan, With leech-craft of the Asvins, I besprinkle for splendour, for the lustre of a Brâhman; With leech-craft of Sarasvatî, besprinkle for manly vigour and for food to feed thee; Besprinkle thee, by special power of Indra, for strength of body and for fame and glory.
verses.hindi: अभिषेक के योग्य राजा वह है जो-(क) परमेश्वर की अनुज्ञा में चलता हे, (ख) अपने प्राणापान के प्रयत्न से अपनी आवश्यकताएं पूर्ण करता है, (ग) पोषण से अधिक वस्तु का ग्रहण नहीं करता, (घ) प्राणापान के शक्तिवर्धन से तेजस्वी व ब्रह्मवर्चस्वी वना है, (ङ) ज्ञान से अपने को पवित्र करके वीर्यसम्पन्न तथा प्रज्वलित
verses.transliteration: devasya tvā savituḥ prasave'śvinorbāhubhyāṃ pūṣṇo hastābhyām | aśvinorbhaiṣajyena tejase brahmavarcasāyābhi ṣiñcāmi sarasvatyai bhaiṣajyena vīryāyānnādyāyābhi ṣiñcāmīndrasyendriyeṇa balāya śriyai yaśase'bhi ṣiñcāmi
verses.wordMeaning: Thee, by the radiant Savitar's impulsion, with arms of Asvins, with the hands of Pûshan, With leech-craft of the Asvins, I besprinkle for splendour, for the lustre of a Brâhman; With leech-craft of Sarasvatî, besprinkle for manly vigour and for food to feed thee;…
verses.commentary: Sense: Thee, by the radiant Savitar's impulsion, with arms of Asvins, with the hands of Pûshan, With leech-craft of the Asvins, I besprinkle for splendour, for the lustre of a Brâhman; With leech-craft of Sarasvatî, besprinkle for manly vigour and for food to feed thee;…

verses.sanskrit: को॑ऽसि कत॒मो॒ऽसि॒ कस्मै॑ त्वा॒ काय॑ त्वा । सुश्लो॑क॒ सुम॑ङ्गल॒ सत्य॑राजन्
verses.translation: Thou art Ka. Noblest Ka art thou. Thee for the state and rank of Ka. Sumangala! Susloka! Satyarâjan!
verses.hindi: राजा स्वयं प्रसन्नता के स्वभाववाला हो, प्रजा को प्रसन्न करनेवाला हो। इसी कारण उसका अभिषेक किया गया है। वह उत्तम शासन के कारण यशस्वी बने, प्रजा का मङ्गल करे ओर सत्य से चमक उठे, सत्य से ही सबका शासन करे। शिरो मे श्रीर्यशो मुखं त्विषिः केशांश्च श्मश्रुणि ।
verses.transliteration: ko'si katamo'si kasmai tvā kāya tvā | suśloka sumaṅgala satyarājan
verses.wordMeaning: Thou art Ka. Noblest Ka art thou. Thee for the state and rank of Ka. Sumangala! Susloka! Satyarâjan!
verses.commentary: Sense: Thou art Ka. Noblest Ka art thou. Thee for the state and rank of Ka. Sumangala! Susloka! Satyarâjan!

verses.sanskrit: शिरो॑ मे॒ श्रीर्यशो॒ मुखं॒ त्विषि॒: केशा॑श्च॒ श्मश्रू॑णि । राजा॑ मे प्रा॒णो अ॒मृत॑ᳪ स॒म्राट् चक्षु॑र्वि॒राट् श्रोत्र॑म्
verses.translation: My head be grace, my mouth be fame, my hair and beard be brilliant sheen! My breath be King and deathlessness, mine eye Sole Lord, mine ear the Prince!
verses.hindi: राजा ब्रत लेता है कि मै (क) बल व इन्द्रिय-शक्ति को ही अपनी भुजा समञ्खंगा। (ख) कर्म व कर्मजनित शक्ति को हाथ समञ्खंगा तथा (ग) आत्मिक बल व क्षात्रबल को ही उरःस्थनीय मानँगा। १. गतमन्त्र के व्रतो के अनुसार अपने जीवन का सुन्दर परिपाक करके राष्ट के प्रति
verses.transliteration: śiro me śrīryaśo mukhaṃ tviṣi: keśāśca śmaśrūṇi | rājā me prāṇo amṛta samrāṭ cakṣurvirāṭ śrotram
verses.wordMeaning: My head be grace, my mouth be fame, my hair and beard be brilliant sheen! My breath be King and deathlessness, mine eye Sole Lord, mine ear the Prince!
verses.commentary: Sense: My head be grace, my mouth be fame, my hair and beard be brilliant sheen! My breath be King and deathlessness, mine eye Sole Lord, mine ear the Prince!

verses.sanskrit: जि॒ह्वा मे॑ भ॒द्रं वाङ्महो॒ मनो॑ म॒न्युः स्व॒राड् भाम॑: । मोदा॑: प्रमो॒दा अ॒ङ्गुली॒रङ्गा॑नि मि॒त्रं मे॒ सह॑:
verses.translation: My tongue be bliss, my voice be might, my mind be wrath, my rage self-lord! Joys be my fingers, and delight my members, conquering strength my friend!
verses.hindi: प्रजा राष्ट्-शरीर के विविध अङ्ग है। राष्ट स्वयं इस शरीर की रीदढ की हड्डी है। राजा प्रजा को अपने शरीर के अङ्कं के समान समञ्जता है। जङ्घ॑भ्यां पद्धयां धर्मो"ऽस्मि विशि राजा प्रतिष्ठितः २॥ १. राजा ही कहता है कि चित्तम् स्मृति- प्रभु का स्मरण, अपने कर्तव्य का स्मरण
verses.transliteration: jihvā me bhadraṃ vāṅmaho mano manyuḥ svarāḍ bhāma: | modā: pramodā aṅgulīraṅgāni mitraṃ me saha:
verses.wordMeaning: My tongue be bliss, my voice be might, my mind be wrath, my rage self-lord! Joys be my fingers, and delight my members, conquering strength my friend!
verses.commentary: Sense: My tongue be bliss, my voice be might, my mind be wrath, my rage self-lord! Joys be my fingers, and delight my members, conquering strength my friend!

verses.sanskrit: बा॒हू मे॒ बल॑मिन्द्रि॒यᳪ हस्तौ॑ मे॒ कर्म॑ वी॒र्य॒म् । आ॒त्मा क्ष॒त्रमुरो॒ मम॑
verses.translation: Let my two arms be Indra's power, my hands be deed of manly might, my soul and breast be princely rule! neck
verses.hindi: राजा अपने जीवन में 'चित्त-विज्ञान-अचिति (पूजा), भसत् (प्रकाश), आनन्द-नन्द-भग तथा सौभाग्य" का समन्वय करके अपने धन व श्रम से प्रजा का धारक लने ओर प्रजा के जीवन को व्यवस्थित व दीप्त बनाए। द्यावापृथिव्योः प्रतिं तिष्ठामि यज्ञे ॥९०॥
verses.transliteration: bāhū me balamindriya hastau me karma vīryam | ātmā kṣatramuro mama
verses.wordMeaning: Let my two arms be Indra's power, my hands be deed of manly might, my soul and breast be princely rule! neck
verses.commentary: Sense: Let my two arms be Indra's power, my hands be deed of manly might, my soul and breast be princely rule! neck

verses.sanskrit: पृ॒ष्ठीर्मे॑ रा॒ष्ट्रमु॒दर॒मᳪसौ॑ ग्री॒वाश्च॒ श्रोणी॑ । ऊ॒रू अ॑र॒त्नी जानु॑नी॒ विशो॒ मेऽङ्गा॑नि स॒र्वत॑:
verses.translation: My ribs be royal government, my belly, shoulders, neck, and hips, Thighs, elbows, knees, the people, yea, my members universally!
verses.hindi: मै "क्षत्र-राष्टर्-अश्व-गौ-प्रत्यङ्क- चित्त. प्राण पुष्ट, द्यावापृथिवी व यज्ञ मे प्रतिष्ठित होॐँ। यै " वश्यविश्व, पशुमान्, आधिव्यधिरहित- श्रीमान् व यज्ञकर्ता" बनू। त्रया देवाऽएकादश त्रयस्िश्शाः सुराध॑सः। चुहस्पतिंपुरोहिता देवस्य॑ सवितुः सवे । देवा देवैरवन्तु मा ।९९॥
verses.transliteration: pṛṣṭhīrme rāṣṭramudaramasau grīvāśca śroṇī | ūrū aratnī jānunī viśo me'ṅgāni sarvata:
verses.wordMeaning: My ribs be royal government, my belly, shoulders, neck, and hips, Thighs, elbows, knees, the people, yea, my members universally!
verses.commentary: Sense: My ribs be royal government, my belly, shoulders, neck, and hips, Thighs, elbows, knees, the people, yea, my members universally!

verses.sanskrit:
नाभि॑र्मे चि॒त्तं वि॒ज्ञानं॑ पा॒युर्मेऽप॑चितिर्भ॒सत् । आ॒न॒न्द॒न॒न्दावा॒ण्डौ मे॒ भग॒: सौभा॑ग्यं॒ पस॑: ।
जङ्घा॑भ्यां प॒द्भ्यां धर्मो॑ऽस्मि वि॒शि राजा॒ प्रति॑ष्ठितः
verses.translation: My navel intellect, etc., etc. ... ... ... ... Duty am I in legs and feet, established King among the folk.
verses.hindi: तेतीस देव मेरे लिए सुराधस् हों, ये मेरी रक्षा करे। वषट कारैर्व'षट्काराऽ आद्टुतिथिरांतयो मे कामान्त्समंर्धयन्तु भूः स्वाह।। १२॥ १. गतमन्त्र के प्रथमाः प्रथम स्थान में स्थित परृथिवीस्थ ग्यारह देव द्वितीयैः द्वितीय स्थान में स्थित अन्तरिक्षस्थ ग्यारह देवों के साथ मे=मेरे कामान्-इष्टो को समर्धयन्तु-समृद्ध
verses.transliteration: nābhirme cittaṃ vijñānaṃ pāyurme'pacitirbhasat | ānandanandāvāṇḍau me bhaga: saubhāgyaṃ pasa: | jaṅghābhyāṃ padbhyāṃ dharmo'smi viśi rājā pratiṣṭhitaḥ
verses.wordMeaning: My navel intellect, etc., etc. ... ... ... ... Duty am I in legs and feet, established King among the folk.
verses.commentary: Sense: My navel intellect, etc., etc. ... ... ... ... Duty am I in legs and feet, established King among the folk.

verses.sanskrit:
प्रति॑ क्ष॒त्रे प्रति॑ तिष्ठामि रा॒ष्ट्रे प्रत्यश्वे॑षु॒ प्रति॑ तिष्ठामि॒ गोषु॑ ।
प्रत्यङ्गे॑षु॒ प्रति॑ तिष्ठाम्या॒त्मन् प्रति॑ प्रा॒णेषु॒ प्रति॑ तिष्ठामि पु॒ष्टे प्रति॒ द्यावा॑पृथि॒व्योः प्रति॑ तिष्ठामि य॒ज्ञे।। १ ०।।
त्र॒या दे॒वा एका॑दश त्रयस्त्रि॒ᳪशाः सु॒राध॑सः ।
बृह॒स्पति॑पुरोहिता दे॒वस्य॑ सवि॒तुः स॒वे । दे॒वा दे॒वैर॑वन्तु मा
verses.translation: May Deities, eleven threes, the three and thirty bounteous Ones Whose House-Priest is Brihaspati, by impulse of bright Savitar, the Gods protect me with the Gods.
verses.hindi: मेरा जीवन देवों की कृपा से समृद्ध-काम हो। मैं स्वस्थ बनू, प्रभु के प्रति १. मम लोमानि प्रयत्तिः=मेरे बाल प्रकृष्ट यत्नवाले है। (मम लोमस्वपि प्रयत्नः) मेरे एक-एक लोम मेँ प्रयत्न कौ भावना है। २. मे त्वक् =मेरी त्वचा आनत्तिः= नम्रता है तथा आगतिः = क्रियाशीलता हे। नतिः= नम्रता आनतिः=सब दुष्टिकोणों से नम्रता। आ-गतिः=
verses.transliteration: prati kṣatre prati tiṣṭhāmi rāṣṭre pratyaśveṣu prati tiṣṭhāmi goṣu | pratyaṅgeṣu prati tiṣṭhāmyātman prati prāṇeṣu prati tiṣṭhāmi puṣṭe prati dyāvāpṛthivyoḥ prati tiṣṭhāmi yajñe|| 1 0|| trayā devā ekādaśa trayastriśāḥ surādhasaḥ | bṛhaspatipurohitā devasya savituḥ save | devā devairavantu mā
verses.wordMeaning: May Deities, eleven threes, the three and thirty bounteous Ones Whose House-Priest is Brihaspati, by impulse of bright Savitar, the Gods protect me with the Gods.
verses.commentary: Sense: May Deities, eleven threes, the three and thirty bounteous Ones Whose House-Priest is Brihaspati, by impulse of bright Savitar, the Gods protect me with the Gods.

verses.sanskrit: प्र॒थ॒मा द्वि॒तीयै॑र्द्वि॒तीया॑स्तृ॒तीयै॑स्तृ॒तीया॑: स॒त्येन॑ स॒त्यं य॒ज्ञेन॑ य॒ज्ञो यजु॑र्भि॒र्यजू॑ᳪषि॒ साम॑भि॒: सामा॑न्यृ॒ग्भिरृच॑: पुरोऽनुवा॒क्या॒भिः पुरोऽनुवा॒क्या॒ या॒ज्या॒भिर्या॒ज्या॒ वषट्का॒रैर्व॑षट्का॒रा आहु॑तिभि॒राहु॑तयो मे॒ कामा॒न्त्सम॑र्धयन्तु॒ भूः स्वाहा॑
verses.translation: May the first Gods with the second, the second with the third, the third with Truth, Truth with Sacrifice, Sacrifice with sacrificial texts, sacrificial texts with Sâmans, Sâmans with praise-verses, praise-verses with fore and after-sentences. fore-sentences with inviting-texts, inviting-texts with Vashat-calls, Vashat calls with oblations, and oblations, fulfil my desires, Earth! All-hail!
verses.hindi: मेरे जीवन में प्रयत्न (प्रयति), नम्रता (आनति), क्रियाशीलता (आगति) आचार्यो के समीप नम्रता से उपस्थान (उपनति)-ये सब बातें है। परिणामतः मेँ वसुओं को यदवा देवहेडनं देवांसश्चकमा वयम् । अग्निर्मा तस्मादेन॑सो विश्वान्मुञ्चत्वः हं सः।। ९४॥।
verses.transliteration: prathamā dvitīyairdvitīyāstṛtīyaistṛtīyā: satyena satyaṃ yajñena yajño yajurbhiryajūṣi sāmabhi: sāmānyṛgbhirṛca: puro'nuvākyābhiḥ puro'nuvākyā yājyābhiryājyā vaṣaṭkārairvaṣaṭkārā āhutibhirāhutayo me kāmāntsamardhayantu bhūḥ svāhā
verses.wordMeaning: May the first Gods with the second, the second with the third, the third with Truth, Truth with Sacrifice, Sacrifice with sacrificial texts, sacrificial texts with Sâmans, Sâmans with praise-verses, praise-verses with fore and after-sentences.…
verses.commentary: Sense: May the first Gods with the second, the second with the third, the third with Truth, Truth with Sacrifice, Sacrifice with sacrificial texts, sacrificial texts with Sâmans, Sâmans with praise-verses, praise-verses with fore and after-sentences.…

verses.sanskrit: लोमा॑नि॒ प्रय॑ति॒र्मम॒ त्वङ्म॒ आन॑ति॒राग॑तिः । मा॒ᳪसं म॒ उप॑नति॒र्वस्वस्थि॑ म॒ज्जा म॒ आन॑तिः
verses.translation: My hair is effort and attempt, my skin is reverence and approach. My flesh is inclination, wealth my bone, my marrow reverence.
verses.hindi: मेरे अन्दर आगे बने कौ भावना हो, यह भावना मुद्ध मार्गभ्रष्ट होने से बचाए ओर मैं पाप व कष्टों से बचा रहू। १. यदि =यदि दिवा=दिन में ओर यदि=अथवा नक्तम्=रात्रि मे वयम्-हम एनांसि =पापों को चकृम=कर बैठते हैँ तौ २. वायुः=अन्तरिक्षस्थ देवों का मुखिया वायु मा=मुञ्ध
verses.transliteration: lomāni prayatirmama tvaṅma ānatirāgatiḥ | māsaṃ ma upanatirvasvasthi majjā ma ānatiḥ
verses.wordMeaning: My hair is effort and attempt, my skin is reverence and approach. My flesh is inclination, wealth my bone, my marrow reverence.
verses.commentary: Sense: My hair is effort and attempt, my skin is reverence and approach. My flesh is inclination, wealth my bone, my marrow reverence.

verses.sanskrit: यद्दे॑वा देव॒हेड॑नं॒ देवा॑सश्चकृ॒मा व॒यम् । अ॒ग्निर्मा॒ तस्मा॒देन॑सो॒ विश्वा॑न्मुञ्च॒त्वᳪह॑सः
verses.translation: Gods, Deities, whatever fault of ours have stirred the wrath of Gods, May Agni set me free from that iniquity and all distress.
verses.hindi: हम ग्राम ओर सभा आदि के विषय में हो जानेवाले अपराधों से बचने का अव॑ देवैर्दवकृतमेनो ऽयक्ष्यव मर््यर्म्त्य'कृतं पुरुराव्णो देव रिषस्पांहि ॥ १८॥ १. है वरूण हमें सब पापों से बचानेवाले प्रभो! आपके आदेश के अनुसार यत्-जो आपः=सब भोगों को प्राप्त करानेवाली हे, अतएव प्राप्त करने योग्य हैँ, अघ्न्या: इति-न
verses.transliteration: yaddevā devaheḍanaṃ devāsaścakṛmā vayam | agnirmā tasmādenaso viśvānmuñcatvahasaḥ
verses.wordMeaning: Gods, Deities, whatever fault of ours have stirred the wrath of Gods, May Agni set me free from that iniquity and all distress.
verses.commentary: Sense: Gods, Deities, whatever fault of ours have stirred the wrath of Gods, May Agni set me free from that iniquity and all distress.

verses.sanskrit: यदि॒ दिवा॒ यदि॒ नक्त॒मेना॑ᳪसि चकृ॒मा व॒यम् । वा॒युर्मा॒ तस्मा॒देन॑सो॒ विश्वा॑न्मुञ्च॒त्वᳪह॑सः
verses.translation: If in the day-time or at night we have committed acts of sin, May Vâyu set me free from that iniquity and all distress.
verses.hindi: हम गोहत्या करके गोमांस भक्षण करने के स्थान में गोरक्षण द्वारा गोदुग्धरूप अमृत का सेवन करे, जिससे हमारे जीवन शान्त, यज्ञात्मक, क्रियामय हों। हम देवों क विषय में पाप न करें, न ही मनुष्यों के विषय मे। सूचना- देवकृतं एन देवताओं के विषय में पाप यही है कि हम शरीरस्थ देवांश के
verses.transliteration: yadi divā yadi naktamenāsi cakṛmā vayam | vāyurmā tasmādenaso viśvānmuñcatvahasaḥ
verses.wordMeaning: If in the day-time or at night we have committed acts of sin, May Vâyu set me free from that iniquity and all distress.
verses.commentary: Sense: If in the day-time or at night we have committed acts of sin, May Vâyu set me free from that iniquity and all distress.

verses.sanskrit: यदि॒ जाग्र॒द्यदि॒ स्वप्न॒ एना॑ᳪसि चकृ॒मा व॒यम् । सूर्यो॑ मा॒ तस्मा॒देन॑सो॒ विश्वा॑न्मुञ्च॒त्वᳪह॑सः
verses.translation: If when awake or in our sleep we have committed acts of sin, May Sûrya set me free from that iniquity and all distress.
verses.hindi: सात्विक वानस्पत्िक भोजन हमें नीरोग बनाए। केवल शरीर मेँ ही नहीं, मन में भी। प्रभु का हम स्मरण करे, सदा कर्मनिष्ठ हों। किसी से द्वेष न करे। कर्मो के द्वारा पवित्रता १. इव=जैसे द्ुपदात्=पादुका=खडाओं से मुमुचानः = ( मुच्यमानः) चछूटता हआ पुरुष
verses.transliteration: yadi jāgradyadi svapna enāsi cakṛmā vayam | sūryo mā tasmādenaso viśvānmuñcatvahasaḥ
verses.wordMeaning: If when awake or in our sleep we have committed acts of sin, May Sûrya set me free from that iniquity and all distress.
verses.commentary: Sense: If when awake or in our sleep we have committed acts of sin, May Sûrya set me free from that iniquity and all distress.

verses.sanskrit:
यद्ग्रामे॒ यदर॑ण्ये॒ यत्स॒भायां॒ यदि॑न्द्रि॒ये ।
यच्छू॒द्रे यदर्ये॒ यदेन॑श्चकृ॒मा व॒यं यदेक॒स्याधि॒ धर्म॑णि॒ तस्या॑व॒यज॑नमसि
verses.translation: Each fault in village or in wild, company or corporeal sense, Each sinful act that we have done to Sûdra or Arya, or to either's disadvantage, e’en of that sin thou art the expiation.
verses.hindi: कर्मशीलता, आप्त पुरुषों का सङ्खं , सर्वव्यापक प्रभु का स्मरण मुञ्धे पवित्र उद्वयं तम॑सस्परि स्तु: पश्य॑न्तऽउत्त॑रम्। देवं देवत्रा सूर्यमग॑न्म ज्योतिरुत्तमम् ॥२९॥ १. "गतमन्त्र के अनुसार उत्तरोत्तर पवित्र होते हए हम प्रभु को प्राप्त होते हें ' इस बात को प्रस्तुत मन्त्र में इस प्रकार कहते हैँ कि वयम्-हम उत्-उत्कृष्ट तमसः तमोबहुल
verses.transliteration: yadgrāme yadaraṇye yatsabhāyāṃ yadindriye | yacchūdre yadarye yadenaścakṛmā vayaṃ yadekasyādhi dharmaṇi tasyāvayajanamasi
verses.wordMeaning: Each fault in village or in wild, company or corporeal sense, Each sinful act that we have done to Sûdra or Arya, or to either's disadvantage, e’en of that sin thou art the expiation.
verses.commentary: Sense: Each fault in village or in wild, company or corporeal sense, Each sinful act that we have done to Sûdra or Arya, or to either's disadvantage, e’en of that sin thou art the expiation.

verses.sanskrit:
यदापो॑ अ॒घ्न्या इति॒ वरु॒णेति॒ शपा॑महे॒ ततो॑ वरुण नो मुञ्च । अव॑भृथ निचुम्पुण निचे॒रुर॑सि निचुम्पु॒णः ।
अव॑ दे॒वैर्दे॒वकृ॑त॒मेनो॑ऽय॒क्ष्यव॒ मर्त्यै॒र्मर्त्य॑कृतं  पुरु॒राव्णो॑ देव रि॒षस्पा॑हि
verses.translation: Waters, Inviolable ones, etc. Said to be repeated from VI. 22. O ever-moving Cleansing Bath, etc. Repeated from III. 48.
verses.hindi: प्रकृति उत्कृष्ट है, परन्तु उसमें आसक्त न होकर उसका ठीक प्रयोग करते हए हम आत्मस्वरूप का दर्शन करे। अधिकाधिक पवित्र होते हए प्रभु को प्राप्त करे। १. गतमन्त्र के ' प्रभु-मिलन' के लिए अद्य=आज ही से मैने आपः अनु अचारिषम्-कर्मो का व आप्त पुरुषों का अनुसरण किया हे। मैने सब प्रकार के आलस्य कौ भावना को परे
verses.transliteration: yadāpo aghnyā iti varuṇeti śapāmahe tato varuṇa no muñca | avabhṛtha nicumpuṇa nicerurasi nicumpuṇaḥ | ava devairdevakṛtameno'yakṣyava martyairmartyakṛtaṃ pururāvṇo deva riṣaspāhi
verses.wordMeaning: Waters, Inviolable ones, etc. Said to be repeated from VI. 22. O ever-moving Cleansing Bath, etc. Repeated from III. 48.
verses.commentary: Sense: Waters, Inviolable ones, etc. Said to be repeated from VI. 22. O ever-moving Cleansing Bath, etc. Repeated from III. 48.

verses.sanskrit:
स॑मु॒द्रे ते॒ हृद॑यम॒प्स्वन्तः सं त्वा॑ विश॒न्त्वोष॑धीरु॒ताप॑: ।
सु॒मि॒त्रि॒या न॒ आप॒ ओष॑धयः सन्तु दुर्मित्रि॒यास्तस्मै॑ सन्तु॒ योऽस्मान्द्वेष्टि॒ यं च॑ व॒यं द्वि॒ष्मः
verses.translation: Thy heart is in the flood, etc. Repeated from VIII. 25. To us let Waters, etc. Repeated from VI. 22.
verses.hindi: हम क्रियाशीलता व आप्तपुरुषों के सद्धं से रसरूप परमात्मा से मेल कर सके। उन्नत होते हए प्रभु को प्राप्त करे। वे प्रभु हमें “शक्ति, उत्तम सन्तान व धन' दे। वैशवानरज्योतिर्भूयासं विभून्कामान्व्यश्नवै भूः स्वाह ।। २३॥ १. गतमन्त्र के अनुसार उस रसमय प्रभु से अपना सम्पर्क बनानेवाला व्यक्ति प्रभु से
verses.transliteration: samudre te hṛdayamapsvantaḥ saṃ tvā viśantvoṣadhīrutāpa: | sumitriyā na āpa oṣadhayaḥ santu durmitriyāstasmai santu yo'smāndveṣṭi yaṃ ca vayaṃ dviṣmaḥ
verses.wordMeaning: Thy heart is in the flood, etc. Repeated from VIII. 25. To us let Waters, etc. Repeated from VI. 22.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thy heart is in the flood, etc. Repeated from VIII. 25. To us let Waters, etc. Repeated from VI. 22.

verses.sanskrit: द्रु॒प॒दादि॑व मुमुचा॒नः स्वि॒न्नः स्ना॒तो मला॑दिव । पू॒तं प॒वित्रे॑णे॒वाज्य॒माप॑: शुन्धन्तु मैन॑सः
verses.translation: As one unfastened from a stake, or cleansed by bathing after toil, As butter which the sieve hath purged, let water clean me from my sin.
verses.hindi: व्यवस्थित क्रियाओंवाला बनू प्रभु के तेजोंऽश को प्राप्त करूं। उदारमना बनू। प्राणशक्तिसम्पन्न होकर समर्पण की वृत्तिवाला होऊं। १. ठे अग्ने-सारे संसार के सञ्चालक प्रभो! व्रतपतेत्रतों का पालन करनेवाले प्रभो! त्वयि आपकी प्राप्ति के निमित्त समिधम्-ज्ञान की दीप्ति को अभ्यादधामितमें धारण
verses.transliteration: drupadādiva mumucānaḥ svinnaḥ snāto malādiva | pūtaṃ pavitreṇevājyamāpa: śundhantu mainasaḥ
verses.wordMeaning: As one unfastened from a stake, or cleansed by bathing after toil, As butter which the sieve hath purged, let water clean me from my sin.
verses.commentary: Sense: As one unfastened from a stake, or cleansed by bathing after toil, As butter which the sieve hath purged, let water clean me from my sin.

verses.sanskrit: उद्व॒यं तम॑स॒स्परि॒ स्व: पश्य॑न्त॒ उत्त॑रम् । दे॒वं दे॑व॒त्रा सूर्य॒मग॑न्म॒ ज्योति॑रुत्त॒मम्
verses.translation: Looking upon the loftier light above the darkness we have come To Sûrya, God among the Gods, the light that is most excellent.
verses.hindi: ९. प्रभु- प्राप्ति के निमित्त मं अपने में ज्ञानदीषप्ति को धारण करं २. व्रत ओर श्रद्धा को धारण करनेवाला वनँं। ३. निष्कामभाव से व्रतो का श्रद्धापूर्वकं पालन मेरे हदय को प्रभु के प्रकाश से पूर्णं करेगा। तं लोकं पुण्यं प्रज्ञैवं यत्र॑ देवाः सहाग्निना ॥ २५५॥
verses.transliteration: udvayaṃ tamasaspari sva: paśyanta uttaram | devaṃ devatrā sūryamaganma jyotiruttamam
verses.wordMeaning: Looking upon the loftier light above the darkness we have come To Sûrya, God among the Gods, the light that is most excellent.
verses.commentary: Sense: Looking upon the loftier light above the darkness we have come To Sûrya, God among the Gods, the light that is most excellent.

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒पो अ॒द्यान्व॑चारिष॒ᳪ रसे॑न॒ सम॑सृक्ष्महि ।
पय॑स्वानग्न॒ आऽग॑मं॒ तं मा॒ सᳪ सृ॑ज॒ वर्च॑सा प्र॒जया॑ च॒ धने॑न च
verses.translation: The waters I this day have sought, and to their essence have we come. Agni, come hither rich in milk, splendour and brilliancy bestow on me, and progeny and wealth.
verses.hindi: पुण्यलोक वही है जहाँ (क) ज्ञान के साथ बल का भी विकास हे। (ख) जहाँ मन्त्रिवर्ग व ज्ञानीवर्ग राजा के साथ एेकमत्यवाला होकर राष्ट कौ उन्नति में तत्पर हे। ध मिलकर राष्ट मे शिक्षणालयों कौ स्थापना करते हैँ, व्यायामशालाओं का निर्माण करते १. गतमन्त्र के पुण्यलोक का ही वर्णन करते हए कहते है कि यत्र=-जहाँ इन्द्रः च
verses.transliteration: apo adyānvacāriṣa rasena samasṛkṣmahi | payasvānagna ā'gamaṃ taṃ mā sa sṛja varcasā prajayā ca dhanena ca
verses.wordMeaning: The waters I this day have sought, and to their essence have we come. Agni, come hither rich in milk, splendour and brilliancy bestow on me, and progeny and wealth.
verses.commentary: Sense: The waters I this day have sought, and to their essence have we come. Agni, come hither rich in milk, splendour and brilliancy bestow on me, and progeny and wealth.

verses.sanskrit:
एधो॑ऽस्येधिषी॒महि॑ स॒मिद॑सि॒ तेजो॑ऽसि॒ तेजो॒ मयि॑ धेहि ।
स॒माव॑वर्ति पृथि॒वी समु॒षाः समु॒ सूर्य॑: । समु॒ विश्व॑मि॒दं जग॑त् ।
वै॒श्वा॒न॒रज्यो॑तिर्भूयासं वि॒भून् कामा॒न् व्य॒श्नवै॒ भूः स्वाहा॑
verses.translation: A brand art thou: fain would we thrive. Fuel art thou and splendour: give me splendour. Earth comes again, the Dawn, the Sun. This Universe all comes again. May I possess Vaisvânara's light, may I attain my vast desires. Earth! All-hail!
verses.hindi: पुण्यलोक में ' इन्द्र॒ ओर वायु! का स्थापन होता है, अर्थात् वरहो के निवासी सबल व सन्ञान होते है। इनमें कोई निर्बल व मूर्खं नहीं होता। अन्नाभाव से कोई मरता नही। १. गतमन्त्र में वर्णित पुण्यलोकं के निवासियों के लिए ही कहते है कि अंशुना ज्ञान की किरण के साथ ते-तेरी अंशु=ज्ञान कौ किरण पृच्यताम् संपृक्त हो , अर्थात् तेरा
verses.transliteration: edho'syedhiṣīmahi samidasi tejo'si tejo mayi dhehi | samāvavarti pṛthivī samuṣāḥ samu sūrya: | samu viśvamidaṃ jagat | vaiśvānarajyotirbhūyāsaṃ vibhūn kāmān vyaśnavai bhūḥ svāhā
verses.wordMeaning: A brand art thou: fain would we thrive. Fuel art thou and splendour: give me splendour. Earth comes again, the Dawn, the Sun. This Universe all comes again. May I possess Vaisvânara's light, may I attain my vast desires. Earth! All-hail!
verses.commentary: Sense: A brand art thou: fain would we thrive. Fuel art thou and splendour: give me splendour. Earth comes again, the Dawn, the Sun. This Universe all comes again. May I possess Vaisvânara's light, may I attain my vast desires. Earth! All-hail!

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒भ्या द॑धामि स॒मिध॒मग्ने॑ व्रतपते॒ त्वयि॑ ।
व्र॒तं च॑ श्र॒द्धां चोपै॑मी॒न्धे त्वा॑ दीक्षि॒तो अ॒हम्
verses.translation: O Agni, Master of the Vow, on thee I lay the kindling- stick. To the fast-vow and faith I come. I, consecrated, kindle thee.
verses.hindi: हमारा ज्ञान अविच्छिन्न हो, शरीर सुदृढ हो। प्रभु-स्मरण के द्वारा हम अपने सोम की रक्षा करे, न क्षरित हुआ-हुआ यह सोम हमारे जीवन मे उल्लास देनेवाला हो। १. गतमन्त्र के अनुसार सोम कौ रक्षा करनेवाले व्यक्ति इस सोम को सिञ्चन्ति-शरीर में ही सिक्त करते हैँ, परिषिञ्चन्ति-शरीर के अद्ध - प्रत्यङ्गं मे इसे सिक्त करने के लिए
verses.transliteration: abhyā dadhāmi samidhamagne vratapate tvayi | vrataṃ ca śraddhāṃ copaimīndhe tvā dīkṣito aham
verses.wordMeaning: O Agni, Master of the Vow, on thee I lay the kindling- stick. To the fast-vow and faith I come. I, consecrated, kindle thee.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Agni, Master of the Vow, on thee I lay the kindling- stick. To the fast-vow and faith I come. I, consecrated, kindle thee.

verses.sanskrit:
यत्र॒ ब्रह्म॑ च क्ष॒त्रं च॑ स॒म्यञ्चो॒ चर॑तः स॒ह ।
तँल्लो॒कं पुण्यं॒ प्रज्ञे॑षं॒ यत्र॑ दे॒वाः स॒हाग्निना॑
verses.translation: Fain would I know that holy world where Deities with Agni dwell, Where priestly rank and princely power together in accordance move.
verses.hindi: हम सोम को शरीर में सुरक्षित करे, अङ्क  प्रत्यज्ख मे व्यापक रक्खें, उसकी ऊर्ध्वगति करे। इससे हम अपने जीवनो को पवित्र बना्ेँ। ज्ञान की दीप्ति व शरीर का ठीक पोषण होने पर जो एक विशेष उल्लास प्राप्त होता है, उसे प्राप्त कर लेने पर हम अपने लिए कह सकैगे कि "तू आज उस आनन्दमय अनिर्वचनीय महिमावाले प्रभु का हो गया
verses.transliteration: yatra brahma ca kṣatraṃ ca samyañco carataḥ saha | ta~llokaṃ puṇyaṃ prajñeṣaṃ yatra devāḥ sahāgninā
verses.wordMeaning: Fain would I know that holy world where Deities with Agni dwell, Where priestly rank and princely power together in accordance move.
verses.commentary: Sense: Fain would I know that holy world where Deities with Agni dwell, Where priestly rank and princely power together in accordance move.

verses.sanskrit: यत्रेन्द्र॑श्च वा॒युश्च॑ स॒म्यञ्चो॒ चर॑तः स॒ह । तँल्लो॒कं पुण्यं॒ प्रज्ञे॑षं॒ यत्र॑ से॒दिर्न वि॒द्यते॑
verses.translation: Fain would I know that holy world where want and languor are unknown, Where in complete accordance move Indra and Vâyu side by side
verses.hindi: हम प्रभु का गायन कररे। यह गायन (क) हमारा वर्धन करेगा, (ख) वासनाओं को विनष्ट करेगा, (ग) हम ऋत का अपने में वर्धन करनेवाले होंगे ओर (घ) हममे वह ज्ञान-ज्योति उत्पन्न होगी, जो हमें दिव्य बनाएगी, सदा जागरणशील- सावधान रक्खेगी तथा हमें प्रभुरूप लक्ष्य -स्थान पर प्ंचाएगी।
verses.transliteration: yatrendraśca vāyuśca samyañco carataḥ saha | ta~llokaṃ puṇyaṃ prajñeṣaṃ yatra sedirna vidyate
verses.wordMeaning: Fain would I know that holy world where want and languor are unknown, Where in complete accordance move Indra and Vâyu side by side
verses.commentary: Sense: Fain would I know that holy world where want and languor are unknown, Where in complete accordance move Indra and Vâyu side by side

verses.sanskrit: अ॒ᳪशुना॑ ते अ॒ᳪशुः पृ॑च्यतां॒ परु॑षा॒ परु॑: । ग॒न्धस्ते॒ सोम॑मवतु॒ मदा॑य॒ रसो॒ अच्यु॑तः
verses.translation: Let thy shoot be united with his tendril, joint combine with joint. Imperishable sap for joy, thine odour be the Soma's guard!
verses.hindi: शरीर में सोम कौ उत्पत्ति इसीलिए की गई है कि (क) शरीर पाषाणतुल्य दृ हा तथा (ख) मनुष्य ज्ञानदीप्त होकर पवित्र जीवनवाला बने ओर (ग) अन्त मं यह प्रभु को प्राप्त कर सकर। यो भूतानामधिंपतिर्यस्िल्लोकाऽअधिं ्चिताः।
verses.transliteration: aśunā te aśuḥ pṛcyatāṃ paruṣā paru: | gandhaste somamavatu madāya raso acyutaḥ
verses.wordMeaning: Let thy shoot be united with his tendril, joint combine with joint. Imperishable sap for joy, thine odour be the Soma's guard!
verses.commentary: Sense: Let thy shoot be united with his tendril, joint combine with joint. Imperishable sap for joy, thine odour be the Soma's guard!

verses.sanskrit: सि॒ञ्चन्ति॒ परि॑ षिञ्च॒न्त्युत्सि॑ञ्चन्ति पु॒नन्ति॑ च । सुरा॑यै ब॒भ्र्वै॒ मदे॑ कि॒न्त्वो व॑दति कि॒न्त्वः
verses.translation: They pour it out, they sprinkle it, they scatter it, they make it pure. In the brown Surâ's ecstasy he says What art thou? What art thou?
verses.hindi: प्रभु का अपने में धारण करने का अभिप्राय है कि (क) हम पृथिवी आदि भूतों के पूर्णं अधिपति बनते हए स्वस्थ बनें, (ख) हम सब लोकों के शरणस्थान बने, (ग) अपनी इन्द्रियों के ईश बनें, ओर (घ) विशाल-से-विशाल हदयवाले हो। सूचना- “मयि गृह्णामि त्वामहम्" का शब्दार्थ इस रूप में भी है कि मै आपको अन्दर
verses.transliteration: siñcanti pari ṣiñcantyutsiñcanti punanti ca | surāyai babhrvai made kintvo vadati kintvaḥ
verses.wordMeaning: They pour it out, they sprinkle it, they scatter it, they make it pure. In the brown Surâ's ecstasy he says What art thou? What art thou?
verses.commentary: Sense: They pour it out, they sprinkle it, they scatter it, they make it pure. In the brown Surâ's ecstasy he says What art thou? What art thou?

verses.sanskrit: धा॒नाव॑न्तं कर॒म्भिण॑मपू॒पव॑न्तमु॒क्थिन॑म् । इन्द्र॑ प्रा॒तर्जु॑षस्व नः
verses.translation: Indra, at morn accept our cake accompanied with grain and groats, with wheaten bread and hymns of praise.
verses.hindi: जवब हम प्रभु को अपने मे धारण कर पाते हैँ तब (क) प्राणापान सुरक्षित होकर हमारे शरीर का बल बदता है, (ख) चक्षुः-श्रोत्र की रक्षा लेकर हमारा ज्ञान बढता हे. (ग) हमारी वाणी प्रभुनाम-स्मरण से सब दोषों से निवृत्त हो जाती है, हम शुभी शब्दों को बोलते हे, (घ) प्रभु में हमारा मन एेसा विलीन हो जाता है कि अपने आप दही
verses.transliteration: dhānāvantaṃ karambhiṇamapūpavantamukthinam | indra prātarjuṣasva naḥ
verses.wordMeaning: Indra, at morn accept our cake accompanied with grain and groats, with wheaten bread and hymns of praise.
verses.commentary: Sense: Indra, at morn accept our cake accompanied with grain and groats, with wheaten bread and hymns of praise.

verses.sanskrit: बृ॒हदिन्द्रा॑य गायत॒ मरु॑तो वृत्र॒हन्त॑मम् । येन॒ ज्योति॒रज॑नयन्नृता॒वृधो॑ दे॒वं दे॒वाय॒ जागृ॑वि
verses.translation: To Indra sing the lofty hymn, Maruts? that slayeth Vritra best, Whereby the Holy Ones created for the God the radiant light that never dies.
verses.hindi: उपहूत प्रभु के हम उपहूत बनें ओर सोमरक्षण के द्वारा प्राणापान कौ शक्ति, ज्ञान व इन्द्रशक्ति का वर्धन करें तथा शरीर व मन को नीरोग बना पार्ं। समिंद्धऽ इन्द्र॑ऽ उषसामनींके पुरोरुचा पूर्वकृद्रावृधानः। त्रिभिर्देवैस्तरिःशता वच्र॑बाहुर्जघानं वृत्रं वि दुरो ववार।।३६॥
verses.transliteration: bṛhadindrāya gāyata maruto vṛtrahantamam | yena jyotirajanayannṛtāvṛdho devaṃ devāya jāgṛvi
verses.wordMeaning: To Indra sing the lofty hymn, Maruts? that slayeth Vritra best, Whereby the Holy Ones created for the God the radiant light that never dies.
verses.commentary: Sense: To Indra sing the lofty hymn, Maruts? that slayeth Vritra best, Whereby the Holy Ones created for the God the radiant light that never dies.

verses.sanskrit: अध्व॑र्यो॒ अद्रि॑भिः सु॒तᳪ सोमं॑ प॒वित्र॒ आ न॑य । पु॒ना॒हीन्द्रा॑य॒ पात॑वे
verses.translation: Adhvaryu, on the straining cloth pour thou the Soma pressed with stones: Purify it for Indra's drink.
verses.hindi: प्रभु का उपासक (उपहूत) स्वाध्याय द्वारा ज्ञानसमिद्ध बनता है। उन्नति करता हुआ सब देवों को अपने में धारण करता है, क्रियाशील जीवन के द्वारा वासना से ऊपर उठता है ओर मोक्ष के चारों द्वारो को अपने लिए खोलता हुआ “शान्त, विचारशील, नराशश्खः प्रति शूरो सिमानस्तनूनपात्प्रतिं यज्ञस्य धाम।
verses.transliteration: adhvaryo adribhiḥ suta somaṃ pavitra ā naya | punāhīndrāya pātave
verses.wordMeaning: Adhvaryu, on the straining cloth pour thou the Soma pressed with stones: Purify it for Indra's drink.
verses.commentary: Sense: Adhvaryu, on the straining cloth pour thou the Soma pressed with stones: Purify it for Indra's drink.

verses.sanskrit:
यो भू॒ताना॒मधि॑पति॒र्यस्मिँ॑ल्लो॒का अधि॑ श्रि॒ताः ।
य ईशे॑ मह॒तो म॒हाँस्तेन॑ गृह्णामि॒ त्वाम॒हं मयि॑ गृह्णामि॒ त्वाम॒हम्
verses.translation: The Sovran Lord of living things, he upon whom the worlds depend, Mighty, the mighty's King—by him I take thee, take thee on myself.
verses.hindi: हम प्रभु को अपने मे धारण करनेवाले बनें, उसकी ज्ञानवाणियों से जीवन में सदगुणौं के बीज बोर्णं। माधुर्यवाले हो। सदा आह्ादमय, यज्ञशील व प्रचेता बने। ईडितो देवैर्हसिवांँ २।ऽअभिष्टिराजुद्धानो हविषा शर््ःमानः। पुरन्दरो गोत्रभिद्त्र॑बाहुरायातु यज्ञमुप॑ नो जुषाणः।। ३८॥
verses.transliteration: yo bhūtānāmadhipatiryasmi~llokā adhi śritāḥ | ya īśe mahato mahā~stena gṛhṇāmi tvāmahaṃ mayi gṛhṇāmi tvāmaham
verses.wordMeaning: The Sovran Lord of living things, he upon whom the worlds depend, Mighty, the mighty's King—by him I take thee, take thee on myself.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Sovran Lord of living things, he upon whom the worlds depend, Mighty, the mighty's King—by him I take thee, take thee on myself.

verses.sanskrit: उ॒प॒या॒मगृ॑हीतोऽस्य॒श्विभ्यां॑ त्वा॒ सर॑स्वत्यै॒ त्वेन्द्रा॑य त्वा सु॒त्राम्ण॑ ए॒ष ते॒ योनि॑र॒श्विभ्यां॑ त्वा॒ सर॑स्वत्यै॒ त्वेन्द्रा॑य त्वा सु॒त्राम्णे॑
verses.translation: Taken upon a base art thou. Thee for the Asvins. This is thy home, etc.
verses.hindi: उपासना से दिव्य गुणों को प्राप्त करते हए हम यज्ञमय जीवनवाले हों। इससे हमारी शक्ति बदेगी ओर अन्ततः हम प्रभु को प्राप्त करेगे। १. जुषाणः गतमन्त्र के अन्तिम शब्दों के अनुसार यज्ञो का सेवन करता हआ २. हरिवान् प्रशस्त इच्दरियोवाला २. नः=हमारा अर्थात् प्रभु का भक्त ४. इन्द्रः=असुरों का संहार
verses.transliteration: upayāmagṛhīto'syaśvibhyāṃ tvā sarasvatyai tvendrāya tvā sutrāmṇa eṣa te yoniraśvibhyāṃ tvā sarasvatyai tvendrāya tvā sutrāmṇe
verses.wordMeaning: Taken upon a base art thou. Thee for the Asvins. This is thy home, etc.
verses.commentary: Sense: Taken upon a base art thou. Thee for the Asvins. This is thy home, etc.

verses.sanskrit:
प्रा॒ण॒पा मे॑ अपान॒पाश्च॑क्षु॒ष्पाः श्रो॑त्र॒पाश्च॑ मे ।
वाचो॑ मे वि॒श्वभे॑षजो॒ मन॑सोऽसि वि॒लाय॑कः
verses.translation: Guard of my breath and outward breath, the guardian of mine eye and ear, All-healer of my voice, thou. art the mollifier of my mind.
verses.hindi: मनुष्य (क) यज्ञो का सेवन करे (ख) उत्तम इद्दरियोवाला बने (ग) प्रभु का होकर संसार में विचरे (घ) जितेन्द्रिय बने (ङ) उदार हो (च) सदा प्रीतियुक्तं हो। एेसा बनकर यह अपने हदय को, इस विशाल पृथिवी का स्मरण करते हए (क) विशाल बनाये (ख) विशालता के द्वारा सुखमय बनाए (ग) गुणों का आदान व उत्तम निवास कौ
verses.transliteration: prāṇapā me apānapāścakṣuṣpāḥ śrotrapāśca me | vāco me viśvabheṣajo manaso'si vilāyakaḥ
verses.wordMeaning: Guard of my breath and outward breath, the guardian of mine eye and ear, All-healer of my voice, thou. art the mollifier of my mind.
verses.commentary: Sense: Guard of my breath and outward breath, the guardian of mine eye and ear, All-healer of my voice, thou. art the mollifier of my mind.

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒श्विन॑कृतस्य ते॒ सर॑स्वतिकृत॒स्येन्द्रे॑ण सु॒त्राम्णा॑ कृ॒तस्य॑ ।
उप॑हूत॒ उप॑हूतस्य भक्षयामि
verses.translation: Invited I feed upon thee invited, Whom Asvins, whom Sarasvatî, whom Indra, Good Protector, made.
verses.hindi: को पवित्र बनानेवाले है। इनके अपना-अपना कार्य ठीक रूप से करने पर हम शारीरिक दुष्टि से स्वस्थ त सुन्दर बनते है ओर आत्मिक बल व वीरता को प्राप्त करते हे सूचना-' कवष्यः' !कु शब्दे" से बनकर मुख के कार्य का संकेत करता हं “ धावमानाः ' धाव् शुद्धौ ' से बनकर पायु के कार्य का, 'जनयः' उपस्थ करे कार्य का संकेत
verses.transliteration: aśvinakṛtasya te sarasvatikṛtasyendreṇa sutrāmṇā kṛtasya | upahūta upahūtasya bhakṣayāmi
verses.wordMeaning: Invited I feed upon thee invited, Whom Asvins, whom Sarasvatî, whom Indra, Good Protector, made.
verses.commentary: Sense: Invited I feed upon thee invited, Whom Asvins, whom Sarasvatî, whom Indra, Good Protector, made.

verses.sanskrit:
समि॑द्ध॒ इन्द्र॑ उ॒षसा॒मनी॑के पुरो॒रुचा॑ पूर्व॒कृद्वा॑वृधा॒नः ।
त्रि॒भिर्दे॒वैस्त्रि॒ᳪशता॒ वज्र॑बाहुर्ज॒घान॑ वृ॒त्रं वि दुरो॑ ववार
verses.translation: Kindred in forefront of the Mornings, Indra with forward light, long-active, waxing mighty, With three-and thirty Gods, the Thunder-wielder, smote. Vritra dead and threw the portals open.
verses.hindi: (क) हम प्रभु का अपने में पूरण करें, जिससे हमारा वर्धन हो ओर हमारी आसुर वृत्तियों का संहार हो, (ख) यज्ञतन्तु को विच्छिन्न न करने क द्वारा हम प्रभु का उपासन करे, (ग) प्रभु-उपासन से हम प्रभु की भति दीप्त हो उठे, प्रभु की दीप्ति से हैव्या मिमाना मनुषः पुस्त्रा होताराविन्द्र प्रथमा सुवाचा ।
verses.transliteration: samiddha indra uṣasāmanīke purorucā pūrvakṛdvāvṛdhānaḥ | tribhirdevaistriśatā vajrabāhurjaghāna vṛtraṃ vi duro vavāra
verses.wordMeaning: Kindred in forefront of the Mornings, Indra with forward light, long-active, waxing mighty, With three-and thirty Gods, the Thunder-wielder, smote. Vritra dead and threw the portals open.
verses.commentary: Sense: Kindred in forefront of the Mornings, Indra with forward light, long-active, waxing mighty, With three-and thirty Gods, the Thunder-wielder, smote. Vritra dead and threw the portals open.

verses.sanskrit:
नरा॒शᳪस॒: प्रति॒ शूरो॒ मिमा॑न॒स्तनू॒नपा॒त्प्रति॑ य॒ज्ञस्य॒ धाम॑ ।
गोभि॑र्व॒पावा॒न् मधु॑ना सम॒ञ्जन् हिर॑ण्यैश्च॒न्द्री य॑जति॒ प्रचे॑ताः
verses.translation: Son of Himself, the Praise of Men, the hero, measuring out the sacrificial stations, Rich in bulls’ fat, anointing with sweet butter, wise, bright with gauds of gold, he sacrificeth.
verses.hindi: हम प्रभु के बने, सब क्रियाओं को मापकर करें, अतिमेन जार्पे, ज्ञान से अपना जरण करे, होता बनें, प्रभु का अपने में विस्तार करें, उत्तम वाणीवाले हों. माधुर्य के साथ ५५ के अग्रभाग में स्थित हों, उस ज्ञान को प्राप्त करें, जो हमारी अग्रगति का साधन तिस्रो देवीः ( ज्ञान-श्रद्धा-वाणी )
verses.transliteration: narāśasa: prati śūro mimānastanūnapātprati yajñasya dhāma | gobhirvapāvān madhunā samañjan hiraṇyaiścandrī yajati pracetāḥ
