verses.wordMeaning: May the Âdityas with the Rains, lauded in Saptadasa hymn And with Vairûpa, with folk, strength, give Indra sacrifice and life.
verses.commentary: Sense: May the Âdityas with the Rains, lauded in Saptadasa hymn And with Vairûpa, with folk, strength, give Indra sacrifice and life.

verses.sanskrit:
शा॒र॒देन॑ ऋ॒तुना॑ दे॒वा ए॑कवि॒ᳪश ऋ॒भव॑ स्तु॒ताः ।
वै॒रा॒जेन॑ श्रि॒या श्रिय॑ᳪ ह॒विरिन्द्रे॒ वयो॑ दधुः
verses.translation: With Autumn may the Ribhus, Gods, praised in the Ekavimsa hymn And with Virâja, give with grace to Indra grace, life, sacrifice.
verses.hindi: हम त्यागपूर्वक उपभोग करनेवाले बनकर "इडा, सरस्वती, भारती ' रूप तीनो देवियों के साथ अपना सम्बन्ध स्थापित करे। ये तीनों ' मन, मस्तिष्क व शरीर' मेँ हमारा धारण करनेवाली है। हमें दूध आदि उत्तमोत्तम पदार्थ प्राप्त हो। हम यज्ञो मे उनका विनियोग करते हए यज्ञशेष का सेवन करनेवाले बने।
verses.transliteration: śāradena ṛtunā devā ekaviśa ṛbhava stutāḥ | vairājena śriyā śriya havirindre vayo dadhuḥ
verses.wordMeaning: With Autumn may the Ribhus, Gods, praised in the Ekavimsa hymn And with Virâja, give with grace to Indra grace, life, sacrifice.
verses.commentary: Sense: With Autumn may the Ribhus, Gods, praised in the Ekavimsa hymn And with Virâja, give with grace to Indra grace, life, sacrifice.

verses.sanskrit:
हे॒म॒न्तेन॑ ऋ॒तुना॑ दे॒वास्त्रि॑ण॒वे म॒रुत॑ स्तु॒ताः ।
बले॑न॒ शक्व॑री॒: सहो॑ ह॒विरिन्द्रे॒ वयो॑ दधुः
verses.translation: With Winter may the Maruts, Gods, praised in the laud of thrice nine parts, The Sakvarîs, with strength give might to Indra, sacrifice and life.
verses.hindi: होता पुरुष उत्तम वीर्यवाला, गतिशील, नरहितकारी कर्मो में लगा हा होता है। यह दूध आदि सात्विक पदार्थो का सेवन करता है, परन्तु इस बात का ध्यान रखता हे कि इन घृत आदि भोज्य पदार्थो से वह अग्निहोत्र अवश्य करता रहे। होतां यश्चद्धनस्पत्तिःशमितारच्छातक्र॑तुं भीमं न मन्युरराजानं व्याघ्रं नम॑साश्विना
verses.transliteration: hemantena ṛtunā devāstriṇave maruta stutāḥ | balena śakvarī: saho havirindre vayo dadhuḥ
verses.wordMeaning: With Winter may the Maruts, Gods, praised in the laud of thrice nine parts, The Sakvarîs, with strength give might to Indra, sacrifice and life.
verses.commentary: Sense: With Winter may the Maruts, Gods, praised in the laud of thrice nine parts, The Sakvarîs, with strength give might to Indra, sacrifice and life.

verses.sanskrit:
शै॒शि॒रेण॑ ऋ॒तुना॑ दे॒वास्त्र॑यस्त्रि॒ᳪशेऽमृता॑ स्तु॒ताः ।
स॒त्येन॑ रे॒वती॑: क्ष॒त्रᳪ ह॒विरिन्द्रे॒ वयो॑ दधुः
verses.translation: With Dew-time may the deathless Gods praised in the Thirty-three-part laud, The Revatîs, with truth give sway to Indra, sacrifice and life.
verses.hindi: होता पुरुष प्रतिदिन अग्निहोत्र करता है, अग्नि मे घृत के कणो को डालता है ओर साथ ही प्राणापान के लिए अजमोद आदि ओषधियों के मध्यभाग की भी आहुतियाँ देता है, ज्ञानवृद्धि के लिए मेदधासिंगी तथा इन्द्र शक्ति के विकास के लिए ऋषभक ओषधि की आहुतियाँ भी देता है। देव लोग घृतादि सात्विक पदार्थो का ही सेवन करते हे, परन्तु
verses.transliteration: śaiśireṇa ṛtunā devāstrayastriśe'mṛtā stutāḥ | satyena revatī: kṣatra havirindre vayo dadhuḥ
verses.wordMeaning: With Dew-time may the deathless Gods praised in the Thirty-three-part laud, The Revatîs, with truth give sway to Indra, sacrifice and life.
verses.commentary: Sense: With Dew-time may the deathless Gods praised in the Thirty-three-part laud, The Revatîs, with truth give sway to Indra, sacrifice and life.

verses.sanskrit: होता॑ यक्षत्स॒मिधा॒ऽग्निमि॒डस्प॒देऽश्विनेन्द्र॒ᳪ सर॑स्वतीम॒जो धू॒म्रो न गो॒धूमै॒: कुव॑लैर्भेष॒जं मधु॒ शष्पै॒र्न तेज॑ इन्द्रि॒यं पय॒: सोम॑: परि॒स्रुता॑ घृ॒तं मधु॒ व्यन्त्वाज्य॑स्य॒ होत॑र्यज
verses.translation: Let the Hotar sacrifice with fuel to Agni in the place of libation, to the Asvins, Indra, Sarasvatî. A grey-coloured he-goat with wheat, jujube-fruit and sprouts of rice becomes a sweet salutary remedy, splendour, might, milk, Soma. Let them enjoy sweet butter with foaming liquor. Hotar, present offerings of butter.
verses.hindi: इस यज्ञमय जीवन मेँ हम अआजमोद ओषधि करे प्रयोग व यज्ञ से प्राणापान शक्ति का वर्धन कररे। मेदढासिंगी ओषधि क प्रयोग से हम मस्तिष्क कौ शक्ति का विकास करे तथा ऋषभक ओषधि का प्रयोग हमारी आत्मशक्ति का विकास करे। १. होता=यज्ञशील पुरुष अश्विनोप्राणापान को सरस्वती ज्ञानाधिदेवता कौ सुत्रामाणम्
verses.transliteration: hotā yakṣatsamidhā'gnimiḍaspade'śvinendra sarasvatīmajo dhūmro na godhūmai: kuvalairbheṣajaṃ madhu śaṣpairna teja indriyaṃ paya: soma: parisrutā ghṛtaṃ madhu vyantvājyasya hotaryaja
verses.wordMeaning: Let the Hotar sacrifice with fuel to Agni in the place of libation, to the Asvins, Indra, Sarasvatî. A grey-coloured he-goat with wheat, jujube-fruit and sprouts of rice becomes a sweet salutary remedy, splendour, might, milk, Soma.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Let the Hotar sacrifice with fuel to Agni in the place of libation, to the Asvins, Indra, Sarasvatî. A grey-coloured he-goat with wheat, jujube-fruit and sprouts of rice becomes a sweet salutary remedy, splendour, might, milk, Soma.…

verses.sanskrit: होता॑ यक्ष॒त्तनू॒नपा॒त्सर॑स्वती॒मवि॑र्मे॒षो न भे॑ष॒जं प॒था मधु॑मता॒ भर॑न्न॒श्विनेन्द्रा॑य वी॒र्यं बद॑रैरुप॒वाका॑भिर्भेष॒जं तोक्म॑भि॒: पय॒: सोम॑: परि॒स्रुता॑ घृ॒तं मधु॒ व्यन्त्वाज्य॑स्य॒ होत॒र्यज॑
verses.translation: Let the Hotar, Tanûnapât, worship Sarasvatî. A sheep, a ram, a salutary remedy on the honey-sweet path, bearing to the Asvins and Indra heroic strength, with jujube-fruit, Indra-grains, sprouts of rice, becomes a salutary remedy, milk, Soma. Let them enjoy, etc., as in verse 29.
verses.hindi: ' छाग, मेष व ऋषभक ' ओषधियों के पथ्य “शष्प, तोक्म व लाजा' हे। इनका यज्ञ करने पर ये अत्यन्त गुणकारी हो जाती हे। पुरा पौरुषेय्या गृभो घस्तां नूनं घासेऽअंज्राणां यव॑सप्रथमाना सुमतक्ष॑राणा द्गौदङ्खादवंत्तानां कर॑तऽ एवाज्विनां जुषेतांथ ह विर्होतर्यजं। ४३।
verses.transliteration: hotā yakṣattanūnapātsarasvatīmavirmeṣo na bheṣajaṃ pathā madhumatā bharannaśvinendrāya vīryaṃ badarairupavākābhirbheṣajaṃ tokmabhi: paya: soma: parisrutā ghṛtaṃ madhu vyantvājyasya hotaryaja
verses.wordMeaning: Let the Hotar, Tanûnapât, worship Sarasvatî. A sheep, a ram, a salutary remedy on the honey-sweet path, bearing to the Asvins and Indra heroic strength, with jujube-fruit, Indra-grains, sprouts of rice, becomes a salutary remedy, milk, Soma. Let them enjoy, etc., as in verse 29.
verses.commentary: Sense: Let the Hotar, Tanûnapât, worship Sarasvatî. A sheep, a ram, a salutary remedy on the honey-sweet path, bearing to the Asvins and Indra heroic strength, with jujube-fruit, Indra-grains, sprouts of rice, becomes a salutary remedy, milk, Soma. Let them enjoy, etc., as in verse 29.

verses.sanskrit: होता॑ यक्ष॒न्नरा॒शᳪसं॒ न न॒ग्नहुं॒ पति॒ᳪ सुर॑या भेष॒जं मे॒षः सर॑स्वती भि॒षग्रथो॒ न च॒न्द्रयश्विनो॑र्व॒पा इन्द्र॑स्य वी॒र्यं बद॑रैरुप॒वाका॑भिर्भेष॒जं तोक्म॑भि॒: पय॒: सोम॑: परि॒स्रुता॑ घृ॒तं मधु॒ व्यन्त्वाज्य॑स्य॒ होत॒र्यज॑
verses.translation: Let the Hotar worship Narâsamsa and the Lord Nagnahu. A ram with Surâ a salutary remedy, Sarasvatî the Physician, the golden car of the Asvins, the victim's omentum, with jujube-fruit, Indra-grains, and rice-sprouts, become a salutary remedy, the manly strength of Indra, milk, Soma. Let them, etc.
verses.hindi: मस्तिष्क के उत्कर्षं के दृष्टिकोण से मेद्ासिंगी ओषधि करे मध्य से उद्धूत गदे का ग्रहण करे। वह गूदा विकृत रसवाला न हो जाए ओर न ही मकं उसपर बैठकर उसे रोगकृमियों से परिपूर्ण कर दे। इसके प्रयोग व हवन से हमारे सब अद्ध सुन्दर व स्वस्थ कडहोतां यक्षद नद्र॑मृषभस्य॑ हविषऽ आक॑यदद्य म॑ध्य॒तो मेद ऽ उद्धूतं पुरा द्वेषोभ्यः पुरा
verses.transliteration: hotā yakṣannarāśasaṃ na nagnahuṃ pati surayā bheṣajaṃ meṣaḥ sarasvatī bhiṣagratho na candrayaśvinorvapā indrasya vīryaṃ badarairupavākābhirbheṣajaṃ tokmabhi: paya: soma: parisrutā ghṛtaṃ madhu vyantvājyasya hotaryaja
verses.wordMeaning: Let the Hotar worship Narâsamsa and the Lord Nagnahu. A ram with Surâ a salutary remedy, Sarasvatî the Physician, the golden car of the Asvins, the victim's omentum, with jujube-fruit, Indra-grains, and rice-sprouts, become a salutary remedy, the manly strength of Indra, milk,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Let the Hotar worship Narâsamsa and the Lord Nagnahu. A ram with Surâ a salutary remedy, Sarasvatî the Physician, the golden car of the Asvins, the victim's omentum, with jujube-fruit, Indra-grains, and rice-sprouts, become a salutary remedy, the manly strength of Indra, milk,…

verses.sanskrit: होता॑ यक्षदि॒डेडि॒त आ॒जुह्वा॑न॒: सर॑स्वती॒मिन्द्रं॒ बले॑न व॒र्धय॑न्नृष॒भेण॒ गवे॑न्द्रि॒यम॒श्विनेन्द्रा॑य भेष॒जं यवै॑ र्क॒र्कन्धु॑भि॒र्मधु॑ लाजै॒र्न मास॑रं॒ पय॒: सोम॑: परि॒स्रुता॑ घृ॒तं मधु॒ व्यन्त्वाज्य॑स्य॒ होत॒र्यज॑
verses.translation: Let the Hotar, magnified with oblations, offering sacrifice, worship Sarasvatî and Indra, increasing them with strength, with a bull and a cow. Strength and medicine to the Asvins and Indra are meath with jujube-fruit, Mâsara with parched grain, milk, Soma. Let them, etc.
verses.hindi: जीवन को सुन्दर ब सामर्थ्यसम्पन्न बनाने के लिए आवश्यक है कि वानस्पतिक भोजन का अङ्कीकार कर ओर दुदढनिश्चयी वनें। इष्टकामधुक् ( स्विष्टकरत् ) अग्नि कहोता। यक्षद्ग्निश्स्विंष्ट कृतमयांडग्निरश्विनोश्छाग॑स्य हविषः प्रिया धामान्ययार्
verses.transliteration: hotā yakṣadiḍeḍita ājuhvāna: sarasvatīmindraṃ balena vardhayannṛṣabheṇa gavendriyamaśvinendrāya bheṣajaṃ yavai rkarkandhubhirmadhu lājairna māsaraṃ paya: soma: parisrutā ghṛtaṃ madhu vyantvājyasya hotaryaja
verses.wordMeaning: Let the Hotar, magnified with oblations, offering sacrifice, worship Sarasvatî and Indra, increasing them with strength, with a bull and a cow. Strength and medicine to the Asvins and Indra are meath with jujube-fruit, Mâsara with parched grain, milk, Soma. Let them, etc.
verses.commentary: Sense: Let the Hotar, magnified with oblations, offering sacrifice, worship Sarasvatî and Indra, increasing them with strength, with a bull and a cow. Strength and medicine to the Asvins and Indra are meath with jujube-fruit, Mâsara with parched grain, milk, Soma. Let them, etc.

verses.sanskrit:
होता॑ यक्षद्ब॒र्हिरूर्ण॑म्म्रदा भि॒षङ्नास॑त्या भि॒षजा॒ऽश्विनाऽश्वा॒ शिशु॑मती भि॒षग्धे॒नुः सर॑स्वती भि॒षग्दु॒ह इन्द्रा॑य भेष॒जं पय॒: सोम॑: परि॒स्रुता॑ घृ॒तं मधु॒ व्यन्त्वाज्य॑स्य॒ होत॑र्यज ।। ३ ३ ।।
होता॑ यक्ष॒द्दुरो॒ दिश॑: कव॒ष्यो न व्यच॑स्वतीर॒श्विभ्यां॒ न दुरो॒ दिश॒ इन्द्रो॒ न रोद॑सी॒ दुघे॑ दु॒हे धे॒नुः सर॑स्वत्य॒श्विनेन्द्रा॑य भेष॒जᳪ शु॒क्रं न ज्योति॑रिन्द्रि॒यं पय॒: सोम॑: परि॒स्रुता॑ घृ॒तं मधु॒ व्यन्त्वाज्य॑स्य॒ होत॒र्यज॑
verses.translation: Let the Hotar worship the Doors, the Regions, the resounding, expansive Doors, the Regions, with the Asvins. Indra milks the two milky worlds. The Mulch-cow Sarasvatî yields medicine for the Asvins and Indra, pure light and strength. Milk, Soma. Let them, etc.
verses.hindi: ९. ज्ञान से मन दिव्य व वासनाशून्य बनता है। २. प्राणापान की साधना हदय को एकाग्र करके प्रभु-दर्शन करे योग्य बनाती हे। ३. इस साधक की आंखें तेजस्वी व द्र्शनशक््ति-सम्पत्र होती हें। ४. वासनाशून्य हदय के साथ इसकी सब इन्द्रियं सशक्त होती हे। ५. वीर्यरक्षा से निवासक तत्वों का उपचय होता है। ६. इस सबके लिए हमे यज्ञशील
verses.transliteration: hotā yakṣadbarhirūrṇammradā bhiṣaṅnāsatyā bhiṣajā'śvinā'śvā śiśumatī bhiṣagdhenuḥ sarasvatī bhiṣagduha indrāya bheṣajaṃ paya: soma: parisrutā ghṛtaṃ madhu vyantvājyasya hotaryaja || 3 3 || hotā yakṣadduro diśa: kavaṣyo na vyacasvatīraśvibhyāṃ na duro diśa indro na rodasī dughe duhe dhenuḥ sarasvatyaśvinendrāya bheṣaja śukraṃ na jyotirindriyaṃ paya: soma: parisrutā ghṛtaṃ madhu vyantvājyasya hotaryaja
verses.wordMeaning: Let the Hotar worship the Doors, the Regions, the resounding, expansive Doors, the Regions, with the Asvins. Indra milks the two milky worlds. The Mulch-cow Sarasvatî yields medicine for the Asvins and Indra, pure light and strength. Milk, Soma. Let them, etc.
verses.commentary: Sense: Let the Hotar worship the Doors, the Regions, the resounding, expansive Doors, the Regions, with the Asvins. Indra milks the two milky worlds. The Mulch-cow Sarasvatî yields medicine for the Asvins and Indra, pure light and strength. Milk, Soma. Let them, etc.

verses.sanskrit: होता॑ यक्षत्सु॒पेश॑सो॒षे नक्तं॒ दिवा॒ऽश्विना॒ सम॑ञ्जाते॒ सर॑स्वत्या॒ त्विषि॒मिन्द्रे॒ न भे॑ष॒जᳪ श्ये॒नो न रज॑सा हृ॒दा श्रि॒या न मास॑रं॒ पय॒: सोम॑: परि॒स्रुता॑ घृ॒तं मधु॒ व्यन्त्वाज्य॑स्य॒ होत॒र्यज॑
verses.translation: Let the Hotar worship the two fair-formed Dawns. At night and by day the Asvins with Sarasvatî compose impetuous power, like healing balm, in Indra, like a falcon, Mâsara with light, thought, and grace. Milk, Soma. Let them enjoy, etc.
verses.hindi: प्राणापान की साधना तथा ज्ञान की आराधना से हमारे सब इद्द्रिय द्वार दिव्य हों। हमारी नासिका में ्राणेन्दिय शक्ति व वीर्य हो। हम निवासक तत्त्वों की प्राप्ति के लिए वीर्य को शरीर में ही व्याप्त करे तथा यज्ञशील बनकर भोगवृकत्ति से ऊपर उठे। देवीऽउषासावश्विनां सुत्रामेन्द्रे सर॑स्वती।
verses.transliteration: hotā yakṣatsupeśasoṣe naktaṃ divā'śvinā samañjāte sarasvatyā tviṣimindre na bheṣaja śyeno na rajasā hṛdā śriyā na māsaraṃ paya: soma: parisrutā ghṛtaṃ madhu vyantvājyasya hotaryaja
verses.wordMeaning: Let the Hotar worship the two fair-formed Dawns. At night and by day the Asvins with Sarasvatî compose impetuous power, like healing balm, in Indra, like a falcon, Mâsara with light, thought, and grace. Milk, Soma. Let them enjoy, etc.
verses.commentary: Sense: Let the Hotar worship the two fair-formed Dawns. At night and by day the Asvins with Sarasvatî compose impetuous power, like healing balm, in Indra, like a falcon, Mâsara with light, thought, and grace. Milk, Soma. Let them enjoy, etc.

verses.sanskrit: होता॑ यक्ष॒द्दैव्या॒ होता॑रा भि॒षजा॒ऽश्विनेन्द्रं॒ न जागृ॑वि॒ दिवा॒ नक्तं॒ न भे॑ष॒जै: शूष॒ᳪ सर॑स्वती भि॒षक् सीसे॑न दुह इन्द्रि॒यं पय॒: सोम॑: परि॒स्रुता॑ घृ॒तं मधु॒ व्यन्त्वाज्य॑स्य॒ होत॒र्यज॑
verses.translation: Let the Hotar worship the two divine Hotars, the Physician Asvins, and Indra. Watchfully by day and night Sarasvatî as Physician, with balms, with lead, yields strength and power. Milk, Soma. Let them enjoy, etc.
verses.hindi: प्रातः-सायं उद्गीथ का गायन करनेवाली वाणी प्राणापान कौ साधना से तथा ज्ञान की आराधना से सबल बनती ै। कानों में यशस्वी श्रोत्ररक्त्ि देवी जोष्टी सस्स्वत्यश्विनेनद्र॑मवर्धयन् ।
verses.transliteration: hotā yakṣaddaivyā hotārā bhiṣajā'śvinendraṃ na jāgṛvi divā naktaṃ na bheṣajai: śūṣa sarasvatī bhiṣak sīsena duha indriyaṃ paya: soma: parisrutā ghṛtaṃ madhu vyantvājyasya hotaryaja
verses.wordMeaning: Let the Hotar worship the two divine Hotars, the Physician Asvins, and Indra. Watchfully by day and night Sarasvatî as Physician, with balms, with lead, yields strength and power. Milk, Soma. Let them enjoy, etc.
verses.commentary: Sense: Let the Hotar worship the two divine Hotars, the Physician Asvins, and Indra. Watchfully by day and night Sarasvatî as Physician, with balms, with lead, yields strength and power. Milk, Soma. Let them enjoy, etc.

verses.sanskrit: होता॑ यक्षत्ति॒स्रो दे॒वीर्न भे॑ष॒जं त्रय॑स्त्रि॒धात॑वो॒ऽपसो॑ रू॒पमिन्द्रे॑ हिर॒ण्यय॑म॒श्विनेडा॒ न भार॑ती वा॒चा सर॑स्वती॒ मह॒ इन्द्रा॑य दुह इन्द्रि॒यं पय॒: सोम॑: परि॒स्रुता॑ घृ॒तं मधु॒ व्यन्त्वाज्य॑स्य॒ होत॒र्यज॑
verses.translation: Let the Hotar worship the three Goddesses. The three active ones, with three sacrificial elements, lay balm and golden hue on Indra. The Asvins, Idâ, Bhâratî—Sarasvatî with Speech yields might and power to Indra. Milk, Soma. Let them enjoy, etc.
verses.hindi: हमारे दिनरात "देवी जोष्ट्री" हों। हम उनमें प्रीतिपूर्वक अपने कर्तव्यो के करने मेँ लगे रदे। इससे हमें कानों में यशस्वी श्रोजरशक्ति प्राप्त हौ। हमारी सब इद्ियोँ सबल हों। हम वीर्यं कौ रक्षा करें ओर यज्ञशील हो। स्तनो में श॒क्र ओर ज्योति
verses.transliteration: hotā yakṣattisro devīrna bheṣajaṃ trayastridhātavo'paso rūpamindre hiraṇyayamaśvineḍā na bhāratī vācā sarasvatī maha indrāya duha indriyaṃ paya: soma: parisrutā ghṛtaṃ madhu vyantvājyasya hotaryaja
verses.wordMeaning: Let the Hotar worship the three Goddesses. The three active ones, with three sacrificial elements, lay balm and golden hue on Indra. The Asvins, Idâ, Bhâratî—Sarasvatî with Speech yields might and power to Indra. Milk, Soma. Let them enjoy, etc.
verses.commentary: Sense: Let the Hotar worship the three Goddesses. The three active ones, with three sacrificial elements, lay balm and golden hue on Indra. The Asvins, Idâ, Bhâratî—Sarasvatî with Speech yields might and power to Indra. Milk, Soma. Let them enjoy, etc.

verses.sanskrit: होता॑ यक्षत् सु॒रेर॑समृष॒भं नर्या॑पसं॒ त्वष्टा॑र॒मिन्द्र॑म॒श्विना॑ भि॒षजं॒ न सर॑स्वती॒मोजो॒ न जू॒तिरि॑न्द्रि॒यं वृको॒ न र॑भ॒सो भि॒षग् यश॒: सुर॑या भेष॒जᳪ श्रि॒या न मास॑रं॒ पय॒: सोम॑: परि॒स्रुता॑ घृ॒तं मधु॒ व्यन्त्वाज्य॑स्य॒ होत॒र्यज॑
verses.translation: Let the Hotar worship Tvashtar full of good seed, the Bull active for men, Indra, the Asvins, Sarasvatî the Physician. Vigour, speed, power, a fierce wolf as physician, fame with Surâ is a medicine, Mâsara with grace. Milk, Soma. Let them enjoy, etc.
verses.hindi: स्नेह व द्वेषाभाव की दिव्य वृत्तिं (मित्रावरुण देव) , प्राणापानरूप दिव्य वैद्य (अश्विना देवानां भिषजा) यज्ञादि उत्तम कर्म तथा ज्ञान हमारे जीवन में दीप्ति को, मति को तथा अङ्ख-ग्रत्यद्ध की शक्ति को धारण कर। हम उत्तम निवास के लि वीर्य को शरीर में ही व्याप्त करें ओर यज्षशील हौ।
verses.transliteration: hotā yakṣat surerasamṛṣabhaṃ naryāpasaṃ tvaṣṭāramindramaśvinā bhiṣajaṃ na sarasvatīmojo na jūtirindriyaṃ vṛko na rabhaso bhiṣag yaśa: surayā bheṣaja śriyā na māsaraṃ paya: soma: parisrutā ghṛtaṃ madhu vyantvājyasya hotaryaja
verses.wordMeaning: Let the Hotar worship Tvashtar full of good seed, the Bull active for men, Indra, the Asvins, Sarasvatî the Physician. Vigour, speed, power, a fierce wolf as physician, fame with Surâ is a medicine, Mâsara with grace. Milk, Soma. Let them enjoy, etc.
verses.commentary: Sense: Let the Hotar worship Tvashtar full of good seed, the Bull active for men, Indra, the Asvins, Sarasvatî the Physician. Vigour, speed, power, a fierce wolf as physician, fame with Surâ is a medicine, Mâsara with grace. Milk, Soma. Let them enjoy, etc.

verses.sanskrit: होता॑ यक्ष॒द्वन॒स्पति॑ᳪ शमि॒तार॑ᳪ श॒तक्र॑तुं भी॒मं न म॒न्युᳪ राजा॑नं व्या॒घ्रं नम॑सा॒ऽश्विना॒ भाम॒ᳪ सर॑स्वती भि॒षगिन्द्रा॑य दुह इन्द्रि॒यं पय॒: सोम॑: परि॒स्रुता॑ घृ॒तं मधु॒ व्यन्त्वाज्य॑स्य॒ होत॒र्यज॑
verses.translation: Let the Hotar worship Vanaspatî the Immolator, the Lord of Hundred Powers, and awful Passion, the King, the Tiger, and the Asvins, with reverence. Sarasvatî the Physician yields wrath and power to Indra. Milk, Soma. Let them enjoy, etc.
verses.hindi: वे प्रभु "देव-इन्द्र-नरांशस व त्रिवरूथ ' हे। प्रभु का यह रथ ज्ञान व प्राणापान से चलता है। वे निर्माता प्रभु "रेतस्, रूप, अमृत, जनित्र व इन्द्ियशक्तियोँ' का धारण करते हे। निवासक तत्त्वो के विजय करे लिए हम शरीर में वीर्य का व्यापन करें ओर यज्ञशीलहो। देवो देवैर्वनस्पतिर्हिरंण्यपर्णोऽञण्विभ्याश्सर॑स्वत्या सुपिप्पलऽइन्द्रंय पच्यते मधुं ।
verses.transliteration: hotā yakṣadvanaspati śamitāra śatakratuṃ bhīmaṃ na manyu rājānaṃ vyāghraṃ namasā'śvinā bhāma sarasvatī bhiṣagindrāya duha indriyaṃ paya: soma: parisrutā ghṛtaṃ madhu vyantvājyasya hotaryaja
verses.wordMeaning: Let the Hotar worship Vanaspatî the Immolator, the Lord of Hundred Powers, and awful Passion, the King, the Tiger, and the Asvins, with reverence. Sarasvatî the Physician yields wrath and power to Indra. Milk, Soma. Let them enjoy, etc.
verses.commentary: Sense: Let the Hotar worship Vanaspatî the Immolator, the Lord of Hundred Powers, and awful Passion, the King, the Tiger, and the Asvins, with reverence. Sarasvatî the Physician yields wrath and power to Indra. Milk, Soma. Let them enjoy, etc.

verses.sanskrit: होता॑ यक्षद॒ग्निᳪ स्वाहाऽऽज्य॑स्य स्तो॒काना॒ᳪ स्वाहा॒ मेद॑सां॒ पृथ॒क् स्वाहा॒ छाग॑म॒श्विभ्या॒ᳪ स्वाहा॑ मे॒षᳪ सर॑स्वत्यै॒ स्वाह॑ ऋष॒भमिन्द्रा॑य सि॒ᳪहाय॒ सह॑स इन्द्रि॒यᳪ स्वाहा॒ऽग्निं न भे॑ष॒जᳪ स्वाहा॒ सोम॑मिन्द्रि॒यᳪ स्वाहेन्द्र॑ᳪ सु॒त्रामा॑ण सवि॒तारं॒ वरु॑णं भि॒षजां॒ पति॒ᳪ स्वाहा॒ वन॒स्पतिं॑ प्रि॒यं पाथो॒ न भे॑ष॒जᳪ स्वाहा॑ दे॒वा आ॑ज्य॒पा जु॑षा॒णो अ॒ग्निर्भे॑ष॒जं पय॒: सोम॑: परि॒स्रुता॑ घृ॒तं मधु॒ व्यन्त्वाज्य॑स्य॒ होत॒र्यज॑
verses.translation: Let the Hotar worship Agni. Of the drops of clarified butter, Svâhâ! Of the fat, omentum, etc., severally, Svâhâ! Svâhâ! the goat for the Asvins. Svâhâ! the ram for Sarasvatî. Svâhâ! the bull for Indra. To the Lion, to his might, power. Svâhâ! Agni the salutary remedy. Svâhâ! Soma, the power. Svâhâ! Indra the Good Deliverer. Savitar, Varuna Lord of Physicians. Svâhâ! Vanaspatî, beloved, food and medicine. Svâhâ! Gods who drink clarified butter. Agni accepting the medicine. Milk, Soma. Let them enjoy, etc.
verses.hindi: यह संसार-वृक्च सूर्यादि देवों के साथ सचमुच दिव्य गुणौवाला है। यह प्राणापान व ज्ञानरूप उत्तम फलोवाला है। जितेन्द्रिय पुरुष के लिए यह मधुर-ही-मधुर हे। -यह ओजस्विता, स्फूर्तिं व तेजस्विता को देनेवाला है। हम उत्तम निवास के लिए वीर्य को शरीर में व्याप्त करे, य्ञशील हो।
verses.transliteration: hotā yakṣadagni svāhā''jyasya stokānā svāhā medasāṃ pṛthak svāhā chāgamaśvibhyā svāhā meṣa sarasvatyai svāha ṛṣabhamindrāya sihāya sahasa indriya svāhā'gniṃ na bheṣaja svāhā somamindriya svāhendra sutrāmāṇa savitāraṃ varuṇaṃ bhiṣajāṃ pati svāhā vanaspatiṃ priyaṃ pātho na bheṣaja svāhā devā ājyapā juṣāṇo agnirbheṣajaṃ paya: soma: parisrutā ghṛtaṃ madhu vyantvājyasya hotaryaja
verses.wordMeaning: Let the Hotar worship Agni. Of the drops of clarified butter, Svâhâ! Of the fat, omentum, etc., severally, Svâhâ! Svâhâ! the goat for the Asvins. Svâhâ! the ram for Sarasvatî. Svâhâ! the bull for Indra. To the Lion, to his might, power. Svâhâ! Agni the salutary remedy.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Let the Hotar worship Agni. Of the drops of clarified butter, Svâhâ! Of the fat, omentum, etc., severally, Svâhâ! Svâhâ! the goat for the Asvins. Svâhâ! the ram for Sarasvatî. Svâhâ! the bull for Indra. To the Lion, to his might, power. Svâhâ! Agni the salutary remedy.…

verses.sanskrit:
होता॑ यक्षद॒श्विनौ॒ छाग॑स्य व॒पाया॒ मेद॑सो जु॒षेता॑ᳪ ह॒विर्होत॒र्यज॑ ।
होता॑ यक्ष॒त्सर॑स्वतीं मे॒षस्य॑ व॒पाया॒ मेद॑सो जु॒षता॑ᳪ ह॒विर्होत॒र्यज॑ ।
होता॑ यक्ष॒दिन्द्र॑मृष॒भस्य॑ व॒पाया॒ मेद॑सो जु॒षता॑ᳪ ह॒विर्होत॒र्यज॑
verses.translation: Let the Hotar worship the Asvins with the omentum of a he-goat. Let them enjoy the fat. Hotar, offer the sacrificial oblation. Let the Hotar worship Sarasvatî with the omentum of a ram. Let her enjoy the fat. Hotar offer the sacrificial oblation. Let the Hotar worship Indra with the omentum of a bull. Let him, etc.
verses.hindi: ईश का छोटा रूप बनने के लिए हम ज्ञानी बनें, नियमित व नियन्त्रित जीवनवाले हों, हदय को वासनाशन्य बना ओर सव इद्दरियो कौ शक्ति को स्थिर रक्खे, कदेवोऽअग्निः स्विष्ट कृददेवान्यंक्षद्यथायथःहोतांराविन्द्र॑मणश्विनां वाचा वाचःसर्स्वती- मग्निश्सोम॑शस्विष्टकृत् स्विष्ट ऽ इन्द्र॑ः सुत्रामा सविता वरुणो भिषगिष्टो देवो
verses.transliteration: hotā yakṣadaśvinau chāgasya vapāyā medaso juṣetā havirhotaryaja | hotā yakṣatsarasvatīṃ meṣasya vapāyā medaso juṣatā havirhotaryaja | hotā yakṣadindramṛṣabhasya vapāyā medaso juṣatā havirhotaryaja
verses.wordMeaning: Let the Hotar worship the Asvins with the omentum of a he-goat. Let them enjoy the fat. Hotar, offer the sacrificial oblation. Let the Hotar worship Sarasvatî with the omentum of a ram. Let her enjoy the fat. Hotar offer the sacrificial oblation.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Let the Hotar worship the Asvins with the omentum of a he-goat. Let them enjoy the fat. Hotar, offer the sacrificial oblation. Let the Hotar worship Sarasvatî with the omentum of a ram. Let her enjoy the fat. Hotar offer the sacrificial oblation.…

verses.sanskrit: होता॑ यक्षद॒श्विनौ॒ सर॑स्वती॒मिन्द्र॑ᳪ सु॒त्रामा॑णमि॒मे सोमा॑: सु॒रामा॑ण॒श्छागै॒र्न मे॒षैरृ॑षभैः सु॒ताः शष्पै॒र्न तोक्म॑भिर्ला॒जैर्मह॑स्वन्तो॒ मदा॒ मास॑रेण॒ परि॑ष्कृताः शु॒क्राः पय॑स्वन्तो॒ऽमृता॒: प्रस्थि॑ता वो मधु॒श्चुत॒स्तान॒श्विना॒ सर॑स्व॒तीन्द्र॑: सु॒त्रामा॑ वृत्र॒हा जु॒षन्ता॑ᳪ सो॒म्यं मधु॒ पिब॑न्तु॒ व्यन्तु॒ होत॒र्यज॑
verses.translation: Let the Hotar worship the Asvins, Sarasvatî, Indra the Good Deliverer. These your Somas, pressed, rejoicing with goats, rams, bulls, giving pleasure with rice-shoots, young blades of corn, parched grain, joy-givers adorned with Mâsara, bright, milky, immortal, presented, dropping honey. these let the Asvins, Sarasvatî, Indra the Good Deliverer, Vritra-slayer, accept. Let them drink, rejoice in, enjoy the Soma meath. Hotar, sacrifice.
verses.hindi: यज्ञशील पुरुष सब अच्छाइयों को अपने साथ सङ्खत करनेवाला बनता है। अग्निमद्य होतारमवृणीतायं यज॑मानः पचन्पक्तीः पच॑न्पुरोडाणान् लध्नन्नण्विभ्यां १. पिले १९ मन्त्रों मे अन्तिम आदेश है " यज'=तू यज्ञ करनेवाला बन। १९० इच््रर्याँ तथा १्वे मन को तू यन्न में लगानैवाला बन। इस आदेश का पालन करनेवाला अयं
verses.transliteration: hotā yakṣadaśvinau sarasvatīmindra sutrāmāṇamime somā: surāmāṇaśchāgairna meṣairṛṣabhaiḥ sutāḥ śaṣpairna tokmabhirlājairmahasvanto madā māsareṇa pariṣkṛtāḥ śukrāḥ payasvanto'mṛtā: prasthitā vo madhuścutastānaśvinā sarasvatīndra: sutrāmā vṛtrahā juṣantā somyaṃ madhu pibantu vyantu hotaryaja
verses.wordMeaning: Let the Hotar worship the Asvins, Sarasvatî, Indra the Good Deliverer. These your Somas, pressed, rejoicing with goats, rams, bulls, giving pleasure with rice-shoots, young blades of corn, parched grain, joy-givers adorned with Mâsara, bright, milky, immortal, presented,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Let the Hotar worship the Asvins, Sarasvatî, Indra the Good Deliverer. These your Somas, pressed, rejoicing with goats, rams, bulls, giving pleasure with rice-shoots, young blades of corn, parched grain, joy-givers adorned with Mâsara, bright, milky, immortal, presented,…

verses.sanskrit: होता॑ यक्षद॒श्विनौ॒ छाग॑स्य ह॒विष॒ आत्ता॑म॒द्य म॑ध्य॒तो मेद॒ उद्भृ॑तं पु॒रा द्वेषो॑भ्यः पु॒रा पौ॑रुषेय्या गृ॒भो घस्तां॑ नू॒नं घा॒से अ॑ज्राणां॒ यव॑सप्रथमानाᳪ सु॒मत्क्ष॑राणाᳪ शतरु॒द्रिया॑णामग्निष्वा॒त्तानां॒ पीवो॑पवसानां पार्श्व॒तः श्रो॑णि॒तः शि॑ताम॒त उ॑त्साद॒तोऽङ्गा॑दङ्गा॒दव॑त्तानां॒ कर॑त ए॒वाश्विना॑ जु॒षेता॑ᳪ ह॒विर्होत॒र्यज॑
verses.translation: Let the Hotar worship Indra, etc., as in
verses.hindi: हम यज्ञशील वनें। यज्ञ के लिए आत्मभाव को पुष्ट करें। प्राणापान-ज्ञान व आत्मशक्ति के विकास के लिए जहाँ विविध ओषध-द्रव्यों की आहति दी जाए वँ वीर्यकणों का संयम करे द्वारा शरीर में ही व्यापन किया जाए। सूपस्थाऽअद्य देवो वनस्पतिरभवद्ण्विभ्यां छागेन सर्स्वत्यै मेषेणेन्द्रायऽ ऋषभेण
verses.transliteration: hotā yakṣadaśvinau chāgasya haviṣa āttāmadya madhyato meda udbhṛtaṃ purā dveṣobhyaḥ purā pauruṣeyyā gṛbho ghastāṃ nūnaṃ ghāse ajrāṇāṃ yavasaprathamānā sumatkṣarāṇā śatarudriyāṇāmagniṣvāttānāṃ pīvopavasānāṃ pārśvataḥ śroṇitaḥ śitāmata utsādato'ṅgādaṅgādavattānāṃ karata evāśvinā juṣetā havirhotaryaja
verses.wordMeaning: Let the Hotar worship Indra, etc., as in
verses.commentary: Sense: Let the Hotar worship Indra, etc., as in

verses.sanskrit: होता॑ यक्ष॒त् सर॑स्वतीं मे॒षस्य॑ ह॒विष॒ आव॑यद॒द्य म॑ध्य॒तो मेद॒ उद्भृ॑तं पु॒रा द्वेषो॑भ्यः पु॒रा पौ॑रुषेय्या गृ॒भो घस॑न्नू॒नं घा॒से अ॑ज्राणां॒ यव॑सप्रथमानाᳪ सु॒मत्क्ष॑राणाᳪ शतरु॒द्रिया॑णामग्निष्वा॒त्तानां॒ पीवो॑पवसनानां पार्श्व॒तः श्रो॑णि॒तः शि॑ताम॒त उ॑त्साद॒तोऽङ्गा॑दङ्गा॒दव॑त्तानां॒ कर॑दे॒वᳪ सर॑स्वती जु॒षता॑ᳪ ह॒विर्होत॒र्यज॑
verses.translation: mutatis mutandis.
verses.hindi: य्लशील पुरुष के लिए यह संसार वृक्ष उत्तम ओषध द्रव्यो से उपस्थान (सेवन) करनेवाला होता हे। मे देवेषु वसु वार्यायंक्ष्यतऽडइति ता या हैवा देव दानान्यदुस्तान्य॑स्माऽआ च शास्स्वा च॑ गुरस्वेषितश्च होतरसि भद्रवाच्याय प्रेषितो मानुषः सूक्तवाकाय सूक्ता ब्रहि ॥६९॥
verses.transliteration: hotā yakṣat sarasvatīṃ meṣasya haviṣa āvayadadya madhyato meda udbhṛtaṃ purā dveṣobhyaḥ purā pauruṣeyyā gṛbho ghasannūnaṃ ghāse ajrāṇāṃ yavasaprathamānā sumatkṣarāṇā śatarudriyāṇāmagniṣvāttānāṃ pīvopavasanānāṃ pārśvataḥ śroṇitaḥ śitāmata utsādato'ṅgādaṅgādavattānāṃ karadeva sarasvatī juṣatā havirhotaryaja
verses.wordMeaning: mutatis mutandis.
verses.commentary: Sense: mutatis mutandis.

verses.sanskrit: होता॑ यक्ष॒दिन्द्र॑मृष॒भस्य॑ ह॒विष॒ आव॑यद॒द्य म॑ध्य॒तो मेद॒ उद्भृ॑तं पु॒रा द्वेषो॑भ्यः पु॒रा पौ॑रुषेय्या गृ॒भो घस॑न्नू॒नं घा॒से अ॑ज्राणां॒ यव॑सप्रथमानाᳪ सु॒मत्क्ष॑राणाᳪ शतरु॒द्रिया॑णामग्निष्वा॒त्तानां॒ पीवो॑पवसानानां पार्श्व॒तः श्रो॑णि॒तः शि॑ताम॒त उ॑त्साद॒तोऽङ्गा॑दङ्गा॒दव॑त्तानां॒ कर॑दे॒वमिन्द्रो॑ जु॒षता॑ᳪ ह॒विर्होत॒र्यज॑
verses.translation: Let the Hotar worship Vanaspatî.
verses.hindi: हम प्रय वश्रेयमेंसे श्रेय का वरण करते हए परमात्मा का दही वरण करे। दस वरण से सब देवों से प्राप्य दान तो हमें प्राप्त होगे ही ओर भद्रवाणी को बोलते हुए हम इस संसार को स्वर्ग बना पार्णगे। नोट : इस अध्याय का मुख्य विषय यज्ञिय जीवनवाला बनना ह। भोगप्रवण जीवन
verses.transliteration: hotā yakṣadindramṛṣabhasya haviṣa āvayadadya madhyato meda udbhṛtaṃ purā dveṣobhyaḥ purā pauruṣeyyā gṛbho ghasannūnaṃ ghāse ajrāṇāṃ yavasaprathamānā sumatkṣarāṇā śatarudriyāṇāmagniṣvāttānāṃ pīvopavasānānāṃ pārśvataḥ śroṇitaḥ śitāmata utsādato'ṅgādaṅgādavattānāṃ karadevamindro juṣatā havirhotaryaja
verses.wordMeaning: Let the Hotar worship Vanaspatî.
verses.commentary: Sense: Let the Hotar worship Vanaspatî.

verses.sanskrit: होता॑ यक्ष॒द्वन॒स्पति॑म॒भि हि पि॒ष्टत॑मया॒ रभि॑ष्ठया रश॒नयाधि॑त । यत्रा॒श्विनो॒श्छाग॑स्य ह॒विष॑: प्रि॒या धामा॑नि॒ यत्र॒ सर॑स्वत्या मे॒षस्य॑ ह॒विष॑: प्रि॒या धामा॑नि॒ यत्रेन्द्र॑स्य ऋष॒भस्य॑ ह॒विष॑: प्रि॒या धामा॑नि॒ यत्रा॒ग्नेः प्रि॒या धामा॑नि॒ यत्र॒ सोम॑स्य प्रि॒या धामा॑नि॒ यत्रेन्द्र॑स्य सु॒त्राम्ण॑: प्रि॒या धामा॑नि॒ यत्र॑ सवि॒तुः प्रि॒या धामा॑नि॒ यत्र॒ वरु॑णस्य प्रि॒या धामा॑नि॒ यत्र॒ वन॒स्पते॑: प्रि॒या पाथा॑ᳪसि॒ यत्र॑ दे॒वाना॑माज्य॒पानां॑ प्रि॒या धामा॑नि॒ यत्रा॒ग्नेर्होतु॑: प्रि॒या धामा॑नि॒ तत्रै॒तान्प्र॒स्तुत्ये॑वोप॒स्तुत्ये॑वो॒पाव॑स्रक्ष॒द्रभी॑यस इव कृ॒त्वी कर॑दे॒वं दे॒वो वन॒स्पति॑र्जु॒षता॑ᳪ ह॒विर्होत॒र्यज॑
verses.translation: He has held with a very well formed and very strong rope. There where the favourite stations of the Asvins are, of the he-goat the sacrifice; of Sarasvatî, of the ram the sacrifice; of Indra, of the bull the sacrifice; there where the favourite stations of Agni are, of Soma, of Indra the Good Deliverer, of Savitar, of Varuna, the favourite places of Vanaspatî, the favourite stations of Gods who drink clarified butter, and of Agni the Hotar, there let him arrange these victims when he has praised and lauded them, and perform when he has made them very strong. Let divine Vanaspatî accept. Hotar, offer oblation.
verses.hindi: ज्ञान व यज्ञ ही जीवन को सार्थक बनानेवाले हे। त्वं नोऽअग्ने वरूणस्य विद्धान् देवस्य हेडोऽअवं यासिसीष्ठाः । १. है अग्ने-अग्नि के समान ज्ञान के प्रकाश से चमकनेवाले वरुणस्य विद्वान=सब बुराइयों का निवारण करनेवाले, हमारे जीवनो को श्रेष्ठ बनानेवाले विद्वन्! प्रभु को
verses.transliteration: hotā yakṣadvanaspatimabhi hi piṣṭatamayā rabhiṣṭhayā raśanayādhita | yatrāśvinośchāgasya haviṣa: priyā dhāmāni yatra sarasvatyā meṣasya haviṣa: priyā dhāmāni yatrendrasya ṛṣabhasya haviṣa: priyā dhāmāni yatrāgneḥ priyā dhāmāni yatra somasya priyā dhāmāni yatrendrasya sutrāmṇa: priyā dhāmāni yatra savituḥ priyā dhāmāni yatra varuṇasya priyā dhāmāni yatra vanaspate: priyā pāthāsi yatra devānāmājyapānāṃ priyā dhāmāni yatrāgnerhotu: priyā dhāmāni tatraitānprastutyevopastutyevopāvasrakṣadrabhīyasa iva kṛtvī karadevaṃ devo vanaspatirjuṣatā havirhotaryaja
verses.wordMeaning: He has held with a very well formed and very strong rope. There where the favourite stations of the Asvins are, of the he-goat the sacrifice; of Sarasvatî, of the ram the sacrifice; of Indra, of the bull the sacrifice; there where the favourite stations of Agni are, of Soma,…
verses.commentary: Sense: He has held with a very well formed and very strong rope. There where the favourite stations of the Asvins are, of the he-goat the sacrifice; of Sarasvatî, of the ram the sacrifice; of Indra, of the bull the sacrifice; there where the favourite stations of Agni are, of Soma,…

verses.sanskrit: होता॑ यक्षद॒ग्निᳪ स्वि॑ष्ट॒कृत॒मया॑ड॒ग्निर॒श्विनो॒श्छाग॑स्य ह॒विष॑: प्रि॒या धामा॒न्यया॒ट् सर॑स्वत्या मे॒षस्य॑  ह॒विष॑: प्रि॒या धामा॒न्यया॒डिन्द्र॑स्य ऋष॒भस्य॑ ह॒विष॑: प्रि॒या धामा॒न्यया॑ड॒ग्नेः प्रि॒या धामा॒न्यया॒ट् सोम॑स्य प्रि॒या धामा॒न्यया॒डिन्द्र॑स्य सु॒त्राम्ण॑: प्रि॒या धामा॒न्यया॑ट् सवि॒तुः प्रि॒या धामा॒न्यया॒ड् वरु॑णस्य प्रि॒या धामा॒न्यया॒ड् वन॒स्पते॑: प्रि॒या पाथा॒ᳪस्यया॑ड् दे॒वाना॑माज्य॒पानां॑ प्रि॒या धामा॑नि॒ यक्ष॑द॒ग्नेर्होतु॑: प्रि॒या धामा॑नि॒ यक्ष॒त् स्वं म॑हि॒मान॒माय॑जता॒मेज्या॒ इष॑: कृ॒णोतु॒ सो अ॑ध्व॒रा जा॒तवे॑दा जु॒षता॑ᳪ ह॒विर्होत॒र्यज॑
verses.translation: Let the Hotar worship Agni Svishtakrit. Let Agni worship the favourite stations of the Asvins, of the he-goat the sacrifice; of Sarasvatî, of the ram the sacrifice; of Indra, of the bull the sacrifice; there, etc., to 'butter' as in 46. Let him worship the favourite stations of Agni the Hotar. Let him worship his own majesty. Let him win for himself by sacrifice food worthy of sacrifice. Let him, Knower of Beings, perform the sacred rites. Let him accept the sacrificial food. Hotar, offer oblation.
verses.hindi: हमें प्रतिदिन विद्वानों का सङ्क प्राप्त हो। वे हमें जान के द्वारा प्रभु से सङ्कत करे ओर इस प्रकार हमें सुखी करे। सत्सङ्ख करे द्वारा अपने में उत्तमगुणों को उत्पन्न करनैवाला यह व्यक्ति ' वामदेव ' बनता हे। महीमू षु मातर्रसुव्रतानामृतस्य पल्नीमव॑से ह्वेम।
verses.transliteration: hotā yakṣadagni sviṣṭakṛtamayāḍagniraśvinośchāgasya haviṣa: priyā dhāmānyayāṭ sarasvatyā meṣasya haviṣa: priyā dhāmānyayāḍindrasya ṛṣabhasya haviṣa: priyā dhāmānyayāḍagneḥ priyā dhāmānyayāṭ somasya priyā dhāmānyayāḍindrasya sutrāmṇa: priyā dhāmānyayāṭ savituḥ priyā dhāmānyayāḍ varuṇasya priyā dhāmānyayāḍ vanaspate: priyā pāthāsyayāḍ devānāmājyapānāṃ priyā dhāmāni yakṣadagnerhotu: priyā dhāmāni yakṣat svaṃ mahimānamāyajatāmejyā iṣa: kṛṇotu so adhvarā jātavedā juṣatā havirhotaryaja
verses.wordMeaning: Let the Hotar worship Agni Svishtakrit. Let Agni worship the favourite stations of the Asvins, of the he-goat the sacrifice; of Sarasvatî, of the ram the sacrifice; of Indra, of the bull the sacrifice; there, etc., to 'butter' as in 46.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Let the Hotar worship Agni Svishtakrit. Let Agni worship the favourite stations of the Asvins, of the he-goat the sacrifice; of Sarasvatî, of the ram the sacrifice; of Indra, of the bull the sacrifice; there, etc., to 'butter' as in 46.…

verses.sanskrit:
दे॒वं ब॒र्हिः सर॑स्वती सुदे॒वमिन्द्रे॑ अ॒श्विना॑ ।
तेजो॒ न चक्षु॑र॒क्ष्यो॒र्ब॒र्हिषा॑ दधुरिन्द्रि॒यं व॑सु॒वने॑ वसु॒धेय॑स्य व्यन्तु॒ यज॑
verses.translation: The Grass divine, for the right Gods, Sarasvatî, the Asvins Twain, Give Indra splendour, with the Grass, sight of his eyes and mighty strength! For gain of wealth let them enjoy. Thou, Hotar, offer sacrifice.
verses.hindi: वेदवाणी को हम अपने जीवनो की उत्तमता के लिए आराधित करते दे। हैवीं नाव॑श्स्वरित्रामनांगसमस्त्र॑वन्तीमा रुहेमा स्वस्तये ।। ६॥ ९. गतमन्त्र का ऋषि अदिति=अदीना देवमाता कौ उपासना करके / वामदेव ' बनता है ओर वामदेव बनने के कारण ही ' गयस्फान' होता है-“गयाः प्राणाः तान् प्रातिः पूरयति"
verses.transliteration: devaṃ barhiḥ sarasvatī sudevamindre aśvinā | tejo na cakṣurakṣyorbarhiṣā dadhurindriyaṃ vasuvane vasudheyasya vyantu yaja
verses.wordMeaning: The Grass divine, for the right Gods, Sarasvatî, the Asvins Twain, Give Indra splendour, with the Grass, sight of his eyes and mighty strength! For gain of wealth let them enjoy. Thou, Hotar, offer sacrifice.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Grass divine, for the right Gods, Sarasvatî, the Asvins Twain, Give Indra splendour, with the Grass, sight of his eyes and mighty strength! For gain of wealth let them enjoy. Thou, Hotar, offer sacrifice.

verses.sanskrit:
दे॒वीर्द्वारो॑ अ॒श्विना॑ भि॒षजेन्द्रे॒ सर॑स्वती ।
प्रा॒णं न वी॒र्यं॒ न॒सि द्वारो॑ दधुरिन्द्रि॒यं व॑सु॒वने॑ वसु॒धेय॑स्य व्यन्तु॒ यज॑
verses.translation: The Doors, the Doors divine, the Two Asvins, Leeches, Sarasvatî— May they give breath to Indra in his nostrils, and heroic strength. For gain of wealth, etc., as in verse 48.
verses.hindi: १. दिव्य गुणोवाले मुख आदि द्वार २. महनीय संकेत देनैवाली दिशाँ ३. निर्माण का कर्त्ता ब्रह्मदेव ४. देवगुरु बृहस्पति ५. ऊ्ध्वदिक्् का आधिपत्य प्राप्त करने कौ इच्छा ६. ओर तुरीयावस्था (पूर्ण एकाग्रता) को प्राप्त करानैवाली ज्ञानरश्मरयाँं हममे इन्द्रियों की शक्ति को तथा उत्कृष्ट जीवन को धारण करे।
verses.transliteration: devīrdvāro aśvinā bhiṣajendre sarasvatī | prāṇaṃ na vīryaṃ nasi dvāro dadhurindriyaṃ vasuvane vasudheyasya vyantu yaja
verses.wordMeaning: The Doors, the Doors divine, the Two Asvins, Leeches, Sarasvatî— May they give breath to Indra in his nostrils, and heroic strength. For gain of wealth, etc., as in verse 48.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Doors, the Doors divine, the Two Asvins, Leeches, Sarasvatî— May they give breath to Indra in his nostrils, and heroic strength. For gain of wealth, etc., as in verse 48.

verses.sanskrit:
दे॒वी उ॒षासा॑व॒श्विना॑ सु॒त्रामेन्द्रे॒ सर॑स्वती ।
बलं॒ न वाच॑मा॒स्य॒ उ॒षाभ्यां॑ दधुरिन्द्रि॒यं व॑सु॒वने॑ वसु॒धेय॑स्य व्यन्तु॒ यज॑
verses.translation: May Dawn and Night, the Goddesses, both Asvins, and Sarasvatî Lay, with both Dawns, strength, voice within Indra the Good Deliverer's mouth. For gain of wealth, etc.
verses.hindi: १. प्राणापान जो हैव्यन्देव की ओर ले-जानेवाले है तथा होतारासदा दानपूर्वक अदन करनेवाले है, सब इन्द्रियों को शक्ति देते हए अपना कार्य करने मे लगे रहते है। २. जीवात्मा के सदा के साथी मन व बुद्धि ३. लोकहित कौ प्रबल भावना ४. जीवन की गाडी को उत्तमता से वहन करनेवाली ज्ञानरशिमर्यँ हमें सशक्त व सुन्दर
verses.transliteration: devī uṣāsāvaśvinā sutrāmendre sarasvatī | balaṃ na vācamāsya uṣābhyāṃ dadhurindriyaṃ vasuvane vasudheyasya vyantu yaja
verses.wordMeaning: May Dawn and Night, the Goddesses, both Asvins, and Sarasvatî Lay, with both Dawns, strength, voice within Indra the Good Deliverer's mouth. For gain of wealth, etc.
verses.commentary: Sense: May Dawn and Night, the Goddesses, both Asvins, and Sarasvatî Lay, with both Dawns, strength, voice within Indra the Good Deliverer's mouth. For gain of wealth, etc.

verses.sanskrit:
दे॒वी जोष्ट्री॒ सर॑स्वत्य॒श्विनेन्द्र॑मवर्धयन् ।
श्रोत्रं॒ न कर्ण॑यो॒र्यशो॒ जोष्ट्री॑भ्यां दधुरिन्द्रि॒यं व॑सु॒वने॑ वसु॒धेय॑स्य व्यन्तु॒ यज॑
verses.translation: Both nursing Goddesses, the Pair of Asvins, and Sarasvatî Have with both nurses given strength to Indra, fame, and power to hear. For gain of wealth, etc.
verses.hindi: १. श्रद्धा, लान व पवित्र वाणी २. मितभाषी पुरुष ३. विशेषरूप से चमकने कौ प्रबल कामना तथा ४. ज्ञानदुग्ध को पिलानेवाली ज्ञानरश्मर्यो हमारे जीवन को उत्कृष्ट १. हममे इन्दरियम्-इन्द्रियों की शक्ति को तथा वयः=उत्कृष्ट जीवन को दश्ुः=धारण कररे। कौन? २. पहले तो त्वष्टा =( त्वष्टा तूर्णमश्नुते , त्विषतेर्वा स्याद् दीप्तिकर्मणः, त्वक्षतेर्वा
verses.transliteration: devī joṣṭrī sarasvatyaśvinendramavardhayan | śrotraṃ na karṇayoryaśo joṣṭrībhyāṃ dadhurindriyaṃ vasuvane vasudheyasya vyantu yaja
verses.wordMeaning: Both nursing Goddesses, the Pair of Asvins, and Sarasvatî Have with both nurses given strength to Indra, fame, and power to hear. For gain of wealth, etc.
verses.commentary: Sense: Both nursing Goddesses, the Pair of Asvins, and Sarasvatî Have with both nurses given strength to Indra, fame, and power to hear. For gain of wealth, etc.

verses.sanskrit:
दे॒वी ऊ॒र्जाहु॑ती॒ दुघे॑ सु॒दुघेन्द्रे॒ सर॑स्वत्य॒श्विना॑ भि॒षजा॑ऽवतः ।
शु॒क्रं न ज्योति॒ स्तन॑यो॒राहु॑ती धत्त इन्द्रि॒यं व॑सु॒वने॑ वसु॒धेय॑स्य व्यन्तु॒ यज॑
verses.translation: Bringers of strengthening sacrifice, both Goddesses, well-yielding cows, Sarasvatî, both Asvins, the Physicians, these are Indra's guards. Forth from their breasts by sacrifice they give him brilliant light and power. For gain of wealth, etc.
verses.hindi: क्रियाशीलता से दीप्त व महापुरुष २. बल व प्रकाश के तत्त्व ३. ज्ञान व कर्म दोनों के अपनाने की प्रबल कामना तथा ४. सुखो का सिज्चक जान हमें सशक्त १. वनस्पतिः = वानस्पतिक भोजन जौ नः शमिता=हमारे मन को शान्त करनेवाला है, अर्थात् जिस वानस्पतिक भोजन के परिणामरूप हमारे जीवन में क्रोध आदि भावनाओं का
verses.transliteration: devī ūrjāhutī dughe sudughendre sarasvatyaśvinā bhiṣajā'vataḥ | śukraṃ na jyoti stanayorāhutī dhatta indriyaṃ vasuvane vasudheyasya vyantu yaja
verses.wordMeaning: Bringers of strengthening sacrifice, both Goddesses, well-yielding cows, Sarasvatî, both Asvins, the Physicians, these are Indra's guards. Forth from their breasts by sacrifice they give him brilliant light and power. For gain of wealth, etc.
verses.commentary: Sense: Bringers of strengthening sacrifice, both Goddesses, well-yielding cows, Sarasvatî, both Asvins, the Physicians, these are Indra's guards. Forth from their breasts by sacrifice they give him brilliant light and power. For gain of wealth, etc.

verses.sanskrit:
दे॒वा दे॒वानां॑ भि॒षजा॒ होता॑रा॒विन्द्र॑म॒श्विना॑ ।
व॒ष॒ट्का॒रै॒: सर॑स्वती॒ त्विषिं॒ न हृद॑ये म॒तिᳪ होतृ॑भ्यां दधुरिन्द्रि॒यं व॑सु॒वने॑ वसु॒धेय॑स्य व्यन्तु॒ यज॑
verses.translation: Both Gods, the Hotars of the Gods, the Asvins the Physicians and Sarasvatî with Vashat-calls, with the two Hotars have bestowed on Indra brilliant light and power, and planted wisdom in his heart. For gain of wealth , etc.
verses.hindi: इन्द्रियों की शक्ति के लिए तथा उत्कृष्ट जीवन के लिए आवश्यक है कि हम १. शान्ति देनेवाले वानस्पतिक भोजन का प्रयोग करे। २. तिर्माणात्मक कार्यो में लगने के द्वारा एेश्वर्यवृद्धि करनेवाले हों। ३. हममे शिखर तक पर्हंचने की प्रबल कामना हो। ४. इन्द्रियों को वश में करे, प्राकृतिक भोगों व धनों को जपने लिए "बन्ध्या गौ' के समान
verses.transliteration: devā devānāṃ bhiṣajā hotārāvindramaśvinā | vaṣaṭkārai: sarasvatī tviṣiṃ na hṛdaye mati hotṛbhyāṃ dadhurindriyaṃ vasuvane vasudheyasya vyantu yaja
verses.wordMeaning: Both Gods, the Hotars of the Gods, the Asvins the Physicians and Sarasvatî with Vashat-calls, with the two Hotars have bestowed on Indra brilliant light and power, and planted wisdom in his heart. For gain of wealth , etc.
verses.commentary: Sense: Both Gods, the Hotars of the Gods, the Asvins the Physicians and Sarasvatî with Vashat-calls, with the two Hotars have bestowed on Indra brilliant light and power, and planted wisdom in his heart. For gain of wealth , etc.

verses.sanskrit:
दे॒वीस्ति॒स्रस्ति॒स्रो दे॒वीर॒श्विनेडा॒ सर॑स्वती ।
शूषं॒ न मध्ये॒ नाभ्या॒मिन्द्रा॑य दधुरिन्द्रि॒यं व॑सु॒वने॑ वसु॒धेय॑स्य व्यन्तु॒ यज॑
verses.translation: Goddesses three, three Goddesses—Asvins, Idâ, Sarasvatî In Indra's midmost navel have laid store of energy and power. For gain of wealth, etc.
verses.hindi: मरुतदेव वे हैँ जो हेमन्तऋतु कौ भांति सब शक्तियों के उपचयवाले होते है, जिनके कर्म्ञानोपासना में प्रवृत्त नवद्वार प्रशंसनीय होते है ओर जिनका अङ्क -प्रत्यङ्ग बल से सशक्त बनता है। यै इन्द्र म "बल, हवि व वयस्-उत्कृष्ट जीवन ' को धारण करते े। शोशिरेण॑ऽ ऋतुना देवास्त्र॑यस्तिच्छो,ऽमृतां स्तुताः।
verses.transliteration: devīstisrastisro devīraśvineḍā sarasvatī | śūṣaṃ na madhye nābhyāmindrāya dadhurindriyaṃ vasuvane vasudheyasya vyantu yaja
verses.wordMeaning: Goddesses three, three Goddesses—Asvins, Idâ, Sarasvatî In Indra's midmost navel have laid store of energy and power. For gain of wealth, etc.
verses.commentary: Sense: Goddesses three, three Goddesses—Asvins, Idâ, Sarasvatî In Indra's midmost navel have laid store of energy and power. For gain of wealth, etc.

verses.sanskrit:
दे॒व इन्द्रो॒ नरा॒शᳪस॑स्त्रिवरू॒थः सर॑स्वत्य॒श्विभ्या॑मीयते॒ रथ॑: ।
रेतो॒ न रू॒पम॒मृतं॑ ज॒नित्र॒मिन्द्रा॑य॒ त्वष्टा॒ दध॑दिन्द्रि॒याणि॑ वसु॒वने॑ वसु॒धेय॑स्य व्यन्तु॒ यज॑
verses.translation: God Narâsamsa, Indra thrice-protecting, whose car moves by Sarasvatî and Asvins May Tvashtar lay seed, deathless form in Indra, a fitting place of birth and mighty powers. For gain of wealth, etc.
verses.hindi: होता शरीर का रक्षक होता है, सरस्वती को अपनाता है, वासनाओं से अपना रक्षक तथा उत्तमताओं में स्पर्धावाला होता है। माधुर्यमय मार्गं से चलना ही इसके लिए ओषध हो जाता है। प्राणापान इसे वीर्यवान् बनाते हैँ। बेर, इन्द्रयव व भुने चावल व जौ ही इसके लिए उत्तमौषध होते है। यह दूध, घृत आदि का सेवन करता हे, परन्तु खाने से
verses.transliteration: deva indro narāśasastrivarūthaḥ sarasvatyaśvibhyāmīyate ratha: | reto na rūpamamṛtaṃ janitramindrāya tvaṣṭā dadhadindriyāṇi vasuvane vasudheyasya vyantu yaja
verses.wordMeaning: God Narâsamsa, Indra thrice-protecting, whose car moves by Sarasvatî and Asvins May Tvashtar lay seed, deathless form in Indra, a fitting place of birth and mighty powers. For gain of wealth, etc.
verses.commentary: Sense: God Narâsamsa, Indra thrice-protecting, whose car moves by Sarasvatî and Asvins May Tvashtar lay seed, deathless form in Indra, a fitting place of birth and mighty powers. For gain of wealth, etc.

verses.sanskrit:
दे॒वो दे॒वैर्वन॒स्पति॒र्हिर॑ण्यपर्णो अ॒श्विभ्या॒ᳪ सर॑स्वत्या सुपिप्प॒ल इन्द्रा॑य पच्यते॒ मधु॑ ।
ओजो॒ न जू॒तिरृ॑ष॒भो न भामं॒ वन॒स्पति॑र्नो॒ दध॑दिन्द्रि॒याणि॑ वसु॒वने॑ वसु॒धेय॑स्य व्यन्तु॒ यज॑
verses.translation: God with the Gods, Vanaspatî of golden leaves and goodly fruit Ripens till Indra finds it sweet, with Asvins and Sarasvatî.
verses.hindi: आत्मशक्ति के विकास के लिए हम ऋषभक ओषधि का यज्ञ करे। हविरूप मे उसका ग्रहण करे। उसका मुख से भी प्रयोग करे। यह ध्यान रक्खें कि वह पडी-पडी विकृत -रसवाली व रोगकृमियों से आक्रान्त न हो जाए। इसके प्रयोग से हमारा शरीर सर्वाग वनस्पतेः प्रिया पाथांसि यत्रं देवानांमाज्यपानो प्रिया धामानि यत्राग्नर्होतुंः प्रिया
verses.transliteration: devo devairvanaspatirhiraṇyaparṇo aśvibhyā sarasvatyā supippala indrāya pacyate madhu | ojo na jūtirṛṣabho na bhāmaṃ vanaspatirno dadhadindriyāṇi vasuvane vasudheyasya vyantu yaja
verses.wordMeaning: God with the Gods, Vanaspatî of golden leaves and goodly fruit Ripens till Indra finds it sweet, with Asvins and Sarasvatî.
verses.commentary: Sense: God with the Gods, Vanaspatî of golden leaves and goodly fruit Ripens till Indra finds it sweet, with Asvins and Sarasvatî.

verses.sanskrit:
दे॒वं ब॒र्हिर्वारि॑तीनामध्व॒रे स्ती॒र्णम॒श्विभ्या॒मूर्ण॑म्रदा॒: सर॑स्वत्या स्यो॒नमि॑न्द्र ते॒ सद॑: ।
ई॒शायै॑ म॒न्युᳪ राजा॑नं ब॒र्हिषा॑ दधुरिन्द्रि॒यं व॑सु॒वने॑ वसु॒धेय॑स्य व्यन्तु॒ यज॑
verses.translation: Strewn, soft as wool, in sacrifice, with Asvins and Sarasvatî, The sacred robe of water-plants be, Indra, a fair seat for thee! Together with the sacred grass limy they, for sovranty, bestow King Passion and great power on thee. For gain of wealth, etc.
verses.hindi: यज्ञाग्नि स्विष्टकृत् हे। यज्ञ को अपनाकर हम सव तेजौ को अपना अपनी वास्तविक महिमा को प्राप्त करे। अहिसा को मूलधर्म समञ्घे। देवं बर्हिः सर॑स्वती सुदे वमिन्द्रंऽअज्विनां। १. सरस्वती ज्ञान कौ अधिदेवता देवम्-दिव्य गुणौवाले बर्हिः=वासनाशून्य हदय को
verses.transliteration: devaṃ barhirvāritīnāmadhvare stīrṇamaśvibhyāmūrṇamradā: sarasvatyā syonamindra te sada: | īśāyai manyu rājānaṃ barhiṣā dadhurindriyaṃ vasuvane vasudheyasya vyantu yaja
verses.wordMeaning: Strewn, soft as wool, in sacrifice, with Asvins and Sarasvatî, The sacred robe of water-plants be, Indra, a fair seat for thee! Together with the sacred grass limy they, for sovranty, bestow King Passion and great power on thee. For gain of wealth, etc.
verses.commentary: Sense: Strewn, soft as wool, in sacrifice, with Asvins and Sarasvatî, The sacred robe of water-plants be, Indra, a fair seat for thee! Together with the sacred grass limy they, for sovranty, bestow King Passion and great power on thee. For gain of wealth, etc.

verses.sanskrit: दे॒वो अ॒ग्निः स्वि॑ष्ट॒कृद्दे॒वान्य॑क्षद्यथाय॒थᳪ होता॑रा॒विन्द्र॑म॒श्विना॑ वा॒चा वाच॒ᳪ सर॑स्वतीम॒ग्निᳪ सोम॑ᳪ स्विष्ट॒कृत् स्वि॑ष्ट॒ इन्द्र॑: सु॒त्रामा॑ सवि॒ता वरु॑णो भि॒षगि॒ष्टो दे॒वो वन॒स्पति॒: स्वि॒ष्टा दे॒वा आ॑ज्य॒पाः स्वि॑ष्टो अ॒ग्निर॒ग्निना॒ होता॑ हो॒त्रे स्वि॑ष्ट॒कृद्यशो॒ न दध॑दिन्द्रि॒यमूर्ज॒मप॑चितिᳪ स्व॒धां व॑सु॒वने॑ वसु॒धेय॑स्य व्यन्तु॒ यज॑
verses.translation: Let the God Agni Svishtakrit worship the Gods as is meet and right for each, the two Hotars, Indra, the Asvins, Vâk with speech, Sarasvatî, Agni, Soma. Svishtakrit has been well worshipped, Indra Good Deliverer, Savitar, Varuna the Physician have been worshipped. The God Vanaspatî, the Gods who drink clarified butter have been well worshipped, Agni by Agni. Let the Hotar Svishtakrit give the Hotar fame, great power, energy, honour, Ancestral libation.
verses.hindi: द्यावापृथिवी दिव्य अत्नं से हमारा पूरण करते हेै। ज्ञान दोषों को दूर् करके हमारा उत्तम पूरण करता है। प्राणापान हमरे वैद्य है ओर रोगों से हमारा रक्षण करते हे। ठेसा होने पर माता के स्तनो में शक्ति व ज्ञानसम्पत्न दूध होता है। ये द्यावापृथिवी हमारी सब इन्द्रियों को सशक्त बनाते है। हम वीर्य की रक्षा करे ओर उसके लिए यनज्ञशील बन
verses.transliteration: devo agniḥ sviṣṭakṛddevānyakṣadyathāyatha hotārāvindramaśvinā vācā vāca sarasvatīmagni soma sviṣṭakṛt sviṣṭa indra: sutrāmā savitā varuṇo bhiṣagiṣṭo devo vanaspati: sviṣṭā devā ājyapāḥ sviṣṭo agniragninā hotā hotre sviṣṭakṛdyaśo na dadhadindriyamūrjamapaciti svadhāṃ vasuvane vasudheyasya vyantu yaja
verses.wordMeaning: Let the God Agni Svishtakrit worship the Gods as is meet and right for each, the two Hotars, Indra, the Asvins, Vâk with speech, Sarasvatî, Agni, Soma. Svishtakrit has been well worshipped, Indra Good Deliverer, Savitar, Varuna the Physician have been worshipped.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Let the God Agni Svishtakrit worship the Gods as is meet and right for each, the two Hotars, Indra, the Asvins, Vâk with speech, Sarasvatî, Agni, Soma. Svishtakrit has been well worshipped, Indra Good Deliverer, Savitar, Varuna the Physician have been worshipped.…

verses.sanskrit: अ॒ग्निम॒द्य होता॑रमवृणीता॒यं यज॑मान॒: पच॒न् पक्ती॒: पच॑न् पुरो॒डाशा॑न् ब॒ध्नन्न॒श्विभ्यां॒ छाग॒ᳪ सर॑स्वत्यै मे॒षमिन्द्रा॑य ऋष॒भᳪ सु॒न्वन्न॒श्विभ्या॒ᳪ सर॑स्वत्या॒ इन्द्रा॑य सु॒त्राम्णे॑ सुरासो॒मान्
verses.translation: To-day this Sacrificer cooking viands, cooking sacrificial rice-cakes, binding a goat for the Asvins, a ram for Sarasvatî, a hull for Indra, pressing Surâ and Soma juices for the Asvins, Sarasvatî, and Indra the Good Deliverer, has chosen Agni as Hotar.
verses.hindi: द्यावापृथिवी दिव्य अत्नं से हमारा पूरण करते हेै। ज्ञान दोषों को दूर् करके हमारा उत्तम पूरण करता है। प्राणापान हमरे वैद्य है ओर रोगों से हमारा रक्षण करते हे। ठेसा होने पर माता के स्तनो में शक्ति व ज्ञानसम्पत्न दूध होता है। ये द्यावापृथिवी हमारी सब इन्द्रियों को सशक्त बनाते है। हम वीर्य की रक्षा करे ओर उसके लिए यनज्ञशील बन
verses.transliteration: agnimadya hotāramavṛṇītāyaṃ yajamāna: pacan paktī: pacan puroḍāśān badhnannaśvibhyāṃ chāga sarasvatyai meṣamindrāya ṛṣabha sunvannaśvibhyā sarasvatyā indrāya sutrāmṇe surāsomān
verses.wordMeaning: To-day this Sacrificer cooking viands, cooking sacrificial rice-cakes, binding a goat for the Asvins, a ram for Sarasvatî, a hull for Indra, pressing Surâ and Soma juices for the Asvins, Sarasvatî, and Indra the Good Deliverer, has chosen Agni as Hotar.
verses.commentary: Sense: To-day this Sacrificer cooking viands, cooking sacrificial rice-cakes, binding a goat for the Asvins, a ram for Sarasvatî, a hull for Indra, pressing Surâ and Soma juices for the Asvins, Sarasvatî, and Indra the Good Deliverer, has chosen Agni as Hotar.

verses.sanskrit: सू॒प॒स्था अ॒द्य दे॒वो वन॒स्पति॑रभवद॒श्विभ्यां॒ छागे॑न॒ सर॑स्वत्यै मे॒षेणेन्द्रा॑य ऋष॒भेणाक्षँ॒स्तान् मे॑द॒स्तः प्रति॑ पच॒तागृ॑भीष॒तावी॑वृधन्त पुरो॒डाशै॒रपु॑र॒श्विना॒ सर॑स्व॒तीन्द्र॑: सु॒त्रामा॑ सुरासो॒मान्
verses.translation: To-day the divine Vanaspatî has done good service to the Asvins with a goat, to Sarasvatî with a ram, to Indra with a bull. They have eaten these from the marrow onwards, they have accepted the cooked viands, they have waxed strong with the rice-cakes. The Agnis, Sarasvatî, and Indra have drunk the Surâ and Soma draughts.
verses.hindi: द्यावापृथिवी दिव्य अत्नं से हमारा पूरण करते हेै। ज्ञान दोषों को दूर् करके हमारा उत्तम पूरण करता है। प्राणापान हमरे वैद्य है ओर रोगों से हमारा रक्षण करते हे। ठेसा होने पर माता के स्तनो में शक्ति व ज्ञानसम्पत्न दूध होता है। ये द्यावापृथिवी हमारी सब इन्द्रियों को सशक्त बनाते है। हम वीर्य की रक्षा करे ओर उसके लिए यनज्ञशील बन
verses.transliteration: sūpasthā adya devo vanaspatirabhavadaśvibhyāṃ chāgena sarasvatyai meṣeṇendrāya ṛṣabheṇākṣa~stān medastaḥ prati pacatāgṛbhīṣatāvīvṛdhanta puroḍāśairapuraśvinā sarasvatīndra: sutrāmā surāsomān
verses.wordMeaning: To-day the divine Vanaspatî has done good service to the Asvins with a goat, to Sarasvatî with a ram, to Indra with a bull. They have eaten these from the marrow onwards, they have accepted the cooked viands, they have waxed strong with the rice-cakes. The Agnis, Sarasvatî,…
verses.commentary: Sense: To-day the divine Vanaspatî has done good service to the Asvins with a goat, to Sarasvatî with a ram, to Indra with a bull. They have eaten these from the marrow onwards, they have accepted the cooked viands, they have waxed strong with the rice-cakes. The Agnis, Sarasvatî,…

verses.sanskrit: त्वाम॒द्य ऋ॑ष आर्षेय ऋषीणां नपादवृणीता॒यं यज॑मानो ब॒हुभ्य॒ आ सङ्ग॑तेभ्य ए॒ष मे॑ दे॒वेषु॒ वसु॒ वार्याय॑क्ष्यत॒ इति॒ ता या दे॒वा दे॑व॒ दाना॒न्यदु॒स्तान्य॑स्मा॒ आ च॒ शास्वा च॑ गुरस्वेषि॒तश्च॑ होत॒रसि॑ भद्र॒वाच्या॑य॒ प्रेषि॑तो॒ मानु॑षः सूक्तवा॒काय॑ सू॒क्ता ब्रू॑हि
verses.translation: Thee, to-day, O Rishi, Rishi's son, descendant of Rishis, hath this Sacrificer chosen for many collected, saying: This (Agni) shall win by sacrifice for me choice-worthy treasures among the Gods. O God, what gifts the Gods have given, these do thou desire and approve. And thou art a commissioned Hotar, a human Hotar sent forward for benediction, for good speech, Speak thou good words.
verses.hindi: द्यावापृथिवी दिव्य अत्नं से हमारा पूरण करते हेै। ज्ञान दोषों को दूर् करके हमारा उत्तम पूरण करता है। प्राणापान हमरे वैद्य है ओर रोगों से हमारा रक्षण करते हे। ठेसा होने पर माता के स्तनो में शक्ति व ज्ञानसम्पत्न दूध होता है। ये द्यावापृथिवी हमारी सब इन्द्रियों को सशक्त बनाते है। हम वीर्य की रक्षा करे ओर उसके लिए यनज्ञशील बन
verses.transliteration: tvāmadya ṛṣa ārṣeya ṛṣīṇāṃ napādavṛṇītāyaṃ yajamāno bahubhya ā saṅgatebhya eṣa me deveṣu vasu vāryāyakṣyata iti tā yā devā deva dānānyadustānyasmā ā ca śāsvā ca gurasveṣitaśca hotarasi bhadravācyāya preṣito mānuṣaḥ sūktavākāya sūktā brūhi
verses.wordMeaning: Thee, to-day, O Rishi, Rishi's son, descendant of Rishis, hath this Sacrificer chosen for many collected, saying: This (Agni) shall win by sacrifice for me choice-worthy treasures among the Gods. O God, what gifts the Gods have given, these do thou desire and approve.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Thee, to-day, O Rishi, Rishi's son, descendant of Rishis, hath this Sacrificer chosen for many collected, saying: This (Agni) shall win by sacrifice for me choice-worthy treasures among the Gods. O God, what gifts the Gods have given, these do thou desire and approve.…

verses.sanskrit:
तेजो॑ऽसि शु॒क्रम॒मृत॑मायु॒ष्पा आयु॑र्मे पाहि ।
दे॒वस्य॑ त्वा सवि॒तुः प्र॑स॒वेऽश्विनो॑र्बा॒हुभ्यां॑ पू॒ष्णो हस्ता॑भ्या॒मा द॑दे
verses.translation: com The Texts of the White Yajurveda, tr. Ralph T.H. Griffith, [1899], BOOK THE TWENTY-SECOND. SPLENDOUR art thou, bright, deathless, life-protector. Protector of my life be thou. By impulse of God Savitar I take thee with arms of Asvins, with the hands of Pûshan.
verses.hindi: हमें “ तेजस्वी, वीर्यवान् व दीर्घजीवी ' बनना है। आयु को प्रभु की धरोहर समञ्ना है। आयु के रक्षण के लिए (क) प्रभु के आदेश के अनुसार प्रत्येक वस्तु का माप-तोलकर प्रयोग करना है। (ख) प्रयत्न से अर्थो का उपार्जन करना है ओर (ग) प्रयोग में मापक 'पोषण' को रखना है न कि "स्वाद व सौन्दर्य" को।
verses.transliteration: tejo'si śukramamṛtamāyuṣpā āyurme pāhi | devasya tvā savituḥ prasave'śvinorbāhubhyāṃ pūṣṇo hastābhyāmā dade
verses.wordMeaning: com The Texts of the White Yajurveda, tr. Ralph T.H. Griffith, [1899], BOOK THE TWENTY-SECOND. SPLENDOUR art thou, bright, deathless, life-protector. Protector of my life be thou. By impulse of God Savitar I take thee with arms of Asvins, with the hands of Pûshan.
verses.commentary: Sense: com The Texts of the White Yajurveda, tr. Ralph T.H. Griffith, [1899], BOOK THE TWENTY-SECOND. SPLENDOUR art thou, bright, deathless, life-protector. Protector of my life be thou. By impulse of God Savitar I take thee with arms of Asvins, with the hands of Pûshan.

verses.sanskrit:
इ॒माम॑गृभ्णन् रश॒नामृ॒तस्य॒ पूर्व॒ आयु॑षि वि॒दथे॑षु क॒व्या ।
सा नो॑ अ॒स्मिन्त्सु॒त आ ब॑भूव ऋ॒तस्य॒ साम॑न्त्स॒रमा॒रप॑न्ती
verses.translation: This girdle, which in their religious meetings sages assumed in earlier time of worship, Is present with us here at this libation, in the Law's hymn, proclaiming rich abundance.
verses.hindi: हम जीवन के प्रारम्भ मेही ऋत कौ रशना का धारण करें। इसे इस जीवनयन्न मे धारण किये रक्ें। यह मेखला हमें सदा कर््तव्यमार्ग का उपदेश देनेवाल हो। १. गतमन्त्र में कहा था कि यह ऋत कौ रशना हमे इस उत्पन्न जगत् मे सदा व्याप्त किये रक्खे, अर्थात् हम इस ऋत की रशना को कभी उतार न दे। यह ऋत की रशना को
verses.transliteration: imāmagṛbhṇan raśanāmṛtasya pūrva āyuṣi vidatheṣu kavyā | sā no asmintsuta ā babhūva ṛtasya sāmantsaramārapantī
verses.wordMeaning: This girdle, which in their religious meetings sages assumed in earlier time of worship, Is present with us here at this libation, in the Law's hymn, proclaiming rich abundance.
verses.commentary: Sense: This girdle, which in their religious meetings sages assumed in earlier time of worship, Is present with us here at this libation, in the Law's hymn, proclaiming rich abundance.

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒भि॒धा अ॑सि॒ भुव॑नमसि य॒न्ताऽसि॑ ध॒र्ता ।
स त्वम॒ग्निं वै॑श्वान॒रᳪ सप्र॑थसं गच्छ॒ स्वाहा॑कृतः
verses.translation: Famous art thou, thou art the world, controller and upholder thou. Go, consecrate by Svâhâ to Agni Vaisvânara widely-famed.
verses.hindi: हम ऋत की रशना को बोँधकर अपने जीवन को नियन्त्रित करते हए सभी का धारण करनेवाले बनें ओर स्वार्थत्याग से जीवन को सुन्दर बनाते हए प्रातः-सायं उस सर्वव्यापक, सर्वहितकारी प्रभु का स्मरण करे। राध्यासम् । तं ब॑धान देवेभ्यं: प्रजापतये तेन॑ राध्नुहि॥। ४॥
verses.transliteration: abhidhā asi bhuvanamasi yantā'si dhartā | sa tvamagniṃ vaiśvānara saprathasaṃ gaccha svāhākṛtaḥ
verses.wordMeaning: Famous art thou, thou art the world, controller and upholder thou. Go, consecrate by Svâhâ to Agni Vaisvânara widely-famed.
verses.commentary: Sense: Famous art thou, thou art the world, controller and upholder thou. Go, consecrate by Svâhâ to Agni Vaisvânara widely-famed.

verses.sanskrit:
स्व॒गा त्वा॑ दे॒वेभ्य॑: प्र॒जाप॑तये॒ ब्रह्म॒न्नश्वं॑ भ॒न्त्स्यामि॑ दे॒वेभ्य॑: प्र॒जाप॑तये॒ तेन॑ राध्यासम् ।
तं ब॑धान दे॒वेभ्य॑: प्र॒जाप॑तये॒ तेन॑ राध्नुहि
verses.translation: For Gods and for Prajâpati I fit thee. For Gods and for Prajâpati, O Brahman, Will I tie up the horse. Thence may I prosper! Binding him for Prajâpati and Gods be thou successful.
verses.hindi: प्रभु-स्मरण करनेवाला व्यक्ति दिव्य गुणों को प्राप्त करता है ओर प्रजा का प्रोक्षामि विश्वेभ्यस्त्वा देवेभ्यो जुष्टं प्रोक्षामि सर्वेभ्यस्त्वा देवेभ्यो जुष्टं प्रोक्षामि । १. प्रजापतये=प्रजा का पति (रक्षक) बनने के लिए जुष्टम्प्रीतिपूर्वक सेवन किये गये त्वाततुञ्े गतमन्त्र के अश्व, अर्थात् सर्वव्यापक परमात्मा को प्रोक्षामि अपने
verses.transliteration: svagā tvā devebhya: prajāpataye brahmannaśvaṃ bhantsyāmi devebhya: prajāpataye tena rādhyāsam | taṃ badhāna devebhya: prajāpataye tena rādhnuhi
verses.wordMeaning: For Gods and for Prajâpati I fit thee. For Gods and for Prajâpati, O Brahman, Will I tie up the horse. Thence may I prosper! Binding him for Prajâpati and Gods be thou successful.
verses.commentary: Sense: For Gods and for Prajâpati I fit thee. For Gods and for Prajâpati, O Brahman, Will I tie up the horse. Thence may I prosper! Binding him for Prajâpati and Gods be thou successful.

verses.sanskrit:
प्र॒जाप॑तये त्वा॒ जुष्टं॒ प्रोक्षा॑मीन्द्रा॒ग्निभ्यां॑ त्वा॒ जुष्टं॒ प्रोक्षा॑मि वा॒यवे॑ त्वा॒ जुष्टं॒ प्रोक्षा॑मि॒
विश्वे॑भ्यस्त्वा दे॒वेभ्यो॒ जुष्टं॒ प्रोक्षा॑मि॒ सर्वे॑भ्यस्त्वा दे॒वेभ्यो॒ जुष्टं॒ प्रोक्षा॑मि ।
यो अर्व॑न्तं॒ जिघा॑ᳪसति॒ तम॒भ्य॒मीति॒ वरु॑णः| प॒रो मर्त॑: प॒रः श्वा
verses.translation: Thee welcome to Prajâpati I sprinkle. I sprinkle thee welcome to Indra-Agni. I sprinkle thee acceptable to Vâyu. Thee welcome to the All-Gods I besprinkle. Thee welcome to all Deities I sprinkle. With fury Varuna attacks the man who fain would slay the steed. Avaunt the man! Avaunt the dog!
verses.hindi: हदयदेश में प्रभु के स्मरण से मनुष्य प्रजापति बनता हे, बल व प्रकाश को प्राप्त करता है, गतिशीलता से बुराइयों को दूर् करता हे, चक्षु आदि इन्द्रियों को स्वस्थ रख पाता है, सूर्यादि देव व विद्धान् इसके अनुकूल होते हे। प्रभु को भूलनेवाला पीडित होता है, अन्ततः निरादृत होता है ओर अधोगति को प्राप्त करता हे।
verses.transliteration: prajāpataye tvā juṣṭaṃ prokṣāmīndrāgnibhyāṃ tvā juṣṭaṃ prokṣāmi vāyave tvā juṣṭaṃ prokṣāmi viśvebhyastvā devebhyo juṣṭaṃ prokṣāmi sarvebhyastvā devebhyo juṣṭaṃ prokṣāmi | yo arvantaṃ jighāsati tamabhyamīti varuṇaḥ| paro marta: paraḥ śvā
verses.wordMeaning: Thee welcome to Prajâpati I sprinkle. I sprinkle thee welcome to Indra-Agni. I sprinkle thee acceptable to Vâyu. Thee welcome to the All-Gods I besprinkle. Thee welcome to all Deities I sprinkle. With fury Varuna attacks the man who fain would slay the steed.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Thee welcome to Prajâpati I sprinkle. I sprinkle thee welcome to Indra-Agni. I sprinkle thee acceptable to Vâyu. Thee welcome to the All-Gods I besprinkle. Thee welcome to all Deities I sprinkle. With fury Varuna attacks the man who fain would slay the steed.…

verses.sanskrit: अ॒ग्नये॒ स्वाहा॒ सोमा॑य॒ स्वाहा॒  ऽपां मोदा॑य॒ स्वाहा॑ सवि॒त्रे स्वाहा॑ वा॒यवे॒ स्वाहा॒  विष्ण॑वे॒ स्वाहेन्द्रा॑य॒ स्वाहा॒ बृह॒स्पत॑ये॒ स्वाहा॑ मि॒त्राय॒ स्वाहा॒ वरु॑णाय॒ स्वाहा॑
verses.translation: To Agni Hail! To Soma Hail! Hail to the Waters’ Joy! Hail to Savitar! Hail to Vâyu! Hail to Vishnu! Hail to Indra! Hail to Brihaspati! Hail to Mitra! Hail to Varuna!
verses.hindi: जवब मनुष्य स्वार्थं से ऊपर उठता है ओर प्रभु के प्रति अर्पण कौ वृत्तिवाला बनता है तव वह अपने अन्दर “अग्नि, सोम, अपां मोद, सविता, वायु, विष्णु, इन्द्र, वृहस्पति, मित्र ओर वरुण" इन दस तत्त्वों को धारण करनेवाला बनता हे। यही दशक उसका धर्म हो जाता है। वह इस दशलक्षण धर्म को धारण करता हे।
verses.transliteration: agnaye svāhā somāya svāhā 'pāṃ modāya svāhā savitre svāhā vāyave svāhā viṣṇave svāhendrāya svāhā bṛhaspataye svāhā mitrāya svāhā varuṇāya svāhā
verses.wordMeaning: To Agni Hail! To Soma Hail! Hail to the Waters’ Joy! Hail to Savitar! Hail to Vâyu! Hail to Vishnu! Hail to Indra! Hail to Brihaspati! Hail to Mitra! Hail to Varuna!
verses.commentary: Sense: To Agni Hail! To Soma Hail! Hail to the Waters’ Joy! Hail to Savitar! Hail to Vâyu! Hail to Vishnu! Hail to Indra! Hail to Brihaspati! Hail to Mitra! Hail to Varuna!

verses.sanskrit: हि॒ङ्का॒राय॒ स्वाहा॒ हिङ्कृ॑ताय॒ स्वाहा॒ क्रन्द॑ते॒ स्वाहा॑ ऽवक्र॒न्दाय॒ स्वाहा॒ प्रोथ॑ते॒ स्वाहा॑ प्रप्रो॒थाय॒ स्वाहा॑ ग॒न्धाय॒ स्वाहा॑ घ्रा॒ताय॒ स्वाहा॒ निवि॑ष्टाय॒ स्वाहोप॑विष्टाय॒ स्वाहा॒ सन्दि॑ताय॒ स्वाहा॒ वल्ग॑ते॒ स्वाहा ऽऽसी॑नाय॒ स्वाहा॑ शया॑नाय॒ स्वाहा॒ स्वप॑ते॒ स्वाहा॒ जाग्र॑ते॒ स्वाहा॒ कूज॑ते॒ स्वाहा॒ प्रबु॑द्धाय॒ स्वाहा॑ वि॒जृम्भ॑माणाय॒ स्वाहा॒ विचृ॑ताय॒ स्वाहा॒ सᳪहा॑नाय॒ स्वाहोप॑स्थिताय॒ स्वाहाऽऽय॑नाय॒ स्वाहा॒ प्राय॑णाय॒ स्वाहा॑
verses.translation: Hail to the sound hiṅ! Hail to the uttered hiṅ! Hail to the neigh! Hail to the down-neigh! Hail to the snort! Hail to the roar! Hail to his smell! Hail to him smelt at! Hail to him seated! Hail to him seated down! Hail to him weary! Hail to him going! Hail to him sitting! Hail to him lying! Hail to him sleeping! Hail to him waking! Hail to him whinnying! Hail to him wakened! Hail to him yawning! Hail to him outstretched! Hail to him drawn together! Hail to him risen! Hail to his going! Hail to his good going! Hail!
verses.hindi: हमारे शरीरो में प्राण के ४९ भेद भिन्नभित्र कार्य करते है। उन्दी से अङ्क -प्रत्यद्ग के सब कार्य चलते है। प्राणों कौ क्रिया से हौ स्वास्थ्य व सुबुद्धि प्राप्त हती है, अतः विविध रूपों में उल्लिखित इन सब कार्यो को करते हए प्राणों के लिए हम तत्संवितुर्वरैण्यं भर्गो" देवस्य॑ धीमहि । धियो यो न॑ः प्रचोदयात् ॥९॥
verses.transliteration: hiṅkārāya svāhā hiṅkṛtāya svāhā krandate svāhā 'vakrandāya svāhā prothate svāhā praprothāya svāhā gandhāya svāhā ghrātāya svāhā niviṣṭāya svāhopaviṣṭāya svāhā sanditāya svāhā valgate svāhā ''sīnāya svāhā śayānāya svāhā svapate svāhā jāgrate svāhā kūjate svāhā prabuddhāya svāhā vijṛmbhamāṇāya svāhā vicṛtāya svāhā sahānāya svāhopasthitāya svāhā''yanāya svāhā prāyaṇāya svāhā
verses.wordMeaning: Hail to the sound hiṅ! Hail to the uttered hiṅ! Hail to the neigh! Hail to the down-neigh! Hail to the snort! Hail to the roar! Hail to his smell! Hail to him smelt at! Hail to him seated! Hail to him seated down! Hail to him weary! Hail to him going! Hail to him sit…
verses.commentary: Sense: Hail to the sound hiṅ! Hail to the uttered hiṅ! Hail to the neigh! Hail to the down-neigh! Hail to the snort! Hail to the roar! Hail to his smell! Hail to him smelt at! Hail to him seated! Hail to him seated down! Hail to him weary! Hail to him going! Hail to him sit…

verses.sanskrit: य॒ते स्वाहा॒ धाव॑ते॒ स्वाहो॑द्द्रा॒वाय॒ स्वाहोद्द्रु॑ताय॒ स्वाहा॑ शूका॒राय॒ स्वाहा॒ शूकृ॑ताय॒ स्वाहा॒ निष॑ण्णाय॒ स्वाहोत्थि॑ताय॒ स्वाहा॑ ज॒वाय॒ स्वाहा॒ बला॑य॒ स्वाहा॑ वि॒वर्त॑मानाय॒ स्वाहा॒ विवृ॑त्ताय॒ स्वाहा॑ विधून्वा॒नाय॒ स्वाहा॒ विधू॑ताय॒ स्वाहा॒ शुश्रू॑षमाणाय॒ स्वाहा॑ शृण्व॒ते स्वाहेक्ष॑माणाय॒ स्वाहे॑क्षि॒ताय॒ स्वाहा॒ वी॒क्षिताय॒ स्वाहा॑ निमे॒षाय॒ स्वाहा॒ यदत्ति॒ तस्मै॒ स्वाहा॒ यत् पिब॑ति॒ तस्मै॒ स्वाहा॒ यन्मूत्रं॑ क॒रोति॒ तस्मै॒ स्वाहा॑ कुर्व॒ते स्वाहा॑ कृ॒ताय॒ स्वाहा॑
verses.translation: Hail to him as he goes! Hail to him running! Hail to him running away! Hail to him when he has run away! Hail to the cry Shoo! Hail to him scared with Shoo! Hail to him seated! Hail to him risen! Hail to his speed! Hail to his strength! Hail to him rolling! Hail to him when he has rolled! Hail to him tossing about! Hail to him when he has tossed about! Hail to him listening! Hail to him hearing. Hail to him looking! Hail to him looked at! Hail to him closely looked at! Hail to his closing his eye! Hail to his food! Hail to his drink! Hail to his stale! Hail to him in action! Hail to what he has done!
verses.hindi: प्रभु 'हिरण्यपाणि, सविता- चेत्ता-देवता व पद' है। उस प्रभु को ही प्राप्त करने के लिए यत्नशील होना चाहिए। देवस्य चेत॑तो महीं प्र संवितुर्ह'वामहे । सु मतिःसत्यराधसम् ।।९९॥ १. देवस्य=सवब दिव्यगुणों के पुञ्ज, देनेवाले, चमकनेवाले व चमकानेवाले चेततः सर्वज्ञ
verses.transliteration: yate svāhā dhāvate svāhoddrāvāya svāhoddrutāya svāhā śūkārāya svāhā śūkṛtāya svāhā niṣaṇṇāya svāhotthitāya svāhā javāya svāhā balāya svāhā vivartamānāya svāhā vivṛttāya svāhā vidhūnvānāya svāhā vidhūtāya svāhā śuśrūṣamāṇāya svāhā śṛṇvate svāhekṣamāṇāya svāhekṣitāya svāhā vīkṣitāya svāhā nimeṣāya svāhā yadatti tasmai svāhā yat pibati tasmai svāhā yanmūtraṃ karoti tasmai svāhā kurvate svāhā kṛtāya svāhā
verses.wordMeaning: Hail to him as he goes! Hail to him running! Hail to him running away! Hail to him when he has run away! Hail to the cry Shoo! Hail to him scared with Shoo! Hail to him seated! Hail to him risen! Hail to his speed! Hail to his strength! Hail to him rolling! Hail to him when he h…
verses.commentary: Sense: Hail to him as he goes! Hail to him running! Hail to him running away! Hail to him when he has run away! Hail to the cry Shoo! Hail to him scared with Shoo! Hail to him seated! Hail to him risen! Hail to his speed! Hail to his strength! Hail to him rolling! Hail to him when he h…

verses.sanskrit: तत्स॑वि॒तुर्वरे॑ण्यं॒ भर्गो॑ दे॒वस्य॑ धीमहि । धियो॒ यो न॑: प्रचो॒दया॑त्
verses.translation: May we attain that excellent glory of Savitar the God: So may he stimulate our prayers.
verses.hindi: प्रभु देव हें, चेत्ता है। उनकी कल्याणी मति को प्राप्त करके हम महिमाशाली व सत्यरूप धन को प्राप्त करनेवाले बनते है। सुष्टुतिः्सुंमतीवृधो रातिःसं॑वितुरीमहे । प्र देवाय मती विदे ॥ १२॥ १. सुमतीवृधः =शोभन बुद्धि का वर्धन करनेवाले, सवितुः=सकल जगदुत्पादक,
verses.transliteration: tatsaviturvareṇyaṃ bhargo devasya dhīmahi | dhiyo yo na: pracodayāt
verses.wordMeaning: May we attain that excellent glory of Savitar the God: So may he stimulate our prayers.
verses.commentary: Sense: May we attain that excellent glory of Savitar the God: So may he stimulate our prayers.

verses.sanskrit: हिर॑ण्यपाणिमू॒तये॑ सवि॒तार॒मुप॑ ह्वये । स चेत्ता॑ दे॒वता॑ प॒दम्
verses.translation: For our protection I invoke the golden-handed Savitar: He knoweth, as a God, the place.
verses.hindi: उस सविता का स्तवन करते हुए हम उत्कृष्ट दिव्य गुणों को प्राप्त करे ओर बुद्धि का वर्धन करनेवाले हों। रातिः्सत्प॑तिं महे स॑वितारमुप॑ ह्ये । आसवं देववीतये।। ९३॥ १. रातिम्-सव आवश्यक पदार्थो को देनेवाले दाता को सत्पतिम् सज्जनो के रक्षक
verses.transliteration: hiraṇyapāṇimūtaye savitāramupa hvaye | sa cettā devatā padam
verses.wordMeaning: For our protection I invoke the golden-handed Savitar: He knoweth, as a God, the place.
verses.commentary: Sense: For our protection I invoke the golden-handed Savitar: He knoweth, as a God, the place.

verses.sanskrit: दे॒वस्य॒ चेत॑तो म॒हीं प्र स॑वि॒तुर्ह॑वामहे । सु॒म॒तिᳪ स॒त्यरा॑धसम्
verses.translation: We specially invoke the grace of Savitar, observant God, The great good-will that gives true boons.
verses.hindi: प्रभु ' राति-सत्पति, सविता व आसव' है। हम इस प्रभु की ही पूजा करे, प्रार्थना करें, जिससे हममे दिव्य गुणों का प्रादुर्भाव हो। इन दिव्य गुणों से हम भी समन्तात् देवस्य॑ सवितुर्मतिमासवं विश्वदेव्यम् । धिया भगै मनामहे ॥९४॥ १. सवितुः=सकल जगदुत्पादक , सर्वेश्वर्ययुक्त देवस्यत=दिव्य गुणों के पुञ्ज प्रभु को
verses.transliteration: devasya cetato mahīṃ pra saviturhavāmahe | sumati satyarādhasam
verses.wordMeaning: We specially invoke the grace of Savitar, observant God, The great good-will that gives true boons.
verses.commentary: Sense: We specially invoke the grace of Savitar, observant God, The great good-will that gives true boons.

verses.sanskrit: सु॒ष्टु॒तिᳪ सु॑मती॒वृधो॑ रा॒तिᳪ स॑वि॒तुरी॑महे । प्र दे॒वाय॑ मती॒विदे॑
verses.translation: We seek the eulogy and gift of Savitar who strengthens grace, Yea, of the God who knows our thoughts.
verses.hindi: मनुष्य स्तवन के द्वारा अपने हदय में प्रभु कौ भावना को जागारित करे। यह प्रभु-स्मरण विषयों के पीछे मरने से बचाता है ओर हदयों को प्रकाश से दीप्त करता है। प्रभु हव्य यक्िय पवित्र पदार्थो को प्राप्त कराके दिव्य गुणों से युक्तं करते हे। प्रज्ञापूर्वक कर्मो सरे प्रभु- प्राप्ति
verses.transliteration: suṣṭuti sumatīvṛdho rāti saviturīmahe | pra devāya matīvide
verses.wordMeaning: We seek the eulogy and gift of Savitar who strengthens grace, Yea, of the God who knows our thoughts.
verses.commentary: Sense: We seek the eulogy and gift of Savitar who strengthens grace, Yea, of the God who knows our thoughts.

verses.sanskrit: रा॒तिᳪ सत्प॑तिं म॒हे स॑वि॒तार॒मुप॑ ह्वये । आ॒स॒वं दे॒ववी॑तये
verses.translation: I invocate the heroes’ Lord, free-giving Savitar, and call The Cheerer to the feast of Gods.
verses.hindi: हम उस प्रभु को प्रज्ञापूर्वक कर्मो द्वारा प्राप्त करने का प्रयत्नत करे जो प्रभु हमें हव्य पदार्थ प्राप्त कराते हें, अमर्त्य बनाते है, हमारे भले की ही कामना करते हें, तप कौ अग्नि में हमें तपाते हैं तथा सात्विक अन्न के सेवन से हमारे हदयों मे निहित होते हेै। ऋषि :-विषूवरूपः। देवता-अग्निः। छन्दः-निचुद्गायत्री। स्वरः-षडजः॥।
verses.transliteration: rāti satpatiṃ mahe savitāramupa hvaye | āsavaṃ devavītaye
verses.wordMeaning: I invocate the heroes’ Lord, free-giving Savitar, and call The Cheerer to the feast of Gods.
verses.commentary: Sense: I invocate the heroes’ Lord, free-giving Savitar, and call The Cheerer to the feast of Gods.

verses.sanskrit: दे॒वस्य॑ सवि॒तुर्म॒तिमा॑स॒वं वि॒श्वदे॑व्यम् । धि॒या भगं॑ मनामहे
verses.translation: The judgment of bright Savitar, that cheers the All-Gods’ company, With prayer we estimate as bliss.
verses.hindi: हम कर्मो को करते हए प्रभु को न भूलें। प्रभु से हव्य (सात्विक) पदार्थो की याचना करे। प्रभु हमारे शुद्ध हदयं में दिव्य गुणों कौ स्थापना करें। इस प्रकार प्रभु का सदा स्मरण करने से हम प्रभु के ही छोटे रूप “विश्वरूप ' बनते है। १. है पवमान=मेरे हदय को पवित्र करनेवाले प्रभो! हि=निश्चय से आप सूर्य
verses.transliteration: devasya saviturmatimāsavaṃ viśvadevyam | dhiyā bhagaṃ manāmahe
verses.wordMeaning: The judgment of bright Savitar, that cheers the All-Gods’ company, With prayer we estimate as bliss.
verses.commentary: Sense: The judgment of bright Savitar, that cheers the All-Gods’ company, With prayer we estimate as bliss.

verses.sanskrit: अ॒ग्निᳪ स्तोमे॑न बोधय समिधा॒नो अम॑र्त्यम् । ह॒व्या दे॒वेषु॑ नो दधत्
verses.translation: Wake Agni with thy laud and set the Immortal One aflame, let him Bestow our offerings on the Gods.
verses.hindi: पवित्रता से ज्ञान दीप्त होता है। शक्ति के लिए हमें सात्विक दुग्ध आदि से तथा बहुत के धारण के उद्देश्य से क्रियाओं को करनेवाले बने। षिः प्रजापतिः। देवता-अग्निः। छन्द:ः-भूरिग्विकृतिः। स्वरः-मध्यमः॥ देवांऽआशापालाऽ एतं देवेभ्योऽश्वं मेधाय प्रोक्षिंतःरक्षतेह रन्तिरिह र्मतामिह धृतिरिह
verses.transliteration: agni stomena bodhaya samidhāno amartyam | havyā deveṣu no dadhat
verses.wordMeaning: Wake Agni with thy laud and set the Immortal One aflame, let him Bestow our offerings on the Gods.
verses.commentary: Sense: Wake Agni with thy laud and set the Immortal One aflame, let him Bestow our offerings on the Gods.

verses.sanskrit: स ह॑व्य॒वाडम॑र्त्य उ॒शिग्दू॒तश्चनो॑हितः । अ॒ग्निर्धि॒या समृ॑ण्वति
verses.translation: Oblation-bearer, well-inclined, immortal, eager Messenger, Agni comes near us with the thought.
verses.hindi: हम उदार हदय व शक्तिशाली बनकर सदा क्रियाशील वनें। अपने को पवित्र कर प्रभु से अपना सम्बन्ध स्थापित करें। इस सम्बन्ध से शक्तिशाली बनकर लोकसेवा क्ते कार्य मे लग जापैँ। सर्वत्र अच्छाई को ग्रहण करके आगे बढते चलें। इसी जीवन में आनन्द प्राप्ति, कष्ट-सहनशक्ति व आत्मधारण है।
verses.transliteration: sa havyavāḍamartya uśigdūtaścanohitaḥ | agnirdhiyā samṛṇvati
verses.wordMeaning: Oblation-bearer, well-inclined, immortal, eager Messenger, Agni comes near us with the thought.
verses.commentary: Sense: Oblation-bearer, well-inclined, immortal, eager Messenger, Agni comes near us with the thought.

verses.sanskrit: अ॒ग्निं दू॒तं पु॒रो द॑धे हव्य॒वाह॒मुप॑ ब्रुवे । दे॒वाँ२ आ सा॑दयादि॒ह
verses.translation: Agni, Envoy, I place in front, the oblation-bearer I address: Here let him seat the Deities.
verses.hindi: हम उस प्रभु के लिए अपना अर्पण करें जो आनन्दस्वरूप है। स्वरूप के स्मरण के लिए हमारा चिन्तन हो, मन प्रजापति में लगा हो, ज्ञान की रुचि हो, अदीना देवमाता, सरस्वती, पूषा, त्वष्टा व विष्णु के हम आराधक बने। विश्वो देवस्य॑ नेतुर्मर्तो" वुरीत सख्यम् ।
verses.transliteration: agniṃ dūtaṃ puro dadhe havyavāhamupa bruve | devā~2 ā sādayādiha
verses.wordMeaning: Agni, Envoy, I place in front, the oblation-bearer I address: Here let him seat the Deities.
verses.commentary: Sense: Agni, Envoy, I place in front, the oblation-bearer I address: Here let him seat the Deities.

verses.sanskrit: अजी॑जनो॒ हि प॑वमान॒ सूर्यं॑ वि॒धारे॒ शक्म॑ना॒ पय॑: । गोजी॑रया॒ रᳪह॑माण॒: पुर॑न्ध्या
verses.translation: Yea, Pavamâna, thou didst generate the Sun and spread the moisture out with power, Basting to us with plenty vivified with milk.
verses.hindi: इस संसार में हमारी उत्तम स्थिति व कल्याण तभी होगा जब हम प्रभु कौ मित्रता का वरण करेगे ओर धन के दास न बन जार्ठैगे। धन को हम उतना ही चाहे जितना कि शरीर-पोषण के लिए आवश्यक हो। सभेयो युवास्य यज॑मानस्य वीरो जायतां निकामेनिकामे नः पर्जन्यो वर्षतु फल॑वत्यो
verses.transliteration: ajījano hi pavamāna sūryaṃ vidhāre śakmanā paya: | gojīrayā rahamāṇa: purandhyā
verses.wordMeaning: Yea, Pavamâna, thou didst generate the Sun and spread the moisture out with power, Basting to us with plenty vivified with milk.
verses.commentary: Sense: Yea, Pavamâna, thou didst generate the Sun and spread the moisture out with power, Basting to us with plenty vivified with milk.

verses.sanskrit: वि॒भूर्मा॒त्रा प्र॒भूः पि॒त्राऽश्वो॑ऽसि॒ हयो॒ऽस्यत्यो॑ऽसि॒ मयो॒ऽस्यर्वा॑ऽसि॒ सप्ति॑रसि वा॒ज्य॒सि॒ वृषा॑ऽसि नृ॒मणा॑ असि । ययु॒र्नामा॑ऽसि॒ शिशु॒र्नामा॑स्यादि॒त्यानां॒ पत्वाऽन्वि॑हि॒ देवा॑ आशापाला ए॒तं दे॒वेभ्योऽश्वं॒ मेधा॑य॒ प्रोक्षि॑तᳪ रक्षते॒ह रन्ति॑ रि॒ह र॑मतामि॒ह धृति॑रि॒ह स्वधृ॑ति॒: स्वाहा॑
verses.translation: Mighty through thy dam, eminent through thy sire, thou art a horse, thou art a steed, thou art a courser, thou art a comfort, thou art a racer, thou art a yoke-horse, thou art a strong steed, thou art a stallion, thou art manly-minded. Thou art called Yayu, thou art called Sisu. Follow thou the flight of the Âdityas. Gods, Warders of the Regions, protect for the Gods this horse besprinkled for sacrifice. Here is delight. Here take thy pleasure. Here is content. Here is self-content.
verses.hindi: हमारे राष्ट में ' ब्राह्यण-क्षत्रिय-वैश्य' सब अपना कार्य ठीक से करें। श्रमिक लोग अपने कृषि आदि कार्यो को ठीक से करनेवाले हों। हमारे सन्तान उत्तम हो। राष्ट में सबका योगक्षेम ठीक से चले। स्वाहा मन॑से स्वाहा ।॥ २३॥
verses.transliteration: vibhūrmātrā prabhūḥ pitrā'śvo'si hayo'syatyo'si mayo'syarvā'si saptirasi vājyasi vṛṣā'si nṛmaṇā asi | yayurnāmā'si śiśurnāmāsyādityānāṃ patvā'nvihi devā āśāpālā etaṃ devebhyo'śvaṃ medhāya prokṣita rakṣateha ranti riha ramatāmiha dhṛtiriha svadhṛti: svāhā
verses.wordMeaning: Mighty through thy dam, eminent through thy sire, thou art a horse, thou art a steed, thou art a courser, thou art a comfort, thou art a racer, thou art a yoke-horse, thou art a strong steed, thou art a stallion, thou art manly-minded. Thou art called Yayu,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Mighty through thy dam, eminent through thy sire, thou art a horse, thou art a steed, thou art a courser, thou art a comfort, thou art a racer, thou art a yoke-horse, thou art a strong steed, thou art a stallion, thou art manly-minded. Thou art called Yayu,…

verses.sanskrit: काय॒ स्वाहा॒ कस्मै॒ स्वाहा॑ कत॒मस्मै॒ स्वाहा॒ स्वाहा॒ऽऽधिमाधी॑ताय॒ स्वाहा॒ मन॑: प्र॒जाप॑तये॒ स्वाहा॑ चि॒त्तं विज्ञा॑ता॒यादि॑त्यै॒ स्वाहा ऽदि॑त्यै मह्यै॒ स्वाहा ऽदि॑त्यै सुमृडी॒कायै॒ स्वाहा॒ सर॑स्वत्यै॒ स्वाहा॒ सर॑स्वत्यै पाव॒कायै॒ स्वाहा॒ सर॑स्वत्यै बृहत्यै॒ स्वाहा॑ पू॒ष्णे स्वाहा॑ पू॒ष्णे प्र॑प॒थ्या॒य॒ स्वाहा॑ पू॒ष्णे न॒रन्धि॑षाय॒ स्वाहा॒ त्वष्ट्रे॒ स्वाहा॒ त्वष्ट्रे॑ तु॒रीपा॑य॒ स्वाहा॒ त्वष्ट्रे॑ पुरु॒रूपा॑य॒ स्वाहा॒ विष्ण॑वे॒ स्वाहा॒ विष्ण॑वे निभूय॒पाय॒ स्वाहा॒ विष्ण॑वे शिपिवि॒ष्टाय॒ स्वाहा॑
verses.translation: Hail to Ka! Hail to Who?! Hail to Which?! Hail to him who has experienced pain! Hail to Prajâpati who knows the mind! Hail to him who discerns the thought! Hail to Aditi! Hail to good Aditi! Hail to gracious Aditi! Hail to Sarasvatî! Hail to purifying Sarasvatî! Hail to great Sarasvatî! Hail to Pûshan! Hail to Pûshan of the highways! Hail to Pûshan observer of men! Hail to Tvashtar! Hail to swift Tvashtar! Hail to Tvashtar of many forms! Hail to Vishnu! Hail to Vishnu Nibhûyapa! Hail to Vishnu Sipivishta!
verses.hindi: हम स्वार्थं से ऊपर उठकर यज्लियवृत्तिवाले बनें. जिससे हमारे ' प्राणापानव्यान ' दिशे स्वहार्वच्यिं दिशे स्वाहावाच्यै दिशो स्वाहार्वच् दिशो स्वाहां ।।२४॥ १. पिछले मन्त्र की भावना को ही विस्तार से इस अध्याय की समाप्ति तक केंगे। जब मनुष्य की वृत्ति यज्ञिय व स्वार्थं से ऊपर उठी हुई होती है तब उसके लिए सारा संसार
verses.transliteration: kāya svāhā kasmai svāhā katamasmai svāhā svāhā''dhimādhītāya svāhā mana: prajāpataye svāhā cittaṃ vijñātāyādityai svāhā 'dityai mahyai svāhā 'dityai sumṛḍīkāyai svāhā sarasvatyai svāhā sarasvatyai pāvakāyai svāhā sarasvatyai bṛhatyai svāhā pūṣṇe svāhā pūṣṇe prapathyāya svāhā pūṣṇe narandhiṣāya svāhā tvaṣṭre svāhā tvaṣṭre turīpāya svāhā tvaṣṭre pururūpāya svāhā viṣṇave svāhā viṣṇave nibhūyapāya svāhā viṣṇave śipiviṣṭāya svāhā
verses.wordMeaning: Hail to Ka! Hail to Who?! Hail to Which?! Hail to him who has experienced pain! Hail to Prajâpati who knows the mind! Hail to him who discerns the thought! Hail to Aditi! Hail to good Aditi! Hail to gracious Aditi! Hail to Sarasvatî! Hail to purifying Sarasvatî! Hail to great Sa…
verses.commentary: Sense: Hail to Ka! Hail to Who?! Hail to Which?! Hail to him who has experienced pain! Hail to Prajâpati who knows the mind! Hail to him who discerns the thought! Hail to Aditi! Hail to good Aditi! Hail to gracious Aditi! Hail to Sarasvatî! Hail to purifying Sarasvatî! Hail to great Sa…

verses.sanskrit:
विश्वो॑ दे॒वस्य॑ ने॒तुर्मर्तो॑ वुरीत स॒ख्यम् ।
विश्वो॑ रा॒य इ॑षुध्यति द्यु॒म्नं वृ॑णीत पु॒ष्यसे॒ स्वाहा॑
verses.translation: Let every mortal man elect, etc., repeated from IV. 8.
verses.hindi: यत्तिय व निःस्वार्थ वृत्ति के द्वारा हमारा यह संसार आगे-पीक, दायें -बायें व ऊपर-नीचे सब ओर से सुन्दर-ही- सुन्दर हो जाता है। आसुरवृत्ति ने ही संसार को मलिन अद्रयः स्वाहा वार्भ्यः स्वाहोदकाय स्वाहा तिष्ठन्तीभ्यः स्वाहा स्त्रव॑न्तीभ्यः स्वाहा १. अद्यः स्वाहा सर्वत्र व्याप्त जलो के लिए हम स्वार्थं की वृत्ति से ऊपर उठकर
verses.transliteration: viśvo devasya neturmarto vurīta sakhyam | viśvo rāya iṣudhyati dyumnaṃ vṛṇīta puṣyase svāhā
verses.wordMeaning: Let every mortal man elect, etc., repeated from IV. 8.
verses.commentary: Sense: Let every mortal man elect, etc., repeated from IV. 8.

verses.sanskrit: आ ब्रह्म॑न् ब्राह्म॒णो ब्र॑ह्मवर्च॒सी जा॑यता॒मा रा॒ष्ट्रे रा॑ज॒न्यः शूर॑ इष॒व्योऽतिव्या॒धी म॑हार॒थो जा॑यतां॒ दोग्ध्री॑  धे॒नुर्वोढा॑न॒ड्वाना॒शुः सप्ति॒: पुर॑न्धि॒र्योषा॑ जि॒ष्णू र॑थे॒ष्ठाः स॒भेयो॒ युवास्य यज॑मानस्य वी॒रो जा॑यतां॒ निका॒मे-नि॑कामे नः प॒र्जन्यो॑ वर्षतु॒ फल॑वत्यो न॒ ओष॑धयः पच्यन्तां योगक्षे॒मो न॑: कल्पताम्
