verses.commentary: Sense: This altar is the earth's extremest limit; this sacrifice of ours is the world's centre. This Soma is the Stallion's genial humour, this Brahman highest heaven where Speech abideth.

verses.sanskrit: सु॒भूः स्व॑य॒म्भूः प्र॑थ॒मोऽन्तर्म॑ह॒त्य॒र्ण॒वे । द॒धे ह॒ गर्भ॑मृ॒त्वियं॒ यतो॑ जा॒तः प्र॒जाप॑तिः
verses.translation: The Strong, the Self-existent One, the First, within the mighty flood Laid down the timely embryo from which Prajâpati was born.
verses.hindi: हम पचो के अन्द्र प्रविष्ट व॒ अन्तः प्रविष्ट होकर र्पोचों का धारण करनेवाले आत्मस्वरूप का मनन करनेवाले वनें। सूचना- यहो प्रश्नोत्तर मेँ ज्ञानविषयक्र स्वस्थ स्पर्धा द्रष्टव्य हे। उदराता का ललकारना व ब्रह्मा का चैलेज्ज को स्वीकार करना सचमुच अभिनयात्मक है। एेसी ज्ञान- चर्चां ही
verses.transliteration: subhūḥ svayambhūḥ prathamo'ntarmahatyarṇave | dadhe ha garbhamṛtviyaṃ yato jātaḥ prajāpatiḥ
verses.wordMeaning: The Strong, the Self-existent One, the First, within the mighty flood Laid down the timely embryo from which Prajâpati was born.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Strong, the Self-existent One, the First, within the mighty flood Laid down the timely embryo from which Prajâpati was born.

verses.sanskrit: होता॑ यक्षत्प्र॒जाप॑ति॒ᳪ सोम॑स्य महि॒म्नः । जु॒षतां॒ पिब॑तु॒ सोम॒ᳪ होत॒र्यज॑
verses.translation: Let the Hotar sacrifice to Prajâpati from the Mahiman-Soma. Let him accept. Let him drink the Soma. Hotar, sacrifice.
verses.hindi: हम पचो के अन्द्र प्रविष्ट व॒ अन्तः प्रविष्ट होकर र्पोचों का धारण करनेवाले आत्मस्वरूप का मनन करनेवाले वनें। सूचना- यहो प्रश्नोत्तर मेँ ज्ञानविषयक्र स्वस्थ स्पर्धा द्रष्टव्य हे। उदराता का ललकारना व ब्रह्मा का चैलेज्ज को स्वीकार करना सचमुच अभिनयात्मक है। एेसी ज्ञान- चर्चां ही
verses.transliteration: hotā yakṣatprajāpati somasya mahimnaḥ | juṣatāṃ pibatu soma hotaryaja
verses.wordMeaning: Let the Hotar sacrifice to Prajâpati from the Mahiman-Soma. Let him accept. Let him drink the Soma. Hotar, sacrifice.
verses.commentary: Sense: Let the Hotar sacrifice to Prajâpati from the Mahiman-Soma. Let him accept. Let him drink the Soma. Hotar, sacrifice.

verses.sanskrit: अश्व॑स्तूप॒रो गो॑मृ॒गस्ते प्रा॑जाप॒त्याः कृ॒ष्णग्री॑व आग्ने॒यो र॒राटे॑ पु॒रस्ता॑त्सारस्व॒ती मे॒ष्यधस्ता॒द्धन्वो॑राश्वि॒नाव॒धोरा॑मौ बा॒ह्वोः सौ॑मापौ॒ष्णः श्या॒मो नाभ्या॑ᳪ सौर्यया॒मौ श्वे॒तश्च॑ कृ॒ष्णश्च॑ पा॒र्श्वयो॑स्त्वा॒ष्ट्रौ लो॑म॒शस॑क्थौ स॒क्थ्योर्वा॑य॒व्य॒: श्वे॒तः पुच्छ॒ इन्द्रा॑य स्वप॒स्या॒य वे॒हद्वै॑ष्ण॒वो वा॑म॒नः
verses.translation: com The Texts of the White Yajurveda, tr. Ralph T.H. Griffith, [1899], BOOK THE TWENTY-FOURTH. HORSE, hornless goat, Gomriga, these belong to Prajâpati. A black-necked goat, devoted to Agni, (is to be bound) in front to the forehead (of the horse); Sarasvatî's ewe below his jaws; two goats belonging to the Asvins, with marks on the lower parts of the body, to his fore-legs; a dark-coloured goat, Soma's and Pûshan's, to his navel; a white and a black, sacred to Soma and Varna, to his sides; Tvashtar's two, with bushy tails, to his hind feet; Vâyu's white goat to his tail; for Indra the Good Worker a cow who slips her calf; a dwarf belonging to Vishnu.
verses.hindi: -शिल्पा वैश्वदेव्यो रो्हिण्यस्त्यव॑यो वाचे ऽविंज्ञाताऽअदित्यै सरूपा धात्रे व॑त्सतर्यो
verses.transliteration: aśvastūparo gomṛgaste prājāpatyāḥ kṛṣṇagrīva āgneyo rarāṭe purastātsārasvatī meṣyadhastāddhanvorāśvināvadhorāmau bāhvoḥ saumāpauṣṇaḥ śyāmo nābhyā sauryayāmau śvetaśca kṛṣṇaśca pārśvayostvāṣṭrau lomaśasakthau sakthyorvāyavya: śvetaḥ puccha indrāya svapasyāya vehadvaiṣṇavo vāmanaḥ
verses.wordMeaning: com The Texts of the White Yajurveda, tr. Ralph T.H. Griffith, [1899], BOOK THE TWENTY-FOURTH. HORSE, hornless goat, Gomriga, these belong to Prajâpati. A black-necked goat, devoted to Agni, (is to be bound) in front to the forehead (of the horse);…
verses.commentary: Sense: com The Texts of the White Yajurveda, tr. Ralph T.H. Griffith, [1899], BOOK THE TWENTY-FOURTH. HORSE, hornless goat, Gomriga, these belong to Prajâpati. A black-necked goat, devoted to Agni, (is to be bound) in front to the forehead (of the horse);…

verses.sanskrit: रोहि॑तो धू॒म्ररो॑हितः क॒र्कन्धु॑रोहित॒स्ते सौ॒म्या ब॒भ्रुर॑रु॒णब॑भ्रु॒: शुक॑बभ्रु॒स्ते वा॑रु॒णाः शि॑ति॒रन्ध्रो॒ऽन्यत॑: शितिरन्ध्रः सम॒न्तशि॑तिरन्ध्र॒स्ते सा॑वि॒त्राः शि॑तिबा॒हुर॒न्यत॑: शितिबाहु सम॒न्तशि॑तिबाहु॒स्ते बा॑र्हस्प॒त्याः पृष॑ती क्षु॒द्रपृ॑षती स्थू॒लपृ॑षती॒ ता मै॑त्रावरु॒ण्य॒:
verses.translation: The red goat, the smoky-red, the jujube-red, these belong to Soma. The brown, the ruddy-brown, the parrot-brown, these are Varuna's. One with white ear holes, one with partly white, one with wholly white, belong to Savitar. One with fore feet white, partly white, wholly white, belongs to Brihaspati. She goats speckled, with small spots, with big spots, these belong to Mitra-Varuna.
verses.hindi: धात्रे क॑त्सतर््यो देवानां पल्ीभ्यः।। ९॥ कृष्णा भौमा धूप्राऽआन्तरिश्षा हन्तो दिव्याः शबलां वैद्युताः सिध्मास्तारकाः
verses.transliteration: rohito dhūmrarohitaḥ karkandhurohitaste saumyā babhruraruṇababhru: śukababhruste vāruṇāḥ śitirandhro'nyata: śitirandhraḥ samantaśitirandhraste sāvitrāḥ śitibāhuranyata: śitibāhu samantaśitibāhuste bārhaspatyāḥ pṛṣatī kṣudrapṛṣatī sthūlapṛṣatī tā maitrāvaruṇya:
verses.wordMeaning: The red goat, the smoky-red, the jujube-red, these belong to Soma. The brown, the ruddy-brown, the parrot-brown, these are Varuna's. One with white ear holes, one with partly white, one with wholly white, belong to Savitar. One with fore feet white, partly white, wholly white,…
verses.commentary: Sense: The red goat, the smoky-red, the jujube-red, these belong to Soma. The brown, the ruddy-brown, the parrot-brown, these are Varuna's. One with white ear holes, one with partly white, one with wholly white, belong to Savitar. One with fore feet white, partly white, wholly white,…

verses.sanskrit:
शु॒द्धवा॑लः स॒र्वशु॑द्धवालो मणि॒वाल॒स्त आ॑श्वि॒नाः श्येत॑: श्येता॒क्षो॒ऽरु॒णस्ते रु॒द्राय॑ पशु॒पत॑ये क॒र्णा या॒मा अ॑वलि॒प्ता रौ॒द्रा नभो॑रूपाः
पार्ज॒न्याः
verses.translation: The bright-tailed, the wholly bright-tailed, the jewel-tailed, these belong to the Asvins. The white, the white-eyed, the reddish, these are for Rudra Lord of Beasts. Long-eared goats are for Yama; proud ones for Rudra; cloud-coloured ones for Parjanya.
verses.hindi: हेमन्ताय पिशङ्काच्छिशिराय।।९१९॥ ् ककुभ ऽनड्वाह पड्ध्ये धेनवो ऽतिंछन्दसे॥।९३॥ श्यामाः पौष्णाः पृश्न॑यो मारुता ब॑ह॒रूपा वैश्वदेवा वशा द्यांवापुथिवीयाः॥। ९४॥
verses.transliteration: śuddhavālaḥ sarvaśuddhavālo maṇivālasta āśvināḥ śyeta: śyetākṣo'ruṇaste rudrāya paśupataye karṇā yāmā avaliptā raudrā nabhorūpāḥ pārjanyāḥ
verses.wordMeaning: The bright-tailed, the wholly bright-tailed, the jewel-tailed, these belong to the Asvins. The white, the white-eyed, the reddish, these are for Rudra Lord of Beasts. Long-eared goats are for Yama; proud ones for Rudra; cloud-coloured ones for Parjanya.
verses.commentary: Sense: The bright-tailed, the wholly bright-tailed, the jewel-tailed, these belong to the Asvins. The white, the white-eyed, the reddish, these are for Rudra Lord of Beasts. Long-eared goats are for Yama; proud ones for Rudra; cloud-coloured ones for Parjanya.

verses.sanskrit: पृश्नि॑स्तिर॒श्चीन॑पृश्निरू॒र्ध्वपृ॑श्नि॒स्ते मा॑रु॒ताः फ॒ल्गूर्लो॑हितो॒र्णी प॑ल॒क्षी ताः सा॑रस्व॒त्य॒: प्लीहा॒कर्ण॑: शुण्ठा॒कर्णो॑ऽध्यालोह॒कर्ण॒स्ते त्वा॒ष्ट्राः कृ॒ष्णग्री॑वः शिति॒कक्षो॑ऽञ्जिस॒क्थस्त ऐ॑न्द्रा॒ग्नाः कृ॒ष्णाञ्जि॒रल्पा॑ञ्जिर्म॒हाञ्जि॒स्त उ॑ष॒स्या॑:
verses.translation: Goats speckled, transversely speckled, upward speckled are for the Maruts. The reddish she-goat, the red-haired, the white, these belong to Sarasvatî. The goat with diseased ears, the short-eared, the red eared are Tvashtar's. The black-necked, the white-flanked, one with bright-coloured thighs belong to Indra and Agni. Those with black marks, small marks, large marks belong to Dawn.
verses.hindi: उक्ताः सं॑ञ्चराऽ एतांऽपेन्द्राग्नाः प्राशृद्धा माहेन्द्रा ब॑हरूपा वैश्वकर्मणाः
verses.transliteration: pṛśnistiraścīnapṛśnirūrdhvapṛśniste mārutāḥ phalgūrlohitorṇī palakṣī tāḥ sārasvatya: plīhākarṇa: śuṇṭhākarṇo'dhyālohakarṇaste tvāṣṭrāḥ kṛṣṇagrīvaḥ śitikakṣo'ñjisakthasta aindrāgnāḥ kṛṣṇāñjiralpāñjirmahāñjista uṣasyā:
verses.wordMeaning: Goats speckled, transversely speckled, upward speckled are for the Maruts. The reddish she-goat, the red-haired, the white, these belong to Sarasvatî. The goat with diseased ears, the short-eared, the red eared are Tvashtar's. The black-necked, the white-flanked,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Goats speckled, transversely speckled, upward speckled are for the Maruts. The reddish she-goat, the red-haired, the white, these belong to Sarasvatî. The goat with diseased ears, the short-eared, the red eared are Tvashtar's. The black-necked, the white-flanked,…

verses.sanskrit: शि॒ल्पा वै॑श्वदे॒व्यो रोहि॑ण्य॒स्त्र्यव॑यो वा॒चेऽवि॑ज्ञाता॒ अदि॑त्यै॒ सरू॑पा धा॒त्रे व॑त्सत॒र्यो दे॒वानां॒ पत्नी॑भ्यः
verses.translation: Parti-coloured female victims belong to the All-Gods; red-coloured, eighteen mouths old to Vâk; victims without distinguishing marks to Aditi; those of one same colour to Dhâtar; weaned kids sacred to the Consorts of the Gods.
verses.hindi: धूम्रा बभ्रुनीकाशाः पितुणाश्सोम॑वतां बभ्रवो धूम्रनीकाशाः पितृणां वर्हिषद कृष्णा लभरनीकाशाः पितुणामंग्निष्वात्तानौ कृष्णाः पृषंन्तस्त्रैयम्बकाः॥। ९८॥
verses.transliteration: śilpā vaiśvadevyo rohiṇyastryavayo vāce'vijñātā adityai sarūpā dhātre vatsataryo devānāṃ patnībhyaḥ
verses.wordMeaning: Parti-coloured female victims belong to the All-Gods; red-coloured, eighteen mouths old to Vâk; victims without distinguishing marks to Aditi; those of one same colour to Dhâtar; weaned kids sacred to the Consorts of the Gods.
verses.commentary: Sense: Parti-coloured female victims belong to the All-Gods; red-coloured, eighteen mouths old to Vâk; victims without distinguishing marks to Aditi; those of one same colour to Dhâtar; weaned kids sacred to the Consorts of the Gods.

verses.sanskrit: कृ॒ष्णग्री॑वा आग्ने॒याः शि॑ति॒भ्रवो॒ वसू॑ना॒ᳪ रोहि॑ता रु॒द्राणा॑ᳪ श्वे॒ता अ॑वरो॒किण॑ आदि॒त्यानां॒ नभो॑रूपाः पार्ज॒न्याः
verses.translation: Black-necked victims for Agni; white browed for the Vasus; red for Rudra; bright ones for the Âdityas; cloud-coloured for Parjanya.
verses.hindi: वसन्ताय॑ कपिञ्ज॑लानालभते ग्रीष्मायं कलविङ्कान् वर्षाभ्य॑स्तित्तिरींञ्छरदे वर्तिका हेमन्ताय ककराच्छिशिराय विकंकरान्॥। २०॥ सम॒द्राय॑ शिशुमारानाल॑भते पर्जन्याय मण्डूकानद्द्रयो
verses.transliteration: kṛṣṇagrīvā āgneyāḥ śitibhravo vasūnā rohitā rudrāṇā śvetā avarokiṇa ādityānāṃ nabhorūpāḥ pārjanyāḥ
verses.wordMeaning: Black-necked victims for Agni; white browed for the Vasus; red for Rudra; bright ones for the Âdityas; cloud-coloured for Parjanya.
verses.commentary: Sense: Black-necked victims for Agni; white browed for the Vasus; red for Rudra; bright ones for the Âdityas; cloud-coloured for Parjanya.

verses.sanskrit:
उ॒न्न॒त ऋ॑ष॒भो वा॑म॒नस्त ऐ॑न्द्रवैष्ण॒वा उ॑न्न॒तः शि॑तिबा॒हुः शि॑तिपृ॒ष्ठस्त ऐ॑न्द्राबार्हस्प॒त्याः शुक॑रूपा वाजि॒नाः क॒ल्माषा॑ आग्निमारु॒ताः श्या॒माः
पौ॒ष्णा:
verses.translation: The tall goat, the sturdy, the dwarf, these are Indra-Vishnu's; the tall, the white fore-footed, the black-backed, Indra-Brihaspati's; parrot-coloured the Vâjins’; speckled Agni-Maruts’; dark-coloured Pûshan's.
verses.hindi: सोमाय क्छुलुङ्घऽआरण्यो.ऽजो न॑कुलः शका ते पौष्णाः क्रोष्टा मायोरिदद्र॑स्य गौरमृगः पिद्धो न्यङ्कुः कक्कटस्ते ऽनुमत्यै प्रतिश्रुत्का यै चक्रवाकः।३२॥ सौरी बलाकां शार्गः संजयः शायाण्डंकस्ते मैत्राः सर्स्वत्यै शारिः पुरुषवाक्
verses.transliteration: unnata ṛṣabho vāmanasta aindravaiṣṇavā unnataḥ śitibāhuḥ śitipṛṣṭhasta aindrābārhaspatyāḥ śukarūpā vājināḥ kalmāṣā āgnimārutāḥ śyāmāḥ pauṣṇā:
verses.wordMeaning: The tall goat, the sturdy, the dwarf, these are Indra-Vishnu's; the tall, the white fore-footed, the black-backed, Indra-Brihaspati's; parrot-coloured the Vâjins’; speckled Agni-Maruts’; dark-coloured Pûshan's.
verses.commentary: Sense: The tall goat, the sturdy, the dwarf, these are Indra-Vishnu's; the tall, the white fore-footed, the black-backed, Indra-Brihaspati's; parrot-coloured the Vâjins’; speckled Agni-Maruts’; dark-coloured Pûshan's.

verses.sanskrit: एता॑ ऐन्द्रा॒ग्ना द्वि॑रू॒पा अ॑ग्नीषो॒मीया॑ वाम॒ना अ॑न॒ड्वाह॑ आग्नावैष्ण॒वा व॒शा मै॑त्रावरु॒ण्योऽन्यत॑एन्यो मै॒त्र्य॒:
verses.translation: Variegated, Indra-Agni's; two-coloured, Agni-Soma's; dwarf oxen, Agni-Vishnu's; barren cows, Mitra-Varuna's; partly variegated, Mitra's.
verses.hindi: पुरूषमृगश्चन्द्रम॑सो गोधा काल॑का दार्वाघाटस्ते वनस्पतीनां कृकवाकुः सावित्रो हश्सो वात॑स्य नाक्रो मकरः कुलीपयस्ते ऽकुपारस्य हयै शल्य॑कः। ३५॥ एण्यद्वो मण्डूको मूषिका तित्तिरिस्ते सर्पणं लोपाशञऽआ॑ज्विनः कृष्णो
verses.transliteration: etā aindrāgnā dvirūpā agnīṣomīyā vāmanā anaḍvāha āgnāvaiṣṇavā vaśā maitrāvaruṇyo'nyataenyo maitrya:
verses.wordMeaning: Variegated, Indra-Agni's; two-coloured, Agni-Soma's; dwarf oxen, Agni-Vishnu's; barren cows, Mitra-Varuna's; partly variegated, Mitra's.
verses.commentary: Sense: Variegated, Indra-Agni's; two-coloured, Agni-Soma's; dwarf oxen, Agni-Vishnu's; barren cows, Mitra-Varuna's; partly variegated, Mitra's.

verses.sanskrit: कृ॒ष्णग्री॑वा आग्ने॒या ब॒भ्रव॑: सौ॒म्याः श्वे॒ता वा॑य॒व्या अवि॑ज्ञाता॒ अदि॑त्यै॒ सरू॑पा धा॒त्रे व॑त्सत॒र्यो॒ दे॒वानां॒ पत्नी॑भ्यः
verses.translation: Black-necked ones, Agni's; brown, Soma's; white, Vâyu's; undistinguished, Aditi's; self-coloured, Dhâtar's; weanlings, the Gods’ Consorts’.
verses.hindi: क्वयिं: कुटरूर्दात्यौहस्ते वाजिनां कामाय पिकः।३९॥ खड्गो वैुवदे वः श्वा कुष्ण: कर्णो गद् भस्तरक्षुस्ते रक्ष॑सा मिन्द्रौय सूकरः सिश्टो मारुतः कुंकलासः पिप्प॑का शकुनिस्ते शरव्यायै विश्वैषां देवानो पृषतः।
verses.transliteration: kṛṣṇagrīvā āgneyā babhrava: saumyāḥ śvetā vāyavyā avijñātā adityai sarūpā dhātre vatsataryo devānāṃ patnībhyaḥ
verses.wordMeaning: Black-necked ones, Agni's; brown, Soma's; white, Vâyu's; undistinguished, Aditi's; self-coloured, Dhâtar's; weanlings, the Gods’ Consorts’.
verses.commentary: Sense: Black-necked ones, Agni's; brown, Soma's; white, Vâyu's; undistinguished, Aditi's; self-coloured, Dhâtar's; weanlings, the Gods’ Consorts’.

verses.sanskrit: कृ॒ष्णा भौ॒मा धू॒म्रा आ॑न्तरि॒क्षा बृ॒हन्तो॑ दि॒व्याः श॒बला॑ वैद्यु॒ताः सि॒ध्मास्ता॑र॒काः
verses.translation: Black ones for Earth; smoke-coloured for Firmament; tall ones for Sky; brindled ones for Lightning; blotched ones for Stars.
verses.hindi: ९. इस अध्याय का भाष्य पण्डित हरिशरणजी नहीं कर पाये थे। अगले अध्याय के नवम मन्त्र तक भी उन्होने भाष्य नहीं किया था, अतः इन म्नो को मूलरूप में ही छापा गया है।
verses.transliteration: kṛṣṇā bhaumā dhūmrā āntarikṣā bṛhanto divyāḥ śabalā vaidyutāḥ sidhmāstārakāḥ
verses.wordMeaning: Black ones for Earth; smoke-coloured for Firmament; tall ones for Sky; brindled ones for Lightning; blotched ones for Stars.
verses.commentary: Sense: Black ones for Earth; smoke-coloured for Firmament; tall ones for Sky; brindled ones for Lightning; blotched ones for Stars.

verses.sanskrit: धू॒म्रान्व॑स॒न्तायाल॑भते श्वे॒तान्ग्री॒ष्माय॑ कृ॒ष्णान्व॒र्षाभ्यो॑ऽरु॒णाञ्छ॒रदे॒ पृष॑तो हेम॒न्ताय॑ पि॒शङ्गा॒ञ्छिशि॑राय
verses.translation: Smoke-coloured ones he sacrifices to Spring; white to Summer; black to the Rains; red ones to Autumn; speckled to Winter; reddish-yellow to the Dewy Season.
verses.hindi: ९. इस अध्याय का भाष्य पण्डित हरिशरणजी नहीं कर पाये थे। अगले अध्याय के नवम मन्त्र तक भी उन्होने भाष्य नहीं किया था, अतः इन म्नो को मूलरूप में ही छापा गया है।
verses.transliteration: dhūmrānvasantāyālabhate śvetāngrīṣmāya kṛṣṇānvarṣābhyo'ruṇāñcharade pṛṣato hemantāya piśaṅgāñchiśirāya
verses.wordMeaning: Smoke-coloured ones he sacrifices to Spring; white to Summer; black to the Rains; red ones to Autumn; speckled to Winter; reddish-yellow to the Dewy Season.
verses.commentary: Sense: Smoke-coloured ones he sacrifices to Spring; white to Summer; black to the Rains; red ones to Autumn; speckled to Winter; reddish-yellow to the Dewy Season.

verses.sanskrit: त्र्यव॑यो गाय॒त्र्यै पञ्चा॑वयस्त्रि॒ष्टुभे॑ दित्य॒वाहो॒ जग॑त्यै त्रिव॒त्सा अ॑नु॒ष्टुभे॑ तुर्य॒वाह॑ उ॒ष्णिहे॑
verses.translation: Calves eighteen months old to Gâyatrî; steers of two and a half years to Trishtup; two year old steers to Jagatî; three year olds to Anushtup; four year olds to Ushnih.
verses.hindi: ९. इस अध्याय का भाष्य पण्डित हरिशरणजी नहीं कर पाये थे। अगले अध्याय के नवम मन्त्र तक भी उन्होने भाष्य नहीं किया था, अतः इन म्नो को मूलरूप में ही छापा गया है।
verses.transliteration: tryavayo gāyatryai pañcāvayastriṣṭubhe dityavāho jagatyai trivatsā anuṣṭubhe turyavāha uṣṇihe
verses.wordMeaning: Calves eighteen months old to Gâyatrî; steers of two and a half years to Trishtup; two year old steers to Jagatî; three year olds to Anushtup; four year olds to Ushnih.
verses.commentary: Sense: Calves eighteen months old to Gâyatrî; steers of two and a half years to Trishtup; two year old steers to Jagatî; three year olds to Anushtup; four year olds to Ushnih.

verses.sanskrit: प॒ष्ठ॒वाहो॑ वि॒राज॑ उ॒क्षाणो॑ बृह॒त्या ऋ॑ष॒भाः क॒कुभे॑ऽन॒ड्वाह॑: प॒ङ्क्त्यै धे॒नवो॑ऽतिच्छन्दसे
verses.translation: Four year old steers to Virâj; full grown bulls to Brihatî; strong bulls to Kakup; draught oxen to Pankti; milch-cows to Atichhandas.
verses.hindi: ९. इस अध्याय का भाष्य पण्डित हरिशरणजी नहीं कर पाये थे। अगले अध्याय के नवम मन्त्र तक भी उन्होने भाष्य नहीं किया था, अतः इन म्नो को मूलरूप में ही छापा गया है।
verses.transliteration: paṣṭhavāho virāja ukṣāṇo bṛhatyā ṛṣabhāḥ kakubhe'naḍvāha: paṅktyai dhenavo'ticchandase
verses.wordMeaning: Four year old steers to Virâj; full grown bulls to Brihatî; strong bulls to Kakup; draught oxen to Pankti; milch-cows to Atichhandas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Four year old steers to Virâj; full grown bulls to Brihatî; strong bulls to Kakup; draught oxen to Pankti; milch-cows to Atichhandas.

verses.sanskrit:
कृ॒ष्णग्री॑वा आग्ने॒या ब॒भ्रव॑: सौ॒म्या उ॑पध्व॒स्ताः सा॑वि॒त्रा व॑त्सत॒र्य॒: सारस्व॒त्य॒: श्या॒माः पौ॒ष्णाः पृश्न॑यो मारु॒ता ब॑हुरू॒पा वै॑श्वदे॒वा व॒शा
द्या॑वापृथि॒वीया॑:  ।। १ ४  ।।
उ॒क्ताः स॑ञ्च॒रा एता॑ ऐन्द्रा॒ग्नाः कृ॒ष्णाः वा॑रु॒णाः पृश्न॑यो मारु॒ताः का॒यास्तू॑प॒राः
verses.translation: Called contemporary, the dappled belong to Indra-Agni; black ones to Varuna; speckled to the Maruts; hornless he-goats to Ka.
verses.hindi: ९. इस अध्याय का भाष्य पण्डित हरिशरणजी नहीं कर पाये थे। अगले अध्याय के नवम मन्त्र तक भी उन्होने भाष्य नहीं किया था, अतः इन म्नो को मूलरूप में ही छापा गया है।
verses.transliteration: kṛṣṇagrīvā āgneyā babhrava: saumyā upadhvastāḥ sāvitrā vatsatarya: sārasvatya: śyāmāḥ pauṣṇāḥ pṛśnayo mārutā bahurūpā vaiśvadevā vaśā dyāvāpṛthivīyā: || 1 4 || uktāḥ sañcarā etā aindrāgnāḥ kṛṣṇāḥ vāruṇāḥ pṛśnayo mārutāḥ kāyāstūparāḥ
verses.wordMeaning: Called contemporary, the dappled belong to Indra-Agni; black ones to Varuna; speckled to the Maruts; hornless he-goats to Ka.
verses.commentary: Sense: Called contemporary, the dappled belong to Indra-Agni; black ones to Varuna; speckled to the Maruts; hornless he-goats to Ka.

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒ग्नयेऽनी॑कवते प्रथम॒जानाल॑भते म॒रुद्भ्य॑: सान्तप॒नेभ्य॑: सवा॒त्यान्म॒रुद्भ्यो॑ गृहमे॒धिभ्यो॒ बष्कि॑हान्म॒रुद्भ्य॑: क्री॒डिभ्य॑: सᳪसृ॒ष्टान्म॒रुद्भ्य॒:
स्वत॑वद्भ्योऽनुसृ॒ष्टान् ।। १ ६  ।।
उ॒क्ताः स॑ञ्च॒रा एता॑ ऐन्द्रा॒ग्नाः प्रा॑शृ॒ङ्गा मा॑हे॒न्द्रा ब॑हुरू॒पा वै॑श्वकर्म॒णाः
verses.translation: Called contemporaneous, the dappled belonging to Indra-Agni; those with projecting horns to Mahendra; the many-coloured to Visvakarman.
verses.hindi: ९. इस अध्याय का भाष्य पण्डित हरिशरणजी नहीं कर पाये थे। अगले अध्याय के नवम मन्त्र तक भी उन्होने भाष्य नहीं किया था, अतः इन म्नो को मूलरूप में ही छापा गया है।
verses.transliteration: agnaye'nīkavate prathamajānālabhate marudbhya: sāntapanebhya: savātyānmarudbhyo gṛhamedhibhyo baṣkihānmarudbhya: krīḍibhya: sasṛṣṭānmarudbhya: svatavadbhyo'nusṛṣṭān || 1 6 || uktāḥ sañcarā etā aindrāgnāḥ prāśṛṅgā māhendrā bahurūpā vaiśvakarmaṇāḥ
verses.wordMeaning: Called contemporaneous, the dappled belonging to Indra-Agni; those with projecting horns to Mahendra; the many-coloured to Visvakarman.
verses.commentary: Sense: Called contemporaneous, the dappled belonging to Indra-Agni; those with projecting horns to Mahendra; the many-coloured to Visvakarman.

verses.sanskrit:
धू॒म्रा ब॒भ्रुनी॑काशाः पितॄ॒णाᳪ सोम॑वतां ब॒भ्रवो॑ धू॒म्रनी॑काशाः पितॄ॒णां ब॑र्हि॒षदां॑ कृ॒ष्णा ब॒भ्रुनी॑काशाः पितॄ॒णाम॑ग्निष्वा॒त्तानां॑ कृ॒ष्णाः
पृष॑न्तस्त्रैयम्ब॒काः
verses.translation: Smoke-coloured, those of brownish hue, to be offered to the Soma-possessing Fathers; the brown and the smoky-looking to the Fathers who sit on sacred grass; the black and the brownish-looking to the Fathers who have been tasted by Agni; the black and the spotted belong to Tryambaka.
verses.hindi: ९. इस अध्याय का भाष्य पण्डित हरिशरणजी नहीं कर पाये थे। अगले अध्याय के नवम मन्त्र तक भी उन्होने भाष्य नहीं किया था, अतः इन म्नो को मूलरूप में ही छापा गया है।
verses.transliteration: dhūmrā babhrunīkāśāḥ pitṝṇā somavatāṃ babhravo dhūmranīkāśāḥ pitṝṇāṃ barhiṣadāṃ kṛṣṇā babhrunīkāśāḥ pitṝṇāmagniṣvāttānāṃ kṛṣṇāḥ pṛṣantastraiyambakāḥ
verses.wordMeaning: Smoke-coloured, those of brownish hue, to be offered to the Soma-possessing Fathers; the brown and the smoky-looking to the Fathers who sit on sacred grass; the black and the brownish-looking to the Fathers who have been tasted by Agni;…
verses.commentary: Sense: Smoke-coloured, those of brownish hue, to be offered to the Soma-possessing Fathers; the brown and the smoky-looking to the Fathers who sit on sacred grass; the black and the brownish-looking to the Fathers who have been tasted by Agni;…

verses.sanskrit: उ॒क्ताः स॑ञ्च॒रा एता॑: शुनासी॒रीया॑: श्वे॒ता वा॑य॒व्या॒: श्वे॒ताः सौ॒र्याः
verses.translation: Called contemporaneous, the dappled belong to Suna and Sîra; white ones to Vâyu; white ones to Sûrya.
verses.hindi: ९. इस अध्याय का भाष्य पण्डित हरिशरणजी नहीं कर पाये थे। अगले अध्याय के नवम मन्त्र तक भी उन्होने भाष्य नहीं किया था, अतः इन म्नो को मूलरूप में ही छापा गया है।
verses.transliteration: uktāḥ sañcarā etā: śunāsīrīyā: śvetā vāyavyā: śvetāḥ sauryāḥ
verses.wordMeaning: Called contemporaneous, the dappled belong to Suna and Sîra; white ones to Vâyu; white ones to Sûrya.
verses.commentary: Sense: Called contemporaneous, the dappled belong to Suna and Sîra; white ones to Vâyu; white ones to Sûrya.

verses.sanskrit: व॒स॒न्ताय॑ क॒पिञ्ज॑ला॒नाल॑भते ग्री॒ष्माय॑ कल॒विङ्का॑न्व॒र्षाभ्य॑स्ति॒त्तिरी॑ञ्छ॒रदे॒ वर्ति॑का हेम॒न्ताय॒ कक॑रा॒ञ्छिशि॑राय॒ विक॑करान्
verses.translation: To Spring he offers Kapiñjalas; to Summer sparrows; to the Rains partridges; to Autumn quails; to Winter. Kakaras; to the Dewy Season Vikakaras.
verses.hindi: ९. इस अध्याय का भाष्य पण्डित हरिशरणजी नहीं कर पाये थे। अगले अध्याय के नवम मन्त्र तक भी उन्होने भाष्य नहीं किया था, अतः इन म्नो को मूलरूप में ही छापा गया है।
verses.transliteration: vasantāya kapiñjalānālabhate grīṣmāya kalaviṅkānvarṣābhyastittirīñcharade vartikā hemantāya kakarāñchiśirāya vikakarān
verses.wordMeaning: To Spring he offers Kapiñjalas; to Summer sparrows; to the Rains partridges; to Autumn quails; to Winter. Kakaras; to the Dewy Season Vikakaras.
verses.commentary: Sense: To Spring he offers Kapiñjalas; to Summer sparrows; to the Rains partridges; to Autumn quails; to Winter. Kakaras; to the Dewy Season Vikakaras.

verses.sanskrit: स॒मु॒द्राय॑ शिशु॒मारा॒नाल॑भते प॒र्जन्या॑य म॒ण्डूका॑न॒द्भ्यो मत्स्या॑न्मि॒त्राय॑ कुली॒पया॒न्वरु॑णाय ना॒क्रान्
verses.translation: To the Sea he sacrifices porpoises; to Parjanya frogs; to the Waters fishes; to Mitra Kulîpayas; to Varuna crocodiles.
verses.hindi: ९. इस अध्याय का भाष्य पण्डित हरिशरणजी नहीं कर पाये थे। अगले अध्याय के नवम मन्त्र तक भी उन्होने भाष्य नहीं किया था, अतः इन म्नो को मूलरूप में ही छापा गया है।
verses.transliteration: samudrāya śiśumārānālabhate parjanyāya maṇḍūkānadbhyo matsyānmitrāya kulīpayānvaruṇāya nākrān
verses.wordMeaning: To the Sea he sacrifices porpoises; to Parjanya frogs; to the Waters fishes; to Mitra Kulîpayas; to Varuna crocodiles.
verses.commentary: Sense: To the Sea he sacrifices porpoises; to Parjanya frogs; to the Waters fishes; to Mitra Kulîpayas; to Varuna crocodiles.

verses.sanskrit: सोमा॑य ह॒ᳪसानाल॑भते वा॒यवे॑ ब॒लाका॑ इन्द्रा॒ग्निभ्यां॒ क्रुञ्चा॑न्मि॒त्राय॑ म॒द्गून्वरु॑णाय चक्रवा॒कान्
verses.translation: To Soma he sacrifices wild geese; to Vâyu female cranes; to Indra-Agni curlews; to Mitra divers; to Varuna Chakravâkas.
verses.hindi: ९. इस अध्याय का भाष्य पण्डित हरिशरणजी नहीं कर पाये थे। अगले अध्याय के नवम मन्त्र तक भी उन्होने भाष्य नहीं किया था, अतः इन म्नो को मूलरूप में ही छापा गया है।
verses.transliteration: somāya hasānālabhate vāyave balākā indrāgnibhyāṃ kruñcānmitrāya madgūnvaruṇāya cakravākān
verses.wordMeaning: To Soma he sacrifices wild geese; to Vâyu female cranes; to Indra-Agni curlews; to Mitra divers; to Varuna Chakravâkas.
verses.commentary: Sense: To Soma he sacrifices wild geese; to Vâyu female cranes; to Indra-Agni curlews; to Mitra divers; to Varuna Chakravâkas.

verses.sanskrit: अ॒ग्नये॑ कु॒टरू॒नाल॑भते॒ वन॒स्पति॑भ्य॒ उलू॑कान॒ग्नीषोमा॑भ्यां॒ चाषा॑न॒श्विभ्यां॑ म॒यूरा॑न्मि॒त्रावरु॑णाभ्यां क॒पोता॑न्
verses.translation: To Agni he sacrifices cocks; to Vanaspatis owls; to Agni-Soma blue jays; to the Asvins peacocks; to Mitra-Varuna pigeons.
verses.hindi: ९. इस अध्याय का भाष्य पण्डित हरिशरणजी नहीं कर पाये थे। अगले अध्याय के नवम मन्त्र तक भी उन्होने भाष्य नहीं किया था, अतः इन म्नो को मूलरूप में ही छापा गया है।
verses.transliteration: agnaye kuṭarūnālabhate vanaspatibhya ulūkānagnīṣomābhyāṃ cāṣānaśvibhyāṃ mayūrānmitrāvaruṇābhyāṃ kapotān
verses.wordMeaning: To Agni he sacrifices cocks; to Vanaspatis owls; to Agni-Soma blue jays; to the Asvins peacocks; to Mitra-Varuna pigeons.
verses.commentary: Sense: To Agni he sacrifices cocks; to Vanaspatis owls; to Agni-Soma blue jays; to the Asvins peacocks; to Mitra-Varuna pigeons.

verses.sanskrit: सोमा॑य ल॒बानाल॑भते॒ त्वष्ट्रे॑ कौली॒कान्गो॑षा॒दीर्दे॒वानां॒ पत्नी॑भ्यः कु॒लीका॑ देवजा॒मिभ्यो॒ऽग्नये॑ गृ॒हप॑तये पारु॒ष्णान्
verses.translation: To Soma he sacrifices quails; to Tvashtar Kaulîkas; Mainas to the Gods’ Consorts; Kulîkas to the Gods’ Sisters; Pârushnas to Agni Lord of the Homestead.
verses.hindi: ९. इस अध्याय का भाष्य पण्डित हरिशरणजी नहीं कर पाये थे। अगले अध्याय के नवम मन्त्र तक भी उन्होने भाष्य नहीं किया था, अतः इन म्नो को मूलरूप में ही छापा गया है।
verses.transliteration: somāya labānālabhate tvaṣṭre kaulīkāngoṣādīrdevānāṃ patnībhyaḥ kulīkā devajāmibhyo'gnaye gṛhapataye pāruṣṇān
verses.wordMeaning: To Soma he sacrifices quails; to Tvashtar Kaulîkas; Mainas to the Gods’ Consorts; Kulîkas to the Gods’ Sisters; Pârushnas to Agni Lord of the Homestead.
verses.commentary: Sense: To Soma he sacrifices quails; to Tvashtar Kaulîkas; Mainas to the Gods’ Consorts; Kulîkas to the Gods’ Sisters; Pârushnas to Agni Lord of the Homestead.

verses.sanskrit: अह्ने॑ पा॒राव॑ता॒नाल॑भते॒ रात्र्यै॑ सीचा॒पूर॑होरा॒त्रयो॑: स॒न्धिभ्यो॑ ज॒तूर्मासे॑भ्यो दात्यौ॒हान्त्सं॑वत्स॒राय॑ मह॒तः सु॑प॒र्णान्
verses.translation: To Day he sacrifices doves; to Night Sîchâpûs; to the Joints of Day and Night bats; to the Months gallinules; to the Year great eagles.
verses.hindi: ९. इस अध्याय का भाष्य पण्डित हरिशरणजी नहीं कर पाये थे। अगले अध्याय के नवम मन्त्र तक भी उन्होने भाष्य नहीं किया था, अतः इन म्नो को मूलरूप में ही छापा गया है।
verses.transliteration: ahne pārāvatānālabhate rātryai sīcāpūrahorātrayo: sandhibhyo jatūrmāsebhyo dātyauhāntsaṃvatsarāya mahataḥ suparṇān
verses.wordMeaning: To Day he sacrifices doves; to Night Sîchâpûs; to the Joints of Day and Night bats; to the Months gallinules; to the Year great eagles.
verses.commentary: Sense: To Day he sacrifices doves; to Night Sîchâpûs; to the Joints of Day and Night bats; to the Months gallinules; to the Year great eagles.

verses.sanskrit: भूम्या॑ आ॒खूनाल॑भते॒ऽन्तरि॑क्षाय पा॒ङ्क्त्रान्दि॒वे कशा॑न्दि॒ग्भ्यो न॑कु॒लान्बभ्रु॑कानवान्तरदि॒शाभ्य॑:
verses.translation: To Ground he sacrifices rats; to Firmament field-rats; to Day voles; to the Quarters mungooses; to the Intermediate Spaces brownish ichneumons.
verses.hindi: ९. इस अध्याय का भाष्य पण्डित हरिशरणजी नहीं कर पाये थे। अगले अध्याय के नवम मन्त्र तक भी उन्होने भाष्य नहीं किया था, अतः इन म्नो को मूलरूप में ही छापा गया है।
verses.transliteration: bhūmyā ākhūnālabhate'ntarikṣāya pāṅktrāndive kaśāndigbhyo nakulānbabhrukānavāntaradiśābhya:
verses.wordMeaning: To Ground he sacrifices rats; to Firmament field-rats; to Day voles; to the Quarters mungooses; to the Intermediate Spaces brownish ichneumons.
verses.commentary: Sense: To Ground he sacrifices rats; to Firmament field-rats; to Day voles; to the Quarters mungooses; to the Intermediate Spaces brownish ichneumons.

verses.sanskrit: वसु॑भ्य॒ ऋश्या॒नाल॑भते रु॒द्रेभ्यो॒ रुरू॑नादि॒त्येभ्यो॒ न्यङ्कू॒॒न्विश्वे॑भ्यो दे॒वेभ्य॑: पृष॒तान्त्सा॒ध्येभ्य॑: कुलु॒ङ्गान्
verses.translation: To the Vasus he sacrifices black-bucks; to the Rudras stags; to the Âdityas Nyanku deer; to the All-Gods spotted deer; to the Sâdhyas Kulinga antelopes,
verses.hindi: ९. इस अध्याय का भाष्य पण्डित हरिशरणजी नहीं कर पाये थे। अगले अध्याय के नवम मन्त्र तक भी उन्होने भाष्य नहीं किया था, अतः इन म्नो को मूलरूप में ही छापा गया है।
verses.transliteration: vasubhya ṛśyānālabhate rudrebhyo rurūnādityebhyo nyaṅkūnviśvebhyo devebhya: pṛṣatāntsādhyebhya: kuluṅgān
verses.wordMeaning: To the Vasus he sacrifices black-bucks; to the Rudras stags; to the Âdityas Nyanku deer; to the All-Gods spotted deer; to the Sâdhyas Kulinga antelopes,
verses.commentary: Sense: To the Vasus he sacrifices black-bucks; to the Rudras stags; to the Âdityas Nyanku deer; to the All-Gods spotted deer; to the Sâdhyas Kulinga antelopes,

verses.sanskrit: ईशा॑नाय॒ पर॑स्वत॒ आल॑भते मि॒त्राय॑ गौ॒रान्वरु॑णाय महि॒षान्बृह॒स्पत॑ये गव॒याँस्त्वष्ट्र॒ उष्ट्रा॑न्
verses.translation: To îsâna he sacrifices wild asses; to Mitra Gauras; to Varuna buffaloes; to Brihaspati Gayals; to Tvashtar camels.
verses.hindi: ९. इस अध्याय का भाष्य पण्डित हरिशरणजी नहीं कर पाये थे। अगले अध्याय के नवम मन्त्र तक भी उन्होने भाष्य नहीं किया था, अतः इन म्नो को मूलरूप में ही छापा गया है।
verses.transliteration: īśānāya parasvata ālabhate mitrāya gaurānvaruṇāya mahiṣānbṛhaspataye gavayā~stvaṣṭra uṣṭrān
verses.wordMeaning: To îsâna he sacrifices wild asses; to Mitra Gauras; to Varuna buffaloes; to Brihaspati Gayals; to Tvashtar camels.
verses.commentary: Sense: To îsâna he sacrifices wild asses; to Mitra Gauras; to Varuna buffaloes; to Brihaspati Gayals; to Tvashtar camels.

verses.sanskrit: प्र॒जाप॑तये॒ पुरु॑षान्ह॒स्तिन॒ आल॑भते वा॒चे प्लुषीँ॒श्चक्षु॑षे म॒शका॒ञ्छ्रोत्रा॑य॒ भृङ्गा॑:
verses.translation: To Prajâpati he sacrifices men elephants; to Vâk white ants; to Sight flies; to Hearing black bees.
verses.hindi: ९. इस अध्याय का भाष्य पण्डित हरिशरणजी नहीं कर पाये थे। अगले अध्याय के नवम मन्त्र तक भी उन्होने भाष्य नहीं किया था, अतः इन म्नो को मूलरूप में ही छापा गया है।
verses.transliteration: prajāpataye puruṣānhastina ālabhate vāce pluṣī~ścakṣuṣe maśakāñchrotrāya bhṛṅgā:
verses.wordMeaning: To Prajâpati he sacrifices men elephants; to Vâk white ants; to Sight flies; to Hearing black bees.
verses.commentary: Sense: To Prajâpati he sacrifices men elephants; to Vâk white ants; to Sight flies; to Hearing black bees.

verses.sanskrit: प्र॒जाप॑तये च वा॒यवे॑ च गोमृ॒गो वरु॑णायार॒ण्यो मे॒षो य॒माय॒ कृष्णो॑ मनुष्यरा॒जाय॑ म॒र्कट॑: शार्दू॒लाय॑ रो॒हिदृ॑ष॒भाय॑ गव॒यी क्षि॑प्रश्ये॒नाय॒ वर्ति॑का॒ नील॑ङ्गो॒: कृमि॑: समु॒द्राय॑ शिशु॒मारो॑  हि॒मव॑ते  ह॒स्ती
verses.translation: To Prajâpati and to Vâyu a Gayal is to be offered; to Varuna a wild ram; to Yama a black ram; to a human king a monkey; to the Tiger a red doe; to the Bull a female Gayal, to the Kshiprasyena a quail; to the Nilangu a worm; to the Sea a porpoise; to the Snowy Mountain an elephant.
verses.hindi: ९. इस अध्याय का भाष्य पण्डित हरिशरणजी नहीं कर पाये थे। अगले अध्याय के नवम मन्त्र तक भी उन्होने भाष्य नहीं किया था, अतः इन म्नो को मूलरूप में ही छापा गया है।
verses.transliteration: prajāpataye ca vāyave ca gomṛgo varuṇāyāraṇyo meṣo yamāya kṛṣṇo manuṣyarājāya markaṭa: śārdūlāya rohidṛṣabhāya gavayī kṣipraśyenāya vartikā nīlaṅgo: kṛmi: samudrāya śiśumāro himavate hastī
verses.wordMeaning: To Prajâpati and to Vâyu a Gayal is to be offered; to Varuna a wild ram; to Yama a black ram; to a human king a monkey; to the Tiger a red doe; to the Bull a female Gayal, to the Kshiprasyena a quail; to the Nilangu a worm; to the Sea a porpoise;…
verses.commentary: Sense: To Prajâpati and to Vâyu a Gayal is to be offered; to Varuna a wild ram; to Yama a black ram; to a human king a monkey; to the Tiger a red doe; to the Bull a female Gayal, to the Kshiprasyena a quail; to the Nilangu a worm; to the Sea a porpoise;…

verses.sanskrit: म॒युः प्रा॑जाप॒त्य उ॒लो ह॒लिक्ष्णो॑ वृषद॒ᳪशस्ते धा॒त्रे दि॒शां क॒ङ्को धुङ्क्षा॑ग्ने॒यी क॑ल॒विङ्को॑ लोहिता॒हिः पु॑ष्करसा॒दस्ते त्वा॒ष्ट्रा वा॒चे क्रुञ्च॑:
verses.translation: The Kinnara belongs to Prajâpati; the Ula, the Halikshna, the cat belong to Dhâtar; the heron belongs to the Quarters; the Dhunkshâ to Agni; sparrow, red snake, Sâras, these are Tvashtar's; the curlew belongs to Vâk.
verses.hindi: ९. इस अध्याय का भाष्य पण्डित हरिशरणजी नहीं कर पाये थे। अगले अध्याय के नवम मन्त्र तक भी उन्होने भाष्य नहीं किया था, अतः इन म्नो को मूलरूप में ही छापा गया है।
verses.transliteration: mayuḥ prājāpatya ulo halikṣṇo vṛṣadaśaste dhātre diśāṃ kaṅko dhuṅkṣāgneyī kalaviṅko lohitāhiḥ puṣkarasādaste tvāṣṭrā vāce kruñca:
verses.wordMeaning: The Kinnara belongs to Prajâpati; the Ula, the Halikshna, the cat belong to Dhâtar; the heron belongs to the Quarters; the Dhunkshâ to Agni; sparrow, red snake, Sâras, these are Tvashtar's; the curlew belongs to Vâk.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Kinnara belongs to Prajâpati; the Ula, the Halikshna, the cat belong to Dhâtar; the heron belongs to the Quarters; the Dhunkshâ to Agni; sparrow, red snake, Sâras, these are Tvashtar's; the curlew belongs to Vâk.

verses.sanskrit:
सोमा॑य कुलु॒ङ्ग आ॑र॒ण्योऽजो न॑कु॒लः शका॒ ते पौ॒ष्णाः क्रो॒ष्टा मा॒योरिन्द्र॑स्य गौरमृ॒गः पि॒द्वो न्यङ्कु॑: कक्क॒टस्तेऽनु॑मत्यै प्रति॒श्रुत्का॑यै
चक्रवा॒कः
verses.translation: To Soma an antelope is to be offered; wild goat, mungoose, Sakâ. these are Pûshan's; the jackal is the Mâyu's; the Gaura Indra's; Pidva, antelope, cock, these are Anumati's; the Chakravâka is for Echo.
verses.hindi: ९. इस अध्याय का भाष्य पण्डित हरिशरणजी नहीं कर पाये थे। अगले अध्याय के नवम मन्त्र तक भी उन्होने भाष्य नहीं किया था, अतः इन म्नो को मूलरूप में ही छापा गया है।
verses.transliteration: somāya kuluṅga āraṇyo'jo nakulaḥ śakā te pauṣṇāḥ kroṣṭā māyorindrasya gauramṛgaḥ pidvo nyaṅku: kakkaṭaste'numatyai pratiśrutkāyai cakravākaḥ
verses.wordMeaning: To Soma an antelope is to be offered; wild goat, mungoose, Sakâ. these are Pûshan's; the jackal is the Mâyu's; the Gaura Indra's; Pidva, antelope, cock, these are Anumati's; the Chakravâka is for Echo.
verses.commentary: Sense: To Soma an antelope is to be offered; wild goat, mungoose, Sakâ. these are Pûshan's; the jackal is the Mâyu's; the Gaura Indra's; Pidva, antelope, cock, these are Anumati's; the Chakravâka is for Echo.

verses.sanskrit:
सौ॒री ब॒लाका॑ शा॒र्गः सृ॑ज॒यः श॒याण्ड॑क॒स्ते मै॒त्राः सर॑स्वत्यै॒ शारि॑: पुरुष॒वाक् श्वा॒विद्भौ॒मी शा॑र्दू॒लो वृक॒: पृदा॑कु॒स्ते म॒न्यवे॒ सर॑स्वते॒  शुक॑:
पुरुष॒वाक्
verses.translation: The female crane is Sûrya's; Sârga, Srijays, Sayândaka, these are Mitra's; to Sarasvatî belongs the human-voiced Maina; to Ground the porcupine; tiger, wolf, viper belong to Passion; to Sarasvân the human-voiced parrot.
verses.hindi: ९. इस अध्याय का भाष्य पण्डित हरिशरणजी नहीं कर पाये थे। अगले अध्याय के नवम मन्त्र तक भी उन्होने भाष्य नहीं किया था, अतः इन म्नो को मूलरूप में ही छापा गया है।
verses.transliteration: saurī balākā śārgaḥ sṛjayaḥ śayāṇḍakaste maitrāḥ sarasvatyai śāri: puruṣavāk śvāvidbhaumī śārdūlo vṛka: pṛdākuste manyave sarasvate śuka: puruṣavāk
verses.wordMeaning: The female crane is Sûrya's; Sârga, Srijays, Sayândaka, these are Mitra's; to Sarasvatî belongs the human-voiced Maina; to Ground the porcupine; tiger, wolf, viper belong to Passion; to Sarasvân the human-voiced parrot.
verses.commentary: Sense: The female crane is Sûrya's; Sârga, Srijays, Sayândaka, these are Mitra's; to Sarasvatî belongs the human-voiced Maina; to Ground the porcupine; tiger, wolf, viper belong to Passion; to Sarasvân the human-voiced parrot.

verses.sanskrit:
सु॒प॒र्णः पा॑र्ज॒न्य आ॒तिर्वा॑ह॒सो दर्वि॑दा॒ ते वा॒यवे॒ बृह॒स्पत॑ये वा॒चस्पत॑ये पैङ्गरा॒जो॒ऽल॒ज आ॑न्तरि॒क्षः प्ल॒वो म॒द्गुर्मत्स्य॒स्ते न॑दीप॒त॑ये द्यावापृथि॒वीय॑:
कू॒र्मः
verses.translation: The eagle is Parjanya's; the Âti, the Vâhasa, the wood-pecker, these are for Vâyu; for Brihaspati Lord of Speech is the Paingarâja; the Alaja belongs to Firmament; pelican, cormorant, fish, these belong to the Lord of Rivers; the tortoise belongs to Heaven and Earth.
verses.hindi: ९. इस अध्याय का भाष्य पण्डित हरिशरणजी नहीं कर पाये थे। अगले अध्याय के नवम मन्त्र तक भी उन्होने भाष्य नहीं किया था, अतः इन म्नो को मूलरूप में ही छापा गया है।
verses.transliteration: suparṇaḥ pārjanya ātirvāhaso darvidā te vāyave bṛhaspataye vācaspataye paiṅgarājo'laja āntarikṣaḥ plavo madgurmatsyaste nadīpataye dyāvāpṛthivīya: kūrmaḥ
verses.wordMeaning: The eagle is Parjanya's; the Âti, the Vâhasa, the wood-pecker, these are for Vâyu; for Brihaspati Lord of Speech is the Paingarâja; the Alaja belongs to Firmament; pelican, cormorant, fish, these belong to the Lord of Rivers; the tortoise belongs to Heaven and Earth.
verses.commentary: Sense: The eagle is Parjanya's; the Âti, the Vâhasa, the wood-pecker, these are for Vâyu; for Brihaspati Lord of Speech is the Paingarâja; the Alaja belongs to Firmament; pelican, cormorant, fish, these belong to the Lord of Rivers; the tortoise belongs to Heaven and Earth.

verses.sanskrit:
पु॒रु॒ष॒मृ॒गश्च॒न्द्रम॑सो गो॒धा काल॑का दार्वाघा॒टस्ते वन॒स्पती॑नां कृक॒वाकु॑: सावि॒त्रो ह॒ᳪसो वात॑स्य ना॒क्रो मक॑रः कुली॒पय॒स्तेऽकू॑पारस्य ह्रि॒यै
शल्य॑कः
verses.translation: The book belongs to the Moon; iguana, Kâlakâ, woodpecker, these belong to the Vanaspatis; the cock belongs to Savitar; the swan is Vâta's; crocodile, dolphin, Kulîpaya, these belong to the Sea; the porcupine to Modesty.
verses.hindi: ९. इस अध्याय का भाष्य पण्डित हरिशरणजी नहीं कर पाये थे। अगले अध्याय के नवम मन्त्र तक भी उन्होने भाष्य नहीं किया था, अतः इन म्नो को मूलरूप में ही छापा गया है।
verses.transliteration: puruṣamṛgaścandramaso godhā kālakā dārvāghāṭaste vanaspatīnāṃ kṛkavāku: sāvitro haso vātasya nākro makaraḥ kulīpayaste'kūpārasya hriyai śalyakaḥ
verses.wordMeaning: The book belongs to the Moon; iguana, Kâlakâ, woodpecker, these belong to the Vanaspatis; the cock belongs to Savitar; the swan is Vâta's; crocodile, dolphin, Kulîpaya, these belong to the Sea; the porcupine to Modesty.
verses.commentary: Sense: The book belongs to the Moon; iguana, Kâlakâ, woodpecker, these belong to the Vanaspatis; the cock belongs to Savitar; the swan is Vâta's; crocodile, dolphin, Kulîpaya, these belong to the Sea; the porcupine to Modesty.

verses.sanskrit: ए॒ण्यह्नो॑ म॒ण्डूको॒ मूषि॑का ति॒त्तिरि॒स्ते स॒र्पाणां॑ लोपा॒श आ॑श्वि॒नः कृष्णो॒ रात्र्या॒ ऋक्षो॑ ज॒तूः सु॑षि॒लीका॒ त इ॑तरज॒नानां॒ जह॑का वैष्ण॒वी
verses.translation: The Black-doe belongs to Day; frog, female rat, partridge, these belong to the Serpents; the jackal belongs to the Asvins; the Black-buck to Night; bear, bat, Sushilikâ, these belong to the Other Folk ( i.e. fairies--JBH ); the polecat belongs to Vishnu.
verses.hindi: ९. इस अध्याय का भाष्य पण्डित हरिशरणजी नहीं कर पाये थे। अगले अध्याय के नवम मन्त्र तक भी उन्होने भाष्य नहीं किया था, अतः इन म्नो को मूलरूप में ही छापा गया है।
verses.transliteration: eṇyahno maṇḍūko mūṣikā tittiriste sarpāṇāṃ lopāśa āśvinaḥ kṛṣṇo rātryā ṛkṣo jatūḥ suṣilīkā ta itarajanānāṃ jahakā vaiṣṇavī
verses.wordMeaning: The Black-doe belongs to Day; frog, female rat, partridge, these belong to the Serpents; the jackal belongs to the Asvins; the Black-buck to Night; bear, bat, Sushilikâ, these belong to the Other Folk ( i.e. fairies--JBH ); the polecat belongs to Vishnu.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Black-doe belongs to Day; frog, female rat, partridge, these belong to the Serpents; the jackal belongs to the Asvins; the Black-buck to Night; bear, bat, Sushilikâ, these belong to the Other Folk ( i.e. fairies--JBH ); the polecat belongs to Vishnu.

verses.sanskrit: अ॒न्य॒वा॒पो॒ऽर्धमा॒साना॒मृश्यो॑ म॒यूर॑: सुप॒र्णस्ते ग॑न्ध॒र्वाणा॑म॒पामु॒द्रो मा॒सां क॒श्यपो॑ रो॒हित्कु॑ण्डृ॒णाची॑ गो॒लत्ति॑का॒ ते॑ऽप्स॒रसां॑ मृ॒त्यवे॑ऽसि॒तः
verses.translation: The cuckoo belongs to the Half Months; antelope, peacock, eagle, these are the Gandharvas’; the otter belongs to the Months; tortoise, doe-antelope, iguana, Golathikâ belong to the Apsarases; the black snake belongs to Death.
verses.hindi: ९. इस अध्याय का भाष्य पण्डित हरिशरणजी नहीं कर पाये थे। अगले अध्याय के नवम मन्त्र तक भी उन्होने भाष्य नहीं किया था, अतः इन म्नो को मूलरूप में ही छापा गया है।
verses.transliteration: anyavāpo'rdhamāsānāmṛśyo mayūra: suparṇaste gandharvāṇāmapāmudro māsāṃ kaśyapo rohitkuṇḍṛṇācī golattikā te'psarasāṃ mṛtyave'sitaḥ
verses.wordMeaning: The cuckoo belongs to the Half Months; antelope, peacock, eagle, these are the Gandharvas’; the otter belongs to the Months; tortoise, doe-antelope, iguana, Golathikâ belong to the Apsarases; the black snake belongs to Death.
verses.commentary: Sense: The cuckoo belongs to the Half Months; antelope, peacock, eagle, these are the Gandharvas’; the otter belongs to the Months; tortoise, doe-antelope, iguana, Golathikâ belong to the Apsarases; the black snake belongs to Death.

verses.sanskrit: व॒र्षा॒हूरृ॒तू॒ना॑मा॒खुः कशो॑ मान्था॒लस्ते पि॑तॄ॒णां बला॑याजग॒रो वसू॑नां क॒पिञ्ज॑लः क॒पोत॒ उलू॑कः श॒शस्ते निरृ॑त्यै॒ वरु॑णायार॒ण्यो मे॒षः
verses.translation: The frog belongs to the Seasons; the vole, the rat, the mouse, these are the Fathers’; the Python, the Balâva belong to the Vasus; Kapiñjala, pigeons owl, hare belong to Nirriti; the wild ram to Varuna.
verses.hindi: ९. इस अध्याय का भाष्य पण्डित हरिशरणजी नहीं कर पाये थे। अगले अध्याय के नवम मन्त्र तक भी उन्होने भाष्य नहीं किया था, अतः इन म्नो को मूलरूप में ही छापा गया है।
verses.transliteration: varṣāhūrṛtūnāmākhuḥ kaśo mānthālaste pitṝṇāṃ balāyājagaro vasūnāṃ kapiñjalaḥ kapota ulūkaḥ śaśaste nirṛtyai varuṇāyāraṇyo meṣaḥ
verses.wordMeaning: The frog belongs to the Seasons; the vole, the rat, the mouse, these are the Fathers’; the Python, the Balâva belong to the Vasus; Kapiñjala, pigeons owl, hare belong to Nirriti; the wild ram to Varuna.
verses.commentary: Sense: The frog belongs to the Seasons; the vole, the rat, the mouse, these are the Fathers’; the Python, the Balâva belong to the Vasus; Kapiñjala, pigeons owl, hare belong to Nirriti; the wild ram to Varuna.

verses.sanskrit: श्वि॒त्र आ॑दि॒त्याना॒मुष्ट्रो॒ घृणी॑वान्वार्ध्रीन॒सस्ते म॒त्या अर॑ण्याय सृम॒रो रुरू॑ रौ॒द्रः क्वयि॑: कु॒टरु॑र्दात्यौ॒हस्ते वा॒जिनां॒ कामा॑य पि॒कः
verses.translation: The white animal belongs to the Âdityas; the camel, the Ghrintîvân, the rhinoceros to Mati; the Srimara belong to the Forest-God; the Raru buck is Rudra's; Kvayi, cock, gallinule, these are the Vâjins’; the cuckoo belongs to Kâma.
verses.hindi: ९. इस अध्याय का भाष्य पण्डित हरिशरणजी नहीं कर पाये थे। अगले अध्याय के नवम मन्त्र तक भी उन्होने भाष्य नहीं किया था, अतः इन म्नो को मूलरूप में ही छापा गया है।
verses.transliteration: śvitra ādityānāmuṣṭro ghṛṇīvānvārdhrīnasaste matyā araṇyāya sṛmaro rurū raudraḥ kvayi: kuṭarurdātyauhaste vājināṃ kāmāya pikaḥ
verses.wordMeaning: The white animal belongs to the Âdityas; the camel, the Ghrintîvân, the rhinoceros to Mati; the Srimara belong to the Forest-God; the Raru buck is Rudra's; Kvayi, cock, gallinule, these are the Vâjins’; the cuckoo belongs to Kâma.
verses.commentary: Sense: The white animal belongs to the Âdityas; the camel, the Ghrintîvân, the rhinoceros to Mati; the Srimara belong to the Forest-God; the Raru buck is Rudra's; Kvayi, cock, gallinule, these are the Vâjins’; the cuckoo belongs to Kâma.

verses.sanskrit:
ख॒ङ्गो वै॑श्वदे॒वः श्वा कृ॒ष्णः क॒र्णो ग॑र्द॒भस्त॒रक्षु॒स्ते रक्ष॑सा॒मिन्द्रा॑य सूक॒रः सि॒ᳪहो मा॑रु॒त: कृ॑कला॒सः पिप्प॑का श॒कुनि॒स्ते श॑र॒व्या॒यै॒ विश्वे॑षां दे॒वानां॑
पृष॒तः
verses.translation: The Khanga is the All-Gods'; the black dog, the long eared, the ass, the hyena, these are the Râkshasas; the boar is for Indra; the lion is for the Maruts; the chameleon, the Pipoaka, the vulture, these belong to Saravyâ; the spotted antelope belongs to the All-Gods.
verses.hindi: ९. इस अध्याय का भाष्य पण्डित हरिशरणजी नहीं कर पाये थे। अगले अध्याय के नवम मन्त्र तक भी उन्होने भाष्य नहीं किया था, अतः इन म्नो को मूलरूप में ही छापा गया है।
verses.transliteration: khaṅgo vaiśvadevaḥ śvā kṛṣṇaḥ karṇo gardabhastarakṣuste rakṣasāmindrāya sūkaraḥ siho māruta: kṛkalāsaḥ pippakā śakuniste śaravyāyai viśveṣāṃ devānāṃ pṛṣataḥ
verses.wordMeaning: The Khanga is the All-Gods'; the black dog, the long eared, the ass, the hyena, these are the Râkshasas; the boar is for Indra; the lion is for the Maruts; the chameleon, the Pipoaka, the vulture, these belong to Saravyâ; the spotted antelope belongs to the All-Gods.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Khanga is the All-Gods'; the black dog, the long eared, the ass, the hyena, these are the Râkshasas; the boar is for Indra; the lion is for the Maruts; the chameleon, the Pipoaka, the vulture, these belong to Saravyâ; the spotted antelope belongs to the All-Gods.

verses.sanskrit: शादं॑ द॒द्भिरव॑कां दन्तमूलै॒र्मृदं॒ बर्स्वै॑स्ते॒गान्दᳪष्ट्रा॑भ्या॒ᳪ सर॑स्वत्या अग्रजि॒ह्वं जि॒ह्वाया॑ उत्सा॒दम॑वक्र॒न्देन॒ तालु॒ वाज॒ᳪ हनु॑भ्याम॒प आ॒स्ये॒न॒ वृष॑णमा॒ण्डाभ्या॑मादि॒त्याँ श्मश्रु॑भि॒: पन्था॑नं भ्रू॒भ्यां द्यावा॑पृथि॒वी वर्तो॑भ्यां वि॒द्युतं॑ क॒नीन॑काभ्याᳪ शु॒क्लाय॒ स्वाहा॑ कृ॒ष्णाय॒ स्वाहा॒ पार्या॑णि॒ पक्ष्मा॑ण्यवा॒र्या॒ इ॒क्षवो॑ऽवा॒र्या॒णि॒ पक्ष्मा॑णि॒ पार्या॑ इ॒क्षव॑:
verses.translation: com The Texts of the White Yajurveda, tr. Ralph T.H. Griffith, [1899], BOOK THE TWENTY-FIFTH. I GRATIFY Fresh Grass with his teeth, Avakâ with his gums, Clay with his tooth-sockets, Tegas with his fangs. The tongue-tip for Sarasvatî; I gratify the root of the tongue and the palate with his neigh, Vâja with his jaws, the Waters with his mouth, the Stallion with his testicles, the Âdityas with the beard, Path with his eyebrows, Heaven and Earth with his eyelashes, Lightning with the pupils of his eyes. Hail to the white! Hail to the black! Effectual are his eyelashes, irresistible are his lower eyelashes; irresistible are his eyelashes, effectual are his lower eyelashes.
verses.hindi: वे हिरण्यगर्भ प्रभु सदा से हे, सबके अद्वितीय रक्षक है त्रिलोकी का धारण कर रहे है। हम उस आनन्दस्वरूप, सर्वप्रद व ज्योतिर्मय प्रभु की ही उपासना करे। ऋषि: प्रजापत्िः। देवता-ईरवरः। छन्दः त्रिष्टुप्। स्वरः- धैवतः। यऽ ईशेऽअस्य द्विपदश्चतुष्पदः कस्मै देवाय हविषां विधेम ॥ ९९॥
verses.transliteration: śādaṃ dadbhiravakāṃ dantamūlairmṛdaṃ barsvaistegāndaṣṭrābhyā sarasvatyā agrajihvaṃ jihvāyā utsādamavakrandena tālu vāja hanubhyāmapa āsyena vṛṣaṇamāṇḍābhyāmādityā~ śmaśrubhi: panthānaṃ bhrūbhyāṃ dyāvāpṛthivī vartobhyāṃ vidyutaṃ kanīnakābhyā śuklāya svāhā kṛṣṇāya svāhā pāryāṇi pakṣmāṇyavāryā ikṣavo'vāryāṇi pakṣmāṇi pāryā ikṣava:
verses.wordMeaning: com The Texts of the White Yajurveda, tr. Ralph T.H. Griffith, [1899], BOOK THE TWENTY-FIFTH. I GRATIFY Fresh Grass with his teeth, Avakâ with his gums, Clay with his tooth-sockets, Tegas with his fangs. The tongue-tip for Sarasvatî;…
verses.commentary: Sense: com The Texts of the White Yajurveda, tr. Ralph T.H. Griffith, [1899], BOOK THE TWENTY-FIFTH. I GRATIFY Fresh Grass with his teeth, Avakâ with his gums, Clay with his tooth-sockets, Tegas with his fangs. The tongue-tip for Sarasvatî;…

verses.sanskrit: वातं॑ प्रा॒णेना॑पा॒नेन॒ नासि॑के उपया॒ममध॑रे॒णौष्ठे॑न॒ सदुत्त॑रेण प्रका॒शेनान्त॑रमनूका॒शेन॒ बाह्यं॑ निवे॒ष्यं मू॒र्ध्ना स्त॑नयि॒त्नुं नि॑र्बा॒धेना॒शनिं॑ म॒स्तिष्के॑ण वि॒द्युतं॑ क॒नीन॑काभ्यां॒ कर्णा॑भ्या॒ᳪ श्रोत्रँ॒ श्रोत्रा॑भ्यां॒ कर्णौ॑ तेद॒नीम॑धरक॒ण्ठेना॒पः शु॑ष्कक॒ण्ठेन॑ चि॒त्तं मन्या॑भि॒रदि॑तिᳪ शी॒र्ष्णा निरृ॑तिं॒ निर्ज॑र्जल्येन शी॒र्ष्णा सं॑क्रोशैः प्रा॒णान् रेष्माण॑ᳪ स्तु॒पेन॑
verses.translation: With his breath I gratify Vâta; with his outbreath the two Nostrils; with his lower lip the Upayâma; with his upper lip Existence. With his bright look I please Antara, with his reflection Bâhya; the Whirlpool with his head; Thunder with his frontal bone; the Lightning-flash with his brain; Lightning with the pupils of his eyes; Hearing with his external ears; Ears with his internal ears; Blood with his lower neck; Waters with the fleshless part of his neck; Thought with the back neck-tendons; Aditi with his head; Nirriti with his ragged head; Vital Breathings with his roars; Tempest with his crest.
verses.hindi: चराचर संसार के नियामक वे प्रभु ही है। सब पशु-पक्षियों में दृश्यमान एश्वर्य उस प्रभु का ही है। उस सुखस्वरूप सर्वज्ञ प्रभु का हम वस्तुओं के त्यागपूर्वक प्रयोग से पूजन करते हे। यस्येमाः प्रदिशो यस्य॑ बाहू. कस्म देवाय॑ हविषां विधेम।।९२॥
verses.transliteration: vātaṃ prāṇenāpānena nāsike upayāmamadhareṇauṣṭhena saduttareṇa prakāśenāntaramanūkāśena bāhyaṃ niveṣyaṃ mūrdhnā stanayitnuṃ nirbādhenāśaniṃ mastiṣkeṇa vidyutaṃ kanīnakābhyāṃ karṇābhyā śrotra~ śrotrābhyāṃ karṇau tedanīmadharakaṇṭhenāpaḥ śuṣkakaṇṭhena cittaṃ manyābhiraditi śīrṣṇā nirṛtiṃ nirjarjalyena śīrṣṇā saṃkrośaiḥ prāṇān reṣmāṇa stupena
verses.wordMeaning: With his breath I gratify Vâta; with his outbreath the two Nostrils; with his lower lip the Upayâma; with his upper lip Existence. With his bright look I please Antara, with his reflection Bâhya; the Whirlpool with his head; Thunder with his frontal bone;…
verses.commentary: Sense: With his breath I gratify Vâta; with his outbreath the two Nostrils; with his lower lip the Upayâma; with his upper lip Existence. With his bright look I please Antara, with his reflection Bâhya; the Whirlpool with his head; Thunder with his frontal bone;…

verses.sanskrit: म॒शका॒न् केशै॒रिन्द्र॒ᳪ स्वप॑सा॒ वहे॑न॒ बृह॒स्पति॑ᳪ शकुनिसा॒देन॑ कू॒र्माञ्छ॒फैरा॒क्रम॑णᳪ स्थू॒राभ्या॑मृ॒क्षला॑भिः क॒पिञ्ज॑लाञ्ज॒वं जङ्घा॑भ्या॒मध्वा॑नं बा॒हुभ्यां॒ जाम्बी॑ले॒नार॑ण्यम॒ग्निम॑ति॒रुग्भ्यां॑ पू॒षणं॑ दो॒र्भ्याम॒श्विना॒वᳪसा॑भ्याᳪ रु॒द्रᳪ रोरा॑भ्याम्
verses.translation: I gratify Flies with his hair; Indra with his active shoulder; Brihaspati with his quick spring; Tortoises with his hoofs; Approach with his fetlocks; Kapiñjalas with his heel-ropes; Speed with his two thighs; the Way with his two fore-legs; the Forest-God with a kneepan; Agni with his two knees; Pûshan with his two fore-feet; the Asvins with his shoulders; Rudra with his shoulder-joints,
verses.hindi: प्रभु पूर्ण व आप्तकाम है। उन्दे अपने लिए कुछ नहीं करना- उन्होने अपने को जीवहित के लिए दे डाला है। उनके सब कार्य जीव को उन्नति-साधन प्राप्त करने के लिए है। वे जीव को सामर्थ्य प्राप्त कराते है। सामान्य लोग इस प्रभ का गुणगान करते हे तो समञ्जदार प्रभु के आदेशो के अनुसार कार्य करने का ध्यान करते ै। प्रभु से दिये गये
verses.transliteration: maśakān keśairindra svapasā vahena bṛhaspati śakunisādena kūrmāñchaphairākramaṇa sthūrābhyāmṛkṣalābhiḥ kapiñjalāñjavaṃ jaṅghābhyāmadhvānaṃ bāhubhyāṃ jāmbīlenāraṇyamagnimatirugbhyāṃ pūṣaṇaṃ dorbhyāmaśvināvasābhyā rudra rorābhyām
verses.wordMeaning: I gratify Flies with his hair; Indra with his active shoulder; Brihaspati with his quick spring; Tortoises with his hoofs; Approach with his fetlocks; Kapiñjalas with his heel-ropes; Speed with his two thighs; the Way with his two fore-legs; the Forest-God with a kneepan;…
verses.commentary: Sense: I gratify Flies with his hair; Indra with his active shoulder; Brihaspati with his quick spring; Tortoises with his hoofs; Approach with his fetlocks; Kapiñjalas with his heel-ropes; Speed with his two thighs; the Way with his two fore-legs; the Forest-God with a kneepan;…

verses.sanskrit: अ॒ग्नेः प॑क्ष॒तिर्वा॒योर्निप॑क्षति॒रिन्द्र॑स्य तृ॒तीया॒ सोम॑स्य चतु॒र्थ्यदि॑त्यै पञ्च॒मीन्द्रा॒ण्यै ष॒ष्ठी म॒रुता॑ᳪ सप्त॒मी बृह॒स्पते॑रष्ट॒म्य॒र्य॒म्णो न॑व॒मी धा॒तुर्द॑श॒मीन्द्र॑स्यैकाद॒शी वरु॑णस्य द्वाद॒शी य॒मस्य॑ त्रयोद॒शी
verses.translation: The first rib is Agni's; the second Vâyu's; the third Indra's; the fourth Soma's; the fifth Aditi's; the sixth Indrânî's; the seventh the Maruts’; the eighth Brihaspati's; the ninth Aryaman's; the tenth Dhâtar's; the eleventh Indra's; the twelfth Varuna's; the thirteenth Yama's. 5 (On the left side) the first rib belongs to Indra-Agni; the second to Sarasvatî; the third to Mitra; the fourth to the Waters; the fifth to Nirriti; the sixth to Agni-Soma; the seventh to the Serpents; the eighth to Vishnu; the ninth to Pûshan; the tenth to Tvashtar; the eleventh to Indra; the twelfth to Varuna; the thirteenth to Yama. The right flank belongs to Heaven and Earth, the left to the All-Gods.
verses.hindi: हमे उत्तम कर्म व सङ्कल्प प्राप्त हो। देव हमारी वृद्धि का कारण वने। आलस्य से ऊपर उठकर दिन-प्रतिदिन वे प्रजा-रक्षण के कार्य मे लगे रहे। “सुमति व राति'=देवसयख्य देवानो भद्रा सुंमतिऋजूयतां दे वानांश्छरातिर् भि नो निवर्तताम्।
verses.transliteration: agneḥ pakṣatirvāyornipakṣatirindrasya tṛtīyā somasya caturthyadityai pañcamīndrāṇyai ṣaṣṭhī marutā saptamī bṛhaspateraṣṭamyaryamṇo navamī dhāturdaśamīndrasyaikādaśī varuṇasya dvādaśī yamasya trayodaśī
verses.wordMeaning: The first rib is Agni's; the second Vâyu's; the third Indra's; the fourth Soma's; the fifth Aditi's; the sixth Indrânî's; the seventh the Maruts’; the eighth Brihaspati's; the ninth Aryaman's; the tenth Dhâtar's; the eleventh Indra's; the twelfth Varuna's;…
verses.commentary: Sense: The first rib is Agni's; the second Vâyu's; the third Indra's; the fourth Soma's; the fifth Aditi's; the sixth Indrânî's; the seventh the Maruts’; the eighth Brihaspati's; the ninth Aryaman's; the tenth Dhâtar's; the eleventh Indra's; the twelfth Varuna's;…

verses.sanskrit: इ॒न्द्रा॒ग्न्योः प॑क्ष॒ति: सर॑स्वत्यै॒ निप॑क्षतिर्मि॒त्रस्य॑ तृ॒तीया॒पां च॑तु॒र्थी निरृ॑त्यै पञ्च॒म्यग्नीषोम॑योः ष॒ष्ठी स॒र्पाणा॑ᳪ सप्त॒मी विष्णो॑रष्ट॒मी पू॒ष्णो न॑व॒मी त्वष्टु॑र्दश॒मीन्द्र॑स्यैकाद॒शी वरु॑णस्य द्वाद॒शी य॒म्यै त्र॑योद॒शी द्यावा॑पृथि॒व्योर्दक्षि॑णं पा॒र्श्वं विश्वे॑षां दे॒वाना॒मुत्त॑रम्
verses.translation: The shoulders belong to the Maruts; the first rib-cartilages to the All-Gods; the second to the Rudras; the third to the Âdityas; the tail belongs to Vâyu; the hind-quarters to Agni-Soma.
verses.hindi: हमें देवों कौ ' सुमति प्राप्त हो। देवों कौ भांति हम "दानवृत्ति' वाले हों तथा देवों कौ ही हमें "मित्रता" प्राप्त हो। ये तीनों बाते हमारे दीर्घजीवन का कारण बने अर्यमणं वरूणश्सोम॑मणश्विना सर॑स्वती नः सुभगा मय॑स्करत्।॥ ९६।। १. गतमन्त्र मे देवों की मित्रता प्राप्त करने की प्रार्थना धी। उन्हीं देवों का वर्णन करते
verses.transliteration: indrāgnyoḥ pakṣati: sarasvatyai nipakṣatirmitrasya tṛtīyāpāṃ caturthī nirṛtyai pañcamyagnīṣomayoḥ ṣaṣṭhī sarpāṇā saptamī viṣṇoraṣṭamī pūṣṇo navamī tvaṣṭurdaśamīndrasyaikādaśī varuṇasya dvādaśī yamyai trayodaśī dyāvāpṛthivyordakṣiṇaṃ pārśvaṃ viśveṣāṃ devānāmuttaram
verses.wordMeaning: The shoulders belong to the Maruts; the first rib-cartilages to the All-Gods; the second to the Rudras; the third to the Âdityas; the tail belongs to Vâyu; the hind-quarters to Agni-Soma.
verses.commentary: Sense: The shoulders belong to the Maruts; the first rib-cartilages to the All-Gods; the second to the Rudras; the third to the Âdityas; the tail belongs to Vâyu; the hind-quarters to Agni-Soma.

verses.sanskrit: म॒रुता॑ᳪ स्कन्धा॒ विश्वे॑षां दे॒वानां॑ प्रथ॒मा कीक॑सा रु॒द्राणां॑ द्वि॒तीया॑ऽऽदि॒त्यानां॑ तृ॒तीया॑ वा॒योः पुच्छ॑म॒ग्नीषोम॑यो॒र्भास॑दौ॒ क्रुञ्चौ॒ श्रोणि॑भ्या॒मिन्द्रा॒बृह॒स्पती॑ ऊ॒रुभ्यां॑ मि॒त्रावरु॑णाव॒ल्गाभ्या॑मा॒क्रम॑णᳪ स्थू॒राभ्यां॒ बलं॒ कुष्ठा॑भ्याम्
verses.translation: I gratify the two Curlews with the hips; Indra-Brihaspati with the thighs; Mitra-Varuna with the groins; Approach with the buttocks; Strength with the two cavities of the loins.
verses.hindi: जव हम ज्ञान प्राप्त कर लेते है तब वायु, पृथिवी, द्युलोक, सोमाभिषव करने मे उपयुक्त ग्रावाणा अथवा अधिक सौम्यता को जन्म देनेवाले उपदेष्टा गुरु-ये सव हमें कल्याणकर ओषध प्राप्त कराते है ओर प्राणापान हमारे लिए सर्वोत्तम ओषध बनते है। तमीशानं जग॑तस्तस्थुषस्पतिं धियञ्जिन्वमव॑से दूमहे वयम्।
verses.transliteration: marutā skandhā viśveṣāṃ devānāṃ prathamā kīkasā rudrāṇāṃ dvitīyā''dityānāṃ tṛtīyā vāyoḥ pucchamagnīṣomayorbhāsadau kruñcau śroṇibhyāmindrābṛhaspatī ūrubhyāṃ mitrāvaruṇāvalgābhyāmākramaṇa sthūrābhyāṃ balaṃ kuṣṭhābhyām
verses.wordMeaning: I gratify the two Curlews with the hips; Indra-Brihaspati with the thighs; Mitra-Varuna with the groins; Approach with the buttocks; Strength with the two cavities of the loins.
verses.commentary: Sense: I gratify the two Curlews with the hips; Indra-Brihaspati with the thighs; Mitra-Varuna with the groins; Approach with the buttocks; Strength with the two cavities of the loins.

verses.sanskrit: पू॒षणं॑ वनि॒ष्ठुना॑ऽन्धा॒हीन्त्स्थू॑लगु॒दया॑ स॒र्पान्गुदा॑भिर्वि॒ह्रुत॑ आ॒न्त्रैर॒पो व॒स्तिना॒ वृष॑णमा॒ण्डाभ्यां॒ वाजि॑न॒ᳪ शेपे॑न प्र॒जाᳪ रेत॑सा॒ चाषा॑न् पि॒त्तेन॑ प्रद॒रान् पा॒युना॑ कू॒श्माञ्छ॑कपिण्डैः
verses.translation: I gratify Pûshan with the rectum; Blind-worms with the large intestines; Serpents with the entrails; Worms with the guts; the Waters with the bladder; Scrotum with the testicles; the Vâjins with his penis; Offspring with his seed; Blue jays with his bile; Fissures with his arms; Kûshmas with his lumps of dung.
verses.hindi: ईशान का आह्वान हमारे शरीर व मानस रक्षा का कारण बने तथा हमें पोषण करे लिए आवश्यक धनो कौ प्राप्ति हो। १. नः=हमारे लिए वृद्धश्रवाः=सदा से बद हुए ज्ञानवाला इन्द्रः=बलवान् व सव शत्रुओं का विद्रावण करनेवाला प्रभु स्वस्ति-कल्याण करनेवाला हो, अर्थात् प्रभु कौ कृपा
verses.transliteration: pūṣaṇaṃ vaniṣṭhunā'ndhāhīntsthūlagudayā sarpāngudābhirvihruta āntrairapo vastinā vṛṣaṇamāṇḍābhyāṃ vājina śepena prajā retasā cāṣān pittena pradarān pāyunā kūśmāñchakapiṇḍaiḥ
verses.wordMeaning: I gratify Pûshan with the rectum; Blind-worms with the large intestines; Serpents with the entrails; Worms with the guts; the Waters with the bladder; Scrotum with the testicles; the Vâjins with his penis; Offspring with his seed; Blue jays with his bile;…
verses.commentary: Sense: I gratify Pûshan with the rectum; Blind-worms with the large intestines; Serpents with the entrails; Worms with the guts; the Waters with the bladder; Scrotum with the testicles; the Vâjins with his penis; Offspring with his seed; Blue jays with his bile;…

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्र॑स्य क्री॒डोऽदि॑त्यै पाज॒स्यं॒ दि॒शां ज॒त्रवोऽदि॑त्यै भ॒सज्जी॒मूता॑न् हृदयौप॒शेना॒न्तरि॑क्षं पुरी॒तता॒ नभ॑ उद॒र्ये॒ण चक्रवा॒कौ मत॑स्नाभ्यां॒ दिवं॑ वृ॒क्काभ्यां॑ गि॒रीन् प्ला॒शिभि॒रुप॑लान् प्ली॒ह्ना व॒ल्मीका॑न् क्लो॒मभि॑र्ग्लौ॒भिर्गुल्मा॑न् हि॒राभि॒: स्रव॑न्तीर्ह्र॒दान् कु॒क्षिभ्या॑ᳪ समु॒द्रमु॒दरे॑ण वैश्वान॒रं भस्म॑ना
verses.translation: His chest belongs to Indra; his belly to Aditi; his clavicles to the Quarters; his nether hind-part to Aditi. I gratify Clouds with his aorta; Firmament with his pericardium; Mist with his belly; the two Chakravâkas with his cardiac bones; Sky with his kidneys; Mountains with his ducts; hocks with his spleen; Ant-hills with his lungs; Shrubs with his heart-vessels; Streams with his veins; Lakes with his flanks; Sea with his belly; Vaisvânara with his ashes.
verses.hindi: हम प्रभु की उपासना करते हुए (क) वृद्ध ज्ञानवाले व काम. क्रोधादि शत्रुओं का संहार करनेवाले बनें, (ख) पोषण के लिए आवश्यक धन प्राप्त करे, (ग) निरन्तर क्रियाशील जीवन विताते हुए कभी मर्यादा का उल्लंघन न कररँ। (घ) उदारहदय बनकर कल्याण को सिद्ध करे।
verses.transliteration: indrasya krīḍo'dityai pājasyaṃ diśāṃ jatravo'dityai bhasajjīmūtān hṛdayaupaśenāntarikṣaṃ purītatā nabha udaryeṇa cakravākau matasnābhyāṃ divaṃ vṛkkābhyāṃ girīn plāśibhirupalān plīhnā valmīkān klomabhirglaubhirgulmān hirābhi: sravantīrhradān kukṣibhyā samudramudareṇa vaiśvānaraṃ bhasmanā
verses.wordMeaning: His chest belongs to Indra; his belly to Aditi; his clavicles to the Quarters; his nether hind-part to Aditi. I gratify Clouds with his aorta; Firmament with his pericardium; Mist with his belly; the two Chakravâkas with his cardiac bones; Sky with his kidneys;…
verses.commentary: Sense: His chest belongs to Indra; his belly to Aditi; his clavicles to the Quarters; his nether hind-part to Aditi. I gratify Clouds with his aorta; Firmament with his pericardium; Mist with his belly; the two Chakravâkas with his cardiac bones; Sky with his kidneys;…

verses.sanskrit: विधृ॑तिं॒ नाभ्या॑ धृ॒तᳪ रसे॑ना॒पो यू॒ष्णा मरी॑चीर्वि॒प्रुड्भि॑र्नीहा॒रमू॒ष्मणा॑ शी॒नं वस॑या॒ प्रुष्वा॒ अश्रु॑भिर्ह्रा॒दुनी॑र्दू॒षीका॑भिर॒स्ना रक्षा॑ᳪसि चि॒त्राण्यङ्गै॒र्नक्ष॑त्राणि रू॒पेण॑ पृथि॒वीं त्व॒चा जु॑म्ब॒काय॒ स्वाहा॑
verses.translation: I gratify Separation with his navel; Butter with his flavour; the Waters with his broth; Sunbeams with his drops of fat; Hoar-frost with his heat; Ice with his marrow; Hailstones with his tears; Thunderbolts with the rheum of his eyes; Râkshasas with his blood; Bright things with his limbs; Stars with his beauty; Earth with his skin. All-hail to Jumbaka!
verses.hindi: देवौँ से प्रेरणा प्राप्त कर हम कानोंसे भद्रही सुनें। आंखों से भद्र ही देखें तथा स्थिर अङ्कोवाले शरीरों से प्रभु का स्तवन करते हए देवोपासनयोग्य जीवन वितापं। शतमिन्चु शरदोऽअन्तिं देवा यत्रां नश्चक्रा जरसं तनूना॑म्। १. है देवाः देवो! शतं शरदः इत्=सौ वर्षो तक निश्चय से अन्ति आप हमारे समीप
verses.transliteration: vidhṛtiṃ nābhyā dhṛta rasenāpo yūṣṇā marīcīrvipruḍbhirnīhāramūṣmaṇā śīnaṃ vasayā pruṣvā aśrubhirhrādunīrdūṣīkābhirasnā rakṣāsi citrāṇyaṅgairnakṣatrāṇi rūpeṇa pṛthivīṃ tvacā jumbakāya svāhā
verses.wordMeaning: I gratify Separation with his navel; Butter with his flavour; the Waters with his broth; Sunbeams with his drops of fat; Hoar-frost with his heat; Ice with his marrow; Hailstones with his tears; Thunderbolts with the rheum of his eyes; Râkshasas with his blood;…
verses.commentary: Sense: I gratify Separation with his navel; Butter with his flavour; the Waters with his broth; Sunbeams with his drops of fat; Hoar-frost with his heat; Ice with his marrow; Hailstones with his tears; Thunderbolts with the rheum of his eyes; Râkshasas with his blood;…

verses.sanskrit:
हि॒र॒ण्य॒ग॒र्भः सम॑वर्त॒ताग्रे॑ भू॒तस्य॑ जा॒तः पति॒रेक॑ आसीत् ।
स दा॑धार पृथि॒वीं द्यामु॒तेमां कस्मै॑ दे॒वाय॑ ह॒विषा॑ विधेम
verses.translation: In the beginning rose Hiranyagarbha, etc., as in XIII. 4; XXIII. 1.
verses.hindi: जेसे वृद्धावस्था में भी शरीर के लिए भोजन आवश्यक होता टै उसी प्रकार मानस पोषण के लिए देवों कौ प्रेरणा भी आवश्यक होती हे। इन प्रेरणाओं से हम मार्ग में नहीं रुक जाते, अपितु पूर्णं जीवन को प्राप्त करनैवाले होते हे। -विष्करैदेवाऽअल्ध्तिः पञ्च जनाऽअदि'तिर्जातमद्ि'तिर्जनिंत्वम्॥ २३
verses.transliteration: hiraṇyagarbhaḥ samavartatāgre bhūtasya jātaḥ patireka āsīt | sa dādhāra pṛthivīṃ dyāmutemāṃ kasmai devāya haviṣā vidhema
verses.wordMeaning: In the beginning rose Hiranyagarbha, etc., as in XIII. 4; XXIII. 1.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the beginning rose Hiranyagarbha, etc., as in XIII. 4; XXIII. 1.

verses.sanskrit:
यः प्रा॑ण॒तो नि॑मिष॒तो म॑हित्वैक॒ इद्राजा॒ जग॑तो ब॒भूव॑ ।
य ईशे॑ अ॒स्य द्वि॒पद॒श्चतु॑ष्पद॒: कस्मै॑ दे॒वाय॑ ह॒विषा॑ विधेम
verses.translation: Who by his grandeur, etc., as in XXIII. 3.
verses.hindi: तीनों लोक तथा घर के मुख्य व्यक्ति राष्ट के सब देव त जनता, भूत, भविष्य में होनेवाले पदार्थ व व्यक्ति सभी हमारे अनुकूल हों! इनकी अनुकूलता हमारे अखण्डन व स्वास्थ्य के लिए हो। सारी प्रजा मेरे स्वास्थ्य के लिए हो। मैं भी " प्रजापति" वनू। यद्वाजिनो देवजा॑तस्य सप्तेः प्रवक्ष्यामो विदथे वीराणि।॥॥ २४॥
verses.transliteration: yaḥ prāṇato nimiṣato mahitvaika idrājā jagato babhūva | ya īśe asya dvipadaścatuṣpada: kasmai devāya haviṣā vidhema
verses.wordMeaning: Who by his grandeur, etc., as in XXIII. 3.
verses.commentary: Sense: Who by his grandeur, etc., as in XXIII. 3.

verses.sanskrit:
यस्ये॒मे हि॒मव॑न्तो महि॒त्वा यस्य॑ समु॒द्रᳪ र॒सया॑ स॒हाहुः ।
यस्ये॒माः प्र॒दिशो॒ यस्य॑ बा॒हू कस्मै॑ दे॒वाय॑ ह॒विषा॑ विधेम
verses.translation: Whose, by his might, are these snow-covered mountains, and men call sea and Rasâ his possession: Whose are these arms, whose are these heavenly regions. What God shall we adore with our oblation?
verses.hindi: (क) हम धन से अपने को आच्छादित करें, अर्थात् खूब कमा, परन्तु शुद्ध साधनों से। (ख) इस धन का मुख्य उपयोग दान हो--दान देकर बचे युए को ही खाने का विचार करर। (ग) प्रभु को हृदयस्थ कर ज्ञान के प्रकाश को प्राप्त करे। (घ) उसी अन्न का सेवन करें जो संयम व पोषण की दृष्टि से ठीक हो।
verses.transliteration: yasyeme himavanto mahitvā yasya samudra rasayā sahāhuḥ | yasyemāḥ pradiśo yasya bāhū kasmai devāya haviṣā vidhema
verses.wordMeaning: Whose, by his might, are these snow-covered mountains, and men call sea and Rasâ his possession: Whose are these arms, whose are these heavenly regions. What God shall we adore with our oblation?
verses.commentary: Sense: Whose, by his might, are these snow-covered mountains, and men call sea and Rasâ his possession: Whose are these arms, whose are these heavenly regions. What God shall we adore with our oblation?

verses.sanskrit:
य आ॑त्म॒दा ब॑ल॒दा यस्य॒ विश्व॑ उ॒पास॑ते प्र॒शिषं॒ यस्य॑ दे॒वाः ।
यस्य॑ छा॒यामृतं॒ यस्य॑ मृ॒त्युः कस्मै॑ दे॒वाय॑ ह॒विषा॑ विधेम
verses.translation: Giver of vital breath, of power and vigour, he whose commandment all the Gods acknowledge: The Lord of death, whose shade is life immortal. What God shall we adore with our oblation?
verses.hindi: हम काम-क्रोधादि का छेदन करं, पोषक अत्न का सेवन करं, दिव्य गुणों कौ प्राप्ति हमारा लक्ष्य हो। एसा होने पर प्रभु हमारी उन्नति का कारण बनेगे। हम यज्ञशेष का ही सेवन करेगे तो ज्ञानदीप्त प्रभु हमें ज्ञान से प्रसादयुक्तं करेगे। यद्धविष्यमृतुशो देवयानं त्रिर्मानुषाः पर्यश्वं नयं॑स्ति।
verses.transliteration: ya ātmadā baladā yasya viśva upāsate praśiṣaṃ yasya devāḥ | yasya chāyāmṛtaṃ yasya mṛtyuḥ kasmai devāya haviṣā vidhema
verses.wordMeaning: Giver of vital breath, of power and vigour, he whose commandment all the Gods acknowledge: The Lord of death, whose shade is life immortal. What God shall we adore with our oblation?
verses.commentary: Sense: Giver of vital breath, of power and vigour, he whose commandment all the Gods acknowledge: The Lord of death, whose shade is life immortal. What God shall we adore with our oblation?

verses.sanskrit:
आ नो॑ भ॒द्राः क्रत॑वो यन्तु वि॒श्वतोऽद॑ब्धासो॒ अप॑रीतास उ॒द्भिद॑: ।
दे॒वा नो॒ यथा॒ सद॒मिद् वृ॒धे अस॒न्नप्रा॑युवो रक्षि॒तारो॑ दि॒वे – दि॑वे
verses.translation: May powers auspicious come to us from every side, never deceived, unhindered and victorious, That the Gods ever may be with us for our gain, our guardians day by day, unceasing in their care.
verses.hindi: हम ठवि के प्रयोग में उत्तम हो, देवयान मार्गं से चले। सदा प्रभु का स्मरण करे, शरीर को सुपुष्ट करे, प्रभु से दिये गये यज्ञ को अपनार्ण। होताध्वर्युराव॑याऽअग्निमिन्धो ग्रावग्राभऽउत शश्प्स्ता सुविप्रः । तेन॑ यज्ञेन स्त्ररङःकृतेन स्विष्टेन वक्षणा आ पूंणध्वम्॥।२८॥
verses.transliteration: ā no bhadrāḥ kratavo yantu viśvato'dabdhāso aparītāsa udbhida: | devā no yathā sadamid vṛdhe asannaprāyuvo rakṣitāro dive – dive
verses.wordMeaning: May powers auspicious come to us from every side, never deceived, unhindered and victorious, That the Gods ever may be with us for our gain, our guardians day by day, unceasing in their care.
verses.commentary: Sense: May powers auspicious come to us from every side, never deceived, unhindered and victorious, That the Gods ever may be with us for our gain, our guardians day by day, unceasing in their care.

verses.sanskrit:
दे॒वानां॑ भ॒द्रा सु॑म॒तिरृ॑जूय॒तां दे॒वाना॑ᳪ रा॒तिर॒भि नो॒ निव॑र्तताम् ।
दे॒वाना॑ᳪ स॒ख्यमुप॑सेदिमा व॒यं दे॒वा न॒ आयु॒: प्रति॑रन्तु जी॒वसे॑
verses.translation: May the auspicious favour of the Gods be ours, on us descend the bounty of the righteous Gods. The friendship of the Gods have we devoutly sought: so may the Gods extend our life that we may live.
verses.hindi: जीवन को सप्तहोताओ से चलनेवाला यज्ञ बनाओ। यज्ञ को उत्तम भावना से व उत्तम प्रकार से करते हुए् तुम अपनी सवर उच्नतियों को सिद्ध करो। युूपत्रस्काऽउत ये युंपवाहाश्चषालं येऽअंश्वयूुपाय तक्ष॑ति। १. गतमन्त्र में जीवन को यज्ञमय बनाने का उल्लेख दहै। उस “जीवन-यञ्न' की
verses.transliteration: devānāṃ bhadrā sumatirṛjūyatāṃ devānā rātirabhi no nivartatām | devānā sakhyamupasedimā vayaṃ devā na āyu: pratirantu jīvase
verses.wordMeaning: May the auspicious favour of the Gods be ours, on us descend the bounty of the righteous Gods. The friendship of the Gods have we devoutly sought: so may the Gods extend our life that we may live.
verses.commentary: Sense: May the auspicious favour of the Gods be ours, on us descend the bounty of the righteous Gods. The friendship of the Gods have we devoutly sought: so may the Gods extend our life that we may live.

verses.sanskrit:
तान्पूर्व॑या नि॒विदा॑ हूमहे व॒यं भगं॑ मि॒त्रमदि॑तिं॒ दक्ष॑म॒स्रिध॑म् ।
अ॒र्य॒मणं॒ वरु॑ण॒ᳪ सोम॑म॒श्विना॒ सर॑स्वती नः सु॒भगा॒ मय॑स्करत्
verses.translation: We call them hither with a hymn of olden time, Bhaga, the friendly Daksha, Mitra, Aditi, Aryaman, Varuna, Soma, the Asvins. May Sarasvatî, auspicious, grant felicity.
verses.hindi: प्रभु हमे प्राप्त होते हैः तो हमारे अन्तःज्ञान का स्रोत उमड् पडता हे। हम एक अनुपम आनन्द अनुभव करते है, प्रभु का यह उपासन हमारी हैवी प्रवृत्ति को बाता है। यद्वां घास्य प्रभुंतमास्यु, तृणःसर्वां ता तेऽअपिं दे वेष्व॑स्तु॥३९॥ १. गतमन्त्र की समाप्ति इन शब्दों पर थी कि "दिव्य गुणों के पोषण के निमित्त हम
verses.transliteration: tānpūrvayā nividā hūmahe vayaṃ bhagaṃ mitramaditiṃ dakṣamasridham | aryamaṇaṃ varuṇa somamaśvinā sarasvatī naḥ subhagā mayaskarat
verses.wordMeaning: We call them hither with a hymn of olden time, Bhaga, the friendly Daksha, Mitra, Aditi, Aryaman, Varuna, Soma, the Asvins. May Sarasvatî, auspicious, grant felicity.
verses.commentary: Sense: We call them hither with a hymn of olden time, Bhaga, the friendly Daksha, Mitra, Aditi, Aryaman, Varuna, Soma, the Asvins. May Sarasvatî, auspicious, grant felicity.

verses.sanskrit:
तन्नो॒ वातो॑ मयो॒भु वा॑तु भेष॒जं तन्मा॒ता पृ॑थि॒वी तत्पि॒ता द्यौ॑: ।
तद् ग्रावा॑णः सोम॒सुतो॑ मयो॒भुव॒स्तद॑श्विना शृणुतं धिष्ण्या यु॒वम्
verses.translation: May the Wind waft to us that pleasant medicine, may Earth our Mother give it, and our Father Heaven, And the joy-giving stones that press the Soma's juice. Asvins, may ye, for whom our spirits long, hear this.
verses.hindi: इस मन्त्र में दिव्य गुणों के लिए पच बातें कही गई है १. शक्तिशाली बनकर ग्रीवा को संयत रखना, कोई अवाच्छनीय शब्द न बोलना, बोलचाल का नपा-तुला होना। २. बुराई के संहार के उदेश्य से पांव को बन्धन में रखना। चाल-ढाल को संयत रखना, व्यर्थ क्रिया नहीं करना। ३. शिरः बन्धन को अपनाना, सब जानेन्द्रियो कौ क्रियाओं
verses.transliteration: tanno vāto mayobhu vātu bheṣajaṃ tanmātā pṛthivī tatpitā dyau: | tad grāvāṇaḥ somasuto mayobhuvastadaśvinā śṛṇutaṃ dhiṣṇyā yuvam
verses.wordMeaning: May the Wind waft to us that pleasant medicine, may Earth our Mother give it, and our Father Heaven, And the joy-giving stones that press the Soma's juice. Asvins, may ye, for whom our spirits long, hear this.
verses.commentary: Sense: May the Wind waft to us that pleasant medicine, may Earth our Mother give it, and our Father Heaven, And the joy-giving stones that press the Soma's juice. Asvins, may ye, for whom our spirits long, hear this.

verses.sanskrit:
तमीशा॑नं॒ जग॑तस्त॒स्थुष॒स्पतिं॑ धियञ्जि॒न्वमव॑से हूमहे व॒यम् ।
पू॒षा नो॒ यथा॒ वेद॑सा॒मस॑द् वृ॒धे र॑क्षि॒ता पा॒युरद॑ब्धः स्व॒स्तये॑
verses.translation: Him we invoke for aid who reigns supreme, the Lord of all that stands or moves, inspirer of the soul, That Pûshan may promote the increase of our wealth, our keeper and our guard infallible for our good.
verses.hindi: हम सात्विक पदार्थो का ही सेवन करे ओर उन सात्विक पदार्थो का सदा उचित परिपाक करके ही सेवन करे। फलों का भी कच्चे व गलेरूप में कभी सेवन न करे। मा तद्धूम्यामाश्चिंषन्मा तृणेषु देवेभ्यस्तदुराद् भ्यो रातमंस्तु॥। ३४॥ १९. गतमन्त्र के अनुसार जब हम सात्विक भोजन का ! शृतपाक पचन '-उचित पचन
verses.transliteration: tamīśānaṃ jagatastasthuṣaspatiṃ dhiyañjinvamavase hūmahe vayam | pūṣā no yathā vedasāmasad vṛdhe rakṣitā pāyuradabdhaḥ svastaye
verses.wordMeaning: Him we invoke for aid who reigns supreme, the Lord of all that stands or moves, inspirer of the soul, That Pûshan may promote the increase of our wealth, our keeper and our guard infallible for our good.
verses.commentary: Sense: Him we invoke for aid who reigns supreme, the Lord of all that stands or moves, inspirer of the soul, That Pûshan may promote the increase of our wealth, our keeper and our guard infallible for our good.

verses.sanskrit:
स्व॒स्ति न॒ इन्द्रो॑ वृ॒द्धश्र॑वाः स्व॒स्ति न॑: पू॒षा वि॒श्ववे॑दाः ।
स्व॒स्ति न॒स्तार्क्ष्यो॒ अरि॑ष्टनेमिः स्व॒स्ति नो॒ बृह॒स्पति॑र्दधातु
verses.translation: Illustrious far and wide, may Indra prosper us: may Pûshan prosper us, the Master of all wealth. May Târkshya with uninjured fellies prosper us: Brihaspati vouchsafe to us prosperity.
verses.hindi: भोजन के परिपाक से उत्सन्न वीर्य का सर्वोत्तम विनियोग यही है कि हम उसे शरीर में सुरक्षित रक्खें, जिससे शरीर मे रोग उत्पन्न न हों ओर हमारे मनो में दिव्य गुणों का विकास हो, मस्तिष्क में ज्ञानाग्नि दीप्त हो। १. गतमन्त्र मेँ वीर्यरक्षा के महत्त्व का प्रतिपादन है। आचार्य गुरुकुलो मे विद्यार्थी के
verses.transliteration: svasti na indro vṛddhaśravāḥ svasti na: pūṣā viśvavedāḥ | svasti nastārkṣyo ariṣṭanemiḥ svasti no bṛhaspatirdadhātu
verses.wordMeaning: Illustrious far and wide, may Indra prosper us: may Pûshan prosper us, the Master of all wealth. May Târkshya with uninjured fellies prosper us: Brihaspati vouchsafe to us prosperity.
verses.commentary: Sense: Illustrious far and wide, may Indra prosper us: may Pûshan prosper us, the Master of all wealth. May Târkshya with uninjured fellies prosper us: Brihaspati vouchsafe to us prosperity.

verses.sanskrit:
पृष॑दश्वा म॒रुत॒: पृश्नि॑मातरः शुभं॒यावा॑नो वि॒दथे॑षु॒ जग्म॑यः ।
अ॒ग्नि॒जि॒ह्वा मन॑व॒: सूर॑चक्षसो॒ विश्वे॑ नो दे॒वा अव॒साग॑मन्नि॒ह
verses.translation: The Maruts, Sons of Prisni, borne by spotted steeds, moving in glory, oft visiting holy rites, Sages whose tongue is Agni and their eyes the Sun,——hither let all the Gods for our protection come.
verses.hindi: आचार्य का कर्तव्य है कि (क) विद्यार्थी को दुद शरीरवाला बनाये (वाजिनम्) (ख) उसके ज्ञान को परिपक्व करे (पक्वम्) , (ग) उसको सुरभि बनाये- सुन्दर शरीरवाला, बुद्धिमान् व दिव्य गुणसम्पन्न करे। (घ) उसे इस ज्ञान को दूर-दूर तक फैलाने का निर्देश करे (-निर्हरः इति), (ङ) लोकहित के लिए जीवन को खपा देने की प्रेरणा
verses.transliteration: pṛṣadaśvā maruta: pṛśnimātaraḥ śubhaṃyāvāno vidatheṣu jagmayaḥ | agnijihvā manava: sūracakṣaso viśve no devā avasāgamanniha
verses.wordMeaning: The Maruts, Sons of Prisni, borne by spotted steeds, moving in glory, oft visiting holy rites, Sages whose tongue is Agni and their eyes the Sun,——hither let all the Gods for our protection come.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Maruts, Sons of Prisni, borne by spotted steeds, moving in glory, oft visiting holy rites, Sages whose tongue is Agni and their eyes the Sun,——hither let all the Gods for our protection come.

verses.sanskrit:
भ॒द्रं कर्णे॑भिः शृणुयाम देवा भ॒द्रं प॑श्येमा॒क्षभि॑र्यजत्राः ।
स्थि॒रैरङ्गै॑स्तुष्टु॒वाᳪस॑स्त॒नूभि॒र्व्य॒शेमहि दे॒वहि॑तं॒ यदायु॑:
verses.translation: Gods, may we with our ears listen to what is good, and with our eyes see what is good, ye Holy Ones. With limbs and bodies firm may we extolling you attain the term of life appointed by the Gods.
verses.hindi: यह शरीर परिपाक द्वारा मांसादि धातुओं का निर्माण करनेवाली उखा (देगची ) है। इसमें १. ज्ञानेन्द्रियोँ से उस-उस विषय के ग्रहण कौ प्रक्रिया २. ग्रन्थियों से रसों का आसेचन ३. गर्मी को सुरक्षित करनेवाली ढक्कन के समान यह त्वचा ४. विषयों का ग्रहण व प्रवचन-ये सब बातें बडी ही अद्भुत है। ये इस उखा में रहकर कार्यव्याप्त
verses.transliteration: bhadraṃ karṇebhiḥ śṛṇuyāma devā bhadraṃ paśyemākṣabhiryajatrāḥ | sthirairaṅgaistuṣṭuvāsastanūbhirvyaśemahi devahitaṃ yadāyu:
verses.wordMeaning: Gods, may we with our ears listen to what is good, and with our eyes see what is good, ye Holy Ones. With limbs and bodies firm may we extolling you attain the term of life appointed by the Gods.
verses.commentary: Sense: Gods, may we with our ears listen to what is good, and with our eyes see what is good, ye Holy Ones. With limbs and bodies firm may we extolling you attain the term of life appointed by the Gods.

verses.sanskrit:
श॒तमिन्नु श॒रदो॒ अन्ति॑ देवा॒ यत्रा॑ नश्च॒क्रा ज॒रसं॑ त॒नूना॑म् ।
पु॒त्रासो॒ यत्र॑ पि॒तरो॒ भव॑न्ति॒ मा नो॑ म॒ध्या री॑रिष॒तायु॒र्गन्तो॑:
verses.translation: A hundred autumns stand before us, O ye Gods, within whose space ye bring our bodies to decay; Within whose space our sons become fathers in turn. Break ye not in the midst our course of fleeting life.
verses.hindi: कामाग्नि का शिकार न होने पर ज्ञान दीप्त रहता है, शरीर तेजस्वी बना रहता हे। कामाग्नि से बचने का उपाय यही है कि हम यज्ञादि उत्तम कर्मो में लगे रहे। यच्च॑ पपो यच्च॑ घासिं जघास सर्वां ता तेऽअपिं देवेष्व॑स्तु।। ३८॥ १. गतमन्त्र के विषय को ही प्रस्तुत करते हए कहते है ते=तेरी ता सर्वातवे सब वाते
verses.transliteration: śataminnu śarado anti devā yatrā naścakrā jarasaṃ tanūnām | putrāso yatra pitaro bhavanti mā no madhyā rīriṣatāyurganto:
verses.wordMeaning: A hundred autumns stand before us, O ye Gods, within whose space ye bring our bodies to decay; Within whose space our sons become fathers in turn. Break ye not in the midst our course of fleeting life.
verses.commentary: Sense: A hundred autumns stand before us, O ye Gods, within whose space ye bring our bodies to decay; Within whose space our sons become fathers in turn. Break ye not in the midst our course of fleeting life.

verses.sanskrit:
अदि॑तिर्द्यौ॒रदि॑तिर॒न्तरि॑क्ष॒मदि॑तिर्मा॒ता स पि॒ता स पु॒त्रः ।
विश्वे॑ दे॒वा अदि॑ति॒: पञ्च॒ जना॒ अदि॑तिर्जा॒तमदि॑ति॒र्जनि॑त्वम्
verses.translation: Aditi is the heaven, Aditi is mid-air, Aditi is the Mother and the Sire and Son. Aditi is all Gods, Aditi five-classed men, Aditi all that hath been born and shall be born.
verses.hindi: आचार्य कर्मठ विद्यार्थी को ' प्रकृति- विज्ञान , आत्मज्ञान, हितरमणीय बातों के प्रति रुचि, भोजन का संयम व गति का नियमन' इन बातों को प्राप्त कराके हैवी सम्पत्तिवाला बनाने का प्रयत्न करते है। १. गतमन््र के अनुसार विद्यार्थी आचार्य से अनुशिष्ट होकर इन्द्रियो का अधिष्ठाता
verses.transliteration: aditirdyauraditirantarikṣamaditirmātā sa pitā sa putraḥ | viśve devā aditi: pañca janā aditirjātamaditirjanitvam
verses.wordMeaning: Aditi is the heaven, Aditi is mid-air, Aditi is the Mother and the Sire and Son. Aditi is all Gods, Aditi five-classed men, Aditi all that hath been born and shall be born.
verses.commentary: Sense: Aditi is the heaven, Aditi is mid-air, Aditi is the Mother and the Sire and Son. Aditi is all Gods, Aditi five-classed men, Aditi all that hath been born and shall be born.

verses.sanskrit:
मा नो॑ मि॒त्रो वरु॑णो अर्य॒मायुरिन्द्र॑ ऋभु॒क्षा म॒रुत॒: परि॑ ख्यन् ।
यद्वा॒जिनो॑ दे॒वजा॑तस्य॒ सप्ते॑: प्रव॒क्ष्यामो॑ वि॒दथे॑ वी॒र्या॒णि
verses.translation: Slight us not Varuna, Aryaman, or Mitra, Ribhukshan, Indra, Âyu, or the Maruts, When we declare amid the congregation the virtues of the Strong Steed, God-descended.
verses.hindi: आचार्य ने विद्यार्थी को "त्वष्टा व अश्व ' दीप्त व सबल बनाना है। इसके लिए वह ऋतुओं के अनुसार सब क्रियाओं को करता हआ विद्यार्थीरूप अग्नि मे बलों की आहति देता हे, अर्थात् उन्हे सर्वाह्ध सबल बनाने का प्रयत्न करता है। १. गतमन्त्र के अनुसार जब आचार्य विद्यार्थी का दीक से निर्माण करता है, तब यह
verses.transliteration: mā no mitro varuṇo aryamāyurindra ṛbhukṣā maruta: pari khyan | yadvājino devajātasya sapte: pravakṣyāmo vidathe vīryāṇi
verses.wordMeaning: Slight us not Varuna, Aryaman, or Mitra, Ribhukshan, Indra, Âyu, or the Maruts, When we declare amid the congregation the virtues of the Strong Steed, God-descended.
verses.commentary: Sense: Slight us not Varuna, Aryaman, or Mitra, Ribhukshan, Indra, Âyu, or the Maruts, When we declare amid the congregation the virtues of the Strong Steed, God-descended.

verses.sanskrit:
यन्नि॒र्णिजा॒ रेक्ण॑सा॒ प्रावृ॑तस्य रा॒तिं गृ॑भी॒तां मु॑ख॒तो नय॑न्ति ।
सुप्रा॑ङ॒जो मेम्य॑द्वि॒श्वरू॑प इन्द्रापू॒ष्णोः प्रि॒यमप्ये॑ति॒ पाथ॑:
verses.translation: What time they bear before the Courser, covered with trappings and with wealth, the grasped oblation, The dappled goat goeth straightforward, bleating, to the place dear to Indra and to Pûshan.
verses.hindi: ज्लानी पुरुष शरीर को छोडता हुआ इस प्रकार आत्मप्रेरणा देता है कि तू मर थोडे ही रहादहै, तू हास को नहीं प्राप्त हो रहा। सरल मार्ग से जीवन बिताकर तू देवलोक को प्राप्त करेगा। तेरी इन्द्रिय योगयुक्त तथा अपने में ज्ञान व शक्ति का सेचन करनेवाली बनें ओर यह सब इस कारण कि तुद्धे शब्दज्ञान देनेवाले उपाध्यायो का अग्रणी
