अध॑ वा॒युं नि॒युत॑: सश्चत॒ स्वा उ॒त श्वे॒तं वसु॑धितिं निरे॒के
verses.translation: The God whom both these worlds brought forth for riches, whom heavenly Dhishanâ for our wealth appointeth— His team of harnessed horses waits on Vâyu and, foremost, on the radiant treasure-holder.
verses.hindi: हे प्रभो! आप "एकमेवाद्वितीयम् ' इन शब्दों के अनुसार एक ही अद्वितीय हो। आप हमें सशक्त कर्मद्दरियो को, शक्ति को व उत्तम ज्ञानेन्द्रिय को प्राप्त कराडए। कऋषिः--शंयुर्बार्दस्पत्यः। देवता-इन्द्रः। छन्दः-निचृदनुष्टुप्। स्वरः गान्ारः। त्वामिच्ि हवांमहे सातौ वाज॑स्य कारव॑ः।
verses.transliteration: rāye nu yaṃ jajñatū rodasīme rāye devī dhiṣaṇā dhāti devam | adha vāyuṃ niyuta: saścata svā uta śvetaṃ vasudhitiṃ nireke
verses.wordMeaning: The God whom both these worlds brought forth for riches, whom heavenly Dhishanâ for our wealth appointeth— His team of harnessed horses waits on Vâyu and, foremost, on the radiant treasure-holder.
verses.commentary: Sense: The God whom both these worlds brought forth for riches, whom heavenly Dhishanâ for our wealth appointeth— His team of harnessed horses waits on Vâyu and, foremost, on the radiant treasure-holder.

verses.sanskrit:
आपो॑ ह॒ यद्बृ॑ह॒तीर्विश्व॒माय॒न् गर्भं॒ दधा॑ना ज॒नय॑न्तीर॒ग्निम् ।
ततो॑ दे॒वाना॒ᳪ सम॑वर्त॒तासु॒रेक॒: कस्मै॑ दे॒वाय॑ ह॒विषा॑ विधेम
verses.translation: With thy yoked teams in hundreds and in thousands come to our sacrifice and solemn worship.
verses.hindi: हे प्रभो! आपकी कृपा से हम (क) शक्ति प्राप्त करें (ख) वासना- संग्राम मे विजय हों। ३. इन्द्रियरूप घोडौं को लक्ष्यस्थान पर पहँचानेवाले बने। ङात्रुओं का धर्षण त विजय १. है प्रभो! सः त्वम्-वे आप जोकि चित्रः-अन्दुत है, जिनके समान न कोई है ओर
verses.transliteration: āpo ha yadbṛhatīrviśvamāyan garbhaṃ dadhānā janayantīragnim | tato devānā samavartatāsureka: kasmai devāya haviṣā vidhema
verses.wordMeaning: With thy yoked teams in hundreds and in thousands come to our sacrifice and solemn worship.
verses.commentary: Sense: With thy yoked teams in hundreds and in thousands come to our sacrifice and solemn worship.

verses.sanskrit:
यश्चि॒दापो॑ महि॒ना प॒र्यप॑श्य॒द्दक्षं॒ दधा॑ना ज॒नय॑न्तीर्य॒ज्ञम् ।
यो दे॒वेष्वधि॑ दे॒व एक॒ आसी॒त् कस्मै॑ दे॒वाय॑ ह॒विषा॑ विधेम
verses.translation: Who in his might surveyed the floods enclosing productive force and generating Worship, He who is God mid Gods, and none beside him—What God shall we adore with our oblation?
verses.hindi: हे प्रभो! हमें उत्तम ज्लानेन्दियाँ व कर्मन्िर्योँ प्राप्त कराइए। हमें वह शक्ति ९. गतमन्त्र के अनुसार उत्तम ज्तानेन्दरियो, कर्मेन्द्रियों व शरीर को प्राप्त करके यह “वामदेव "सुन्दर दिव्य गुणोवाला बनता है ओर प्रभु-स्तवन करते हए कहता है कि चित्रः= वह ज्ञान देनेवाले अद्धुत परमात्मा कया ऊती=किस कल्याणकारक रक्षण के द्वारा नः
verses.transliteration: yaścidāpo mahinā paryapaśyaddakṣaṃ dadhānā janayantīryajñam | yo deveṣvadhi deva eka āsīt kasmai devāya haviṣā vidhema
verses.wordMeaning: Who in his might surveyed the floods enclosing productive force and generating Worship, He who is God mid Gods, and none beside him—What God shall we adore with our oblation?
verses.commentary: Sense: Who in his might surveyed the floods enclosing productive force and generating Worship, He who is God mid Gods, and none beside him—What God shall we adore with our oblation?

verses.sanskrit:
प्र याभि॒र्यासि॑ दा॒श्वाᳪस॒मच्छा॑ नि॒युद्भि॑र्वायवि॒ष्टये॑ दुरो॒णे ।
नि नो॑ र॒यिᳪ सु॒भोज॑सं युवस्व॒ नि वी॒रं गव्य॒मश्व्यं॑ च॒ राध॑:
verses.translation: The teams wherewith thou seekest him who offers, within his house, O Vâyu, to direct him, Therewith send wealth to us with full enjoyment, a hero son and gifts of kine and horses.
verses.hindi: प्रभु का रक्षण व मास, ऋतु आदि के परिवर्तन से शक्ति का वर्धन-ये दोनों हमारे लिए कल्याणकर हे। ऋषि :ः-वामदेवः। देवता-इन्द्रः। छन्दः-निचुद्गायत्री। स्वरः षड्जः। कस्त्वा सत्यो मदानां मध्हिष्ठो मत्स॒दन्ध॑सः । दृढा चिदारुजे वसुं॥४०॥
verses.transliteration: pra yābhiryāsi dāśvāsamacchā niyudbhirvāyaviṣṭaye duroṇe | ni no rayi subhojasaṃ yuvasva ni vīraṃ gavyamaśvyaṃ ca rādha:
verses.wordMeaning: The teams wherewith thou seekest him who offers, within his house, O Vâyu, to direct him, Therewith send wealth to us with full enjoyment, a hero son and gifts of kine and horses.
verses.commentary: Sense: The teams wherewith thou seekest him who offers, within his house, O Vâyu, to direct him, Therewith send wealth to us with full enjoyment, a hero son and gifts of kine and horses.

verses.sanskrit:
आ नो॑ नि॒युद्भि॑: श॒तिनी॑भिरध्व॒रᳪ स॑ह॒स्रिणी॑भि॒रुप॑ याहि य॒ज्ञम् ।
वायो॑ अ॒स्मिन्त्सव॑ने मादयस्व यू॒यं पा॑त स्व॒स्तिभि॒: सदा॑ नः
verses.translation: O Vâyu, make thee glad at this libation. Preserve us evermore, ye Gods, with blessings.
verses.hindi: वे अनिर्वचनीय, आनन्दमय, सत्यस्वरूप, सर्वाधिक आनन्द के दाता प्रभु सोमरक्षा के द्वारा हमारे जीवन को उल्लास से युक्त करते है। वे कठोर स्वर्णादि धनँ कौ बँट-बोँटकर सबके लिए देते हे। ९. है प्रभो! आप नः सखीनाम्-हम मित्रं के अभि-आभिमुख्येन के अविता=उत्तम
verses.transliteration: ā no niyudbhi: śatinībhiradhvara sahasriṇībhirupa yāhi yajñam | vāyo asmintsavane mādayasva yūyaṃ pāta svastibhi: sadā naḥ
verses.wordMeaning: O Vâyu, make thee glad at this libation. Preserve us evermore, ye Gods, with blessings.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Vâyu, make thee glad at this libation. Preserve us evermore, ye Gods, with blessings.

verses.sanskrit:
नि॒युत्वा॑न्वाय॒वा ग॑ह्य॒यᳪ शु॒क्रो अ॑यामि ते ।
गन्ता॑सि सुन्व॒तो गृ॒हम्
verses.translation: Drawn by thy team, O Vâyu, come: to thee is offered this, the pure. Thou visitest the presser's house.
verses.hindi: हम प्रभु के सखा व स्तोता बनें, हमें प्रभुरक्षण प्राप्त होगा। यज्ञायज्ञा वोऽअग्नयें गिरागिरा च दक्ष॑से। प्रप्र॑ वयममुतं जातवेदसं प्रियं यित्रं न शःसिषम् ॥।४२।॥ ९. गतमन्त्र के अनुसार प्रभु का सखा व स्तोता बनकर प्रभु का रक्षण प्राप्त करनेवाला
verses.transliteration: niyutvānvāyavā gahyaya śukro ayāmi te | gantāsi sunvato gṛham
verses.wordMeaning: Drawn by thy team, O Vâyu, come: to thee is offered this, the pure. Thou visitest the presser's house.
verses.commentary: Sense: Drawn by thy team, O Vâyu, come: to thee is offered this, the pure. Thou visitest the presser's house.

verses.sanskrit:
वायो॑ शु॒क्रो अ॑यामि ते॒ मध्वो॒ अग्रं॒ दिवि॑ष्टिषु ।
आ या॑हि॒ सोम॑पीतये स्पा॒र्हो दे॑व नि॒युत्व॑ता
verses.translation: Vâyu, the bright is offered thee, best of the meath at holy rites. Come thou to drink the Soma juice, God longed-for, on thy team-drawn car.
verses.hindi: प्रभु अमृत हें, यज्ञो दारा उन्नत होते हए हम भौ अमर बनने का प्रयत्न करे। प्रभु जातवेदाः है, प्रभु से दी गई इन ज्ञान की वाणि से ठम भी अपनी योग्यता को बढ्ानेवाले ों। संक्षेप में ' अमृत व जातवेदाः" बनकर ही हम शयु '=शान्ति को प्राप्त होनैवाले होगे। १. गतमन्त्र मेँ "गिरागिरा च दक्षसे ' इस वाक्य में जिस ज्ञान की वाणी का उल्लेख था,
verses.transliteration: vāyo śukro ayāmi te madhvo agraṃ diviṣṭiṣu | ā yāhi somapītaye spārho deva niyutvatā
verses.wordMeaning: Vâyu, the bright is offered thee, best of the meath at holy rites. Come thou to drink the Soma juice, God longed-for, on thy team-drawn car.
verses.commentary: Sense: Vâyu, the bright is offered thee, best of the meath at holy rites. Come thou to drink the Soma juice, God longed-for, on thy team-drawn car.

verses.sanskrit:
वा॒युर॑ग्रे॒गा य॑ज्ञ॒प्रीः सा॒कं ग॒न्मन॑सा य॒ज्ञम् ।
शि॒वो नि॒युद्भि॑: शि॒वाभि॑:
verses.translation: Lover of worship, leader, come Vâyu with thought, to sacrifice, Propitious with propitious teams!
verses.hindi: हम ऋग्, यजुः साम व अथर्वरूप चारों वाणियों से चतुष्पाद् धर्म का सेवन करे। ऋचाओं द्वारा प्राप्त विन्लान हमारे एश्वर्य को बद्धाए्, यजु: में प्रतिपादित यज्ञ हमारी पवित्रता का कारण बनें। साम द्वारा की गई उपासना हमारे बल व प्राण का वर्धन करनेवाली हो तथा अथर्व के उपदेश से वाचस्पति बनकर हम इस शरीर व जगत् मे अपने
verses.transliteration: vāyuragregā yajñaprīḥ sākaṃ ganmanasā yajñam | śivo niyudbhi: śivābhi:
verses.wordMeaning: Lover of worship, leader, come Vâyu with thought, to sacrifice, Propitious with propitious teams!
verses.commentary: Sense: Lover of worship, leader, come Vâyu with thought, to sacrifice, Propitious with propitious teams!

verses.sanskrit:
वायो॒ ये ते॑ सह॒स्रिणो॒ रथा॑स॒स्तेभि॒रा ग॑हि ।
नि॒युत्वा॒न्त्सोम॑पीतये
verses.translation: With all the thousand chariots that are thine, O Vâyu, come to us, Team-drawn, to drink the Soma juice.
verses.hindi: प्रभुकृपा से हमारा जीवन पाञ्चों भृतो, ज्ञानेन्द्रियों, कर्मेन्द्रियों व प्राणो के दृष्टिकोण से पूर्ण हो। सब काल-विभाग हमें शक्ति देनेवाले हों। उत्तम गतिवाले होकर हम अपनी शक्ति को फैलानेवाले बनें। स्वस्थ व ज्ञानी बनकर प्रभु-संग से रसमय-जीवनवाले होकर मर्यादामय जीवनवाले हों।
verses.transliteration: vāyo ye te sahasriṇo rathāsastebhirā gahi | niyutvāntsomapītaye
verses.wordMeaning: With all the thousand chariots that are thine, O Vâyu, come to us, Team-drawn, to drink the Soma juice.
verses.commentary: Sense: With all the thousand chariots that are thine, O Vâyu, come to us, Team-drawn, to drink the Soma juice.

verses.sanskrit:
एक॑या च द॒शभि॑श्च स्वभूते॒ द्वाभ्या॑मि॒ष्टये॑ विᳪश॒ती च॑ ।
ति॒सृभि॑श्च॒ वह॑से त्रि॒ᳪशता॑ च नि॒युद्भि॑र्वायवि॒ह ता वि मु॑ञ्च
verses.translation: Come thou with one, and ten, O Self-Existent! with two unto the sacrifice, and twenty. Three are the teams and thirty which convey thee. O Vâyu, in this place unyoke thy coursers.
verses.hindi: हम दुष्टाचारणों को त्यागे, जिससे उत्तम धन ओर वीर सन्तानो से युक्त हो अनाधृष्यो जातवेदाऽअनिष्टृतो विराडग्ने श्षत्रभृदींदिदीह। १. है अग्नेप्रगतिशील जीव! इह इस कर्म में वर्तमान हृआ-हआ तू. अर्थात् गतमन्त्र के अनुसार उत्तम मार्ग मेँ चलता हआ तू विषवाः आशाः=सब दिशाओं को दीदिहिनप्रकाशमय
verses.transliteration: ekayā ca daśabhiśca svabhūte dvābhyāmiṣṭaye viśatī ca | tisṛbhiśca vahase triśatā ca niyudbhirvāyaviha tā vi muñca
verses.wordMeaning: Come thou with one, and ten, O Self-Existent! with two unto the sacrifice, and twenty. Three are the teams and thirty which convey thee. O Vâyu, in this place unyoke thy coursers.
verses.commentary: Sense: Come thou with one, and ten, O Self-Existent! with two unto the sacrifice, and twenty. Three are the teams and thirty which convey thee. O Vâyu, in this place unyoke thy coursers.

verses.sanskrit:
तव॑ वायवृतस्पते॒ त्वष्टु॑र्जामातरद्भुत ।
अवा॒ᳪस्या वृ॑णीमहे
verses.translation: Wonderful Vâyu, Lord of Truth, thou who art Tvashtar's Son in-law, Thy saving succour we elect.
verses.hindi: प्रभुभक्त अपने सुन्दर जीवन से प्रभु के यश का वर्धन करनेवाला होता हे। वह क्रोधादि से धर्षित नहीं होता, ज्ञानी बनता हे, रोगों से अहिसित होता है, चमकता हे, बल का धारण करता है, सब दिशाओं को चमकानेवाला बनता हे, मनुष्य के जीवन में अआनेवाले भयो से ऊपर उठता है, शिव भावनाओं से युक्त होता है।
verses.transliteration: tava vāyavṛtaspate tvaṣṭurjāmātaradbhuta | avāsyā vṛṇīmahe
verses.wordMeaning: Wonderful Vâyu, Lord of Truth, thou who art Tvashtar's Son in-law, Thy saving succour we elect.
verses.commentary: Sense: Wonderful Vâyu, Lord of Truth, thou who art Tvashtar's Son in-law, Thy saving succour we elect.

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒भि त्वा॑ शूर नोनु॒मोऽदु॑ग्धा इव धे॒नव॑: ।
ईशा॑नम॒स्य जग॑तः स्व॒र्दृश॒मीशा॑नमिन्द्र त॒स्थुष॑:
verses.translation: Like kine unmilked we call aloud, Hero, to thee and sing thy praise, Looker on heavenly light, Lord of this moving world, Lord, Indra! of what moveth not.
verses.hindi: प्रगतिशील जीव की इन्द्रियो शक्तियों से चमकती ठै, इसकी मानस पवित्रतां, इसका ज्ञान अत्यन्त दीप्त होते ै। इस प्रकार शरीर व चमकते हुए मस्तिष्कवाला यह अग्नि चचमकते हुए मुखवाला व प्रसन्नवदन होता हे। तनूनपादसुरो विश्ववैदा देवो देवेषुं देवः । पथो अनक्तु मध्वा घृतेन॑ ॥९२॥
verses.transliteration: abhi tvā śūra nonumo'dugdhā iva dhenava: | īśānamasya jagataḥ svardṛśamīśānamindra tasthuṣa:
verses.wordMeaning: Like kine unmilked we call aloud, Hero, to thee and sing thy praise, Looker on heavenly light, Lord of this moving world, Lord, Indra! of what moveth not.
verses.commentary: Sense: Like kine unmilked we call aloud, Hero, to thee and sing thy praise, Looker on heavenly light, Lord of this moving world, Lord, Indra! of what moveth not.

verses.sanskrit:
न त्वावाँ॑२ अ॒न्यो दि॒व्यो न पार्थि॑वो॒ न जा॒तो न ज॑निष्यते ।
अ॒श्वा॒यन्तो॑ मघवन्निन्द्र वा॒जिनो॑ ग॒व्यन्त॑स्त्वा हवामहे
verses.translation: None other like to thee, of earth or of the heavens, hath been or ever will be born. Desiring horses, Indra, Bounteous Lord! and kine, as men of might we call on thee.
verses.hindi: हम शरीर को स्वस्थ व प्राणशक्ति-सम्पन्न बना, ज्ञानी व धनी बनें, देववृत्ति- वाले. देवों के भी देव बनें। हमारे व्यवहार मुधर, निर्मल व समञ्जदारी को लिये हए हो। मध्वां यज्ञं न॑क्षसे प्रीणानो नराशद्सो अग्ने। सुकृद्ेवः सविता विरुववारः।। ९३॥। १. मध्वा माधुर्य से यज्ञम्-अपने श्रेष्ठतम कर्मो को नक्षसे=तू व्याप्त करता है अथवा
verses.transliteration: na tvāvā~2 anyo divyo na pārthivo na jāto na janiṣyate | aśvāyanto maghavannindra vājino gavyantastvā havāmahe
verses.wordMeaning: None other like to thee, of earth or of the heavens, hath been or ever will be born. Desiring horses, Indra, Bounteous Lord! and kine, as men of might we call on thee.
verses.commentary: Sense: None other like to thee, of earth or of the heavens, hath been or ever will be born. Desiring horses, Indra, Bounteous Lord! and kine, as men of might we call on thee.

verses.sanskrit:
त्वामिद्धि हवा॑महे सा॒तौ वाज॑स्य का॒रव॑: ।
त्वां वृ॒त्रेष्वि॑न्द्र॒ सत्प॑तिं॒ नर॒स्त्वां काष्ठा॒स्वर्व॑तः
verses.translation: That we may win us wealth and power, we poets call on only thee. In war men call on thee, Indra! the hero's Lord, in the steed's race-course call on thee.
verses.hindi: हम में यज्तियवृत्ति हो, हमारी जिह्वा प्रभु का नामोच्चारण करे ओर हमारी तिस्रो देवीर्बर्हिरेद रसंद न्त्विडा सर॑स्वती भार॑ती । मही गरंणाना।।९९॥ ९. ' अग्नि ' प्रगतिशील जीव प्रभु से प्रार्थना करता है कि है प्रभो! आपकी कृपा से तिस्रः देवीःतये तीन देविर्यो, दिव्य भावनां इदं बर्हिः =इस मेरे वासनाशुन्य हृदय में
verses.transliteration: tvāmiddhi havāmahe sātau vājasya kārava: | tvāṃ vṛtreṣvindra satpatiṃ narastvāṃ kāṣṭhāsvarvataḥ
verses.wordMeaning: That we may win us wealth and power, we poets call on only thee. In war men call on thee, Indra! the hero's Lord, in the steed's race-course call on thee.
verses.commentary: Sense: That we may win us wealth and power, we poets call on only thee. In war men call on thee, Indra! the hero's Lord, in the steed's race-course call on thee.

verses.sanskrit:
स त्वं न॑श्चित्र वज्रहस्त धृष्णु॒या म॒ह स्त॑वा॒नो अ॑द्रिवः ।
गामश्व॑ᳪ र॒थ्य॒मिन्द्र॒ सं कि॑र स॒त्रा वाजं॒ न जि॒ग्युषे॑
verses.translation: As such, O Wonderful, whose hand holds thunder, praised as mighty, Caster of the Stone! Pour on us boldly, Indra, kine and chariot-steeds ever to be the conqueror's strength.
verses.hindi: ' वसिष्ठ" का अपना जीवन उत्तम होता है. वह सन्तानो को भी उत्तम बनाता है। यह अत्न का पौष्टिकता के दृष्टिकोण से सेवन करता है, धन का उचित वर्धन करनेवाला होता है, उत्तम बुद्धिवाला, क्रियाशीलता से अपना वर्धन करनेवाला, जञानेन्धियों व कर्मेन्द्रिय को शोभायुक्त बनानेवाला होता है। यही इसकी "उपासना" होती है
verses.transliteration: sa tvaṃ naścitra vajrahasta dhṛṣṇuyā maha stavāno adrivaḥ | gāmaśva rathyamindra saṃ kira satrā vājaṃ na jigyuṣe
verses.wordMeaning: As such, O Wonderful, whose hand holds thunder, praised as mighty, Caster of the Stone! Pour on us boldly, Indra, kine and chariot-steeds ever to be the conqueror's strength.
verses.commentary: Sense: As such, O Wonderful, whose hand holds thunder, praised as mighty, Caster of the Stone! Pour on us boldly, Indra, kine and chariot-steeds ever to be the conqueror's strength.

verses.sanskrit:
कया॑ नश्चि॒त्र आ भु॑वदू॒ती स॒दावृ॑ध॒: सखा॑ ।
कया॒ शचि॑ष्ठया वृ॒ता
verses.translation: What succour will he bring to us, wonderful, ever-prospering Friend? With what most mighty company?
verses.hindi: ' वसिष्ठ" अपने मस्तिष्क व शरीर दोनों को स्वस्थ बनाता है, अपनी बुद्धि व वाणी को व्यवहारकुशल करता है ओर इस प्रकार धन का अर्जन करता है, परन्तु इस धनार्जन को करते हए भी अध्यात्मवृत्ति का बना रहता है ओर इस धन का दान करके प्रभु काही बन जाता है। उस प्रभु को ही सब धनों का दाता व वर्धन करनेवाला मानता है)
verses.transliteration: kayā naścitra ā bhuvadūtī sadāvṛdha: sakhā | kayā śaciṣṭhayā vṛtā
verses.wordMeaning: What succour will he bring to us, wonderful, ever-prospering Friend? With what most mighty company?
verses.commentary: Sense: What succour will he bring to us, wonderful, ever-prospering Friend? With what most mighty company?

verses.sanskrit:
कस्त्वा॑ स॒त्यो मदा॑नां॒ मᳪहि॑ष्ठो मत्स॒दन्ध॑सः ।
दृ॒ढा चि॑दा॒रुजे॒ वसु॑
verses.translation: What, genuine and most liberal draught will spirit thee with juice to burst Open e’en strongly-guarded wealth
verses.hindi: सृष्टि के मूल व्यापक तत्त्व मे प्रभु गर्भरूप से स्थित न होते तो उस मूलतत्त्व से अग्नि आदि देवों कौ उत्पत्ति ही न होती। वे प्रभु ही इन सूर्यादि देवों के देवत्व का कारण है। उस अनिर्वचनीय महिमावाले देव के प्रति हम समर्पण द्वारा आराधना प्रभु की अध्यक्षता यें
verses.transliteration: kastvā satyo madānāṃ mahiṣṭho matsadandhasaḥ | dṛḍhā cidāruje vasu
verses.wordMeaning: What, genuine and most liberal draught will spirit thee with juice to burst Open e’en strongly-guarded wealth
verses.commentary: Sense: What, genuine and most liberal draught will spirit thee with juice to burst Open e’en strongly-guarded wealth

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒भी षु ण॒: सखी॑नामवि॒ता ज॑रितॄ॒णाम् ।
श॒तं भ॑वास्यू॒तये॑
verses.translation: Do thou who art protector of us thy friends who praise thee With hundred aids approach us.
verses.hindi: (क) प्रभु हमे उत्तम इनद्दरियाश्व प्राप्त करार, (ख) हम शुद्ध जीवनवाले बनकर प्रभु को प्राप्त करें, (ग) प्रभु यज्ञशील व शक्ति सम्पादन करनेवाले को प्राप्त होते है। आ याहि सोम॑पीतये स्पार्हो देव नियुत्व॑ता।॥ ३०॥ १. गतमन्त्र का " गृत्समद ' जब लोकहित में प्रवृत्त होता टै तब वह " पुरुमीढ '= बहुत पर
verses.transliteration: abhī ṣu ṇa: sakhīnāmavitā jaritṝṇām | śataṃ bhavāsyūtaye
verses.wordMeaning: Do thou who art protector of us thy friends who praise thee With hundred aids approach us.
verses.commentary: Sense: Do thou who art protector of us thy friends who praise thee With hundred aids approach us.

verses.sanskrit:
य॒ज्ञा-य॑ज्ञा वो अ॒ग्नये॑ गि॒रा-गि॑रा च॒ दक्ष॑से ।
प्र-प्र॑ व॒यम॒मृतं॑ जा॒तवे॑दसं प्रि॒यं मि॒त्रं न श॑ᳪसिषम्
verses.translation: Sing to your Agni with each song, at every sacrifice, for strength. Come, let us praise the Wise and Everlasting God even as a well-belovd Friend.
verses.hindi: प्रभु कौ आराधना के लिए हम यज्ञशील होँ। ' यज्ञप्रीः" प्रभु को हम यज्ञ से १. प्रभु का स्तवन करता हुआ गृत्समद प्रार्थना करता है-वायो=हे सम्पूर्ण संसार के सञ्चालक प्रभो! ये-जो ते=आपके सहस्िणः=(स+हस्) प्रसन्नता से युक्त रथासः शरीररूपं रथ है तेथिः=उनके साथ आगहि हमें प्राप्त होए, अर्थात् आपकी कृपा से हम
verses.transliteration: yajñā-yajñā vo agnaye girā-girā ca dakṣase | pra-pra vayamamṛtaṃ jātavedasaṃ priyaṃ mitraṃ na śasiṣam
verses.wordMeaning: Sing to your Agni with each song, at every sacrifice, for strength. Come, let us praise the Wise and Everlasting God even as a well-belovd Friend.
verses.commentary: Sense: Sing to your Agni with each song, at every sacrifice, for strength. Come, let us praise the Wise and Everlasting God even as a well-belovd Friend.

verses.sanskrit:
पा॒हि नो॑ अग्न॒ एक॑या पा॒ह्युत द्वि॒तीय॑या ।
पा॒हि गी॒र्भिस्ति॒सृभि॑रूर्जां पते पा॒हि च॑त॒सृभि॑र्वसो
verses.translation: Protect us, Agni, through the first, protect us through the second hymn. Protect us through three hymns, O Lord of Power and Might; through four hymns, Vasu! guard thou us.
verses.hindi: संसार के सञ्चालक, सृष्टि-नियमों के स्वामी स्वाध्यायशील कौ बुद्धि का निर्माण करनेवाले उस अनुपम प्रभु के रक्षण हमें प्राप्त हों। १. गतमन्त्र का अंगिरस प्रभु-स्तवन करता हआ अपने जीवन को सुन्दर बनाता हेतो यह उत्तम निवासवाला ' वसिष्ठ ' हो जाता है ओर प्रभु से प्रार्थना करता है कि ठे शूर-ठमारे
verses.transliteration: pāhi no agna ekayā pāhyuta dvitīyayā | pāhi gīrbhistisṛbhirūrjāṃ pate pāhi catasṛbhirvaso
verses.wordMeaning: Protect us, Agni, through the first, protect us through the second hymn. Protect us through three hymns, O Lord of Power and Might; through four hymns, Vasu! guard thou us.
verses.commentary: Sense: Protect us, Agni, through the first, protect us through the second hymn. Protect us through three hymns, O Lord of Power and Might; through four hymns, Vasu! guard thou us.

verses.sanskrit:
ऊ॒र्जो नपा॑त॒ᳪ स हि॒नायम॑स्म॒युर्दाशे॑म ह॒व्यदा॑तये ।
भुव॒द्वाजे॑ष्ववि॒ता भुव॑द्वृ॒ध उ॒त त्रा॒ता त॒नूना॑म्
verses.translation: The Son of Strength; for is he not our Friend? Let us serve him for offering our gifts. In battles may he be our help and strengthener, yea, be the saviour of our lives.
verses.hindi: वसिष्ठ इसीलिए वसिष्ठ है कि वह यौवन से ही प्रभु-स्तवन मे लगा है। वह चराचर का आधार प्रभु को ही जानता है, प्रभु को सूर्य के समान देदीप्यमान रूप मे देखता है। १. प्रभु का उपासन करता हआ वसिष्ट! शान्त जीवनवाला बनता है, अतः "शयु! हो जाता हे। यह ऊँचा ज्ञानी बनता हे, अतः ' बार्हस्पत्य" कहलाता है। यह कहता है कि हे
verses.transliteration: ūrjo napāta sa hināyamasmayurdāśema havyadātaye | bhuvadvājeṣvavitā bhuvadvṛdha uta trātā tanūnām
verses.wordMeaning: The Son of Strength; for is he not our Friend? Let us serve him for offering our gifts. In battles may he be our help and strengthener, yea, be the saviour of our lives.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Son of Strength; for is he not our Friend? Let us serve him for offering our gifts. In battles may he be our help and strengthener, yea, be the saviour of our lives.

verses.sanskrit:
सं॒व॒त्स॒रो॒ऽसि परिवत्स॒रो॒ऽसीदावत्स॒रो॒ऽसीद्वत्स॒रो॒ऽसि वत्स॒रो॒ऽसि ।
उ॒षस॑स्ते कल्पन्तामहोरा॒त्रास्ते॑ कल्पन्तामर्धमा॒सास्ते॑ कल्पन्तां मा॒सास्ते कल्पन्तामृ॒तव॑स्ते कल्पन्ताᳪ संवत्स॒रस्ते॑ कल्पताम् । प्रेत्या॒ एत्यै॒ सं चाञ्च॒ प्र च॑ सारय ।
सुप॒र्ण॒चिद॑सि॒ तया॑ दे॒वत॑याऽङ्गिर॒स्वद् ध्रु॒व: सी॑द
verses.translation: Thou art Samvatsara; thou art Parivatsara; thou art Idâvatsara; thou art Idvatsara; thou art Vatsara. Prosper thy Dawns! Prosper thy Day-and-Nights! Prosper thy Half-months, Months, Seasons, and Years! Combine them for their going and their coming, and send then forward on their ordered courses. In eagle's shape thou art piled up and layered. With that divinity, Angiras-like, lie steady.
verses.hindi: हम अपने कर्मोसेप्रभु को प्रीणित कर। वे हमारा भला-ही-भला चाहते है। उनके प्रति हम अपना अर्पण करदे, वे वासना-संग्राम मे हमारी रक्षा करेगे, हमारी वृद्धि का कारण होगे, हमें आधि-व्याधियों से बचार्णेगे। तयां देवत्त॑याङ्धिर् स्वद् श्रुवः सींद।।४५॥
verses.transliteration: saṃvatsaro'si parivatsaro'sīdāvatsaro'sīdvatsaro'si vatsaro'si | uṣasaste kalpantāmahorātrāste kalpantāmardhamāsāste kalpantāṃ māsāste kalpantāmṛtavaste kalpantā saṃvatsaraste kalpatām | pretyā etyai saṃ cāñca pra ca sāraya | suparṇacidasi tayā devatayā'ṅgirasvad dhruva: sīda
verses.wordMeaning: Thou art Samvatsara; thou art Parivatsara; thou art Idâvatsara; thou art Idvatsara; thou art Vatsara. Prosper thy Dawns! Prosper thy Day-and-Nights! Prosper thy Half-months, Months, Seasons, and Years! Combine them for their going and their coming,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Thou art Samvatsara; thou art Parivatsara; thou art Idâvatsara; thou art Idvatsara; thou art Vatsara. Prosper thy Dawns! Prosper thy Day-and-Nights! Prosper thy Half-months, Months, Seasons, and Years! Combine them for their going and their coming,…

verses.sanskrit:
होता॑ यक्षत्स॒मिधेन्द्र॑मि॒डस्प॒दे नाभा॑ पृथि॒व्या अधि॑ ।
दि॒वो वर्ष्म॒न्त्समि॑ध्यत॒ ओजि॑ष्ठश्चर्षणी॒सहां॒ वेत्वाज्य॑स्य॒ होत॒र्यज॑
verses.translation: com The Texts of the White Yajurveda, tr. Ralph T.H. Griffith, [1899], BOOK THE TWENTY-EIGHTH. ON the earth's centre, at libation's place let the Priest worship Indra with the kindling-stick. The mightiest of the lords of men is kindled on the height of heaven. Let him enjoy the butter. Hotar, worship.
verses.hindi: होता बनकर, ज्ञान कौ वाणियों कौ चर्चा करते हुए हम हृदयदेश में प्रभु का दर्शन करने का प्रयत्न करें। इससे हमे शक्ति प्राप्त होगी, हम श्रमशील व शत्रु-विजेताओं होता यक्षत्तनूनपांतमृतिभिर्जेतांरमपराजितम् इन्द्रं देवश्स्वर्विदं पथिधिर्मधुमत्तमेर्नराशय्सेन तेज॑सा वेत्वाज्य॑स्य होतर्यज॑।। २।॥
verses.transliteration: hotā yakṣatsamidhendramiḍaspade nābhā pṛthivyā adhi | divo varṣmantsamidhyata ojiṣṭhaścarṣaṇīsahāṃ vetvājyasya hotaryaja
verses.wordMeaning: com The Texts of the White Yajurveda, tr. Ralph T.H. Griffith, [1899], BOOK THE TWENTY-EIGHTH. ON the earth's centre, at libation's place let the Priest worship Indra with the kindling-stick. The mightiest of the lords of men is kindled on the height of heaven.…
verses.commentary: Sense: com The Texts of the White Yajurveda, tr. Ralph T.H. Griffith, [1899], BOOK THE TWENTY-EIGHTH. ON the earth's centre, at libation's place let the Priest worship Indra with the kindling-stick. The mightiest of the lords of men is kindled on the height of heaven.…

verses.sanskrit:
होता॑ यक्ष॒त्तनू॒नपा॑तमू॒तिभि॒र्जेता॑र॒मप॑राजितम् ।
इन्द्रं॑ दे॒वᳪ स्व॒र्विदं॑ प॒थिभि॒र्मधु॑मत्तमै॒र्नरा॒शᳪसे॑न॒ तेज॑सा॒ वेत्वाज्य॑स्य॒ होत॒र्यज॑
verses.translation: Him let the Hotar worship, him Tanûnapât with ready aids; the conqueror never overcome, Indra, the God who finds heaven's light on paths most rich in pleasant sweets, with Narâsamsa all aglow. Let him enjoy, etc., as in verse 1.
verses.hindi: प्रभु वेदवाणियों से स्तुत होते है। उन प्रभु सरे मेल बनाकर जीव भी देव बनता हे। जन्म-मरण के चक्र से ऊपर उठता है „ अतः जीव को चाहिए कि शक्ति की रक्षा करे ओर दानशील बनकर प्रभु को प्राप्त करने के लिए प्रयत्तशील हो। होता यक्षद् वर्हिषीन्दर॑ निषद्वरं वुंषभं नयीपसम्।
verses.transliteration: hotā yakṣattanūnapātamūtibhirjetāramaparājitam | indraṃ deva svarvidaṃ pathibhirmadhumattamairnarāśasena tejasā vetvājyasya hotaryaja
verses.wordMeaning: Him let the Hotar worship, him Tanûnapât with ready aids; the conqueror never overcome, Indra, the God who finds heaven's light on paths most rich in pleasant sweets, with Narâsamsa all aglow. Let him enjoy, etc., as in verse 1.
verses.commentary: Sense: Him let the Hotar worship, him Tanûnapât with ready aids; the conqueror never overcome, Indra, the God who finds heaven's light on paths most rich in pleasant sweets, with Narâsamsa all aglow. Let him enjoy, etc., as in verse 1.

verses.sanskrit:
होता॑ यक्ष॒दिडा॑भि॒रिन्द्र॑मीडि॒तमा॒जुह्वा॑न॒मम॑र्त्यम् ।
दे॒वो दे॒वै: सवी॑र्यो॒ वज्र॑हस्तः पुरन्द॒रो वेत्वाज्य॑स्य॒ होत॒र्यज॑
verses.translation: With viands let the Hotar worship Indra immortal, praised, receiver of oblations. The God, the equal of the Gods in vigour, the thunder-wielder, breaker-down of castles. Let him enjoy, etc.
verses.hindi: प्रभु ' नर्यापस् ' है, उनके सब कार्य जीव के लिए हितकर है। हम भी वसु, रुद्र व आदित्य बनकर प्रभु से मिलकर कार्य करनेवाले हो (सयुज्)। अपने मेँ शक्ति का व्यापन करते हुए होता बनें ओर खूब दान देनेवाले हो। होता यक्चदोजो न वीर्युःसहो द्वारऽ इन्द्र॑मवर््धयन् । सुप्रायणाऽअस्मिन् यज्ञे वि
verses.transliteration: hotā yakṣadiḍābhirindramīḍitamājuhvānamamartyam | devo devai: savīryo vajrahastaḥ purandaro vetvājyasya hotaryaja
verses.wordMeaning: With viands let the Hotar worship Indra immortal, praised, receiver of oblations. The God, the equal of the Gods in vigour, the thunder-wielder, breaker-down of castles. Let him enjoy, etc.
verses.commentary: Sense: With viands let the Hotar worship Indra immortal, praised, receiver of oblations. The God, the equal of the Gods in vigour, the thunder-wielder, breaker-down of castles. Let him enjoy, etc.

verses.sanskrit:
होता॒ यक्षद्ब॒र्हिषीन्द्रं॑ निषद्व॒रं वृ॑ष॒भं नर्या॑पसम् ।
वसु॑भी रु॒द्रैरा॑दि॒त्यैः सु॒युग्भि॑र्ब॒र्हिरास॑द॒द्वेत्वाज्य॑स्य॒ होत॒र्यज॑
verses.translation: Let the Priest worship Indra, Bull who sitteth on sacred grass, doer of manly actions. Let him be seated on the grass with Vasus and Rudras and Âdityas for companions. Let him enjoy, etc.
verses.hindi: मन में श्रद्धा, मस्तिष्क मे सरस्वती ओर शरीर में भारती- ये तीनों देवियाँ हमारे शरीर, मन व मस्तिष्क का धारण करनेवाली हो। ये शरीर में शक्ति का पान होता यश्चतत्वष्ट।रमिनद्र॑ देवं भिषज॑सुयज घृतश्चिय॑म् । १. होतादानपूर्वक अदन करनेवाला त्वष्टारम्=देवशिल्पी, दिव्यगुणों का निर्माण
verses.transliteration: hotā yakṣadbarhiṣīndraṃ niṣadvaraṃ vṛṣabhaṃ naryāpasam | vasubhī rudrairādityaiḥ suyugbhirbarhirāsadadvetvājyasya hotaryaja
verses.wordMeaning: Let the Priest worship Indra, Bull who sitteth on sacred grass, doer of manly actions. Let him be seated on the grass with Vasus and Rudras and Âdityas for companions. Let him enjoy, etc.
verses.commentary: Sense: Let the Priest worship Indra, Bull who sitteth on sacred grass, doer of manly actions. Let him be seated on the grass with Vasus and Rudras and Âdityas for companions. Let him enjoy, etc.

verses.sanskrit:
होता॑ यक्ष॒दोजो॒ न वी॒र्यᳪ सहो॒ द्वार॒ इन्द्र॑मवर्धयन् ।
सुप्रा॒य॒णा अ॒स्मिन्य॒ज्ञे वि श्र॑यन्तामृता॒वृधो॒ द्वार॒ इन्द्रा॑य मी॒ढुषे॒ व्यन्त्वाज्य॑स्य॒ होत॒र्यज॑
verses.translation: Let the Priest sacrifice. The Doors have strengthened Indra, his force and conquering might and vigour. At this our worship let the Doors be opened, easy to pass, the strengtheners of Order: wide let them open out for bounteous Indra. Let them enjoy, etc.
verses.hindi: वे प्रभु त्वष्टा है, हममे दिव्य गुणों का निर्माण करनेवाले हे, जान से दीप्त है ओर सृष्टिनिर्माण आदि यज्ञात्मक कर्मो को करनेवाले हेँ। उनके संग से सुरेतस् बनकर हम भी दिव्य गुण-सम्प्न, ज्लानदीप्त व यज्ञशील बरने। होता यक्षद्वनस्पततिशमितारब्शतक्र॑तुं धियो जोष्टारभिद्धियम्। मध्वां समञ्जन्
verses.transliteration: hotā yakṣadojo na vīrya saho dvāra indramavardhayan | suprāyaṇā asminyajñe vi śrayantāmṛtāvṛdho dvāra indrāya mīḍhuṣe vyantvājyasya hotaryaja
verses.wordMeaning: Let the Priest sacrifice. The Doors have strengthened Indra, his force and conquering might and vigour. At this our worship let the Doors be opened, easy to pass, the strengtheners of Order: wide let them open out for bounteous Indra. Let them enjoy, etc.
verses.commentary: Sense: Let the Priest sacrifice. The Doors have strengthened Indra, his force and conquering might and vigour. At this our worship let the Doors be opened, easy to pass, the strengtheners of Order: wide let them open out for bounteous Indra. Let them enjoy, etc.

verses.sanskrit:
होता॑ यक्षदु॒षे इन्द्र॑स्य धे॒नू सु॒दुघे॑ मा॒तरा॑ म॒ही ।
स॒वा॒तरौ॒ न तेज॑सा व॒त्समिन्द्र॑मवर्धतां वी॒तामाज्य॑स्य॒ होत॒र्यज॑
verses.translation: Let the Priest sacrifice to Night and Morning, the teeming Cows of Indra, Mighty Mothers. Indra their calf with lustre have they strengthened, even as two mothers of a calf in common. Let them enjoy, etc.
verses.hindi: प्रभु ज्ञान की किरणों के पति है, हमारे जीवनों को शान्त बनानेवाले हेै। जीवन में माधुर्य, दीप्ति व सरलता का सञ्चार करनेवाले है। उस प्रभु के स्मरण से हम शक्ति को अपने में सुरक्षित कर ओर जीवन को मधुर बनां। होता यक्षदिन्दरश्स्वाहाज्य॑स्य स्वाहा मेदसः स्वाहा स्तोकानाश्शस्वाहा
verses.transliteration: hotā yakṣaduṣe indrasya dhenū sudughe mātarā mahī | savātarau na tejasā vatsamindramavardhatāṃ vītāmājyasya hotaryaja
verses.wordMeaning: Let the Priest sacrifice to Night and Morning, the teeming Cows of Indra, Mighty Mothers. Indra their calf with lustre have they strengthened, even as two mothers of a calf in common. Let them enjoy, etc.
verses.commentary: Sense: Let the Priest sacrifice to Night and Morning, the teeming Cows of Indra, Mighty Mothers. Indra their calf with lustre have they strengthened, even as two mothers of a calf in common. Let them enjoy, etc.

verses.sanskrit:
होता॑ यक्ष॒द्दैव्या॒ होता॑रा भि॒षजा॒ सखा॑या ह॒विषेन्द्रं॑ भिषज्यतः ।
क॒वी देवौ॒ प्रचे॑तसा॒विन्द्रा॑य धत्त इन्द्रि॒यं वी॒तामाज्य॑स्य॒ होत॒र्यज॑
verses.translation: Let the Priest worship both the heavenly Hotars, Friends, Leeches, healing Indra with oblation. The sages, Gods preminent for wisdom bestow on Indra his surpassing power. Let them enjoy, etc.
verses.hindi: होता प्रभु के साथ अपना मेल करे। घृत आदि पदार्थो का त्यागभावना से उपभोग करें। अपने मेँ वीर्यकणों को, प्राणाशक्ति को तथा मधुर प्रार्थना व शक्तियों को आहत करे, अर्थात् इनको धारण करे। सूचना-ये १९ मन्त्र ' प्रयाजप्रैष" काते है. अर्थात् वे प्रेषप्रकृष्ट प्रेरणा के मन्त्र जो
verses.transliteration: hotā yakṣaddaivyā hotārā bhiṣajā sakhāyā haviṣendraṃ bhiṣajyataḥ | kavī devau pracetasāvindrāya dhatta indriyaṃ vītāmājyasya hotaryaja
verses.wordMeaning: Let the Priest worship both the heavenly Hotars, Friends, Leeches, healing Indra with oblation. The sages, Gods preminent for wisdom bestow on Indra his surpassing power. Let them enjoy, etc.
verses.commentary: Sense: Let the Priest worship both the heavenly Hotars, Friends, Leeches, healing Indra with oblation. The sages, Gods preminent for wisdom bestow on Indra his surpassing power. Let them enjoy, etc.

verses.sanskrit:
होता॑ यक्षत्ति॒स्रो दे॒वीर्न भे॑ष॒जं त्रय॑स्त्रि॒धात॑वो॒ऽपस॒ इडा॒ सर॑स्वती॒ भार॑ती म॒हीः ।
इन्द्र॑पत्नीर्ह॒विष्म॑ती॒र्व्यन्त्वाज्य॑स्य॒ होत॒र्यज॑
verses.translation: Let the Priest offer sacrifice to the three Goddesses and balm. Let the three triple active Ones, let Idâ and Sarasvatî and Bhâratî the mighty Dames, Consorts of Indra, who receive our sacrificial offerings, enjoy the butter, etc.
verses.hindi: हम अपने हदयों को दिव्य बनाँ। यह हदय धनार्जन का ध्यान करता हआ प्रभु का भी स्मरण करे। देवीः द्वार्ः=दिव्य इन्द्रियद्वार देवीर्द्रारऽडन्द्र॑ःसङ्घते वीडवीर्या्मिन्रवर्दधयन् । आ वत्सेन तरुणेन कुमारेण च
verses.transliteration: hotā yakṣattisro devīrna bheṣajaṃ trayastridhātavo'pasa iḍā sarasvatī bhāratī mahīḥ | indrapatnīrhaviṣmatīrvyantvājyasya hotaryaja
verses.wordMeaning: Let the Priest offer sacrifice to the three Goddesses and balm. Let the three triple active Ones, let Idâ and Sarasvatî and Bhâratî the mighty Dames, Consorts of Indra, who receive our sacrificial offerings, enjoy the butter, etc.
verses.commentary: Sense: Let the Priest offer sacrifice to the three Goddesses and balm. Let the three triple active Ones, let Idâ and Sarasvatî and Bhâratî the mighty Dames, Consorts of Indra, who receive our sacrificial offerings, enjoy the butter, etc.

verses.sanskrit:
होता॑ यक्ष॒त्त्वष्टा॑र॒मिन्द्रं॑ दे॒वं भि॒षज॑ᳪ सु॒यजं॑ घृत॒श्रिय॑म् ।
पु॒रु॒रूप॑ᳪ सु॒रेत॑सं म॒घोन॒मिन्द्रा॑य॒ त्वष्टा॒ दध॑दिन्द्रि॒याणि॒ वेत्वाज्य॑स्य॒ होत॒र्यज॑
verses.translation: Let the Priest worship Tvashtar radiant Indra, Physician good at sacrifice, graced with butter, Multiform and prolific, rich and bounteous. Let Tvashtar, giving wondrous powers to Indra, enjoy, etc.
verses.hindi: हम दिन-रात इस जीवनयात्रा को चलाते हुए उस प्रभु का स्मरण करे। उत्तम वृत्तिवाले लोगों से ही अपना मेल बना, सन्तुष्ट बनकर हितकारी कार्यो मेँ लगे हए धनार्जन करें, परन्तु प्रभु को भूलें नहीं। यक्षशील हों। देवी जोष्टी ( अहोरात्रे )
verses.transliteration: hotā yakṣattvaṣṭāramindraṃ devaṃ bhiṣaja suyajaṃ ghṛtaśriyam | pururūpa suretasaṃ maghonamindrāya tvaṣṭā dadhadindriyāṇi vetvājyasya hotaryaja
verses.wordMeaning: Let the Priest worship Tvashtar radiant Indra, Physician good at sacrifice, graced with butter, Multiform and prolific, rich and bounteous. Let Tvashtar, giving wondrous powers to Indra, enjoy, etc.
verses.commentary: Sense: Let the Priest worship Tvashtar radiant Indra, Physician good at sacrifice, graced with butter, Multiform and prolific, rich and bounteous. Let Tvashtar, giving wondrous powers to Indra, enjoy, etc.

verses.sanskrit:
होता॑ यक्ष॒द्वन॒स्पति॑ᳪ शमि॒तार॑ᳪ श॒तक्र॑तुं धि॒यो जो॒ष्टार॑मिन्द्रि॒यम् ।
मध्वा॑ सम॒ञ्जन्प॒थिभि॑: सु॒गेभि॒: स्वदा॑ति य॒ज्ञं मधु॑ना घृ॒तेन॒ वेत्वाज्य॑स्य॒ होत॒र्यज॑
verses.translation: Let the Priest worship him, the Forest-Sovran, the Immolator, Lord of Hundred Powers, the lover of the prayer, the friend of Indra. Balming with mead, may he on easy pathways sweeten our sacrifice with savoury butter. Let him enjoy, etc.
verses.hindi: रात्रि हमें सव द्वेषो व पापों को भुला देती है। दिन हमें वरणीय धनों के प्रापण में सहायक होता है। ये हमें धन प्राप्त कराते हए प्रभु का भी स्मरण करां। ऋषि:- अश्विनौ देवता-इन्द्रः। छन्दः- भुरिगाकृतिः। स्वरः निषादः। देवी ऊर्जाह्टुती ८ द्यावापृथिव्यौ )
verses.transliteration: hotā yakṣadvanaspati śamitāra śatakratuṃ dhiyo joṣṭāramindriyam | madhvā samañjanpathibhi: sugebhi: svadāti yajñaṃ madhunā ghṛtena vetvājyasya hotaryaja
verses.wordMeaning: Let the Priest worship him, the Forest-Sovran, the Immolator, Lord of Hundred Powers, the lover of the prayer, the friend of Indra. Balming with mead, may he on easy pathways sweeten our sacrifice with savoury butter. Let him enjoy, etc.
verses.commentary: Sense: Let the Priest worship him, the Forest-Sovran, the Immolator, Lord of Hundred Powers, the lover of the prayer, the friend of Indra. Balming with mead, may he on easy pathways sweeten our sacrifice with savoury butter. Let him enjoy, etc.

verses.sanskrit:
होता॑ यक्ष॒दिन्द्र॒ᳪ स्वाहाऽऽज्य॑स्य॒ स्वाहा॒ मेद॑स॒: स्वाहा॑ स्तो॒काना॒ᳪ स्वाहा॒ स्वाहा॑कृतीना॒ᳪ स्वाहा॑ ह॒व्यसू॑क्तीनाम् ।
स्वाहा॑ दे॒वा आ॑ज्य॒पा जु॑षा॒णा इन्द्र॒ आज्य॑स्य॒ व्यन्तु॒ होत॒र्यज॑
verses.translation: Let the Priest offer sacrifice to Indra: with Hail! to Gods of butter; with Hail! to Gods of marrow; with Hail! to Gods of drops; with Hail! to Gods of offerings paid with Svâhâ; with Hail! to Gods of sacrificial hymns. All hail! May butter-drinking Gods and Indra rejoicing taste the butter. Hotar, worship.
verses.hindi: द्युलोक व पृथिवीलोक हमारे लिए उत्तम अन्नं का दोहन करनेवाले हौ। ये यनत्ञशील को वार्य वसु प्राप्त करार्णँ। इनसे धनां को प्राप्त करते हुए हम धनौं के आधारभूत देवा हैव्या होतारा देवमिन्द्र॑मवर्दधताम्। इताघ॑शध्सावाभार्ष्या वसु वायीणि १. ए० २।४ के अनुसार प्राणापान ' देव्य होता" ै। ये देवाः=दिव्य गुणयुक्त व शरीर
verses.transliteration: hotā yakṣadindra svāhā''jyasya svāhā medasa: svāhā stokānā svāhā svāhākṛtīnā svāhā havyasūktīnām | svāhā devā ājyapā juṣāṇā indra ājyasya vyantu hotaryaja
verses.wordMeaning: Let the Priest offer sacrifice to Indra: with Hail! to Gods of butter; with Hail! to Gods of marrow; with Hail! to Gods of drops; with Hail! to Gods of offerings paid with Svâhâ; with Hail! to Gods of sacrificial hymns.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Let the Priest offer sacrifice to Indra: with Hail! to Gods of butter; with Hail! to Gods of marrow; with Hail! to Gods of drops; with Hail! to Gods of offerings paid with Svâhâ; with Hail! to Gods of sacrificial hymns.…

verses.sanskrit:
दे॒वं ब॒र्हिरिन्द्र॑ᳪ सुदे॒वं दे॒वैर्वी॒रव॑त्स्ती॒र्णं वेद्या॑मवर्धयत् ।
वस्तो॑र्वृ॒तं प्राक्तोर्भृ॒तᳪ रा॒या ब॒र्हिष्म॒तोऽत्य॑गाद्वसु॒वने॑ वसु॒धेय॑स्य वेतु॒ यज॑
verses.translation: Vigorous, strewn by Gods upon the altar the right Gods’ sacred Grass hath strengthened Indra. Cut in the day, cherished by night it hath surpassed those who have sacrificial Grass with wealth. For gain of riches let him taste. Pay sacrifice.
verses.hindi: हम ! भारती, सरस्वती व इडा' इन देवियों के पति बनें। इनसे हमारे १. देवः=दिव्य गुणों का पुञ्ज, इन्द्रः=परमैश्वर्यशाली, नराशंसः= मनुष्यों से स्तुति करने योग्य, त्रिवरूथः शरीर (-इन्िर्यो) , मन व बुद्धि को सुरक्षित करनेवाला ( वरूथ=००४८ ) अथवा भौतिक सम्पत्ति-शारीरिक बलरूप सम्पत्ति तथा मस्तिष्क के ज्ञानरूप धन को देनेवाला
verses.transliteration: devaṃ barhirindra sudevaṃ devairvīravatstīrṇaṃ vedyāmavardhayat | vastorvṛtaṃ prāktorbhṛta rāyā barhiṣmato'tyagādvasuvane vasudheyasya vetu yaja
verses.wordMeaning: Vigorous, strewn by Gods upon the altar the right Gods’ sacred Grass hath strengthened Indra. Cut in the day, cherished by night it hath surpassed those who have sacrificial Grass with wealth. For gain of riches let him taste. Pay sacrifice.
verses.commentary: Sense: Vigorous, strewn by Gods upon the altar the right Gods’ sacred Grass hath strengthened Indra. Cut in the day, cherished by night it hath surpassed those who have sacrificial Grass with wealth. For gain of riches let him taste. Pay sacrifice.

verses.sanskrit:
दे॒वीर्द्वार॒ इन्द्र॑ᳪ सङ्घा॒ते वी॒ड्वीर्याम॑न्नवर्धयन् ।
आ व॒त्सेन॒ तरु॑णेन कुमा॒रेण॑ च मीव॒तापार्वा॑णᳪ रे॒णुक॑काटं नुदन्तां वसु॒वने॑ वसु॒धेय॑स्य व्यन्तु॒ यज॑
verses.translation: Firm, closely joined, the Doors divine have strengthened Indra in the rite. Pressed by a calf or tender boy may they drive off the courser as he tosses up the sand. For gain of wealth let then enjoy. Pay sacrifice.
verses.hindi: हम ‹ त्रिवरूथ -त्रिवन्धुर' प्रभु का स्मरण करे। विज्ञान के अध्ययन में जिज्ञासाओं के द्वारा प्रभु-भावना का हममे उदय हो। धन का सञ्चय करते हए वस्तुतः धनँ के स्वामी उस प्रभु को हम न भृले। प्रधुायवः सुपिप्पलः ( यह संसार-वुक्ष)
verses.transliteration: devīrdvāra indra saṅghāte vīḍvīryāmannavardhayan | ā vatsena taruṇena kumāreṇa ca mīvatāpārvāṇa reṇukakāṭaṃ nudantāṃ vasuvane vasudheyasya vyantu yaja
verses.wordMeaning: Firm, closely joined, the Doors divine have strengthened Indra in the rite. Pressed by a calf or tender boy may they drive off the courser as he tosses up the sand. For gain of wealth let then enjoy. Pay sacrifice.
verses.commentary: Sense: Firm, closely joined, the Doors divine have strengthened Indra in the rite. Pressed by a calf or tender boy may they drive off the courser as he tosses up the sand. For gain of wealth let then enjoy. Pay sacrifice.

verses.sanskrit:
दे॒वी उ॒षासा॒नक्तेन्द्रं॑ य॒ज्ञे प्र॑य॒त्य॒ह्वेताम् ।
दैवी॒र्विश॒: प्राया॑सिष्टा॒ᳪ सुप्री॑ते॒ सुधि॑ते वसु॒वने॑ वसु॒धेय॑स्य वीतां॒ यज॑
verses.translation: Morning and Night, the Goddesses, have called on Indra as the rite advanced. May they well-pleased and ordered well make the Celestial Tribes come forth. For gain of wealth let them enjoy. Pay sacrifice.
verses.hindi: यह ' हिरण्यपर्ण मधुशाख, सुपिप्पल ' संसारवृक्च हमारे लिए वर्धन का कारण बने। धन के सेवन में धन के आधारभूत प्रभु का प्रादुर्भाव करनेवाला हो। देवं बर्हिर्वारितीनां देवमिन्द्र॑मवर्दयत्। १. वारितीनाम्=' वे प्रभु वरणीय है, उस प्रभु म (वारि इतिर्गतिर्येषां) इति=गतिवाले ,
verses.transliteration: devī uṣāsānaktendraṃ yajñe prayatyahvetām | daivīrviśa: prāyāsiṣṭā suprīte sudhite vasuvane vasudheyasya vītāṃ yaja
verses.wordMeaning: Morning and Night, the Goddesses, have called on Indra as the rite advanced. May they well-pleased and ordered well make the Celestial Tribes come forth. For gain of wealth let them enjoy. Pay sacrifice.
verses.commentary: Sense: Morning and Night, the Goddesses, have called on Indra as the rite advanced. May they well-pleased and ordered well make the Celestial Tribes come forth. For gain of wealth let them enjoy. Pay sacrifice.

verses.sanskrit:
दे॒वी जोष्ट्री॒ वसु॑धिती दे॒वमिन्द्र॑मवर्धताम् ।
अया॑व्य॒न्याघा द्वेषा॒ᳪस्यान्या व॑क्ष॒द्वसु॒ वार्या॑णि॒ यज॑मानाय शिक्षि॒ते व॑सु॒वने॑ वसु॒धेय॑स्य वीतां॒ यज॑
verses.translation: Two Goddesses, wealth-givers, kind, have heightened radiant Indra's strength. One drives away hatreds and sins; the other shall bring the Sacrificer boons and treasure. Instructed, let them both enjoy, for gain of wealth. Pay sacrifice.
verses.hindi: आसनों के अभ्यास व उपासना से हमारा हदय वासनाशून्य हो। यह हदय प्रभु को कभी भुलानेवाला न हो। देवोऽअग्निः स्विष्ट कृटेवमिन्द्र॑मवर्द्धयत् । स्विष्टं कुर्वन्त्स्विष्ट कृत् स्विंष्टमद्य करोतु नो वसुवने वसुधेय॑स्य वेतु यज॑। २२॥
verses.transliteration: devī joṣṭrī vasudhitī devamindramavardhatām | ayāvyanyāghā dveṣāsyānyā vakṣadvasu vāryāṇi yajamānāya śikṣite vasuvane vasudheyasya vītāṃ yaja
verses.wordMeaning: Two Goddesses, wealth-givers, kind, have heightened radiant Indra's strength. One drives away hatreds and sins; the other shall bring the Sacrificer boons and treasure. Instructed, let them both enjoy, for gain of wealth. Pay sacrifice.
verses.commentary: Sense: Two Goddesses, wealth-givers, kind, have heightened radiant Indra's strength. One drives away hatreds and sins; the other shall bring the Sacrificer boons and treasure. Instructed, let them both enjoy, for gain of wealth. Pay sacrifice.

verses.sanskrit:
दे॒वी ऊ॒र्जाहु॑ती॒ दुघे॒ सु॒दुघे॒ पय॒सेन्द्र॑मवर्धताम् ।
इष॒मूर्ज॑म॒न्या व॑क्ष॒त्सग्धि॒ᳪ सपी॑तिम॒न्या नवे॑न॒ पूर्वं॒ दय॑माने पुरा॒णेन॒ नव॒मधा॑ता॒मूर्ज॑मू॒र्जाहु॑ती ऊ॒र्जय॑माने॒ वसु॒ वार्या॑णि॒ यज॑मानाय शिक्षि॒ते व॑सु॒वने॑ वसु॒धेय॑स्य वीतां॒ यज॑
verses.translation: Bringers of strengthening sacrifice, the Goddesses, the teeming Cows, have prospered Indra with their milk. Let one bring food and energy, the other feast and banqueting. Bringers of strengthening sacrifice, allotting the several portions they have put together old energy with new and new with olden, strengthening boons and treasures for the Sacrificer. Instructed, let them, etc., as in verse 15.
verses.hindi: हम प्रतिदिन अग्निहोत्र में अग्न्याधान करते हुए अपने इष्ट नैरोग्य व सोमनस्य को सिद्ध करे। संसार में विचरते हुए प्रभु को भूल न जार्पँ। सदा यज्ञशील बने रहे। अग्निमद्य होतारमवृणीतायं यज॑मानः पचन् पक्तीः पच॑न् पुरोडाशं बध्नत्नि्द्रौय छाग॑म्। सूपस्थाऽअद्य देवो वनस्पतिंरभवदिन्द्रय छारगेन। अघत्तं मेदस्तः प्रतिं
verses.transliteration: devī ūrjāhutī dughe sudughe payasendramavardhatām | iṣamūrjamanyā vakṣatsagdhi sapītimanyā navena pūrvaṃ dayamāne purāṇena navamadhātāmūrjamūrjāhutī ūrjayamāne vasu vāryāṇi yajamānāya śikṣite vasuvane vasudheyasya vītāṃ yaja
verses.wordMeaning: Bringers of strengthening sacrifice, the Goddesses, the teeming Cows, have prospered Indra with their milk. Let one bring food and energy, the other feast and banqueting. Bringers of strengthening sacrifice,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Bringers of strengthening sacrifice, the Goddesses, the teeming Cows, have prospered Indra with their milk. Let one bring food and energy, the other feast and banqueting. Bringers of strengthening sacrifice,…

verses.sanskrit:
दे॒वा दैव्या॒ होता॑रा दे॒वमिन्द्र॑मवर्धताम् ।
ह॒ताघ॑शᳪसा॒वाभा॑र्ष्टां॒ वसु॒ वार्या॑णि॒ यज॑मानाय शिक्षि॒तौ व॑सु॒वने॑ वसु॒धेय॑स्य वीतां॒ यज॑
verses.translation: The two Celestial Hotars, Gods, have heightened radiant Indra's might. Freed from slain sinners these have brought the Sacrificer wealth and boons. Instructed, let them, etc.
verses.hindi: हम होता बनकर देदीप्यमान प्रभु से अपना मेल बना्ंँ। प्राणरक्षा की हमारी प्रबल कामना हो, शरीर, मन व बुद्धि की रक्षा करनेवाली वेदवाणी को हम अपनापं। होतां यक्षत्तनूनपांतमुदधिदं यं गर्भमदितिर्दधे शुचिमिन्द्र॑ वयोधसम् । १. होता=दानपूर्वक अदन करनेवाला यक्षत्=-अपने साथ संगत करता है, उस प्रभु को,
verses.transliteration: devā daivyā hotārā devamindramavardhatām | hatāghaśasāvābhārṣṭāṃ vasu vāryāṇi yajamānāya śikṣitau vasuvane vasudheyasya vītāṃ yaja
verses.wordMeaning: The two Celestial Hotars, Gods, have heightened radiant Indra's might. Freed from slain sinners these have brought the Sacrificer wealth and boons. Instructed, let them, etc.
verses.commentary: Sense: The two Celestial Hotars, Gods, have heightened radiant Indra's might. Freed from slain sinners these have brought the Sacrificer wealth and boons. Instructed, let them, etc.

verses.sanskrit:
दे॒वीस्ति॒स्रस्ति॒स्रो दे॒वीः पति॒मिन्द्र॑मवर्धयन् ।
अस्पृ॑क्ष॒द्भार॑ती॒ दिव॑ᳪ रु॒द्रैर्य॒ज्ञᳪ सर॑स्व॒तीडा॑ वसु॑मती गृ॒हान् व॑सु॒वने॑ वसु॒धेय॑स्य व्यन्तु॒ यज॑
verses.translation: Goddesses three, three Goddesses have heightened their Lord Indra's strength. One, Bhâratî, hath touched the sky, Sarasvatî the sacrifice with Rudras, and, enriched with wealth, Idâ the homesteads of the folk. For gain of wealth let them enjoy. Pay sacrifice.
verses.hindi: हम होता बनकर सव उन्नतियों के साधक प्रभु को धारण करे। हमारा स्नेह प्रकृति से न होकर प्रभु से हो। हम वासनाओं का खण्डन करनेवाले वेदज्ञान को अपनार्णं। होतां यक्षदीडेन्य॑मीडितं वुत्रहन्त॑ममिडांभिरीङ्यध्सहः सोममिन्द्र॑ वयोधसम् । १. होता-दानपूर्वक अदन करनेवाला यक्षत् अपने साथ उस प्रभु को संगत करता है,
verses.transliteration: devīstisrastisro devīḥ patimindramavardhayan | aspṛkṣadbhāratī diva rudrairyajña sarasvatīḍā vasumatī gṛhān vasuvane vasudheyasya vyantu yaja
verses.wordMeaning: Goddesses three, three Goddesses have heightened their Lord Indra's strength. One, Bhâratî, hath touched the sky, Sarasvatî the sacrifice with Rudras, and, enriched with wealth, Idâ the homesteads of the folk. For gain of wealth let them enjoy. Pay sacrifice.
verses.commentary: Sense: Goddesses three, three Goddesses have heightened their Lord Indra's strength. One, Bhâratî, hath touched the sky, Sarasvatî the sacrifice with Rudras, and, enriched with wealth, Idâ the homesteads of the folk. For gain of wealth let them enjoy. Pay sacrifice.

verses.sanskrit:
दे॒व इन्द्रो॒ नरा॒शᳪस॑स्त्रिवरू॒थस्त्रि॑बन्धु॒रो दे॒वमिन्द्र॑मवर्धयत् ।
श॒तेन॑ शितिपृ॒ष्ठाना॒माहि॑तः स॒हस्रे॑ण॒ प्र व॑र्तते मि॒त्रावरु॒णेद॑स्य हो॒त्रमर्ह॑तो॒ बृह॒स्पति॑ स्तो॒त्रम॒श्विनाध्व॑र्यवं वसु॒वने॑ वसु॒धेय॑स्य वेत्तु॒ यज॑
verses.translation: The radiant Indra, Praise of Men, thrice-shielding, borne on three car-seats, hath heightened radiant Indra's strength. Set on a hundred white-backed cows, yea, on a thousand forth he goes. Mitra and Varuna alone deserve to be his Hotar-Priests, Brihaspati his Chanter, and the Asvins his Adhvaryavas. For gain of wealth let him enjoy. Pay sacrifice.
verses.hindi: होता पुरुष अपने इच्दरियद्वारो को ज्योतिर्मय बनाकर, इनक द्वारा प्रभु की महिमा को देखता हुआ, प्रभु को अपने साथ संगत करे। होता यक्षत्सुपेश॑सा सुशिल्पे बुंहतीऽ उभे नक्तोषासा न दर्शते विश्वसिन्द्र १. होता=दानपूर्वक अदनशील पुरुष नक्तोषासा=उन "दिन ओर रात" को अपने साथ
verses.transliteration: deva indro narāśasastrivarūthastribandhuro devamindramavardhayat | śatena śitipṛṣṭhānāmāhitaḥ sahasreṇa pra vartate mitrāvaruṇedasya hotramarhato bṛhaspati stotramaśvinādhvaryavaṃ vasuvane vasudheyasya vettu yaja
verses.wordMeaning: The radiant Indra, Praise of Men, thrice-shielding, borne on three car-seats, hath heightened radiant Indra's strength. Set on a hundred white-backed cows, yea, on a thousand forth he goes. Mitra and Varuna alone deserve to be his Hotar-Priests, Brihaspati his Chanter,…
verses.commentary: Sense: The radiant Indra, Praise of Men, thrice-shielding, borne on three car-seats, hath heightened radiant Indra's strength. Set on a hundred white-backed cows, yea, on a thousand forth he goes. Mitra and Varuna alone deserve to be his Hotar-Priests, Brihaspati his Chanter,…

verses.sanskrit:
दे॒वो देवै॒र्वन॒स्पति॒र्हिर॑ण्यपर्णो॒ मधु॑शाखः सुपिप्प॒लो दे॒वमिन्द्र॑मवर्धयत् ।
दिव॒मग्रे॑णास्पृक्ष॒दान्तरि॑क्षं पृथि॒वीम॑दृᳪहीद्वसु॒वने॑ वसु॒धेय॑स्य वेतु॒ यज॑
verses.translation: Vanaspatî, a God with Gods, with golden leaves, sweet boughs, fair fruit, hath heightened radiant Indra's strength. Sky with his summit hath he touched, and firmament, and stablished earth. For gain of wealth let him enjoy. Pay sacrifice.
verses.hindi: होता पुरुष के लिए दिन-रात बड़ सुन्दर होते हं, ये उसे सौन्दर्य प्रदान करते हे। यह इनके चक्र मेँ प्रभु के रचना- सौन्दर्य को देखता हुआ प्रभ को पूजता हे, उसके साथ अपना सम्पर्क बनाता है ओर उसके प्रति अपना अर्पण कर देता हे। होतौ यक्षत्प्रचैतसा देवानामुत्तमं यशो होतारा हैव्यां कवी सयुजेन्द्रं बयोधसंम् ।
verses.transliteration: devo devairvanaspatirhiraṇyaparṇo madhuśākhaḥ supippalo devamindramavardhayat | divamagreṇāspṛkṣadāntarikṣaṃ pṛthivīmadṛhīdvasuvane vasudheyasya vetu yaja
verses.wordMeaning: Vanaspatî, a God with Gods, with golden leaves, sweet boughs, fair fruit, hath heightened radiant Indra's strength. Sky with his summit hath he touched, and firmament, and stablished earth. For gain of wealth let him enjoy. Pay sacrifice.
verses.commentary: Sense: Vanaspatî, a God with Gods, with golden leaves, sweet boughs, fair fruit, hath heightened radiant Indra's strength. Sky with his summit hath he touched, and firmament, and stablished earth. For gain of wealth let him enjoy. Pay sacrifice.

verses.sanskrit:
दे॒वं ब॒र्हिर्वारि॑तीनां दे॒वमिन्द्र॑मवर्धयत् ।
स्वा॒स॒स्थमिन्द्रे॒णास॑न्नम॒न्या ब॒र्हीᳪष्य॒भ्य॒भूद्वसु॒वने॑ वसु॒धेय॑स्य वेतु॒ यज॑
verses.translation: Let the Priest worship Agni, Indra, kindled, splendidly kindled, excellent strength-giver, Lending him mighty power, Gâyatrî metre, a cow aged eighteen months, and vital vigour. Let him enjoy the butter. Hotar, worship.
verses.hindi: होता पुरुष के लिए प्राणापान प्रकृष्टं जान को देनेवाले होते है। ये उसके अन्दर क्रियाशीलता को उत्पन्न करते हँ, इन्द्रियों के सामर्थ्यं को देते है, जीवनयात्रा को पूर्ण करने कौ क्षमता देते है ओर उसके जीवन को उत्कृष्ट बनाते है होता यक्षत्पेस्वतीस्तिस्ो देवीर्दिरण्ययीभरितीर्बहतीर्महीः पतिमिन्द्र वयोधसम् ।
verses.transliteration: devaṃ barhirvāritīnāṃ devamindramavardhayat | svāsasthamindreṇāsannamanyā barhīṣyabhyabhūdvasuvane vasudheyasya vetu yaja
verses.wordMeaning: Let the Priest worship Agni, Indra, kindled, splendidly kindled, excellent strength-giver, Lending him mighty power, Gâyatrî metre, a cow aged eighteen months, and vital vigour. Let him enjoy the butter. Hotar, worship.
verses.commentary: Sense: Let the Priest worship Agni, Indra, kindled, splendidly kindled, excellent strength-giver, Lending him mighty power, Gâyatrî metre, a cow aged eighteen months, and vital vigour. Let him enjoy the butter. Hotar, worship.

verses.sanskrit:
दे॒वो अ॒ग्निः स्वि॑ष्ट॒कृद्दे॒वमिन्द्र॑मवर्धयत् ।
स्वि॑ष्टं कु॒र्वन्त्स्वि॑ष्ट॒कृत्स्वि॑ष्टम॒द्य क॑रोतु नो वसु॒वने॑ वसु॒धेय॑स्य वेतु॒ यज॑
verses.translation: Agni, Fair-offering-maker, bright, hath heightened radiant Indra's strength. To-day may Svishtakrit, Fair-offering-maker, paying good sacrifice, for us perform it. For gain of wealth let him enjoy. Pay sacrifice.
verses.hindi: होता का जीवन ' भारती, सरस्वती व इडा' के कारण बड़ा सुन्दर हो जाता हे। ये देवियाँ उसके जीवन को ज्योतिर्मय बना देती है। ऋषि -सरस्वती। देवता-इन्द्रः। छन्दः-भुरिक्छाक्वरी। स्वरः- धैवतः। होता यक्षत्सुरेत॑सं त्वष्टारं पुष्टि वर््धनर्रूपाणि बिभ्र॑तं पथक् पुष्टिमिन्द्र
verses.transliteration: devo agniḥ sviṣṭakṛddevamindramavardhayat | sviṣṭaṃ kurvantsviṣṭakṛtsviṣṭamadya karotu no vasuvane vasudheyasya vetu yaja
verses.wordMeaning: Agni, Fair-offering-maker, bright, hath heightened radiant Indra's strength. To-day may Svishtakrit, Fair-offering-maker, paying good sacrifice, for us perform it. For gain of wealth let him enjoy. Pay sacrifice.
verses.commentary: Sense: Agni, Fair-offering-maker, bright, hath heightened radiant Indra's strength. To-day may Svishtakrit, Fair-offering-maker, paying good sacrifice, for us perform it. For gain of wealth let him enjoy. Pay sacrifice.

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒ग्निम॒द्य होता॑रमवृणीता॒यं यज॑मान॒: पच॒न्पक्ती॒: पच॑न्पुरो॒डाशं॑ ब॒ध्नन्निन्द्रा॑य॒ छाग॑म् ।
सू॒प॒स्था अ॒द्य दे॒वो वन॒स्पति॑रभव॒दिन्द्रा॑य॒ छागे॑न । अघ॒त्तं मे॑द॒स्तः प्रति॑ पच॒ताग्र॑भी॒दवी॑वृधत्पुरो॒डाशे॑न ।
त्वाम॒द्य ऋ॑षे
verses.translation: To-day the Sacrificer hath elected—dressing messes of cooked food and a rice-cake, binding a goat for Indra—Agni as his Hotar. To-day divine Vanaspatî hath with a goat served Indra well. He hath eaten from the fat, he hath accepted the cooked food, he hath waxed strong with the rice-cake. Thee, to-day, O Rishi, etc., as in XXI. 61.
verses.hindi: विद्वान्, शान्त, यज्ञशील पुरुषों का संग हमारे जीवन को भी उत्कृष्ट बनाये। हम उन्नति के शिखर पर पहंचने की कामना करें। फल कौ इच्छा से ऊपर उठकर कर्तव्य बुद्धि से कर्म करें ओर बुराई को गर्भं में ही समाप्त करने का ध्यान कर। होता यश्चत् स्वाहांकृतीरग्निं गृहप॑तिं पृथग्वरुणं भेषजं कविं क्त्रमिन्द्र॑ वयोधसम् ।
verses.transliteration: agnimadya hotāramavṛṇītāyaṃ yajamāna: pacanpaktī: pacanpuroḍāśaṃ badhnannindrāya chāgam | sūpasthā adya devo vanaspatirabhavadindrāya chāgena | aghattaṃ medastaḥ prati pacatāgrabhīdavīvṛdhatpuroḍāśena | tvāmadya ṛṣe
verses.wordMeaning: To-day the Sacrificer hath elected—dressing messes of cooked food and a rice-cake, binding a goat for Indra—Agni as his Hotar. To-day divine Vanaspatî hath with a goat served Indra well. He hath eaten from the fat, he hath accepted the cooked food,…
verses.commentary: Sense: To-day the Sacrificer hath elected—dressing messes of cooked food and a rice-cake, binding a goat for Indra—Agni as his Hotar. To-day divine Vanaspatî hath with a goat served Indra well. He hath eaten from the fat, he hath accepted the cooked food,…

verses.sanskrit:
होता॑ यक्षत्समिधा॒नं म॒हद्यश॒: सुस॑मिद्धं॒ वरे॑ण्यम॒ग्निमिन्द्रं॑ वयो॒धस॑म् ।
गा॒य॒त्रीं छन्द॑ इन्द्रि॒यं त्र्यविं॒ गां वयो॒ दध॒द्वेत्वाज्य॑स्य॒ होत॒र्यज॑
verses.translation: Let the Priest serve with sacrifice him who breaks forth, Tanûnapât, the germ which Aditi conceived, pure Indra who bestoweth strength, Bringing him mighty power, the Ushnih metre, an ox of two years old, and vital vigour.
verses.hindi: हममें स्वार्थत्याग कौ भावना हो, हमारे घर का प्रत्येक सभ्य यज्ञ के स्वभाववाला बने। हम द्वेष से दूर रहकर स्वस्थ व ज्ञानी बनें, भौतिक इच्छाओं से ऊपर उदे। देवं बर्हिर्व॑योधस देवमिन्द्र॑मवर्द्धयत् । गायत्र्या छन्दं सेद्धियं चक्षुरिन्द्रे वयो दधंद्रसुवन वसुधेय॑स्य वेतु यज॑॥ ३५॥
verses.transliteration: hotā yakṣatsamidhānaṃ mahadyaśa: susamiddhaṃ vareṇyamagnimindraṃ vayodhasam | gāyatrīṃ chanda indriyaṃ tryaviṃ gāṃ vayo dadhadvetvājyasya hotaryaja
verses.wordMeaning: Let the Priest serve with sacrifice him who breaks forth, Tanûnapât, the germ which Aditi conceived, pure Indra who bestoweth strength, Bringing him mighty power, the Ushnih metre, an ox of two years old, and vital vigour.
verses.commentary: Sense: Let the Priest serve with sacrifice him who breaks forth, Tanûnapât, the germ which Aditi conceived, pure Indra who bestoweth strength, Bringing him mighty power, the Ushnih metre, an ox of two years old, and vital vigour.

verses.sanskrit:
होता॑ यक्ष॒त्तनू॒नपा॑तमु॒द्भिदं॒ यं गर्भ॒मदि॑तिर्द॒धे शुचि॒मिन्द्रं॑ वयो॒धस॑म् ।
उ॒ष्णिहं॒ छन्द॑ इन्द्रि॒यं दि॑त्य॒वाहं॒ गां वयो॒ दध॒द्वेत्वाज्य॑स्य॒ होत॒र्यज॑
verses.translation: Let him enjoy; etc.
verses.hindi: दिव्य हदय प्रभु-प्राप्ति का प्रथम साधन है। प्रभु प्राप्ति के लिए साधना का प्रारम्भ वहीं से होता दहै कि हम हदय को वासनाशुन्य बना्े। उष्णिदा छन्द॑सेद्धियं प्राणमिनद्र वयो दधंद्रसुवने वसुधेयस्य व्यन्तु यज॑।। ३६॥ १. देवीः द्वारः =दिव्य गुणोवाले, व्यवहारो को उत्तमता से सिद्ध करनेवाले (दिव
verses.transliteration: hotā yakṣattanūnapātamudbhidaṃ yaṃ garbhamaditirdadhe śucimindraṃ vayodhasam | uṣṇihaṃ chanda indriyaṃ dityavāhaṃ gāṃ vayo dadhadvetvājyasya hotaryaja
verses.wordMeaning: Let him enjoy; etc.
verses.commentary: Sense: Let him enjoy; etc.

verses.sanskrit:
होता॑ यक्षदी॒डेन्य॑मीडि॒तं वृ॑त्र॒हन्त॑म॒मिडा॑भि॒रीड्यँ॒ सह॒: सोम॒मिन्द्रँ॑ वयो॒धस॑म् ।
अ॒नु॒ष्टुभं॒ छन्द॑ इन्द्रि॒यं पञ्चा॑विं॒ गां वयो॒ दध॒द्वेत्वाज्य॑स्य॒ होत॒र्यज॑
verses.translation: Let the Priest sacrifice to Soma, Indra, adorable, adored, best Vritra-slayer, strength-giver, might, to be adored with viands, Bringing him mighty power, Anushtup metre, a cow of thirty months, and vital vigour. Let him enjoy, etc
verses.hindi: 'दिन-रात को ज्लान-प्राप्ति द्वारा दीप्त बनाना ओर प्रत्येक कर्म में सफलता के साथ प्रभु का स्मरण करना, जिससे उस सफलता का गर्व न हो जाए" यह प्रभु-प्राप्ति देवी जोष्टी वसुधिती देवमिन्द्र वयोधसं देवी देवमवर्धताम् । बृहत्या छन्द॑सेद्दियश्श्रोत्रमिदरे वयो दधंद्रसुवनै वसुधेय॑स्य वीतां यज॑ ॥३८॥
verses.transliteration: hotā yakṣadīḍenyamīḍitaṃ vṛtrahantamamiḍābhirīḍya~ saha: somamindra~ vayodhasam | anuṣṭubhaṃ chanda indriyaṃ pañcāviṃ gāṃ vayo dadhadvetvājyasya hotaryaja
verses.wordMeaning: Let the Priest sacrifice to Soma, Indra, adorable, adored, best Vritra-slayer, strength-giver, might, to be adored with viands, Bringing him mighty power, Anushtup metre, a cow of thirty months, and vital vigour. Let him enjoy, etc
verses.commentary: Sense: Let the Priest sacrifice to Soma, Indra, adorable, adored, best Vritra-slayer, strength-giver, might, to be adored with viands, Bringing him mighty power, Anushtup metre, a cow of thirty months, and vital vigour. Let him enjoy, etc

verses.sanskrit:
होता॑ यक्षत्सुब॒र्हिषं॑ पूष॒ण्वन्त॒मम॑र्त्य॒ᳪ सीद॑न्तं ब॒र्हिषि॑ प्रि॒येऽमृतेन्द्रं॑ वयो॒धस॑म् ।
बृ॒ह॒तीं छन्द॑ इन्द्रि॒यं त्रि॑व॒त्सं गां वयो॒ दध॒द्वेत्वाज्य॑स्य॒ होत॒र्यज॑
verses.translation: Let the Priest worship Indra, strength-bestower, immortal, with fair grass, allied with Pûshan, seated on sacred grass, dear, everlasting, Bringing him mighty power, Brihatî metre, a steer of three years’ age and vital vigour. Let him enjoy, etc.
verses.hindi: हम प्राणसाधना के द्वारा कामादि वासनाओं पर विजय पापँ ओर प्रभु-प्राप्ति देवीस्तिस््रस्तिस््रो देवीर्वयोधसरं पत्तिमिन्द्र॑मवर्द्धयन्। जग॑त्या छन्द॑ सेद्धियद्शूषमिन्द्रे वयो द ध॑दरसुवनै वसुधेय॑स्य व्यन्तु यज॑।। ४९॥ १. देवीः तिस्रः =दिव्य गुणोवाली तीनों  भारती, सरस्वती, इडा' तिस्रः =तीनों ही
verses.transliteration: hotā yakṣatsubarhiṣaṃ pūṣaṇvantamamartya sīdantaṃ barhiṣi priye'mṛtendraṃ vayodhasam | bṛhatīṃ chanda indriyaṃ trivatsaṃ gāṃ vayo dadhadvetvājyasya hotaryaja
verses.wordMeaning: Let the Priest worship Indra, strength-bestower, immortal, with fair grass, allied with Pûshan, seated on sacred grass, dear, everlasting, Bringing him mighty power, Brihatî metre, a steer of three years’ age and vital vigour. Let him enjoy, etc.
verses.commentary: Sense: Let the Priest worship Indra, strength-bestower, immortal, with fair grass, allied with Pûshan, seated on sacred grass, dear, everlasting, Bringing him mighty power, Brihatî metre, a steer of three years’ age and vital vigour. Let him enjoy, etc.

verses.sanskrit:
होता॑ यक्ष॒द्व्यच॑स्वतीः सुप्राय॒णा ऋ॑ता॒वृधो॒ द्वारो॑ दे॒वीर्हि॑र॒ण्ययी॑र्ब्र॒ह्माण॒मिन्द्रं॑ वयो॒धस॑म् ।
प॒ङ्क्तिं छन्द॑ इ॒हेन्द्रि॒यं तु॑र्य॒वाहं॒ गां वयो॒ दध॒द्व्यन्त्वाज्य॑स्य॒ होत॒र्यज॑
verses.translation: Let the Priest worship the wide-opening Portals, easy to pass, divine, Law-strengthening, golden, Indra, the Brahman Priest, the strength-bestower, Bringing him mighty power, the Pankti metre, a bullock four years old, and vital vigour. Let them enjoy the butter. Hotar, worship.
verses.hindi: हमारे जीवन सें ' भारती, सरस्वती व इडा' एक विशेष दीप्ति को उत्पन्न करनेवाली है। ये हमें शत्रुओं के शोषक बल को प्राप्त करा। देवो नराशध्सो देवमिन्द्रं वयोधसं देवो देवमवर्धयत् । विराजा छन्द॑सेद्दियश्रूपमिन्दरे वयो दध॑द्रसुवन/ वसुधेय॑स्य वेतु यजं ॥४२॥
verses.transliteration: hotā yakṣadvyacasvatīḥ suprāyaṇā ṛtāvṛdho dvāro devīrhiraṇyayīrbrahmāṇamindraṃ vayodhasam | paṅktiṃ chanda ihendriyaṃ turyavāhaṃ gāṃ vayo dadhadvyantvājyasya hotaryaja
verses.wordMeaning: Let the Priest worship the wide-opening Portals, easy to pass, divine, Law-strengthening, golden, Indra, the Brahman Priest, the strength-bestower, Bringing him mighty power, the Pankti metre, a bullock four years old, and vital vigour. Let them enjoy the butter. Hotar, worship.
verses.commentary: Sense: Let the Priest worship the wide-opening Portals, easy to pass, divine, Law-strengthening, golden, Indra, the Brahman Priest, the strength-bestower, Bringing him mighty power, the Pankti metre, a bullock four years old, and vital vigour. Let them enjoy the butter. Hotar, worship.

verses.sanskrit:
होता॑ यक्षत्सु॒पेश॑सा सुशि॒ल्पे बृ॑ह॒ती उ॒भे नक्तो॒षासा॒ न द॑र्श॒ते विश्व॒मिन्द्रं॑ वयो॒धस॑म् ।
त्रि॒ष्टुभं॒ छन्द॑ इ॒हेन्द्रि॒यं प॑ष्ठ॒वाहं॒ गां वयो॒ दध॑द्वी॒तामाज्य॑स्य॒ होत॒र्यज॑
verses.translation: Let the Priest worship lofty Night and Morning, well-decked, of varied hue, lovely to look on, Indra the Universal, strength-bestower, Bringing him mighty power, the Trishtup metre, a bullock four years old, and vital vigour. Let them enjoy the butter. Hotar, worship.
verses.hindi: हम अपने जीवन को दीप्त ब व्यवस्थित बना, जिससे इस संसार में विचरते हए भी इसमें उल न जार्पँ ओर प्रभु को विस्मृत न करे। देवो वनस्पतिर्देवमिन्द्र॑ वयोधसं देवो देवम॑वर्द्धयत्। द्विपदा छन्द॑सेद्दियं भगमिन्द्र वयो दधंद्रसुवन वसुधेयस्य वेतु -यजं।।४३॥
verses.transliteration: hotā yakṣatsupeśasā suśilpe bṛhatī ubhe naktoṣāsā na darśate viśvamindraṃ vayodhasam | triṣṭubhaṃ chanda ihendriyaṃ paṣṭhavāhaṃ gāṃ vayo dadhadvītāmājyasya hotaryaja
verses.wordMeaning: Let the Priest worship lofty Night and Morning, well-decked, of varied hue, lovely to look on, Indra the Universal, strength-bestower, Bringing him mighty power, the Trishtup metre, a bullock four years old, and vital vigour. Let them enjoy the butter. Hotar, worship.
verses.commentary: Sense: Let the Priest worship lofty Night and Morning, well-decked, of varied hue, lovely to look on, Indra the Universal, strength-bestower, Bringing him mighty power, the Trishtup metre, a bullock four years old, and vital vigour. Let them enjoy the butter. Hotar, worship.

verses.sanskrit:
होता॑ यक्ष॒त्प्रचे॑तसा दे॒वाना॑मुत्त॒मं यशो॒ होता॑रा दैव्या क॒वी स॒युजेन्द्रं॑ वयो॒धस॑म् ।
जग॑तीं॒ छन्द॑ इन्द्रि॒यम॑न॒ड्वाहं॒ गां वयो॒ दध॑द्वी॒तामाज्य॑स्य॒ होत॒र्यज॑
verses.translation: Let the Priest worship both celestial Hotars, the Gods’ best glory, sages famed for wisdom, the two companions, Indra strength-bestower, Bringing him mighty power, Jagatî metre, an ox that draws the wain, and vital vigour. Let them enjoy the butter. Hotar, worship.
verses.hindi: हम अपने जीवनो मे ज्ञानमार्ग व कर्ममार्ग को मिलाकर चले, ज्ञानयोग व्यवस्थिति' ही हैवी संपत्ति का अंश है। देवं बर्हिर्वारितीनां देवमिन्दर॑ वयोधसं देवं देवम॑वर्््धयत्। ककुभा छन्द॑सेद्धियं यशाऽडनदरे वयो दधंद्रसुवनै वसुधेयस्य वेतु यज॑।। ४४॥
verses.transliteration: hotā yakṣatpracetasā devānāmuttamaṃ yaśo hotārā daivyā kavī sayujendraṃ vayodhasam | jagatīṃ chanda indriyamanaḍvāhaṃ gāṃ vayo dadhadvītāmājyasya hotaryaja
verses.wordMeaning: Let the Priest worship both celestial Hotars, the Gods’ best glory, sages famed for wisdom, the two companions, Indra strength-bestower, Bringing him mighty power, Jagatî metre, an ox that draws the wain, and vital vigour. Let them enjoy the butter. Hotar, worship.
verses.commentary: Sense: Let the Priest worship both celestial Hotars, the Gods’ best glory, sages famed for wisdom, the two companions, Indra strength-bestower, Bringing him mighty power, Jagatî metre, an ox that draws the wain, and vital vigour. Let them enjoy the butter. Hotar, worship.

verses.sanskrit:
होता॑ यक्ष॒त्पेश॑स्वतीस्ति॒स्रो दे॒वीर्हि॑र॒ण्ययी॒र्भार॑तीर्बृह॒तीर्म॒हीः पति॒मिन्द्रं॑ वयो॒धस॑म् ।
वि॒राजं॒ छन्द॑ इ॒हेन्द्रि॒यं धे॒नुं गां न वयो॒ दध॒द्व्यन्त्वाज्य॑स्य॒ होत॒र्यज॑
verses.translation: Let the Priest sacrifice to three well-decorated Goddesses, gold-decked, great, lofty, Bhâratîs, Indra their Lord who giveth strength, Bringing him mighty power, Virâj the metre, and a cow in milk. Let him enjoy the butter. Hotar, worship.
verses.hindi: वासनाशून्य हदय हममे शिखर तक पहुंचने की भावना को धारण कराये ओर यह भावना हमें प्रभु तक ले-जानेवाली हो। देवोऽअग्निः स्विष्ट कृदेवपिन््र॑ वयोधसं देवो देवम॑वर्द्दधयत्। अतिच्छन्दसा छन्द॑सेद्धियं क्षत्रमिनद्रे बयो द धंद्रसुवने वसुधेय॑स्य वेतु यज॑।। ४५५॥
verses.transliteration: hotā yakṣatpeśasvatīstisro devīrhiraṇyayīrbhāratīrbṛhatīrmahīḥ patimindraṃ vayodhasam | virājaṃ chanda ihendriyaṃ dhenuṃ gāṃ na vayo dadhadvyantvājyasya hotaryaja
verses.wordMeaning: Let the Priest sacrifice to three well-decorated Goddesses, gold-decked, great, lofty, Bhâratîs, Indra their Lord who giveth strength, Bringing him mighty power, Virâj the metre, and a cow in milk. Let him enjoy the butter. Hotar, worship.
verses.commentary: Sense: Let the Priest sacrifice to three well-decorated Goddesses, gold-decked, great, lofty, Bhâratîs, Indra their Lord who giveth strength, Bringing him mighty power, Virâj the metre, and a cow in milk. Let him enjoy the butter. Hotar, worship.

verses.sanskrit:
होता॑ यक्षत्सु॒रेत॑सं॒ त्वष्टा॑रं पुष्टि॒वर्ध॑नᳪ रू॒पाणि॒ बिभ्र॑तं॒ पृथ॒क् पुष्टि॒मिन्द्रं॑ वयो॒धस॑म् ।
द्वि॒पदं॒ छन्द॑ इन्द्रि॒यमु॒क्षाणं॒ गां न वयो॒ दध॒द्वेत्वाज्य॑स्य॒ होत॒र्यज॑
verses.translation: Let the Priest worship Tvashtar the prolific, strengthener of growth, maintaining varied growth and form, Indra who giveth vital force, Bringing him Dvipad metre, mighty power, and an ox full-grown. Let him enjoy the butter. Hotar, sacrifice.
verses.hindi: यज्ञाग्नि हमारे सब इष्टो को पूर्णं करे। हम इन यनज्ञौ को भी अहकार व फलेच्छा से ऊपर उठकर करे (सङ्गं त्यक्त्वा फलं चैव) तभी तो हम प्रभु को प्राप्त करेगे। प्रभु-वरण ( पुरोडाशपचन ) अग्निमद्य होतारमवृणीतायं यज॑मानः पचन् पक्तीः पच॑न् पुरोडाश बध्नन्निन्द्रौय
verses.transliteration: hotā yakṣatsuretasaṃ tvaṣṭāraṃ puṣṭivardhana rūpāṇi bibhrataṃ pṛthak puṣṭimindraṃ vayodhasam | dvipadaṃ chanda indriyamukṣāṇaṃ gāṃ na vayo dadhadvetvājyasya hotaryaja
verses.wordMeaning: Let the Priest worship Tvashtar the prolific, strengthener of growth, maintaining varied growth and form, Indra who giveth vital force, Bringing him Dvipad metre, mighty power, and an ox full-grown. Let him enjoy the butter. Hotar, sacrifice.
verses.commentary: Sense: Let the Priest worship Tvashtar the prolific, strengthener of growth, maintaining varied growth and form, Indra who giveth vital force, Bringing him Dvipad metre, mighty power, and an ox full-grown. Let him enjoy the butter. Hotar, sacrifice.

verses.sanskrit:
होता॑ यक्ष॒द्वन॒स्पति॑ᳪ शमि॒तार॑ᳪ श॒तक्र॑तु॒ᳪ हिर॑ण्यपर्णमु॒क्थिन॑ᳪ रश॒नां बिभ्र॑तं व॒शिं भग॒मिन्द्रं॑ वयो॒धस॑म् ।
क॒कुभं॒ छन्द॑ इ॒हेन्द्रि॒यं व॒शां वे॒हतं॒ गां वयो॒ दध॒द्वेत्वाज्य॑स्य॒ होत॒र्यज॑
verses.translation: Let the Priest serve with sacrifice the Forest Lord Vanaspatî, the Immolator, hundred-powered, praise-worthy, golden-leafed, who wears the girdle, loved, the gracious Lord, Indra who gives the strength of life, Giving him Kakup metre, mighty power, a barren, a calf- slipping cow, and vital vigour. Let him enjoy the butter. Hotar, sacrifice.
verses.hindi: हम अपनी शक्तियों का ठीक से परिपाक करे, अपने को प्रभु-प्राप्ति के नोट-अगला अध्याय "आप्री" संज्ञक मन्त्रों से प्रारम्भ होता है। इन मन्त्रों मे भक्त अपने कर्मो से (आ सर्वथा प्री उस प्रभु को प्रीणत) करता है। ४ बार उस प्रभु से अपने मेल का संकल्प करके उसने एेसा करना ही था।
verses.transliteration: hotā yakṣadvanaspati śamitāra śatakratu hiraṇyaparṇamukthina raśanāṃ bibhrataṃ vaśiṃ bhagamindraṃ vayodhasam | kakubhaṃ chanda ihendriyaṃ vaśāṃ vehataṃ gāṃ vayo dadhadvetvājyasya hotaryaja
verses.wordMeaning: Let the Priest serve with sacrifice the Forest Lord Vanaspatî, the Immolator, hundred-powered, praise-worthy, golden-leafed, who wears the girdle, loved, the gracious Lord, Indra who gives the strength of life, Giving him Kakup metre, mighty power, a barren,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Let the Priest serve with sacrifice the Forest Lord Vanaspatî, the Immolator, hundred-powered, praise-worthy, golden-leafed, who wears the girdle, loved, the gracious Lord, Indra who gives the strength of life, Giving him Kakup metre, mighty power, a barren,…

verses.sanskrit:
होता॑ यक्ष॒त्स्वाहा॑कृतीर॒ग्निं गृ॒हप॑तिं॒ पृथ॒ग्वरु॑णं भेष॒जं क॒विं क्ष॒त्रमिन्द्रं॑ वयो॒धस॑म् ।
अति॑च्छन्दसं॒ छन्द॑ इन्द्रि॒यं बृ॒हदृ॑ष॒भं गां वयो॒ दध॒द्व्यन्त्वाज्य॑स्य॒ होत॒र्यज॑
verses.translation: Let the Priest offer worship to the Svâhâkriti Goddesses, to Agni Household Lord apart, to Varuna the Leech and Sage. might, Indra who bestoweth strength, Bringing him Atichhandas metre, great and mighty power, a strong bull, his prime, and vital vigour. Let them enjoy the butter. Hotar, sacrifice.
verses.hindi: प्रभु हमारे शरीर को नीरोग बनानेवाले है। हमारे शत्रुओं को जीतनेवाले है। हम मधुर मार्गो से चलते हैँ ओर प्रशंसनीय तेजवाले होते हैँ तोवे प्रभु हमें सुखी करते ह। हमें चाहिए कि हम वीर्य को शरीर में सुरक्षित करते हए दान की वृत्तिवाले बनें ओर प्रभु से अपना मेल करे।
verses.transliteration: hotā yakṣatsvāhākṛtīragniṃ gṛhapatiṃ pṛthagvaruṇaṃ bheṣajaṃ kaviṃ kṣatramindraṃ vayodhasam | aticchandasaṃ chanda indriyaṃ bṛhadṛṣabhaṃ gāṃ vayo dadhadvyantvājyasya hotaryaja
verses.wordMeaning: Let the Priest offer worship to the Svâhâkriti Goddesses, to Agni Household Lord apart, to Varuna the Leech and Sage. might, Indra who bestoweth strength, Bringing him Atichhandas metre, great and mighty power, a strong bull, his prime, and vital vigour.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Let the Priest offer worship to the Svâhâkriti Goddesses, to Agni Household Lord apart, to Varuna the Leech and Sage. might, Indra who bestoweth strength, Bringing him Atichhandas metre, great and mighty power, a strong bull, his prime, and vital vigour.…

verses.sanskrit:
दे॒वं ब॒र्हिर्व॑यो॒धसं॑ दे॒वमिन्द्र॑मवर्धयत् ।
गा॒य॒त्र्या छन्द॑सेन्द्रि॒यं चक्षु॒रिन्द्रे॒ वयो॒ दध॑द्वसु॒वने॑ वसु॒धेय॑स्य वेतु॒ यज॑
verses.translation: The Grass divine hath added might to radiant Indra strength-giver, Laying in Indra wondrous power and sight and strength by Gâyatrî. For gain of wealth let him enjoy the butter. Offer sacrifice.
verses.hindi: हम अपने में ओजस्विता को धारण करे। हमारे इन्द्रियद्वार् उस प्रभु का वर्धन करनेवाले हों। इनसे सत्य का ही पोषण हो ओर शक्ति का रक्षण करते हुए हम प्रभु को उषास्रानक्ता- दोनों सन्ध्याकाल होता यक्षदुषेऽ इन्द्र॑स्य धेनू सुदु मातरां मही।
verses.transliteration: devaṃ barhirvayodhasaṃ devamindramavardhayat | gāyatryā chandasendriyaṃ cakṣurindre vayo dadhadvasuvane vasudheyasya vetu yaja
verses.wordMeaning: The Grass divine hath added might to radiant Indra strength-giver, Laying in Indra wondrous power and sight and strength by Gâyatrî. For gain of wealth let him enjoy the butter. Offer sacrifice.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Grass divine hath added might to radiant Indra strength-giver, Laying in Indra wondrous power and sight and strength by Gâyatrî. For gain of wealth let him enjoy the butter. Offer sacrifice.

verses.sanskrit:
दे॒वीर्द्वारो॑ वयो॒धस॒ᳪ शुचि॒मिन्द्र॑मवर्धयन् ।
उ॒ष्णिहा॒ छन्द॑सेन्द्रि॒यं प्रा॒णमिन्द्रे॒ वयो॒ दध॑द्वसु॒वने॑ वसु॒धेय॑स्य व्यन्तु॒ यज॑
verses.translation: The Doors divine have magnified bright Indra, who bestoweth strength. With Ushnih laying mighty power in Indra, vital breath and force. For gain of wealth let them enjoy the butter. Offer sacrifice.
verses.hindi: दोनों उषःकाल जीव का वर्धन, पूरण व निर्माण करनेवाले हो। ये इसे वायु के समान क्रियाशील बना्ँ। इसके लिए शक्ति का पान करनेवाले हों। प्राणापान (हैव्या होतारा) होता यक्चदेव्या होतारा भिषजा सखाया हविषेन्द्र॑ भिषज्यतः।
verses.transliteration: devīrdvāro vayodhasa śucimindramavardhayan | uṣṇihā chandasendriyaṃ prāṇamindre vayo dadhadvasuvane vasudheyasya vyantu yaja
verses.wordMeaning: The Doors divine have magnified bright Indra, who bestoweth strength. With Ushnih laying mighty power in Indra, vital breath and force. For gain of wealth let them enjoy the butter. Offer sacrifice.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Doors divine have magnified bright Indra, who bestoweth strength. With Ushnih laying mighty power in Indra, vital breath and force. For gain of wealth let them enjoy the butter. Offer sacrifice.

verses.sanskrit:
दे॒वी उ॒षासा॒नक्ता॑ दे॒वमिन्द्रं॑ वयो॒धसं॑ दे॒वी दे॒वम॑वर्धताम् ।
अ॒नु॒ष्टुभा॒ छन्द॑सेन्द्रि॒यं बल॒मिन्द्रे॒ वयो॒ दध॑द्वसु॒वने॑ वसु॒धेय॑स्य वीतां॒ यज॑
verses.translation: Morning and Night, divine Ones, have strengthened bright Indra, strength-giver, the Goddesses advanced the God, With the Anushtup laying power in Indra, strength and vital force. For gain of wealth let them enjoy. Pay sacrifice.
verses.hindi: प्राणापान साधक को नीरोग करते है। ये उसे क्रान्तदर्शी , दिव्य गुणोवाला ओर ज्ञानी बनाते है। प्राणापान हमारे रेतस् की ऊर्ध्वगति का साधन हो। होता यक्षत्तिस्रो दे वीर्न भेषजं त्रय॑स्तिधात॑वो ऽपसऽडइडा सर॑स्वती भार॑ती महीः । १. होता=दानपूर्वक अदन करनेवाला तिस्रः देवीः = तीन देवियों को यक्षत्=-अपने साथ
verses.transliteration: devī uṣāsānaktā devamindraṃ vayodhasaṃ devī devamavardhatām | anuṣṭubhā chandasendriyaṃ balamindre vayo dadhadvasuvane vasudheyasya vītāṃ yaja
verses.wordMeaning: Morning and Night, divine Ones, have strengthened bright Indra, strength-giver, the Goddesses advanced the God, With the Anushtup laying power in Indra, strength and vital force. For gain of wealth let them enjoy. Pay sacrifice.
verses.commentary: Sense: Morning and Night, divine Ones, have strengthened bright Indra, strength-giver, the Goddesses advanced the God, With the Anushtup laying power in Indra, strength and vital force. For gain of wealth let them enjoy. Pay sacrifice.

verses.sanskrit:
दे॒वी जोष्ट्री॒ वसु॑धिती दे॒वमिन्द्रं॑ वयो॒धसं॑ दे॒वी दे॒वम॑वर्धताम् ।
बृ॒ह॒त्या छन्द॑सेन्द्रि॒यᳪ श्रोत्र॒मिन्द्रे॒ वयो॒ दध॑द्वसु॒वने॑ वसु॒धेय॑स्य वीतां॒ यज॑
verses.translation: Kind, bounteous, and divine, they have strengthened bright Indra, force-giver, the Goddesses advanced the God, Laying in Indra power and force and hearing with the Brihatî. For gain of wealth let them enjoy. Pay sacrifice.
verses.hindi: इन्द्रियां बडी प्रबल ठै, विषय-वासनाओं के तृणाच्छन्न कूप के समान है। हम प्रभु-नामस्मरण करते हए इन्द्रियों को इस कूणँ मे गिरने से -चा्ं। धन कमाण, परन्तु प्रभु को न भूलें ओर धन का दान करनेवाले हों। देवीऽ उषासानक्तेन्द्र॑ यज्ञे प्र॑यत्य्ह्वेताम्।
verses.transliteration: devī joṣṭrī vasudhitī devamindraṃ vayodhasaṃ devī devamavardhatām | bṛhatyā chandasendriya śrotramindre vayo dadhadvasuvane vasudheyasya vītāṃ yaja
verses.wordMeaning: Kind, bounteous, and divine, they have strengthened bright Indra, force-giver, the Goddesses advanced the God, Laying in Indra power and force and hearing with the Brihatî. For gain of wealth let them enjoy. Pay sacrifice.
verses.commentary: Sense: Kind, bounteous, and divine, they have strengthened bright Indra, force-giver, the Goddesses advanced the God, Laying in Indra power and force and hearing with the Brihatî. For gain of wealth let them enjoy. Pay sacrifice.

verses.sanskrit:
दे॒वी ऊ॒र्जाहु॑ती॒ दुघे॑ सु॒दु॒घे॒ पय॒सेन्द्रं॑ वयो॒धसं॑ दे॒वी दे॒वम॑वर्धताम् ।
प॒ङ्क्त्या छन्द॑सेन्द्रि॒यᳪ शु॒क्रमिन्द्रे॒ वयो॒ दध॑द्वसु॒वने॑ वसु॒धेय॑स्य वीतां॒ यज॑
verses.translation: Bringers of strengthening sacrifice, the Goddesses, two teeming cows, have heightened Indra's power with milk, Laying bright power in Indra with Pankti, and vital energy. For gain of wealth let them enjoy. Pay sacrifice.
verses.hindi: प्राणापान कौ साधना हमारे दृष्टिकोण को शुद्ध करे। हम पाप को पाप के देवीस्तिस््रस्तिस््रो देवीः पतिमिन्द्र॑मवर्द्धयन् । अस्पुश्चद्धार॑ती दिव॑ःरुदरर्यज्ञः १. तिस्रः देवीः = भारती, सरस्वत्ती व इडा नामक तीन देवियँ, जो तिस्रः = तीनों की तीनों देवीः =द्युति- ज्लानदीप्ति व दानवृत्ति को हमें प्राप्त करानेवाली है, ये देवियाँ पतिम्
verses.transliteration: devī ūrjāhutī dughe sudughe payasendraṃ vayodhasaṃ devī devamavardhatām | paṅktyā chandasendriya śukramindre vayo dadhadvasuvane vasudheyasya vītāṃ yaja
verses.wordMeaning: Bringers of strengthening sacrifice, the Goddesses, two teeming cows, have heightened Indra's power with milk, Laying bright power in Indra with Pankti, and vital energy. For gain of wealth let them enjoy. Pay sacrifice.
verses.commentary: Sense: Bringers of strengthening sacrifice, the Goddesses, two teeming cows, have heightened Indra's power with milk, Laying bright power in Indra with Pankti, and vital energy. For gain of wealth let them enjoy. Pay sacrifice.

verses.sanskrit:
दे॒वा दैव्या॒ होता॑रा दे॒वमिन्द्रं॑ वयो॒धसं॑ दे॒वौ दे॒वम॑वर्धताम् ।
त्रि॒ष्टुभा॒ छन्द॑सेन्द्रि॒यं त्विषि॒मिन्द्रे॒ वयो॒ दध॑द्वसु॒वने॑ वसु॒धेय॑स्य वीतां॒ यज॑
verses.translation: The Gods, two heavenly Hotars, have strengthened bright Indra, force-giver, those Gods have magnified the God, With Trishtup giving Indra power, impetuous might, and vital strength. For gain of wealth let them enjoy. Pay sacrifice.
verses.hindi: यज्ञशील पुरुष प्रभु का ही वरण करता हे। वासना-विनाश से वह प्रभु सुगमता से उपस्थान के योग्य होता है। वह अपनी शक्तियों का ठीक से परिपाक करता हे। ऋषि --सरस्वती। देवता-अग्निः। छन्दः- स्वराङजगतती। स्वरः निषादः। होता यक्षत्समिधानं महद्यशः सुस॑मिद्धं वरैण्यमग्निमिन्द्र॑ वयोधसम् ।
verses.transliteration: devā daivyā hotārā devamindraṃ vayodhasaṃ devau devamavardhatām | triṣṭubhā chandasendriyaṃ tviṣimindre vayo dadhadvasuvane vasudheyasya vītāṃ yaja
verses.wordMeaning: The Gods, two heavenly Hotars, have strengthened bright Indra, force-giver, those Gods have magnified the God, With Trishtup giving Indra power, impetuous might, and vital strength. For gain of wealth let them enjoy. Pay sacrifice.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Gods, two heavenly Hotars, have strengthened bright Indra, force-giver, those Gods have magnified the God, With Trishtup giving Indra power, impetuous might, and vital strength. For gain of wealth let them enjoy. Pay sacrifice.

verses.sanskrit:
दे॒वीस्ति॒स्रस्ति॒स्रो दे॒वीर्व॑यो॒धसं॒ पति॒मिन्द्र॑मवर्धयन् ।
जग॑त्या॒ छन्द॑सेन्द्रि॒यᳪ शूष॒मिन्द्रे॒ वयो॒ दध॑द्वसु॒वने॑ वसु॒धेय॑स्य व्यन्तु॒ यज॑
verses.translation: Goddesses three, three Goddesses have heightened their Lord Indra's strength, his who bestoweth vital force, Laying in Indra power and might and vital strength with Jagatî. For gain of wealth let them enjoy. Pay sacrifice.
verses.hindi: हम होता बनकर वासनाओं को नष्ट करनेवाले ' वृत्रहन्तम ' प्रभु का अपने से मेल बना्ँ। हम प्रत्येक सफलता को प्रभु की शक्ति से होता हआ समञ्ञे। हम उस वेदवाणी को अपनार्णँ जो पँचों इन्द्रियों की रक्षा करनेवाली हे। ऋषि:- सरस्वती। देवता-इन्द्रः। छन्द :- स्वराडतिजगती। स्वरः निषादः
verses.transliteration: devīstisrastisro devīrvayodhasaṃ patimindramavardhayan | jagatyā chandasendriya śūṣamindre vayo dadhadvasuvane vasudheyasya vyantu yaja
verses.wordMeaning: Goddesses three, three Goddesses have heightened their Lord Indra's strength, his who bestoweth vital force, Laying in Indra power and might and vital strength with Jagatî. For gain of wealth let them enjoy. Pay sacrifice.
verses.commentary: Sense: Goddesses three, three Goddesses have heightened their Lord Indra's strength, his who bestoweth vital force, Laying in Indra power and might and vital strength with Jagatî. For gain of wealth let them enjoy. Pay sacrifice.

verses.sanskrit:
