दे॒वो नरा॒शᳪसो॑ दे॒वमिन्द्रं॑ वयो॒धसं॑ दे॒वो दे॒वम॑वर्धयत् ।
वि॒राजा॒ छन्द॑सेन्द्रि॒यᳪ रु॒पमिन्द्रे॒ वयो॒ दध॑द्वसु॒वने॑ वसु॒धेय॑स्य वेतु॒ यज॑
verses.translation: The God, the Praise of all men, hath strengthened bright Indra force-giver, the God hath magnified the God, Laying in Indra with Virâj beauty and power and vital force. For gain of wealth let him enjoy. Pay sacrifice.
verses.hindi: होता उस प्रभु को अपने साथ संगत. करता है जो प्रभु प्रिय, अर्थात् द्वेष से शून्य तथा अमृत, विषयों के पीछे न मरनेवाले वासनाशन्य हृदय में निवास करते हेँ। होतां यक्षद्वयच॑स्वतीः सुप्रायणाऽऋतावृधो द्वारो देवीर्दिरण्ययीर्रह्याणयिन्दर १. होता=दानपूर्वक अदन करनेवाला व्यक्ति देवीः द्वारः =दिव्य इन्द्रियो को- जीवनयात्रा
verses.transliteration: devo narāśaso devamindraṃ vayodhasaṃ devo devamavardhayat | virājā chandasendriya rupamindre vayo dadhadvasuvane vasudheyasya vetu yaja
verses.wordMeaning: The God, the Praise of all men, hath strengthened bright Indra force-giver, the God hath magnified the God, Laying in Indra with Virâj beauty and power and vital force. For gain of wealth let him enjoy. Pay sacrifice.
verses.commentary: Sense: The God, the Praise of all men, hath strengthened bright Indra force-giver, the God hath magnified the God, Laying in Indra with Virâj beauty and power and vital force. For gain of wealth let him enjoy. Pay sacrifice.

verses.sanskrit:
दे॒वो वन॒स्पति॑र्दे॒वमिन्द्रं॑ वयो॒धसं॑ दे॒वो दे॒वम॑वर्धयत् ।
द्विप॑दा॒ छन्द॑सेन्द्रि॒यं भग॒मिन्द्रे॒ वयो॒ दध॑द्वसु॒वने॑ वसु॒धेय॑स्य वेतु॒ यज॑
verses.translation: The God the Forest Sovran hath strengthened bright Indra, force-giver, the God hath magnified the God, With Dvipad storing Indra with fortune and power and vital strength. For gain of wealth let him enjoy. Pay sacrifice.
verses.hindi: - होता पुरुष के लिए दिन-रात बड़ सुन्दर होते हं, ये उसे सौन्दर्य प्रदान करते हे। यह इनके चक्र मेँ प्रभु के रचना- सौन्दर्य को देखता हुआ प्रभ को पूजता हे, उसके साथ अपना सम्पर्क बनाता है ओर उसके प्रति अपना अर्पण कर देता हे। होतौ यक्षत्प्रचैतसा देवानामुत्तमं यशो होतारा हैव्यां कवी सयुजेन्द्रं बयोधसंम् । त्वष्टादेव हमें सुरेतस् बना, हमारे जीवनो को सुन्दर व पुष्ट करे। ऋषि: सरस्वती। देवता-इन्द्रः। छन्द: निचुदत्यष्टिः। स्वरः-गान्धारः। १. होता=दानपूर्वक अदन करनेवाला यक्षत् अपने साभ उस विद्वान को संगत करता है , जोकि वनस्पतिम् ज्ञान की किरणों का पति हे, शमितारम्-शान्ति प्रदाता व शान्तस्वभाव
verses.transliteration: devo vanaspatirdevamindraṃ vayodhasaṃ devo devamavardhayat | dvipadā chandasendriyaṃ bhagamindre vayo dadhadvasuvane vasudheyasya vetu yaja
verses.wordMeaning: The God the Forest Sovran hath strengthened bright Indra, force-giver, the God hath magnified the God, With Dvipad storing Indra with fortune and power and vital strength. For gain of wealth let him enjoy. Pay sacrifice.
verses.commentary: Sense: The God the Forest Sovran hath strengthened bright Indra, force-giver, the God hath magnified the God, With Dvipad storing Indra with fortune and power and vital strength. For gain of wealth let him enjoy. Pay sacrifice.

verses.sanskrit:
दे॒वं ब॒र्हिर्वारि॑तीनां दे॒वमिन्द्रं॑ वयो॒धसं॑ दे॒वं दे॒वम॑वर्धयत् ।
क॒कुभा॒ छन्द॑सेन्द्रि॒यं यश॒ इन्द्रे॒ वयो॒ दध॑द्वसु॒वने॑ वसु॒धेय॑स्य वेतु॒ यज॑
verses.translation: The Grass divine of water-plants hath helped bright Indra force-giver, the God hath magnified the God, Laying in Indra mighty power with Kakup, fame and vital strength. For gain of wealth let it enjoy. Pay sacrifice.
verses.hindi: - विद्वान्, शान्त, यज्ञशील पुरुषों का संग हमारे जीवन को भी उत्कृष्ट बनाये। हम उन्नति के शिखर पर पहंचने की कामना करें। फल कौ इच्छा से ऊपर उठकर कर्तव्य बुद्धि से कर्म करें ओर बुराई को गर्भं में ही समाप्त करने का ध्यान कर। होता यश्चत् स्वाहांकृतीरग्निं गृहप॑तिं पृथग्वरुणं भेषजं कविं क्त्रमिन्द्र॑ वयोधसम् ।
verses.transliteration: devaṃ barhirvāritīnāṃ devamindraṃ vayodhasaṃ devaṃ devamavardhayat | kakubhā chandasendriyaṃ yaśa indre vayo dadhadvasuvane vasudheyasya vetu yaja
verses.wordMeaning: The Grass divine of water-plants hath helped bright Indra force-giver, the God hath magnified the God, Laying in Indra mighty power with Kakup, fame and vital strength. For gain of wealth let it enjoy. Pay sacrifice.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Grass divine of water-plants hath helped bright Indra force-giver, the God hath magnified the God, Laying in Indra mighty power with Kakup, fame and vital strength. For gain of wealth let it enjoy. Pay sacrifice.

verses.sanskrit:
दे॒वो अ॒ग्निः स्वि॑ष्ट॒कृद्दे॒वमिन्द्रं॑ वयो॒धसं॑  दे॒वम॑वर्धयत् ।
अति॑च्छन्दसा॒ छन्द॑सेन्द्रि॒यं क्ष॒त्रमिन्द्रे॒ वयो॒ दध॑द्वसु॒वने॑ वसु॒धेय॑स्य वेतु॒ यज॑
verses.translation: Agni, the God who makes fair rites, hath strengthened Indra force-giver, the God hath magnified the God, Laying with Atichhandas power in Indra, sway, and vital strength. For gain of wealth let him enjoy. Pay sacrifice.
verses.hindi: सब इच्दरियद्वारों कौ पवित्रता तथा हीन स्नेह से ऊपर उठना, हमें प्रभु कौ ओर ले-आता है। प्रकृति व प्रभु में हमारा स्नेह प्रभु के लिए हो, हम प्रकृति कौ ओर देवीऽ उषासानक्ता देवभिन्द्र॑ वयोधसं देवी देवमवर्धताम् । अनुष्टुभा छन्द॑सेद्धियं बलमिद्रं वयो दधंद्रसुवन वसुधेय॑स्य वीतां यजं॑॥। ३७॥ दिन-रात आगे बदढ्ने की भावना" हमें उत्कर्षं कौ ओर ले-जाकर प्रभु के समीप प्राप्त करानेवाली होती है। हम अपने कानों से दिन-रात प्रभु की महिमा का श्रवण करे ओर वैसा ही बनने का प्रयत्न करे। देवीऽ ऊर्जाहंती दुघे' सुदुघे पयसेनद्र॑ वयोधसं देवी देवम॑वर्दधताम्।
verses.transliteration: devo agniḥ sviṣṭakṛddevamindraṃ vayodhasaṃ devamavardhayat | aticchandasā chandasendriyaṃ kṣatramindre vayo dadhadvasuvane vasudheyasya vetu yaja
verses.wordMeaning: Agni, the God who makes fair rites, hath strengthened Indra force-giver, the God hath magnified the God, Laying with Atichhandas power in Indra, sway, and vital strength. For gain of wealth let him enjoy. Pay sacrifice.
verses.commentary: Sense: Agni, the God who makes fair rites, hath strengthened Indra force-giver, the God hath magnified the God, Laying with Atichhandas power in Indra, sway, and vital strength. For gain of wealth let him enjoy. Pay sacrifice.

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒ग्निम॒द्य होता॑रमवृणीता॒यं यज॑मान॒: पच॒न्पक्ती॒: पच॑न्पुरो॒डाशं॑ ब॒ध्नन्निन्द्रा॑य वयो॒धसे॒ छाग॑म् ।
सू॒प॒स्था अ॒द्य दे॒वो वन॒स्पति॑रभव॒दिन्द्रा॑य वयो॒धसे॒ छागे॑न ।
अघ॒त्तं मे॑द॒स्तः प्रति॑पच॒ताग्र॑भी॒दवी॑वृधत्पुरो॒डाशे॑न । त्वाम॒द्य ऋ॑षे
verses.translation: To-day the Sacrificer hath elected, etc., as in verse 23. To-day divine Vanaspatî, etc. . . . . . . Thee, to-day, O Rishi, etc. . . . . . .
verses.hindi: द्यावापृथिवी से उत्तम अन्न-रस को प्राप्त करके हम अपनी पौँचों ज्ञानेन्द्रिय कर्मेन्दियों व पचो प्राणों को पुष्ट करते हए संसार में आवश्यक धन का अर्जन करे ओर देवा हैव्या होतारा देवमिन्द्र वयोधसं देवौ देवम॑वर्द्धताम्। वरष्टुभा छन्द॑सेद्धियं त्विषिमिन्द्रे वयो द धंदरसुवन वसुधेय॑स्य वीतां यज॑ ॥४०॥
verses.transliteration: agnimadya hotāramavṛṇītāyaṃ yajamāna: pacanpaktī: pacanpuroḍāśaṃ badhnannindrāya vayodhase chāgam | sūpasthā adya devo vanaspatirabhavadindrāya vayodhase chāgena | aghattaṃ medastaḥ pratipacatāgrabhīdavīvṛdhatpuroḍāśena | tvāmadya ṛṣe
verses.wordMeaning: To-day the Sacrificer hath elected, etc., as in verse 23. To-day divine Vanaspatî, etc. . . . . . . Thee, to-day, O Rishi, etc. . . . . . .
verses.commentary: Sense: To-day the Sacrificer hath elected, etc., as in verse 23. To-day divine Vanaspatî, etc. . . . . . . Thee, to-day, O Rishi, etc. . . . . . .

verses.sanskrit:
समि॑द्धो अ॒ञ्जन् कृद॑रं मती॒नां घृ॒तम॑ग्ने॒ मधु॑म॒त्पिन्व॑मानः ।
वा॒जी वह॑न् वा॒जिनं॑ जातवेदो दे॒वानां॑ वक्षि प्रि॒यमा स॒धस्थ॑म्
verses.translation: com The Texts of the White Yajurveda, tr. Ralph T.H. Griffith, [1899], BOOK THE TWENTY-NINTH. DECKING the treasure-house of prayers, O Agni, enkindled, pouring forth sweet-tasted butter, Swift-moving, bearing curd, O Jâtavedas, bear what they love to the Gods’ habitation.
verses.hindi: प्रभुभक्त के जीवन में ज्ञान का सर्वोपरि स्थान होता है। उसे यह पता है कि ज्ञानीभक्त दी प्रभु को आत्मतुल्य प्रिय है। घृतेनाञ्जन्त्सं पथो देवयानान् प्रजानन्वाज्यप्यैतु देवान् । १. गतमन्त्र के अनुसार एक प्रभुभक्त अपने जीवन को ज्ञानमय बनाने का प्रयत्न करता
verses.transliteration: samiddho añjan kṛdaraṃ matīnāṃ ghṛtamagne madhumatpinvamānaḥ | vājī vahan vājinaṃ jātavedo devānāṃ vakṣi priyamā sadhastham
verses.wordMeaning: com The Texts of the White Yajurveda, tr. Ralph T.H. Griffith, [1899], BOOK THE TWENTY-NINTH. DECKING the treasure-house of prayers, O Agni, enkindled, pouring forth sweet-tasted butter, Swift-moving, bearing curd, O Jâtavedas, bear what they love to the Gods’ habitation.
verses.commentary: Sense: com The Texts of the White Yajurveda, tr. Ralph T.H. Griffith, [1899], BOOK THE TWENTY-NINTH. DECKING the treasure-house of prayers, O Agni, enkindled, pouring forth sweet-tasted butter, Swift-moving, bearing curd, O Jâtavedas, bear what they love to the Gods’ habitation.

verses.sanskrit:
घृ॒तेना॒ञ्जन्त्सं प॒थो दे॑व॒याना॑न् प्रजा॒नन् वा॒ज्यप्ये॑तु दे॒वान् ।
अनु॑ त्वा सप्ते प्र॒दिश॑: सचन्ताᳪ स्व॒धाम॒स्मै॒ यज॑मानाय धेहि
verses.translation: Balming the paths that lead to heaven with fatness, let the Steed go unto the Gods well-knowing. Courser, the Quarters of the sky attend thee! Bestow thou food upon this Sacrificer.
verses.hindi: हम सन्मार्ग से चलनेवाले हों, देवों के सम्पर्क में आरण, विद्वान् अतिथियों का सत्कार करनेवाले हों। अग्निष्ट्वा देवैर्वसंभिः स॒जोषाः प्रीतं वद्धिः वहतु जातवेदाः॥ ३॥ १. है बृहदुक्थ! तू देवयानमार्गं को अपनाकर अपने सुन्द्र व्यवहार के कारण ईड्यः
verses.transliteration: ghṛtenāñjantsaṃ patho devayānān prajānan vājyapyetu devān | anu tvā sapte pradiśa: sacantā svadhāmasmai yajamānāya dhehi
verses.wordMeaning: Balming the paths that lead to heaven with fatness, let the Steed go unto the Gods well-knowing. Courser, the Quarters of the sky attend thee! Bestow thou food upon this Sacrificer.
verses.commentary: Sense: Balming the paths that lead to heaven with fatness, let the Steed go unto the Gods well-knowing. Courser, the Quarters of the sky attend thee! Bestow thou food upon this Sacrificer.

verses.sanskrit:
ईड्य॒श्चासि॒ वन्द्य॑श्च वाजिन्ना॒शुश्चासि॒ मेध्य॑श्च सप्ते ।
अ॒ग्निष्ट्वा॑ देवै॒र्वसु॑भिः स॒जोषा॑: प्री॒तं वह्निं॑ वहतु जा॒तवे॑दाः
verses.translation: Thou, Steed, art meet for laud and veneration; swift, fit for sacrifice art thou, O Courser. In concert with the Gods and Vasus Agni Omniscient waft thee a contented bearer!
verses.hindi: हम आपने उत्तम कर्मो से ईड्य व वन्य बनें। यज्ञात्मक उत्तम कर्मो मे लगे रहे। देव, वसु, प्रीत (सन्तुष्ट) व वहि (कर्तव्य को करनेवाले) बनकर प्रभु के प्रिय हो। देवेभिरर्यक्तमदितिः सजोषाः स्योनं कण्वाना सुंविते द॑धातु ४॥ १. गतमन्त्र के अनुसार जब हम प्रभु के प्रिय बनते है तब हमारा हदय प्रभु कौ भावना
verses.transliteration: īḍyaścāsi vandyaśca vājinnāśuścāsi medhyaśca sapte | agniṣṭvā devairvasubhiḥ sajoṣā: prītaṃ vahniṃ vahatu jātavedāḥ
verses.wordMeaning: Thou, Steed, art meet for laud and veneration; swift, fit for sacrifice art thou, O Courser. In concert with the Gods and Vasus Agni Omniscient waft thee a contented bearer!
verses.commentary: Sense: Thou, Steed, art meet for laud and veneration; swift, fit for sacrifice art thou, O Courser. In concert with the Gods and Vasus Agni Omniscient waft thee a contented bearer!

verses.sanskrit:
स्ती॒र्णं ब॒र्हिः सु॒ष्टरी॑मा जुषा॒णोरु पृ॒थु प्रथ॑मानं पृथि॒व्याम् ।
दे॒वेभि॑र्यु॒क्तमदि॑तिः स॒जोषा॑: स्यो॒नं कृ॑ण्वा॒ना सु॑वि॒ते द॑धातु
verses.translation: Pleased with much Sacred Grass which we have scattered wide spread upon the earth, a pleasant carpet, Joined with the Gods may Aditi, accordant, bestowing bliss award it happy fortune.
verses.hindi: प्रभु हमारे हदयों कौ वासनाओ से सुरक्षित करके सन्मार्ग में स्थापित करे। प्रभुकृपा से हमारे हदय विशाल हों, विशालता के कारण ही उनकी ख्याति हो। ऋष्वाः सतीः कवषः शुम्भ॑माना द्वारो देवीः सुप्रायणा भ॑वन्तु ॥५॥ १. गतमन्त्र के अनुसार जब हमारे हदय सुरक्षित होते हे, उनमें विशालता होती है ओर
verses.transliteration: stīrṇaṃ barhiḥ suṣṭarīmā juṣāṇoru pṛthu prathamānaṃ pṛthivyām | devebhiryuktamaditiḥ sajoṣā: syonaṃ kṛṇvānā suvite dadhātu
verses.wordMeaning: Pleased with much Sacred Grass which we have scattered wide spread upon the earth, a pleasant carpet, Joined with the Gods may Aditi, accordant, bestowing bliss award it happy fortune.
verses.commentary: Sense: Pleased with much Sacred Grass which we have scattered wide spread upon the earth, a pleasant carpet, Joined with the Gods may Aditi, accordant, bestowing bliss award it happy fortune.

verses.sanskrit:
ए॒ता उ॑ वः सु॒भगा॑ वि॒श्वरू॑पा॒ वि पक्षो॑भि॒: श्रय॑माणा॒ उदातै॑: ।
ऋ॒ष्वाः स॒तीः क॒वष॒: शुम्भ॑माना॒ द्वारो॑ दे॒वीः सु॑प्राय॒णा भ॑वन्तु
verses.translation: May these your Doors divine that wear all colours, auspicious, with uplifted leaves unfolding, Lofty and closely fitted and sonorous, rich in adornment, offer easy passage.
verses.hindi: हमारे इन्द्ियद्वार उत्तम, प्रकृष्ट गमनवाले हो। प्रभुनामोच्चारण से बुराइयों को नष्ट करनेवाले होकर सुन्दर व दिव्य वनें। अन्तरा सित्रावरूणा चर॑न्ती मुख यज्ञानांमभि स॑विदाने। ९. प्रभु यजमान व यजमानपत्नी से कहते है कि गतमन्त्र के अनुसार जब तुम अपने
verses.transliteration: etā u vaḥ subhagā viśvarūpā vi pakṣobhi: śrayamāṇā udātai: | ṛṣvāḥ satīḥ kavaṣa: śumbhamānā dvāro devīḥ suprāyaṇā bhavantu
verses.wordMeaning: May these your Doors divine that wear all colours, auspicious, with uplifted leaves unfolding, Lofty and closely fitted and sonorous, rich in adornment, offer easy passage.
verses.commentary: Sense: May these your Doors divine that wear all colours, auspicious, with uplifted leaves unfolding, Lofty and closely fitted and sonorous, rich in adornment, offer easy passage.

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒न्त॒रा मि॒त्रावरु॑णा॒ चर॑न्ती॒ मुखं॑ य॒ज्ञाना॑म॒भि सं॑विदा॒ने ।
उ॒षासा॑ वाᳪ सुहिर॒ण्ये सु॑शि॒ल्पे ऋ॒तस्य॒ योना॑वि॒ह सा॑दयामि
verses.translation: Your two Dawns rich in gold and varied colour, travelling on ’twixt Varuna and Mitra, Acquainted with the face of sacrifices, I settle here within the home of Order.
verses.hindi: हमारे उषाःकाल स्नेह व निर्ंषता के संकल्पवाले हों, हम इनमे यज्ञो के करनेवाले हों, स्वाध्याय व उत्तम कर्मो से इन्हे सुन्दर बनार्णँ ओर दोनों कालों में अपने को ऋत के उत्पत्तिस्थान प्रभु में स्थापित करने का प्रयत्न करें, अर्थात् दोनों समय ध्यान करे। अपिंप्रयं चोदना वां मिमाना होतारा ज्योतिः प्रदिशां दिशन्ता ।७।
verses.transliteration: antarā mitrāvaruṇā carantī mukhaṃ yajñānāmabhi saṃvidāne | uṣāsā vā suhiraṇye suśilpe ṛtasya yonāviha sādayāmi
verses.wordMeaning: Your two Dawns rich in gold and varied colour, travelling on ’twixt Varuna and Mitra, Acquainted with the face of sacrifices, I settle here within the home of Order.
verses.commentary: Sense: Your two Dawns rich in gold and varied colour, travelling on ’twixt Varuna and Mitra, Acquainted with the face of sacrifices, I settle here within the home of Order.

verses.sanskrit:
प्र॒थ॒मा वा॑ᳪ सर॒थिना॑ सु॒वर्णा॑ देवौ॒ पश्य॑न्तौ॒ भुव॑नानि॒ विश्वा॑ ।
अपि॑प्रयं॒ चोद॑ना वां॒ मिमा॑ना॒ होता॑रा॒ ज्योति॑: प्र॒दिशा॑ दि॒शन्ता॑
verses.translation: Your two chief Hotars have I pleased, bright-coloured, borne on one car, Gods who behold all creatures, Those who prepare your rules and ordinances and make you see the light by their direction.
verses.hindi: पति-पत्नी का प्रयत्न होना चाहिए कि वे "प्रथम, सरथी, देव, सर्वपालक, वेद-प्रेरणानुसार क्रियायों के कर्ता, होता तथा ज्ञानोपदेष्टा' बने। आदित्येन भास्ती वष्टु यज्ञशसस्स्वती सह रद्रर्न'ऽआवीत्। इडोपहूता वसुभिः सजोषा यज्ञं नो देवीरमूतेषु धत्त।।८॥
verses.transliteration: prathamā vā sarathinā suvarṇā devau paśyantau bhuvanāni viśvā | apiprayaṃ codanā vāṃ mimānā hotārā jyoti: pradiśā diśantā
verses.wordMeaning: Your two chief Hotars have I pleased, bright-coloured, borne on one car, Gods who behold all creatures, Those who prepare your rules and ordinances and make you see the light by their direction.
verses.commentary: Sense: Your two chief Hotars have I pleased, bright-coloured, borne on one car, Gods who behold all creatures, Those who prepare your rules and ordinances and make you see the light by their direction.

verses.sanskrit:
आ॒दि॒त्यैर्नो॒ भार॑ती वष्टु य॒ज्ञᳪ सर॑स्वती स॒ह रु॒द्रैर्न॑ आवीत् ।
इडोप॑हूता॒ वसु॑भिः स॒जोषा॑ य॒ज्ञं नो॑ देवीर॒मृते॑षु धत्त
verses.translation: Bhâratî with Âdityas love our worship! Sarasvatî with Rudras be our helper, And Idâ in accord, invoked with Vasus! Goddesses, place our rite among the Immortals.
verses.hindi: ' प्रकृति, जीव, परमात्मा ' का उच्च ज्ञान प्राप्त करनेवाले ' आदित्य ' हे। ' प्रकृति त जीव" का विशेष रूप से ज्ञान प्राप्त करनेवाले “रुद्र ' हे। ' प्रकृति" का ज्ञान प्राप्त करनेवाले  वसु" है। इनकी कपास हम में क्रमशः “भारती, सरस्वती व इडा" का जन्म होता है। ' भारती" ज्ञान है। "सरस्वती ' शिक्षा व सभ्यता है। "इडा" (+ 1.५५) जीवन का एक नियमहै। ये सबके
verses.transliteration: ādityairno bhāratī vaṣṭu yajña sarasvatī saha rudrairna āvīt | iḍopahūtā vasubhiḥ sajoṣā yajñaṃ no devīramṛteṣu dhatta
verses.wordMeaning: Bhâratî with Âdityas love our worship! Sarasvatî with Rudras be our helper, And Idâ in accord, invoked with Vasus! Goddesses, place our rite among the Immortals.
verses.commentary: Sense: Bhâratî with Âdityas love our worship! Sarasvatî with Rudras be our helper, And Idâ in accord, invoked with Vasus! Goddesses, place our rite among the Immortals.

verses.sanskrit:
त्वष्टा॑ वी॒रं दे॒वका॑मं जजान॒ त्वष्टु॒रर्वा॑ जायत आ॒शुरश्व॑: ।
त्वष्टे॒दं विश्वं॒ भुव॑नं जजान ब॒होः क॒र्तार॑मि॒ह य॑क्षि होतः
verses.translation: The God-devoted son Tvashtar produces: from Tvashtar springs to life your fleet-foot Courser. Tvashtar gave being to this All about us. Priest, worship here the mighty work's achiever.
verses.hindi: आचार्य विद्यार्थी को “वीर, देवकाम, अर्वा, आशु, अश्व, विश्वं (पूर्ण) व बहु (दृद ) ' बनाये। विद्यार्थी आचार्य करे प्रति सदा सन्मान कौ भावनावाला हो। एकोनत्रिंशोऽध्यायः ३५९ अश्वो घृतेन त्मन्या सम॑क्तऽ उप॑ देवाँ २ ऋतुशः पाऽ एतु ।
verses.transliteration: tvaṣṭā vīraṃ devakāmaṃ jajāna tvaṣṭurarvā jāyata āśuraśva: | tvaṣṭedaṃ viśvaṃ bhuvanaṃ jajāna bahoḥ kartāramiha yakṣi hotaḥ
verses.wordMeaning: The God-devoted son Tvashtar produces: from Tvashtar springs to life your fleet-foot Courser. Tvashtar gave being to this All about us. Priest, worship here the mighty work's achiever.
verses.commentary: Sense: The God-devoted son Tvashtar produces: from Tvashtar springs to life your fleet-foot Courser. Tvashtar gave being to this All about us. Priest, worship here the mighty work's achiever.

verses.sanskrit:
अश्वो॑ घृ॒तेन॒ त्मन्या॒ सम॑क्त॒ उप॑ दे॒वाँ२ ऋ॑तु॒शः पाथ॑ एतु ।
वन॒स्पति॑र्देवलो॒कं प्र॑जा॒नन्न॒ग्निना॑ ह॒व्या स्व॑दि॒तानि॑ वक्षत्
verses.translation: Let the Steed seek his home, and balmed with butter go of himself unto the Gods in season. To the Gods’ world Vanaspatî, well-knowing, bear our oblations which the fire has tasted!
verses.hindi: उठते ही हम प्रभु- स्तवन करे, आचार्य के समीप रहकर उच्रति को प्राप्त करे, गृहस्थ मे सभी का पालन-पोषण करते हए हम उन्नत हो। हमारा ज्ञान व उपासन हमें गतिशील बनार्पँ। हमारे प्रयत्न ओसरो का दुःख हरण करने के लिए हो। इस प्रकार वासनाओं का संहार करने पर हमारा जीवन उत्तम होगा।
verses.transliteration: aśvo ghṛtena tmanyā samakta upa devā~2 ṛtuśaḥ pātha etu | vanaspatirdevalokaṃ prajānannagninā havyā svaditāni vakṣat
verses.wordMeaning: Let the Steed seek his home, and balmed with butter go of himself unto the Gods in season. To the Gods’ world Vanaspatî, well-knowing, bear our oblations which the fire has tasted!
verses.commentary: Sense: Let the Steed seek his home, and balmed with butter go of himself unto the Gods in season. To the Gods’ world Vanaspatî, well-knowing, bear our oblations which the fire has tasted!

verses.sanskrit:
प्र॒जाप॑ते॒स्तप॑सा वावृधा॒नः स॒द्यो जा॒तो द॑धिषे य॒ज्ञम॑ग्ने ।
स्वाहा॑कृतेन ह॒विषा॑ पुरोगा या॒हि सा॒ध्या ह॒विर॑दन्तु दे॒वाः
verses.translation: Thou, waxing by Prajâpati's strong fervour, born quickly, guardest sacrifice, O Agni. With consecrated offering go, preceding, and let the Sâdhyas, Gods, eat our oblation.
verses.hindi: मनुष्य कौ मनच्तरवर्णिति नौ ब्रत धारण करने चाहिणँ। इन्हीं को प्रभु कौ उपासना समञ्जना चाहिए। ये व्रत ही उसके जीवन का परम विकास करनेवाले होगे। ९. गतमन्त्र में वर्णित त्रत मनुष्य को शक्तिशाली बनाते है, अतः उस व्रती का सम्बोधन ही ' वाजिन्" शब्द से करते है। ठे वाजिन्-शक्तिशालिन्! इमाये त्रत ही तेतर
verses.transliteration: prajāpatestapasā vāvṛdhānaḥ sadyo jāto dadhiṣe yajñamagne | svāhākṛtena haviṣā purogā yāhi sādhyā haviradantu devāḥ
verses.wordMeaning: Thou, waxing by Prajâpati's strong fervour, born quickly, guardest sacrifice, O Agni. With consecrated offering go, preceding, and let the Sâdhyas, Gods, eat our oblation.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thou, waxing by Prajâpati's strong fervour, born quickly, guardest sacrifice, O Agni. With consecrated offering go, preceding, and let the Sâdhyas, Gods, eat our oblation.

verses.sanskrit:
यदक्र॑न्दः प्रथ॒मं जाय॑मान उ॒द्यन्त्स॑मु॒द्रादु॒त वा॒ पुरी॑षात् ।
श्ये॒नस्य॑ प॒क्षा ह॑रि॒णस्य॑ बा॒हू उ॑प॒स्तुत्यं॒ महि॑ जा॒तं ते॑ अर्वन्
verses.translation: What time, first springing into life, thou neighedst, proceeding from the sea or cloudy vapour, Limbs of the deer hadst thou, and eagle pinions. O Steed, thy birth is high and must be lauded.
verses.hindi: हम जितेन्द्रिय वनें। जितेन्द्रिय बनकर हम ज्योतिर्मय मस्तिष्कवाले, सुदृढ पववाले, कार्यपटु मनवाले तथा देवों का आतिथ्य करनेवाले ने। ऋषि :- भार्गवो जमदग्निः। देवता-मनुष्याः। छन्द :- भुरिक्पङक्तिः। स्वरः-पञ्चमः। १. ईर्मान्तासः (ईर्यते ईर्म: प्रेरितः अन्तः येषां ते) जिनके प्रान्तभाग प्रकृष्ट गतिवाले
verses.transliteration: yadakrandaḥ prathamaṃ jāyamāna udyantsamudrāduta vā purīṣāt | śyenasya pakṣā hariṇasya bāhū upastutyaṃ mahi jātaṃ te arvan
verses.wordMeaning: What time, first springing into life, thou neighedst, proceeding from the sea or cloudy vapour, Limbs of the deer hadst thou, and eagle pinions. O Steed, thy birth is high and must be lauded.
verses.commentary: Sense: What time, first springing into life, thou neighedst, proceeding from the sea or cloudy vapour, Limbs of the deer hadst thou, and eagle pinions. O Steed, thy birth is high and must be lauded.

verses.sanskrit:
य॒मेन॑ द॒त्तं त्रि॒त ए॑नमायुन॒गिन्द्र॑ एणं प्रथ॒मो अध्य॑तिष्ठत् ।
ग॒न्ध॒र्वो अ॑स्य रश॒नाम॑गृभ्णा॒त् सूरा॒दश्वं॑ वसवो॒ निर॑तष्ट
verses.translation: This Steed, bestowed by Yama, Trita harnessed, and Indra was the first to mount and ride him. His bridle the Gandharva grasped. O Vasus, from out the Sun ye fashioned forth the Courser.
verses.hindi: प्रभु के उपासन से शरीर कौ गतिशीलता, चित्त की विज्ञान-कुशलता व ज्ञानदीप्तियों की विविधता विकसित होती है। “कवि व रेभ'-प्रभु-स्मरणपूर्वक कार्य उप प्रागाच्छसनं वाज्यर्वौ देवद्रीचा मन॑सा दीध्यांनः।
verses.transliteration: yamena dattaṃ trita enamāyunagindra eṇaṃ prathamo adhyatiṣṭhat | gandharvo asya raśanāmagṛbhṇāt sūrādaśvaṃ vasavo nirataṣṭa
verses.wordMeaning: This Steed, bestowed by Yama, Trita harnessed, and Indra was the first to mount and ride him. His bridle the Gandharva grasped. O Vasus, from out the Sun ye fashioned forth the Courser.
verses.commentary: Sense: This Steed, bestowed by Yama, Trita harnessed, and Indra was the first to mount and ride him. His bridle the Gandharva grasped. O Vasus, from out the Sun ye fashioned forth the Courser.

verses.sanskrit:
असि॑ य॒मो अस्या॑दि॒त्यो अ॑र्व॒न्नसि॑ त्रि॒तो गुह्ये॑न व्र॒तेन॑ ।
असि॒ सोमे॑न स॒मया॒ विपृ॑क्त आ॒हुस्ते॒ त्रीणि॑ दि॒वि बन्ध॑नानि
verses.translation: Yama art thou, O Horse; thou art Âditya; Trita art thou by secret operation. From Soma thou art thoroughly divided. They say there are three bonds in heaven that hold thee.
verses.hindi: शक्तिशाली बनकर हम वासनाओं का संहार करे प्रभु मं मन लगाकर हम देदीप्यमान जीवनवाले हो प्रत्येक कार्य को प्रभु स्मरण से प्रारम्भ करे। प्रभु ही हमारा केन्द्र हो। हम ज्ञानी स्तोता बनकर अनुकूलता से कार्यो को करनेवाले चने। ब्रह्यनिष्ठता करा मार्ग
verses.transliteration: asi yamo asyādityo arvannasi trito guhyena vratena | asi somena samayā vipṛkta āhuste trīṇi divi bandhanāni
verses.wordMeaning: Yama art thou, O Horse; thou art Âditya; Trita art thou by secret operation. From Soma thou art thoroughly divided. They say there are three bonds in heaven that hold thee.
verses.commentary: Sense: Yama art thou, O Horse; thou art Âditya; Trita art thou by secret operation. From Soma thou art thoroughly divided. They say there are three bonds in heaven that hold thee.

verses.sanskrit:
त्रीणि॑ त आहुर्दि॒वि बन्ध॑नानि॒ त्रीण्य॒प्सु त्रीण्य॒न्तः स॑मु॒द्रे ।
उ॒तेव॑ मे॒ वरु॑णश्छन्त्स्यर्व॒न् यत्रा॑ त आ॒हुः प॑र॒मं ज॒नित्र॑म्
verses.translation: Three bonds, they say, thou hast in heaven to bind thee, three in the waters, three within the ocean. To me thou seemest Varuna, O Courser, there where they say is thy sublimest birthplace.
verses.hindi: वासनाओं के विनाश से हम प्रभु के समीप पर्ुचते है। याँ पषौचने के लिए हमारे जीवन का निर्माण माता, पिता व आचार्यो के शिक्षणालय में सच्चरित्रता, सदाचार व ज्ञान के शिक्षण से होता है। ठम आचार्यो के प्रति अपना अर्पण करते है, आचार्य हमें ऊँचे से ऊँचा ज्ञान देते हे।
verses.transliteration: trīṇi ta āhurdivi bandhanāni trīṇyapsu trīṇyantaḥ samudre | uteva me varuṇaśchantsyarvan yatrā ta āhuḥ paramaṃ janitram
verses.wordMeaning: Three bonds, they say, thou hast in heaven to bind thee, three in the waters, three within the ocean. To me thou seemest Varuna, O Courser, there where they say is thy sublimest birthplace.
verses.commentary: Sense: Three bonds, they say, thou hast in heaven to bind thee, three in the waters, three within the ocean. To me thou seemest Varuna, O Courser, there where they say is thy sublimest birthplace.

verses.sanskrit:
इ॒मा ते॑ वाजिन्नव॒मार्ज॑नानी॒मा श॒फाना॑ᳪ सनि॒तुर्नि॒धाना॑ ।
अत्रा॑ ते भ॒द्रा र॑श॒ना अ॑पश्यमृ॒तस्य॒ या अ॑भि॒रक्ष॑न्ति गो॒पाः
verses.translation: Here, Courser, are the places where they groomed thee; here are the traces of thy hooves as winner. Here have I seen the auspicious reins that guide thee, which those who guard the holy Law keep safely.
verses.hindi: ठम सुक्रतु, शुचि, धी-सम्पत्न व हव्यो के ग्रहण करनेवाले बनकर प्रभु की सच्ची भक्ति करनेवाले हो। त्वं दवानांमसि यदह होता सऽ एनान्यक्षीषितो यजींयान्॥। २८॥ १. है अग्ने-परमात्मन्! आप आयाहि=आईइषए। जो आप (क) आजुह्ानः=( आहयमानः)
verses.transliteration: imā te vājinnavamārjanānīmā śaphānā saniturnidhānā | atrā te bhadrā raśanā apaśyamṛtasya yā abhirakṣanti gopāḥ
verses.wordMeaning: Here, Courser, are the places where they groomed thee; here are the traces of thy hooves as winner. Here have I seen the auspicious reins that guide thee, which those who guard the holy Law keep safely.
verses.commentary: Sense: Here, Courser, are the places where they groomed thee; here are the traces of thy hooves as winner. Here have I seen the auspicious reins that guide thee, which those who guard the holy Law keep safely.

verses.sanskrit:
आ॒त्मानं॑ ते॒ मन॑सा॒राद॑जानाम॒वो दि॒वा प॒तय॑न्तं पत॒ङ्गम् ।
शिरो॑ अपश्यं प॒थिभि॑: सु॒गेभि॑ररे॒णुभि॒र्जेह॑मानं पत॒त्रि
verses.translation: Thyself from far I recognized in spirit, a Bird that from below flew through the heaven. I saw thy head still soaring, striving upward by paths unsoiled by dust, pleasant to travel.
verses.hindi: हमारे दिन- रात स्मयमान हों। यस्तव्यापृत प्रभु की उपासना मे लगे हए ये दिनरात हमारी बुराइयों को दूर करके अच्छाइयों को प्राप्त कराते हए हमें भी सम्पन्न करे। हैव्या होतारा प्रथमा सुवाचा मिमाना यज्ञं मनुषो यज॑ध्यै । प्रचोदयन्ता विदथेषु कारू प्राचीनं ज्योतिः प्रदिशां दिशान्ता।।३२॥
verses.transliteration: ātmānaṃ te manasārādajānāmavo divā patayantaṃ pataṅgam | śiro apaśyaṃ pathibhi: sugebhirareṇubhirjehamānaṃ patatri
verses.wordMeaning: Thyself from far I recognized in spirit, a Bird that from below flew through the heaven. I saw thy head still soaring, striving upward by paths unsoiled by dust, pleasant to travel.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thyself from far I recognized in spirit, a Bird that from below flew through the heaven. I saw thy head still soaring, striving upward by paths unsoiled by dust, pleasant to travel.

verses.sanskrit:
अत्रा॑ ते रू॒पमु॑त्त॒मम॑पश्यं॒ जिगी॑षमाणमि॒ष आ प॒दे गोः ।
य॒दा ते॒ मर्तो॒ अनु॒ भोग॒मान॒डादिद् ग्रसि॑ष्ठ॒ ओष॑धीरजीगः
verses.translation: Here I beheld thy form matchless in beauty, eager to win thee food at the Cow's station. Whene’er a man brings thee to thine enjoyment, thou swallowest the herbs, most greedy eater.
verses.hindi: हमारे जीवन मेँ ' भारती, इडा व सरस्वती ' तीनों देवियों का समुचित स्थान तमद्य होतरिषितो यजींयान्देवं त्वष्टारमिह य॑क्षि विद्धान्।। ३४॥ १. यः=जो त्वष्टा इमे=इन दद्यावापृथिवी=द्युलोक व पृथिवीलोक को ओर जनित्री-सव भूतो को जन्म देनेवाला है, उनको रूपै अपिंशत्चरूपो से अलंकृत करता है तथा विष्वा
verses.transliteration: atrā te rūpamuttamamapaśyaṃ jigīṣamāṇamiṣa ā pade goḥ | yadā te marto anu bhogamānaḍādid grasiṣṭha oṣadhīrajīgaḥ
verses.wordMeaning: Here I beheld thy form matchless in beauty, eager to win thee food at the Cow's station. Whene’er a man brings thee to thine enjoyment, thou swallowest the herbs, most greedy eater.
verses.commentary: Sense: Here I beheld thy form matchless in beauty, eager to win thee food at the Cow's station. Whene’er a man brings thee to thine enjoyment, thou swallowest the herbs, most greedy eater.

verses.sanskrit:
अनु॑ त्वा॒ रथो॒ अनु॒ मर्यो॑ अर्व॒न्ननु॒ गावोऽनु॒ भग॑: क॒नीना॑म् ।
अनु॒ व्राता॑स॒स्तव॑ स॒ख्यमी॑यु॒रनु॑ दे॒वा म॑मिरे वी॒र्यं॒ ते
verses.translation: After thee, Courser, come the car, the bridegroom, the kine come after, and the charm of maidens. Full companies have followed for thy friendship: the pattern of thy vigour Gods have followed.
verses.hindi: हम देवयान मार्गं से चलते हए जीवन को सद्गुणो से अलंकृत करने के हेतु सात्विक भोजन का ही सेवन करे। य्िय, वनस्पति भोजन, मधु व धृत का ही प्रयोग करे। सद्यो जातो व्य॑मिमीत यज्ञमन्निर्दवानांमभवत्पुरोगाः। अस्य होतु: प्रदिश्य॒तस्य॑ वाचि स्वाहांकृतःहविरदन्तु देवाः ॥३६॥
verses.transliteration: anu tvā ratho anu maryo arvannanu gāvo'nu bhaga: kanīnām | anu vrātāsastava sakhyamīyuranu devā mamire vīryaṃ te
verses.wordMeaning: After thee, Courser, come the car, the bridegroom, the kine come after, and the charm of maidens. Full companies have followed for thy friendship: the pattern of thy vigour Gods have followed.
verses.commentary: Sense: After thee, Courser, come the car, the bridegroom, the kine come after, and the charm of maidens. Full companies have followed for thy friendship: the pattern of thy vigour Gods have followed.

verses.sanskrit:
हिर॑ण्यशृ॒ङ्गोऽयो॑ अस्य॒ पादा॒ मनो॑जवा॒ अव॑र॒ इन्द्र॑ आसीत् ।
दे॒वा इद॑स्य हवि॒रद्य॑माय॒न् यो अर्व॑न्तं प्रथ॒मो अ॒ध्यति॑ष्ठत्
verses.translation: His horns are golden and his feet are iron. Less fleet than he, though swift as thought, was Indra. The Gods came only to the oblation-banquet of him who mounted first of all the Courser.
verses.hindi: आचार्यकुल से समावृत्त होकर हम गृहस्थ बनें तो यक्ञषशील होँं। वेदानुसार अग्निहोत्र करे। मात-पिता को खिलाकर खाप, अतिथियों से पूर्व न खाने लग जार्ं। यज्ञशेष खानेवाले ही देव व अमर बना करते है। केतुं कृण्वन्न॑केतवे पेशो मर्याऽअपेश्टसें । समुषद्धिंरजायथाः॥ ३७॥
verses.transliteration: hiraṇyaśṛṅgo'yo asya pādā manojavā avara indra āsīt | devā idasya haviradyamāyan yo arvantaṃ prathamo adhyatiṣṭhat
verses.wordMeaning: His horns are golden and his feet are iron. Less fleet than he, though swift as thought, was Indra. The Gods came only to the oblation-banquet of him who mounted first of all the Courser.
verses.commentary: Sense: His horns are golden and his feet are iron. Less fleet than he, though swift as thought, was Indra. The Gods came only to the oblation-banquet of him who mounted first of all the Courser.

verses.sanskrit:
ई॒र्मान्ता॑स॒: सिलि॑कमध्यमास॒: सᳪ शूर॑णासो दि॒व्यासो॒ अत्या॑: ।
ह॒सा इ॑व श्रेणि॒शो य॑तन्ते॒ यदाक्षि॑षुर्दि॒व्यमज्म॒मश्वा॑:
verses.translation: The Steed is come unto the noblest mansion, is come unto his Father and his Mother. This day shall he approach the Gods, most welcome: then he declares good gifts to him who worships.
verses.hindi: हम अज्ञानी के लिए ज्ञान दें, अधन के लिए धन देनेवाले हों तथा अरूप को स्वास्थ्य के द्वारा रूप प्रदान कररे। उघषाःकाल में ही उद्बुद्ध होकर अपने कर्तव्य कर्मो मे लगते हुए अपनी शक्तियों का विकास करे। १. गतमन्त्र के अनुसार प्रातःकाल जागकर अपने कर्त्तव्यो में लगनेवाला व्यक्ति अपना
verses.transliteration: īrmāntāsa: silikamadhyamāsa: sa śūraṇāso divyāso atyā: | hasā iva śreṇiśo yatante yadākṣiṣurdivyamajmamaśvā:
verses.wordMeaning: The Steed is come unto the noblest mansion, is come unto his Father and his Mother. This day shall he approach the Gods, most welcome: then he declares good gifts to him who worships.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Steed is come unto the noblest mansion, is come unto his Father and his Mother. This day shall he approach the Gods, most welcome: then he declares good gifts to him who worships.

verses.sanskrit:
तव॒ शरी॑रं पतयि॒ष्ण्व॒र्व॒न्तव॑ चि॒त्तं वात॑ इव॒ ध्रजी॑मान् ।
तव॒ शृङ्गा॑णि॒ विष्ठि॑ता पुरु॒त्रार॑ण्येषु॒ जर्भु॑राणा चरन्ति
verses.translation: A body formed for flight hast thou, O Charger; swift as the wind in motion is thy spirit. Thy horns are spread abroad in all directions; they move with restless beat in wildernesses.
verses.hindi: ब्रह्मरूप कवच को धारण करके मनुष्य काम के आक्रमणों से वचा रहे। धनुः शत्रोरपकामं कुणोति धन्व॑ना सर्वः प्रदिशो जयेम ।३९॥। ९. धन्वना=धनुष से गा=गौवों को जयेम जीते। धन्वना=धनुष से आनलित्युद्ध को जयेम जीते। धन्वना धनुष से तीत्राः=उग्र व पटु बने हुए हम समदः=संग्रामों को जयेम
verses.transliteration: tava śarīraṃ patayiṣṇvarvantava cittaṃ vāta iva dhrajīmān | tava śṛṅgāṇi viṣṭhitā purutrāraṇyeṣu jarbhurāṇā caranti
verses.wordMeaning: A body formed for flight hast thou, O Charger; swift as the wind in motion is thy spirit. Thy horns are spread abroad in all directions; they move with restless beat in wildernesses.
verses.commentary: Sense: A body formed for flight hast thou, O Charger; swift as the wind in motion is thy spirit. Thy horns are spread abroad in all directions; they move with restless beat in wildernesses.

verses.sanskrit:
उप॒ प्रागा॒च्छस॑नं वा॒ज्यर्वा॑ देव॒द्रीचा॒ मन॑सा॒ दीध्या॑नः ।
अ॒जः पु॒रो नी॑यते॒ नाभि॑र॒स्यानु॑ प॒श्चात्क॒वयो॑ यन्ति रे॒भाः
verses.translation: The strong Steed hath come forward to the slaughter, pondering with a mind directed God-ward. The goat who is his kin is led before him: the sages and the singers follow after.
verses.hindi: हम प्रणवरूप धनुष् के महत्त्व को समञ्च ओर अर्थभावनपूर्वक ओम्" का जप करते हुए सच्चे धानुष्क (धनुधरी) बनें। वक्ष्यन्तीवेदा ग॑नीगन्ति कर्णः प्रियःसखा॑यं परि षस्वजाना। १. जिस समय धनुष् पर तीर लगाकर ज्या को खीचते है तव यह ज्या कान के पास
verses.transliteration: upa prāgācchasanaṃ vājyarvā devadrīcā manasā dīdhyānaḥ | ajaḥ puro nīyate nābhirasyānu paścātkavayo yanti rebhāḥ
verses.wordMeaning: The strong Steed hath come forward to the slaughter, pondering with a mind directed God-ward. The goat who is his kin is led before him: the sages and the singers follow after.
verses.commentary: Sense: The strong Steed hath come forward to the slaughter, pondering with a mind directed God-ward. The goat who is his kin is led before him: the sages and the singers follow after.

verses.sanskrit:
उप॒ प्रागा॑त्पर॒मं यत्स॒धस्थ॒मर्वाँ॒२ अच्छा॑ पि॒तरं॑ मा॒तरं॑ च ।
अ॒द्या दे॒वाञ्जुष्ट॑तमो॒ हि ग॒म्या अथा शा॑स्ते दा॒शुषे॒ वार्या॑णि
verses.translation: Thou in the house of man this day enkindled worshippest Gods, a God, O Jâtavedas.
verses.hindi: प्रणवरूप धनुष् कौ श्रद्धा व विद्यारूप दोना कोटियो परस्पर सम्बद्ध होंगी तौ इस धनुष् से इस प्रकार कर्मरूप तीत्र शर चलेगे कि वासनारूप सब शत्रुओं का संहार हो ९. प्रस्तुत मन्त्र में तरकस का उल्लेख करते है। इस तरकस मे तीर रखे जाते है ओर यह धानुष्क कौ पीठ पर वेधा होता है। इसमें तीर सुरक्षित होते ठै, सो कहते है कि
verses.transliteration: upa prāgātparamaṃ yatsadhasthamarvā~2 acchā pitaraṃ mātaraṃ ca | adyā devāñjuṣṭatamo hi gamyā athā śāste dāśuṣe vāryāṇi
verses.wordMeaning: Thou in the house of man this day enkindled worshippest Gods, a God, O Jâtavedas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thou in the house of man this day enkindled worshippest Gods, a God, O Jâtavedas.

verses.sanskrit:
समि॑द्धो अ॒द्य मनु॑षो दुरो॒णे दे॒वो दे॒वान् य॑जसि जातवेदः ।
आ च॒ वह॑ मित्रमहश्चिकि॒त्वान्त्वं दू॒तः क॒विर॑सि॒ प्रचे॑ताः
verses.translation: Wealthy in friends! observant, bring them hither. Thou art a sapient envoy, full of wisdom.
verses.hindi: तरकस का युद्ध में अपना महत्त्वपूर्ण स्थान हे। वही स्थान शरीर मे हृदय का हे। यह शत्रुओं के संहारक आत्मसङ्कल्परूप शरों से भरपूर होना चाहिए। रथे तिष्ठन्नयति वाजिनः पुरो यत्र॑यत्र कामय॑ते सुषारथिः। ९. रथेरथ पर तिष्ठन्-स्थिरता से ठहरा हुआ सुषारथिः उत्तम सारथि यत्र-यत्र -जहँ
verses.transliteration: samiddho adya manuṣo duroṇe devo devān yajasi jātavedaḥ | ā ca vaha mitramahaścikitvāntvaṃ dūtaḥ kavirasi pracetāḥ
verses.wordMeaning: Wealthy in friends! observant, bring them hither. Thou art a sapient envoy, full of wisdom.
verses.commentary: Sense: Wealthy in friends! observant, bring them hither. Thou art a sapient envoy, full of wisdom.

verses.sanskrit:
तनू॑नपात्प॒थ ऋ॒तस्य॒ याना॒न्मध्वा॑ सम॒ञ्जन्त्स्व॑दया सुजिह्व ।
मन्मा॑नि धी॒भिरु॒त य॒ज्ञमृ॒न्धन् दे॑व॒त्रा च॑ कृणुह्यध्व॒रं न॑:
verses.translation: Tanûnapât, fair-tongued, with sweet mead balming the paths and ways of Order, make them pleasant. Convey our sacrifice to heaven, exalting with holy thoughts our hymns of praise and worship.
verses.hindi: बुद्धिरूप सारथि उत्तम होगा तो वह इन्द्रियों से हमारी जीवन-यात्रा को पूर्ण करेगा। इन इद्धियों कौ मनरूप लगाम द्वारा ही काबू किया जा सकता है। वुद्धिरूप सारथि का नाम ही मनीषा (मनसः ईष्टे) हे, यह मन का शासन करती है। अवक्रामन्तः प्रप॑हैरमित्रान् क्िणन्ति शत्रँ९।।ऽ रन॑पव्ययन्तः।। ४य॥
verses.transliteration: tanūnapātpatha ṛtasya yānānmadhvā samañjantsvadayā sujihva | manmāni dhībhiruta yajñamṛndhan devatrā ca kṛṇuhyadhvaraṃ na:
verses.wordMeaning: Tanûnapât, fair-tongued, with sweet mead balming the paths and ways of Order, make them pleasant. Convey our sacrifice to heaven, exalting with holy thoughts our hymns of praise and worship.
verses.commentary: Sense: Tanûnapât, fair-tongued, with sweet mead balming the paths and ways of Order, make them pleasant. Convey our sacrifice to heaven, exalting with holy thoughts our hymns of praise and worship.

verses.sanskrit:
नरा॒शᳪस॑स्य महि॒मान॑मेषा॒मुप॑ स्तोषाम यज॒तस्य॑ य॒ज्ञैः ।
ये सु॒क्रत॑व॒: शुच॑यो धिय॒न्धाः स्वद॑न्ति दे॒वा उ॒भया॑नि ह॒व्या
verses.translation: With sacrifice to these we with laudations will honour holy Narâsamsa's greatness— To these the pure, most wise, the thought-inspirers, Gods who enjoy both sorts of our oblations.
verses.hindi: १. हमारे राष्ट के " सेनानायक कैसे हो ', यह विषय गतमन्त्र का था। प्रस्तुत मन्त्र का प्रारम्भिक विषय यह है कि  हमारे राष्ट के आचार्य कैसे हो? ' आचार्य (क) ब्राह्मणासः = (ब्रह्मवेत्ता) ब्रह्म के जाननेवाले अर्थात् पराविद्या मे भी निपुण हों। “परा यया तदक्षरमधिगम्यते ' , पराविद्या वही है जिससे उस अक्षर, अविनाशी, परमात्मा का ज्ञान होता है। “पराविद्या मेँ
verses.transliteration: narāśasasya mahimānameṣāmupa stoṣāma yajatasya yajñaiḥ | ye sukratava: śucayo dhiyandhāḥ svadanti devā ubhayāni havyā
verses.wordMeaning: With sacrifice to these we with laudations will honour holy Narâsamsa's greatness— To these the pure, most wise, the thought-inspirers, Gods who enjoy both sorts of our oblations.
verses.commentary: Sense: With sacrifice to these we with laudations will honour holy Narâsamsa's greatness— To these the pure, most wise, the thought-inspirers, Gods who enjoy both sorts of our oblations.

verses.sanskrit:
आ॒जुह्वा॑न॒ ईड्यो॒ वन्द्य॒श्चा या॑ह्यग्ने॒ वसु॑भिः स॒जोषा॑: ।
त्वं दे॒वाना॑मसि यह्व॒ होता॒ स ए॑नान्यक्षीषि॒तो यजी॑यान्
verses.translation: Invoked, deserving laud and adoration, O Agni, come accordant with the Vasus. Thou art, O vigorous One, the Gods’ Invoker, so, best of Sacrificers, bring them quickly.
verses.hindi: राष्ट् के ब्राह्मण (पितर व सोम्य' हों तो द्युलोक व पृथिवीलोक हमारा कल्याण करनेवाले होगे। सूर्य भी हमे अशुभावस्था से बचाएगा। सव देव हमारी रक्षा करे। हम दुर्जनो कौ बातों के प्रभाव मेन आ जार्णँ। एकोनत्रिंशोऽध्यायः ३९७९
verses.transliteration: ājuhvāna īḍyo vandyaścā yāhyagne vasubhiḥ sajoṣā: | tvaṃ devānāmasi yahva hotā sa enānyakṣīṣito yajīyān
verses.wordMeaning: Invoked, deserving laud and adoration, O Agni, come accordant with the Vasus. Thou art, O vigorous One, the Gods’ Invoker, so, best of Sacrificers, bring them quickly.
verses.commentary: Sense: Invoked, deserving laud and adoration, O Agni, come accordant with the Vasus. Thou art, O vigorous One, the Gods’ Invoker, so, best of Sacrificers, bring them quickly.

verses.sanskrit:
प्रा॒चीनं॑ ब॒र्हिः प्र॒दिशा॑ पृथि॒व्या वस्तो॑र॒स्या वृ॑ज्यते॒ अग्रे॒ अह्ना॑म् ।
व्यु॑ प्रथते वित॒रं वरी॑यो दे॒वेभ्यो॒ अदि॑तये स्यो॒नम्
verses.translation: By rule the Sacred Grass is scattered eastward, a robe to clothe the earth when dawns are breaking. Widely it spreads around and far extended, fair for the Gods and bringing peace and freedom.
verses.hindi: राष्ट कौ रक्षा के लिए आयुध-सामग्री ठीक से तैयार होनी चाहिए्। यह शत्रुसैन्य को पराजित करके राष्ट् मे सुख व शान्ति को बद्धानेवाली हो। जुगमन ( सरल्न व्यवहार  १. गतमन्त्र के अनुसार “ शत्रुओं क भय से सुरक्षित राष्ट मे हम कैसे बनें' इस बात
verses.transliteration: prācīnaṃ barhiḥ pradiśā pṛthivyā vastorasyā vṛjyate agre ahnām | vyu prathate vitaraṃ varīyo devebhyo aditaye syonam
verses.wordMeaning: By rule the Sacred Grass is scattered eastward, a robe to clothe the earth when dawns are breaking. Widely it spreads around and far extended, fair for the Gods and bringing peace and freedom.
verses.commentary: Sense: By rule the Sacred Grass is scattered eastward, a robe to clothe the earth when dawns are breaking. Widely it spreads around and far extended, fair for the Gods and bringing peace and freedom.

verses.sanskrit:
व्यच॑स्वतीरुर्वि॒या वि श्र॑यन्तां॒ पति॑भ्यो॒ न जन॑य॒: शुम्भ॑मानाः ।
देवी॑र्द्वारो बृहतीर्विश्वमिन्वा दे॒वेभ्यो॑ भवत सुप्राय॒णाः
verses.translation: Let the expansive Doors be widely opened, like wives who deck their beauty for their husbands. Lofty, celestial, all-impelling Portals, admit the Gods and give them easy access.
verses.hindi: हमारा व्यवहार सरल, कपटशन्य हो। शरीर . पाषाणवत् दृद हो। सौम्य आचार्यो से हमें ज्ञान प्राप्त हो। अदीनता व दिव्यता हमें सुखी व शान्त करे। १. जहाँ रथ मेँ घोडों का महत्त्व है, वहौँ घोड़ों को चलानेवाले रथवाहक का महत्त्व भी कम नहीं है। समज्ञदार रथवाहक सामान्य घ्ोडों को भी बड़ी अच्छी गतिवाला कर लेता
verses.transliteration: vyacasvatīrurviyā vi śrayantāṃ patibhyo na janaya: śumbhamānāḥ | devīrdvāro bṛhatīrviśvaminvā devebhyo bhavata suprāyaṇāḥ
verses.wordMeaning: Let the expansive Doors be widely opened, like wives who deck their beauty for their husbands. Lofty, celestial, all-impelling Portals, admit the Gods and give them easy access.
verses.commentary: Sense: Let the expansive Doors be widely opened, like wives who deck their beauty for their husbands. Lofty, celestial, all-impelling Portals, admit the Gods and give them easy access.

verses.sanskrit:
आ सु॒ष्वय॑न्ती यज॒ते उपा॑के उ॒षासा॒नक्ता॑ सदतां॒ नि योनौ॑ ।
दि॒व्ये योष॑णे बृह॒ती सु॑रु॒क्मे अधि॒ श्रिय॑ᳪ शुक्र॒पिशं॒ दधा॑ने
verses.translation: Pouring sweet dews, let holy Night and Morning, each close to each, be seated at their station— Lofty, celestial Dames, with gold to deck them, assuming all their fair and radiant beauty.
verses.hindi: इस शरीर रथ मे हम मस्तिष्क को ज्ञानपूर्णं करं, शरीर को बल-सम्पन्न बना्। वनस्पतियों के सेवन से सहनशील बनें । रेतस् कणो कौ रक्षा से ओजस्वी ने। ज्ञानकिरणों से प्रकाशित इस रथ को जितेन्द्रियता द्वारा वजतुल्य बनार्णँ ओर सदा यज्ञशेष का सेमां नो हव्यदातिं जुषाणो देव॑ रथ प्रतिं हव्या गंभाय।॥५४॥
verses.transliteration: ā suṣvayantī yajate upāke uṣāsānaktā sadatāṃ ni yonau | divye yoṣaṇe bṛhatī surukme adhi śriya śukrapiśaṃ dadhāne
verses.wordMeaning: Pouring sweet dews, let holy Night and Morning, each close to each, be seated at their station— Lofty, celestial Dames, with gold to deck them, assuming all their fair and radiant beauty.
verses.commentary: Sense: Pouring sweet dews, let holy Night and Morning, each close to each, be seated at their station— Lofty, celestial Dames, with gold to deck them, assuming all their fair and radiant beauty.

verses.sanskrit:
दैव्या॒ होता॑रा प्रथ॒मा सु॒वाचा॒ मिमा॑ना य॒ज्ञं मनु॑षो॒ यज॑ध्यै ।
प्र॒चो॒दय॑न्ता वि॒दथे॑षु का॒रू प्रा॒चीनं॒ ज्योति॑: प्र॒दिशा॑ दि॒शन्ता॑
verses.translation: Come the two chief celestial sweet-voiced Hotars, arranging sacrifice for man to worship, As singers who inspire us in assemblies, showing the eastward light with their direction!
verses.hindi: हम हवि के सेवन से, यत्तशेष के भोजन से, अपने मे शरीर की दृता, प्राणों कौ तेजस्विता, स्नेहभाव व द्वेष-निवारण को स्थिर करे। स दुन्दुभे सजृरिन्द्र॑ंण देवैर्दूरादवीयोऽअप॑ं सेध श्रन् ॥५५५॥ १. है बुन्दुभे-दन्दुशब्द से शत्रुओं को भयभीत करनेवाली दुन्दुभे! तरू पृथिवीम्-पृथिवी
verses.transliteration: daivyā hotārā prathamā suvācā mimānā yajñaṃ manuṣo yajadhyai | pracodayantā vidatheṣu kārū prācīnaṃ jyoti: pradiśā diśantā
verses.wordMeaning: Come the two chief celestial sweet-voiced Hotars, arranging sacrifice for man to worship, As singers who inspire us in assemblies, showing the eastward light with their direction!
verses.commentary: Sense: Come the two chief celestial sweet-voiced Hotars, arranging sacrifice for man to worship, As singers who inspire us in assemblies, showing the eastward light with their direction!

verses.sanskrit:
आ नो॑ य॒ज्ञं भार॑ती॒ तूय॑मे॒त्विडा॑ मनु॒ष्वदि॒ह चे॒तय॑न्ती ।
ति॒स्रो दे॒वीर्ब॒र्हिरेदᳪ स्यो॒नᳪ सर॑स्वती॒ स्वप॑सः सदन्तु
verses.translation: Let Bhâratî come quickly to our worship, and Idâ showing like a human being. So let Sarasvatî and both her fellows, deft Goddesses, on this fair grass be seated.
verses.hindi: जव हम धर्म्य संग्राम में अवतीर्ण होते हें, तव हमारा युद्ध के लिए किया गया आह्वान का शब्द शत्रु को भयभीत करनेवाला हो। हमारी दुन्दुभि के शब्द् को सुनकर परायों को रुलाना-अषपने को सवरत व्रनाना १. है दुन्दुभे! तू बलम्=शत्रुसैन्य को आक्रन्दयरुला दे। “मेरा भाई मारा गया, मेरे
verses.transliteration: ā no yajñaṃ bhāratī tūyametviḍā manuṣvadiha cetayantī | tisro devīrbarhireda syona sarasvatī svapasaḥ sadantu
verses.wordMeaning: Let Bhâratî come quickly to our worship, and Idâ showing like a human being. So let Sarasvatî and both her fellows, deft Goddesses, on this fair grass be seated.
verses.commentary: Sense: Let Bhâratî come quickly to our worship, and Idâ showing like a human being. So let Sarasvatî and both her fellows, deft Goddesses, on this fair grass be seated.

verses.sanskrit:
य इ॒मे द्यावा॑पृथि॒वी जनि॑त्री रूपै॒रपि॑ᳪश॒द्भुव॑नानि॒ विश्वा॑ ।
तम॒द्य हो॑तरिषि॒तो यजी॑यान् दे॒वं त्वष्टा॑रमि॒ह य॑क्षि वि॒द्वान्
verses.translation: Hotar more skilled in sacrifice, bring hither with speed today God Tvashtar, thou who knowest, Even him who framed these two, the Earth and Heaven, the Parents, with their forms, and every creature.
verses.hindi: दुन्दुभि का शब्द जहाँ शत्रु को भयभीत करता है, वरहा अपने सैनिकों को उत्साहयुक्त करता है। इसके शब्द से शक्र-सैन्य कुत्तो कौ भ्रति भाग खडा हो। आमूरज प्रत्यावर्तयेमाः केतुमरहन्दुभिवौवदीति । १. केतुमत्-विजय-पताकावाली अथवा (केतुनप्रज्ञा) विजय की प्रकाशक, विजय
verses.transliteration: ya ime dyāvāpṛthivī janitrī rūpairapiśadbhuvanāni viśvā | tamadya hotariṣito yajīyān devaṃ tvaṣṭāramiha yakṣi vidvān
verses.wordMeaning: Hotar more skilled in sacrifice, bring hither with speed today God Tvashtar, thou who knowest, Even him who framed these two, the Earth and Heaven, the Parents, with their forms, and every creature.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hotar more skilled in sacrifice, bring hither with speed today God Tvashtar, thou who knowest, Even him who framed these two, the Earth and Heaven, the Parents, with their forms, and every creature.

verses.sanskrit:
उ॒पाव॑सृज॒ त्मन्या॑ सम॒ञ्जन् दे॒वानां॒ पाथ॑ ऋतु॒था ह॒वीᳪषि॑ ।
वन॒स्पति॑: शमि॒ता दे॒वो अ॒ग्निः स्वद॑न्तु ह॒व्यं मधु॑ना घृ॒तेन॑
verses.translation: Send to our offerings which thyself thou balmest the Companies of Gods in ordered season. Agni, Vanaspatî, the Immolator sweeten our offered gift with mead and butter.
verses.hindi: राष्ट मे समुचित प्रेरणा (व्यवस्था) के लिए सव अधिकारी अपने देवताओं करे गुणधर्मोवाले पशुओं को अपना सूचक चि बनाँ। अग्नये ऽनीकवते रोर्हिंताज्िरनङ्वानधोरांमौ सावित्रौ पौष्णौ स्जतना॑भी वैश्वदेवो १. रोहिताञ्जिः= (रोहितोऽच्जिस्तिलको यस्य) लाल तिलकवाला अनड्वान् वृषभ
verses.transliteration: upāvasṛja tmanyā samañjan devānāṃ pātha ṛtuthā havīṣi | vanaspati: śamitā devo agniḥ svadantu havyaṃ madhunā ghṛtena
verses.wordMeaning: Send to our offerings which thyself thou balmest the Companies of Gods in ordered season. Agni, Vanaspatî, the Immolator sweeten our offered gift with mead and butter.
verses.commentary: Sense: Send to our offerings which thyself thou balmest the Companies of Gods in ordered season. Agni, Vanaspatî, the Immolator sweeten our offered gift with mead and butter.

verses.sanskrit:
स॒द्यो जा॒तो व्य॑मिमीत य॒ज्ञम॒ग्निर्दे॒वाना॑मभवत् पुरो॒गाः ।
अ॒स्य होतु॑: प्र॒दिश्यृ॒तस्य॑ वा॒चि स्वाहा॑कृतᳪ ह॒विर॑दन्तु दे॒वाः
verses.translation: Agni as soon as he was born made ready the sacrifice and was the Gods’ preceder. May the Gods eat our offering consecrated according to the true Priest's voice and guidance.
verses.hindi: पशुओं के गुणधर्म को समञ्लकर हम अपने प्रतीकभूत पशु के चिह से बार्ह"तायैकांदशकपालो विश्वेभ्यो देवेभ्यो जागं तेभ्यः सप्तदशेभ्यो वैरूपेभ्यो १. याज्ञिक परिभाषा मे आठ कपालो (पात्र) में संस्कृत हवि को अष्टाकपाल! कहते है। यहाँ याज्ञिक परिभाषा का ही प्रयोग करते हुए कहते हैँ कि अग्नये=-आगे बदढने के
verses.transliteration: sadyo jāto vyamimīta yajñamagnirdevānāmabhavat purogāḥ | asya hotu: pradiśyṛtasya vāci svāhākṛta haviradantu devāḥ
verses.wordMeaning: Agni as soon as he was born made ready the sacrifice and was the Gods’ preceder. May the Gods eat our offering consecrated according to the true Priest's voice and guidance.
verses.commentary: Sense: Agni as soon as he was born made ready the sacrifice and was the Gods’ preceder. May the Gods eat our offering consecrated according to the true Priest's voice and guidance.

verses.sanskrit:
के॒तुं कृ॒ण्वन्न॑के॒तवे॒ पेशो॑ मर्या अपे॒शसे॑ ।
समु॒षद्भि॑रजायथाः
verses.translation: Thou, making light where no light was, and form, O men! where form was not, Wast born together with the Dawns.
verses.hindi: इस संसार मँ जीवन को सुन्दर बनाने करे लिए पंचभूतों, इन्द्रियों, मन, बुद्धि, अंहकार--इन सबका ठीक परिपाक हौना चाहिप्। साथ ही हम सदा यज्लिय पदार्थो का दही सूचना-इस प्रकार प्रस्तुत अध्याय की समाप्ति जीवन को सज्लिय बनाने के उपदेश से हई हे। अव अगले अध्याय का प्रारम्भ इस यज्ञिय भावना को जागरित करने की प्रार्थना
verses.transliteration: ketuṃ kṛṇvannaketave peśo maryā apeśase | samuṣadbhirajāyathāḥ
verses.wordMeaning: Thou, making light where no light was, and form, O men! where form was not, Wast born together with the Dawns.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thou, making light where no light was, and form, O men! where form was not, Wast born together with the Dawns.

verses.sanskrit:
जी॒मूत॑स्येव भवति॒ प्रती॑कं॒ यद्व॒र्मी याति॑ स॒मदा॑मु॒पस्थे॑ ।
अना॑विद्धया त॒न्वा॒ जय॒ त्वᳪ स त्वा॒ वर्म॑णो महि॒मा पि॑पर्तु
verses.translation: The warrior's look is like a thunderous rain-cloud's when, armed with mail, he seeks the lap of battle. Be thou victorious with unwounded body: so let the thickness of thine armour save thee.
verses.hindi: कर्मव्याप्त जीव निर्मल व जानी बनता“ है। यह मार्ग पर चलता हआ देवों के समीप पचता है। देवलोक को प्राप्त करने की कामना से यज्ञशेष का सेवन करता हे। प्रजाप॑तेस्तप॑सा वावृधानः सद्यो जातो द॑धिषे यज्ञमंग्ने। स्वाहा॑कृतेन हविषा पुरोगा याहि साध्या हविरदन्तु देवाः। ९९॥
verses.transliteration: jīmūtasyeva bhavati pratīkaṃ yadvarmī yāti samadāmupasthe | anāviddhayā tanvā jaya tva sa tvā varmaṇo mahimā pipartu
verses.wordMeaning: The warrior's look is like a thunderous rain-cloud's when, armed with mail, he seeks the lap of battle. Be thou victorious with unwounded body: so let the thickness of thine armour save thee.
verses.commentary: Sense: The warrior's look is like a thunderous rain-cloud's when, armed with mail, he seeks the lap of battle. Be thou victorious with unwounded body: so let the thickness of thine armour save thee.

verses.sanskrit:
धन्व॑ना॒ गा धन्व॑ना॒ऽऽजिं ज॑येम॒ धन्व॑ना ती॒व्राः स॒मदो॑ जयेम ।
धनु॒: शत्रो॑रपका॒मं कृ॑णोति॒ धन्व॑ना॒ सर्वा॑: प्र॒दिशो॑ जयेम
verses.translation: With Bow let us win kine, with Bow the battle, with Bow be victors in our hot encounters. The Bow brings grief and sorrow to the foeman: armed with the Bow may we subdue all regions.
verses.hindi: अग्रगामी जीवन मेँ तप है, यज्ञ है। सबसे बडी साधना त्याग ही े। १. अब अध्याय करे अन्त तक मन्त्र भार्गवजमद्ग्नि' के है। ' भृगु का अपत्य" भार्गव दे, अपने ज्ञान को पूर्ण परिपाक करनेवाला (-भ्रस्न पाके)। जिसके वहाँ अग्निँ जीमती है, अग्नियो को हव्य पदार्थ प्राप्त होते है, वह जमदग्नि ' है। यह निमयपूर्वक अग्निहोत्रादि
verses.transliteration: dhanvanā gā dhanvanā''jiṃ jayema dhanvanā tīvrāḥ samado jayema | dhanu: śatrorapakāmaṃ kṛṇoti dhanvanā sarvā: pradiśo jayema
verses.wordMeaning: With Bow let us win kine, with Bow the battle, with Bow be victors in our hot encounters. The Bow brings grief and sorrow to the foeman: armed with the Bow may we subdue all regions.
verses.commentary: Sense: With Bow let us win kine, with Bow the battle, with Bow be victors in our hot encounters. The Bow brings grief and sorrow to the foeman: armed with the Bow may we subdue all regions.

verses.sanskrit:
व॒क्ष्यन्ती॒वेदा ग॑नीगन्ति॒ कर्णं॑ प्रि॒यᳪ सखा॑यं परिषस्वजा॒ना ।
योषे॑व शिङ्क्ते॒ वित॒ताधि॒ धन्व॒ञ्ज्या इ॒यᳪ सम॑ने पा॒रय॑न्ती
verses.translation: Close to his ear, as fain to speak, She presses, holding her well-loved Friend in her embraces. Strained on the Bow, She whispers like a woman—this Bow-string that preserves us in the combat.
verses.hindi: त्रित इन्द्ियाश्वों को जोतता है. इन्द्र इसका अधिष्ठाता बनता हे. गन्धवं एकोनत्रिंशोऽध्यायः ३६१ इसकी लगाम पकडता है, वसु इसका निर्माण करते हैँ । 'त्रित' इन अश्वं को ! जान, कर्मव उपासना, मेँ लगाये रखता है। “ इन्द्र" जितेन्द्रिय इन्दे वश मेँ करता ह “ज्ञान में लगा पुरुष!
verses.transliteration: vakṣyantīvedā ganīganti karṇaṃ priya sakhāyaṃ pariṣasvajānā | yoṣeva śiṅkte vitatādhi dhanvañjyā iya samane pārayantī
verses.wordMeaning: Close to his ear, as fain to speak, She presses, holding her well-loved Friend in her embraces. Strained on the Bow, She whispers like a woman—this Bow-string that preserves us in the combat.
verses.commentary: Sense: Close to his ear, as fain to speak, She presses, holding her well-loved Friend in her embraces. Strained on the Bow, She whispers like a woman—this Bow-string that preserves us in the combat.

verses.sanskrit:
ते आ॒चर॑न्ती॒ सम॑नेव॒ योषा॑ मा॒तेव॑ पु॒त्रं बि॑भृतामु॒पस्थे॑ ।
अप॒ शत्रू॑न् विध्यताᳪ संविदा॒ने आर्त्नी॑ इ॒मे वि॑ष्फु॒रन्ती॑ अ॒मित्रा॑न्
verses.translation: These, meeting like a woman and her lover, bear, mother-like, their child upon their bosom. May the two Bow-ends, starting swift asunder scatter, in unison, the foes who hate us.
verses.hindi: हम इन्द्रियो का नियमन करते है तो ज्ञान को ग्रहण करनेवाले आदित्य बनते ह। ब्रह्मचर्य त्रत के द्वारा हम सोम को सुरक्षित करते है ओर मस्तिष्क मे "ऋग्. यजुः व साम' को बोँधनेवाले होते है, अर्थात् इनके लान को प्राप्त करते है। १. है भार्गव जमदग्ने! ते दिवि=तेरे मस्तिष्करूप द्युलोक में त्रीणि बन्धननि= तीन
verses.transliteration: te ācarantī samaneva yoṣā māteva putraṃ bibhṛtāmupasthe | apa śatrūn vidhyatā saṃvidāne ārtnī ime viṣphurantī amitrān
verses.wordMeaning: These, meeting like a woman and her lover, bear, mother-like, their child upon their bosom. May the two Bow-ends, starting swift asunder scatter, in unison, the foes who hate us.
verses.commentary: Sense: These, meeting like a woman and her lover, bear, mother-like, their child upon their bosom. May the two Bow-ends, starting swift asunder scatter, in unison, the foes who hate us.

verses.sanskrit:
ब॒ह्वी॒नां पि॒ता ब॒हुर॑स्य पु॒त्रश्चि॒श्चा कृ॑णोति॒ सम॑नाव॒गत्य॑ ।
इ॒षु॒धिः सङ्का॒ पृत॑नाश्च॒ सर्वा॑: पृ॒ष्ठे निन॑द्धो जयति॒ प्रसू॑तः
verses.translation: With many a son, father of many daughters, He clangs and clashes as he goes to battle. Slung on the back, pouring his brood, the Quiver vanquishes all opposing bauds and armies.
verses.hindi: त्रत हमें पवित्र बनाते हे, ये हमारी शान्ति के निधान दहै। इन व्रतो में किये हए दृद निश्चय हममे ऋत का रक्षण करते है ओर इन्द्रियो को सुरक्षित करते ै। सूर्खद्धार सरे प्रभु क्ी प्राप्ति १. प्रभु गतमन्त्र के "व्रती" अतएव “वाजी ' पुरुष से कहते है कि ते मनसातेरी
verses.transliteration: bahvīnāṃ pitā bahurasya putraściścā kṛṇoti samanāvagatya | iṣudhiḥ saṅkā pṛtanāśca sarvā: pṛṣṭhe ninaddho jayati prasūtaḥ
verses.wordMeaning: With many a son, father of many daughters, He clangs and clashes as he goes to battle. Slung on the back, pouring his brood, the Quiver vanquishes all opposing bauds and armies.
verses.commentary: Sense: With many a son, father of many daughters, He clangs and clashes as he goes to battle. Slung on the back, pouring his brood, the Quiver vanquishes all opposing bauds and armies.

verses.sanskrit:
रथे॒ तिष्ठ॑न् नयति वा॒जिन॑: पु॒रो यत्र॑-यत्र का॒मय॑ते सुषार॒थिः ।
अ॒भीशू॑नां महि॒मानं॑ पनायत॒ मन॑: प॒श्चादनु॑ यच्छन्ति र॒श्मय॑:
verses.translation: Upstanding in the Car the skilful Charioteer guides his strong Horses on whitherso’er he will. See and admire the strength of those controlling Reins which from behind declare the will of him who drives
verses.hindi: प्रभु व्रतीपुरुष के समीप होते है, यह त्रतीपुरुष सूर्यमार्ग से प्रमु को प्राप्त करता है, यह रजोगुण से ऊपर उठता हुआ, सात्विक मार्ग से चलता हुआ शिखर पर १. गतमन्त्र के अनुसार जब मेँ रजोगुण से ऊपर उठकर सात्विक मार्ग पर चलता हुँ तब अत्र यहाँ ते=तेरे उत्तमम् रूपम् सर्वोत्तम सच्चिदानन्दरूप को अपश्यम् =देखता दूं। जो
verses.transliteration: rathe tiṣṭhan nayati vājina: puro yatra-yatra kāmayate suṣārathiḥ | abhīśūnāṃ mahimānaṃ panāyata mana: paścādanu yacchanti raśmaya:
verses.wordMeaning: Upstanding in the Car the skilful Charioteer guides his strong Horses on whitherso’er he will. See and admire the strength of those controlling Reins which from behind declare the will of him who drives
verses.commentary: Sense: Upstanding in the Car the skilful Charioteer guides his strong Horses on whitherso’er he will. See and admire the strength of those controlling Reins which from behind declare the will of him who drives

verses.sanskrit:
ती॒व्रान् घोषा॑न् कृण्वते॒ वृष॑पाण॒योऽश्वा॒ रथे॑भिः स॒ह वा॒जय॑न्तः ।
अ॒व॒क्राम॑न्त॒: प्रप॑दैर॒मित्रा॑न् क्षि॒णन्ति॒ शत्रूँ॒१ रन॑पव्ययन्तः
verses.translation: Horses whose hoofs rain dust are neighing loudly, yoked to the Chariots, showing forth their vigour. With their forefeet descending on the foemen, they, never flinching, trample and destroy them.
verses.hindi: सात्त्विक मार्ग पर चलने से प्रभु का दर्शन होता है, क्रोधादि को हम जीत पाते है. वेदवाणी से प्रतिपादित मार्म पर चलते हँ, यज्ञशेष का सेवन करते है, ओषधि-वनस्पतियाों अनु त्रातांसस्तव॑ सख्यमीयुरनु देवा म॑मिरे वीर्य ते॥९९॥ १. गतमन्त्र के अनुसार जब हम प्रभु के उत्तम रूप को देखते है ओर ओषधि -वनस्पतियों
verses.transliteration: tīvrān ghoṣān kṛṇvate vṛṣapāṇayo'śvā rathebhiḥ saha vājayantaḥ | avakrāmanta: prapadairamitrān kṣiṇanti śatrū~1 ranapavyayantaḥ
verses.wordMeaning: Horses whose hoofs rain dust are neighing loudly, yoked to the Chariots, showing forth their vigour. With their forefeet descending on the foemen, they, never flinching, trample and destroy them.
verses.commentary: Sense: Horses whose hoofs rain dust are neighing loudly, yoked to the Chariots, showing forth their vigour. With their forefeet descending on the foemen, they, never flinching, trample and destroy them.

verses.sanskrit:
र॒थ॒वाह॑णᳪ ह॒विर॑स्य॒ नाम॒ यत्रायु॑धं॒ निहि॑तमस्य॒ वर्म॑ ।
तत्रा॒ रथ॒मुप॑ श॒ग्मᳪ स॑देम वि॒श्वाहा॑ व॒यᳪ सु॑मन॒स्यमा॑नाः
verses.translation: Car-bearer is the name of his oblation, whereon are laid his Weapons and his Armour. So let us here, each day that passes, honour the helpful Car with hearts exceeding joyful.
verses.hindi: हम प्रबल मस्तिष्क व पांववाले हों, कृशोदर हों, युद्ध में शीघ्र विजयी, दिव्य व गतिशील बनें। हंसों की भाँति मिलकर सहकारी समितियों कै रूप मे काम करे ओर इस प्रकार शक्तिशाली बनकर दिव्य मार्ग का आक्रमण करे। १. है अर्वन्-वासनाओं का संहार करनेवाले जीव! तव छशरीरम्-तेरा यह शरीर
verses.transliteration: rathavāhaṇa havirasya nāma yatrāyudhaṃ nihitamasya varma | tatrā rathamupa śagma sadema viśvāhā vaya sumanasyamānāḥ
verses.wordMeaning: Car-bearer is the name of his oblation, whereon are laid his Weapons and his Armour. So let us here, each day that passes, honour the helpful Car with hearts exceeding joyful.
verses.commentary: Sense: Car-bearer is the name of his oblation, whereon are laid his Weapons and his Armour. So let us here, each day that passes, honour the helpful Car with hearts exceeding joyful.

verses.sanskrit:
स्वा॒दु॒ष॒ᳪसद॑: पि॒तरो॑ वयो॒धाः कृ॑च्छ्रे॒श्रित॒: शक्ती॑वन्तो गभी॒राः ।
चि॒त्रसे॑ना॒ इषु॑बला॒ अमृ॑ध्राः स॒तोवी॑रा उ॒रवो॑ व्रातसा॒हाः
verses.translation: In sweet association lived the fathers who gave us life, profound and strong in trouble, Unwearied, armed with shafts and wondrous weapons, free, real heroes, conquerors of armies.
verses.hindi: ब्रह्मनिष्ठ व्यक्ति (क) शरीर- गृह को पवित्र बनाकर ज्ञान संचय करता हे, (ख) देवों के संघ में रहता हे, (ग) स्तेहशील, तेजस्वितावाला बनकर लोगो को ज्ञान प्राप्त कराता है, (घ) यह प्रभु का बड़ा समञ्जदार दूत बनता है। मन्मानि धीभिरुत यज्ञमुन्धन्देवत्रा च॑ कृणुह्यध्वरं न॑:॥ २६॥।
verses.transliteration: svāduṣasada: pitaro vayodhāḥ kṛcchreśrita: śaktīvanto gabhīrāḥ | citrasenā iṣubalā amṛdhrāḥ satovīrā uravo vrātasāhāḥ
verses.wordMeaning: In sweet association lived the fathers who gave us life, profound and strong in trouble, Unwearied, armed with shafts and wondrous weapons, free, real heroes, conquerors of armies.
verses.commentary: Sense: In sweet association lived the fathers who gave us life, profound and strong in trouble, Unwearied, armed with shafts and wondrous weapons, free, real heroes, conquerors of armies.

verses.sanskrit:
ब्राह्म॑णास॒: पित॑र॒: सोम्या॑सः शि॒वे नो॒ द्यावा॑पृथि॒वी अ॑ने॒हसा॑ ।
पू॒षा न॑: पातु दुरि॒तादृ॑तावृधो॒ रक्षा॒ माकि॑र्नो अ॒घश॑ᳪस ईशत
verses.translation: The Brâhmans, and the Fathers meet for Soma draughts, and, graciously inclined, unequalled Heaven and Earth. Guard us from evil, Pûshan! guard us strengtheners of Law! let not the evil-wisher master us.
verses.hindi: ब्रह्मनिष्ठ को चाहिए कि (क) शरीर के स्वास्थ्य को स्थिर रक्खे, (ख) ऋत करे मार्ग का मुधरता से आक्रमण करे, (ग) मधुर शब्दों से सबके मनों को आनन्दित करे। (घ) बुद्धियोँ से ज्ञान कौ बद्धाए (ङ) यज्ञ को सिद्ध करे, (च) देवों के विषय में यज्ञं को करनेवाला हो, अर्थात् उनकौ हिसा से दूर रहे।
verses.transliteration: brāhmaṇāsa: pitara: somyāsaḥ śive no dyāvāpṛthivī anehasā | pūṣā na: pātu duritādṛtāvṛdho rakṣā mākirno aghaśasa īśata
verses.wordMeaning: The Brâhmans, and the Fathers meet for Soma draughts, and, graciously inclined, unequalled Heaven and Earth. Guard us from evil, Pûshan! guard us strengtheners of Law! let not the evil-wisher master us.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Brâhmans, and the Fathers meet for Soma draughts, and, graciously inclined, unequalled Heaven and Earth. Guard us from evil, Pûshan! guard us strengtheners of Law! let not the evil-wisher master us.

verses.sanskrit:
सु॒प॒र्णं व॑स्ते मृ॒गो अ॑स्या॒ दन्तो॒ गोभि॒: सन्न॑द्धा पतति॒ प्रसू॑ता ।
यत्रा॒ नर॒: सं च॒ वि च॒ द्रव॑न्ति॒ तत्रा॒स्मभ्य॒मिष॑व॒: शर्म॑ यᳪसन्
verses.translation: Her tooth a deer, dressed in an eagle's feathers, bound with cow-hide, launched forth, She flieth onward. There where the heroes speed hither and thither, there may the arrows shelter and protect us.
verses.hindi: हे प्रभो! आप स्तुति के योग्य तथा वन्दनीय हैँ, आप ही सर्वमहान् देव है, सब आवश्यक पदार्थो के देनेवाले हैँ, आप हमें प्राप्त होइए। नोट-- यह्व होताचयहः चासौ होता च। षिः-जमदग्निः। देवता-अन्तरिक्षम्। छन्दः- भुरिक्पङ्क्तिः स्वरः- पञ्चमः,
verses.transliteration: suparṇaṃ vaste mṛgo asyā danto gobhi: sannaddhā patati prasūtā | yatrā nara: saṃ ca vi ca dravanti tatrāsmabhyamiṣava: śarma yasan
verses.wordMeaning: Her tooth a deer, dressed in an eagle's feathers, bound with cow-hide, launched forth, She flieth onward. There where the heroes speed hither and thither, there may the arrows shelter and protect us.
verses.commentary: Sense: Her tooth a deer, dressed in an eagle's feathers, bound with cow-hide, launched forth, She flieth onward. There where the heroes speed hither and thither, there may the arrows shelter and protect us.

verses.sanskrit:
ऋजी॑ते॒ परि॑ वृङ्धि॒ नोऽश्मा॑ भवतु नस्त॒नूः ।
सोमो॒ अधि॑ ब्रवीतु॒ नोऽदि॑ति॒: शर्म॑ यच्छतु
verses.translation: Avoid as thou whose flight is straight, and let our bodies be as stone. May Soma kindly speak to us, and Aditi protect us well.
verses.hindi: प्रभु के प्रिय बनने के लिए हम हदय को विशाल च वासनाशृन्य बनार्े। शरीर को पूर्ण स्वस्थ करने का प्रयत्न करें। ' वसु" बनकर ही हम प्रभु करे प्रिय बन सकगे। देवींद्रारो बुहतीर्विश्वमिन्वा देवेभ्यो भवत सुप्रायणाः॥३०॥ १. ' वसुओं' की--उत्तम निवासवालों की इन्दरयो व्यचस्वतीः = (व्यञ्चनवत्य: गमनवत्यः)
verses.transliteration: ṛjīte pari vṛṅdhi no'śmā bhavatu nastanūḥ | somo adhi bravītu no'diti: śarma yacchatu
verses.wordMeaning: Avoid as thou whose flight is straight, and let our bodies be as stone. May Soma kindly speak to us, and Aditi protect us well.
verses.commentary: Sense: Avoid as thou whose flight is straight, and let our bodies be as stone. May Soma kindly speak to us, and Aditi protect us well.

verses.sanskrit:
आ ज॑ङ्घन्ति॒ सान्वे॑षां ज॒घनाँ॒२ उप॑ जिघ्नते ।
अश्वा॑जनि॒ प्रचे॑त॒सोऽश्वा॑न्त्स॒मत्सु॑ चोदय
verses.translation: Lord of the Wood, be firm and strong in body: be, bearing us, a brave victorious hero.
verses.hindi: धनुष् में ज्या का जो महत्त्व है वही जीवन मेँ वाणी का महत्त्व हे। इसी से आत्मारूप शर प्रेरित होता है। प्रभु की वाणी हम आत्माओं को प्रेरणा दे रही हे। हम स्वयं भी वाणी द्वारा आत्मा को प्रेरणा (आत्मप्रेरणा) देकर आगे बढते चि १. ते आलत्नी-वे दोनों धनुष्कोटियाँ समना योषा इव आआचरन्ती=समान पत्ति में गये
verses.transliteration: ā jaṅghanti sānveṣāṃ jaghanā~2 upa jighnate | aśvājani pracetaso'śvāntsamatsu codaya
verses.wordMeaning: Lord of the Wood, be firm and strong in body: be, bearing us, a brave victorious hero.
verses.commentary: Sense: Lord of the Wood, be firm and strong in body: be, bearing us, a brave victorious hero.

verses.sanskrit:
अहि॑रिव भोगै॒: पर्ये॑ति बा॒हुं ज्याया॑ हे॒तिं प॑रि॒बाध॑मानः ।
ह॒स्त॒घ्नो विश्वा॑ व॒युना॑नि वि॒द्वान् पुमा॒न् पुमा॑ᳪसं॒ परि॑ पातु वि॒श्वत॑:
verses.translation: It compasses the arm with serpent windings, fending away the friction of the bowstring: So may the Brace, well skilled in all its duties, guard manfully the man from every quarter.
verses.hindi: हमारे इन्द्रियाश्व शक्तिशाली हों। उनकी लगाम हमारे हाथों मे हो तभी हम इस शरीर-रथ से यात्रा में आगे बढ पार्पगे। १. अस्य=इस मन्त्र के ऋषि ' भरद्वाज पायु" का हविः =दानपूर्वक अदन, यज्ञशेष के रूप मे भोजन का सेवन रथवाहनम् नाम=निश्चय से शरीररूप रथ के धारण के लिए ही
verses.transliteration: ahiriva bhogai: paryeti bāhuṃ jyāyā hetiṃ paribādhamānaḥ | hastaghno viśvā vayunāni vidvān pumān pumāsaṃ pari pātu viśvata:
verses.wordMeaning: It compasses the arm with serpent windings, fending away the friction of the bowstring: So may the Brace, well skilled in all its duties, guard manfully the man from every quarter.
verses.commentary: Sense: It compasses the arm with serpent windings, fending away the friction of the bowstring: So may the Brace, well skilled in all its duties, guard manfully the man from every quarter.

verses.sanskrit:
वन॑स्पते वी॒ड्व॒ङ्गो॒ हि भू॒या अ॒स्मत्स॑खा प्र॒तर॑णः सु॒वीर॑: ।
गोभि॒: सन्न॑द्धो असि वी॒डय॑स्वास्था॒ता ते॑ जयतु॒ जेत्वा॑नि
verses.translation: Show forth thy strength, compact with straps of leather, and let thy rider win all spoils of battle.
verses.hindi: जैसे रथ के ठीक होने पर तथा सब उपकरणों व रक्षासानों से युक्त होने पर यात्री सुख व शान्ति अनुभव करता ह, उसी प्रकार हमारा यह शरीररूप रथ भी हो। इसमे इन्द्रियों, प्राण, मन व बुद्धि आदि सभी उपकरण ठीक हों, जिससे सोमनस्यवाले होकर हम यात्रा को पूर्णं करे।
verses.transliteration: vanaspate vīḍvaṅgo hi bhūyā asmatsakhā prataraṇaḥ suvīra: | gobhi: sannaddho asi vīḍayasvāsthātā te jayatu jetvāni
verses.wordMeaning: Show forth thy strength, compact with straps of leather, and let thy rider win all spoils of battle.
verses.commentary: Sense: Show forth thy strength, compact with straps of leather, and let thy rider win all spoils of battle.

verses.sanskrit:
दि॒वः पृ॑थि॒व्याः पर्योज॒ उद्भृ॑तं॒ वन॒स्पति॑भ्य॒: पर्याभृ॑त॒ᳪ सह॑: ।
अ॒पामो॒ज्मानं॒ परि॒ गोभि॒रावृ॑त॒मिन्द्र॑स्य॒ वज्र॑ᳪ ह॒विषा॒ रथं॑ यज
verses.translation: Its mighty strength was borrowed from the heaven and earth its conquering force was brought from sovrans of the wood. Honour with holy gifts the Car like Indra's bolt, the Car bound round with straps, the vigour of the floods.
verses.hindi: - राष्ट कौ रक्षा के लिए आयुध-सामग्री ठीक से तैयार होनी चाहिए्। यह शत्रुसैन्य को पराजित करके राष्ट् मे सुख व शान्ति को बद्धानेवाली हो। जुगमन ( सरल्न व्यवहार  १. गतमन्त्र के अनुसार “ शत्रुओं क भय से सुरक्षित राष्ट मे हम कैसे बनें' इस बात
verses.transliteration: divaḥ pṛthivyāḥ paryoja udbhṛtaṃ vanaspatibhya: paryābhṛta saha: | apāmojmānaṃ pari gobhirāvṛtamindrasya vajra haviṣā rathaṃ yaja
verses.wordMeaning: Its mighty strength was borrowed from the heaven and earth its conquering force was brought from sovrans of the wood. Honour with holy gifts the Car like Indra's bolt, the Car bound round with straps, the vigour of the floods.
verses.commentary: Sense: Its mighty strength was borrowed from the heaven and earth its conquering force was brought from sovrans of the wood. Honour with holy gifts the Car like Indra's bolt, the Car bound round with straps, the vigour of the floods.

verses.sanskrit:
इन्द्र॑स्य॒ वज्रो॑ म॒रुता॒मनी॑कं मि॒त्रस्य॒ गर्भो॒ वरु॑णस्य॒ नाभि॑: ।
सेमां नो॑ ह॒व्यदा॑तिं जुषा॒णो देव॑ रथ॒ प्रति॑ ह॒व्या गृ॑भाय
verses.translation: Thou bolt of Indra, Vanguard of the Maruts, close knit to Varuna and Child of Mitra,— As such, accepting gifts which here we offer, receive, O Godlike Chariot, these oblations.
verses.hindi: - हमारा व्यवहार सरल, कपटशन्य हो। शरीर . पाषाणवत् दृद हो। सौम्य आचार्यो से हमें ज्ञान प्राप्त हो। अदीनता व दिव्यता हमें सुखी व शान्त करे। १. जहाँ रथ मेँ घोडों का महत्त्व है, वहौँ घोड़ों को चलानेवाले रथवाहक का महत्त्व भी कम नहीं है। समज्ञदार रथवाहक सामान्य घ्ोडों को भी बड़ी अच्छी गतिवाला कर लेता
verses.transliteration: indrasya vajro marutāmanīkaṃ mitrasya garbho varuṇasya nābhi: | semāṃ no havyadātiṃ juṣāṇo deva ratha prati havyā gṛbhāya
verses.wordMeaning: Thou bolt of Indra, Vanguard of the Maruts, close knit to Varuna and Child of Mitra,— As such, accepting gifts which here we offer, receive, O Godlike Chariot, these oblations.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thou bolt of Indra, Vanguard of the Maruts, close knit to Varuna and Child of Mitra,— As such, accepting gifts which here we offer, receive, O Godlike Chariot, these oblations.

verses.sanskrit:
उप॑ श्वासय पृथि॒वीमु॒त द्यां पु॑रु॒त्रा ते॑ मनुतां॒ विष्ठि॑तं॒ जग॑त् ।
स दु॑न्दुभे स॒जूरिन्द्रे॑ण दे॒वैर्दू॒राद्दवी॑यो॒ अप॑ सेध॒ शत्रू॑न्
verses.translation: Send forth thy voice aloud through earth and heaven, and let the world in all its breadth regard thee; O Drum, accordant with the Gods and Indra, drive thou afar, yea, very far, our foemen.
verses.hindi: हमारा शरीररूप रथ ' वनस्पतिविकार' दी हो, अर्थात् हम वानस्पतिक भोजन ही करे। गोदुग्ध से हमारे अङ्घ-प्रत्यङ्ग सुगटित हों। इस शरीररूप रथ पर आसीन होकर हम विजेतव्य वस्तुओं का विजय करे। १. गतमन्त्र के शरीररूप रथ मेँ दिवः-मस्तिष्करूप द्युलोक का तथा पृथिव्याः
verses.transliteration: upa śvāsaya pṛthivīmuta dyāṃ purutrā te manutāṃ viṣṭhitaṃ jagat | sa dundubhe sajūrindreṇa devairdūrāddavīyo apa sedha śatrūn
verses.wordMeaning: Send forth thy voice aloud through earth and heaven, and let the world in all its breadth regard thee; O Drum, accordant with the Gods and Indra, drive thou afar, yea, very far, our foemen.
verses.commentary: Sense: Send forth thy voice aloud through earth and heaven, and let the world in all its breadth regard thee; O Drum, accordant with the Gods and Indra, drive thou afar, yea, very far, our foemen.

verses.sanskrit:
आ क्र॑न्दय॒ बल॒मोजो॑ न॒ आधा॒ निष्ट॑निहि दुरि॒ता बाध॑मानः ।
अप॑ प्रोथ दुन्दुभे दु॒च्छुना॑ इ॒त इन्द्र॑स्य मु॒ष्टिर॑सि वी॒डय॑स्व
verses.translation: Thunder out strength and fill us fall of vigour: yea, thunder forth and drive away all dangers. Drive hence, O War-drum, drive away misfortune: thou art the Fist of Indra: show thy firmness.
verses.hindi: - दुन्दुभि का शब्द जहाँ शत्रु को भयभीत करता है, वरहा अपने सैनिकों को उत्साहयुक्त करता है। इसके शब्द से शक्र-सैन्य कुत्तो कौ भ्रति भाग खडा हो। आमूरज प्रत्यावर्तयेमाः केतुमरहन्दुभिवौवदीति । १. केतुमत्-विजय-पताकावाली अथवा (केतुनप्रज्ञा) विजय की प्रकाशक, विजय
verses.transliteration: ā krandaya balamojo na ādhā niṣṭanihi duritā bādhamānaḥ | apa protha dundubhe ducchunā ita indrasya muṣṭirasi vīḍayasva
verses.wordMeaning: Thunder out strength and fill us fall of vigour: yea, thunder forth and drive away all dangers. Drive hence, O War-drum, drive away misfortune: thou art the Fist of Indra: show thy firmness.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thunder out strength and fill us fall of vigour: yea, thunder forth and drive away all dangers. Drive hence, O War-drum, drive away misfortune: thou art the Fist of Indra: show thy firmness.

verses.sanskrit:
आमूर॑ज प्र॒त्याव॑र्तये॒माः के॑तु॒मद्दु॑न्दु॒भिर्वा॑वदीति ।
समश्व॑पर्णा॒श्चर॑न्ति नो॒ नरो॒ऽस्माक॑मिन्द्र र॒थिनो॑ जयन्तु
verses.translation: Drive hither those, and these again bring hither: the War-drum speaks aloud as battle's signal. Our heroes, winged with horses, come together. Let our car-warriors, Indra, be triumphant.
verses.hindi: - दुन्दुभि का शब्द जहाँ शत्रु को भयभीत करता है, वरहा अपने सैनिकों को उत्साहयुक्त करता है। इसके शब्द से शक्र-सैन्य कुत्तो कौ भ्रति भाग खडा हो। आमूरज प्रत्यावर्तयेमाः केतुमरहन्दुभिवौवदीति । १. केतुमत्-विजय-पताकावाली अथवा (केतुनप्रज्ञा) विजय की प्रकाशक, विजय
verses.transliteration: āmūraja pratyāvartayemāḥ ketumaddundubhirvāvadīti | samaśvaparṇāścaranti no naro'smākamindra rathino jayantu
verses.wordMeaning: Drive hither those, and these again bring hither: the War-drum speaks aloud as battle's signal. Our heroes, winged with horses, come together. Let our car-warriors, Indra, be triumphant.
verses.commentary: Sense: Drive hither those, and these again bring hither: the War-drum speaks aloud as battle's signal. Our heroes, winged with horses, come together. Let our car-warriors, Indra, be triumphant.

verses.sanskrit: आ॒ग्ने॒यः कृ॒ष्णग्री॑वः सारस्व॒ती मे॒षी ब॒भ्रुः सौ॒म्यः पौ॒ष्णः श्या॒मः शि॑तिपृ॒ष्ठो बा॑र्हस्प॒त्यः शि॒ल्पो वै॑श्वदे॒व ऐ॒न्द्रो॒ऽरु॒णो मा॑रु॒तः क॒ल्माष॑ ऐन्द्रा॒ग्नः स॑ᳪहि॒तोऽधोरा॑मः सावि॒त्रो वा॑रु॒णः कृ॒ष्ण एक॑शितिपा॒त्पेत्व॑:
verses.translation: The black-necked victim belongs to Agni; the ewe to Sarasvatî; the brown victim is Soma's; the dusky Pûshan's; the white-backed is Brihaspati's; the dappled belongs to the All-Gods; the red to Indra; the spotted to the Maruts; the strong-bodied to Indra-Agni; one with white marks below to Savitar; to Varuna a black ram with one white foot
verses.hindi: - दुन्दुभि का शब्द जहाँ शत्रु को भयभीत करता है, वरहा अपने सैनिकों को उत्साहयुक्त करता है। इसके शब्द से शक्र-सैन्य कुत्तो कौ भ्रति भाग खडा हो। आमूरज प्रत्यावर्तयेमाः केतुमरहन्दुभिवौवदीति । १. केतुमत्-विजय-पताकावाली अथवा (केतुनप्रज्ञा) विजय की प्रकाशक, विजय
verses.transliteration: āgneyaḥ kṛṣṇagrīvaḥ sārasvatī meṣī babhruḥ saumyaḥ pauṣṇaḥ śyāmaḥ śitipṛṣṭho bārhaspatyaḥ śilpo vaiśvadeva aindro'ruṇo mārutaḥ kalmāṣa aindrāgnaḥ sahito'dhorāmaḥ sāvitro vāruṇaḥ kṛṣṇa ekaśitipātpetva:
verses.wordMeaning: The black-necked victim belongs to Agni; the ewe to Sarasvatî; the brown victim is Soma's; the dusky Pûshan's; the white-backed is Brihaspati's; the dappled belongs to the All-Gods; the red to Indra; the spotted to the Maruts; the strong-bodied to Indra-Agni;…
verses.commentary: Sense: The black-necked victim belongs to Agni; the ewe to Sarasvatî; the brown victim is Soma's; the dusky Pûshan's; the white-backed is Brihaspati's; the dappled belongs to the All-Gods; the red to Indra; the spotted to the Maruts; the strong-bodied to Indra-Agni;…

verses.sanskrit: अ॒ग्नयेऽनी॑कवते॒ रोहि॑ताञ्जिरन॒ड्वान॒धोरा॑मौ सावि॒त्रौ पौ॒ष्णौ र॑ज॒तना॑भी वैश्वदे॒वौ पि॒शङ्गौ॑ तूप॒रौ मा॑रु॒तः क॒ल्माष॑ आग्ने॒यः कृ॒ष्णोऽजः सा॑रस्व॒ती मे॒षी वा॑रु॒णः पेत्व॑:
verses.translation: To Agni Anîkavân is sacrificed a red-marked ox; two with white spots below are for Savitar; two with silvery navels for Pûshan; two yellow hornless he-goats for the All-Gods; a spotted one for the Maruts; the black-faced he-goat is Agni's; the ewe is Sarasvatî's; the ram is Varuna's.
verses.hindi: - दुन्दुभि का शब्द जहाँ शत्रु को भयभीत करता है, वरहा अपने सैनिकों को उत्साहयुक्त करता है। इसके शब्द से शक्र-सैन्य कुत्तो कौ भ्रति भाग खडा हो। आमूरज प्रत्यावर्तयेमाः केतुमरहन्दुभिवौवदीति । १. केतुमत्-विजय-पताकावाली अथवा (केतुनप्रज्ञा) विजय की प्रकाशक, विजय
verses.transliteration: agnaye'nīkavate rohitāñjiranaḍvānadhorāmau sāvitrau pauṣṇau rajatanābhī vaiśvadevau piśaṅgau tūparau mārutaḥ kalmāṣa āgneyaḥ kṛṣṇo'jaḥ sārasvatī meṣī vāruṇaḥ petva:
verses.wordMeaning: To Agni Anîkavân is sacrificed a red-marked ox; two with white spots below are for Savitar; two with silvery navels for Pûshan; two yellow hornless he-goats for the All-Gods; a spotted one for the Maruts; the black-faced he-goat is Agni's; the ewe is Sarasvatî's;…
verses.commentary: Sense: To Agni Anîkavân is sacrificed a red-marked ox; two with white spots below are for Savitar; two with silvery navels for Pûshan; two yellow hornless he-goats for the All-Gods; a spotted one for the Maruts; the black-faced he-goat is Agni's; the ewe is Sarasvatî's;…

verses.sanskrit: अ॒ग्नये॑ गाय॒त्राय॑ त्रि॒वृते॒ राथ॑न्तराया॒ष्टाक॑पाल॒ इन्द्रा॑य त्रैष्टु॑भाय पञ्चद॒शाय॒ बार्ह॑ता॒यैका॑दशकपालो॒ विश्वे॑भ्यो दे॒वेभ्यो॒ जाग॑तेभ्यः सप्तद॒शेभ्यो॑ वैरू॒पेभ्यो॒ द्वाद॑शकपालो मि॒त्रावरु॑णाभ्या॒मानु॑ष्टुभाभ्यामेकवि॒ᳪशाभ्यां॑ वैरा॒जाभ्यां॑ पय॒स्या बृह॒स्पत॑ये॒ पाङ्क्ता॑य त्रिण॒वाय॑ शाक्व॒राय॑ च॒रुः स॑वि॒त्र औष्णि॑हाय त्रयस्त्रि॒ᳪशाय॑ रैव॒ताय॒ द्वाद॑शकपालः प्राजाप॒त्यश्च॒रुरदि॑त्यै॒ विष्णु॑पत्न्यै च॒रुर॒ग्नये॑ वैश्वान॒राय॒ द्वाद॑शकपा॒लोऽनु॑मत्या अ॒ष्टाक॑पालः
verses.translation: To Agni of the Gâyatrî, of the Trivrit hymn and of the Rathantara Sâman is to be offered a rice-cake on eight potsherds; to Indra of the Trishtup, the Pañchadasa hymn and the Brihat Sâman one on eleven potsherds; to the All-Gods of the Jagatî, the Seventeenfold hymn and the Vairûpa Sâman, one on twelve potsherds; to Mitra-Varuna of the Anushtup, the Ekavimsa hymn, and the Vairâja Sâman, a mess of curdled milk; to Brihaspati of the Pankti metre, the Trinava hymn, and the Sâkvara Sâman, an oblation of rice boded in milk; to Savitar of the Ushnih, the Thirty-threefold hymn, and the Raivata Sâman, a rice-cake on eight potsherds; a mess of boiled rice is to be made for Prajâpati; the same for Vishnu's Consort Aditi; to Agni Vaisvânara is to be offered a rice-cake on twelve potsherds, and to Anumati one on eight.
verses.hindi: - दुन्दुभि का शब्द जहाँ शत्रु को भयभीत करता है, वरहा अपने सैनिकों को उत्साहयुक्त करता है। इसके शब्द से शक्र-सैन्य कुत्तो कौ भ्रति भाग खडा हो। आमूरज प्रत्यावर्तयेमाः केतुमरहन्दुभिवौवदीति । १. केतुमत्-विजय-पताकावाली अथवा (केतुनप्रज्ञा) विजय की प्रकाशक, विजय
verses.transliteration: agnaye gāyatrāya trivṛte rāthantarāyāṣṭākapāla indrāya traiṣṭubhāya pañcadaśāya bārhatāyaikādaśakapālo viśvebhyo devebhyo jāgatebhyaḥ saptadaśebhyo vairūpebhyo dvādaśakapālo mitrāvaruṇābhyāmānuṣṭubhābhyāmekaviśābhyāṃ vairājābhyāṃ payasyā bṛhaspataye pāṅktāya triṇavāya śākvarāya caruḥ savitra auṣṇihāya trayastriśāya raivatāya dvādaśakapālaḥ prājāpatyaścaruradityai viṣṇupatnyai caruragnaye vaiśvānarāya dvādaśakapālo'numatyā aṣṭākapālaḥ
verses.wordMeaning: To Agni of the Gâyatrî, of the Trivrit hymn and of the Rathantara Sâman is to be offered a rice-cake on eight potsherds; to Indra of the Trishtup, the Pañchadasa hymn and the Brihat Sâman one on eleven potsherds; to the All-Gods of the Jagatî,…
verses.commentary: Sense: To Agni of the Gâyatrî, of the Trivrit hymn and of the Rathantara Sâman is to be offered a rice-cake on eight potsherds; to Indra of the Trishtup, the Pañchadasa hymn and the Brihat Sâman one on eleven potsherds; to the All-Gods of the Jagatî,…

verses.sanskrit:
देव॑ सवित॒: प्र सु॑व य॒ज्ञं प्र सु॑व य॒ज्ञप॑तिं॒ भगा॑य ।
दि॒व्यो ग॑न्ध॒र्वः के॑तु॒पूः केतं॑ नः पुनातु वा॒चस्पति॒र्वाजं॑ नः स्वदतु
verses.translation: com The Texts of the White Yajurveda, tr. Ralph T.H. Griffith, [1899], OUR sacrifice, God Savitar! speed onward: speed to his share the sacrifice's patron. May the Celestial Gandharva, cleanser of thought and will, make clean our thoughts and wishes. The Lord of Speech sweeten the words we utter!
