verses.hindi: हम निरन्तर प्रभु का ध्यान करे, प्रभु कौ तेजस्विता हमारे लिए वरेण्य हो। यह लक्ष्य हमें मार्गश्रष्ट होने से बचाएगा। विश्वानि देव सवितर्दुरितानि परा सुव। यं द्धद्रन्तन्न ऽआ सुंव ॥ ३॥ १. है देव=दिव्य गुणों के पुञ्ज! सवितः=सबके प्रेरक प्रभो! विश्वानि हमारे न
verses.transliteration: deva savita: pra suva yajñaṃ pra suva yajñapatiṃ bhagāya | divyo gandharvaḥ ketupūḥ ketaṃ naḥ punātu vācaspatirvājaṃ naḥ svadatu
verses.wordMeaning: com The Texts of the White Yajurveda, tr. Ralph T.H. Griffith, [1899], OUR sacrifice, God Savitar! speed onward: speed to his share the sacrifice's patron. May the Celestial Gandharva, cleanser of thought and will, make clean our thoughts and wishes.…
verses.commentary: Sense: com The Texts of the White Yajurveda, tr. Ralph T.H. Griffith, [1899], OUR sacrifice, God Savitar! speed onward: speed to his share the sacrifice's patron. May the Celestial Gandharva, cleanser of thought and will, make clean our thoughts and wishes.…

verses.sanskrit:
तत्स॑वि॒तुर्वरे॑ण्यं॒ भर्गो॑ दे॒वस्य॑ धीमहि ।
धियो॒ यो न॑: प्रचो॒दयात्
verses.translation: May we attain that excellent glory of Savitar the God: So may he stimulate our prayers.
verses.hindi: प्रभुकृपा से हमारे दोष दूर हों ओर हमें भद्र की प्राप्ति हो। १. गतमन्त्र में प्रार्थित दुरितों को दूर करने व भद्रके प्रापण का प्रकार यहटहै कि प्रभु धन का विभाग करते है। उस धन के केन्द्रित होने पर ही दोष उत्पन्न होते है। मनुष्य भी नासमञ्ञी व स्वार्थपरता के कारण धन पर केन्द्रित होने लगता है ओर सारा सामाजिक शरीर
verses.transliteration: tatsaviturvareṇyaṃ bhargo devasya dhīmahi | dhiyo yo na: pracodayāt
verses.wordMeaning: May we attain that excellent glory of Savitar the God: So may he stimulate our prayers.
verses.commentary: Sense: May we attain that excellent glory of Savitar the God: So may he stimulate our prayers.

verses.sanskrit:
विश्वा॑नि देव सवितर्दुरि॒तानि॒ परा॑ सुव ।
यद्भ॒द्रं तन्न॒ आ सु॑व
verses.translation: Savitar, God, send far away all troubles and calamities, And send us only what is good.
verses.hindi: प्रभु धन का विभाग करते है। यदि धन एक स्थान पर केन्द्रित होने लगता है तो दुरितों की वृद्धि हो जाती है, अतः ' मेधातिथि' समञ्चदारी से चलनेवाला, धन को केन्द्रित नहीं होने देता। ज्ञान क लिए ब्राह्मण को
verses.transliteration: viśvāni deva savitarduritāni parā suva | yadbhadraṃ tanna ā suva
verses.wordMeaning: Savitar, God, send far away all troubles and calamities, And send us only what is good.
verses.commentary: Sense: Savitar, God, send far away all troubles and calamities, And send us only what is good.

verses.sanskrit:
वि॒भ॒क्तार॑ᳪ हवामहे॒ वसो॑श्चि॒त्रस्य॒ राध॑सः ।
स॒वि॒तारं॑ नृ॒चक्ष॑सम्
verses.translation: We call on him distributer of wondrous bounty and of wealth, On Savitar who looks on men.
verses.hindi: राजा को चाहिए कि राष्ट् के भिन्न-भिन्न कार्यो के लिए उपयुक्ततम व्यक्ति नत्ताय॑ सूतं गीताय॑ शोलूषं धर्मीय सभाचरं नरिष्ठायै भीमलं नर्माय रेभश्टसांय कारिंमानन्दायं स्त्रीषखं प्रमदे कुमारीपुत्र मेधायै रथकार धैयीय तक्षाणम्।। ६॥ ११. चृत्ताय सूतम् नृत्य के लिए-इशारो से नृत्य कौ प्रेरणा देनेवाले को प्राप्त करे।
verses.transliteration: vibhaktāra havāmahe vasościtrasya rādhasaḥ | savitāraṃ nṛcakṣasam
verses.wordMeaning: We call on him distributer of wondrous bounty and of wealth, On Savitar who looks on men.
verses.commentary: Sense: We call on him distributer of wondrous bounty and of wealth, On Savitar who looks on men.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्म॑णे ब्राह्म॒णं क्ष॒त्राय॑ राज॒न्यं॒ म॒रुद्भ्यो॒ वैश्यं॒ तप॑से शू॒द्रं तम॑से॒ तस्क॑रं नार॒काय॑ वीर॒हणं॑ पा॒प्मने॑ क्ली॒बमा॑क्र॒याया॑ अयो॒गूं कामा॑य पुँश्च॒लूमति॑क्रुष्टाय माग॒धम्
verses.translation: For Brahman (Priesthood) he binds a Brahman to the stake; for Kshatra (Royalty) a Râjanya; for the Maruts a Vaisya; for Penance a Sûdra; for Darkness a robber; for Hell a homicide or a man who has lost his consecrated fire; for Misfortune a eunuch; for Venality an Ayogû; for Kâma a harlot; for Excessive Noise a Mâgadha;
verses.hindi: राजा राष्ट में नृत्य आदि कार्यो के लिए सूत आदि को नियुक्त करे। तप॑से कौलालं मायायै कर्मार॑ रूपाय मणिकारः शुभे वपशरव्य्रायाऽ इषुकारः हत्ये धनुष्कारं कर्मणे ज्याकारं दिष्टाय रज्जुसर्ज मृत्यवे मृगयुमन्त॑काय शुवनिन॑म्॥। ७।॥ २९. तपसे कौलालम् तपनेवाले कार्यो के लिए कुम्हार के पुत्र को प्राप्त करे। वह
verses.transliteration: brahmaṇe brāhmaṇaṃ kṣatrāya rājanyaṃ marudbhyo vaiśyaṃ tapase śūdraṃ tamase taskaraṃ nārakāya vīrahaṇaṃ pāpmane klībamākrayāyā ayogūṃ kāmāya pu~ścalūmatikruṣṭāya māgadham
verses.wordMeaning: For Brahman (Priesthood) he binds a Brahman to the stake; for Kshatra (Royalty) a Râjanya; for the Maruts a Vaisya; for Penance a Sûdra; for Darkness a robber; for Hell a homicide or a man who has lost his consecrated fire; for Misfortune a eunuch; for Venality an Ayogû;…
verses.commentary: Sense: For Brahman (Priesthood) he binds a Brahman to the stake; for Kshatra (Royalty) a Râjanya; for the Maruts a Vaisya; for Penance a Sûdra; for Darkness a robber; for Hell a homicide or a man who has lost his consecrated fire; for Misfortune a eunuch; for Venality an Ayogû;…

verses.sanskrit: नृ॒त्ताय॑ सू॒तं गी॒ताय॑ शैलू॒षं धर्मा॑य सभाच॒रं न॒रिष्ठा॑यै भीम॒लं न॒र्माय॑ रे॒भᳪ हसा॑य॒ कारि॑मान॒न्दाय॑ स्त्रीष॒खं प्र॒मदे॑ कुमारीपु॒त्रं मे॒धायै॑ रथका॒रं धै॑र्याय॒ तक्षा॑णम्
verses.translation: For Dance a stable-master; for Song a public dancer; for Duty one who attends court; for Pastime a timid man; for Sport a chatterer; for Laughter an artist; for Pleasure a woman-lover; for Desire a damsel's son; for Dexterity a car-builder; for Firmness a carpenter;
verses.hindi: मृगयु, श्वनी आदि को भी राजा राष्ट के उपयोगी कार्यो में विनियुक्त करे। उनके द्वारा शोर आदि की हत्या कराके ग्रामवासियों के आतङ्क को दूर करे। नदियों के लिए पौञ्जिष्ठ को नदीभ्यः पौज्जिष्ठमृक्षीकाभ्यो नैषादं पुरुषव्याघ्रायं दुर्मद गन्धर्वाप्सरोभ्यो त्रात्य॑
verses.transliteration: nṛttāya sūtaṃ gītāya śailūṣaṃ dharmāya sabhācaraṃ nariṣṭhāyai bhīmalaṃ narmāya rebha hasāya kārimānandāya strīṣakhaṃ pramade kumārīputraṃ medhāyai rathakāraṃ dhairyāya takṣāṇam
verses.wordMeaning: For Dance a stable-master; for Song a public dancer; for Duty one who attends court; for Pastime a timid man; for Sport a chatterer; for Laughter an artist; for Pleasure a woman-lover; for Desire a damsel's son; for Dexterity a car-builder; for Firmness a carpenter;
verses.commentary: Sense: For Dance a stable-master; for Song a public dancer; for Duty one who attends court; for Pastime a timid man; for Sport a chatterer; for Laughter an artist; for Pleasure a woman-lover; for Desire a damsel's son; for Dexterity a car-builder; for Firmness a carpenter;

verses.sanskrit: तप॑से कौला॒लं मा॒यायै॑ क॒र्मार॑ᳪ रू॒पाय॑ मणिका॒रᳪ शु॒भे व॒पᳪ श॑र॒व्या॒या इषुका॒रᳪ हे॒त्यै ध॑नुष्का॒रं कर्म॑णे ज्याका॒रं दि॒ष्टाय॑ रज्जुस॒र्जं मृ॒त्यवे॑ मृग॒युमन्त॑काय श्व॒निन॑म्
verses.translation: For Trouble a potter's son; for Device an artificer; for Beauty a jeweller; for Welfare a sower; for the Arrow-deity a maker of shafts; for Injury a bowyer; for Action a bowstring-maker; for Fate a rope-maker; for Death a hunter; for the Finisher a dog-leader;
verses.hindi: राजा ने राष्टोत्नति के लिए विविध पुरुषों को विविध कार्यो में लगाना है। मच्छियारों से लेकर कुन्तधारियों तक सभी की यथास्थान नियुक्ति करनी हे। एदिधिषुःपतिं निष्कृत्यै पेशस्कारीश्श्संज्ञानाय स्मरक्ारीं प्र॑कामोद्ययोपसदं वर्णीयानुरुधं ४१. सन्धये जारम्-सन्धि के लिए वृद्ध (जीर्ण) पुरुष को प्राप्त करे। ये वृद्ध पुरुष
verses.transliteration: tapase kaulālaṃ māyāyai karmāra rūpāya maṇikāra śubhe vapa śaravyāyā iṣukāra hetyai dhanuṣkāraṃ karmaṇe jyākāraṃ diṣṭāya rajjusarjaṃ mṛtyave mṛgayumantakāya śvaninam
verses.wordMeaning: For Trouble a potter's son; for Device an artificer; for Beauty a jeweller; for Welfare a sower; for the Arrow-deity a maker of shafts; for Injury a bowyer; for Action a bowstring-maker; for Fate a rope-maker; for Death a hunter; for the Finisher a dog-leader;
verses.commentary: Sense: For Trouble a potter's son; for Device an artificer; for Beauty a jeweller; for Welfare a sower; for the Arrow-deity a maker of shafts; for Injury a bowyer; for Action a bowstring-maker; for Fate a rope-maker; for Death a hunter; for the Finisher a dog-leader;

verses.sanskrit: न॒दीभ्य॑: पौञ्जि॒ष्ठमृ॒क्षीका॑भ्यो॒ नैषादं पुरुषव्या॒घ्राय॑ दु॒र्मदं॑ गन्धर्वाप्स॒रोभ्यो॒ व्रात्यं॑ प्र॒युग्भ्य॒ उन्म॑त्तᳪ सर्पदेवज॒नेभ्योऽप्र॑तिपद॒मये॑भ्यः कित॒वमी॒र्यता॑या॒ अकि॑तवं पिशा॒चेभ्यो॑ बिदलका॒रीं या॑तु॒धाने॑भ्यः कण्टकीका॒रीम्
verses.translation: For Rivers a fisherman; for Rikshîkâs a Nishâda's son; for the Man-tiger a madman; for the Gandharvas and Apsarases a Vrâtya; for Motives one demented; for Serpents and Genii an untrustworthy man; for Dice a gambler; for Excitement a non-gambler; for Pisâchas a woman who splits cane; for Yâtudhânas a woman who works in thorns;
verses.hindi: राजा शिक्षा के प्रसार के लिए एेसे अध्यापकों को नियत करे जो विद्यार्थियों करे ज्लान को प्रश्नात्मक शैली से निरन्तर बद्धानेवाले हों। अर्मेभ्यो हस्तिपं जवायांर्वपं पुष्ट्यै गोपालं वीर्यायाविपालं तेज॑से ऽजपालमिरायै कीनाशं कीलालांय सुराकारं भद्राय गृहपश्शश्रय॑से वित्तधमाध्यक्ष्यायानुक्षत्तार॑म्॥। ९९॥
verses.transliteration: nadībhya: pauñjiṣṭhamṛkṣīkābhyo naiṣādaṃ puruṣavyāghrāya durmadaṃ gandharvāpsarobhyo vrātyaṃ prayugbhya unmatta sarpadevajanebhyo'pratipadamayebhyaḥ kitavamīryatāyā akitavaṃ piśācebhyo bidalakārīṃ yātudhānebhyaḥ kaṇṭakīkārīm
verses.wordMeaning: For Rivers a fisherman; for Rikshîkâs a Nishâda's son; for the Man-tiger a madman; for the Gandharvas and Apsarases a Vrâtya; for Motives one demented; for Serpents and Genii an untrustworthy man; for Dice a gambler; for Excitement a non-gambler;…
verses.commentary: Sense: For Rivers a fisherman; for Rikshîkâs a Nishâda's son; for the Man-tiger a madman; for the Gandharvas and Apsarases a Vrâtya; for Motives one demented; for Serpents and Genii an untrustworthy man; for Dice a gambler; for Excitement a non-gambler;…

verses.sanskrit: स॒न्धये॑ जा॒रं गे॒हायो॑पप॒तिमार्त्यै॒ परि॑वित्तं॒ निरृ॑त्यै परिविविदा॒नमरा॑द्ध्या एदिधिषुः प॒तिं निष्कृ॑त्यै पेशस्का॒रीᳪ सं॒ज्ञाना॑य स्मरका॒रीं प्र॑का॒मोद्या॑योप॒सदं॒ वर्णा॑यानु॒रुधं॒ बला॑योप॒दाम्
verses.translation: For Rendezvous a lover; for Homestead a paramour; for Trouble an unmarried elder brother; for Nirriti a younger brother who has married before his elder; for Misfortune the husband of a younger sister whose elder sister has not been married; for Representation a woman who embroiders; for Agreement a woman who deals in love-charms; for Garrulity a by-sitter; for Colour an obstinate man; for Strength a yielding man;
verses.hindi: राष्ट् मे गोप, अश्वपाल, अविपाल व किसान आदि का स्थान अत्यन्त भ्रा क्रे लिए दार्वाह्ार को भायै दार्वाहारं प्रभायांऽअग्न्येधं ब्रध्नस्य॑ विष्टपांयाभिषेक्तारं वर्षिष्ठाय नाकाय परिवेष्टारं देवलोकाय पेशितारं मनुष्यलोकाय प्रकरितारई सर्वेभ्यो लोकेभ्यऽ
verses.transliteration: sandhaye jāraṃ gehāyopapatimārtyai parivittaṃ nirṛtyai parivividānamarāddhyā edidhiṣuḥ patiṃ niṣkṛtyai peśaskārī saṃjñānāya smarakārīṃ prakāmodyāyopasadaṃ varṇāyānurudhaṃ balāyopadām
verses.wordMeaning: For Rendezvous a lover; for Homestead a paramour; for Trouble an unmarried elder brother; for Nirriti a younger brother who has married before his elder; for Misfortune the husband of a younger sister whose elder sister has not been married;…
verses.commentary: Sense: For Rendezvous a lover; for Homestead a paramour; for Trouble an unmarried elder brother; for Nirriti a younger brother who has married before his elder; for Misfortune the husband of a younger sister whose elder sister has not been married;…

verses.sanskrit: उ॒त्सा॒देभ्य॑: कु॒ब्जं प्र॒मुदे॑ वाम॒नं द्वा॒र्भ्यः स्रा॒मᳪ स्वप्ना॑या॒न्धमध॑र्माय बधि॒रं प॒वित्रा॑य भि॒षजं॑ प्र॒ज्ञाना॑य नक्षत्रद॒र्शमा॑शि॒क्षायै॑ प्र॒श्निन॑मुपशि॒क्षाया॑ अभिप्र॒श्निनं॑ म॒र्यादा॑यै प्रश्नविवा॒कम्
verses.translation: For Interruptions a hunch-back; for Delight a dwarf, for Doors a blear-eyed man; for Sleep a blind man; for Unrighteousness a deaf man; for Purifying Medium a physician; for Insight an astrologer; for Craving for Knowledge an inquisitive man; for Desire of extra Knowledge an extra-inquisitive man; for Moral Law a question solver;
verses.hindi: स्तेनहदय लोगों का भी राष्ट के लिए सुन्दर उपयोग हो सकता है। मन्यु के लिए अयस्ताप को मन्यवे ऽयस्तापं क्रोधाय निखरं योगाय योक्तारः शोकायाभिसत्तरि क्षेमाय विमोक्तार॑मुत्कूलनिकूलेभ्य॑स्तरिष्ठिनं वपुषे मानस्कृतः शीर्लायाञ्जनीकारीं निकऋत्यै
verses.transliteration: utsādebhya: kubjaṃ pramude vāmanaṃ dvārbhyaḥ srāma svapnāyāndhamadharmāya badhiraṃ pavitrāya bhiṣajaṃ prajñānāya nakṣatradarśamāśikṣāyai praśninamupaśikṣāyā abhipraśninaṃ maryādāyai praśnavivākam
verses.wordMeaning: For Interruptions a hunch-back; for Delight a dwarf, for Doors a blear-eyed man; for Sleep a blind man; for Unrighteousness a deaf man; for Purifying Medium a physician; for Insight an astrologer; for Craving for Knowledge an inquisitive man;…
verses.commentary: Sense: For Interruptions a hunch-back; for Delight a dwarf, for Doors a blear-eyed man; for Sleep a blind man; for Unrighteousness a deaf man; for Purifying Medium a physician; for Insight an astrologer; for Craving for Knowledge an inquisitive man;…

verses.sanskrit: अर्मे॑भ्यो हस्ति॒पं ज॒वाया॑श्व॒पं पुष्ट्यै॑ गोपा॒लं वी॒र्या॒याविपा॒लं तेज॑सेऽजपा॒लमिरा॑यै की॒नाशं॑ की॒लाला॑य सुराका॒रं भ॒द्राय॑ गृह॒पᳪ श्रेय॑से वित्त॒धमाध्य॑क्ष्यायानुक्ष॒तार॑म्
verses.translation: For Eye-diseases an elephant-keeper; for Speed a horse-keeper; for Nourishment a cowherd; for Manliness a shepherd; for Keenness a goatherd; for Refreshment a ploughman; for Sweet Beverage a preparer of Surâ; for Weal a house-guard; for Well-being a possessor of wealth; for Supervision a doorkeeper's attendant;
verses.hindi: राष्ट् कौ उत्तम व्यवस्था के लिए उचित कर आदि लेनेवाले व्यक्तियों को यमाय॑ यमसूमथंर्वभ्यो ऽव॑तोका संवत्सराय पर्यायिणीं परिवत्सरायाविंजाता- १०१. यमायनियन्त्रण के लिए यमसूम्-नियमोपनियम बनानेवाली सभा को प्राप्त करे, आजकल की भाषा मे “विधान-सभा' का निर्माण करे। १०२. अथर्वभ्यः =(न थर्वति)
verses.transliteration: armebhyo hastipaṃ javāyāśvapaṃ puṣṭyai gopālaṃ vīryāyāvipālaṃ tejase'japālamirāyai kīnāśaṃ kīlālāya surākāraṃ bhadrāya gṛhapa śreyase vittadhamādhyakṣyāyānukṣatāram
verses.wordMeaning: For Eye-diseases an elephant-keeper; for Speed a horse-keeper; for Nourishment a cowherd; for Manliness a shepherd; for Keenness a goatherd; for Refreshment a ploughman; for Sweet Beverage a preparer of Surâ; for Weal a house-guard; for Well-being a possessor of wealth;…
verses.commentary: Sense: For Eye-diseases an elephant-keeper; for Speed a horse-keeper; for Nourishment a cowherd; for Manliness a shepherd; for Keenness a goatherd; for Refreshment a ploughman; for Sweet Beverage a preparer of Surâ; for Weal a house-guard; for Well-being a possessor of wealth;…

verses.sanskrit: भायै॑ दार्वा॒हारं॑ प्र॒भाया॑ अग्न्ये॒धं ब्र॒ध्नस्य॑ वि॒ष्टपा॑याभिषे॒क्तारं॒ वर्षि॑ष्ठाय॒ नाका॑य परिवे॒ष्टारं॑ देवलो॒काय॑ पेशि॒तारं॑ मनुष्यलो॒काय॑ प्रकरि॒तार॒ᳪ सर्वे॑भ्यो लो॒केभ्य॑ उपसे॒क्तार॒मव॑ ऋत्यै व॒धायो॑पमन्थि॒तारं॒ मेधा॑य वासः पल्पू॒लीं प्र॑का॒माय॑ रजयि॒त्रीम्
verses.translation: For Light a wood-bringer; for Brightness a fire-kindler; for the Sun's Station a besprinkler; for Highest Heaven a high steward; for the World of Gods a carver; for the World of Men a distributer; for All-Worlds a pourer-out: for Poverty, Affliction a stirrer-up of strife; for Sacrifice a washerwoman; for Delight a female dyer;
verses.hindi: जँ राष्ट् का उत्तम सञ्चालन, व्यवस्थापिका, सभादि के होने से होता है वहाँ घर में उत्तम निवास के लिए कार्यो के क्रम को सम्यक् समञ्जनेवाली पत्नी का होना १११. सरोभ्यः=तलाबों के लिए धैवरम्-धीवर सन्तानं को नियत करे। तालाबों को स्वच्छ रखना इनका कार्य हो। ११२. उपस्थावराभ्यः=तालाबों के समीप (उप) लगी
verses.transliteration: bhāyai dārvāhāraṃ prabhāyā agnyedhaṃ bradhnasya viṣṭapāyābhiṣektāraṃ varṣiṣṭhāya nākāya pariveṣṭāraṃ devalokāya peśitāraṃ manuṣyalokāya prakaritāra sarvebhyo lokebhya upasektāramava ṛtyai vadhāyopamanthitāraṃ medhāya vāsaḥ palpūlīṃ prakāmāya rajayitrīm
verses.wordMeaning: For Light a wood-bringer; for Brightness a fire-kindler; for the Sun's Station a besprinkler; for Highest Heaven a high steward; for the World of Gods a carver; for the World of Men a distributer; for All-Worlds a pourer-out: for Poverty, Affliction a stirrer-up of strife;…
verses.commentary: Sense: For Light a wood-bringer; for Brightness a fire-kindler; for the Sun's Station a besprinkler; for Highest Heaven a high steward; for the World of Gods a carver; for the World of Men a distributer; for All-Worlds a pourer-out: for Poverty, Affliction a stirrer-up of strife;…

verses.sanskrit: ऋ॒तये॑ स्ते॒नहृ॑दयं वैर॑हत्याय॒ पिशु॑नं॒ विवि॑क्त्यै क्ष॒त्तार॒मौप॑द्रष्ट्र्यायानुक्ष॒त्तारं॒ बला॑यानुच॒रं भू॒म्ने प॑रिष्क॒न्दं प्रि॒याय॑ प्रियवा॒दिन॒ मरि॑ष्ट्या अश्वसा॒दᳪ स्व॒र्गा॑य लो॒काय॑ भागदु॒घं वर्षि॑ष्ठाय॒ नाका॑य परिवे॒ष्टार॑म्
verses.translation: For Assault a thievish-hearted man; for Homicide a slanderer; for Discrimination a door-keeper; for Inspection a door-keeper's attendant; for Strength a servant; for Plenty a running footman; for the Beloved a sweet speaker; for Safety the rider of a horse; for the World of Svarga a dealer-out of portions; for Highest Heaven a high steward;
verses.hindi: तालाबों व पहाडों पर कार्यव्यवस्था के लिए तदुपयुक्त पुरुषों को नियत करना चाहिए। तालाबों के लिए धीवर आदि तो पर्वतो के लिए किरात आदि। ्रीभत्स के त्तिए पौल्कस को बीभत्सायै पौल्कसं वणय हिरण्यकारं तुलायै वाणिजं पंश्चादोषायं ग्लाविनं
verses.transliteration: ṛtaye stenahṛdayaṃ vairahatyāya piśunaṃ viviktyai kṣattāramaupadraṣṭryāyānukṣattāraṃ balāyānucaraṃ bhūmne pariṣkandaṃ priyāya priyavādina mariṣṭyā aśvasāda svargāya lokāya bhāgadughaṃ varṣiṣṭhāya nākāya pariveṣṭāram
verses.wordMeaning: For Assault a thievish-hearted man; for Homicide a slanderer; for Discrimination a door-keeper; for Inspection a door-keeper's attendant; for Strength a servant; for Plenty a running footman; for the Beloved a sweet speaker; for Safety the rider of a horse;…
verses.commentary: Sense: For Assault a thievish-hearted man; for Homicide a slanderer; for Discrimination a door-keeper; for Inspection a door-keeper's attendant; for Strength a servant; for Plenty a running footman; for the Beloved a sweet speaker; for Safety the rider of a horse;…

verses.sanskrit: म॒न्यवे॑ऽयस्ता॒पं क्रोधा॑य निस॒रं योगा॑य यो॒क्तार॒ᳪ शोका॑याभिस॒र्तारं॒ क्षेमा॑य विमो॒क्तार॑मुत्कूलनिकू॒लेभ्य॑स्त्रि॒ष्ठिनं॒ वपु॑षे मानस्कृ॒तᳪ शीला॑याञ्जनीका॒रीं निरृ॑त्यै कोशका॒रीं य॒माया॒सूम्
verses.translation: For Passion an iron-smelter; for Anger a remover; for Yoking a yoker; for Pain an assailant; for Quiet an unyoker; for Up-hill and Down-hill one who stands on three legs; for Form a conceited man; for Virtue a female ointment-maker; for Nirriti a female scabbard-maker; for Yama a barren woman;
verses.hindi: राष्ट् मे बीभत्स व छेदनादि कार्यो में निपुण व्यक्ति कौ नियुक्ति करनी है। अक्षराज क त्तिए कितव को सभास्थाणां मृत्यव गोव्यच्छमन्त॑काय गोघातं क्षुधे यो गां विकृन्तन्तं भिक्षमाणऽउप तिष्ठ॑ति दुष्कृताय चस्काचार्य पाप्मन सेलगम्।। १८॥
verses.transliteration: manyave'yastāpaṃ krodhāya nisaraṃ yogāya yoktāra śokāyābhisartāraṃ kṣemāya vimoktāramutkūlanikūlebhyastriṣṭhinaṃ vapuṣe mānaskṛta śīlāyāñjanīkārīṃ nirṛtyai kośakārīṃ yamāyāsūm
verses.wordMeaning: For Passion an iron-smelter; for Anger a remover; for Yoking a yoker; for Pain an assailant; for Quiet an unyoker; for Up-hill and Down-hill one who stands on three legs; for Form a conceited man; for Virtue a female ointment-maker; for Nirriti a female scabbard-maker;…
verses.commentary: Sense: For Passion an iron-smelter; for Anger a remover; for Yoking a yoker; for Pain an assailant; for Quiet an unyoker; for Up-hill and Down-hill one who stands on three legs; for Form a conceited man; for Virtue a female ointment-maker; for Nirriti a female scabbard-maker;…

verses.sanskrit: य॒माय॑ यम॒सूमथ॑र्व॒भ्योऽव॑तोकाᳪ संवत्स॒राय॑ पर्या॒यिणीं॑ परिवत्स॒रायावि॑जातामिदावत्स॒राया॒तीत्व॑रीमिद्वत्स॒राया॑ति॒ष्कद्व॑रीं वत्स॒राय॒ विज॑र्जराᳪ संवत्स॒राय॒ पलि॑क्नीमृ॒भुभ्यो॑ऽजिनस॒न्धᳪ सा॒ध्येभ्य॑श्चर्म॒म्नम्
verses.translation: For Yama a mother of twins; for the Atharvans a woman who has miscarried; for the First Year a gad-about; for the Parivatsara one who has not borne a child; for the Idâvatsara one who exceeds; for the Idvatsara one who transgresses; for the Vatsara one who is worn out; for the Samvatsara one with grey hair; for the Ribhus a hide-dresser; for the Sâdhyas a currier;
verses.hindi: जँ उद्घोषणा आदि के लिए ढोल आदि बजानेवाले कौ नियुक्ति करनी दहे वहाँ वनों कौ रक्षा के लिए रक्षापुरुषों को भी नियुक्त करना हे। नर्म के लिए पँश्चत्तू को नर्माय पश्चलू हसाय कारिं याद॑से शाबल्यां ग्रामण्युं गणकमभिक्रोश॑कं
verses.transliteration: yamāya yamasūmatharvabhyo'vatokā saṃvatsarāya paryāyiṇīṃ parivatsarāyāvijātāmidāvatsarāyātītvarīmidvatsarāyātiṣkadvarīṃ vatsarāya vijarjarā saṃvatsarāya paliknīmṛbhubhyo'jinasandha sādhyebhyaścarmamnam
verses.wordMeaning: For Yama a mother of twins; for the Atharvans a woman who has miscarried; for the First Year a gad-about; for the Parivatsara one who has not borne a child; for the Idâvatsara one who exceeds; for the Idvatsara one who transgresses; for the Vatsara one who is worn out;…
verses.commentary: Sense: For Yama a mother of twins; for the Atharvans a woman who has miscarried; for the First Year a gad-about; for the Parivatsara one who has not borne a child; for the Idâvatsara one who exceeds; for the Idvatsara one who transgresses; for the Vatsara one who is worn out;…

verses.sanskrit: सरो॑भ्यो धैव॒रमु॑प॒स्थाव॑राभ्यो॒ दाशं॑ वैश॒न्ताभ्यो॑ बै॒न्दं न॑ड्व॒लाभ्यः शौष्क॑लं पा॒राय॑ मार्गा॒रम॑वा॒राय॑ कै॒वर्तं॑ ती॒र्थेभ्य॑ आ॒न्दं विष॑मेभ्यो मैना॒लᳪ स्वने॑भ्य॒: पर्ण॑कं॒ गुहा॑भ्य॒: किरा॑त॒ᳪ सानु॑भ्यो॒ जम्भ॑कं॒ पर्व॑तेभ्यः किम्पूरु॒षम्
verses.translation: For Lakes a fisherman; for Standing Waters a fisher; for Tank-waters a Nishâda; for Reed-beds a fish-vender; for the Opposite Bank one who gropes for fish; for This Bank a fish-catcher; for Fords an Âuda; for shallows a Mainâla; for Sounds a Bhilla; for Caverns a Kirâta; for Mountain-heights a destructive savage; for Mountains a wild man;
verses.hindi: आठ विरूप पुरुषों को तथा मागध आदि चार को राजा प्रजा से दूर दही रखे, जिससे राष्ट का कार्य सुचारुरूपेण चलता रहे। न प्रजा तमाशा देखने मे लग जाए ओर न सूचना-राष्ट् मे सबको यथोचित कार्यो में लगाना ही "पुरुषमेध ' है (मेधसंगम)। “पुरुषमेध ' के ठीक होने पर ही राज्य का सारा एश्वर्य बढता है।
verses.transliteration: sarobhyo dhaivaramupasthāvarābhyo dāśaṃ vaiśantābhyo baindaṃ naḍvalābhyaḥ śauṣkalaṃ pārāya mārgāramavārāya kaivartaṃ tīrthebhya āndaṃ viṣamebhyo maināla svanebhya: parṇakaṃ guhābhya: kirāta sānubhyo jambhakaṃ parvatebhyaḥ kimpūruṣam
verses.wordMeaning: For Lakes a fisherman; for Standing Waters a fisher; for Tank-waters a Nishâda; for Reed-beds a fish-vender; for the Opposite Bank one who gropes for fish; for This Bank a fish-catcher; for Fords an Âuda; for shallows a Mainâla; for Sounds a Bhilla; for Caverns a Kirâta;…
verses.commentary: Sense: For Lakes a fisherman; for Standing Waters a fisher; for Tank-waters a Nishâda; for Reed-beds a fish-vender; for the Opposite Bank one who gropes for fish; for This Bank a fish-catcher; for Fords an Âuda; for shallows a Mainâla; for Sounds a Bhilla; for Caverns a Kirâta;…

verses.sanskrit: बी॒भ॒त्सायै॑ पौल्क॒सं वर्णा॑य हिरण्यका॒रं तु॒लायै॑ वाणि॒जं प॑श्चादो॒षाय॑ ग्ला॒विनं॒ विश्वे॑भ्यो भू॒तेभ्य॑: सिध्म॒लं भूत्यै॑ जागर॒णमभू॑त्यै स्वप॒नमार्त्यै॑ जनवा॒दिनं॒ व्यृ॒र्द्ध्या अपग॒ल्भᳪ स॑ᳪश॒राय॑ प्र॒च्छिद॑म्
verses.translation: For Abhorrence a Paulkasa; for Colour a goldsmith; for Balance a merchant; for Repentance a sluggard; for All Spirits a leper; for Prosperity a watchful man; for Failure a sleepy man; for Mischief a chatterer; for Misfortune a shameless man; for Undoing one who cuts up into small pieces;
verses.hindi: प्रभु हमे यज्ञ की प्रेरणा दें। यज्ञपति बनकर हम एेश्वर्यशाली हो। प्रभु हमारे ज्ञान को पवित्र करें ओर वाणी को माधुर्य से भर दे। तत्स॑वितुर्वरेण्यं भर्गो" देवस्य धीमहि। धियो यो न॑ः प्रचोदयात् ॥ २॥ १. गतमन्त्र के अनुसार ' यज्ञ+ज्ञान+व वाङ्माधुर्य' को अपनाकर हम अपने जीवन को
verses.transliteration: bībhatsāyai paulkasaṃ varṇāya hiraṇyakāraṃ tulāyai vāṇijaṃ paścādoṣāya glāvinaṃ viśvebhyo bhūtebhya: sidhmalaṃ bhūtyai jāgaraṇamabhūtyai svapanamārtyai janavādinaṃ vyṛrddhyā apagalbha saśarāya pracchidam
verses.wordMeaning: For Abhorrence a Paulkasa; for Colour a goldsmith; for Balance a merchant; for Repentance a sluggard; for All Spirits a leper; for Prosperity a watchful man; for Failure a sleepy man; for Mischief a chatterer; for Misfortune a shameless man;…
verses.commentary: Sense: For Abhorrence a Paulkasa; for Colour a goldsmith; for Balance a merchant; for Repentance a sluggard; for All Spirits a leper; for Prosperity a watchful man; for Failure a sleepy man; for Mischief a chatterer; for Misfortune a shameless man;…

verses.sanskrit: अ॒क्ष॒रा॒जाय॑ कित॒वं कृ॒ताया॑दिनवद॒र्शं त्रेता॑यै क॒ल्पिनं॑ द्वा॒परा॑याधिक॒ल्पिन॑मास्क॒न्दाय॑ सभास्था॒णुं मृ॒त्यवे॑ गोव्य॒च्छमन्त॑काय गोघा॒तं क्षु॒धे यो गां वि॑कृ॒न्तन्तं॒ भिक्ष॑माण उप॒तिष्ठ॑ति दुष्कृ॒ताय॒ चर॑काचार्यं पा॒प्मने॑ सैल॒गम्
verses.translation: For the Dice-king a gambler; for the die Krita one who contemplates his adversary's ill luck, for the Tretâ a gamble-manager; for the Dvâpara a chief manager; for Askanda one who will not leave the gambling-hall; for Mrityu one who approaches cows; for Antaka a Cow-killer; for Hunger one who goes begging to a man who is cutting up a cow; for Misdeed a leader of the Charakas; for Misery a robber;
verses.hindi: राजा राष्ट मे सन्धि आदि कार्यो के लिए उपयुक्त व्यक्तियों को नियत करे। नोट- आर्ति का अर्थ पीडा के लिए सामान्यत होता हे। यँ पीड़ा कौ निवृत्ति के लिए किया गया हे। जैसे मशकाय धूमः' का अर्थं " मच्छरों की निवृत्ति के लिए धूंञा' होता हे। ५५१. उत्सादेभ्यः =विनाशकारी कार्यो के लिए कुल्जम्-कुबडे को नियत करे। इन लोगों
verses.transliteration: akṣarājāya kitavaṃ kṛtāyādinavadarśaṃ tretāyai kalpinaṃ dvāparāyādhikalpinamāskandāya sabhāsthāṇuṃ mṛtyave govyacchamantakāya goghātaṃ kṣudhe yo gāṃ vikṛntantaṃ bhikṣamāṇa upatiṣṭhati duṣkṛtāya carakācāryaṃ pāpmane sailagam
verses.wordMeaning: For the Dice-king a gambler; for the die Krita one who contemplates his adversary's ill luck, for the Tretâ a gamble-manager; for the Dvâpara a chief manager; for Askanda one who will not leave the gambling-hall; for Mrityu one who approaches cows; for Antaka a Cow-killer;…
verses.commentary: Sense: For the Dice-king a gambler; for the die Krita one who contemplates his adversary's ill luck, for the Tretâ a gamble-manager; for the Dvâpara a chief manager; for Askanda one who will not leave the gambling-hall; for Mrityu one who approaches cows; for Antaka a Cow-killer;…

verses.sanskrit: प्र॒ति॒श्रुत्का॑या अर्त॒नं घोषा॑य भ॒षमन्ता॑य बहुवा॒दिन॑मन॒न्ताय॒ मूक॒ᳪ शब्दा॑याडम्बराघा॒तं मह॑से वीणावा॒दं क्रोशा॑य तूणव॒ध्मम॑वरस्प॒राय॑ शङ्ख॒ध्मं वना॑य वन॒पम॒न्यतो॑रण्याय दाव॒पम्
verses.translation: For Echo a reviler; for Noise a snarler; for End a very talkative man; for Endless a mute; for Sound a drummer; for Might a lute-player; for Cry a flute-blower; for Confused Tone a Conch-blower; for the Wood a wood-ranger; for Partly-wooded Land a forest fire guard;
verses.hindi: उत्तम लोकों कौ प्राप्ति के लिए त्याग व अशुभवृत्ति-विनाश आवश्यक हे। ऋति के लिए स्तेनददय को लोकाय भागदुघं वर्षिष्ठाय नाकाय परिवेष्टारंम्।। ९३॥ ८१. ऋतये=शत्नु-सैन्य के लिए स्तेनहदयम्-( हृदयस्य स्तेनः) हदय को चुरा लेनेवाले
verses.transliteration: pratiśrutkāyā artanaṃ ghoṣāya bhaṣamantāya bahuvādinamanantāya mūka śabdāyāḍambarāghātaṃ mahase vīṇāvādaṃ krośāya tūṇavadhmamavarasparāya śaṅkhadhmaṃ vanāya vanapamanyatoraṇyāya dāvapam
verses.wordMeaning: For Echo a reviler; for Noise a snarler; for End a very talkative man; for Endless a mute; for Sound a drummer; for Might a lute-player; for Cry a flute-blower; for Confused Tone a Conch-blower; for the Wood a wood-ranger; for Partly-wooded Land a forest fire guard;
verses.commentary: Sense: For Echo a reviler; for Noise a snarler; for End a very talkative man; for Endless a mute; for Sound a drummer; for Might a lute-player; for Cry a flute-blower; for Confused Tone a Conch-blower; for the Wood a wood-ranger; for Partly-wooded Land a forest fire guard;

verses.sanskrit:
न॒र्माय॑ पुँश्च॒लूᳪ हसा॑य॒ कारिं॒ याद॑से शाब॒ल्यां ग्रा॑म॒ण्यं गण॑कमभि॒क्रोश॑कं॒ तान्मह॑से वीणावा॒दं पा॑णि॒घ्नं तू॑णव॒ध्मं तान्नृ॒त्ताया॑न॒न्दाय॑
तल॒वम्
verses.translation: For Pastime a harlot; for Laughter a jester; for Lust a woman with spotty skin; for Might these, the head-man of a village, an astrologer, and a watchman; a lute-player; a hand-clapper, a flutist, these for Dance; for Pleasure a musician;
verses.hindi: राष्ट में गोहत्या आदि पापों को दूर करने का पूर्ण प्रयत्न किया जारए्। प्रतिश्चुत्क के लिए अर्तन करो प्रतिश्रुत्कायाऽअर्तनं घोषाय भषमन्तांय बहुवादिन॑मनन्ताय मूक शब्दायाडम्बराघातं महसे वीणावादं क्रोशाय तृणवध्मम॑वरस्परायं शडखध्मं वनाय वनपमन्यतोरण्याय
verses.transliteration: narmāya pu~ścalū hasāya kāriṃ yādase śābalyāṃ grāmaṇyaṃ gaṇakamabhikrośakaṃ tānmahase vīṇāvādaṃ pāṇighnaṃ tūṇavadhmaṃ tānnṛttāyānandāya talavam
verses.wordMeaning: For Pastime a harlot; for Laughter a jester; for Lust a woman with spotty skin; for Might these, the head-man of a village, an astrologer, and a watchman; a lute-player; a hand-clapper, a flutist, these for Dance; for Pleasure a musician;
verses.commentary: Sense: For Pastime a harlot; for Laughter a jester; for Lust a woman with spotty skin; for Might these, the head-man of a village, an astrologer, and a watchman; a lute-player; a hand-clapper, a flutist, these for Dance; for Pleasure a musician;

verses.sanskrit: अ॒ग्नये॒ पीवा॑नं पृथि॒व्यै पी॑ठस॒र्पिणं॑ वा॒यवे॑ चाण्डा॒लम॒न्तरि॑क्षाय वᳪशन॒र्तिनं॑  दि॒वे ख॑ल॒तिᳪ सूर्या॑य हर्य॒क्षं नक्ष॑त्रेभ्यः किर्मि॒रं च॒न्द्रम॑से कि॒लास॒मह्ने॑ शु॒क्लं पि॑ङ्गा॒क्षᳪ रात्र्यै॑ कृ॒ष्णं पि॑ङ्गा॒क्षम्
verses.translation: For Fire a fat man; for Earth a cripple; for Wind a Chândâla; for Mid-Air a pole-dancer; for Sky a bald-head; for the Sun a green-eyed man; for Stars a spotty man; for the Moon a leper; for Day a white yellow-eyed man; for Night a black man with yellow eyes.
verses.hindi: जहाँ रामों के प्रबन्ध के लिए ग्रामणी आदि को नियत करना हे, वहाँ आमोद -प्रमोद के उत्सवों के लिए वीणावादक आदि को भी प्राप्त करना हे। दिवे खलतिः सूर्याय हर्यक्षं नक्षत्रेभ्यः किर्मिरं चन्द्रम॑से किलासमद् शुक्लं १६३. अग्नये-अग्नि के लिए, अग्नि के समीप कार्य करने के लिए पीवानम्-मोटे
verses.transliteration: agnaye pīvānaṃ pṛthivyai pīṭhasarpiṇaṃ vāyave cāṇḍālamantarikṣāya vaśanartinaṃ dive khalati sūryāya haryakṣaṃ nakṣatrebhyaḥ kirmiraṃ candramase kilāsamahne śuklaṃ piṅgākṣa rātryai kṛṣṇaṃ piṅgākṣam
verses.wordMeaning: For Fire a fat man; for Earth a cripple; for Wind a Chândâla; for Mid-Air a pole-dancer; for Sky a bald-head; for the Sun a green-eyed man; for Stars a spotty man; for the Moon a leper; for Day a white yellow-eyed man; for Night a black man with yellow eyes.
verses.commentary: Sense: For Fire a fat man; for Earth a cripple; for Wind a Chândâla; for Mid-Air a pole-dancer; for Sky a bald-head; for the Sun a green-eyed man; for Stars a spotty man; for the Moon a leper; for Day a white yellow-eyed man; for Night a black man with yellow eyes.

verses.sanskrit:
अथै॒तान॒ष्टौ विरू॑पा॒ना ल॑भ॒तेऽति॑दीर्घं॒ चाति॑ह्रस्वं॒ चाति॑स्थूलं॒ चाति॑कृशं॒ चाति॑शुक्लं॒ चाति॑कृष्णं॒ चाति॑कुल्वं॒ चाति॑लोमशं च ।
अशू॑द्रा॒ अब्रा॑ह्मणा॒स्ते प्रा॑जाप॒त्याः ।
मा॒ग॒धः पुँ॑श्च॒ली कि॑त॒वः क्ली॒बोऽशू॑द्रा॒ अब्रा॑ह्मणा॒स्ते प्रा॑जाप॒त्याः
verses.translation: Now he ties up the eight following variform men: one too tall, one too short, one too stout, one too thin, one too white, one too black, one too bald, one too airy. These must be neither Sûdras nor Brâhmans, and must be dedicated to Prajâpati. A minstrel, a harlot, a gambler, and a eunuch—neither of Sûdra nor Brâhman caste—are to be dedicated to Prajâpati.
verses.hindi: राष्ट मे प्रत्येक स्थान पर तदुपयुक्त पुरुषों को ही कार्यार्थ नियुक्त करना चाहिए। १. अथ=अवब विविध स्थानों पर उपर्युक्त पुरुषों कौ नियुक्ति के बाद एतान्=इन अष्टौ=आठ विरूपान् परस्पर विरुद्ध रूपवाले व विकृत रूपवाले पुरुषों को आलभतेप्राप्त करता हे। (क) अतिदीर्घम्-बडे लम्बे कदवाले, (ख) च=ओौर अतिहस्वम्-बहुत छोटे
verses.transliteration: athaitānaṣṭau virūpānā labhate'tidīrghaṃ cātihrasvaṃ cātisthūlaṃ cātikṛśaṃ cātiśuklaṃ cātikṛṣṇaṃ cātikulvaṃ cātilomaśaṃ ca | aśūdrā abrāhmaṇāste prājāpatyāḥ | māgadhaḥ pu~ścalī kitavaḥ klībo'śūdrā abrāhmaṇāste prājāpatyāḥ
verses.wordMeaning: Now he ties up the eight following variform men: one too tall, one too short, one too stout, one too thin, one too white, one too black, one too bald, one too airy. These must be neither Sûdras nor Brâhmans, and must be dedicated to Prajâpati. A minstrel, a harlot, a gambler,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Now he ties up the eight following variform men: one too tall, one too short, one too stout, one too thin, one too white, one too black, one too bald, one too airy. These must be neither Sûdras nor Brâhmans, and must be dedicated to Prajâpati. A minstrel, a harlot, a gambler,…

verses.sanskrit:
स॒हस्र॑शीर्षा॒ पुरु॑षः सहस्रा॒क्षः स॒हस्र॑पात् ।
स भूमि॑ᳪ स॒र्वत॑ स्पृ॒त्वाऽत्य॑तिष्ठद्दशाङ्गु॒॒लम्
verses.translation: com The Texts of the White Yajurveda, tr. Ralph T.H. Griffith, [1899], BOOK THE THIRTY-FIRST. PURUSHA hath a thousand heads, a thousand eyes, a thousand feet. Pervading earth on every side he fills a space ten fingers broad.
verses.hindi: १. वे प्रभु अनन्त सिरो, ओंखों व पोँवोंवाले हे। २. इस ब्रह्माण्ड को आवृत करके इसकी रक्षा कर रहे है ओर इसके अन्दर निवास कर रहे हेँ। ३. वे प्रभु इस दशांगुल पुरुषऽ एवेद ःसर्व यद् भूतं यच्च॑ भाव्यम्। उतामुंतत्वस्येशानो यदत्र नातिरोहं ति।।२॥ १. इस संसार में जन्म के दृष्टिकोण से जीव तीन भागों में विभक्त है (क) प्रथम
verses.transliteration: sahasraśīrṣā puruṣaḥ sahasrākṣaḥ sahasrapāt | sa bhūmi sarvata spṛtvā'tyatiṣṭhaddaśāṅgulam
verses.wordMeaning: com The Texts of the White Yajurveda, tr. Ralph T.H. Griffith, [1899], BOOK THE THIRTY-FIRST. PURUSHA hath a thousand heads, a thousand eyes, a thousand feet. Pervading earth on every side he fills a space ten fingers broad.
verses.commentary: Sense: com The Texts of the White Yajurveda, tr. Ralph T.H. Griffith, [1899], BOOK THE THIRTY-FIRST. PURUSHA hath a thousand heads, a thousand eyes, a thousand feet. Pervading earth on every side he fills a space ten fingers broad.

verses.sanskrit:
पुरु॑ष ए॒वेदᳪ सर्वं॒ यद्भू॒तं यच्च॑ भा॒व्य॒म् ।
उ॒तामृ॑त॒त्वस्येशा॑नो॒ यदन्ने॑नाति॒रोह॑ति
verses.translation: Purusha is in truth this All, what hath been and what yet shall be; Lord, too, of immortality which waxes greater still by food.
verses.hindi: वे पुरुष प्रभु ' भूत, भाव्य व अमर ' तीनों प्रकार के प्राणियों के ईशान है। उस समन्तात् सेवनीय (आनम्) अन्न नामक प्रभु की अनुकम्पा से जीव जन्म-मरण को १. अस्य इस पुरुष की एतावान्=इतनी महिमा-महिमा हे। प्रथम मन्त्र मे दशांगुल जगत् का संकेत है, पञ्चस्थूलभूत व पञ्चसृक्ष्मभूतों से बना हुआ यह दशांगुल जगत् उस
verses.transliteration: puruṣa eveda sarvaṃ yadbhūtaṃ yacca bhāvyam | utāmṛtatvasyeśāno yadannenātirohati
verses.wordMeaning: Purusha is in truth this All, what hath been and what yet shall be; Lord, too, of immortality which waxes greater still by food.
verses.commentary: Sense: Purusha is in truth this All, what hath been and what yet shall be; Lord, too, of immortality which waxes greater still by food.

verses.sanskrit:
ए॒तावा॑नस्य महि॒मातो॒ ज्यायाँ॑श्च॒ पूरु॑षः ।
पादो॑ऽस्य॒ विश्वा॑ भू॒तानि॑ त्रि॒पाद॑स्या॒मृतं॑ दि॒वि
verses.translation: So mighty in his grandeur; yea, greater than this is Purusha. All creatures are one fourth of him, three fourths eternal life in heaven.
verses.hindi: सारा चराचर संसार ब्रह्म की ओर जा रहा है, वे ब्रह्म ही गति के स्रोत हेै। १. ततः=उस पुरुष (निमित्तकारण) से विराट्-एक देदीप्यमान पिण्ड अजायतउत्पन्न हुआ। सांख्यदर्शन मेँ यही  महत्' नाम से कहा गया है। जो प्रकृति के कणों का साम्यावस्था का पुञ्ज सर्वत्र समरूप से फैला हुआ था, वह सृष्टि के प्राम्भ में प्रभु द्वारा
verses.transliteration: etāvānasya mahimāto jyāyā~śca pūruṣaḥ | pādo'sya viśvā bhūtāni tripādasyāmṛtaṃ divi
verses.wordMeaning: So mighty in his grandeur; yea, greater than this is Purusha. All creatures are one fourth of him, three fourths eternal life in heaven.
verses.commentary: Sense: So mighty in his grandeur; yea, greater than this is Purusha. All creatures are one fourth of him, three fourths eternal life in heaven.

verses.sanskrit:
त्रि॒पादू॒र्ध्व उदै॒त्पुरु॑ष॒: पादो॑ऽस्ये॒हाभ॑व॒त् पुन॑: ।
ततो॒ विष्व॒ङ् व्य॒क्रामत्साशनानश॒ने अ॒भि
verses.translation: With three fourths Purusha rose up: one fourth of him again was here. Thence he moved forth to every side over what eats not and what eats.
verses.hindi: यह संसार प्रभु द्वारा प्राम्भ में एक विराट् पिण्ड के रूप में उत्पन्न किया जाता हे। उस विराट् पिण्ड से ही इन लोकों व शरीरों कौ उत्पत्ति होती हे। तस्मांदयज्ञात्सर्वह तः सम्भुतं पृषदाज्यम्। १. अब तक प्रभु को ' पुरुष ' नाम से स्मरण किया था। इसी पुरुष को अब “ यज्ञ' नाम
verses.transliteration: tripādūrdhva udaitpuruṣa: pādo'syehābhavat puna: | tato viṣvaṅ vyakrāmatsāśanānaśane abhi
verses.wordMeaning: With three fourths Purusha rose up: one fourth of him again was here. Thence he moved forth to every side over what eats not and what eats.
verses.commentary: Sense: With three fourths Purusha rose up: one fourth of him again was here. Thence he moved forth to every side over what eats not and what eats.

verses.sanskrit:
ततो॑ वि॒राड॑जायत वि॒राजो॒ अधि॒ पूरु॑षः ।
स जा॒तो अत्य॑रिच्यत प॒श्चाद्भूमि॒मथो॑ पु॒रः
verses.translation: From him Virâj was born; again Purusha from Virâj was born. When born, he spread to west and east beyond the boundaries of earth.
verses.hindi: उस सर्वदाता यज्ञ नामक प्रभुने अन्नवदूध का संभरण किया। उसके लिए ही पक्षियों, आरण्य व ग्राम्य पशुओं का निर्माण किया। नोट -यहौँ “वायव्य पशुओं" से एेसा नहीं समञ्लना चाहिए कि किसी युग में कु उडनेवाले पशु भी भथे। उडनेवाले पर्वतो कौ कल्पना से एेसा भ्रम हो जाता है। वास्तव में
verses.transliteration: tato virāḍajāyata virājo adhi pūruṣaḥ | sa jāto atyaricyata paścādbhūmimatho puraḥ
verses.wordMeaning: From him Virâj was born; again Purusha from Virâj was born. When born, he spread to west and east beyond the boundaries of earth.
verses.commentary: Sense: From him Virâj was born; again Purusha from Virâj was born. When born, he spread to west and east beyond the boundaries of earth.

verses.sanskrit:
तस्मा॑द्य॒ज्ञात्स॑र्व॒हुत॒: सम्भृ॑तं पृषदा॒ज्यम् ।
प॒शूँस्ताँश्च॑क्रे वाय॒व्या॒नार॒ण्या ग्रा॒म्याश्च॒ ये
verses.translation: From that great General Sacrifice the dripping fat was gathered up. He formed the creatures of the air and animals both wild and tame.
verses.hindi: प्रभु- प्रदत्त वेद-्लान से हम प्रतिदिन उन्नति करते हुए प्रभु को प्राप्त करने मनुष्य जीवन व पश्णुजीवन-दार्फौँ व ल्रार्णँ हाथ तस्मादश्वाऽअजायन्त ये के चोंभयाद॑तः। गावों ह जजिरे तस्मात्तस्मांज्जाताऽअंजावय॑ः।। ८ ॥
verses.transliteration: tasmādyajñātsarvahuta: sambhṛtaṃ pṛṣadājyam | paśū~stā~ścakre vāyavyānāraṇyā grāmyāśca ye
verses.wordMeaning: From that great General Sacrifice the dripping fat was gathered up. He formed the creatures of the air and animals both wild and tame.
verses.commentary: Sense: From that great General Sacrifice the dripping fat was gathered up. He formed the creatures of the air and animals both wild and tame.

verses.sanskrit:
तस्मा॑द्य॒ज्ञात् स॑र्व॒हुत॒ ऋच॒: सामा॑नि जज्ञिरे ।
छन्दा॑ᳪसि जज्ञिरे॒ तस्मा॒द्यजु॒स्तस्मा॑दजायत
verses.translation: From that great General Sacrifice Richas and Sâma hymns were born: Therefrom were spells and charms produced; the Yajus had its birth from it.
verses.hindi: प्रभु को धारण करनेवाले मनुष्य के मुख आदि में एक विशेष शक्ति उत्पत्न हो जाती है, जो उसे सामान्य पुरुषों से विशिष्ट बना देती है। १. अस्य इस प्रभुभक्त का मुखम्-मुख ब्राह्मणः =ब्राह्यण आसीत् हो जाता है। यह प्रभुभक्त अपने मुख से सदा ब्रह्म का प्रतिपादन करनेवाला (ब्राह्मण) बनता हे, इसका मुख
verses.transliteration: tasmādyajñāt sarvahuta ṛca: sāmāni jajñire | chandāsi jajñire tasmādyajustasmādajāyata
verses.wordMeaning: From that great General Sacrifice Richas and Sâma hymns were born: Therefrom were spells and charms produced; the Yajus had its birth from it.
verses.commentary: Sense: From that great General Sacrifice Richas and Sâma hymns were born: Therefrom were spells and charms produced; the Yajus had its birth from it.

verses.sanskrit:
तस्मा॒दश्वा॑ अजायन्त॒ ये के चो॑भ॒याद॑तः ।
गावो॑ ह जज्ञिरे॒ तस्मा॒त्तस्मा॑ज्जा॒ता अ॑जा॒वय॑:
verses.translation: From it were horses born, from it all cattle with two rows of teeth From it were generated kine, from it were goats and sheep produced.
verses.hindi: प्रभुभक्त ज्ञान का प्रचारक, निर्बलों का रक्षक, सभी का पालक तथा शीघ्रता से कार्यो को करनेवाला होता है, दूसरे शब्दों में ब्राह्मण, क्षत्रिय, वैश्य व शूद्र बनता ह। नोट- १. प्रस्तुत मन्त्र में प्रसंगवश वर्णव्यवस्था का भी संकेत हो गया है। समाज का शरीर ब्राह्मणरूप मुखवाला हे, क्षत्रिय इसकी भुजा है, इसका मध्यभाग ही वैश्य है ओर
verses.transliteration: tasmādaśvā ajāyanta ye ke cobhayādataḥ | gāvo ha jajñire tasmāttasmājjātā ajāvaya:
verses.wordMeaning: From it were horses born, from it all cattle with two rows of teeth From it were generated kine, from it were goats and sheep produced.
verses.commentary: Sense: From it were horses born, from it all cattle with two rows of teeth From it were generated kine, from it were goats and sheep produced.

verses.sanskrit:
तं य॒ज्ञं ब॒र्हिषि॒ प्रौक्ष॒न् पुरु॑षं जा॒तम॑ग्र॒तः ।
तेन॑ दे॒वा अ॑यजन्त सा॒ध्या ऋष॑यश्च॒ ये
verses.translation: They balmed as victim on the grass Purusha born in earliest time. With him the Deities and all Sâdhyas and Rishis sacrificed.
verses.hindi: प्रभुभक्त सदा प्रसन्न, प्रकाशमय, गतिशील-प्राणशक्तिसम्पन्न ओर अग्नि के समान योजक व भेदक बन जाता हे। पद्भ्यां भूमिर्दिशः श्रोत्रात्तथा लोर्कों२।।ऽअकल्पयन्।। ९३॥ १. नाभ्या (नाभ्ये) नाभि के लिए अथवा नाभि के हेतु से अन्तरिक्षम्-अन्तरिक्ष
verses.transliteration: taṃ yajñaṃ barhiṣi praukṣan puruṣaṃ jātamagrataḥ | tena devā ayajanta sādhyā ṛṣayaśca ye
verses.wordMeaning: They balmed as victim on the grass Purusha born in earliest time. With him the Deities and all Sâdhyas and Rishis sacrificed.
verses.commentary: Sense: They balmed as victim on the grass Purusha born in earliest time. With him the Deities and all Sâdhyas and Rishis sacrificed.

verses.sanskrit:
यत्पुरु॑षं॒ व्यद॑धुः कति॒धा व्य॑कल्पयन् ।
मुखं॒ किम॑स्यासी॒त् किं बा॒हू किमू॒रू पादा॑ उच्येते
verses.translation: When they divided Purusha how many portions did they make? What was his mouth? what were his arms? what are the names of thighs and feet?
verses.hindi: यह प्रभुभक्त सदा मध्यमार्ग पर चलनेवाला, जगमगाते मस्तिष्कवाला, निर्माणात्मक क्रियाओं मे लगा हुआ, वेद के अनुसार जीवन-मार्ग पर चलता हुआ शक्तिशाली अङ्खोंवाला नोट - प्रस्तुत मन्त्रों में विराट् को पुरुष का शरीर मानकर यह भी संकेत दिया गया दहै कि उस विराट् शरीर की नाभि से अन्तरिक्ष, सिर से द्युलोक, पवि से भूमि, श्रोत्र से दिशां
verses.transliteration: yatpuruṣaṃ vyadadhuḥ katidhā vyakalpayan | mukhaṃ kimasyāsīt kiṃ bāhū kimūrū pādā ucyete
verses.wordMeaning: When they divided Purusha how many portions did they make? What was his mouth? what were his arms? what are the names of thighs and feet?
verses.commentary: Sense: When they divided Purusha how many portions did they make? What was his mouth? what were his arms? what are the names of thighs and feet?

verses.sanskrit:
ब्रा॒ह्म॒णो॒ऽस्य॒ मुख॑मासीद्बा॒हू रा॑ज॒न्य॒: कृ॒तः ।
ऊ॒रू तद॑स्य॒ यद्वै॑श्यः प॒द्भ्याᳪ शू॒द्रो अ॑जायत
verses.translation: The Brâhman was his mouth, of both his arms was the Râjanya made. His thighs became the Vaisya, from his feet the Sûdra was produced.
verses.hindi: ' देवपूजा, संगतिकरण व दान" ही मुख्य धर्म है, इन्हें आपनानेवाला प्रभु को अयैथुनी स्रष्टि-जाजान देवत्व अद्भ्यः सम्भरंतः परथिव्यै रसाच्च विषुवकर्मणः सम॑वर््तताग्र । तस्य त्वष्टा विदधंद्रूपमेति तन्मर्त्यस्य देवत्वमाजानमग्र ॥ ९७॥
verses.transliteration: brāhmaṇo'sya mukhamāsīdbāhū rājanya: kṛtaḥ | ūrū tadasya yadvaiśyaḥ padbhyā śūdro ajāyata
verses.wordMeaning: The Brâhman was his mouth, of both his arms was the Râjanya made. His thighs became the Vaisya, from his feet the Sûdra was produced.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Brâhman was his mouth, of both his arms was the Râjanya made. His thighs became the Vaisya, from his feet the Sûdra was produced.

verses.sanskrit:
च॒न्द्रमा॒ मन॑सो जा॒तश्चक्षोः॒ सूर्यो॑ अजायत ।
श्रोत्रा॑द्वा॒युश्च॑ प्रा॒णश्च॒ मुखा॑द॒ग्निर॑जायत
verses.translation: The Moon was gendered from his mind, and from his eye the Sun had birth; Vâyu and Prâna from his ear, and from his mouth was Agni born.
verses.hindi: प्रभु-कृपा से हम अपने आजनदेवत्व को स्थिर रख पार्णे। संसार के प्रलोभनं में फेसकर असुर न बन जारएँ। जतिमृत्यु-जयन- मृत्यु के पार वेदाहमेतं पुरुषं महान्त॑मादित्यवंर्ण तम॑सः परस्ता।त्।
verses.transliteration: candramā manaso jātaścakṣoḥ sūryo ajāyata | śrotrādvāyuśca prāṇaśca mukhādagnirajāyata
verses.wordMeaning: The Moon was gendered from his mind, and from his eye the Sun had birth; Vâyu and Prâna from his ear, and from his mouth was Agni born.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Moon was gendered from his mind, and from his eye the Sun had birth; Vâyu and Prâna from his ear, and from his mouth was Agni born.

verses.sanskrit:
नाभ्या॑ आसीद॒न्तरि॑क्षᳪ शी॒र्ष्णो द्यौ॒: सम॑वर्तत ।
प॒द्भ्यां भूमि॒र्दिश॒: श्रोत्रा॒त्तथा॑ लो॒काँ२ अ॑कल्पयन्
verses.translation: Forth from his navel came mid-air; the sky was fashioned from his head; Earth from his feet, and from his ear the Quarters. Thus they formed the worlds.
verses.hindi: प्रभु को जानकर हम मृत्यु से ऊपर उट ओर मोक्ष का लाभ करे। आजायमान-कविजायमान-न होते हुए, होना पिछले मन्त्र में कहा था कि "मैं इस महान् पुरुष को जानता हूँ" प्रस्तुत मन्त्र में कहते है कि “किस रूप मे?" (क) प्रजापतिःत्वे प्रभु प्रजा के पति है। सबके रक्षक है। मेरी
verses.transliteration: nābhyā āsīdantarikṣa śīrṣṇo dyau: samavartata | padbhyāṃ bhūmirdiśa: śrotrāttathā lokā~2 akalpayan
verses.wordMeaning: Forth from his navel came mid-air; the sky was fashioned from his head; Earth from his feet, and from his ear the Quarters. Thus they formed the worlds.
verses.commentary: Sense: Forth from his navel came mid-air; the sky was fashioned from his head; Earth from his feet, and from his ear the Quarters. Thus they formed the worlds.

verses.sanskrit:
यत्पुरु॑षेण ह॒विषा॑ दे॒वा य॒ज्ञमत॑न्वत ।
व॒स॒न्तो॒ऽस्यासी॒दाज्यं॑ ग्री॒ष्म इ॒ध्मः श॒रद्ध॒विः
verses.translation: When Gods performed the sacrifice with Purusha as offering Spring was the butter, Autumn the oblation, Summer was the wood.
verses.hindi: प्रभु प्रजापति है, नानारूपों को वो जन्म दे रहे हें, वही सब लोको का धारण यो देवेभ्य॑ऽओतप॑ति यो देवान पुरोहिंतः। पूर्वो यो देवेभ्यो जातो नमो रुचाय ब्राह्य॑ये।। २०॥ गतमन्त्र की समाप्ति इन शब्दों पर थी कि "उस प्रभुमेंदही ये सब लोक आश्रित हें'।
verses.transliteration: yatpuruṣeṇa haviṣā devā yajñamatanvata | vasanto'syāsīdājyaṃ grīṣma idhmaḥ śaraddhaviḥ
verses.wordMeaning: When Gods performed the sacrifice with Purusha as offering Spring was the butter, Autumn the oblation, Summer was the wood.
verses.commentary: Sense: When Gods performed the sacrifice with Purusha as offering Spring was the butter, Autumn the oblation, Summer was the wood.

verses.sanskrit:
स॒प्तास्या॑सन् परि॒धय॒स्त्रिः स॒प्त स॒मिध॑: कृ॒ताः ।
दे॒वा यद्य॒ज्ञं त॑न्वा॒ना अब॑ध्न॒न् पुरु॑षं प॒शुम्
verses.translation: Then seven were his enclosing-sticks, his kindling-brands were three times seven, When Gods, performing sacrifice, bound as their victim Purusha.
verses.hindi: प्रभु ही सब सूर्यादि देवों को दीप्ति देनेवाले हैँ। उस ब्रह्मरुचि दीप्ति को प्राप्त करने के लिए मै भी नमस्-नग्रता की भावना को धारण करता हूं। रुचं ब्राह्यं जनय॑न्तो देवाऽअग्रे तदं ्रुवन्। गतमन्त्र की भावना यह है कि ' सूर्यादि सब देव उस ब्राह्यतेज से ही दीप्त हो रहे हे।'
verses.transliteration: saptāsyāsan paridhayastriḥ sapta samidha: kṛtāḥ | devā yadyajñaṃ tanvānā abadhnan puruṣaṃ paśum
verses.wordMeaning: Then seven were his enclosing-sticks, his kindling-brands were three times seven, When Gods, performing sacrifice, bound as their victim Purusha.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then seven were his enclosing-sticks, his kindling-brands were three times seven, When Gods, performing sacrifice, bound as their victim Purusha.

verses.sanskrit:
य॒ज्ञेन॑ य॒ज्ञम॑यजन्त दे॒वास्तानि॒ धर्मा॑णि प्रथ॒मान्या॑सन् ।
ते ह॒ नाकं॑ महि॒मान॑: सचन्त॒ यत्र॒ पूर्वे॑ सा॒ध्याः सन्ति॑ दे॒वाः
verses.translation: Gods, sacrificing, sacrificed the victim: these were the earliest holy ordinances. The Mighty Ones attained the height of heaven, there where the Sâdhyas, Gods of old, are dwelling.
verses.hindi: ब्रह्मवेत्ता को सब देवों की अनुकूलता प्राप्त होती है। एक आदर्ण ब्रह्मवेत्ता का जीवन श्रीश्च ते लक्ष्मीश्च पल्यावहोरात्रे पाश्वे नक्ष॑त्राणि रूपमश्विनौ व्यात्त॑म् । "सब देव उसके अनुकूल होते है' इस वाक्य का अभिप्राय यह है कि कोई भी
verses.transliteration: yajñena yajñamayajanta devāstāni dharmāṇi prathamānyāsan | te ha nākaṃ mahimāna: sacanta yatra pūrve sādhyāḥ santi devāḥ
verses.wordMeaning: Gods, sacrificing, sacrificed the victim: these were the earliest holy ordinances. The Mighty Ones attained the height of heaven, there where the Sâdhyas, Gods of old, are dwelling.
verses.commentary: Sense: Gods, sacrificing, sacrificed the victim: these were the earliest holy ordinances. The Mighty Ones attained the height of heaven, there where the Sâdhyas, Gods of old, are dwelling.

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒द्भ्यः सम्भृ॑तः पृथिव्यै॒ रसा॑च्च वि॒श्वक॑र्मण॒: सम॑वर्त॒ताग्रे॑ ।
तस्य॒ त्वष्टा॑ वि॒दध॑द्रू॒पमे॑ति॒ तन्मर्त्य॑स्य देव॒त्वमा॒जान॒मग्रे॑
verses.translation: In the beginning he was formed, collected from waters, earth, and Visvakarman's essence. Fixing the form thereof Tvashtar proceedeth. This was at first the mortal's birth and godhead.
verses.hindi: नर से नारायण बनने के लिए मन्त्र में वर्णित ७ बातों को अपनाना है।
verses.transliteration: adbhyaḥ sambhṛtaḥ pṛthivyai rasācca viśvakarmaṇa: samavartatāgre | tasya tvaṣṭā vidadhadrūpameti tanmartyasya devatvamājānamagre
verses.wordMeaning: In the beginning he was formed, collected from waters, earth, and Visvakarman's essence. Fixing the form thereof Tvashtar proceedeth. This was at first the mortal's birth and godhead.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the beginning he was formed, collected from waters, earth, and Visvakarman's essence. Fixing the form thereof Tvashtar proceedeth. This was at first the mortal's birth and godhead.

verses.sanskrit:
वेदा॒हमे॒तं पुरु॑षं म॒हान्त॑मादि॒त्यव॑र्णं॒ तम॑सः प॒रस्ता॑त् ।
तमे॒व वि॑दि॒त्वाति॑ मृ॒त्युमे॑ति॒ नान्यः पन्था॑ विद्य॒तेऽय॑नाय
verses.translation: I know this mighty Purusha whose colour is like the Sun, beyond the reach of darkness. He only who knows him leaves Death behind him. There is no path save this alone to travel.
verses.hindi: सारा ब्रह्याण्ड प्रभु के एकदेश में हे, उस प्रभु का त्रिपात् द्योतनमय अमृतरूप त्रिपादूर्ध्व उहैत्पुरुषः पादो ऽस्येहाभंवत्पुन॑ः। १. त्रिपात् पुरुषः=यह तीन पादोंवाला पुरुष ऊर्ध्वः उहैत्-इस विविध हलचलवाले अशान्त संसार से ऊपर उठा हुआ है। यह सारे दृश्यमान ब्रह्माण्ड कौ हलचल उसके इस
verses.transliteration: vedāhametaṃ puruṣaṃ mahāntamādityavarṇaṃ tamasaḥ parastāt | tameva viditvāti mṛtyumeti nānyaḥ panthā vidyate'yanāya
verses.wordMeaning: I know this mighty Purusha whose colour is like the Sun, beyond the reach of darkness. He only who knows him leaves Death behind him. There is no path save this alone to travel.
verses.commentary: Sense: I know this mighty Purusha whose colour is like the Sun, beyond the reach of darkness. He only who knows him leaves Death behind him. There is no path save this alone to travel.

verses.sanskrit:
प्र॒जाप॑तिश्च॒रति॒ गर्भे॑ अ॒न्तरजा॑यमानो बहु॒धा वि जा॑यते ।
तस्य॒ योनिं॒ परि॑ पश्यन्ति॒ धीरा॒स्तस्मि॑न् ह तस्थु॒र्भुव॑नानि॒ विश्वा॑
verses.translation: In the womb moves Prajâpati: he, never becoming born, is born in sundry figures. The wise discern the womb from which he springeth. In him alone stand all existing creatures.
verses.hindi: हम पशुओं की उपयोगिता को समञ्लकर उनका भी ध्यान करनेवाले वने "गौ" को तो घर का अत्यन्त आवश्यक अङ्क समञ्कर अवश्य ही पाले। तं यज्ञं बर्हिषि प्रौक्षन् पुरूषं जातमंग्रतः। तेन॑ देवाऽअयजन्त साध्याऽ ऋषयश्च ये।।९॥
verses.transliteration: prajāpatiścarati garbhe antarajāyamāno bahudhā vi jāyate | tasya yoniṃ pari paśyanti dhīrāstasmin ha tasthurbhuvanāni viśvā
verses.wordMeaning: In the womb moves Prajâpati: he, never becoming born, is born in sundry figures. The wise discern the womb from which he springeth. In him alone stand all existing creatures.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the womb moves Prajâpati: he, never becoming born, is born in sundry figures. The wise discern the womb from which he springeth. In him alone stand all existing creatures.

verses.sanskrit:
यो दे॒वेभ्य॑ आ॒तप॑ति॒ यो दे॒वानां॑ पु॒रोहि॑तः ।
पूर्वो॒ यो दे॒वेभ्यो॑ जा॒तो नमो॑ रु॒चाय॒ ब्राह्म॑ये
verses.translation: He who gives light and heat to Gods, first, foremost Agent of the Gods, Born ere the Gods—to him the bright, the holy One, be reverence
verses.hindi: हम अपने हृदयो को पवित्र बना, वहोँ प्रभु कौ ज्योति को जगार््। देव, साध्य व ऋषि बनकर अर्थात् हदय, हस्त व मस्तिष्क तीनों कौ उन्नति करके प्रभु से अपना मेल यत्पुरुषं व्यद॑धुः कतिधा व्य॑कल्पयन्। १. यत्-जव पुरुषम्-उस पुरुष प्रभु से व्यदधुः ये  देव , साध्य व ऋषि" व्यकल्पयन्
verses.transliteration: yo devebhya ātapati yo devānāṃ purohitaḥ | pūrvo yo devebhyo jāto namo rucāya brāhmaye
verses.wordMeaning: He who gives light and heat to Gods, first, foremost Agent of the Gods, Born ere the Gods—to him the bright, the holy One, be reverence
verses.commentary: Sense: He who gives light and heat to Gods, first, foremost Agent of the Gods, Born ere the Gods—to him the bright, the holy One, be reverence

verses.sanskrit:
रु॒चं ब्रा॒ह्म्यं ज॒नय॑न्तो दे॒वा अग्रे॒ तद॑ब्रुवन् ।
यस्त्वै॒वं ब्रा॑ह्म॒णो वि॒द्यात्तस्य॑ दे॒वा अ॑स॒न् वशे॑
verses.translation: Thus spake the Gods at first, as they begat the bright and holy One: The Brahman who may know thee thus shall have the Gods in his control.
verses.hindi: प्रभुभक्त के लिए वसन्त प्रभु कौ महिमा को दिखाती है तो ग्रीष्म ज्लानदीप्ति को ओर शरत् त्यागशीलता को। वसन्त सौन्दर्य को, ग्रीष्म ज्योति को, शरत् त्याग को देवा यद्यज्ञं त॑न्वानाऽअव॑ध्नन् पुरुषं पशुम्॥। ९५५॥ ९. देवाः =देवलोग यत्-जब यज्ञम्-प्रभु के साथ मेल को तन्वानाः विस्तृत करते हए प्रभुभक्ति व प्रभुसे मेल के तीन परिणाम है १. काम-क्रोध का वशीकरण २. इन्द्रियों का मर्यादा में रहना ओर ३. शक्तियों का वर्धन व दीपन। यज्ञेन य॒ज्ञम॑यजन्त देवास्तानि धर्माणि प्रथमान्यांसन्। ते ह नाकं महिमानः सचन्त यत्र पूर्वे" साध्याः सन्ति देवाः ॥ १६॥
verses.transliteration: rucaṃ brāhmyaṃ janayanto devā agre tadabruvan | yastvaivaṃ brāhmaṇo vidyāttasya devā asan vaśe
verses.wordMeaning: Thus spake the Gods at first, as they begat the bright and holy One: The Brahman who may know thee thus shall have the Gods in his control.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus spake the Gods at first, as they begat the bright and holy One: The Brahman who may know thee thus shall have the Gods in his control.

verses.sanskrit:
श्रीश्च॑ ते ल॒क्ष्मीश्च॒ पत्न्या॑वहोरा॒त्रे पा॒र्श्वे नक्ष॑त्राणि रू॒पम॒श्विनौ॒ व्यात्त॑म् ।
इ॒ष्णन्नि॑षाणा॒मुं म॑ इषाण सर्वलो॒कं म॑ इषाण
verses.translation: Beauty and Fortune are thy wives: each side of thee are Day and Night. The constellations are thy form: the Asvins are thine open jaws. Wishing, wish yonder world for me, wish that the Universe be mine.
verses.hindi: - ब्रह्मवेत्ता को सब देवों की अनुकूलता प्राप्त होती है। एक आदर्ण ब्रह्मवेत्ता का जीवन श्रीश्च ते लक्ष्मीश्च पल्यावहोरात्रे पाश्वे नक्ष॑त्राणि रूपमश्विनौ व्यात्त॑म् । "सब देव उसके अनुकूल होते है' इस वाक्य का अभिप्राय यह है कि कोई भी
verses.transliteration: śrīśca te lakṣmīśca patnyāvahorātre pārśve nakṣatrāṇi rūpamaśvinau vyāttam | iṣṇanniṣāṇāmuṃ ma iṣāṇa sarvalokaṃ ma iṣāṇa
verses.wordMeaning: Beauty and Fortune are thy wives: each side of thee are Day and Night. The constellations are thy form: the Asvins are thine open jaws. Wishing, wish yonder world for me, wish that the Universe be mine.
verses.commentary: Sense: Beauty and Fortune are thy wives: each side of thee are Day and Night. The constellations are thy form: the Asvins are thine open jaws. Wishing, wish yonder world for me, wish that the Universe be mine.

verses.sanskrit:
तदे॒वाग्निस्तदा॑दि॒त्यस्तद्वा॒युस्तदु॑ च॒न्द्रमा॑: ।
तदे॒व शु॒क्रं तद्ब्रह्म॒ ता आप॒: स प्र॒जाप॑तिः
verses.translation: com The Texts of the White Yajurveda, tr. Ralph T.H. Griffith, [1899], BOOK THE THIRTY-SECOND. AGNI is That; the Sun is That; Vâyu and Chandramâs are That. The Bright is That; Brahma is That, those Waters, that Prajâpati.
verses.hindi: हम अग्नि आदि नामों से प्रभु का स्मरण करते हुए स्वयं अग्नि आदि बनने ऋषि :- स्वयम्भु ब्रह्म। देवता-परमात्मा। छन्दः-अनुष्टुप्। स्वरः- गान्धारः। सर्वेः निमेषा ज॑जिरे विद्युतः पुरुषादधि १. सर्वे=सारे निमेषाः = ओंखों के पलक गिरने आदि छोटे-से-छछोटे व्यापार भी
verses.transliteration: tadevāgnistadādityastadvāyustadu candramā: | tadeva śukraṃ tadbrahma tā āpa: sa prajāpatiḥ
verses.wordMeaning: com The Texts of the White Yajurveda, tr. Ralph T.H. Griffith, [1899], BOOK THE THIRTY-SECOND. AGNI is That; the Sun is That; Vâyu and Chandramâs are That. The Bright is That; Brahma is That, those Waters, that Prajâpati.
verses.commentary: Sense: com The Texts of the White Yajurveda, tr. Ralph T.H. Griffith, [1899], BOOK THE THIRTY-SECOND. AGNI is That; the Sun is That; Vâyu and Chandramâs are That. The Bright is That; Brahma is That, those Waters, that Prajâpati.

verses.sanskrit:
सर्वे॑ निमे॒षा ज॑ज्ञिरे वि॒द्युत॒: पुरु॑षा॒दधि॑ ।
नै॑नमू॒र्ध्वं न ति॒र्यञ्चं॒ न मध्ये॒ परि॑ जग्रभत्
verses.translation: All twinklings of the eyelid sprang from Purusha, resplendent One. No one hath comprehended him above, across, or in the midst.
verses.hindi: पत्ता-पत्ता उस प्रभु के प्रशासन में हिल रहा हे। वे प्रभु कण-कण मेँ व्याप्त है, किसी देशविशेष में स्थित नहीं है. इसी से सारे ब्रह्माण्ड को गति दे रहे है। प्रभु का प्रतिरूप-विनीतता+नामस्मरणा तस्य=उस प्रभु की प्रतिमाः=मूर्ति, नाप, सादृश्य, तुल्यता न अस्ति-नहीं टे। २. प्रभु
verses.transliteration: sarve nimeṣā jajñire vidyuta: puruṣādadhi | nainamūrdhvaṃ na tiryañcaṃ na madhye pari jagrabhat
verses.wordMeaning: All twinklings of the eyelid sprang from Purusha, resplendent One. No one hath comprehended him above, across, or in the midst.
verses.commentary: Sense: All twinklings of the eyelid sprang from Purusha, resplendent One. No one hath comprehended him above, across, or in the midst.

verses.sanskrit:
न तस्य॑ प्रति॒मा अ॑स्ति॒ यस्य॒ नाम॑ म॒हद्यश॑: ।
हि॒र॒ण्य॒ग॒र्भ इत्ये॒षः  मा मा॑ हिᳪसी॒दित्ये॒षा यस्मा॒न्न जा॒त इत्ये॒ष:
verses.translation: There is no counterpart of him whose glory verily is great. In the beginning rose Hiranyagarbha, etc. Let not him harm me, etc. Than whom there is no other born, etc.
verses.hindi: ईश्वर की मूर्तिं नहीं हे। हम निराकार प्रभु का स्मरण करे, जिससे हमारा एषो ह देवः प्रदिशोऽनु सर्वाः पूर्वो" ह जातः सञऽडउ गर्भऽअन्तः। १. एषः=ये प्रभु ह निश्चय से देवः देव हेँ। देव के अर्थ यास्कानुसार निम्न हैँ -(क) देवो दानात् =वे प्रभु देनेवाले है। प्रभु ने जीव के हित करे लिए उसे क्या नहीं दिया? वे
verses.transliteration: na tasya pratimā asti yasya nāma mahadyaśa: | hiraṇyagarbha ityeṣaḥ mā mā hisīdityeṣā yasmānna jāta ityeṣa:
verses.wordMeaning: There is no counterpart of him whose glory verily is great. In the beginning rose Hiranyagarbha, etc. Let not him harm me, etc. Than whom there is no other born, etc.
verses.commentary: Sense: There is no counterpart of him whose glory verily is great. In the beginning rose Hiranyagarbha, etc. Let not him harm me, etc. Than whom there is no other born, etc.

verses.sanskrit:
ए॒षो ह॑ दे॒वः प्र॒दिशोऽनु॒ सर्वा॒: पूर्वो॑ ह जा॒तः स उ॒ गर्भे॑ अ॒न्तः ।
स ए॒व जा॒तः स ज॑नि॒ष्यमा॑णः प्र॒त्यङ् जना॑स्तिष्ठति स॒र्वतो॑मुखः
verses.translation: This very God pervadeth all the regions; yea, born aforetime, in the womb he dwelleth. He verily born and to be born hereafter meeteth his offspring, facing all directions.
verses.hindi: हम देव, सब दिशाओं में व्याप्त, अनादि, अनन्त, सृष्टि-प्रलय-चक्र को चलानेवाले, हदय मे विद्यमान, सर्वतोमुख प्रभु का ध्यान करे। तीन ज्योतिर्यौँ : रमणा करता दा षोडशी १. यस्मात्-जिससे पुरा=पहले किञ्चन एवन्कुक भी न जातम्=-नहीं हआ, जो
verses.transliteration: eṣo ha devaḥ pradiśo'nu sarvā: pūrvo ha jātaḥ sa u garbhe antaḥ | sa eva jātaḥ sa janiṣyamāṇaḥ pratyaṅ janāstiṣṭhati sarvatomukhaḥ
verses.wordMeaning: This very God pervadeth all the regions; yea, born aforetime, in the womb he dwelleth. He verily born and to be born hereafter meeteth his offspring, facing all directions.
verses.commentary: Sense: This very God pervadeth all the regions; yea, born aforetime, in the womb he dwelleth. He verily born and to be born hereafter meeteth his offspring, facing all directions.

verses.sanskrit:
यस्मा॑ज्जा॒तं न पु॒रा किं चनै॒व य आ॑ब॒भूव॒ भुव॑नानि॒ विश्वा॑ ।
प्र॒जाप॑तिः प्र॒जया॑ सᳪररा॒णस्त्रीणि॒ ज्योती॑ᳪषि सचते॒ स षो॑ड॒शी
verses.translation: Before whom naught whatever sprang to being; who with his presence aids all living creatures, Prajâpati, rejoicing in his offspring, he, Shodasî, maintains the Three great Lustres.
verses.hindi: हमारा मस्तिष्क दीप्त हो, शरीर दृढ हो, हम यज्ञादि कर्मो से स्वर्गं का लाभ करे, कामना से ऊपर उठकर मोक्ष को प्राप्त करे। कभी भी विकर्म में फैसकर लोक- लोकान्तरो मे भटके नहीं। प्रभु की भाँति दानशील बनकर प्रभु के उपासक ने। यत्राधि सूर ऽउदि'तो विभाति कस्मै देवाय हविषां विधेम।।७॥
verses.transliteration: yasmājjātaṃ na purā kiṃ canaiva ya ābabhūva bhuvanāni viśvā | prajāpatiḥ prajayā sararāṇastrīṇi jyotīṣi sacate sa ṣoḍaśī
verses.wordMeaning: Before whom naught whatever sprang to being; who with his presence aids all living creatures, Prajâpati, rejoicing in his offspring, he, Shodasî, maintains the Three great Lustres.
verses.commentary: Sense: Before whom naught whatever sprang to being; who with his presence aids all living creatures, Prajâpati, rejoicing in his offspring, he, Shodasî, maintains the Three great Lustres.

verses.sanskrit:
येन॒ द्यौरु॒ग्रा पृ॑थि॒वी च॑ दृ॒ढा येन॒ स्व॒ स्तभि॒तं येन॒ नाक॑: ।
यो अ॒न्तरि॑क्षे॒ रज॑सो वि॒मान॒: कस्मै॑ दे॒वाय॑ ह॒विषा॑ विधेम
verses.translation: By whom the heavens are strong and earth stands firmly, by whom light's realm and sky-vault are supported; By whom the regions in mid-air were measured. What God shall we adore with our oblation?
verses.hindi: प्रभु-प्राप्ति के उपाय निम्न दहै ९. प्रभु को पुकारना, प्रभु की प्रार्थना करनी। २. इच्धियों का दमन। ३. मन को निर्मल करना। ४. दानपूर्वक अदन। ५. पापों का स्वीकार १. "वेन ' शब्द वेन् धातु से बना हे। इसके अर्थ है (क) क्रियाशील-!७ ०. 10 111०0५९. (ख) ज्ञान प्राप्त करनेवाला-10 ।८०५५. (ग) प्रभु का पुजारी 0 ५0181101 एवं, वेनः =
verses.transliteration: yena dyaurugrā pṛthivī ca dṛḍhā yena sva stabhitaṃ yena nāka: | yo antarikṣe rajaso vimāna: kasmai devāya haviṣā vidhema
verses.wordMeaning: By whom the heavens are strong and earth stands firmly, by whom light's realm and sky-vault are supported; By whom the regions in mid-air were measured. What God shall we adore with our oblation?
verses.commentary: Sense: By whom the heavens are strong and earth stands firmly, by whom light's realm and sky-vault are supported; By whom the regions in mid-air were measured. What God shall we adore with our oblation?

verses.sanskrit:
यं क्रन्द॑सी॒ अव॑सा तस्तभा॒ने अ॒भ्यैक्षे॑तां॒ मन॑सा॒ रेज॑माने ।
यत्राधि॒ सूर॒ उदि॑तो वि॒भाति॒ कस्मै॑ दे॒वाय॑ ह॒विषा॑ विधेम ।
आपो॑ ह॒ यद्बृ॑ह॒तीर्यश्चि॒दाप॑:
verses.translation: To whom, supported by his help, two armies embattled look while trembling in their spirit, Where over them the risen Sun is shining. What God shall we adore with our oblation? What time the mighty waters, etc. He in his might surveyed, etc.
verses.hindi: प्रभु-दर्शन के लिए ज्ञान, क्रिया व भक्ति का समुच्चय आवश्यक हे। वे प्रभु हदय मेँ ही निहित है, सर्वव्यापक है। “अजमरत-ध्ाम-सत्' : पिता का भी पिता त्रीणि पदानि निदिता गुहास्य यस्तानि वेद स पितुः पितासत् ॥९॥
verses.transliteration: yaṃ krandasī avasā tastabhāne abhyaikṣetāṃ manasā rejamāne | yatrādhi sūra udito vibhāti kasmai devāya haviṣā vidhema | āpo ha yadbṛhatīryaścidāpa:
verses.wordMeaning: To whom, supported by his help, two armies embattled look while trembling in their spirit, Where over them the risen Sun is shining. What God shall we adore with our oblation? What time the mighty waters, etc. He in his might surveyed, etc.
verses.commentary: Sense: To whom, supported by his help, two armies embattled look while trembling in their spirit, Where over them the risen Sun is shining. What God shall we adore with our oblation? What time the mighty waters, etc. He in his might surveyed, etc.

verses.sanskrit:
वे॒नस्तत्प॑श्य॒न्निहि॑तं॒ गुहा॒ सद्यत्र॒ विश्वं॒ भव॒त्येक॑नीडम् ।
तस्मि॑न्नि॒दᳪ सं च॒ वि चै॑ति॒ सर्व॒ᳪ स ओत॒: प्रोत॑श्च वि॒भूः प्र॒जासु॑
verses.translation: The Sage beholdeth That mysterious Being wherein this All hath found one only dwelling. Therein unites the Whole, and thence it issues: far-spread it is the warp and woof in creatures.
verses.hindi: उस ' अमृत, सत्, धाम" का प्रवचन ज्ञानी लोग करे। हम प्रभु के इन पदों को जानकर पिताओं के पिता- ज्ञानियों के भी ज्ञानी बनें। स नो बन्धुर्जनिता स विधाता धामानि वेद भुव॑नानि विश्वा। यत्र॑ देवाऽअमृत॑ंमानशानास्तृतीये धामंन्नध्यैर॑यन्त।। ९०॥
verses.transliteration: venastatpaśyannihitaṃ guhā sadyatra viśvaṃ bhavatyekanīḍam | tasminnida saṃ ca vi caiti sarva sa ota: protaśca vibhūḥ prajāsu
verses.wordMeaning: The Sage beholdeth That mysterious Being wherein this All hath found one only dwelling. Therein unites the Whole, and thence it issues: far-spread it is the warp and woof in creatures.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Sage beholdeth That mysterious Being wherein this All hath found one only dwelling. Therein unites the Whole, and thence it issues: far-spread it is the warp and woof in creatures.

verses.sanskrit:
प्र तद्वो॑चेद॒मृतं॒ नु वि॒द्वान् ग॑न्ध॒र्वो धाम॒ विभृ॑तं॒ गुहा॒ सत् ।
त्रीणि॑ प॒दानि॒ निहि॑ता॒ गुहा॑स्य॒ यस्तानि॒ वेद॒ स पि॒तुः पि॒ताऽस॑त्
verses.translation: Knowing Eternity, may the Gandharva declare that station, parted, kept in secret. Three steps thereof in mystery are hidden: he who knows these shall be the father's father.
verses.hindi: मनोविन्लान व विज्ञान के अध्ययन, श्रमण तथा स्वाध्याय से हम अपने मन को प्रभु की ओर जानेवाला बनार्। परि द्यावापृथिवी सद्यऽ इत्वा परि लोकान्परि दिशः परि स्त्रः। १. यहाँ पिछले मन्त्र के " भूतानि" पद का स्थान ' द्यावापृथिवी" ने ले-लिया हे।
verses.transliteration: pra tadvocedamṛtaṃ nu vidvān gandharvo dhāma vibhṛtaṃ guhā sat | trīṇi padāni nihitā guhāsya yastāni veda sa pituḥ pitā'sat
verses.wordMeaning: Knowing Eternity, may the Gandharva declare that station, parted, kept in secret. Three steps thereof in mystery are hidden: he who knows these shall be the father's father.
verses.commentary: Sense: Knowing Eternity, may the Gandharva declare that station, parted, kept in secret. Three steps thereof in mystery are hidden: he who knows these shall be the father's father.

verses.sanskrit:
स नो॒ बन्धु॑र्जनि॒ता स वि॑धा॒ता धामा॑नि वेद॒ भुव॑नानि॒ विश्वा॑ ।
यत्र॑ दे॒वा अ॒मृत॑मानशा॒नास्तृ॒तीये॒ धाम॑न्न॒ध्यैर॑यन्त
verses.translation: He is our kin, our Father and Begetter: he knows all beings and all Ordinances, In whom the Gods obtaining life eternal have risen upward to the third high station.
verses.hindi: हम ठीक व्यवहार से मन को शान्त, वस्तुओं के ठीक प्रयोग से शरीर को नीरोग, भ्रमण से दृष्टि को विशाल, सूर्य-दर्शन से प्रभु-महिमा का दर्शन करके उस ऋत के वितत तन्तु का विश्लेषण करे ओर प्रभु का दर्शन कर प्रभु-जैसे ही बन जारपं। सद॑सस्पतिमद्धंतं प्रियमिन्द्र॑स्य काम्य॑म्। सनिं मेधाम॑यासिष स्वाह।॥। ९३
verses.transliteration: sa no bandhurjanitā sa vidhātā dhāmāni veda bhuvanāni viśvā | yatra devā amṛtamānaśānāstṛtīye dhāmannadhyairayanta
verses.wordMeaning: He is our kin, our Father and Begetter: he knows all beings and all Ordinances, In whom the Gods obtaining life eternal have risen upward to the third high station.
verses.commentary: Sense: He is our kin, our Father and Begetter: he knows all beings and all Ordinances, In whom the Gods obtaining life eternal have risen upward to the third high station.

verses.sanskrit:
प॒रीत्य॑ भू॒तानि॑ प॒रीत्य॑ लो॒कान् प॒रीत्य॒ सर्वा॑: प्र॒दिशो॒ दिश॑श्च ।
उ॒प॒स्थाय॑ प्रथम॒जामृ॒तस्या॒त्मना॒ऽऽत्मान॑म॒भि सं वि॑वेश
verses.translation: Having encompassed round existing creatures, the world; and all the Quarters and Mid-quarters, Having approached the first-born Child of Order he with his Self into The Self hath entered.
verses.hindi: प्रभु मुञ्ञे बुद्धि दे, जिससे मे देव व पितर ' रक्षक बन पाऊं। सदा उन्नति के १. मेत मु वरुणः वरुण मेधाम्-बुद्धि को ददातुदे। वरुण का अर्थ है जो वरण करता है (०१८ ५1० €1€८15) ओर इस प्रकार श्रेष्ट ( वरुण= वरश्रेष्ठ) बनता है। संसार मेँ "प्रेय व श्रेय' में यदि मन्दबुद्धिता से मैने प्रेय का वरण कर लिया तो लक्ष्य तक न पंच
verses.transliteration: parītya bhūtāni parītya lokān parītya sarvā: pradiśo diśaśca | upasthāya prathamajāmṛtasyātmanā''tmānamabhi saṃ viveśa
verses.wordMeaning: Having encompassed round existing creatures, the world; and all the Quarters and Mid-quarters, Having approached the first-born Child of Order he with his Self into The Self hath entered.
verses.commentary: Sense: Having encompassed round existing creatures, the world; and all the Quarters and Mid-quarters, Having approached the first-born Child of Order he with his Self into The Self hath entered.

verses.sanskrit:
परि॒ द्यावा॑पृथि॒वी स॒द्य इ॒त्वा परि॑ लो॒कान् परि॒ दिश॒: परि॒ स्व॒: ।
ऋ॒तस्य॒ तन्तुं॒ वित॑तं वि॒चृत्य॒ तद॑पश्य॒त्तद॑भव॒त्तदा॑सीत्
verses.translation: Having gone swiftly round the earth and heaven, around the worlds, around the sky, the Quarters, Having spread out the lengthened thread of Order, he views, and he becomes and is That Being.
verses.hindi: में "वरुण, अग्नि, प्रजापति, इन्द्र, वायु व धाता" इन नामो से सूचित मार्ग को अपना्ॐँ। मेरी बुद्धि श्रेष्ट हो ओर ठीक मार्ग को अपनाकर मेँ अपना धारण कर सककरं। श्री चितय (८ ब्रह्यश्री, क्षत्रश्री, देवश्री ) ज्ञान+व्रलल+विनय मयि देवा द॑धतु श्रियमुत्त॑मां तस्यै ते स्वाह।॥॥ ९६॥
verses.transliteration: pari dyāvāpṛthivī sadya itvā pari lokān pari diśa: pari sva: | ṛtasya tantuṃ vitataṃ vicṛtya tadapaśyattadabhavattadāsīt
verses.wordMeaning: Having gone swiftly round the earth and heaven, around the worlds, around the sky, the Quarters, Having spread out the lengthened thread of Order, he views, and he becomes and is That Being.
verses.commentary: Sense: Having gone swiftly round the earth and heaven, around the worlds, around the sky, the Quarters, Having spread out the lengthened thread of Order, he views, and he becomes and is That Being.

verses.sanskrit: सद॑स॒स्पति॒मद्भु॑तं प्रि॒यमिन्द्र॑स्य॒ काम्य॑म् । स॒निं मे॒धाम॑यासिष॒ᳪस्वाहा॑
verses.translation: To the Assembly's wondrous Lord, to Indra's lovely Friend who gives Wisdom. have I drawn near in prayer.
verses.hindi: इस शरीर में हम तमोगुण व रजोगुण से ऊपर उठकर सत्त्वगुण मे विचरते हुए प्रकृति व जीव से परे उस तृतीय धाम प्रभु में विचरे। इसी से हम अमृतत्त्व क्रा लाभ परीत्य॑ भूतानि परीत्य॑ लोकान् परीत्य सर्वौः प्रदिशो दिश॑श्च। १. आत्मना=मन से आत्मानम् अभि सम् विवेश परमात्मा मे प्रवेश करता हे।
verses.transliteration: sadasaspatimadbhutaṃ priyamindrasya kāmyam | saniṃ medhāmayāsiṣasvāhā
verses.wordMeaning: To the Assembly's wondrous Lord, to Indra's lovely Friend who gives Wisdom. have I drawn near in prayer.
verses.commentary: Sense: To the Assembly's wondrous Lord, to Indra's lovely Friend who gives Wisdom. have I drawn near in prayer.

verses.sanskrit:
यां मे॒धां दे॑वग॒णाः पि॒तर॑श्चो॒पास॑ते ।
तया॒ माम॒द्य मे॒धयाऽग्ने॑ मे॒धावि॑नं कुरु॒ स्वाहा॑
verses.translation: That wisdom which the Companies of Gods, and Fathers, recognize, Even with that intelligence, O Agni, make me wise to-day. All-hail!
verses.hindi: हमारे जीवन में बुद्धिवाद के परिणामस्वरूप विश्वप्रेम, अद्धुत उन्नति, देवगण त पितरों से उपासित बुद्दधि-मेध्रावी यां मेधां देवगणाः पित्र श्चोपासं ते। १. याम्-जिस मेधाम्=बुद्धि कौ देवगणाः =देवगण पितरः च=ओर रक्षक लोग
verses.transliteration: yāṃ medhāṃ devagaṇāḥ pitaraścopāsate | tayā māmadya medhayā'gne medhāvinaṃ kuru svāhā
verses.wordMeaning: That wisdom which the Companies of Gods, and Fathers, recognize, Even with that intelligence, O Agni, make me wise to-day. All-hail!
verses.commentary: Sense: That wisdom which the Companies of Gods, and Fathers, recognize, Even with that intelligence, O Agni, make me wise to-day. All-hail!

verses.sanskrit:
मे॒धां मे॒ वरु॑णो ददातु मे॒धाम॒ग्निः प्र॒जाप॑तिः ।
मे॒धामिन्द्र॑श्च वा॒युश्च॑ मे॒धां धा॒ता द॑दातु मे॒ स्वाहा॑
verses.translation: Varuna grant me wisdom! grant it Agni and Prajâpati! Wisdom may Indra, Vâyu grant. May the Creator grant it me. All-hail!
verses.hindi: ज्ञान के द्वारा हमारी श्री उत्कृष्ट हो, ज्ान+बल के द्वारा वह उत्कृष्टतर हो, ओर ज्ञान+बल+दिव्यता से बह उत्कृष्टतम हो। इस श्री कौ प्राप्ति के लिए हम प्रभु के प्रति अपना अर्पण करे। हम वह चित्र हों, जिसके चित्रकार प्रभु हो।
verses.transliteration: medhāṃ me varuṇo dadātu medhāmagniḥ prajāpatiḥ | medhāmindraśca vāyuśca medhāṃ dhātā dadātu me svāhā
verses.wordMeaning: Varuna grant me wisdom! grant it Agni and Prajâpati! Wisdom may Indra, Vâyu grant. May the Creator grant it me. All-hail!
verses.commentary: Sense: Varuna grant me wisdom! grant it Agni and Prajâpati! Wisdom may Indra, Vâyu grant. May the Creator grant it me. All-hail!

verses.sanskrit:
इ॒दं मे॒ ब्रह्म॑ च क्ष॒त्रं चो॒भे श्रिय॑मश्नुताम् ।
मयि॑ दे॒वा द॑धतु॒ श्रिय॒मुत्त॑मां॒ तस्यै॑ ते॒ स्वाहा॑
verses.translation: Let these the Priests and Nobles both enjoy the splendour that is mine. Best splendour may the Gods bestow on me. To thee, that splendour, hail!
verses.hindi: ज्ञान के द्वारा हमारी श्री उत्कृष्ट हो, ज्ान+बल के द्वारा वह उत्कृष्टतर हो, ओर ज्ञान+बल+दिव्यता से बह उत्कृष्टतम हो। इस श्री कौ प्राप्ति के लिए हम प्रभु के प्रति अपना अर्पण करे। हम वह चित्र हों, जिसके चित्रकार प्रभु हो।
verses.transliteration: idaṃ me brahma ca kṣatraṃ cobhe śriyamaśnutām | mayi devā dadhatu śriyamuttamāṃ tasyai te svāhā
verses.wordMeaning: Let these the Priests and Nobles both enjoy the splendour that is mine. Best splendour may the Gods bestow on me. To thee, that splendour, hail!
verses.commentary: Sense: Let these the Priests and Nobles both enjoy the splendour that is mine. Best splendour may the Gods bestow on me. To thee, that splendour, hail!

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒स्याजरा॑सो द॒माम॒रित्रा॑ अ॒र्चद्धू॑मासो अ॒ग्नय॑: पाव॒काः ।
श्वि॒ती॒चय॑: श्वा॒त्रासो॑ भुर॒ण्यवो॑ वन॒र्षदो॑ वा॒यवो॒ न सोमा॑:
verses.translation: com The Texts of the White Yajurveda, tr. Ralph T.H. Griffith, [1899], BOOK THE THIRTY-THIRD. His be the fires, eternal, purifying, protectors of our homes, whose smoke is shining, White, waxing in their strength, for ever stirring, and seated in the wood: like winds are Somas.
verses.hindi: षिः विष्वरूपः। देवता-अग्नयः। छन्द: गायत्री। स्वरः-षड्जः। हर॑यो धूमकेतवो वात॑जूताऽ उप द्यवि । यतन्ते वृथ॑ग॒ग्नय॑: ।। २॥ ९. गतमन्त्र- वर्णित प्रभुभक्त हरयः ओरों के दुःखों को हरण करनेवाले होते हे वस्तुतः ये ओरों के दुःखों को अपना बना लेते हैँ ओर उसे दूर किये चिना शान्ति अनुभव
verses.transliteration: asyājarāso damāmaritrā arcaddhūmāso agnaya: pāvakāḥ | śvitīcaya: śvātrāso bhuraṇyavo vanarṣado vāyavo na somā:
verses.wordMeaning: com The Texts of the White Yajurveda, tr. Ralph T.H. Griffith, [1899], BOOK THE THIRTY-THIRD. His be the fires, eternal, purifying, protectors of our homes, whose smoke is shining, White, waxing in their strength, for ever stirring, and seated in the wood: like winds are Somas.
verses.commentary: Sense: com The Texts of the White Yajurveda, tr. Ralph T.H. Griffith, [1899], BOOK THE THIRTY-THIRD. His be the fires, eternal, purifying, protectors of our homes, whose smoke is shining, White, waxing in their strength, for ever stirring, and seated in the wood: like winds are Somas.

verses.sanskrit: हर॑यो धू॒मके॑तवो॒ वात॑जूता॒ उप॒ द्यवि॑ । यत॑न्ते॒ वृथ॑ग॒ग्नय॑:
verses.translation: Gold-coloured, bannered with the smoke, urged by the wind, aloft to heaven Rise, lightly borne, the flames of fire. Bring to us Mitra-Varuna, bring the Gods to the great sacrifice; Bring them, O Agni, to thine home.
verses.hindi: हम स्वयं अग्नि बनकर ओरों को भी अग्नि बनाने का प्रयत्न करे। यजा नो मित्रावरुणा यजां देवाँ २।ऽ ऋतं बुहत्। अग्ने यक्षि स्वं दम॑म्॥३॥ १. गतमन्त्र मेँ वर्णित आग्नि" बनने के लिए हम प्रभु से प्रार्थना करते है कि दहे अग्ने आगे ले-चलनेवाले प्रभो! आप अग्नि है. आपकर सम्पर्क से हम भी अग्नि बन
verses.transliteration: harayo dhūmaketavo vātajūtā upa dyavi | yatante vṛthagagnaya:
verses.wordMeaning: Gold-coloured, bannered with the smoke, urged by the wind, aloft to heaven Rise, lightly borne, the flames of fire. Bring to us Mitra-Varuna, bring the Gods to the great sacrifice; Bring them, O Agni, to thine home.
verses.commentary: Sense: Gold-coloured, bannered with the smoke, urged by the wind, aloft to heaven Rise, lightly borne, the flames of fire. Bring to us Mitra-Varuna, bring the Gods to the great sacrifice; Bring them, O Agni, to thine home.

verses.sanskrit:
यजा॑ नो मि॒त्रावरु॑णा॒ यजा॑ दे॒वाँ२  ऋ॒तं बृ॒हत् ।
अग्ने॒ यक्षि॒ स्वं दम॑म्
verses.translation: To fair goals travel Two unlike in semblance: each in succession nourishes an infant.
verses.hindi: प्रभु के स्वागत कौ तैयारी का स्वरूप यदी है कि हम १. स्वास्थ्य के द्वारा शरीर को रोगरूप मलों से दूर करते हैं २. दिव्य गुणों के द्वारा द्वेषरूप मानसमल को दूर करते है ३. ऋत के द्वारा उन्नति के विघ्नो को समाप्त करते हैँ ओर ४. आत्मदमन से अपने सब मलों को दूर करने का प्रयत्न करते है।
verses.transliteration: yajā no mitrāvaruṇā yajā devā~2 ṛtaṃ bṛhat | agne yakṣi svaṃ damam
verses.wordMeaning: To fair goals travel Two unlike in semblance: each in succession nourishes an infant.
verses.commentary: Sense: To fair goals travel Two unlike in semblance: each in succession nourishes an infant.

verses.sanskrit: यु॒क्ष्वा हि दे॑व॒हूत॑माँ॒२ अश्वाँ॑२ अग्ने र॒थीरि॑व । नि होता॑ पू॒र्व्यः स॑दः
verses.translation: Yoke, Agni, as a charioteer, thy steeds who best invoke the Gods: As ancient Hotar take thy seat.
verses.hindi: इन्द्रियों को परिशुद्ध करके हम अपने हदयों मे प्रभु का आह्वान करे। १. ३श्वें अध्याय की समाप्ति पर ' श्रीश्च ते लक्ष्मीश्च पत्न्यौ ' इन शब्दों मे कहा था कि "धन व ज्ञान' वे दो तेरी पत्नियों टै। इसी बात को "यत्र ब्रह्मच क्त्रं च' इन शब्दों में दुहराया गया है ( क्षत्रमिति धननाम -नि० २।१०)। यहाँ "ब्रह्य ' ज्ञान का वाचक टै ओर
verses.transliteration: yukṣvā hi devahūtamā~2 aśvā~2 agne rathīriva | ni hotā pūrvyaḥ sadaḥ
verses.wordMeaning: Yoke, Agni, as a charioteer, thy steeds who best invoke the Gods: As ancient Hotar take thy seat.
verses.commentary: Sense: Yoke, Agni, as a charioteer, thy steeds who best invoke the Gods: As ancient Hotar take thy seat.

verses.sanskrit:
द्वे विरू॑पे चरत॒: स्वर्थे॑ अ॒न्याऽन्या॑ व॒त्समुप॑ धापयेते ।
हरि॑र॒न्यस्यां॒ भव॑ति स्व॒धावा॑ञ्छु॒क्रो अ॒न्यस्यां॑ ददृशे सु॒वर्चा॑:
verses.translation: One bears a Godlike Babe of golden colour: bright and fair-shining is be with the other.
verses.hindi: हम कर्मनिष्ठ, तपस्वी, जानी बनकर प्रभु के प्रिय बने, उपासक बनकर ज्ञान प्राप्त करे, सबके साथ अद्वैत का अनुभव करते हुए शक्तिशाली वने, प्रभु की शक्ति का देवो क्री जनुक्रूत्तता त्रीणि शाता त्री सहस्राण्यग्निं त्रिच्शच्चं देवा न॑ चासपर्यन् ।
verses.transliteration: dve virūpe carata: svarthe anyā'nyā vatsamupa dhāpayete | hariranyasyāṃ bhavati svadhāvāñchukro anyasyāṃ dadṛśe suvarcā:
verses.wordMeaning: One bears a Godlike Babe of golden colour: bright and fair-shining is be with the other.
verses.commentary: Sense: One bears a Godlike Babe of golden colour: bright and fair-shining is be with the other.

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒यमि॒ह प्र॑थ॒मो धा॑यि धा॒तृभि॒र्होता॒ यजि॑ष्ठो अध्व॒रेष्वीड्य॑: ।
यमप्न॑वानो॒ भृग॑वो विरुरु॒चुर्वने॑षु चि॒त्रं वि॒भ्वं॒ वि॒शे-वि॑शे
verses.translation: Here by ordainers was this God appointed first Invoker, best at worship, to be praised at rites, Whom Apnavâna and the Bhrigus caused to shine, bright-coloured in the wood, spreading to every house.
verses.hindi: सब प्राकृतिक देवों की अनुकूलता होने पर हमें स्वास्थ्य, नैर्मल्य व दीप्ति प्राप्त होती है ओर हमारा हृदय प्रभु का आसन बनता है। देकरत ग्नि क्रा चिक्ास कवि सम्राजमतिथिं जनानामासन्ना पात्र जनयन्त देवाः ।॥८॥
verses.transliteration: ayamiha prathamo dhāyi dhātṛbhirhotā yajiṣṭho adhvareṣvīḍya: | yamapnavāno bhṛgavo virurucurvaneṣu citraṃ vibhvaṃ viśe-viśe
verses.wordMeaning: Here by ordainers was this God appointed first Invoker, best at worship, to be praised at rites, Whom Apnavâna and the Bhrigus caused to shine, bright-coloured in the wood, spreading to every house.
