verses.commentary: Sense: Here by ordainers was this God appointed first Invoker, best at worship, to be praised at rites, Whom Apnavâna and the Bhrigus caused to shine, bright-coloured in the wood, spreading to every house.

verses.sanskrit:
त्रीणि॑ श॒ता त्री स॒हस्रा॑ण्य॒ग्निं त्रि॒ᳪशच्च॑ दे॒वा नव॑ चासपर्यन् ।
औक्ष॑न् घृ॒तैरस्तृ॑णन् ब॒र्हिर॑स्मा॒ आदिद्धोता॑रं॒ न्य॒सादयन्त
verses.translation: Three times a hundred Gods, and thrice a thousand, and three times ten, and nine have worshipped Agni, For him spread sacred grass, balmed him with butter, and stablished him as Priest and Sacrificer.
verses.hindi: देवों कौ कृपा से हमारा जीवन मन्त्र-वर्णित बातों से युक्त होकर नव (नवीन) ही बन जाए ओर सबका स्तुत्य (नू स्तुतौ) हो सके। १. अग्निः=हमारी सव उन्नतियों के साधक वे प्रभु वृत्राणिसान पर पर्दा डालनेवाली कामादि वासनाओं को जंघनत्=नष्ट करते है। जीव स्वयं वासना के विजय में समर्थ नही।
verses.transliteration: trīṇi śatā trī sahasrāṇyagniṃ triśacca devā nava cāsaparyan | aukṣan ghṛtairastṛṇan barhirasmā ādiddhotāraṃ nyasādayanta
verses.wordMeaning: Three times a hundred Gods, and thrice a thousand, and three times ten, and nine have worshipped Agni, For him spread sacred grass, balmed him with butter, and stablished him as Priest and Sacrificer.
verses.commentary: Sense: Three times a hundred Gods, and thrice a thousand, and three times ten, and nine have worshipped Agni, For him spread sacred grass, balmed him with butter, and stablished him as Priest and Sacrificer.

verses.sanskrit:
मू॒र्धानं॑  दि॒वो अ॑र॒तिं पृ॑थि॒व्या वै॑श्वान॒रमृ॒त आ जा॒तम॒ग्निम् ।
क॒विᳪ स॒म्राज॒मति॑थिं॒ जना॑नामा॒सन्ना पात्रं॑ जनयन्त दे॒वाः
verses.translation: Him, messenger of earth and head of heaven, Agni Vaisvânara, born in holy Order, The Sage, the King, the Guest of men, a vessel fit for their mouths, the Gods have generated.
verses.hindi: हम प्रभु के प्रति अपना अर्पण करने का प्रयत्न करे. इसी उदेश्य से धनां का यज्ञो में विनियोग करे, जिससे प्रभु हमपर आक्रमण करनेवाले वृत्रो का विनाश करे। १९. है अग्ने=(अगि गतौ) निरन्तर प्रभु की ओर चलनेवाले। उन्नतिपथ पर आगे बद्नेवाले जीव! तू सित्रस्य=अपने मित्र प्रभु के धामभिः=तेजों के उदेश्य से सोम्यम् मधु
verses.transliteration: mūrdhānaṃ divo aratiṃ pṛthivyā vaiśvānaramṛta ā jātamagnim | kavi samrājamatithiṃ janānāmāsannā pātraṃ janayanta devāḥ
verses.wordMeaning: Him, messenger of earth and head of heaven, Agni Vaisvânara, born in holy Order, The Sage, the King, the Guest of men, a vessel fit for their mouths, the Gods have generated.
verses.commentary: Sense: Him, messenger of earth and head of heaven, Agni Vaisvânara, born in holy Order, The Sage, the King, the Guest of men, a vessel fit for their mouths, the Gods have generated.

verses.sanskrit: अ॒ग्निर्वृ॒त्राणि॑ जङ्घनद्द्रविण॒स्युर्वि॑प॒न्यया॑ । समि॑द्धः शु॒क्र आहु॑तः
verses.translation: May Agni slay the foemen,—fain for riches, through the love of song Kindled, bright, served with sacrifice.
verses.hindi: हम महान् सौभग के लिए प्रयत्न कर, हमारे द्युम्न उत्तम हों। हमारा दाम्पत्य संयमवाला ठो ओर ठम क्रोधादि के वेग को समाप्त कर दे। इन्द्रं न त्वा शव॑सा देवता वायुं पुंणन्ति राध॑सा नृत॑माः ।॥९३॥ १. गत मन्त्र के आशीर्वाद को सुनकर अग्नि प्रभु से कहता है कि मन्द्रतमम्- अत्यन्त
verses.transliteration: agnirvṛtrāṇi jaṅghanaddraviṇasyurvipanyayā | samiddhaḥ śukra āhutaḥ
verses.wordMeaning: May Agni slay the foemen,—fain for riches, through the love of song Kindled, bright, served with sacrifice.
verses.commentary: Sense: May Agni slay the foemen,—fain for riches, through the love of song Kindled, bright, served with sacrifice.

verses.sanskrit: विश्वे॑भिः सो॒म्यं मध्वग्न॒ इन्द्रे॑ण वा॒युना॑ । पिबा॑ मि॒त्रस्य॒ धाम॑भिः
verses.translation: With the All-Gods, with Indra and with Vâyu drink the Soma mead, O Agni, after Mitra's laws.
verses.hindi: - हम ' सूरि, यन्ता, मघवा व इन्द्रियो कौ रक्षा करनेवाले ' बनकर प्रभु कर प्रिय श्रुधि श्रुत्कर्ण वद्धिभिरदँवैर॑स्ने स॒याव॑भिः। १. है श्रुत्कर्ण ज्ञान का विकर्ण करनेवाले (-श्रुतचज्ञान, कर्ण=विकीर्ण करना) ओर इस प्रकार अग्ने=अग्रेणी प्रभो! श्रुधि=आप हमारी प्रार्थना को सुनिए। प्रभु ज्ञान को सहैव
verses.transliteration: viśvebhiḥ somyaṃ madhvagna indreṇa vāyunā | pibā mitrasya dhāmabhiḥ
verses.wordMeaning: With the All-Gods, with Indra and with Vâyu drink the Soma mead, O Agni, after Mitra's laws.
verses.commentary: Sense: With the All-Gods, with Indra and with Vâyu drink the Soma mead, O Agni, after Mitra's laws.

verses.sanskrit:
आ यदि॒षे नृ॒पतिं॒ तेज॒ आन॒ट् शुचि॒ रेतो॒ निषि॑क्तं॒ द्यौर॒भीके॑ ।
अ॒ग्निः शर्ध॑मनव॒द्यं युवा॑नᳪ स्वा॒ध्यं॒ जनयत् सू॒दय॑च्च
verses.translation: When splendour reached the Lord of men to speed him, down from the heaven was shed the brilliant moisture. Agni brought forth to light and filled with spirit the youthful host benevolent and blameless.
verses.hindi: हमारे हृदयो में स्नेह, दान व यज्ञोपस्थान कौ वृत्तियाँ हों। विश्वैषामदितिर्यज्ञियानां विश्वेंषामतिंथिर्मानुंषाणाम्। अन्निर्देवानामव॑ऽआचरृणानः सुमृडीको भ॑वतु जातवेदाः ९६॥ १. (क) गत मन्त्र मे हम यन्नो मे जानैवाले हों ', इन शब्दों से प्रार्थना समाप्त हई
verses.transliteration: ā yadiṣe nṛpatiṃ teja ānaṭ śuci reto niṣiktaṃ dyaurabhīke | agniḥ śardhamanavadyaṃ yuvāna svādhyaṃ janayat sūdayacca
verses.wordMeaning: When splendour reached the Lord of men to speed him, down from the heaven was shed the brilliant moisture. Agni brought forth to light and filled with spirit the youthful host benevolent and blameless.
verses.commentary: Sense: When splendour reached the Lord of men to speed him, down from the heaven was shed the brilliant moisture. Agni brought forth to light and filled with spirit the youthful host benevolent and blameless.

verses.sanskrit:
अग्ने॒ शर्ध॑ मह॒ते सौ॑भगाय॒ तव॑ द्यु॒म्नान्यु॑त्त॒मानि॑ सन्तु ।
सं जा॑स्प॒त्यᳪ सु॒यम॒मा कृ॑णुष्व शत्रूय॒ताम॒भि ति॑ष्ठा॒ महा॑ᳪसि
verses.translation: Show thyself strong for mighty bliss, O Agni; most excellent be thine effulgent splendours. Make easy to maintain our household lordship and trample down the might of those who hate us.
verses.hindi: हम रेतस् रक्ता द्वारा अपना आप्यायन करनेवाले, शक्तिशाली ज्ञानेन्दरियोवाले, ऋत को प्राप्त, वायु की भति नियत कर्मो में व्याप्त, प्रज्ञानों व कर्मो से शक्ति व धनों को १. गावः=ठे वेदवाणियो! अवतम्-हदयान्तरिक्ष के, मेरी हदयरूप गुहा को उपावतम्- (अवनभाग, बृद्धि) अपना भाग बनाओ-उसका सेवन करो ओर उसका वर्धन करो।
verses.transliteration: agne śardha mahate saubhagāya tava dyumnānyuttamāni santu | saṃ jāspatya suyamamā kṛṇuṣva śatrūyatāmabhi tiṣṭhā mahāsi
verses.wordMeaning: Show thyself strong for mighty bliss, O Agni; most excellent be thine effulgent splendours. Make easy to maintain our household lordship and trample down the might of those who hate us.
verses.commentary: Sense: Show thyself strong for mighty bliss, O Agni; most excellent be thine effulgent splendours. Make easy to maintain our household lordship and trample down the might of those who hate us.

verses.sanskrit:
त्वाᳪ हि म॒न्द्रत॑ममर्कशो॒कैर्व॑वृ॒महे॒ महि॑ न॒: श्रोष्य॑ग्ने ।
इन्द्रं॒ न त्वा॒ शव॑सा दे॒वता॑ वा॒युं पृ॑णन्ति॒ राध॑सा॒ नृत॑माः
verses.translation: We have elected thee as most delightful for thy beams’ glow: hear our great laud, O Agni. The best men praise thee as the peer of Indra in strength, mid Gods, like Vâyu in thy bounty.
verses.hindi: हमारे हृदयो में वेदवाणी का प्रादुर्भाव हो। इन वेदवाणियों से हमारे हदय विशाल बनें व यक्िय भावनावाले हौ। हमारे कान सदा इन वाणियो के श्रवण से पचित्र व कपिः वसिष्ठः। देवता-सविता। छन्दः. निचृद्गायत्री । स्वर ः-षड्जः।। गतमन्त्र मं वेदवाणियों से दोनों कानों के ज्योतिर्मय होने का उल्लेख था। उसी से
verses.transliteration: tvā hi mandratamamarkaśokairvavṛmahe mahi na: śroṣyagne | indraṃ na tvā śavasā devatā vāyuṃ pṛṇanti rādhasā nṛtamāḥ
verses.wordMeaning: We have elected thee as most delightful for thy beams’ glow: hear our great laud, O Agni. The best men praise thee as the peer of Indra in strength, mid Gods, like Vâyu in thy bounty.
verses.commentary: Sense: We have elected thee as most delightful for thy beams’ glow: hear our great laud, O Agni. The best men praise thee as the peer of Indra in strength, mid Gods, like Vâyu in thy bounty.

verses.sanskrit:
त्वे अ॑ग्ने स्वाहुत प्रि॒यास॑: सन्तु सू॒रय॑: ।
य॒न्तारो॒ ये म॒घवा॑नो॒ जना॑नामू॒र्वान् दय॑न्त॒ गोना॑म्
verses.translation: O Agni who art worshipped well, dear let our princes be to thee, Our wealthy patrons who are governors of men, who part in gifts their stalls of kine.
verses.hindi: धन का दान देनेवाला व्यक्ति सर्वत्र यश प्राप्त करता है। भै क्रो विस्तृत करना-विुवरूप नना १, आतिष्ठन्तम्-जो केवल अपने में स्थित न टोकर सनमें स्थित है (०1८ ५110 15 7७1 ७९।६८७१४९०) , उस सबमे- विश्व में ' मै" की भावना करनेवाले को , विश्वे=सब दिव्य
verses.transliteration: tve agne svāhuta priyāsa: santu sūraya: | yantāro ye maghavāno janānāmūrvān dayanta gonām
verses.wordMeaning: O Agni who art worshipped well, dear let our princes be to thee, Our wealthy patrons who are governors of men, who part in gifts their stalls of kine.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Agni who art worshipped well, dear let our princes be to thee, Our wealthy patrons who are governors of men, who part in gifts their stalls of kine.

verses.sanskrit:
श्रु॒धि श्रु॑त्कर्ण॒ वह्नि॑भिर्दे॒वैर॑ग्ने स॒याव॑भिः ।
आ सी॑दन्तु ब॒र्हिषि॑ मि॒त्रो अ॑र्य॒मा प्रा॑त॒र्यावा॑णो अध्व॒रम्
verses.translation: Hear, Agni who hast ears to hear, with all thy train of escort Gods. Let Mitra, Aryaman, seeking betimes our rite, seat them upon the sacred grass.
verses.hindi: हम अपनी "मै" को विस्तृत करके विश्वरूप वने ओर परिणामतः अमर हो विरुवरूप प्रभु च्री उपासना ९. गतमन्त्र का विषय "विश्वरूप ' बनना था। प्रस्तुत मन्त्र मे कहते है कि विश्वरूप बनने करे लिए उस विश्वरूप प्रभु कौ उपासना करो। वः तुम्हारे महे महनीय, पूजनीय व
verses.transliteration: śrudhi śrutkarṇa vahnibhirdevairagne sayāvabhiḥ | ā sīdantu barhiṣi mitro aryamā prātaryāvāṇo adhvaram
verses.wordMeaning: Hear, Agni who hast ears to hear, with all thy train of escort Gods. Let Mitra, Aryaman, seeking betimes our rite, seat them upon the sacred grass.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hear, Agni who hast ears to hear, with all thy train of escort Gods. Let Mitra, Aryaman, seeking betimes our rite, seat them upon the sacred grass.

verses.sanskrit:
विश्वे॑षा॒मदि॑तिर्य॒ज्ञिया॑नां॒ विश्वे॑षा॒मति॑थि॒र्मानु॑षाणाम् ।
अ॒ग्निर्दे॒वाना॒मव॑ आवृणा॒नः सु॑मृडी॒को भ॑वतु जा॒तवे॑दाः
verses.translation: The Freedom of all Gods who merit worship, freely received as Guest in all men's houses, Agni who hath secured the Gods’ high favour, may he be gracious to us, Jâtavedas.
verses.hindi: हम विश्वरूप प्रभु कौ उपासना करे ओर स्वयं विश्वरूप बनकर अमरता ९. येषाम्-जिनके युवादुरितों से दूर करके (यु-अमिश्रण) भद्रं से सम्युक्त कराने- वाले (यु-मिश्रण) इन्द्रः परमैश्वर्यशाली प्रभु सखामित्र होते है एषाम्-इनकी इध्मः =लानदीप्ति इत्-निश्चय से बृहत्-बहत अधिक वदी दुई ढोती है। प्रभु ज्ञान के पुञ्ज है, प्रभुका मित्र
verses.transliteration: viśveṣāmaditiryajñiyānāṃ viśveṣāmatithirmānuṣāṇām | agnirdevānāmava āvṛṇānaḥ sumṛḍīko bhavatu jātavedāḥ
verses.wordMeaning: The Freedom of all Gods who merit worship, freely received as Guest in all men's houses, Agni who hath secured the Gods’ high favour, may he be gracious to us, Jâtavedas.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Freedom of all Gods who merit worship, freely received as Guest in all men's houses, Agni who hath secured the Gods’ high favour, may he be gracious to us, Jâtavedas.

verses.sanskrit:
म॒हो अ॒ग्नेः स॑मिधा॒नस्य॒ शर्म॒ण्यना॑गा मि॒त्रे वरु॑णे स्व॒स्तये॑ ।
श्रेष्ठे॑ स्याम सवि॒तुः सवी॑मनि॒ तद्दे॒वाना॒मवो॑ अ॒द्या वृ॑णीमहे
verses.translation: In great enkindled Agni's keeping and, for bliss, free from all sin before Mitra and Varuna, May we share Savitar's best animating help. We crave this gracious favour of the Gods to-day.
verses.hindi: सुरक्षित वीर्यवाला व्यक्ति सदा प्रफुल्लित वदन (1111118 1०९€ ) होता ठै. यह महान् बनता है, इसका दिल छोटा नहीं होता तथा साथ ही यह प्रभु का पुजारी होता हे ओर शक्ति से रोगों पर आक्रमण करनेवाला होता है। १, राजनीति में उन्नति के विघातक तत्त्वं को "वृत्र" कहते है। जैसे सूर्यं के प्रकाश
verses.transliteration: maho agneḥ samidhānasya śarmaṇyanāgā mitre varuṇe svastaye | śreṣṭhe syāma savituḥ savīmani taddevānāmavo adyā vṛṇīmahe
verses.wordMeaning: In great enkindled Agni's keeping and, for bliss, free from all sin before Mitra and Varuna, May we share Savitar's best animating help. We crave this gracious favour of the Gods to-day.
verses.commentary: Sense: In great enkindled Agni's keeping and, for bliss, free from all sin before Mitra and Varuna, May we share Savitar's best animating help. We crave this gracious favour of the Gods to-day.

verses.sanskrit:
आप॑श्चित्पिप्यु स्त॒र्यो न गावो॒ नक्ष॑न्नृ॒तं ज॑रि॒तार॑स्त इन्द्र ।
या॒हि वा॒युर्न नि॒युतो॑ नो॒ अच्छा॒ त्वᳪ हि धी॒भिर्दय॑से॒ वि वाजा॑न्
verses.translation: Like barren cows, moreover, swelled the waters: singers approached thy holy cult, O Indra. Come thou to us as to his team comes Vâyu. Thou through our solemn hymns bestowest bounty.
verses.hindi: राजा के पाँच कर्तव्य है। इन कर्तव्यो का पालन करनेवाला राजा ही राजा कहलाने के योग्य होता है। कुतस्त्वमिन्द्र माहिनः सन्नेको यासि सत्पते किं त॑ऽ इत्था । सं पुच्छसे समराणः शभानैर्वोचेस्तन्नः हरिवो यत्तऽअस्मे ॥ २७॥
verses.transliteration: āpaścitpipyu staryo na gāvo nakṣannṛtaṃ jaritārasta indra | yāhi vāyurna niyuto no acchā tva hi dhībhirdayase vi vājān
verses.wordMeaning: Like barren cows, moreover, swelled the waters: singers approached thy holy cult, O Indra. Come thou to us as to his team comes Vâyu. Thou through our solemn hymns bestowest bounty.
verses.commentary: Sense: Like barren cows, moreover, swelled the waters: singers approached thy holy cult, O Indra. Come thou to us as to his team comes Vâyu. Thou through our solemn hymns bestowest bounty.

verses.sanskrit: गाव॒ उपा॑वताव॒तं म॒ही य॒ज्ञस्य॑ र॒प्सुदा॑ । उ॒भा कर्णा॑ हिर॒ण्यया॑
verses.translation: Ye Cows, protect the fount. The two mighty Ones bless the sacrifice. The handles twain are wrought of gold.
verses.hindi: राजा को कभी स्वच्छन्द न होना चाहिए्। मन्त्रीपरिषद् से सलाह करके ही जितेन्द्रियता त वेद-दोहन “इन्द्र शब्द का अर्थ राजा भी होता है, तो प्रसंगवश रद व रवे मन्त्रम राजा का उल्लेख करके फिर आत्मा के विषय में कहते ठै कि ९. है इन्द्र-सर्वशक्तिमन्,
verses.transliteration: gāva upāvatāvataṃ mahī yajñasya rapsudā | ubhā karṇā hiraṇyayā
verses.wordMeaning: Ye Cows, protect the fount. The two mighty Ones bless the sacrifice. The handles twain are wrought of gold.
verses.commentary: Sense: Ye Cows, protect the fount. The two mighty Ones bless the sacrifice. The handles twain are wrought of gold.

verses.sanskrit:
यद॒द्य सूर॒ उदि॒तेऽना॑गा मि॒त्रो अ॑र्य॒मा ।
सु॒वाति॑ सवि॒ता भग॑:
verses.translation: Now when the Sun hath risen to-day may sinless Mitra, Aryaman, Bhaga, and Savitar speed us forth.
verses.hindi: प्रभु की उपासना "जितेन्द्रियता" व “ वेद-दोहन' से हआ करती हे। तमुत्सवे च॑ प्रसवे च॑ सासहिमिन्द्रं देवासः शव॑ंसामदन्ननु ।। २९॥ १. है महः=महान् प्रभो! इमाम्=इस ते=तेरी महीम्=महिमा. को प्राप्त करानेवाली धियम्=वुद्धि को, प्रज्ञा व कर्मो की प्रतिपादक वेदवाणी को प्रभरे-मेैं प्रकर्षेण अपने में
verses.transliteration: yadadya sūra udite'nāgā mitro aryamā | suvāti savitā bhaga:
verses.wordMeaning: Now when the Sun hath risen to-day may sinless Mitra, Aryaman, Bhaga, and Savitar speed us forth.
verses.commentary: Sense: Now when the Sun hath risen to-day may sinless Mitra, Aryaman, Bhaga, and Savitar speed us forth.

verses.sanskrit: आ सु॒ते सि॑ञ्चत॒ श्रिय॒ᳪ रोद॑स्योरभि॒श्रिय॑म् । र॒सा द॑धीत वृष॒भम् ।।तं प्र॒त्नथा॒ ऽयं वे॒न:
verses.translation: Pour on the juice the ornament which reaches both the heaven and earth; Supply the liquid to the Bull. Thou in the first old time. See, Vena.
verses.hindi: में वेदवाणी को अपने अन्दर भरनेवाला बनं, जिससे सम -दु :ख- सुख बनकर आनन्दमय जीवनवाला हो सकर। विभ्राड् बृहत्विलतु सोम्यं मध्वायुर्दधंद्यज्ञप॑तावविंहुतम् । १. पिच्छलो मन्त्र मँ वेदवाणी कौ अपने मेँ भरने का वर्णन धा। यह पुरुष विभ्राट्-विशिष्ट
verses.transliteration: ā sute siñcata śriya rodasyorabhiśriyam | rasā dadhīta vṛṣabham ||taṃ pratnathā 'yaṃ vena:
verses.wordMeaning: Pour on the juice the ornament which reaches both the heaven and earth; Supply the liquid to the Bull. Thou in the first old time. See, Vena.
verses.commentary: Sense: Pour on the juice the ornament which reaches both the heaven and earth; Supply the liquid to the Bull. Thou in the first old time. See, Vena.

verses.sanskrit:
आ॒तिष्ठ॑न्तं॒ परि॒ विश्वे॑ अभूष॒ञ्छ्रियो॒ वसा॑नश्चरति॒ स्वरो॑चिः ।
म॒हत्तद्वृष्णो॒ असु॑रस्य॒ नामा वि॒श्वरू॑पो अ॒मृता॑नि तस्थौ
verses.translation: As he was rising up they all revered him: self-luminous he travels, clothed in splendour. That is the Bull's, the Asura's lofty nature: he, Omniform, hath reached the eternal waters.
verses.hindi: उदु, त्यं जातवेदसं देवं व॑हन्ति केतवः । दुरो विरूवांय सूर्य"म्।। ३९॥ पिले मन्त्र का “विराट् ' यर्हौँ ' प्रस्कण्व '  अत्यन्त मेधावी ' इस नाम से कहा गया है। यह ९. उत्-निश्चय से प्रकृति से ऊपर उठता है। उत्-०५५। यह प्रकृति के अन्दर उलज्ञा नदीं रहता। २. प्रकृति से ऊपर उठकर केतवः =ये ज्ञानी लोग त्यम्=उस अव्यक्त प्रभु को
verses.transliteration: ātiṣṭhantaṃ pari viśve abhūṣañchriyo vasānaścarati svarociḥ | mahattadvṛṣṇo asurasya nāmā viśvarūpo amṛtāni tasthau
verses.wordMeaning: As he was rising up they all revered him: self-luminous he travels, clothed in splendour. That is the Bull's, the Asura's lofty nature: he, Omniform, hath reached the eternal waters.
verses.commentary: Sense: As he was rising up they all revered him: self-luminous he travels, clothed in splendour. That is the Bull's, the Asura's lofty nature: he, Omniform, hath reached the eternal waters.

verses.sanskrit:
प्र वो॑ म॒हे मन्द॑माना॒यान्ध॒सोऽर्चा॑ वि॒श्वान॑राय विश्वा॒भुवे॑ ।
इन्द्र॑स्य॒ यस्य॒ सुम॑ख॒ᳪ सहो॒ महि॒ श्रवो॑ नृ॒म्णं च॒ रोद॑सी सप॒र्यत॑:
verses.translation: I laud your Mighty One who joyeth in the juice, him who is good to all men, who pervadeth all; Indra whose conquering strength is powerful in war, whose fame and manly vigour Heaven and Earth revere.
verses.hindi: हम प्रकृति से ऊपर उदे, प्रभु को धारण कर, जिससे विश्व का दर्शन कर १. प्रभु पावक पवित्र करनेवाले है। गतमन्त्र मेँ ब्रह्मज्ञान का उल्लेख था। यह ब्रह्मज्ञान मनुष्य करे जीवन को पवित्र करता दे। ब्रह्मदर्शन करने पर पाप सम्भव ही नहीं। पापौ को दूर करके वे प्रभु अपने सखा जीव के जीवन को सुन्दर बनाते हैँ. प्रभु वरुण है, क्योंकि
verses.transliteration: pra vo mahe mandamānāyāndhaso'rcā viśvānarāya viśvābhuve | indrasya yasya sumakha saho mahi śravo nṛmṇaṃ ca rodasī saparyata:
verses.wordMeaning: I laud your Mighty One who joyeth in the juice, him who is good to all men, who pervadeth all; Indra whose conquering strength is powerful in war, whose fame and manly vigour Heaven and Earth revere.
verses.commentary: Sense: I laud your Mighty One who joyeth in the juice, him who is good to all men, who pervadeth all; Indra whose conquering strength is powerful in war, whose fame and manly vigour Heaven and Earth revere.

verses.sanskrit: बृ॒हन्निदि॒ध्म ए॑षां॒ भूरि॑ श॒स्तं पृ॒थुः स्वरु॑: । येषा॒मिन्द्रो॒ युवा॒ सखा॑
verses.translation: Great is their fuel, strung their laud, wide is their sacrificial post Whose Friend is Indra, ever young.
verses.hindi: लान से हम अपने जीवन को पवित्र करें, लोकधारण करनेवाले बनेँ। तब वह प्रभु हमारा उसी प्रकार धारण व ध्यान करगे जैसे माता पुत्र का। हैव्यावध्वर्यूऽआ ग॑त रथैन सूर्यत्वचा । मध्वां यज्ञ: समंञ्जाथे।।३३॥ पिले मन्त्र में प्रस्कण्वनेप्रभुसेप्रार्थनाकौ है कि है प्रभो! आप मेरा ध्यान कौजिए।
verses.transliteration: bṛhannididhma eṣāṃ bhūri śastaṃ pṛthuḥ svaru: | yeṣāmindro yuvā sakhā
verses.wordMeaning: Great is their fuel, strung their laud, wide is their sacrificial post Whose Friend is Indra, ever young.
verses.commentary: Sense: Great is their fuel, strung their laud, wide is their sacrificial post Whose Friend is Indra, ever young.

verses.sanskrit:
इन्द्रेहि॒ मत्स्यन्ध॑सो॒ विश्वे॑भिः सोम॒पर्व॑भिः ।
म॒हाँ२ अ॑भि॒ष्टिरोज॑सा
verses.translation: Come, Indra, and delight thee with the juice at all the Soma feasts, Conqueror, mighty in thy strength.
verses.hindi: दिव्यता, अहिंसा, स्वास्थ्य व माधुर्य मनुष्य को प्रभु-प्राप्ति के योग्य बनाते आ नऽइडायिर्विंदथं सुषटास्ति विषवानरः सविता देवऽ एतु । ९. विद थे ज्ञानयज्ञो मे इडाभिः =वाणियों के द्वारा सुशस्ति-( सप्तमी का लुक ) उत्तम शंसन होने पर विश्वानरः=सबको उन्नतिपथ पर लै-चलनेवाला सवित्ता=सवका प्रेरक
verses.transliteration: indrehi matsyandhaso viśvebhiḥ somaparvabhiḥ | mahā~2 abhiṣṭirojasā
verses.wordMeaning: Come, Indra, and delight thee with the juice at all the Soma feasts, Conqueror, mighty in thy strength.
verses.commentary: Sense: Come, Indra, and delight thee with the juice at all the Soma feasts, Conqueror, mighty in thy strength.

verses.sanskrit:
इन्द्रो॑ वृ॒त्रम॑वृणो॒च्छर्ध॑नीति॒: प्र मा॒यिना॑ममिना॒द्वर्प॑णीतिः ।
अह॒न् व्य॒ᳪसमु॒शध॒ग्वने॑ष्वा॒विर्धेना॑ अकृणोद्रा॒म्याणा॑म्
verses.translation: Leading his band, Indra encompassed Vritra; weak grew the wily leader of enchanters. He who burns fierce in forests slaughtered Vyamsa, and made the milch-kine of the nights apparent.
verses.hindi: हम अपने घर के सदस्यों को सानयसों में प्रवृत्त करे ओर उनमें प्रभु की, ऋषियों की वाणिर्याँ पदं तो हमारा काव ९. प्रभु कौ ओर रहेगा २. जीवन ममदन हो पाएगा तथा ३. प्रत्येक स्थिति मे हम समज्ञ से चलेगे। १. प्रभु ज्ञानयज्ञो का विस्तार करनेवालों से कहते हैः कि है वृत्रहन्-वासना को नष्ट
verses.transliteration: indro vṛtramavṛṇocchardhanīti: pra māyināmaminādvarpaṇītiḥ | ahan vyasamuśadhagvaneṣvāvirdhenā akṛṇodrāmyāṇām
verses.wordMeaning: Leading his band, Indra encompassed Vritra; weak grew the wily leader of enchanters. He who burns fierce in forests slaughtered Vyamsa, and made the milch-kine of the nights apparent.
verses.commentary: Sense: Leading his band, Indra encompassed Vritra; weak grew the wily leader of enchanters. He who burns fierce in forests slaughtered Vyamsa, and made the milch-kine of the nights apparent.

verses.sanskrit:
कुत॒स्त्वमि॑न्द्र॒ माहि॑न॒: सन्नेको॑ यासि सत्पते॒ किं त॑ इ॒त्था ।
सं पृ॑च्छसे समरा॒णः शु॑भा॒नैर्वो॒चेस्तन्नो॑ हरिवो॒ यत्ते॑ अ॒स्मे ।
म॒हाँ२  इन्द्रो॒ य ओज॑सा  क॒दा च॒न स्त॒रीर॑सि क॒दा च॒न प्र यु॑च्छसि
verses.translation: Whence comest thou alone, thou who art mighty, Indra, Lord of the Brave? What is thy purpose? Thou greetest us, encountering us the Bright Ones. Lord of Bay Steeds, say what thou hast against us. Indra, great in his power and might. Ne’er art thou fruitless. Never art thou neglectful.
verses.hindi: हम जीविका के कार्यो का उपसंहार करके सधस्थ प्रभु से ज्ञान प्राप्त करे, जिससे हमपर अनलान का पर्दा न पड़ा रहे। १. सूर्यः =ज्ञान- सूर्य को अपने अन्दर उदित करनेवाला यह व्यक्ति द्योः=उस प्रकाशमय प्रभु के उपस्थे-समीप, उसकौ गोद में व्रेठता हुआ मित्रस्यचस्नेह की भावना को तथा
verses.transliteration: kutastvamindra māhina: sanneko yāsi satpate kiṃ ta itthā | saṃ pṛcchase samarāṇaḥ śubhānairvocestanno harivo yatte asme | mahā~2 indro ya ojasā kadā cana starīrasi kadā cana pra yucchasi
verses.wordMeaning: Whence comest thou alone, thou who art mighty, Indra, Lord of the Brave? What is thy purpose? Thou greetest us, encountering us the Bright Ones. Lord of Bay Steeds, say what thou hast against us. Indra, great in his power and might. Ne’er art thou fruitless.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Whence comest thou alone, thou who art mighty, Indra, Lord of the Brave? What is thy purpose? Thou greetest us, encountering us the Bright Ones. Lord of Bay Steeds, say what thou hast against us. Indra, great in his power and might. Ne’er art thou fruitless.…

verses.sanskrit:
आ तत्त॑ इन्द्रा॒यव॑: पनन्ता॒भि य ऊ॒र्वं गोम॑न्तं॒ तितृ॑त्सान् ।
स॒कृ॒त्स्वं ये पु॑रुपु॒त्रां म॒हीᳪ स॒हस्र॑धारां बृह॒तीं दुदु॑क्षन्
verses.translation: Those men extolled that deed of thine, O Indra, those who would fain burst through the stall of cattle, Fain to milk her who bare but once, great, lofty, whose sons are many and her streams a thousand.
verses.hindi: हम प्रभु का उपस्थान करते हुए ज्ञान प्राप्त करें ओर सभी के साथ स्नेह करनेवाले बनें। तेजस्वी बन ओर ओरों को भी ज्ञान देनेवाले बने। जगदग्नि का प्रभु-स्तवनन्द्रष्टा व श्रोता महस्त सतो महिमा प॑नस्यतेऽ द्धा देव महाँ २।।ऽअसि॥ ३९॥
verses.transliteration: ā tatta indrāyava: panantābhi ya ūrvaṃ gomantaṃ titṛtsān | sakṛtsvaṃ ye puruputrāṃ mahī sahasradhārāṃ bṛhatīṃ dudukṣan
verses.wordMeaning: Those men extolled that deed of thine, O Indra, those who would fain burst through the stall of cattle, Fain to milk her who bare but once, great, lofty, whose sons are many and her streams a thousand.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those men extolled that deed of thine, O Indra, those who would fain burst through the stall of cattle, Fain to milk her who bare but once, great, lofty, whose sons are many and her streams a thousand.

verses.sanskrit:
इ॒मां ते॒ धियं॒ प्र भ॑रे म॒हो म॒हीम॒स्य स्तो॒त्रे धि॒षणा॒ यत्त॑ आन॒जे ।
तमु॑त्स॒वे च॑ प्रस॒वे च॑ सास॒हिमिन्द्रं॑ दे॒वास॒: शव॑सामद॒न्ननु॑
verses.translation: To thee the Mighty One I bring this mighty hymn, for thy desire hath been gratified by my laud. In Indra, yea, in him victorious through his might, the Gods have joyed at feast and when the Soma flowed.
verses.hindi: में देव वनँ, जिससे प्रभु मुञ्लमें प्राणशक्ति का सच्चार करे ओर मै एक श्राय॑न्तऽ इव सूर्य विश्वेदिन्द्र॑स्य भक्षत । १. प्रस्तुत मन्त्र का ऋषि 'नृ-मेध' है. जो सव नरो से मिलकर चलता है (मेध संगम) । ' यह अकेला खाएगा' यह कैसे हो सकता है! इसका विचार है कि सूर्यम् इव=
verses.transliteration: imāṃ te dhiyaṃ pra bhare maho mahīmasya stotre dhiṣaṇā yatta ānaje | tamutsave ca prasave ca sāsahimindraṃ devāsa: śavasāmadannanu
verses.wordMeaning: To thee the Mighty One I bring this mighty hymn, for thy desire hath been gratified by my laud. In Indra, yea, in him victorious through his might, the Gods have joyed at feast and when the Soma flowed.
verses.commentary: Sense: To thee the Mighty One I bring this mighty hymn, for thy desire hath been gratified by my laud. In Indra, yea, in him victorious through his might, the Gods have joyed at feast and when the Soma flowed.

verses.sanskrit:
वि॒भ्राड् बृ॒हत्पि॑बतु सो॒म्यं मध्वायु॒र्दध॑द्य॒ज्ञप॑ता॒ववि॑ह्रुतम् ।
वात॑जूतो॒ यो अ॑भि॒रक्ष॑ति॒ त्मना॑ प्र॒जाः पु॑पोष पुरु॒धा वि रा॑जति
verses.translation: May the Bright God drink glorious Soma-mingled mead, giving the sacrifice's lord uninjured life; He who, wind-urged, in person guard our offspring well, hath nourished them with food and shone o’er many a land.
verses.hindi: सूर्य की भाँति हम श्रमशील हौ, उत्पन्न धनां को सबके साथ बोँरकर खा, धनों को प्रभु का समञ्चे। अद्या देवाऽ उदिता सूर्य॑स्य निरश्टसः पिपृता निर्वद्यात् । १. प्रस्तुत मन्त्र का ऋषि "कुत्स ' है। यह वासनाओों को (कुथ हिसायाम्) कुचल
verses.transliteration: vibhrāḍ bṛhatpibatu somyaṃ madhvāyurdadhadyajñapatāvavihrutam | vātajūto yo abhirakṣati tmanā prajāḥ pupoṣa purudhā vi rājati
verses.wordMeaning: May the Bright God drink glorious Soma-mingled mead, giving the sacrifice's lord uninjured life; He who, wind-urged, in person guard our offspring well, hath nourished them with food and shone o’er many a land.
verses.commentary: Sense: May the Bright God drink glorious Soma-mingled mead, giving the sacrifice's lord uninjured life; He who, wind-urged, in person guard our offspring well, hath nourished them with food and shone o’er many a land.

verses.sanskrit: उदु॒ त्यं जा॒तवे॑दसं दे॒वं व॑हन्ति के॒तव॑: । दृ॒शे विश्वा॑य॒ सूर्य॑म्
verses.translation: His bright rays bear him up aloft, the God who knoweth all that lives, Sûrya, that all may look on him.
verses.hindi: कुत्स ऋषि वह है जो  स्नेह व निद्रता, स्वास्थ्य, सोम, उदारता व प्रकाश का पुञ्ज बनने का प्रयत करता हे। इसी से वह पञ्जजन ' कहलाएगा। हिरण्ययेन सविता रथेना देवो याति भुव॑नानि पश्य॑न् ।॥४३॥ १. गतमन्त्र के अनुसार अपनी पाच वस्तुओं का विकास करके. विकास ही नहीं
verses.transliteration: udu tyaṃ jātavedasaṃ devaṃ vahanti ketava: | dṛśe viśvāya sūryam
verses.wordMeaning: His bright rays bear him up aloft, the God who knoweth all that lives, Sûrya, that all may look on him.
verses.commentary: Sense: His bright rays bear him up aloft, the God who knoweth all that lives, Sûrya, that all may look on him.

verses.sanskrit: येना॑ पावक॒ चक्ष॑सा भुर॒ण्यन्तं॒ जनाँ॒२ अनु॑ । त्वं व॑रुण॒ पश्य॑सि
verses.translation: Pure Varuna, with that same eye wherewith thou lookest upon one Actively stirring mid the folk—
verses.hindi: -हम हिरण्यस्तूप बनकर शरीर व आत्मा को स्वस्थ रखते हुए प्रजा मे भी स्वास्थ्य कौ फैलाने का प्रयत्न करते हुए प्रभु की ओर चले। प्रस्तुत मन्त्र का ऋषि वसिष्ठ है, उत्तम निवासवाला। इसके जीवन कौ निम्न बाते ध्यान देने योग्य हें --९. प्रवावृजे-यह वासनाओं का स्वयं ही वर्जन करता है, काम-क्रोध
verses.transliteration: yenā pāvaka cakṣasā bhuraṇyantaṃ janā~2 anu | tvaṃ varuṇa paśyasi
verses.wordMeaning: Pure Varuna, with that same eye wherewith thou lookest upon one Actively stirring mid the folk—
verses.commentary: Sense: Pure Varuna, with that same eye wherewith thou lookest upon one Actively stirring mid the folk—

verses.sanskrit:
दैव्या॑वध्वर्यू॒ आ ग॑त॒ᳪ रथे॑न॒ सूर्य॑त्वचा । मध्वा॑ य॒ज्ञᳪ सम॑ञ्जाथे ।
तं प्र॒त्नथा॒ ऽयं वे॒नश्चि॒त्रं दे॒वाना॑म्
verses.translation: Ye two divine Adhvaryus, come hither upon a sun-bright car: Bedew our sacrifice with stead. Thou in the first old time. See, Vena. The brilliant presence.
verses.hindi: लोकसंग्रह करता हुआ लोगों के हृदयं तक पद्ंचने का प्रयत्न करूं। प्रातः-सायं यही आराधना करूं कि मै क्रियाशील, पोषण करनेवाला व उत्तम इन्द्रियोवाला बनकर उत्तम १. पिछले मन्त्र की समाप्ति पर कहा था कि रत्रिव उषा के प्रारम्भ मे प्रथम पुकार (प्रार्थना) के समय “वायु व पूषा" को पुकारते है। उसी प्रार्थना को कु विस्तार से प्रस्तुत
verses.transliteration: daivyāvadhvaryū ā gata rathena sūryatvacā | madhvā yajña samañjāthe | taṃ pratnathā 'yaṃ venaścitraṃ devānām
verses.wordMeaning: Ye two divine Adhvaryus, come hither upon a sun-bright car: Bedew our sacrifice with stead. Thou in the first old time. See, Vena. The brilliant presence.
verses.commentary: Sense: Ye two divine Adhvaryus, come hither upon a sun-bright car: Bedew our sacrifice with stead. Thou in the first old time. See, Vena. The brilliant presence.

verses.sanskrit:
आ न॒ इडा॑भिर्वि॒दथे॑ सुश॒स्ति वि॒श्वान॑रः सवि॒ता दे॒व ए॑तु ।
अपि॒ यथा॑ युवानो॒ मत्स॑था नो॒ विश्वं॒ जग॑दभिपि॒त्वे म॑नी॒षा
verses.translation: Loved of all men, may Savitar through praises offered as sacred food come to our synod, That ye too, through our hymns, ye ever youthful, may gladden at your visit all our people.
verses.hindi: हम प्रभु से अपना सजात्य अन॒भव करें ओर वासनाओं में फंसने को अपनी शान के विरुद्ध समञ्धे। अग्नऽ इन्द्र॒ वरूण मित्र देवाः शर्धः प्र य॑न्त मारूतोत विष्णो । उभा नासत्या रुद्रोऽअध ग्नाः पूषा भगः सर॑स्वती जुषन्त । ४८॥।
verses.transliteration: ā na iḍābhirvidathe suśasti viśvānaraḥ savitā deva etu | api yathā yuvāno matsathā no viśvaṃ jagadabhipitve manīṣā
verses.wordMeaning: Loved of all men, may Savitar through praises offered as sacred food come to our synod, That ye too, through our hymns, ye ever youthful, may gladden at your visit all our people.
verses.commentary: Sense: Loved of all men, may Savitar through praises offered as sacred food come to our synod, That ye too, through our hymns, ye ever youthful, may gladden at your visit all our people.

verses.sanskrit: यद॒द्य कच्च॑ वृत्रहन्नु॒दगा॑ अ॒भि सू॑र्य । सर्वं॒ तदि॑न्द्र ते॒ वशे॑
verses.translation: Whatever, Vritra-slayer! thou Surya hast risen on to-day, That, Indra, all is in thy power.
verses.hindi: प्रभुकृपा से मेँ ज्ञानी बनं ओर इस ज्ञान से एश्वर्य का सदुपयोग करनेवाला ऋषि. वत्सारः। देवता--विष्वेदेवाः। छन्द :-निचूज्जगती। स्वरः-निषादः। भी कहा जाता है। यह सारभूत वस्तु सोम कौ रक्षा करे कारण “अवत्सार' हआ है। यह अवत्सार हुवे आवाहन करता है , पुकारता' है, किनको १. इन्द्राग्नी=इन्द्र ओर अग्नि को।
verses.transliteration: yadadya kacca vṛtrahannudagā abhi sūrya | sarvaṃ tadindra te vaśe
verses.wordMeaning: Whatever, Vritra-slayer! thou Surya hast risen on to-day, That, Indra, all is in thy power.
verses.commentary: Sense: Whatever, Vritra-slayer! thou Surya hast risen on to-day, That, Indra, all is in thy power.

verses.sanskrit: त॒रणि॑र्वि॒श्वद॑र्शतो ज्योति॒ष्कृद॑सि सूर्य । विश्व॒मा भा॑सि रोच॒नम्
verses.translation: Swift, visible to all art thou, O Sûrya, maker of the light, Illuming all the radiant realm.
verses.hindi: -हम सदा यक्षशील बनें ओर यजो द्वारा वासनाओं से दर रहे। प्राण, अग्नि, देव, धन व शक्ति विश्व नो देवाऽअवसा ग॑मन्तु विश्व॑मस्तु द्रविणं वाजोंऽअस्मे ॥५२॥ प्रस्तुत मन्त्र का ऋषि ' लुश' है " लुनाति, श्यति ' वासना का केदन-भेदन करता है ओर
verses.transliteration: taraṇirviśvadarśato jyotiṣkṛdasi sūrya | viśvamā bhāsi rocanam
verses.wordMeaning: Swift, visible to all art thou, O Sûrya, maker of the light, Illuming all the radiant realm.
verses.commentary: Sense: Swift, visible to all art thou, O Sûrya, maker of the light, Illuming all the radiant realm.

verses.sanskrit:
तत्सूर्य॑स्य देव॒त्वं तन्म॑हि॒त्वं म॒ध्या कर्तो॒र्वित॑त॒ᳪ सं ज॑भार ।
य॒देदयु॑क्त ह॒रित॑: स॒धस्था॒दाद्रात्री॒ वास॑स्तनुते सि॒मस्मै॑
verses.translation: This is the Godhead, this the might of Sûrya: he hath withdrawn what spread o’er work unfinished. When he hath loosed his horses from their station, straight over all Night spreadeth out her garment.
verses.hindi: हम अपने जीवन को प्राणसाधना से प्रारम्भ करें, इससे हममे स्वास्थ्य, प्रेम व ज्ञान की अग्निर्यो समिद्ध होँगी। ये हमें दिव्य बनार्फँगी ओर हम जीवन के लिप् आवश्यक धन का अर्जन करते हुए उसमें आसक्त न होगे। विश्वेदेवाः श्रृणुतेमः हव॑ मे येऽअन्तरिक्षे यऽउप द्यवि ष्ठ ।
verses.transliteration: tatsūryasya devatvaṃ tanmahitvaṃ madhyā kartorvitata saṃ jabhāra | yadedayukta harita: sadhasthādādrātrī vāsastanute simasmai
verses.wordMeaning: This is the Godhead, this the might of Sûrya: he hath withdrawn what spread o’er work unfinished. When he hath loosed his horses from their station, straight over all Night spreadeth out her garment.
verses.commentary: Sense: This is the Godhead, this the might of Sûrya: he hath withdrawn what spread o’er work unfinished. When he hath loosed his horses from their station, straight over all Night spreadeth out her garment.

verses.sanskrit:
तन्मि॒त्रस्य॒ वरु॑णस्याभि॒चक्षे॒ सूर्यो॑ रू॒पं कृ॑णुते॒ द्योरु॒पस्थे॑ ।
अ॒न॒न्तम॒न्यद्रुश॑दस्य॒ पाज॑: कृ॒ष्णम॒न्यद्ध॒रित॒: सं भ॑रन्ति
verses.translation: Approach ye, and be near to us. Drink, O ye Asvins, of the mead. Draw forth the milk, ye mighty, rich in genuine wealth! Injure us not, and come to us.
verses.hindi: हम "सुहोत्र" बनकर अग्निकुण्ड में सब वासनाओं को भस्म कर दे ओर अपने हदय को देवासन बनाकर आनन्द का लाभ करे। वामदेव को प्रभु करा प्रसाद देवेभ्यो हि प्रथमं यज्ञियेभ्यो ऽमृतत्वः सुवसि भागमुत्तमम् ।
verses.transliteration: tanmitrasya varuṇasyābhicakṣe sūryo rūpaṃ kṛṇute dyorupasthe | anantamanyadruśadasya pāja: kṛṣṇamanyaddharita: saṃ bharanti
verses.wordMeaning: Approach ye, and be near to us. Drink, O ye Asvins, of the mead. Draw forth the milk, ye mighty, rich in genuine wealth! Injure us not, and come to us.
verses.commentary: Sense: Approach ye, and be near to us. Drink, O ye Asvins, of the mead. Draw forth the milk, ye mighty, rich in genuine wealth! Injure us not, and come to us.

verses.sanskrit:
बण्म॒हाँ२ अ॑सि सूर्य॒ बडा॑दित्य म॒हाँ२ अ॑सि ।
म॒हस्ते॑ स॒तो म॑हि॒मा प॑नस्यते॒ऽद्धा दे॑व म॒हाँ२  अ॑सि
verses.translation: Verily, Sûrya, thou art great; truly, Âditya, thou art great. As thou art great indeed thy greatness is admired: yea, verily thou, God, art great.
verses.hindi: हम वामदेव बनें ताकि प्रभु से प्रसाद के रूप में अमृतत्वतस्वास्थ्य, उत्तम धन, संयम व अनुकूल जीवन प्राप्त कर सकरे। निःश्रेयस+अभ्युदय=धर्मः १. गतमन्त्र का वामदेव सदा सरल मार्ग से चलता है, अतः वह प्रस्तुत मन्त्रो में
verses.transliteration: baṇmahā~2 asi sūrya baḍāditya mahā~2 asi | mahaste sato mahimā panasyate'ddhā deva mahā~2 asi
verses.wordMeaning: Verily, Sûrya, thou art great; truly, Âditya, thou art great. As thou art great indeed thy greatness is admired: yea, verily thou, God, art great.
verses.commentary: Sense: Verily, Sûrya, thou art great; truly, Âditya, thou art great. As thou art great indeed thy greatness is admired: yea, verily thou, God, art great.

verses.sanskrit:
बट् सू॑र्य॒ श्रव॑सा म॒हाँ२ अ॑सि स॒त्रा दे॑व म॒हाँ२ अ॑सि ।
म॒ह्ना दे॒वाना॑मसु॒र्य॒: पु॒रोहि॑तो वि॒भु ज्योति॒रदा॑भ्यम्
verses.translation: Yea, Sûrya, thou art great in fame: thou, evermore, O God, art great. Thou by thy greatness art the Gods’ Home-Priest, divine, far-spread, unconquerable light.
verses.hindi: हम ' ऋजिश्व' ऋजुमार्ग से चलनेवाले बनकर, आत्मतत्त्व कौ ओर चलनेवाले नें। सुपथ से ही धन कमा्पँ। ज्योतिर्मय बनकर, कर्तव्य पालन करते हए यज्ञमय जीवन -बनारपँ ओर कवि बनकर उस कवि को प्राप्त करें। १. मन्त्र का सरलार्थ यह है -इन्द्रवायू=इन्द्र ओर वायु इमे=ये इन्दवः=सोमकण
verses.transliteration: baṭ sūrya śravasā mahā~2 asi satrā deva mahā~2 asi | mahnā devānāmasurya: purohito vibhu jyotiradābhyam
verses.wordMeaning: Yea, Sûrya, thou art great in fame: thou, evermore, O God, art great. Thou by thy greatness art the Gods’ Home-Priest, divine, far-spread, unconquerable light.
verses.commentary: Sense: Yea, Sûrya, thou art great in fame: thou, evermore, O God, art great. Thou by thy greatness art the Gods’ Home-Priest, divine, far-spread, unconquerable light.

verses.sanskrit:
श्राय॑न्त इव॒ सूर्यं॒ विश्वेदिन्द्र॑स्य भक्षत ।
वसू॑नि जा॒ते जन॑मान॒ ओज॑सा॒ प्रति॑ भा॒गं न दी॑धिम
verses.translation: Turning, as ’twere, to meet the Sun, enjoy from Indra all good things. When he who will be horn is born with power we look to treasures as our heritage.
verses.hindi: हम सात्विक अन्न के सेवन से इच्दरियों के अधिष्ठाता बने तथा निरन्तर क्रिया में लगे रहने से सोम के प्रिय बरन, अर्थात् शक्ति की रक्षा करनेवाले हो। ९. सोमकणों की रक्षा के लिए ' मानस स्वास्थ्य ' की अत्यन्त आवश्यकता है। मनुष्य का मन क्षुब्ध होगा तो सोमरक्षा सम्भव न होगी, अतः ' मधुच्छन्दा प्रार्थना करता है कि
verses.transliteration: śrāyanta iva sūryaṃ viśvedindrasya bhakṣata | vasūni jāte janamāna ojasā prati bhāgaṃ na dīdhima
verses.wordMeaning: Turning, as ’twere, to meet the Sun, enjoy from Indra all good things. When he who will be horn is born with power we look to treasures as our heritage.
verses.commentary: Sense: Turning, as ’twere, to meet the Sun, enjoy from Indra all good things. When he who will be horn is born with power we look to treasures as our heritage.

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒द्या दे॑वा॒ उदि॑ता॒ सूर्य॑स्य॒ निरᳪह॑सः पिपृ॒ता निर॑व॒द्यात् ।
तन्नो॑ मि॒त्रो वरु॑णो मामहन्ता॒मदि॑ति॒: सिन्धु॑: पृथि॒वी उ॒त द्यौ:
verses.translation: To-day, ye Gods, when Sûrya hath ascended, deliver us front trouble and dishonour. This boon may Varuna and Mitra grant us, and Aditi and Sindhu, Earth and Heaven.
verses.hindi: मधुच्छन्दा! की मधुर इच्छां निम्न शब्दों मे व्यक्त हुई ठै (क) मित्रत्मे सबके साथ स्नेहं करनेवाला बनँं। (ख) वरुणनमैं द्वेष का सदा वारण करनेवाला हो। (ग) मलों के क्षरण" से मेँ दीप्त बुद्धि को सिद्ध करूं (घृताचीं धियं) ओौर (ख) सव के प्रति स्नेहवाला बनकर द्वेष से सदा दूर रहता हुआ मैं सोमरक्षक बनूं।
verses.transliteration: adyā devā uditā sūryasya nirahasaḥ pipṛtā niravadyāt | tanno mitro varuṇo māmahantāmaditi: sindhu: pṛthivī uta dyau:
verses.wordMeaning: To-day, ye Gods, when Sûrya hath ascended, deliver us front trouble and dishonour. This boon may Varuna and Mitra grant us, and Aditi and Sindhu, Earth and Heaven.
verses.commentary: Sense: To-day, ye Gods, when Sûrya hath ascended, deliver us front trouble and dishonour. This boon may Varuna and Mitra grant us, and Aditi and Sindhu, Earth and Heaven.

verses.sanskrit:
आ कृ॒ष्णेन॒ रज॑सा॒ वर्त॑मानो निवे॒शय॑न्न॒मृतं॒ मर्त्यं॑ च ।
हि॒र॒ण्यये॑न सवि॒ता रथे॒ना दे॒वो या॑ति॒ भुव॑नानि॒ पश्य॑न्
verses.translation: Throughout the dusky firmament advancing, laying to rest the immortal and the mortal, Borne on his golden chariot he cometh, Savitar, God, beholding living creatures.
verses.hindi: प्रस्तुत मन्त्र मे मधुच्छन्दा की मधुर इच्छा यह है कि मेरे प्राण प्रभु का आदर्शं पत्नी के कर्तव्य-आदर्शं गृहिणी का गुणदशक १. मन्त्र का ऋषि कुशिक टै (कुशा+इक) का घोडे कौ लगाम, इक = वाला। इन््रियरूपी घोड़ों कौ लगामवाला। जिसने मनरूपी लगाम से इन्द्रियरूप घोड़ो को वश में
verses.transliteration: ā kṛṣṇena rajasā vartamāno niveśayannamṛtaṃ martyaṃ ca | hiraṇyayena savitā rathenā devo yāti bhuvanāni paśyan
verses.wordMeaning: Throughout the dusky firmament advancing, laying to rest the immortal and the mortal, Borne on his golden chariot he cometh, Savitar, God, beholding living creatures.
verses.commentary: Sense: Throughout the dusky firmament advancing, laying to rest the immortal and the mortal, Borne on his golden chariot he cometh, Savitar, God, beholding living creatures.

verses.sanskrit:
प्र वा॑वृजे सुप्र॒या ब॒र्हिरे॑षा॒मा वि॒श्पती॑व॒ व्वीरि॑ट इयाते ।
वि॒शाम॒क्तोरु॒षस॑: पू॒र्वहू॑तौ वा॒युः पू॒षा स्व॒स्तये॑ नि॒युत्वा॑न्
verses.translation: Soft to the tread the sacred grass is scattered: these go like Kings amid the band around them, At the folk's early call on Night and Morning,—Vâyu, and Pûshan with his team to bless us.
verses.hindi: हम प्रभु को अपना मार्गदर्शक बनाषं। एेसा करने पर हम भटकेगे नही। संसार संग्राम में पराजित नहीं होगे ओर सभी के साथ स्नेह करनेवाले बरनेँगे। पत्ति-पत्नी, राजा-रानी अथवा राजा व सेनापति ९. प्रस्तुत मन्त्र का देवता " इन्द्राग्नी ' है । “ इन्द्र" पति है उसने शक्तिशाली होना है ओर
verses.transliteration: pra vāvṛje suprayā barhireṣāmā viśpatīva vvīriṭa iyāte | viśāmaktoruṣasa: pūrvahūtau vāyuḥ pūṣā svastaye niyutvān
verses.wordMeaning: Soft to the tread the sacred grass is scattered: these go like Kings amid the band around them, At the folk's early call on Night and Morning,—Vâyu, and Pûshan with his team to bless us.
verses.commentary: Sense: Soft to the tread the sacred grass is scattered: these go like Kings amid the band around them, At the folk's early call on Night and Morning,—Vâyu, and Pûshan with his team to bless us.

verses.sanskrit: इ॒न्द्र॒वा॒यू बृह॒स्पतिं॑ मि॒त्राग्निं पू॒षणं भग॑म् । आ॒दि॒त्यान् मारु॑तं ग॒णम्
verses.translation: Indra, Vâyu, Brihaspati, Mitra, Agni, Pûshan, Bhaga, Âdityas, and the Marut host.
verses.hindi: प्रभु-उपासन के तीन लाभ है-पवित्रता, शक्ति व दिव्यता" विप्र का लक्षण विप्र बनने का उपाय १. प्रस्तुत मन्त्र का ऋषि विश्वामित्र है। यह सभी से प्रेम करता है। ह विश्वामित्र पहला काम ' अहि-हत्या' के रूप में करता हे। “ अहि" वृत्र है। ये दोनों शब्द समानार्थकः
verses.transliteration: indravāyū bṛhaspatiṃ mitrāgniṃ pūṣaṇaṃ bhagam | ādityān mārutaṃ gaṇam
verses.wordMeaning: Indra, Vâyu, Brihaspati, Mitra, Agni, Pûshan, Bhaga, Âdityas, and the Marut host.
verses.commentary: Sense: Indra, Vâyu, Brihaspati, Mitra, Agni, Pûshan, Bhaga, Âdityas, and the Marut host.

verses.sanskrit: वरु॑णः प्रावि॒ता भु॑वन्मि॒त्रो विश्वा॑भिरू॒तिभि॑: । कर॑तां नः सु॒राध॑सः
verses.translation: Be Varuna our chief defence, let Mitra guard us with all aids: Both make us rich exceedingly!
verses.hindi: विप्र वह दहै जो काम पर विजय पाता है, ईर्ष्या को नष्ट करता है, ज्लानय्ञ का विस्तार करता है, प्रभु प्राप्ति मे आनन्दानुभव करता है। विप्र बनने के लिए वह जितेन्द्रिय बनकर प्राणसाधना के द्वारा वीर्य की ऊर्ध्वगति के लिए प्रसत्नशील होता है। जनिंष्ठाऽ उग्रः सहसे तुराय॑ मन्द्रऽओजिंष्ठो बहुलाभि॑मानः।
verses.transliteration: varuṇaḥ prāvitā bhuvanmitro viśvābhirūtibhi: | karatāṃ naḥ surādhasaḥ
verses.wordMeaning: Be Varuna our chief defence, let Mitra guard us with all aids: Both make us rich exceedingly!
verses.commentary: Sense: Be Varuna our chief defence, let Mitra guard us with all aids: Both make us rich exceedingly!

verses.sanskrit:
अधि॑ न इन्द्रैषां॒ विष्णो॑ सजा॒त्या॒नाम् । इ॒ता मरु॑तो॒ अश्वि॑ना ।
तं प्र॒त्नथा॒ ऽयं वे॒नो ये दे॑वास॒ आ न॒ इडा॑भि॒र्विश्वे॑भिः सो॒म्यं मध्वोमा॑सश्चर्षणीधृतः
verses.translation: Regard us, Indra, Vishnu, here, ye Asvins, and the Marut host, us who are kith and kin to you. Thou in the first old time. See, Vena. O ye eleven Gods. Loved of all men, may Savitar. With the All-Gods. Ye Visvedevas who protect.
verses.hindi: हम जितेन्द्रिय बनें ओर अशुभ को दूर करके अपने जीवन को श्रीसम्पन्न जितेद्दरिय के लिए सव्र अनुकूल १. मनुष्य कर वार प्रतिकूलता कौ शिकायत करता टै ओर कहता है कि "ये लोग मेरे विरोधी है" या "यहाँ कौ जल-वायु मेरे अनुकूल नहीं ' ये दोनों ही बातें ठीक नहीं है।
verses.transliteration: adhi na indraiṣāṃ viṣṇo sajātyānām | itā maruto aśvinā | taṃ pratnathā 'yaṃ veno ye devāsa ā na iḍābhirviśvebhiḥ somyaṃ madhvomāsaścarṣaṇīdhṛtaḥ
verses.wordMeaning: Regard us, Indra, Vishnu, here, ye Asvins, and the Marut host, us who are kith and kin to you. Thou in the first old time. See, Vena. O ye eleven Gods. Loved of all men, may Savitar. With the All-Gods. Ye Visvedevas who protect.
verses.commentary: Sense: Regard us, Indra, Vishnu, here, ye Asvins, and the Marut host, us who are kith and kin to you. Thou in the first old time. See, Vena. O ye eleven Gods. Loved of all men, may Savitar. With the All-Gods. Ye Visvedevas who protect.

verses.sanskrit:
अग्न॒ इन्द्र॒ वरु॑ण॒ मित्र॒ देवा॒: शर्ध॒: प्र य॑न्त॒ मारु॑तो॒त वि॑ष्णो ।
उ॒भा नास॑त्या रु॒द्रो अध॒ ग्नाः पू॒षा भग॒: सर॑स्वती जुषन्त
verses.translation: O Agni, Indra, Varuna, and Mitra, give, O ye Gods, and Marut host, and Vishnu. May both Nâsatyas, Rudra, heavenly Matrons, Pûshan, Sarasvatî, Bhaga accept us.
verses.hindi: किया हुआ यज्ञ सुख के रूप में परिवर्तित होकर यज्ञकर्ता के प्रति लौट हिर॑ण्यजिह्वः सुविताय नव्य॑से रक्षा माक्छि्नोऽअघश॑सऽ ईत ।॥६९॥ १. "आदित्य ब्रह्मचारी लोगों को कल्याणी मति प्राप्त करानेवाले हों ', इन शब्दों पर पिछला मन्त्र समाप्त हुआ भा। वह आदित्य ब्रह्मचारी स्वयं अपने जीवन को सुन्दर बनाने
verses.transliteration: agna indra varuṇa mitra devā: śardha: pra yanta mārutota viṣṇo | ubhā nāsatyā rudro adha gnāḥ pūṣā bhaga: sarasvatī juṣanta
verses.wordMeaning: O Agni, Indra, Varuna, and Mitra, give, O ye Gods, and Marut host, and Vishnu. May both Nâsatyas, Rudra, heavenly Matrons, Pûshan, Sarasvatî, Bhaga accept us.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Agni, Indra, Varuna, and Mitra, give, O ye Gods, and Marut host, and Vishnu. May both Nâsatyas, Rudra, heavenly Matrons, Pûshan, Sarasvatî, Bhaga accept us.

verses.sanskrit:
इ॒न्द्रा॒ग्नी मि॒त्रावरु॒णादि॑ति॒ᳪ स्व॑: पृथि॒वीं द्यां म॒रुत॒: पर्व॑ताँ२ अ॒पः ।
हु॒वे विष्णुं॑ पू॒षणं॒ ब्रह्म॑ण॒स्पतिं॒ भगं॒ नु शᳪस॑ᳪ सवि॒तार॑मू॒तये॑
verses.translation: Indra, Agni, Mitra, Varuna, Aditi, the Waters, Mountains, Maruts, Sky, and Earth and Heaven, Vishnu I call, Pûshan and Brahmanaspati, and Bhaga, Samsa, Savitar that they may help.
verses.hindi: हम अपने जीवनो में शक्ति भरके ओरौ में भी शक्ति का सञ्चार करनैवाले वह॑ वायो नियुतो याह्यच्छा पिबा सुतस्यान्ध॑सो मदाय ॥७०॥ १. पिछले मन्त्र मे भारद्वाज ने प्रभु से प्रार्थना की थी कि प्रभु उसको रक्षा करे। प्रस्तुत कौ प्रेरणा देते है। २. प्रभु एक गृहस्थ से कहते है कि वाम्-पति-पत्नी तुम दोनों के मलों
verses.transliteration: indrāgnī mitrāvaruṇāditi sva: pṛthivīṃ dyāṃ maruta: parvatā~2 apaḥ | huve viṣṇuṃ pūṣaṇaṃ brahmaṇaspatiṃ bhagaṃ nu śasa savitāramūtaye
verses.wordMeaning: Indra, Agni, Mitra, Varuna, Aditi, the Waters, Mountains, Maruts, Sky, and Earth and Heaven, Vishnu I call, Pûshan and Brahmanaspati, and Bhaga, Samsa, Savitar that they may help.
verses.commentary: Sense: Indra, Agni, Mitra, Varuna, Aditi, the Waters, Mountains, Maruts, Sky, and Earth and Heaven, Vishnu I call, Pûshan and Brahmanaspati, and Bhaga, Samsa, Savitar that they may help.

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒स्मे रु॒द्रा मे॒हना॒ पर्व॑तासो वृत्र॒हत्ये॒ भर॑हूतौ स॒जोषा॑: ।
यः शᳪस॑ते स्तुव॒ते धायि॑ प॒ज्र इन्द्र॑ज्येष्ठा अ॒स्माँ२ अ॑वन्तु दे॒वाः
verses.translation: With us are raining Rudras, clouds accordant in call to battle at the death of Vritra, The strong, assigned to him who sings and praises. May Gods with Indra as their chief protect us.
verses.hindi: सोमपान द्वारा हम सब मलों का विदीर्ण करनेवाले वनँ तथा उल्लासयुक्त होकर लक्ष्य की ओर बते चले। गावऽ उपावतावतं मही य॒ज्ञस्य॑ रप्सुद। । उभा कर्णी हिरण्यर्या॥।७९॥ वसिष्ठ वेदबाणियों को सम्बोधित करते हए कहता है कि गावः=हे वेदवाणियो
verses.transliteration: asme rudrā mehanā parvatāso vṛtrahatye bharahūtau sajoṣā: | yaḥ śasate stuvate dhāyi pajra indrajyeṣṭhā asmā~2 avantu devāḥ
verses.wordMeaning: With us are raining Rudras, clouds accordant in call to battle at the death of Vritra, The strong, assigned to him who sings and praises. May Gods with Indra as their chief protect us.
verses.commentary: Sense: With us are raining Rudras, clouds accordant in call to battle at the death of Vritra, The strong, assigned to him who sings and praises. May Gods with Indra as their chief protect us.

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒र्वाञ्चो॑ अ॒द्या भ॑वता यजत्रा॒ आ वो॒ हार्दि॒ भय॑मानो व्ययेयम् ।
त्राध्वं॑ नो देवा नि॒जुरो॒ वृक॑स्य॒ त्राध्वं॑ क॒र्ताद॑व॒पदो॑ यजत्राः
verses.translation: Turn yourselves hitherward this day, ye Holy, that fearing in my heart I may approach you. Protect us, Gods, let not the wolf destroy us. Save us, ye Holy, from the pit and falling.
verses.hindi: हम अपने सधस्थघर को "दक्ष का दुरोण" बनाने का प्रयत्न करे। हैव्यांवध्वर्यूऽआ ग॑त रथेन सूर्यत्वचा । मध्वा यज्ञ सम॑ञ्जाथे।।७३॥ प्रस्तुत मन्त्र का ऋषि भी "दक्ष" हे। पिछले मन्त्र के पति-पत्नी का ही यहाँ भी उल्लेख हे। वे ९. हैव्यौ =देवस्य इमौप्रभु के हों, अर्थात् इनका स्ुकाव प्रकृति की ओर
verses.transliteration: arvāñco adyā bhavatā yajatrā ā vo hārdi bhayamāno vyayeyam | trādhvaṃ no devā nijuro vṛkasya trādhvaṃ kartādavapado yajatrāḥ
verses.wordMeaning: Turn yourselves hitherward this day, ye Holy, that fearing in my heart I may approach you. Protect us, Gods, let not the wolf destroy us. Save us, ye Holy, from the pit and falling.
verses.commentary: Sense: Turn yourselves hitherward this day, ye Holy, that fearing in my heart I may approach you. Protect us, Gods, let not the wolf destroy us. Save us, ye Holy, from the pit and falling.

verses.sanskrit:
विश्वे॑ अ॒द्य म॒रुतो॒ विश्व॑ ऊ॒ती विश्वे॑ भवन्त्व॒ग्नय॒: समि॑द्धाः ।
विश्वे॑ नो दे॒वा अव॒सा ग॑मन्तु॒ विश्व॑मस्तु॒ द्रवि॑णं॒ वाजो॑ अ॒स्मे
verses.translation: This day come all the Maruts, etc., as in XVIII. 31.
verses.hindi: पति-पत्नी अपने कर्तव्यो को समञ्च ओर उनका पालन करे। १. एषाम्=इन प्रजाओं की, जिनके लिए गतत मन्त्र मे हैव्य व अध्वर्यु! बनने का उल्लेख है, रश्मिः-वासना, सांसारिक वस्तुओं के प्रति रस तिरश्चीन: विततः=आर पार (ल०५5५७९) कैला हुआ है। किसी की किसी लोक को प्राप्त करने की कामना है ओर
verses.transliteration: viśve adya maruto viśva ūtī viśve bhavantvagnaya: samiddhāḥ | viśve no devā avasā gamantu viśvamastu draviṇaṃ vājo asme
verses.wordMeaning: This day come all the Maruts, etc., as in XVIII. 31.
verses.commentary: Sense: This day come all the Maruts, etc., as in XVIII. 31.

verses.sanskrit:
विश्वे॑ देवाः शृणु॒तेमᳪ हवं॑ मे॒ ये अ॒न्तरि॑क्षे॒ य उप॒ द्यवि॒ ष्ठ ।
ये अ॑ग्निजि॒ह्वा उ॒त वा॒ यज॑त्रा आ॒सद्या॒स्मिन्ब॒र्हिषि॑ मादयध्वम्
verses.translation: Listen, All-Gods, to this mine invocation, ye who inhabit heaven and air's mid-region. All ye; O Holy Ones, whose tongue is Agni, seated upon this sacred grass be joyful.
verses.hindi: हमारी वासनां नीचे कौ ओर न जाकर ऊपर उठे ओर हम प्रजापति बन -विशूवासित्र का स्वर्ग-निर्माण-प्रेम+कर्मस्वर्ग १. प्रस्तुत मन्त्र का ऋषि विश्वामित्र है। यह सभी से स्नेह करता हे, इसका किसी से भी द्वेष नही। रोदसीजद्युलोक व पृथिवीलोक को, अर्थात् सभी प्राणियों को आसर्वभा
verses.transliteration: viśve devāḥ śṛṇutema havaṃ me ye antarikṣe ya upa dyavi ṣṭha | ye agnijihvā uta vā yajatrā āsadyāsminbarhiṣi mādayadhvam
verses.wordMeaning: Listen, All-Gods, to this mine invocation, ye who inhabit heaven and air's mid-region. All ye; O Holy Ones, whose tongue is Agni, seated upon this sacred grass be joyful.
verses.commentary: Sense: Listen, All-Gods, to this mine invocation, ye who inhabit heaven and air's mid-region. All ye; O Holy Ones, whose tongue is Agni, seated upon this sacred grass be joyful.

verses.sanskrit:
दे॒वेभ्यो॒ हि प्र॑थ॒मं य॒ज्ञिये॑भ्योऽमृत॒त्वᳪ सु॒वसि॑ भा॒गमु॑त्त॒मम् ।
आदिद्दा॒मान॑ᳪ सवित॒र्व्यू॒र्णुषेऽनूची॒ना जी॑वि॒ता मानु॑षेभ्यः
verses.translation: For thou at first producest for the holy Gods the noblest of all portions, immortality. Thereafter as a gift to men, O Savitar, thou openest existence, life succeeding life.
verses.hindi: आदर्श गृह मे पति “इन्द्र' होता है आओौर पत्नी "अग्नि" पुत्रों के त्निए पवित्र कामना उप॑ नः सूनवो गिर॑: शृण्वन्त्वमृतस्य ये । सुमृडीका भ॑वन्तु नः।।७७॥ पिच्छले मन्त्र में वर्णित पति-पत्नी प्रार्थना करते है कि-ये=जो नः हमारे सूनवः =पुत्र
verses.transliteration: devebhyo hi prathamaṃ yajñiyebhyo'mṛtatva suvasi bhāgamuttamam | ādiddāmāna savitarvyūrṇuṣe'nūcīnā jīvitā mānuṣebhyaḥ
verses.wordMeaning: For thou at first producest for the holy Gods the noblest of all portions, immortality. Thereafter as a gift to men, O Savitar, thou openest existence, life succeeding life.
verses.commentary: Sense: For thou at first producest for the holy Gods the noblest of all portions, immortality. Thereafter as a gift to men, O Savitar, thou openest existence, life succeeding life.

verses.sanskrit:
प्र वा॒युमच्छा॑ बृह॒ती म॑नी॒षा बृ॒हद्र॑यिं वि॒श्ववा॑रᳪ रथ॒प्राम् ।
द्यु॒तद्या॑मा नि॒युत॒: पत्य॑मानः क॒विः क॒विमि॑यक्षसि प्रयज्यो
verses.translation: I with a lofty song call hither Vâyu all-bounteous, filler of his car, most wealthy. Thou, Sage, with bright path, Lord of harnessed horses, impetuous, promptly honourest the prudent.
verses.hindi: हमारी सन्तान स्वाध्याय-रुचि बने, जिससे उनके जीवन उत्तम रहे । आ शांसते प्रति हर्यन्त्युक्थेमा हरीं वहतस्ता नोऽअच्छ।।७८॥ १. मे=मेरी मतयः= मतिर्या, इच्छा, विचारपूर्वक निश्चित कौ गई कामना ब्रह्माणि (ब्रह्य वेदः, तपः, तत्त्वम्) =वेद, तप व तत्तव (वास्तविक सत्ता) को आशासते चाहती है
verses.transliteration: pra vāyumacchā bṛhatī manīṣā bṛhadrayiṃ viśvavāra rathaprām | dyutadyāmā niyuta: patyamānaḥ kaviḥ kavimiyakṣasi prayajyo
verses.wordMeaning: I with a lofty song call hither Vâyu all-bounteous, filler of his car, most wealthy. Thou, Sage, with bright path, Lord of harnessed horses, impetuous, promptly honourest the prudent.
verses.commentary: Sense: I with a lofty song call hither Vâyu all-bounteous, filler of his car, most wealthy. Thou, Sage, with bright path, Lord of harnessed horses, impetuous, promptly honourest the prudent.

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्र॑वायू इ॒मे सु॒ता उप॒ प्रयो॑भि॒रा ग॑तम् । इन्द॑वो वामु॒शन्ति॒ हि
verses.translation: These, Indra-Vâyu, have been shed, etc., as in VII. 8.
verses.hindi: अगस्त्यत=पाप-समूह का संहार करनेवाला बनने का उपाय यह है कि हम बुद्धि को ज्ञानोपार्जन में लगार्प, शरीर को सोमरक्षा से नीरोग बना ओर इन्द्रियों को प्रभु-स्तवन में प्रेरित करं। अगस्त्य का प्रभ्रुवन्दन
verses.transliteration: indravāyū ime sutā upa prayobhirā gatam | indavo vāmuśanti hi
verses.wordMeaning: These, Indra-Vâyu, have been shed, etc., as in VII. 8.
verses.commentary: Sense: These, Indra-Vâyu, have been shed, etc., as in VII. 8.

verses.sanskrit: मि॒त्रᳪ हु॑वे पू॒तद॑क्षं॒ वरु॑णं च रि॒शाद॑सम् । धियं॑ घृ॒ताची॒ᳪ साध॑न्ता
verses.translation: Mitra of holy strength I call, and foe-destroying Varuna, Who make the oil-fed rite complete.
verses.hindi: प्रभु सर्वप्ररक हे, सर्वज्ञ है, सर्वमहान् है। उनका स्तवन करता हुआ मै जपने जीवन- निर्माण का भार भी उन्दीं पर छोड्ता दू ९. तत्= वह दूर-से-दूर भी वर्तमान, ( तत्") सर्वव्यापक प्रभु (तनु विस्तारे) इत्= निश्चय से भुवनेषु=सारे लोकों में ज्येष्ठम्-बडे जआसहै। प्रभु सर्वव्यापक हैँ, सर्वमहान् है।
verses.transliteration: mitra huve pūtadakṣaṃ varuṇaṃ ca riśādasam | dhiyaṃ ghṛtācī sādhantā
verses.wordMeaning: Mitra of holy strength I call, and foe-destroying Varuna, Who make the oil-fed rite complete.
verses.commentary: Sense: Mitra of holy strength I call, and foe-destroying Varuna, Who make the oil-fed rite complete.

verses.sanskrit:
दस्रा॑ यु॒वाक॑वः सु॒ता नास॑त्या वृ॒क्तब॑र्हिषः । आ या॑तᳪ रुद्रवर्तनी ।। तं प्र॒त्नथा॒ ऽयं वे॒नः ।। ५ ८  ।।
वि॒दद्यदी॑ स॒रमा॑ रु॒ग्णमद्रे॒र्महि॒ पाथ॑: पू॒र्व्यᳪ स॒ध्र्य॒क्कः ।
अग्रं॑ नयत्सु॒पद्यक्ष॑राणा॒मच्छा॒ रवं॑ प्रथ॒मा जा॑न॒ती गा॑त्
verses.translation: When Saramâ had, found the mountain's fissure, that vast and ancient place she plundered thoroughly . In the floods’ van she led them forth, light-footed: she who well knew came first unto their lowing.
verses.hindi: हम प्रभु की ज्येष्ठता को अनुभव करे, प्रभु के सम्पर्क सखे दीप्तबलवाले चनें, शत्रुजों का संहार करे, आनन्द का लाभ करनेवाले हों। ९. ' मेधातिथि ' वह व्यक्ति है जो इस संसार में बुद्धिपूर्वक चलता है। समञ्चदार व्यक्ति सर्वत्र प्रभु की शक्ति को अनुभव करता है ओर निम्न शब्दो में प्रभु का स्तवन करता हे
verses.transliteration: dasrā yuvākavaḥ sutā nāsatyā vṛktabarhiṣaḥ | ā yāta rudravartanī || taṃ pratnathā 'yaṃ venaḥ || 5 8 || vidadyadī saramā rugṇamadrermahi pātha: pūrvya sadhryakkaḥ | agraṃ nayatsupadyakṣarāṇāmacchā ravaṃ prathamā jānatī gāt
verses.wordMeaning: When Saramâ had, found the mountain's fissure, that vast and ancient place she plundered thoroughly . In the floods’ van she led them forth, light-footed: she who well knew came first unto their lowing.
verses.commentary: Sense: When Saramâ had, found the mountain's fissure, that vast and ancient place she plundered thoroughly . In the floods’ van she led them forth, light-footed: she who well knew came first unto their lowing.

verses.sanskrit:
न॒हि स्पश॒मवि॑दन्न॒न्यम॒स्माद्वै॑श्वान॒रात्पु॑र ए॒तार॑म॒ग्नेः ।
एमे॑नमवृधन्न॒मृता॒ अम॑र्त्यं वैश्वान॒रं क्षै॑त्रजित्याय दे॒वाः
verses.translation: For nowhere did they find another envoy to lead the way than this Vaisvânara Agni. The Gods immortal strengthened the immortal Vaisvânara to win the land in battle.
verses.hindi: हम सदा प्रभु- स्तवन करनेवाले हों। हमारी कोई भी क्रिया प्रभु को भूलकर नहो तो हम स्वस्थ बनेगे, निर्देष होगे ओर तीव्र बुद्धि का सम्पादन कर पार्णँगे। १. मेधातिथि ‹ विपश्चित्" बनकर अनुभव करता है कि प्रभु तो वे है यस्य-जिसका अयम् विश्वः यह सारा संसार है, चाहे वे आर्यः =ब्राह्यण है (आर्यो ब्राह्यणकु मारयो : )
verses.transliteration: nahi spaśamavidannanyamasmādvaiśvānarātpura etāramagneḥ | emenamavṛdhannamṛtā amartyaṃ vaiśvānaraṃ kṣaitrajityāya devāḥ
verses.wordMeaning: For nowhere did they find another envoy to lead the way than this Vaisvânara Agni. The Gods immortal strengthened the immortal Vaisvânara to win the land in battle.
verses.commentary: Sense: For nowhere did they find another envoy to lead the way than this Vaisvânara Agni. The Gods immortal strengthened the immortal Vaisvânara to win the land in battle.

verses.sanskrit: उ॒ग्रा वि॑घ॒निना॒ मृध॑ इन्द्रा॒ग्नी ह॑वामहे । ता नो॑ मृडात ई॒दृशे॑
verses.translation: The strong, dispellers of the foe, Indra and Agni, we invoke: May they be kind to one like me.
verses.hindi: सभी व्यक्ति प्रभुके है। सर्वत्र प्रभु की ज्योति ही दीप्तिका कारण बन रही सत्यः सोऽअ॑स्य महिमा गुणे शवो यज्ञेषुं विप्रराज्ये ।॥८३॥ १. संसार मे कभी-कभी इस प्रकार के व्यक्ति भी दिख जाते है, जिनके लिए वेद कहता है कि “तितिश्चन्ते अथिशस्तिं जनानाम् "= लोगो के अपशब्दं को मुस्कराते हए सह
verses.transliteration: ugrā vighaninā mṛdha indrāgnī havāmahe | tā no mṛḍāta īdṛśe
verses.wordMeaning: The strong, dispellers of the foe, Indra and Agni, we invoke: May they be kind to one like me.
verses.commentary: Sense: The strong, dispellers of the foe, Indra and Agni, we invoke: May they be kind to one like me.

verses.sanskrit: उपा॑स्मै गायता नर॒: पव॑माना॒येन्द॑वे । अ॒भि दे॒वाँ२ इय॑क्षते
verses.translation: Sing forth to Indu, O ye men, to him as he is purified, Fain to pay worship to the Gods.
verses.hindi: प्रभु का रक्षण अदब्ध व शिव है। प्रभु की प्रेरणा हितरमणीय है। उसका सुननेवाला शुभमार्ग से विचलित नहीं होता ओर दुष्टो कौ बातों से बहक नहीं जाता। ऋषि :-जमदग्निः। देवता- वायुः। छन्दः-विराडवृहती। स्वरः मध्यमः॥ आ नो यज्ञं दिविस्पृशं वायो याहि सुमन्म॑भिः।
verses.transliteration: upāsmai gāyatā nara: pavamānāyendave | abhi devā~2 iyakṣate
verses.wordMeaning: Sing forth to Indu, O ye men, to him as he is purified, Fain to pay worship to the Gods.
verses.commentary: Sense: Sing forth to Indu, O ye men, to him as he is purified, Fain to pay worship to the Gods.

verses.sanskrit:
ये त्वा॑ऽहि॒हत्ये॑ मघव॒न्नव॑र्ध॒न्ये शा॑म्ब॒रे ह॑रिवो॒ ये गवि॑ष्टौ ।
ये त्वा॑ नू॒नम॑नु॒मद॑न्ति॒ विप्रा॒: पिबे॑न्द्र॒ सोम॒ᳪ सग॑णो म॒रुद्भि॑:
verses.translation: Drink Soma, Indra, handed with the Maruts who, Boon Lord! strengthened thee at Ahi's slaughter, ’Gainst Sambara, Lord of Bays! in winning cattle, and now rejoice in thee, the holy singers.
verses.hindi: हमारा जीवन "जमदग्नि, तापस, जमदग्नि" का जीवन हो। १. प्रस्तुत मन्त्र का देवता ' अश्वनौ ' प्राणापान ठैँ। इनकी साधना करके इनको अपने शमे करनेवाला " वशिष्ठ" प्रस्तुत मन्त्र का ऋषि है। यह प्रार्थना करता ठै-२. हे अश्विना=प्राणापानो! आयातम् सर्वत्र प्राप्त होवो। “ अश् व्याप्तौ ' से आश्विनी शब्द् बना
verses.transliteration: ye tvā'hihatye maghavannavardhanye śāmbare harivo ye gaviṣṭau | ye tvā nūnamanumadanti viprā: pibendra soma sagaṇo marudbhi:
verses.wordMeaning: Drink Soma, Indra, handed with the Maruts who, Boon Lord! strengthened thee at Ahi's slaughter, ’Gainst Sambara, Lord of Bays! in winning cattle, and now rejoice in thee, the holy singers.
verses.commentary: Sense: Drink Soma, Indra, handed with the Maruts who, Boon Lord! strengthened thee at Ahi's slaughter, ’Gainst Sambara, Lord of Bays! in winning cattle, and now rejoice in thee, the holy singers.

verses.sanskrit:
जनि॑ष्ठा उ॒ग्रः सह॑से तु॒राय॑ म॒न्द्र ओजि॑ष्ठो बहु॒लाभि॑मानः ।
अव॑र्ध॒न्निन्द्रं॑ म॒रुत॑श्चि॒दत्र॑ मा॒ता यद्वी॒रं द॒धन॒द्धनि॑ष्ठा
verses.translation: Thou vast born mighty for victorious valour, exulting, strongest, full of pride and courage. There, even there the Maruts strengthened Indra when his most rapid Mother stirred the Hero.
verses.hindi: प्राणापान कौ साधना द्वारा वसिष्ठ बनकर हम कण कण करक्र अच्छायो का संग्रह करनेवाले बनें। हमारा मस्तिष्क ब्रह्मणस्पति का निवास-स्थान हो. हदय सूनृता देवी का तथा हाथ यज्ञो के आश्रय बने। १. पिछले मन्त्र का कण्व ' सान, सत्य व यक्ल' का विस्तार करके “त्रीन् तनोती इति
verses.transliteration: janiṣṭhā ugraḥ sahase turāya mandra ojiṣṭho bahulābhimānaḥ | avardhannindraṃ marutaścidatra mātā yadvīraṃ dadhanaddhaniṣṭhā
verses.wordMeaning: Thou vast born mighty for victorious valour, exulting, strongest, full of pride and courage. There, even there the Maruts strengthened Indra when his most rapid Mother stirred the Hero.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thou vast born mighty for victorious valour, exulting, strongest, full of pride and courage. There, even there the Maruts strengthened Indra when his most rapid Mother stirred the Hero.

verses.sanskrit: आ तू न॑ इन्द्र वृत्रहन्न॒स्माक॑म॒र्धमा ग॑हि । म॒हान्म॒हीभि॑रू॒तिभि॑:
verses.translation: O thou who slewest Vritra, come, O Indra, hither to our side, Mighty One with thy mighty aids.
verses.hindi: इस त्रित के जीवन मे तीन बातें है (क) यह प्रसत्रतापूर्वक कर्मो मे लगा रहता है (ख) ज्ञान में अपना शोधन करता है, ज्ञान- सम्पत्ति को बद्धाता है (ग) सदा देवंदेवं वोऽव॑से देवं देवमभिष्य्ये। देवदेवः हवेम वाज॑सातये गृणन्तो देव्या धिया ।॥९९॥
verses.transliteration: ā tū na indra vṛtrahannasmākamardhamā gahi | mahānmahībhirūtibhi:
verses.wordMeaning: O thou who slewest Vritra, come, O Indra, hither to our side, Mighty One with thy mighty aids.
verses.commentary: Sense: O thou who slewest Vritra, come, O Indra, hither to our side, Mighty One with thy mighty aids.

verses.sanskrit:
त्वमि॑न्द्र॒ प्रतू॑र्तिष्व॒भि विश्वा॑ असि॒ स्पृध॑: ।
अ॒श॒स्ति॒हा ज॑नि॒ता वि॑श्व॒तूर॑सि॒ त्वं तू॑र्य तरुष्य॒तः
verses.translation: Thou in thy battles, Indra, art subduer of all hostile bands. Father art thou, all-conquering, cancelling the curse: vanquish the men who fight with us.
verses.hindi: मनु'-एक समञ्जदार व्यक्ति दिव्यगुणों को धारण करता है, जिससे उसका शरीर नीरोग हो पाए, उसका मन वासनाओं पर आक्रमण कर, उन्हें पराजित कर सके ओर वह ५ का धारण कर पाए। इसी उदेश्य से वह बुद्धिपूर्वक प्रभु नाम-स्मरण में प्रवृत्त ९. पिछले मन्त्र का मनु इस मन्त्र मे "मेध ' (मेध संगमे) लोगों से सम्पर्क करनेवाला
verses.transliteration: tvamindra pratūrtiṣvabhi viśvā asi spṛdha: | aśastihā janitā viśvatūrasi tvaṃ tūrya taruṣyataḥ
verses.wordMeaning: Thou in thy battles, Indra, art subduer of all hostile bands. Father art thou, all-conquering, cancelling the curse: vanquish the men who fight with us.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thou in thy battles, Indra, art subduer of all hostile bands. Father art thou, all-conquering, cancelling the curse: vanquish the men who fight with us.

verses.sanskrit:
अनु॑ ते॒ शुष्मं॑ तु॒रय॑न्तमीयतुः क्षो॒णी शिशुं॒ न मा॒तरा॑ ।
विश्वा॑स्ते॒ स्पृध॑: श्नथयन्त म॒न्यवे॑ वृ॒त्रं यदि॑न्द्र॒ तूर्व॑सि
verses.translation: Heaven and Earth cling close to thy victorious might As sire and mother to their child.
verses.hindi: हम अपने जीवन को "मेध" का जीवन बना ओर संसार में प्रकाश १. ' इन्द्राग्नी ' शब्द द्विवचन हे, परन्तु मन्त्रके अगले “ अपात्", “इयं ' आदि सब शब्द एकवचन हैँ, अतः “इन्द्र॒ ओर अग्नि" अर्थ न करके हम “इन्द्र कौ अग्नि" अर्थ लेगे। घर में पुरुष ने “इन्द्र' होना, अर्थात् पति को सदा जितेन्द्रिय होना। इसकी पत्नी अग्नि हे, घर
verses.transliteration: anu te śuṣmaṃ turayantamīyatuḥ kṣoṇī śiśuṃ na mātarā | viśvāste spṛdha: śnathayanta manyave vṛtraṃ yadindra tūrvasi
verses.wordMeaning: Heaven and Earth cling close to thy victorious might As sire and mother to their child.
verses.commentary: Sense: Heaven and Earth cling close to thy victorious might As sire and mother to their child.

verses.sanskrit:
य॒ज्ञो दे॒वानां॒ प्रत्ये॑ति सु॒म्नमादि॑त्यासो॒ भव॑ता मृड॒यन्त॑: ।
आ वो॒ऽर्वाची॑ सुम॒तिर्व॑वृत्याद॒ᳪहो॑श्चि॒द्या व॑रिवो॒वित्त॒रास॑त्
verses.translation: The sacrifice obtains the Gods’ acceptance, etc., as in VIII. 4.
verses.hindi: हमे देवताओं का सम्पर्कं प्राप्त हो ओर हम ज्ञानरूप धन को प्राप्त करनेवाले देवास्त॑ऽ इन्द्र स॒ख्याय॑ येपिरे बृहद्भानो मरुद्गण ।॥ ९८५॥ ९. गत मन्त्र का मनु देवों से देवत्व प्राप्त करके अव नृमेध बनता है, ओरों के सम्पर्क मे आकर उनके हित में प्रवृत्त होता है। २. यह नृमेध अभिश्णस्तीः-सब प्रकार की दिसाओ
verses.transliteration: yajño devānāṃ pratyeti sumnamādityāso bhavatā mṛḍayanta: | ā vo'rvācī sumatirvavṛtyādahościdyā varivovittarāsat
verses.wordMeaning: The sacrifice obtains the Gods’ acceptance, etc., as in VIII. 4.
verses.commentary: Sense: The sacrifice obtains the Gods’ acceptance, etc., as in VIII. 4.

verses.sanskrit:
अद॑ब्धेभिः सवितः पा॒युभि॒ष्ट्वᳪ शि॒वेभि॑र॒द्य परि॑ पाहि नो॒ गय॑म् ।
हिर॑ण्यजिह्वः सुवि॒ताय॒ नव्य॑से॒ रक्षा॒ माकि॑र्नो अ॒घश॑ᳪस ईशत
verses.translation: Protect our habitation, Savitar, this day with guardian aids around, propitious, ne’er beguiled. God of the golden tongue, keep us for newest bliss: let not the evil-wisher have us in his power.
verses.hindi: ठम दिसा से दूर रटे, बुराइयों को नष्ट करे, लानधन को प्राप्त करे, प्राणसाधना से देवों कौ अनुकूलता का सम्पादन करके प्रभु के सखा बने। प्राणों का ब्रह्मार्चन-छातपर्व वचर ९. है मरुतः=प्राणो! वः=अपने बृहते=लान का वर्धन करनेवाले इन्द्राय इन्द्रियों क
verses.transliteration: adabdhebhiḥ savitaḥ pāyubhiṣṭva śivebhiradya pari pāhi no gayam | hiraṇyajihvaḥ suvitāya navyase rakṣā mākirno aghaśasa īśata
verses.wordMeaning: Protect our habitation, Savitar, this day with guardian aids around, propitious, ne’er beguiled. God of the golden tongue, keep us for newest bliss: let not the evil-wisher have us in his power.
verses.commentary: Sense: Protect our habitation, Savitar, this day with guardian aids around, propitious, ne’er beguiled. God of the golden tongue, keep us for newest bliss: let not the evil-wisher have us in his power.

verses.sanskrit:
प्र वी॑र॒या शुच॑यो दद्रिरे वामध्व॒र्युभि॒र्मधु॑मन्तः सु॒तास॑: ।
वह॑ वायो नि॒युतो॑ या॒ह्यच्छा॒ पिबा॑ सु॒तस्यान्ध॑सो॒ मदा॑य
verses.translation: For you have flowed, through noble ministration, pressed by Adhvaryus, bright sweet-flavoured juices. Drive on thy team and come thou hither, Vâyu: drink for thy rapture of the sap of Soma.
verses.hindi: हम प्रभु के बने, शक्तिशाली हों, प्रभु का स्तवन करे ओौर उन्नत हो।
verses.transliteration: pra vīrayā śucayo dadrire vāmadhvaryubhirmadhumantaḥ sutāsa: | vaha vāyo niyuto yāhyacchā pibā sutasyāndhaso madāya
verses.wordMeaning: For you have flowed, through noble ministration, pressed by Adhvaryus, bright sweet-flavoured juices. Drive on thy team and come thou hither, Vâyu: drink for thy rapture of the sap of Soma.
verses.commentary: Sense: For you have flowed, through noble ministration, pressed by Adhvaryus, bright sweet-flavoured juices. Drive on thy team and come thou hither, Vâyu: drink for thy rapture of the sap of Soma.

verses.sanskrit: गाव॒ उपा॑वताव॒तं म॒ही य॒ज्ञस्य॑ र॒प्सुदा॑ । उ॒भा कर्णा॑ हिर॒ण्यया॑
verses.translation: Ye Cows, protect, etc., as in verse 14.
verses.hindi: लक्ष्मी व श्रीरूप धात्रियों का दुग्धपान करके हम हरि, स्वाधावान्, शुक्र व सुवर्चाः" बनें। हम सब दुःखों से दूर हो, अपना धारण करने में समर्थ हो, देदीप्यमान व प्रभु के प्रिय कौन? (प्रभु का प्रकाश क्िनमे?) अयपिह प्रथमो धायि धातुभिर्होता यजिंष्टोऽअध्वरेष्वीङ्यंः ।
verses.transliteration: gāva upāvatāvataṃ mahī yajñasya rapsudā | ubhā karṇā hiraṇyayā
verses.wordMeaning: Ye Cows, protect, etc., as in verse 14.
verses.commentary: Sense: Ye Cows, protect, etc., as in verse 14.

verses.sanskrit: काव्य॑योरा॒जाने॑षु॒ क्रत्वा॒ दक्ष॑स्य दुरो॒णे । रि॒शाद॑सा स॒धस्थ॒ आ
verses.translation: Come ye foe-slayers to the place of meeting, to the birth-places of the two great Sages, With force of intellect unto the dwelling.
verses.hindi: हम जितेन्द्रियता व प्राणसाधना के द्वारा "सौम्य मधु' (वीर्य) का पान करनेवाले बनें, जिससे अपने मित्र उस प्रभु के तेजों से तेजस्वी बन सकं। आ यदिषे नुपत्तिं तेजऽआनट् शुचि रेतो निषिक्तं द्यौरभीके। अग्निः श्ध॑मनवद्यं युवान स्वाध्यं जनयत्सुद य॑च्च।। ९९॥
verses.transliteration: kāvyayorājāneṣu kratvā dakṣasya duroṇe | riśādasā sadhastha ā
verses.wordMeaning: Come ye foe-slayers to the place of meeting, to the birth-places of the two great Sages, With force of intellect unto the dwelling.
verses.commentary: Sense: Come ye foe-slayers to the place of meeting, to the birth-places of the two great Sages, With force of intellect unto the dwelling.

verses.sanskrit:
दै॑व्यावध्वर्यू॒ आ ग॑त॒ᳪ रथे॑न॒ सूर्य॑त्वचा । मध्वा॑ य॒ज्ञᳪ सम॑ञ्जाथे ।
तं प्र॒त्नथा॒  ऽयं वे॒नः
verses.translation: Ye two divine Adhvaryus, etc., as in verse 33. Thou in the time of old. See, Vena.
verses.hindi: प्रभु प्रेरणा से जितेन्द्रिय बन हम ऊर्ध्वरेतस् वनँ. लानाग्नि को दीप्त कर प्रभु-दर्शन करे। वासनाओं को सुदूर विशरण करनेवाला व्यक्ति ही "पराशर" हे। प्रभु का आशीर्वाद व देश सं जास्पत्य: सुयममा करणुष्व शत्रूयतामभि तिष्ठा महाश्परसि ॥९२॥
verses.transliteration: daivyāvadhvaryū ā gata rathena sūryatvacā | madhvā yajña samañjāthe | taṃ pratnathā 'yaṃ venaḥ
verses.wordMeaning: Ye two divine Adhvaryus, etc., as in verse 33. Thou in the time of old. See, Vena.
verses.commentary: Sense: Ye two divine Adhvaryus, etc., as in verse 33. Thou in the time of old. See, Vena.

verses.sanskrit:
ति॒र॒श्चीनो॒ वित॑तो र॒श्मिरे॑षाम॒धः स्वि॑दा॒सी३दु॒परि॑ स्विदासी३त् ।
रे॒तो॒धा आ॑सन्महि॒मान॑ आसन्त्स्व॒धा अ॒वस्ता॒त्प्रय॑तिः प॒रस्ता॑त्
verses.translation: Transversely was the severing line extended: was it above, or was it, haply, under? There were begetters, there were mighty forces, free action here and energy up yonder.
verses.hindi: (क) हम उपासना व ज्ञानदीप्ति से आनन्दमय प्रभु को आराधित करके हदय कौ महत्ता व बुद्धि को प्राप्त कररे। ये ही दो वस्तु हमारे जीवन को आनन्दमय बनाती है। (ख) हम देव बनकर बल कौ साधना से उस सर्वशक्तिसम्पन्न इन्द्र का आराधन करें तथा (ग) सदा क्रियाशील प्रभु को पौरुषमय जीवन से प्राप्त करे।
verses.transliteration: tiraścīno vitato raśmireṣāmadhaḥ svidāsī3dupari svidāsī3t | retodhā āsanmahimāna āsantsvadhā avastātprayatiḥ parastāt
verses.wordMeaning: Transversely was the severing line extended: was it above, or was it, haply, under? There were begetters, there were mighty forces, free action here and energy up yonder.
verses.commentary: Sense: Transversely was the severing line extended: was it above, or was it, haply, under? There were begetters, there were mighty forces, free action here and energy up yonder.

verses.sanskrit:
आ रोद॑सी अपृण॒दा स्व॑र्म॒हज्जा॒तं यदे॑नम॒पसो॒ अधा॑रयन् ।
सो अ॑ध्व॒राय॒ परि॑ णीयते क॒विरत्यो॒ न वाज॑सातये॒ चनो॑हितः
verses.translation: He hath filled heaven and earth and the great realm of light, when at his birth the skilful held him in their hold. He like a steed is led forth to the sacrifice, Sage, graciously inclined, that he may win us wealth.
verses.hindi: हम यज्िय वनेगे तो प्रभु हमारे लिए "अदिति" होगे। हम मानुष बनें प्रभु अतिथि होगे। हम देव बनें प्रभु हमारा रक्षण कररेगे। वे जातवेद प्रभु हमें सदा सुख देते है। श्रेष्ठे स्याम सवितुः सवीमनि तदेवानामवोऽ अद्या वुंणीमहे ॥ ९७॥ १. महः अग्नेः=उस महान्, अग्निवत् प्रकाशमय, दोषों के दहन करनेवाले प्रभु के
verses.transliteration: ā rodasī apṛṇadā svarmahajjātaṃ yadenamapaso adhārayan | so adhvarāya pari ṇīyate kaviratyo na vājasātaye canohitaḥ
verses.wordMeaning: He hath filled heaven and earth and the great realm of light, when at his birth the skilful held him in their hold. He like a steed is led forth to the sacrifice, Sage, graciously inclined, that he may win us wealth.
verses.commentary: Sense: He hath filled heaven and earth and the great realm of light, when at his birth the skilful held him in their hold. He like a steed is led forth to the sacrifice, Sage, graciously inclined, that he may win us wealth.

verses.sanskrit: उ॒क्थेभि॑र्वृत्र॒हन्त॑मा॒ या म॑न्दा॒ना चि॒दा गि॒रा । आ॒ङ्गू॒षैरा॒विवा॑सतः
verses.translation: Call hither with the song and lauds the two best slayers of the foe, Delighting even in our hymn.
verses.hindi: हम निष्पाप बनें, कल्याण प्राप्त करे, प्रभु प्रेरणा में चलें, देवरक्षण को वरे। याहि वायुर्न नियुतो नोऽअच्छा त्वः हि धीभिर्दय॑से वि वाजान् ॥९८॥ १. जव हम देववरण करके वासनाओं को दूर भगाते है तव आपः=रेतस (आपः रेतो भूत्वा) चित्=निश्चय से पिष्युः= हमारा आप्यायन करते है। वीर्यशक्ति के द्वारा रोग कम्पित
verses.transliteration: ukthebhirvṛtrahantamā yā mandānā cidā girā | āṅgūṣairāvivāsataḥ
verses.wordMeaning: Call hither with the song and lauds the two best slayers of the foe, Delighting even in our hymn.
verses.commentary: Sense: Call hither with the song and lauds the two best slayers of the foe, Delighting even in our hymn.

verses.sanskrit: उप॑ नः सू॒नवो॒ गिर॑: शृ॒ण्वन्त्व॒मृत॑स्य॒ ये । सु॒मृ॒डी॒का भ॑वन्तु नः
verses.translation: All Sons of Immortality shall listen to the songs we sing, And be exceeding good to us.
verses.hindi: -हम रेतस् रक्ता द्वारा अपना आप्यायन करनेवाले, शक्तिशाली ज्ञानेन्दरियोवाले, ऋत को प्राप्त, वायु की भति नियत कर्मो में व्याप्त, प्रज्ञानों व कर्मो से शक्ति व धनों को १. गावः=ठे वेदवाणियो! अवतम्-हदयान्तरिक्ष के, मेरी हदयरूप गुहा को उपावतम्- (अवनभाग, बृद्धि) अपना भाग बनाओ-उसका सेवन करो ओर उसका वर्धन करो।
verses.transliteration: upa naḥ sūnavo gira: śṛṇvantvamṛtasya ye | sumṛḍīkā bhavantu naḥ
verses.wordMeaning: All Sons of Immortality shall listen to the songs we sing, And be exceeding good to us.
verses.commentary: Sense: All Sons of Immortality shall listen to the songs we sing, And be exceeding good to us.

verses.sanskrit:
ब्रह्मा॑णि मे म॒तय॒: शᳪ सु॒तास॒: शुष्म॑ इयर्ति॒ प्रभृ॑तो मे॒ अद्रि॑: ।
आ शा॑सते॒ प्रति॑ हर्यन्त्यु॒क्थेमा हरी॑ वहत॒स्ता नो॒ अच्छ॑
verses.translation: Mine are devotions, hymns, sweet are libations. Strength stirs, and hurled forth is my rocky weapon. They call for me, for me their lauds are longing. To their libations these my Bay Steeds bear me.
verses.hindi: ान- सूर्योदय से हम निष्पाप, स्नेहमय व दातृत्व कौ भावनावाले बनकर प्रमु से दीयमान भग करे पात्र बने। गतमन्त्र मे भावना थी कि दो ओर पाओ। दोगे, प्रभु तुम्हें देगे। वही भावना प्रस्तुत मन्त्र में इस प्रकार कही जा रही है कि सुते=इस उत्पन्न जगत् मे एश्वर्य का लाभ होने पर
verses.transliteration: brahmāṇi me mataya: śa sutāsa: śuṣma iyarti prabhṛto me adri: | ā śāsate prati haryantyukthemā harī vahatastā no accha
verses.wordMeaning: Mine are devotions, hymns, sweet are libations. Strength stirs, and hurled forth is my rocky weapon. They call for me, for me their lauds are longing. To their libations these my Bay Steeds bear me.
verses.commentary: Sense: Mine are devotions, hymns, sweet are libations. Strength stirs, and hurled forth is my rocky weapon. They call for me, for me their lauds are longing. To their libations these my Bay Steeds bear me.

verses.sanskrit:
अनु॑त्त॒मा ते॑ मघव॒न्नकि॒र्नु न त्वावाँ॑२ अस्ति दे॒वता॒ विदा॑नः ।
न जाय॑मानो॒ नश॑ते॒ न जा॒तो यानि॑ करि॒ष्या कृ॑णु॒हि प्र॑वृद्ध
verses.translation: Nothing, O Bounteous Lord, stands firm before thee: among the Gods not one is found thine equal. None born or springing into life comes near thee. Do what thou hast to do, exceeding mighty!
verses.hindi: ज्ञान से हमारा मस्तिष्क दीप्त हो, पोषक कर्म हमारे हाथों को प्रशस्त करें ओर त्याग का भाव हमारे हदयों को निष्कलंक बनाये। सोमसरे सोप की प्राप्ति प्रभु जीव को उपदेश देते है कि १. इन्द्र-हे इन्द्रियो के अधिष्ठाता जीव! तू इहि
verses.transliteration: anuttamā te maghavannakirnu na tvāvā~2 asti devatā vidānaḥ | na jāyamāno naśate na jāto yāni kariṣyā kṛṇuhi pravṛddha
verses.wordMeaning: Nothing, O Bounteous Lord, stands firm before thee: among the Gods not one is found thine equal. None born or springing into life comes near thee. Do what thou hast to do, exceeding mighty!
verses.commentary: Sense: Nothing, O Bounteous Lord, stands firm before thee: among the Gods not one is found thine equal. None born or springing into life comes near thee. Do what thou hast to do, exceeding mighty!

verses.sanskrit:
तदिदा॑स॒ भुव॑नेषु॒ ज्येष्ठं॒ यतो॑ ज॒ज्ञ उ॒ग्रस्त्वे॒षनृ॑म्णः ।
स॒द्यो ज॑ज्ञा॒नो नि रि॑णाति॒ शत्रू॒ननु॒ यं विश्वे॒ मद॒न्त्यूमा॑:
verses.translation: In all the worlds That was the Best and Highest whence sprang the mighty God of splendid valour. Quickly when born he overcomes his foemen, he in whom all who lend him aid are joyful.
verses.hindi: - सुरक्षित वीर्यवाला व्यक्ति सदा प्रफुल्लित वदन (1111118 1०९€ ) होता ठै. यह महान् बनता है, इसका दिल छोटा नहीं होता तथा साथ ही यह प्रभु का पुजारी होता हे ओर शक्ति से रोगों पर आक्रमण करनेवाला होता है। १, राजनीति में उन्नति के विघातक तत्त्वं को "वृत्र" कहते है। जैसे सूर्यं के प्रकाश
verses.transliteration: tadidāsa bhuvaneṣu jyeṣṭhaṃ yato jajña ugrastveṣanṛmṇaḥ | sadyo jajñāno ni riṇāti śatrūnanu yaṃ viśve madantyūmā:
verses.wordMeaning: In all the worlds That was the Best and Highest whence sprang the mighty God of splendid valour. Quickly when born he overcomes his foemen, he in whom all who lend him aid are joyful.
verses.commentary: Sense: In all the worlds That was the Best and Highest whence sprang the mighty God of splendid valour. Quickly when born he overcomes his foemen, he in whom all who lend him aid are joyful.

verses.sanskrit:
इ॒मा उ॑ त्वा पुरूवसो॒ गिरो॑ वर्धन्तु॒ या मम॑ ।
पा॒व॒कव॑र्णा॒: शुच॑यो विप॒श्चितो॒ऽभि स्तोमै॑रनूषत
verses.translation: May these my songs of praise exalt thee, Lord, who hast abundant wealth. Men skilled in holy hymns, pure, with the hues of fire, have sung them with their lauds to thee.
verses.hindi: - प्रभु की उपासना "जितेन्द्रियता" व “ वेद-दोहन' से हआ करती हे। तमुत्सवे च॑ प्रसवे च॑ सासहिमिन्द्रं देवासः शव॑ंसामदन्ननु ।। २९॥ १. है महः=महान् प्रभो! इमाम्=इस ते=तेरी महीम्=महिमा. को प्राप्त करानेवाली धियम्=वुद्धि को, प्रज्ञा व कर्मो की प्रतिपादक वेदवाणी को प्रभरे-मेैं प्रकर्षेण अपने में
verses.transliteration: imā u tvā purūvaso giro vardhantu yā mama | pāvakavarṇā: śucayo vipaścito'bhi stomairanūṣata
verses.wordMeaning: May these my songs of praise exalt thee, Lord, who hast abundant wealth. Men skilled in holy hymns, pure, with the hues of fire, have sung them with their lauds to thee.
verses.commentary: Sense: May these my songs of praise exalt thee, Lord, who hast abundant wealth. Men skilled in holy hymns, pure, with the hues of fire, have sung them with their lauds to thee.

verses.sanskrit:
यस्या॒यं विश्व॒ आर्यो॒ दास॑: शेवधि॒पा अ॒रिः ।
ति॒रश्चि॑द॒र्ये रु॒शमे॒ पवी॑रवि॒ तुभ्येत्सो अ॑ज्यते र॒यिः
verses.translation: Good Lord of wealth is he to whom all Âryas, Dâsas here belong. E’en over unto thee, the pious Rusama Pavîru, is that wealth brought nigh.
verses.hindi: - में वेदवाणी को अपने अन्दर भरनेवाला बनं, जिससे सम -दु :ख- सुख बनकर आनन्दमय जीवनवाला हो सकर। विभ्राड् बृहत्विलतु सोम्यं मध्वायुर्दधंद्यज्ञप॑तावविंहुतम् । १. पिच्छलो मन्त्र मँ वेदवाणी कौ अपने मेँ भरने का वर्णन धा। यह पुरुष विभ्राट्-विशिष्ट
verses.transliteration: yasyāyaṃ viśva āryo dāsa: śevadhipā ariḥ | tiraścidarye ruśame pavīravi tubhyetso ajyate rayiḥ
verses.wordMeaning: Good Lord of wealth is he to whom all Âryas, Dâsas here belong. E’en over unto thee, the pious Rusama Pavîru, is that wealth brought nigh.
verses.commentary: Sense: Good Lord of wealth is he to whom all Âryas, Dâsas here belong. E’en over unto thee, the pious Rusama Pavîru, is that wealth brought nigh.

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒यᳪ स॒हस्र॒मृषि॑भि॒: सह॑स्कृतः समु॒द्र इ॑व पप्रथे ।
स॒त्यः सो अ॑स्य महि॒मा गृ॑णे॒ शवो॑ य॒ज्ञेषु॑ विप्र॒राज्ये॑
verses.translation: He, with his might advanced by Rishis thousandfold, hath like an ocean spread himself. His majesty is praised as true at solemn rites, his power where holy singers rule. 84. Protect our habitation, Savitar, etc., as in verse 69.
