अ॒व॒स्यवे॑ त्वा॒ वाता॑य॒ स्वाहा॑ ऽशिमि॒दाय॑ त्वा॒ वाता॑य॒ स्वाहा॑
verses.translation: Thee with Svâhâ to Vâta the sea. Thee with Svâhâ to Vâta the flood. Thee with Svâhâ to Vâta the unconquerable. Thee with Svâhâ to Vâta the irresistible. Thee with Svâhâ to Vâta the protection-seeker. Thee with Svâhâ to Vâta the non-destructive.
verses.hindi: हम सदा सावधानी से कर्मो में लगे रहकर सोम का पान कररे। यह हमें हदयों का विजेता, स्वस्थ ओर बुद्धि व विद्या से सम्पन्न बनाएगा। ऋषि :--दीर्घतमाः। देवता-अश्िविनौ। छन्द: निचुदुष्णिक््। स्वरः-ऋषभः। १. अश्विना-कर्मो मे व्याप्त रहनेवाले पति-पत्नी घर्मम्-शरीर में शक्ति को बनाये
verses.transliteration: samudrāya tvā vātāya svāhā sarirāya tvā vātāya svāhā | anādhṛṣyāya tvā vātāya svāhā 'pratidhṛṣyāya tvā vātāya svāhā | avasyave tvā vātāya svāhā 'śimidāya tvā vātāya svāhā
verses.wordMeaning: Thee with Svâhâ to Vâta the sea. Thee with Svâhâ to Vâta the flood. Thee with Svâhâ to Vâta the unconquerable. Thee with Svâhâ to Vâta the irresistible. Thee with Svâhâ to Vâta the protection-seeker. Thee with Svâhâ to Vâta the non-destructive.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thee with Svâhâ to Vâta the sea. Thee with Svâhâ to Vâta the flood. Thee with Svâhâ to Vâta the unconquerable. Thee with Svâhâ to Vâta the irresistible. Thee with Svâhâ to Vâta the protection-seeker. Thee with Svâhâ to Vâta the non-destructive.

verses.sanskrit:
इन्द्रा॑य त्वा॒ वसु॑मते रु॒द्रव॑ते॒ स्वाहेन्द्रा॑य त्वाऽऽदि॒त्यव॑ते॒ स्वाहेन्द्रा॑य त्वाऽभिमाति॒घ्ने स्वाहा ।
स॒वि॒त्रे त्व॑ ऋभु॒मते॑ विभु॒मते॒ वाज॑वते॒ स्वाहा॒ बृह॒स्पत॑ये त्वा वि॒श्वदे॑व्यावते॒ स्वाहा॑
verses.translation: Thee with Svâhâ to Indra Lord of Vasus. Thee with Svâhâ to Indra Lord of Rudras. Thee with Svâhâ to Indra killer of foes. Thee with Svâhâ to Savitar attended by Ribhu, Vibhu, and Vâja. Thee with Svâhâ to Brihaspati beloved of all the Gods.
verses.hindi: हम शरीर मे सोम की रक्षा करें। यह सारे ब्रह्माण्ड को हमारे अनुकूल पिन्वस्व । धर्मासि सुधममिन्यस्मे नुम्णानिं धारय ब्रह्म॑ धारय कषत्रं धारय विषौ १. इषे=प्रेरणा के लिए पिन्वस्व (10 ५78€ ०) अपने को उत्साहित कर, अर्थात् तुद्धो प्रबल इच्छा हो कि भै प्रभु-प्रेरणा को सुननेवाला बनं २. ऊर्जे पिन्वस्व=-बल ओर
verses.transliteration: indrāya tvā vasumate rudravate svāhendrāya tvā''dityavate svāhendrāya tvā'bhimātighne svāhā | savitre tva ṛbhumate vibhumate vājavate svāhā bṛhaspataye tvā viśvadevyāvate svāhā
verses.wordMeaning: Thee with Svâhâ to Indra Lord of Vasus. Thee with Svâhâ to Indra Lord of Rudras. Thee with Svâhâ to Indra killer of foes. Thee with Svâhâ to Savitar attended by Ribhu, Vibhu, and Vâja. Thee with Svâhâ to Brihaspati beloved of all the Gods.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thee with Svâhâ to Indra Lord of Vasus. Thee with Svâhâ to Indra Lord of Rudras. Thee with Svâhâ to Indra killer of foes. Thee with Svâhâ to Savitar attended by Ribhu, Vibhu, and Vâja. Thee with Svâhâ to Brihaspati beloved of all the Gods.

verses.sanskrit: य॒माय॒ त्वाऽङ्गि॑रस्वते पितृ॒मते॒ स्वाहा॑ । स्वाहा॑ घ॒र्माय॒ स्वाहा॑ घ॒र्मः पि॒त्रे
verses.translation: Svâhâ to Yama attended by the Angirases, attended by the Fathers! Svâhâ to the Gharma! The Gharma for the Father!
verses.hindi: हम प्रभु प्रेरणा को सुनकर, उस प्रेरणा को क्रिया मेँ परिणत करने की शक्तिवाले बने, ज्ञान-बल व धन तीनों का अपने में सुन्दर समन्वय करके अपने जीवन को स्वाहां पृष्णे शर॑से स्वाहा ग्राव॑भ्यः स्वाहां प्रतिरिवेभ्य॑ः। स्वाहां पितुभ्य॑ऽ ऊर्ध्वव॑रहिर्भ्यो घर्मपाव॑भ्यः स्वाहा दद्यावापृथिवीभ्याश स्वाहा विश्वेभ्यो देवेभ्यंः।। १५॥
verses.transliteration: yamāya tvā'ṅgirasvate pitṛmate svāhā | svāhā gharmāya svāhā gharmaḥ pitre
verses.wordMeaning: Svâhâ to Yama attended by the Angirases, attended by the Fathers! Svâhâ to the Gharma! The Gharma for the Father!
verses.commentary: Sense: Svâhâ to Yama attended by the Angirases, attended by the Fathers! Svâhâ to the Gharma! The Gharma for the Father!

verses.sanskrit:
विश्वा॒ आशा॑ दक्षिण॒सद्विश्वा॑न् दे॒वानया॑डि॒ह ।
स्वाहा॑कृतस्य घ॒र्मस्य॒ मधो॑: पिबतमश्विना
verses.translation: Here hath he worshipped, seated south, all the sky-regions, all the Gods. Drink, Asvins, of the heated draught, the Svâhâ-consecrated mead.
verses.hindi: आचार्यो से ज्ञान प्राप्त करे। द्वितीय आश्रम में शक्ति की रक्षा के द्वारा, ब्रह्मचर्य-पालन के द्वारा उत्तम सन्तान को जन्म दे। तृतीयाश्रम मे शरीर व मस्तिष्क को पूर्णं स्वस्थ बनार्णं ओर चौथे आश्रम मेँ ज्ञान की दीप्ति को ओरों तक पर्ुचानेवाले बनें। प्रभु-स्तोताओं का सङ्क व प्रभु-प्राप्ति
verses.transliteration: viśvā āśā dakṣiṇasadviśvān devānayāḍiha | svāhākṛtasya gharmasya madho: pibatamaśvinā
verses.wordMeaning: Here hath he worshipped, seated south, all the sky-regions, all the Gods. Drink, Asvins, of the heated draught, the Svâhâ-consecrated mead.
verses.commentary: Sense: Here hath he worshipped, seated south, all the sky-regions, all the Gods. Drink, Asvins, of the heated draught, the Svâhâ-consecrated mead.

verses.sanskrit: दि॒वि धा॑ इ॒मं य॒ज्ञमि॒मं य॒ज्ञं दि॒वि धा॑: । स्वाहा॒ऽग्नये॑ य॒ज्ञिया॑य॒ शं यजु॑र्भ्यः
verses.translation: In heaven lay thou this sacrifice; lay thou this sacrifice in heaven. To sacrificial Agni hail! May bliss be ours from Yajus texts.
verses.hindi: प्रभु-स्तोताओं के सद्धं में रहकर मै अपने ज्ञान को बदाऊँ ओर अन्ततः प्रभु का सङ्खी बनकर सव प्रकार के विनाश से ऊपर उट जाऊ असि रोच॑स्व देववीत॑मः। वि धूमम॑ग्नेऽअरूषं मियेन्द्य सृज प्र॑शस्त दर्शतम्।। ९७॥ १. इमं दिवम्इस प्रकाशमय जीवनवाले को अभिलक्ष्य करके महिमा-महनत्त्व
verses.transliteration: divi dhā imaṃ yajñamimaṃ yajñaṃ divi dhā: | svāhā'gnaye yajñiyāya śaṃ yajurbhyaḥ
verses.wordMeaning: In heaven lay thou this sacrifice; lay thou this sacrifice in heaven. To sacrificial Agni hail! May bliss be ours from Yajus texts.
verses.commentary: Sense: In heaven lay thou this sacrifice; lay thou this sacrifice in heaven. To sacrificial Agni hail! May bliss be ours from Yajus texts.

verses.sanskrit: अश्वि॑ना घ॒र्मं पा॑त॒ᳪ हार्द्वा॑न॒मह॑र्दि॒वाभि॑रू॒तिभि॑: । तन्त्रा॒यिणे॒ नमो॒ द्यावा॑पृथि॒वीभ्या॑म्
verses.translation: Drink, Asvins, with your daily helps, the Gharma, strengthener of hearts. To him who draweth out the thread be homage, and to Heaven and Earth.
verses.hindi: हम अपने जीवन को उत्तम बनाकर लोकहित के दृष्टिकोण से बड़ी मधुरतापूर्वक ज्ञान के फैलानेवाले बने। पिछले मन्त्र मे महिमा कौ प्राप्ति का संकेत था। इस महिमा की प्राप्ति के लिए शरीर की त्रिलोकी का ठीक होना बड़ा आवश्यक है। उसके ठीक होने के लिए शरीर में
verses.transliteration: aśvinā gharmaṃ pāta hārdvānamahardivābhirūtibhi: | tantrāyiṇe namo dyāvāpṛthivībhyām
verses.wordMeaning: Drink, Asvins, with your daily helps, the Gharma, strengthener of hearts. To him who draweth out the thread be homage, and to Heaven and Earth.
verses.commentary: Sense: Drink, Asvins, with your daily helps, the Gharma, strengthener of hearts. To him who draweth out the thread be homage, and to Heaven and Earth.

verses.sanskrit: अपा॑ताम॒श्विना॑ घ॒र्ममनु॒ द्यावा॑पृथि॒वी अ॑मᳪसाताम् । इहै॒व रा॒तय॑: सन्तु
verses.translation: The Gharma have the Asvins drunk: with Heaven and Earth have they agreed. Here, verily, be their boons bestowed.
verses.hindi: राजा ज्ञानी व शक्तिशाली हो। प्रजा धर्म से राजा का अनुगमन करे। परिणामतः राष्ट में दुरित नहीं होते ओर प्रजाओं का जीवन स्तुत्य होता हे। १. ऋतस्य = ( ऋत यन्ञ-नि° ८।६) यज्ञ का नाभिः केन्द्र, अर्थात् यज्ञरूप केन्द्र चतुःस्रक्ति =' धर्म, अर्थ, काम व मोक्ष इन चारों पुरुषार्थो को सिद्ध करनेवाला है। खक्ति"
verses.transliteration: apātāmaśvinā gharmamanu dyāvāpṛthivī amasātām | ihaiva rātaya: santu
verses.wordMeaning: The Gharma have the Asvins drunk: with Heaven and Earth have they agreed. Here, verily, be their boons bestowed.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Gharma have the Asvins drunk: with Heaven and Earth have they agreed. Here, verily, be their boons bestowed.

verses.sanskrit:
इ॒षे पि॑न्वस्वो॒र्जे पि॑न्वस्व॒ ब्रह्म॑णे पिन्वस्व क्ष॒त्राय॑ पिन्वस्व॒ द्यावा॑पृथि॒वीभ्यां॑ पिन्वस्व ।
धर्मा॑सि सु॒धर्मामे॑न्य॒स्मे नृ॒म्णानि॑ धारय॒ ब्रह्म॑ धारय क्ष॒त्रं धा॑रय॒ विशं॑ धारय
verses.translation: Overflow for food. Overflow for energy. Overflow for the Priesthood. Overflow for the Nobility. Overflow for Heaven and Earth. Thou, O duteous one, art Duty. Innocent one, in us establish manly powers; establish the People.
verses.hindi: यज्ञ के निम्न लाभ है ९. इससे धर्म, अर्थ, काम व मोक्ष चारो पुरुषार्थो कौ सिद्धि होती है। २. यह हमारी शवित्तयों का विस्तार करते हए शतायु बनाता है। ३. इससे हम शरीर, मन व मस्तिष्क तीनों के स्वास्थ्य को प्राप्त करके पूर्णं जीवनवाले होते है ४, हमसे द्वेष व कुटिलता दूर रहती है।
verses.transliteration: iṣe pinvasvorje pinvasva brahmaṇe pinvasva kṣatrāya pinvasva dyāvāpṛthivībhyāṃ pinvasva | dharmāsi sudharmāmenyasme nṛmṇāni dhāraya brahma dhāraya kṣatraṃ dhāraya viśaṃ dhāraya
verses.wordMeaning: Overflow for food. Overflow for energy. Overflow for the Priesthood. Overflow for the Nobility. Overflow for Heaven and Earth. Thou, O duteous one, art Duty. Innocent one, in us establish manly powers; establish the People.
verses.commentary: Sense: Overflow for food. Overflow for energy. Overflow for the Priesthood. Overflow for the Nobility. Overflow for Heaven and Earth. Thou, O duteous one, art Duty. Innocent one, in us establish manly powers; establish the People.

verses.sanskrit:
स्वाहा॑ पू॒ष्णे शर॑से॒ स्वाहा॒ ग्राव॑भ्यः स्वाहा॑ प्रतिर॒वेभ्य॑: ।
स्वाहा॑ पि॒तृभ्य॑ ऊ॒र्ध्वब॑र्हिर्भ्यो घर्म॒पाव॑भ्य॒: स्वाहा॒ द्यावा॑पृथि॒वीभ्या॒ᳪ स्वाहा॒ विश्वे॑भ्यो दे॒वेभ्य॑:
verses.translation: All-hail to Pûshan, to the milk's skin! All-hail to the press-stones! All-hail to their echoes! All-hail to the Fathers who are above the grass, who drink the Gharma! All-hail to Heaven and Earth! All-hail to the All-Gods!
verses.hindi: हम शरीर मे सोम की रक्षा करे। इससे अपना वर्धन व आप्यायन करके हम ओरों का वर्धन करनेवाले बने। गतमन्त्र मै घर्म-रक्षा द्वारा अपना वर्धन करके ओसरो के हित में प्रवृत्त होने का उल्लेख ह। यह ओसरो के हित में प्रवृत होनेवाला व्यक्ति ९. अचिक्रदत्-शब्द करता है, ओरो को
verses.transliteration: svāhā pūṣṇe śarase svāhā grāvabhyaḥ svāhā pratiravebhya: | svāhā pitṛbhya ūrdhvabarhirbhyo gharmapāvabhya: svāhā dyāvāpṛthivībhyā svāhā viśvebhyo devebhya:
verses.wordMeaning: All-hail to Pûshan, to the milk's skin! All-hail to the press-stones! All-hail to their echoes! All-hail to the Fathers who are above the grass, who drink the Gharma! All-hail to Heaven and Earth! All-hail to the All-Gods!
verses.commentary: Sense: All-hail to Pûshan, to the milk's skin! All-hail to the press-stones! All-hail to their echoes! All-hail to the Fathers who are above the grass, who drink the Gharma! All-hail to Heaven and Earth! All-hail to the All-Gods!

verses.sanskrit:
स्वाहा॑ रु॒द्राय॑ रु॒द्रहू॑तये॒ स्वाहा॒ सं ज्योति॑षा॒ ज्योति॑: ।
अह॑: के॒तुना॑ जुषताᳪ सु॒ज्योति॒र्ज्योति॑षा॒ स्वाहा॑ ।
रात्रि॑: के॒तुना॑ जुषताᳪ सु॒ज्योति॒र्ज्योति॑षा॒ स्वाहा॑ ।
मधु॑ हु॒तमिन्द्र॑तमे अ॒ग्नाव॒श्याम॑ ते देव॒ घर्म॒ नम॑स्ते अस्तु॒ मा मा॑ हिᳪसीः
verses.translation: All-hail to Rudra invoked by worshippers! All-hail! Let light combine with light. May Day together with his sheen, fair-lighted with his light, accept. All hail! May Night together with her sheen, fair-lighted with her light, accept. All-hail! May we enjoy the mead offered in most Indra-like Agni. Homage to thee, divine Gharma! Do not thou injure me.
verses.hindi: घर्म की रक्षा से स्वयं बदढकर ओरों को बद्धानेवाला "दीर्घतमा! स्लान का उपदेश करता है ओर इस प्रकार सबके दुःखों को दूर करने के लिए यत्नशील होता हे। ऋषि:--दीर्घतमाः। देवता-आपः। छन्दः-निचुदनुष्टुप्। स्वरः-गान्धारः। गतमन्त्र की भावना के अनुसार जब हम द्वेष व कुटिलता से दूर होकर् (२०) अपना
verses.transliteration: svāhā rudrāya rudrahūtaye svāhā saṃ jyotiṣā jyoti: | aha: ketunā juṣatā sujyotirjyotiṣā svāhā | rātri: ketunā juṣatā sujyotirjyotiṣā svāhā | madhu hutamindratame agnāvaśyāma te deva gharma namaste astu mā mā hisīḥ
verses.wordMeaning: All-hail to Rudra invoked by worshippers! All-hail! Let light combine with light. May Day together with his sheen, fair-lighted with his light, accept. All hail! May Night together with her sheen, fair-lighted with her light, accept.…
verses.commentary: Sense: All-hail to Rudra invoked by worshippers! All-hail! Let light combine with light. May Day together with his sheen, fair-lighted with his light, accept. All hail! May Night together with her sheen, fair-lighted with her light, accept.…

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒भीमं म॑हि॒मा दिवं॒ विप्रो॑ बभूव स॒प्रथा॑: ।
उ॒त श्रव॑सा पृथि॒वीᳪ सᳪ सी॑दस्व म॒हाँ२ अ॑सि॒ रोच॑स्व देव॒वीत॑मः
verses.translation: Thy far-spread majesty, instinct with wisdom, hath surpassed this heaven, And, with its glorious fame, the earth. Seat thee, for thou art mighty: shine, best entertainer of the Gods. Worthy of sacred food, praised Agni! loose the smoke ruddy and beautiful to see.
verses.hindi: हम द्वेष की भावना से शून्य होकर सदा सबके हित की भावना से ओत-प्रोत मनवाले बनकर भोजन कररे। नि्द्रेष मनसे होनेवाला खान-पान हितकर परिणामवाला होता हे, तो द्वेषी मन भोजन को भी अहितकर कर देता है। उद्वयन्तम॑सस्परि स्वुः पश्य॑न्द्ऽ उन्त॑रम्। देवं देवत्रा सूर्यमग॑न्म ज्योक्तिरुत्तमम्॥ २४॥
verses.transliteration: abhīmaṃ mahimā divaṃ vipro babhūva saprathā: | uta śravasā pṛthivī sa sīdasva mahā~2 asi rocasva devavītamaḥ
verses.wordMeaning: Thy far-spread majesty, instinct with wisdom, hath surpassed this heaven, And, with its glorious fame, the earth. Seat thee, for thou art mighty: shine, best entertainer of the Gods. Worthy of sacred food, praised Agni! loose the smoke ruddy and beautiful to see.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thy far-spread majesty, instinct with wisdom, hath surpassed this heaven, And, with its glorious fame, the earth. Seat thee, for thou art mighty: shine, best entertainer of the Gods. Worthy of sacred food, praised Agni! loose the smoke ruddy and beautiful to see.

verses.sanskrit:
या ते॑ घर्म दि॒व्या शुग्या गा॑य॒त्र्याᳪ ह॑वि॒र्धाने॑ ।
सा त॒ आ प्या॑यतां॒ निष्टया॑यतां॒ तस्यै॑ ते॒ स्वाहा॑ ।
या ते॑ घर्मा॒न्तरि॑क्षे॒ शुग्या त्रि॒ष्टुभ्याग्नी॑ध्रे ।
सा त॒ आ प्या॑यतां॒ निष्टया॑यतां॒ तस्यै॑ ते॒ स्वाहा॑ ।
या ते॑ घर्म पृथि॒व्याᳪ शुग्या जग॑त्याᳪ सद॒स्या॒ ।
सा त॒ आ प्या॑यतां॒ निष्टया॑यतां॒ तस्यै॑ ते॒ स्वाहा॑
verses.translation: Gharma, that heavenly light of thine in Gâyatrî, in the Soma-store,— May it increase and be confirmed for thee, that light. Gharma, that light of thine in air, in Trishtup, in the sacred hearth,— May it increase and be confirmed for thee, that light. Gharma, that light of thine on earth, in Jagatî, of the priest's shed,— May that increase and be confirmed for thee, that light.
verses.hindi: हम प्रकृति के सौन्दर्य को समञ्जते हुए, उसका यथायोग- उचित उपयोग करते हए, प्रकृति से ऊपर उटठे। उससे ऊपर उठकर आत्मस्वरूप का चिन्तन करे। आत्म-चिन्तन करते हुए हम उस सर्वोत्तम ज्योति देवों के भी देव परमात्मा का दर्शन करें। प्रभु के तेज क्रा धारण
verses.transliteration: yā te gharma divyā śugyā gāyatryā havirdhāne | sā ta ā pyāyatāṃ niṣṭayāyatāṃ tasyai te svāhā | yā te gharmāntarikṣe śugyā triṣṭubhyāgnīdhre | sā ta ā pyāyatāṃ niṣṭayāyatāṃ tasyai te svāhā | yā te gharma pṛthivyā śugyā jagatyā sadasyā | sā ta ā pyāyatāṃ niṣṭayāyatāṃ tasyai te svāhā
verses.wordMeaning: Gharma, that heavenly light of thine in Gâyatrî, in the Soma-store,— May it increase and be confirmed for thee, that light. Gharma, that light of thine in air, in Trishtup, in the sacred hearth,— May it increase and be confirmed for thee, that light. Gharma,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Gharma, that heavenly light of thine in Gâyatrî, in the Soma-store,— May it increase and be confirmed for thee, that light. Gharma, that light of thine in air, in Trishtup, in the sacred hearth,— May it increase and be confirmed for thee, that light. Gharma,…

verses.sanskrit:
क्ष॒त्रस्य॑ त्वा प॒रस्पा॑य॒ ब्रह्म॑णस्त॒न्वं॒ पाहि ।
विश॑स्त्वा॒ धर्म॑णा व॒यमनु॑ क्रामाम सुवि॒ताय॒ नव्य॑से
verses.translation: Thee for the sure protection of the Nobles. Guard thou from injury the Brahman's body. We follow thee in interest of the People, for the renewal of our peace and comfort.
verses.hindi: प्रभुभक्त वर्धमान, ज्ञानी व तेजस्वी बनता हे। दीर्घतमा कहता है कि यावती द्यावापृथिवी =जबतक ये द्युलोक ओर पृथिवीलोक है च ओर यावत्-जवबतक सप्त सिन्धवः सातो समुद्र वितस्थिरे-विशेषरूप से अपनी मर्यादा मे स्थित है तावन्तम्-उतने समय तक इन्द्र-हे परमैश्वर्यशाली प्रभो! ते ग्रहम् आपके
verses.transliteration: kṣatrasya tvā paraspāya brahmaṇastanvaṃ pāhi | viśastvā dharmaṇā vayamanu krāmāma suvitāya navyase
verses.wordMeaning: Thee for the sure protection of the Nobles. Guard thou from injury the Brahman's body. We follow thee in interest of the People, for the renewal of our peace and comfort.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thee for the sure protection of the Nobles. Guard thou from injury the Brahman's body. We follow thee in interest of the People, for the renewal of our peace and comfort.

verses.sanskrit:
चतु॑: स्रक्ति॒र्नाभि॑रृ॒तस्य॑ स॒प्रथा॒: स नो॑ वि॒श्वायु॑: स॒प्रथा॒: स न: स॒र्वायु॑: स॒प्रथा॑: ।
अप॒ द्वेषो॒ अप॒ ह्वरो॒ऽन्यव्र॑तस्य सश्चिम
verses.translation: Square, far-spread is the sacrifice's navel: it spreads for us wide, full of all existence, spreads wide for us full of complete existence. We turn against the hate and guiles of him who keeps an alien law.
verses.hindi: प्रभु-उपासक कौ आत्मशक्ति "दक्षता, कर्मसंकल्प, ज्ञान व तेज' से युक्त यह मन्त्र इस अध्याय का अन्तिम मन्त्र हे। इसमे मनुष्य अपने को समर्पण के लिए सन्नद्ध करता हे। शुद्ध सात्विक भोजन से जीवन को प्रारम्भ करता है, जिससे सात्विक मनवाला बनकर “अग्निह्त '= प्रभु-अर्पित' हो सके। यह कहता है कि १. पयसः = सर्वाङ्ग
verses.transliteration: catu: sraktirnābhirṛtasya saprathā: sa no viśvāyu: saprathā: sa na: sarvāyu: saprathā: | apa dveṣo apa hvaro'nyavratasya saścima
verses.wordMeaning: Square, far-spread is the sacrifice's navel: it spreads for us wide, full of all existence, spreads wide for us full of complete existence. We turn against the hate and guiles of him who keeps an alien law.
verses.commentary: Sense: Square, far-spread is the sacrifice's navel: it spreads for us wide, full of all existence, spreads wide for us full of complete existence. We turn against the hate and guiles of him who keeps an alien law.

verses.sanskrit: घर्मै॒तत्ते॒ पुरी॑षं॒ तेन॒ वर्ध॑स्व॒ चा च॑ प्यायस्व । व॒र्धि॒षी॒महि॑ च व॒यमा च॑ प्यासिषीमहि
verses.translation: This, Gharma! is thy liquid store. Swell out and wax in strength thereby. May we too grow in strength and wax to greatness.
verses.hindi: उल्लिखित अर्थ से स्पष्ट है कि गोदूध शक्तिवर्धक है, नीरोगता देनेवाला हे, जितेन्द्रिय बनने में सहायक है, रक्षण कौ वृत्ति को बद्धानेवाला है, जीवन की प्रत्येक क्रिया मे माधुर्य को उपजाता है। इस दूध का सेवन करनेवाले हम उत्तम मनोवृतिवाले बनकर प्रभु के प्रति अपना अर्पण करनेवाले बनें। हम “ अग्निहुत' हो।
verses.transliteration: gharmaitatte purīṣaṃ tena vardhasva cā ca pyāyasva | vardhiṣīmahi ca vayamā ca pyāsiṣīmahi
verses.wordMeaning: This, Gharma! is thy liquid store. Swell out and wax in strength thereby. May we too grow in strength and wax to greatness.
verses.commentary: Sense: This, Gharma! is thy liquid store. Swell out and wax in strength thereby. May we too grow in strength and wax to greatness.

verses.sanskrit: अचि॑क्रद॒द्वृषा॒ हरि॑र्म॒हान्मि॒त्रो न॑ दर्श॒तः । सᳪ सूर्ये॑ण दिद्युतदुद॒धिर्नि॒धिः
verses.translation: Loudly the tawny Stallion neighed, mighty, like Mitra fair to see. Together with the Sun the sea, the store shone out with flashing light.
verses.hindi: हमारे जीवन के तीन सूत्र हों-हम ९. प्रभु कौ आज्ञा में २. प्रयत्न से ३. पोषण के ही लिए वस्तुओं का ग्रहण करे। इडऽ एह्यदिंतऽ एहि सर॑स्वत्येदिं । असावेह्यसावेद्यसावेहि।। २॥ संसार यात्रा का सुखमय बीतना बहुत कु पत्नी पर निर्भर करता हे। प्रस्तुत मन्त्र में
verses.transliteration: acikradadvṛṣā harirmahānmitro na darśataḥ | sa sūryeṇa didyutadudadhirnidhiḥ
verses.wordMeaning: Loudly the tawny Stallion neighed, mighty, like Mitra fair to see. Together with the Sun the sea, the store shone out with flashing light.
verses.commentary: Sense: Loudly the tawny Stallion neighed, mighty, like Mitra fair to see. Together with the Sun the sea, the store shone out with flashing light.

verses.sanskrit: सु॒मि॒त्रि॒या न॒ आप॒ ओष॑धयः सन्तु  दुर्मित्रि॒यास्तस्मै॑ सन्तु॒ योऽस्मान् द्वेष्टि॒ यं च॑ व॒यं द्वि॒ष्मः
verses.translation: To us let Waters and let Plants be friendly; to him who hates us, whom we hate, unfriendly.
verses.hindi: पति ' प्रसन्न-शान्त, न दबनेवाला, न दबानेवाला, वासनाओं से ऊपर उट कर्मो को कभी न छोड्नेवाला, वायु कौ भांति सदा क्रियाशील ' होना चाहिए। १. इन्द्राय जितेन्द्रिय वसुमते रुद्रवते त्वा= वसुमान् ओर रुद्रवान् आपके लिए स्वाहा मै अपना त्याग करती हं वसुमान् वह है जिसने अपने शरीर में उस--उस स्थान पर देवों
verses.transliteration: sumitriyā na āpa oṣadhayaḥ santu durmitriyāstasmai santu yo'smān dveṣṭi yaṃ ca vayaṃ dviṣmaḥ
verses.wordMeaning: To us let Waters and let Plants be friendly; to him who hates us, whom we hate, unfriendly.
verses.commentary: Sense: To us let Waters and let Plants be friendly; to him who hates us, whom we hate, unfriendly.

verses.sanskrit: उद्व॒यं तम॑स॒स्परि॒ स्व: पश्य॑न्त॒ उत्त॑रम् । दे॒वं दे॑व॒त्रा सूर्य॒मग॑न्म॒ ज्योति॑रुत्त॒मम्
verses.translation: Looking upon the loftier light above the darkness we have come To Sûrya, God among the Gods, the light that is most excellent.
verses.hindi: पति जितेन्द्रिय, पूर्णं स्वस्थ, प्रभुभक्त, ज्ञान का आदान करनेवाला, निरभिमानी , धन का सत्य व पुरुषार्थ से अर्जन करनेवाला, उदार हदय, शक्तिशाली , ब्रह्मनिष्ठ व दिव्य १. यमायसव इन्द्रियों का नियमन करनेवाले अङ्कगिरस्वते=एक-एक अद्घ मे रसवाले पितृमते त्वाउत्तम पितृत्व की शक्तिवाले तेरे लिए स्वाहा=मै अपना समर्पण करती
verses.transliteration: udvayaṃ tamasaspari sva: paśyanta uttaram | devaṃ devatrā sūryamaganma jyotiruttamam
verses.wordMeaning: Looking upon the loftier light above the darkness we have come To Sûrya, God among the Gods, the light that is most excellent.
verses.commentary: Sense: Looking upon the loftier light above the darkness we have come To Sûrya, God among the Gods, the light that is most excellent.

verses.sanskrit: एधो॑ऽस्येधिषी॒महि॑ स॒मिद॑सि॒ तेजो॑ऽसि॒ तेजो॒ मयि॑ धेहि
verses.translation: A brand art thou, fain would we thrive, Fuel art thou, and splendour: Give me splendour,
verses.hindi: हम भोजन को भी यज्ञ का रूप दे दे। परिणामतः हम "दक्षिण ' बनेंगे. हमारी सभी आशा पूरी होगी, दिव्य गुणों से हमारा मेल होगा। दिवि धा॑ऽ डमं यज्ञमिमं यज्ञं दिवि धाः। स्वाहाग्नये यज्ञियाय शं यजुभ्यः॥ ९९॥ १. है प्रभो! दिवि=ज्ञान के प्रकाशवाले इस पुरुष में इमं यनज्ञम्-इस यज्ञ को धाः=
verses.transliteration: edho'syedhiṣīmahi samidasi tejo'si tejo mayi dhehi
verses.wordMeaning: A brand art thou, fain would we thrive, Fuel art thou, and splendour: Give me splendour,
verses.commentary: Sense: A brand art thou, fain would we thrive, Fuel art thou, and splendour: Give me splendour,

verses.sanskrit:
याव॑ती॒ द्यावा॑पृथि॒वी याव॑च्च स॒प्त सिन्ध॑वो वितस्थि॒रे ।
तव॑न्तमिन्द्र ते॒ ग्रह॑मू॒र्जा गृ॑ह्णा॒म्यक्षि॑तं॒ मयि॑ गृह्णा॒म्यक्षि॑तम्
verses.translation: Far as the heaven and earth are spread in compass, far as the Seven Rivers are extended, So vast thy cup which I with strength am taking, Indra, unharmed in me, uninjured ever.
verses.hindi: हमारे जीवन मे ज्ञान व यज्ञ दोनों का सुन्दर समन्वय हो। हम यज्ञिय अग्नि के लिए अपना त्याग कररे। ' देवपूजा, संगतिकरण व दान ' रूप यज्ञ हमारे जीवन कौ शान्ति १. है अश्विना कर्मो मे शीघ्रता से व्यापनेवाले पति-पत्नियो। अहर्दिवाभिः ऊतिभिः दिनरात के रक्षणो से इस हा्द्वानम्-( हृदं वनति ५11८) ५15 111 1८1) हदय को
verses.transliteration: yāvatī dyāvāpṛthivī yāvacca sapta sindhavo vitasthire | tavantamindra te grahamūrjā gṛhṇāmyakṣitaṃ mayi gṛhṇāmyakṣitam
verses.wordMeaning: Far as the heaven and earth are spread in compass, far as the Seven Rivers are extended, So vast thy cup which I with strength am taking, Indra, unharmed in me, uninjured ever.
verses.commentary: Sense: Far as the heaven and earth are spread in compass, far as the Seven Rivers are extended, So vast thy cup which I with strength am taking, Indra, unharmed in me, uninjured ever.

verses.sanskrit:
मयि॒ त्यदि॑न्द्रि॒यं बृ॒हन्मयि॒ दक्षो॒ मयि॒ क्रतु॑: ।
घ॒र्मस्त्रि॒शुग्वि रा॑जति वि॒राजा॒ ज्योति॑षा स॒ह ब्रह्म॑णा॒ तेज॑सा स॒ह
verses.translation: In me be that great hero power, in me be strength and mental force: The Gharma shines with triple light, with lustre fulgent far away, with holy lore, with brilliancy.
verses.hindi: शरीर मे सोमपान के द्वारा १. हमारा मस्तिष्क ज्ञान से उज्ज्वल हो। हम यथोचित मार्ग पर चलते हए अपने प्राणों कौ रक्षा करें तथा यज्ञमय जीवनवाले हो। २. हमारे मन निर्मल हों, उसमें काम- क्रोध ओर लोभ कौ समाप्ति होकर परमेश्वर का प्रतिष्ठापन हो। ३. हमारे शरीर स्वस्थ व क्रियामय हों जिससे इस संसार मे हमारा निवास उत्तम हो।
verses.transliteration: mayi tyadindriyaṃ bṛhanmayi dakṣo mayi kratu: | gharmastriśugvi rājati virājā jyotiṣā saha brahmaṇā tejasā saha
verses.wordMeaning: In me be that great hero power, in me be strength and mental force: The Gharma shines with triple light, with lustre fulgent far away, with holy lore, with brilliancy.
verses.commentary: Sense: In me be that great hero power, in me be strength and mental force: The Gharma shines with triple light, with lustre fulgent far away, with holy lore, with brilliancy.

verses.sanskrit:
पय॑सो॒ रेत॒ आभृ॑तं॒ तस्य॒ दोह॑मशीम॒ह्युत्त॑रामुत्तरा॒ᳪ समा॑म् ।
त्विष॑: सं॒वृक् क्रत्वे॒ दक्ष॑स्य ते सुषु॒म्णस्य॑ ते सुषुम्णाग्निहु॒तः ।
इन्द्र॑पीतस्य प्र॒जाप॑तिभक्षितस्य॒ मधु॑मत॒ उप॑हूत॒ उप॑हूतस्य भक्षयामि
verses.translation: Brought hither is the seed of milk. Through each succeeding year may we enjoy the bliss of draining it. Invited, I enjoy a share of that which hath been offered me, the savoury draught by Indra drunk and tasted by Prajâpati.
verses.hindi: मै सतत साधना के द्वारा प्रभु को अपने अन्दर ग्रहण करूं, जिससे मुञ्े बल व प्राणशक्ति प्राप्त हो ओर भै क्षीणता से बच सकू। गतमन्त्र मेँ वर्णित प्रभु का ग्रहण भँ इसलिए करता हूँ कि १. मयिचमुञ्चमें त्यत् =उस प्रसिद्ध इन्द्रियम्=इन्द्र की शक्ति उत्पन्न होती हे। उपासना से इन्द्र की शक्ति का विकास
verses.transliteration: payaso reta ābhṛtaṃ tasya dohamaśīmahyuttarāmuttarā samām | tviṣa: saṃvṛk kratve dakṣasya te suṣumṇasya te suṣumṇāgnihutaḥ | indrapītasya prajāpatibhakṣitasya madhumata upahūta upahūtasya bhakṣayāmi
verses.wordMeaning: Brought hither is the seed of milk. Through each succeeding year may we enjoy the bliss of draining it. Invited, I enjoy a share of that which hath been offered me, the savoury draught by Indra drunk and tasted by Prajâpati.
verses.commentary: Sense: Brought hither is the seed of milk. Through each succeeding year may we enjoy the bliss of draining it. Invited, I enjoy a share of that which hath been offered me, the savoury draught by Indra drunk and tasted by Prajâpati.

verses.sanskrit:
स्वाहा॑ प्रा॒णेभ्य॒: साधि॑पतिकेभ्यः । पृ॒थि॒व्यै स्वाहा॒ ऽग्नये॒ स्वाहा॒ ऽन्तरि॑क्षाय॒ स्वाहा॑ वा॒यवे॒ स्वाहा॑ ।
दि॒वे स्वाहा॒ सूर्या॑य॒ स्वाहा॑
verses.translation: com The Texts of the White Yajurveda, tr. Ralph T.H. Griffith, [1899], BOOK THE THIRTY-NINTH. SVÂHÂ to the Vital Breathings with their Controlling Lord! To Earth Svâhâ! To Agni Svâhâ! To Firmament, Svâhâ! To Vâyu Svâhâ! To Sky Svâhâ! To Sûrya Svâhâ!
verses.hindi: हम अपने अन्तिमि समय (०) ५८० ४८) मनसहित प्राणो, अग्निसहित पृथिवी, वायुसहित अन्तरिक्ष तथा सूर्यसहित द्युलोक का धन्यवाद करते हुए इनसे विदा लै। १. दिग्भ्यः स्वाहा=इन दिशाओं के लिए मेँ धन्यवाद करता हूँ। इस "प्राची" ने मुल (प्रआञ्च) आगे बद्ने का पाठ पाया था तो "दक्षिण ने दाक्षिण्य का उपदेश दिया,
verses.transliteration: svāhā prāṇebhya: sādhipatikebhyaḥ | pṛthivyai svāhā 'gnaye svāhā 'ntarikṣāya svāhā vāyave svāhā | dive svāhā sūryāya svāhā
verses.wordMeaning: com The Texts of the White Yajurveda, tr. Ralph T.H. Griffith, [1899], BOOK THE THIRTY-NINTH. SVÂHÂ to the Vital Breathings with their Controlling Lord! To Earth Svâhâ! To Agni Svâhâ! To Firmament, Svâhâ! To Vâyu Svâhâ! To Sky Svâhâ! To Sûrya Svâhâ!
verses.commentary: Sense: com The Texts of the White Yajurveda, tr. Ralph T.H. Griffith, [1899], BOOK THE THIRTY-NINTH. SVÂHÂ to the Vital Breathings with their Controlling Lord! To Earth Svâhâ! To Agni Svâhâ! To Firmament, Svâhâ! To Vâyu Svâhâ! To Sky Svâhâ! To Sûrya Svâhâ!

verses.sanskrit:
दि॒ग्भ्यः स्वाहा॑ च॒न्द्राय॒ स्वाहा॒ नक्ष॑त्रेभ्य॒: स्वाहा॒  ऽद्भ्यः स्वाहा॒ वरु॑णाय॒ स्वाहा॑ ।
नाभ्यै॒ स्वाहा॑ पू॒ताय॒ स्वाहा॑
verses.translation: To the Quarters Svâhâ! To the Moon Svâhâ! To the Stars Svâhâ! To the Waters Svâhâ! To Varuna Svâhâ! To the Navel Svâhâ! To the Purified Svâhâ!
verses.hindi: आज जीवन के इस अन्तिम दिन मै सव देवों सेव शरीर की नाभि व शोधक अगो से विदाई लेता ह सप्तर्षियो-डइद््रियो से चिदा १. वाचे स्वाहा=मै इस वाणी के लिए शुभ शब्द कहता दूँ इसी के द्वारा जीवन भर
verses.transliteration: digbhyaḥ svāhā candrāya svāhā nakṣatrebhya: svāhā 'dbhyaḥ svāhā varuṇāya svāhā | nābhyai svāhā pūtāya svāhā
verses.wordMeaning: To the Quarters Svâhâ! To the Moon Svâhâ! To the Stars Svâhâ! To the Waters Svâhâ! To Varuna Svâhâ! To the Navel Svâhâ! To the Purified Svâhâ!
verses.commentary: Sense: To the Quarters Svâhâ! To the Moon Svâhâ! To the Stars Svâhâ! To the Waters Svâhâ! To Varuna Svâhâ! To the Navel Svâhâ! To the Purified Svâhâ!

verses.sanskrit:
वा॒चे स्वाहा॑ प्रा॒णाय॒ स्वाहा॑ प्रा॒णाय॒ स्वाहा॑ । चक्षु॑षे॒ स्वाहा॒ चक्षु॑षे॒ स्वाहा॒  श्रोत्रा॑य॒ स्वाहा॒
श्रोत्रा॑य॒ स्वाहा॑
verses.translation: To Speech Svâhâ! To Breath Svâhâ! To Breath Svâhâ! To Sight Svâhâ! To Sight Svâhâ! To Hearing Svâhâ! To Hearing Svâhâ!
verses.hindi: मेरा जीवन उत्तम संकल्पोँवाला, सत्यमय, स्वस्थ, सात्विक अन्न का सेवन करनेवाला तथा यश ओर श्री से युक्त हो। सूचना-'श्री' का अर्थं धन भी होता हे। मै अपने जीवन में उचित च आवश्यक धन को प्राप्त करनेवाला बनूं। धन का अभाव मेरी परेशानी का कारण न बने।
verses.transliteration: vāce svāhā prāṇāya svāhā prāṇāya svāhā | cakṣuṣe svāhā cakṣuṣe svāhā śrotrāya svāhā śrotrāya svāhā
verses.wordMeaning: To Speech Svâhâ! To Breath Svâhâ! To Breath Svâhâ! To Sight Svâhâ! To Sight Svâhâ! To Hearing Svâhâ! To Hearing Svâhâ!
verses.commentary: Sense: To Speech Svâhâ! To Breath Svâhâ! To Breath Svâhâ! To Sight Svâhâ! To Sight Svâhâ! To Hearing Svâhâ! To Hearing Svâhâ!

verses.sanskrit: मन॑स॒: काम॒माकू॑तिं वा॒चः स॒त्यम॑शीय । प॒शू॒नाᳪ रू॒पमन्न॑स्य॒ रसो॒ यश॒: श्रीः श्र॑यतां॒ मयि॒ स्वाहा॑
verses.translation: The wish and purpose of the mind and truth of speech may I obtain. Bestowed on me be cattle's form, swept taste of food, and fame and grace. Svâhâ!
verses.hindi: आसुरी सम्पत्तिवाले ' उग्रस्वभाव के, लोक- भयंकर, अज्ञानी, ओरों को कम्पित करनेवाले, दूसरों को कुचलनेवाले, उनपर आक्रमण करनेवाले व विक्षिप्त-खे' होते है। अग्निशहद्येनाशनिंहदयाग्रेणं पशुपतिं कृत्स्नहदयेन भवं यक्ना। शर्वं मत॑स्ताभ्यामीशानं मन्युनां महादेवमं॑न्तः पष्व्यिनोग्रं देवं व॑निष्टुनां
verses.transliteration: manasa: kāmamākūtiṃ vācaḥ satyamaśīya | paśūnā rūpamannasya raso yaśa: śrīḥ śrayatāṃ mayi svāhā
verses.wordMeaning: The wish and purpose of the mind and truth of speech may I obtain. Bestowed on me be cattle's form, swept taste of food, and fame and grace. Svâhâ!
verses.commentary: Sense: The wish and purpose of the mind and truth of speech may I obtain. Bestowed on me be cattle's form, swept taste of food, and fame and grace. Svâhâ!

verses.sanskrit:
प्र॒जाप॑तिः सम्भ्रि॒यमा॑णः स॒म्राट् सम्भृ॑तो वैश्वदे॒वः स॑ᳪस॒न्नो घ॒र्मः प्रवृ॑क्त॒स्तेज॒ उद्य॑त आश्वि॒नः पय॑स्यानी॒यमा॑ने पौ॒ष्णो वि॑ष्य॒न्दमा॑ने मारु॒तः क्लथ॑न् ।
मै॒त्रः शर॑सि सन्ता॒य्यमा॑ने वाय॒व्यो॒ ह्रि॒यमा॑ण आग्ने॒यो हू॒यमा॑नो॒ वाग्घु॒तः
verses.translation: Prajâpati while in preparation; Samrâj when prepared; All-Gods’ when seated; Gharma when heated with fire; Splendour when lifted up; the Asvins’ while milk is poured in; Pûshan's when the butter trickles down it; the Maruts’ when the milk is clotting; Mitra's when the milk's skin is spreading; Vâyu's when it is carried off; Agni's while offered as oblation; Vâk when it has been offered.
verses.hindi: हम कुशलतापूर्वक व्यवहार करते हुए तथा स्वास्थ्य व दीर्घं जीवन के नियमों का पालन करते हृए् अपने जीवन को सुखमय बना स्वास्थ्य के लिए उत्तम अदनीय ( भक्ष्य) अज्र का सेवन लोहिताय स्वाहा मेदोभ्यः स्वाहा मेदोभ्यः स्वाह। । मासेभ्यः स्वाहां माश्छसेभ्यः
verses.transliteration: prajāpatiḥ sambhriyamāṇaḥ samrāṭ sambhṛto vaiśvadevaḥ sasanno gharmaḥ pravṛktasteja udyata āśvinaḥ payasyānīyamāne pauṣṇo viṣyandamāne mārutaḥ klathan | maitraḥ śarasi santāyyamāne vāyavyo hriyamāṇa āgneyo hūyamāno vāgghutaḥ
verses.wordMeaning: Prajâpati while in preparation; Samrâj when prepared; All-Gods’ when seated; Gharma when heated with fire; Splendour when lifted up; the Asvins’ while milk is poured in; Pûshan's when the butter trickles down it; the Maruts’ when the milk is clotting;…
verses.commentary: Sense: Prajâpati while in preparation; Samrâj when prepared; All-Gods’ when seated; Gharma when heated with fire; Splendour when lifted up; the Asvins’ while milk is poured in; Pûshan's when the butter trickles down it; the Maruts’ when the milk is clotting;…

verses.sanskrit:
स॒वि॒ता प्र॑थ॒मेऽह॑न्न॒ग्निर्द्वि॒तीये॑ वा॒युस्तृ॒तीय॑ आदि॒त्यश्च॑तु॒र्थे च॒न्द्रमा॑: पञ्च॒म ऋ॒तुः ष॒ष्ठे म॒रुत॑: सप्त॒मे बृह॒स्पति॑रष्ट॒मे ।
मि॒त्रो न॑व॒मे वरु॑णो दश॒म इन्द्र॑ एकाद॒शे विश्वे॑ दे॒वा द्वा॑द॒शे
verses.translation: Savitar on the first day; Agni on the second; Vâyu on the third; Âditya (the Sun) on the fourth; Chandramâs (the Moon) on the fifth; Ritu on the sixth; the Maruts on the seventh; Brihaspati on the eighth; Mitra on the ninth; Varuna on the tenth; Indra on the eleventh; the All-Gods on the twelfth.
verses.hindi: सात्विक अन्न का सेवन हमारे जीवन में प्रयत्तशीलता व पवित्रता का संचार तप॑से स्वाहा तप्य ते स्वाहा तप्यमानाय स्वाहा तप्ताय स्वाह घर्माय स्वाहा । १. जिस प्रकार पिछले मन्त्र में पवित्रता के विषय मे कहा गया है उसी प्रकार प्रस्तुत करते है कि (९) तप कौ रुचि (२) तप में लगना (३) तप को अपना स्वभाव बना लेना
verses.transliteration: savitā prathame'hannagnirdvitīye vāyustṛtīya ādityaścaturthe candramā: pañcama ṛtuḥ ṣaṣṭhe maruta: saptame bṛhaspatiraṣṭame | mitro navame varuṇo daśama indra ekādaśe viśve devā dvādaśe
verses.wordMeaning: Savitar on the first day; Agni on the second; Vâyu on the third; Âditya (the Sun) on the fourth; Chandramâs (the Moon) on the fifth; Ritu on the sixth; the Maruts on the seventh; Brihaspati on the eighth; Mitra on the ninth; Varuna on the tenth; Indra on the eleventh;…
verses.commentary: Sense: Savitar on the first day; Agni on the second; Vâyu on the third; Âditya (the Sun) on the fourth; Chandramâs (the Moon) on the fifth; Ritu on the sixth; the Maruts on the seventh; Brihaspati on the eighth; Mitra on the ninth; Varuna on the tenth; Indra on the eleventh;…

verses.sanskrit:
उ॒ग्रश्च॑ भी॒मश्च॒ ध्वा॒न्तश्च॒ धुनि॑श्च ।
सा॒स॒ह्वाँश्चा॑भियु॒ग्वा च॑ वि॒क्षिप॒: स्वाहा॑
verses.translation: Fierce; Terrible; The Resonant; The Roarer; Victorious; Assailant; and Dispeller. Svâhâ.
verses.hindi: हम उत्तम कर्म करनेवाले वने, जिससे हमारा अगला जन्म उत्तम हो। हैवीसंपत्-युक्त ज्ञान के दृष्टिकोण सरे उत्तम जन्म विश्वेदेवा द्वांदरो॥ ६॥ पिछले मन्त्र मे उत्तम कर्मो व गुणों के दृष्टिकोण से जन्म का विचार हआ है। प्रस्तुत
verses.transliteration: ugraśca bhīmaśca dhvāntaśca dhuniśca | sāsahvā~ścābhiyugvā ca vikṣipa: svāhā
verses.wordMeaning: Fierce; Terrible; The Resonant; The Roarer; Victorious; Assailant; and Dispeller. Svâhâ.
verses.commentary: Sense: Fierce; Terrible; The Resonant; The Roarer; Victorious; Assailant; and Dispeller. Svâhâ.

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒ग्निᳪ हृद॑येना॒शनि॑ᳪ हृदया॒ग्रेण॑ पशु॒पतिं॑ कृत्स्न॒हृद॑येन भ॒वं य॒क्ना ।
श॒र्वं मत॑स्नाभ्या॒मीशा॑नं म॒न्युना॑ महादे॒वम॑न्तःपर्श॒व्येनो॒ग्रं दे॒वं व॑नि॒ष्ठुना॑ वसिष्ठ॒हनुः॒ शिङ्गी॑नि को॒श्याभ्या॑म्
verses.translation: Agni with the heart; Lightning with the heart's point; Pasupati with the whole heart; Bhava with the liver. Sarva with the two cardiac bones; îsâna with Passion; Mahâdeva with the intercostal flesh; the Fierce God with the rectum; Vasishtha-hanuh, Singis with two lumps of flesh near the heart.
verses.hindi: जीवन को आनन्दमय नाने के लिए उपर्युक्त नौ वाते ध्यान देने योग्य हँ १. हदय मे उत्साह २. हृदयाग्र में दीप्ति ३. पूर्णहदय मे प्रभु-ध्यान ४. जिगर में पर्जन्य की तरह दानवृत्ति ५. गुर्दो में जल £. मन्यु से आदित्य॒ ७. आमाशय के ठीक होने से प्रसन्नता ८. अति मे कृमिसंहारक शक्ति तथा ९. कोश्यों (८७॥५।९३) मे प्रजननशक्ि व
verses.transliteration: agni hṛdayenāśani hṛdayāgreṇa paśupatiṃ kṛtsnahṛdayena bhavaṃ yaknā | śarvaṃ matasnābhyāmīśānaṃ manyunā mahādevamantaḥparśavyenograṃ devaṃ vaniṣṭhunā vasiṣṭhahanuḥ śiṅgīni kośyābhyām
verses.wordMeaning: Agni with the heart; Lightning with the heart's point; Pasupati with the whole heart; Bhava with the liver. Sarva with the two cardiac bones; îsâna with Passion; Mahâdeva with the intercostal flesh; the Fierce God with the rectum; Vasishtha-hanuh,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Agni with the heart; Lightning with the heart's point; Pasupati with the whole heart; Bhava with the liver. Sarva with the two cardiac bones; îsâna with Passion; Mahâdeva with the intercostal flesh; the Fierce God with the rectum; Vasishtha-hanuh,…

verses.sanskrit: उ॒ग्रँल्लोहि॑तेन मि॒त्रᳪ सौ॑व्रत्येन रु॒द्रं दौर्व्र॑त्ये॒नेन्द्रं॑ प्रक्री॒डेन॑ म॒रुतो॒ बले॑न सा॒ध्यान् प्र॒मुदा॑ । भ॒वस्य॒ कण्ठ्य॑ᳪ रु॒द्रस्या॑न्तः पा॒र्श्व्यं म॑हादे॒वस्य॒ यकृ॑च्छ॒र्वस्य॑ वनि॒ष्ठुः प॑शु॒पते॑: पुरी॒तत्
verses.translation: The Fierce with blood; Mitra with obedience, Rudra with disobedience; Indra with pastime; the Maruts with strength; the Sâdhyas with enjoyment. Bhava's is what is on the throat; Rudra's what is between the ribs; Mahâdeva's is the liver; Sarva's the rectum; Pasupati's the pericardium.
verses.hindi: भोजन के विषय मे यह ध्यान रखा जाए कि वह लोमों से लेकर वीर्य तक शरीर की सब धातुओं के लिए हितकर हो तथा कोष्ठबद्धता को पैदा करनेवाला न हो। स्वाहां । शुचे स्वाहा शोच॑ ते स्वाहा शोच॑मानाय॒ स्वाहा शोकाय स्वाह॥ ९९॥ जा भोजन स्वास्थ्य के लिए हितकर हो वहाँ भोजन एेसा होना चाहिए जो मनुष्य को
verses.transliteration: ugra~llohitena mitra sauvratyena rudraṃ daurvratyenendraṃ prakrīḍena maruto balena sādhyān pramudā | bhavasya kaṇṭhya rudrasyāntaḥ pārśvyaṃ mahādevasya yakṛccharvasya vaniṣṭhuḥ paśupate: purītat
verses.wordMeaning: The Fierce with blood; Mitra with obedience, Rudra with disobedience; Indra with pastime; the Maruts with strength; the Sâdhyas with enjoyment. Bhava's is what is on the throat; Rudra's what is between the ribs; Mahâdeva's is the liver; Sarva's the rectum;…
verses.commentary: Sense: The Fierce with blood; Mitra with obedience, Rudra with disobedience; Indra with pastime; the Maruts with strength; the Sâdhyas with enjoyment. Bhava's is what is on the throat; Rudra's what is between the ribs; Mahâdeva's is the liver; Sarva's the rectum;…

verses.sanskrit:
लोम॑भ्य॒: स्वाहा॒ लोम॑भ्य॒: स्वाहा॑ त्व॒चे स्वाहा॑ त्व॒चे स्वाहा॒ लोहि॑ताय॒ स्वाहा॒ लोहि॑ताय॒ स्वाहा॒ मेदो॑भ्य॒: स्वाहा॒ मेदो॑भ्य॒: स्वाहा॑ ।
मा॒ᳪसेभ्य॒: स्वाहा॑ मा॒ᳪसेभ्य॒: स्वाहा॒ स्नाव॑भ्य॒: स्वाहा॒ स्नाव॑भ्य॒: स्वाहा॒ ऽस्थभ्य॒: स्वाहा॒ स्थभ्य॒: स्वाहा॑ म॒ज्जभ्य॒: स्वाहा॑ म॒ज्जभ्य॒: स्वाहा॑ ।
रेत॑से॒ स्वाहा॑ पा॒यवे॒ स्वाहा॑
verses.translation: To the hair Svâhâ! To the hair Svâhâ! To the skin Svâhâ! To the skin Svâhâ! To the blood Svâhâ! To the blood Svâhâ! To the fats Svâhâ! To the fats Svâhâ! To the fleshy parts Svâhâ! To the fleshy parts Svâhâ! To the sinews Svâhâ! To the sinews Svâhâ! Svâhâ to the bones! Svâhâ to the bones! To the marrows Svâhâ! To the marrows Svâhâ! To the seed Svâhâ! To the anus Svâhâ!
verses.hindi: भोजन एेसा हो जो मुञ्धे तपस्वी बनाए, शक्तिशाली बनाए, पापों के लिए मै प्रायश्चित्त की वृत्तिवाला बनं ओर अन्त मे भोजन को मैं ओषध सम यमाय स्वाहान्त॑काय स्वाहा मृत्यवे स्वाह।। ब्रह्म॑णे स्वाहां ब्रह्महत्यायै स्वाहा विश्वेभ्यो देवेभ्यः स्वाहा द्यावापुथिवीभ्याश्शस्वाह।।। ९३
verses.transliteration: lomabhya: svāhā lomabhya: svāhā tvace svāhā tvace svāhā lohitāya svāhā lohitāya svāhā medobhya: svāhā medobhya: svāhā | māsebhya: svāhā māsebhya: svāhā snāvabhya: svāhā snāvabhya: svāhā 'sthabhya: svāhā sthabhya: svāhā majjabhya: svāhā majjabhya: svāhā | retase svāhā pāyave svāhā
verses.wordMeaning: To the hair Svâhâ! To the hair Svâhâ! To the skin Svâhâ! To the skin Svâhâ! To the blood Svâhâ! To the blood Svâhâ! To the fats Svâhâ! To the fats Svâhâ! To the fleshy parts Svâhâ! To the fleshy parts Svâhâ! To the sinews Svâhâ! To the sinews Svâhâ! Svâhâ to the bones! Svâhâ to…
verses.commentary: Sense: To the hair Svâhâ! To the hair Svâhâ! To the skin Svâhâ! To the skin Svâhâ! To the blood Svâhâ! To the blood Svâhâ! To the fats Svâhâ! To the fats Svâhâ! To the fleshy parts Svâhâ! To the fleshy parts Svâhâ! To the sinews Svâhâ! To the sinews Svâhâ! Svâhâ to the bones! Svâhâ to…

verses.sanskrit:
आ॒या॒साय॒ स्वाहा॑ प्राया॒साय॒ स्वाहा॑ संया॒साय॒ स्वाहा॑ विया॒साय॒ स्वाहो॑द्या॒साय॒ स्वाहा॑ ।
शु॒चे स्वाहा॒ शोच॑ते॒ स्वाहा॒ शोच॑मानाय॒ स्वाहा॒ शोका॑य॒ स्वाहा॑
verses.translation: To Effort Svâhâ! To Exertion Svâhâ! To Endeavour Svâhâ! To Viyâsa Svâhâ! To Attempt Svâhâ!
verses.hindi: आचार्य विद्यार्थी को ज्ञान देता है, सद्गुणों से अलंकृत करता है तथा अव्यसनी बनाकर स्वस्थ शरीरवाला बनाता है। इत्येकोनच्त्वारिछोऽध्यायः।1
verses.transliteration: āyāsāya svāhā prāyāsāya svāhā saṃyāsāya svāhā viyāsāya svāhodyāsāya svāhā | śuce svāhā śocate svāhā śocamānāya svāhā śokāya svāhā
verses.wordMeaning: To Effort Svâhâ! To Exertion Svâhâ! To Endeavour Svâhâ! To Viyâsa Svâhâ! To Attempt Svâhâ!
verses.commentary: Sense: To Effort Svâhâ! To Exertion Svâhâ! To Endeavour Svâhâ! To Viyâsa Svâhâ! To Attempt Svâhâ!

verses.sanskrit:
तप॑से॒ स्वाहा॒ तप्य॑ते॒ स्वाहा॒ तप्य॑मानाय॒ स्वाहा॑ त॒प्ताय॒ स्वाहा॑ घ॒र्माय॒ स्वाहा॑ ।
निष्कृ॑त्यै॒ स्वाहा॒ प्राय॑श्चित्त्यै॒ स्वाहा॑ भेष॒जाय॒ स्वाहा॑
verses.translation: To Grief Svâhâ! To the Grieving Svâhâ! To the Sorrowing Svâhâ! To Sorrow Svâhâ! To Heat Svâhâ! To him who grows hot Svâhâ! To him who is being heated Svâhâ! To him who has been heated Svâhâ! To Gharma Svâhâ! To Atonement Svâhâ! To Expiation Svâhâ! To Remedy Svâhâ!
verses.hindi: आचार्य विद्यार्थी को ज्ञान देता है, सद्गुणों से अलंकृत करता है तथा अव्यसनी बनाकर स्वस्थ शरीरवाला बनाता है। इत्येकोनच्त्वारिछोऽध्यायः।1
verses.transliteration: tapase svāhā tapyate svāhā tapyamānāya svāhā taptāya svāhā gharmāya svāhā | niṣkṛtyai svāhā prāyaścittyai svāhā bheṣajāya svāhā
verses.wordMeaning: To Grief Svâhâ! To the Grieving Svâhâ! To the Sorrowing Svâhâ! To Sorrow Svâhâ! To Heat Svâhâ! To him who grows hot Svâhâ! To him who is being heated Svâhâ! To him who has been heated Svâhâ! To Gharma Svâhâ! To Atonement Svâhâ! To Expiation Svâhâ! To Remedy Svâhâ!
verses.commentary: Sense: To Grief Svâhâ! To the Grieving Svâhâ! To the Sorrowing Svâhâ! To Sorrow Svâhâ! To Heat Svâhâ! To him who grows hot Svâhâ! To him who is being heated Svâhâ! To him who has been heated Svâhâ! To Gharma Svâhâ! To Atonement Svâhâ! To Expiation Svâhâ! To Remedy Svâhâ!

verses.sanskrit: य॒माय॒ स्वाहा ऽन्त॑काय॒ स्वाहा॑ मृ॒त्यवे॒ स्वाहा॒ ब्रह्म॑णे॒ स्वाहा॑ ब्रह्मह॒त्यायै॒ स्वाहा॒ विश्वे॑भ्यो दे॒वेभ्य॒: स्वाहा॒ द्यावा॑पृथि॒वीभ्या॒ᳪ स्वाहा॑
verses.translation: To Yama Svâhâ! To the Finisher Svâhâ! To Death Svâhâ! To the Priesthood Svâhâ! To Brâhmanicide Svâhâ! To the All-Gods Svâhâ! To Heaven and Earth Svâhâ!
verses.hindi: आचार्य विद्यार्थी को ज्ञान देता है, सद्गुणों से अलंकृत करता है तथा अव्यसनी बनाकर स्वस्थ शरीरवाला बनाता है। इत्येकोनच्त्वारिछोऽध्यायः।1
verses.transliteration: yamāya svāhā 'ntakāya svāhā mṛtyave svāhā brahmaṇe svāhā brahmahatyāyai svāhā viśvebhyo devebhya: svāhā dyāvāpṛthivībhyā svāhā
verses.wordMeaning: To Yama Svâhâ! To the Finisher Svâhâ! To Death Svâhâ! To the Priesthood Svâhâ! To Brâhmanicide Svâhâ! To the All-Gods Svâhâ! To Heaven and Earth Svâhâ!
verses.commentary: Sense: To Yama Svâhâ! To the Finisher Svâhâ! To Death Svâhâ! To the Priesthood Svâhâ! To Brâhmanicide Svâhâ! To the All-Gods Svâhâ! To Heaven and Earth Svâhâ!

verses.sanskrit:
ई॒शा वा॒स्य॒मि॒दᳪ सर्वं॒ यत्किं च॒ जग॑त्यां॒ जग॑त् ।
तेन॑ त्य॒क्तेन॑ भुञ्जीथा॒ मा गृ॑ध॒: कस्य॑ स्वि॒द्धन॑म्
verses.translation: com The Texts of the White Yajurveda, tr. Ralph T.H. Griffith, [1899], ENVELOPED by the Lord must be This All—each thing that moves on earth. With that renounced enjoy thyself. Covet no wealth of any man.
verses.hindi: हम प्रभु के इन दो आदेशो का सदा स्मरण करें "सदा कर्मशील रहो', सौ वर्षं जीने की कामना रक्खो '। असुर्या, नाम ते लोकाऽअन्धेन तमसावुंताः। तास्ते प्रेत्यापि गच्छन्ति ये के चंत्पहनो जनां: ३॥
verses.transliteration: īśā vāsyamida sarvaṃ yatkiṃ ca jagatyāṃ jagat | tena tyaktena bhuñjīthā mā gṛdha: kasya sviddhanam
verses.wordMeaning: com The Texts of the White Yajurveda, tr. Ralph T.H. Griffith, [1899], ENVELOPED by the Lord must be This All—each thing that moves on earth. With that renounced enjoy thyself. Covet no wealth of any man.
verses.commentary: Sense: com The Texts of the White Yajurveda, tr. Ralph T.H. Griffith, [1899], ENVELOPED by the Lord must be This All—each thing that moves on earth. With that renounced enjoy thyself. Covet no wealth of any man.

verses.sanskrit:
कु॒र्वन्ने॒वेह कर्मा॑णि जिजीवि॒षेच्छ॒तᳪ समा॑: ।
ए॒वं त्वयि॒ नान्यथे॒तो॒ऽस्ति॒ न कर्म॑  लिप्यते॒ नरे॑
verses.translation: One, only doing Karma here, should wish to live a hundred years. No way is there for thee but this. So Karma cleaveth not to man.
verses.hindi: हम प्रभु की सर्वव्यापकता को अनुभव करे। कण-कण मे उसकी शक्ति को काम करता हुआ देखें ओर अपनी सफलताओं को प्रभुशक्ति से होता हुआ समञ्ञँ तथा सदा तह परावर प्रभु (अन्दर भी, बाहर भी), दूर भी, समीप भी तदेजति तन्नैज॑ति तद् दूरे तद्व॑न्तिके।
verses.transliteration: kurvanneveha karmāṇi jijīviṣecchata samā: | evaṃ tvayi nānyatheto'sti na karma lipyate nare
verses.wordMeaning: One, only doing Karma here, should wish to live a hundred years. No way is there for thee but this. So Karma cleaveth not to man.
verses.commentary: Sense: One, only doing Karma here, should wish to live a hundred years. No way is there for thee but this. So Karma cleaveth not to man.

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒सु॒र्या नाम॑ ते लो॒का अ॒न्धेन॒ तम॒सावृ॑ताः ।
ताँस्ते प्रेत्यापि॑ गच्छन्ति॒ ये के चा॑त्म॒हनो॒ जना॑:
verses.translation: Aye, to the Asuras belong those worlds enwrapt in blinding gloom. To them, when life on earth is done, depart the men who kill the Self.
verses.hindi: जीवात्मा व परमात्मा दो सत्ता है, परन्तु सव जीव प्रभु में है, सो प्रथक् न होने से ' आत्मा-ही-आत्मा' है, एेसा अनुभव करके हम  शोक-मोहातीत विजानन् ' बने। स पर्यगाच्छुक्रम॑कायमंत्रणमंस्नाविरच्शुद्धमपापविन्धम्। १. सः=वे प्रभु परि अगात्- चारों ओर (पहले से ही) गये हुए है। वह कौन-सा स्थान
verses.transliteration: asuryā nāma te lokā andhena tamasāvṛtāḥ | tā~ste pretyāpi gacchanti ye ke cātmahano janā:
verses.wordMeaning: Aye, to the Asuras belong those worlds enwrapt in blinding gloom. To them, when life on earth is done, depart the men who kill the Self.
verses.commentary: Sense: Aye, to the Asuras belong those worlds enwrapt in blinding gloom. To them, when life on earth is done, depart the men who kill the Self.

verses.sanskrit:
अने॑ज॒देकं॒ मन॑सो॒ जवी॑यो नैन॑द्दे॒वा आ॑प्नुव॒न् पूर्व॒मर्श॑त् ।
तद्धाव॑तो॒ऽन्यानत्ये॑ति॒ तिष्ठ॒त्तस्मि॑न्न॒पो मा॑त॒रिश्वा॑ दधाति
verses.translation: Motionless, one, swifter than Mind—the Devas failed to o’ertake it speeding on before them. It, standing still, outstrips the others running. Herein Both Mâtarisvan stablish Action.
verses.hindi: हम इस तत्त्व को समज्ञ कि जो जितना व्यापक है, वह उतना ही शुद्ध हेै। यह समञ्चकर हमारा ध्येय “व्यापक दृष्टिकोणवाला बनना' ही हो जाए्। १. “सम्' शब्द का अर्थ होता है "मिलकर" ओर भूति=होना। मिलकर होना, अर्थात् व्यक्तित्व को अलग न समञ्चकर समाज को ही सब-कु सम्ना “ सम्भूति' है। इसके
verses.transliteration: anejadekaṃ manaso javīyo nainaddevā āpnuvan pūrvamarśat | taddhāvato'nyānatyeti tiṣṭhattasminnapo mātariśvā dadhāti
verses.wordMeaning: Motionless, one, swifter than Mind—the Devas failed to o’ertake it speeding on before them. It, standing still, outstrips the others running. Herein Both Mâtarisvan stablish Action.
verses.commentary: Sense: Motionless, one, swifter than Mind—the Devas failed to o’ertake it speeding on before them. It, standing still, outstrips the others running. Herein Both Mâtarisvan stablish Action.

verses.sanskrit:
तदे॑जति॒ तन्नैज॑ति॒ तद्दू॒॒रे तद्व॑न्ति॒के ।
तद॒न्तर॑स्य॒ सर्व॑स्य॒ तदु॒ सर्व॑स्यास्य बाह्य॒तः
verses.translation: It moveth; it is motionless. It is far distant; it is near. It is within This All; and it surrounds This All externally.
verses.hindi: हमारे जीवन में व्यक्तिवाद व समाजवाद का समन्वय हो। प्रस्तुत मन्त्र में अविद्या ओर विद्या के अर्थं को समञ्लने के लिए उपनिषद् का यह वाक्य स्मरणीय है कि द्व विद्ये वेदितव्ये, परा चैवापरा च" परा ओर अपरा दोनों ही विद्या जाननी चाहि्णं। परा वह है जिससे अक्षरब्रह्म का ज्ञान होता हे, अर्थात् ब्रह्मविद्या व
verses.transliteration: tadejati tannaijati taddūre tadvantike | tadantarasya sarvasya tadu sarvasyāsya bāhyataḥ
verses.wordMeaning: It moveth; it is motionless. It is far distant; it is near. It is within This All; and it surrounds This All externally.
verses.commentary: Sense: It moveth; it is motionless. It is far distant; it is near. It is within This All; and it surrounds This All externally.

verses.sanskrit:
यस्तु सर्वा॑णि भू॒तान्या॒त्मन्ने॒वानु॒पश्य॑ति ।
स॒र्व॒भू॒तेषु॑ चा॒त्मानं॒ ततो॒ न वि चि॑कित्सति
verses.translation: The man who in his Self beholds all creatures and all things that be, And in all beings sees his Self, thence doubts no longer, ponders not.
verses.hindi: केवल प्रकृतिविद्या के उपासक अँधेरे में प्रवेश करते है तो केवल ब्रह्मविद्या के उपासक उससे भी घने अंधेरे मे पदुंचते है। विद्यायाः आत्मविद्या का अन्यत् एवविलक्षण ही फल आटुः कहते हँ। योगदर्शन का विभूत्तिपाद आत्मविद्या के फलों का विशद् वर्णन करता है। आत्मविद्या के चमत्कार
verses.transliteration: yastu sarvāṇi bhūtānyātmannevānupaśyati | sarvabhūteṣu cātmānaṃ tato na vi cikitsati
verses.wordMeaning: The man who in his Self beholds all creatures and all things that be, And in all beings sees his Self, thence doubts no longer, ponders not.
verses.commentary: Sense: The man who in his Self beholds all creatures and all things that be, And in all beings sees his Self, thence doubts no longer, ponders not.

verses.sanskrit:
यस्मि॒न्त्सर्वा॑णि भू॒तान्यात्मै॒वाभू॑द्विजान॒तः ।
तत्र॒ को मोह॒: कः शोक॑ एक॒त्वम॑नु॒पश्य॑तः
verses.translation: When, in the man who clearly knows, Self hath become all things that are, What wilderment, what grief is there in him who sees the One alone?
verses.hindi: हम अविद्या से मृत्यु को तरे ओर विद्या से अमरता का लाभ कर। विद्या से हम विषयों कौ अपातरमणीयता को जा्नेगे ओर उन विषयों के पीके मरेगे नहीं। १९  आत्मा ' शब्द “ अत्-गतौ ' धातु से बना है, इसका ठीक पर्यायवाची शब्द “वा-गतौ ' से बना हुआ वायु' है। ये दोनों ही शब्द जीव को उसके स्वभाव की सूचना दे रहे है,
verses.transliteration: yasmintsarvāṇi bhūtānyātmaivābhūdvijānataḥ | tatra ko moha: kaḥ śoka ekatvamanupaśyataḥ
verses.wordMeaning: When, in the man who clearly knows, Self hath become all things that are, What wilderment, what grief is there in him who sees the One alone?
verses.commentary: Sense: When, in the man who clearly knows, Self hath become all things that are, What wilderment, what grief is there in him who sees the One alone?

verses.sanskrit:
स पर्य॑गाच्छु॒क्रम॑का॒यम॑व्र॒णम॑स्नावि॒रᳪ शु॒द्धमपा॑पविद्धम् ।
क॒विर्म॑नी॒षी प॑रि॒भूः स्व॑य॒म्भूर्या॑थातथ्य॒तोऽर्था॒न् व्य॒दधाच्छाश्व॒तीभ्य॒: समा॑भ्यः
verses.translation: He hath attained unto the Bright, Bodiless, Woundless, Sinewless, the Pure which evil hath not pierced. Far-sighted, wise, encompassing, he self-existent hath prescribed aims, as propriety demands, unto the everlasting Years.
verses.hindi: आत्मा की अपार्थिवता को ओर शरीर कौ भस्मान्तता को स्मरण करे, जिससे हमारा जीवन भोगप्रधान न हो। प्रभु का स्मरण करें, जिससे शक्ति प्राप्त करके अपने कर्त्तव्य को सुचारुरूपेण निभा सकें। लिना क्किसी अपराध क्के ५९८11110 पा (पाट, साक्षा अ
verses.transliteration: sa paryagācchukramakāyamavraṇamasnāvira śuddhamapāpaviddham | kavirmanīṣī paribhūḥ svayambhūryāthātathyato'rthān vyadadhācchāśvatībhya: samābhyaḥ
verses.wordMeaning: He hath attained unto the Bright, Bodiless, Woundless, Sinewless, the Pure which evil hath not pierced. Far-sighted, wise, encompassing, he self-existent hath prescribed aims, as propriety demands, unto the everlasting Years.
verses.commentary: Sense: He hath attained unto the Bright, Bodiless, Woundless, Sinewless, the Pure which evil hath not pierced. Far-sighted, wise, encompassing, he self-existent hath prescribed aims, as propriety demands, unto the everlasting Years.

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒न्धं तम॒: प्रवि॑शन्ति॒ येऽसं॑भूतिमु॒पास॑ते ।
ततो॒ भूय॑ इव॒ ते तमो॒ य उ॒ सम्भू॑त्याᳪ र॒ताः
verses.translation: Deep into shade of blinding gloom fall Asambhûti's worshippers. They sink to darkness deeper yet who on Sambhûti are intent.
verses.hindi: हे प्रभो! एेसी कृपा करो कि हम सदा सन्मार्ग से ही धन कमाँ। आपकी कृपा से कुटिलता व पाप हमसे दूर रें। हिरण्मयेन पात्रेण सत्यस्यापिहितं मुख॑म्। यो ऽसावादित्ये पुरुषः सो.ऽसावहम्। ओडेम् खं ब्रह्म॑ ।। १७॥
verses.transliteration: andhaṃ tama: praviśanti ye'saṃbhūtimupāsate | tato bhūya iva te tamo ya u sambhūtyā ratāḥ
verses.wordMeaning: Deep into shade of blinding gloom fall Asambhûti's worshippers. They sink to darkness deeper yet who on Sambhûti are intent.
verses.commentary: Sense: Deep into shade of blinding gloom fall Asambhûti's worshippers. They sink to darkness deeper yet who on Sambhûti are intent.

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒न्यदे॒वाहुः स॑म्भ॒वाद॒न्यदा॑हु॒रस॑म्भवात् ।
इति॑ शुश्रुम॒ धीरा॑णां॒ ये न॒स्तद्वि॑चचक्षि॒रे
verses.translation: One fruit, they say, from Sambhava, another from Asambhava. Thus from the sages have we heard who have declared this lore to us.
verses.hindi: सांसारिक चमक से हमारी आंखें चँधियाँ न जाँ, तभी हम सत्य को देख
verses.transliteration: anyadevāhuḥ sambhavādanyadāhurasambhavāt | iti śuśruma dhīrāṇāṃ ye nastadvicacakṣire
verses.wordMeaning: One fruit, they say, from Sambhava, another from Asambhava. Thus from the sages have we heard who have declared this lore to us.
verses.commentary: Sense: One fruit, they say, from Sambhava, another from Asambhava. Thus from the sages have we heard who have declared this lore to us.

verses.sanskrit:
सम्भू॑तिं च विना॒शं च॒ यस्तद्वेदो॒भय॑ᳪ स॒ह ।
वि॒ना॒शेन॑ मृ॒त्युं ती॒र्त्वा सम्भू॑त्या॒मृत॑मश्नुते
verses.translation: The man who knows Sambhûti and Vinâsa simultaneously, He, by Vinâsa passing death, gains by Sambhûti endless life.
verses.hindi: प्रभु कौ सर्वव्यापकता का अनुभव करो, त्यागपूर्वक प्रकृति का उपभोग करो, लोलुपता से दूर रहो ओर सदा विचारो कि भला धन किसका है? एवं त्वयि नान्यथेत्नोऽस्ति न कर्मः लिप्यते नरे॥। २॥ प्रस्तुत मन्त्र में प्रभु आदेश करते है कि-१. इह इस लोक मे तथा इस मानव- जीवन
verses.transliteration: sambhūtiṃ ca vināśaṃ ca yastadvedobhaya saha | vināśena mṛtyuṃ tīrtvā sambhūtyāmṛtamaśnute
verses.wordMeaning: The man who knows Sambhûti and Vinâsa simultaneously, He, by Vinâsa passing death, gains by Sambhûti endless life.
verses.commentary: Sense: The man who knows Sambhûti and Vinâsa simultaneously, He, by Vinâsa passing death, gains by Sambhûti endless life.

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒न्धं तम॒: प्रवि॑शन्ति॒ येऽवि॑द्यामु॒पास॑ते ।
ततो॒ भूय॑ इव॒ ते तमो॒ य उ॑ वि॒द्याया॑ᳪ र॒ताः
verses.translation: To blinding darkness go the men who make a cult of Nescience. The devotees of Science enter darkness that is darker still.
verses.hindi: हम आत्मोत्रति के मार्ग पर चलें। आत्महन् बनकर असुर्य लोकों मे जन्म के ऋषि; --दीर्घतमाः। देवता-ब्रह्य। छन्दः- निचच्त्रिष्टुप्। स्वरः-धैवतः। अनैजदेकं मन॑सो जवीयो नैन॑देवाऽआप्नुवन् पूर्वम॑त्। १. पिक्ले मन्त्र की फलश्रुति के बाद प्रस्तुत मन्त्र में ' सर्वव्यापकता' की भावना का
verses.transliteration: andhaṃ tama: praviśanti ye'vidyāmupāsate | tato bhūya iva te tamo ya u vidyāyā ratāḥ
verses.wordMeaning: To blinding darkness go the men who make a cult of Nescience. The devotees of Science enter darkness that is darker still.
verses.commentary: Sense: To blinding darkness go the men who make a cult of Nescience. The devotees of Science enter darkness that is darker still.

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒न्यदे॒वाहुर्वि॒द्याया॑ अ॒न्यदा॑हु॒रवि॑द्यायाः ।
इति॑ शुश्रुम॒ धीरा॑णां॒ ये न॒स्तद्वि॑चचक्षि॒रे
verses.translation: Different is the fruit, they say, of Science and of Nescience. Thus from the sages have we heard who have declared this lore to us.
verses.hindi: प्रभु दूर-से-दूर व समीप-से-समीप है, अन्द्र व बाहर सर्वत्र व्याप्त हे। १. "प्रभु की सर्वव्यापकता, अन्द्र व बाहर सर्वत्र उसकौ सत्ता का अनुभव करनेवाला व्यक्ति सब प्रकार के सन्देह व घृणा से ऊपर उठ जाता हे, इस बात को प्रस्तुत मन्त्र इन शब्दों मे कहता है. यः तु-जो तो सर्वाणि भूतानिसब प्राणियों को आत्मन्-सर्वव्यापक
verses.transliteration: anyadevāhurvidyāyā anyadāhuravidyāyāḥ | iti śuśruma dhīrāṇāṃ ye nastadvicacakṣire
verses.wordMeaning: Different is the fruit, they say, of Science and of Nescience. Thus from the sages have we heard who have declared this lore to us.
verses.commentary: Sense: Different is the fruit, they say, of Science and of Nescience. Thus from the sages have we heard who have declared this lore to us.

verses.sanskrit:
वि॒द्यां चावि॑द्यां च॒ यस्तद्वेदो॒भय॑ᳪ स॒ह ।
अवि॑द्यया मृ॒त्युं ती॒र्त्वा वि॒द्यया॒ऽमृत॑मश्नुते
verses.translation: The man who knoweth well these two, Science and Nescience, combined, O’ercoming death by Nescience by Science gaineth endless life.
verses.hindi: हम प्रभु को सबमें ओर सबमें प्रभु को देखें, यही " तत्त्वज्ञान ' हे। यही सन्देह व घृणा से ऊपर उठने का साधन दे। ऋषि :- दीर्घतमाः। देवता-आत्मा। छन्दः-निचृदनुष्टुप्। स्वरः गान्धारः। तत्र को मोहः कः शोक॑ऽएकत्वमंनुपश्यंतः।।७॥।
verses.transliteration: vidyāṃ cāvidyāṃ ca yastadvedobhaya saha | avidyayā mṛtyuṃ tīrtvā vidyayā'mṛtamaśnute
verses.wordMeaning: The man who knoweth well these two, Science and Nescience, combined, O’ercoming death by Nescience by Science gaineth endless life.
verses.commentary: Sense: The man who knoweth well these two, Science and Nescience, combined, O’ercoming death by Nescience by Science gaineth endless life.

verses.sanskrit:
वा॒युरनि॑लम॒मृत॒मथे॒दं भस्मा॑न्त॒ᳪ शरी॑रम् ।
ओ३म् क्रतो॑ स्मर । क्लि॒बे स्म॑र । कृ॒तᳪ स्म॑र
verses.translation: My breath reach everlasting Air! In ashes let my body end. OM! Mind, remember thou; remember thou my sphere; remember thou my deeds.
verses.hindi: व्यक्तिवादी अन्धकार मेँ जाता है तो समाजवादी ओर भी अधिक अन्धकार ऋषि :- दीर्घतमाः। देवता-आत्मा। छन्दः अनुष्टुप्। स्वरः गान्धारः) -व्यक्त्िवाद व समाजवाद क्रा चमत्कार अन्यदेवाहुः सं॑म्भवादन्यदाहुरसंम्भवात्
verses.transliteration: vāyuranilamamṛtamathedaṃ bhasmānta śarīram | o3m krato smara | klibe smara | kṛta smara
verses.wordMeaning: My breath reach everlasting Air! In ashes let my body end. OM! Mind, remember thou; remember thou my sphere; remember thou my deeds.
verses.commentary: Sense: My breath reach everlasting Air! In ashes let my body end. OM! Mind, remember thou; remember thou my sphere; remember thou my deeds.

verses.sanskrit:
अग्ने॒ नय॑ सु॒पथा॑ रा॒ये अ॒स्मान्विश्वा॑नि देव व॒युना॑नि वि॒द्वान् ।
यु॒यो॒ध्यस्मज्जु॑हुरा॒णमेनो॒ भुयि॑ष्ठां ते॒ नम॑ उक्तिं विधेम
verses.translation: By goodly path lead us to riches, Agni, thou God who knowest all our works and wisdom. Remove the sin that makes us stray and wander: most ample adoration will we bring thee.
verses.hindi: व्यक्तिवाद व समाजवाद दोनों के ही फल विलक्षण है सम्भूतिं च विनाशं च -यस्तद्वेदोभय॑ःसह। ऊपर दो बात देखी जा चुकी ै। १. सम्भूति व असम्भूति के फल चमत्कारिक है, ओर २. अलग-अलग ये दोनों ही मनुष्य को अंधेरे में ले-जाते हैँ, अतः एेसी अवस्था में
verses.transliteration: agne naya supathā rāye asmānviśvāni deva vayunāni vidvān | yuyodhyasmajjuhurāṇameno bhuyiṣṭhāṃ te nama uktiṃ vidhema
verses.wordMeaning: By goodly path lead us to riches, Agni, thou God who knowest all our works and wisdom. Remove the sin that makes us stray and wander: most ample adoration will we bring thee.
verses.commentary: Sense: By goodly path lead us to riches, Agni, thou God who knowest all our works and wisdom. Remove the sin that makes us stray and wander: most ample adoration will we bring thee.

verses.sanskrit:
हि॒र॒ण्मये॑न॒ पात्रे॑ण स॒त्यस्यापि॑हितं॒ मुख॑म् । यो॒ऽसावा॑दि॒त्ये पुरु॑ष॒: सोऽसाव॒हम् ।
ओ३म् खं ब्रह्म॑
verses.translation: The Real's face is hidden by a vessel formed of golden light. The Spirit yonder in the Sun, the Spirit dwelling there am I. OM! Heaven! Brahma! verses.hindi: भौतिक व आत्मिक दोनों ही ज्ञानं के विलक्षण फल हैँ। भोत्िक ज्ञान क्लोरोफार्म आदि के द्वारा हमें अचेतन करके पीड़ा का अनुभव नहीं होने देता, तो आत्मज्ञान हमें सदेह होते हए भी विदेह बनाकर पीड़ा से ऊपर उठा देता है म्रत्यु से तैरना व अमर नना
verses.transliteration: hiraṇmayena pātreṇa satyasyāpihitaṃ mukham | yo'sāvāditye puruṣa: so'sāvaham | o3m khaṃ brahma
verses.wordMeaning: The Real's face is hidden by a vessel formed of golden light. The Spirit yonder in the Sun, the Spirit dwelling there am I.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The Real's face is hidden by a vessel formed of golden light. The Spirit yonder in the Sun, the Spirit dwelling there am I.…
